[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 39|Volume 39]] (actual) |Manga = |Anime = [[Episode 50]] (appearance) |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Clind''' (クリンド) is a house steward serving [[Annerose Miload]]. Despite joining the main cast after [[Arc 4]], he does not play a supporting role until [[Arc 9]]. A longtime partner of the [[Roswaal L. Mathers|original Roswaal]], Clind is a mysterious man who has long served the noble [[House Mathers]]. Following the [[Sanctuary Incident]], he was brought into the [[Emilia Camp]] by Roswaal to oversee [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s training after he officially became [[Emilia]]'s knight. ==Appearance== Clind appears to be a handsome young man around the age of twenty with a slender face and a tall, lean body. Along with that, he has eyebrow-length dark blue hair and gold eyes. Clind wears a well-starched black butler uniform with a frilly blue tie and sports a monocle on his left eye.''The one who said that with a bow was a slender faced handsome young man wearing black butler clothes. His hair, blue yet darker than Rem’s, was carefully fixed, and the impression of his sharp eyes was softened by a monocle. He looked around 20 years old, but there was something strange about his aura that wouldn’t let her sense his age. This smiling young man was the one behind the tailored maid clothes that fit the sisters perfectly. Using flowery words, the young man complemented the sisters standing close to each other. However──.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 1. Despite being a [[Dragon#Dragonkin|dragonkin]], Clind has shed his past and conceals his draconic characteristics in order to blend in with humanity. When manifesting his true power, he has removed his monocle, which has no special qualities whatsoever, as a gesture to signify his shift in mentality, prompting his natural deep black horns to protrude from his head. He may also possess other characteristics associated with dragonkin, such as wings or a tail, though they have not been observed with him. ==Personality== Clind is well-mannered, highly considerate of others, is extremely skilled as a servant, and tends to add idioms to the end of his sentences. Despite his good traits, he sometimes jokes around a little while behaving in a polite manner. According to [[Frederica Baumann]], he apparently has low self-esteem, which leads him to believe that his work as a butler is unworthy of praise, and likewise, despite having been responsible for teaching the other servants of House Mathers or House Miload, he is convinced that he has merely had the chance to convey what he knew many times due to his position rather than because he wanted to be a teacher, claiming it to be a noble role. However, by [[Petra Leyte]]'s observation, he is fully aware of what he is capable of yet believes it is not something to be proud of, something which makes him come off as though he was modest, reserved, and had low self-esteem. Clind is loyal to Roswaal, willing to follow him despite his faults. This being said, though he will not go against his orders, he does not necessarily approve of his actions, even going out of his way to ask for an explanation for why he would be willing to put his own servants in such a dangerous situation, even if it did result in someone getting their just punishment.''“It’s about the thing that happened, of course. ──The result that happened because I gave the key to the basement warehouse to Rem and ordered her to rearrange it, just like Master told me to. That disastrous scene. Explanation.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 7.''“I don’t have any thoughts on that man’s death because of the circumstances. But what I want to hear from Master is an explanation for why you made Rem do that. Rights and wrongs.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 7. He is shown to worry for the man as well, even going out of his way to attempt to convince him to marry and wash away the face paint. As the dragonkin of [[Volcanica]], Clind has inherited many of its memories, experiences, and emotions. One of the traits that Clind inherited is Volcanica's envy and high opinion of those with unrealized potential. In particular, this makes Clind to be drawn towards the souls of those within children, which is filled to the point of bursting with potential due to their youths.''Born as a member of the absolute race known as Dragons, Volcanica innately esteemed the unripeness within humans as radiant, as it meant they needed to grow and develop whilst they headed towards their goals, thus validating its own absolute way of being. That disposition was carried forth into the present with him as a dragonkin, and now, unrealized beings who concealed within themselves great potential―― children, were something that Clind could not help but greatly revere, respect, esteem, love, and cherish.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6. By his own claim, he is drawn to people who have pure and genuine souls, and that those who have such souls are also typically young in age.''“One-sided views and close minded, truly foolish. Besides, it’s wrong to think of it as having lust for young girls. I love pure souls. Therefore, boys are also included. Indiscriminate.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 1.''“To be enraptured by pure, immaculate souls is natural. And it happens that many possessors of such souls are young.”'' One Day II, Chapter 2, Section 1. However, he is also able to determine that Emilia was mentally young for her age and that [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu]]'s soul was much more mature than her appearance suggested. This inherited nature often leads to others, such as Frederica, misunderstanding him.''That nature of Clind’s, carried over from his past life, so to speak, was something that Frederica and the like harbored an enormous misunderstanding about.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6. However, as there are secrets related to dragonkin that he prefers to be concealed from Frederica, he deliberately does not correct the misunderstandings of her and the people around her,''Only, there was another matter concerning dragonkin that he wished to keep concealed from Frederica, so he deliberately refrained from clarifying that misunderstanding with her and those around her.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6. leading to his discontentment to be kept at a distance from certain individuals and thus not fully witnessing their potential. ==History== ===Early Life=== Clind was born as the dragonkin to the Divine Dragon, Volcanica.''“――Dragonkin of the Divine Dragon, Clind.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 2, Section 8. Having lived before the [[Great Calamity]], Clind was acquainted with the Witches and Warlocks of that era, as well as the Valiant and the Saintess. At some point in time, he let go of everything, feeling empty as a result. However, he gained and accumulated things in the path he began to walk afterwards.''“Once before, I relinquished everything, entirely. Even if it is true that I became empty because of that, on the path I have come to walk afterwards, there exists that which I have gained, and that which I have accumulated. Reflection.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 2. He went on to make a contract with Roswaal A. Mathers, which entailed Clind to protect Roswaal's property by any and all means, though he was prevented from interacting with [[Beatrice]] by Roswaal for yet unknown reasons. According to Roswaal, he had compensated the contract with Clind by forming a united front and defeating Roswaal's nemesis.''“The price of the contract, huh? In regards to that, we fulfilled that a long time ago. Indeed, to fight together to defeat a certain enemy. For me too, they were a longstanding foe, which was quite convenient.”'' [[Re:IF Kasaneru]], Chapter 3, Section 7. Clind has faithfully abided to his contract ever since, due to his ability to perceive souls and sensing Roswaal A. Mathers's soul in the bodies of his descendants. At some point in time, Clind became the custodian of the Witch Factor of Melancholy, having succeeded its previous user, [[Hector]], following his and Roswaal's joint battle with the Warlock of Melancholy. However, he notes that while he does bear said Witch Factor, this does not make him a Warlock. According to Clind himself, he has also made a covenant with a person he cannot name that restricts him from revealing his origins to others, and he claims that revealing said origins would greatly trouble the Emilia Camp. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]=== Following the end of the [[Demi-Human War]], Clind accompanied [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] (Julia Mathers) to a pub where she met with the Sword Demon, [[Wilhelm van Astrea]], where they discussed the threat of [[Stride Vollachia]]. During their talk, however, the trio were assaulted by a group of [[shinobi]], who were swiftly dispatched by Roswaal, Wilhelm, and Clind. Wilhelm noted that Clind's technique was neither sword skill nor magic, but something completely different. To ward off any risks to King [[Gionis Lugunica]] during the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon, Roswaal made the suggestion to let Clind protect him. After receiving [[Miklotov McMahon]]'s approval and having [[Orphe]] make the preparations for it, Clind attacked and subdued [[Raizo]], who was attempting to assassinate Gionis. Using his crushing power, he defeated Raizo, who thought he had accounted for every powerful individual in the Kingdom. As a send-off, Clind revealed to Raizo that he was a part of history and had been around since the era of Witches, before dealing a final blow to him. Following Roswaal's death at the hands of Stride Vollachia and [[Shasuke]], he started to take care of her son, [[Roswaal K. Mathers]], who at the time went by the name Karl, who inherited the soul of the original Roswaal A. Mathers. During the funeral of Karl’s mother, during the short exchange with Wilhelm, Wilhelm swore he would do everything in his power to help Karl if in need in order to honor Julia who greatly helped him during and after the Demi-Human War. A few minutes later, Karl and Clind left the cemetery. ===Post-Sword Demon Trilogy=== Sometime in the following decades, Clind was entrusted with protecting and training Frederica Baumann, teaching her how to work as a servant and to control her beast form.''"so even when beast-changed, she retains her reasoning. Clind prepared her."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1050874986649378816 Garfiel Birthday Q&A] ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]=== After [[Rem]] and [[Ram]] were hired as staff for the [[Roswaal Manor]], Clind was responsible for the creation of their maid uniforms, something that made Frederica suspicious and started an argument. During the following months, he and Frederica taught the sisters how to be servants. One day, two months after they were hired, Roswaal order him to give Rem the key to the basement so that she would find the imprisoned [[Fogg]]. On the day that everyone left the manor, Clind had also left. However, after Rem fought and killed Fogg, Clind found her bloody body and brought her to her room. After she and Roswaal spoke, Clind confronted him for why he gave that order, though he did not get an answer. Afterward, he urged Roswaal to get married and wash away the face paint, to which Roswaal said that he would consider marriage prospects but not removing his face pain. Another month later, after the deaths of [[Dudley Miload|Dudley]] and [[Grace Miload]] and the birth of Annerose, because most of the servants had either died or resigned because of the attack by the [[Witch Cult]], Clind and Frederica were tasked with serving her, and they would also continue his hobby of training demi-human servants there, leaving Rem and Ram as the only servants of Roswaal Manor.''The Miload family, which lost the married couple who were the head of it, stayed alive thanks to Roswaal becoming a guardian. However, because of the incident that happened, many servants died and many resigned, and as a result, Clind and Frederica were to be sent to the Miload residence so that it could be maintained. On top of that, the job training for demi-humans that was carried out at the Mathers residence would have to take place at the Miload residence from now on. Thus, the Mathers residence would be left with the bare minimum number of workers ── in other words, Rem and Ram would stay with Roswaal as his attendants.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Epilogue, Section 1. ===[[Emily-san's Maid Path]]=== Shortly after leaving [[Elior Forest]], Emilia encounters and helps Annerose and Clind. Due to this intervention and a letter from Roswaal, Emilia is taken to the Miload mansion, where Annerose decides to take her in as a maid. During her introduction, her name is misheard as “Emily,” a nickname by which she becomes known in that environment. At the mansion, Frederica explains that it is a place that shelters discriminated demi-humans, allowing Emilia to remain there. However, Emilia misunderstands the situation as a test imposed by Roswaal to evaluate her effort and character, leading her to take her role as a maid very seriously. Despite her determination, her complete lack of experience with human life and household tasks causes her to fail repeatedly in her duties, and she is regarded as incompetent for the role. Even so, Emilia continues to persevere, convinced that overcoming these difficulties is part of her path toward a greater future. ===[[The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting]]=== Following the Sanctuary Incident, Annerose and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the [[Sanctuary]] to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and [[Otto Suwen|Otto]], who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia. Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where [[Puck]] slept and called everyone there precious to her. Over the following year, Clind taught Subaru in survival techniques and how to use a whip. ===[[Golden Siblings Part 2|Golden Siblings]]=== After learning of the predicament that Garfiel and Frederica were in in [[Costuul]], Clind arrived in the city as a reinforcement. After assisting Garfiel with fighting off some of the haywire Lightbugs in the city and leaving the resolution of the situation to Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice, he and Garfiel followed a trail of blood Frederica left to discover [[Hayden Garo]]'s hideout. While Garfiel had a bout with Hayden, Clind was responsible for rescuing Frederica and repelled his subordinate, [[Leonardo Baroness]], by employing the Authority he wielded. ===[[Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle / Page 1|Petra’s Emilia Camp Struggle]]=== Occurring simultaneously with the [[Battle for Priestella]], Clind took part in a meeting alongside Roswaal, Annerose, Frederica, and Petra Leyte with the council of western nobles and leaders. With Roswaal and Petra successfully swaying the western leaders into backing Emilia of their own accord, Clind was impressed, and they soon returned home. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Missing Child Search Chronicle 1|Missing Child Search]] and [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]]=== With Subaru and Rem having been abducted following the end of the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], Clind was responsible for moving people around with the Authority in his possession, which Roswaal offered four magics for, much to Clind’s shock. As such, he delivered the camp members to their various destinations before returning to [[Meili Portroute]] and Annerose’s side in the [[Royal Capital]]. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Records 2|Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Records]]=== Having brought Meili and Annerose to the Royal Capital, he took part in the meeting with the Council of Wise Men by their side. However, he and Annerose did not take part in the second expedition, leaving that to Meili and the [[Felt Camp]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As the dragonkin of Volcanica, Clind is incredibly powerful. He is shown to be able to work alongside other strong combatant like Roswaal in order to fight and win against opponents on the level of the Warlock of Melancholy Hector, whose strength is considered among the top combatants introduced thus far, and Volcanica while under the control of Aldebaran. ===[[Authority]]=== Clind is a user of the '''Witch Factor of Melancholy''' and its corresponding '''Authority of Melancholy''' (憂鬱の権能, ''Yū'utsu no Ken'nō'').''“The potential influences that may be brought upon the world, upon Od Lagna, those serve as the price. That is the condition to utilize the Authority of the Witch Factor of Melancholy, in my possession. ――Confession.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 2. As the Witch Factor's custodian, he is in possession of a black box containing the Factor from which he has employed the Authority. Although he is incompatible with Melancholy, Clind has maintained his sanity unlike [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Petelgeuse]], and is limited in making use of its full power unless it is in exchange for a price. '''[[Authority#Authority of Melancholy|Compression]]''' (圧縮, ''Asshuku''): Using this Authority, Clind possesses the power to compress space and time. He primarily wields Compression as a form of teleportation by compressing the distance that would be required to travel from one point to another, or as an offensive force that dissipates and crushes targets of his choosing. As any individual besides Hector is incompatible with Melancholy due to its nature,''“No. Refutation. I am not compatible with the Witch Factor of Melancholy. Consequently, I necessitate compensation in order to draw out the Authority of Melancholy. Inadequate. By nature, those compatible with a Witch Factor do not require compensation in order to exercise the Authority. It is the right to rewrite the world, as recognized by Od Lagna. Official.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 3. Clind is required to bypass [[Od Lagna]] to wield Compression. In order to do this, he must take from people something with the possibility to influence the world as compensation to offer to Od Lagna in order to use the Authority, whether that is the existence of a spell that could open up many futures or something else with a similar influence. Clind has been provided compensation by [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], who gave up "four magics" to allow him to use his power,''“Three… no, four magics is what I’ll provide in compensation. And so, I ask to borrow the power of your Authority.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]], Section 2. and in one failed loop, Petra, who forfeit the possibility of becoming Subaru's bride.''Considering the peculiarities of the Witch Factor of Melancholy, it would be more accurate to say that Petra had offered up part of her ability to exert influence over the world, specifically, “the efforts she would have needed to make in order to secure a future in which she married Subaru”.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Interlude. Once the price is paid, an incompatible user of the Witch Factor can unrestrainedly exercise Compression until the provided compensation is used up. However, Clind's mentality is such that he refuses to accept how the Witch Factor of Melancholy stifles potential as compensation,''After all, that was the stoutest pillar of the mentality that would never accept the Witch Factor of Melancholy, which demanded the stifling of potential as compensation.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 5, Section 1. and thus, he has not been shown to forfeit any compensation of his own. *'''Instant Teleportation''': With this utilization of Compression, Clind can seemingly instantaneously transport himself and other people alongside him if necessary in the blink of an eye from a place he started at to another place of his choosing by compressing the time and distance that would be required to travel from one point to another. In Clind's case, it can be employed so long as it is within the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]],''“Now I understand the circumstances. As well as the reason why you want to borrow Clind’s power, Uncle. …However, he can only use it to reduce the distance between places within the Kingdom of Lugunica.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]], Section 2. whereas another user, Petra, was not forced to abide by the same limitation. It is also difficult for Clind to reach a place such as the [[Pleiades Watchtower]].''“He said so himself that he could not. Apparently, there is a reason why the tower is hard to reach… but he did not tell me in detail.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]], Section 2. However, using this form of Compression becomes significantly more difficult on wary and resistant opponents, and it is considered a herculean task to perform it on foes such as a Sin Archbishop or the Divine Dragon. To use this manner of Compression effectively, either the target must give their consent, or the opponent must be caught off guard.''If the opponent was cautious of Compression, then the difficulty of applying the Authority’s effects would rapidly increase. Not to mention, against such foes as the Divine Dragon and a Sin Archbishop, even just taking them away was a herculean undertaking. Unless it was used on a person who consented to its effects, or a person who was caught off guard, the possible applications of Compression were extremely narrow; such was its weakness.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 2, Section 8. *'''Dissipation and Crushing''': This offensive utilization of the Authority of Melancholy allows Clind to dissipate or crush things. By dissipating the space an object or person occupies, he can effectively make them vanish. Though the full extent to how he can use it is not known, in one instance, he was shown to use this technique of assault against Leonardo Baroness through the action of spreading his hand and clenching it. As a result, Leonardo's body was filled with holes and the space his body occupied was “devoured”, leaving no drop of blood or a trace of his existence behind.''As it was, Leonardo’s transformed blood-clot body had become riddled with holes like a moth-eaten piece of cloth, and one after another, the space his body had occupied was devoured and disappeared. He faded away and then, finally, disappeared.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 2|Golden Siblings]], Section 10. However, according to Clind, he is not required to use his hand to utilize his abilities.''“I am truly sorry. My hand, is inconsequential. Error.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 2|Golden Siblings]], Section 10. Furthermore, he can also squeeze an object or a person from a short distance, completely crushing a target. Unlike his power of teleportation, it is not known if these utilizations of the Authority of Melancholy require compensation. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Increased Lifespan''': As a dragonkin, Clind is not bound by age, and he is capable of living for centuries at a time without so much a hint of having grown older. '''Enhanced Strength''': As a dragonkin, Clind's base physical strength is superior to a typical human's. He has enough might that, despite not being able to pierce through its scales, he was able to knock down a being as tough as Volcanica with a single kick to its face. '''Skilled Swordsman''': Clind is talented enough with the sword that he could fight with it in emergencies, though he is never seen holding a sword or engaging in a sword fight. '''Whipmanship''': Clind is skilled at using a whip and taught Subaru the basics on how to use one.''Whips had a longer range and were more difficult to manipulate than movies had made them seem, but in the past year, under Clind's tutelage, Subaru's skill had vastly improved.'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 20, Section 1. '''Parkour Talent''': Clind is skilled enough at parkour to teach it to Subaru. Subaru mentions that he is able to finish the Athletic Zone that Garfiel made without rumpling his clothes and without breaking a sweat, calling him inhuman.''"Subaru had Clind watch him practice his parkour, but then Clind defeated Garfiel’s obstacle course without breaking a sweat and without ruffling his clothes. He’s inhuman."'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 3, Section 1. ===Other=== '''Sealing Shackles''': Through an unknown method, Clind is able to seal his own power away. By doing so, he can disguise his dragonkin traits and appear fully human, which he has used to deceive people into thinking he was human for decades, as well as restrain his own power. These seals seem to have multiple layers to them. It is unknown if this is an ability related to his race or due to an outside influence. *'''Second Stage''': By further unlocking his self-imposed shackles, Clind can access more of his own power. Upon releasing this shackle, his lightning can intensify to the point that it can produce Dragon-like defenses. *'''Third Stage''': By unlocking yet another shackle, more of his strength is unleashed, and it allows him to pierce through Volcanica's reverse scale. '''Lightning Manipulation''': Clind is able to generate lightning from his body, primarily the soles of his feet and from his horns. By doing so, he can dramatically enhance the effectiveness of his strikes, including being able to sever one of the various uncharged breaths of the Divine Dragon, as well as increasing his speed by a dramatic amount. By utilizing the shockwaves created by lightning, he can achieve pseudo-flight by kicking against the air. He can also create a defense on par with Volcanica's by wrapping lightning around his body like a barrier. In fact, by [[Ezzo Cadner]]'s observations, while the lightning can be used offensively, its utilization seems to be focused towards defense more than offense.''“Certainly, that individual has the ability to engage in aerial combat by himself. But per my judgement, the original usage of that magical light is not suited to such purposes, and rather, is meant to be an astonishing defensive ability. Since he is a powerful individual of such mastery, he is utilizing it in a different way in order to fight, but if the dissipation of that power is set aside, it might be incomparable to its intrinsic might.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 5, Section 2. It is unclear if he is able to do this naturally or if he is required to generate the lightning through magic. '''Soul Perception''': Clind has the power to perceive qualities from the souls of other people. For example, he used this ability to perceive the soul of the original Roswaal within his descendants.''“He is exceedingly principled, you see. He could have walked away the moment the generation he had made the promise to had passed on. It seems that being able to see souls makes him a bit rigid in his ways.”'' [[Re:IF Kasaneru]], Chapter 3, Section 7. Presumably, he is also able to use this ability in order to perceive the "purity" of a person's soul. It is unknown whether this ability falls under his Authority or his traits as a dragonkin. '''Possession''': As the dragonkin of the Divine Dragon, Clind is able to inhabit Volcanica's husk, allowing him to control its body freely. He has done this in order to act on the covenant made during the time of the Great Calamity. The last known time he has performed this is during the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]]. However, if something has taken over Volcanica's husk, he cannot possess it. '''Survival Skills''': He is mentioned by Subaru as being skilled at survival, enough to be able to teach him the basics (finding water, how to start a fire, etc.).''"Edible grass and fruits are… ahh, I was right to learn it from Clind-san. Gotta thank my mentor…"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 1, Section 3. '''Excellent Teacher''': Due to his vast experience, Clind is a talented teacher. He was able to teach Subaru how to utilize a whip, survival skills, and parkour in just a year. ==Trivia== *Clind's birthday was decided at a signing event in 2025. *Like the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] and Stride, Clind is one of the only confirmed holders of a Witch Factor who isn't named after a celestial body. *Clind used his Authority differently in the original Monthly Comic Alive release of Golden Siblings Part 2. In addition to clenching and spreading his hand, which Clind still performs in [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9|Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], he uttered the word “melancholy” before using his Authority.''“This, is not the most desirable method. Melancholy.”'' [[Golden Siblings Part 2]], Section 6. Its ability allowed Clind to crush Leonardo Baroness's limbs from a distance.''Then the young man, twisting in midair, reached out and clenched his five outstretched fingers. One Day II (side story) |Anime = [[Episode 50]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kana Ichinose|Ichinose Kana]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Emi Lo|Emi Lo]]}} '''Annerose Miload''' (アンネローゼ・ミロード) is the heir of House Miload, a branch family of [[House Mathers]]. Although she was introduced in [[Arc 4]], she has yet to play a proper role in the main story. She became the heiress-in-waiting to House Miload after losing her parents following her birth. [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] brought her and her servant, [[Clind]], into the [[Emilia Camp]] so the latter could oversee [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s training after the boy officially became [[Emilia]]'s knight. ==Appearance== Annerose has light blue eyes and long, dark indigo colored hair, which is braided around her head, prompting Subaru to call her a "Braid Loli" as he didn't know what her hairstyle was called. She wears an extravagant dress similar to [[Beatrice]] but the decorations are much plainer. Contrary to her young age, she has a hard look and a distinguished expression. ==Personality== As the heir to the Miload family, Annerose is mentally mature for her age, capable of speaking toe to toe with most adults and willingly going out of her way to travel long distances to scold people like Roswaal for their behavior. She is intelligent for her age as well, being quick to understand any situation she is dragged into, and she is decisive upon coming to those understandings. She is also considerably well adapted to handling nobles and has enough knowledge to meet with nobles in Roswaal's place, and willing to show off her intelligence and political knowledge to keep their mouths shut about her. She is also free of prejudice toward [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], having lived in an environment where many of them work throughout her life, showing particular adoration toward Emilia despite her existence as a silver-haired half elf. Despite her usual behavior, she shows a particularly harsher demeanor toward Roswaal. She scolds him for his actions, and she even approved of him being struck, telling as much to [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] upon being told by Roswaal that he had hit him, and she even claimed that she would be his ally in the event that he caused hassle for him. On the other hand, she can be particularly defensive of Emilia, to the point that she will act as a practical "love rival" when speaking with [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], not unwilling to pick fights without even a hint of her usual refined demeanor. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]=== On the day that [[Ram]] and [[Rem]] were [[Attack on Miload Manor|targeted]] by [[Faust]] from the [[Witch Cult]], Annerose's mother, [[Grace Miload]], died shortly after giving birth to her. Later, Clind started serving her. ===[[Emily-san's Maid Path]]=== Shortly after leaving [[Elior Forest]], Emilia encounters and helps Annerose and Clind. Due to this intervention and a letter from Roswaal, Emilia is taken to the Miload mansion, where Annerose decides to take her in as a maid. During her introduction, her name is misheard as “Emily,” a nickname by which she becomes known in that environment. At the mansion, [[Frederica Baumann]] explains that it is a place that shelters discriminated demi-humans, allowing Emilia to remain there. However, Emilia misunderstands the situation as a test imposed by Roswaal to evaluate her effort and character, leading her to take her role as a maid very seriously. Despite her determination, her complete lack of experience with human life and household tasks causes her to fail repeatedly in her duties, and she is regarded as incompetent for the role. Even so, Emilia continues to persevere, convinced that overcoming these difficulties is part of her path toward a greater future. ===[[The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting]]=== Following the [[Sanctuary Incident]], Annerose and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the [[Sanctuary]] to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to Garfiel that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and [[Otto Suwen|Otto]], who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when [[Petra Leyte]] said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia. Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where [[Puck]] slept and called everyone there precious to her. ===[[Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle / Page 1|Petra’s Emilia Camp Struggle]]=== Occurring simultaneously with the [[Battle for Priestella]], Annerose took part in a meeting alongside Roswaal, Clind, Frederica, and Petra with the council of western nobles and leaders. With Roswaal and Petra successfully swaying the western leaders into backing Emilia of their own accord, they soon returned home. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Missing Child Search Chronicle 1|Missing Child Search]] and [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]]=== With Subaru and Rem having been abducted following the end of the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], Roswaal came to the Miload Manor to request Clind's assistance, which he was granted. Clind was responsible for moving people around with his [[Authority]], which Roswaal offered four magics for, much to Clind’s shock. As such, he delivered the camp members to their various destinations before returning to [[Meili Portroute]] and Annerose’s side in the [[Royal Capital]]. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record|Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record]]=== Having arrived in the Royal Capital to meet with the Council of Wise Men, after being led to them by the [[Marcos Gildark|Commander of the Royal Guard]], Annerose shut down [[Bordeaux Zergev]]'s skepticism of her authority due to her age, and they got down to business about the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] and Meili being the key to getting there. With the arrival of [[Reinhard van Astrea]], who confirmed Meili's [[Divine Protection]] was legitimate, and [[Felt]], who kept the tension in the room from escalating, Meili was tasked to go with the [[Felt Camp]] on the second expedition to the Pleiades Watchtower so that she could be pardoned for her history as an assassin. Around this timeframe, Annerose was responsible for hiring [[Sylphy Elmart]] and the other former wives of [[Regulus Corneas]] that Emilia saved as maids for [[Roswaal Manor]]. ==Trivia== *In [[Re:IF Kasaneru]], Roswaal states that Annerose is a candidate to become the next Roswaal.''“To begin with, he’s serving Annerose on my orders. Annerose is, after all, a candidate to become the next Roswaal, you seeeee~. I needed some insurance to keep her safe.”'' [[Re:IF Kasaneru]], Chapter 3, Section 7. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Royal Selection Navbox}} [[Category:Emilia Camp]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:House Miload]]

Mathers]]. She played supporting roles during the [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]]. A member of the renowned [[House Remendis]], she acted as Theresia's arms and legs, as well as her guard. During the [[Demi-Human War]], Carol was a warrior who fought alongside the powerful Zergev Squadron, and after the war's conclusion, she married her comrade and colleague, [[Grimm Fauzen]]. In the present day, she currently works as a servant for the Astrea family alongside Grimm, often interacting with both [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] and [[Felt]]. ==Appearance== Carol was a beautiful young woman with medium length blonde hair and green eyes. When she was young, she wore a blue and white outfit along with black stockings and armor. ==Personality== On the surface, she comes across as a stoic woman with a strait-laced personality who rarely minces her words when she has something to say. However, Carol has a more nuanced and softer side that is typically reserved for those who have earned her trust. Her fierce loyalty and personal affection for Theresia can also sometimes overpower her usually rational sound judgements and reveal more competitive and childish characteristics, particularly when in the presence of [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]], who stole her master's heart. She has shown to be especially soft around Grimm. Otherwise, she is a very dutiful person. In her later years, Carol is a kind old lady, though she will get mad at people who don't show proper manners, such as licking a plate clean after eating. Though she still shows respect to people, she also is not afraid to lash out at people who are deliberately rude. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== Carol was born as the heir to House Remendis, a warrior class noble family that has produced excellent swordsmen that would serve House Astrea for generations. Two years before the Demi-Human War began in earnest, when Theresia had awoken to the Divine Protection of Sword Saint at age 13, a 14-year-old Carol, who had been displaying skills among the best of her generation in her House, was assigned to be Theresia's personal attendant. Although their relationship had started off somewhat rough, after attempting to challenge her and being swiftly defeated, she learned of her [[Divine Protection]]s and saw her genuinely crying for hurting her. Gaining immense respect for her, she decided to loyally follow her. However, Theresia soon lost the ability to smile after her failure in the beginning of the Demi-Human War which resulted in one of her brothers' death. With Theresia unable to wield her blade, Carol took her place by Roswaal's side to protect her. Following the [[Battle of Castour Field]], the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]] decided to call in the [[magic]] specialist Roswaal J. Mathers to analyze the magic circles used. When the Zergev Squadron arrived at Castour Field, they officially met Roswaal and Carol. However, it took no time for Carol and Wilhelm to start arguing, Grimm having to step between them. With everyone split into group, Grimm kept Carol company to keep her mind off of Wilhelm. After arriving and allowing Roswaal to check the circle, after she claimed it would be a threat to the Kingdom, Grimm had a bad feeling that he thought Wilhelm might share. That feeling turned out to be correct when the undead Tholter fired arrows at them and corpse soldiers began rising. Leaving Grimm to cover Roswaal alongside Carol, Wilhelm went to fight the undead, where he met [[Sphinx]]. With Roswaal intending to join the fight, furious, Sphinx decided to retreat, leaving everyone to clean up the undead. With some help from Roswaal, Wilhelm realized that Tholter was the main corpse soldier to defeat, and after giving him the push he needed to overcome his trauma and fight, Grimm ran forward and put his old friend to rest. Shortly after this, Carol spoke to Grimm, who was still fearful after having killed Tholter, and after calming him down, he fell in love with her. Afterward, meeting up with the Bordeaux and Pivot, Roswaal relayed Sphinx's identity and the threat she bore. For 3 years, he and the other members of the Zergev Squadron, and often Roswaal and Carol, were sent to some of the most dangerous and brutal battles of the war. Once, while speaking with Grimm, he alleviated her fears over both Wilhelm and her own master, saying that people could change. Before leaving, she offered to teach Grimm to use the shield, leading to their regular meetups to train. Likewise, more and more of Theresia's family began to die in the war, breaking her heart further. With people trying to convince her to join the army, Carol, who was upset that she couldn't help Theresia, convinced her to go outside and away from everyone, which resulted in the girl making a flower field in the slums. One day, however, when she went to retrieve her, she found her smiling, with the girl saying that she met a rude boy that day. In time, she learned that boy was Wilhelm, and at times, she would even spy on her conversations. Though frustrated that it was Wilhelm's influence that was healing her, as she still didn't get along very well with him, she was grateful and started harboring more respect and envy for him for letting Theresia smile again. One day, she met Grimm and gave him a locket with a flower as a good luck charm. However, that day, everyone met their new commander, [[Leip Barielle]], who struck Wilhelm for his disrespect. Though Roswaal pacified him and led him away, Carol followed, still worried about Wilhelm. During the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], Carol joined Roswaal and ten other knights to investigate the location of a magic circle, which activated and brought everyone to their knees. Not wanting to allow it to be destroyed, Sphinx appeared and got in her way, killing several of the knights in an attempt to convince Roswaal to join her. However, Roswaal managed to easily corner her, causing Sphinx to fly away. After Roswaal destroyed the circle, Carol was worried for Grimm's safety on the field. In the month following the battle, Carol visited Grimm after he lost his voice due to a throat injury, apologizing to and crying for him. This led to him kissing her and their becoming lovers. During a later meeting with Grimm, she gave him a House Remendis shield as a present for surviving. Later, she visited Wilhelm when Grimm wanted him to visit, and she chastised him for the way he treated Grimm. A little while after this, uprisings started all over the country, forcing the regional lords to take care of them on their own. With the Zergev Squadron rebuilt and left behind, they prepared to move as well when Wilhelm realized that the enemies' movement was a distraction so that the leaders could attack the castle and the [[Gionis Lugunica|king]]. With the rest of the unit, Grimm, who returned to duty, and [[Bordeaux Zergev]] trusting his judgment, they made for the castle, and with Roswaal and Carol's appearances, they were allowed inside. With the squad split up to cover the castle, Wilhelm took his group to the chapel while Bordeaux split off from them. Confronting Valga and Sphinx, the former of which had enhanced is size via a magic circle and his ancestors' bones, he had his companions chase after Sphinx while he battled Valga. With Carol's aerial combat, Roswaal's techniques, and Grimm's defenses, they cornered Sphinx and forced her to retreat, with Roswaal chasing after her and leaving the rest to assist Wilhelm, who eventually managed to defeat Valga. Within the following year of the [[Invasion of the Royal Castle]], having been knighted and being made the vice commander of the Zergev Squadron, Wilhelm started to become friendlier to his comrades, to the point that he would even share drinks with and tease Grimm about his relationship with Carol, much to Carol's frustration. However, one day, when Roswaal informed him that his territory was in danger, he disappeared without telling anyone. Learning about it, Carol decided to inform Theresia, who chose to pick up a sword to protect Wilhelm. Later, they arrived in the Trias Domain with the Zergev Squadron, where Theresia started killing their enemies, much to her sadness and Carol's worry. After [[Battle of the Trias Domain]], once Theresia spoke with Wilhelm, Wilhelm disappeared for years. It wasn't until after the war was over that anyone saw him again, when he challenged and defeated Theresia in the middle of her award ceremony, and Carol, who was worried for him for both her and Theresia's sakes, was happy to see him again and grateful that he managed to take away the reason for Theresia to wield the sword anymore. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]]=== After Theresia dragged Wilhelm to her mansion and forced him to take a bath, he spoke with Carol and Grimm, the former of which lashed out at him, and he learned of her position as Theresia's attendant. After this, they informed him that he was unemployed, leading him to finding a way to rejoin. Later, upon Carol and Grimm's return to the mansion, Carol chided Wilhelm for upsetting Theresia and went to speak with her while Wilhelm and Grimm finished all of the food that Theresia prepared. The next day over breakfast, Carol warned him not to do anything that would upset Theresia. The day after that, Wilhelm found himself face to face with the best warriors the country had to offer, including Bordeaux, Carol, and Grimm. With Gionis and Miklotov overseeing the battle, Wilhelm fought and defeated all forty soldiers. However, after Theresia arrived and chided the king for allowing this, it was revealed that she would have been let go of her position if she married Wilhelm, much to everyone's but the king and Miklotov's shock. Wilhelm accepted this, and they embraced, Theresia calling him Wilhelm van Astrea, much to Carol's relief. Three months later, she and Theresia went to confront Theresia's father, [[Veltol Astrea|Veltol]]. When they met, Theresia was quick to chide her father for his actions, and she even threatened to leave [[House Astrea]] because of him. Even Carol and her mother, [[Tishua Astrea|Tishua]], joined in to chide him. However, she believed in Wilhelm, and she knew that he would arrive on time for their wedding, despite her father's meddling. The next day, wearing her wedding dress, she waited patiently for the return for the Zergev Squadron with Carol and her parents. Eventually, Bordeaux arrived and informed her of the squad's return, and soon after, her wedding took place. Carol was one of the many attendees who watched the two get married. Towards the end of the reception, Theresia threw the bouquet to her, leading to Grimm taking it, pulling her close, and holding the bouquet in the air, essentially declaring that they would be next. In the month that followed, Veltol made numerous appearances, much to Theresia's frustration, and eventually, he even suggested going along on the honeymoon as well, leading to another argument. However, with help from Tishua, they were able to get him to leave. Given two months for their honeymoon, they prepared to leave, taking Carol as Theresia's attendant, and they decided to visit the cities to the south of the Royal Capital. ===[[Sword Demon Love Story: Earth Dragon Capital, Flanders]]=== After their marriage, Wilhelm and Theresia went on their honeymoon with Carol accompanying them, and they first visited [[Flanders]], the Earth Dragon Capital, where Theresia was going to ride an earth dragon for the first time. After experiencing one for a moment, Carol interrupted them after Wilhelm got a little intimate with Theresia, to which Theresia scolded Carol. Though Carol was heavily reluctant, partially due to her own misgivings and Veltol's request to not let him take things too far with her, she entrusted Theresia to Wilhelm's care. As they rode atop one earth dragon, Theresia told Wilhelm about how the different species of earth dragons were named after flowers, which Wilhelm was curious about. As they rode, Wilhelm was reminded of his family, and after Theresia grabbed his attention, she described them to her. After a few hours time, Theresia improved her riding to the point that she surpassed Carol, and she and Carol ran around on their respective earth dragons. Wilhelm, watching them from a distance as a rancher watched approached him and said the earth dragon she was riding became attached to her. After he offered it to Wilhelm, he was told its name was [[Minor Characters#Diana|Diana]], which Wilhelm laughed at. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story: Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]]=== After leaving Flanders, because Theresia insisted they not visit her home in Hakuchuri, they made for [[Picoutatte]], where her father was waiting, leading to another argument. However, with his reason for visiting to collect the present for his wife, they accompanied him to the Suwen Company. With Veltol asking Wilhelm and Carol to allow him and Theresia to shop together, they left to observe the town. However, when a commotion at the shop ensued, they returned to find a ton of blood and Theresia, and they were soon rushed to the hospital, where Veltol lay cursed and injured, as informed to them by [[Garitch Fabless]], who attempted to heal him. Accordingly, the only way to remove the curse was to cut it off at the source. Soon after, [[Yaktol Suwen]], who ran the shop, informed the group of the message given by the perpetrator of the incident, [[Stride Vollachia]], that they would be waiting at a great bridge in Picoutatte's west district with the source of the curse. Impatient, Carol ran off with Yaktol in search of the man while Theresia resolved herself to go to the bridge with Wilhelm. The next morning, Carol returned, unable to find Stride. After Yaktol then provided Wilhelm with his new sword that Veltol picked out for him, he and Theresia left for the bride where Stride and his champion [[Kurgan]] were waiting. Meanwhile, Carol remained behind at the hospital to watch over Veltol. Eventually, the curse was lifted, and when Theresia and Wilhelm returned, she informed them as much. Later, she and Theresia bought an accessory for Veltol to gift Tishua. However, when Theresia got into another argument with his dad, she and Carol left to greet Tishua, who was informed of the situation and decided to come to Picoutatte. ===[[Sword Demon Love Story: The Other Side of the Honeymoon]]=== Following the [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Theresia and Carol wandered the streets of Picoutatte while Wilhelm and Veltol were recovering from their injuries. As they walked, they came across Garitch and spoke with him. Theresia apologized to him for having destroyed the bridge and creating more work for him, but he waved it off. Still worried about it, Carol tried to pin the blame on the one responsible for the challenge while Garitch said that Veltol could pay for the damages and treatment and nobody would be upset. However, he also asked her if she could get Veltol to reconsider his recommendation of Garitch to the Royal Capital, as he did not want to go to the capital since the mother of his [[Roswaal K. Mathers|son]] was there. Though he believed that it would probably be for the best that he didn't go, Theresia claimed that happiness was up to the individual to choose, which ultimately cemented that Garitch did not want to go, saying it wasn't the right time yet, and the girls left his going to the capital to Veltol. Afterward, they asked about the mother, which he described, leading to Garitch telling her that someone so immoral should not be recommended and telling her that Wilhelm was fastidious, so she didn't have to worry, triggering an emotional response from Carol. After he recommended the sherbet, he left, and the two had a bowl for themselves. ===[[Felt-chan Saw!]]=== In the ten days that followed the Loot House Incident, Felt tried several times to escape, having managed to escape Reinhard's side only once successfully before being caught. Likewise, the other servants stopped her. Being served confectionaries by Carol, Felt enjoyed it and asked if Carol wouldn't go with her when she escaped, to which she appreciated the offer but claimed that she had to refuse for Grimm's sake. ===[[Felt-chan Rises to the Center Stage]]=== On the way to the Royal Castle, Felt, who had lost a bet to Reinhard, started to kick at him in annoyance while Carol drove the carriage with her husband. She ultimately failed to hit him even once, and she asked once more where they were headed. Though Reinhard wanted to keep it a secret, they reached the castle, much to her frustration. Inside the castle, Reinhard left her side and Felt was brought to be dressed by maids while Carol watched on. However, [[Heinkel Astrea|Heinkel]], having come in response to Reinhard's arrival, entered the room, much to Carol's anger and Felt's annoyance. Afterward, Carol informed Heinkel of Felt's reason being in the castle was for the Royal Selection, which he laughed at. Though Felt was ready to attack him, Heinkel stepped in front of her quickly and claimed that they were both in the same position before leaving. Felt asked Carol about her Heinkel, and she replied that she, Grimm, and Reinhard all had connections to him, and she was dismayed that Reinhard had apparently guessed correctly. Deciding to get things back on track, Felt positioned herself to continue getting dressed while a couple of the maids cleaned up a mess Heinkel had made, and while that was happening, Felt noticed Heinkel's hair tone being like Reinhard and claimed she knows people with red hair suck. ===[[Felt-chan Forms a Hooligan Squad]]=== Felt sat with the trio of thugs to discuss with them, and after some talk and a bit of resistance from them, she eventually convinced them to help destroy the country, as she thought they had similar views to her. Later on at night, Reinhard had a secret meeting with Grimm and Carol, commenting how the events that transpired confirmed that his choice to follow Felt was the correct one and that he felt a little guilty that he would use her to make the Astrea family name rise to glory again. Changing the main subject, the old lady asks if they really should allow their master to get near Reinhard's mother, as they feared what could come of the encounter. Reinhard stated that he cannot deny him this, as it was his right, and he mentioned that he would soon leave with Felt to take care of other matters, thanking the both of them for everything they had done. ==Abilities== '''Remendis Style Swordsmanship''': An aerial form of swordsmanship utilized by House Remendis. While mid-air, Carol can change her trajectory and direction to strike opponents from different angles at high speeds. According to Wilhelm, she specializes at deflecting attacks with her blade. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Maids]] [[Category:House Remendis]] [[Category:House Astrea]]

Unnamed sister-in-law (deceased) |Light Novel = [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Third Encyclopedia]] (shop special) [[Re:Zero Bonds of Ice: Before Memories]] (side story volume)}} '''Alviero Juukulius''' (アルビエロ・ユークリウス) is the current head of House Juukulius. ==Appearance== Alviero is a well-dressed man with a well-groomed haircut, a sophisticated figure, light purple hair, and yellow eyes. ==Personality== Alviero is a good-natured man who is shown to care for his family and children, to the point that if his son, [[Joshua Juukulius|Joshua]], started to cry, he would panic. He also apparently talked regularly to Joshua about his younger brother, [[Klein Juukulius|Klein]], despite the fact that they didn't talk all that much, implying that he did seem to care for his brother. He was also quick to laugh when [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]] made the wrong introduction gesture. Alviero cares about the future of House Juukulius, and he will act to preserve its standing when he must. This can lead to him feeling guilt toward Joshua for having to adopt his nephew, Julius, to have him become a knight in Joshua's place. This being said, he can be strict when necessary, and he was very enthusiastic when it comes to teaching about being a knight, as he had been looking forward to it for a long time. ==History== Alviero's brother, Klein, ran away from his aristocratic family and married a commoner woman after Alviero became the head of House Juukulius. Together they had a son, Julius. After their untimely death in a flash flood, Alviero took Julius back into the family and effectively introduced him to a fine life of aristocracy, ultimately choosing Julius to become the next head of House Juukulius due to the frailty of his own son, Joshua, much to his guilt. ==Abilities== '''Swordsmanship''': As a knight, Alviero is a competent swordsman, and he is skilled enough to teach Julius who to use a sword in his youth. ==Trivia== *In the Monthly Comic Alive release of [[First Mission Part 1]], Alviero was erroneously given the name '''Jonas Juukulius''' (ヨナス・ユークリウス, ''Yonasu Yūkuriusu''). It was corrected to Alviero in [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12|Tanpenshuu Volume 12]]. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:House Juukulius]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Knights]] [[es:Alviero Juukulius]] [[ru:Альвиеро Юклиус]] [[zh:角色:阿尔维里奥]]

Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7|Volume 7]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 24|Arc 3 Chapter 24]] |Anime = [[Episode 19]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Hideyuki Umezu|Umezu Hideyuki]]}} '''Conwood Melahau''' (コンウッド・メラハウ) is a former deputy commander of the [[Royal Army|Royal Guard]] and a friend of [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] from his younger days. ==Appearance== Conwood has green hair and brown eyes. ==Personality== Conwood is a man with quick wit and strong enthusiasm. ==History== Conwood was part of the Zergev Squadron in the midst of the [[Demi-Human War]], later becoming the advisor to [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] when he took over the role of commander from [[Bordeaux Zergev]]. They and the rest of the Zergev Squadron participated in the hunt for a Sand Earthworm and the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]]. After these incidents, the Zergev Squadron was invited to join the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]], and [[Grimm Fauzen]] resigned from his position as the squadron's deputy commander to marry [[Carol Remendis]]. Wilhelm became the new commander of the Royal Guard, and Conwood was selected to take Grimm's place, making him the deputy commander. At some point after the [[Great Conquest]] ended in failure, Conwood retired from the Royal Guard due to injury. He left with a positive reputation among the knights. He started up a tavern, Silver Shield, in the [[Royal Capital|Royal Capital's]] Commercial District. As a result of Conwood's positive reputation, he attracted a lot of knights to his tavern, which had the side effect of making normal customers shy away from it, much to his own lament. ==Trivia== *Conwood was originally unnamed in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Ex 2]]. *The one who returned the [[Terminology#Ten Enchanted Swords|Dragon Sword Reid]] back to the Astreas after the Great Conquest was Conwood.''“I didn’t depict it, but I’m sure Conwood, who represents the old men, has been apologizing to Wilhelm ever since he brought back Theresia’s sword.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/764859766657003521 Re:Zero Episode 20 Commentary] ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Advisors]] [[Category:Zergev Squadron]] [[de:Conwood Melahau]] [[es:Conwood Melahau]] [[pt-br:Conwood Melahau]] [[ru:Конвуд Мелахау]] [[zh:角色:库乌德]]
