[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 28|Volume 28]] (main story)}} '''Chisha Gold''' (チシャ・ゴールド) is the '''Fourth ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] and Emperor [[Vincent Vollachia]]'s military advisor and decoy. He played important roles in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]], [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]], and [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7|Sword Identity]], where he aided the emperor with the best of his abilities. As the instigator and ringleader of the [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] that struck the [[Vollachia Empire]] before [[Arc 7]], he was the apparent main antagonist of the aforementioned arc. Originally a commoner who happened to help the young emperor, Chisha quickly became a great ally to Vincent, helping him rise to the throne of the Empire. However, after the appearance of a certain [[Ubilk|Stargazer]] with a prophecy of the future, Chisha ousted the emperor from the throne with the help of the [[Berstetz Fondalfon|Imperial Prime Minister]], hoping to save him from his demise, triggering Vollachia's civil war in the process. Eventually, he was killed by a resurrected [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] at the [[Great Disaster]]'s commencement after sacrificing his own life to save Vincent's. ==Appearance== Chisha Gold was a tall, lean man with relatively long snow-white hair with the tips of his bangs being purple in color. His extremely pale complexion made him give off an impression as if all the color drained from him. He was also noted to emit an aura of not entirely being present in the room. His golden eyes had a decorative purple teardrop at the outer side of each of his eyes which give off an air of mystery which befitted the Divine General rather well. He dressed in a long white coat that covers his body in its entirety. The coat had a rather high white collar and what appear to be 6 purple-colored gems at his chest area; three for each side of the chest. The inside of the coat seemed to be a mixture of different colors arranged in stripes; darker white, grey and grey with circular purple designs respectively. Before the coronation of the seventy-seventh emperor of the Vollachia Empire, Chisha wore the exact same dress but solely black. His hair was also of the same color, as well as his weapon. Following his injury that almost cost him his life, Chisha's hair turned white,''During the Imperial Selection Ceremony, after being nearly killed in a stand-off with an enemy and then returning from the brink of death, Chisha’s black hair had been drained of all its color, turning completely white.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 5. and thus, the Divine General decided to entirely switch his color scheme.''Since then, he had been wearing white, exactly the opposite of the black attire he had been donning, for some reason or another. Having even repainted the iron fan he used out of preference, he was thus completely white, his clothing uniform.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 5. ==Personality== Chisha was a calm and collective individual, preferring to rely on his keen intellect rather than on his limited fighting strength. He walked around with an air of mystery and uncanniness, spoke in a polite manner, in contrast with some other Divine Generals such as [[Cecilus Segmunt|Cecilus]] and [[Yorna Mishigure|Yorna]], and generally gave off a more pacifistic vibe. Despite being a Divine General in the Vollachia Empire, Chisha was shown to not have much of the nationalistic tendencies others have, and admits his poor fighting capabilities,''"Though, I must say, the empire's way of life rather disagrees with me..."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], The Silver Flower Dance of The Sword Saint and The Lightning, Section 8. claiming that he only became a Divine General out of necessity. In fact, he even believed that he was being overvalued.''Hence, albeit he was of the opinion that he was being overvalued, Chisha had resigned himself to that position and role. For the most part, it worked well.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. Since his youth, he has also had an impatient and slightly impulsive nature, something which had once resulted in him getting into trouble and even drove him to answer a query by a young Vincent with his true thoughts.''With his impatient nature as the reason, he had gotten in trouble with a powerful individual and ended up banished from his hometown. Time after time he would tell himself that his behavior could ruin his prospects, yet he had never been able to mend it.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. He had a proclivity towards theory over practice, and he was aware that he was socially clumsy as well.''Despite everything, after a lifetime of being ostracized for his proclivity to theory over practice and for his social clumsiness, Chesha’s rebirth as Chisha brought a welcome change.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. Despite his outward appearance, however, Chisha was cold and calculative, planning his every step and manipulating all of his opponents with borderline ease. With his keen intellect, he was easily able to impersonate Vincent's mannerisms and ways of thinking to perfection, while his decoy ability seemingly allowed him to morph into the emperor, keeping the throne occupied and preventing a nation-wide rebellion from occurring. This being said, by the speculation of [[Natsuki Subaru]], his actions, despite not being born of loyalty to Vincent, despite his own claim that he would not give his life for Vincent, were in an attempt to challenge and overcome the fate that seemed to ridicule Vincent. Chisha himself even believed that his actions were for that day, to challenge and mock the disaster that was beset to claim Vincent's life.If you are someone who can kill him, then what are you waiting for? If you say you will snatch him away, go for it. Forewarned ruin and all the like, don’t you dare think that you can destroy our Emperor, our Empire. That day, when I got the wheel out of the ditch, it was for the sake of this moment. For the sake of ridiculing this destruction, all of it was――, ''"――Foreshadowing. Though, I shall absolutely not say such a thing, for if I did, Cecilus would get overly enthused."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 9. ==History== Chisha was born in a commoner family under the name '''Chesha Trim''' (チェシャ・トリム, ''Chesha Torimu''), and because he had been born with black hair, his social clumsiness, and was inept at performing tilling or harvesting of fields, he had been a subject of mockery.''His hair and irises, both black as if imbued with shadows, were considered uncommon traits, even in a land so rich in racial diversity like the Vollachian Empire. Although Chesha’s eye color differed, he likewise had been born with black hair. For that, he would often become the subject of mockery, so he could sympathize with the boy.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2.''He had gotten the opportunity to resettle, far from those who had unjustly scorned him for being inept at tilling or harvesting the fields, and he would never trade that for anything in the world.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. Due to his impatient nature, Chesha had gotten into trouble with someone important and was banished from his hometown. Chesha first met Vincent Abellux when he was fourteen,''Chesha, fourteen years old at the time, had believed himself to be mature for his age, but meeting that boy, two years younger than himself, forced him to reconsider.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. when Vincent's dragon carriage got stuck in a ditch. Using his calculative skills, Chesha helped the prince get his dragon carriage unstuck, and immediately afterward, he was brought aboard that very carriage,''Chesha reminisced on his course of action heretofore, seeking to solve one doubt: how had he ended up encountering such an outstanding lad, not to mention riding the same carriage as him? All had begun with a simple act of assistance. He had come across a stranded carriage, its wheel stuck in a ditch on the highway. Pushing and pulling, many attempts were being made in vain to release it. He approached the scene and freed the lurched carriage from the deep ditch by inserting a board and utilizing it as a lever.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. both as a way to thank him and to bring him to his mansion.''In the first place, he had been invited aboard for two reasons: to thank him for releasing the wheel, and to bring him into the mansion.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. Afterward, Vincent asked him Chesha if he would die for him,''"Chesha Trim, would you be willing to die for my sake?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. which Chesha declined on impulse. Despite expecting to be executed for his insolence, his answer impressed Vincent, and telling him to keep that outlook, decided to hire him.''"Perfect. Maintain that outlook, for you shall be serving me hereafter."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. His confusion led him to question Vincent's decision, as he was aware of the events of the Miracle of Abellux, to which Vincent merely replied that his actions were to prevent any future rebellions through fear. As Vincent asked what Chesha thought he expected of him, Vincent claimed that the road he walked was one filled with ditches, and he believed he would need Chesha's abilities to get out of such problems.''"Correct. The road I am traversing is fraught with ditches, and I cannot avoid all of them. However, I cannot stay in a ditch waiting for the issue to solve itself; otherwise, death shall come for me. And that means, I shall need a method to pull myself out whenever I get stuck."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. After being hired, Chesha started to go by the name Chisha Gold, adopting the surname of a certain house that Vincent had exterminated,''Funnily or not, the surname Gold pertained to a family exterminated by Vincent as a punishment for treachery.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. because he did not want to cause his family any troubles.''"Since my family is back at my hometown, I would rather keep my name from becoming well-known to avoid causing them unwarranted trouble. Though, I suppose you would find it easy to murder all my worries away…"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. Thanks to the adoption of the Gold name, rumors began to spread that Vincent left one descendant from the family alive to serve him in order to condemn the family to endure the humiliation to escape his control, further reinforcing his own reputation.''Perhaps it had been a little jape of revenge from Vincent towards Chesha’s rudeness; but that aside, it misled the public into rumoring that he had spared one descendant of Gold, while condemning them to endure the humiliation of failing to escape his control, which reinforced his standing as the Sanguinary Prince.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. From then forward, Chisha helped Vincent get out of various "ditches", and once he was well learned about the flood control systems, he decided to finally be rid of the administrator and have him executed for embezzlement.''"Chisha, you have educated yourself well on the flood control system. Now, I must discharge that incompetent administrator from his post. I shall adduce his charges of embezzlement heretofore and have him decapitated."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. As more time passed, Vincent eventually told Chisha about Stride Vollachia and his journal. However, he did not tell him what he read within it. At an unknown point after this, Vincent picked up Cecilus,''The boy, named Cecilus Segmunt, was of the same class as Chisha years ago: somebody whom Vincent had sensed potential in and thus picked up.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 4. and about six months after a conversation between Chisha and Cecilus regarding their roles came the Imperial Selection Ceremony. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== During the time of the Imperial Selection Ceremony, Chisha worked as Vincent Abellux's chief of strategy. His plans were instrumental to Vincent's success, though one of them, concocted in preparation for the [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]], led to his near-fatal injury caused by [[Arakiya]]. This led to him completely losing his color,''“Did I surprise you, milady? My apologies. My near-death experience on the occasion of our last encounter seems to have robbed me of my color.’'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], [[Crimson Afterglow Part 3|Crimson Afterglow]], Section 17. as well as his sudden manifestation of his Noh ability. After [[Palladio Manesque]]'s death at the hands of [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]], Chisha made his presence known in the Manesque Castle and offered wine to her, which she ordered Arakiya to destroy, expecting it was poison. However, Arakiya, who had been convinced by Vincent to join his side in order to ensure Prisca's survival, began to lick the poisoned wine, quickly falling in an unstable condition. Chisha watched as Prisca took part of the poison from Arakiya in an attempt to save her life, and before she lost consciousness, proclaimed that he would have been willing serving her if he had not been working under Vincent. Much to Chisha's pleasure, Vincent's plan to defy the rules of the Imperial Selection Ceremony and spare his sister was successful,''Since the Imperial Selection Ceremony was the fate of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, they mutually acknowledged that they were not allowed to coexist, even with compromises―― Until Vincent tore that fate apart by his own hand. This came much to the delight of Chisha, and, above everything else, as a relief.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 5. with the girl managing to take on a new identity while Arakiya joined their faction. Meanwhile, thanks to his near-death experience, Chisha changed his color scheme in order to match his new ability, Noh, an ability he decided to keep the particulars of a secret from everyone.''In any case, the particulars of this Noh had been kept from Vincent as well. He would not disclose it to anyone, naturally. Let alone to the loose-lipped Cecilus, or to others with whom he had little connection.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 5. Following the selection's conclusion and Vincent's ascendance to the throne, Chisha was appointed to the ranks of the Divine Generals. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== After the rebellion four to five months before [[Arc 1]], Chisha took place in a meeting about the incident alongside Vincent, [[Goz Ralfon]], [[Groovy Gumlet]], and [[Moguro Hagane]]. About a month later, he visited [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]] in order to retrieve or dispose of [[Gramdart Holstoy]], the culprit who conspired with [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] in the recent rebellion against Vincent and had faked his death to escape to Lugunica, in addition to finding and stop Cecilus, who entered the country without warning on his own accord to catch the traitor himself. Before returning to Vollachia, he witnessed the bout between Cecilus and the Sword Saint, [[Reinhard van Astrea]]. ===In The Years That Followed=== During one of Ubilk's visits to the castle, he spoke with Chisha and Vincent, saying that the Great Disaster had been foretold by the stars,''"――The coming of the Great Disaster has been passed down in a commandment. It is regrettable, Your Excellency."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. something that he brought up with the intention of informing Chisha about.''"I know, I know. Buuut~, if His Excellency has trouble speaking about the matter, I thought it’d be better if I did. That’s why I’m present together with General First-Class Chisha, isn’t that so?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. When Chisha began questioning him, having not heard of this Great Disaster, Ubilk claimed that it would bring ruin, also mentioning Yang Sword's glow, implying he knew about what went down with Prisca and resulting in Chisha nearly killing him for it. Afterward, he claimed that it would be the death of Vincent Vollachia that would trigger the Great Disaster.''"――The death of His Excellency Vincent Vollachia, that will be the signal for the beginning of the commandment."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. After Ubilk left the room, Vincent and Chisha discussed why he kept it secret from Chisha, which Vincent claimed was futile and something that Chisha could not prevent anyway, something that Chisha disagreed with and claimed his intentions to go against, which Vincent refuted. When asked for how long he had known about the Great Disaster and its trigger, Vincent brought out the journal, and he stated that everything he had done was to minimize the damage, including preparing Chisha for the future.''"――After my death, the ruin caused by the Great Disaster must be minimized. This is the purpose of the reform, that of the Nine Divine Generals."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 7.''"――Your purpose, Chisha Gold."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 7. A few days later, having come to realize that he had no way to directly reject Vincent's thoughts, Chisha cornered Ubilk, intent on getting answers out of him. Despite the threats of Ubilk's inevitable death because of Vincent's possible death, Ubilk was undeterred and merely claimed that his role was to prevent the destruction that was to follow the Great Disaster,''"More important than my own destruction, is the fulfillment and realization of the commandment. My purpose, is to ward off the destruction due to follow the Great Disaster."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 8. and if the Great Disaster didn't occur, since he would need to fulfill his commandment, he would become one of the causes to trigger the Great Disaster.''"If the Great Disaster doesn't actually happen, my commandment won’t be fulfilled. For that reason, even if all the factors that’d cause the Great Disaster are destroyed, I’d become said factor."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 8. Though Chisha was tempted to kill him to prevent that, Ubilk merely claimed another [[Stargazer]] would appear in his place. Afterward, he mentioned that four disasters would occur to destroy the world and that the time to stop one of them has come.''"Four major disasters will destroy the world. The opportunity to stop one of them has come. We are terminals of self-purification and self-defense brought about by the stars, and there are infinite substitutes."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 8. As he thought about what to do, he asked how the commandment was conveyed to Ubilk, and when Ubilk said he would have dreams, Chisha claimed to wonder which Vincent it was he saw in his dream, using his Noh to paint over himself and become "Vincent Vollachia".''"――The Vincent Vollachia that dies there, which one is it, I wondeeer?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 8. ===[[Guardians of the Crimson Flame]]=== In an attempt to remove Vincent's little sister from the board and bring the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] to its full power, Chisha made attempts to snuff her life via the [[shinobi]]. At the recommendation of [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], he requested to meet with [[Yae Tenzen]] in hopes that she could carry out the task of infiltrating [[Leip Barielle]]'s staff to observe Priscilla. He received her evaluation of her own skills and tasked her to stand by and closely observe Priscilla once hired and await the possibility of being given new instructions depending on the situation. Eventually, the time came for her to assassinate Priscilla, but she failed in her attempt, having been stopped by her knight, [[Al]], who forced her into becoming his servant. Some time later, in response to Yae's failure, Chisha assigned a suicide squad comprised of ten shinobi, to kill Priscilla. The shinobi squad, led by [[Hamayal Wesmi]], who was to personally carry out the assassination, took advantage of an event held by Priscilla in their effort to kill her. However, the majority of them were killed by Aldebaran and Yae, and Hamayal's mind was broken by Al, who made him into a pawn. Following the second failed assassination attempt, on Al's orders, Hamayal sent his Phantom Wolf through the letter that was to report how the mission had gone. The Phantom Wolf was set on Chisha as soon as he opened said letter, but Cecilus, who was in the room with him, eradicated it in a flash, ending Hamayal's life. Recognizing that Priscilla's guardians had taken care of the incident, Chisha gave up his attempts to assassinate her, having partially expected that it would be infeasible to begin with. ===[[Imperial Civil War#Imperial Coup|Imperial Coup]]=== When the time came to set the board to achieve his aim, after directing most of the Divine Generals to various locations, infantilizing Cecilus after convincing him to go along with his plans and sending him to [[Ginunhive]], placing the [[Muspel|Stone]] in [[Garkla]], and dispatching more shinobi assassins to lure Priscilla Barielle back to Vollachia, he teamed up with Berstetz Fondalfon and instigated a coup to oust the emperor. Defeating and imprisoning Goz, who was defending the emperor, they successfully managed to make Vincent retreat to Buddheim Jungle. In order to make sure that Vincent was taking the threat seriously, Chisha sent imperial soldiers after him while he prepared himself. With Ubilk, Olbart, and [[Kafma Irulux]] as his escorts, he soon set out to visit Yorna in [[Chaosflame]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Chisha's power and proficiency can be described as being that of an average person.''After joining the House of Abellux, Chisha himself had trained in martial arts, for bodyguarding and self-defense purposes, but he was aware that his proficiency was that of an average man. And rather than moving his own body, he was suited to moving crowds.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 4. He had trained himself in martial-arts for self-defense after being taken in by Vincent, and though he has the skill to defeat most average people, his combat capabilities lag far behind that of the other Nine Divine Generals. However, Chisha makes up for this with his intellect, and his rank as the Fourth among the Nine Divine Generals reflects this. Although not as physically dangerous, the majority of his plans have led to victory. ===Techniques=== '''Noh''' (能, ''Nō''): Chisha utilized a "power" that he dubbed "Noh". By stealing the "colors" of a target he wished to become and wearing the "mask" of them that he received as a result, he could take on the exact form of another person,''Chisha explained that his power to change his form was called Noh. He said that its detailed principles were difficult to explain, but by stealing the colors of a target he wanted to become and wearing the “mask” produced, he could take on their very identity itself.'' Re:Deceiving Life In Another World from Zero, Section 8. allowing him to reproduce eighty percent of their abilities.''“As briefly mentioned in Cecilus’s sections, Noh is a copying ability able to reproduce around eighty percent of the abilities of another who has been traced as a ‘mask’.”'' Azamuku Route Supplement, Chisha Gold. When putting on a mask, his body underwent a grotesque transformation to match that of the individual whose mask he wore.''His bones creaked loudly, as his constitution, the thickness of his flesh, and the structure of his body all began to change. While seeing this grotesque Noh transformation of sorts before his eyes, Subaru/Schwartz had the transformation sequence of a hero of justice in his head.'' Re:Deceiving Life In Another World from Zero, Section 10. However, he could not wear and remove someone's mask repeatedly, and after he had torn off a mask a single time, it was used up and reduced to dust,''The “mask” of Vincent he had torn off and the “mask” of Ferris that had cracked, both had vanished in the end by turning into dust. He had a sense that it had been something that should be called a disappearance or loss, that it was not the type of ability where it could be used over and over again; somehow he had possessed that intuition.'' Re:Deceiving Life In Another World from Zero, Section 8. and he was required to steal their colors again before being able to reacquire their mask. Furthermore, his thorough replication of the original person was not determined by simply wearing their mask alone, as in situations where he was forced to wear the mask of Vincent to act as his body double, Chisha had to devote his utmost efforts to avoid being perceived by someone such as Groovy, whose sense of smell could expose him,''“Even when I am substituting for His Excellency, if I do not devote one hundred percent, he will see through me.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Sword Identity Part 3|Sword Identity]], Section 17.''From the perspective of Chisha, who during times of emergency worked as Vincent’s body double, Groovy’s sense of smell was the ultimate indicator of whether he had been successful in the substitution.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Sword Identity Part 3|Sword Identity]], Section 17. unless he successfully obscured his heart from being smelled.''The guy was a detached man who kept his emotions closed off from the eyes of others, but he had ultimately hid away even the inner workings of his heart from the smell.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 5, Section 4. Having acquired this ability during the Imperial Selection Ceremony after being brought to the verge of death by Arakiya and losing his color, Chisha was required to maintain constant awareness to dye himself in another's colors.''After being on the verge of death, and after losing his color, Chisha had awakened to a strange “Noh”. In order to handle this "Noh" of painting himself in the color of others, he had to keep constant awareness. A measure necessary, as to imply to himself that he was able to dye himself in any color.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 4, Section 5. However, in one case, when he was in front of a mirror while taking on someone else's form, his true appearance could be briefly reflected in the mirror,''However, rather than this cruel reality, Subaru’s awareness was seized by the strange phenomenon before his eyes―― the profound mystery within the full-length mirror placed beside the handsome man looking down on him. Upon the mirror, the reflected image of the dark-haired handsome man was different. ――Reflected there was a man, taller than the handsome man with black hair, possessing white hair, white clothes, and a pale face.'' Re:Deceiving Life In Another World from Zero, Section 3. before quickly returning to match the appearance of the person whose mask he was wearing.''Then, the figure of the man in white who had just been visible within the mirror a moment prior was nowhere to be seen, and all that remained was the form of the handsome man who stared at him with a dreadfully overbearing attitude.'' Re:Deceiving Life In Another World from Zero, Section 3. Prior to instigating the civil war, he used this ability to take Olbart's colors,''“Well, Chesshy, you’ve taken my colors, haven’t’cha?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 5, Section 4. and donned the mask of him to reproduce the Infantilization technique to shrink Cecilus,''“――About Cecilus Segmunt, I have replicated a technique of Olbart Dunkelkenn's to shrink him, then he was sent to the Gladiator Island.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 5, Section 5. before going on to don Vincent's mask until the end of his life. He kept the true nature of his ability a secret to everyone, including Vincent, as a contingency.''In any case, the particulars of this "Noh" had been kept from Vincent as well. He would not disclose it to anyone, naturally. Let alone to the loose-lipped Cecilus, or to others with whom he had little connection. It was always a good idea to have an ace up one’s sleeve, a trump card, or a secret move or two ready to go.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 4, Section 5. To this end, he had also stolen the colors of other people he had met in his life such as [[Ferris]] and Priscilla, preserving their masks in case there ever came a time where he needed them. *'''Infantilization''' (幼児化, ''Yōji-ka''): By taking Olbart's "colors", Chisha was able to reproduce his Infantilization technique. By forcing a contract onto the target and altering their Od, he can rejuvenate the target’s body and physically make them younger, even altering their mind to revert to their youthful personality to match their body. This was originally a technique made to render the target powerless against the user. Likewise, unlike Olbart's usage of the technique, he was able to seal the memories of his targets. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Chisha possessed considerable intellect and was capable of rapid critical thinking and planning. He had ascended to the rank of Fourth purely due to his calculative skills and outstandingly brilliant tactics. With him at his side, Vincent easily won conflicts and swiftly dispatched any and all dangers facing him. Furthermore, Chisha's keen intellect allowed him to impersonate Vincent to perfection and predicting his next moves, all the while fooling everyone in Vollachia with his "ability". According to the author, Chisha was the smartest character in the series.April 5, 2026 Talk Show. ===Equipment=== *'''White Fan''': Chisha wielded a fan in combat and was somewhat skilled with it. ==Trivia== *Before Chesha Trim was revealed to be his old name, Chisha was first called the name "Chesha" by Cecilus in [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy ZERO Arakiya]]. *Chisha has his own named chapter in Arc 7, in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 7: The Land of Wolves|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33|light novels]]. *In the Azamuku IF, when Chisha attempted to wear the mask of Natsuki Subaru, it instantly rejected him and broke into pieces. As a result, the Taboo of Subaru's [[Natsuki Subaru#Abilities|Return by Death]] was activated, bringing an incomplete manifestation of [[Satella]] to their location. *Per the April 6, 2025 talk show, if Chisha had lived on Earth, he would be a secretary. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Advisors]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33|Volume 33]] (main story)}} '''Balleroy Temeglyph''' (バルロイ・テメグリフ) was the former '''Ninth ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He played an antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]], [[Arc 7]], and [[Arc 8]], as well as a small supporting role toward the end of the latter arc. Having grown up in the Dracroy Domain alongside [[Flop O'Connell]], [[Medium O'Connell]], and [[Carillon]], Balleroy was one of the most experienced of all of the Flying Dragon Riders, having been so powerful that he was eventually recognized by the [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]] and promoted to the Ninth of the Nine Divine Generals. However, due to the death of [[Miles]] by the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]]'s [[Reinhard van Astrea]], he decided to accept the role of coup co-conspirator in an effort to get some payback on the Sword Saint, and though he died in the end, his efforts allowed for Vollachia to sign a non-aggression pact with the Kingdom. During the [[Great Disaster]], both he and Carillon appear as [[Undead#Zombies|zombies]] working alongside [[Sphinx]]. Though initially among the enemies in the arc, after his defeat and speaking with both Medium and Vincent, Balleroy used his final moments to save the Empire from destruction, riding with Carillon far into the clouds while carrying the overloaded core of [[Moguro Hagane]], where they were caught and destroyed by the ensuing explosion. ==Appearance== Balleroy was a tall man with ashen brown hair and blue eyes. He had a pale complexion and droopy eyes. He wore a green shirt under copper-plated armor, and brown gloves on his hands. He also wore black pants with four small bags around his hips and brown boots. As a zombie, he possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across his body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. ==Personality== Balleroy was a calm, talkative and cheerful man, who took pride in his title as the Ninth Divine General. Despite his apparent nature, however, Balleroy was cold and ruthless in battle. In his own words, whether they were men, women, children, or the elderly, if he was tasked with killing them, he would have no problem with doing so, though before he died, he expressed a sense of gratitude at never having actually killed any women or children. Following the death of Miles, Balleroy swore to take revenge on Reinhard van Astrea no matter what it would take. Sadly for him, however, he never had the chance to face off against the Sword Saint, as he was defeated and killed in a duel between him and [[Julius Juukulius]], roughly four to five months before the start of the main story. ==History== Balleroy was adopted by Miles as a child and grew up at House Dracroy. He had a deep attachment to Miles and thought of him as a sworn brother. When he was around 12 or 13 years old, he got his hands on a dragon egg and decided to incubate it. During this process, he came across two kids like him, Flop O'Connell and Medium O'Connell, and became friends with them. Together, Balleroy, Miles, and Flop thought up a name for the [[Dragon#Flying Dragons|flying dragon]], Carillon, when it hatched. When Carillon's fangs were replaced by new ones, Balleroy gave one fang each to Flop and Medium as souvenirs. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Around seven years before the main story, Serena sent the Miles and Balleroy, now Imperial Soldiers of the [[Imperial Army]], to the Pendleton Estate in order to invite [[Jorah Pendleton]] and his wife [[Priscilla Barielle]] to the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. While they were there, the gladiators attempted to spark a [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|revolution]] that would render the island independent from the mainland, which later ended up failing thanks to Priscilla's actions and the intervention of the Imperial Army. [[Serena Dracroy]], Priscilla, Jorah, Balleroy, and Miles then went back to the Pendleton mansion after this incident. Later, after Jorah was killed and Priscilla escaped execution, Balleroy and Miles were sent to find Priscilla, and after they found her, the three helped smuggle Priscilla into the Kingdom of Lugunica. At an unknown point in time after this, Balleroy became the Ninth of the Nine Divine Generals. ===Meeting Madelyn=== At some point, Balleroy decided to fly to the peak of Mount Palzoa with Carillon, where he met a [[Madelyn Eschart|young girl]] and the Cloud Dragon [[Mezoreia]]. Though initially shocked to see her, he decided to continue visiting her, gifting her with clothes, teaching her how to speak, and giving her the name Madelyn after an [[Minor Characters#Madelyn|acquaintance]] of his. In time, the two became close, and Balleroy sought to bring Madelyn outside of the cave. This resulted in a fight with Mezoreia, though they made peace in the end, and Balleroy stopped trying to take her away from the mountain, and his visits became less frequent. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly 4 to 5 months before the start of the main story, Reinhard van Astrea, Julius Juukulius, and [[Ferris]] escorted two members of the Council of Wise Men on a diplomatic mission to the Empire in order to sign a non-aggression pact between the Kingdom and the Empire. After an unfortunate turn of events, Reinhard found himself standing in front of Balleroy's corpse and was subsequently labeled as guilty for the man's murder, leaving him no other choice but to escape, taking the emperor as a "hostage". After battling with three of the other Nine Divine Generals, Vincent, Julius, Ferris, and Reinhard came to the conclusion that Balleroy was not actually dead but rather faked his own death in order to divert the attention of the three Royal Guards. He attempted to use the situation to seize revenge on Reinhard for killing his sworn brother, Miles, who had died a few months earlier during a mission in Lugunica. Before long, Balleroy entered a deadly duel with Julius after the death of his beloved dragon, Carillon, which concluded with his death when he was pierced on the left side of his chest. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Despite having held the lowest rank among the Nine Divine Generals, Balleroy was one who even members of the Kingdom's government felt the need to be particularly wary of. His strength was such that he could kill his enemies long before they noticed him, and regardless of obstacles, his attacks effectively could not be prevented without extreme preparation. ===Techniques=== '''Flying Dragon Rider''': Balleroy was an expert flying dragon rider and the best in Vollachia. He used his talent for dragon riding in conjunction with his magic for mobility. His dragon was named Carillon. Balleroy learned how to tame and fly flying dragons from Miles.''"All of it to repay the one who taught him how to live, who had helped him forge his connection with his dragon."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 17.''"It ensured he would have his revenge and that his sworn brother could rest in peace."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 17. ===[[Magic]]=== Although it is unclear what attribute Balleroy had an affinity for, he could use wind and yang magic, and he was one of only a bare few within the Empire capable of even using magic. Even one of the Kingdom's strongest combatants, [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], after having confronted him in combat, felt as though he would very likely lose if they had fought one on one. What's more, due to his abilities as a Flying Dragon Rider, he has command over the skies, meaning that nobody can hide from him. '''Spells''': *'''Magic Bullets''' (魔弾, ''madan''): Balleroy is capable of firing relatively large and colorless bursts of yang magic, using his spear to aim them. Each bullet could move extremely fast since they lack weight, and they have enough destructive power to easily destroy trees, walls, and other structures.''In the past, there had been instances where people had tried to avoid Balleroy’s Magical Bullets by escaping to a forest, dense with trees, or by hiding away in a sturdy fortress. When those had happened, Balleroy had cleared the trees with a rapid hail of Magical Bullets to secure a line of sight, and in the second case, he had identified where the opponent was hiding, and then shot a Magical Bullet through the wall to kill the enemy.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 9. Likewise, since the bullets are magical in nature, they leave no physical trace behind, they can easily burn straight through an enemy and kill them in one shot,''By ensuring that physical bullets would not remain in the wound, it would be difficult for an opponent to discern the true nature of the attack, and furthermore, the area around the wound would be scorched by the light, easily causing a serious wound to be sustained.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 6. and there is no recoil.''Balleroy’s Magical Bullets had no recoil. Therefore, there was no impediment to shooting in rapid succession.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 7. He is not necessarily limited in firing single shots either;''With that, he consecutively fired from the fourth shot to the eighth shot in a single breath.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 7. by his own claim, if he so chose, he could easily wipe out a forest in front of him by firing repetitive shots of magic bullets, allowing him to strike hiding enemies. The bullets themselves also cost very little mana, which further improves the number of times he can fire his shots.''A single one of these shots consumed very little mana, and since it maximized the effect with a minimal number of required processes, it had a good affinity with his nature. ――To settle things reliably, it was the embodiment of that approach.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 7. Despite the simple nature of his magic, his proficiency with and perfection of the magic bullets left even a master of magic, Roswaal, impressed.''Roswaal praised it as an attack undoubtedly worthy of being called Magical Bullets.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 6. *'''Wind Shrouding''': Balleroy was able to shroud himself and his partner in wind, allowing him to increase their speed and reduce impacts levied onto them.''By shrouding wind around the flying dragon he steered, he actualized a maneuver that other flying dragon riders could not, increasing its speed and softening the impacts it took, making himself unable to ever be caught.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 108, Section 2. *'''Scope''': By focusing yang magic directly in front of his eye, Balleroy is able to see far off enemies and snipe them from far away.''Using magic to bend light, Balleroy created a scope of light in order to see far into the distance. Looking through it with his left eye, he imposingly aimed his spearhead in that direction.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 2. '''Combined Spells''': *'''Camouflage Magic''': By using magic to bend light around him and using the wind to diffuse his aura, Balleroy is capable of becoming invisible.''“I can use light magic to bend light around me and wind magic to diffuse my aura.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 17. While invisible, however, he is unable to hear his surroundings.''"If there was any downside, it was that Balleroy himself couldn't hear anything"'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 17. According to the [[Al|Aldebaran]] taking over [[Volcanica]]'s husk, performing this magic while moving is difficult. However, Balleroy seems to be able to circumvent this issue by riding on Carillon, allowing it to move while he focused on his magic. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Incredible Marksmanship''': Balleroy is an accomplished sniper whose precision has been considered so dangerous that he was considered one of the Empire's greatest threats. He was capable of shooting his magic bullets with extreme precision and immense speed, dispatching enemies with ease and deadly proficiency, even from a super long distance away,''Securing the sniping angle and distance from his flying dragon’s speed, he specialized in the one trick of firing bullets of light to achieve ultra-long-range sniping, and in combination with a scope of light that prevented him from losing sight of his target, Balleroy would fight.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 2. and given a clear line of sight, he could snipe someone from kilometers away.''Supposing it was an open plain with no obstacles, Balleroy’s light orbs could hit a moving target from several kilometers away.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 2. He even learned how to ricochet shots off of falling debris, as seen during the Great Disaster.''The bullet that had been fired flew straight in a direction that was off the mark from the enemy. However, in the line of fire of the bullet of light was some falling debris from the chunks of ice, and the light bullet slid diagonally across the surface of the ice. With that momentum, the light bullet bounced around the surrounding debris, bouncing around, bouncing around―― then, it pierced the back of the enemy who had unleashed the rainbow upon him. Having been born, having died, he had succeeded in the ricocheting of light for the first time.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 11. Combined with his reputation as one of the best flying dragon riders, which he often utilized to give him the freedom of movement to pursue his enemy while sniping at them and their potential hiding spots simultaneously,''Those were the fundamentals of sniping, and ought to have been an ironclad rule. Yet, this sniper was defying all that, accurately pursuing the fleeing pair, and was even anticipating their moves to find cover, and firing accordingly. It was as if they were surrounded by a hundred snipers, or being targeted by a single sniper with the complete freedom to move around at rapid speeds.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 36, Section 2. Balleroy became feared through the lands under the alias of Magic Bullet Sharpshooter. According to Roswaal, in ordinary circumstances, he is not sure he would come out victorious against him,''“――As expected, I caaan’t~ win this on my own.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 6.''If one were to think about it, they would likely come to this conclusion; were it possible to do battle from a distant location and one-sidedly attack the opponent, it would be impossible to lose. That was naturally Roswaal’s fighting style, and fighting from the greatest range that was possible for himself could be said to be the fundamental tactic for certain victory as a magician. The problem was that even with his greatest attack range, it would still be a situation in which his opponent would have the upper hand.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 6. and in one failed loop, Balleroy was even capable of predicting the movements of an infantilized [[Cecilus Segmunt]] and sniping off his legs.''But, Al was not the one who was directly affected by the impact. Having leaped into the sky alongside Al, it was Cecilus―― Struck by the sniper fire, the impact had blown off one of his legs.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 36, Section 2. '''Spearmanship''': Although understated compared to his marksmanship, Balleroy is an accomplished spearman, able to swiftly handle experienced gladiators with a mere few attacks of his spear and fists combined. He later fought evenly against Julius Juukulius with his spear. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Strategist''': Despite his carefree attitude, Balleroy is strategical in regard to how he typically fights. According to Flop, if he were to serve in the vanguard, he would move in before anyone else to take out key strategical points,''“Supposing Balleroy were to come here, he would’ve come here at the outset before anybody else, shooting out the vital points of this city. The Magic Bullet Sharpshooter, Balleroy Temeglyph, didn’t serve as the vanguard. That’s my basis for thinking that Balleroy isn’t coming to this battlefield.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 1. and part of the reason he does this is to prevent reckless casualties from his own soldiers' side.''But, he did not want his own people to die. That was why, Balleroy’s sniping desired the fastest conclusion. Without regard to enemies or allies, he was confident that this was the best method of preventing casualties among his people.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 2. Even when not on the vanguard and defending a strategical location, he is smart enough to keep himself hidden and watch over a relatively wide area to prevent dangerous people from advancing while simultaneously keeping his own location hidden. Likewise, he is also capable of quickly striking at the leader of the enemy, and because of this, the Kingdom considered that, alongside [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], Balleroy was one of the most feared war assets the Empire had.''The best way to end a war would be to end the lives of the enemy’s leaders. ――And for that, what was feared more than the First and the Second, was the Vicious Old Man and the Magic Bullet Sharpshooter.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 6. ===Equipment=== *'''Spear''': Balleroy wielded a long spear from the tip of which he used to fire his magic bullets.''The tip of the spear within Balleroy’s hand contained a faint light as he pointed it towards the sky, and in that instant, the fired bullet of light collided with the descending blaze, and as an explosion occurred midair, the sky was dyed red.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 2. ==Trivia== *As of Ex Volume 4's release in December 2019, Balleroy's design was the author's favorite for a character from Vollachia, as he found him to be the most dashing and sexy guy.''"Unfortunately, this left my illustrator, Otsuka, with a crazy number of character designs to come up with all at once. But doesn’t the Vollachian cohort look great? Incidentally, your author's favorite is Balleroy! Isn't he just the most dashing, sexy guy?"'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Afterword. It is unknown if his opinion has changed over time. *Balleroy's birthday was decided at a talk show held on April 5, 2026. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30|Volume 30]] (main story) |Manga = |Anime = [[Episode 72]] (mentioned) |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Cecilus Segmunt''' (セシルス・セグムント) is the '''First ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He acts as [[Vincent Vollachia]]'s sword and is hailed as the indisputably strongest individual from the Empire as well as one of the strongest individuals in the modern world alongside the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]]'s [[Reinhard van Astrea]], the [[Kararagi|City-States]]' [[Halibel]], and the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom]]'s [[Vague Adgard]]. He played pivotal roles in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]], and he played supporting roles in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. Born to the former [[Stargazer]] [[Rowan Segmunt]], he was raised for the sword, showing himself as a powerful prodigy of the blade. Though a Stargazer himself,''――Cecilus Segmunt was a Stargazer.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 1. he aims for the Heavenly Sword on his own merit,''――The desire towards the Heavenly Sword harbored by Rowan, was something that Cecilus also harbored himself.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 64, Section 1. acting as a performer on a stage for his audience, the Observers who he cannot hear. ==Appearance== Cecilus is a youthful man of the same age as Reinhard, who usually stands out as an oddity to those who see him. His blue eyes, which give off a rather playful and relaxed aura, coupled with his long dark-blue hair which he has tied messily into a ponytail, make Cecilus give off a rather mysterious aura. To further exemplify his messy personality, various strands of long hair can be seen covering the right side of his face, although not to the extent that his right eye is obscured in any way. Completely opposite to his true nature, Cecilus' facial features are soft enough that, when coupled with his slender frame, he could be mistakenly identified as a woman if one were to quickly glance at him. On the left side of his face, just below his mouth, Cecilus has a noticeable mole. Despite the many hundreds of lives he has taken throughout the years, his face isn't burdened by a sense of guilt and his smile is usually described as surprisingly friendly, warm, and welcome. File:Re Zero Ex Volume 4 7.png|Cecilus dressed in his usual kimono. File:little Cecilus.png|Cecilus regressed as a ten-year-old child. File:Young Cecilus Segmunt.png|A teenage Cecilus during the Imperial Selection Ceremony. Although he is the greatest warrior in Vollachia, the Blue Lightning wears clothing commonly found in the western Kararagi City-States. During one of his rare visits to Kararagi, Cecilus fell in love with the clothing and had some custom-made for him to wear on daily basis. His outfit consists of a subdued peach-pink kimono with a purple mist-like pattern along its bottom, a bright blue haori that rests over his kimono with a pair of white diamond-shaped patterns on its breasts, and a pair of hand-made wooden [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zōri zori] sandals on his feet that he takes off during more serious battles. A white sash can also be seen tied around his waist that keeps his blades attached to his side. He wore the same clothing as a teenager and while under the effects of the [[Olbart Dunkelkenn#Techniques|infantilization technique]]. As Cecilus has more than two blades, the katanas dangling from his waist often change. The coupling of his youthful appearance and odd dress-sense could at first glance portray an image of a boy playing dress-up, entirely disregarding his cruel and often-times brutal personality. ==Personality== Although considered a rather charming and easy-going person, as the strongest member of the Nine Divine Generals, Cecilus is incredibly prideful of his position to the point he believes that he should be the center of the universe and therefore receive attention and praise, which in turn often results in him looking down on other people and treating them as inferior, though he is not unwilling to accept the strengths that other people have. He often speaks in an overly dramatic flair, acting as if he is in the center of the world's stage and that he is being watched by an audience, the Observers or other people, and he often uses theater terms when speaking about everyday life, such as foreshadowing, hero, heroine, climax, main character, performer, leading actor, development, or other such words. He often speaks quite nonsensically, sometimes going off on long tangents that have basically nothing to do with what someone has asked from him, a trait he seems to share with his father, and he is also prone to acting with a certain level of maliciousness when he wishes to ascertain things, such as when he kicked [[Al|Aldebaran]] off of a roof for apparently no reason while claiming that he could have been an [[undead]]. He's shown to be extremely childish as well, overreacting to small and insignificant things which regularly irritates the people around him. Despite his eccentricity, he is actually quite friendly with the people around him, he believes that the world is filled with blessings,''Unlike Rowan, Cecilus did not view all things in the world as trifle. So long as one could properly distinguish between the cheers and the other interference, the world was filled with blessings as far as the eye could see. The light of the sun, the cool breeze, the trickle of raindrops, the fragrance of grass, and Rowan Segmunt―― all were blessings that had been granted to Cecilus.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 64, Section 6. and he is absolutely loyal to the emperor, referring to himself as his sword, and is nigh impossible to bribe. Although he rarely takes his opponents seriously, he is shown to be overly passionate about fighting, as he was elated seeing how skilled [[Julius Juukulius]] was when he attacked him. Following his initial loss against the Sword Saint Reinhard van Astrea, Cecilus went to great lengths in order to illegally trespass the closed borders with the Empire and fulfill his desire to fight the famed Sword Saint once more in order to finally defeat him and prove his superiority. Though, despite his arrogance and childishness, following his duel with Reinhard, he admitted that Reinhard was an incredibly tough opponent and rather than sulking in his failure, he decided to strive and do his best to surpass the Sword Saint. He is also implied to be somewhat of a flirt as he told the thugs that attacked him that he would be far happier to give them his signature if they were women. He has shown this side of himself while speaking to [[Emilia]], and he has even claimed to want to show off in such a situation. Though, if he learns that such a person is the object of affection for someone else or that someone else sees them in such a way, though he will remain friendly with such a person, he will back down with his advances. He is also shown to be generous, shown when he gave the owner of a restaurant too many holy coins and he mentioned that she deserved it. He also claims to be the same kind of person as [[Natsuki Subaru]] in that he is a promise breaker,''It was a promise formed with mutual respect for one another, but Cecilus knew. [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 6. and despite the number of lives he has claimed, he does not want to see people who are not his enemies die in great numbers, as he claims that the world would get lonely.''"A whole lotta people would die. It may be fine if they were just enemies, but I don’t really find it desirable for people who aren’t enemies to die in great numbers. The world will get lonely, after all."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 43, Section 2. His sole goal is to achieve the Heavenly Sword, a title that is made for the strongest swordsman existing. Contrary to common belief, if it means achieving the Heavenly Sword, he would easily go against the word of Vincent. ==History== Well over ten years ago, Vincent came into contact with young Cecilus and took him under his wing as he recognized his insane prowess with the blade. From there on out, Cecilus acted as Vincent's sworn sword. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Roughly 7 years before the start of the main story, Vincent and the rest of [[Drizen Vollachia]]'s children entered the Imperial Selection Ceremony, in which they slaughtered each other with the sole goal of surviving and claiming the title of the seventy-seventh Vollachian emperor. During those dangerous times, Vincent often employed Cecilus on different missions, most often on assassinations. One event in particular catapulted Cecilus' name amidst the ranks of the most feared and renowned swordsmen alive; [[Lamia Godwin]] and [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]] orchestrated the [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]]. Lamia commanded her army known as the Pruning Corpse to siege the manor's entrance. As a countermeasure, Vincent employed a single swordsman: Cecilus Segmunt. He single-handedly slaughtered the entire army which numbered in hundreds. The word of a one-sided slaughter soon spread throughout the Empire and soon reached the ears of the neighboring countries and kingdoms as well, forever engraving the Blue Lightning's name in history. ===Years during Vincent's rule=== A couple of years before the main story, Cecilus was tasked with escorting a convoy in Vollachia and act as a bodyguard of an important person; the very same person [[Elsa Granhiert]] was sent to assassinate. Cecilus and Elsa proceeded to fight; Cecilus easily came out victorious but slipped up and gave Elsa an opportunity to kill the VIP, which she did. At another point, he engaged in a battle with [[Arakiya]] that resulted in the destruction of a portion of the Imperial Capital, and that area was repurposed into a reservoir by Chisha. Likewise, he was also forced to confront and nearly kill his father, Rowan Segmunt, when he plotted to attack the emperor, and he dumped him somewhere where he had a chance to survive. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Shortly after the death of the Lugunican [[Royal Family]] (roughly 4–5 months before the start of the main story), Reinhard van Astrea, Julius Juukulius, and [[Ferris]] accompanied [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]], two members of the Council of Wise Men, on a diplomatic mission to Vollachia in order to negotiate a pact of non-aggression between the Kingdom and the Empire. After an unprecedented turn of events which lead to the three Royal Guards and Vincent escaping to a nearby forest, Cecilus was dispatched and ordered to retrieve the emperor and kill the "murderers". After locating the trio of Julius, Ferris, and Vincent, Cecilus began his faceoff with the Spirit Knight. Seconds before finishing the fight by beheading the knight, [[Groovy Gumlet]] and [[Moguro Hagane]] arrived at the scene after retreating from the Sword Saint. Pursuing them, Reinhard came to the rescue and took the Blue Lightning's attention, swiftly defeating him with a single kick to his neck afterwards, rendering Cecilus unconscious. Upon waking up later, he resolved himself to eventually seize victory in a battle against Reinhard. Roughly a month after the signing of the non-aggression pact, Cecilus was sent on a secret mission to assassinate or bring back the perpetrator who wanted to seize the Vollachian throne, [[Gramdart Holstoy]]. On his unannounced trip to the Kingdom, Cecilus encountered Julius and Ferris. After exchanging words over a nice cup of tea, Cecilus requested their help as he wanted an opportunity to fight the Sword Saint for real. After initially refusing to give him help, Julius and Ferris finally gave in as if they'd continue refusing, they'd lose their heads and risk further unnecessary bloodshed. They told the Blue Lightning about Reinhard's whereabouts and upon realizing there's no way to fight him, Cecilus decided to stay in the [[Royal Capital]] and eagerly await the red-haired knight's return. He spent the next couple of days in the Juukulius Household where he spent his time talking with [[Joshua Juukulius]] and sharpening his sword skills. Not long after, Cecilus ran away in search of the Vollachian traitor; it took him no more than a couple of hours to locate him, slaughter his guards and behead him–or so he would have done if [[Chisha Gold]], the Divine General sent to help Cecilus retrieve Gramdart, wouldn't interrupt him. After their successful mission, they were preparing to return back to the Empire when news came of the Sword Saint's return and Cecilus was finally given an opportunity to face off against the most powerful opponent in the world. Reinhard van Astrea with his [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]] unsheathed and Cecilus Segmunt with his beloved blades fought; both survived the battle, which resulted in a draw, confirmed by Cecilus himself. ===[[Sword Identity Part 1|Sword Identity]]=== About two months before the events of [[Arc 1]], Cecilus and Arakiya were sent to quell the rebellion raised by [[Yorna Mishigure]] in response to the death of [[Zoey]]. Though Cecilus himself confronted Yorna, he was unable to kill her or deal any lasting damage to her due to her Soul Marriage Technique. In the end, the rebellion came to an end when the soldiers responsible for Zoey's death were caught and killed, and Cecilus's party retreated from [[Chaosflame]]. ===[[Imperial Civil War#Imperial Coup|Imperial Coup]]=== A short time before the events of Arc 7, Cecilus and Chisha talk in the latter’s office. During their conversation, Chisha asked of what Cecilus would do if Vincent and Chisha were at odds, to which Cecilus states that he would take Vincent's side. Because of their friendship, however, he was willing to at least let Chisha try to convince him otherwise. With Chisha trusting him to take care of Vincent after his plans were complete, Cecilus allowed Chisha to infantilize him, and he was sent to the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]] with the memories of a child. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 1|Undead Busters]]=== Following the Great Disaster, Subaru and Vincent entrusted [[Spica]]’s protection to Cecilus and Arakiya while she was hunting down the remaining undead in Vollachia. Unfortunately, when they went to retrieve Arakiya, she immediately attacked Cecilus, leading to a battle between the two. Though he warned Spica to stay back, having every intention of respecting Subaru’s and Vincent’s wishes, Spica was the one who put an end to the fight, using Leaper to incapacitate Arakiya and impressing Cecilus. Afterward, they reported back to Vincent. After a turbulent conversation caused by Cecilus's rambling and Arakiya's aggression, the group finally set off on their mission, with Spica being in charge of keeping Arakiya in check. After setting forth, they encountered several undead, including [[Minor Characters#Harlein|Harlein]], who the three dispatched with ease. After sitting down for food, they soon encountered the undead [[Volcas]], who clashed with and was defeated by Cecilus. However, because he did not want to let Spica eat his name just yet, this led to an argument between him and Arakiya, while Spica attended to Volcas. Afterward, they returned to [[Garkla]] with Volcas, intent on letting Volcas speak with Vincent. Shortly after their arrival, however, Yorna took Volcas away, and the two engaged in combat, everyone else standing to bear witness. Eventually, the battle stopped, and Volcas mentioned that he recognized Yorna as Iris. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Cecilus is one of the most powerful people in the world and one of the only people considered claimed to have a similar level of martial prowess compared to Reinhard. His strength is feared due to having once massacred Lamia Godwin’s Pruning Corps by himself, and it has even been stated that he could kill all of the Imperial Army if he so chose. {{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Relationships |tab3 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Berstetz Fondalfon |Image = Berstetz Fondalfon LN character design.png |Kanji = ベルステツ・フォンダルフォン |Romaji = Berusutetsu Fondarufon |Alias = His Excellency (閣下, ''Kakka'') |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Age = Around 70 |Hair Color = Grey |Eye Color = Grey |Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]] |Previous Affiliation = House Godwin |Occupation = Imperial Prime Minister
Count |Previous Occupation = Strategist |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|Ex Volume 4]] (side story)
[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30|Volume 30]] (main story)}} '''Berstetz Fondalfon''' (ベルステツ・フォンダルフォン) is the Prime Minister of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], and the second-in-command after the [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]] in terms of political power. Though playing minor roles in both [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]], he was one of the main antagonists of [[Arc 7]] as one of the masterminds behind the [[Imperial Civil War]], and he played a supporting role in [[Arc 8]]. He was originally the aide of Princess [[Lamia Godwin]], helping her in both advisory matters and planting her poison. After her death by the hands of [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]] and the latter’s faked death, once Vincent Abellux took the throne, he appointed Berstetz as the Prime Minister, having been impressed by his intelligence. ==Appearance== Berstetz is a very old man of short stature. He has relatively long grey hair that is tied back with an aged and wrinkled face. Underneath his slightly crooked nose, he sports a bushy mustache. Befitting of his position as the Prime Minister, Berstetz can be seen wearing a dark pink long-sleeved robe in addition to a purple and uniform with the Empire's symbol, the Sword Wolf, near its base. ==Personality== Berstetz is a very wise and shrewd old man who is easily able to outsmart people. He is loyal to the Empire, and though he was never able to due to his meager strength, he always wanted to be one of the Empire's Sword Wolves.''He had not been blessed with martial prowess, he always yearned to be the Sword Wolf of the Empire, yet he never quite reached it.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 27, Section 1. As such, when Lamia saw worth in him, he felt gratitude.''Not garnering respect from others, he could only live a life of scorn, but the fact that she had deemed him useful was perhaps something worthy of gratitude.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 27, Section 1. When he was loyal to Lamia as her subordinate and strategist, he was willing to assist her in the murders of her siblings in order to put her on the throne. Despite having been heavily loyal to Lamia before her passing, he had no qualms about working for the emperor partially responsible for her death, as he was more than capable of leading the country to prosperity. However, that loyalty is so strong that if he believes that the emperor is not doing his duty as the country's ruler, he is willing to scheme to dethrone said ruler and replace them with someone more fitting who will do their duties as expected of them, even if he knows he might lose his head were he to fail. Despite his advanced age and his rather meager power, he also believes in the way of the Empire, and he is willing to die fighting in order to rid the country of its enemies, even if said threat was his [[Undead#Zombies|undead]] former master. Berstetz seems to have more going for him than what meets the eye as Vincent himself seemed to be aware that something was off with the old man.''“Hmph. And to think, I very nearly had the tiger by the tail.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]]: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed, Section 19. According to [[Ubilk]], the Empire's [[Stargazer]], Berstetz hides “hell itself” within him.''“I’m more afraid of His Excellency the Prime Minister. It seems that within him, he is hiding hell itself.”'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 1. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== During the Imperial Selection Ceremony, Berstetz, having been a Count of unknown rank, acted as a strategist under Lamia Godwin's command, helping her achieve her goal of slaughtering every single one of her half-brothers and half-sisters in order to be crowned as the seventy-seventh emperor of the Vollachia Empire. During the [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]], Berstetz helped to command the army led by Lamia by controlling the artillery on her behalf. After Lamia realized the battle was lost, she ordered him to cover her retreat. Following Lamia's death and Vincent's coronation as the seventy-seventh emperor of the Vollachia Empire, Berstetz started working under him and was eventually appointed as the Prime Minister, granting him political strength second only to the emperor himself. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Six months before the events of [[Arc 1]], two members of the Council of Wise Men, [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]], accompanied by [[Reinhard van Astrea]], [[Julius Juukulius]], and [[Ferris]], chose to go on a diplomatic visit to the Empire in order to sign a non-aggression pact between the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]] and the Empire. While not immediately meeting with the five diplomats, Berstetz acted in the shadows, swiftly getting rid of the traitorous noble who planned the coup d'état during the aforementioned diplomats' visit in the Empire, effectively keeping the rebellion at bay. ===[[Sword Identity Part 1|Sword Identity]]=== Two to three months after this, [[Madelyn Eschart]] was suggested by Berstetz to inherit [[Balleroy Temeglyph]]'s position as the 9th ranking Divine General, despite not having any concrete accomplishments and being largely unknown to the other Divine Generals. After [[Yorna Mishigure|Yorna]]'s rebellion, his suggestion was confirmed, and Madelyn was appointed as the 9th ranking Divine General to the reluctance of the emperor. ===[[Imperial Civil War]]=== Sometime before the events of Arc 7, his frustration with the emperor for not siring a child as his duty as the emperor requires was reaching its peak. Taking advantage of this, [[Chisha Gold]], who was attempting to thwart the [[Great Disaster]] by replacing Vincent as the one who would die, offered Berstetz the proposal to remove Vincent from his throne, hiding his true motives. Accepting the proposal, he and Chisha led a coup that resulted in [[Goz Ralfon]]'s defeat and Vincent retreating to the Buddheim Jungle. Afterward, he and Chisha sent imperial soldiers to the jungle to flush him out. Likewise, they sent [[Arakiya]] to [[Guaral]] as reinforcements. Shortly after the [[Fall of Guaral]], when [[Todd Fang]] returned to [[Lupugana]] with the injured Arakiya, Berstetz officially made Todd Arakiya's subordinate. Afterward, he gave them a directive to go to [[Ginunhive]] and give [[Gustav Morello]] an order from himself as the Prime Minister, rather than an order from the emperor, that the lives all of the prisoners on the island were to be reaped. Otherwise, he was to be killed. Similarly, he ordered Madelyn to [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm|attack]] Guaral with her flying dragons in response to Guaral's fall. With those failures, however, and the rise of a "black-haired crown prince", he and Chisha prepared for an all-out civil war with the Rebel Army. ==Abilities== '''Keen Intellect''': While Berstetz is not a powerful warrior, he is an intelligent man, and he was the one to act as both an advisor and strategist to Lamia during the Imperial Selection Ceremony. Even after the selection, Vincent found his intellect worthy of praise, and he took him on as the Prime Minister. His intellect and foresight are on a similar level to Chisha Gold, and the two were both capable of leading a civil war together without allowing anyone to found out. '''Equipment''': Berstetz wears a [[Meteor|meteor]] ring on his finger that is imbued with the element of fire.''Curled around one of his fingers was a ring. Proof that he was the Prime Minister of the Vollachian Empire. It was a Meteor, imbued with mana of the element of fire.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 27, Section 6. It has enough power to blow out the side of one of a coupled dragon carriage’s walls. ==Trivia== *Berstetz has his own named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8: Vincent Vollachia|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35|light novels]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Advisors]] [[Category:Strat [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]]
