[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 27|Volume 27]] (main story) |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Arakiya''' (アラキア) is the '''Second ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. She played a major antagonistic role in [[Arc 7]], and a major supporting role in [[Arc 8]]. She also played a supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. Originally the aide and foster sister of [[Priscilla Barielle]], she viewed her as her “sun”, which allowed her to maintain her sense of self as a Spirit Eater. Though she assisted her throughout the Imperial Selection, she was forced to help fake her death out of fear of her being killed. Once the newly crowned emperor, [[Vincent Vollachia]], took the throne, he took her on as the Second of the Nine Divine Generals. ==Appearance== Arakiya has red eyes, uneven dog ears, wears only the minimum clothing that allows her to keep her modesty so to help her attract micro-spirits, and has short silver hair with one of her bangs being red, and long, drooping silver ears that are black at their tips. She also wears an ornate eye patch on her left eye, which she cannot see out of, and a sash-like decoration on her right hip. Following her defeat in [[Guaral]]’s city hall, Arakiya was cut down by Priscilla's [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]], leaving a nastily deep and cauterized scar spanning across the entirety of her back. ==Personality== As a spirit eater, Arakiya has a diluted sense of self and ego that is neither particularly strong or weak.''On the other hand, an overly strong ego would greatly hinder one’s affinity with Spirits, making it impossible to achieve the full potential of a Spirit Eater in the first place. Therefore, in order to be in harmony with the power of the Spirit they had taken in, a Spirit Eater would be required to have an almost diluted sense of self and ego. However, as mentioned above, an ego that was too weak would invite an easy assimilation with the captured Spirit, and there was a high chance that they would lose their humanity.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1. She also takes certain measures to maintain her sense of self, as the side effects of her being a spirit eater directly affect her personality. One of those measures, of course, is wearing the clothes that she does, but more importantly, Arakiya needs a sort of emotional anchor: her "pillar",''To prevent that from happening, Spirit Eaters were bestowed with a pillar―― that was to say, a “core”, one which took the place of their weak ego and sense of self and kept them from losing sight of themselves.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1.''Her ego daringly diluted, Arakiya, who had clung only to the existence of the “pillar” that she deemed important to herself, had devoured Spirits, acted as a formidable being, and fulfilled her role.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 1. which in her case was Priscilla, an older sister figure, who she considered her "sun".''One was that the individual Arakiya had deemed as her pillar was like a dazzling sun, shining so brightly that, even when separated, she could not lose sight of them.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 1. Most of Arakiya's personality is defined by her fierce loyalty to her pillar, Priscilla. As imprinting is something deeply instilled in spirit eaters, Arakiya's mind and power are occupied and wielded for Priscilla, and she became the reason for her existence.''The function of imprinting, akin to when a newly-hatched bird would think of the first one it gazed upon as its parent bird, was deeply rooted into the instincts of the Spirit Eaters, forming their foundation, just like a pillar. The tremendous power of a Spirit Eater would be wielded for the sake of that pillar, and the naïve mind of a Spirit Eater would then be occupied by that pillar. Doubtlessly, a Spirit Eater’s precise reason for existence was their pillar. ――Devoid of any ambition for betrayal, a Spirit Eater would continue to selflessly pledge service to their pillar.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1. Her immense loyalty leads her to acting solely for her and obeying her as her right hand, even going as far to neglect herself.''"By gaining an understanding of emotion and attachment, for the first time, I have discerned the methodology regarding their uses. She is commendable, is she not? If it is for your sake, she does not take herself into account. ――Deliberation: Required."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 42, Section 2. She is very protective of Priscilla as well, going as far as to attack [[Cecilus Segmunt|Cecilus]] both on Priscilla's command and out of anger towards him. She was even willing to devour the likes of the [[Muspel|Stone]] in order to fight and protect her, despite knowing that doing so could kill her; she did this on two occasions, the first time to fight for her and the second time in an effort to rescue her. Likewise, this loyalty and protectiveness makes her someone who is easy to use or deceive. Vincent once used this to have her fake Priscilla's death; [[Chisha Gold]] used the girl's wish to have Priscilla sitting on the Vollachian throne to have her assist in the [[Imperial Civil War]] on his side, even if it meant confronting Priscilla and injuring her to make her stay; [[Sphinx]] used her desperation to try and rescue Priscilla to make her devour the rest of the Stone to rescue her, despite it being part of Sphinx's schemes to have her die and end the country as a result.''It was tremendously colossal. Unbelievably heavy. Intolerably twisted. If left unchecked, it would destroy the Empire. If she could not keep it under control, her “pillar”―― Prisca, would not be protected. That was why Arakiya, without being told by anyone, swallowed it down. Into her own incomparably thin and small body, she took the Stone, Muspel. The Empire must not be destroyed by the monster who called herself a Witch, utilizing this Great Spirit.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 1. Outside of that, Arakiya also has a sense of attachment toward those who feel like they lost someone close and even wish for vengeance, something that others have also taken advantage of; [[Todd Fang]] used this as a way for her to protect him until they made it back to the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]]. Likewise, once she trusts someone, she is willing to listen to them, which Todd also used to make her fight smarter and more efficiently, and she would even take such a person as her own subordinate. She is also rather kind and somewhat naive; when she first met [[Al|Aldebaran]] on [[Ginunhive]], after listening to his self-deprecation, she innocently refuted his words. She also has a temper, however. For various reasons, she carries a grudge against both Vincent and Cecilus. In the case of the former, she was willing to kill him when she had the chance for Priscilla to be put on the throne, though she was also willing to listen to him as the emperor before this since he also saved Priscilla from being killed during the Imperial Selection. On the other hand, she is constantly hostile towards Cecilus, leading her to attacking him on various occasions. This being said, it is thanks to Cecilus's behavior that her ego did not fully collapse after she was separated from Priscilla, as his presence stoked her inferiority and stimulated her individuality.''The other reason, and one that Arakiya would never want to admit―― in the days after being separated from her “pillar”, the Thunder that reminded Arakiya of the fact that she was herself shook her soul incessantly, evoking feelings of inferiority and stimulating her individuality.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 1. Following Priscilla's demise, Arakiya was heavily affected, hiding herself away in a depression. Her sadness and rage culminated into yet another battle with Cecilus, and she even rejected people who showed her kindness like [[Spica]]. However, despite this, she did not completely reject Spica's kindness, and it was later noted by [[Medium O'Connell]] that her mood overall improved after traveling with Spica and Cecilus. Despite having taken in the entirety of the Stone, she does not seem to have been affected personality-wise. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== When she was young, numerous sacrifices were made in order to make Arakiya into a spirit eater.''After many sacrifices, so numerous as to make one feel depressed if they were counted, the Spirit Eaters of ancient times had been resurrected in the present day. Even the people of the Empire could not possibly justify this success considering the number of lives that had been paid.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1. However, the organization responsible for doing this were believed to have been taken out in part by [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], and even he believed that what they had done had gone too far. At an unknown point in time after this, she was presented to [[Drizen Vollachia]], and he offered her to his daughter, Prisca, for unknown reasons.''Therefore, the girl who had become the sole instance of completion, as an existence with invaluable abilities, was presented to the emperor of the time, Drizen Vollachia, and Drizen had bestowed her as a foster sister to one of the daughters that had inherited his own blood. It was unknown what impression Emperor Drizen Vollachia had harbored for the girl that had been presented to him, or for what reason he had bestowed her to his own daughter.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1. Thanks to this, Arakiya grew up with Prisca Benedict and was her sworn sword and foster sister before and during the Imperial Selection Ceremony. During the [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]], a fierce battle between Prisca Benedict, [[Lamia Godwin]], and Vincent Abellux, Arakiya fought against Chisha Gold, swiftly defeating and almost killing him. As Lamia tried to exploit the fact Priscilla and Vincent would inevitably duel, she set up a bombardment of the forest Prisca was located in. Arakiya had no other choice but to eat a portion of the Stone, Muspel, to save everyone from certain death, though she almost died in the process. In the months following the battle, Arakiya made a deal with Vincent, which gave her a chance to save Prisca from certain death by Vincent's hand. As Prisca received a bottle of sake mixed with poison, Arakiya drank half of it, which resulted in Prisca's life being saved, however, Arakiya herself lost vision in her left eye. Upon waking up in the Crystal Palace, she was greeted by Cecilus Segmunt and Chisha Gold, who explained her situation and notified her of Vincent's request for her to join his ranks. One day, Vincent heard of a [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|rebellion]] on the Gladiator Island Ginunhive, and he sent 2000 people to exterminate the perpetrator, two of them including Arakiya and Olbart. After arriving at the island, they discussed how to get the drawbridge down, to which Arakiya devoured a lesser water [[spirit]] in order to become water and bypass the [[witchbeast]]s infesting the water. On the way, she followed the scent of blood and discovered Al on an island-like pile of rocks in the lake. After giving him first aid, the two made their way to the island, where Al explained things about an enemy called [[Hornet]] and how somethings on the island worked. After having her burn the body of a poison-infested [[shinobi]] nearby, the two made their way to the control tower, where Hornet lay in wait. After Al mentioned that he could do nothing about Hornet, Arakiya, still invisible after devouring a lesser wind spirit, attempted to sneak by Hornet, but she was easily seen through and quickly cornered. Al, having seen this, stepped forward to defend her and fought Hornet in her place, surprising her with his "miracles" while fighting her. As she attempted to get up, she heard the voice Priscilla speaking to the gladiators, and Arakiya stood to fight against Hornet with Al. Eventually, the two led Hornet to the area with the poison, where Hornet ultimately died. Afterward, the two lowered the drawbridge, allowing the soldiers to reach the island. After a short conversation with Olbart and Al, she thanked Al and left the island with Olbart. When Priscilla and her new husband [[Jorah Pendleton]] were accused of treason against the emperor, [[Goz Ralfon]] was sent to deal with them, and Arakiya joined them. Though Jorah was killed, Arakiya let Priscilla go, and she reported that she committed suicide, eventually becoming the Second of the Nine Divine Generals. At some point, she and Cecilus fought in an area of the Imperial Capital. The aftermath of their battle left the entire area destroyed, leaving it to be later repurposed by Chisha to be a reservoir. ===[[Sword Identity Part 1|Sword Identity]]=== After [[Madelyn Eschart|Madelyn]]'s failure to quell the rebellion of [[Yorna Mishigure]], Arakiya and Cecilus were sent to deal with the matter. During the fight, Arakiya razed a portion of [[Chaosflame]] to the ground, but she was unable to kill and of its residents or even Yorna herself. In the end, when Yorna's demands were met, Arakiya and Cecilus pulled back from Chaosflame, and the rebellion subsided. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 1|Undead Busters]]=== Following the events of the [[Great Disaster]], Arakiya hid herself away in a shack-like building, depressed over losing the source of her light, Priscilla, while she survived. Having been tasked with guarding Spica and using her own power to sense the remaining [[Undead#Zombies|zombies]] left in the country, Cecilus and Spica went to collect her, resulting in yet another fight between her and Cecilus. However, Spica ultimately put a stop to the fight by using Leaper on Arakiya, leaving her unable to keep fighting. Afterward, they reported back to Vincent. After a turbulent conversation caused by Cecilus's rambling and Arakiya's aggression, the group finally set off on their mission, with Spica being in charge of keeping Arakiya in check. After setting forth, they encountered several undead, including [[Minor Characters#Harlein|Harlein]], who the three dispatched with ease. After sitting down for food, they soon encountered the undead [[Volcas]], who clashed with and was defeated by Cecilus. However, because he did not want to let Spica eat his name just yet, this led to an argument between him and Arakiya, while Spica attended to Volcas. Afterward, they returned to [[Garkla]] with Volcas, intent on letting Volcas speak with Vincent. Shortly after their arrival, however, Yorna took Volcas away, and the two engaged in combat, everyone else standing to bear witness. Eventually, the battle stopped, and Volcas mentioned that he recognized Yorna as Iris. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Arakiya is one of the most powerful people in Vollachia, whose strength allows her to contend with the likes of Cecilus. Thanks to her connection to Muspel, she has the power of one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]], making her abilities with magic tremendous. In terms of sheer firepower, Arakiya is the one most capable of causing widespread devastation from among the Nine Divine Generals. ===Techniques=== '''[[Spirit]] Eating''' (精霊喰らい, ''Seirei Kurai''): Arakiya has the power to eat spirits, assimilate her body with them, and use their powers as her own without needing to form a contract with them. Among all the spirit eaters, Arakiya has surpassed all of her predecessors in strength.''――As a Spirit Eater, Arakiya had been perfected as an existence that was more obstreperously powerful than any of her predecessors who had once been called upon to fight against the Witch.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1. Doing so comes with the risk of ceasing to be human and extreme self-harm.''If one took in a Fire Spirit, their body temperature would rise; if one took in a Wind Spirit, there was the danger that the inside of their bodies would be torn apart. If one took in a Water Spirit, it could put the circulation of one’s blood at risk; if one took in an Earth Spirit, it was possible that they would become one with the earth, and the possibility of even losing their human form existed. In fact, because of those side effects, many aspiring Spirit Eaters had ceased to be human.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1. By eating a Water micro-spirit, for example, she's described as almost becoming one with water, allowing her to swim past witchbeasts residing in the waters, undetected. Her power is so strong that it even allowed her to take in one of the Four Great Spirits' power without losing her sanity. Arakiya is able to use other spirits' powers until she completely digests them, and it is unknown what happens to spirits, after she eats them. Furthermore, the firmer one's sense of self is, the better they are with their power. This ability does have a downside, however. If exposed to larger quantities of mana, Arakiya will become confused and eventually sick, as she starts experiencing symptoms of mana poisoning. This trick was used against her at the [[Fall of Guaral]], when Vincent flooded the entire room with mana, confusing her and allowing Al to hold his own against her. Also, if she devours a spirit that is too powerful, such as one of the Four Great Spirits, she risks her body self-destructing, and likewise, even if her body can contain such power without destroying itself, if she cannot acclimate to said power, it will cause her to temporarily lose control of her body and go berserk.''Nevertheless, by taking in something that did not mesh with her own capacity, Arakiya’s own brilliance would instead turn against herself, her surroundings, and the things she wanted to cherish.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 2. Furthermore, during the acclimation process, the immense power threatens to paint over her sense of self with much more fervor than other spirits.''Gradually feeling her existence, the whereabouts of her soul, being painted over, amidst the pain and anguish, Arakiya earnestly tried to recall the radiance of her Sun.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 3.''She was detaining a being that would engulf her, and would fully overtake her presence.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 3. This ability was originally a secret technique wielded by unnamed tribes living on the frontier of the Empire but were wiped out due to the ability's potential. After devouring the entirety of Muspel and fully assimilating with it thanks to the Dream Sword and the Priscilla's Soul Marriage Technique,''"Mine Soul Marriage Technique and the Blue Lightning’s Masayume were factors beyond the realm of your expectation. Nobody can say what would have happened if it were just one or the other, but both had been assembled for Arakiya. ――But then again, if Arakiya had not been able to withstand it until they assembled, your calculations would have come to fruition."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 3. her power has increased severalfold, and now, her life is synonymous with the Stone,''"――The Stone residing within Arakiya was exorcized by Cecilus Segmunt with the Dream Sword. Hence, her life is now synonymous with the Stone."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 3. and in turn, at present, the Empire.''"However, you are still the one cornered. If she… if General First-Class Arakiya were to lose her life, then the Stone, Muspel, would likewise meet its demise. The Vollachian Empire shall not escape destruction."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 3. *'''Shadow Diving''': Although it is unspecified if she achieved this by devouring a yin spirit, Arakiya can mask her presence by diving into the shadows. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== Arakiya’s spirit-eating gives her a plethora of abilities surrounding the elements of mana governed by spirits, including: *'''Fire''': Arakiya can launch intense flames which can destroy ranks of soldiers or half of a city with ease.''In one breath, Arakiya had burned one half of her city, and today, she also burned the rebels to nothing by the ramparts.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 2. She can envelop her limbs as well as her whole body in fire. When doing so, she is often seen flying in midair,''With one of the bastions of the star-fortress behind her, as if to protect it, Arakiya flew through the air, her legs ablaze below the knees.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 2. and when her whole body is fire, she becomes unable to be grabbed until she reverts to her normal state or unless someone has a way to bypass those flames and directly strike her body, such as with the Yang Sword. The flames can also change color, becoming blue, and the flames are also intense enough that they can scorch the ground to naught and even paint the sky red. While under Muspel's influence, she was even capable of producing so much heat around herself that foreign objects will threaten to burst into flame and turn to ash, and both she and the space around her appears distorted.''Surrounding Arakiya as she radiated light, so much heat was being generated that it appeared as if both herself, and even the space around her were being distorted, so there was no way any half-hearted attack could have drawn near her.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 43, Section 2. She has also displayed the ability to enlarge her fist of flame to ten meters, and her strike packs enough punch to make even the [[Moguro Hagane|Giant Magic Crystal Soldier]] stumble.''The moment after Vincent and the others wondered if something had passed over their heads, a mighty fist of flame clad in light―― that, which was ten meters in size, was unleashed, resolutely striking the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 73, Section 4. *'''Wind''': Arakiya can summon powerful gusts of wind that can devastate and uproot the earth with ease and blow her enemies away with force equivalent to be stricken by a giant palm, and even someone of Priscilla's caliber can be threatened to be crushed by it if it her directly.''As Arakiya swung her arm holding the branch, the great wind that was released completely uprooted the floating earth and mowed down all the paths. Rather than a storm, the great wind was powerful enough to be equivalent to being hit by a giant palm, and the force of it was such that even Priscilla could have been completely crushed by it if it hit her directly.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 2. She also has the ability to assimilate into wind, making herself invisible.''“As Al watched, Arakiya’s body began to transform into wind. Meaning she gradually turned invisible.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], [[The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame Part 2.5|The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame]], Section 16. She can also use the wind to lift and hurl hundreds of buildings towards her target if she wishes,''As to not allow the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier to fire off its next move, an undulation of power differing from that of the Yang Sword spread out―― slowly, as if giant unseen fists were being drawn out of the ground, the buildings that made up the cityscape of the Imperial Capital rose out of the ground; ten, twenty, nearing a total of one-hundred, they surrounded the Giant Soldier.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 74, Section 2. as well as to fly.''As Todd muttered that, Arakiya flew overhead, her whole body clad in a swirling wind.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 86, Section 3. *'''Water''': Arakiya can summon jets of water powerful enough to decapitate people or tear through the land with ease,''Letting that out together with a long sigh, Yorna glanced behind――through the pressure of the unleashed water, the land itself had been split vertically all the way until the horizon.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 2.''While the beams of water had each been compressed to be as thick as a single finger, it would be better if the power employed to achieve were not belittled as the strength of a single finger. The densely compressed torrent, piercing through everything standing in its path, felling any potential threats without mercy, was capable of tearing someone limb-from-limb in a single fatal blow.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 2. or summon a massive flash flood.''Similar to Priscilla, flying to the opposing left, was Yorna――In between the two of them, a massive flash flood rushed through.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 2. She can also fill people’s heads with water to make them burst from the inside. Additionally, she can turn her whole body into water to swim at high speeds.''“That was how she had become like a lesser water spirit in order to safely cross the lake. In fact, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that she had become water itself, swimming at a speed that far outstripped any normal person.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], [[The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame Part 2.5|The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame]], Section 16. *'''Yang''': She can turn her body into light to both phase through attacks and counterattack in all directions.''Immediately after Yorna’s astonishment and Priscilla’s irritation spilled over simultaneously, Arakiya’s body, having seemingly taken in both attacks, glowed white, as a counterattack was unleashed. It was as if Arakiya’s whole body exploded――No, it had, in fact, exploded. Arakiya’s body scattered into rays of white light, dispersing with terrifying force spread in every direction like buckshot, hitting Yorna and Priscilla like a fountain of water.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 2. She can also unleash belts of light with enough power to evaporate anything they hit. *'''Earth''': Numerous magic crystals burst out of Arakiya’s body, some in scattered places across her body with other forming wings from her back.''Arakiya’s appearance, it was even more bizarre than it had been just a few moments earlier, with Magic Crystals growing out of the thin girl’s body as if piercing from within. From a distance, the growths on Arakiya’s arms and back resembled the wings of an angel.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 2. The crystals are sharp enough that they can be used like blades and slash through her enemies.''The girl’s slender arms were essentially blades due to the sharpness of the Magic Crystals that densely grew on them, and alas, Cecilus’s slim chest was mercilessly cut open, staining his favorite kimono with blood as he began to fall.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 4. However, this form was the effect of Muspel's great power attempting to devour through and spill out of her body,''However, in reality, Arakiya had absorbed an exceedingly large entity, and it was attempting to devour through and spill out from the body of the girl in which it had been trapped.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 2. so it is unlikely she is able to use this form at will. Regardless, she can fire off countless of these crystals, which Cecilus has compared to diamonds,''Right after he uttered those words, belts of diamond were fired from the feathered robe of the heavenly maiden.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 2. like missiles with intense speed and power,''What was particularly eye-catching about that figure, which could even be called beautiful, were the belts of light gently caressing the sky that floated around the heroine―― Magic Crystals of thin and flat construction. Due to some sort of principle, one of the belts of magical nature was illuminated in turn by the flaming cityscape, swimming through the sky on a silky trajectory that could sway with the wind; that instant, it was fired towards Cecilus, cutting through the world.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 2. create and manipulate crystal pillar from all directions,''A moment later, the area around Cecilus distorted, and twisted pillars of stone burst forth from all directions like giant serpents and attacked the boy.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 2. and generate stone constructs to grab and crush her opponent,''As he kicked the earth, the ground following Cecilus’s path swelled as he accelerated, creating a series of huge arms of stone and earth that grabbed at the boy as if to crush him.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 2. which even Cecilus Segmunt struggled to avoid or fight against. The projectile crystals that she fires can act independently of each other, and attempting to defend by normal means aagainst them can be self-destructive.''The twelve dancing light belts each acted independently with their own will, and drew irregular trajectories like living creatures differing from ordinary weapons. When he tried to knock one down with a karate chop, the part which made contact was gouged out entirely and became painful to look at.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 2. Likewise, these crystals are capable of breaking down and reconstructing themselves,''Thereupon, through the process of breaking down and reconstructing themselves, the twelve belts of adamantine light blocked the way again.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 2 which allows them to multiply into numbers unenumerable,''As the light belts branched to an extent that became too absurd to enumerate, they beautifully glistened in the sky as they came falling like a waterfall.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 2. thus making them next to impossible to avoid. *'''Lightning''': Though the process by which she generates it is unknown, Arakiya is capable of summoning lightning as part of her attacks.''Priscilla charged in with a shout as if to make her stance apparent, about to take on the streams of water and flashes of lightning rushing toward her with nothing but her body and sword――, "――Love me."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 2. '''Massive Mana Pool''': After devouring a portion of one of the Four Great Spirits, her mana pool expanded greatly, allowing her to generate all forms of magic. This pool increased later when she devoured and assimilated with the rest of the Stone. *'''Mana Sensing''': Thanks to her connection to the Stone, she is able to sense the flow of mana that is connected to the Great Spirit. Using this, she can sense the zombies that were revived by its power and locate them. However, this ability seems to be exclusive to anything that is using its power. '''Flight''': After having devoured the entirety of Muspel, Arakiya has displayed the ability to float in the air without the assistance of the elements.''But, Cecilus jumped into the area that had become a garden of magma, making full use of the limited footholds to close in on Arakiya, who was floating in the sky.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 43, Section 2. While she can achieve flight through turning her body into flame or using the wind, it seems that she doesn't necessarily require doing so, as she was seen floating while she was influenced by Muspel's power. This being said, it is unclear if she can do this freely without Muspel's influence. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Enhanced Physicality''': With years of experience and becoming one of the strongest people in the Empire after Cecilus alone, she is capable of fighting against Cecilus, and though she has yet to defeat him, their clashes are devastating enough that they tend to cause extreme collateral damage. After devouring the entirety of Muspel, Arakiya became significantly tougher to damage. She was even capable of withstanding a chop from the infantilized Cecilus,''Unperturbed even when suffering the full strength of Cecilus’s karate chops, the heroine had many small Magic Crystals growing on her slender shoulders and arms, her appearance having turned into one that gave the fantastical illusion of being clad with sparkling wings.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 57, Section 2. which is capable of splitting an iron castle in two, and she was able to counter him rather easily.''Already a dozen or so times, Cecilus’s lightning-swift attacks had been countered, and continued to be shot down. As a result, the situation was rapidly becoming severely unfavorable.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 56, Section 2. '''Intangibility''': Having taken in the power of Muspel, Arakiya can switch back and forth between a physical and mana-based body, allowing her to temporarily become intangible. Though this can be exhausted should she exhaust her Od, with Muspel’s immeasurable amount of mana, the chances of this are practically moot, effectively making Arakiya unkillable. '''Extended Lifespan''': Due to absorbing Muspel, Arakiya's lifespan has been dramatically extended. In the Sasageru IF, she had lived for 400 years. ===Equipment=== *'''Wand''': Arakiya carries a tri-pronged wand with her to help channel her magic. ==Trivia== *At the very start of [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 28|Volume 28]], Arakiya is said to be a half beast person. *Arakiya owns a private plot of land somewhere near the Imperial Capital of Lupugana, where she currently resides. Furthermore, it's been stated that Cecilus Segmunt also resides on her land, though not in the same building as her; he lives close-by in a rundown shack. *Arakiya's goal to become the First ranking Divine General results in her actively trying to attack and kill Cecilus, though it is to no avail as Cecilus always outmatches her. *Arakiya has her own named chapter in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8: Vincent Vollachia|web novel]] of Arc 8. In the [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|light novel]], it was adapted as an interlude. *Due to having devoured Muspel, Arakiya has been compared to Spirit Humans in the fact that she can switch between her human body and spirit body at will and is effectively immortal. *According to the author, Arakiya having children in the Sasageru IF was mainly due to Cecilus believing that her mental state would crumble after he died, and he gave a casual proposal as a "reward" for defeating her in a fight. That said, by the time of the Sasageru IF, their line of descendants had gone extinct.July 26, 2026 Talk Show ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]]

[[Omega Party]] |Equipment = Beast Protection Bracelet |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6|Tanpenshuu Volume 6]]}} '''Colette''' (コレット) is a girl who once lived as an outcast in a forest after being shunned from her village for being a “Beast”. She, alongside [[Palmyra]], later joined [[Omega]] and formed the [[Omega Party]]. ==Appearance== Colette is a girl with light brown hair, brown eyes, youthful-looking features, and a short stature. She wears a green coat, a green trapper hat, and average-sized boots. She and Palmyra have matching hairpins. ==Personality== Colette was initially presented as a recluse with a warm yet wary temperament. Due to the prejudices she faced as a result of her circumstances, she was labelled a “Beast”, and attempted to conform to those expectations until she met Omega and they began to travel together. Her true disposition was quickly shown to be that of a kind and accepting girl who quickly befriends and makes an effort to understand the people she meets. In a similar vein, this makes it to where she is willing to accept other people in her party and not worry about potential problems that might come with accepting them.''“Just so you know, you can’t use Colette as an excuse to back out. She’ll be more than happy to have you accompany us, no matter the situation. She isn’t the type to worry about potential problems.”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Extra]]. Because of her innocent nature and vulnerability, she is often excluded from discussions on grim matters with her companions, and her friend Palmyra is particularly protective of her. ==History== ===Early Life=== As a young child, Colette's parents were on business outside of their home village and brought back home a bracelet they received during their travels as a memento for her. This bracelet was the Beast Protection bracelet, a [[meteor]] that transformed its user into a “Beast” whenever it sensed danger. Due to Colette being a young child, this effect could cause her to feel danger even in a nightmare. As such, she transformed into a “Beast” when the bracelet sensed danger, unwittingly killing her parents in the process. Although taken in by other families, she was eventually outcast from her village after being accused of being a Witch for surviving supposed [[witchbeast]] assaults that would kill everyone near her. As a result, she grew a warped belief that she herself was a Witch and tried to perform rituals to become one, turning into the “Beast” and killing animals to do so, with her friend Palmyra making graves for the slain animals. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch|The Requirements to be a Witch]]=== One day, Colette happened to meet an elven girl being swept along the river she was at and saved her from its currents. She introduced herself as Omega, and the two got to know one another over the course of several days, exchanging stories from their pasts. Omega decided to take a walk on another day, Colette informed her to not travel to the eastern side of the forest to avoid a witchbeast that had been attacking people there, though she visited anyways, meeting Palmyra there. Upon returning, Omega relayed to Colette her intent to leave the forest but take care of the witchbeast first as a show of gratitude for her kindness, which the young girl hesitantly accepted. That night, she travelled to the eastern side of the forest and attempted to murder the beast herself until Palmyra came and revealed that it was Colette. Piecing together the circumstances behind the “Beast” and its attacks, Omega manifested her true form to Palmyra and the unconscious Colette, before deciding to set off for the village in hopes of setting things straight with the villagers. However, this only made things worse for Colette, as she was forced to leave the area as a consequence for being acquainted with an actual Witch. Seeing as how Colette had nowhere else to go and Palmyra had used up all of her courtesy for the village, the two of them were invited by Omega to join her, officially forming their party. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 1|One Wild Night]]=== The trio then proceeded to cross over into [[Gusteko]]. One day, they were caught in a severe blizzard and rescued by [[Noelle Tuérico]], an Itinerant Preacher of the [[Gustekan Church]], after Omega launched a fire spell into the distance. They waited for Omega to regain her energy in a makeshift snow house Noelle created and spoke with her in the meantime, learning about the term Silver Blessing, her position in the Gustekan Church, and the nearby church building they can use as a refuge. They visit the church once Omega is rejuvenated and acquaint themselves with [[Podoso]], [[Admonsah]], and [[Maqueena]], each of whom had come to the church to meet the pastor who lives there, [[Coatl]]. The trio learned of Coatl's history of having saved a local town from the effects of an avalanche unintentionally caused by the Ice Thieves and how he took up a position of the town's watcher following his charity towards its people, becoming known by the moniker Saint of the Avalanche. Maqueena and Podoso split off from everyone else to visit another part of the church, and another visitor named [[Trellock]] arrives while they are out. Eventually, Maqueena discovers something and screams, prompting everyone else to follow after her to find what has caused her fear. They all stumble upon Coatl's corpse, prompting Omega to say that there was a cold-blooded killer among them. Omega took charge of the situation, using detective work to determine the killer's identity. She heard from Podoso that there had been a string of serial murders, with Coatl being the eighth known victim. The other victims were peddlers and travelers. Querying him about the seventh victim, Omega then sets her sights on Admonsah, whom she was certain was associated with them. They learn Admonsah was a former slave who unexpectedly killed his owner. Colette scolded Omega for the presumption that Admonsah had acted out of malice and proposed that he was acting in self-defense, which led to him being unequivocally forgiven by a majority of the group. Omega tries to ascertain why Coatl would be murdered, searching for any hidden savings. Suddenly, everyone but Maqueena in the room fell asleep to the effects of the Muskrim flower, and she made her getaway with Coatl's collection of magic stones, not wanting to stay and fall victim to his murderer, and Noelle chased after her. While Omega, who had woken up, went to deal with them, the culprit responsible for the serial murderers, Trellock, attempted to murder Colette, but her Beast Protection Bracelet activated, severely injuring him. In the end, they pretended that Noelle had apprehended Trellock and left, Podoso decided to take in Admonsah, and Maqueena was forced to stop conning people. With her revenge foiled, Noelle was left aimless. Colette proposed for her to join their group to which she accepted upon Omega's approval. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Extra|One Wild Night Extra]]=== Later, the party decided to head to the town Podoso had told them about. Eventually, they set up camp, and while Colette and Noelle set up the camp, Palmyra decided to talk with Omega about including Noelle in their travels, worried about getting her involved in their troubles, which included Omega being a half-elf Witch and Colette's bracelet. Omega believed that there was nothing to worry about, and shortly after, Noelle, who had heard part of their conversation appeared and said that she already knew about Omega's secret and chose to follow them regardless. Though Palmyra asked if she had a thing for odd people and Noelle's joking reply that she did, just like Palmyra, she claimed to be just as odd, as she was an itinerant preacher from the Gustekan Church who had decided to leave. Though Palmyra thought it wasn't as bad as Omega's secret, Omega told her that she was underestimating the Church and what they bestowed Noelle, and the two claimed that they would not be amicable toward her effectively breaking a contract, something which might end up leading to them falling into her mess. Though Palmyra told Omega to be prepared to fight, when Noelle told her to feel free to kick her from the party if she ever became a burden, to which she replied by saying not to underestimate her and spoke of her own circumstances, basically unintentionally cornering Noelle into staying in the party after saying not to use Colette as an excuse. Colette arrived shortly after, and the group decided not to talk to her about their conversation. Instead, they ate, and Noelle explained repairs that she had made to their equipment and offered her knowledge of how to use their equipment and how to survive in Gusteko, including knowledge on the Gustekan Church, to which Palmyra and Omega realized that they wouldn't be able to survive in Gusteko without Noelle. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Omega in Wonderland Part 1|Omega in Wonderland]]=== The party continued to trudge to the snows of Gusteko, with Palmyra and Omega becoming exhausted. Attempting to give Palmyra some more energy, Colette attempted to let her use her bracelet, but when Palmyra tried, it left her weak and vomiting. Omega explained the reason for this, claiming she allowed it to happen because she wanted to see the look on her face. Afterward, she had Noelle carry Palmyra while Colette carried her. As the got closer to the town of Sylphoa, Omega dispelled a barrier, and eventually they reached the town, where she and Colette fell subject to the Dream Arts spell that had been cast over the town. Impressed with the size of the space and likening it to her Castle of Dreams, even claiming it as superior to herself, Omega cast Al Shario in order to lure out the caster. The caster, [[Lilac]], appeared shortly after, erasing the star Omega summoned and questioning who they were. After a small dispute, she left convincing her to take down the spell to Colette. Despite her standoffish attitude, Omega claimed that Colette's words were getting through to her. However, upon hearing Omega's use of a loan word, Lilac wanted to know where she heard it, leading to negotiations. Despite becoming frustrated with her and even slapping her, she decided to give Omega a chance to take care of the [[Mikli Yulitô|Temple Knight]] who had come after her, breaking the seal that she'd placed. The fight that followed was short lived as the Witches of Sin quickly dispatched her, much to Lilac's shock. Shortly after, Palmyra entered the dream space with a message from Lilac's partner, [[Shion]]. Following this, after Omega spoke to the [[Zank Metley|other Temple Knight]] who had come to retrieve Mikli and had him leave with her and report the death of the heretic, Lilac released the people of Sylphoa from her dream world, and Omega offered Shion and Lilac to join her party. Since she couldn't quite trust the two, having just met them, she would give them a chance to look into her memories with their Dream Arts, giving them a chance to find the person from which the loan words they speak come from. The two accepted her offer and joined the party. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 1|Witch Trials]]=== One day, having moved on from Sylphoa, the Omega Party was walking in a snow field, where they encountered a [[Witchbeast#Snow Blight|Snow Blight]]. However, Omega swiftly dispatched it with Minya. Soon after, they arrived at Limbus, where signs claiming it was forbidden to go out at night and to comply with the "vows of the faith". Though slightly concerned about the town's eeriness, as the group was low on supplies, they decided to enter Limbus, where after a few minutes, they found themselves surrounded by the townsfolk who were armed with farming tools. Though they attempted to calm the townsfolk and offer them a gift in the form of the Snow Blight's crystallized head, they instead accuse her of being a Witch after seeing it, leading Omega to warn Colette against using her bracelet's transformation and Lilac from turning back into Shion, else they be declared Witches. Thanks to the appearance of [[Nananna Pezza]] and speaking with Noelle, she was able to vouch for them and clear them of being Witches. Omega's group finds an inn to reside in where they discussed the issue at present, warning everyone about how easily they could be made into scapegoats whether for their abilities, race, or even the look in their eyes, and Noelle explained about Witch Hunts and Witch Trials being rare occurrences in Gusteko that Itinerant Preachers were sometimes sent to deal with. Although wanting to leave the town quickly, the group decides to stay in the town to help Noelle repay her debt to Nananna, and soon after, they meet with Nananna when she arrived to ask for the group's assistance. That night, the Witch Hunt is for a person named [[Minor Characters#Piditz|Piditz]] who had been tipped off as a Witch, and Nananna wanted him taken into custody only. When they later spotted Piditz and chased after him, Omega split off to corner him, only to find [[Mireille Hetia]] using her [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] to kill Piditz. Thanks to being near the body, Omega was quickly turned into a scapegoat and declared a Witch so that Mireille could cover up her kill and at least prevent her from getting in the way of her and Nananna's revenge, and Omega was taken into custody. Later, Colette visits Omega, and they point out that killings began before the party arrived, which should clear Omega's name, but instead, Mireille decides to have her executed anyway, and Palmyra objects to [[Edmon Quayle]]. As part of Omega's plan, Noelle persuades Nananna to speak up, and Nananna insists on the town holding a Witch Trial for Omega, and Palmyra declares that if she is a Witch that she would burn with her. At the inn, the party discusses how if the scale of this event expands, they will be unable to prevent the spread of the news this time, which could result in the party's persecution, even abroad, and their possible extradition back to the church. To clear their names, Colette states that they should find the real culprit for the murders. Lilac and Colette go to gather information around the town, and they meet with Mireille, who explained to them how the hunts started. The next day, the Witch Trial is being held for Omega, overseen by Nananna and the Town Hall, while Palmyra acts as Omega's attorney. Despite her arguments, Edmon counter with his supposed knowledge of the Witches and Omega's chatter does not help. Colette speaks up and claims that she believes that things will not go as the council claims, as people will begin to notice that the entire event seems off, which resounds with the townsfolk. Because of this, Palmyra claims that there is a conspiracy, which Edmon fights against and asks for Nananna's assistance. Because she sides with the town, Lilac and Shion believe her to be part of the conspiracy, and they decide to use their dream arts to influence the people's mental states. Palmyra then claims that the council is using the Witch rumors to get rid of inconvenient people, which Edmon also fights against, though is quickly silenced when she states she heard it herself from a council member and declares that there is no Witch. Unfortunately, Omega claims otherwise. Despite angering Palmyra, Omega decides to clear things up by declaring that there were two conspiracies taking place in town. Despite Nananna trying to prevent her from talking, Omega ignores her and explains that many of the victims were relatives of council members, and she claims that Nananna is the second conspirator, calling her the bastard child of Edmon whose mother was banished from the town, and as a result, she despised the town. Noelle later appears and confirms that her actions were in response to the death of an [[Minor Characters#Elderly Healer|elderly healer]], and she claims that Nananna tried to remove her from the trial by knocking her out since her only ire was with Limbus. Afterward, Noelle declares that the secretary, Mireille, was helping Nananna, as she was a bastard child of Edmon as well, and she stated how the corpses of Piditz and other people connected to the council and other outside officials were already dumped in a hole. Omega also declares that she witnessed Mireille killing Piditz. Enraged, Mireille uses her spiritual arts to char Edmon's arm with blue fire, and with the intent of killing the entire council, surrounds the council with blue fire, and she and Nananna stand against them. Although Omega is fine with leaving things as they are and taking their leave, Colette states she doesn't want things to end like this, and Omega decides to end the fighting in response to her plea, burning through her restraints and declaring herself a Witch. Later, as Omega's party begins to leave the town, Noelle says her goodbyes to Nananna, and it is declared that the evil [[spirit]] accompanying Mireille will be disposed of. Likewise, it is claimed that Edmon's position is under threat with both his severe injuries and the loss of the citizens' trust, and Mireille claims she was mistaken about real Witches. Despite Colette believing that things were settled peacefully, however, Omega thinks to herself that Limbus would soon face its destruction, as since Omega, Nananna, and Mireille were not executed, there would be continuous Witch Hunts and deaths for scapegoats for the whole incident. Although considering telling Colette about this, she decides against it. ==Abilities== '''Miasma Resistance''': Colette seems to have a higher resistance to miasma compared to the average person, as noted by [[Minerva]]. Despite having been exposed to the miasma of Omega, which had previously caused numerous fully grown men to go mad and kill themselves, Colette showed no signs of being negatively affected by it. '''Equipment''': Colette owns the '''[[Meteor#Beast Protection Bracelet|Beast Protection Bracelet]]''' (獣護輪, ''Juugorin''), a meteor that allows the user to transform into a beast to protect themselves against danger when the bracelet senses it. As a beast, the user gains a rapid influx of mana making them stronger in combat despite losing most of their capabilities to reason. It is possible to control this effect. Even when not transformed, however, the meteor improves the user's stamina. ==Trivia== *In [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch|The Requirements to be a Witch]], Colette is twelve years old.''Though adults would probably laugh it off as her being “cheeky” if she used a phrase like “compared to the typical year”, considering she was still twelve years old.'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch]], Section 1. However, this was contradicted in the Comic Alive version of [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 2|One Wild Night]], where her age is said to be fifteen.''Faintly drawing her eyebrows together, Palmyra fixed her gaze on Omega. The pleas of this young girl, so brave at only fifteen—the same age as Colette—left Omega with no choice but to surrender.'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 2]], Section 2. The adaptation of One Wild Night in [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10|Tanpenshuu Volume 10]] changes the sentence to avoid any mention of age, thus making Colette's age twelve. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Omega Party]]

[[Natsuki Subaru]] (basis) |Game = [[Re:Zero Lost in Memories]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Yuusuke Kobayashi (voice actor)|Kobayashi Yuusuke]] }} '''Alcor''' (アルコル) is an exclusive character from the video game [[Re:Zero Lost in Memories]]. He is one of the main antagonists of the game. ==Appearance== Alcor wears a black coat with black fur around the collar and a purple tracksuit inside with a large black scar on the torso. He wears a white mask with a large purple scar across his right eye and black feathers behind the mask. It was later revealed that Alcor was an illusion of [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] created by [[Lilac]]. When unmasked, he has black hair and dark circles under his eyes. ==Personality== Alcor's personality was the opposite of Subaru's. Alcor has a cold and heartless personality as if any emotions from him was gone. He also claims himself to be the "real" Natsuki Subaru. ==History== Unlike the loops that Subaru fought, Alcor was from the failed loop where he had tried to defeat [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Petelgeuse]]. He had died so many times up to the point that he had discarded his original name and adopted the name Alcor and took on a different appearance. ==Abilities== '''Return by Death''' (死に戻り ''Shinimodori''): Return by Death is an [[Authority]] that allows Alcor to return back to an unspecified, unpredictable and uncontrollable "save point" after his death. It happens instantly after his life is taken and there's no lag between the point of death and the point of resurrection. To Alcor, it looks exactly as if someone switched camera angles inside his head and the sudden influx of new information and sensations often makes him feel dizzy and confused. This ability was given to him by [[Satella]] as a means to help him save the ones he loves, should he need it. *'''Penalties''': Alcor is unable to reveal his ability to others. There are three primary penalties for attempting to do so: **Alcor will be forcibly and painfully silenced by the Witch's hand, and, in some cases, die. **Anyone who is told about Return by Death might potentially die. **It will increase the density of the Witch's Scent at least for a short time, which will draw any [[witchbeast]]s in the immediate area to him like moths to a flame. *'''Memory Retainment''': For some unknown reason, anyone who has some intense bond or connection with Alcor will slightly remember past iterations of the timeline before it is reset, similar to Deja Vu. Though knowledge is limited, it can help them predict future events which is extremely useful to any allies of Alcor as they can predict what will happen next, unless the timeline was changed in a far different manner from its previous incarnation. It can also be used in a fight to throw of his opponent by using an attack they didn't predict or fighting in a way he hadn't done before. *'''Postmortem Timeline Alteration''': Alcor has an ability which allows him to recreate or force changes in the timeline after his death if it does not end how he wants it to end. He can alter events or prevent possible situations which can completely change the timeline to his liking. This even works on realms where time is non-existent. The changes during a reset are strong enough to bring back the world after its destruction and revive or recover anyone no matter their condition. **'''Penalties''': The butterfly effect of Alcor's reset is completely out of his control. This means that any changes Alcor's Authority produces can be manipulated, and what happens beyond said time is completely unknown. Future events could happen entirely differently after he changes the timeline and could be nothing like his prediction. He would have to use the ability again if he wished to change the timeline to his preference. ==Trivia== *Alcor's name comes from the binary star [[Wikipedia:Alcor (star)|Alcor]], which is a part of the Ursa Major constellation. ==Navigation== {{Non-Canon Navbox}} [[Category:Phantoms]]

'''Beli Hainelga''' (ベリ・ハイネルガ) is one of the most fearsome serial killers from the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom of Gusteko]]. His gruesome reputation is second only to the [[Elsa Granhiert|Bowel Hunter]]. Until the climax of [[Arc 6]], his name and memories have been eaten by [[Lye Batenkaitos]]. Currently, his status remains unknown.

==Appearance==
Beli was a large obese man with a long beard and ponytail.

==Personality==
Due to his reputation as one of the most feared serial killers from the Holy Kingdom, it can be deducted that Beli was a rather sadistic and disgusting person. As his only actual presence was through Lye and [[Rui Arneb|Rui]] using Solar Eclipse and Lunar Eclipse, there are no concrete examples of Beli's personality.

==History==
Having been born with an extraordinary growth spurt, Beli Hainelga was blessed with physical predispositions which are impossible to be achieved by any normal human beings. Due to his inhuman strength and resistance to damage, he soon discovered joy in harming men to his liking, and before long, he committed several heinous crimes. His reputation would soon label him to become one of the most fearsome serial killers from the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko. At one point, when Beli was attacked by a garrison, his skin was so sturdy that, from the thousand swords pierced into him, not a single one had been effective, and the garrison failed to seize him. 

Sometime before the events of Arc 6, his name and memories were eaten by the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Lye Batenkaitos. Following the Sin Archbishop's death, it's unknown if he awoke from his vegetative state or not.

==Abilities==
'''Carnivorous Beast''' (肉食獣): Due to Beli's extraordinary growth spurt, he was blessed with inhuman physical attributes. This ability allowed Beli to strengthen his body which gave him two advantages: he could withstand powerful attacks and strengthen his limbs to deliver devastating blows. This move was shown in Arc 6 when used by Lye Batenkaitos. With this ability, he was able take a hit from Emilia's ice spear and come out unscathed, and deliver a retaliating punch that, from Subaru's perspective, would be as devastating as getting hit by a car. 

==Trivia==
*Although Beli's surname was mentioned in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 25|Volume 25]], his given name was never mentioned in the light novel. His full name was only revealed in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]].

[[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]] (canon side story) |Manga = |Anime = [[Episode 16]] (mentioned)}} '''Alec Hoshin''' (アレク・ホーシン), better known to history as '''Hoshin of the Wilderness''' (荒れ地のホーシン), was a man who lived in the era of the [[Great Calamity]] and traveled with the [[Witch Era Party]]. He is most well-known for uniting a multitude of small countries, founding one of the Four Great Nations known as the [[Kararagi|Kararagi City-States]], implementing within it a culture that strongly resembled that of Japan, and being the first chief of Kararagi. He is considered a world-wide symbol of success for merchants and, as such, is a figure who is looked up to by any individual remotely associated with business. ==Appearance== Alec appeared to be a middle-aged man with long, dark red hair tied into a ponytail, amber eyes, a small mustache, and a beard. He wore a long, black cloak with red on the inside and grey woven robes. He was also adorned with a bronze pin that featured a hanging red robe and a cane given to him by [[Farsale Lugunica]]. ==Personality== According to [[Echidna]], Alec was personable and the kind of person who could hit it off with anyone. Despite this, he was incredibly shrewd, a schemer, and a colossal liar whose ability to sway hearts could achieve results on par with [[Authority|Authorities]]. Furthermore, he was compared to a beast tamer for being the only person able to handle [[Reid Astrea]] and preventing his rampages. He was also claimed to be a gentleman to Echidna and [[Satella]], and despite his quirks, he was fundamentally good at heart. Alec considered himself pessimistic. His nature was to long for the company of others. He hated the sky because he thought it looked down at him and tormented him. It is mentioned that he was both brave and sympathetic. Some theorized that Hoshin was a lolicon, as [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]] described him as one, though the word was coined as a common term in Kararagi that meant "love at first sight". Remembered as Hoshin of the Wilderness, he is said to have been a rather brutal and, at times, savage person who did everything to achieve his goals both as a merchant and as the founder of the Kararagi City-States. It is precisely due to this trait that he was able to unite all the countries and cities into one of the Four Great Nations. If one refused to join them, he did not hesitate to topple the entire city and build a new one from its ashes. ==History== At some point in the distant past, Alec, along with [[Flugel]], Reid Astrea, Farsale Lugunica, Echidna, and Satella travelled together. Alec went through many brutal experiences, including being chased by a [[Dragon]], being swallowed by a great flood, and the bloodless capture of a barbarian fort. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of [[Magrizza]]. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. However, the nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and [[Volcanica]] went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the [[Black Serpent]] destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent. Though it is not known how much the claims of his past is accurate, according to history, Hoshin was responsible for uniting the cities and small countries scattered around the Western regions of the continent. Eventually, he was able to successfully bring them under his dominion, thus creating the nation that would soon become known as Kararagi. During that time, he was purported to have given the small nation of [[Banan]] the choice to surrender or face an all-out attack, thus creating the anecdote "Hoshin was Banan's sunset". Hoshin is also thought to have introduced cultures and previously unseen cultural aspects, such as clothing, like [[wikipedia:kimono|kimonos]] and [[wikipedia:yukata|yukatas]], and foods, like [[wikipedia:okonomiyaki|okonomiyaki]] (later named daisukiyaki), and [[wikipedia:dorayaki|dorayaki]], which became a popular phenomenon in the new world. He also introduced the new world to [[wikipedia:kansai dialect|Kansai dialect]], a version of Japanese that was used in the Kansai region of Japan. It was adopted in the world, and it became the native way of speaking in the Kararagi City-States. ==Abilities== ===[[Divine Protection]]=== '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Evaluation|Divine Protection of Evaluation]]''' (目利きの加護, ''Mekiki no Kago''): This Divine Protection enabled Alec to determine if an item was of good or bad quality and, if the item was in front of him, he could evaluate its condition and quality with perfect accuracy. However, if he happened to be evaluating an item he'd never seen before, he would only know if it was of good or bad quality and therefore gained no knowledge of how it was used or how much it was worth. According to Echidna, this Divine Protection was unwieldy. ===Intelligence=== '''Silver Tongue''': By Echidna's claim, Alec was a schemer, liar, and willing to commit scams, and he could rein in people as absurd as Reid. According to Echidna, his ability to sway people's hearts was so incredible that he could achieve results comparable to those brought about by Authorities. ==Trivia== *Different anecdotes about Hoshin are still circulating around the world. For example, in one of the failed loops of [[Arc 4]], [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] used the anecdote "Hoshin was Banan's sunset" as a declaration of hostility towards Subaru, [[Ram]], and [[Otto Suwen|Otto]]. *It is speculated that one of Ricardo's ancestors was involved in the battle of Banan. The reason being is that Ricardo was the only one that referenced him by name (before Anastasia adopted the name) in [[Anastasia's Kararagi Merchant Path]] as he knows what a lolicon is. *It is unknown if Hoshin had any children. [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]] only adopted the name from inspiration and is not directly related by blood. *Alec knows some English words, implying that Flugel taught him these words. *Alec says he would have died in the middle of nowhere if he had not been found by a kind person's hand in the past. *Hoshin considered himself the second most likely to die in his group. Reid was unlikely to die, and he was not worried about Farsale since his personality was such that he could get on with things anywhere he was. According to him, Flugel was the most likely to die. *He had tried to commit suicide once due to loneliness but was saved by a gentle hand. *Alec's reveal as a character is unique in that his first official appearance takes place not in licensed Re:Zero media, but rather in the non-canon-relevant Isekai Quartet Movie as part of promotional material. *In the Isekai Quartet movie, Alec seems to know both Subaru and [[Emilia]], as well as Emilia's real age. *Albeit only in side content, Alec is one of the few characters in which there is narration written in the first-person perspective of. ==Navigation== {{Kararagi Navbox}} [[Category:Witch Era Party]] [[Category:Merchants]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[de:Alec Hoshin]] [[pt-br:Alec Hoshin]] [[ru:Алек Хосин]] [[zh:角色:亚历克]]
