The '''Black Serpent''' (黒蛇), alternatively known as the '''Vilest of Witchbeasts''',<ref>''Worthy of being crowned the Vilest of Witchbeasts beyond any shadow of a doubt, that was a being whose very existence tolled the warning bells of life.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> is one of the [[Witchbeast#Three Great Witchbeasts|Three Great Witchbeasts]] created by the [[Witch]] of Gluttony, [[Daphne]], and it is currently the only one of the three that is still roaming the [[World|world of Re:Zero]]. It played a secondary antagonistic role in [[Arc 9]].

Considered the worst among the Three Great Witchbeasts, it was unlike the other Great Witchbeasts as it was specifically made to kill and reduce the numbers of people in order to curb the amount of people starving to death,<ref name="quell">''"It was sort of an attempt to reduce the number of mouths to feed."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref> and thus, it was made specifically to be almost entirely unkillable. Because of its extremely lethal nature, it is by far the most feared among all [[witchbeast]]s, to the point that it could be considered to be the sole Great Witchbeast.<ref>''As stated previously, the Three Great Witchbeasts were beings that wrought frighteningly more harm than any other Witchbeasts. ――If that condition were to have been strictly obeyed, then the Black Serpent, rather than having been listed among the Three Great Witchbeasts, would have instead been worthy of reigning as the sole Great Witchbeast.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref>

==Appearance==
The Black Serpent's true form, rather than being a snake covered in flesh or scales, is instead a massive coalescence of all manner of disease and pestilence forming together to create the shadowy contour of a serpent.<ref>''The befoulment that had overflowed from the forest’s shadows coalesced, taking form as a serpentine contour. However, that contour was not of flesh or scale, instead, ‘twas naught more than a festering den of pathology, pestilence, and plague innumerable, an endless helix of lesions, disease, and blight, brought together by malign coincidence to assume such a shape.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> Ulcerations akin to a serpent's scales swell and burst across its body, and anything the pus-like droplets touch rots away.<ref>''Its ulcerations, akin to the scales that clad a snake’s body, would swell and burst, releasing droplets of deep black to scatter like pus; a mere touch from a single drop enough to make anything rot and wither away with nary a sound.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> The serpent seems to bear multiple heads, each one commanding different types of blights and plagues, while within those very heads writhe tentacle-like or tongue-like protuberances akin to a gathering of parasites,<ref>''The tip of the contour, barely acceptable to even be called a head, began to bloom like a flower, and from within writhed countless slender, filamentous protuberances, akin to tongues or tentacles, or perhaps more aptly, an infestation of parasites.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> with its only known head as of now being the one representing Elder's Blight. Its mere presence also exudes a dense miasma so thick that it could be seen with the naked eye and immediately recognized as miasma.<ref>''That instant, burgeoning from the shadow at Felt’s feet, was a dense conglomeration of miasma so dark that its true state could be ascertained on sight―― appearing just as though the shadow itself had poked its head up, it was an utmost malefic menace made manifest, unparalleled in its ability to remind all living creatures of their instinctive aversion to Death.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref>

==Behavior==
Unlike its fellow Great Witchbeasts, the Black Serpent is stated to be entirely uncontrollable. Its actions are entirely unpredictable, to the point that even the Witch of Vainglory, [[Pandora]], could only direct it instead of control it. Because it was given the role of culling people, its kill count is astronomically higher than its fellows, and it seems to target everyone indiscriminately. Although it is unclear why, at times, it seems to lie dormant in shadows, and because of its size and nature, it also moves relatively slow. Despite its uncontrollable nature, however, Pandora's [[Authority#Authority of Vainglory|Authority of Vainglory]] is capable of directing it, while [[Roy Alphard]] was able to have it obey him during the [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict]]. It was also shown to be affected by [[Meili Portroute]]'s [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]], albeit only slightly, and instead of being controlled, the influence only caused its movement to slow or halt for mere moments at a time. It is presently unknown whether or not it can be influenced by the scent of the Witch on [[Natsuki Subaru]].

==History==
At an unknown point after its birth, the Black Serpent was claimed to be chasing after [[Flugel]]'s party for unknown reasons, and in this time, it destroyed the country of [[Magrizza]]. It has been said that the Black Serpent was responsible for destroying what was once a great nation around this time, reducing the world's Five Great Nations to four;<ref>''After all, the Black Serpent had bereaved a number of lives astronomically greater than that of either the White Whale or the Great Rabbit, what with it having delivered ruination unto a great country that had formerly existed, reducing what were once the Five Great Nations to the Four Great Nations.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> it is unclear if this great nation was Magrizza or a separate nation entirely. Around three hundred years after Daphne's death, the Black Serpent was manipulated into [[Permafrost of Elior Forest|attacking]] the elven village in [[Elior Forest]] by the Witch of Vainglory. Pandora's Authority of Vainglory allowed her to manipulate phenomena, meaning she could direct it into a rough direction she wanted it to go. In the aftermath of its attack, a large quantity of the Black Serpent's venom was left frozen in the Forest which eventually emerged about a century later and caused havoc before being stopped by the half-elf [[Emilia]]. At some point nearly one century after its attack on Elior Forest, it infected the birthplace of the members of the [[White Dragon's Scales]], creating a disease in the soil that would turn any person infected by it into stone.<ref>''An endemic disease had broken out several years ago where they’d been born, with the contamination in the soil being pinned as the cause behind it. They needed a lot of money to mend the soil. The endemic disease was a strange kind, in which the bodies of people afflicted by it would gradually turn into something like stone, until finally, completely turning into actual stone ――It was a diabolical endemic that occurred in lands defiled by a certain Witchbeast.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 17.</ref><ref>''“The aftereffects of the Black Serpent spreading its pestilence.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 17.</ref> Because of this, [[Dynas Trussardi]] formed the White Dragon's Scales.

==Abilities==
===Overall Power===
The Black Serpent is considered the worst of all witchbeasts and is responsible for far more deaths than any other witchbeasts, including the other greats. Having been made specifically to quell the number of people living in the world,<ref name="quell" /> it was made in such a manner that it was basically almost impossible to touch or get close to it, let alone kill it. It is thanks to this trait that it remains a threat in the present day.

===Physical Traits===
<gallery type="slideshow">
Kurohebi-Attacks.gif|Archi's leg struck by the Black Serpent.
Kurohebi-burned (1).gif|Archi's leg burned by the Black Serpent.
</gallery>
'''Plague Inducement''': The Black Serpent is known to be able to inflict any living being it touches with a hundred diseases, and regardless of whether the target was human, animal, or witchbeast, they would succumb to its plague. When [[Witch Cult]] members came into contact with its tongue, one was scarred with reddish black burns, another had their skin from the neck up covered in reddish black spots that gushed black blood, and another had their body dried up to the point that touching them might break their body apart. Even if one removes the part of their body contaminated by the Black Serpent's diseases, it will not stop it, and said diseases will continue to encroach from the wound. The Black Serpent can also take advantage of its rather malleable body in order to splash multiple targets at once. It can spread its pus-like "scales" like rain or expand its body like a pillar and fall onto its prey, allowing it to cover a wide area in its plague. As of yet, the only living being known to have survived being contaminated by the Black Serpent's filth, touch, or cursed land is [[Heinkel Astrea]], who was turned into an "immortal knight" via [[Dragon]]'s blood.
*'''Elder's Blight''' (老苦, ''Rō Ku''): The head that represents Elder's Blight is able to dole out plagues that would not kill those inflicted. Instead, the targets would be robbed of their mobility and thinking, essentially placing them in a state of eternal stasis.<ref>''All that remained was the downpour of the Black Serpent’s befoulment―― this particular head was charged with representing Elder’s Blight, so it would not go so far as to rob them of their lives. It would occlude their thinking and mobility, restraining them on the precipice of mortality in perpetuum.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 14.</ref> Anyone inflicted by Elder's Blight were claimed to suffer in endless darkness and anguish and would never be able to recover.<ref>''He had heard that the precipice where they would be restrained offered no refuge, anguish and darkness lasted unceasing, but in the end, the pain and affliction they shall taste would settle within Roy and vanish, so it was fine.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 14.</ref>

'''Corruption''': Any ground that it slithers over is cursed, making anything, including other witchbeasts, unable to live on it. Upon the ground touched by its filth, trees wither, plants rot, water becomes blighted, and any and all life that touches the cursed ground will quickly come to its end.<ref>''Arboreal watchers of wood and bark withered, flora festered in rot, and waters seethed with blight. Nary a hue of life was left behind by the Black Serpent’s foul tongue following its tarnish; instead, it engulfed aught in its path, extinguishing all embers of life without discrimination.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> Mere moments after a Guiltylowe touched corrupted land, it died. It is possible to weaponize this corrupted land as well by scattering debris from corrupted land to scatter among living beings, inflicting them with diseases.

===Other===
<gallery type="slideshow">
Kurohebi-Black Serpent.gif|The Black Serpent's poison.
The Kurohebi movement.gif|Movement of the Black Serpent's poison in Elior Forest.
Kurohebi kills Guiltylowe in seconds.gif|The Black Serpent's poison consumes a Guiltylowe in seconds.
</gallery>
'''Semi-Sentient Poison''': The Black Serpent is capable of secreting a potent poison which takes the form of a black liquid-like substance. The poison is capable of semi sentience, as it moves on its own and attempts to devour any and all living creatures it comes across even when its creator isn't present. The liquid is incredibly durable, as blunt force attacks had no effect on it. The poison was also potent enough to completely erode a [[Witchbeast#Guiltylowe|Guiltylowe]], one of the strongest living witchbeasts that is neither unique nor one of the three greats, in seconds.

'''Shadow Stealth''': Through an unknown method, the Black Serpent is capable of hiding within the shadows. While hidden away like this, the land is unaffected by its presence.

==Trivia==
*Like Roy, the Black Serpent is likely inspired or represents the constellation of Hydra.
**The Black Serpent having multiple heads is also likely inspired by the Lernaean Hydra, a beast in Greek mythology that is said to have multiple heads.
*The author originally intended for the pronunciation of the Black Serpent's name in Japanese to be "kurohebi" (くろへび), but offered "kokuja" (こくじゃ) and "kokuda" (だこく) as alternatives.<ref>Narō impression response on June 15, 2014, at 13:46 JST</ref> He eventually settled on "kokuja" over "kurohebi",<ref>''“It’s kokuja, but I call it ‘kurohebi’ in my heart.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/495515323492478976 August 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A]</ref> until the release of [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14|Volume 14]], where the pronunciation was "kurohebi".
*In the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], there is a patch of land near the Karsten Domain known as the Black Serpent Contamination Zone.

[[Minor Characters#Radkain Vollachia|Radkain Vollachia]] (ancestor) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|Ex Volume 5]]}} '''Barthroy Fitts''' (バルトロイ・フィッツ) was an Imperial Prince of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He worked with [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent Abellux]] to save the lives of his nine siblings who did not participate in the ceremony. Before Barthroy could see his plan come to fruition, he was killed by [[Lamia Godwin]]'s poison. Despite this, his plan turned out successful in the end. ==Appearance== Barthroy's appearance was never described. ==Personality== Barthroy always acted sweet and friendly to his siblings, which were unusual traits for the Imperial Family, as most of them either hated or were distant with one another. He also had a minimal amount of personnel at his mansion, making him appear relatively incautious. However, Barthroy's outward sweetness and friendliness was an act that served as his means to achieve what he desired. Contrary to many of his other siblings, he hated how the Imperial Selection Ceremony required his family to kill each other, and in order to prevent unnecessary deaths during the ceremony, he worked with Vincent to save their lives while burying the truth of his machinations, which even had his own death factored into them.'' Barthroy had buried the truth. He had always been so convincingly sweet and friendly in order to get what he wanted. Vincent was particularly impressed that Barthroy had even been prepared to incorporate his own death into his plans if it would achieve his goal. Barthroy Fitts had, in truth, been a worthy member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 16. ==History== Unlike many of his other family members, Barthroy seemed unwary of his siblings for at least seven years preceding the Imperial Selection Cerermony. While he was attending a party celebrating his [[Drizen Vollachia|father]]'s birthday at age 20, he met with Lamia and lamented how it was not possible for his siblings to get along. Barthroy looked deeply moved when Lamia pretended to share his sentiment. Barthroy chose not to lay his hands on the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] during the Imperial Selection Ceremony, thus forfeiting his qualifications to participate in the ceremony. During it, he worked with his younger half-brother, Vincent Abellux, by persuading nine of his siblings to abandon their hopes of participating and giving Vincent their territories in exchange for their lives. In the midst of a meeting with Lamia, however, he passed away due as a result of his younger half-sister poisoning the wine he was drinking. Although he perished before he could see his plan achieved, it was successful after his nine siblings betrayed Lamia during the [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]]. ==Trivia== *Barthroy sent flowers to [[Serena Dracroy]] when she succeeded her father. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Family]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Deceased]]

Alongside Balleroy, it played an antagonistic role during [[Arc 7]], [[Arc 8]], and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]. Born and raised by Balleroy and his closest friends, [[Flop O'Connell|Flop]] and [[Medium O'Connell]], he grew to become Balleroy's most trusted partner, becoming his mount as a Flying Dragon Rider. However, Carillon met his end after he helped Balleroy during the staged coup prior to the main story, something that allowed the [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachian]] [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]] to sign a non-aggression pact with the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]. During the [[Great Disaster]], Carillon and Balleroy both appeared as [[Undead#Zombies|zombies]] working alongside [[Sphinx]]. Despite being an antagonist alongside Balleroy, it still gave up its undead life alongside its master by flying the unstable core of [[Moguro Hagane]] into the sky, where it was caught in the explosion. ==Appearance== Carillon was a flying dragon with golden eyes. ==Personality== Carillon was a companion and friend to Balleroy for its whole life. The duo had strong coordination, and their souls were bound to one another. ==History== Ever since it was in an egg, Carillon was cared for by Balleroy. When it hatched, Balleroy thought up its name together with [[Miles]] and Flop O'Connell.''“I was there when Carillon was born. I thought up its name together with them. With Big Bro Miles and Balleroy.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30]], Chapter 6, Section 8. As proof of their bond with Balleroy, Flop and his sister Medium were given Carillon's old fangs when it grew new ones. Balleroy eventually shared his Od with Carillon,''The man had cared for his dragon partner since before it emerged from its egg and shared his Od with it; their souls were bound together.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 17. became a dragon rider, and it grew to be his beloved partner. When Balleroy conspired with [[Gramdart Holstoy]] and the Insect Cage Clan in a rebellion, he and Carillon worked together to attack Vincent Vollachia. However, it was knocked out of the sky by [[Julius Juukulius]]'s Al Clauseria, which gave it a fatal injury. Before Carillon's death, Balleroy comforted it in its last moments by patting its nose, and he asked it to tell Miles to wait for him. ==Trivia== *Despite appearing purple in official illustrations, Carillon has been described as having two distinct colors. It was said to be green in Ex Volume 4''The result was that a green flying dragon got caught in the rainbow maze and then quickly began to drop through the air.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 18. and dark in a line exclusive to the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] version of Arc 8.''Clad in a fierce wind, that dark, undead flying dragon swooped into the dragon carriage, and snatched up Lamia.'' In the past, he lost a part of one of his legs. ==Personality== In the past, Coatl was not above thievery until Leanotte’s avalanche. The avalanche led him to act selflessly by prioritizing saving the townspeople’s lives and watching over them out of a sense of regret and his desire to repent. However, he was prone to being blackmailed, and he refused to put his former comrades, who also contributed to causing the avalanche, in danger. ==History== Coatl was an Itinerant Preacher whose name was famous in the Gustekan Church while simultaneously acting as a member of the Ice Thieves. One day, when he and his cohorts attempted to retrieve the buried treasures they stole, they caused an avalanche and became unable to reach them. The town of Leanotte was caught in the avalanche, and out of regret and repentance for causing it, Coatl decided to participate in rescue operations, losing a leg in the process, and to offer up his savings to restore what was damaged in the town. Afterward, he decided to become a pastor, moving to a nearby church. Watching over the town for years to come, he lived a simple life of atonement, and became known as the Saint of the Avalanche. Years later, a con artist named [[Maqueena]] perceived the connection between Coatl and the Ice Thieves. She masqueraded as a bard and blackmailed Coatl to extort money from him countless times. Twelve years after the avalanche, a survivor from Leanotte, [[Noelle Tuérico]], was forwarded a letter from Coatl by the Church. In the letter, he confessed his sins and revealed that he had belonged to the Ice Thieves. When Noelle arrived at the church he resided in, he welcomed her, affirming the sins he had committed, and requesting that retribution be limited only to his life. Noelle, whose reason for joining the Gustekan Church had been to exact revenge against all of the Ice Thieves, refused to accept the result. She tortured Coatl in an attempt to force him to divulge the identities of his peers, but he refused, leading Noelle to murder him by dealing a blow to his head. ==Navigation== {{Gusteko Navbox}} [[Category:Gustekan Church]] [[Category:Deceased]]

{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Admonsah |Image = Admonsah LN character design.png |Kanji = アドモンサ |Romaji = Adomonsa |Alias = |Nickname = |Race = Multi-Arm Tribe |Gender = Male |Hair Color = Unknown |Eye Color = Unknown |Affiliation = [[Gusteko]]

Slave |Status = Alive |Equipment = Knives |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10|Tanpenshuu Volume 10]]}} '''Admonsah''' (アドモンサ) is a former travelling entertainer and slave. ==Appearance== Admonsah, as a member of the Multi-Arm Tribe, has dark blue skin, a tall figure, and four arms. He is a young man who wears a long robe to cover the scars that cover his body and the white burn marks left on his neck he received from a [[Meteor#Collar of Subservience|Collar of Subservience]]. ==Personality== Admonsah has a kind, honest, and gentle disposition. He is considerate and acts protective of children. ==History== ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 1|One Wild Night]]=== For years, Admonsah was a slave who suffered abuse at the hands of a cruel slave owner who whipped him and shocked him with a Collar of Subservience. He gained his skills in knife throwing under the slave owner. Eventually, he got in a confrontation with his owner, used his fists to crush and kill the man in self-defense near the town of Leanotte, managed to remove his slave collar, and took all of his former owner's belongings. The next day, he sought refuge at the nearby church that [[Coatl|Pastor Coatl]] lived in, finding [[Maqueena]] and [[Podoso]] within it. [[Omega]]'s [[Omega Party|group]] and [[Noelle Tuérico]] quickly followed, and the seven of them were forced to stay inside it as a shelter for an ongoing blizzard outside. While Podoso and Maqueena moved to a separate part of the church, [[Trellock]] arrived, and Admonsah was the one to hand him a towel. A short time later, Podoso and Maqueena discovered Coatl's corpse in the church's hidden basement, and the whole group followed, seeing the scene for themselves. Admonsah quietly listened as Podoso disclosed a recent string of serial murders and Omega deduced the situation until she pieced together his involvement in the death of the man from the previous day and exposed his circumstances and past to everyone in the basement. However, everyone except Maqueena recognized his kindness and was sympathetic to him. Noelle, an Itinerant Preacher, forgave Admonsah for his actions, and he was comforted by [[Colette]] as he began to weep. When Maqueena was close to having her true profession exposed, she used Muskrim to escape the church, rendering everyone apart from Noelle unconscious. In the end, Maqueena was exposed for her crimes as a con artist, Trellock was revealed to be the one responsible for the serial murders, and Podoso, hypothesizing that Admonsah's crime may very well be attributed to the actual serial killer, offered the young man to become his assistant. The two parted ways with Omega's group on friendly terms, taking Maqueena with them to Leanotte. ==Abilities== '''Equipment''': Admonsah is skilled at launching knives at fast speeds to hit targets as part of a performance. He views his knives as simple tools and does not use them as weapons. ==Navigation== {{Gusteko Navbox}} [[Category:Slaves]]

Noble |Status = Deceased |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Ex Volume 6]]}} '''Cragrell Dawson''' (クラグレル・ドーソン) was the leader of the Demi-Human Alliance and the sole leader who succeeded the Alliance's previous three leaders. After the Demi-Human Alliance fell and the fighting ended, he was the representative who met with [[Gionis Lugunica]] and signed the treaty that officially concluded the war. ==Appearance== Cragrell belonged to a subspecies of lizard humans. He was an elderly man who had green scales, a yellow crest on his head, three-fingered hands, and a long tongue that often darted in and out of his thick lips. At a glance, he looked similar to a frog human or a lizard human, but his eyes were more similar to a fish's than a reptile's. He also had the capability to keep objects in his stomach. ==Personality== Cragrell was a self-deprecating man who described himself as feeble and stubborn. He cared deeply about his comrades and assisted others who shared his feelings. ==History== As one of the leaders of the Demi-Human Alliance, Cragrell was an intermediary between [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] and [[Libre Fermi]]. He did not take part in combat and merely watched as Valga brought [[Sphinx]] into the Alliance and became its backbone, having Shamrock Valley cleared out for her plans. A couple of years later, following Libre's death at Aihiya Swamp, Valga and Sphinx's apparent deaths at the Royal Catle, and the rise of the Sword Saint, [[Theresia van Astrea]], negotiations with the Kingdom finally ensued. In due course, Cragrell agreed to end the war peacefully. Following the war's end, Cragrell was conferred a rank of nobility for his contributions to ending the war and granted a mansion in the Royal Capital. His mansion was kept strictly guarded to prevent the possibility of his assassination and having his death reignite the flames of war. When [[Stride Vollachia]] began his attacks in Lugunica, [[Theresia van Astrea]], visited him to request his cooperation, and the two of them had a conversation about the Demi-Human War and the past. It ultimately ended with Cragrell agreeing to cooperate with Theresia and the Kingdom. Because Cragrell was already at an advanced age four decades before the beginning of the main story, it is presumed that he is deceased in the present. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Demi-Human Alliance]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Unknown Race]] [[Category:Lizard Human]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Deceased]]

In accordance with his orders, he infiltrated the membership of The Brotherhood and [[Reiner Wahrheit]]'s organization in the past. ==Appearance== Belmont is a thin man with orange hair, cat-like orange eyes, and wears an oversized hat pulled low over his head. Fifteen years before the start of the main story, he was under the age of fourteen, had a short stature, and dressed in a light button-down shirt with cut sleeves and dark pants. Ten years later, he appeared to look a little bit over twenty years of age, and he donned a more casual shirt with a vest and gloves. ==Personality== When he was a boy, Belmont maintained the disposition of an ornery slum child, but in reality, the attitude was a pretense. He displays a deep allegiance to Russell. ==History== ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica]]=== On the day when a ceremony was held to appoint [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] as the new head of House Mathers, Belmont was tasked with stealing the nobleman's golden plume. Although initially successful in stealing the plume, and counterattacking Roswaal to make a getaway, Belmont was eventually cornered in an alleyway until the leader of The Brotherhood, [[Marcos Gildark]], rescued him. Marcos made quick work of Roswaal and made him lose consciousness. With Russell in tow, Roswaal came to reclaim his plume, which bore similarities to fake golden plumes owned by the Golden Wing Faction. Upon recovering his plume and learning of the circumstances between The Brotherhood and the Golden Wing Faction, Roswaal hosted a meeting between both groups which Bel attended. It resulted in both groups agreeing to move to [[Costuul]] so they could begin to create magicreation tools there. Later that night, Belmont met with Russell to receive orders on his next course of action and inform his superior of the origin of the power that affected Marcos earlier in the day. Finished with his duties in the [[Royal Capital]], Belmont followed Russell's orders to accompany the Golden Wing Faction and The Brotherhood to Costuul and keep in touch with him. ===[[First Mission Part 1|First Mission]]=== Ten years later, Belmont, now a young adult, had left Costuul at an indeterminate time and returned to the Royal Capital to infiltrate Reiner Wahrheit's organization, becoming an irreplaceable member of the underground group responsible for distributing the Hexcel drug. While acting as an insider, Belmont got to know [[Julius Juukulius]], who managed to rescue him from capture by the knights. In an attempt to shake up the organization, Belmont spread a rumor that he was affiliated with the knights. The two were assigned to transport Hexcel to the Royal Capital. However, just as the city was about to reach their sight, the members of the organization ambushed them and captured Belmont, suspecting he was a mole for the knights due to his former membership in the Brotherhood that Marcos, the knight commander, used to lead. Holding himself responsible for Belmont's capture, as he had been the mole for the knights who had infiltrated the organization to aid in taking them down, Julius and his two collaborators, [[Bikram Edditz]] and [[Helaine Gatness]], the latter of whom was a covert Six Tongues member like Belmont, hatched a plan to save him before he could be executed by Reiner. Using [[Minor Characters#Blau|Blau]], a member of the organization whom Julius had injured, Helaine drugged him with Hexcel of potent quality, sending him on a rampage that ended with his life being cut short by Reiner's hand while Julius rescued Belmont. The plan succeeded, and Julius sent Belmont outside to a boat along a river where Bikram and Helaine retrieved him. In the end, Julius took down Reiner and another person who had infiltrated the group, a girl calling herself Adelheid, also captured his collaborator, Count [[Minor Characters#Easley Oruon|Easley Oruon]], ending the duo's operations once and for all. With their mission complete, Helaine and Belmont prepared themselves to move to their next tasks, briefly conversing with one another after the latter's reunion with Marcos. Following the incident, Adelheid, who had actually been [[Reinhard van Astrea]] in disguise, bargained with the Six Tongues to promote his father, [[Heinkel Astrea]], to the role of the knights' deputy commander, which they accepted. Following Heinkel's departure from a bar in the Commoner District in which he had been speaking to Reinhard about his promotion, he happened upon Belmont, who told him that his group's people were keeping an eye on his father. Thought Reinhard was surprised that the young man had been a member of the Six Tongues, Belmont surmised that, while acting as Adelehid, he realized that he had been hiding something. Reinhard informed him that he had gained permission to join the knights from Heinkel and subsequently swore he would never swing his sword for the sake of the Six Tongues, a sentiment which Belmont wholeheartedly accepted on behalf of his organization. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Costuul]] [[Category:Six Tongues]]

'''Belka''' (ベルカ) is an original character from [[Re:Zero Witch’s Re:surrection]]. A scholar of [[Witch]] research, she had been tracking the [[Witch Cult]], but ended up captured until she was saved by [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and the others.

==Appearance==
Belka has greyish purple eyes, brown hair, and uses glasses. She wears a white button-down dress, a small corset belt that she keeps her bag attached to, leggings that extend below her knees, and a long, green coat.

==Personality==
Belka has a determined spirit when it comes to advancing her research. She intended on finding new information about an unknown Witch and was interested in said Witch's graveyard.

==Trivia==
*Belka was designed by Fuku Fox, the illustrator of the Tanpenshuu novels starting from [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7|Volume 7]] and onwards.
*The author has previously stated multiple times that he had no intention of introducing a character who actively wears glasses into the story. Despite this, Belka is the first character introduced, non-canon or otherwise, to actively wear glasses.

'''Clarissa''' (クラリッサ) is a member of the [[Beloved Children]]. She plays an antagonistic role in [[Arc 10]].

==Appearance==
Clarissa is a pale woman who wears a coat of an unspecified color that is neither black nor grey, has dark, wavy green hair tucked into her collar, and dark circles under her eyes.<ref>''A woman adorned in a mantle dyed with a color that could not be strictly defined as either black or gray, her billowing dark green hair tucked into the collar, with markedly dark circles under her eyes.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2.</ref> She has a pouch that holds the pebbles she uses for her ability.<ref>''The woman who had been called Clarissa did not respond. Merely, she once again picked out another small shard from the drawstring bag held in her limp arm. A pebble, was what it seemed.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2.</ref>

==Personality==
Clarissa seems to be fearful of her position in the Beloved Children, and she has exhibited a no-nonsense attitude toward the other members out of fear of reprimand of [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]]. Likewise, she is usually downcast, and her lips quiver as she speaks.<ref>''Having done so, her eyes did not meet with anybody else's, instead remaining downcast as she quivered her lips, "C-come on… sit down already… if we don’t get started and finish quickly, Mama will be mad. She’ll be mad… won’t she? I don’t… want that. I don’t, so…"'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> She bears a sense of enmity towards the [[Six Tongues]] for the same reason, as their actions can dictate Mother's mood, which reflects onto the Beloved Children. When on a mission, she does not hesitate to attack her targets, and she has merely wordlessly attacked.

==Abilities==
===Technique===
'''Shattering Technique''': Clarissa has a pouch that contains pebbles within it. Through an unspecified principle, with the action of merely breaking a pebble she pulls from her pouch, she can create cracks and fissures across a wide area, causing it to crumble.<ref>''With one of her arms hanging languidly, her other arm―― in the fingers of her left hand, which she raised in front of her chest, she pinched something that looked like a white shard. That shard was shattered by the movement of her fingers. ――Immediately following that, fissures extended outward from beneath the woman’s feet, writhing like snakes across the cobblestones of the sewers, and closed in on Subaru and the others.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2.</ref> The damage that it can cause can easily cause a large portion of the sewers to collapse, and it has been described that everything affected by her power was reflexively replaced by glass.<ref>''The fissures that had begun to run rampant did not stop at just the floor. Across the walls, across the ceiling, they spanned the sullied stones of the sewers one by one, steadily causing the ancient, damp skeleton supporting the foundation of the Royal Capital to turn a cloudy white. It was almost as if everything within view was being progressively replaced with glass.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2.</ref><ref>''While protecting Crusch upon his back from that rain of pumice and pulling Beatrice close, Subaru sprung far back―― in that instant, the sewers were half buried in the cave-in as the weight returned.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2.</ref> This power can also be used defensively, allowing her to shatter any earth that comes flying at her in an instant.<ref>''Its aim did not falter, thundering toward Clarissa in the recesses of the passage, and yet―― with a ''crack'', as soon as that slight noise was heard, the stones sailing through the air shattered, reduced to dust by the time they reached her.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2.</ref> [[Natsuki Subaru]] speculates that her power should not be able to shatter something without a true physical form, such as fire, but this is left untested.<ref>''"Oi, use fire! If it lacks physical form, she shouldn’t be able to stop it through shattering!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2.</ref>

He plays a supporting role in [[Arc 10]]. ==Appearance== Black Dog is a tall young man with dark skin and golden brown hair. He is described as having a gallant appearance as well as a handsome and refined face, though his face, which is often twisted into a sneer,''Lumbering across the floor, the one to peer into the room without reserve was a tall young man of gallant looks, with swarthy skin and golden brown hair. As he scornfully distorted a face that would have likely been quite masculine if held straight, he brought the bottle of alcohol in his hand to his lips in good humor.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 2. is claimed to not suit his personality.''Even when concealing himself behind a mask and robes, he was a man who gave off an insolent impression, but when stripped of those, laying bare his true face that did not suit his personality, it only served to strengthen his eccentric impression.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 2. When obscuring his appearance, Black Dog dons a yellow uniform with a black overcoat that touches the ground, black gloves and boots, and switches between several masks with different expressions.''The one who spoke thus, who then broke into a great fit of laughter that caused his body to shake, was a man―― and moreover, he could not glean anything beyond the fact that the individual was a tall man. The reason why was because that man was wearing a black costume that concealed his entire body, with his face covered by a clownlike mask.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 19, Section 2. At least one of his masks is known to have Xs in place of eyes,''Tilting his head, tilting his mask, it was as if Clown Mask was making a bewildered face―― actually, he had somehow replaced the truly villainous mask he had first appeared in without them noticing, affixing one with a different facial expression, a design that possessed X marks in place of eyes.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. while another has a crying expression.''Swapping out his mask for the one with the crying expression, Black Dog firmly urged Crusch.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 3. He also briefly wears a waiter's uniform reminiscent of a bartender, though his expression and attitude almost make him appear as if he was wearing entirely different attire.''For the most part, he was supposed to be in the same waiter uniform as Ferris and Rachins, but it was quite strange that due to his words and conduct, he almost appeared to be clad in an entirely different attire.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 2. ==Personality== Black Dog is an extremely talkative person who outwardly acts foolish. However, his words are typically malicious. He will laud praise towards who he is talking to while his tone actually hurling sarcastic insults,''Contrary to his words lauding Subaru in a booming voice, Clown Mask said with his tone of voice that Subaru was entirely unworthy of such praise, as he gave a vigorous round of applause. As that loud applause that seemed to split the air echoed fruitlessly throughout the sewers, Subaru gritted his teeth, silently suffering the abuse wrapped up as praise from his opponent.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. and he will even insult people who should be considered his benefactor. Even after a mere few seconds, one can tell that Black Dog is not a decent person.''Those words and actions, that demeanor, and that vicious gaze directed through his mask; through their mere five-second long encounter, Subaru could immediately understand. ――This clown mask guy was no decent fellow.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 19, Section 2. He shows no qualms towards attacking people he is meeting for the first time with the intent to kill,''The man in a clown mask who had suddenly appeared, a character whose affiliation and motives were entirely unknown; instead of proper greetings such as “Nice to meet you” or “Farewell”, he had opted to send an enormous fireball hurtling toward Subaru and the others.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. as well as attacking uninvolved parties in order to achieve the goals of himself and his associates, and if the person he is talking to does exceeds his expectations, he will pretend it did not happen and continue hurling abuse.''"That just now, was Subaru’s cleverness exceeding your expectations, in fact. What foolish behavior, pretending it didn’t happen and launching cheap jabs at another’s character, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. He is also not above behaving childishly, stomping his feet when being scolded for his behavior,''Raising his voice, Clown Mask stamped his feet, complaining to the person on the other side of the Conversation Mirror.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. and he is fond of using hand gestures that [[Natsuki Subaru]] taught him, particularly the throat slashing gesture.''As Black Dog made snide comments and gestured cutting off his head with his index finger, Subaru and Beatrice responded by booing him with thumbs down in unison. That finger action in itself was something disturbing, but even so, this was the amicable communication method they had cultivated over these two months. It was Subaru who had taught it to him, but it seemed the Black Dog was surprisingly fond of it.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 1. According to [[Beatrice]], rather than having a lack of tact, Black Dog instead lacks comprehension of people's hearts.''"How can you act so high and mighty over that, in fact. No way, was that intended to be an assist just now, I suppose? If so, it’s not a lack of tact, but rather a lack of comprehension when it comes to people’s hearts, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2. ==History== At an unknown point in time, Black Dog, alongside [[Melty Pristis]], became subservient to [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]], who forced them to refer to her as Mama and work as part of her Beloved Children.''"I was formerly one of the Beloved Children. Black Dog was also in the same situation."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. It is unknown how long they worked for her. However, following the [[Subjugation of Sloth]] led by Subaru, they were provided a chance to from the Beloved Children as Mama was panicked.''"Fing…? That is incorrect, but, it did cause Mama to be rattled, and we slipped out amidst the kerfuffle… and here we are."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. Afterward, they joined the Six Tongues, taking on the names of "Black Dog" and "White Sheep", and for the next year, the managed to thwart several of the Beloved Children's plans.''"If that were true, it would have made far more sense for us to have been crushed long ago. It has already been over a year since White Sheep and Black Dog joined us… during that time, we have thwarted the Beloved Children’s intrigues on more occasions than can be counted on a single hand. There would be no purpose to contribute so much."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. ==Abilities== ===[[Magic]]=== Although it is unknown what attribute Black Dog has an affinity for, he is shown to be capable of using magic. However, for unknown reasons, it seems he can only use specific magics a limited number of times, and once he uses one element, he does not seem to be capable of using it again.''"I see, certainly, but what a shame! I already used up my fire, it’s no longer playable!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2. It is unknown if he can replenish his uses of magic. Thus far, he has exhibited the ability to produce fire,''In an instant, a colossal gout of flames lit up the darkness of the sewers, incomparable to the light of the lagmite ore, and a severe wave of heat surged toward Subaru’s party.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 19, Section 2. wind,''Black Dog, who had gladly used Beatrice’s efforts to deal with the collapse to escape it, exclaimed as if laughing, and then gave rise to a gale towards the mountain of rubble that piled up from the collapse, launching a tempest of stones into the depths of the passage.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2. and earth.''As he said this, Black Dog threw himself towards Subaru and Crusch, as well as Beatrice, dragging them all into the sewage in one fell swoop. Just before they hit the water―― unexpectedly, his view was obstructed by something dark, and the anticipated embrace of the contaminated water did not come. Upon closer inspection, it was an enormous unfinished sphere that had been produced from earthen clods by Black Dog, snugly wrapping and enveloping them――, "Please! Believe in him!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 2. Furthermore, the flames he produces are capable of changing colors, from orange, to green,''Nimbly swapping to one of the masks kept in reserve on his robe, Dogblack had green flames alight on both of his hands, and tried to curve them around in a spin to intercept Schcru.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 2. to blue.''Uttering that, Crusch planted a foot forward, and Black Dog, swapping out his mask, set his right hand alight with a blue flame as he used his left to thrust White Sheep from beside him over towards Subaru and Beatrice.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 3. It is unclear what significance there is to the changing colors, however. ===[[Curse]]=== '''[[Curse#Six Tongues's Curse Mark|Curse Mark]]''' (呪印, ''Juin''): After joining the Six Tongues, [[Russell Fellow]] placed a curse mark on him that, according to Black Dog, is capable of killing him.''"I already said the cause and reason! Just how much of a pushover are you? If we let that woman go, do you really think that sly bastard would let us off the hook? I’m not about to die to a curse mark!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 3. ===Other=== '''Smokescreen''': It is unclear if he is using a tool or magic to produce it, but Black Dog can produce a large amount of black smoke which can act as a smokescreen to obscure his and his allies' movements from their enemies. ===Equipment=== *'''[[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|Conversation Mirror]]''' (対話鏡, ''Taiwa-kyō''): Black Dog has a Conversation Mirror on his person which allows him to get in touch with his allies.''"By any chance, is that a Conversation Mirror?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. *'''Cognitive Disruption Cloak''': Black Dog has been lent a cloak with cognitive disruption built into it, allowing him to obscure his features from others. ==Trivia== *Black Dog is likely intended to be a depiction of [[Salum Pristis|Wolf]], an exclusive character from [[Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World: The Prophecy of the Throne|The Prophecy of the Throne]], in the main story. However, despite sharing the same character design, his name remains unconfirmed. **In Arc 10, Black Dog refers to himself as the Malevolent Magician, the same title used by Wolf in the game. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Beloved Children Navbox}} [[Category:Six Tongues]] [[Category:Unknown Race]]

'''Arbalest''' (アルバレスト) is a member of the [[Beloved Children]]. He plays an antagonistic role in [[Arc 10]].

==Appearance==
Arbalest is an elderly man with dark skin, grey hair, green eyes, thick eyebrows, a thick beard, and a massive build that is tall and wide. He wears work clothes that have a style similar to what is seen in [[Kararagi]].<ref>''His massive build was both tall and wide, and when positioned next to the petite youth, it was the same difference in stature as between an adult and child. Dressed in work clothes reminiscent of the styles one might find in Kararagi, the old man turned towards the youth, and, "Hey, Reborn, just hypothetically speakin’, what kinda answer were ya hopin’ for when ya asked that question just now? Go ahead ‘n say whatever answer ya wanted. It can be hypothetical, I don’t mind."'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>

==Personality==
Arbalest acts like a generally friendly man, and he has a tendency to bring up hypotheticals, whether in response to others' actions or in a discussion.<ref>''"――. What, it was just a hypothetical, a hypothetical I tell ya."'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> He believes that respect ought to be shown to objects or people that have existed for many years, which includes himself.<ref>''"I’ll have ya know that this round table uses old wood from a tree that's several hundreds of years old. Ya oughta pay respects to things that’ve gone through so many long years. Most of the time, those years don’t lie. Same goes for my eminence. Respect the elderly."'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> Despite his general attitude, however, he has displayed a certain level of hostility, having said that, hypothetically, in a manner of respect for him as an elder, if he told someone to die, that they should hurry up and die.<ref>''"Listen up, don’t take this too seriously. Just think of it as a hypothetical. When I say ta respect the elderly, this is what I mean. ――If I ever tell ya to die, ya hurry up ‘n die."'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> When participating in a meeting with the other members of the Beloved Children, he tends to stay on track with the topics being discussed. He also seems to have a certain level of pride in his craftsmanship, and he prepares himself for both praise and criticism.<ref name="craftsman">''"What, I’m the eminent one who made this round table, after all. Be it praise or be it heartless criticism, ya gotta be prepared for whatever might be said, right?"'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>

==Abilities==
===Physical Traits===
'''Expert Woodcraftsmen''': Arbalest is skilled at crafting things from wood, having been responsible for creating the table used by the Beloved Children.<ref name="craftsman" />

'''Bellaris''' (ベラリス) is a member of the [[Beloved Children]]. She plays an antagonistic role in [[Arc 10]].

==Appearance==
Bellaris is a woman with yellow eyes and purplish black hair that appears to be so long that it can reach the floor and is curled at the ends. She wears a black dress with one sleeve and leaves one of her shoulders exposed, is slitted from the right side of the waist down, reaches the floor and is fuchsia at the ends, has fuchsia flowers and black feathery protrusions along the top of the dress, a large fuchsia flower adornment at the right side of her waist. She also wears a large purple and black hat with fuchsia spider lilies on it, black high heels, a black collar that matches her dress, and a black glove that matches her dress. Despite giving off a mature look, the gleam in her eyes is said to be reminiscent to that of a daydreaming young girl.<ref>''Pronouncing so, a woman’s excitement-filled voice rudely sliced through the atmosphere. With cheeks flushed red, the one standing with both her hands placed on the table was a woman clad in a black dress, her purple-tinged black hair, so long it seemed like it could reach the floor, crowned with a large hat. Contrary to her mature appearance, her eyes gleamed like a daydreaming young girl, and she held her cheeks with her own two hands.'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>

==Personality==
Bellaris has a fixation on the concept of love and speaks about it positively, excitedly, and excessively, bringing it up at seemingly every opportunity she gets. Due to this, she consistently creates justifications based on others' interactions with each other to assert that one person is in love with another person, regardless of their age or gender.<ref>''"――Heyyy, I just realized something. Just now when Tornel protected Arbalest, it was an outburst of his emotions that stemmed from cherishing him… in other words, aren’t the two of you in love? My goodness! What an incredible age gap! What blazing love!"'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref><ref>''"None of that fucking “This is surely it”! Quit spouting all that creepy shit, Bellaris… you love-obsessed FREAK! Day and night, that goddamn brain of yours is always churning and mulching around that romance SLOP in your head."'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> She will even posit that others are in love with her based on their interactions with her.<ref>''"Come on now, are you getting embarrassed about being part of a romance? If you keep that up, your precious someone is going to turn the other way… wait? Perhaps, it’s that you just don’t want me to misunderstand? Is that why you’re acting like this? Do you like me? I like you too!"'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> Bellaris also believes the greatest obstacle to love is death, as in her mind, there is nothing that separates two people more than death but also brings the love between two closer together. Having said that, her mentality comes off as insane to other people, including to other members of the Beloved Children. Furthermore, similarly to [[Clarissa]], she has a deep-seated fear of doing anything that could create trouble for [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mama]].

==Abilities==
===Techniques===
'''Ring Finger''' (薬指, ''Kusuriyubi''): Bellaris uses a technique that employs various chemicals in combat, using them for various purposes, both in support and in offense. However, because she uses airborne chemicals and agents, it is possible to use wind to blow them away and redirect them elsewhere, likewise with the effects that she might be able to trigger.
*'''Multi-Colored Explosions''': By using a sulfuric compound, Bellaris can generate explosions with flames of various colors. The explosions carry enough power to injure the likes of someone like [[Reborn]] or cause the limited collapse of structures around her. However, prior to the explosions, the smell of sulfur permeates the air, which can provide the targets a warning and give them a chance to disperse the compound beforehand or redirect the explosions elsewhere.
*'''Emotion Amplification''': By using a chemical that affects one's brain, she can remove the limiters on their emotions.<ref>''"――We lost the ability to regulate our emotions?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 3.</ref> Even the emotions that one becomes used to over times, such as minor annoyance at someone's actions or slight excitability, will intensify greatly, and in some cases, it will lead those with violent temperaments or even those who are usually calm to attack each other.<ref>''Crusch drawing her sword, and Black Dog immediately resorting to a use of force, no matter how one looked at it, they had both acted way too quickly. Not to mention, Subaru had only gotten impatient and irritated, and White Sheep had been rendered unable to do anything as she wept and sobbed. Everyone had been acting slightly off.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 3.</ref> She typically uses this to incite panic or discomposure in her targets.<ref>''"I believe it was. Strife was incited amongst our group. They succeed in splitting us up…"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 3.</ref>
*'''Pain Numbing Agent''': It is implied by Reborn that Bellaris can use a chemical of some kind to numb one's sensation to pain, allowing the target to continue fighting in spite of their injuries.

==Trivia==
*Bellaris's name was originally '''Lycoris''' (リコリス, ''Rikorisu'') upon her debut. However, shortly before the release of [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 46|Volume 46]], her name was revised to be Bellaris to avoid confusion with [[Lycoris Anthurium]]. 
**The name Lycoris comes from a [[wikipedia:Lycoris (genus)|genus]] of flowers.

'''Dandon''' (ダンドン) is a member of the [[Beloved Children]]. He plays an antagonistic role in [[Arc 10]].

==Appearance==
Dandon is a tall young man with black hair, golden eyes, dark skin, and a long black cloak with gold and white accents.<ref>''Speaking with a projecting voice as he walked with flurried, clopping footsteps, a single young man entered the room. His skin was dark, and clad in a long black cloak with accents of white and gold, he was a handsome young man with a tall, well-proportioned body. Accompanying him from behind, were two girls who gave off very different impressions.'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>

==Personality==
Dandon generally expresses a relatively friendly and jovial mood in the presence of his “siblings”, whom he claims to care for and consider precious.<ref>''"Hahaha, I don’t fancy myself any kind of “Discriminator” who would favor either Reborn or Bellaris. They are both equally precious siblings to me! It’s simply, Bellaris, I don’t fancy myself any kind of “Pervert” who would bear romantic feelings to my brothers and sisters, so do ensure you don’t forget it!"'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> Although his cheerfulness may slightly slip if he is faced with an unexpected outcome,<ref>''Dandon gave a friendly smile to the party reflected on the mirror’s surface, but as he listened to the words they said in reply, that expression of his slightly stiffened.'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref><ref>''Eventually, he took the wanted posters stacked up atop the round table, and relocated them to the sole vacant seat―― the seat of honor in which nobody was sitting, before placing his hands over his face as if lamenting.'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> he remains composed and serious, immediately taking action with the intent to resolve an issue.<ref>''"――Deploy the “Supporters”. Why, this is no cause for panic."'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> He also has a tendency to emphasize certain words that he uses to refer to people.

Dandon is the one who [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mama]] tasked with being in charge of keeping the Beloved Children in order.<ref>''“My dear brother and honored grandfather, I told you to take your seats, did I not? It is I, after all, whom Mama placed in charge of keeping everyone in line. I should so hate to brand you an ‘encumbrance’, grandfather.”'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> As such, he takes charge of their meetings and orders his fellow siblings to act. He has also claimed to be governing a nation.<ref>''“Right then, ‘scuse me, ‘scuse us, we ended up running a tad late! Terribly sorry for gathering you all today. Mind you, governing a nation’s a proper busy job, amirite!?”'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>

==Abilities==
===Equipment===
'''Conversation Mirror''' (対話鏡, ''Taiwa-kyō''): A meteor that allows its user to communicate with others over a long distance by connecting with a separate Conversation Mirror, similar to a cell phone. Dandon owns a Conversation Mirror and has used it to communicate with an unknown party.<ref>''"With those words, Dandon, who had just been about to wrap up the discussion, reached into his long cloak, and pulled out a small mirror―― a Conversation Mirror, before opening it up in his hand."'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>
