She is a half-elf and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]] in the [[Royal Selection]], who met [[Natsuki Subaru]] on the day he was summoned to the world. Emilia has played a supporting role in every arc, with major and pivotal roles in more than half of them. Born and raised by her [[Fortuna|aunt]] in [[Elior Forest]], Emilia is a half-elf terribly beloved by the spirits. However, during the [[Permafrost of Elior Forest]], her memories were locked away, and she was frozen for approximately 100 years. After being watched over by [[Puck]], she eventually became a Royal Selection candidate in the hopes of unfreezing the residents of the forest. Through many trials and tribulations, including mass discrimination, she came into her role well, holding many feats under her belt, including helping to defeat the [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]] and the [[Great Rabbit]], becoming the administrator of the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], and forming an alliance with [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. ==Appearance== Emilia is a beautiful half-elf with long silver hair, purple-blue eyes, and pointed ears. She wears a white and purple outfit along with a white flower in her hair. Although she appears to be in her late teens, Emilia's chronological age remains unknown, though mentally she has been stated to be in her early to mid-teens. She has styled her hair in a variety of ways, as per her contract with Puck, the [[Spirit#The Beast of the End, Puck|Beast of the End]] was the one who arranged her hairstyle. Though she rarely uses it in the present, for a time, she wore a white cloak with cat ears on the hood that had [[Magic#Types|cognitive obstruction]] enchanted on it. She can be seen wearing this several times in the early arcs, to protect herself from the sands of the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] in [[Arc 6]], and in [[Arc 7]] to temporarily disguise herself. At the end of [[Arc 4]] during Subaru's knight ceremony, Emilia wore a white dress and a white mantle. The mantle had purple fur lining its edges, and the inside of it was also purple. She also wore a hairpiece that had a flower ornament on each side of her head. In [[Arc 5]], she wore a yukata in the Water Plumage Inn, and after being taken by Regulus, she was made to wear a special wedding dress, though once the fight against him got underway, she ripped the dress at the legs for more freedom of movement. In Arc 6, her outfit is very reminiscent of Fortuna's. During one side story, Emilia also donned a maid's uniform reminiscent of Rem and Ram's. When Emilia still lived in Elior Forest as a child, she had a different set of clothes with the same color pattern. She had a light green ribbon instead of her necklace, a different flower in her hair, and could be seen wearing a light-purple headband. ==Personality== Emilia is a very kind, good-natured, and energetic girl who is also incredibly selfless and likes to take care of others, though she herself sometimes refuses to admit this, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness or something everyone would do in her position despite that often not being true. Emilia has a tendency to use a myriad of archaic words, such as "dunderhead". This quirk of hers is mostly pointed out by Subaru, who has a tendency to tease her about it, though Emilia doesn't pay it any mind. Fortuna has also questioned where she had picked up such a vocabulary. Furthermore, Emilia also has a strong tendency to drag out the word "really", which can be best observed when she's talking about something dear or important to her. This quirk was likely picked up from Fortuna, who had the same verbal tic. She is rarely angered by the people around her, only having been angered by the despicable actions of [[Pandora]], Regulus, and [[Al|Aldebaran]]'s [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|betrayal]] thus far. She is a poor liar as well, to the point that people would just be suspicious of her if she tried.''All the suspicions aside, Emilia was simply not good at lying. When she thought about how trying too hard would just increase the likelihood of being exposed, she just shrugged her shoulders in resignation.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2. She also has a strong belief in promises, having been raised by Fortuna to believe that if someone makes a promise, they should always keep them, something she took to heart not just with the [[spirit]]s around her but also with the people she interacts with, and it is because of this that she sometimes became emotional with Subaru, a habitual promise breaker. She is someone who believes in a person's good nature, and she displays a kindness similar to Subaru's, typically wanting to befriend others even despite race, appearance, and even position putting herself and others at odds, and she does not want to fight with others if she can help it, preferring to talk with her enemies and understand them rather than fight if it is an option. That said, if she is forced to, she will enter a fight with the intention of killing if it is necessary, though her fighting style still focuses on capturing her enemies alive, something very reminiscent of her gentle nature. Just like the other Royal Selection Candidates, Emilia is also driven by a strong motive which shapes most of her actions, be it rational or irrational. Following her awakening by Puck in Elior Forest, she desperately tried to do something about the frozen elves in the forest. She cleaned them daily, talked to them, and spent a great deal of time and effort with them, trying to somehow get rid of their icy fate to absolutely no avail. However, a couple of months before the start of the main story, she was visited by an eccentric mage who introduced himself as [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]]. Though they initially started off on the wrong foot which caused Roswaal and Puck to fight for half a day, the two decided to form a truce, and Roswaal presented Emilia with a plan that would allow her to unfreeze her people in the frozen Forest. By becoming the 42nd monarch of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, Emilia would gain access to the Dragon's Blood locked up in the vaults of the Royal Castle, its magical properties possibly able to unfreeze the frozen inhabitants of the Great Elior Forest. Emilia hastily accepted the offer and decided to participate in the Royal Selection and forging a goal of having the Kingdom be equal and free from prejudice. When she was young, Emilia was a mischievous child who was prone to sneaking out of her room, creating messes, or coming up with schemes like faking stomach pains in order to get attention and get what she wanted. However, she was also kind and wanted to be friends with others, and she would feel guilty at seeing others being troubled by her actions. She was usual seen smiling and playful, and she was often happy. However, following the attack on her village and seeing her family killed and manipulated, she showed a vengeful side when she attacked Pandora and lost control of herself, leading to her powers going out of her control. After losing her memories and waking up about a century later, she was diligent about caring for the frozen people of her village and often felt guilt about their situation. She was also exposed to prejudice and hostility for the first time during her trips to nearby villages and the attack by [[Melakuera]]. Because of this, though her kind nature did not diminish, she became somewhat closed off, and she remained naive. Initially, because of her supposed "selfishness" as well as having to protect herself from the prejudice that was flung toward her, Emilia closed herself off from others and did not entrust others with her emotions or how she felt about different situations she was subjected to, as she was always of the mindset to endure passively and maintain a valiant disposition. Likewise, she was quick to give up on things she didn't understand, blame it on something, and then naively assume that listening to Puck was the right thing to do.''Previously, Emilia had been quick to give up on things she did not understand. She was quick to blame it on something, give up, and naively assume that doing as Puck said was the right thing to do. Lately, she had been enlisting the help from others who were good at thinking, like Ram and Otto.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 88, Section 1. This resulted in her becoming both mentally and emotionally fragile, which in turned caused her to be overly obstinate and somewhat childish about certain subjects. This led her to constantly depend on other people for support, most notably Puck or Subaru who became her main pillars of emotional support, and without them, she would become more and more emotionally unstable, to a point where in a failed loop she believed that if she succeeded and completed the task that she had been entrusted, despite having failed so many times, Puck or Subaru would return to her. In Arc 4, following her period of extreme emotional instability after Puck severed his contract with her and Subaru breaking another promise with her, things that respectively affected her since her only family had supposedly left her and her belief in promises was being casually left aside, Emilia completely lost faith in herself, leading her to hide from others. After having an argument with Subaru, however, in which she spilled all of her own insecurities onto him and believed that he was only looking at her through rose-colored glasses without seeing her flaws, not considering her feelings, not putting his faith in her like she was for him, and breaking his promises which she believed was a sacred thing, Subaru not only threw all of those notions aside but even told her all of those flaws and frustrations to her face, and despite telling her what he really thought of her, he still claim to love her and have faith in her, enabling Emilia to stand up and challenge her painful past in order to overcome the three trials presented by the [[Echidna|Witch of Greed]]. With this and seeing everything that Subaru had carved into Echidna's Tomb, Emilia became significantly stronger both mentally and emotionally, able to withstand Roswaal's harassment, shake his beliefs and view of her, and keep faith in herself, and because of this, she started to become more charismatic and reliable, which even the stalwart [[Ram]] had come to truly respect, to the point that she wanted to entrust to her the Royal Selection for Roswaal's sake. In the end, she was able to overcome all of the trials, which each tested her mind and beliefs, and [[Sanctuary Incident|liberated]] the [[Sanctuary]]. Over the following year, Emilia developed a great deal of self-confidence and greatly improved her self-image even after her contract with Puck was severed, forcing her to break out of her shell and live on her own. Thanks in part to this, Emilia's name becoming household,''It had been more than a year since the Royal Selection began, and in the Kingdom of Lugunica, those unaware that one of the candidates was a silver-haired half-elf with amethyst eyes were few. To put it Subaru-style, Emilia, as Emilia, had become a household name.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 1. and her scarcely being discriminated against anymore,''For that reason, it had been a while since she had been called the Witch of Envy. And even when called so, she had remained unperturbed. ――For she had the conviction to confidently say, “You’re mistaken”.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 1. she came to realize that she was no longer hurt by people referring to her as the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]],''The cause of her surprise had been twofold: one reason was how long it had been since she was treated like the Witch of Envy, the other was that being called the Witch of Envy had not hurt her.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 1. and the times she went outside with her recognition inhibiting cloak became sparse.''As a result, even occasions when Emilia needed to wear her usual cognitive disruption robe had become sparse. And the reason she had donned it so diligently in the Empire for the first time in a long while, was to prevent people from recognizing her as Emilia.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 1. Instead of giving up on what she didn't understand and relying completely on others, she came to start trying to understand such things on her own, especially as someone in a position of importance who can directly affect others' lives.''But she did not want to turn into a person who simply changes the people to rely on. Petra mentioned that the emperor of Vollachia was very good at utilizing people. But even an emperor who was good at manipulating people still needs to think about what he was going to use them for. And those in important positions, those who are in the center of everyone else’s lives, must be able to do that. That was what Emilia had chosen to work towards.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 88, Section 1. Though her view on the world and human relations is still also rather childish and easy-going, she learned how to balance that shortcoming out with a level of professionalism and a unique air of authority. This change is particularly evident in the initial chapters of Arc 5, where some characters even point it out, and, according to [[Heinkel Astrea]], the rumors surrounding her don't seem to be true anymore. Namely, her timidity and indecisiveness she was known for around the Kingdom was nowhere to be seen. She became much bolder, to the point that when she was captured by Regulus, rather than sitting and waiting for someone to rescue her, she took advantage of her position to gather information from the inside, relay that information to a reliable ally, and remain in her dangerous position so that she could protect everyone who was effectively being held hostage. Her kindness remained just as strong, something which led all of those hostages, [[Sylphy Elmart]] and the women Regulus took as his wives, to believe in her and entrust her with their fates. Also, despite understanding Subaru's feelings for her after he unleashed them all on her and even kissed her, because she didn't fully understand her own feelings nor the idea of what it meant to fall in love with someone, she did not improve romantically, but despite that, she did believe that she knew who she would fall in love with.''"Ah, I’m sorry. I’ve already decided on the person I’ll fall in love with."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 104, Section 2. Over time, she began to exhibit other sides of herself when the situation involved Subaru. In Arc 5, when she was split up from Subaru, she believed that he would be able to find and fight alongside her, which was further reinforced when he gave his speech to [[Priestella]]. In Arc 6, she started showing signs of jealousy after seeing [[Shaula]]'s interactions with him, and when Subaru lost his memories, she became very anxious, wanting to hear him refer to the nickname he had given her and say the habitual lines he was known to say. Likewise, when her name was temporarily eaten, though she was a little shaken, her morale was tremendously boosted after Subaru not only retrieved his memories but even remembered her, which allowed her to fight to her best. Following Subaru's being taken to Vollachia, she showed great resolve to go find him, even being willing to risk smuggling herself into the country, despite her position and the closed borders. In [[Arc 8]], she showed a bolder side to her relationship with Subaru, even claiming that while she was not his, he was hers, and she was shown willing to trust in his heavy decision to accept [[Spica]], in spite of her [[Rui Arneb|past]]. In [[Arc 9]], following his capture, she grew extremely angry when he was betrayed by someone he was worried about and felt the urge to go assist him immediately, and even started to recognize an unknown emotion inside of her towards Subaru, which she failed to place but led her to want to be near him again. ==History== ===Early Life=== About a century ago, Emilia lived with her aunt on her father's side, Fortuna, in Elior Forest.''"I'm the younger sister of your father, Emilia. My brother... your father."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 1, Section 3. For reasons not known to her, she was considered a rather special child and was subsequently forced to spend most of her days isolated from the other elven villagers in a place called the "Princess Room" with only Fortuna and her dolls as company. Eventually, her frustrations reached a boiling point, and in an act of defiance, she broke her promise to not leave her room only to venture into the forest to search for everyone. Free to do what she wanted and not holding obligations that were never explained to her, Emilia snuck out on several occasions while hiding the fact, doing everything from exploring to behaving mischievously. It was in this room she discovered she had an affinity for spirits, and summoned countless lesser spirits to play with her. She did not realize how rare the ability was and referred to them as fairies. One day, she snuck into the center of the village and witnessed [[Witch Cult|strange men]] giving supplies such as food and clothes to the elves. Emilia then witnessed a tall, green-haired man idly chatting with Fortuna, with her calling him [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Geuse]]. Emilia started to view him as a rival for Fortuna's affection, as Fortuna made a "special face" at him and smiled, expressions which she only showed to Emilia, as well as having everyone in the village meet them, leaving her in the Princess Room. She overheard Geuse asking about her safety and then asking her about a mysterious seal which was supposedly kept safe somewhere in the forest. After sneaking back into the Princess Room and being visited by Fortuna, she set out to find this seal, and trekked through the forest, led by the lesser spirits who showed her the way. She finally came to a clearing deep within the forest. Before her, stood a pair of huge metal doors that stood by themselves. Deducing that this was the "seal" everyone was talking about, Emilia, now satisfied, decided to head back to her room. By chance, she ran into Geuse, who was strolling around in the forest. When Geuse saw her, he wept tears of joy, leading to Emilia forgiving him. ===[[Elior Forest Team, Waiting for the Thaw]]=== After meeting Geuse for the first time, Emilia wanted to be friends with him. However, Fortuna kept her away from him. Thinking that Fortuna would panic if she faked stomach pains, she believed that Fortuna would ask what she wanted and let her see Geuse. However, when she committed to her act, Fortuna seemed to panic more than she expected, and she brought her to the village square and asked for help. [[Archi Elior|Archi]] asked if she was acting, getting him into an argument with Fortuna since Emilia had never fallen ill even when the entire village had when they all ate rotten appas. Geuse decided to pray for her since she had helped him before, causing the whole village to lower their heads in silence. Feeling guilty, Emilia began to cry and said that her stomach had stopped hurting, causing everyone to rejoice, and Geuse told her that instead of apologizing when she troubles someone to instead say thank you. Afterward, walking back the way she came, Geuse held the sleeping Emilia on his back while Fortuna thanked him for going along with her act. Fortuna recalled how she worried for her, even after Archi became her guardian, and after Emilia called her a crybaby in her sleep, Geuse claimed that Fortuna was just like Emilia when she was younger with her brother, to her annoyance. ===[[Permafrost of Elior Forest]]=== It's unknown how many times following their first interaction, Emilia and Geuse spent time together; however, sometime later, the duo, together with Fortuna, who supposedly quickly caught wind of Geuse's and Emilia's meeting, went on a walk around the forest. There, Emilia revealed her fairy-friends, leaving both Fortuna and Geuse in utter shock. When the two argued about how she could develop her potential abilities as a spiritual arts user, Emilia commented how they were like her parents, which left Fortuna greatly embarrassed. When Fortuna asked her to return to the Princess Room, Emilia made her promise to let her see Geuse again. Just as she was about to leave, however, disaster struck, and Emilia's life was changed forever. A white-haired figure stopped in front of them, an introduced themselves as the [[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishop of Greed, Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]], Regulus Corneas. Geuse demanded to know why he came, stating that Regulus had broken their agreement,''"I was promised that no one save me would involve themselves with this forest and this incident!"'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 3, Section 1. and that they could have discussed this back at their Church,''"If you do not like the arrangement, then you should have raised the issue at the church!"'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 3, Section 1. but every complaint was swiftly countered by Regulus to no avail. As Fortuna held Emilia, another figure revealed themselves: Pandora, the [[Witch#Witch of Vainglory, Pandora|Witch of Vainglory]]. She stated she had come to open the mysterious seal of Elior Forest. When Fortuna saw Pandora, she flew into a fit of rage, stating that she would avenge her brother and sent a huge hurdle of Ice Spikes flying her way. Upon seeing her initial attack has no effect on her, Fortuna proceeded to summon a huge mass of ice and dropped it onto the pair's heads, crushing them to death. However, as the ice shattered into pieces, Regulus stepped forth, not a scratch on him or on Pandora. Geuse then ordered Fortuna to escape with Emilia, saying that their lives were more important than vengeance. As Fortuna ran with Emilia, she witnessed Geuse remove a strange box from his robes, containing an [[Authority#Authority of Sloth|unknown essence]]. Emilia then screamed, as Geuse slammed the box up to his chest and absorbed the contents, gaining the Authority of Sloth. As Fortuna ran deep into the forest, she stated that she would go back to save Geuse. Emilia begged Fortuna not to leave her, but Fortuna said she would be safe. Archi suddenly arrived and informed her that Geuse's men and the elves were repelling the attack from the assailants. Fortuna then apologized to him for bringing Emilia and herself to the village and burdening them, a notion Archi immediately denied, saying they had helped them. Fortuna then declared she would defend the forest and protect the seal, entrusting Emilia to Archi, promising to her that they would always be together, and then heading back toward Geuse. As Archi ran through the forest, they encountered a black robed man, and prepared to attack him, before he stated that he was one of Petelgeuse's fingers. The member then revealed that the Radical Faction and their leader, Regulus Corneas, the Witch of Vainglory, and the [[Black Serpent]], had arrived at the village. When Archi expressed disbelief, stating it was neigh uncontrollable, one of Petelgeuse's fingers whom they had met confirmed his statement, adding that Pandora possessed the power to vaguely guide it to a general location. The forest then erupted around them, with Archi cursing himself, realizing they had stumbled onto its hunting grounds. The Cultist was suddenly licked by something ominous–he immediately recognized it as the Black Serpent. As Archi attempted to save him, the finger told Archi to run, saying that it was too late for him, as the Black Serpent's poison consumed him, withering his body away, until he died before Archi's eyes. Archi turned around and darted deeper into the woods, however, not long after, something entangled his legs and the two fell. The Black Serpent had made physical contact with Archi. Realizing what has happened, Archi hugged Emilia close to his chest and immediately severed his leg above the knee with Wind Magic and cauterized it with Fire Magic; however, he was too late. The poison had already started to consume his body. Archi, knowing his fate was sealed, ordered Emilia to run towards a nearby patch of flowers, which she did without a second guess. As Emilia ran far beyond the flowers she was sent to, the lesser spirits revealed themselves again, and flew away, almost as if wanting Emilia to follow them, which she naively did. The spirits led her back to the Seal in the depths of Elior Forest. There, Pandora stood, arms widespread. She then revealed she had been controlling the spirits the entire time, helping her locate the Seal. Pandora then asked her to open the seal, to which Emilia responded she couldn't. The Witch naturally didn't react nicely to that, stating she would rip the forest from the ground-up if she didn't, and also stated Fortuna and Geuse are okay, and that she would leave the forest if Emilia listened to her and gave her what she was asking for. Emilia then discovered she indeed possessed the key to the door,''"She looked at her hand. There she saw an old, large silver key."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 4, Section 1. but then remembered Fortuna had made her promise never to open the Seal. Before Pandora could react, Fortuna arrived and assaulted Pandora, saying she would not let her harm Emilia. Pandora merely smiled and kept reverting her own death, every time Fortuna had killer her. Shortly after Fortuna, Geuse had made contact with the group as well. The two confirmed Emilia's safety and Pandora's presence and vowed to end it together. As Fortuna rushed forward and engaged in further one-sided slaughter with Pandora, the Witch used her Authority of Vainglory one last time, to trick Geuse's eyes, resulting in him tearing a hole in Fortuna's chest, inflicting mortal and irreparable wounds to Emilia's aunt. Geuse, realizing what he had done, snapped. With his reason for fighting lying in a pool of blood, he succumbed to the effects of the Witch Factor of Sloth, as his mind shattered beyond repair. Mere moments before Fortuna passed away, she told Emilia one last time that she loved her very much. Emilia, enraged, unleashed her full magic and attacked Pandora continuously, killing her over and over again as she used her Authority of Vainglory to rewrite her death. Emilia then lost control, and froze Elior Forest entirely, ending the bloodbath at Elior Forest. The last thing she could see before falling asleep, were Pandora and Geuse, now Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti, the newly born Sin Archbishop of Sloth, leaving the forest together. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice|Bonds of Ice]]=== Roughly seven years before the start of the Royal Selection, the ice around Emilia melted and Emilia met Puck. The two began to live in the now snow-covered Elior Forest. Exposed to the outside world for some time now, Emilia came to face the hostile reality of what it meant to be a half-elf in the world, especially one with her appearance which was nearly identical to that of the infamous Witch of Envy. Following those days, she suffered many hardships, not just from neighborhood human towns that feared her, hated her, betrayed her, and attempted to sell her into slavery, but even from higher beings such as one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]], Melakuera, who governed fire mana who sought to exterminate her for the crime of her existence and dangerous power that slept within her. Because of these issues, Emilia minimized any contact with outsiders, sticking to a frugal life by only leaving the forest to trade the magic stones she could find with people willing to deal with her in nearby towns for food and clothing. Humans, who called her the Witch of Frost, mostly tried to avoid her when she came around, but other than these excursions, Emilia would otherwise stay with the frozen elves as a guardian, as they were connected to her past. After the harrowing incident with Melakuera, Emilia formed a contract with Puck to preserve his life after his Od had been damaged. Puck then began to act as her surrogate father and mentor. He used the contract itself to seal parts of her memories that had been tampered with by Pandora.''"If I'm gone, the lid covering your memories will come off."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 4, Section 1. Several months before Subaru arrived, she and Puck were visited by an eccentric man who named himself Roswaal L. Mathers, the first human who didn't react negatively to her appearance. He then invited her to the Royal Selection after being chosen by the Dragon Jewel by giving her a way to save the citizens of Elior Forest, through the usage of the Dragon's Blood.''"The blood of the Dragon, that grants bountiful harvests upon the land, and cures deviant earth. He said it could definitely thaw the forest."'' One Day II, Final Chapter, Section 2. ===[[Emily-san's Maid Path]]=== Shortly after leaving the forest, Emilia encounters and helps [[Annerose Miload]] and her butler, [[Clind]]. Due to this intervention and a letter from Roswaal, Emilia is taken to the Miload mansion, where Annerose decides to take her in as a maid. During her introduction, her name is misheard as “Emily,” a nickname by which she becomes known in that environment. At the mansion, [[Frederica Baumann]] explains that it is a place that shelters discriminated [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], allowing Emilia to remain there. However, Emilia misunderstands the situation as a test imposed by Roswaal to evaluate her effort and character, leading her to take her role as a maid very seriously. Despite her determination, her complete lack of experience with human life and household tasks causes her to fail repeatedly in her duties, and she is regarded as incompetent for the role. Even so, Emilia continues to persevere, convinced that overcoming these difficulties is part of her path toward a greater future. ===[[Emilia's Royal Capital Tour Book]]=== During her visit to the [[Royal Capital]], after getting separated from Ram, she wandered around the capital. She soon saw a [[Mimi Pearlbaton|little girl]] who was struggling to pay for the food she'd eaten. Emilia at first tried to help by paying for it with her own money, only to realize her wallet was missing. She then quickly thought of showing Puck around while doing tricks to earn some change for her. Her plan worked but not as intended as a citizen recognizes Puck as a great spirit and a whole crowd of people flee en masse, leaving their wallets behind due to hysteria, as they thought a half-elf would unleash the great spirit's wrath upon them if they did not pay. The little girl later thanked Emilia for the help she provided. It was a short while after that that her insignia was stolen by [[Felt]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Emilia is an incredibly powerful fighter capable of standing toe to toe with [[Sphinx|beings who declare themselves a Witch]], Sin Archbishops of the Witch Cult, mighty [[Madelyn Eschart|dragonkin]], and even the [[Mezoreia|husk of a Dragon]]. Her power is great enough that the Witch of Vainglory was even forced to retreat after being killed multiple times by her. Furthermore, Emilia also has a powerful charisma that is capable of drawing others to her, including her Authority-wielding knight, a [[Meili Portroute|former assassin]], the Beast of the End, or even those who lived their lives in fear of their captor, something which has given her a large number of allies in spite of the prejudice levied against her. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spritual Arts]]=== Emilia has a natural affinity for the fire attribute, though her suitability for ice spells is significantly better,[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/843489782328057858 Author's Comment] and she has shown this by using her ice in incredibly adaptable ways, such as dropping massive glaciers from the sky which have the potential to devastate entire regions, assaulting her enemy with an ice storm,''Ice pebbles――Though, it was not as pretty as pebbles; it was an ice storm.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2. creating weapons, freezing her enemies solid, or having her ice form in the shape of vines and thorns to bind her enemies.''She raised both hands and slammed them hard onto the ground, and in the next moment, while avoiding Emilia and Tanza, ice spread throughout the street in a manner akin to branches, entrapping the hands, legs, and torsos of the swordsmen. ――That ice had an appearance just like that of a vine of thorns.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 62, Section 2. Furthermore, in terms of sheer magical power, Emilia is stated to be roughly as strong as the original Roswaal A. Mathers, though when it comes to capacity, she outclasses even the current Roswaal. Her [[mana]] is so abnormally great that she easily has the capacity to freeze over an entire forest or the tremendous amount of water spilled by the Grand Mogolade Geyser, according to Emilia, if she gathers a lot of energy, she can cause an explosion. It isn't until after the first trials in the Sanctuary that she recalled she could use magic on her own. With this ability, she was able to utterly nullify the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]]'s purifying breath, which has been described to be hot enough and strong enough to melt through anything and disintegrate everything it comes into contact with; Emilia's Ice Soldiers were sturdier than even metal, yet they were instantly scorched from existence by Volcanica's purifying breath. Even with Emilia's level of mana, Absolute Zero consumes a massive amount to perform. This ability was named by Natsuki Subaru sometime following the events of Arc 4.''“ーーAbsolute Zero.” That was what Subaru had named it, and had spoken of the empty theory that its materialization may be arduous.'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 88, Section 2. **'''Ice Age''' (アイスエイジ, ''Aisu Eiji''): This technique was first used by Emilia when she teamed up with [[Priscilla Barielle]] against Madelyn Eschart. It is a controlled version of the climate changing magic she used to freeze Elior Forest, and it causes temperature within a given area to drop rapidly.''Opening her eyes, Emilia concentrated on her gate deep inside her body, releasing all her accumulated mana at once and dropping the temperature of her surroundings at a furious pace.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2. When used, it begins to snow, the sky seems to be dyed white, and anyone caught within the area of effect will feel cold enough that they start to go numb and cannot move freely.''Everyone’s fingers would get numb, they would be unable to pick up their weapon, they would be unable to use their skills with their knees shaking, their teeth would not stop chattering, their gaze would be unsteady, and their breath would be so white that they would be shocked.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2. '''Conditional Spells''': *'''Cocytus''' (コキュートス ''Kokyūtosu''): Cocytus is a large-scale spell made out of two combined elements, which was used by Subaru and Emilia during their fight against the Great Rabbit. While Subaru used Yin Magic to form some sort of a barricade around the witchbeasts to prevent them from escaping, Emilia used Fire Magic to carefully apply magical energy to the already-casted Minya spell, creating an icy cage and lifting the cage, the witchbeasts, and the ground itself high in the air. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== [[File:Emilia Melee Fighter.gif|thumb|250px|Emilia engaging in hand-to-hand combat.]] While she leans more on the magical side, Emilia is also apt at close-quarters combat. Like [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]], rather than having a known practiced form, she is a more instinctual fighter, relying on her body's natural talents such as its high nimbleness, sharp senses, and above-average physical strength combined with her magical arts. This creates her own unique style. With her melee combat abilities, Emilia was capable of defeating a group of bandits all on her own as well as easily catch the arrows that were shot at her. Additionally, Emilia is highly proficient in the use of the weapons she makes through her Ice Brand Arts. ===Other=== [[File:Emilia speaks to spirits.gif|thumb|right|250px|Emilia speaking to spirits.]] '''Spirit Affinity''': Emilia has a rare innate gift to form contracts with spirits. Her gift was so prominent that even in her youth, numerous spirits were attracted to her. In the present day, she speaks with numerous lesser spirits regularly. '''Strong Intuition''': Emilia is very intuitive by nature, something which has been incorporated into her melee fighting style. Likewise, it also naturally influences the creations that she makes with her ice, such as her wings, which Aldebaran had noted were incredibly difficult to make right in order to glide. Most of all, however, her intuition has also led her to taking actions separate from others, which has led to her preventing the worst possible scenario in certain battles. During the [[Great Disaster]], she relied on this intuition and moved separately from others,''And so, at the same time that Olbart shouted in his blood-stained garb―― Emilia stood, reflecting on the fact that she had taken an unplanned action with her intuition as the basis.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 67, Section 5. which led to her encountering an enemy who was working to further her plan to kill everyone, and because of this, she was able to ultimately prevent said enemy from doing so. ===Equipment=== The Emilia Crystal shattered.gif|Puck breaks Emilia's original glintstone. Pyroxene Crystal.jpg|thumb|250px|Emilia's new glintstone. *'''Glintstone''' (輝石, ''Kiseki''): Emilia wielded a magical crystal of this type until it broke after Puck forcefully severed the contract in order to remove the lid off of Emilia's memories, allowing her to challenge the Trials from the Tomb of the Witch of Greed. After the end of Arc 4, she received another glintstone from Subaru, which he got from Frederica Baumann. The glintstone harbored Puck for roughly a year, until the end of Arc 5, when Emilia was given a new and much more powerful glintstone. With it, she would be able to reunite with the Beast of the End, though she still needs to accumulate enough mana so he could manifest. *'''Recognition Obstruction Robe''' (認識阻害のローブ, ''Ninshiki Sogai no Rōbu''): A robe that allows the wearer to obstruct anyone from perceiving them unless the wearer allows it or the person is strong enough to overcome its effects. The robe was given to her by Roswaal, in order to avoid any unwanted situations due to her race. Following the events of Arc 4, however, Emilia decided to stop using the cloak, as according to her, one cannot be a proper leader if they're constantly hiding from others. *'''A Fragment of the Divine Dragon's Talon''': Following the climax of Arc 6 and the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|liberation]] of the Pleiades Watchtower, Emilia became the Watchtower's administrator, as she was the one who solved all three trials. This resulted in her having control over the tower and its inhabitants–namely, the Divine Dragon Volcanica. In order to prevent the Witch Cult or anyone else to access the Tower, Emilia tasked the Dragon with guarding the Watchtower and warding off anyone who approaches–though in typical Emilia fashion, she also ordered the Dragon not to harm a living being, no matter what. Volcanica then gave the half-elf a fragment of its jet-black talon, which was observed by [[Beatrice]] to be brimming with mana. It was soon concluded that the Dragon would be able to recognize its talon from far away and not attack Emilia or anyone else who will be holding the talon at the time. It should be also said that the talon does not have any other purpose besides what has already been mentioned. ==Trivia== *Emilia is [[Tappei|Tappei Nagatsuki]]'s favorite Re:Zero character. At one point, he even stated that she's one of the main reasons why he started writing the story in the first place. He also said he doesn't like ranking his characters, but Emilia comes first and all other Re:Zero characters are ranked second.''"Emilia is the best, and everybody else is second."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1038426684809043968 September 8, 2018 Twitter Q&A] *There is a popular fan theory asserting that the Emilia who was seen in the first loop was actually Satella. [[Meili Portroute]] (little sister figure) |Weapon = Northern Kukri Knives |Equipment = Magic Negating Cloaks |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1|Volume 1]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 1 Chapter 3|Arc 1 Chapter 3]] |Anime = [[Episode 1]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Mamiko Noto|Noto Mamiko]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Cristina Vee|Cristina Vee]]}} '''Elsa Granhiert''' (エルザ・グランヒルテ) was an assassin working together with [[Meili Portroute]] as the "child" of an individual known as [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]]. She was the main antagonist of [[Arc 1]] and one of the two secondary antagonists of [[Arc 4]]. A woman who experienced the dark side of [[Gusteko]] as a slave from childhood, Elsa was eventually inducted into the [[Featherrun Sisters]] and obtained her regenerative [[curse]]. After meeting Mother, Elsa became one of her children, typically taking on tasks that included assassinations, and as a result, she developed an infamous reputation as an assassin known throughout the land as the Bowel Hunter. During the [[Sanctuary Incident]], Elsa, along with a fellow assassin, Meili, attempted to slay the maids of [[Roswaal Manor]]. However, after confronting [[Garfiel Tinzel]], she lost her life. After her body reanimated itself with the curse and attempted to posthumously kill [[Natsuki Subaru]], it was ultimately entirely incinerated in a backdraft explosion, bringing a complete end to the Bowel Hunter. ==Appearance== Elsa Granhiert was unusually tall for a woman, as she stood around the same height as Natsuki Subaru at the time of his summoning. Her purple eyes angled down towards their edges and presented Elsa with a certain level of calmness and gentleness. Below her left eye Elsa had a beauty spot. Her long wavy hair was the same shade of black as Subaru's (a trait that was very rare in her world) and was braided into a long tail on the left side of her head that reached down to her hips. A single purple flower decorated the left side of Elsa's head. Elsa was a woman of incredible beauty who apparently oozed eroticism with every move she made. Her white skin was unusually pale to the point that it could almost be described as sickening, and Elsa's slim body was well-endowed with large breasts and sultry curves. Her bewitching beauty coupled with her well-endowed body was enough to catch the eye of most people she met. Elsa's clothing, as if to match the woman herself, was extremely provocative. Her outfit consisted of a pair of black elbow-length gloves with purple trimmings at the top, a pair of black high-heel shoes, a black dress with purple decorations that was both strapless and backless and featured brown tights, and on a couple of occasions, cloaks that were given to her by one of her employers. The dress, that clung to Elsa's body fairly tightly, also had thigh-high slits on either side and an exposed front that flaunted her belly button and cleavage. ==Personality== Elsa was a battle maniac, not even hesitating to injure herself if she could fight strong opponents, which was helped by her abnormal healing rate. This was also shown through her persistence. Her favorite things were seeing colorful bowels and touching warm looking internal organs. Within combat, she enjoyed cleaving through the abdominal region with the intent of tearing the target's bowels out. Perhaps Elsa's defining trait was the arousal she garnered from gutting people and toying with their steaming entrails. Upon facing worthy opponents, Elsa would express excitement at the prospect of gutting them, pondering on random variables such as what color her opponents' entrails would be. After disemboweling Natsuki Subaru she barraged him with a flurry of questions related to the pain he was feeling as he lay dying on the floor of the Loot House, conveying that she received sadistic arousal from the pain others felt due to her actions. Her warped sense of arousal didn't end with her opponents, as Elsa also felt masochistic ecstasy whenever she was wounded by others, such as when Subaru kicked her in the Loot House. She didn't feel any remorse towards those she gutted, even if they were children or the elderly. Elsa also enjoyed knitting cotton dolls,''"Meili found it was cotton stuffed into soft cloth, a plush doll, hand-made by Elsa."'' [[Elsa and Meili, Assassin Sisters' Dark Diary KILL 2]], Section 2. especially after a good kill, and she is mentioned to have over 10 years of experience. Although it wasn't mentioned, she presumably destroyed them later. ==History== ===Early Life=== Elsa was born to ordinary parents in the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, the northernmost of the world's Four Great Nations, known for its harsh, freezing weather and spiritualism. Due to their living circumstances becoming difficult, her parents sold Elsa into slavery while she was a young child in order to get by. She eventually lost her recollection of her parents, and never came to harbor a grudge against them for their decision. Oftentimes, she would run away from her buyers, stealing from and hurting people in order to survive, although her way of life didn't allow for any happiness or sense of fulfilment. One day, while stealing from a store in a blizzard, the owner of the shop caught Elsa and tried to have his way with her. Without hesitation, Elsa grasped a shard of glass from a bottle of Granhiert and slit her assailant's belly open. The warmth of the man's entrails made Elsa forget the coldness that enveloped her life, and for the first time she felt truly alive. As a result, she developed a gruesome fetish for gutting people and fighting with her life on the line against opponents doing the same. She earned recognition as the "Bowel Hunter," who was feared across the world for her gruesome fetish. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls|Apocalypse Girls]]=== Approximately nine years before the start of the story, Elsa after having slain her twelve previous owners and returned to the slaver [[Oliver Zeppes]] each time, she was bought by [[Holosseo Featherrun]], a member of the [[Gustekan Church]] who intended to indict her into the Featherrun Sisters, and sometime after the purchase, she had a ritual performed on her by Holosseo, which turned her into a Curse Doll. Eventually, in order to truly perfect the Curse Doll curse, Holosseo ordered the sisters to kill each other. Elsa, who had no intention to kill her sisters, wanted to persuade him not to, but as her thoughts were swayed, she instead resorted to force and killed him. Despite this, she was forced to fight and kill [[Dorothea Featherrun|Dorothea]], [[Saria Featherrun|Saria]], and [[Hildea Featherrun|Hildea]] anyways. She then fought [[Ornea Featherrun|Ornea]] after she was poisoned by one of her other sisters, [[Sithonia Featherrun|Sithonia]]. After defeating her, she fought and killed Sithonia, and upon her departure, she entrusted Ornea's care and the Featherrun mansion to Oliver. However, when Elsa departed from the Featherrun mansion, Capella intercepted her, revealing what she truly desired was love from someone who could devote themselves to her. Threatening Elsa with the lives of Ornea and Oliver, Capella successfully managed to acquire her as a new “child”. ===Time as one of Mother's Children=== At some point, Elsa was sent after Meili Portroute, who was living with the [[witchbeast]]s as a feral child in a forest. As instructed, she killed all the witchbeasts and brought the child back. At that time, Meili was in a state where she couldn't speak, so her manner of speech and such was greatly influenced by Elsa.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/990622405113475074 Q&A] Elsa found a partner in the young girl, who had the power to control witchbeasts. Elsa and Meili became as close as sisters overtime. At one point, the Bowel Hunter was tasked with killing an important figure from the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], a meritocratic nation located to the far south of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko. Although she was able to kill her target, she was confronted by Vollachia's [[Cecilus Segmunt|Blue Lightning]], who was acting as the person's bodyguard. Barely escaping with her life, the event would be forever engraved in Elsa's memory. ===[[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1|Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain]]=== In the months prior to the beginning of the story, Elsa found herself involved in the conflict between [[Igor Kenash]] and [[Viktor Orcos]]. ===[[Felt-chan's Job]]=== Sometime later, having been hired by [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] to attack [[Emilia]], Elsa met Felt, a young thief from the slums, and she hired her to steal Emilia's insignia from her, leading to the [[Loot House Incident|events]] of Arc 1. ===[[Elsa and Meili, Assassin Sisters' Dark Diary]]=== Following Elsa's defeat and near death by the hands of [[Reinhard van Astrea]], she escaped so that her wounds could mend themselves. After being picked up by Meili, who was shocked to hear that she was defeated and that her wounds weren't regenerating like they were supposed to, Meili patched up her wounds, and they decided to leave the [[Royal Capital]] in order to escape the people searching for her, leading to Elsa, buck naked, deciding to procure clothes from someone. After causing bloodshed to obtain these clothes, she and Meili used a witchbeast to change their hair colors, and with the help of a guard who didn't recognize them pointing them in the direction of the highway, they left the capital behind. However, Meili had received an objective from Mother, who had told her to stir mayhem in the area around Roswaal Manor, much to Elsa's chagrin. While the two split up, Elsa decided to knit a doll of Reinhard for Meili. Later, as Meili took on her [[Wolgarm Incident|task]], Elsa watched from afar the chaos, and as Roswaal lit the forest ablaze to kill all of the [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarms]], Elsa made her way to assist Meili, delighted that their roles were reversed from the incident in the capital. As they ran, she gave Meili the doll of Reinhard, and shortly after, she carried Meili on her back, despite the girl's reluctance and frustration, and ran beyond the mountains. Soon enough, they found themselves surrounded by witchbeasts, which Meili decided to speak with and have them regroup with other witchbeasts to rebuild her numbers. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== [[File:Elsa Granhiert vs Garfiel Tinsel.gif|thumb|230px|Elsa fighting against Garfiel.]] Elsa was an infamous assassin who was highly talented at manipulating and using blade techniques to overwhelm her opponents. She was easily capable of defeating [[Rom]], [[Felt]], and Subaru with ease, fought on par with Emilia and [[Puck]] while both were contracted and in a weakened state, and was able to go toe to toe with a warrior of Garfiel's caliber during his early days of fighting. Although not among the strongest of combatants, easily outclassed by a fair number of warriors, she was still extremely dangerous for her ability to kill her targets, and ridiculously hard to kill because of her curse, and because of this, she ultimately was able to kill her enemies and escape, even after being forced to face two of the world's most powerful people. ===[[Curse]]=== [[File:Elsa using her Curse Doll ability to regenerate.gif|thumb|230px|Elsa regenerating from Garfiel’s attack instantaneously by utilizing her Curse Doll curse.]] '''[[Curse#Curse Doll|Curse Doll]]''' (呪い人形, ''Noroi Ningyō''): Elsa's seeming immortality was caused from a curse that made her into a so-called "curse doll", which was cast on her by Holosseo Featherrun. It is a curse art which involves the user carving a curse mark that includes the information of the target they want to kill on someone, and upon activation, the person with the curse mark gains immortality, but as a cost, they lose their sense of self and can't do anything else but kill the target and they die when the target is killed. Also, there seems to be a limit to the immortality. However, there's a way to cast the curse without the person losing their sense of self, which is what happened to Elsa, though repeatedly dying turned her into a curse doll. People who become curse dolls are mistakenly referred to as vampires due to a curse doll once drinking blood in an attempt to die. In the past, she mockingly called her curse a Blessing, a term used for abilities that originate from Gusteko. *'''Regeneration''': Elsa had the ability to rapidly recreate lost or damaged cells. She could instantly recover from major lacerations and was able to regrow severed body parts. She was able to regenerate after having her entire body crystalized and shattered by [[Beatrice]] and even survived an attack from the Sword Saint himself. Those who were unaware of her power thought her to be an unstoppable killing machine incapable of dying or tiring. However, there was a limit to how much damage she could sustain, as eventually her healing factor could become overwhelmed by continuous significant wounds that would cause it to stop functioning. Additionally, the strikes of the Sword Saint were capable of delaying or negating the Bowel Hunter's regeneration. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Enhanced Agility''': Elsa is an incredibly fast, agile fighter who is easily capable of fighting her enemies by jumping off of walls, the floor, and the ceiling with incredible ease and speed, giving her the capability to fight in three dimensions. '''Enhanced Olfaction''': Elsa was born, for no apparent reason, with an unnaturally acute sense of smell. Her heightened sense allowed her to better distinguish the scents of a person in the air, meaning she could smell people who were keeping out of sight and have a better bearing on her surroundings in general. Much like a dog, the Bowel Hunter could determine a person's emotional state through their scent. For instance, she could tell if someone was afraid or trying to deceive her by smelling them. ===Equipment=== Elsa's Kukri Knives.png|Elsa's Kukri Knives. Elsa's White and Black blades.jpg|Elsa wielding the white and black blades in one of Volume 15 illustrations. *'''Kukri Knives''': Elsa's primary weapons of choice were a set of short ornate black Kukri blades. She always carried multiple spares to be used if her primaries were destroyed, and depending on her mood she would wield either a single blade or a pair of blades. These weapons were a design that originated from Elsa's homeland of Gusteko, and over time, they became synonymous with the Bowel Hunter. Additionally, she wielded ornate short blades, and she had two secret weapons which were specialized blades that she only ever used against special opponents whom she aimed to kill rather than just seeing their guts. **'''White Blade''': A thick kukri with a surprisingly large amount of mass specialized for crushing bone. The bladed portion can extend a string of blades not dissimilar from a snake sword for mid-range attacks. **'''Black Blade''': Looks similar to her standard knives but has distinctive serrated edged that gives it an appearance of animal teeth. It's supposedly created for goring opponents rather than ripping them. [[File:Elsa - Needles.gif|thumb|250x250px|Elsa throwing needles to kill Petra.]] *'''Throwing Needles''': Elsa wielded needles that could be used to attack people from afar. [[File:Elsa's magic cloak.gif|thumb|250x250px|Elsa using her magic cloak to defend herself from an incoming magical attack.]] *'''Enchanted Cloaks''': Upon being hired by Margrave Roswaal L. Mathers, Elsa was given a feathered cloak that was enchanted with a Yang magic enhancement. The enchantment in question ensured that any offensive magical attack that struck the cloak would dissipate and leave its wearer unharmed. However, it is only effective for singular usage, as after negating an attack the cloak would dissipate. Another drawback was that it only worked against spells intended to harm her physically, thus indirect magic like Shamak bypassed it. The cloaks were imbued with a yang magic buff based on the theory established by [[Roswaal K. Mathers]]. Elsa was given the cloak to compensate for her natural weakness to magic, and after having used it to negate an attack from Puck, she was given a second one. ==Trivia== *Elsa's birthday is April 29, a play on the words death and meat in Japanese. April is the 4th month and four (四) has the same pronunciation as death (死), while two (二) and nine (九) can be pronounced as "ni" and "ku", the same as meat (肉). *In the web novel Arc 1 character settings, Elsa was stated to have an unnamed Divine Protection. Later in the web novel, it was never confirmed that she had a Divine Protection, and she was only said to be a vampire up until her death. In [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 12|Volume 12]], she claims to have had a Blessing of Gusteko, though in a [[Elsa and Meili, Assassin Sisters' Dark Diary KILL 4|subsequent side story]], it was instead revealed to be the curse doll curse art. *Elsa was greatly weak against magic attacks.''"I'm not sure if you'll be satisfied with my answer, but Elsa is very weak against magic."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/500278064027537408 April 30, 2018 Twitter Q&A] So weak, she didn't want to risk running into Subaru's Shamak, when he used it. *Tappei hinted at the possibility that Roswaal gave Elsa her magic cape, in order for her to corner Emilia more easily.''"It's possible that Roswaal gave it to her. In order to corner Emilia"'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/990622753148485632 Q&A] *According to the author, Elsa arranged the characters she wanted to kill, as follows: Emilia > Subaru > [[Petra Leyte|Petra]] > [[Ram]] > [[Rem]] > [[Frederica Baumann|Frederica]] > [[Otto Suwen|Otto]] >> Garfiel >>> Roswaal. *She got her surname Granhiert from a bottle of brandy she used to kill the man who tried to violate her. *In the IF chapter commonly referred to as Mimagau IF, Elsa makes an appearance as a male assassin dressed in black named Eins (エインズ). *Elsa has a named epilogue in [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls|Apocalypse Girls]]. *Due to her curse, Elsa has been referred to the slang term vampire.''"Ain't that right, vampire?"''
