[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Chinatsu Akasaki|Akasaki Chinatsu]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Christine Marie Cabanos|Christine Marie Cabanos]] }} '''Felt''' (フェルト) is a former thief and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. After being involved in the [[Loot House Incident]] along with [[Emilia]], [[Natsuki Subaru]], and [[Reinhard van Astrea]], she was discovered to be a potential monarch for the Kingdom, and she is forced to participate in the [[Royal Selection]]. Having grown up in the slums, she takes the opportunity to get revenge on the Kingdom by making her primary policy to disband all government. She plays a major role in [[Arc 1]] and [[Arc 9]], a supporting role in [[Arc 5]] and [[Arc 10]], and a minor supporting role in [[Arc 3]]. ==Appearance== Felt is a short girl with fair skin and medium-length golden hair with a black bow. She has a [[Wikipedia:Yaeba|yaeba]] that becomes prominent when she laughs. She has red eyes and wears a sleeveless black top, red scarf with a golden patch on it, black pants that are incomplete on the left side, and a red ribbon on her left ankle. She also wears a vest, gloves, brown shoes, and has a belt with a sheath where her knife is. When Reinhard took her, he forced her to wear a yellow dress, white gloves on her hands that reached her upper arms, boots, and an orange bun in the center of her hair to look presentable as a candidate for the throne in the Royal Selection. After the Royal Selection Ceremony, Reinhard made a new outfit for Felt. Just like her former outfit, it's very light. She wears a black top with long sleeves yet leaves her stomach exposed, a blue scarf with a golden patch on it, a brown leather vest, boots of the same material, black leggings, a black belt, and brown leather shorts that she wears over her leggings. She keeps a few pouches on her belt. In the Water Plumage Inn in Arc 5, she wore a yukata. Her appearance is considered to be a sign of having royal blood.''"Blond hair and crimson eyes---these are peculiar to be the bloodline of the Lugunica Royal Family."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 1. However, as all members of the [[Royal Family]] are currently deceased, there is currently no way to confirm if she actually is part of the royal family. ==Personality== Felt is short tempered, hot headed, and rather unladylike. Reinhard has commented about this trait several times with Felt often not caring. She is also very childish about a lot of things, although this childish nature goes away when faced with a dangerous situation. Felt is a stickler when it comes to money due to living in the slums which also blessed her with a mentality of never allowing herself to lose in any kind of way. She cares about [[Rom|Old Man Rom]] and treats him like her real grandfather. She greatly trusts Rom's word, especially when it comes to appraisals in price. Felt has stated multiple times that she resents everything about the Kingdom and plans to tear it all down, which is likely due to the way Felt grew up. Likewise, though she is aware of how useful it is for the people of the slums and does not believe it to be useless, she herself dislikes being given charity, to the point that she has never gone to collect the bread being given out by the [[Divine Dragon Church]].''"Sorry, but I hate taking charity. I’ve never lined up for the bread the Church hands out. And, it’s not like I’m saying that those activities are useless, or that I hate them. What I’m talking about right now is the part where your bunch can save Duchess Karsten."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. After spending a year living a completely different life from what she was used to, Felt started viewing the world in a different light, not being scared of changes anymore as she realized that change is a natural course of action, one she is unable to avoid.''—Felt was not afraid of change. For change was only the natural course of things.'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 3]], Section 1. As a result, Felt developed a strong preference for the theory of the "Survival of the Fittest", where the one who could adapt to their situation and discern the best manner of survival would survive and strive over those who could not.''As a result, Felt had a preference for the theory of the Survival of the Fittest—where the one who could adapt to their situation and discern the best manner of survival would survive—rather than the theory of ‘Only the Strong Survive.’'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 3]], Section 1. Consequentially to this mentality, Felt believes she's what she is today due to the belief that she adapted, opting her to accept every decision she made thus far as something natural. Due to this mindset, she has fully accepted the scrutinizing gazes of others,''This was no bravado, but full acceptance of the scrutiny directed towards herself, as Felt twisted the corners of her mouth into a smile.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. and Felt has a habit of determining whether someone was useful or not to herself or whatever they might be thinking, a habit that has aided her both in life and in the Royal Selection.''Setting aside the Royal Selection, this worldly wisdom was Felt’s method of survival in the Slums, or perhaps something akin to life experience. Whether the other party was useful to oneself or not, what they might be thinking deep down, she had made a habit of ascertaining such things. In truth, even since becoming a Royal Candidate, this ingrained habit had come to her aid.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. This being said, she is also the type to play fairly against opponents during the Royal Selection. Likewise, even if it might make the path ahead unclear, she was not unwilling to become friends with said opponents, even if she was aware that it would have been easier for her to act otherwise.''She had no regrets accepting Emilia’s offer, but she felt that the path ahead had become unclear yet again. She had no intention of resorting to dirty tricks or schemes, but there was no doubt it would have been easier to make decisions without holding back if they were just rival camps clashing fiercely against each other.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. Similarly, when it comes to certain secrets involving other camps, such as [[Otto Suwen]]'s [[Divine Protection]], she will keep quiet about such things to others out of a sense of obligation, even being willing to use her knight as a cover for such things.''The origin of the information, that the discussion being held with the Divine Dragon Church at the Castle involved Crusch, had actually been Otto, so Felt concealed that fact out of obligation. At this point, adding on a few more rumors about Reinhard having hellish ears, or a habit of eavesdropping, would not hurt him much anyway. It was a fact that he could likely distinguish the sound of a needle being dropped a kilometer away, too.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. She is a calm and collected person, and though she comes off as quick-tempered, she is capable of handling difficult people without giving them an inch, and she is willing to do whatever it takes when it truly matters.''Considering only prior information, theirs was a complicated relationship such that it would be only natural for them to bicker, but it seemed as though they were kindred spirits when it came to doing whatever it took for the sake of what truly mattered.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 3. She is also a rather frank person. In one case, after dealing with Reinhard's foul-mouthed father [[Heinkel Astrea|Heinkel]] when he ruined a moment between his family and picked a fight with the Royal Selection candidates, though she was quick to shoot him down, after he left, she decided to use the time afforded to her to chide him for his behavior. She dislikes being followed around everywhere and prefers being able to make decisions on her own without outside input, something that leads to her having a somewhat strained relationship with her knight. Because of this, she will do what she can to ditch such people and any requests they might have in favor of doing as she wishes. This often leads to her trying to escape from her knight, and in one case, she even ignored him when he asked her to remain in a safe spot during an [[Battle for Priestella|attack]] and instead went to assist in repelling the attackers. Likewise, even when she finds herself in a complicated situation and has extremely limited options and means to obtain information, such as her isolation during the [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy]], Felt is willing to take charge when she needs to or even leave things to chance,''"Fine, I’m in. To begin with, I’ve been meaning to get a move on sooner or later. Then again, I was planning to just chokehold the guy who brings me food or whatever, then steal his sword and keys before booking it. Then I figured it’d also be great if I could find Emilia-neechan along the way, but it would’ve mostly been left up to chance."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 3. as well as to accept when help comes her way.''"I ain’t got any access to tools or info in here, so there wasn’t any other way. But now, those tools and information went out of their way to grow legs and come running here to me. I don’t have the option to pass this up."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 3. Felt is also willing to risk her life when it comes to bringing down her enemies. In one of the encounters in a failed loop against the Bowel Hunter [[Elsa Granhiert]], she viciously targeted her after she defeated Rom. More prominently, when she was held hostage by Heinkel in order to force Reinhard's hand, she did not flinch and instead told Reinhard to do his duty as a knight instead of worrying about his charge. Later, she is shown to be willing to let [[Al]] use her as a hostage to prevent any deaths while using her position to secretly relay information to her allies. She is also honorable, willing to properly compete with the other Royal Selection candidates rather than eliminate them one by one, as claimed by her knight and Al. Despite becoming aware of the fact that her existence may be that of Filore Lugunica, the princess who had gone missing during the [[Royal Abduction Incident]], Felt never considered herself to be a part of the royal family, and never once did she attempt to that to her advantage. However, she could not disregard the expectations that she might be that princess.''That lined up with Felt in terms of age, and her hair and eye color were also consistent with the characteristic traits of the Royal Family of Lugunica. Of course, Felt had never thought of herself as a member of the Royal Family, and she had never attempted to take advantage of it. ――However, she was not so self-centered that she could completely disregard the possibility those around her might have been expecting.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Although she herself had scoffed at the idea of being royalty, when [[Filore]] appeared and made her existence known, although the question of herself being the missing princess had not been repudiated and the facts remained uncertainties, she still felt a deep turmoil in her soul, not due to wanting to be royalty herself but for the disappointment and possible betrayal of those who had hope in her caused by circumstances beyond her control.''They had been repudiated. ――No, it was not a repudiation, they stubbornly remained as uncertainties. In addition, Felt had so far scoffed at that possibility and walked all over it. And yet, when it was repudiated once and for all before her own eyes, a clear turmoil churned within her soul. It was not due to some desire to attain royalty. Those who had hoped Felt was a member of the Royal Family found their expectations betrayed, a disappointment caused by circumstances beyond her control.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 1, Section 2. ==History== ===Early Life=== Felt was born roughly 14 years before the start of the main story, under circumstances that remain unknown until this day, though it's been heavily implied by multiple high ranking and knowledgeable individuals such as [[Miklotov McMahon]] and Reinhard van Astrea that she was, in fact, born as the last daughter of Ford Lugunica, the younger brother of the 41st and last King of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, Randohal Lugunica. At an unknown age, early in her life, Felt was picked up by Rom, who gave her current name and acted as her adoptive grandfather. For over a decade, Felt spent her days in the slums of the [[Royal Capital]], unable to get along with the children who stuck together and often disliked by even those of the same gender, causing her to choose to remain alone except for her only family, Rom.''She didn’t get along with the orphans who chose to live together. She was often disliked by the people of her own gender, and, having gotten tired of socializing with others, chose to remain alone. The only exception was her only family.'' [[Lone Wolf of the Slums, Felt-chan's Noisy Days]], Section 2. However, she did not rely on his kindness alone out of her sense of pride, so she would solve her own problems.''Despite his fierce appearance, he was very compassionate, and enjoyed acting as Felt’s guardian. But what made Felt not want to rely too much on his kindness was her small amount of pride. The one she called family made a living by selling the stuff that had gotten stolen in back alleys. But even though he was in that line of work, he paid a fair price for the stolen goods people brought him. Felt knew that her pride was tainted, but it was an important ritual for her. —Thus, Felt felt really miserable when she caused him trouble due to her insistence on doing things on her own.'' So… [[Lone Wolf of the Slums, Felt-chan's Noisy Days]], Section 2. In order to earn enough money to move out of the slums and start her own life, at some point, Felt started stealing from people.''Felt’s objective—though it was still a far-off goal since she didn’t make much from stealing—was to eventually save enough money to escape from the poverty of the slum. She would be even happier if the only one she considered family was there with her when it happened.'' [[Lone Wolf of the Slums, Felt-chan's Noisy Days]], Section 4. Starting off with simple pickpocketing, she broadened out and started accepting requests from other people. Soon, she became a master thief, earning a considerable amount of money through dirty business. ===[[Lone Wolf of the Slums, Felt-chan's Noisy Days]]=== One day, after witnessing the attempted kidnapping of a child from an old man in a part of the slums that wasn't her turf, she attacked the kidnappers, helping the two escape, before being chased around by the dozen kidnappers, who were all intent on selling her off, and she started running back in the direction of her turf. When one of the men warned the others about not harming her face after they fired an arrow at her, she turned the tables on them by jumping on their heads and attacking the man in charge. After slipping away from the group, who hesitated to pursue her, she blended in with the crowd, casually pickpocketing passersby. Sometime later, however, the kidnappers found and surrounded her, claiming that it was because the people who hated her had sold her out for money. In response to them, Felt pulled out a whistle she stole from a guard and blew into it, summoning the guards who patrolled and causing them to take down the kidnappers with ease while she escaped. Later, she arrived at the Loot House, where Rom was waiting for her. ===[[Felt-chan's Job]]=== On the day of Natsuki Subaru's arrival to the new world, Felt accepted a very profiting job from a shady woman with a snake-like gaze, thinking this would be her last job, as 10 gold coins would be more than enough for her to start a new life somewhere outside of the Royal Capital's slums. It didn't take her long to locate her target: a woman with white clothes with golden birds woven on it, and long, dazzling silver hair. Just as she was about to approach the woman and steal the object of interest, she was tasked to take, another person grabbed the opportunity and snatched away the woman's purse. Just as he was about to scurry off into the back alley, a [[Wilhelm van Astrea|tall old man in a black suit]] pressed his sword against the man's throat, demanding the thief to return what he stole. Noticing Felt, who was staring at the whole ordeal, he casually walked towards her, noting he knew she had the same intentions as the man he had just caught. Despite that, he kindly asked Felt to return the stolen purse to its owner. When Felt started objecting and stating she'll just scurry off with the purse, the man calmly rebuked her, and for a moment, his stare became as sharp and cold as a blade, prompting Felt to agree to his request in fear. Right after, [[Ferris|another person]] called out to the old man, catching his attention. Felt used the chance to escape to a back alley nearby. In the alleyway, she tried to confirm the object of interest was in the stolen purse, however, all she could find was change, barely enough for a short shopping spree. Annoyed, Felt returned to the main street and quickly located the woman who was, at the time, in the middle of a commotion, trying to get attention so she could pay for a [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] [[Mimi Pearlbaton|child's]] meal. Felt used the opportunity to throw the woman's purse back to her, making sure she found it right after. Felt then continued to tail the woman who was aimlessly wandering around the Royal Capital. After some time, Felt was finally blessed with a situation that would allow her to snatch away the object of interest. She used her Divine Protection to scale a large building, jumped off behind the woman and snatched away what she was keeping safe in her waist pocket. What Felt found was a black dragon-shaped insignia with a red stone shining inside her palm. ===[[Felt-chan's Imprisonment Life]]=== After the Loot House Incident, Felt woke up to find herself naked in an unfamiliar room. Reinhard appeared and said that her clothes were currently being washed and that they would be returned soon. In her frustration, she asked where they were and why Reinhard brought her there, to which he revealed that he brought her to the rarely used Astrea Manor in the Royal Capital. Afterward, he gave her another insignia, and after it shined in her hand, he explained that it meant that she was chosen by fate and needed to appear at the castle. This angered her, and though when she attempted to deceive him by asking for a pair of clothes to wear, she attempted to escape, only to easily be caught. Reinhard claimed that if she was able to escape the manor, then he would not go after her. However, he and the servants would attempt to prevent her from doing so. Inside, the [[Carol Remendis|maid]] had prepared a dress for her in place of her ordinary clothes, and Reinhard asked her to wear what they had at the manor while she was there. ===[[Felt-chan Saw!]]=== In the ten days that followed the Loot House Incident, Felt tried several times to escape, having managed to escape Reinhard's side only once successfully before being caught. Being served confectionaries by Carol, Felt enjoyed it and asked if Carol wouldn't go with her when she escaped, to which she appreciated the offer but claimed that she had to refuse for [[Grimm Fauzen|Grimm]]'s sake. After finishing her snack, Felt wandered the mansion thinking of a way to escape when she stumbled upon a room that she was warned not to enter. Looking inside, she found a woman asleep inside, and when she got suspicious if Reinhard had kidnapped someone else, Reinhard appeared and said that the woman was his mother, [[Louanna Astrea]], and that due to unknown reasons, she was in the Sleeping Beauty state. When she exited the room, Reinhard asked her not to tell anyone about her and thanked her for her concern. Afterward, he informed Felt that Rom ran away from the guardhouse during his treatment, to which she claimed he was fine. Looking at him, she claimed that Reinhard did look like his mother, which seemed to make him happy, though Felt was still annoyed by him keeping her there. ===[[Felt-chan Rises to the Center Stage]]=== On the way to the Royal Castle, Felt, who had lost a bet to Reinhard, started to kick at him in annoyance. She ultimately failed to hit him even once, and she asked once more where they were headed. Though Reinhard wanted to keep it a secret, they reached the castle, much to her frustration. Inside the castle, Reinhard left her side and Felt was brought to be dressed by maids while Carol watched on. However, Heinkel, having come in response to Reinhard's arrival, entered the room, much to Carol's anger and Felt's annoyance. Afterward, Carol informed Heinkel of Felt's reason being in the castle was for the Royal Selection, which he laughed at. Though Felt was ready to attack him, Heinkel stepped in front of her quickly and claimed that they were both in the same position before leaving. Felt asked Carol about her Heinkel, and she replied that she, Grimm, and Reinhard all had connections to him, and she was dismayed that Reinhard had apparently guessed correctly. Deciding to get things back on track, Felt positioned herself to continue getting dressed while a couple of the maids cleaned up a mess Heinkel had made, and while that was happening, Felt noticed Heinkel's hair tone being like Reinhard and claimed she knows people with red hair suck. ===[[Felt-chan Gathers Thugs]]=== Felt, Reinhard, and Rom were on a carriage on their way back from the Royal Selection Ceremony. Rom and Reinhard had a cryptic conversation regarding a kidnapping that happened years ago and the incident of the old royal guards being restructured. Felt asked the carriage to stop at the Loot House in the slums, as Felt wished to see what remained of it. While Felt inspected the slums with her [[Felt Camp|camp]], she found [[Gaston]], [[Rachins Hoffman]], and [[Camberley]] running away and badly injured. They decided to attempt to rob her to make enough money to get away from Lugunica, as they had attempted to trick [[Russell Fellow]] into a shady business that did not end well for them, and they were now marked for death by him. Reinhard easily defeated one of them as the others attempted to run, but they were intercepted by Felt while she was scolding Reinhard, as letting them run away would mean they would be dead by Russell's capable henchman the next day. She then recruited the trio for her camp in hopes of using their help for ruining the country. ===[[Lugunican Papers Part 2|Lugunican Papers]]=== In the year that followed the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], Felt was requested an interview by [[Shorty Megan]] and [[Lululala]]. Meeting at the Astrea Manor, Shorty witnessed the usual interaction between Felt and Reinhard, which he felt was peculiar. Likewise with the other candidates, Felt gave her opinion on the Royal Selection and the other candidates. Having both grown up in the slums of the Royal Capital, they both understood the plight of the people there and were able to agree on numerous things. In the end, Lululala drew an image of Felt and Reinhard, which Felt felt dismayed about. ===[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 4]]=== Following the Battle for Priestella, after hearing [[Garfiel Tinzel]]'s resolve not to lose to Reinhard when he was speaking to Otto, Felt visited the injured Otto with Reinhard in tow and teased him. Though Otto found it funny thinking that he used to call himself a humble merchant and that he seemed to have gone pretty far from that ideal, Felt sympathized, but she claimed that duty called and she had to fight. Afterward, though she joked that she was there to visit him to help eat the fruits he'd been gifted, she was there to thank him for his assistance, both in the battle with [[Lye Batenkaitos]] and Heinkel before that, and Reinhard agreed with her gratitude. Felt also claimed that they had a debt towards Otto now, which made Otto twist his expression unconsciously. Then, Felt and Reinhard took their leave, leaving Otto thinking about work. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 1|The Lion’s Ferocity]]=== Following the Battle for Priestella, she and Reinhard were responsible for escorting the [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Wrath]] to the Royal Capital’s Prison Tower. Due to Sirius’s attraction of trouble, it took two months before they arrived. When Reinhard took her up the tower, Felt was invited to dinner that night by Russell Fellow. She ultimately accepted, and that night with Reinhard, she went to dinner and spoke with Russell about the heretic hunts of [[Gusteko]], the declining balance of power between [[Kararagi]]’s mayors, and the signs of a [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] in [[Vollachia Empire]]. Likewise, they spoke about how the times were changing drastically, with Felt associating those changes with Subaru and Emilia. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record|Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record]]=== Sometime later, after the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], she took part in a meeting with [[Meili Portroute]] and the Council of Wise Men, and she helped negotiations smooth out, resulting in members of her camp and Meili being tasked with investigating the conquered [[Pleiades Watchtower]]. As they made their way through the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], [[Volcanica]] attacked them, leaving Reinhard to defend them. However, thanks to Meili, Volcanica stopped attacking, and they successfully reached the tower. Inside, the group bore witness to the innumerable Books of the Dead, and Felt suggested to Reinhard to look for the book of his [[Theresia van Astrea|grandmother]], to which he was grateful, though she was curious as to why there were so many empty books laid on the ground. However, the nearby birds caught their attention, and after the [[Shaula|crimson scorpion]] killed the one they’d caught, Reinhard and [[Ezzo Cadner]] began slaughtering the others, as they were being used to spy. Though they didn’t know the assailant, the group decided to leave the tower, with Ezzo and [[Flam Remendis]] remaining in the tower. In the Royal Capital, Felt reported their discoveries to the Council of Wise Men. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Although Felt is quite scrappy, strong-willed, and a good escape artist, she is not particularly powerful, having just enough power to protect herself and escape from most ordinary pursuers. Despite this, she makes up for this with her people skills and her instincts, something which has led to her coming out of most situations untouched, ===[[Divine Protection]]=== [[File:Felt's_Divine_Protection.gif|thumb|250px|Felt, confronting Elsa with the assistance of her Divine Protection.]] Felt has a currently unnamed Divine Protection which Elsa mentions is related to wind.''"So you have the protection of the wind, Oh, how wonderful. The world must adore you..."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 2, Section 6. Felt mentions that she's used to using this ability rather than relying on tools and weapons. The Divine Protection allows Felt to dash ahead as fast as the blink of an eye, exactly like the wind, releasing a gust of wind when she stops moving. During Arc 5, Felt has also shown that she can use her Divine Protection to climb up walls and buildings. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== From a young age, Felt has physically trained herself to utilize her full agility while fighting. She is so quick that she can steal the insignia from Emilia without her realizing it, and she is quick to draw her knife when she is forced into a dangerous situation. However, she does not know the Flow Method, and her physical strength is on par with most humans. '''Expert Thief''': Felt has been a pickpocket for years, and she became heavily experienced in thievery over the course of her life. She became rather well known in the slums for it. *'''Parkour''': Felt is rather capable in parkour. With assistance from her Divine Protection, she can jump and run off of walls, roofs, and trees. *'''Stealth''': Felt is also rather accomplished with stealth. Throughout the entire fight against Al in Arc 9, she trailed behind him without letting him, Heinkel, or even [[Yae Tenzen]] catch wind of her. ===Intelligence=== '''Street Smarts''': Having grown up in the slums, Felt is considerably smart when it comes to handling other people. Naturally, this makes it hard to trick her. She can speak to people as shrewd as Russell Fellow and those who work in underground organizations such as in Flanders with no issue, and she can quickly understand darker political matters associated with them without allowing them to walk circles around her. Likewise, she also used these street smarts in order to bring the people of lower class to her side during the Royal Selection. ===Equipment=== *'''Knife''': Felt wields a knife that she has used since her time as a thief. *'''Whistle''': It is unknown whether she still possesses it, but at one point, Felt had stolen a whistle from one of the Kingdom's knights that would signal to other knights to appear at the location it was blown at. *'''[[Meteor#Star Staff|Star Staff]]''': By the time of the Battle for Priestella, she came into ownership of [[Echidna]]'s meteor staff, which can be used to fire the light of Shario at an opponent, and it is strong enough to defeat even a Sin Archbishop. Though, Felt has also attempted to use it as a melee weapon due to her lack of knowledge in how to use it. ==Trivia== *Though unconfirmed, there is abundant circumstantial evidence suggesting that Felt is, in fact, the missing royal princess '''Filore Lugunica''' (フィルオーレ・ルグニカ, ''Firuōre Rugunika''), the daughter of King [[Randohal Lugunica]]'s younger brother [[Ford Lugunica|Ford]], who was separated from the royal family after an unknown perpetrator supposedly kidnapped her in the events of the Royal Abduction Incident. **Felt has gold hair and crimson red eyes, the physical characteristics that the royal family was known to pass across generations. The author has also stated that, between her parents, Felt might take more after her father. **Felt is the name Rom gave her, but it is not recognized as her true name by Od Lagna. During the Battle for Priestella, Lye failed to eat Felt's name because of this very reason. In the midst of the [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict]] several months later, [[Roy Alphard]] suggested to Felt that, deep in her heart, she knew her true name was the same as the missing princess, to which she did not affirm. **The Divine Dragon, Volcanica, as well as a recreated persona from Al's memories that usurped the Dragon's body and mind, both acknowledge Felt as [[Farsale Lugunica]], the royal family member known for establishing Lugunica's covenant with Volcanica. *As Felt was an orphan, she is unaware of her true birthday and believes she is 15. The date considered to be Felt's birthday, which is the day he found her, was arranged by Rom.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1214930766473256960 Re:Zero Director's Cut Episode 2+3 Commentary] *According to the author, Felt and Reinhard are scheduled to be more active in the latter stages of the story. *Albeit only in side content, Felt is one of the few characters in which there is narration written in the first-person perspective of. *In Arc 1, during Elsa's attack, Felt ran for help and encountered Reinhard who she asked for assistance. The author later revealed that the place the two encountered each other for the first time was the same place where Wilhelm Trias and Theresia van Astrea first met, 40 years before the start of the main story.''"It would be alright to think that the place where Reinhard and Felt ran into each other in episode three was around that field of flowers from just now."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1240285151109599233 Director Cut Episode 11 Commentary] *Shin'ichirō Ōtsuka, the illustrator of the series, considered Felt to be easy to draw in comparison to other characters. since her design was able to be completed in under an hour. *According to the author, Felt is only interested in older men. *Felt received her earth dragon, [[Romy]], after an arrangement Reinhard made with a rancher at an earth dragon ranch to the south of [[Flanders]]. She named it after Rom. *In the IF chapter commonly referred to as Mimagau IF, Felt makes an appearance as a gold-haired boy named Forte (フォルテ). ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Felt Camp]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Royal Selection Candidates]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[de:Felt]] [[es:Felt]] [[fr:Felt]] [[it:Felt]] [[nl:Felt]] [[pl:Felt]] [[pt-br:Felt]] [[ru:Фельт]] [[uk:Фельт]] [[zh:角色:菲鲁特]]

[[Felt Camp]] |Previous Affiliation = [[Royal Capital]] |Previous Occupation = Thug |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1|Volume 1]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 1 Chapter 1|Arc 1 Chapter 1]] |Anime = [[Episode 1]] |Japanese Voice = Yamamoto Itaru |English Voice = Chris Tergliafera}} '''Gaston''' (ガストン), commonly known as '''Ton''' (トン), is one of the three thugs that attacked [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] at the very start of story. He later joined the [[Felt Camp]] when [[Felt]] employed him after [[Royal Selection]] began. He plays an antagonistic role in [[Arc 1]] and [[Arc 3]] and a supporting role in [[Arc 5]] and [[Arc 9]]. ==Appearance== Gaston has a large body with purple hair and eyes. He wears tan clothes, an orange sash around his waist, a green vest, and black shoes. After joining the Felt Camp, he starts wearing a suit. ==Personality== Gaston has a rough personality, though he is loyal to Felt after joining her camp. Even following his enactment to the camp and having a more noble life, Gaston still retained his thug-like mindset and often berates [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] just like how Felt, [[Rachins Hoffman|Rachins]] and [[Camberley]] do. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly 3 to 4 months before Subaru's arrival, Rachins, Gaston, and Camberley met an [[Gramdart Holstoy|Imperial traitor]], who paid the trio and fifteen other thugs a fair amount of gold coins in order to tail a [[Cecilus Segmunt|Divine General]] who was after his head. The thugs disobeyed the orders and lured the swordsman into a dark alley, wanting to attack, beat and rob the man. However, as they were dealing with Cecilus Segmunt, the strongest person from the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] and one of the three men who are about as skilled as Reinhard in terms of martial arts, they were defeated within a second and left beaten half to death. Following their arrest by the Knight guards who rushed the scene soon after, the three thugs were then approached by [[Julius Juukulius]], [[Ferris]], and [[Chisha Gold]], who wanted to know about Cecilus' location. Upon being promised freedom, they spilled the beans and were subsequently freed, with the money they would have gotten from Gramdart. ===[[Behind the Scenes of Life in Another World from Zero]]=== A short while after harassing Subaru and being scared off by Reinhard, he, Rachins, and Camberley, attempted to corner [[Emilia]], who was looking for Felt. However, before they could do anything to her, she quickly cornered them. Afterward, she asked them about the Loot House, and they pointed her in the right direction. ===[[Ram's Flirting Refusal]]=== Later, they attempted to ambush [[Ram]], who was searching for Emilia throughout the capital. However, she easily dispatched them. ===[[Felt-chan Gathers Thugs]]=== While Felt inspected the slums with her camp, she found Gaston, Rachins, and Camberley running away and badly injured. They decided to attempt to rob her to make enough money to get away from Lugunica, as they had attempted to trick [[Russell Fellow]] into a shady business that did not end well for them, and they were now marked for death by him. Reinhard easily defeated one of them as the others attempted to run, but they were intercepted by Felt while she was scolding Reinhard, as letting them run away would mean they would be dead by Russell's capable henchman the next day. She then recruited the trio for her camp in hopes of using their help for ruining the country. Since then, Reinhard van Astrea started to train all three of them so they would grow stronger with his help. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Despite his large physique, Gaston is not particularly powerful. In fact, early on, not only was he easily defeated by Subaru at one point, but he was also defeated easily by several other relatively decent fighters. After joining the Felt Camp, his proficiency in combat has increased, and he can do considerably better compared to before, but overall, Gaston would still likely be defeated by most combatants. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== After being trained by Reinhard, Gaston learned how to use the Flow Method, and as of Arc 5, he was declared to be average with it. It is unknown if his proficiency with it has improved. [[File:Gaston using the Flow Method to break's Lye dagger.gif|thumb|right|250px|Gaston using the '''Flow Method''' to break one of Lye Batenkaitos's blades.]] '''Enhanced Strength/Durability''': Gaston can temporarily boost strength and durability to act like a shield capable of snapping weapons, including one of the blades of [[Lye Batenkaitos]]. '''Considerable Endurance''': Though not as much as other fighters, Gaston is rather tough. Even after having been struck down by someone as strong as the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, he retained his consciousness and even grabbed ahold of him while still on the ground. '''Acrobatics''': Despite his brutish size, Gaston is capable of performing feats of acrobatics that can even catch veterans off guard. The extent of said acrobatics is unknown, but it can be used to help him escape and counter his enemies simultaneously. ==Trivia== *Ton, Chin, and Kan's names are a play on the Japanese word tonchinkan which means irrelevant or inconsistent. *Gaston is a surprisingly good cook. *According to the author, Ton, Chin, and Kan don't play an active role after Arc 1 until [[Arc 8]].[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/433963345868103680 2014 Q&A] **As the original plan for [[Arc 7]] changed and it was split into two separate arcs, it can be assumed that this statement about Arc 8 now applies to Arc 9. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Felt Camp]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Arc 1 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 3 Antagonists]] [[es:Ton]] [[fr:Gaston]] [[pl:Ton]] [[pt-br:Gastom]] [[ru:Тон]] [[uk:Тон]] [[zh:角色:阿顿]]

[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Yui Horie|Horie Yui]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Sarah Anne Williams|Sarah Anne Williams]]}} '''Felix Argyle''' (フェリックス・アーガイル), commonly known as '''Ferris''' (フェリス), is [[Crusch Karsten]]'s knight, a member of her [[Crusch Camp|camp]], and a member of the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]]. He plays a major role in [[Arc 3]], a supporting role in [[Arc 5]] and [[Arc 10]], and a minor yet important role in [[Arc 9]]. He is also one of the main protagonists of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]. Though born of the fallen House Argyle, Ferris is a longtime friend of Crusch, having been raised like family ever since she rescued him. Despite the troubles brought about by his [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] traits, Ferris has shown himself to be the best healer throughout the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], earning himself the title of '''Blue''' and a place within the Royal Guard. Following the death of [[Fourier Lugunica]], Ferris was anointed as Crusch's knight, and he strives to make Crusch the country's next monarch. ==Appearance== Ferris has flax colored hair and yellow eyes, as well as cat ears and a tail. His casual wear consists of a blue collar with a ribbon, primarily white dress with a light blue chest with thin white stripes as well as a light blue hem, light blue ribbons with thin white stripes attached to the waist of the dress, a large white ribbon tied to the back of the dress, black tights, blue leggings with thin white stripes, dark blue shoes, white arm covers that are detached from the dress and leave his shoulders exposed, a dark blue scarf tied around his right arm, and a dark blue ribbon tied around his left ankle. He also wears white-and-blue ribbon hair accessories on either side of his head, which he wears regardless of his outfit. At times, however, he can be seen wearing the standard uniform of the Royal Army, primarily whenever he is acting with the army itself or is involved with major operations such as the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and [[Subjugation of Sloth|Sloth]]. In Arc 5, he wore a yukata. In Arc 10, he can be seen wearing a slender, navy blue tailcoat alongside more masculine clothing.''A character garbed in a slender, navy blue tailcoat. The elegance of their conduct as visible from their back potently transmitted their esteem and labor toward the mausoleum.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 8, Section 2. Later, he briefly wears a waiter's uniform reminiscent of a bartender's.''For the most part, he was supposed to be in the same waiter uniform as Ferris and Rachins, but it was quite strange that due to his words and conduct, he almost appeared to be clad in an entirely different attire.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 2. ==Personality== Ferris usually refers to himself in third person, calling himself '''Ferri-chan'''. Though in the past, he has shown himself to be accepting of Crusch's father, [[Meckart Karsten|Meckart]], formally calling him Felix, and used it once in a formal capacity when receiving orders from Fourier, in most contexts, whether informal or professional, he has admitted he generally hates being referred to by his birth name, preferring to instead be called Ferris and also finding Ferri-chan okay.''“Correct, but Ferri-chan haaates being called that. If you need to use a name, just say Ferris. Ferri-chan is fine too, if you’d like.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Lugunican Papers Part 1|Lugunican Papers]], Section 3. Even during a ceremony of great magnitude for Lugunica's future, the Royal Selection Ceremony, he showed visible frustration after [[Marcos Gildark|Marcos]] used his birth name. He also enjoys teasing other people, especially those that are surprised that he is male, using cutesy language and gestures in order to agitate them. Ferris carries a very strong point of view over life and death, and although he hides it through his actions and words, as a healer, he holds those who no longer have any will to live in contempt from the bottom of his heart. Because of his own complex about being weak and helpless, he often hates and finds himself disgusted with weaklings, something that initially caused him to hate [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]. He also often feels helpless when he is unable to prevent someone from dying or heal them, as seen when he showed endless frustration and disgust at seeing all of the victims of the [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop of Lust]]. He attributes his father, [[Biehn Argyle|Biehn]], and the cruel abuse suffered at his hand, as being responsible for depriving him from the body he could have had, and accordingly, for being too physically weak to protect Crusch.''“Look at these skinny arms! I can’t wield a sword! Can’t hold a shield! I’m her knight, and these worthless arms can’t even fight for her! And my legs are no better! I can’t run fast or jump high… I can’t do anything! All I want is to protect her, and I can’t even do that!” [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 10.''“You stole it from me! You stole it from me and left me empty… Crusch-sama gave me my way of life, my way of being!”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 10. In his youth, he greatly hated his parents for locking him up and abusing him, and by the point that he was freed, upon seeing his mother, he attempted to attack her as soon as he saw her for the many years of injustice he faced, though he was stopped by Crusch. Despite this, following being saved, cleaned up, and given a new home and family, Felix become extremely loyal to Crusch, to the point that he tried to train himself in the way of the sword, despite having no talent for it, and learned how to use healing magic to be of assistance to her, and he is constantly thankful for Crusch and for her giving him a way of life when he had lacked one. When Crusch one day unloaded her worries about the way she is seen for her behavior and more masculine preferences and the way she gets scolded by her father, Felix made a promise with Crusch that he would act as Crusch's feminine side while Crusch could be the man that he never could, a promise that was kept for years, and after his name was misheard as Ferris, he started using that name in place of his own. Because of his loyalty to her, Ferris can get extremely emotional when it comes to Crusch; there are times that he will suggest things that she herself does not want, such as when he proposed nulling the alliance between the Crusch Camp and [[Emilia Camp]] after she was attacked by the [[Witch Cult]] to prevent her from being involved with such danger again, or the time when she was infected by Capella's dragon blood, becoming visibly stressed by her poor condition and even going as far as to demand to see a captured [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sirius]] so he could torture her to gain information on how to cure her, and at one point, he even had to use Subaru as a support when he didn't know what to do because of this and his inability to help her. Later on, despite knowing the consequences towards the camp, Ferris was even willing to accept the [[Divine Dragon Church]]'s help, even though it meant that he would be going against the oath they made to Fourier. Likewise, for others that he is close to, such as the late Fourier, he was willing to attempt to perfect the Sacrament of the Immortal King so that he could bring him back to life perfectly, though Fourier ultimately convinced him not to do this. ==History== ===[[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening]]=== From the moment Felix Argyle was born, he had cat-like appendages due to a distant ancestor from his father's family, the Argyles, having them as a recessive trait.''“Your mother was not unfaithful. I confirmed it myself. After that, I climbed up the Argyle family tree and found the cause. Your ears are a throwback, a recessive trait from a distant relative four generations back.”'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening]], Section 2. However, his parents mistreated him because they suspected an affair. He was locked in the basement of the Argyle Mansion for the first nine years of his life and was barely cared for. One day, as a result of rumors that were in the Karsten Duchy, a young Crusch Karsten visited the Argyles’ household and found Felix. After slowly learning about the truth behind his circumstances, he encountered his parents and attempted to stab his mother out of hatred. However, Crusch was ultimately the target of his fury, and as she approached death and told him to live in a way that brought no shame to his soul,''“Never forget, Felix… Live in a way that brings no shame to your soul.”'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening]], Section 3. a blue-white light emerged from Felix and spread to the girl's body. By using healing magic for the first time in his life, Felix saved Crusch's life and, remembering her words, requested that she allow him to use his life by her side.''“Please let me stay beside you. I want to use up my life by your side. I know it will be the best place for me to make my soul shine.”'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening]], Section 3. He was subsequently taken to the Karsten Manor to be cared for and made Crusch's attendant while his parents lost what little standing they had with the Karsten family, leading to their decline. In the following years to come, Felix would establish a strong sense of loyalty and devotion towards Crusch for taking him from the hell that was his life before. Half a year after arriving at her mansion, Felix made an oath with Crusch to act like a girl and “exchange” his boyhood to her,''“I… I’ll take care of being a girl, so I’ll give my boyhood to you! Please; I know it might not be much, but please accept it!”'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening, Oath Chapter]] since she sought to succeed her father and become a duke, which she did not believe she could do as a woman.''“Succeeding the duke, and becoming the next duke. That path has no use for sword skill or being a woman.”'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening, Oath Chapter]] While Felix began wearing girls’ clothes, Crusch wore formal men’s suits to fulfill her oath and cease acting like a woman.''“I shall no longer wear dresses, only formal men’s attire. I don’t want to be the kind of master that breaks her promise with her retainer.”'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening, Ferris' Sudden Emergence]], Section 3.''Crusch briefly told Fourier that she had made a vow to see a certain promise through: to stop acting like a woman, and to become the finest swordswoman and aristocrat.'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening, Ferris' Sudden Emergence]], Section 3. Sometime after their oath, Felix met Fourier Lugunica for the first time. When Fourier mistook Felix's name as Ferris, he began using that name at Crusch's suggestion.''“Your original name feels somewhat odd due to that attire. Ferris has a nice ring to it. If you like it, I would like to call you that too… What do you think?”'' [[Stories of the Great Crusch-sama Opening, Ferris' Sudden Emergence]], Section 3. Together, Crusch, Ferris, and Fourier would get into all kinds of mischief that defined much of their friendship. Under Fourier's recommendation, he also took lessons from [[Garitch Fabless]], the then-court healer. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== When Ferris was 13, talks of a political marriage for Fourier were in the works, and in an effort to help him out of it, when it was time to speak with the other party, a woman from the lineage of [[Gusteko]]'s Archbishop, [[Tiriena]], Ferris accompanied him during the meeting. In the end, after meeting with her and [[Minor Characters#Misère|Misère]], they were able to instead lead them towards their own marriage. A few years later, before Crusch's 17th birthday, Ferris spoke to a worried Meckart about his daughter, and soon after, they bore witness as Fourier challenged Crusch to take part in the party and even wear a dress at the event. On the night of her birthday, however, the [[Great Rabbit]] was spotted, and everyone was tasked with preventing Crusch about learning of it. However, when she did and decided to assist in holding it back, Fourier and Ferris were tasked with keeping the party attendants distracted while she was out fighting. Eventually, after warding it away, she and the rest of the Karsten militia returned, and she made her debut as the Valkyrie. At age 18, Ferris would join the Royal Guard under recommendations from Fourier and the Royal Treatment Center. Although he wanted to be of better use to Crusch, Ferris at first was not very comfortable in being the elite group for several reasons: he stood out due to his odd features marking him as a demi-human, his preference for wearing women's clothing, his own lacking combat abilities and lastly dissatisfaction of his unusual and sudden appointment despite all that from the other knights. However, on the first day, he also came to be acquainted with [[Reinhard van Astrea]] and [[Julius Juukulius]] which would be the first step in breaking the wall between Ferris and his new environment. Through his good relationship with both of them and the subtle opportunities to display his worth crafty granted by Marcos Gildark, Ferris would come to earn the respect of the other knights for saving their lives with his magic. This would come to give him a sense of his abilities and place there. Around ten days after he joined the Royal Guard, before he became a permanent member, dark rumors surrounding his old family would reach his ears via Fourier. After speaking to an official about Crusch's solo investigation into his family, they learned that Crusch had not emerged from the manor and that her soldiers were encountering the [[undead]]. After leaving for his manor with Fourier and Julius, Ferris received a message from his father that would demand he came to Argyle estate alone in exchange for Crusch's life. Returning to Argyle mansion for the first time in nearly a decade, Ferris would confront his father and [[Hannah Regret]], who he felt a familiar connection to. Following a cold reunion, Ferris would acquiesce to his father's demand to revive his mother with the Argyle family's ancient spell called the Sacrament of the Immortal King. However, when Ferris was brought to the master bedroom, and examined his mother's corpse he would come to the shocking conclusion that she was murdered due to numerous and frenetic stab wounds in her body, partially thanks to Biehn's meticulous preservation. After a tense argument between Ferris and Biehn, the later would lose his composure and admit his guilt in the matter. Eventually realizing any further discussion was pointless, Ferris revived the woman. The spell, however, ended up being a partial failure as despite his mother seemingly coming back with some part of her personality, she was but a walking corpse without her former soul. Moreover, his now undead mother would kill Biehn as they embraced, then she crumbled into ash a moment later. The maid would then reveal to Ferris where Crusch was being held and that she had already freed her from her bonds. Just as Ferris raced out of the room, he would hear the locking and smoke coming from the room. Despite his protest, the maid would not open the door, choosing to die along with her master and mistress. The event marked a scar on Ferris' heart, and he developed deep hate for those who easily gave up their lives. He would meet Crusch and Julius in the foyer of the manor, relieved but utterly distraught by the whole event and escape the burning building with them. After the [[Raid of Argyle Manor|incident]], Fourier would collapse from a mysterious illness and Ferris would spend over a month looking after him. Desperate and frustrated at the lack of progress, Ferris would consider using the Sacrament of the Immortal King to revive him after death, but Fourier would forbid it, as he wanted to be allowed to die on his own terms if that was the case. They share a somber heart to heart moment and Fourier would pass away a couple of days later. On that same day, Ferris would take his oath of knighthood to Crusch to support her and Fourier's memory. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly 4–5 months before the events of Arc 1 and a couple of months after the [[Royal Plague|mysterious illness]] took the lives of the entire [[Royal Family]], Julius, Reinhard, and Ferris were tasked with escorting two members of the Council of Wise Men, [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]], on a diplomatic mission to the neighboring [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. During their stay, the Ninth ranking Divine General, [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], was seemingly killed, and Reinhard was blamed for it, forcing the Royal Guard trio to "kidnap" the seventy-seventh emperor, [[Vincent Vollachia]], and flee the Crystal Palace. In a nearby forest, they were ambushed by the Eighth and Sixth ranking Divine Generals [[Moguro Hagane]] and [[Groovy Gumlet]] respectively. As Reinhard held back the two Generals, Julius and Ferris fled further ahead with the emperor, but they encountered the First ranking Divine General, [[Cecilus Segmunt]]. Julius and Cecilus fought but the Royal Knight was no match for the Divine General. After successfully breaking Cecilus' one of his swords, the Blue Lightning decided to fight him a bit more seriously. Just as he was about to decapitate the Spirit Knight, Reinhard came to the rescue. A short duel between the two strongest swordsmen of their respective nations followed, and Reinhard came out victorious. After successfully escaping from the three Divine Generals, Julius, Reinhard, Ferris, and Vincent finally had some time to breathe and plan out their next steps. Vincent revealed that Balleroy most likely stands behind the ongoing coup d'état. Before they could devise a plan, however, a group of 30 assassins from the Insect Cage Clan engaged the three Knights and the emperor. However, Reinhard stayed behind and swiftly defeated all thirty of them. Meanwhile, while making their escape from yet another serious threat, Julius, Ferris, and Vincent fell into an ambush created by the thought-to-be-dead Divine General Balleroy Temeglyph, who managed to snipe off Vincent's right arm by the shoulder while riding on his flying dragon [[Carillon]]. While Ferris healed the mortally wounded emperor, Julius continued deflecting Balleroy's magical snipes, keeping him at bay and defending his friends. After devising a plan and using Ferris as a decoy, Julius was able to pinpoint Balleroy's location despite the man's invisibility, and he hit them with Al Clauzeria, killing Carillon and seriously wounding Balleroy. Julius and Balleroy then engaged in their final duel, which ended with the Spirit Knight's blade piercing the Divine General's chest, killing him. After the threat was finally dealt with, Julius, Vincent, and Ferris regrouped with Reinhard and returned to the Crystal Palace, resolving the conflict. As a token of gratitude, the emperor signed a non-aggression pact between the Empire and the Kingdom, marking the Kingdom's ambassadors' mission as successful. Roughly a month after Balleroy's rebellion, Julius and Ferris encountered Cecilus in a tavern located in the [[Royal Capital]]. Due to the danger that the Divine General presented, the duo accompanied him to a tea house located on the outskirts of the city, where Cecilus informed them of his plans to fight with the Sword Saint Reinhard van Astrea. However, because of Reinhard's absence due to him being on a mission at the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko's borders with Lugunica, Julius had no other option but to secretly accept the Divine General as a guest in his mansion, since his presence in the Royal Capital was illegal. After four days of hiding a Divine General inside House Juukulius, Julius and Ferris were suddenly called to Captain Marcos Gildark's office, where the Fourth ranking Divine General, [[Chisha Gold]], was waiting. The two knights were then given a task to accompany Chisha to his needs in the Royal Capital, and the trio set out to find the person Chisha was after. Arriving just in time, they were able to prevent Cecilus from beheading the High Count [[Gramdart Holstoy]] who was behind the failed coup d'état and had fled the Empire. Having fulfilled their mission, Chisha and Cecilus were prepared to return back to the Empire with High Count Holstoy, but they were stopped by Marcos, who arranged a proxy match between Cecilus and Reinhard. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Ferris has at one point been called one of the weakest characters in the series by the author. Due to his constitution and Divine Protection, although he would be among the hardest characters to kill, he has no combat capabilities. He lacks all talent with the blade, and though he has a strong aptitude with water magic and can effectively paralyze a person with his magic, he has no true offensive capabilities. However, he makes up for this by being the greatest healer in the world, his healing magic entirely unmatched by anyone. ===[[Divine Protection]]=== '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Water|Divine Protection of Water]]''' (水の加護, ''Mizu no Kago''): Ferris's Divine Protection grants him a strong aptitude for healing magic.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1088131872951914496 January 24, 2019 Twitter Q&A]''“Yes. His aptitude for healing magic is greatly enhanced with the Divine Protection of the Blue.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1088130689126457344 January 24, 2019 Twitter Q&A] ===[[Magic]]=== Ferris has a strong natural affinity for the water attribute and a deep connection to water [[mana]] as a whole, and according to the author, he has one of the deepest wells of mana to draw from. He has extraordinary capabilities and talent with healing magic thanks to the combination of his bloodline and his Divine Protection of Water. He is so exceptional with it, in fact, that in his desperation to heal his master, in three months, he had elevated the field of healing magic in the Kingdom by "three whole levels,"''Amidst his feelings of desperation, the research of the Blue had elevated the field of healing magic existing in the Kingdom of Lugunica by not one, but three whole levels in this short period, but at this time, that did not make Ferris feel anything other than worthless.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Curtain's Close, Section 6. and his already impressive healing magic had improved tremendously,''His healing arts were the same as ever―― no, very clearly, they had reached miraculous heights far greater than his previous expertise.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45]], Chapter 6, Section 5. enough so that it was capable of surprising a Great Spirit capable of healing magic like [[Beatrice]]. In the two months that followed, that, Ferris even rewrote the very principles of healing magic, such that he could even heal said spirit if needed.''"…Betty is a Spirit, so regular healing magic isn’t effective, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 1.''"Yep, I know. That’s why over these two months, I’ve gone and made the necessary improvements."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 1. However, he has no aptitude for attack magic.''“No, he can't use it. He has no aptitude for attack magic.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/954298401981587456 January 19, 2018 Twitter Q&A] '''Spells''': [[File:Ferris Healing Magic.gif|thumb|275px|Ferris using healing magic.]] *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法, ''Chiyu Mahō''): Ferris can summon Water Mana through a person's body which stimulates an individual's natural healing capabilities and speeds up wound recoveries. Healing magic can help restore an injured body or cure a target of any ailment they might have within an instant. That being said, healing magic can only treat physical wounds and ailments whilst having no effect on mental afflictions. The skill, talent, and raw power of the mage using healing magic naturally affects the effectiveness of the treatment. Ferris is a healing prodigy who is considered to the greatest healer in the Kingdom if not the world, earning him the alias of Blue. He can, with little effort, instantly bring someone back to perfect health from the brink of death, and even a gravely wounded person can be completely healed by Ferris without so much as a scar to show after the healing procedure. Ferris can even seamlessly reattach lost limbs such as when he reattached Crusch's cut-off right forearm after it had been cleanly severed by the [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]]. There are, however, at least two known afflictions that not even Ferris can heal: the illness that felled the Kingdom's entire Royal Family and the curse caused by Sin Archbishop of Lust's Dragon's blood. Additionally, the target of Ferris's healing magic needs to still have an ember of life within them for him to be able to save them, as even someone who had only recently passed away cannot be rejuvenated by Ferris. **'''Perpetual Healing''': Ferris is capable of using his magic on a person in order to force their body to heal at a rapid rate on its own, even once Ferris has stepped away. However, this is entirely dependent on the amount of mana available to the target, and if their mana is exhausted, then the healing will not work. When he used this on [[Al|Aldebaran]], whose gate was connected to [[Volcanica]]'s and was providing him a practically inexhaustible amount of mana, even after Ferris had been moved away from him and Al was even slashed in half by Reinhard, he rapidly healed from the fatal damage, as if it had never happened before. [[File:Ferris destroying the circulatory system.gif|thumb|275px|Ferris destroying the circulatory system.]] *'''Bodily Function Manipulation''': Ferris can also use his magic in order to tamper with a target's internal functions. For example, Ferris can make someone's body go out of control, enabling him to do things such as using their body like a puppet or destroying the circulatory system of their Gate from inside. Likewise, he can use his magic to mostly nullify a target's pain, though he typically avoids doing this so that his target doesn't overextend themselves and make their injuries worse. *'''Sacrament of the Immortal King''' (不死王の秘蹟, ''Fushiou no Hiseki''): Sacrament of the Immortal King is an ancient and incredibly powerful spell created by an unknown Witch long ago.''"It was one of the exceptional magics, supposedly created by a witch who held the world in thrall, before the knowledge was lost."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 8. The spell, when cast correctly, will allow the user to reanimate corpses of the dead and make them do their bidding.''"Put briefly, it allowed the user to control corpses according to their will."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 8. Sadly, the technique to properly cast the spell has been long lost to time, and only an incomplete incantation exists which was transcribed in an old and withered book regarded as the most important heirloom of House Argyle.''"Look at this! This is the text describing the Sacrament of the Immortal King, that has been passed down in our house." Biehn dug in his bag and pulled out a worn book.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 11. Originally, the spell was thought to be capable of fully reviving a dead person, and there are legends of the aforementioned Witch being supposedly capable of bringing back people exactly as they were before their demise.''"The Witch who invented the spell had been said to be able to bring the dead back, looking exactly as they had in life..."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 8. Effectively, the written chunks of the spell's full passage is incapable of producing anything more than walking corpses with no soul of their own,''"Though the flesh is revived, the soul does not reside within it. Reconstructing the Sacrament of the Immortal King is indeed difficult."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fifth Stanza, Section 3. creating "[[Undead#Corpse Soldiers|corpse soldiers]]" whose flesh slowly withers away and decomposes through time.''"It's not just that the spell book is incomplete. It was never a question of the power as a spell caster. Using an awful spell like that – forcing a body that's stopped to start again – of course it was going to break down right away."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 11. To further limit the usefulness of this mostly-lost spell, a caster with an extremely rare natural affinity for it must be found in order to recreate even the most basic effects of this forbidden spell.''"And even the most basic manifestation was all but impossible to achieve without a caster who had a natural affinity for the spell. It was a very rare affinity – no one had been known to possess it in over a hundred years."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 8. Ferris used this spell once, roughly a year before the start of the main story, on the two-year-old corpse of his mother — who had been repeatedly stabbed and killed by her husband and Ferris' father Biehn Argyle. Upon chanting the incomplete incantation, a faint blue light transferred from his palms and seeped into the dead body, springing it back to life almost immediately. In total, the corpse had remained "alive" for no more than a couple of seconds as almost immediately after opening her eyes, Hannah strangled Biehn and — after killing him — dissipated to dust. Perhaps the most enigmatic thing about the whole ordeal was Hannah's faint but genuine smile upon laying her eyes on her husband and her supposed son — something that was not a possible reaction from one of Biehn's countless reanimated corpses.''"He smiled at the feeling of them, and Hannah, too, smiled faintly. It was a reaction that would not have been possible from a mere moving corpse, like one of those undead warriors."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 11. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== Due to his deep connection to water mana and his regenerative capabilities, his body is considerably weak, and he cannot use the Flow Method. '''Heightened Senses''': Due to the demi-human blood flowing through his veins, Ferris sensory organs were significantly enhanced past the limitations displayed by most humans. His cat-like ears in particular were able to detect the slightest change in his surroundings to the point that he could tell when someone turned to look at him. Because of his excellent hearing, he could always tell when someone was approaching him, with the exception of Reinhard van Astrea. '''Accomplished Cook''': According to the author, Ferris is an outstanding cook who personally serves for Crusch.''"Just like it looks, Ferris has a cat-like love of fish dishes. He’s not fond of citrus. Incidentally, Ferri-chan is outstandingly good at cooking. He personally prepares food for Crusch-sama too."'' Felix and Julius's Birthdays Q&A. ===Other=== '''Pseudo-Immortality''': One way Ferris' body differs from most humans and demi-humans is his extraordinary connection with Water Mana, which imbues it with the passive effect of rapid cellular regeneration. With this in effect, it means he can resurrect from death. However, in exchange it further weakens his ability to fight, and it is unknown if he has a limit to how many times he can do this. ===Equipment=== *'''Sword''': Ferris owns a short sword he received from Crusch, but as he doesn't like to damage his skin, he generally refuses to wield it. He has wielded it once in an effort to intimidate an unimpressed Capella, but he otherwise has not talent with the blade. ==Trivia== *As stated by the author, Ferris’s character was intended to be a boy who wears girls’ clothes.''“Enough of that noise already! Everyone’s saying ‘Girl, girl’ too much! It’s to do the ‘He wears girls’ outfits, but is a guy’ thing I wanted to try! I have nearly as many things I want him to do as I do for Subaru, so Ferris’s suffering will continue on after this! Look forward to it!”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/821011014531436544 January 16, 2017 Q&A] Furthermore, the author says he did this because he wanted to write things that could only be done with a character like Ferris.''“I can only say it’s because it was necessary to make him a boy. Please understand that as a result of making him a boy, I’m able to write things than I could only write that way. Thanks.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/821011907586834432 January 16, 2017 Q&A]''“If I answer very seriously, it’s because I had things I wanted to do that I could only do with a ‘Wears girls’ clothes, but is a boy’ character. Please look forward to Ferri-chan from now on. Thanks.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/821009589390884866 January 16, 2017 Q&A] *According to Tappei Nagatsuki, Ferris was considered to become the “last boss” of the series,''“She's one of the candidates, yes. There were around five of them. Ferris was originally one of them.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955852943906947072 January 24, 2018 Twitter Q&A] but due to Crusch's existence, he scrapped the idea fairly quickly. *Ferris, just like Reinhard, is drawn with the wrong sword hilt on the cover of Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4. The hilt looks identical to Julius' treasured sword. *Ferris has been ranked among the five weakest characters in Re:Zero.''"Subaru, Petra, Anastasia, original Ryuzu, Ferris."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473461952275288066 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] *In 2014, the author stated that Ferris was among nine known characters introduced in the story up to that point who had the highest capacity for holding mana. However, he chose to not rank Ferris or any of the other listed characters in order.''“Emilia, Roswaal, Echidna, Typhon, Carmilla, Daphne, Ferris, Priscilla, and Mimi have a large capacity. It’s scary to rank them, considering the future, so I will stop…”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/499581653728378880 2014 AskFM Q&A] It is unknown if the list has changed since then. *Within the text of [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4|Volume 4]] in a scene set prior to Subaru realizing Ferris was not a woman, he was described as wearing a women's uniform for the Royal Guard, which included a skirt.''It was the messenger girl who had triggered their trip to the Royal Capital. Subaru was a little surprised to see her standing with the knights, dressed in a female uniform for the Royal Guard, complete with a skirt.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 3, Section 6. However, in illustrations of his knight uniform, the skirt has never been depicted, and he has not been described with one since Volume 4. *According to the author in a talk show held on April 6th, 2025, among the knights of the Royal Selection candidates, Ferris is the second most popular. He apparently receives his popularity due to the medical visits he performs when disease outbreaks occur, or when he visits people of importance. *The alias that Ferris goes by in Arc 10, Blue Snake, is a nod to snakes and their connection to medicine and healing,''According to Subaru’s knowledge, snakes and medicine went hand-in-hand, completely inseparable from one another. One example could be found in the rod of Asclepius, a serpent-entwined staff wielded by a physician in Greek mythology. Of course, the name Blue Snake would have been but a coincidental relation.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 23, Section 1. as well as the color title he is recognized by, the Blue. *According to the author, due to the atavistic nature of his demi-human traits, Ferris does not experience cat-like instincts.''"Unfortunately, he doesn't manifest cat-like instincts that much. Ferris' demi-human blood is a throwback to earlier generations, so he mostly doesn't have those characteristics aside from his external appearance. He had a terrible time as a child due to that appearance, so it was quite a nuisance."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/952944671809941506 January 16, 2018 Twitter Q&A] *According to the author, Ferris likes to eat fish.''"Food made from fish! White meat! The culture of eating fish raw isn’t widespread in Lugunica, so he doesn’t eat raw fish!"'' Felix and Julius's Birthdays Q&A. Meanwhile, he dislikes citrus. *Ferris was the one most upset by Subaru's speech against the knights in Arc 3.''"Minerva-ta...wait, no. The nameless knights were really upset, but seriously I think Ferris was the most upset."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, Ferris is the one with the best fashion sense.''"That’s probably Ferris."''
