[[Wikipedia:Kana Ueda|Ueda Kana]] (within Anastasia) |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Cassandra Lee Morris|Cassandra Lee Morris]] (within Anastasia)}} '''Echidna''' (エキドナ), commonly known as '''Eridna''' (襟ドナ), is an [[Spirit|artificial spirit]] created by the [[Witch#Witch of Greed, Echidna|Witch of Greed]], [[Echidna]], who is currently in service of [[Anastasia Hoshin]]. First introduced in [[Arc 5]], she later plays a pivotal role in [[Arc 6]] and a minor supporting character in [[Arc 8]]. A spirit sharing her name with her creator, the Witch of Greed, she met Anastasia by pure chance. After [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]] had his name eaten, Anastasia allowed her to possess her so she would not forget him. In Arc 6, she guided [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and his companions to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]]. In the arc's climax, she gave Anastasia her body back, causing her to forget Julius but also allowing the two to start over. ==Appearance== Echidna takes the appearance of a white fox with snow white hair and sharp black eyes, though she usually takes the form of Anastasia's scarf. ==Personality== Similarly to her creator, Echidna speaks, sounds, and acts just like the Witch herself. However, she has no memories of her past aside from her name. Because of this, Subaru nicknamed her Eridna (Scarfidna). She's also shown to deeply care about Anastasia, going to extreme lengths to make sure no one would find out about their condition. According to the author, she is the equivalent of Echidna in personality if she had a heart. ==History== Whilst it is known that the Witch of Greed created Echidna, the exact purpose of her creation and what happened prior to her meeting Anastasia is unknown. However, Echidna states that she felt like the purpose of her birth was completed the second she was born. ===[[Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye Part 1|Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye]]=== Nine years prior to Subaru’s arrival to the world, [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]] tasked a former slave named [[Reisel]] with retrieving an object relating to the legacy of the Witches. He visited [[Ricardo Welkin]], asking for help with stealing a [[meteor]] inside a cart. They ambushed the fleet but were stopped by [[Shiroro Tonerico]]. While Ricardo was fighting with Shiroro, Reisel stole the target carriage and abandoned his old friend. However, his plan was inadvertently thwarted by Anastasia, who exchanged the carriages. In the carriage, Anastasia met Echidna, and the two formed a bond. Reisel came back to take the true cart, but he was defeated by Anastasia, Echidna, the Pearlbaton siblings, and Ricardo, who formed a ceasefire with Shiroro. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Camp Formation Stories|Camp Formation Stories]]=== Anastasia initially sought to join the [[Royal Selection]] after learning she had the qualifications to be a candidate, but refused to enter the race once she learned that Julius would not become her knight. However, in time, Julius eventually decided to become Anastasia's knight, and the two performed a ritual of knighting. Anastasia and Echidna spoke once he left, with the former telling the latter that she would show her the end destination of her greed. ===[[Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook]]=== After the [[Battle for Priestella]], Subaru, accompanied by Julius and "Anastasia", were visiting wards of hospitals, seeing if Subaru could recognize any of those were made Nameless. The trio lamented about how the "Sleeping Beauty" state that had been discovered prior to these events was caused by the [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]] and how it could affect make others forget them completely. However, they believe that Subaru, who was unaffected by Gluttony's effects, was proof that there was hope. Anastasia apologized to Subaru for taking him all over the place, but Subaru didn't mind, though he regretted not seeing more people. Though Julius attempted to reassure him, Subaru claimed that if he were in Subaru's position, he'd be the same, which Julius agreed with. As the group was preparing to leave and go to the next ward, however, another stretcher passed by, and Subaru recognized the person on it, turning to the others and telling them that it was [[Joshua Juukulius]], Julius's brother. ===[[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose]]=== A few days after the Battle for Priestella, as they were making preparations to leave [[Priestella]], Subaru informed [[Beatrice]] that Anastasia had been possessed by the artificial spirit Echidna and asked what they should do. Deciding to observe the flow of mana surrounding the girl, she quickly realized that Anastasia's gate was defective. As she was observing her, however, [[Emilia]] appeared and asked why she was watching Anastasia. Although not wanting to lie to her, due to Subaru not wanting Anastasia's condition to spread, Beatrice struggled with what to tell her. Mistaking her observations as nervousness to meet Anastasia, Emilia brought Beatrice over to meet her. After a little bit of small talk, "Anastasia" mentioned to Beatrice that she figured the Subaru had already talked to her about her state, much to Emilia's confusion. ===[[Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook II]]=== A few days after the Battle for Priestella, as they were on the road, Julius could often be seen offering his assistance to "Anastasia", who had forgotten him thanks. Subaru noticed the awkwardness between them, though Emilia was glad to see that they were close, and Subaru expressed his gratitude for her being able to say something like that even if she did know the current circumstances. Before long, he asked Emilia to take Julius aside so he could talk to "Anastasia", who had silently asked for help. Taken aside, she quietly complained about Julius being too intimate and that she didn't know how to deal with him, even using what she knew about Anastasia's etiquette and personality. Despite his own frustrations at dealing with her due to her similarities to her creator, he told her he'd help about Julius and talk to him. Moments later, he returned to Emilia and Julius. Despite having an emotional reaction towards her interactions with Julius, he asked Emilia to see to "Anastasia" since she seemed a little tired while he spoke with Julius. Though Emilia thought he was hiding something, he covered that up with a confession of love to her, causing her to call him a dunderhead and go with "Anastasia". ===[[Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook III]]=== A few hours after Subaru's group was separated from the others, [[Shaula]] returned to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] with Subaru's group, and Julius reunited with "Anastasia", who claimed that their side had also gotten dangerous. This being said, she also mentioned that something seemed to have happened between the woman and Subaru, and when Julius looked in the woman's direction, he noticed that the only thing in her eyes seemed to be Subaru. "Anastasia" claimed that she had saved them and that there seemed to be only one-sided negotiations between her and Subaru, and though she had only intended to take Subaru, "Anastasia" convinced her to guide the others to the tower. Afterward, "Anastasia" mentioned they'd managed to finally step foot inside the tower before chiding Julius for thinking negatively. Shortly after, they approached the woman, and though Julius attempted to thank her and ask for her name, she turned her back to him, as she only intended to speak if Subaru had been involved. Nearby, Emilia and Beatrice were trying but failing to pry Subaru's arms off of [[Ram]], as he had been holding her tight to protect, and though Julius went to help them, he questioned if Subaru was more worthy of the title of Knight, as he was trying to protect others even while unconscious. ===[[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose! In Fact!]]=== The next day, after observing the first trial of the tower, Emilia and Beatrice spoke with "Anastasia" and Julius, Beatrice accidentally sounding malicious with her joke towards the effect of Julius's [[Divine Protection]]. After Emilia and "Anastasia" talked about Emilia's worry for Subaru, Ram exited the carriage. After asking about Rem, she asked for the details about their current circumstances, only to learn that Subaru had been holding her tightly. Embarrassed, Ram walked toward the carriage with her wand out, claiming she would erase Subaru, leading Emilia to stop her. ===[[Kararagi Reaper Incident 1|Kararagi Reaper Incident]]=== Shortly after the events of the [[Great Disaster]], Anastasia, accompanied by Julius, [[Halibel]], and Echidna, returned to [[Kararagi]], where they decided to report their discoveries to the mayor of the Third City Ivada, [[Orgo Hayata]]. Unfortunately, there was yet another problem: the windstorm created by the Slasher, [[Zarestia]], that was thrust upon [[Banan]]. After learning of this, she, Anastasia, and Julius made their way to Banan to meet up with [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]]. Sometime after Ricardo quelled Zarestia's rage, Anastasia's group arrived and were led to the holding cells in [[Riften Magoji]]'s mansion, where Zarestia was being held. During their conversation, Anastasia learned that Riften went missing, Julius noticed that Zarestia was a Great Spirit and introduced himself, and Halibel unintentionally riled her up by noticing her strange constitution, that something was missing. However, when Anastasia mentioned Zarestia being responsible for other such town-destroying wind cataclysms, Zarestia declared otherwise, saying that she only rampaged in Banan. Shortly afterward, this is confirmed when a massive tornado appeared outside of Banan, not made by Zarestia. After giving her orders and securing Zarestia's assistance, the group made their way to stop the tornado. After leaving Riften’s mansion, Anastasia’s group and Zarestia managed to quell the winds. However, in the process, Anastasia and Echidna were kidnapped. When Anastasia later woke up, she found herself in Zarestia’s Bed, and Echidna had left her side to ensure her safety, as she was the main target behind their enemy’s actions. Anastasia spoke with said enemy, a woman identical to Zarestia who she referred to as [[Reize|Black Tia]], and after a one-sided conversation, Anastasia promised to help Black Tia, as otherwise, everyone who would come to find Anastasia, Black Tia, and Anastasia herself would find themselves likely killing each other. Not long after, Echidna appeared after realizing Anastasia would be safe, and despite her concerns, Anastasia convinced her that everything would be fine. A full day after being taken, she and Anastasia were brought back to Banan by Black Tia, and shortly after, likely due to her exhaustion catching up with her, Anastasia passed out with a fever. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Although she is capable of using magic by drawing on the Od of who she possesses, Echidna is not necessarily powerful, nor is she really much of a combatant. Though about as crafty as Anastasia herself, she is not truly meant for combat and can be prone to making panicked actions. Furthermore, because she only possesses Anastasia and must draw from her Od instead of her gate, she cannot freely use magic as she likes without putting Anastasia in danger and severely exhausting her body, further limiting her overall capabilities. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== Echidna has a natural affinity for the yang attribute. She also has enough knowledge with magic to be able to recognize the spatial distortions created by the Sand Time barrier that covered the [[Augria Sand Dunes]]. By her claim, she already naturally had the knowledge that could allow her to approach the Pleiades Watchtower when even [[Reinhard van Astrea]] couldn't bypass the barrier. It is likely that said knowledge is in reference to said distortions. It is unclear, however, if the knowledge she was born with extends beyond her attribute and the barrier. This being said, Echidna lacks in certain ways compared to a normal spirit.''“I’m a being lacking in a lot of ways compared with a normal spirit.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 7, Section 5. Though considered a great spirit,''She had not had many points of contact with great spirits―― strictly speaking, Echidna, who disguised herself as Anastasia’s scarf, counted as a great spirit while also being artificial, so she could not say that she had never had a point of contact, but that was a troublesome quality.'' [[Kararagi Reaper Incident 3]], Section 2. she lacks the ability to contract with humans and it is difficult for her to use magic to defend herself with, and in exchange, she is skilled at concealing herself.''“I’m unable to contract with a human. It is difficult for me to use magic to defend myself as well. In exchange, I am good at concealing my presence.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 7, Section 5. She is also a low-consumption spirit.''“I am a particularly low-consumption spirit and have never once burdened Ana with my mana needs.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 7, Section 5. '''Spells''': Eridna - Jiwald.gif|Echidna (in Anastasia's body) using '''Jiwald''' against Capella Emerada Lugunica. Eridna - El Jiwald.gif|Echidna (in Anastasia's body) using '''El Jiwald''' to attack a transformed Shaula. *'''Jiwald''' (ジワルド): Jiwald is a yang attribute spell that allows Echidna to fire heat rays from her fingers. **'''El Jiwald''' (エル・ジワルド): Echidna can fire several rays from her fingers which are then brought down in a claw-like motion. *'''Cognitive Disruption''' (認識阻害, ''Ninshiki Sogai''): A built-in mechanism within Echidna that can prevent others from being able to recognize her true form. This ability doesn't work on certain people with defective Gates, such as Anastasia. ===Other=== '''Possession''': In emergencies, Echidna can overwrite her existence onto Anastasia's Od, making her able to temporarily borrow her body, and by doing so, she can draw on Anastasia's Od to use magic at the former's expense. Furthermore, due to Anastasia's deficient gate, it would be incredibly difficult for even a master of magic such as Beatrice to notice the possession if one wasn't purposefully looking into her flow of mana. However, it is possible to be stuck possessing Anastasia's body if Anastasia locks herself away in her Od, in which case, Echidna can only wait for her to come out willingly or force her out. ==Trivia== *Echidna's name refers to 42355 Typhon I Echidna, 42355 Typhon's moon and a companion to a binary asteroid. In Greek mythology, Echidna is a monster who was the mate of Typhon. *Echidna is indirectly stated to be the second artificial spirit created by the Witch of Greed, [[Puck]] being the first and Beatrice being the last.''Of the artificial spirits that were created by the Witch Echidna, in which Beatrice was included, only three existed in this world. The first of which was Puck, and the last was Beatrice.'' [[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose]], Section 2. *Anastasia and Echidna have good compatibility together because they both have the same latent attribute, the yang attribute.''“They have the same attribute. They have good compatibility for the same reason.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1113713587363520512 April 4, 2019 Twitter Q&A] *According to the author, the difference between Echidna and Eridna is the existence and nonexistence of a human heart.''“The presence or lack of a conscience? No, the presence or lack of a human heart?”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1096037612056236032 February 14, 2019 Twitter Q&A] ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Anastasia Camp]] [[Category:Contract Spirits]] [[Category:Spirit]] [[Category:Great Spirits]]

White (Pupil) |Height = 164 cm (5'5")[[Re:Zeropedia 2]], Chapter 1: Character Profile, Witches of Sin, Page 82. |Weight = |Birthday = January 24''"According to his senses, the danger posed by the girl before him rivaled that of the White Whale and Sloth―― no, it exceeded them."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10]], Chapter 2, Section 5. In actuality, Echidna from four centuries ago and Echidna from the Castle of Dreams were stated to be two separate entities. Accordingly, their appearances slightly vary. While being mostly identical, Echidna from four centuries ago was noted to be in her mid to late twenties, rather than late teens. Her face was almost the exact same as the Trial Echidna, save for a much calmer and wise air it gave off. She was often seen smiling and acting very nonchalantly, until the topic shifted to something she was genuinely interested in. Due to her beautiful appearance, she often gave off a maidenly impression. ==Personality== Echidna's curiosity toward the unknown and thirst for knowledge were the two things that defined her behavior, and she has once referred to it as love and directed those feelings toward Subaru's Return by Death, which she was interested to the point that she longed to become his advisor to record the many possibilities created with Subaru’s Authority. At first glance, she was polite, soft-spoken, understanding, and even a bit childish. However, she was not very good at tidying up after herself,''"I ought to have told you, in fact. ――Mother was not particularly skilled at tidying up, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 32, Section 1. and she was stated by the other Witches to be quite clumsy like the time when she accidentally set a forest on fire, nearly burning to death, as she was trying to warm herself.''"It can be roughly guessed that the fireball fired by Echidna had ignited the trees and eventually ignited a forest fire."'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party]], Section 1. She was also somewhat forgetful in regards to daily tasks; the other Witches mentioned that she once forgot to change from her nightgown, and accidentally went out in public without properly dressing.''"W-wasn't there a time... that you went out... i-in public... still wearing your nightgown?"'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]], Section 2. Echidna also seemed to have pride in being a Witch, as, according to Beatrice, she would desire seeing a reaction of awe and fear from those who bore witness to her laboratory.''"Inspiring fear and awe are also necessary for a Witch… rather, this sort of reaction is exactly what Mother would hope for, in fact. It’s nothing to apologize for, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 32, Section 1. Likewise, she was not above handing out information to those who could successfully reach her [[Palace of the Witch|palace]], though she was also selective about information that she gave out, especially in regards to her research, something which Beatrice claims may have been in response to an unpleasant experience.''"…Mother had no particular desire to show her research to others, in fact. She was also extremely careful in selecting what knowledge she shared, I suppose. It’s likely that she had an unpleasant experience, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 32, Section 1. Described as being black-hearted, she could not understand the feelings of others and could be seen as a sociopath by normal standards. According to herself, she learned many negative emotions such as contempt and ridicule from her parents, and because she was never given a proper example of how love was meant to feel, she could not understand her own emotions of love or other such positive emotions. If it was to get a hold of more knowledge, she had no problems with employing sophistry, lying, and deceiving others. She was reasonably polite and even jovial to Subaru, whenever the two interacted. Even after the reveal that she was black hearted and after Subaru called her a monster, she kept acting like an affable individual. Though Echidna ultimately respected Subaru's decision to press on in his struggles without her help, she revoked his qualifications for entering her Castle of Dreams, as payback for not taking her hand. While Echidna does have some trouble with certain emotions, she isn't actually as emotionless as she made herself out to be to Subaru. It also is notable that she does maintain elements of the personality she showed Subaru even when she isn't around him. This being said, [[Al]] noticed that, despite not being able to understand the hearts of others, she was not heartless herself, as at times, he would catch glimpses of sadness, guilt, and loneliness in her. As Echidna from four centuries ago and Echidna from the Castle of Dreams were stated to be two separate entities, the two also differ somewhat in personality. The original Echidna is much more considerate, empathetic, and helpful than her counterpart from the Castle of Dreams. This being said, however, the Castle of Dreams version of Echidna seemed to originally share the same traits with her alternative counterpart four centuries ago, and following her and Al's defeat against a certain enemy, she sacrificed her love and a good portion of what made her the "Witch" in order to become the "Witch of Greed", turning her into the Witch seen in the present day. According to Beatrice, the Echidna that she knew was not an evil person,''"If you ask Betty, the Witch of Greed who Subaru and Emilia are familiar with is nothing but a poorly-made knockoff, I suppose. Mother was not such a mean-spirited villain, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 2. and Subaru speculates that the difference between the personalities may stem from the fact that the Castle of Dreams version of Echidna was a representation of her younger self.''Though he had not fully worked everything out yet, Subaru had a theory that might solve this issue. ――That was, perhaps the Echidna Subaru met in the tomb had been during her younger years, and as a result of growing up and learning to behave like an adult, she became the Parentdona endowed with the qualities of Beatrice’s mother. In that case, the Echidna in the tomb might have been a version of her who, by making herself younger in soul-form, may have lost all the wisdom she had painstakingly acquired over the years.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 2. However, whether this is true remains to be confirmed. ==History== Echidna is the daughter of the Warlock of Melancholy, [[Hector]], and the Witch of Vainglory, [[Pandora]].''“You could say it was a warped sense of love, I suppose. But, it wasn't like he was head over heels for Mother, in fact. After all, Hector was Mother's father, I suppose.”'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 2.''“A Witch, I suppose. ――The Witch of Vainglory, Pandora, that is Mother’s mother, in fact.”'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 2. Unlike any other Witches across history, Echidna was the only person who was born as a Witch. Echidna's parents were responsible for her birth, having supposedly produced her with a specific goal in mind, that goal being unknown.''“That is a complexity unique to disorganized opinions. But, there are many holes in that logic. You claim I am off the mark, but my parents produced the existence known as myself for a purpose, and I produced the existence known as yourself for a purpose… in that case, you could say that I, who perpetuated the chain, am more malicious.”'' [[No Stella No Life 4]]. By Echidna's claim, her parents were good-for-nothings, and she learned negative emotions such as contempt and ridicule from them. However, she believed that, from their perspective, her existence was a failed imitation to them.''“I have hinted at it many times now, but my parents were good-for-nothings. I learned many negative emotions, such as contempt and ridicule, from my parents. Though from their perspective, my very existence would have been a failed imitation, a result that they had not desired.”'' [[No Stella No Life 4]]. She despised her parents, and at some point in time, she parted ways with them.''“Ah, but it is quite ironic how I, who despise my parents in such a manner, am now doing the same thing that they did. I suppose this could be called self-deprecation or self-reproach? Haha, even though a long time has passed since we parted ways, I still find myself learning new things from those two.”'' [[No Stella No Life 4]]. Echidna has claimed that she experienced the pains of having excess mana in her body when she was younger. In the years predating the [[Great Calamity]], Echidna travelled alongside Satella, [[Flugel]], [[Reid Astrea]], [[Farsale Lugunica]], and [[Alec Hoshin]] for unknown reasons, though according to Alec, it was a journey to save the world. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of [[Magrizza]]. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. The nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and [[Volcanica]] went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the [[Black Serpent]] destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent. Over four centuries ago, Echidna acted as a tutor for a young Roswaal after saving him from suffering inflicted on him by mana poisoning. In the following years, she created three [[Spirit|artificial spirits]], with [[Puck]] being the first created by Echidna and Beatrice being the last.''Of the artificial spirits that were created by the Witch Echidna, in which Beatrice was included, only three existed in this world. The first of which was Puck, and the last was Beatrice.'' [[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose]], Section 2.. She also started researching means of immortality by transferring her soul into a body which belonged to someone else. Throughout the years, she gathered humans and [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] alike, in order to create a perfect "sanctuary" which would be able to support the barrier, and after the Sanctuary was created, she would often travel back and forth between her castle, '''Kugelschreiber Castle''', with Beatrice. When Roswaal was 16 years old, he faced off against Hector and after being defeated and nearly killed, Echidna saved his life and engaged Melancholy. After [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu Meyer]], the Apostle of Greed, sacrificed herself in order to bypass the requirements and instantly activate the barrier, she successfully fended Hector off and saved the lives of everyone in the Sanctuary. At some point during her immortality experiments, she made numerous copies of Ryuzu, one of which was given the name [[Sphinx]] after the mythological monster. However, despite having obtained her knowledge of the magical arts, Echidna disposed of her as a failure, unintentionally setting her upon the world with barely the ability to survive. According to her, royals of every country came to visit Echidna to borrow her wisdom at some point in the past when she was alive. Echidna mentioned that she has a connection with [[Kararagi]] since she "helped found it". She also became acquainted with the Divine Dragon and [[Emilia's Mother]]. She also hired Petelgeuse at one point to act as some form of mentor to Beatrice. At an unknown point, Echidna became the mentor and parent-figure to Aldebaran. He was taught various kinds of knowledge, different types of magic, forbidden arts, such as Ol Shamak, and even how to use his Authority all by Echidna. Their relationship was one where he could not entirely dislike her, they interacted with each other regularly and carefreely, and he questioned whether her relationship was one that could be classified as parental or not, ultimately coming to refer to her as Teacher out of apparent spite. Because of her methods, the other Witches seemed to object to them, and even Al noticed at times that she seemed to feel guilt, though she never backed down. Numerous times during their training, she mentioned that nobody could defeat Al, who she created, and with that resolve in the two of them, they went to confront the task that Echidna had for Al, something which seemed to be connected to Satella. In the end, however, Echidna found herself heavily injured, and Al arm was taken by the shadow. While Al's spirit was shattered, Echidna, deciding there was some other form of damage that could be handled, sealed Al away in Ol Shamak. What she did after that is unknown. However, for reasons unknown, this resulted in her becoming compatible with her Witch Factor and being reduced to the Witch of Greed in exchange for her love. After the deaths of [[Typhon]], [[Minerva]], [[Daphne]], [[Carmilla]], and [[Sekhmet]], Echidna, who was purportedly 19 at this time, later collected their souls before her body was destroyed so as to not lose them, and was sealed away by Volcanica, coming to reside in the Castle of Dreams within her tomb at the Sanctuary.''“――The souls of they who passed on reside alongside me in this Castle of Dreams. So that I would not lose them, I gathered them myself before my body was destroyed and I was sealed away by Volcanica.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 11]], Chapter 5, Section 4. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Echidna was an incredibly powerful Witch whose mastery of magic allowed her to effortlessly take down the likes of Dragons with ease. Also, thanks to her clumsiness, she can also become a threat accidentally, as her clumsiness has led to her unintentionally burning down a forest in a simple attempt to warm herself. Although not considered one of the stronger Witches, Sekhmet has mentioned that she feared the day that Echidna became bored of the world, and she claimed that she could very easily become capable of destroying the world. ===[[Authority]]=== Despite being a Witch, unlike the other Witches of Sin, she was an applicable candidate for her theory of inheritance, which hypothesizes that someone without a Witch Factor by birth who shares a profound connection to someone who was compatible with a Factor could innately unlock the door to an Authority.''Although, in that case, neither Aldebaran, who did not bear a Witch Factor, nor the Witch herself could be explained with this, so she had proposed the theory that a connection to a being who was compatible with a Witch Factor would innately open the door to the right to interfere with the world.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 4, Section 9. This being said, Echidna claims that it is difficult to explain the Authorities of someone in this position, as they had their door "half-open by birth".''“Just as how a being with wings might fail to explain how it moves its wings to someone bereft of them, it is difficult to explain our Authorities, as they were not appended after the fact. You could say that our doors were half-open by birth.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 4, Section 9. It is unknown why Echidna differs from the Witches of Sin. After failing to make a Factor hers for an unknown length of time, upon the failure of her student, placing her on the verge of death, she became compatible with and was chosen by her Witch Factor, losing her love in exchange and becoming the "Witch of Greed" in the process.''She had become compatible. The Witch had become compatible. It required selfishness, yet no matter how much she yearned for it, she had never been able to make it her own, the qualification to become complete as a Witch in the truest sense―― she had become compatible with the Witch Factor. The Witch had been reduced. ――Reduced from the one who guided Aldebaran, to the Witch of Greed.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Prologue.''Aldebaran had been defeated in the battle he could not afford to lose, and as compensation for that, the Witch had been placed on the verge of death. On that boundary of death, after parting ways with Aldebaran, the Witch had been chosen. ――In exchange for her sincere love, she had been chosen by the qualification to become inhuman, thereby gaining the power needed to grant her wishes.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Prologue. Upon returning to the world as Omega, she has not yet shown to have access to her Authority of Greed outside of the Castle of Dreams. However, since a Witch Factor is not required after it has already unlocked a user's Authority, it is unknown whether or not she still retains said Authority even with her new body. '''[[Authority#Authority of Greed|Authority of Greed]]''' (強欲の権能, ''Gōyoku no Ken'nō''): Echidna was a previous holder of the '''Witch Factor of Greed''' and can use its Authority of Greed, which has granted her the abilities related to peering into all of the world's knowledge, past, present, and future. According to [[No Stella No Life 3]], while Echidna was the "Witch", she had been chosen by the Witch Factor of Greed due to her intense thirst for knowledge and attained the title of Witch of Greed as a result.''The Witch before his eyes was a monster of curiosity, and for that reason had attained the title of the Witch of Greed. The explanation of her Authority just now could only have been seen as fitting for the Witch who was chosen by the Witch Factor of Greed due to her intense thirst for knowledge.'' [[No Stella No Life 3]]. *'''Book of Wisdom''' (叡智の書, ''Eichi no Sho''): In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], Echidna's Authority was a white '''[[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]]''', which she called the '''Memories of the World''' (世界の記憶, ''Sekai no Kioku''), that allowed her to draw knowledge from the world's memory at any point in time, sending the knowledge directly into her mind and skipping the learning process she enjoys. It allowed her to see any event in the past, present, and future, which she considered uninteresting and monotonous.''“It is an uninteresting Authority. ――Through ‘Past’, ‘Present’, and ‘Future’, I can view any event I wish to. It is truly monotonous.”'' [[No Stella No Life 3]]. It has been said that the Book of Wisdom provided to Beatrice is an imperfect copy of her Authority of Greed.''“An imperfect copy of my Authority. This is the Book of Wisdom.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Chapter 7, Section 1. However, the mind of an ordinary person attempting to read her book would be fried by the sheer amount of knowledge flowing into the reader's mind. It is unclear whether this book is the entirety of her Authority or merely one manifestation of her Authority. ===[[Magic]]=== Echidna was able to use all six elements and was extremely skilled in all of them with–at the time–unparalleled mastery. She was capable of using every spell that existed at the time and even created her own spells to use. Even following her death, no one ever came close to her overall skill with manipulating magic, until Roswaal L. Mathers became the first and only person who would rival and even surpass her in magical knowledge and proficiency. It should also be noted that there exist individual beings who are stronger in the usage of a specific magical element, such as Puck, who was noted as the most powerful Fire Magic user in the series, with the raw power of his spells even surpassing that of Roswaal's. She has been claimed to be capable of using high level multiplefold magic, with the only other people said to be capable of doing so being Roswaal and [[Myonmyon]]. Her mastery and skill with magic is claimed to be powerful enough to get past Volcanica's halo, which provides with extremely high-level magical defenses, and it is claimed by the author that she remembers every ancient magic that has not been handed down, not written down, or forgotten.''"There’s a fair number of magics that were not handed down, not written down, and simply forgotten. Echidna remembers all of them, however."'' AskFM Q&A. According to Beatrice, although she lacked the mana necessary, if she was able to overcome that, Echidna could have been akin to a deity of creation.''"If she could, Mother would have ended up spawning as many worlds as she pleased, in fact. Even if it's Mother, there would never be enough Mana to accomplish such a feat, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 32, Section 1.''"Ah, it's an issue of Mana? So if she managed to clear that, she could be something like a deity of creation?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 32, Section 1.''"It would not be strange if she could… that is how incredible Mother is, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 32, Section 1. '''Spells''': *'''Goa''' (ゴーア): Echidna was able to manifest a blaze of fire to incinerate foes. *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法): Echidna summoned water mana to heal the wounds of herself and others, however it only affected physical ones. *'''Jiwald''' (ジワルド): Jiwald allowed Echidna to fire heat rays from her fingers which would effortlessly pierce her enemies. *'''Ol Shamak''' (オル・シャマク): An anti-Witch spell that was originally created by Echidna. It is a forbidden art that immobilizes its target, preventing them from moving and ceasing the activity of their body's gate. When activated on a target without a Witch Factor or Authority, they are bound in a black light with a contradictory force. The spell can only be used to its full potential when cast on someone with a Witch Factor or Authority, encasing them in a completely black orb. Anyone else who enters the vicinity of the spell while it is being used on a Witch Factor or Authority bearer will also find themselves captured within the orb. The orb can vary in strength, and it has the capability to become so tough that it cannot be destroyed by outside interference or simple brute strength, to the point that only something like a slash from the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]] can destroy it. It unusually uses an "Ol" prefix, meaning it classifies as separate from the typical prefix classifications. *'''Soul Transcription''' (魂の転写): A lost magic technique that allows a person to transcribe their own soul over another's. By doing this over and over to extend their life indefinitely, the user can achieve what Beatrice termed as "subjective immortality". However, it has one major restriction in that for it to work, the person whose soul is overwritten must usually be of blood-relation to the caster. The spell was originally created by Echidna to gain immortality, but she could not complete it before her demise. Instead, it was finished by Roswaal, who had been using it to survive until the present era. After the Sanctuary's fall, it is revealed that Echidna has slowly been latching more and more of her soul onto Ryuzu Shima, until she successfully hijacked her body, later renaming herself into Omega. *'''Al Shario''' (アル・シャリオ): Echidna was capable of casting a forbidden spell that literally brought stardust down to earth, massacring her opponents. The speed of the stardust was described to be almost impossible to evade. She once used this spell to massacre a swarm of around 100 Silver Dragons. *'''Dream Arts''': Echidna is capable of utilizing a lost type of forbidden art known as dream arts which allows its user to manipulate the minds of the target.''"Magic that uses dreams as intermediary to meddle with the opponent’s mind, in fact. On top of that, it is a kind of forbidden art, and its users were almost entirely eradicated, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 4, Section 1. Though her level of skill with it is not on the same level as someone such as [[Shion]], she still had enough proficiency with it to create the Castle of Dreams. **'''[[Castle of Dreams]]''' (夢の城, ''Yume no Shiro''): A special space outside the world, which Echidna from the Castle of Dreams has control of, is mentioned to be her dream. Echidna's and the other five Witches' souls manifest within this space after their deaths. The Castle of Dreams primarily takes the form of a seemingly limitless empty grassland with a little hill in the middle, although Echidna can change its appearance at will, being able to turn it into a dark empty void as if a curtain had fallen upon the world. She is capable of creating portals in and out of the Castle of Dreams. Due to it being outside of the world, Subaru suffered none of the penalties from '''Return By Death''' while within the Castle of Dreams though Echidna had stated that if he died in the Castle of Dreams, his soul would shatter, resulting in his real body's death as well. **'''Memory Manipulation''': Echidna from the Castle of Dreams was capable of searching through the memories of others, shown in Arc 4 where she rummages through Subaru's memories to recreate a Japanese high school girl uniform, and she even became aware of Subaru’s memories and meetings from previous failed loops. She was also capable of erasing memories, as seen in Arc 4 where she temporarily seals away Subaru's memories of their meeting in the Castle of Dreams to follow the rule about it being forbidden to talk about their "little tea party" until his trial went underway. *'''Teleportation''': Like Beatrice, Echidna was capable of teleportation magic, with no one else holding the capabilities to display such type of magic, not even her genius disciple Roswaal. '''Magic/Forbidden Arts Creation''': Echidna is responsible for making numerous techniques, forbidden or otherwise. Three of her most notable creations in this regard are the Soul Transcription technique, which both she and her pupil Roswaal utilized; Ol Shamak, which was made to combat Witch Factor wielders such as the Witches and Sin Archbishops and was taught only to Aldebaran; and Al Shario. ===Intelligence=== '''Vast Intellect''': As the embodiment of the thirst for knowledge, Echidna was obsessed with gaining knowledge and was in possession of The Book of Wisdom which could show her the world's memory. Echidna possessed one of the greatest intellects in the world, and had conducted numerous experiments with magic, creating powerful meteors. Numerous people from every nation used to come to her, seeking her knowledge when she was alive. She possessed vast knowledge about the older era, to the point she could boast there is nothing she didn't know. ===Other=== '''Item/Life Construction''': During her lifetime, Echidna created a variety of items and beings due to her vast intellect and absolute mastery of magic. *'''Artificial Spirit Creation''': Echidna has created three artificial spirits: Puck, Beatrice, and [[Eridna|Echidna]]. It is unknown how she created them but they were created via an unspecified mechanisms.''Using the elf, Ryuzu Meyer, as a model, a certain technique established in the Sanctuary had been used to produce replicants―― constructed using mechanisms similar to the artificial spirits, each one was a brand new life.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 1, Section 5. *'''Clone Creation''': Echidna was capable of creating Ryuzu Meyer copies by using the original Ryuzu Meyer as a basis for an experiment to research immortality. They were created by crafting an artificial Od through a special spell and creating the rest of the body through mana, adding that all Ryuzu copies created were given enough intelligence to follow orders from birth. *'''Meteor Creation''': Echidna could create [[Meteor|meteors]], which are items that allow people to use magic without utilizing a gate. However, the only meteors she was known to have forged in her lifetime were [[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|Conversation Mirrors]] and the [[Meteor#Star Staff|Star Staff]]. *'''Gospel/Book of Wisdom Creations''': Echidna researched ways to recreate her Book of Wisdom for others to use. Though they were all considered failures, several of them ended up in the hands of the [[Witch Cult]], guiding them toward their desires, albeit vaguely. The two most advanced versions were passed on to Roswaal and Beatrice, which gave them more accurate looks into the future towards their desires, but still did not show them everything. In fact, Beatrice’s book eventually became void of any words at all. '''Miasma''': According to Echidna from the Castle of Dreams, she was known for emitting intense miasma that caused people to throw up in her vicinity. If exposed to it for too long, one would be at risk for falling into madness or suffering a mental breakdown, and even dying. Omega used this miasma to kill eighteen bandits in thirty seconds, as soon as she left the Sanctuary. She also noted that someone with the qualifications to become a Sage Candidate would be able to resist her miasma. While he did not receive that side effect, Subaru noted her presence felt as dangerous or more so than the White Whale or the Sin Archbishop of Sloth. '''Unknown Ability''': During a failed loop of Arc 4, Echidna was capable of modifying [[Petra Leyte]]'s handkerchief that Subaru had given Echidna earlier, allowing Subaru to harden it in accordance to his will and use it as a weapon to cut away Satella's shadows trying to absorb him. A light shone from the handkerchief. The process which she does this by is unknown. ==Trivia== *Like the other Witches (with the exception of Satella), Echidna's namesake matches both an asteroid and a mythological being. [[Wikipedia:42355 Typhon I Echidna|42355 Typhon I Echidna]] is the name of a large moon that orbits the scattered disc [[Wikipedia:42355 Typhon|42355 Typhon]]. The mythological [[Wikipedia:Echidna (mythology)|Echidna]] was a half-woman and half-snake monster that is known for being the mother of many monsters from Greek mythology. *Echidna's birthday is January 24, a play on the Japanese word "inishie" (古), meaning antiquity. The numbers one (一), two (二), and four (四) can sequentially be pronounced as "i-ni-shi". The author chose this date for Echidna because she is a very ancient person. *Echidna used to live in different mansions she owned. One of those was situated on a floating island that she created.''"She made a floating island just before the Great Waterfall and lived there."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1096037717568356352 Echidna Birthday Q&A] **In [[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]], [[Toska Astrea|Toska]] ventured to Echidna's mansion which was located high on a mountain, peaking above the clouds. According to Puck and Beatrice, Echidna made it so high that it was impossible for a mere human to access it. *Echidna is the only person to have been born as a "witch".''"She alone was born as a witch." [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955841073561010176 Echidna Birthay Q&A]'' *The author stated that Echidna started being called the Witch of Greed after killing a "certain Witch".''"It was after she killed the "witch."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955842314806546432 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *According to the author, there was one book that Echidna held very dear to her heart, which has even changed her fate.''"There is one book that is unusually important to Echidna, to the point it could be said to have changed her fate, but it's a spoiler so that's a secret."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955839856155926528 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *According to the author, Echidna's favorite color is silver.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955843685987397632 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *The author has stated that Echidna is tone-deaf, much like Emilia.''"But Echidna is also tone-deaf."'' AskFM Q&A. *The author has stated that Echidna's favorite witch is a spoiler.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1096039352176566273 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *According to the author, the witch that Echidna gets along the most with is Minerva.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955841941895180288 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *According to the author, Echidna from the Castle of Dreams and Echidna from 400 years ago should be considered as two separate entities.''"According to the author's understanding, they're separate."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955851873948377088 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *Echidna is one of the very few people in her world who can somewhat use teleportation magic. Alongside herself, Beatrice, and unnamed Witch Cult members, no one else holds the capabilities to use this type of magic. *The author has stated that Echidna fears Emilia.''"It's Emilia."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955843195006414848 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *Tappei once stated that Echidna's tea is in fact something similar to her saliva, as it doesn't have any taste.''"It's body fluid, carrying the meaning that is has no flavour in particular, so maybe it's similar to the taste of your own Saliva I'd guess."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/955849779426205696 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *According to Sekhmet, Echidna brought chaos to several countries for unknown reasons''"This isn't like you, considering you've brought chaos to so many countries for one reason or another, hhaa."'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]]. and was even once close to ending the world due to one of her flops.''"Don't you think the world is going to end this time, hhaa, if one of your flops goes out and about again, like the olden days? Hhuu."'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]]. *Sekhmet stated to be more terrified than anyone that Echidna may lose interest in the world, saying that nobody knows what she would do.''"I'm more terrified of your losing your interest in the world than anyone else, hhuu. After all, there's no knowing what you would do, hhaa."'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]]. She also mentioned how scared she was by saying that Echidna's nosiness could quite easily destroy the world.''"It terrifies me that your nosiness, hhaa, could quite easily destroy the world, hhuu."'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]]. *According to the author, Echidna doesn't wear anything other than black clothing because, long ago, she was told it suits her.''"She doesn't. Echidna wears black clothing because, long ago, she was told it suits her."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1096043234327851013 Echidna Birthday Q&A] *According to the author, Echidna is capable of understanding the concept of love intellectually. *Echidna's Japanese voice actress, [[Wikipedia:Maaya_Sakamoto|Maaya Sakamoto]], only took one take to record the Witch of Greed's long-winded speech in episode 37 of the anime adaptation. Echidna's English voice actress, [https://animevoiceover.fandom.com/wiki/Anairis_Quinones Anairis Quiñones], recorded the monologue in sections and took multiple takes. That being said, Quiñones also stated that it took less time to record than she thought it would. *According to the author, if Echidna were to meet Aldebaran, she would not be interested in him at all.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1096042608676065280 2019 Echidna's Birthday Q&A] This was stated before the reveal that he was her apparent student. *When she was alive, Echidna had issues with low blood pressure. However, instead of believing that the issue was with her body, Echidna believes that the issue is with her soul.''"She didn’t think this was an issue with her body, but rather one with her soul. When she thought back to it, she’d never been great at getting up, even when she’d had her own body. She hadn’t been aware of it, but perhaps it was down to what they called 'low blood pressure.' How strange it was that even changing the receptacle of her soul didn’t solve her issues with her blood pressure one bit."'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch]], Section 6. *In 2014, the author stated that Echidna was among nine known characters introduced in the story up to that point who had the highest capacity for holding [[mana]]. However, he chose to not rank Echidna or any of the other listed characters in order.''“Emilia, Roswaal, Echidna, Typhon, Carmilla, Daphne, Ferris, Priscilla, and Mimi have a large capacity. It’s scary to rank them, considering the future, so I will stop…”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/499581653728378880 2014 AskFM Q&A] It is unknown if the list has changed since then. *According to Al's observations, Echidna's physical abilities are atrocious, to the point that no matter what theories she came up with, her body could not perform any athletic feats.''It was strange. It was not possible. As far as Al knew, she had a propensity to try her hand at everything without restraint, but her athletic skills were atrocious. No matter how much she theorized she was never able to apply it to her own body; she could never learn to perform such feats even if she were to stand up on her head. In fact, she could not even perform a headstand.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 2. *According to Beatrice, the technique Echidna uses to slip into another person's mind despite being dead may apply methods similar to dream arts, but the technique she uses is separate from dream arts.''"T-that’s way too pessimistic, in fact…! Ahem, anyhow, I suppose. The approach of Mother, whom you and Emilia encountered in the Tomb, may seem to apply the principles of dream arts, but strictly speaking, it is something entirely different, so invading the consciousnesses of living beings, like invading dreams should be undoable, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 4, Section 1. *According to the author, Echidna is "endlessly" interested in erotic things.''"Endlessly."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, Echidna only uses "boku" to refer to herself in front of Subaru,''"She uses ‘boku’ only with Subaru."'' AskFM Q&A. which he explains as being akin to trying to get the attention of someone she likes.''"It’s sort of like she’s trying to get the attention of someone she likes."'' AskFM Q&A. The reason she uses "boku" in front of him supposedly has to do with her birth, which will be discussed in the "Witch chapter".''"The answer to that would lead back to Echidna’s birth, so we’ll leave that for the witch chapter."'' [[Episode 34]] (actual) |Game = [[Re:Zero Lost in Memories]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Nao Tōyama|Tōyama Nao]] |English Voice = Michelle Marie}} '''Daphne''' (ダフネ) was the '''[[Witch#Witch of Gluttony, Daphne|Witch of Gluttony]]'''. Mentioned throughout the story, she formally debuted in [[Arc 4]] as a supporting character. In life, Daphne, with her Authority of Gluttony, created [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]] in an effort to combat world hunger. Though she met her end starving to death in a "sand sea", her soul was preserved by the [[Echidna|Witch of Greed]] in the [[Castle of Dreams]] placed within the [[Sanctuary]]. Following the events of Arc 4, her soul was taken into a glintstone necklace that [[Omega]] wears on her travels. ==Appearance== Daphne had shoulder length ashen hair which she had tied in two tails. Her appearance was that of a 13- or 14-year-old child. She was dressed in a pitch-black straitjacket which she wore over her white clothing, that were chained to her coffin. Both of her eyes were completely covered by a blindfold, wrapped to cross over the center of her face, which lent to her appearance having a more witch-like aura as opposed to other Witches of Sin. Despite her eerie and off-putting aura, she could be quite adorable at times. Her eyes were golden yellow, with her left eye resembling a closed mouth with teeth, whereas her right eye had a visible pupil and resembled an open mouth. Daphne herself was chained to a black coffin which was mostly seen standing vertically. Daphne named it the [[Witchbeast#Centipede Coffin|Centipede Coffin]]. On her command, the coffin's lower part would open up and reveal eight crab-like legs that would move itself and its host anywhere Daphne wished to go. She stated her coffin operated on her sweat, saliva, and other bodily wastes produced by her. Subaru described it as a living being, similar to crabs or spiders but more repulsive. The coffin itself was actually a witchbeast created by Daphne long ago, for the sole purpose of serving her as transport. ==Personality== As the Witch of Gluttony, Daphne's reason for living was to feel full, causing her to care about the amount more than taste and hunger. She is also anorexic.''"Flavor is important too, but basically it’s quantity. The feeling of a full belly is what Daphne lives for. But, she has anorexia, so she also immediately vomits up what she’s eaten."'' AskFM Q&A. She was also stated to repeatedly vomit out food and eat it again, although she seems to have indulged in such acts only when there was no more food left. If that option failed, she would resort to eating objects she could chew, such as rugs, curtains, clothes, etc. In an effort to try and get rid of the never-ending hunger, Daphne created witchbeasts but soon after lost control of them and accidentally released them into the world. Despite the threat the witchbeasts present, they were created with a positive mindset - to save the world from hunger. Her view on hunger was bizarre, as to her, those who try to eat others should be wary of being eaten themselves. Because of it, she was unable to comprehend [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s counterarguments to her self-serving theory. Daphne's speech was described as incoherent and surreal. Talking with her eye to eye was practically impossible for anyone who wasn't suffering from extreme hunger, as she did not understand the basic human mindset and values. Her only goal was to save the world and herself from hunger, no matter the cost. Subaru described her mentality as animalistic and not something a person should possess. Her manner of speech was usually cheerful and childish, indicating her age. She also likes to give nicknames to people, such as Subarun to Subaru, Dna Dna to Echidna, Met Met to [[Sekhmet]], Ner Ner to [[Minerva]], Mila Mila to [[Carmilla]], and Tyu Tyu to [[Typhon]]. She regarded Gluttony as the most important craving in life, saying that a person is unable to live without eating. She rarely showed emotions or the will for basic human functions apart from indulging in her gluttony. The author has stated that Daphne doesn't care about other people.''"Someone like Daphne who doesn’t care at all about other people is really her type. If only Daphne was a guy."'' AskFM Q&A. Following her death, Daphne accepted her demise and didn't care much about "dying again". Hence, she was perfectly willing to go against Echidna in her Castle of Dreams, even if it meant her one last destruction, most likely by Sekhmet's hands. ==History== A long time ago, a man was afflicted with an incurable disease, and, as he was afraid of dying, he began using various methods to try and prolong his life. Daphne was one of the many people he used in his experiments, and eventually he succeeded in achieving his goal by using her body. In his joy, he forcibly undid her binds, and when she came to her senses, she found herself all alone in the man's castle, suffering from hunger. To satisfy her hunger, she began eating everything in the castle, including things like the throne and the carpets, and resorted to eating what she threw up when necessary. Her body could supposedly not die;''At that pace, she would starve to death. Her body, which cannot die, would starve to death.'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 26, Section 1. however, she felt like she was going to die from hunger. Eventually, she somehow began creating witchbeasts in the castle, which she considered to be illusions at the time, and started to use them as a food source. After a while, her binds broke from the fighting between her and the beasts, allowing her to leave the castle. The witchbeasts also left and spread across the world. At some point in the past, Minerva and Daphne found themselves in the same location, where they found themselves in an infinite loop of eating and healing, angering each other. However, the context for why this is is unclear.''"It did happen, and they were angry."'' AskFM Q&A. It was claimed that over 400 years ago, Daphne died of starvation in an unnamed desert. Echidna later proceeded to locate and collect her soul, allowing Daphne to manifest in Echidna's Castle of Dreams. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Considering Daphne is ranked just behind Typhon in terms of strength, it's safe to assume she holds considerable power. The author has stated that Daphne cannot create anything stronger than herself, meaning she is individually stronger than any one of the Three Great Witchbeasts.''"As you’d expect, she can’t create a witchbeast with more power than she herself has. It’s another matter if the witchbeast grows stronger. It’s impossible if, by a witchbeast that’s “stronger than she is”, we mean the Three Great Witchbeasts. Do you understand what I’m saying?"'' AskFM Q&A. She could eat the entire [[White Whale]] in a single bite.''"One serious bite from Daphne would be all it would take."'' AskFM Q&A. ===[[Authority]]=== '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]]''' (暴食の権能, ''Bōshoku no Ken'nō''): As the Witch of Gluttony, Daphne was a user of the Authority of Gluttony and was a compatible holder of its corresponding Witch Factor.''This phenomenon had a precedent; for instance, having once been compatible with Witch Factors and possessed Authorities, the Witches of Sin still retained the same powers even after being reduced to souls post-mortem.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 4, Section 9. Her Authority granted her abilities related to consumption. *'''Consumption''': According to the author, Daphne is capable of devouring the entire White Whale in a single bite, and later, she was shown to be able to eat even [[spirits]] with ease. According to Echidna, she was a terror if she decided to "devour" someone. It should be noted that while she is capable of eating spirits, this is not the same as the Spirit Eating employed by the Spirit Eater tribe. *'''Magic Eyes''': '''In the web novel''', Daphne could be seen using her Authority of Gluttony and making people feel extreme hunger by touching or looking at them. She had two so-called “magic eyes”: her left eye, the magic eye of '''famine''', and her right eye, the magic eye of '''apastia'''. This ability has been removed from the light novel, hence should not be considered as canon until stated or proven otherwise. That being said, an illustration from the [[Re:Zero Ootsuka Shinichirou Art Works Re:BOX 2nd|second art book]] displays two labels of famine and apastia alongside Daphne's eyes, though the eyes are reversed from what they were in the web novel.[https://rezero.fandom.com/wiki/Re:Zero_Ootsuka_Shinichirou_Art_Works_Re:BOX_2nd?file=Minerva_and_Daphne_character_designs_ReZero_2nd_Artbook.png Referenced illustration] **'''Famine''' (飢餓, ''Kiga''): The magic eye in Daphne's left eye. Just a single glance from this eye was enough to force the target to experience extreme famine, causing them to eat their arm and try to lick their own blood while ignoring everything other than the thought of eating. Despite this, Echidna described Daphne's left eye as "nothing much" when compared to her right eye. **'''Apastia''' (拒食, ''Kyoshoku''): The magic eye in Daphne's right eye, which Echidna claimed was a terror if she used. *'''Life Creation''': Daphne is able to create living things out of nothing. She creates witchbeasts when her mood is "woozy" from her "Third Mouth".''"They emerge from her “third mouth”."'' AskFM Q&A. Through her ability, she created all witchbeasts, including the Three Great Witchbeasts: the White Whale, [[Great Rabbit]], and [[Black Serpent]]. The White Whale had the ability to erase anything it touched with its mist of elimination from existence. The Great Rabbit had an insatiable hunger and only ate living things, and there were as many of them as there are water droplets in mist as it could multiply infinitely so long as at least one of them was left alive. It left no trace of the people it ate, and it was said to be able to reduce land to a barren wasteland. The Black Serpent can plague its victims with a hundred diseases just by touching them, and any ground that it slithers over becomes cursed, making anything except witchbeasts unable to live on it. A person that came into contact with its tongue was scarred with reddish black burns, another had their skin from the neck up covered in reddish black spots that gushed black blood, and another had their body dried up to the point that touching them might break their body apart. ==Trivia== *Like the other Witches (with the exception of [[Satella]]), Daphne's namesake matches both an asteroid and a mythological being. [[Wikipedia:41 Daphne|41 Daphne]] is the name of a large asteroid located in the solar system's asteroid belt. The mythological Daphne was a minor naiad in Greek mythology. *She ate her own parents.''"Daphne’s parents are in Daphne’s belly, so head there to ask for permission."'' AskFM Q&A. *Daphne was shown to recognize Subaru as a Sage Candidate. It's not known what makes her think that but she's not alone as it's implied that Sekhmet recognizes him as a Sage Candidate as well. *In a Q&A, the author stated that if Daphne and a Sin Archbishop of Gluttony were to fight, it would most likely end in a draw. It is unknown if this answer was either stating that [[Lye Batenkaitos]], [[Roy Alphard]], and [[Rui Arneb]] would reach a draw against the Witch of Gluttony if they fought her all at once, nor is it known if the resulting draw would only come from a match with one of them. *The author has stated that Daphne has a beautiful voice, and if she was a normal girl, she’d likely enjoy karaoke. *In 2014, the author stated that Daphne was among nine known characters introduced in the story up to that point who had the highest capacity for holding [[mana]]. However, he chose to not rank Daphne or any of the other listed characters in order.''“Emilia, Roswaal, Echidna, Typhon, Carmilla, Daphne, Ferris, Priscilla, and Mimi have a large capacity. It’s scary to rank them, considering the future, so I will stop…”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/499581653728378880 2014 AskFM Q&A] It is unknown if the list has changed since then. *The only things that Daphne would not eat are foods that are boiled or fried.''"Boiled or fried, she couldn’t eat Zaboela."'' AskFM Q&A. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Witches of Sin]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[ru:Дафна]] [[de:Daphne]] [[es:Daphne]] [[fr:Daphné]] [[it:Daphne]] [[nl:Daphne]] [[pl:Daphne]] [[pt-br:Daphne]] [[zh:角色:达芙妮]]

Though mentioned throughout the series, his identity as the Great Sage is not revealed until [[Arc 6]], his name having been mostly erased from history and his exploits instead credited to his disciple, [[Shaula]]. Although his ultimate fate is unknown, [[Natsuki Subaru]] theorizes that he rules over the [[Od Lagna#Corridor of Memories|Corridor of Memories]].''“She may be staying in the Corridor of Memories, but she can’t be its ruler. Its ruler is… a guy even more nasty, I think. Considering it from this situation…” Halting words there for once, Subaru and “Subaru” collectively stated. “――The Sage, Flugel.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 25]], Chapter 2, Section 8. ==Appearance== Not much is known about Flugel or what he looked like, despite his face being engraved on the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunican]] currency. It is presumed that his outfit resembled Shaula's in some way as she mentioned she dressed similarly to him. ==Personality== Shaula mentioned that Flugel was a very smart and intelligent person. He apparently stated how tiring it was to talk to Shaula multiple times, implying he was also exasperated of her antics. Both [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Petelgeuse]] and [[Volcanica]] spoke of him with respect and fondness respectively, indicating he was rather likeable. According to [[Alec Hoshin]], Flugel was the most likely person to die in their travelling group, ahead of Alec himself. ==History== Approximately 400 years before Subaru's arrival, Flugel was summoned to the world from Japan. Later, he would go on a journey with [[Satella]], [[Echidna]], [[Reid Astrea]], [[Farsale Lugunica]], and Alec Hoshin. He and [[Daphne]] would also create the unique [[witchbeast]], Shaula, for currently unknown reasons at an unknown point in time. He also formed a partnership of sorts with Echidna. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of [[Magrizza]]. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. However, the nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and Volcanica went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the [[Black Serpent]] destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent. At some point, the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], which Flugel is said to have built, was constructed. The Sage is said to have met the first generation's Sword Saint, Reid Astrea, and the Divine Dragon, Volcanica, in one of the Kingdom's five regional capitals, [[Flanders]], located in southern part of the Kingdom, and blessed the grounds of Flanders so Earth Dragons would be born. After Satella, the Witch of Envy, suddenly went out of control and went on a rampage across the world, Flugel met with Reid and Volcanica in Flanders, forming an alliance with the heroes.''“According to legend, Flanders is also where the Divine Dragon Volcanica was bound in friendship to the first Sword Saint, Reid, and the Sage, Shaula.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5. The three heroes set their goals on defeating the rampaging Witch who mercilessly killed thousands and thousands of innocents and toppled one country after another. After realizing they were unable to kill her, Flugel and the rest managed to defeat her and seal her away in the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] at the very east of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. At the Pleaides Watchtower, which was in the vicinity of the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine, Flugel gave Shaula the task of watching over the Witch of Envy's seal, giving her the order to indiscriminately kill anyone who attempted to approach the area. He also erased himself from history, giving Shaula all the credit for his role in the fight against the Witch for an unspecified reason. Sometime after, the Sage was said to have planted a seed in the middle of the Lifaus Highway; a seed that would later grow into a giant tree dubbed [[Flugel's Tree]]. The tree would later be destroyed by Natsuki Subaru in order to defeat the [[White Whale]]. At some point, he entrusted Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti with a box containing the [[Authority#Authority of Sloth|Witch Factor of Sloth]]. The Kingdom of Lugunica also engraved his purported face on their silver coins. ==Abilities== '''Great Power''': As Flugel potentially had the power to kill Shaula and played a role in the sealing of the Witch of Envy, Flugel is rumored to have had a considerable amount of power. However, it is not known if Flugel actually fought the Witch herself. '''Vast Intellect:''' Considering his title as the Sage and numerous legends surrounding him, Flugel was known for having been a very intelligent person, considered by many to rival the Divine Dragon himself, in terms of intellect. Throughout the centuries following Satella's defeat, numerous countries dispatched envoys to the Tower in order to make contact with the Sage and gain knowledge that was unable to be obtained in any other way. ==Trivia== *"Flügel" means "wing/wings" in German. *The author has stated that the box that he gave to Petelgeuse was made out of the Sage's bones, containing the Witch Factor of Sloth. Having said that, no concrete proof exists that the box was made specifically out of Flugel's bones as, just like how there were other Witches of Sin before the ones introduced in [[Arc 4]], there likely were other Sages throughout history, meaning the box could have very well been made out of bones from a long-dead Sage predating Flugel's summoning to the new world. *Flugel seems to have vast knowledge of Earth's constellations. The first trial of the monolith he created required the person being tested to know the constellations Orion and Scorpius (as well as knowing that "Shaula" was the name of the brightest star in Scorpius). The name of the watchtower itself was "Pleiades", the name of a cluster of stars, and the floors were named after the stars within Pleiades (Merope, Maia, Electra, Taygeta, Alcyone, Celaeno, and Asterope respectively). *According to the author, the relationship between Flugel and Reid is similar to Suneo and Gian (characters from Doraemon series). *Shaula has stated that Subaru "smells" similar to Flugel. Based on her description of their scent, it is likely that Flugel reeked of miasma in a similar manner to Subaru. *Flugel is depicted on the silver coins exchanged within the Kingdom of Lugunica. It is possible the depiction that does not correspond with his true appearance, as it is unlikely any member of the Kingdom would ever have met him personally due to Flugel preferring to operate in secrecy. The face on the coin is stated to be a handsome man with long hair and a sharp look. *Among the scripture of the [[Divine Dragon Church]] is a line that mentions a Sage.''"You don't have to keep testing my resolve like that time and time again. This too, is in the scriptures. “The Sage unravels the abstruse, and the Saint reveres the simple. However, the Dragon’s way is succinct. Love, protect, and believe. There existeth no wisdom deeper than this.”!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 2. It is unclear whether this line refers to Flugel or a different sage. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Individual Parties Navbox}} [[Category:Witch Era Party]] [[Category:Japanese]] [[Category:Unknown Status]] [[fr:Flugel]]
