[[Episode 39]] (debut) |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Haruka Tomatsu|Tomatsu Haruka]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Amber Lee Connors|Amber Lee Connors]]}} '''Fortuna''' (フォルトナ) was [[Emilia]]'s paternal aunt and the guardian of the seal in [[Elior Forest]]. Roughly a century before the events of the main story, she took care of a young Emilia instead of her parents. She was repeatedly brought up during the events of [[Arc 4]] until she officially debuted in Emilia's first trial. Having been the person Emilia was closest to throughout her supposed childhood, she played a pivotal role in Emilia's character arc, as she greatly influenced the young half-elf's view of the world. She was killed by [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]] after he was deceived by [[Pandora]]. ==Appearance== Fortuna was a beautiful woman with a fit physique whose glistening silver hair was cut fairly short. Her almond-shaped violet [[Wikipedia:Sanpaku|sanpaku]] eyes, which looked similar to [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s, glistened like gemstones and were sharp and intimidating. As an elf, her ears were abnormally pointed. In her hair, Fortuna wore a silver hairpin shaped like a four-petaled flower, which Emilia decided to wear following her demise. Like every elf in Elior Forest, Fortuna wore clothing that was primarily white and violet. Her outfit, which prioritized ease of movement, consisted of a sleeveless skin-tight violet unitard, white knee-high boots with violet soles, a band consisting of identical white flowers on her right thigh, and a white cold shoulder jacket with violet edging that went down to her waist and was open below the breasts. A golden brooch in the shape of a pair of open wings was affixed to her collar. In Emilia's [[Terminology#The Second Trial|Second Trial]], Fortuna wore a white sun hat with a light blue band and a long dress in a similar style to her usual outfit. As an elf, Fortuna had an unspecified lifespan that far surpassed a human one. At the time of her death, she had lived for at least over a century, yet she still maintained the physical appearance and athleticism of a young woman. ==Personality== Fortuna was a kind-hearted and modest woman who cared deeply for her loved ones and would give anything to protect and nurture them, and according to Geuse, she was similar to a young Emilia when she was younger. She seemed to have low self-esteem, as she routinely understated her positive features. As a result of her pessimistic outlook on herself, Fortuna became easily flustered by compliments given to her by her loved ones, particularly Geuse. In a weak attempt to hide her embarrassment, she would usually admonish the person who complimented her and act as though she was angry with them. Despite her self-esteem problems, the elven woman was courageous in battle, refusing to yield even if she stood no chance of victory and would die as a result of her failure. ==History== ===Early Life=== Fortuna was an elven woman whose [[Minor Characters#Emilia's Unnamed Father|brother]] married a [[Emilia's Mother|human woman]] and bore a half-elven girl named [[Emilia]]. However, after her brother and sister-in-law could no longer take care of their child, Fortuna took Emilia in and raised her as her own daughter. At some point, the pair moved into an elven village in the Great Elior Forest, where they were warmly welcomed. Emilia, for unclear reasons, was of paramount importance and, as such, was protected by the villagers. The settlement would occasionally receive supply deliveries from Geuse Romanée-Conti and his [[Witch Cult]] underlings. Fortuna and Geuse shared a long history, and both had unspoken feelings for the other. ===[[Elior Forest Team, Waiting for the Thaw]]=== After meeting Geuse for the first time, Emilia wanted to be friends with him. However, Fortuna kept her away from him. Thinking that Fortuna would panic if she faked stomach pains, she believed that Fortuna would ask what she wanted and let her see Geuse. However, when she committed to her act, Fortuna seemed to panic more than she expected, and she brought her to the village square and asked for help. [[Archi Elior|Archi]] asked if she was acting, getting him into an argument with Fortuna since Emilia had never fallen ill even when the entire village had when they all ate rotten appas. Geuse decided to pray for her since she had helped him before, causing the whole village to lower their heads in silence. Feeling guilty, Emilia began to cry and said that her stomach had stopped hurting, causing everyone to rejoice, and Geuse told her that instead of apologizing when she troubles someone to instead say thank you. Afterward, walking back the way she came, Geuse held the sleeping Emilia on his back while Fortuna thanked him for going along with her act. Fortuna recalled how she worried for her, even after Archi became her guardian, and after Emilia called her a crybaby in her sleep, Geuse claimed that Fortuna was just like Emilia when she was younger with her brother, to her annoyance. ===[[Permafrost of Elior Forest]]=== One day, the village was attacked by radical members of the Witch Cult led by the Sin Archbishop of Greed, [[Regulus Corneas]], as well as Pandora. After ordering Archi to evacuate Emilia from the forest, Fortuna attempted to defeat Regulus and Pandora alongside Geuse. The Witch of Vainglory was able to separate herself from the fight and catch up with Emilia, who herself had already been separated from Archi. When Geuse and Fortuna arrived on the scene, Pandora was able to use her power to trick Geuse into killing Fortuna using his Authority. Fortuna died in the arms of Emilia, who subsequently froze the entire forest in her rage. Petelgeuse, driven insane by his accidental actions, joined the Witch as she left the frozen forest. ==Abilities== '''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): Fortuna was an experienced fire magic user. Fortuna - El Huma .gif|Fortuna using '''El Huma''' against Pandora. Fortuna - Al Huma .gif|Fortuna using '''Al Huma''' against Regulus Corneas and Pandora. Fortuna - Ul Huma .gif|Fortuna using '''Ul Huma''' against Pandora. Fortunate - ice Weapons.gif|Fortuna using Ice Weapons against Pandora. *'''El Huma''' (エル・ヒューマ): The user forms and shoots multitudes of ice spikes from their hands, which easily pierce through human flesh and immediately vanish after impact. *'''Ul Huma''' (ウル・ヒューマ): By freezing the air around her, Fortuna could produce large amounts of sturdy ice that she could then telekinetically direct. *'''Al Huma''' (アル・ヒューマ): A bit different from the standard version of a spell, Fortuna summoned a giant ball of ice so large as to encompass the entirety of the visible sky to crush her foes. *'''Ice Weapons''': Fortuna was able to form weapons out of ice, such as swords and spears. They were sharp enough to easily cut Pandora in half. ==Trivia== *Fortuna and Geuse's relationship spanned across a long period of time. During that time, Geuse changed many bodies, at some point even using a female body. Despite that, Fortuna's feelings for Geuse never changed. *In [[Episode 43]] of the anime adaptation, Fortuna erroneously chanted ''Al Fula'' (the name of a wind magic spell) when using ''Al Huma'' against [[Regulus Corneas]]. *Fortuna and Petelgeuse's Japanese voice actors also voice [[w:c:swordartonline:Yuuki Asuna|Yuuki Asuna]] and [[w:c:swordartonline:Kirigaya Kazuto|Kirigaya Kazuto]], a well known and popular couple from the anime series ''Sword Art Online'', respectively. *Fortuna can be seen sporting an insignia in shape of a golden eagle just under her neck. It looks almost exactly the same as [[House Mathers|House Mathers's]] very own insignia, which the consecutive patriarchs and matriarch tended to use to mark what is and was theirs. *Fortuna's birthday was decided at a talk show held on July 26, 2026. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Guardians]] [[Category:Demi-Human]]

[[wikipedia:Dawn M. Bennett|Dawn M. Bennett]] (Season 2)}} '''Frederica Baumann''' (フレデリカ・バウマン) is a maid in service to [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and a member of the [[Emilia Camp]]. Frederica has played a supporting role in [[Arc 4]] and a lesser supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. Having grown up in the [[Sanctuary]] as a rough and tumble tomboy with her brother [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]], in her youth, she left to become a maid so that she could find a place for the people of the Sanctuary. Though having been let go for a period of time, following the events of [[Arc 3]], she resumed her position as a maid for [[House Mathers]] at [[Ram]]'s request. ==Appearance== Frederica has very long pale gold hair and green eyes. She is a little taller than [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], has a muscular build, and a mouth with sharp fangs. She is mentioned to look like a carnivorous hunter locking onto its prey when she narrows her eyes. According to Subaru, Frederica would be a beautiful woman if she covered her mouth. She is also commonly seen wearing maid’s attire, as her job requires. When she was young, Frederica’s unkempt hair reached her shoulders, and she wore a pink dress with a red scarf and red socks. During her outing to [[Costuul]], Frederica wore a white and green dress, and she wore a green mantle over her shoulders with yellow designs along its edges. When she transforms, she becomes a golden leopard that even the People of Shudrak found beautiful. When she transforms back from her leopard form, her clothes have either been forsaken or torn off, leaving her completely naked. ==Personality== Unlike her younger brother Garfiel, Frederica uses her father's surname Baumann. She is a kind person, although she can be strict at times, especially to [[Petra Leyte|Petra]] who started working as a maid. She also cares deeply about Garfiel and used to send him letters regularly when he was still in the Sanctuary, and after learning from Roswaal that he enjoyed reading, she also sent him books.''“When I talked with Master, he said that Garfiel likes to read books. He wants to become heroic, so I send him heroic tales of the past.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 2. As children, she used to spar with him and often sent him flying, completely ignoring the seven-year difference between them. She has a complex about her teeth, which causes her to hide them from others.''She was an adolescent girl. Frederica had her own inferiority complex because of her mouth. And Rem also knew how it felt to worry about having a hopeless nature. She knew the feeling so well that it hurt.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 2, Section 2. She also seemed to want to be called "big sister" by her junior coworkers, and she was disappointed when Rem and Ram refused to do so. In the past, she was not as polite or graceful as she is in the present day. She had a temper, which she most often showed around [[Clind]], [[Rem]], or Ram, and though she started to become strict due to her position, Roswaal had complained that she was often too stiff.'' “…Sheesh, what a kill-joy. Frederica, you are excellent, but you don’t loosen up enouuuugh. And wouldn’t that make you butt heads wiiiiith Clind?”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 2, Section 3. ==History== ===Early Life=== Frederica was born around 21 years prior to the start of the story to a father who was a half-beastman and a human mother, [[Reala Thompson|Reshia Tinzel]], and was born a quarter beast human. Eventually, after wandering around, Frederica, along with Reala and Garfiel, were picked up by Roswaal and given a home at the Sanctuary. Reala left her children at the Sanctuary to bring back her missing husband. Frederica lived at the Sanctuary until she was 11 years old when she became a maid, working for Roswaal she could give her people and brother in the Sanctuary a home for when the barrier would eventually come down. During her time, she was taught by Clind how to be a servant, and she seemed to be fairly fond of him. However, as she aged, Clind started acting cold toward her, and she came to despise the man. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Sisters of the Hidden Village]]=== After the destruction of the [[Oni]] village, Roswaal brought Rem and Ram back to the manor, and Frederica helped watch over them. After Rem woke up to Ram sitting beside her, Frederica appeared to retrieve Ram and bring her back to her room. Though she smiled at Rem when she introduced herself, she seemed to scare her, causing Frederica to become uncomfortable and hide her teeth. Then she scolded Ram and mentioned how she no longer had her horn, causing Rem, who remembered everything, to lash out. After the two held her down and Ram bit her horn and made her pass out, Ram passed out, leaving the indignant Frederica to deal with the mess. When Rem woke up again, Frederica was present as Roswaal poked at her emotional scars to drag a response out of the despondent Rem. Rem eventually snapped at him, and afterward, demanded to see her sister. Though both Frederica and Roswaal seemed to be against it, Roswaal had Frederica lead her to Ram's room. Along the way, she explained that Roswaal was not as a bad person despite the way he speaks. After arriving at Ram's room, which was heavily locked and sealed behind a magic circle, Frederica fully unlocked the door, allowing Rem, whose instincts were telling her to run, to see Ram, who was chained to the bed with her power going out of control. Rem then ran away to beg Roswaal to save Ram. The next day, Rem and Ram were hired as maids, and Frederica and Clind saw to their outfits. While there, they explained that Roswaal exclusively hired [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] with nowhere to go and gave them a job and an education without asking for anything in return. When the twins noticed that it was different for them, Frederica claimed to suspect that it was because the girls would have run away otherwise, which they could not refute. Over the following months, she and Clind were responsible for teaching the girls how to work and other education, and they learned about Ram's backlash from the horn getting in the way of her work. One day, two months after hiring them, Roswaal took Ram with him to the Sanctuary, Clind had gone somewhere unspecified, and Frederica was taking some of the other maids to find themselves another place to work, as they had been found to have been ready to do so. After she returned, however, she was furious at Roswaal and Clind for the state Rem was in, having been forced to fight with someone they claimed was an [[Fogg|intruder]]. Another month later, Roswaal, Frederica, Ram, and Rem visited the Royal Capital, which was celebrating the Tammuz Festival, to buy a gift to celebrate the birth of the child of House Miload. Deciding to split up to search for a gift, Roswaal took Ram with him while Frederica took Rem, and the two decided to meet up again later. As the two looked at the stores, Frederica asked about the kinds of gifts that Rem and Ram would give to each other, setting off Rem to go and buy a gift for Ram now that she had the chance. However, Frederica stopped her, and having been inspired by Rem's answers and responses, they looked through various shops. Eventually, however, Rem's nose caught a whiff of the same scent that came off of Fogg, and she followed it, leading to a bag containing a magical miasma stone. Deciding to reunite with Roswaal and Ram, the former of which had bought gifts for the latter, they discussed the possible plans that the Witch Cult were scheming. Deciding to split again, Roswaal and Ram went to alert the capital's guardsmen while Frederica beastified and took Rem with her to look for the scattered stones, which Ram had predicted the locations of. After dealing with the stones, the two came across [[Sado]], the man planting them. Having been prepared to escape at a moment's notice, he dodged Rem's morningstar, which she had been training with, and summoned other [[Witch Cult]]ists to hold them off while he flew away. Although the two were cornered and were nearly forced to retreat, much to Rem's outrage due to knowing that she would never come across the man again, a young [[Reinhard van Astrea]] appeared and offered to hold off the remaining Witch Cultists, allowing for Frederica and Rem to chase after Sado. However, as the two approached more heavily populated areas and Sado was off in the distance, the two were forced to stop. However, thanks to her Clairvoyance and Synesthesia, Ram was able to see through Rem's eyes, and using her new wand fashioned from her horn and gifted to her by Roswaal, she used her magic to sever Sado's limbs from afar, effectively defeating him. Rem and Frederica then chased after Sado. Upon meeting him, Rem attempted to question him, but the man merely said that he pitied her and gave his name before he died, giving her no answers and frustrating her. Afterward, Reinhard appeared, having successfully captured all of the Witch Cultists alive, and after deciding to preserve the scene to allow Frederica to revert back and clothe herself, she and Rem left, with the intent to explain things to the guards. As they left, Rem solidified her resolve before mentioning they would have to find a gift for House Miload now. Following the attack on Miload Manor and the deaths of [[Dudley Miload|Dudley]] and [[Grace Miload]], because most of the staff had either been killed or resigned, Frederica and Clind were sent to take care of the infant [[Annerose Miload]], and they would continue Roswaal's hobby of hiring and educating demi-humans at the Miload Manor.''The Miload family, which lost the married couple who were the head of it, stayed alive thanks to Roswaal becoming a guardian. However, because of the incident that happened, many servants died and many resigned, and as a result, Clind and Frederica were to be sent to the Miload residence so that it could be maintained. On top of that, the job training for demi-humans that was carried out at the Mathers residence would have to take place at the Miload residence from now on. Thus, the Mathers residence would be left with the bare minimum number of workers ── in other words, Rem and Ram would stay with Roswaal as his attendants.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Epilogue, Section 1. ===In The Years That Followed=== Two years before Subaru appeared in the world, Frederica, who was still working with House Miload, had been summoned to the manor and asked to deliver a message to the mayor of [[Arlam Village]]. There, she met a young and vain Petra, who she asked for directions and was taken by her cuteness. There, she claimed that she would have liked to be Frederica's friend, though unbeknownst to Frederica, she was thinking of her pinafore as reference rather than thinking too much of Frederica. Afterward, she led her to the mayor. ===[[Emily-san's Maid Path]]=== Shortly after leaving [[Elior Forest]], [[Emilia]] encounters and helps Annerose and Clind. Due to this intervention and a letter from Roswaal, Emilia is taken to the Miload mansion, where Annerose decides to take her in as a maid. During her introduction, her name is misheard as “Emily,” a nickname by which she becomes known in that environment. At the mansion, Frederica explains that it is a place that shelters discriminated demi-humans, allowing Emilia to remain there. However, Emilia misunderstands the situation as a test imposed by Roswaal to evaluate her effort and character, leading her to take her role as a maid very seriously. Despite her determination, her complete lack of experience with human life and household tasks causes her to fail repeatedly in her duties, and she is regarded as incompetent for the role. Even so, Emilia continues to persevere, convinced that overcoming these difficulties is part of her path toward a greater future. ===[[Frederica and Petra's Maid-san Days]]=== Upon hearing that Ram couldn't handle the mansion by herself following the erasure of Rem's existence, Frederica returned to Roswaal Manor, and she put up posters in Arlam Village that the manor was hiring for new servants. Though hopeful that there would be takers for the position due to the improvement of the villagers' opinions of those in the manor, shortly after Subaru's return and meeting him for the first time, Petra, who had requested the other village girls not to accept the request so that she could work at the manor, was the only one to appear. Though intending to turn her down for her age and the lack of time to train new maids in the basics, she still interviewed Petra's qualifications, receiving responses that made her favorable to Frederica to want to hire her. Warning Petra that her behavior would reflect on Roswaal, Frederica accepted when she was told that Petra would not give up for the person she cared for, and afterward, had Petra refer to her as her big sister. Afterward, Frederica went to speak with Petra's mother about her decision to hire her, and after mentioning her concerns about coming to do so due to the lack of applicants from the village, Frederica was told about Petra's pleading convincing the others not to take the position. After hiring her, Frederica began instructing her, only to find that Petra was already excellent at completing her tasks. Commenting on how a young Ram could have learned from Petra, the two headed to the village. While there, Frederica shopped for what she could while the half of the villagers were still gone, while Petra spoke with her friends. On their way back to the manor, however, Petra was in a bad mood, having been defending Frederica after they said her mouth was scary. Moved, Frederica urged her to speak with her friends again, who looked like they wanted to apologize. One night, she and Petra shared a bath, in which Frederica told Petra about Clind and warned her to stay away from him due to his proclivities. Recognizing the complicated emotions in Frederica's voice, Petra asked to stay the night in her room. Later, after leaving food out for [[Beatrice]], she appeared in Frederica's room, where she learned of one of Frederica's old bad habits. After laughing about it, the two went to bed, hoping that by the next morning, the food left for Beatrice would have been gone. The next morning, as she was preparing breakfast, Petra spoke to Frederica, apologizing for her behavior on the day that the two first met. Though Frederica said there was nothing to apologize about since she had almost forgotten, she recalled Petra mentioning wanting to be friends, and now they were. Asking Petra what made her think of apologizing, Petra claimed that something had been bugging her and she had remembered. Believing she believed what caused her to remember, Frederica began to panic, only for Petra to say it was because of something she had said the night before. Afterward, she helped Frederica prepare breakfast. ===[[The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting]]=== Following the [[Sanctuary Incident]], Annerose and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the Sanctuary to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to Garfiel that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and [[Otto Suwen|Otto]], who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia. Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where [[Puck]] slept and called everyone there precious to her. ===[[Poltergeist Story]]=== Two months after the Sanctuary Incident, Roswaal called for the maids of Roswaal Manor. Intending to begin making allies with other nobles with Emilia for the [[Royal Selection]], he set his sights on first targeting Viscount [[Minor Characters#Torion Aruz|Torion Aruz]], he tasked the girls with cleaning a villa that was once the workshop of his father, [[Roswaal K. Mathers]]. Two days later, the girls arrived in the evening, birds attempting to steal their luggage having delayed their arrival. There, they found that the workshop was covered in ivy and vines and was practically falling apart from disuse. As nighttime approached, despite Frederica starting to panic over the workshop's creepy atmosphere, they decided that they would have to stay the night there. While Ram remained out front for a while, Frederica and Petra went to the back of the workshop, which is in even worse condition than the front. However, after a hole just large enough for the two to slip into, Petra walked inside, followed shortly after by Frederica. Unable to see Petra, she instead saw a doll in the darkness, shortly before the lights came on. Soon after, she reunited with Petra and Ram, afraid of the doll. Despite Ram's insistence that it was Frederica's imagination, Frederica and Petra heard an explosion-like noise in the distance while Ram heard nothing. Wanting to leave, Frederica clung to Ram as they headed for the front door, only to find that it was storming outside, and Petra had to stop Frederica from beastifying and running away. Deciding they would investigate the strange sounds and dolls, Petra headed upstairs, hoping to catch sight of a hollow. Frederica, still sticking with Ram, tried to follow after her, only to fall through the floor of the stairs. Shortly after, Frederica became a target of harassment for the doll, and before long, she ended up latching onto one in fear, having mistaken it for one of the other two. In a panic, she beastified and ran off, the doll gripping her tail. She eventually smashed it away with her tail on the roof, only to find others that made her fall. Ram, who recognized what they were, ordered the dolls to catch her. Shortly after, Frederica, her clothes destroyed, and Petra were told that the dolls had been magicreation tools that were defending the manor, and they treated Petra and Frederica as intruders, treating them differently because due to their different sizes. First claiming the dolls could help them clean the place up with them, Petra then thought to dress up the dolls and fix their makeup before calling Roswaal to the workshop. Before long, Roswaal had flown over to the workshop and wondered how long it had been since he'd been there. Meeting up with the maids, he found 111 of those dolls dressed up and fixed. Surprised that they were still, having created more of themselves to continue protecting the place until the master could return, he thanked them, causing them to bow and finally shut down. Afterward, facing the confused Petra, he thanked them for allowing him to right a wrong, upsetting Petra for his attitude. With Roswaal deciding to help them, Frederica told Petra she could work him hard, while Ram had knelt down and gently thanked the dolls for their service. A little while later, while they were cleaning, Frederica asked what Roswaal was going to do with the dolls since they had broken down, concerned about hollows potentially possessing them, to which Roswaal claimed that he would reuse the dolls, replace the aged parts, and even potentially create a pseudo-gate, something which Frederica is shocked to learn as attempting to do so is the same as attempting to create a new heart. Roswaal treats it as entirely possible, and though Frederica claims that doing so is implausible by comparing him to his father, Roswaal brushes it away by questioning whether she thinks his knowledge is inferior to his father's. Knowing that he is speaking with full knowledge he can do it, she muttered that it was like he was saying he could recreate anything with magic, which he claimed could be done and that magic was something that existed to fulfill one's wishes, saying that achieving one's goal was the most important part of extending one's bloodline, to pass down knowledge and ideals. She mentions that she isn't sure whether he cares or not about his dolls after claiming to want to use them in his experiments, while he replies that doing so could help to relieve the burden on everyone else as the dolls could keep up with maintenance even when everyone is gone. When Frederica doesn't understand the word "maintenance", as it's a loan word from Subaru's home, she questions whether the artificial gates were for the sake of Subaru and Beatrice, as Subaru's gate had been broken. He claims to want to agree and deny her statement, as while it is true, it was his grandmother who had started this research due to her incapacity to use magic, to which Frederica realizes that this is his way of making amends for causing the Sanctuary Incident. Ultimately, she accepts what he says while making sure to warn him to take care of his body, though Roswaal claims that he already has the formulas for the dolls ready in his head and could finish in a couple of days. Afterward, he tells Frederica that if they wanted, he could help Frederica and Garfiel looking into their bloodline if they wanted, but she declines, as her only family were her brother, the [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzus]], and her mother, and telling him to ask Garfiel directly if he wanted to know. With Frederica taking over for him, she tells Roswaal to go deal with the dolls, while he leaves coming up with the names for them to Frederica and the others. ===[[Golden Siblings Part 1|Golden Siblings]]=== Sometime after Subaru’s knighting ceremony, Frederica and Garfiel, who were on an outing in Costuul, discovered a man named [[Hayden Garo]] who could manipulate the city's magicreation tools and reported the incident to Costuul’s [[Leno Rex|mayor]]. With Hayden causing City Hall’s collapse by sending a giant magicreation tool haywire and kidnapping Frederica after she and her brother rescued everyone from the collapsing building, Garfiel and Clind ventured to retrieve her and put the incident to rest while Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice took care of the haywire Lightbugs in Costuul. Frederica's kidnapper, Hayden, intended to make Frederica into the queen of a new nation where demi-humans were dominant and humans were exterminated by unlocking the secrets of rare blood, which he and the kidnapped maid both possessed. Present with him was one of his subordinates, a researcher of rare blood, [[Leonardo Baroness]]. The duo of Garfiel and Clind found Hayden and Leonardo's hideout due to Frederica leaving a trail of blood behind. Clind took care of rescuing Frederica, fending off Leonardo when he absorbed his vials of rare blood and transformed into a liquid blood monster. Garfiel successfully defeated Hayden, however, he managed to escape before being captured. He briefly met with Frederica before his escaping, swearing to her that they would meet again, and he allowed her to deal him a scar as remembrance of their encounter. ===[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle]]=== After the decision to visit the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]] was made, Frederica entered the room Otto was working in. Frederica apologized to Otto for Petra's discourteous manner earlier in the day. Otto tried to pass it off as nothing, but Frederica rebutted, saying that it would not be good for the girl's growth. She then continued to speak to Otto, mentioning that she was worried about Garfiel, as he wouldn't be in arm's reach to her where he was going. She was worried that her brother's behavior would cause problems to Emilia, and she politely asked Otto if he could look after everyone, especially Garfiel. Otto pledged that he would do his best and then asked if Frederica would be worried about Otto himself too, to which Frederica showed nothing but confusion. ===[[Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle / Page 1|Petra’s Emilia Camp Struggle]]=== Occurring simultaneously with the [[Battle for Priestella]], Petra took part in the meeting with the western nobles alongside Roswaal, Annerose, Petra, and Clind. There, she witnessed as Roswaal attempted to convince the other nobles into backing Emilia of their own accord. Shortly after the meeting began, Roswaal had Petra speak on his behalf regarding Emilia, much to Frederica’s annoyance, as if he were to do so, it may sound insincere or manipulative. Though reluctant to let her do so, Frederica relented, and Petra did as she was asked and gave her opinion and facts on Emilia, successfully managing to convince the other nobles to back her. Later, they returned to Roswaal Manor. ===[[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose!]]=== After returning to Roswaal Manor, after Beatrice, who had gone to sleep over with Petra, awoke and left to get a drink for her parched throat, she came across Frederica. The two decided to have tea together, and Frederica claimed she could imagine just how much danger Subaru and Emilia must have been in in Priestella based on the injuries sustained by Garfiel and Otto, further claiming their next hardships based on their next destination. Frederica then asked to look out for them and herself with a gaze that reminded Beatrice of [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu]]. ===[[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]] and [[The Dragon Nation / Missing Child Search Chronicle 1|Missing Child Search]]=== Following the disappearance of Subaru and Rem from the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], the camp members came to retrieve Garfiel and Otto from Priestella with Clind’s assistance. Soon after, the group found themselves in [[Picoutatte]], which they needed to pass through to reach [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. With Otto making peace with [[Diadora Regundra]], they made their way through the Everlasting Darkness with the guidance of the mole humans. However, their travels were interrupted due to [[Musica]] wishing to meet with Emilia. After negotiating Petra Leyte, the group was allowed to continue, and they entered Vollachia. ===[[Yae Tenzen's Crimson Sakura State of Affairs]]=== Following the reveal of Priscilla's will, [[Yae Tenzen]] met with Frederica in the hallway of the Barielle Estate, and she asked the maid to be friends and brought her to have tea in her room. As they spoke, Yae got the sense that she could have genuinely become friends with Frederica if she hadn't had ulterior motives. After Frederica mentioned that she saw the members of the Emilia Camp like family, something that was foreign to Yae, she asked Yae if her relationship with [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] was anything like that, to which Yae wasn't certain how to define their relationship. As they spoke, Frederica mentioned that she was nervous about being invited by Yae and felt on guard, so to be friends with her, she proposed talking about less intrusive topics. Doing so led Frederica to point out Yae's use of loan words, which she had picked up from Al, though Yae decided to keep it a secret who she learned those words from. Realizing that she was having fun, Yae continued to talk with Frederica. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== While Frederica is a strong combatant and has been capable of combat from a relatively young age, the full extent of her power is currently unexplored. This being said, she struggles to contend with people on the level of [[Elsa Granhiert]]. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== Frederica is an adept melee combatant. However, her physical strength pales in comparison with other warriors. The full extent of her physical abilities is unknown. '''Improved Senses''': Due to having feline-type beast person blood, Frederica's senses are naturally greater than a typical human's. *'''Heightened Olfaction''': Frederica has a heightened sense of smell. With just a sniff, she can determine if plants or fruits in a forest are poisonous. *'''Night Vision''': If she focuses, Frederica is able to easily see in the dark.''Frederica had cat-people ancestry, meaning she naturally had good night vision. There was nothing she couldn’t see—even in the dark of night—if she focused. Therefore, she could clearly see that the thing making the footsteps was not Petra, but another being entirely.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Poltergeist Story]], Section 3. [[File:Frederica - Beastification.gif|thumb|right|250px|Frederica's full beast transformation.]] '''Beastification''' (獣化, ''Kemonoka''): Thanks to her quarter demi-human lineage from her father's side, Frederica can either fully or partially transform into a large leopard with golden fur and larger and sharper teeth.''Frederica’s long, blond hair shrunk, and at the same time, golden hair on her body started to grow to cover her naked body. Frederica, standing up straight, stretches her limbs to the ground as that happened, and her build transforms with a creaking sound, enlarging. Her characteristic fangs showing from her wide-open mouth were clearly bigger and sharper than usual, and even her looks no longer appeared to be human as she transformed into a wild cat. In front of Rem, who was speechless, there wasn’t the Frederica she was used to. The entity that had just been Frederica was now a beautiful, huge cat covered in golden fur.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 3. While she is in this form, she can run at incredible speeds, easily able to traverse through long distances in quick time or overtop the rooftops of the Royal Capital without being spotted,''Frederica was saying something inside the windstorm, but Rem wasn’t in the right state of mind to answer. When Frederica softly landed on the building’s roof, that’s when they dashed at an astonishing speed, and they were running through the capital, so fast that one would think they were the wind.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 3. and her eyesight is also given a boost.''Frederica was struck speechless at the sisters that conversed nonchalantly as they gazed at the rampart in the distance. As a half-beast, Frederica currently had better eyesight than usual in her beast form. Even so, she could see nothing other than the cloud of dust that hung over the wall the pair were gazing at.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 91, Section 1. While in this state, she is easily capable of crushing her enemies' heads with her paws.''Frederica mowed down the black clothed beings rushing over with her forefeet, smashing their heads, and she motivated Rem with her words. Rem comes to her senses thanks to her voice, and she immediately nodded.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 5. She is also able to partially beastify, typically doing so with her arms in combat, which can allow her to stop the strikes of even the [[Elsa Granhiert|Bowel Hunter]] momentarily. '''Rare Blood''': Frederica's blood is of a rare kind, and according to Clind, there can be dangers associated with it.[[Golden Siblings Part 2]] In fact, [[Al]] went out of his way to separate Frederica from Subaru’s group in [[Arc 9]] precisely because of her rare blood, implying that it would provide an obstacle and was dangerous, while Hayden Garo implied that those with this rare blood are special. ===[[Magic]]=== Frederica has an affinity for the wind attribute, but never developed her magic side, preferring melee combat.''"Frederica hasn't developed the magical side of things, so she can't launch magic attacks. Her affinity is wind magic but she's no match for Ram, so she's completely devoted to physical combat."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1071056939000324097 Frederica Birthday Q&A] ===Equipment=== *'''Glintstone''' (輝石): When Frederica was younger, she and her brother Garfiel each received a glintstone from their mother, Reshia Tinzel. *'''Cestus Weapon''': In the web novel, Frederica used a pair of gauntlet-like weapons that allowed her to fight in hand-to-hand combat. This was cut from the light novel and replaced by her beastification. ==Trivia== *In response to a fan letter, Frederica's birthday was decided to be December 6, which in Japan is Older Sister's Day. *Before her novel character design was shown in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10|Volume 10]], Frederica's design was initially revealed in [[Episode 11]] of the anime. *In 2018, Frederica's main arc was said to be the eleventh arc,''"She'll likely show up normally in Arc 7. If you're asking when she'll be a main character, her main arc is Arc 11."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/947874016156459008 Frederica's Birthday 2018 Q&A] which was still the final arc as of then. Thus, it can currently be assumed that [[Arc 12]] will be her main arc. *The dress that Subaru used when he dressed as a woman belongs to Frederica.''"By the way, the dress when Subaru dresses up as a woman is also Frederica's dress."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1071057566824710145 Frederica Birthday Q&A] *Her hobby is to collect dolls and putting cute clothes on them.''"but I collect and display dress-up doll."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1071067169469812737 Frederica Birthday Q&A] *Frederica needs to gnaw on objects to wear her teeth down because they keep growing.''"Now, she choses the place, carefully picks things that are alright to chew on, and chews on them. She has the sort of body where her teeth continue to grow"'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1071060093737660421 Frederica Birthday Q&A] *Frederica lacks the courage to wear cute outfits because she thinks they do not fit her frame.''"I think I'm too big to wear pretty clothes, so I used to dress my dolls in pretty clothes."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1071067169469812737 Frederica Birthday Q&A] *Frederica has a habit of sneaking to eat sweets. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Sanctuary]] [[Category:Emilia Camp]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Maids]] [[Category:House Mathers]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Human Hybrids]] [[de:Frederica Baumann]] [[es:Frederica Baumann]] [[fr:Frédérica Baumann]] [[pl:Frederica Baumann]] [[pt-br:Frederica Baumann]] [[ru:Фредерика Бауманн]] [[uk:Фредеріка Бауманн]] [[zh:角色:弗雷德莉卡·鲍尔曼]]
