Minami Mayu (child) |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Zeno Robinson|Zeno Robinson]]}} '''Garfiel Tinzel''' (ガーフィール・ティンゼル) is [[Frederica Baumann]]'s younger half-brother, the former guardian of the [[Sanctuary]], and the current military officer of the [[Emilia Camp]]. Introduced as a secondary antagonist during the first half of [[Arc 4]], he later became one of the main supporting characters of Re:Zero, with major roles in the second half of Arc 4, [[Arc 5]], [[Arc 7]], [[Arc 8]], [[Arc 9]], and [[Arc 10]]. He harbored an immense fear of the outside world following a family tragedy. However, with [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s help, he overcame his past trauma, and after overcoming the [[Sanctuary Incident|incidents]] at the Sanctuary and [[Roswaal Manor]], he joined the Emilia Camp. Since being exposed to the outside world, he has faced many situations where he was powerless, yet he still remains determined to protect those close to him. ==Appearance== Garfiel is a young and relatively short boy with short gold hair and deep and sharp emerald-colored eyes. He originally kept his hair spiky and long but began to have a significantly neater haircut after the events of Arc 4. Due to his [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] blood, he has sharp feline like fangs, similar to Frederica's. In fact, both Frederica and Garfiel share a similar face with perhaps the main difference being the large white scar stretching across the entirety of Garfiel's forehead, which he inflicted upon himself when, after experiencing the First Trial and seeing his [[Reala Thompson|mother]]'s "death", he fell into a state of panic and repeatedly bashed his head against the walls of the Tomb, leaving him with a permanent X-shaped white scar. Due to his vigorous training and his demi-human blood, Garfiel is extremely strong and possesses a rather well built and muscular physique. He can usually be seen wearing long black pants and a torn-up loincloth that is heliotrope-purple on the outside and red-violet on the inside and a short black vest with fuchsia accents. To match his color palette, Garfiel can also be seen wearing black long-sleeved gloves with fuchsia in them. A blue glintstone can also be seen dangling around his neck. ==Personality== Garfiel is an extremely protective and diligent young man with some chuunibyou tendencies, such as often being impressed with Subaru's naming sense. He's even shown to be rather protective of women and children, as pointed out by [[Meili Portroute]], and he has a sense for a person's romance, which is part of the reason that, despite not seeing eye to eye with Subaru at the time, he did not interrupt his conversation with [[Emilia]] in Arc 4. With the exceptions of people like [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], Garfiel is not good at hating people.''In general, Garfiel was not good at hating people, but amongst the types of people he hated was the one in front of him, Olbart. However, the person he unmistakably despised the most was standing right behind him.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 3. For the people he does hate, however, he does not let such hatred cloud his judgement, and he will work with those people if necessary. He cares for his allies, friends, and family, and he will become extremely hostile when those people are threatened. It is precisely because of this that, in his youth, he trained using the regimen detailed in a book detailing [[Reid Astrea]]'s exercises, and he even went out of his way to learn healing magic in order to heal everyone around him. Because of his strong sense of duty, responsibility, and the need to protect those around him, Garfiel has set his sights and being among the strongest people around, as he does not want to lose anyone. However, he has a tendency to beat himself up over failing to live up to expectations he was given, and in these times, he feels powerless and becomes somewhat self-deprecating, which in turn results in him becoming depressed. Despite this, he usually finds a way to overcome those internal conflicts, usually becoming all the stronger and fiercer for it. Garfiel has shown to have a crush on [[Ram]], and that is part of his motivation for becoming stronger, often doing what he can to look good in front of her, usually to no avail. Regardless, because of this and the circumstances of his environment when he was younger, he read many stories, leading him to garnering a habit of speaking in idioms from these stories. Though initially, he started speaking with them to impress Ram, those idioms became one of Garfiel's signifying traits, and he can regularly be heard making comparisons to real life via these idioms. Likewise, these stories also ignited his great degree of respect for warriors, something he displayed in his confrontations with both [[Kurgan]] and [[Kafma Irulux]]. Because of this, he can’t stand when others mock these warriors for a loss, as seen when he defended Kafma from Olbart’s mocking and stood to protect him.''"Sure enough? Old man, you ain’t got the fuckin’ right to laugh at this guy."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 1.''Kafma was an enemy. That would not change, but no one was qualified to speak about how Kafma fought except Garfiel, who had exchanged fists with him head-on.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 1.''"I’m sayin’ I don’t like yer damn attitude! Is that how ya talk to a fellow General on yer own side!? Huh!?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 1. Similarly, he greatly respects [[Dragon]]s. In Arc 7, he expressed his disappointment at not being able to meet with the Dragons that Emilia had, but later, when he got to meet (as enemies) the Cloud Dragon [[Mezoreia]], he immediately recognized its strength and was even honored to do battle with it. This respect was even greater for the Divine Dragon [[Volcanica]], who he immediately recognized as beyond even the Cloud Dragon. In his youth, Garfiel had a complex over his mother. Though he initially believed that she had abandoned him and his sister, he wanted to believe that she did so so that she could have a better life, something which led to Garfiel becoming protective and looking down on himself, and as a way to remember his mother, he started using her surname Tinzel, unlike Frederica. After witnessing her supposed death in the first trial of the Sanctuary, Garfiel was in denial, and in his distraught and panicked state, he permanently scarred his head. Following this, he considered himself the shield of the Sanctuary, and in order to protect the Sanctuary's residents, he did not want the barrier to be taken down out of his need to protect everyone, coming to believe that the outside world was a harsh and dangerous place. During the events of Arc 4, Garfiel was forced to confront this side of himself after his confrontation with Subaru and the other members of the Emilia Camp. Despite his rage, trauma, and refusal to allow the destruction of the Sanctuary's barrier, after his defeat, he was convinced to face his past through the first trial again, in which he finally overcame his trauma. Following this, he began calling Subaru his Captain and began teasing him, seeing him, and [[Otto Suwen]] before him, a warrior worthy of respect, and he showed willingness to fight alongside him and the rest of the camp. Despite still maintaining a slightly aggressive side to him, he started becoming friendly with everyone in the camp, teasing Subaru and Otto and treating them like brothers, and following Emilia, wanting to help her bring about the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]] that she envisions. He even came to rely on Subaru quite a lot, as when [[Mimi Pearlbaton]] was injured and he was unable to heal her, his first thought was to find Subaru, as he believed he might be able to do something that he couldn't. And because of how Subaru saved him in the Sanctuary, Garfiel was inspired to do the same for others in a similar manner if he saw that they were suffering.''"Let my amazin’ self hear yer story. ――Just like how Captain ‘n the others once listened to mine."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 7. For example, when he could see the anger, sadness, and suffering of [[Madelyn Eschart]] through Mezoreia, he resolved to defeat her so that he could speak to her and save her heart. That said, following his fight with [[Elsa Granhiert]] at the end of Arc 4, Garfiel was left somewhat traumatized by the weight of his first kill, and he was temporarily haunted by a black phantom of the Bowel Hunter, who appeared at the edge of his vision every time Garfiel's psyche dropped significantly. Furthermore, following his encounter with the world's strongest person, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], and humiliatingly being forced to flee from the inn before he could even exchange words with the Sword Saint, Garfiel could observe Elsa's phantom looking at him from around every corner, keeping her distance and smiling at him. Despite the eeriness of the situation, the phantom was not real, as Garfiel stated he couldn't smell her scent, and the narration later explained how Elsa's phantom was simply a manifestation of Garfiel's weakness and regrets. Fortunately, thanks to reuniting with his amnesiac mother and meeting his younger [[Fred Thompson|brother]] and [[Rafiel Thompson|sister]], some words from Mimi, feeling the effects of Subaru's speech, and witnessing how many people were cheering for him to win during his fight with the [[undead]] Eight Arms, Garfiel managed to overcome this, and in doing so, it allowed him to grow to greater heights and become braver. ==History== ===Early Life=== Garfiel was born around fourteen years prior to the start of the story to a father who was a half-beast human and a human mother, therefore, being brought to this world as a Quarter-Beast Human. Eventually, after wandering about, he and Frederica, along with their mother Reala (Reshia), were picked up by Roswaal and given a home in the Sanctuary. Reshia had left her children in Sanctuary to bring back her missing husband. Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since. Growing up with the [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu clones]] who took care of him like their grandchild, he came to love the people of the Sanctuary. However, after seeing his mother's "death" during the first trial when he was young, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary. At some point, his sister eventually left the Sanctuary as well to find a home for their people for when they brought down the barrier, leaving Garfiel to live with the Ryuzus. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Really Really Complicated and Twisted Love Affair ZERO]]=== Shortly after her first visit to the Sanctuary with Roswaal, Ram met Garfiel, who was immediately infatuated and attempted to propose to her twice. However, she rejected him both times, and he continued to have a crush on her. During one of her later visits to the Sanctuary, Garfiel asked why she was working with Roswaal when he didn't really need her assistance. Although she initially joked that her sister [[Rem]] was held hostage, she told him that it was more like she had become Rem's shackle. Seeing her sad, Garfiel decided to start studying and reading to help get rid of what made Ram sad. One night, having found an appa, he intended to give it to Ram, but he found Roswaal giving Ram mana. Not understanding what was happening, he unconsciously beastified for the first time and attacked Roswaal but was handily knocked out. When he later awoke to see Ram, she told him what happened and said he needed to get control of it before explaining her circumstances about her severed horn. From then, Garfiel decided to become strong, and afterward, he asked her to marry him many times. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Complicated Love Affair]]=== A short time after Roswaal brought Emilia to Roswaal Manor, Roswaal and Ram visited the Sanctuary. Garfiel, finding the talk between Roswaal and Ryuzu boring, left the conversation to talk to Ram. After a short conversation about Garfiel's willingness to continue chasing after Ram, despite her love being for Roswaal, he asked for an explanation for their unusual visit, to which Ram told him about Emilia being brought to the manor and the potential involvement of the Sanctuary. Ram gave her impression of Emilia as lacking in every manner, though she didn't give a final conclusion since she hadn't been given the chance to learn anything, and Garfiel realized that Roswaal intended to back her in the [[Royal Selection]] for his own schemes, which angered Garfiel and made him question if he'd gone mad. Before he could transform, Ram calmed him down, and soon after Roswaal appeared, saying they wouldn't be staying for long. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Really Complicated Love Affair]]=== One day later on, intending to let her see the "White Snow Sakura", Ram brought Rem to the Sanctuary. After Rem went to speak to Ryuzu, Ram spoke with Garfiel about why she was there without Roswaal. When Rem returned, she sent Garfiel flying away and started talking with Ram. After Garfiel quickly recovered, he and Rem started to argue, and the sisters playfully complained about Garfiel finding out about what they were there for. Ram worried about how Rem rarely got to act herself, though their worry made her dismiss the thought. Eventually, the arrived at their destination, and the twins were mesmerized by the sight of the trees covered in white flowers. They eventually sat down to eat, and after a moment, Garfiel passed out of Ram's shoulder. After learning from Rem that Rem and Garfiel had actually worked together to bring Ram here, she moved his head to her lap and ran her hand through his hair in gratitude. After a few moments, however, she moved Garfiel so that the jealous Rem could lay her head on her lap instead. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Really Really Complicated and Twisted Love Affair]]=== Later on, in response to the upcoming [[Subjugation of Sloth]], half of the [[Arlam Village]]rs were escorted by Ram to the Sanctuary, where Garfiel was waiting and questioned her. After being told about the evacuation, he told the villagers to behave themselves while they were there before leaving to inform the other residents of the Sanctuary. Although the villagers were given a place to stay in, Garfiel made it known that they were not welcome. However, at seeing the villagers slowly unpacking the carriages while gloomy, Garfiel eventually decided to help them. After teasing Garfiel about it, Ram spoke with [[Milde Arlam]] and said she would be tending to Roswaal, leaving them to choose their own rooms. From then on, Garfiel continued to "harass" the villagers before helping on his own. When he was done, Milde thanked him for his help, though Garfiel claimed it wasn't for the villagers but that it was bad for his heart if he didn't help, to which Milde replied her gratitude was in kind. Because he couldn't accept the gratitude so easily, Ram proceeded to reward him. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Garfiel is an incredibly powerful warrior whose potential for growth is abnormally high. Due to his wild combat style, Garfiel is frequently seen avoiding certain death in the most unexpected ways possible. His training matched with his power makes him a combative prodigy who, by his early teens, was capable of dueling legendary fighters such as the Bowel Hunter Elsa Granhiert, Eight-Arms Kurgan, Kafma Irulux, and even the Cloud Dragon. His skill is further improved with guidance from Roswaal L. Mathers, causing someone as dangerous as Olbart Dunkelkenn to take him seriously,''However, the Vicious Old Man’s light-hearted derogation contained genuine hostility. ――Yes, hostility. Up till this moment, Olbart had considered Garfiel to be of a lower rank, aiming to eliminate him. It was proof that Garfiel had finally been recognized as an enemy.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 1. and by the [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|events]] of Arc 10, though he was previously unable to do a thing to Reinhard just a few months prior, his growth since then has skyrocketed to the point that the shockwaves of his attacks and his improved strength, techniques, and style can reach and even shock the Sword Saint.''Howling, Garfiel’s body pulsed with vigor, forcibly rejecting the redirection of his strength. As Reinhard received that directly with his arm, the impact exploded, shredding the sleeve of the Sword Saint’s white garb while the undeflected energy caused the ground beneath him to fissure in the pattern of a spider’s web. Then, to Reinhard, marveling at the strike that had far surpassed his imagination, Garfiel laughed a “Hah!” in a manner which flashed his bared fangs, "Don’t’cha go thinkin’ that everyone other than ya’s just gonna keep trudgin’ around forever!!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 18, Section 1. ===[[Divine Protection]]=== Garfiel - Divine Protection of Earth Spirits.gif|thumb|250px|Garfiel using his Divine Protection of Earth Spirits to create a barrier from the ground against Ram's attacks. Garfiel-Divine Protection of Earth Spirits.gif|thumb|250px|Garfiel using his Divine Protection of Earth Spirits during his fight with Elsa. '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Earth Spirits|Divine Protection of the Earth Spirits]]''' (地霊の加護, ''Chirei no Kago''): Garfiel's Divine Protection allows him to use the power of the earth that he stands on to manipulate it, strengthen himself, reduce the effects of Earth Magic, notice disturbances in the earth that even a veteran mage of Roswaal's caliber is unable to detect,''If he could not feel it, then it was probably not mana that was causing the disturbance. It was a huge, tremendous sensation which Garfiel could feel underfoot drawing near. ――It was a feeling that Garfiel, who possessed the Divine Protection of Earth Spirits, noticed most quickly.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 1.''Garfiel could feel the horrifying screams of the vast earth.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 1. and even to heal himself. As long as he has his feet on the ground, Garfiel can freely use this Divine Protection. It should also be noted that Garfiel’s view of the ground is anywhere he can plant his feet, and as such, his Divine Protection will work while standing on said “ground”.''It was an effect of Garfiel’s Divine Protection of Earth Spirits. Essentially, the Divine Protection made it possible to receive power from earth and conversely interfere with it, but the scope was largely depending on the interpretation of the Divine Protection’s wielder. In Garfiel’s case, as long as his feet were on solid footing, that was the earth.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. Due to the Divine Protection giving an intense physical burden, most of its users would be forced to take a break from using it by removing their legs from the ground. However, due to his physique as a demi-human, Garfiel does not feel the backlash, and he can use it continuously.''Garfiel’s Divine Protection of Earth Spirits also had a positive effect while he was standing on the ground, but at the same time, it placed a high burden on his body in order to maintain his physical well-being. It just happened that Garfiel was physically strong, so he was not affected by the negative effects, but if a normal human were to possess it, they would need to regularly take breaks and relieve the burden on their body by lifting their legs from the ground.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 3. However, according to [[Clind]], the effect of this Divine Protection is reduced in areas such as the miasma-laden [[Augria Sand Dunes]]. *'''Earth Manipulation''': So long as his feet touch the ground, Garfiel is capable of freely manipulating the earth beneath him at will, whether that be to create a shield of earth to protect himself from both attacks and magic, to redirect and divert wide-ranging attacks,''Clenching his teeth so hard they creaked, Garfiel swung his foot down fiercely after being struck by the surging wave of thorned vines. The force spreading from the sole of his shoe rose up the portion of the wall he was standing on and tilted Kafma’s foothold on the opposite side of the vines, causing the stunned “General” to lose his position.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. or to create explosions that force debris to fly towards his enemy. This being said, it is possible to disrupt the energy generated by the earth, and if that happens, because there is no longer any specific place for the energy to emerge, it can cause extreme widespread damage to the surrounding area.''In that moment, just before it could erupt, the energy lost its destination, expanding radially outward below the soles of Reinhard’s feet. As that power was left to run rampant, it fissured the road, upheaving it, rupturing a corner of the Royal Capital. One after another, many of the buildings in the environs of the battlefield were enveloped by the explosive energy, and came crumbling down.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 18, Section 3. *'''Increased Recovery Rate''': By absorbing power from the ground, Garfiel is able to accelerate the recovery of wounds and stamina.''The eyes of the Cloud Dragon, retaining the form of a dragonhusk constructed with a large volume of mana, perceived that mana was flowing from the ground into Garfiel with abnormal vigor. Garfiel’s abnormal recovery ability and stamina until now had likely been from absorbing power from the ground like that, but its scale and vigor had immediately skyrocketed.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 2.''The Dragon was motionless, and as white steam emitted from all over its body, with eyes wide-open, it witnessed Garfiel’s body, seared a deep red to the extent that it would make one want to avert their eyes, rapidly healing.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 2. He often combines this with his healing magic to keep himself standing during battle, and though this would ordinarily reduce his life span, thanks to his battle in [[Priestella]], he has overcome this.''Even now, he was absorbing power through the soles of his feet planted on the earth, and through invoking healing magic with all of his might, Garfiel’s body healed at a furious pace, both inside and out. Normally, this would be a load on the body that could potentially reduce his life span, but the events in the Watergate City forced Garfiel to break out of his shell, both physically and mentally.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 1. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== In addition to his natural strength, Garfiel is able to hone his skills in melee combat over the years despite his isolated upbringing. It was revealed that the secret behind Garfiel's strength is an old book about Reid Astrea. In that book, an unknown person described Reid's training in detail. Garfiel took the training regime to heart and spent his entire childhood training like Reid. Interestingly enough, the training primarily consists of hand-to-hand combat, without any weapons whatsoever. He spent years replicating the training that Reid Astrea put himself through, honing himself into a skilled unarmed combatant whose savage fighting style revolves primarily around instinct and is therefore difficult to analyze. He also made use of the enhanced physiology provided by his blood to his advantage in battle, performing feats that his opponents wouldn't think possible. He frequently partially-transforms into a tiger to deliver heavy hits so as catch people off guard, and he is even able to transmit the impact of his strikes throughout the entire body of his enemies when necessary.''With a shivering response from its back, the body of the struck undead was smashed to dust, lagging a moment behind the area that had been directly punched. It was proof that the impact had been transmitted throughout the entire body, and that the Corebug had been killed.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 69, Section 1. '''Enhanced Strength''': Garfiel is extremely strong. In his normal human form, the physical power displayed by Garfiel far exceeds that of an ordinary person. Not only was he unscathed by a bite received from an earth dragon, but he was able to effortlessly perform a suplex on said dragon despite its frame being comparable to a horse's. He's fully capable of stopping a Rock Pig's destructive attack and even lift it up, despite it weighing multiple tons, punch down fully grown trees without much effort, and even rip entire buildings out of the ground and toss them like cannonballs,''Then, before the house exposed to the breath could be demolished to rubble, the roaring Garfiel had used both his hands to tear out the house from the very ground, and heartily hurled it through the air.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 44, Section 1. and do so continuously without much effort.''Since it had defended against the first house-cannonball, Garfiel grabbed them up from the systematically laid out townscape of the Imperial Capital one-by-one, and flung them towards the Cloud Dragon in the sky with tremendous strength.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 44, Section 1. While duking it out with Kafma Irulux, he his blows were described as being strong enough that it would be no surprise if his opponent had died from them.''Even though they were both pounding each other’s vitals with such ferocious vigor and might that it would not have been strange if one of them died, and even though there was no room for a proper exchange of words, he heard it.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. By the time of Arc 8, he is even capable of causing significant damage to a Dragon as powerful as Mezoreia, his fists being compared to a cannonball and the aftershock resounding like a warehouse filled magic stones exploding,''Having flown above the breath, having approached the Cloud Dragon, Garfiel released both his tensed-up arms and let loose simultaneous blows, the destructive power of a cannonball seizing Mezoreia’s nose. A sound as loud as a warehouse stuffed with Magic Stones exploding reverberated through the sky; the Cloud Dragon was knocked back having received a direct hit, and the next moment, blood spurted forth.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 44, Section 1. and even toss it backwards by the end of its tail,''――Garfiel had parried the blow from Mezoreia’s tail, and had thrown the Dragon.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 54, Section 4. as well as fully redirect a blast from said Dragon's breath.''With the sound of a crash as he broke through, Garfiel swung both his arms up. By doing that, the final stretch of the Cloud Dragon’s breath shot up into the sky.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 2. '''Enhanced Durability''': Garfiel is incredibly physically tough, a fact that is often combined with the healing aspect of his Divine Protection. He has taken beatings from incredibly powerful fighters such as the Bowel Hunter, the Eight Arms, the Fighting Insect General, the Vicious Old Man, and even the Cloud Dragon, and he has managed to not only stay alive, but he even healed and fought back despite the pain, and he is even capable of withstanding the pain of biting out a part of his body that was poisoned, scraping against his own bones in the process, to let it regenerate.''Garfiel opened his mouth wide to bite off the shoulder on which the red handprint had been imprinted, tearing off the poison eating away at him. The taste of his own poisoned flesh and blood was terrible, as the bones his fangs grazed brought him unbearable pain. However, the pain was only momentary. The deep gouge that was the shoulder wound emitted steam originating from blood, as the wound was restored by a tremendous surge of flesh――.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 3. He has shown to be able to survive being thrust off of the tall ramparts of [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]'s [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]] while being simultaneously internally torn apart,''Still, the damage done to his body was severe, with his head split, the sensation of his body being stirred up from the inside beckoned for death to encroach on Garfiel’s life with every passing second. A split head could be restored with healing magic. However, an “insect” was preventing the activation of it. Since the “insect” was not actually attacking, healing magic could not get rid of it either. In the first place, there was no time to use the healing magic, and with the interference of the “insect”, his head was split and the blood was, blood was, blood was, blood was.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 5.''Clenching his back teeth and holding on to his tenuous grasp on life, he stopped using his head. Naturally, it was a split head. It could not be relied upon. What was needed was the instinct to live, to follow it, to move the body forcefully, and then.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 5. igniting himself with fire magic stones during his bout with Kafma,''And then, the Magic Stone Cannon that had been prepared on the wall, ready to intercept the enemy coming from outside the walls, he had swallowed the magic stone loaded inside it and crushed it in his belly. Instantly, the mana that had been stored within swelled up inside Garfiel, burning the “insect”. Once the “insect” was burned, all that Garfiel was left with were fierce scars.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 5.''Having swallowed the Fire Magic Stones, Garfiel’s body was still burning red-hot. His whole body was covered in flames, but inside his body must have been in an even more unmanageable state of conflagration.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. gutting himself to free his insides from being torn apart and bursting from thorns,''The large tiger with golden-fur had swelled up to the verge of bursting from thorns that poured into his mouth. Before that body could burst, the pressure in the thorns was rapidly lost. Why was that? ――It was because an escape route had been created for the thorns that entered his body. Garfiel’s sharp claws tore across his own abdomen, and thorns poured out from the wound.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. being crushed between the mighty hands of a Dragon,''Being pinched in a trajectory akin to striking one’s fists together before their chest, the mid-air Garfiel swung his shield-clad arms in order to parry. Taking the Dragon’s left arm with his right, and the Dragon’s right arm with his left, he received the blows. An intense impact ran through Garfiel’s entire body, his clenched teeth fissured, and his nose bled. But, if this were anyone other than Garfiel, they would be smashed into a lump of meat without lasting even a second. Mezoreia’s whiskers also quivered at that outcome, its shock at the existence of a human that was not crushed laid bare.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 44, Section 1. not only survive but also push through a direct strike from the Cloud Dragon's breath,''In the first place, for him to suffer a direct hit from a Dragon’s breath, and live to tell the tale, was no laughing matter.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.''As proof of that, Garfiel was not simply holding his ground, but while basking in the Cloud Dragon’s breath, he advanced one step forward, of all things. One step, and then another, he steadily advanced, closing the distance on Madelyn.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 2. and survive an indirect blast from the Divine Dragon's Dragon breath. '''Enhanced Speed''': He can also move at speeds greater than an average human, outmaneuvering most foes and easily jumping over trees and multi-story buildings. His speed is such that ordinary people would struggle to perceive him during combat. '''Enhanced Olfaction''': The potency of his sense of smell is also far greater than a regular human's. He can distinguish the scents of separate individuals from a considerable distance. Garfiel - Beastification.gif|Garfiel using his ancestral blood to transform into his Golden Tiger form. Garfiel - Demi-Human blood.gif|thumb|250px|Garfiel partially transforming his body and tearing off half of Elsa's head. '''Beastification''' (獣化, ''Kemonoka''): Garfiel can transform himself into a towering, 4-meter-long golden tiger with massive and thick limbs, as well as razor-sharp fangs and claws, which can easily rip a man or even a fully grown earth dragon in two with a single swipe. Naturally, Garfiel's physical strength in his tiger form increases exponentially, although his speed suffers a reduction due to his size increase. When in this form, he can easily deal devastating attacks and decimate entire areas, but with a cost of losing his reason, making him avoid it if possible. He uses this ability when he is pushed to the limit or facing an overwhelming foe, as seen in Arc 5 when he fought the War God. Garfiel is also capable of partial transformation, and he has shown a habit of often transforming only his arms to increase his strength or catch his enemies off guard. ===[[Magic]]=== Garfiel is proficient in the use of water magic, though he doesn't use it for combat purposes. It is unknown what attribute he has an affinity for. '''Spells''': [[File:Garfiel using healing magic.gif|thumb|right|250px|Garfiel using healing magic on Ram.]] *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法, ''Chiyu Mahō''): Garfiel summons water mana to heal the wounds of himself and others. Garfiel is quite experienced with healing magic, having been given many chances since joining the Emilia Camp to use it, and his contributions with this magic allowed him to save numerous lives alongside the Blue, [[Ferris]], during following the [[Battle for Priestella|events]] in Priestella. He often combines his healing magic with his Divine Protection as well, and combined with its rapid recovery rate, he is capable of quickly healing any wounds inflicted on his own body. Although doing so would ordinarily strain his body and risk him reducing his life span, thanks to his battle in Priestella, he was able to overcome this. When he heals in this way, steam is emitted from his wounds.''With the steam rising from his many bloody wounds, as if his body were truly blazing hot, Garfiel settled his resolve to face the Dragon in the distance.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 1. ===Other=== '''Keen Instincts''': Garfiel has great instincts that can allow him to make optimal decisions mid-combat or during a crisis. During the Battle for Priestella, when Mimi was injured, his first instinct was to find his way to Subaru, which in turn led him to Ferris. Likewise, during the battle against Kafma, he was able to avoid a devastating blast from one of his attacks,''Following the urging of every survival instinct, he abandoned Kafma’s body and leaped directly to the side. It was the correct decision. Right where Garfiel had previously been, the golden insect had gouged out the entire top of the city wall in its line of fire. As short hairs on his body were shaved away, Garfiel felt a chill run his spine.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. and later, he even decided to burn insects inside his body, albeit in an absurd way, that would have otherwise been lethal.''Rather, it was probably the result of following instinct rather than thinking with one’s head. If he had thought it through with his head, he would have never been able to swallow the magic stone and burn his body.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. '''Apostle of Greed''' (強欲の使徒): Garfiel, after attempting the Trial of the Sanctuary, acquired the mark of the Witch of Greed [[Echidna]], which indicates him as an Apostle of Greed. Because of this title, Garfiel has the ability to command the many clones of Ryuzu Meyer created by Echidna, essentially affording him with a small army should the need arise. The clones follow his orders unquestionably, as they are compelled to do so. ===Equipment=== Garfiel's Shield.jpg|Garfiel's shields. Garfiel - Pyroxene Crystal.jpg|Garfiel's glintstone. *'''Twin Shields''': Garfiel uses two shields in combat. He's very skilled with them, using them for both offense and defense as they're sturdy enough to withstand devastating blows that would usually shatter his bones or cut off his arms, as well as deliver bone-shattering punches capable of subduing his opponents. *'''Glintstone''' (輝石): When Garfiel was younger, he and his sister Frederica each received a glintstone from their mother, Reshia Tinzel. *'''Fire Magic Stones''': During his bout with Kafma, Garfiel used fire magic stones meant for a magic stone cannon to ignite the insects that were infecting him as well as set his body ablaze. ==Trivia== *Garfiel's birthday is October 12, the same birthday as actor [[Wikipedia:Hugh Jackman|Hugh Jackman]], who is known for playing [[Wikipedia:Wolverine (character)|Wolverine]]. The author's rationale for giving Garfiel this birthday was that he felt like Wolverine somehow overlapped with Garfiel. *Garfiel originally learned healing magic as one of the ways to support the residents of the Sanctuary. *According to Wilhelm, if Kurgan were to be at his full strength, Garfiel would have been promptly killed right away in Arc 5. *Garfiel was originally meant to have a named chapter in Arc 7. However, with the arc being split, his named chapter was pushed back to a later arc. *At a talk show with the author held on March 30, 2024, when someone asked who would make up the Nine Divine Generals of Lugunica if it existed, Garfiel was one of the names he listed.March 30, 2024 Talk Show. *When asked who he would date from among the male cast of the series if the author was female, he said it would be Garfiel.April 5, 2026 Talk Show. *After becoming the Emilia Camp's Military Officer, Garfiel started learning how to dress formally and use proper etiquette, and he has grown to the point that Otto can look on with relief. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Sanctuary]] [[Category:Emilia Camp]] [[Category:Guardians]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Human Hybrids]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[de:Garfiel Tinsel]] [[es:Garfiel Tinsel]] [[fr:Garfiel Tinsel]] [[pl:Garfiel Tinsel]] [[pt-br:Garfiel Tinsel]] [[ru:Гарфиэль Тинзель]] [[uk:Гарфіель Тінзель]] [[zh:角色:加菲尔]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7|Volume 7]] (mentioned) |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Fourier Lugunica''' (フーリエ・ルグニカ) was the Fourth Prince of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] and the childhood friend of [[Crusch Karsten]] and [[Ferris]]. Though his only mention in the main story was in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7|Volume 7]], Fourier was one of the main protagonists in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. He died roughly a year before the events of the main story, having succumbed to the [[Royal Plague|mysterious illness]] that plagued the Lugunican [[Royal Family]] on the same day as his father, [[Randohal Lugunica]], thus having had his death treated as nothing more than a small note next to the news of the King's death. ==Appearance== As a member of the Lugunican Royal Family, Fourier was characterized by his shining golden hair and large crimson red eyes that burned like the twilight sun. His extraordinarily handsome face would've captured the hearts of many women if not for his outgoing personality. He had a [[Wikipedia:Yaeba|yaeba]] that became prominent when he laughed. Fourier strongly resembled [[Felt]] in terms of general looks, like all other members of the Royal Family. When Fourier grew ill, his physical state greatly deteriorated. His beautiful golden hair lost its shining luster, the burning light of his scarlet red eyes faded significantly, and his usually charming smiles lost their energy. His body completely lost its modest musculature, leaving the prince with an emaciated body and protruding cheekbones. ==Personality== Fourier was an energetic and magnanimous young man who appeared more self-assured and assertive than he actually was. That being said, he had a gentle caring heart and a very strong sense of responsibility that earned him the faith and trust of Crusch and Ferris. He had an excessively cheerful personality, and despite his position as a prince, he had even snuck out of the castle numerous times to mingle with the common people.''"By nature, many members of the Lugunican Royal Family had good personalities, who were gentle and well-liked by others, but His Highness Fourier was an individual of exceptionally cheerful and pleasant personality. So he would frequently sneak out of the Castle, and make merry with the people of the Royal Capital."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 9, Section 2. Moreover, he had the potential to be the current generation's "Lion King" due to his unusually sharp intuition that sometimes manifested which made him seem wise beyond his years. This trait of his only grew stronger as he matured over the years.''"He would on occasion sense an answer emerge, for no particular reason, from among countless choices. What he discovered this way always led him down the right path."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], A Dream's Beginning, Section 3. Likewise, despite the rumor of the royal family being more like figureheads than actual rulers, Fourier acted as a true leader at times, making people such as [[Julius Juukulius]] believe that the rumors were not entirely true. He also made for an excellent leader, combining his unique intuition and his position to maneuver people around during a crisis, such as during the [[Raid of Argyle Manor]]. Fourier had a dislike of both hot and cold weather, although he found cold weather far more unbearable. Even on a sunny day, Fourier always had a thick fur coat prepared in case the weather turned cold. He could be incredibly prideful and often spoke highly of himself, although the arrogance he exuded was considered endearing instead of condescending by those around him. Whenever he did a good thing unintentionally, he would always act as though he had meant to do so. Another one of the prince’s charming features was his unconquerable optimism. Regardless of the situation he was in, Fourier almost always maintained a positive outlook. In an extreme case, the withering prince found joy in the peaceful state of the castle gardens, not taking heed of the fact that the reason it was practically deserted was because of the ongoing illness that had already claimed the lives of many of his relatives. As a member of the royal family, Fourier was carefully nurtured from birth. He was forced to attend classes relating to the history and politics of the Kingdom. Fourier hated these classes, as he found them unbearably boring. Nevertheless, he learned many things from his tutors. Shortly before the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], Ferris noted that [[Natsuki Subaru]] reminded him of Fourier, as their personalities were remarkably similar. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== From birth, Fourier Lugunica had excellent intuition. Whether it be in arithmetic, history, or board games, the prince displayed paranormal talent at a young age. In an extreme case from his childhood, he once had successfully predicted that a wheel would fall off of his father’s carriage, and, almost as if he were an oracle, the event came to transpire. Even as a boy, Fourier understood that there was something special about how things came to pass around him, and he began to trust in his instincts to guide his actions. As a young boy, Fourier had little patience for his royal duties. He would often do everything he could to avoid studying, causing quite the hassle for those who tutored him. The prince had hated relying on other people to solve his own problems and would never ask them to do so. That being said, he would graciously accept the favor of a person if they showered him with it of their own accord. Sometimes, he would even sneak out of the castle and mingle with the common people, something which would often cause trouble to the people around him; he had even gone to a soup kitchen hosted by the [[Divine Dragon Church]] at one point, something that nearly caused friction between the church and castle.''"Well, it did turn out like that. The Royal Guard was mobilized to search for His Highness in the wake of his disappearance. In the end, His Highness was at a soup kitchen in the slums, that turned out to be run by the Divine Dragon Church, which almost caused friction between the Castle and the Church, and a big fuss ensued."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 9, Section 2. Although they would not properly meet until a little later, when they were both children, Fourier first beheld Crusch in the Royal Castle's courtyard gardens when he found her staring at budding blossoms. He had been so transfixed by that moment in time, he had fallen for her at first sight but would be too embarrassed to approach her. In the later weeks since then, he would sneak out in disguise to the same spot hoping to catch glimpse of her without Crusch being aware. However, one day during his excisions he would accidentally fall into the garden alerting her of his presence for the first time. Thinking he was an assailant after the Royal Family, Crusch would pull a dagger out on him with intent to attack. After frantically clearing the misunderstanding and stopping Crusch for trying to take her own life out of shame of pointing her weapon against a member of the Royal Family, they would become good friends. It was here that Fourier would exchange an important promise with her that would influence Crusch's worldview. As Crusch revealed her thoughts regarding Lugunica's stagnation due to the Dragon's blessing, and lamented being unable to choose a life befitting of her family crest, the fang-bearing lion, because she was a woman, Fourier told her that she ought to never concede herself. Several days later, Fourier asserted that the two of them would resurrect the bond between the Lion King and his loyal retainer, which Crusch and soon Fourier laughed over. A year later Fourier would also meet and befriend Ferris and together the three of them – Fourier, Crusch and Ferris – would go through the trials and tribulations of navigating high society over the years of their teenage-to-adult lives. From dealing with his arranged marriage to [[Tiriena]], to supporting Crusch as she dealt with the conflicts of her womanhood and becoming the noble expected of her, to being Ferris' stalwart ally as he confronted elements of his dark past that still had lingering effects on his present. These experiences would reaffirm their eternal friendship to each other. It would be Fourier who recommended Ferris for knighthood and get him into the Royal Guard to better serve Crusch who was now coming onto her own as the head of one of the most prominent noble houses of the country.''"You are here at the urging of His Highness Fourier, as well as a number of other strong recommendations."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 2. It would show his keen understanding of how important it would be both their futures and the one he wanted. At age 20 he played an important role in the Raid of House Argyle doing work behind scenes such as secretly keeping [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] on standby to clean up the loose ends, where the maturity of his leadership skills and forethought would be displayed, which would serve to protect Ferris's place in [[House Karsten]]. However, it would be from that point on where tragedy would strike–he fell ill to the mysterious diseases that had been affecting the Royal Family of late. In spite of this, Fourier's condition would gain little national attention due to the commonality of the occurrence among the Royal Family. An entire month later, he would still show no signs of improving despite the efforts of Ferris Argyle and best healers from the Royal Treatment Center. Despite this, Fourier would surprisingly show signs of vitality, but it would merely be a front he kept on from adding to Crusch's worries, who was facing increasing pressure in her political life, as her duties mounted from crisis of the absence of Royal Family. During one of her visits, Fourier would ask Crusch to take him outside. They would go to the Royal Gardens where they first met, then sit on the bench and Fourier would talk about his dreams for the future and the promise he made to her there. He would then finally admit his feelings for her and pass away peacefully in her lap.''""Crusch." "Yes, Your Highness." "I...Lo...""'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], The Dream of the Lion King, Section 5. Fourier's death was payed little to no mind, as the news of his passing came at the same time as the news of the last King Randohal Lugunica's passing, which resulted in everyone for the most part dismissing the Fourth Prince's death. ==Abilities== '''Gifted Mind''': Fourier was born with naturally excellent intuition in the form of a gut feeling that led [[Miklotov McMahon]] to believe he could become a wise ruler like the Lion Kings of old. The wisdom and intelligence demonstrated by the young prince were both well beyond his years. As noted by those close to him, the statements he made, no matter how outlandish they seemed, usually came true. In this regard, Fourier was excellent at predicting future events, almost as if he were an oracle. Under his direction, the incident involving the House of Argyle became a complete military success. Furthermore, as a member of the royal family, Fourier received the very best education the Kingdom had to offer, affording him with impressive academic capabilities, and he was a gifted leader as well, taking advantage of his unique intuition and directing people as needed during crises. '''Skilled Swordsman''': As a child, Fourier made a promise with Crusch Karsten that she would never wear feminine clothing until he could defeat her in a duel. The young prince regretted the promise greatly, as he could never defeat his beloved, leading him to believe he was the reason she could never express her femininity. As such, Fourier trained diligently to surpass Crusch in terms of swordsmanship. His efforts provided him with skills that far surpassed a majority of nobles. While his skill never surpassed Crusch's, he was able to fight on par with her several times, a fact he felt pride over. He is much stronger than an average knight. ==Trivia== *For her 17th birthday, Fourier gifted Crusch a jeweled pommel sword of finest bladework, which she took to battle against the [[Great Rabbit]] that had appeared on the Foutour Plains that day. *According to the author, if Subaru and Fourier ever met, they would likely get along.April 5, 2026 Talk Show. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Royal Family of Lugunica]]

[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|Ex Volume 1]] (referenced) |Manga = |Anime = [[Episode 54]] (mentioned) |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Emerada Lugunica''' (エメラダ・ルグニカ) was a princess hailing from the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]'s [[Royal Family]]. She lived before the events of the [[Demi-Human War]] and had died at a very young age due to a mysterious illness. Though she has yet to make an appearance in the main story or any side stories, Emerada has been briefly mentioned by [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] and indirectly mentioned by [[Miklotov McMahon]] at the very start of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. Strangely enough, the current Witch Cult's Sin Archbishop of Lust, [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]], also shares the same name as her, as well as a vile personality that's incidentally attributed to Emerada as well. Furthermore, Capella most often tends to take shape of a younger girl with gold hair and crimson red eyes, matching the characteristic physical attributes of the Lugunican Royal Family to a tee. Capella has also expressed confusion after [[Natsuki Subaru]] accused her of impersonating the princess. ==Appearance== Emerada is mentioned to have been exceptionally beautiful.''"I never met her in person, but the records mention that she was a lady of exceptional beauty and wisdom."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 3, Section 3. Like the rest of the Royal Family, she had gold hair and red eyes. Besides these two facts, however, nothing else is known about Emerada's appearance. ==Personality== Emerada Lugunica was described as being very wise and capable. Despite that, however, Emerada was said to be extremely cruel, and was considered to be a nonconformist within the Royal Family as she had an immeasurable darkness toward others.''"Lady Emerada was a terribly beautiful and wise person... But she was also reportedly cruel in the extreme, and constantly shrouded in unfathomable darkness. As such, though she was part of the Royal Family, she was branded a heretic and even news of her passing seemed to have been suppressed for some time."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 3, Section 3. According to [[Miklotov McMahon]], she apparently had the qualities necessary to be a Lion King.''"So you may say, Your Highness, but the blood has not run thin. It is a fact that once every several generations a true master appears in the royal line. Two generations ago..." Miklotov had been speaking fluently, but suddenly he stopped. His wrinkled face darkened and he shook his head and murmured, "No."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], A Dream's Beginning, Section 2. ==History== Emerada lived before the Demi-Human War, more than fifty years before the start of the main story. At an unspecified point in time, she died at a young age due to a disease, and the news of her death was hidden for a while. As the national sentiment was against it, she wasn't given a state funeral, with a surface reason claiming that it wasn't possible under their current circumstances.''"Lady Emerada succumbed to an illness at a young age. However, not only was her death not mourned by the kingdom, she also was denied a state funeral, as would be standard. The stated reason was that the condition at the time were too dire to hold a formal ceremony. However, the real reason was that the kingdom's people had no desire to do any such thing."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 3, Section 3. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Royal Family of Lugunica]] [[ru:Эмерада Лугуника]]

[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Ex Volume 3]] (actual) |Manga = [[Manga Love Song Chapter 26|Love Song Chapter 26]] |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Gionis Lugunica''' (ジオニス・ルグニカ) was the 40th King of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. He was succeeded by [[Randohal Lugunica]]. He played a supporting role in the [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]]. ==Appearance== Gionis had glistering red eyes and moderately short gold hair. He was described to have a cheerful look to his face and a relaxed demeanor. ==Personality== Gionis was a generous and compassionate figure who was beloved by his people. This could be best seen in the handling of [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]]'s transgression in the end of Sword Saint Ceremony by overlooking them because he was highly moved by the affection he had seen. He was known to not have much of a mind for military affairs, but he was nonetheless a decisive person who did not shy from action to safeguard his Kingdom. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]]=== Gionis ruled the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica during the [[Demi-Human War]], commanding the [[Royal Army]] who was trying to suppress the Demi-Human uprising, though it's not stated what exactly he did during those days. In the year following the end of the War, Gionis continued to rule the now-united nation. Shortly after the end of the conflict, he hosted a ceremony to award [[Theresia van Astrea]] in return for all she had done for the Kingdom in the last two years of the war. After [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]] fought and defeated her and took her reason to wield the sword away from her, when Gionis asked Theresia what she wanted for her award, it was to free Wilhelm, who had been arrested for his actions, which Gionis accepted. Afterward, he spoke with Theresia and told her that if she were to wed Wilhelm, he would allow her to retire from the military, something which a young [[Miklotov McMahon]] was aware of. In the following days, Wilhelm visited and made a deal with him, that if he could defeat the country's best fighters that Theresia would be allowed to retire, which Gionis accepted. Ultimately, he watched over the battle, which Wilhelm won. However, when Theresia appeared, she scolded him for allowing this, as Wilhelm was unaware of their deal. Afterward, the two were engaged, and three months later, Gionis was secretly present for their wedding. During the months of [[Stride Vollachia]]'s devastating rampages across the entire Kingdom, Gionis desperately tried to put an end to the seemingly endless damage caused by him. It was only after Stride had unleashed [[Valgren]] onto one of the Five Great Cities of the Kingdom, [[Picoutatte]], in hopes of toppling the entire nation, that Gionis was finally able to make contact with the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] itself, summoning it to the devastated city and ending the nightmare once and for all. ==Trivia== *It is unknown when Gionis was succeeded by his son, Randohal Lugunica. He was around 40 years old during the events of Ex 3 and Ex 6, and he could have ruled for a maximum of 24 more years until he either died or abdicated himself. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Royal Family of Lugunica]]

He played a small but important role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]]. ==Appearance== Garitch Fabless was a wizened white haired old man. From the appearance of his blood-colored, poor skin, and his sunken cheeks, he was sometimes referred to his other alias. He was lanky and wore a white garment. Though he had a tendency to narrow his eyes in displeasure due to his nervousness, he had a weak spot in his fondness for frozen desserts. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]]=== Garitch was a doctor who worked in [[Picoutatte]] during the events of the [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]]. He treated [[Veltol Astrea]] and with his skill with healing magic he was able to confine the curse to Veltol's arm. Following this display of proficiency, Garitch was recommended for a position in the [[Royal Capital]]. ===[[Sword Demon Love Story: The Other Side of the Honeymoon]]=== Following the Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte, [[Theresia van Astrea]] and [[Carol Remendis]] wandered the streets of Picoutatte while [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] and [[Veltol Astrea]] were recovering from their injuries. As they walked, they came across Garitch and spoke with him. Theresia apologized to him for having destroyed the bridge and creating more work for him, but he waved it off. Still worried about it, Carol tried to pin the blame on the one responsible for the challenge while Garitch said that Veltol could pay for the damages and treatment and nobody would be upset. However, he also asked her if she could get Veltol to reconsider his recommendation of Garitch to the Royal Capital, as he did not want to go to the capital since the [[Roswaal J. Mathers|mother]] of his [[Roswaal K. Mathers|son]] was there. Though he believed that it would probably be for the best that he didn't go, Theresia claimed that happiness was up to the individual to choose, which ultimately cemented that Garitch did not want to go, saying it wasn't the right time yet, and the girls left his going to the capital to Veltol. Afterward, they asked about the mother, which he described, leading to Garitch telling her that someone so immoral should not be recommended and telling her that Wilhelm was fastidious, so she didn't have to worry, triggering an emotional response from Carol. After he recommended the sherbet, he left, and the two had a bowl for themselves. ===In the Years That Followed=== After the events in Picoutatte, Garitch ended up receiving the position of the Blue of the Kingdom's titles of color. He eventually got married, though he and his wife had no children together, and she eventually passed away. Garitch was originally the doctor of [[Louanna Astrea]] when she was afflicted with a condition known as '''Sleeping Beauty''' (眠り姫 ''Nemurihime''). Over the years, [[Heinkel Astrea]] started to curse Garitch for not being able to heal Louanna. He later became Ferris' teacher as he would be the successor of his alias. Six years before the events of [[Arc 1]], Garitch was stabbed by a disciple of his, a curse arts user, and died. Ferris attempted to find out who the murderer was, to no avail. Heinkel grieved over Garitch's death, drowning his sorrows in alcohol. In the end, after Garitch's disciple was caught and executed during his state funeral, his casket was laid into the Kingdom Cemetery. ==Abilities== '''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): As the former '''Blue''', he can be considered as an extremely skilled water magic user. *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法, ''Chiyu Mahō''): Garitch was highly skilled in using healing magic. Before his death, he recognized that Ferris's healing magic would surpass his own in a matter of years. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[de:Garitch Fabless]] [[Category:Teachers]] [[Category:Picoutatte]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Deceased]]

Filore Lugunica (descendant) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]] (side story) |Manga = [[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 5|Arc 3 Chapter 5]] (mentioned) |Anime = [[Episode 85]] (mentioned)}} '''Farsale Lugunica''' (ファルセイル・ルグニカ) was the 35th King of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]] and a member of the [[Witch Era Party]]. Farsale is famous for making a contract with the Divine Dragon [[Volcanica]] to help protect the Kingdom of Lugunica, and he was the last known "Lion King". ==Appearance== Not much is known of Farsale Lugunica but considering how he was a member of the [[Royal Family]], it is a high probability that he had golden hair and bright crimson red eyes, the same as the other members of the family. ==Personality== [[Alec Hoshin]] describes Farsale as someone who lives by the principle of lavishness. Alec also states that Farsale's personality is such that he can get on with things anywhere he is. Additionally, Alec claims that Farsale was foreign to the concept of loneliness and wouldn't be able to sympathize with him. By [[Echidna]]'s claim, he was honest to a fault, even exhibiting traits that could be considered for a fool, which at one point led him to unveil his identity, despite it supposing to have been kept secret. In her words, she claims that he was incredibly open and cheerful and was the type to never intimidated by anybody. She also describes him as an idiot; however, despite her claim, he is actually described as the embodiment of "the line between genius and madness". Despite his sometimes foolish behavior, his actions were not thoughtless, and there was usually reasonable logic behind is actions. However, the thought processes leading to actions were hard to see by others, and they were typically left gaping by the bizarre results that he would produce. He has been known to set [[Reid Astrea]] off on a rampage or go along with Alec on a scam. Furthermore, he was willing to ally with a [[Dragon]] and make an enemy of a major power to protect a [[Witch]]. ==History== In the years predating the [[Great Calamity]], Farsale travelled alongside [[Satella]], Echidna, [[Flugel]], Reid, and Alec for unknown reasons, though according to Alec, it was a journey to save the world. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of [[Magrizza]]. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. The nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and Volcanica went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the [[Black Serpent]] destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent. Around 400 years ago, Lugunica and the [[Vollachia Empire]] were always in conflict at that time due to unknown reasons and Farsale decided to make a covenant with the Divine Dragon Volcanica to help safeguard and guide the country in times of turmoil, resulting in peace between the two countries. ==Abilities== ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Despite his behavior, Echidna described Farsale as the type of person who typically acted only after putting his genius level intellect into thinking, and he would go along with his friends' scams or even manipulate Reid into going off on a rampage if it resulted in the outcome that he desired. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Royal Family of Lugunica]] [[Category:Witch Era Party]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Leaders]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40|Volume 40]] (main story)}} '''Doltero Amule''' (ドルテロ・アムル) is the head of the Black Silver Coin organization in [[Flanders]]. He plays a supporting role in [[Arc 9]]. ==Appearance== Doltero is a pig human, and therefore has the facial characteristics of a pig, as well as has blonde hair and deep blue eyes. He is mentioned to be almost two meters tall and weighs no less than 200 kilograms, with a body wrapped in muscles like armor. He is also mentioned to be agile despite his large body. He is seen wearing a suit and tie. ==Personality== Doltero is a serious man who takes his duties as the most powerful, influential man in Flanders solemnly. Though he harbors deep love for those closest to him, he prioritizes his position over them, exhibiting the willingness to disown them even in the face of grief on account of it. When coming face to face with an opponent, he will stand up to them down with the will to lose a limb if necessary, and he wouldn't flinch even at the loss of one. Likewise, he is unwilling to properly converse with his enemies. Doltero has a habit of referencing pigs and things in relation to them when he speaks, whether he is rudely calling people he sees as beneath him pigs or making disparaging jokes about his own race. ==History== Doltero is mentioned to have known [[Rom]] and is old friends with him. He fathered a daughter named [[Ilya]] with his mistress [[Kalifa]], a human woman. Doltero revealed his relationship with them to only one person, his closest and most loyal confidant, [[Safis]]. ===[[Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint Part 1|The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint]]=== Recognizing that Kalifa and Ilya were Doltero's weaknesses, Safis attempted to have them killed out of loyalty to his boss and a desire to remove the "vulnerabilities" he had. As a result, Kalifa was attacked by an assailant Safis sent and had her larynx destroyed, inhibiting her from ever being able to speak again. She and her daughter both survived, and she entrusted Ilya to the Astrea Manor for protection. Doltero sent one of his men after the two, but he was discovered by [[Felt]] and [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] and revealed his affiliation with the Black Silver Coin once the candidate threatened with the Sword Saint. Shortly afterwards, [[Gaston]], [[Rachins Hoffman|Rachins]], and [[Camberley]] located Kalifa and brought her back to the mansion, where they discovered that Doltero was Ilya's father. Deciding to visit Doltero in Flanders, Rom used his connection to Doltero to hold a meeting with him. When Felt, Reinhard, and Rom, alongside Kalifa and Ilya, met with Doltero, he discovered that his confidant was responsible for ordering the attack on his mistress and daughter. Safis revealed his intentions, preparing to commit suicide to atone for his misdeeds, only for Doltero to suddenly assault him to keep him alive and demote him to a simple lackey position in the Black Silver Coin unless he could work to regain the Pig King's trust. Understanding Safis's argument, he disowned his mistress and his daughter, much to the displeasure of Felt and Rom. Before leaving, Kalifa turned to Doltero and bowed, showing him the face of his sleeping baby one last time, and Doltero murmured Ilya's name once the room was clear of everyone besides him. Following the incident, Safis was stripped of his executive position in the organization, but was allowed the chance to prove his loyalty and regain Doltero's trust. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 1|Riot in Flanders]]=== Two months after the incident with Safis, Doltero took part in a meeting between the heads of the other organizations in Big Three, those being [[Toto]] of the Flower Prison Garden and [[Manfred Madison]] of the Balance, as well as the representative of the Flanders branch of the Golden Beetle, [[Helaine Gatness]]. The meeting concerned a series of murders that had been committed against members of the Big Three organizations, as well as the Golden Beetle. Helaine proposed the one responsible was Felt, the Royal Selection Candidate being housed by the Sword Saint of Hakuchuri, having received reports that she contacted Doltero and the Black Silver Coin before. As a result, Manfred and Toto went on to seek courtesy visits from her as a means to verify her intentions, with Doltero sending Safis to inform her of their wishes. Several days after Felt's courtesy visits, the Big Three started began pursuing [[Ezzo Cadner]], who was framed for burning down a brothel in the red-light district and killing members of the Big Three, including a veteran of the Black Silver Coin and [[Mimosa]], a prostitute from the Flower Prison Garden. Once Felt discovered his location at an abandoned mansion and heard his side of the story and Reinhard defeated a hundred members of the Black Silver Coin who had gathered at the mansion to catch the dwarf while using the name of the Masked Knight Veltol, the candidate and the Sword Saint proceeded to Doltero's mansion. Reinhard defeated another hundred men from Doltero's group, and him and Felt met with the Pig King and Safis. Felt suspected that the Black Silver Coin was responsible for the strife in Flanders, having learned that Kalifa and Ilya were targeted again. Neither Doltero nor Safis claimed responsibility, and nobody else in the organization had realized the truth about their relation to the Pig King. However, Safis mentioned that the veteran of the group who died on the night of the brothel's arson had been present when Kalifa and Ilya visited Doltero with Felt, and had revealed this information to Mimosa, who then relayed it to someone else. Ultimately, the incident's mastermind attempted to pit Felt and her group and the Black Silver Coin against each other, and succeeded in guiding her faction's actions. Despite that, Felt maintained confidence and relied on her comrade's approach to resolve the strife in Flanders. Soon enough, the true culprits were discovered and the incident was resolved, and the Black Silver Coin continued operation. One of the culprits, [[Mozolite]], a traitor in the Balance who attempted to steal Manfred's position for himself, had the eyes in which his [[Divine Protection]]'s effects resided gouged out and was tortured by his boss in the presence of Doltero and Toto. In the end, the three leaders of the Big Three unanimously concluded that Felt was the candidate they would back. Gaston also managed to earn Doltero's respect for successfully defending Kalifa and Ilya from their attackers. ==Abilities== '''Enhanced Strength''': Doltero has enough physical strength that if he hit an ordinary person, assuming they didn't die instantly, they would be left severely injured. According to Rom, he has enough strength that if he were born ten years earlier, he would likely have made a name for himself during the [[Demi-Human War]]. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Flanders]] [[Category:Demi-Human]]

'''Faust''' (ファウスト) was one of the [[Witch Cult]]ists that attacked [[Ram]] and [[Rem]]'s village. He was also [[Sado]] and [[Fogg]]'s master and the one who cut off Ram's horn. He was ultimately killed during his [[Attack on Miload Manor]], beaten by Rem and blown up with his own explosions by Ram.

==Appearance==
Faust was a large and muscular man with short hair and fine features.<ref>''What went through her vision was a large, muscular, short-haired man──Ram had encountered that man once before in red scenery like the one happening right now. It was when she was surrounded by her kind’s burnt corpses in the Oni village burning down. That disastrous scene.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 4.</ref><ref>''Her head was caught, and her legs were in the air. A strange man with finely chiseled features came into Ram’s vision.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref>

==Personality==
Faust smokes tobacco leaves and enjoys fire, and one of his motives for attacking the [[Oni]] village was to smell the burning onis and confront a true oni to burn.<ref>''“I love fire. Plus, I wanted to try burning Onis. I wanted to know the smell.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> As his hobby and profitable moneymaker, Faust took the initiative to spread the knowledge of fire making and put it into practice,<ref>''“He’s an arson apprentice. It makes sense to kill people, destroy things, and burn things. However, not everyone could do all that. If there isn’t anyone to teach it, then the skills won’t spread. So, I take the initiative and do so. It’s a practice that is a hobby and it has benefits.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> though he seems to have poor opinions of at least one of his apprentices.<ref>''“──Fogg must be the one who couldn’t keep his mouth shut. He was an awful apprentice.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> Despite being a member of the Witch Cult, he had no interest in the organization at all, being only a member because it was convenient.

==History==
===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]===
Around ten years before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, Faust, Sado, [[Sergei]], and Fogg attacked the Oni Village. Three months later, he staged an assault on Miload Manor, killing many of the servants and guards in the process. Eventually, Ram confronted him in the hallway, and the two battled. She dodged most of his attacks and attempted to strike him down with Al Fura, but she failed to deal significant damage. Thanks to the arrival of Rem, however, the two were able to fight back Faust, punching him straight through the ceiling before sending him plummeting into his own traps. Then, Ram uses the man's leaf tobacco to trigger the explosions, reducing the man to ash.

==Abilities==
'''Explosion Technique''' (爆裂術式): By setting up magic formulas in the air beforehand, Faust can create invisible traps that can explode and kill whoever gets caught in it.<ref>''The invisible explosions──Rem had already saw through that trick. It’s a special magic where he can cause explosions on the spot by setting up magic formulas in the air beforehand. It definitely would’ve been very troublesome for her without her background knowledge. However, once she’d figured out the trick, it was no big deal.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> Once triggered, it can create a chain reaction with other set-up traps.<ref>''“Once the explosions start at one spot, it causes a chain reaction. Don’t you think it’d be a magnificent and splendid farewell gift for a genuine Oni like yourself?”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> The technique requires precise calculations and a calm use of the user's magic power, and it can be triggered by the user or from outside stimulation, such as a magic stone or the burning end of leaf tobacco. It is possible to locate the traps beforehand, however, by either smelling miasma in the air or sensing the disturbance in mana in the air, allowing his targets to avoid most of the damage.<ref>''Rem had exposed it with her sense of smell, but Ram saw through it by the disturbance in mana right before the explosions.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref>

'''Wind Reading''': Faust was able to read the wind and taught Sado how to do so.<ref>''“I didn’t expect your trump card to be related to wind. That’s my specialty. I was the one who taught Sado how to read wind. I know how wind protection works.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> This ability allows him to be scrupulous with preparations and is the reason he is excellent at pursuit.<ref>''“He’s scrupulous with preparations, and on top of that, he’s excellent at pursuit… It’s as if he’s reading the wind.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 5.</ref>
