title: Fogg
wikitext:
{{Character |Name = Fogg |Kanji = フォッグ |Romaji = Foggu |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Previous Affiliation = [[Witch Cult]] |Previous Occupation = Prisoner
Follower |Status = Deceased |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]}} '''Fogg''' (フォッグ) was one of the [[Witch Cult]]ists that attacked [[Ram]] and [[Rem]]'s village. He was also [[Faust]]'s disciple until he was killed by Rem. ==Appearance== Fogg was an extremely skinny, unhealthy-looking man, whose cheeks and eye sockets were depressed and made him appear ill. He wore nothing on his upper torso and only a pair of hemp trousers. His body was also covered in burns, lacerations, and scars, suggesting he'd experienced torture.''It was an extremely skinny, unhealthy looking man. He had depressing cheeks and eye sockets, and a countenance that was so vapid that it looked ill. He wore nothing over his upper half of his body, and he only had hemp trousers for his lower half, but there were many burns and lacerations on his exposed skin. It looked as if he had been tortured before.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 5. ==Personality== Fogg was a cruel man who enjoyed hearing the screams of his victims. As an apprentice in arson, he also seemed to enjoy burning things, though he seemed to experience shock whenever his explosion technique, the only thing he was good at, failed to work on someone. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sister of the Hidden Village]]=== Around ten years before [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s arrival, Faust, [[Sado]], [[Sergei]], and Fogg attacked the Oni Village. He was captured during by [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] during the attack and was imprisoned under [[Roswaal Manor]]. For two months, he got the bare minimum of food and drink. However, one day, he was freed by Rem, who'd smelled the scent of the [[Witch]] from beyond his seal. Taking advantage of this, he used his explosion technique to blow her away and attempt to kill her. He found himself quickly cornered by her, however, as she was able to predict and avoid most of the damage by the explosions. Ultimately, he detonated all of his explosions when she managed to set off one of the explosions with a magic stone and blow away part of his face. Although he thought he killed her and attempted to leave, he was hit with a morningstar that Rem picked up. She then proceeded to torture him with the weapon and repetitive healing magic, getting the names of the other three accomplices out of him, before she killed him. ==Abilities== '''Explosion Technique''' (爆裂術式): Fogg manipulated mana, creating drifts around him, and placed the Explosion Technique inside of it, using the mana to cause an explosion. The technique itself is invisible and can be set up in a single motion, though it requires precise calculations and a calm use of the user's [[magic]] power.''The man, pain and fear taking over his brain, couldn’t get his explosion techniques to work at all. In order to set up the techniques, he needed to calculate accurately and calmly use his magic. With the man’s current state, he couldn’t possibly hope to do any of that. As for the mana scattered aimlessly, that was just the result of the Oni horn sucking it in.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 5. It can be triggered by the user or from outside stimulation.''The magic stone gave a slight amount of mana, and a spark was produced right near the man’s face. ──The next instant, the technique arranged there reacted with the fire and it exploded with the man’s face getting caught in it.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 5. His technique is dangerous to use in enclosed spaces, and he has to make sure not to make the explosions too big in such scenarios.''Therefore, the technique wouldn’t detonate at unset spaces, and he was limited to using extremely minor firepower so that he wouldn’t blast himself away.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 5. Likewise, if one can sense the disturbance in mana or the accompanying scent of the Witch prior to the detonation, one can avoid the worst of the damage.''He clicked his tongue, and right after that, there was the stink that would brush against her nasal cavity. Rem twisted her body at once, and she avoided coming in contact with the space where the stink gathered. However, she couldn’t escape from the produced blast.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 5. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Cult Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Apprentices]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 2]] (side story) |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Nobuo Tobita|Tobita Nobuo]]}} '''Dartz''' (ダーツ) is a constructor in [[Priestella]]. ==Appearance== Dartz is an adult man with a mustache. His long hair is covered by an iron skin-tight helmet. His left eye is for some reason covered by a mechanical binocular eye. He wears a black shirt underneath his coat. ==Personality== Dartz is a brave man who fought for Priestella following the orders of [[Otto Suwen]]. Otto and Dartz are business friends, as Otto is shown to have shared a drink with him in the past. In addition, Dartz was described to be a workaholic, who couldn't abandon a job half-done, going as far as to keep working during the [[Battle for Priestella]]. He is also claimed to be rather fond of alcohol. ==History== ===[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 2]]=== In the Watergate City of Priestella, the night that they arrived there, Otto extracted himself away from [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and the others to perform an errand, carrying a bag with the remnants of [[Roswaal L. Mathers]]'s Book of Wisdom. Though he initially thought to get rid of it, he decided against that and wanted to confirm its contents, leading him to visit the "Master Restorer" Dartz, who was famous for being able to repair items with his restoration magic, including, according to rumors, [[meteor]]s. After arriving at Dartz's shop, Otto presented the burnt book to him, and Dartz was able to immediately identify that it was an item surrounded by mystery. Otto asked if it was possible to restore it, and Dartz replied that with the item in this state, returning it to its original state would be a legendary feat. But, he said that he could do it. Dartz continued by asking what Otto intended to use it for. Otto replied by saying that after checking the contents of the book he would burn it completely it so that not even a fragment of it remained. Dartz agreed that he would take the book from Otto, to try and restore it. But before he did, Otto had brought him a present. As Dartz was renowned for his fondness of alcohol, Otto had brought him a bottle. They drank together, and the next morning he returned back to the Water Plumage Inn, completely drunk. ==Abilities== '''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): Dartz is capable of using magic. *'''Restoration Magic''' (復元魔法, ''Fukugen Mahō''): A type of magic that can recover objects to their original state. According to rumors, he has used it to fix numerous objects, including a meteor, and though he claimed it would be a legendary feat, he said he could restore even the burnt Book of Wisdom Otto brought him. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Priestella]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 39|Volume 39]] (main story) |Manga = [[Manga Arc 2 Chapter EX03|Arc 2 Chapter EX04]]}} '''Ezzo Cadner''' (エッゾ・カドナー) is a mage and a member of the [[Felt Camp]], officially serving as their strategist and as a teacher to [[Felt]]. He plays a supporting role in [[Arc 9]]. ==Appearance== Ezzo has short, dark green hair, red eyes, a short stature, and an intelligent countenance. Although many dwarves, including Ezzo himself, look childish, he is actually approaching the end of his twenties. ==Personality== Ezzo is a mage with plenty of pride in his craft, as he had mastered many forms of magic, becoming one of the highest-rated mages in the country. He has a logical and pragmatic nature, yet also a compassionate and charitable side to him, which he shows with his desire to act as a teacher to the disadvantaged. He abhors injustice and pursues retribution when he feels someone is wronged, whether it is himself or someone else. He is also rather scholarly when it comes to things that may be related to magic and prideful when it comes to techniques he has developed, showing them off while grinning and explaining their functions. His goal is to take the four titles of color from [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and [[Ferris]] respectively, as he believes they are indifferent to the development of magic. To that end, he has written a number of magic theories and attempted to construct techniques that will ease the difficulty of learning magic. He can also be prone to jumping to conclusions, initially believing that Roswaal was a fraud for possessing three titles of color. Ezzo does not like laziness or complacency. Although he will not judge others for living such a life, such as in the case of his siblings, he refuses to become lazy or complacent, choosing to put all of his hard work and effort into furthering his magic and refusing to settle. It is for this reason that, during the Arc 9 loop, upon witnessing Roswaal's use of magic for the first time, he burst into tears; having initially believed that his titles of color were given to him due to his lineage rather than actual effort, he was happy to see that the person who surpassed him had put in even more hard work than himself. Ezzo has shown to be a respectful person to others, as he acknowledged both [[Al]] and Subaru at the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] and spoke respectfully to both of them. He also showed respect towards the former’s [[Priscilla Barielle|master]], after hearing of her demise, and upon learning that he wished to read her Book of the Dead, he was fully ready to stop Al if he was hesitant about it, as reading said book would be an invasion of her privacy and contrary to her wishes. ==History== Ezzo was born as the youngest of ten siblings. Unlike his siblings, who were all born with Divine Protections due to dwarves being predisposed to being blessed with one at birth, Ezzo was not gifted one. At some point in his early life, when he discovered a book on magic covered in dust tucked within a box that a street vendor had, Ezzo decided to dedicate himself to magic. He was first seen between [[Arc 2]] and [[Arc 3]], attempting to steal Roswaal's titles for his own benefit by attempting to trap him into a [[meteor]] so that he could claim a defeat on the most powerful magician of the Kingdom and claim his titles. This failed horribly, as he had imprisoned [[Rem]] and [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] (dressed as Roswaal), instead of [[Ram]] and Roswaal as he originally intended. He later gained an opportunity to trap Roswaal within the meteor once Subaru and Rem escaped, but he managed to escape from it quickly, proving his merit as a magician. Ezzo then accepted a duel with Rem as a means to compare his strength as a magic user, but was easily defeated by a single punch to his face. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 1|Riot in Flanders]]=== Around a month after the events of the Royal Selection Ceremony, Ezzo was in [[Flanders]]. He was taken advantage of by [[Camberley]], who left him penniless, causing him to take up a position as a bodyguard for the Flower Prison Garden. He began tutoring the organization's prostitutes to help them learn reading, writing, and arithmetic skills out of a compassionate desire to aid them. Ezzo had another run-in with Camberley several days later, attacking him on the spot, only to be stopped by [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]], who was accompanying [[Felt]] on a courtesy visit to each of the three organizations that made up Flanders' Big Three. He attended the knight and candidate duo's meeting with [[Toto]], the Flower Prison Garden's proprietress, getting to know them before and during their discussion with her. On one night a few days later, a lackey of a [[Mozolite|high-ranking member]] of the Balance fatally wounded one of Ezzo's students, [[Mimosa]], and killed the customer connected to the Black Silver Coin that she had been with. He cast healing magic on her to ease her pain before her inevitable death, but he was promptly attacked by the murderer. The magic he attempted to cast had no effect on the man due to his having the same Excess Mana Circulation Constitution as Reinhard. The man set fire to the brothel and Ezzo was left as the suspected culprit. He escaped the red-light district with Camberley's help and confronted [[Helaine Gatness]], exchanging the unpublished magic theories he had created in exchange for an abandoned mansion to use as a safe house. Felt, Reinhard, [[Flam Remendis]], and [[Rachins Hoffman]] acquired the information of Ezzo's location from Helaine and met him at the mansion, where he engaged in a clash with Reinhard. Though ultimately ending in his failure, he successfully bypassed Reinhard's Excess Mana Circulation Constitution by rewriting the composition of a magic spell mid-casting. Ezzo proceeded to inform them of the truth of the fire at the brothel and requested their help in his pursuit of revenge for Mimosa's death. When they were surrounded at the mansion, he made a mask and wove a Cognitive Disruption spell within it so Reinhard could fend off their attackers while acting as the “Masked Knight Veltol” rather than the Sword Saint. He made use of another mask with the same technique when he and Flam accompanied Rachins to his face-off with Helaine. When given the chance, he successfully defeated the arson who framed him by using the same method he used to land magic on Reinhard and took revenge for Mimosa, leaving the man's fate to [[Manfred Madison]]. In the end, Ezzo rejected Manfred's offer to join the Balance and instead decided to join the [[Felt Camp]], going back to Flanders in his free time twice a month to continue his tutorship hobby. ===[[Those Remaining in the Watergate City, Priestella Reconstruction Journal|Priestella Reconstruction Journal]]=== In the aftermath of the [[Battle for Priestella]], he took part in an investigation alongside [[Garfiel Tinzel]], [[Liliana Masquerade]], and [[Ricardo Welkin]] in the catacombs beneath [[Priestella]] to search for the remains of a [[Typhon|Witch]], as it had been previously targeted and needed to be placed in a safe location. After several tribulations and overcoming the Witch’s trial, they successfully managed to retrieve the withered arm and brought it back above ground. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record|Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record]]=== Shortly after the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], Ezzo took part in a follow-up expedition alongside Felt, Reinhard, Flam and [[Grassis Remendis]], [[Meili Portroute]], and the little scorpion [[Shaula]]. There, they investigated the Taygeta library and met the senile Divine Dragon [[Volcanica]]. They’d also noticed the same birds that had been flying around the tower. After Shaula killed one with her stinger, Ezzo discovered the birds’ nature and ordered for them to all be killed, which he and Reinhard got to immediately. Deciding to report what they found, Felt took most of the group back to the [[Royal Capital]] while Ezzo remained behind with Flam. ==Abilities== '''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): Ezzo is able to use all six magic affinities. He is a talented magic user who regards himself as the second-best mage in the Kingdom behind Roswaal L. Mathers. He does not need to utilize incantations and is skilled enough to disguise the chant of one spell as another spell. Ezzo can cast several high-level magic spells in quick succession or at the same time, and he can rearrange the magic composition of a spell while casting it, though doing the latter results in him receiving multiple lacerations. His control of magic is also quite impressive, displaying the ability to summon and manipulate numerous balls of water at once and either attack with them or use them all to support his allies simultaneously. His ingenuity with magic is such that he is able to quickly understand numerous theories and techniques regarding magic as well as repurpose said theories and techniques in order to refine them. Likewise, he is able to integrate new techniques for his own casting of magic, as he did after studying the theories and techniques crafted by [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] and explained to him by Roswaal L. Mathers. When working together with the latter Roswaal, the two are even capable of coming up with other new methods to cast magic, and they are quickly capable of learning how to cast the strongest magic known to man. *'''Multiplefold Magic''': Like Roswaal, Ezzo is capable of casting multiple spells at the same time, albeit not at the same level as Roswaal individually. **'''Al Sextet''' (アル・セクステット, ''Aru Sekusutetto''): By combining his magic with Roswaal's, they cast six Al level spells simultaneously, creating an aurora pillar with enough power to rewrite the laws of heaven and earth. A target caught within can have its own strength used as fuel for the magic and increase its density. It has enough power to shatter Volcanica's dragon halo. It is considered to be a miracle of magic that even [[Echidna]] and [[Myonmyon]] were unable to use. Due to the Arc 9 loop having been undone, however, he has yet to achieve this. *'''Ul Goa''' (ウル・ゴーア): Ezzo fires a large number of powerful fire bullets. A powerful flame scatters when the bullets land. *'''El Shiha''' (エル・シーハ): Ezzo gathers water from the atmosphere to bind a target in place. *'''Cognitive Disruption''' (認識阻害, ''Ninshiki Sogai''): A spell effect that can be woven into objects, such as cloaks or masks. It inhibits people from being able to recognize the person wearing the object that the spell is enchanted into. *'''Magic Composition Rewriting''': Ezzo can rewrite a spell's composition. By changing the composition of a spell mid-casting, it is possible for Ezzo to disassemble a spell into mana, absorbing it through his own gate. Furthermore, by utilizing this magic technique, he was even able to circumvent the effects of Reinhard's [[Reinhard van Astrea#Abilities|Excess Mana Circulation Constitution]] and land a blow on the Sword Saint with magic. *'''Silencing Magic''': An application of Yang Magic that makes a person’s voice so high that it cannot be picked up by the ear. '''Excellent Intuition''': Ezzo is very experienced, to the point that he can determine a person’s relative power level shortly after meeting them. He was even able to somewhat determine the ability of Al’s Authority as something separate from magic after a short confrontation with him. Likewise, he can quickly analyze a person's abilities mere moments after witnessing them for himself, and he can act with appropriate measures to assist them with minimal effort. '''Equipment''': *'''[[Terminology#Equipment|White Fox's Nest]]''' (白狐の巣):[[File:Meteor - White Fox's Nest.jpg|thumb|200x200px]] A meteor which captures people and makes them do trials based on the owner's magical experience and mana. The targets cannot escape unless the trial is finished or once the user considers that the subjects failed the trials and allow them to escape, the targets of the meteor cannot die within the trials. Once the trials start, more subjects cannot be imprisoned until the trials inside it are over either due to failure or success. He has used this meteor to imprison both Rem and Subaru at the same time in the past. When activated, the person using the meteor cannot use any magic or they will be released from the trial. ==Trivia== *Ezzo underwent a major redesign in [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10|Tanpenshuu Volume 10]], having his hair changed from grey-brown to green and being given a completely new uniform. *Thus far, Ezzo has read 12 Books of the Dead, and despite being aware of the danger in reading them, he is of the mindset of "stopping" when he hits a certain number of books, and that specified number is liable to increase.April 5, 2026 Talk Show. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Royal Selection Navbox}} [[Category:Felt Camp]] [[Category:Mages]] [[Category:Teachers]] [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Demi-Human]]

She later joined the [[Felt Camp]] along with her sister. She plays a supporting role in [[Arc 9]]. ==Appearance== Like her sister, she is a short girl and has peach hair with yellow ribbons in her hair. She wears white and pink clothes. Unlike her sister Grassis, her fringe is lateral. ==Personality== Though she is a maid, according to [[Ezzo Cadner]], she is not afraid to speak of things she does not want to do. She also has a rather sharp mouth, as she often interrupted or made fun of Ezzo while he was speaking. Apparently, her attitude reminds [[Natsuki Subaru]] of [[Ram]]. Flam is still kind, nevertheless: for instance, she did not hesitate to join a group hug for Subaru despite only being acquaintances. She and her sister are also mischievous, habitually teasing others. In times of emergency, Flam can become vicious, using whatever means she has to in order to bring down her enemies. Likewise, if she is put in a position where she must use her [[Divine Protection]] but is unable to relax and sleep to be able to use it again, she will not hesitate to strangle herself to force herself to sleep. She and her sister also hold grudges towards those who wrong the members of [[House Astrea]], particularly when it comes to [[Heinkel Astrea]], and they will show no qualms in delivering ruthless beatings towards their enemies. ==History== Born to one of Carol and Grimm's children, servants of House Astrea, she and her sister Grassis have been trained by the family they've served since birth. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record|Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record]]=== A short time after the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], members of the Felt Camp, which included Flam and Grassis, were tasked with reaching the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] and investigating it. During their travels through the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] attacked them to protect the tower, leaving [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] to defend the party. Fortunately, [[Meili Portroute]], who was protecting the party from [[witchbeast]]s as they made their way toward the tower, presented Volcanica’s talon, and they were allowed passage into the tower. There, they came across the Books of the Dead, which Meili explained to them, much to the fascination of Ezzo. Understanding their importance, [[Felt]] suggested Reinhard find the book of his [[Theresia van Astrea|grandmother]], and though he was hesitant to do so, when Felt persuaded him to find it at some point, he was grateful. Shortly after, they noticed the same birds that Subaru and [[Eridna]] had witnessed before. With one captured for study, Ezzo quickly discovered its true nature, and the [[Shaula|crimson scorpion]] being carried by Meili killed it in his hands. Realizing the birds were being used to spy, Ezzo and Reinhard set to killing them all. Deciding to return to the capital, they left Ezzo and Flam at the tower. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護 ''Kago''): Flam and her sister both have the '''Divine Protection of Mindspeak''' (念話の加護 ''Nenhanashi no Kago''), which allows them to speak to each other through their mind. The distance between them does not matter, but it can only be used once a day. According to [[Petra Leyte|Petra]]'s observations, the once-a-day condition seems to be connected to the amount of time that she sleeps rather than a full 24-hour time period. '''Flow Method''' (流法): Despite being young, Flam is an expert in using the Flow Method. By enhancing her strength with it, a strike from her hand is easily enough to pierce through the body of a grown man, bringing about near-instant death, and her recuperation speed is increased. She is shown to be powerful enough to beat the three thugs, [[Gaston]], [[Rachins]] and [[Camberley]], with ease. Flam is also mentioned to be stronger than Felt, [[Rom]], and the other Felt Camp members except Ezzo Cadner and Reinhard van Astrea. '''Stealth''': Flam is able to hide her presence excellently. While within the Pleiades Watchtower, while everyone was distracted by the events taking place, she managed to successfully sneak up on [[Al]] and kill him in several loops. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Royal Selection Navbox}} [[Category:Felt Camp]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Maids]] [[Category:House Remendis]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]]

'''Edda Rayfast''' (エッダ・レイファスト) was a representative of a lumber manufacturer who managed a watermill along the Tenrill River. She was killed and had her body taken over by a parasite, becoming a [[Undead#Parasite-Based Zombies|zombie]] in the process.

==Appearance==
Edda was quite tall, quite plump and had dark skin with stout limbs. She wore a fur coat and heavy make-up that looks like war paint. However, aftering being infected by parasites that turn people into undead, Edda's body concealed a mass of cadavers controlled by the parasites. 

==Personality==
Edda was described as being a tough woman who acted very masculine. 

==History==
Edda was taken over by the parasites that turned people into zombies and became the host to their queen. She tried to pass the infestation to [[Priscilla Barielle]] by making her drink some contaminated liquor, but was ultimately unsuccessful. Edda was soon after defeated by [[Al]] and incinerated by Priscilla.

While not playing an active role in the main story, Drizen made an appearance in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. He burned to ash when the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]] no longer recognized him as someone fit to rule the Empire. His death caused the Imperial Selection Ceremony to begin. ==Appearance== Drizen was an old man with white hair, crimson eyes, skin that had an unhealthy white pallor to it, and a skinny figure that typified his old age. However, despite his old age, his eyes were still chock-full of ambition. ==Personality== It was claimed that Drizen unthinkably believed the unwritten rule that the strong were absolutely right, something that had led to internal corruption within Vollachia.''By purging those who had become a mere shell of their former selves and enjoyed high status because of history alone, the way of the Vollachian Empire, which flew the national flag of a “wolf pierced by swords”, was enforced inside and outside its borders without exception. The way of doing things that had lasted till the previous Emperor, who had unthinkingly believed the unwritten rule that the strong were absolutely right and had let the Empire fall to ruin internally, was completely disavowed and the initial principle that the strong were to be respected was scrubbed out.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. ==History== In his youth, Drizen participated in the Imperial Selection Ceremony of his generation and began fighting and warring with his family. Eventually, Drizen was victorious and won the Selection. When he was older, he had 67 children—including [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]] and [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent Abellux]]—then left all of them around the country. At some point in time, he bestowed [[Arakiya]] to his daughter, Prisca, as a gift for unknown reasons.''Therefore, the girl who had become the sole instance of completion, as an existence with invaluable abilities, was presented to the Emperor of the time, Drizen Vollachia, and Drizen had bestowed her as a foster sister to one of the daughters that had inherited his own blood. It was unknown what impression the Emperor Drizen Vollachia had harbored for the girl that had been presented to him, or for what reason he had bestowed her to his own daughter.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 101, Section 1. On his deathbed, he gathered all of his surviving children together and commenced the next Imperial Selection Ceremony by allowing the Yang Sword to incinerate him. ==Abilities== '''Equipment''': *'''[[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]]''' (陽剣ヴォラキア, ''Youken Vorakia''): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Drizen was capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. The sword appears out of thin air when the user wishes to use it and it cuts and burns whatever the user desires. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Family]] [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Imperial Selection Candidates]] [[Category:Enchanted Sword Users]] [[Category:Deceased]]

Her skin is blue with a white underside. She has a crest with yellow edges. ==Personality== Frufoo has a sarcastic and straightforward attitude. She is docile towards humans, especially Otto, whom she, despite often questioning and scolding, cares for and obeys. ==History== Frufoo was raised in the Suwen household, located in Otto's hometown, [[Picoutatte]]. She has known Otto since he was a child, and the two used to have conversations via Otto's Divine Protection. When Otto was banished from Picoutatte, he took Frufoo with him. They have been traveling together since. ===[[Otto's Peddling Record of Joy and Sorrow]]=== At one point, having made a successful business venture in the town of Guineb, as he and Frufoo prepared to leave, he was invited by the town's mayor, [[Colin Lavril]], to his residence. There, he was asked how he crossed the mountains, to which Otto refused to discuss his secret. Colin then introduced Otto to his son, [[Minor Characters#Aheem Lavril|Aheem]], and stated that his fiancée, [[Marone Lisbon]], had been kidnapped, and because of that, he wanted to know how to cross the mountains. Though Otto still refused to give up his secrets, he proposed to relay a rescue service for the girl. Afterward, he was guided by his son, but along the way, Aheem led Otto into a trap, which resulted in Otto being imprisoned by slave traders. In a cell, he met a girl who called him Number Two and introduced herself as Marone. According to her, Aheem was not her fiancée. He had deceived her and given her to the slave traders. After a while, some of the slave traders appeared, and when he asked where Frufoo was, they claimed that she worked for them. At some point after this while still in the cell, he told Marone that he had the "Divine Protection of Guidance" and made an agreement with her. Afterward, when they were put on his dragon carriage, he was told to reveal his path through the mountains. The deal with Aheem was that he would provide the traders women in exchange for leaving Guineb alone. With Frufoo taking the carriage, Otto directed the traders where there was a supposed path that they could use. Then, after calling out to Marone as part of their agreement, they held on tight as Frufoo was signaled to crash the carriage. Otto and Marone had their injuries treated in a hospital in a nearby town, where he revealed that Guineb's mayor and son were likely to be investigated for the incident and Aheem likely arrested. Upon asking if she would return to Guineb, Marone refused. When Marone asked for his name, he said she could keep calling him Number Two, and he gave her his own savings, enough for her to start a new life anywhere she wanted, lying to her by saying it was a reward for taking down the slave traders. Then, Otto took off, Frufoo scolding him for lying but believing it was fine, and she looked forward to seeing his dream come true. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護 ''Kago''): Frufoo has the '''Divine Protection of Wind Evasion''' (風避けの加護 ''Kazeyoke no Kago''), which enables her to be unaffected by the wind and not encounter any wind resistance while running. The effect also applies to a dragon carriage that she pulls. After activation, there is a cooldown before she can use it again. '''Endurance''': Frufoo is physically strong and has high stamina. According to Otto, she is able to run for three days without having to rest. ==Trivia== *Frufoo's birthday is September 6, a play on the word hardship in Japanese. The birthday is on 9/6 in numerical form, and nine (九) and six (六) can be pronounced as "ku" and "ro", the same as hardship (苦労). The author chose this date for Frufoo because she is a hard worker. **When combined, the references in Frufoo and Otto's birthdays form a single phrase that can be translated as "take hardship to heart" (苦労が身に染みる). ==References== ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Emilia Camp]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]]

He threw away his family and his life, becoming an eccentric man who chose to believe in non-existent things and ideals. Becoming a destroyer of order, he assassinated numerous people with positions of power. He eventually joined the ranks of the Witch Cult. However, his Leaper technique was regarded as a heresy within a heresy, and he was cast out from even the cult itself. Sometime after that, the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Lye Batenkaitos, defeated him and ate his name and memories, effectively putting Dorkell in suspended animation. ==Abilities== *'''Leaper''' (跳躍者): This technique allows Dorkell to use a short-range teleportation in quick succession, essentially allowing him to "leap" behind his opponents or avoid extremely precise and quick attacks. wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Relationships |tab3 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Flop O'Connell |Image = Flop O'Connell LN character design (finished, png).png |Caption = |Kanji = フロップ・オコーネル |Romaji = Furoppu Okōneru |Alias = Flora (フローラ, ''Furōra'') |Nickname = Fuu (フー) (by [[Utakata Shudrak|Utakata]]) |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Age = 22 |Hair Color = Cream Blonde |Eye Color = Sky Blue |Height = 175 cm (5'9")[https://rezero.fandom.com/wiki/Flop_O%27Connell/Image_Gallery?file=Flop_O%27Connell_LN_character_design_png.png Flop character design sketch] |Birthday = April 10[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1910576367269535989 Author's 2025 Flop and Medium Birthday Commemoration] |Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]] |Occupation = Merchant |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Medium O'Connell]] (younger sister)
[[Taritta Shudrak]] (wife)
[[Vincent Vollachia]] (brother-in-law)
[[Mizelda Shudrak]] (sister-in-law) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 27|Volume 27]]}} '''Flop O'Connell''' (フロップ・オコーネル) is a merchant and the older brother of [[Medium O'Connell]]. He played a supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. Originally an orphan with his sister, the two found themselves being raised in the Dracroy Domain with [[Balleroy Temeglyph]]. Eventually, wishing to take revenge on the world by spreading kindness and overwhelming the evil spread throughout, he took his sister and became a traveling merchant, helping many who he crossed paths with, contrary to the beliefs held within the [[Vollachia Empire]]. ==Appearance== Flop has long bangs and long cream blonde hair, which is the same color as his sister. His eyes are a sky blue, which complement his pale skin rather well. He is also described as shorter than his sister Medium. Compared to her, Flop is also not physically strong. ==Personality== Flop is a kind-hearted man who dislikes violence and is friendly to everyone he meets. Flop is extremely helpful to almost everyone he meets, as shown when he helps [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], [[Rem]], and [[Spica]] into the city of [[Guaral]], and he even helps them sell off the horn of the Elgina so that Subaru can fund his trip back home. He is also shown to be very caring for people, as shown when he rushes to the aid of a man who was thrown through a window and when he tries to stop Subaru from giving away all his money to [[Rowan Segmunt|Rowan]]. He was also willing to sacrifice himself to save Subaru from [[Todd Fang]] when he was about to kill him, and he later did the same for Rem to protect her from [[Madelyn Eschart]]. Likewise, even after only having known him for less than an hour, he was quick to trust Subaru when he suddenly yelled at an unseen enemy and was willing to listen to him and help him escape from the town. His kind-hearted and naive thinking, however, can get in the way of negotiations when dealing with people of opposing thought processes, such as [[Vincent Vollachia]], which can lead to a standstill. This being said, it is because of his honest and straightforward personality that people can trust him. In fact, it is partially for this reason that the man posing as the false emperor, [[Chisha Gold]], entrusted him with a message to Vincent for the instance he was able to return to his side. He is also a quick thinker and risk taker; despite having taken a severe injury and was on the verge of both losing his consciousness and even dying, he was able to convince Rem to use his injury and her ability to heal him as a bargaining chip against Madelyn, who wanted answers from him after she saw [[Carillon]]'s baby teeth, in order to get her to stop attacking Guaral during the [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm]]. Likewise, he was even willing to have his healing slowed so that he could use his position to both protect Rem and himself as well as gather information. He is also quite perceptive and apparently fearless. After meeting the false emperor, he quickly saw through him, and he showed no fear at all while speaking to him, despite the man essentially holding his life in his hands. Due to the way he was raised with his sister in an abusive orphanage, despite being given the chance to get payback on the man responsible for his and his sister's suffering, although he did not stop Medium or the other children from giving the man what he deserved, he chose not to do so. Instead, he vowed to get revenge on the world. However, because he believed that violence wouldn't solve anything, his version of revenge against the world is to spread kindness to everyone he comes across, something he believed would slowly but steadily affect the world, and with that goal in mind, he decided to become a traveling merchant. Thanks to this, many people owe him favors, and his influence has left a positive impact on those he has come across. Despite his overall positive stance and attitude, he is also rather ambitious. A part of the reason he joined the [[Imperial Civil War]] on Vincent's side, while indeed intent to help his new friends, was also because he knew he could take advantage of his position to gain greater influence and further his dream. Later on, though he still kept her best interests in mind while making the offer, he was even shown willing to offer up his sister for marriage to Vincent while negotiating. In the same conversation, he also admitted to the emperor's face that he had considered that, if he didn't believe Vincent was worthy of it, he was even willing to remove Vincent from the throne and have Subaru take his place,''"If that happened, I would’ve brought the message to Husband-kun instead of Your Excellency the Emperor-kun, saved the Empire, and then have him become Emperor."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 25, Section 3. though he ultimately decided against it due to the best interests of everyone involved and the fact that he approved of Vincent. ==History== When he was young, he and his sister Medium grew up in an orphanage in a small town called Averyk, where they were routinely beaten by adults. One day, an imperial soldier named [[Miles]] arrived at the orphanage and promptly beat and tied up the adults in charge of the orphanage. As Flop watched as the other children, his sister included, started beating the adults for all the years of their abuse, Flop realized that this cycle of violence is what leads children and adults alike into reprehensible situations like theirs. Combined with the unjust treatment he’d also received, Flop resolved to get vengeance on by replacing violence and cruelty with kindness. Soon after, he and Medium were brought to the Dracroy Domain, where [[Serena Dracroy]] resided. Understanding their circumstances, she became an older sister figure to the two of them and allowed them to reside in her domain. A few years after this, they met Balleroy Temeglyph, and they helped him raise the newborn Carillon. At some point, when Carillon lost some of his baby teeth, they were made into a necklace that he started to wear. Some years after this, he decided to set out from the Dracroy Domain to become a merchant to achieve his revenge, with his sister acting as his bodyguard. During his travels, however, he heard of the demise of Balleroy, Carillon, and Miles, each of which saddened him and his sister. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 4|Undead Busters]]=== During her time as empress consort, Medium regularly practiced with the imperial soldiers, which Flop praised her for. However, as she anxious about how to be a good wife to Vincent, she sought out marital advice. Soon after she received her advice, Flop and Medium's group met with [[Cecilus Segmunt]]'s party as they returned to [[Garkla]], intending to speak with Vincent about how to handle [[Volcas]]. ==Trivia== *Flop's birthday, April 10, is the same day as Medium's birthday, but they are two years apart in age. **Although Flop's age was never stated directly in the story, it can be determined that he is 22 years old by Medium's declaration of her own age in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 29|Volume 29]].''“Me? I’m what, twenty?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 29]], Chapter 2, Section 2. *Flop has his own named chapter in Arc 7 in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 7: The Land of Wolves|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30|light novels]]. *According to the author, Flop would write letter to the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunican]] cast in the future.July 26, 2026 Talk Show ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Merchants]]

House Peitiet |Previous Occupation = High Count |Status = Deceased |Weapon = Halberd |Light Novel = [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy ZERO Vincent]] (side story)
[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|Volume 37]] (main story)}} '''Gaoran Peitiet''' (ガオラン・ペイシット) was a High Count of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He was killed by [[Rowan Segmunt]] after attempting to start a rebellion and failing. In [[Arc 8]], Gaoran briefly appeared as a resurrected [[Undead#Zombies|zombie]] in the midst of the [[Great Disaster]]. He was eaten by [[Spica]] with [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s aid. ==Appearance== Gaoran was described as a relatively old man with a large frame. As a zombie, he possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across her body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. ==Personality== Gaoran was a somewhat naive and reckless Count, who was willing to send his entire army and his famed flying dragon, Feyron, into death, simply to have an opportunity to kill the emperor. Furthermore, Gaoran seemingly wasn't that good of a tactician, as he marched straight towards the Crystal Palace, betting everyone's lives on a surprise attack, which obviously failed. ==History== A couple of months following the seventy-seventh emperor Vincent Vollachia's coronation, Gaoran sprung various insurgencies across the nation's larger cities, prompting Vincent to disperse the Nine Divine Generals away from the Crystal Palace which weakened its defences. Gaoran then gathered his troops and attacked the Crystal Palace head-on, betting it all on a surprise attack. His forces were quickly surrounded and taken out one by one by the defending armies led by Third-Class General [[Zikr Osman]], while Gaoran was circling the battlefield on his flying dragon, Feyron. After his dragon was shot down and killed, Gaoran encountered Vincent and blindly sprung towards him. Just as he was about to pierce the emperor's chest, however, a slash from Rowan Segmunt deflected his halberd's end and another slash cut him down diagonally across his body, ending the High Count's life almost in an instant. Following his death, Vincent ordered every one of Gaoran's captured troops to be executed on the spot, in order to demonstrate a point. ==Abilities== '''Halberd''': Gaoran has been stated to be considerably skilled in wielding his halberd, though he was no match for Rowan Segmunt's two rapid sword slashes. ==Trivia== *Gaoran owned a flying dragon named [[Minor Characters#Feyron|Feyron]]. Due to its snow-white scales and eyes, Feyron was considered to be one of the most beautiful flying dragons in the Empire, further elevating Gaoran's special status. Sometimes, he even put Feyron on display for all others to marvel at its beauty. However, Feyron was killed during the siege of the Crystal Palace, a few short months following Vincent's coronation and the subjugation of the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]'s rebellion. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

She wears a red-violet and magenta dress with decorative yellow stripes and a bright blue bow just under her neck. ==Personality== Due to hailing from a wealthy family, Diadora is selfish, arrogant, and naive. In spite of this, she has an insecure and vulnerable side. When she was once rejected by [[Oslo Suwen]], Diadora attempted to mend the pain in her heart by surrounding herself with a multitude of men who adored her. However, when [[Otto Suwen|Otto]]—Oslo's younger brother—exposed Diadora's affairs in public, she was quick to respond with anger and put out an assassination order to take his life out of embarrassment. {{Clear}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Picoutatte]]

title: Earth Spider
wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Earth Spider |Image = Tsuchigumo.jpg |Kanji = 土蜘蛛 |Romaji = Tsuchigumo |Race = Spirit |Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]
Suwen Treatment Center |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 5|Tanpenshuu Volume 5]]}} The '''Earth Spider''' (土蜘蛛) is a [[Spirit|spirit]]. It currently resides in the city of Pappelt, under the care of [[Regin Suwen]] and [[Marone Lisbon]]. ==Appearance== The spirit's original appearance is unknown. Starting from an unspecified time in the past, the spirit began gathering various living beings and mixing them into a single mass, which became the spirit's provisional body. This mass was covered in skin of different colors: one part red, one part black, and one part white. Its surface exhibited fibers similar to fur, along with several eyes and mouths scattered unevenly on it. It also had around twenty limbs, plus tentacles, which is why it was named the Earth Spider. The size of its body increased with each new creature that the spirit incorporated into the mass. The first reported sighting of the Earth Spider indicated that it was nearly the size of a child at the time, whereas three months later, at the time of its last sighting, it was more akin to the size of a hill. After being adopted by Regin and Marone, the Earth Spider freed all the creatures mixed into its provisional body and took the form of a small spider, which it currently maintains. ==Personality== The Earth Spider was born as an emotionless spirit, with barely any conscience. It started developing interests of its own when it first witnessed the anguish of dying creatures. After fusing with one of those creatures and vicariously experiencing the fear of death, which was the first emotion the spirit ever felt, the shock drove it to develop an obsession with saving every being from death. Thus, the Earth Spider began to absorb other creatures while searching for a method to save them. When Regin, [[Otto Suwen|Otto]], [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]], and Marone first tried to reason with it and tell the spirit that its goal was impossible, the Earth Spider refused to accept the truth. However, in the end, thanks to Regin and Marone's words, it abandoned its fixation on death and accepted the two as its mentors. ==Trivia== *In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] version of Arc 5, Earth Spiders were said to be a kind of [[Witchbeast|witchbeast]] that were mass-produced in a certain village. This was changed so that there was only a single Earth Spider, and it was made into a spirit instead of a witchbeast. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|Ex Volume 5]] (actual)}} '''Ghajit''' (ガジート) was a gladiator at the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. He sought to escape the island by participating in [[Ubilk]]'s [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|rebellion]] and later assisting in quelling it, but he was ultimately unsuccessful, having been killed by [[Al]]. ==Appearance== Ghajit was a man with a distinct hairstyle that was shaved on the left side of his head and long on the right side. In addition, he wore a black outfit. ==Personality== Ghajit desired to escape the Gladiator Island through any means necessary, though this made him prone to being influenced by others. He was willing to feign acting nice to [[Priscilla Barielle|Priscilla]], yet he was not above pointing his blade at her. Once he realized that he was played by Ubilk and used as a pawn in a greater scheme, Ghajit grew increasingly panicked and violent. Throughout the island's uprising, Ghajit acted as an arbiter of sorts between the captives and his fellow rebelling gladiators, but he lacked the courage to act as a leader when Ubilk was present. He was also acquainted with Al and thought of him as an idiot for failing to join [[Hornet]]'s side. By the time he and Al dueled, Ghajit accepted that everyone at Ginunhive, including him, would be gladiators until they died. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Ghajit was among the many gladiators who were cajoled by Ubilk to participate in an uprising at the Gladiator Island. When the insurrection began, Ghajit was in the group who searched for [[Serena Dracroy]] amidst the spectators. He and his comrades took Priscilla Pendleton—who claimed to be Serena—and her husband, [[Jorah Pendleton|Jorah]], to the murdered island owner's room, where Ubilk was waiting for them. Priscilla relayed that the mutiny was futile because the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] would be dispatched to swiftly end it, instilling doubt in Ghajit and causing him to question Ubilk about the claim's truth. A short time afterwards, Priscilla convinced Ghajit and the gladiators alongside him to turn against the other revolting gladiators. Both he and [[Balleroy Temeglyph|Balleroy]] came to rescue her when she was confined. He began to panic upon realizing that he was used as a pawn by Ubilk, and when Priscilla said that he was easy to manipulate, he pointed his saber at her neck until [[Miles]] arrived and subdued him with a chunk of debris, putting him out of commission for the rest of the coup. After the mutiny ended, Al fought Ghajit in a match and skewered him with an attack to the stomach, ending his life.''Just as what he did to the imposter, Al had killed Ghajit by skewering him in the stomach.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[Sunlight Illuminating the Water's Surface]], Section 5. ==Abilities== '''Equipment''': Ghajit wielded a saber that he was well-acquainted with using. It was his weapon of choice during deathmatches and the Ginunhive uprising. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Ginunhive]] [[Category:Gladiators]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

[[Enchanted Sword#Fiend Sword Murasame|Fiend Sword Murasame]] (temporarily) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36|Volume 36]]}} '''Eugard Vollachia''' (ユーガルド・ヴォラキア) was the sixty-first emperor of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] and the former lover of [[Yorna Mishigure|Iris]]. He played both an antagonistic and supportive role in [[Arc 8]], and he is one of the main characters of the [[Re:Zero EX#Iris and the King of Thorns|Iris and the King of Thorns]] EX chapter. Eugard was an emperor from 300 years before the main story who one day ruled with the village girl [[Yorna Mishigure|Iris]] by his side. However, after a “betrayal”, Iris was killed. In his grief, he cast the [[Curse#Soul Marriage Curse|Soul Marriage Curse]] on Iris's soul, making it so that she would reincarnate with her memories over and over. Their story was later immortalized as the famed Vollachian story, Iris and the King of Thorns. During the [[Great Disaster]], he was revived as a [[Undead#Zombie|zombie]] under [[Sphinx]]'s influence. However, after being freed from the influence, assisting in ending the Great Disaster, and reuniting with Iris, he requested the end of his centuries old command for the mole and wolf people's deaths, and he returned to death in peace. ==Appearance== Eugard was a short and thin man who had dark green hair that was nearly black and almost reached his shoulders, blue eyes, and a handsome face. He had a vague resemblance to [[Vincent Vollachia]]. As a zombie, he possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across his body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. He returned to his original form upon being slashed by the Fiend Sword. He has been shown to wear royal garments that were red and charcoal grey, as well as a red cloak with charcoal grey shoulders. He wore a thorny crown around his head, and he carried with him a scepter, of which the top bore resemblance to a flower, with a red "bud", four black "petals", and black thorns that wrapped around the upper handle. He also wore a sash with the symbol of the Sword Wolf on it. ==Personality== Eugard is portrayed as having a cold, emotionless personality, stated to be split half-and-half between his natural personality and how it was shaped by his solitude due to his curse.''Even his family and servants did not approach him, and living by himself in the mansion which had been bestowed to him, Eugard spent his childhood without any opportunities to make contact with others; he thought that this was the reason why his expression was always so stiff, but it was fifty-fifty between that and his natural disposition being the reason.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 4. Despite being born with his curse, which forced him into solitude, he did not consider himself unhappy,''However, despite his circumstances, Eugard did not consider himself unhappy.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 6. and in fact, he was actually quite indifferent to his curse, comparing it to something similar to a birth defect, and thus, something that could not be helped.''Some people were born blind, some were crippled. He thought that his inability to live side-by-side with others was just one of those things.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 6. In fact, with the world the way it was, he even considered himself lucky to have survived in such a state.''And, in a world where people constantly lost their lives due to blindness or crippled limbs, he considered himself lucky to have survived thanks to his position as a member of the imperial family.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 6. Despite his portrayal as emotionless, Eugard was actually someone whose love spread to everyone around him, which was reflected in the indiscriminate effects on the people around him.''That was to say, the Curse of Thorns would not be activated unless directed at something one loved.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 7. He was not one to cast blame so simply, not even toward the nameless person both cursed him and ordered his curse.''He did not feel that he was cursed, and as there was a rational answer to the “why”, he did not resent the person who had done it.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 50, Section 1. He is also typically forgiving towards small discourtesies, such as a small lie or foul language, and does not take such issues seriously, simply referring to such issues as irreverent. It is said that amongst all of the emperors of Vollachia, he is the one who was least reserved about handing out compliments. Despite his demeanor and way of speaking, he often praises those he comes across, similar to the [[Halibel|Admirer]], though not to the same extent.''This was not a widely known fact, but among the Vollachian Emperors throughout history, Eugard Vollachia was the Emperor who spoke those words the most. Precisely because they stood not on the same base, precisely because he understood he had been granted a position that differed to that of others, Eugard was generous in his praise towards others.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. Even after his death, this was true. During his battle with [[Groovy Gumlet]], he complimented his strength as greater than the Nine Divine Generals of his time, and against Halibel, despite his hatred for the man's kind, he complimented him for his skill. He was also quite studious and harbored a sense of duty before he ever decided to partake in the Imperial Selection Ceremony, having gathered as much knowledge as he could so that he could serve both the imperial family and his country.''Until that age, Eugard would gather all the knowledge he could and serve the imperial family―― namely, for the improvement and peace of life of the people of the Empire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. Because of his natural state being that of one without much expression and as one who never had to exert his full might, due in part to his curse, Eugard had never felt much toward the concept of battle, merely swinging his sword because he had to due to his position or to protect himself or others, seeing swinging the blade as little more than an execution.''For Eugard, battles were not a contest of strength, but rather a situation in which he must perform the duty of executioner.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 50, Section 3. However, when he confronted Halibel during the Great Disaster, he, for the first time, felt a strong surge of emotion during battle,''Since his birth, since his death, this was the very first time he felt his spirits surge within himself while swinging his sword at another.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 50, Section 3. having for the first time produced a roar with all of his might as he refined his skills against Halibel, and the emotions and roar shocked him.''Realizing that he had involuntarily roared as he blew his opponent away, Eugard gained a slight shock.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 50, Section 3. Eugard's life was changed forever when he met Iris. Her presence had become one with which she had produced a tremendous change in his life. It was because of his love for her that Eugard had resolved himself to take part in the Imperial Selection Ceremony of his era, as he believed that without the throne, he could not live with Iris in his life.''Despite having understood that he ought to relinquish it, that he ought to give up on it, the reason Eugard had desired the imperial throne was because he understood that without it, he would not be able to keep the time he had with Iris for even a second longer.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. He respected her wishes, and he would often allow her certain privileges that others were not allowed, such as sneaking up behind him or looking at him with certain gazes. It was also a daily occurrence that Eugard would promptly ignore matters while in the presence of Iris, only paying her attention.''Though Iris/Yorna wholeheartedly apologized on behalf of Tanza, Eugard’s reply did not touch upon the core of the matter. This sort of thing had once been a daily occurrence with Eugard.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 63, Section 2. Eugard is intensely vengeful towards those who steal the lives of those he loves. Eugard personally killed the Nine Divine Generals of his time when they turned their fangs on Iris, and due to the conspiracy revolving around the death of Iris, Eugard held an immense hatred for the mole and wolf humans, and he personally killed the people responsible. His hatred was so intense that he became responsible for organizing their mass genocide and leaving the command for their demise active for the next three centuries. This hatred even affected how his Curse of Thorns worked on them: none of them were afflicted with it as the curse does not work on anyone he has no love for. However, after his battle with Halibel, where the Admirer became responsible for removing his curse from him, and his reuniting with Iris, who had been reincarnated as Yorna Mishigure, he was willing to ask the present-day emperor, Vincent, to revoke his command that sent the races into hiding. This being said, thanks to his battle with Halibel, Halibel's removal of Eugard's curse, and his reuniting with Iris during the Great Disaster, he was willing to forgive the wolf and mole humans, and he had even gone out of his way, at the end of his time as a zombie, to request from the emperor of the present day, Vincent, to rescind the order of the genocide of the two races.''"‘Tis because the time that remaineth for mineself is meager. Before that reacheth its terminus, I wish to discuss matters pertaining to the wishes of Mine Star with the child of mine own children."'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 3.''"――I wish to repeal it. To annul the decree of extinction put out by the Empire in regards to the wolfpeople and the molepeople."'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 3. ==History== {{Construction|Iris and the King of Thorns history to be added}} Born with congenital analgesia, which prevents him from feeling pain, '''Eugard Elcanti''' (ユーガルド・エルカンティ, ''Yūgarudo Erukanti''), the future Emperor of the Briar, was cursed with the Curse of Thorns as an infant by an unknown curse arts user who was either sent to curse the boy or did so of their own volition as a result of envy directed at the Elcanti family of Special High Counts as part of sabotage for the Imperial Selection Ceremony.''――Eugard Vollachia, the Emperor of the Briar, had received a curse as part of sabotage concerning the Imperial Selection Ceremony, a rite of succession for the imperial throne that had persisted for a long time within the Vollachia Empire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 4. Although his congenital analgesia prevented him from feeling the pain of the Curse of Thorns, the curse still affected those around him, forcing him to live a life of solitude while still experiencing a feeling of suffocation from the curse still eating into his body.''By birth, Eugard had “congenital analgesia”, the inability to feel pain. Therefore, the constantly active Curse of Thorns did not bestow pain upon Eugard himself, but instead only continued to grant pain to those around him; as a result, he was left completely alone.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 4.''The curse had forced Eugard into solitude, but it had not fulfilled its goal of tormenting his congenitally analgesic self. But, he had only been divorced from the pain, the curse still continued to eat into Eugard's body. In truth, though the young Eugard had not felt pain either, he had experienced a suffocating sensation due to the oppressive nature of the curse. That was an inconvenient obstacle for Eugard, whose time left to live had already been decided.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. At some point, his body accustomed itself to the thorns, giving it a symbiotic relationship with the Curse of Thorns.''But, at some point, the effects of the Curse of Thorns had stopped having any disturbance whatsoever on Eugard’s body, and Eugard became fully capable of taking action for the sake of fulfilling his own objectives. That was to say, Eugard’s body had grown to be able to deal with the danger that constantly threatened his life. ――The details of how the strongest Emperor in the history of the Empire had been born lay within that irony. Having optimized itself in order to simply live, Eugard’s body worked incredibly as a foundation for nurturing his mechanical diligence.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. He began training himself in the sword and, with his talent and a body that could utilize that talent, increased his strength to bewildering heights. Around 300 years before the present era, Eugard met a village girl named Iris, but had to part with her until he was betrayed and ousted from the throne. Thereafter, Iris began to shelter Eugard, supported his path to return to his position, and the two fell in love. However, when a betrayal from the mole human and wolf human races cost the life of his beloved, he descended into madness and abandoned the paradise he had once intended to build. In his madness, he chose to eradicate the races that betrayed him, and he brought his beloved back to life by casting a curse known as the Soul Marriage Curse on her, which forced Iris's soul to rise again while preventing it from ever returning to [[Od Lagna]], causing her to endlessly reincarnate. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Eugard's skill with the sword and strength was so great that, even if he lacked the Curse of Thorns, he would have been able to slay the Nine Divine Generals from his era regardless.''Since the Curse of Thorns had made Eugard stronger, this was a meaningless supposition, but his strength and ability with the sword were such that even if the Curse of Thorns had been absent, he still would have been able to wipe out the Nine Divine Generals of that era.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. Unable to have any guards because of his Curse of Thorns, he learned and mastered an assortment of sword techniques to defend himself with, and in time, Eugard was recognized as the Empire's strongest emperor.''――The Emperor of the Briar, Eugard Vollachia, was the strongest emperor in the history of the Empire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. According to Groovy Gumlet, Eugard is a master martial artist,''He, too, was a master martial artist, and he must have known that Groovy was approaching him with some means of resisting the Curse of Thorns.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 48. and his skill in combat improved during his fight with Halibel.''But, absorbing such enormous amounts of combat experience through this confrontation of which he was ignorant, as an undead, Eugard was allowed to grow into a being that greedily became stronger, to an extent much greater than he had been during his lifetime.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. ===[[Curse]]=== '''[[Curse#Curse of Thorns|Curse of Thorns]]''' (茨の呪い, ''Ibara no Noroi''): Eugard had the Curse of Thorns, a curse placed onto him by an unknown yet talented curse arts user that caused him to bind himself and the people around him with intangible thorns. He had the capability to bind people with sharp, ashen grey thorns that pierced the heart of their targets and had no tangible form, making them impossible to remove.''Grey thorns emerged just above the left side of his chest, and the moment his fingers, trying to pluck them, passed straight through, the sharp thorns pierced his heart, causing an intense pain that made Groovy’s fur stand on end. The sensation of having a sharp object thrust into the innermost parts of one’s body, especially a vital spot directly linked to life, was a pain so intense that even a seasoned warrior would not be able to help but writhe.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 5, Section 3.''Infuriatingly, the thorns had no tangible form. It made it impossible to shake them off.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 5, Section 3. The effect of the thorns were dependent on the target's Od.''For example, these thorns were clearly more dependent on the target’s Od than the caster’s, a perfect example.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 5, Section 3. So long as a target met the conditions, the thorns indiscriminately applied themselves to anyone within who entered a given distance centered around Eugard and more intensely harmed them the closer they got to him.''The Curse of Thorns was, by how it had looked, a powerful curse that indiscriminately engulfed a wide area centered on the caster.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1.''The closer one would get to the user, the stronger the curse of thorns would act. Most people would probably be incapacitated by the pain before they could ever reach the user.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 5, Section 3. The curse could not activate on a target unless the person with the curse loved them; because Eugard directed his love to everyone in his life, the curse afflicted everyone he came into contact with, until Iris's death led to wolf humans and mole humans being excluded from the curse's effects.''Thereupon, the Curse of Thorns was not present. Upon him, who ought to have been an abominable, detestable wolfman to Eugard, the curse was not being invoked.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 5. These rules also applied to Eugard.''――Just like Groovy, the Curse of Thorns had also been planted upon Eugard’s chest.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. As a result of Eugard's congenital analgesia, he felt no pain from the thorns and was able to become accustomed to them when his body optimized itself because of their presence, thus allowing him to increase his power. Originally, the range of his Curse of Thorns was only one hundred meters, but when he was separated from Iris, its range increased to hundreds of meters and started piercing through those he had attempted to speak to through a [[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|Conversation Mirror]].''Until now, Eugard's Curse of Thorns had impacted a range of around one hundred meters. This had some margin for error depending on the day, but it underwent a sudden change. The range of the curse had expanded to several hundreds of meters in an instant, and on top of that, it had also become capable of perforating the Conversation Mirrors, binding hearts on a basis unrelated to physical distance.'' [[Re:Zero EX#Iris and the King of Thorns|Iris and the King of Thorns]] Part 2, Section 10. Likewise, even during his battle with Halibel, he was aware of Groovy's presence and was even ready for him to make his move. ===Equipment=== In life, Eugard primarily wielded a sword that was a family heirloom, and later, as a member of the imperial family, the '''[[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]]'''. [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. No matter the object or phenomenon, or even concept, there existed a “point” that signified its essence. The Fiend Sword Murasame, was an Enchanted Sword that severed that perceived “point”―― Murasame hated Groovy, who had melted it down and reforged it in the past, so to never again be hunted for, it cut the point of its “scent”.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. This allows it to cut through things without a physical form, including curses and contracts.''“I mean the Fiend Sword Murasame! That fucking sword’s the fastest way to cut through curses, contracts, and other things that don’t have any form!”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 5, Section 3. The sword has a very long and storied history. Due to it being an Enchanted Sword, it requires sacrifice and blood in order to satisfy its hunger for violence.''These two blades of his, Murasame and Masayume, needed even more attention than most, as befitted two of the greatest works of a master swordsmith's art. Three unnamed older brothers |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 11|Tanpenshuu Volume 11]]}} '''Fareed Impusen''' (ファリド・インプセン) is the leader of the Golden Wing Faction. ==Appearance== Fareed is a tall man with a handsome face and a formal air to him. ==Personality== Fareed possesses a burning feeling of patriotism for the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], something rare for most nobles to have. He was concerned with issues such as the relations between humans and [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], internal interference from foreign nations, and the Brotherhood. However, Fareed was unable to make use of passion for the Kingdom on his own, allowing [[Russell Fellow]] to advise him in such a way that he never realized that the merchant was effectively influencing and directing his choices. ==History== As the fourth son of House Impusen, Fareed envied his brothers for being able to succeed to contributing roles within his family and lamented his lack of ability to use his burning sense of patriotism to contribute to Lugunica. Around the same time as when [[Marcos Gildark]] founded the Brotherhood, spearheaded by Russell Fellow's advise, Fareed founded the Golden Wing Faction, a gathering of nobles who felt patriotism for their country but lacked the purpose to act on it. One day, Russell came to Fareed and offered him a chance to attend a meeting between the Golden Wing Faction and The Brotherhood that would be hosted by [[Roswaal L. Mathers]]. He attended this meeting, and after much conversation with Marcos, Russell, and Roswaal, it resulted in both groups agreeing to move to [[Costuul]] so they could begin to create magicreation tools there. Because the members of the Golden Wing Faction had to prepare and sort out their courses of action, Fareed saw Roswaal and The Brotherhood off before they set course for Costuul. Some time later, the members of the Golden Wing Faction, including Fareed, moved to Costuul. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Costuul]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Leaders]]

Vollachia Shinobi Village |Previous Occupation = [[Shinobi]]
Instructor |Status = Deceased |Relatives = |Light Novel = [[Arc 9]] (flashback)}} '''Fujirou Tenzen''' (フジロウ・テンゼン) was a [[shinobi]] instructor of Vollachia's shinobi village and the one who gave [[Yae Tenzen]] her name. ==Appearance== Fujirou's appearance was never described. ==Personality== Befitting of a shinobi instructor, Fujirou desired to tap into the potential of a person training to be a shinobi and make them in his ideal image. When faced with a genin who possessed immense talent, he grew enthralled by their ability and his desire morphed into obsession. He remained resolved in his conviction to the point that he refused to accept any other outcomes, clinging to the possibility that repeating the same process would produce his desired result. Due to his obsession and refusal to concede on his outlook, his premature death was brought about at the hands of Yae. ==History== As an instructor in the shinobi village, Fujirou was among those responsible for handling the memory disposal process for kidnapped children who were to be trained as shinobi. After performing the memory disposal on a young red-haired girl assigned the name Red Number 8, he was left speechless by how effective and smooth the procedure had been. In time, he was given the chance to tell her about his surprise personally, and ended up becoming her teacher. On the day she qualified to become a genin, Fujirou bestowed the girl with the name Yae, with the reason she received the name being unknown to her, and she also inherited his family name, Tenzen. Fujirou was captivated by Yae's talent and potential as a shinobi to the point that molding her into what he viewed as the very model of an ideal shinobi became an obsession to him. To this end, he arranged the Kodoku, a ritual resembling the Imperial Selection Ceremony in which Yae and thirty other genin were brought to a forest and ordered to fight to the death until a sole victor remained. However, in the end, while Yae had succeeded in victory as he and the other shinobi who came to harbor the same expectations as him they had all hoped, not only did she go on the offensive, choosing to overpower those who came after her instead, but she also permitted the escape of a fellow genin from both the Kodoku and the shinobi village as a whole. This roused the rage of Fujirou and his allies, who resolved themselves to repeat the Kodoku until Yae fulfilled their expectations. As a result, all of them were killed by Yae, with Fujirou's last words to her being that she would overturn the very way of what a shinobi ought to be. In a twist of fate, Yae grew to be the very opposite of Fujirou's image of an ideal shinobi, distancing herself from that model of her own accord. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Shinobi]] [[Category:Teachers]]
