[[Royal Selection|Royal Selection Candidate]] |Previous Occupation = |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43|Volume 43]]}} '''Filore''' (フィルオーレ) is a nun and the Saintess of the [[Divine Dragon Church]], and she is a candidate in the [[Royal Selection]] to become the 42nd monarch of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]. She plays a major supporting role in [[Arc 10]]. Bearing the physical characteristics of a member of the Kingdom of Lugunica's [[Royal Family|royal family]], she shares her given name with Filore Lugunica, the missing princess who was kidnapped in the events of the [[Royal Abduction Incident]].''――Fifteen years ago, the daughter of the king’s younger brother had been abducted, her whereabouts unknown ever since. With the same name as that vanished princess, and bearing the golden hair and crimson eyes emblematic of the royal family, the nun introduced herself.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 6. ==Appearance== Filore is a young woman who has the characteristic gold hair and crimson red eyes of Lugunica's royal family.''This was a woman whose mere presence had harbored enough allure to naturally draw the attention of everyone present. But, in this moment, everyone’s shared reaction was not merely caused by the way she conducted herself. ――It was her appearance. Long, elegant golden hair, and crimson eyes blazing with dignified intent; possessing a meaning far more significant than simply being beautiful, they were striking to all those present here―― nay, to all who lived in the Kingdom of Lugunica.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 5. She wears the garments of a member of the Divine Dragon Church, which is composed of a dark blue habit with a white chest and shoulders, a long dark blue veil that trails behind her, purple pants, and white boots. She also wears the symbol of the church around her neck. ==Personality== Filore has displayed a dignified demeanor that is capable of shocking numerous political figures, including members of the Council of Wise Men and various civil officials. She has also shown to be used to dealing with such treatment, implied to be due in part to her appearance, which bears resemblance to the royal family. Likewise, when dealing with business matters, she mostly speaks in a friendly business-like manner, and even if she has personal opinions regarding certain matters, she will set those opinions aside in order not to be sidetracked or distracted from her original purpose. This being said, she also tends to act impulsively and is easily swayed by her emotions,''As one might surmise from their considerably startling first encounter with her, as well as their brief conversation up to this point, Filore appeared to be the fairly impulsive type, or rather, someone easily swayed by her own emotions.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 7, Section 2. leading her to act on her own without informing others in her impatience,''"That is becaaause… one of our impatient girls went running ahead on her ooown."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. is somewhat airheaded and rather childish, something which is believed to stem from her sheltered upbringing and isolation from the world,''Filore claimed to be fifteen years of age, and contrary to her mature appearance, she was most certainly fifteen years old on the inside―― or perhaps, even more childish. [[Arc 10]], Chapter 7, Section 2. craves to see the outside world due to this upbringing,''"I have no excuse for it. [[Arc 10]], Chapter 2, Section 2.''That aside, there would most likely be some complaints about the scriptures of the Divine Dragon Church being used as a dictionary of excuses.'' Her breathing was markedly fatigued, and despite the amount of sweat covering her forehead, the woman broke out in a smile, "This too, is in the scriptures. “The salvation of but one, is according to the prayers of the many. For it is only in communion that the grace of the Dragon shall reign supreme.”"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 2, Section 3. and though it is unclear if it is related to the fatigue she felt or due to the secrecy involved with them, but she was told that she should not use the Sacraments too much. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Observation''': Despite her usual airheadedness, Filore is very observant. Throughout her visits to the castle, she noticed the way the knights moved, the layout of the castle floors, and various other factors and used it to make a map of the castle in preparation for a breakout.''Furthermore, utilizing a different colored pen from the hand-drawn map, she had included annotations regarding the security network she had observed upon each of her visits to the castle, with things such as the number of Knights on duty, and the times when they changed shifts for keeping guard. ――It had been put together far more thoroughly than Heinkel could have imagined, and was the result of secret intelligence activities that had no room for excuses.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 1. ===Equipment=== *'''Scripture''': Filore carries around with her scripture from the Church, which she can be seen reading from at times. ==Trivia== *Filore's birthday was decided at a talk show held on April 5, 2026. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Royal Selection Navbox}} [[Category:Filore Camp]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Divine Dragon Church]] [[Category:Royal Selection Participants]] [[Category:Royal Selection Candidates]]

title: Edmon Quayle
wikitext:
{{Character |Name = Edmon Quayle |Image = |Kanji = エドモン・クウェイル |Romaji = Edomon Kuueiru |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Age = Late 30s |Hair Color = Unknown |Eye Color = Unknown |Affiliation = [[Gusteko]]
Limbus |Occupation = Representative of Limbus's Town Council |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Nananna Pezza]] (daughter)
[[Mireille Hetia]] (daughter) |Light Novel = [[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 2]]}} '''Edmon Quayle''' (エドモン・クウェイル) is the representative of the town council in Limbus. ==Appearance== Edmon is a man in his late thirties with a carefully trimmed moustache and an unusual atmosphere to him. He attempts to present himself with neatness and style. Toward the end of the conspiracies in Limbus, his arm was charred. It is unclear if he lost his arm or if remains on him, severely injured. ==Personality== ==History== At an unknown point in time, Edmon had affairs with two women from Limbus, which resulted in the births of his daughters [[Mireille Hetia]] and [[Nananna Pezza]]. In order to cover it up, he had them banished from Limbus. One day, because of an illness that had taken hold of Limbus, numerous people found their lives in danger, but thanks to an [[Minor Characters#Elderly Healer|elderly healer]] coming up with an appropriate medicine, lives were saved and the illness vanished. However, a rumor declared that she started the illness in order to provide the solution and increase her reputation. She was then declared a [[Witch]] and burned to death. Following the healer's death, the council members began to get rid of anyone the council considered inconvenient, including the noble who had once taken the healer's cure, and they declared it the response of a Witch, resulting in the subsequent Witch Hunts. At some point around this time, Mireille was appointed to be a subordinate to a government official in Limbus, where she learned of the healer's execution, and she began committing murders with her [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] in the town against relatives of the council members. Later, Nananna was sent to deal with the strange killings in Limbus, where, having heard about the execution of the elderly healer as well, Nananna conspired with Mireille to bring down their father and the people of Limbus for their transgressions, with Mireille getting rid of any other officials who came to the town. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 2|Witch Trials]]=== One night, the [[Omega Party]] arrived in Limbus and were nearly declared Witches and attacked. However, thanks to Nananna, they were freed of suspicion, and they were allowed to assist in that night's Witch Hunt for a man named [[Minor Characters#Piditz|Piditz]], who had been tipped off to be a Witch. Unfortunately, he was killed by Mireille, and because [[Omega]] was found near the body, she was declared a Witch and arrested. Later, [[Colette]] visits Omega, and they point out that killings began before the party arrived, which should clear Omega's name, but instead, Mireille decides to have her executed anyway, and [[Palmyra]] objects to Edmon. Later, as part of the plan to free Omega of suspicion, [[Noelle Tuérico]] joined Nananna, who had been speaking with Edmon about finding Piditz. The next day, the Witch Trial is being held for Omega, overseen by Nananna and the Town Hall, while Palmyra acts as Omega's attorney. Despite her arguments, Edmon countered with his supposed knowledge of the Witches and Omega's chatter does not help. Colette speaks up and claims that she believes that things will not go as the council claims, as people will begin to notice that the entire event seems off, which resounds with the townsfolk. Because of this, Palmyra claims that there is a conspiracy, which Edmon fights against and asks for Nananna's assistance. Because she sides with the town, [[Lilac]] and [[Shion]] believe her to be part of the conspiracy, and they decide to use their dream arts to influence the people's mental states. Palmyra then claims that the council is using the Witch rumors to get rid of inconvenient people, which Edmon also fights against, though is quickly silenced when she states she heard it herself from a council member and declares that there is no Witch. Unfortunately, Omega claims otherwise. Despite angering Palmyra, Omega decides to clear things up by declaring that there were two conspiracies taking place in town. Despite Nananna trying to prevent her from talking, Omega quickly ignores her and explains that many of the victims were relatives of council members, and she claims that Nananna is the second conspirator, calling her the bastard child of Edmon whose mother was banished from the town, and as a result, she despised the town. Noelle later appears and confirms that her actions were in response to the death of the elderly healer, and she claims that Nananna tried to remove her from the trial by knocking her out since her only ire was with Limbus. Afterward, Noelle declares that the secretary, Mireille, was helping Nananna, as she was a bastard child of Edmon as well, and she stated how the corpses of Piditz and other people connected to the council and other outside officials were already dumped in a hole. Omega also declares that she witnessed Mireille killing Piditz. Enraged, Mireille uses her spiritual arts to char Edmon's arm with blue fire, and with the intent of killing the entire council, surrounds the council with blue fire, and she and Nananna stand against them. Although Omega is fine with leaving things as they are and taking their leave, Colette states she doesn't want things to end like this, and Omega decides to end the fighting in response to her plea, burning through her restraints and declaring herself a Witch. Later, as Omega's party begins to leave the town, it is claimed that Edmon's position is under threat with both his severe injuries and the loss of the citizens' trust. ==Navigation== {{Gusteko Navbox}}

[https://animevoiceover.fandom.com/wiki/Alejandro_Saab Alejandro Saab] (Season 2+) }} '''Julius Juukulius''' (ユリウス・ユークリウス) is [[Anastasia Hoshin]]'s knight and a member of the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]]. He played major roles in both [[Arc 3]] and [[Arc 6]] and supporting roles in [[Arc 5]] and [[Arc 8]]. Julius was also one of the main protagonists of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]], as well as a supporting character in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. Though born into the life of a commoner, he was adopted into House Juukulius by his uncle following his parents’ deaths, where he would eventually become the next in line to take over the house. Joining the Royal Guard, he became known as the Finest of Knights, respected across the entirety of the knights’ order, and later, he’d become Anastasia’s knight, effectively joining her [[Anastasia Camp|camp]] during the [[Royal Selection]]. Unfortunately, his name was devoured by the [[Roy Alphard|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]], leaving him forgotten from the memories of all except [[Natsuki Subaru]]. ==Appearance== Julius is a tall young man of a well-built muscular stature with yellow eyes and gleaming light purple hair that is arranged neatly with a strand hanging down his face. He almost exclusively wears the formal Royal Guard uniform. When he fought with Subaru, he took off his Royal Guard's coat and wore a black suit with blue borders. In the Water Plumage Inn in Arc 5, he wore a yukata, and for a short period later, he wore a cloak that protected him from the sands of the [[Augria Sand Dunes]]. After his fight with [[Reid Astrea]] in Arc 6, Julius received a cut directly under his left eye. Due to the nature of the cut, the scar is permanent. During the events of Arc 8, Julius wore [[Kararagi]]an fashioned clothing: a kimono with a black nagagi and white hakama, a haori the same shade of purple as his hair, a red scarf, his sword at his waist, and a pair of sandals. ==Personality== As a member of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]'s nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, whilst currently, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are. Julius also appears to be somewhat of a history buff, and he tends to display hints of excitement when a situation involves people who have left their mark on history.''In fact, when the topic of Reid had come up at the tower, it became more evident that Julius was a history geek. He had also properly settled matters with Reid. He was not the kind of man who would fall behind, but Subaru doubted his remark that he could keep his composure when facing an eminent figure.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 20, Section 1. In fact, a part of him felt excited by the prospect of confronting such people during the [[Great Disaster]], albeit he tempered his expectations after having already met Reid Astrea prior, who both lived up to and betrayed the image he had of the first Sword Saint.''"Regrettably, I have already confronted Reid Astrea. Thus, I am disciplining myself as to not harbor excessive expectations."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 20, Section 1. Despite his demeanor, which clashes with Subaru's modernized world view, Julius tends to worry about others, even those who do not like him. When Subaru lashed out during the Royal Selection Ceremony, despite agreeing with Subaru, because he feared that Subaru would be executed for his remarks by the [[Royal Army]], Julius made an example of him in order to save his life and to quell the army's anger, while resulted in a one-sided and publicly humiliating beating and his own temporary house arrest. [[Ferris]] later points out that despite these actions, he held out hope in the young man, even when later they decided they would never be friends. Of course, despite this, Julius still wishes to befriend people such as Subaru, and despite early rocky relationships, he is more than willing to listen to their accounts of important matters, such as believing Subaru on everything he had to say regarding the [[Witch Cult]] before the [[Subjugation of Sloth]]. However, as pointed out by Reid Astrea, beneath his noble demeanor, Julius is actually a very insecure person who desperately holds on to his bonds with others. This mindset seems to be the result of his parents' deaths, causing him to seek attention to fill the void in his heart. During his final duel with Reid, Julius acknowledged his flaws and gained mutual respect with the first-generation Sword Saint. He then began working to remake the bonds he lost when after his name was eaten. During said duel with Reid, he also claimed that maintaining his appearance as a noble and chivalrous knight was something he kept up for others. As he was once inspired by such a knight, he wished to keep up his appearance as one of a similar kind so that others may have something to strive for, something which Reid acknowledged and claimed was very similar to a friend of his. It is thanks to his interactions with Reid, Subaru, who made him question who would be more worthy of the title of knight, and the reforging of his bonds after his name was devoured that he was able to restore his confidence and steel his resolve to one day ask for a proper spar with his friend, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], whose strength he was fully aware of. Likewise, it also strengthened his ambition to become stronger, going as far as to request training from another of the world's strongest citizens, [[Halibel]], to attain strength so that he could become a better knight that could protect the people around him. Julius is also as idealistic as Subaru and [[Emilia]], believing that goodness exists in everyone, even those who are classified as evil.''At his core, this was proof that Julius was an idealist just like Subaru. He believed that human beings were fundamentally good. But that was not because he was carefree. It was not because he was ignorant of reality. Even knowing the reality, he was still able to boast like that. That was the same as Natsuki Subaru and Emilia, their way of walking in the light.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 24, Section 2. In fact, it is for this reason that Julius assists Subaru with handling [[Spica]], who had originally been the [[Rui Arneb|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]] of the Witch Cult, people who are criminals and hated by everyone in the world, as he believed that she was an inherently new person as she was at this point. ==History== ===[[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Third Encyclopedia|Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia]] (Early Life)=== Julius was born as the son of [[Klein Juukulius]], who had run away from his noble family and married a commoner woman. Sometime later, his parents died while saving people in a flash flood,''The reason for his and his wife’s death was a flood that occurred in a town where Julius’s family lived. They were apparently swept away in a flash flood while trying to help others.'' [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Third Encyclopedia]], Section 3. and Julius was taken in by his uncle, [[Alviero Juukulius]]. One day, Alviero explained the situation to his son, [[Joshua Juukulius]], asking him if he had any questions about it since it would affect his life. After claiming that he had no questions, he had Julius introduce himself. When Julius introduced himself, he offered a handshake which led to him mistakenly giving an introduction meant for a lady and causing Alviero to laugh. However, Joshua started to cry, causing Julius, Alviero, and the servants of the house to panic. The next morning, Julius had started practicing swordsmanship with Alviero, which Joshua had awoken to hear. It did not take long for Julius to be disarmed and lose to Alviero, causing him great frustration, which Alviero said to treasure and recalled how his own frustration and sense of loss to swing the sword had faded away at some point. With morning practice over, Julius noticed Joshua and asked if he slept well. Not long after, Julius visited Joshua in his room and explained that he hadn't been taught about being a knight before and that he wished he had been more serious. When asked what he did when he lived with his parents, Julius told him that he would either help them or play with his friends, and he wasn't aware of being a member of House Juukulius until Alviero came to adopt him. Joshua recalled that Julius's parents died in a flash flood while saving people, and he called them great people. However, Julius asked if it was weird that he just wanted his parents to be alive and worried about whether it was fine to do as Alviero said. After thinking about it, Joshua said he needed to become a hero to become worthy of his parents. Desperate, he asked what a hero was, and Joshua looked to a bookshelf where his favorite story was, which would be Julius's ideal. From that point forward, they met regularly in Joshua's room to read those epics. In the month that followed, Julius's studies and training continued, and he discovered his [[Divine Protection]] and that he was beloved by [[spirit]]s. He and Joshua had also gone to Julius's debut, where Julius first saw a young Reinhard, and he realized that he was a real hero. Joshua, however, who felt humiliated, suddenly had an attack and blacked out, and his health deteriorated. When Julius visited him, worried about him, he asked if he wanted him to do anything, and Joshua pointed towards that appas on a tree. When Julius went to get one, Joshua got a reminder of the differences between them and laughed and cried, questioning why he was even still alive. At some point after this, about a month after Julius first arrived in the manor, Julius went to Joshua's room, where Joshua was waiting with the next chronicle of Reid Astrea, which he was looking forward to. After Julius noticed his strange expression, Joshua said he was just happy that Julius was interested in the book, and he asked if his training, both with the sword and Divine Protection, was tough, and though Julius said it was hard, he didn't say it was tough, though he admitted that these were the kinds of things that the heroes they read about experienced, something which made Joshua recall what happened with Reinhard. It is unknown if it was during that month or after, but one day, a group of [[Minor Characters#Julius's Contracted Spirits|spirits]] approached Julius, and they eventually made a contract with him. ===[[First Mission Part 1|First Mission]]=== Five years before the Royal Selection, Julius was involved in the investigation of the organization led by [[Reiner Wahrheit]] alongside [[Bikram Edditz]] and [[Helaine Gatness]]. With assistance from Reinhard, who had infiltrated the organization by disguising himself as a girl named Adelheid, they were able to bring him down and arrest him. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== Roughly 8 to 9 months before the start of the [[Arc 1]], Julius, together with Reinhard van Astrea, formed a friendly bond with a new knight of the Royal Guard, Felix Argyle. The two knights stood behind Ferris' back, supporting him on his endeavors in the Royal Guard. One faithful day, Julius was tasked with escorting Prince [[Fourier Lugunica]] to the Argyle Manor, in order to rescue [[Crusch Karsten]], who has been taken hostage by [[Biehn Argyle]], the lord of the manor. After retrieving the Duchess, Julius swiftly dispatched the remaining [[undead]], who had been resurrected via the Sacrament of the Immortal King. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly 4–5 months before the events of Arc 1 and a couple of months after the [[Royal Plague|mysterious illness]] took the lives of the entire royal family, Julius, alongside Reinhard and Ferris, were tasked with escorting two members of the Council of Wise Men, [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]], on a diplomatic mission to the neighboring [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. During their stay, the Ninth ranking Divine General, [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], was seemingly killed, and Reinhard was blamed for it, forcing the Royal Guard trio to "kidnap" the seventy-seventh emperor, [[Vincent Vollachia]], and flee the Crystal Palace. In a nearby forest, they were ambushed by Eighth and Sixth ranking Divine Generals [[Moguro Hagane]] and [[Groovy Gumlet]] respectively. As Reinhard held back the two Generals, Julius and Ferris fled further ahead with the emperor, but they encountered the First ranking Divine General, [[Cecilus Segmunt]]. Julius and Cecilus fought but the Royal Knight was no match for the Divine General. After successfully breaking Cecilus' one of his swords, the Blue Lightning decided to fight him a bit more seriously. Just as he was about to decapitate the Spirit Knight, Reinhard came to the rescue. A short duel between the two strongest swordsmen of their respective nations followed, and Reinhard came out victorious. After successfully escaping from the three Divine Generals, Julius, Reinhard, Ferris, and Vincent finally had some time to breathe and plan out their next steps. Vincent revealed that Balleroy most likely stands behind the ongoing coup d'état. Before they could devise a plan, however, a group of 30 assassins from the Insect Cage Clan engaged the three Knights and the emperor. However, Reinhard stayed behind and swiftly defeated all thirty of them. Meanwhile, while making their escape from yet another serious threat, Julius, Ferris, and Vincent fell into an ambush created by the thought-to-be-dead Divine General Balleroy Temeglyph, who managed to snipe off Vincent's right arm by the shoulder while riding on his Flying Dragon [[Carillon]]. While Ferris healed the mortally wounded emperor, Julius continued deflecting Balleroy's magical snipes, keeping him at bay and defending his friends. After devising a plan and using Ferris as a decoy, Julius was able to pinpoint Balleroy's location despite the man's invisibility, and he hit them with Al Clauzeria, killing Carillon and seriously wounding the Balleroy. Julius and Balleroy then engaged in their final duel, which ended with the Spirit Knight's blade piercing the Divine General's chest, killing him. After the threat was finally dealt with, Julius, Vincent, and Ferris regrouped with Reinhard and returned to the Crystal Palace, resolving the conflict. As a token of gratitude, the emperor signed a non-aggression pact between the Empire and the Kingdom, marking the Kingdom's ambassadors' mission as successful. Roughly a month after Balleroy's rebellion, Julius and Ferris encountered Cecilus in a tavern located in the [[Royal Capital]]. Due to the danger that the Divine General presented, the duo accompanied him to a tea house located on the outskirts of the city, where Cecilus informed them of his plans to fight with the Sword Saint Reinhard van Astrea. However, because of Reinhard's absence due to him being on a mission at the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom of Gusteko]]'s borders with Lugunica, Julius had no other option but to secretly accept the Divine General as a guest in his mansion, since his presence in the Royal Capital was illegal. After four days of hiding a Divine General inside House Juukulius, Julius and Ferris were suddenly called to Captain [[Marcos Gildark]]'s office, where the Fourth ranking Divine General, [[Chisha Gold]], was waiting. The two knights were then given a task to accompany Chisha to his needs in the Royal Capital, and the trio set out to find the person Chisha was after. Arriving just in time, they were able to prevent Cecilus from beheading the High Count [[Gramdart Holstoy]] who was behind the failed coup d'état and had fled the Empire. Having fulfilled their mission, Chisha and Cecilus were prepared to return back to the Empire with High Count Holstoy, but they were stopped by Marcos, who arranged a proxy match between Cecilus and Reinhard. ===Pre-Royal Selection=== Anastasia Hoshin, having met Alviero several years prior, decided to hold talks with the Juukulius family, seeking to expand into Lugunica's market. As the meeting began to progress towards a fruitless result for both sides, Mimi happened to find a Dragon Insignia. Anastasia told her to give it back, and she claimed it from Mimi, apologizing for the hassle after Julius told her it was a valuable artifact. However, as she held it, the insignia shone brightly. This designated her as a candidate for the Royal Selection. At that time, Julius asked himself what he would choose to do if Anastasia decided to become involved with the Royal Selection. After learning of its meaning, she soon set her mind on participating. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Camp Formation Stories|Camp Formation Stories]]=== Anastasia and Julius went to a meeting at the Royal Castle with the knights, the noble civil servants, and the Council of Wise Men, with Crusch Karsten also in attendance. She declared her intent to participate in the Royal Selection, and Julius explained how she was discovered as a candidate. Bordeaux Zergev lashed out at Julius for bringing a foreigner into the mix, but Miklotov McMahon reprimanded him, causing him to back down. Anastasia agreed to sign a non-disclosure contract and proved her candidacy to the audience by making the Dragon Jewel shine. Following the meeting, Crusch spoke with Anastasia and recognized her as a rival for the throne. Afterwards, Julius and Reinhard van Astrea went to [[Conwood Melahau]]'s tavern, the Silver Shield, where he requested the Sword Saint to become Anastasia's knight. That night, Julius returned to his mansion and spoke with Anastasia again, and upon learning of his request to Reinhard from him, she immediately became upset and said she would return to her home country, quickly leaving the mansion. Julius was troubled and did not realize the mistake he had made, but after receiving encouragement from Joshua, who said the Kingdom's number one knight was the Finest of Knights and that Anastasia needed the best knight, even if it meant that House Juukulius would face opposition for supporting a foreigner, he resolved himself to meet her. At an inn, Anastasia told Ricardo and the triplets to not allow anyone through to her. Julius encountered them and fought with Ricardo without a sword, easily beating him, although he had not been in top condition because he had been drinking. Julius then spoke to Anastasia through her door, retracting his request to Reinhard and offering his services instead, after which she opened the door and they performed the ritual of knighting, and in the end, the Finest of Knights became the merchant's knight. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Though not nearly on the same level as Reinhard or Marcos Gildark, Julius is among the strongest individuals of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. At one point, he was stated to be skilled and powerful enough to be able to reach the title of a Second-Class General in the [[Imperial Army]] of the Vollachia Empire, a position reserved for individuals who are either unparalleled tacticians, have distinguished themselves with excellent leadership capabilities, or stand out from the rest in terms of overall strength and skill in combat, but are not walking monsters capable of single-handedly turning the tide of a major battle. Though almost completely outmatched in both instances, Julius displayed enough strength to survive battles with legends of such strength as the Blue Lightning and the first Sword Saint and even withstand their onslaught of attacks for a short time. After the contract with his spirits was renewed, his strength was enhanced significantly further to the point that he was able to easily defeat the undead [[Sphinx]] with little resistance. He continues to improve his skill and has even trained with the strongest man in Kararagi, Halibel, following the Great Disaster, and Halibel has acknowledged his skill as being one of the most powerful people in the Kingdom. ===[[Divine Protection]]=== [[File:Julius - Clarista.gif|thumb|250px|Julius encased in the power of his spirits.]] '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Gathering Spirits|Divine Protection of Gathering Spirits]]''' (誘精の加護 ''Yūsei no Kago''): This enables Julius to see, talk, and be liked by spirits, though he has to work hard to actually get liked by spirits. The effect is so prominent that most lesser and quasi-spirits are willing to fight with each other to approach him, while more powerful spirits, though not so blinded by this Divine Protection, become fond or at least have a positive impression of him. Likewise, this makes him one of the few people within the Kingdom to have a gift to form contracts with spirits. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== Julius Quasi Spirits.gif|Julius' six quasi-spirits. Julius' bloomed Spirits.jpg|Julius and his newly bloomed spirits. Spirits imbuing Julius with strength.gif|Julius enhancing his sword with spiritual arts. Julius has an affinity for the wind attribute. However, he does not practice ordinary magic. Instead, Julius, who is contracted with the six spirits, '''[[Ia]]''' (イア, red/fire), '''Kua''' (クア, blue/water), '''Aro''' (アロ, green/wind), '''Iku''' (イク, yellow/earth), '''In''' (イン, orange/white/yang), and '''Nes''' (ネス, purple/black/yin), excels in using spiritual arts, making him one of only two '''Spirit Knights''' (精霊騎士, ''Seirei Kishi'') in the Kingdom of Lugunica. By entrusting his spirits with the use of magic in his place, he is able to combine different attributes of magic simultaneously and weave it into his swordplay, whether that is to cast offensive spells, to boost his weapon's or his own abilities, to heal, or to impair his opponent's abilities. Although he was forced to sever his contract at one point with his spirits, because he was able to renew it, his spirits, which had previously been quasi-spirits, managed to evolve, making both them and himself stronger and capable of a wider array of strong spells. When they are not in materialized, they reside within their own crystal which Julius keeps on his person.''“He has appropriate crystals for each of his quasi-spirits.”'' November 15, 2014 AskFM Q&A '''Spells''': *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法, ''Chiyu Mahō''): Julius can use water mana via '''Kua''' to heal his allies' wounds. [[File:Julius uses Aro.gif|thumb|250px|Julius using '''Aro''' as a propeller and cushion.]] *'''El Fura''' (エル・フーラ, ''Eru Fūra''): With assistance from his wind spirit '''Aro''', Julius can unleash the second level of Fura in which he can create a burst of wind, with uses ranging from several slashes, cushioning a fall, or churning the air and ground to create dust clouds. *'''Strength Enhancement''': Julius can call on '''In''' to boost his strength and agility, granting him superhuman abilities for a period of time. *'''Strength Impairment''': Julius can call on '''Nes''' to impair the power of his opponent. The full extent of this impairment is unknown, but at the very least, it does seem to affect his opponent's physical abilities to an extent. *'''Yin Magic Sealing''': Julius is able to employ a type of seal made of yin magic that can both prevent the target from dying and keep them from moving. It is the same kind of seal that was used to seal the Witch of Envy. According to [[Al]], it works similarly to Ol Shamak, and according to Roy Alphard, anyone sealed this way can still somewhat sense the outside world. It required the combined efforts of [[Beatrice]] and Julius to create,''"To begin with, that Gluttony’s body was secured with Yin Magic. Betty and Julius had worked together to do it, so it was rigid and solid security, impervious to any meager, measly attempts on it, in fact… That Betty couldn’t develop that advanced form by herself is mortifying, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 6, Section 1. and the only way to undo the seal would require that the one breaking the seal is skilled in Yin Magic as well.''"A thing impossible to meddle with, of course for the captive person, but also from those on the outside, in fact. Unfastening it would require suitable mastery of Yin Magic, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 6, Section 1. '''Combined Spells''': Since he can call on more than one spirit to use magic, he can have them combine their respective attributes in order to create or combine spells together, either enhancing their effectiveness or using spells rarely used by other mages. Likewise, depending on how he times his spells, he can activate two separate spells simultaneously onto different targets or with very different purposes. [[File:Julius - Ul Gora.gif|thumb|250px|Julius using Ul Gora.]] *'''Ul Gora''' (ウル・ゴーラ): Julius calls on '''Ia''' and '''Aro''' to produce a powerful magical firestorm by combining both Fire and Wind magic. [[File:Julius and Subaru Using Nect.gif|thumb|250px|Julius and Subaru using Nect.]] *'''Nect''' (ネクト): A high-level magic that enables people to share senses within the effect area by connecting their gates. It is considered to be difficult to use, however, In and Nes can use it by pairing Yin and Yang Magic together and tuning the interference of mana between people. If it is too weak, the thoughts won't get through, yet if it's too strong, people won't know where the line between them and other people begins. Performed with '''In''' and '''Nes'''. '''Unique Spells''': Although he does not generally create spells, he is one of only a few capable of using all six elements. Furthermore, with his contracts, he can activate them all simultaneously without suffering the same kind of backlash as a non-spiritual arts using mage. As such, he is effectively one of the only people capable of casting these spells, and freely, in the world. [[File:Julius Using Al Clarista.gif|thumb|250px|Julius using Al Clarista.]] *'''Clarista '''(クラリスタ): Julius imbues his sword with the power of his six spirits, empowering it. Clarista and its different levels are Julius' original magic. **'''Al Clarista''' (アル・クラリスタ): Al Clarista allows Julius to imbue his sword with the power of his six quasi-spirits (after his fight with Reid Astrea, he can do that with his newly bloomed spirits), cladding his blade in a brilliant rainbow light. According to him, when this spell is in use, he can cut almost everything with his sword, no matter the toughness. Julius displayed this ability two times, roughly half a year before the start of the Royal Selection on his diplomatic journey to the Sacred Vollachia Empire. There, he fought the First and Ninth ranking Divine Generals on separate occasions, and managed to break the former's 5th best sword, and kill the latter. Julius is also capable of using the long-range version of Clarista where the spell takes the form of a beam of pure destructive energy. The light is capable of cutting through anything and everything in its path. After Julius reforged his contract with his quasi-spirits, the power and range of the attack greatly increased, surprising even Julius. During his battle with the Ninth ranking Divine General of the Vollachia Empire, Julius used this spell to melt away the General's spear and pierce his chest, killing him. [[File:Julius Using Al Clauseria.gif|thumb|250px|Julius using Al Clauzeria.]] *'''Al Clauzeria''' (アル・クラウゼリア): When Al Clauzeria is casted, six different colored spirits start circling around Julius and join into one whirling rainbow-hued vortex of light which is shot out from the tip of his sword. Immediately following the impact of the rainbow light, the torrent of light explodes in a sizeable shock wave that sends his opponents flying. The wall as well as the vortex are composed of six elements, which are able to repel any sort of magic that is casted against it as well as any and all physical attacks. Furthermore, in the novelization of Julius' duel with [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]], the rainbow shockwave started expanding directly from his own body, rather being shot out from the tip of his sword, easily purifying away close to a hundred unseen hands that enveloped the Knight from all sides, just seconds prior. Despite the small difference in execution, both versions have the same effect. Following the evolution of his quasi-spirits into spirits, this attack has enough power to completely wipe away one of the heads of a Dragon the caliber of [[Valgren]].''Ensnared by thorns, Valgren had ceased its movements mid-air. Aiming for one of the Blight Dragon’s writhing heads, an aurora of rainbow ran diagonally across the sky. Vibrantly it seized Valgren’s right head, blowing it away from its base. A graceful, magnificent, dazzling stroke of magic unleashed by the Finest.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 6. By tweaking the spell, Julius can use this spell to create a dome-like barrier around himself and his targets. Ordinarily, this is used for defense, but it can also be used to trap aerial opponents such as Balleroy Temeglyph near the ground. Following the evolution of his spirits, his barrier has shown to be able to extend to cover up to half of the entirety of the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]].''In the blink of an eye, the skies of the Fortified City were engulfed in an aurora of rainbow―― however, the size and extent of that rainbow were enough to defend around half of the extensive Fortified City.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 5. *'''Al Cranvel''' (アル・クランヴェル): Al Cranvel is Julius' secret technique he developed long ago but never managed to properly utilize, due to his lack of experience. After he forged a new contract with his newly bloomed spirits, Julius called upon their power and clad himself in their sixfold power, greatly increasing his speed and overall power. To the other party, Julius appeared as if he was swallowed alive by a rainbow. This sword skill is noted as Julius' ultimate attack. Debuting this trump card during his final duel with legendary Reid Astrea, it played a vital role in helping him overcome the obstacle known as the first generation's Sword Saint. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== Julius Using Enhanced Strength.gif|thumb|250px|Julius while fighting Petelgeuse. Julius Magic Swordplay.gif|Julius's swordplay against the Unseen Hands. '''Master Swordsman''': Julius is a master of swordsmanship who is considered one of the greatest practitioners within the Kingdom. He uses an orthodox style of swordsmanship that is fast and precise, and though he is not very fond of using underhanded tricks with his attacks, he more than makes up for it with pure skill. His skills can be further augmented with his spiritual arts. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Strategist''': Julius is rather knowledgeable in various matters. With such knowledge at his disposal, he is able to come up with various strategies in order to counter his target. In one notable example, during the Reaper Disaster, Julius used his knowledge of how tornadoes are formed in order to counter one created with the power of a [[Zarestia|great spirit]], using large pieces of rubble to slow the wind and use fire to counteract the fronts that were giving the tornado its momentum and destructive force. In another case, he used a barrier, ordinarily used for defense over a limited area, to trap his enemy, Balleroy, and prevent him from taking to the skies and regaining the advantage. ===Equipment=== *'''Heirloom Sword''': Julius wielded a sword, which was a prized heirloom of House Juukulius. He spent years mastering its use. During the events of Arc 6, however, the sword broke when Julius fought against Reid for the first time. *'''Spare Sword''': Following his duel with Reid, Julius resorted to using a spare sword he brought with him. According to Subaru's observation from one of the failed loops, Julius' new sword looked like a cheap and mass-produced weapon, a model likely used by many of the other knights.''"And as he came to that conclusion, the first thing that popped into his mind was the sword Julius carried. It was a cheap-looking, likely mass-produced sword, but certainly it ought to be plenty to have slashed through the body of a woman as delicate as Echidna. The question remained, he had no idea what reason Julius would have to kill Echidna."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 42, Section 3 ==Trivia== *According to the author, Julius's birth flower is a Nymphaea, also known as a water lily, which symbolizes purity of heart. *His name was chosen by his father, Klein Juukulius. *Julius' favorite color is blue. *At the very young age of twenty-two, Julius already is recognized as one of the Kingdom's greatest knights and is well on his way to becoming the Royal Guard's next Captain. According to multiple individuals throughout the story, not even Reinhard can compare with Julius in terms of knightly virtues. *After his match with Natsuki Subaru toward the start of Arc 3, Julius was suspended from his duties for five days by Marcos as a punishment for detaining Subaru and thoroughly beating him in the training grounds. The punishment came after many of the other knights requested Marcos to show leniency to Julius. During that period, Julius was forbidden from entering both the Royal Castle and the knights’ garrison, placed under house arrest, and had his sword temporarily taken by Marcos. *According to the author, Julius is quite easy to write about, out of all male characters.''"I don’t think putting characters you created yourself in order is done very often, you know? They’re not in order, but Subaru, Otto, Wilhelm, Garf, and Julius are easy to write."'' AskFM Q&A. *Julius generally prefers vegetables and fruit over meat. His favorite vegetable are tomatoes''"He has vegetarian leanings, so it’s vegetables. He likes fruit, too. Taking it all together, it’s tomatoes (tometos in the Re:Zero world) and such. He probably likes ketchup more than mayonnaise. He’s su~ch a kid."'' AskFM Q&A. and he'd much prefer ketchup over mayonnaise. *Due to his decision to support a foreigner in the Royal Selection, he received some repercussions from his family members.''"Oh, there were. Look forward to when it’s Julius’ turn."'' AskFM Q&A. *Julius feels a strange sense of admiration for Subaru's "Little Girl User" alias.''"He feels an odd admiration for him, in a ‘He even has little girls as allies!’ sort of way."'' AskFM Q&A. *Julius put together Clarista in honor of the hero of his childhood tales.''"People who can use six colors are rare, but Clarista itself is not so much his own original work as his trump card. I think Roswaal would be able to do something similar, but it wouldn’t work the same way. He put it together in honor of the hero of his childhood fairy tales."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, Julius is quite fond of alcohol and often drinks together with his friends.''"Julius enjoys it, but Reinhard is completely unable to get drunk, so he only drinks on social occasions."'' AskFM Q&A. *Julius was actually defeated by [[Crusch Karsten]] in a sword fight, though neither of them knew each other at the time. Even to this day, neither of them are aware that they fought each other.''"Actually, in the past, she defeated Julius with the sword. Neither of them were aware who the other was, so they didn't realize it."'' AskFM Q&A. *Reid Astrea is Julius' hero and the one who he looks up to. *Julius actually has problems with his eyesight, so he can usually be seen wearing glasses when reading. *His first meeting with Reinhard didn't go too well for Julius. According to the author, the feelings accompanying their first meeting were mostly extreme shame.''"He was extremely ashamed of himself."'' AskFM Q&A. *Because of how his Divine Protection made his nature likeable to lesser spirits and quasi-spirits, there were many of them that wanted to form a contract with him before he met the six he currently has contracts with. While they were lesser spirits, the six of them partook in a fierce battle with other lesser spirits over which of them could create a contract with him, and they were the victors. Julius, to this day, is unaware of this battle.''“To begin with, his nature is easy for spirits to like due to his Divine Protection of Gathering Spirits, so there were all kinds of spirits that were looking to form contracts with him. Having said that, spirits aren't deceived by blessings, so the only candidates were young lesser spirits. And, the six that came through the fierce fighting are the ones that are his contracted spirits. Julius is unaware of that battle.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1015648626058514432 July 8, 2018 Twitter Q&A] *The first spirit that Julius made a contract with and the one he is best friends with is Ia.''“I think it's Ia in both cases.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1015645766331723776 July 8, 2018 Twitter Q&A] *Julius' earth dragon, [[Shaknar]], was gifted to Julius for his 15th birthday from an earth dragon trainer that's very close with the Juukulius family. *According to the author, the reason why Julius isn't in the same state as Joshua after being eaten by Roy Alphard is a spoiler.''"Both of them were eaten by Roy, and Roy has no eating standards. He's "Bizarre Eating", so he'll eat anything, after all. The reason Julius is not asleep is a spoiler."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1088124974722834432 2019 Joshua's Birthday Q&A] *Julius has his own named chapter in Arc 6 in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 6: The Corridor of Memories|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 22|light novels]], as well as a named [[Episode 72|episode]] in the anime. *Prior to Subaru contracting Beatrice as his spirit and becoming a spirit knight, Julius was the only spirit knight in the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica.''"I believe you are well aware, but my older brother is also a spirit knight... previously the only one in the entire kingdom." ''[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 1. *At a talk show with the author held on March 30, 2024, when someone asked who would make up the Nine Divine Generals of Lugunica if it existed, Julius was one of the names he listed. *According to the author in a talk show held on April 6th, 2025, among the knights of the Royal Selection candidates, he and Subaru tied for being the third most popular. *According to the author, when Nes, Julius's yin spirit, sees Beatrice, she thinks that she wants to be like her for Julius's sake.''"It thinks “I wanna be like that…! For master!”"'' AskFM Q&A. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Anastasia Camp]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Knights]] [[Category:House Juukulius]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:Spirit Knights]] [[Category:Spiritual Arts Users]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[de:Julius Juukulius]] [[es:Julius Juukulius]] [[fr:Julius Juukulius]] [[pl:Julius Juukulius]] [[pt-br:Julius Euclius]] [[ru:Юлиус Юклиус]] [[uk:Юліус Юкуліус]] [[zh:角色:由里乌斯·尤克历乌斯]]

[[Grassis Remendis]] (niece) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1|Volume 1]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 1 Chapter 1|Arc 1 Chapter 1]] |Anime = [[Episode 1]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kenta Miyake|Miyake Kenta]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Patrick Seitz|Patrick Seitz]]}} '''Kadomon Risch''' (カドモン・リッシュ) is a fruit seller in the [[Royal Capital]] of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. ==Appearance== Kadomon is a muscular and firmly built fruit seller and often carries a twig in his mouth. He has green hair which he bands back into a slicked-back style, with a hairband to hold it tightly together. He wears a black vest with a golden outline and two bracelets line his wrists. His face is dominated by two large scars running down from his forehead to his chin and right below his left eye, given to him by his wife [[Raksha Risch|Raksha]]. He also has a small goatee and two sky blue eyes. ==Personality== Despite his rough looks, Kadomon is actually a kind and good-natured person, though he gets annoyed with people's antics when they happen in front of his store since it usually detracts from his business. When it comes to his family, he shows gratitude toward those who help them and is willing to repay them however he can, which he did for [[Emilia]] in spite of her appearance. Furthermore, he will immediately move to assist others when an accident happens, and he is willing to go against the [[Royal Army]] to protect others who are doing what they can to help others, such as what he did for [[Natsuki Subaru]]. ==History== At an unknown point in time, Kadomon met Raksha, and she gave him his scar. The two worked as part of the same mercenary troupe for a time,April 6, 2026 Talk Show. and at some point, the two got married and had their child, [[Plum Risch|Plum]]. ===[[Behind the Scenes of Life in Another World from Zero]]=== On the day of Subaru's arrival into the world, sometime after Subaru left his stand, his wife arrived at his stand, and at some point after, Emilia appeared with his daughter, who had gotten lost after being separated from her mother. When Kadomon asked her how he could repay her, though she didn't give the full explanation, she asked about [[Felt]] and how something she had was stolen, leading him to tell her about the Loot House and warning her not to go there. Emilia still resolved to go there, and before she could go, Plum offered her a red flower ornament as thanks for her help. ==Trivia== *Kadomon's surname, Risch, his birthday, November 6, and the names of his wife and daughter, were revealed in an interactive game that was available during the 2016 MF Bunko J Summer School Festival event. *According to the author, Kadomon is pretty strong for a normal guy.''"Kadomon is actually fairly strong for a normal guy."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16|Volume 16]] (main story) |Manga = [[Manga Arc 5 Chapter 1|Arc 5 Chapter 1]] |Anime = [[Episode 51]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Shōya Ishige|Ishige Shōya]] |English Voice = [https://animevoiceover.fandom.com/wiki/Brian_Anderson Brian Timothy Anderson]}} '''Joshua Juukulius''' (ヨシュア・ユークリウス) is [[Julius Juukulius]]'s cousin and adoptive younger brother, and he is a member of the [[Anastasia Camp]]. He played a lesser supporting role in [[Arc 5]]. A frail and sickly boy in his youth, Joshua was the only son of House Juukulius's [[Alviero Juukulius|family head]]. After meeting Julius, despite his jealousy of his abilities, he became a fervent admirer of his and followed him even in the [[Royal Selection]]. However, just before the [[Battle for Priestella]], Joshua unluckily stumbled across the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]], who ate his name and memories, putting him in a vegetative-like state. Currently, Joshua is yet to wake up. ==Appearance== Joshua is an elegant and handsome young man with a clear and slender face and long, light purple hair that he regularly ties into a tail, leaving it to elegantly fall down his shoulders. He has bright and sparkling, yellow slant up eyes that give off a sharp look which left a pretty bad first impression on Subaru. His black clothes are well tailored and perfectly fit his slender physique; paired with his monocle, they give off a strict and scholarly impression, and one can easily figure out his social standing. He's described to give off an impression of a boy who would best fit into a quiet room, immersed in literature - which coincidentally was how he spent most of his childhood. Despite that, Joshua is extremely well mannered, and his posture is elegant and befitting of a noble. ==Personality== Unlike his brother Julius, Joshua does not have the same composed personality, as shown when he gets flustered with the antics of the [[Emilia Camp]] members and can be quick to fear others based off of rumors. Despite this, he has a serious yet amiable personality, and [[Natsuki Subaru]] considers him easier to get along with than Julius. He respects his brother to the utmost degree and cannot stop when he starts talking about him, and likewise, he has a great respect for [[Spirit|spirits]] and the people who are able to contract with them, which he displayed upon meeting Subaru and [[Beatrice]]. He has also developed a passion for art and painting. Even with his utmost calm and collected personality, he was previously subtly racist towards [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], with Julius describing that Joshua had a narrowed view towards the world. Since then, he has shed his prejudice, and he has shown not to be fazed when dealing with either members of the Anastasia Camp, which is comprised of many demi-humans, or even [[Emilia]], someone who was hated and feared for being a silver-haired half elf who bore a resemblance to the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], though in the case of the latter, he had to be convinced that his lingering fear was baseless. Despite all this, due to his frail condition, Joshua was jealous of his brother, even bordering on a slight hatred, which [[Roy Alphard]] stated using Joshua's memories. ==History== ===[[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Third Encyclopedia|Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia]] (Early Life)=== Joshua was born sickly, and he would regularly have coughing fits and would be forced to be bedridden. Because of this, he was physically very weak and quickly ran out of stamina. As such, unable to train himself or learn combat skills, he spent his childhood buried in books. One day, Alviero explained the situation to his son regarding the adoption of his cousin, Julius, into the family, asking him if he had any questions about it since it would affect his life. After claiming that he had no questions, he had Julius introduce himself. When Julius introduced himself, he offered a handshake which led to him mistakenly giving an introduction meant for a lady and causing Alviero to laugh. However, Joshua started to cry, causing Julius, Alviero, and the servants of the house to panic. The next morning, Julius had started practicing swordsmanship with Alviero, which Joshua had awoken to hear. It did not take long for Julius to be disarmed and lose to Alviero, causing him great frustration, which Alviero said to treasure and recalled how his own frustration and sense of loss to swing the sword had faded away at some point. With morning practice over, Julius noticed Joshua and asked if he slept well. Not long after, Julius visited Joshua in his room and explained that he hadn't been taught about being a knight before and that he wished he had been more serious. When asked what he did when he lived with his parents, Julius told him that he would either help them or play with his friends, and he wasn't aware of being a member of House Juukulius until Alviero came to adopt him. Joshua recalled that Julius's parents died in a flash flood while saving people, and he called them great people. However, Julius asked if it was weird that he just wanted his parents to be alive and worried about whether it was fine to do as Alviero said. After thinking about it, Joshua said he needed to become a hero to become worthy of his parents. Desperate, he asked what a hero was, and Joshua looked to a bookshelf where his favorite story was, which would be Julius's ideal. From that point forward, they met regularly in Joshua's room to read those epics. In the month that followed, Julius's studies and training continued, and he discovered his [[Divine Protection]] and that he was beloved by spirits. He and Joshua had also gone to Julius's debut, where Julius first saw a young [[Reinhard van Astrea]], and he realized that he was a real hero. Joshua, however, who felt humiliated, suddenly had an attack and blacked out, and his health deteriorated. When Julius visited him, worried about him, he asked if he wanted him to do anything, and Joshua pointed towards that appas on a tree. When Julius went to get one, Joshua got a reminder of the differences between them and laughed and cried, questioning why he was even still alive. Though he never said so out loud since, seeing Julius climb that tree to get an appa stirred his jealousy and made him feel a small sense of hatred. At some point after this, about a month after Julius first arrived in the manor, Julius went to Joshua's room, where Joshua was waiting with the next chronicle of [[Reid Astrea]], which he was looking forward to. After Julius noticed his strange expression, Joshua said he was just happy that Julius was interested in the book, and he asked if his training, both with the sword and Divine Protection, was tough, and though Julius said it was hard, he didn't say it was tough, though he admitted that these were the kinds of things that the heroes they read about experienced, something which made Joshua recall what happened with Reinhard. As he watched Julius's feats growing up, observing him practicing with a sword and often wishing he could join him, his admiration long since outweighed his envy, and he started learning clerical duties. ===Pre-Royal Selection=== At some point before the Royal Selection's start, [[Anastasia Hoshin]] visited House Juukulius in an effort to expand her business into [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. While Joshua was concerned over her presence as well as the presence of demi-humans, he shared these concerns with his brother, though he was scolded for his narrow sightedness. After meeting Anastasia and her party, he came to respect her and her business-oriented mind. After learning of Anastasia's qualification to become Lugunica's monarch and her official induction into the Royal Selection, Julius and Joshua, alongside other members of the [[Iron Fang]], began helping her set up her business in Lugunica, and he joined his brother in joining the Anastasia Camp. He also came to look up to [[Tivey Pearlbaton]] after meeting him, and he began mimicking him by wearing a monocle. ===[[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia]]=== As [[Mimi Pearlbaton|Mimi]], [[Hetaro Pearlbaton|Hetaro]], and Tivey had entered his room the moment they realized that there was food, Joshua, who was honored to have finally been chosen to do something for Anastasia, was concerned that he had to act as a messenger to invite Emilia to [[Priestella]], nervous and somewhat fearful of her due to her race and the rumors of her appearance being a match for the Witch of Envy. However, Mimi declared that Emilia wasn't scary, and recalling that Hetaro and Tivey had interacted with the Emilia Camp for the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], he asked for their opinions. While Tivey claimed that Emilia didn't seem to be scary, Hetaro declared that he only ever talked with her knight, Natsuki Subaru, someone else that Joshua had heard rumors and was wary of, as his origins were unknown and he had no known power. He also recalled the other worrisome rumors about the camp, which only increased his worries. Deciding to directly ask Anastasia her intentions of sending him, Joshua shared his thoughts with her and asked her outright. Though she said that Emilia and Subaru wouldn't be scary, she had called for Julius and told him that Joshua was worried about coming off as rude toward the members of the Emilia Camp, which Julius agreed with since he said that they were nothing like the rumors claimed them to be. However, he also said to watch out for Subaru, who was more than what he seemed, was very loyal and determined, and had earned his position as her knight as a [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] user himself. After a moment of silence, Joshua thanked Julius for sharing that with him, knew to be wary if Subaru, and left the room, leaving Julius and Anastasia to speak with each other. After leaving them, he encountered [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]] who came to check on him, and he was relieved to see that Joshua was doing better. In Priestella, after Anastasia gave him a letter to pass along, Joshua, who had dropped it at some point, encountered [[Schult Barielle|Schult]], who had given him the letter, much to his gratitude. Wanting to thank him, he asked what the boy, Schult, wanted in return, to which Schult said he was lost. Walking together, Schult gave an explanation of his history and the respect that he shows to the members of his [[Priscilla Camp|camp]], and he asked Joshua if there was someone he respected, to which Joshua replied that that person was his brother, though after recalling something in the past, his feelings became a little complicated. Schult looked forward to meeting him, and Joshua claimed that Julius would treat him kindly, but soon after, they noticed a commotion ahead. Realizing the danger, Joshua gave Schult his letter and told him to run, telling him to convey it Schult's [[Priscilla Barielle|master]] to pass along to his brother. After Schult ran, Joshua stepped in the way of Lye Batenkaitos as he was about to attack a defenseless woman, allowing her to escape while Lye became interested in him and devoured his name and memories. ===[[Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook]]=== As he was being brought into a hospital ward, Subaru stopped the stretcher, having recognized him, and he told Julius and "[[Eridna|Anastasia]]". Later, as Julius was lamenting having forgotten even forgotten his own brother, apologizing to him for it at his bedside, Ricardo came into the room and confirmed that the two were related through his sense of smell. Though he had forgotten Julius, he claimed that in spite of that, he could tell that he was still one of them, and he patted his head. Julius's gaze sank to Ricardo's severed arm, and Ricardo scolded him for it, stating that it was his own problem. The lack of change in the man gave Julius a sense of relief, and Ricardo mentioned that thinking in such a way naturally comes to someone who live for a long time, including Julius. Afterward, Ricardo entrusted Anastasia to Julius, as he was aware of their next [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|journey]], and he claimed he would not forget it and that Julius must not forget either. After accepting his trust and entrusting Joshua to him in return, Julius pulled out a notebook, which he claimed that he would be writing his experiences and words he's spoken with in, that way he wouldn't forget again, which brought relief to Ricardo. ==Trivia== *Joshua's birthday was decided to be January 10 as a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Book of Joshua|Book of Joshua]], in which [[Wikipedia:Joshua|Joshua]] was said to have died at the age of 110. *Joshua wears a monocle because he thinks Tivey looks cool wearing it, so he decided to imitate him.''Joshua got along with him most, perhaps because they both had older brothers. He even copied wearing a monocle, which he had started doing after becoming friends with him and developing a slight admiration for him.'' [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia]], Section 1. *Joshua started respecting Julius when he was around 7 years old. *The only reason why Joshua decided to serve Anastasia Hoshin is due to Julius's influence on him. Without Julius, he wouldn't have joined her camp.''“It was none other than Julius’s influence. Currently, there’s no story where Joshua himself decides to serve Anastasia.”'' [https://x.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1088117358734897152 January 24, 2019 Twitter Q&A] *Joshua's latent magic attribute is the water attribute, although he does not have an aptitude for it. **Originally, before settling on the water attribute for Joshua, the author thought that he might have had an affinity for wind.''“If he could use it, I think it might be wind. Unfortunately, he hasn’t been trained to use magic.”'' [https://x.com/nezumiironyanko/status/951102178956988416 January 10, 2018 Twitter Q&A] *Originally, rather than Lye, it was his brother Roy who was responsible for eating Joshua's name and memories. However, in the shop special release of [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Second Encyclopedia]], the illustration incorrectly depicted Lye instead. To remedy this, in the release of [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 11|Tanpenshuu Volume 11]], it was rewritten so that Lye devoured Roy instead. *Joshua has an aptitude for swordsmanship. However, due to Joshua's frailty at the time, his father was forced to give up on his training, and as a result, he was unable to hone his skill.''“I often heard this from Father. Albeit they could not help but give up on his instruction given his physical condition, Joshua indeed possessed a talent for swordsmanship.”'' [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia Ex]], Section 2. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Anastasia Camp]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:House Juukulius]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Inactive]]

[[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 24|Arc 3 Chapter 24]] (actual) |Anime = [[Episode 19]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Megumi Han|Han Megumi]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kira Buckland|Kira Buckland]]}} '''Hetaro Pearlbaton''' (ヘータロー・パールバトン) is one of [[Anastasia Hoshin]]'s followers and is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary group known as the [[Iron Fang]]. ==Appearance== Hetaro has aqua green eyes and medium-length orange hair. He has orange cat ears along with a tail and wears a white robe. Unlike his sister [[Mimi Pearlbaton|Mimi]], he has differently shaped eyebrows and slightly droopy eyes. He is described to be a boy with big round eyes who is easily mentally fatigued. ==Personality== Unlike his cheerful sister, Hetaro has a more cautious personality, which comes from his experiences of taking care of his sister. As he is a siscon, he generally tends to let his sister do whatever she wants, leading her to grow into her current personality, though because of this he is attentive and is sensitive to changes in mood. Despite this, he is also on good terms with his younger brother [[Tivey Pearlbaton|Tivey]], who listens to what he has to say. Due to [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]]'s habit of heading straight into the battle, he is virtually the commander of the Iron Fang while in battle. ==History== ===Early Life=== Sometime in the past, Mimi, Hetaro, and Tivey were abandoned by their parents. When they were two, Tivey was about to be kidnapped. Mimi attempted to fight off the kidnappers, but she was stabbed four times in the process, and Hetaro was also injured.As Mimi recalls, Tivey was about to get caught by the kidnappers and Mimi somehow stopped it but got stabbed in the belly by Mimi’s opponent. Mimi got stabbed four times, and Mimi was still two years old, so Mimi was only at the beginning stage of being the strenghtiest, so even Mimi was in a near death situation. [[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]], Section 2. As they were running away, they ran into [[Roshi Pearlbaton]], who healed them,''While they were running for their lives while Hetaro was dealing with a stomach wound as bad as Mimi’s, an old man suddenly appeared in front of Mimi when her wound started to feel better.'' [[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]], Section 2. and after taking them in, he taught them how to survive.''Roshi, who had picked up Mimi and her siblings, laughed with his dirty clothes and his ugly face with a chipped tooth. After that, the three cat’s and Roshi’s life began somehow. The three of them didn’t know anything, as they were just kittens. The three kitten siblings were taught the means to survive by Roshi, who was very knowledgeable. The energetic Mimi was taught how to fight. The kind Hetaro was taught how to live cautiously. And the wise Tivey was taught knowledge regarding various things. Roshi had always said that it would help the three of them in the future.'' [[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]], Section 2. ===[[Kararagi Girl Meets Cats Part 1|Kararagi Girl Meets Cats]] and [[Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye Part 1|Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye]]=== Mimi and Hetaro attempted to rescue Anastasia, but they were incidentally captured instead by [[Razcrew]]. Razcrew planned to sell them on the slave markets in the north of [[Kararagi]]. However, his plan was thwarted, and he ended up being enslaved himself. After the defeat of [[Reisel]], Anastasia vowed that if anything happened to Roshi, she would take the Pearlbatons under her care. Eventually, Roshi made a kamikaze attack while on a mission, blowing up with an enemy in the process. Ever since, the siblings have lived with the Iron Fang under Anastasia and Ricardo's care. ===[[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia]]=== As Mimi, Hetaro, and Tivey had entered his room the moment they realized that there was food, [[Joshua Juukulius]], who was honored to have finally been chosen to do something for Anastasia, was concerned that he had to act as a messenger to invite [[Emilia]] to [[Priestella]], nervous and somewhat fearful of her due to her race and the rumors of her appearance being a match for the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. However, Mimi declared that Emilia wasn't scary, and recalling that Hetaro and Tivey had interacted with the [[Emilia Camp]] for the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], he asked for their opinions. While Tivey claimed that Emilia didn't seem to be scary, Hetaro declared that he only ever talked with her knight, [[Natsuki Subaru]], someone else that Joshua had heard rumors and was wary of, as his origins were unknown and he had no known power. He also recalled the other worrisome rumors about the camp, which only increased his worries, and then, he went ask Anastasia about her intentions directly. ===[[Kararagi Reaper Incident 2|Kararagi Reaper Incident]]=== Sometime after the [[Battle for Priestella]], the Pearlbatons returned to [[Banan]] in Kararagi. However, at some point after the events of the [[Great Disaster]], the Slasher, [[Zarestia]] set a windstorm on the town, destroying half of it and raising everyone in town sans Ricardo into the sky - an event that would be remembered as the Shinigami Disaster. Believing Ricardo to have stolen her Light Sphere, the two confronted each other, worrying the Pearlbatons. However, after withstanding all of her attacks, she stopped attacking him, made the windstorm dissipate, and lowered everyone to the ground. Later, everyone went to counter a black tornado that had started to assail Banan, and though they managed to quell it, Anastasia and [[Eridna|Echidna]] had gone missing. ==Abilities== ===[[Divine Protection]]=== '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Trisection|Divine Protection of Trisection]]''' (三分の加護 ''Sanbun no Kago''): This Divine Protection enables him and his siblings to bear each other's physical and emotional burdens and can also be used to split damage between them such as to block death blows. However, as Mimi is the strongest out of the three, her brothers are often stuck with bearing her burdens. In addition, they can launch a destructive interference wave using the Divine Protection and the other siblings, though Mimi is limited to five times and Hetaro and Tivey are limited to two times, so the maximum usage per day is four times. ===[[Magic]]=== Hetaro has the capacity to use water magic. ===Other=== [[File:Hetaro & Mimi - Resonance Wave.gif|thumb|250px|Hetaro uses the '''Roaring Wave''' against the [[White Whale]]]] '''Roaring Wave''' (咆哮波, ''Hōkōha''): The triplets unleash a burst of violent destructive [[mana]] from their mouths together. Only two of the three of them can do it at a time. This ability was learned from Ricardo as he is the originator of that ability. {{Clear}} ==Trivia== *Because Mimi is full of energy, the author decided to make her, Hetaro, and Tivey's birthday fall on Children's Day in Japan. *He is the wisest of the three siblings. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Kararagi Navbox}} [[Category:Banan]] [[Category:Anastasia Camp]] [[Category:Iron Fang]] [[Category:Mercenaries]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[de:Hetaro Pearlbaton]] [[es:Hetaro Pearlbaton]] [[fr:Hetarô Pearlbaton]] [[pl:Hetaro Pearlbaton]] [[pt-br:Hetaro Pearlbaton]] [[ru:Хетаро Перлбатон]] [[zh:角色:黑塔罗]]
