[[Reinhard van Astrea]] (son) |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = Holy Sword Astrea |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16|Volume 16]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 5 Chapter 5|Arc 5 Chapter 5]] |Anime = [[Episode 51]] |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kenjiro Tsuda|Tsuda Kenjiro]] |English Voice = }} '''Heinkel Astrea''' (ハインケル・アストレア) is the current Patriarch of [[House Astrea]] and the Deputy Commander of the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]]. He plays a supporting role in [[Arc 7]], [[Arc 8]], and [[Arc 10]], and an antagonistic role in [[Arc 5]] and [[Arc 9]]. Once a gentle and kind man, after his [[Louanna Astrea|wife]] fell into a coma, he turned into an alcoholic, causing him to neglect his [[Reinhard van Astrea|son]] and abuse his power as Deputy Commander. Sometime prior to Arc 5, he joined the [[Priscilla Camp]] in hopes that, if their camp won the [[Royal Selection]], he could gain access to the Dragon's Blood and save his wife. Following the disbandment of the Priscilla Camp, he became the knight of [[Filore]] and joined her [[Filore Camp|camp]]. ==Appearance== Heinkel is a muscular man with short red hair, blue eyes, and, initially, a stubble beard. He wears a black tabard with brown shoulder plates and chest armor, along with a dark cape, brown pants, gloves, and black boots, and he carries a sword at his hip. After later becoming Filore's knight, Heinkel's stubble is shaved, leaving a small beard on his chin. He also begins to wear vestments of the [[Divine Dragon Church]], which is comprised of a blue suit with golden lining and a white collar, similarly covered shoulder armor and bracers, white gloves, a dark blue cape held in place by a symbol of the church, a belt with a medallion hanging from it, and his sword hanging from his waist. ==Personality== When he is first introduced, Heinkel is shown to be a slovenly, arrogant, and brash man who outwardly has no care for what others think about him, is not ashamed to throw around his position to intimidate others for petty reasons, and is regularly seen drinking alcohol regardless of the time of day or the events taking place. He is quick to insult others and intentionally acts malicious for no reason, and he is fully aware that others despise him. Likewise, he appears to be a cowardly man who is willing to take hostages in order to ensure that extremely mighty figures, such as his son, will remain nearby and assure his own safety. Likewise, he is seemingly fully willing to use his son as a tool to maintain his position within the Royal Guard, while fully refusing to give up his title as the patriarch of House Astrea despite not caring to perform his responsibilities. Despite his rough attitude, Heinkel is actually typically heavily bitter and depressed, and he is more negative toward himself than to others, loathing his own personality and weaknesses. Likewise, he has always had the bad habit of fretting over things that could not be helped and that he would not have been able to do anything about even if he thought long and hard about it.''Fretting about things that could not be helped even if he thought long and hard about it, at scenes where he could not do anything about it even if he thought long and hard about it, was a bad habit Heinkel had carried since birth. It was a feeling akin to getting kicked in the back while being told that it was pointless.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 3. Despite currently being decently skilled with a blade, he does not find swinging his sword enjoyable, seeing it as a shackle.''He had no such memories of the sword ever being enjoyable to swing. For him, the sword had never been anything but a shackle that was heavier than it appeared.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 93, Section 2. He is also heavily fearful of those with great power, visibly freezing when forced to confront them. He has shown to be uncomfortable with taking other people's lives or seeing them taken in front of him, even if it is deemed necessary. Likewise, he is not very fond of hurting children and is reluctant to do so, even when said children are visibly and easily beating him within an inch of his life. When [[Al]] stated that there was no need to kill anyone during his [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|scheme]], Heinkel showed visible relief. Likewise, it has been noted by several people that despite his bitterness, he does consider the consequences of his actions, and according to [[Volcanica]], whose mind had been overwritten by Al, Heinkel is actually a decent person, as evidenced in how he always considers fear, and would never be like the many demented people that he has met. Despite this, he himself does not believe so, and he believes that his actions following [[Priscilla Barielle]]'s demise prove as such. He also becomes extremely hostile and defensive when someone pokes into the issues surrounding Heinkel and his family's predicament, and this hostility can become so great that Al was unable to prevent him from killing [[Felt]] several times for it. In the past, Heinkel was not always bitter and resentful. On the contrary, he was typically happy, and he both deeply respected the [[Royal Family]] and loved his family. He admired his father, [[Wilhelm van Astrea]], more than anyone else in the world, and looked up to his strength, power, and unwillingness to give up,''But, on the other hand, the adult whom Heinkel had admired more than anybody else in this world was a person who never let go of the sword until the very end of the end, cutting through even impossibility itself while never giving up on the things that he loved.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 2. even if he wasn't able to understand Wilhelm's teachings about the sword. He loved his mother, [[Theresia van Astrea]], who loved him dearly. His love for his wife, Louanna, filled his heart, and he was always fiercely protective of his son, Reinhard. However, things took a dramatic turn when Louanna was inflicted with Sleeping Beauty for unknown reasons related to Reinhard. Because of this, Heinkel regularly prayed at the Divine Dragon Church,''Heinkel was no exception to that, and that was precisely why when his wife fell into a slumber from which she never awoke, he began making frequent visits to the church, placing his belief in the house of prayer and miracle.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 3. and he looked into remedies for every recognized illness,''All the medicines listed there were ones he was familiar with, and he could also roughly imagine the conditions of the patients who were in need of them. ――Ever since his wife had fallen asleep, he had inquired into the remedies for every illness he could discover. Having made use of his privileged family status residing in the Royal Capital, Heinkel had a greater knowledge of medicine than the average healer.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 1. and he would jump at any opportunity he had to rescue her, even if they were rumors, such as a [[meteor]] that could "cure any illness". He became desperate enough that, despite having initially been called upon to challenge the [[White Whale]], aside from his fear in challenging it, he was more than willing to suggest his mother take on the role while he would be willing to effectively betray the Royal Family by sneaking into the [[Royal Castle]] and steal the [[Dragon]]'s blood in their stocks. Despite his desperation, this tremendously backfired, and his family was further broken apart. Because his mother was killed in the [[Great Conquest]], it caused his father to lash out at Reinhard, and Heinkel, who still cared for his son, decided to completely sever ties between them, not allowing the man to even apologize. Furthermore, because of his own failure and his own body's resulting near invincibility, his depression and desperation increased, and he stopped praying at the church, unable to face the Divine Dragon or its followers.''Regrettably, Heinkel’s prayers had borne no fruit, and he had gone on to commit a momentous transgression such that he could no longer bring himself to face the Divine Dragon or its followers. Since then, he had grown distant from the Church, hence why he could not help but scoff at how ill-suited his current position was.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 3. Likewise, his alcoholism intensified. Although he still loved his son and was willing to protect him from the [[Six Tongues]] in spite of the child's already tremendous strength, when Reinhard started acting as the [[Sword Saint]], Heinkel came to want to basically destroy the relevance of the title for his son's sake, so he started acting spitefully toward him as well, often throwing negative remarks and comments Reinhard's way. Over time, these fractures only deepened, and his bitterness and depression increased, and even though he hurled abuse towards even the [[Garitch Fabless|doctor]] meant to help cure his wife, he hit his lowest point after that doctor's murder. Furthermore, thanks to the [[Battle for Priestella]], the fractures in his family increased further with the battle against the [[undead]] Theresia serving as the catalyst, causing Heinkel to lash out even more harshly at both his father and son. Eventually, his desperation grew to the point of apparent opportunism, willing to join whichever group he had to find a cure and destroy the "Sword Saint", whether that be joining the Priscilla Camp or attempting to jump to [[Emilia]]'s [[Emilia Camp|camp]] after the former's demise. Likewise, even if it means completely betraying and making an enemy of the entire world, Heinkel would be willing to do it if there was a real chance of curing his wife. This being said, even though he is willing to take such actions, he is still shown to worry of his son, especially when he was forced to confront the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. Despite all of this, after he was retrieved by Filore and was convinced to become her knight, despite initially treating her with outward skepticism to make her reconsider her choice, Heinkel started to display pieces of his former kindness by properly advising Filore and scolding her when need be, and he believed that his becoming Filore's knight only served to shackle her, as he was fully aware of how he was perceived, something which he seems to feel regretful about.''"Don’t go bringing up my name each and every time. I’ll be blunt, but seriously, it will only get in the way of your campaign in the Royal Selection, Miss Filore."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 1.''To be perfectly honest, he was still regretting his decision. ――As expected, Heinkel should not have accepted the request of Filore, which could only be seen as delusional. Whenever he witnessed the attitude of his master, a girl who, while still clumsy, was earnestly taking part in the Royal Selection, more and more did he end up despising his own self, who served as naught but a hindrance to her ambitions. Doubly so if when considering that all the infamy he had accrued until now had been earned through his own volition.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 1. Likewise, he sympathized with the people who had to deal with Filore's decision to make him her knight, claiming that he'd react the same way as them.''"No, I heard it alright, and I sympathize with you all. Even though it’s probably already hard enough being Miss Filore’s attendant, being forced to take someone like me along too is, well…"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 2. Furthermore, despite internally complaining, he has shown willing to follow her lead when she acts carelessly, dealt with any of the extensive amount of paperwork as part of the responsibilities of being her knight, and, despite being fully aware of just how reckless her intentions were, even decided to help Filore when she was dead set on infiltrating the castle to help her friends. Later, despite being repeatedly beaten by [[Marcos Gildark]], who despised who Heinkel had become after his wife fell asleep, even though he was terribly afraid and did not want to fight, not only did he act to serve as Filore's shield, but, unconsciously, he also would not drop his sword, unable to give up despite his precarious and terrifying predicament.''"――Even after enduring all this, you still mean to draw your sword?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1.''While his right arm had been broken and shattered, while his face beaten and caved in, while his organs had burst open, and while bloody vomit and stool continued to spill out from him, his left hand, which he had kept protected till the end, had been attempting to draw his sword.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. ==History== ===Early Life=== Heinkel was born to his father, Wilhelm, and to his mother, Theresia. In his younger days, he was a much more earnest and kind man who seemed to have aspirations of becoming the next Sword Saint like his mother and worked quite hard. He fell in love with a woman named Louanna at first sight and sometime later the two had an arranged marriage. They had a son, Reinhard Astrea. However, things would soon begin to go awry for the Astreas, first with Louanna suddenly falling into deep sleep two years after Reinhard's birth and left in an inanimate state without any cure for such condition. He began to take up drinking alcohol during this time but still showed care for his other family members. On the night of the [[Royal Abduction Incident]], in which the daughter of [[Ford Lugunica]] was kidnapped, Heinkel committed an unspecified grave sin,''The Divine Dragon’s query had been in regards to Heinkel’s body. Of course, that was his own body. He was aware of its abnormality, and was also properly aware of the reasons for it. ――Among the many sins Heinkel had committed, this was punishment for an especially grave one.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 3, Section 2. having perpetrated an unknown betrayal and a terrible mistake that rendered said betrayal pointless,''The night of the incident, Heinkel had perpetrated an unforgivable betrayal, and the worst possible mistake that had made his betrayal meaningless. ――The divine punishment bequeathed, was Heinkel's current state.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 3, Section 2. the result being with Heinkel becoming doused in Dragon's blood and becoming an "immortal knight". In the time afterwards, when the White Whale appeared in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], Heinkel was requested to lead a group of men to eliminate it in a subjugation that would come to be known as the Great Conquest, but he refused. Theresia took Heinkel's place at his request, but she ended up dying. When Wilhelm returned from the search for Filore Lugunica, the kidnapped royal princess, he was as upset with Heinkel for his irresponsibility as he was with Reinhard for taking the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint from Theresia during the battle. However, Heinkel also chided Wilhelm for publicly blaming Reinhard for Theresia's death, and he refused to allow Wilhelm to see Reinhard, as Heinkel believed that he had no right to apologize to him. With Heinkel swearing to prove that Reinhard's acquiring the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint was not the cause of his mother's death, a rift was born in the Astrea family. Heinkel continued working for the Royal Guard, and Wilhelm left them and concentrated all of his efforts on slaying the White Whale to avenge Theresia. Heinkel inherited the estate and domain of House Astrea after this. Shortly after this, Heinkel lost a duel to a five-year-old Reinhard, resulting in unsavory rumors about the two's relationship which suggest that Reinhard was being treated like a slave. Over the years, he became a bitter alcoholic with such a deep hatred for himself that he started taking it out on the world around him. He began to admonish Garitch, Louanna's doctor, over the years, due to him not being able to cure Louanna. Soon after Garitch's murder by a resentful disciple of his, Heinkel fell into grief as a result of the doctor's death, realizing that nobody could treat his wife. ===[[First Mission After|First Mission]]=== Five years before the Royal Selection, while [[Reiner Wahrheit]]'s drug operation was running rampant, Heinkel was placed under house arrest on suspicion of aiding and abetting in the former knight's organization. In an attempt to clear Heinkel's name, Reinhard decided to crossdress and take up the identity of a young girl named Adelheid to infiltrate and bring down Reiner's organization. After Reiner and his collaborator, Count [[Minor Characters#Easley Oruon|Easley Oruon]], were incarcerated, the Commander of the Royal Guard, Marcos Gildark, came to notify Heinkel that the Council of Wise Men had decided to promote him to Deputy Commander, much to his bewilderment and vexation. That night, he went down to a bar in the Commoner District and encountered Reinhard there. Suspecting that Reinhard had pulled strings to get him promoted, Heinkel asked him if he had done so, which his son denied. Being reminded from Reinhard that accepting the position could help Louanna, he accepted his new role and told his son to join the knights when he turned fifteen. He then proceeded to return to Marcos to accept his appointment, unaware that Reinhard had conspired with the Six Tongues to prompt his promotion. Reinhard eventually joined the Royal Guard and would earn a reputation as the Knight Among Knights as he was told to, while Heinkel, dishonored, further languished and rotted in his own self-hatred, continued to grow more bitter, at some point ceasing calling his son by his name and instead calling him a brat or by his title of Sword Saint. ===[[Felt-chan Rises to the Center Stage]]=== In response to Reinhard's arrival to the castle, Heinkel entered the room that Felt was getting changed in, much to [[Carol Remendis|Carol]]'s anger and Felt's annoyance. Afterward, Carol informed Heinkel of Felt's reason being in the castle was for the Royal Selection, which he laughed at. Though Felt was ready to attack him, Heinkel stepped in front of her quickly and claimed that they were both in the same position before leaving. ===[[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Drunk Father Part]]=== A couple of months after the [[Sanctuary Incident|incident]] at the [[Sanctuary]], hearing of rumors of a meteor that could cure any ailment of the one who drinks out of it, Heinkel set out for a bandit den, and he slew all of the bandits there. However, this was in vain, as the cup turned out to be a sham. While here, he met Priscilla Barielle who offered to form an alliance of sorts with him so that in exchange for helping her take the throne, he would obtain the Dragon's Blood so that he could cure his sleep-bound wife, acting in opposition to Reinhard and Felt's efforts in the Royal Selection.[[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Drunk Father Part]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Although he will tremble and panic before the mass majority of powerful warriors, Heinkel is a strong fighter in his own right, capable of easily killing a den of bandits, an army of golems, or a horde of [[Dragon#Flying Dragons|flying dragons]]. Although his skill with the sword pales in comparison to his overpowered son and experienced war veteran father, Heinkel's abilities are such that he could fight against just about anyone and almost always survive, even if he doesn't win. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Expert Swordsmanship''': Despite being overshadowed by his more famous relatives, and his insecurity in his own abilities, Heinkel is still rather skilled with a sword. He was able to defend himself against Theresia's attacks, albeit for a short period of time, and easily dispatch assassins that outnumbered him,''Six corpses were lying there on the fluffy carpet inside Priscilla's room; and in front of these corpses, a red-haired man, Heinkel, was crossing swords with the last intruder.'' [[Priscilla-sama's Cheers for Me! Shadows of Conspiracy Part]], Section 3. with Al even commenting his swordplay could be described as beautiful. To further exemplify his sword abilities, he is capable of changing his stance and the way he attacks according to whichever enemy he faces,''The opponents were stone golems, and above not being able to dampen their fighting strength by merely cutting off their head or limbs, what was required more than a refined swordsmanship was to drive the opponent into a position where they could no longer do anything, an attack akin to that of a barbaric tribe. Changing his grip on his sword, he spread his legs wide and decided on a stance.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 93, Section 2. and it should be noted that Heinkel easily slaughtered an entire camp of bandits, slayed hordes of flying dragons, and handily dealt with [[Moguro Hagane]]'s golems.''A powerful sword roared, and mowing down the stone golems, it blew them away. It was a rough and violent slash that could hardly be described as brilliant. However, it was the most appropriate swordsmanship to use against the stone golems that needed to be destroyed in order to keep them suppressed. Swinging that sword and burying the onrushing horde of stone golems was a red-haired swordsman―― A man who she only knew as a follower of the proud and haughty Priscilla, Heinkel.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 93, Section 1. This being said, his personality inhibits him from being capable of performing the same level or feats as his other relatives, something which has resulted in Heinkel not receiving the title of van in his name. '''Supernatural Survivability''': After his failure on the night of the Royal Abduction Incident resulted in him being doused in Dragon's blood, Heinkel has become someone who is almost impossible to kill through ordinary methods or attacks; as described by Filore, this has turned him into an "immortal knight".''“――One from the lineage of Sword Saints who, upon conquering the Dragon’s Blood that washed over his body, was reforged into an immortal knight, Heinkel Astrea-sama: I wish to name him as my Knight.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 44]], Chapter 4, Section 5. His durability is such that he can withstand the strikes of incredibly powerful opponents, such as Priscilla, [[Madelyn Eschart]], Moguro Hagane, [[Groovy Gumlet]], the Cloud Dragon [[Mezoreia]], the Divine Dragon Volcanica, and Marcos Gildark, as well as blasts from weapons as powerful as the [[Meteor#Star Staff|Star Staff]], and not only take minor overall damage, but even stand up shortly after as if nothing had happened to him. Similarly, he is also seemingly immune to diseases or poisons, even if they come from a source as immediately lethal as the [[Black Serpent]]. Even standing upon its corrupted land and being swallowed by it, something that would kill others, including a witchbeast as strong as a [[Witchbeast#Guiltylowe|Guiltylowe]], in seconds, Heinkel was capable of not only surviving but also without any form of pestilence. So far, the only known way for Heinkel to die is through starvation.April 5, 2026 Talk Show. '''Enhanced Strength''': Heinkel has great physical might. He is able to lift trees without much effort, and when combined with [[Yae Tenzen|Yae]]'s steel wires, he was able to turn them into impromptu cannonballs. Likewise, he has enough leg strength to easily bound leap up to the top of [[Lupugana]]'s ramparts.''The stone golems standing directly opposite him, their formation was blown away from a sidewards sword slash, and trying to look at the imminent ramparts, he funneled power into his knees as he leaped towards them. Immediately taking hold of the ramparts, if he eradicated the enemies atop the wall, then the capture of the third bastion―― to be clear, it was not that he would slay some enemy General, so would it really be a contribution?'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 93, Section 2. '''Skilled Hand-to-Hand Combatant''': Even without using his sword, Heinkel carries enough skill that he can swiftly and easily bring down a pair of knights before they have time to react to him.''Ducking his knees to vanish from the opponent’s view, Heinkel grabbed Zeolle’s wrist, the latter’s eyes wide with shock, before slamming a thrust into his defenseless neck and robbing him of his voice. Heinkel swept Zeolle’s legs to knock him over as he cried a “Kah”, and then, faster than the remaining person could draw their blade in response, he wielded the hilt of his sword to strike their solar plexus, sinking them to the floor with a single counterplay.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 3. ===Intelligence=== '''Skilled Tactician''': Despite his usual demeanor, Heinkel is proficient in coming up with and preparing for plans. Although not usually seen, he used this in order to infiltrate the Royal Castle not just once, but twice.''"At minimum, half a month is needed to iron out a plan and make preparations. The guard shifts and patrol routes of the castle are also sure to be revised on a regular basis. We won’t be able to use the information you’ve gathered, Miss Filore. You don’t wanna be the fool who eats up all the outdated information and gets caught, now do you?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 1.''Just as Heinkel himself had estimated, the necessary preparations were completed across a span of half a month. A reason for entering the castle, a time frame with lighter security, a diversion to draw attention someplace else, the optimal route to reach the captive Felt and Emilia, the escape route to bring them out―― and, the avoidance of the one understood to be their greatest weakness if present in the Royal Capital. What started out as a reckless plan on paper, over half a month, became something feasible so long as they had the courage to entrust their fates to it. ――By some chance, the day happened to be exactly two months since Heinkel and Filore had sworn their oaths of lady and vassal.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 2. '''Pharmaceutical Knowledge''': Due to the predicament with his wife, Heinkel scoured over every conceivable way to cure her. As such, he has greater knowledge in this subject than the average healer does. ===Equipment=== *'''Holy Sword Astrea''' (聖剣アストレア, ''Seiken Asutorea''): Heinkel's sword was once given to him by his father who wielded it in his youth, receiving it as a wedding gift from his [[Veltol Astrea|father-in-law]].''“The name of the Holy Sword that Wilhelm used when he was young, and that Heinkel now carries, is also Astrea.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/947855966673842177 January 1, 2018 Q&A] ==Trivia== *Heinkel's birthday was a fan birthday decided during the 10th anniversary talk show held on April 20, 2022. *Heinkel was named by Veltol Astrea, his grandfather.''“It seems like he only came up with boys' names. I guess you could call it being dead set on that… That sort of stuff was rather like your honored Father.”'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Curtain's Close]], Section 6. *According to the author, if he were to write a story where Subaru wasn't the main character, he'd give the protagonist role to Heinkel.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/492255058567122945 AskFM Q&A] *Every year, Heinkel visits his mother's grave the day after the anniversary of her death, believing himself unqualified to visit on the day of. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Priscilla Camp]] [[Category:Filore Camp]] [[Category:Knights]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Arc 9 Antagonists]] [[de:Heinkel Astrea]] [[es:Heinkel Astrea]] [[fr:Heinkel Astrea]] [[pl:Heinkel Astrea]] [[pt-br:Heinkel Astrea]] [[ru:Хейнкель Астрея]] [[zh:角色:亨克尔]]

Michael Tatum|J. Michael Tatum]]}} '''Hector''' (ヘクトール) was the '''Valiant'''While Hector has not been explicitly stated to be the Valiant within the text, he is depicted in an illustration with Clind before the latter disclosed info concerning the Valiant and the Saintess, and the only person known to be called the Warlock of Melancholy and thus fits the criteria to be considered the Valiant is Hector. Furthermore, at a talk show held on July 26, 2026, Hector was stated to be the original holder of the Witch Factor of Melancholy. and the [[Witches of Sin#Warlock of Melancholy, Hector|'''Warlock of Melancholy''']]. A [[Witch#Supernumerary Witches|supernumerary Warlock]] who, along with the Saintess, was considered separate from the rest of the Witches, he consistently pursued [[Echidna]] for unknown reasons. As the reason for the [[Sanctuary]]'s creation, roughly 400 years ago, he pursued Echidna to the Sanctuary, where he swiftly defeated the original [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] and engaged with the Witch of Greed, with the outcome of their fight being unclear. ==Appearance== Hector had the look of a young man with a tall body and a slender frame. His long messy charred-brown colored hair was tied into a braid that trailed below his waist. His brown eyes had heavy bags under them that gave off the impression of a sickly person. Although he was described as appearing to be around twenty years of age,''He was around twenty years of age, had dark brown hair that was tied in the back, and possessed a slender figure with unhealthy, dark bags under his eyes.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 2, Section 8. as the effects of the [[Authority#Authority of Melancholy|Authority of Melancholy]] in users other than him could allow them to suspend their body from aging, it is unknown whether or not he did the same or if he even had the capacity to do so. His mouth was slightly puckered, and his cheekbones were fairly pronounced. The color of his face was poor, and his posture was crooked, which, when coupled with his worn eyes, gave the impression of someone who found it demanding to put on clothes and leave the house. Indeed, every part of Hector's demeanor portrayed lethargy and a general lack of vitality. Rather paradoxically, despite the lack of joviality conveyed by his attitude and posture. Contrary to his facial features however, Hector wore a rather colorful attire; that of a jester. Half of it was purple and half of it was white. The suit was extremely skinny, left his shoulders visible, and had a red and black tail on it. In the anime adaptation, he is shown to be surrounded by a purple distorted hue which somewhat resembles a force field. ==Personality== As the Warlock of Melancholy, Hector has a negative personality, frequently expressing his negativity in words. His manner of speaking is similar to Roswaal, who started to speak like Hector after getting beaten. Hector is stronger than Echidna, but despite that, his existence was left unknown for future generations to know. It should be noted that his mind was corrupted by his Witch Factor, so this personality may be different to what it was prior to the corruption. According to Beatrice, he was obsessed with Echidna due to a warped sense of love for her as her father.''“Subaru, it seems you’ve heard about it from Ryuzu, in fact. ――The Warlock of Melancholy, Hector, was a man who acted as a longtime enemy of Betty and Mother, and while we’re at it, Roswaal too, I suppose. He was obsessed with Mother, and tailed endlessly after her, in fact.”'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 2.''“You could say it was a warped sense of love, I suppose. But, it wasn't like he was head over heels for Mother, in fact. After all, Hector was Mother's father, I suppose.”'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 2. ==History== More than 400 years ago, Hector was known as the Valiant. Though it is unknown for what reason he bore this title, he willingly took in the Witch Factor of Melancholy, something which was tailor-made for his usage,''“To begin with, it is inconceivable that you, Petra, would be compatible with the Witch Factor of Melancholy. This Factor and one other, the Factor of Vainglory, are both unenumerated… no, supernumerary is the right word. These have each been fine-tuned to their respectively singular and uniquely compatible persons―― the Valiant and the Saintess. Tailored. They shall never be compatible with any other. Besides.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 3. and became counted as a supernumerary Witch Factor holder alongside the Saintess, [[Pandora]]. According to [[Clind]], however, despite being compatible with their respective Factors, the Valiant and the Saintess were unable to avoid the mental corruption that came with Witch Factors.''“Even they who were compatible, were unable to escape the corruption of their minds. Disgrace.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 3. By Roswaal's claim, even if Hector's way of life grew twisted, he chose to become the person he ended up being from his own limited choices, which he himself has affirmed. Hector was also once married, and his wife deemed it suitable to refer to him as a Warlock of Melancholy as a pet name, which stuck with him over time.''“The erstwhile owner… the one compatible with the Witch Factor of Melancholy, named himself as the Warlock of Melancholy. Self-named… no, named by another. That individual had no fixations towards any manner of address, but his wife simply deemed it would be suitable to call him as such and named him. Pet name.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 3. Hector and the Witch of Vainglory, Pandora, had a daughter together, that being Echidna.''“A Witch, I suppose. ――The Witch of Vainglory, Pandora, that is Mother’s mother, in fact.”'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 2. Hector and Pandora were responsible for her birth, having supposedly produced her with a specific goal in mind, that goal being unknown.''“That is a complexity unique to disorganized opinions. But, there are many holes in that logic. You claim I am off the mark, but my parents produced the existence known as myself for a purpose, and I produced the existence known as yourself for a purpose… in that case, you could say that I, who perpetuated the chain, am more malicious.”'' [[No Stella No Life 4]]. By Echidna's claim, she never learned anything positive from her parents, having only learned negative emotions such as contempt and ridicule from them. However, she believed that, from their perspective, her existence was a failed imitation to them.''“I have hinted at it many times now, but my parents were good-for-nothings. I learned many negative emotions, such as contempt and ridicule, from my parents. Though from their perspective, my very existence would have been a failed imitation, a result that they had not desired.”'' [[No Stella No Life 4]]. Later on, Hector began to pursue his daughter, Echidna, out of his obsession for her. During this period, he chased her down to Kugelschreiber Castle, and the ensuing conflict left the whole building in ruin.''“That would be correct, I suppose. Certainly, although Mother was not particularly skilled at tidying up, this was not a byproduct of that, in fact. ――This was the doing of the Warlock of Melancholy, I suppose.”'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 2. Eventually, Echidna was forced to flee to the Sanctuary located in the Kremaldy Forest. In order to prevent him from entering the Sanctuary, Echidna tried to create a magical barrier but failed, resulting in Hector successfully accessing the hiding place and facing off against Roswaal A. Mathers, swiftly defeating him without breaking a sweat. Just before delivering the finishing blow, Echidna intercepted him, saving Roswaal's life. The Witch and the Warlock clashed with the outcome of their fight being unknown, though both survived the ordeal. An unknown amount of time after this, Hector engaged in a battle with Roswaal and Clind.''He could say that he had not fought a battle like this since he had faced the Warlock of Melancholy alongside Clind.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 7. In the end, his Witch Factor of Melancholy was assumed by Clind, who took the role of its custodian. Sometime following this battle, Hector died.July 26, 2026 Talk Show ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Hector has at one point been called among the upper echelons of strength in the series by the author. Hector was incredibly powerful, capable of not only defeating a young Roswaal, but even requiring preparations to repel by someone of the caliber of the Witch of Greed. This being said, the full extent of his power is currently unknown. ===[[Authority]]=== '''[[Authority#Authority of Melancholy|Authority of Melancholy]]''' (憂鬱の権能 ''Yū'utsu no Ken'nō''): Hector was the previous wielder of the '''Witch Factor of Melancholy''' and could use its respective Authority. As the Valiant, Hector was compatible with the Factor of Melancholy, allowing him to unrestrainedly exercise its abilities until his death. Do you believe in gravity.gif|Hector using Authority of Melancholy to attack Roswaal. SWEAT.gif|Hector using Authority of Melancholy to negate Roswaal's magic. *'''Crushing Force Field''': Hector surrounds himself in an invisible force field that is able to crush both living things and magic alike. The more he closes his distance with the target, the stronger the damage is. As Hector himself seems to be the very center of this force field, the damage has the highest magnitude when in direct contact with him; by simply jabbing his finger into Roswaal's chest, he shattered his bones, completely crushed his chest and organs and twisted and crumbled his limbs, completely destroying the mage's body beyond repair.''He had suffered unhealed wounds during the battle with that Warlock, putting Roswaal's body into a state that made day-to-day life arduous.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Chapter 7, Section 2. *'''Long Range Force Field''': Hector also seems to be able to create force fields outside his reach by looking at a place or pointing his open palm towards it, as seen when he destroyed a hut in which [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu]] was hiding, several tens of meters away from where Hector was standing.''He looked toward the cabin Ryuzu was in-and without warning, it was crushed under the strain.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 2, Section 8. ==Trivia== *Like the Witches (with the exception of Satella), Hector's namesake matches both an asteroid and a mythological being. [[Wikipedia:624 Hektor|624 Hektor]] is the name of the largest Jupiter trojan, an asteroid that shares the planet Jupiter's orbit around the Sun. The mythological [[Wikipedia:Hector|Hector]] was a Trojan prince and hero in Greek mythology. *The author ranked Hector in the upper echelon in the story in terms of strength, though the full extent of his abilities remain unknown.''"But Hector is in the top strength class in the story, after all."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1362051122656120832 Season 2, Episode 20 Commentary] *Hector is the only known Warlock.''"Of course, there are no confirmed Warlocks other than this Hector of "Melancholy."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1362050031558164483 Season 2 Episode 20 Commentary] *The fact that the barrier of the Sanctuary was made to counter Hector implies that he may have been a [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] of some sort, though no conclusions have been made so far. *According to the author, Hector will make another appearance in the story, though he did not divulge any specifics. ==References== {{References}} ==Note== ==Navigation== {{Witch Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Unknown Race]] [[Category:Warlocks]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[Category:Arc 4 Antagonists]] [[it:Hector]] [[ru:Гектор]]

'''Ketty Muttart''' (ケティ・ムッタート) was a merchant and a member of the [[Witch Cult]].

==Appearance==
Ketty is a man with brown hair and green eyes.

==History==
Ketty is first seen at [[Arc 3]] as a merchant, He is the one that introduces [[Natsuki Subaru]] to a drunk [[Otto Suwen]], a merchant he is an acquaintance, Otto at the time was in desperate need to sell his oil and accepted Subaru's offer to take him to the Mathers Domain at the time.

Later on, it is revealed that he is one of the fingers of [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]], Subaru uses this knowledge to spread disinformation amongst the merchants, knowing that Ketty would fall for it and report incorrect info for the members of the cult. After he had fallen for Subaru's trick, he was arrested, the magic formula that allowed him to become a finger and explode upon a dangerous situation was removed by [[Ferris]] and he was taken in for questioning about Witch Cult activity, never to be seen again. The last mention of him was when Otto said that he was disappointed with Ketty after discovering he was a member of the Witch Cult. 

==Abilities==
'''Equipment''': Ketty carried a Conversation Mirror on his person to contact other members of the Witch Cult. Upon his arrest, his Conversation Mirror was confiscated.

==Trivia==
*In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], Ketty was killed by [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]]. However, in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9|Volume 9]], he survived the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], being taken captive and sent to the [[Royal Capital]] for questioning.

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17|Volume 17]] (main story) |Manga = |Anime = [[Episode 54]] |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Takaya Kuroda|Kuroda Takaya]] |English Voice = Chris Tergliafera }} '''Kurgan''' (クルガン) was a hero of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] who was regarded as its strongest warrior.''"However, his opponent was the Eight Arms Kurgan―― The War God who’d assumed the name of Strongest in the Vollachian Empire."'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 7]], Section 2. Debuting in [[Arc 5]], he played the role of a secondary antagonist, after the [[Witch Cult]] resurrected him as a [[Undead|corpse soldier]] and he was used as a pawn of the [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop of Lust]] to wreak havoc in the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]]. He was defeated by [[Garfiel Tinzel]]. During [[Stride Vollachia]]'s rampage across the Kingdom of Lugunica, in the years following the Demi-Human War, Kurgan acted as Stride's bodyguard, doing the dirty work for him. In that 1-year-span, he had two duels with [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] in a battle that would go down in history as the [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]]. Following Stride's and his own defeat, Kurgan was extradited back to the Empire, where he remained as a slave in the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]] until he died at the hands of [[Regulus Corneas]] while defending the city. ==Appearance== Kurgan was a giant who stood around seven feet tall and towered above most other people. His huge body was armored by thick, twisting muscles and his fists were said to be as large as a child's head. The trait that distinguished Kurgan as a member of the Many-Armed Tribe and earned him the legendary appellation "Eight Arms" was his eight powerful arms. His blue skin and black eyes gave the impression of a vengeful demon. The warrior's physical appearance and combat might bestowed Kurgan with a legendarily intimidating presence. Even the likes of the previous Sword Saint, [[Theresia van Astrea]], failed to suppress a shudder upon gazing at Kurgan for the first time. Reflecting his barbarism, Kurgan wore scant clothing. His ensemble consisted of a tattered black loincloth, black bracers on each forearm that had golden bracelets attached to their bottom hems, and black hosiery that covered his legs below the knees and had the same golden bracelets adorned at the bottom. Kurgan had various pieces of gold jewelry traipsing down his body, including his neck, face, and waist area. He has no shoes as he states that he prefers nature's ground. ==Personality== Kurgan had a rough and straightforward personality but spoke in a surprisingly sophisticated manner. He was also highly perceptive and seemed to have above average intelligence despite his otherwise brutish appearance. However, he was ever eager to battle strong opponents in order test his strength and go beyond his limits, thus Kurgan was never one to turn down a fight. He deeply admired the peak of martial arts mastery, such as the one that [[Reid Astrea]] once achieved, holding deep admiration for the "Heavenly Sword". He had a fascination with the darkness within Stride, this being the reason why Kurgan initially took an interest in him. Witnessing a dark emotion such as despair in an individual was enough to spur Kurgan to act in alignment with them. The emotions within Stride influenced Kurgan into taking on the role of his father, growing to unconditionally love and serve him in the wake of the devastation he brought with him. Despite the paternal care he bore for Stride, Kurgan possessed a corrupt, brutish mindset. He frequently taunted his enemies and was not above threatening their loved ones, at one point boasting to the Sword Demon during their first duel that he would kill him, abduct and impregnate his wife Theresia, and name his son with her after Wilhelm. ==History== Kurgan was born to the Multi-Arm Tribe. Despite their main characteristic of having more arms than normal, even in their tribe, having eight arms was unheard of. In his youth, Kurgan managed to raise his clan's status and protect their land from a Vollachian lord who sought to claim it, which marked the start of his world-renowned exploits. He rose in strength to become the Vollachia Empire's strongest warrior, achieving a legendary status tantamount to receiving an order of merit from the Vollachian emperor himself.  More than half a decade ago, Kurgan was given responsibility over Stride Vollachia, who was given up by his family due to his frail constitution. Kurgan felt jubilated at seeing the darkness within the boy's eyes, growing to care for him and eventually considering himself Stride's foster father. While attempting to participate in the Imperial Selection Ceremony, an unknown culprit poisoned Stride with a powerful poison, causing Stride to drift between life and death for three arduous and agonizing months. When Stride beat his illness, he awoke to tell Kurgan that he saw entities known as the Observers in the heavens, toying with people as if they were mere pieces on a board. At that moment, Kurgan determined that he would not obey the Vollachia Empire that sought Stride's death, choosing instead to prioritize the love that he, as a father, felt for his foolish son. From then on, [[Shasuke]], [[Raizo]], and [[Melinda]], the other three who came to pledge themselves to Stride, all walked together to see where the Destruction Wish would arrive at. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]]=== Approximately forty years prior to the start of the story, aiming for Sword Saint, Stride used the gift of [[Veltol Astrea]] as an excuse to meet with him in the Suwen Company in [[Picoutatte]], where he openly insulted him and his daughter. With Veltol challenging him to a duel, he claimed to be unable to fight due to his illness, which Theresia had noticed, and he decided to have Kurgan act as his champion. Further antagonizing the two with insults to them and Theresia's husband, Veltol struck him, leading to his brutal beating by Kurgan and being cursed by Stride. Leaving [[Yaktol Suwen]] with a message that he would be waiting at a great bridge in the city's west district with the source of the curse, he left. The next morning, he met with Theresia and Wilhelm, who challenged him to a duel. Despite being irritated that the rumors he heard regarding her award ceremony were true and that Wilhelm had equivalent battle aura to Kurgan, the duel ensued. Despite this, both sides took great damage, and seeing that he was in danger of losing his pawn, he stopped the duel and claimed it their loss, tossing his ring to them, and using another to turn the bridge beneath them into sand, allowing him and Kurgan to escape. Sometime later, the two arms that were severed during this fight were reattached. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]=== He was eventually defeated once more by Wilhelm in the city during the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]] and lay dying on the streets of Picoutatte until [[Volcanica]]'s miracle healed him. Having been the only survivor of the Stride Faction, Kurgan was then extradited back to the Vollachia Empire and reduced to a mere slave in the Fortified City of Garkla, willingly accepting this fate despite having the power to resist. ===[[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Finale of the Eight Arms|Finale of the Eight Arms]]=== Decades later, Kurgan was involved in the defense against Regulus Corneas's rampage in Garkla. He was initially ordered along with his fellow laborers to attack the Sin Archbishop by an Imperial Soldier supervising them. Defeated with just a single attack and having no will to fight back, he was spurred to act by the voice of [[Vincent Vollachia|a young prince]] whose desperation reminded him of his foster son's. Gathering the motivation to prevent the prince from dying, he was granted his old arms of choice, Demon Cleavers, which happened to be in Garkla, and took up arms against the Sin Archbishop of Greed. Although the Fortified City fell in just a single hour, without the intervention of Kurgan, who singlehandedly impeded Regulus's path, allowing the city's survivors to be evacuated in time, it would have fell in half that time. His final word being the same commendation he had offered twice to the Sword Demon in Picoutatte, he met his end as Regulus delivered a speech that fell on deaf ears. In commemoration of Kurgan's achievement at Garkla, the prince exhausted all efforts to restore Kurgan's reputation, and successfully managed to do so after enough time, with his Demon Cleavers being restored and put on display on the uppermost floor of Garkla's Great Fortress. ==Abilities== [[File:Kurgan - Master Swordsmanship.gif|thumb|right|250px|Kurgan demonstrating his swordsmanship against Garfiel Tinzel.]] '''Master Swordsmanship''': As noted by Theresia, she saw Kurgan as an enemy that was far, far stronger than the usual crop with swordsmanship that rivalled Wilhelm's. His sword strikes can create a fierce gale, which raged at tremendous speeds. '''Enhanced Physicality''': Kurgan has a powerful body that is both incredibly strong and tough to damage. With just his physical strength as a corpse soldier, he was able to easily overwhelm Garfiel, and in life, by simply flexing his muscles, he was able to halt bleeding from missing limbs. A single one of his strikes, with or without his blades, is enough to deal massive damage to his opponents and cause severe internal injuries. Likewise, even in the face of losing his limbs, Kurgan is unflinching, acting essentially unbothered after losing two of his arms in combat. '''Equipment''': Kurgan wielded four large greatswords that required even Kurgan to use two hands to wield, and he called them his '''Demon Cleavers''' (鬼包丁). They were his favorite weapons, but two of them were later destroyed by Wilhelm during their duel. Despite this, all four weapons seemed to be in perfect condition by the time of the [[Battle for Priestella]]. '''Great Power''': By mastering and taking full advantage of his body's unique features and developing techniques to suited it, Kurgan became one of the strongest fighters of the Vollachia Empire. He was easily able to parry and deflect blows from a [[Valgren|Dragon]]. As a corpse soldier, however, despite retaining incredible strength, it was but a shadow of his former self, compared back to when he was still alive,''“Before that moment, the skill of her sword was false… were it not, if I had truly fought my wife in her prime, there would be no way that I at my age would have returned alive. And I can say the same for Kurgan.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 21]], Interlude, Section 4. to the point that Wilhelm gauged he would have easily killed Garfiel if he had been at his complete strength in life.''“Neither you nor I. I would be a corpse, and you would be naught but hunks of flesh scattered about. That is the truth.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 21]], Interlude, Section 4. ==Trivia== *Among Garfiel's idioms is one that includes Kurgan: "Kurgan felled his foes even if it meant losing his arms."''"――Hk, ‘s nothin’! “Kurgan felled his foes even if it meant losin’ his arms”, ya know! My amazin’ self can’t keep bein’ so hesitant either!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 16, Section 3. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Stride Faction]] [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Corpse Soldiers]] [[Category:Arc 5 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

He is the last survivor of Priestella's Council of Ten. Though initially making his debut in a side story, Kiritaka played a passive, yet rather strong supporting role throughout [[Arc 5]]. ==Appearance== Kiritaka has pale gold hair that's carefully smoothed toward the back of his head. He has a tall and thin body and wears well-tailored clothes with a limited number of adornments which make him look refined. ==Personality== As one of the major merchants of Priestella, Kiritaka has a sense of dignity and self-worth, and is shown to be educated based on his words and actions. He is skilled as a merchant, making him constantly busy. Every morning, he uses the broadcast [[Meteor|meteors]] in the city center building to broadcast in order to let the citizens know that it would be used in emergencies. Kiritaka has a strange obsession with younger girls and puts emphasis in whether a woman looks young rather than their actual age or mentality. Currently, he claims that his heart has been stolen by [[Liliana Masquerade]] and tends to get out of control when things involve her, such as the time he attacked [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] when he saw him with conversing with her. Despite this, Kiritaka is shown to have honorable qualities, as when the [[Witch Cult]] attacked his company during the [[Battle for Priestella]], he was intent on sacrificing himself to let [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]] escape. ==Abilities== '''[[White Dragon's Scales]]''' (白竜の鱗, ''Hakuryū no Uroko''): Kiritaka hired a mercenary group, known as the White Dragon's Scales, to be his personal bodyguards. The group consists of highly skilled individuals, who are more than capable of protecting Kiritaka, when needed. During the fight with the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]], most of the members had their names eaten and were put in suspended animation, with [[Dynas Trussardi]] and some others managing to escape the same fate. Following Lye's death, it's unknown if they have already regained their names. '''Leadership''': Although normally a merchant, Kiritaka has shown to be an excellent leader, which has allowed him to rise up to the Priestellan Council of Ten. Despite being the only member active throughout the Battle for Priestella due to the deaths of the others, he quickly responded to the Witch Cult’s attack by leading everyone to shelters and deciding to make use of his company as both a medical station and the temporary headquarters of the resistance. Likewise, he had the foresight to have everyone moved after a short period of its use to counter a surprise attack. ==Trivia== *Despite behavior demonstrated during the story, the author claims Kiritaka is only pretending to be a lolicon and just genuinely likes Liliana.''"Kiritaka pretends to be a lolicon, but in fact, he is a gentleman when he sees Petra, because he genuinely likes Liliana."'' [[Manga Love Song Prologue|Love Song Prologue]]}} '''Grimm Fauzen''' (グリム・ファウゼン) is a servant for [[House Astrea]] alongside his wife, [[Carol Remendis|Carol]], and he is the former second and final Deputy Commander of the [[Royal Army#Zergev Squadron|Zergev Squadron]]. He played a primary supporting role in the [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]]. Born to a commoner family, Grimm is a knight of great experience, having fought alongside [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] in his youth during the [[Demi-Human War]]. As a result of his achievements both during the war and in the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]], Grimm received the title of a Great Knight, married Carol, and started his servitude to the Astreas, remaining a steadfast follower for decades. ==Appearance== In the past, Grimm Fauzen wore the standard outfit and armor of the [[Royal Army]] and wielded a shield. He was a man with short, messy purple hair, and dark yellow brown eyes. Having suffered burns in his youth during the war, he has burn scars on his hands and wrists. In the present, Grimm is an old man and is shown to have a scar on his throat due to an injury he got during the Demi-Human War. He has short white hair, a strong jawline, a white beard, and sharp eyes. He appeared wearing a pretty and chic butler outfit, similar to that of Wilhelm van Astrea. It is mentioned that he aged better than his beloved Carol Remendis. ==Personality== Grimm is a strong-willed man, shown to be extremely stalwart and loyal to the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]]'s Army. He placed great faith in others to act as the sword, whilst he acted as their shield. Despite that, he was quite a jocund person, who was easy to get along even on the brink of disaster. When adversity affected his loved one, Grimm was shown to be less easy-going, and in continuous blame of himself for the situation that had occurred. As he grew older, Grimm became more serious, and after marrying Carol Remendis, he swore absolute loyalty to the Astrea family. In his younger days, Grimm, having grown up in a small town, was somewhat idealistic and sought excitement that his small town could not offer, and as such, he became independent as he became of age. He also sought glory and to become a hero, which, in place of patriotism, is what initially inspired him to join the Royal Army when they were recruiting during the Demi-Human War. However, following his survival during his first [[Battle of Redonas Plateau|battle]] and his multiple near-death experiences, Grimm became realistic and shed himself of those dreams, knowing that neither dreams nor facing reality were not what fills a person's stomach. Despite his attitude, he decided to keep with the army, filled with the trauma of the deaths and cries of his allies. This being said, thanks to his interactions with Wilhelm, which at first were rocky, he was able to overcome his trauma and push forward. Due to a throat wound inflicted on him during the Demi-Human War, Grimm temporarily lost the ability to speak. Later, he began communicating more from his expressions and through paper, though he can still talk in brief intervals. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== Grimm was born in a small village called Fleur, situated north-east of the [[Royal Capital]]. When he was fifteen, Grimm moved out of Fleur out of boredom and into the Royal Capital to become independent, and for the next few years, he worked at several shops and taverns, performing menial work. One day, the Royal Army sought new recruits to join the army in an effort to fight in the Demi-Human War. Wishing to become a hero and attain glory, Grimm joined the army, where he met [[Tholter Weasily]] and was trained alongside him and the other knights by the commander, [[Razak Gildark]]. Six months after he joined, Grimm participated in his first battle, the Battle for Redonas Plateau, where a noble had also sought to make a name for himself. However, soon after the battle began, he, alongside many others in Grimm's unit, were all quickly killed. Having barely survived by being just outside the blast and being blown away, Grimm ran away, and he encountered a violet-skinned demi-human. As he was facing death, however, he was saved by the arrival of Wilhelm Trias, who easily beheaded him. Grimm, wanting to survive, followed after him, and he bore witness to the mountain of corpses that Wilhelm had created. Shortly after, the army signaled their victory, due in no small part to Wilhelm's efforts. His experience here greatly changed his beliefs, and instead of resigning in fear or clinging to his dreams, he remained in the army to keep himself fed, and soon after, Wilhelm was adopted into his squad. After sharing drinks with his comrades and returning to the barracks early, he found Wilhelm training behind the barracks. After a short conversation with Wilhelm, who claimed that he didn't understand how the others couldn't devote themselves to their training instead of pleasures and calling Grimm a coward for making excuses, Grimm left to sleep, and in the following days, he continued to mask his trauma. Shortly after this, the Royal Army was baited into Castour Field, where they found themselves handily dealing with the demi-humans that they had struggled with prior. While Wilhelm was cutting down his enemies and bringing awe to friend and foe alike, both he and Grimm, who was protecting Tholter with his shield as he fired his arrows, had a bad feeling. It wasn't long after that their premonitions came true and the earth shook through magic, causing chaos among the army. Realizing the plot, Wilhelm moved forward to fight his enemies while the others retreated, much to his chagrin. Grimm, having dropped his sword, chased after him to bring him back, and along the way, he damaged a magic circle. After speaking with Wilhelm, who appeared and dispatched an attacking demi-human, he was told what the idea, crafted by [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]], was meant for and that retreating was part of the trap. Despite Grimm's misgivings, Wilhelm continued to fight, and Grimm chased after him. Witnessing his carnal display against his enemies, Grimm called him the Sword Demon. Soon after, a massive cry from his allies could be heard as they fell for the trap, and Grimm was left sobbing for his decision. That day, the [[Battle of Castour Field]] ended in the army's defeat. After being taken back by the rest of the army and given treatment, Grimm and Wilhelm joined the Zergev Squadron, with Grimm becoming akin to [[Pivot Arnancy]]'s shadow. With the great defeat at Castour Field, the Kingdom decided to call in the [[magic]] specialist [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] to analyze the magic circles used. On the way there, Grimm and Wilhelm argued about when the latter called him a coward for his trauma, and before long, alongside the rest of the squadron, they arrived at Castour Field, where they officially met Roswaal and her bodyguard Carol. After once again getting into an argument with him, he, Wilhelm, and a few other members of the squadron moved on as a group to the magic circle. Along the way, he kept Carol company so that there would be any problems with Wilhelm. After arriving and allowing Roswaal to check the circle, after she claimed it would be a threat to the Kingdom, Grimm had a bad feeling that he thought Wilhelm might share. That feeling turned out to be correct when the undead Tholter fired arrows at them and corpse soldiers began rising. Covering Roswaal alongside Carol, Wilhelm went to fight the undead, where he met [[Sphinx]]. With Roswaal intending to join the fight, furious, Sphinx decided to retreat, leaving everyone to clean up the undead. With some help from Roswaal, Wilhelm realized that Tholter was the main corpse soldier to defeat, and after giving him the push he needed to overcome his trauma and fight, Grimm ran forward and put his old friend to rest. Though still fearful, after a conversation with Carol shortly after the fight, he fell in love with her. Afterward, meeting up with the commander [[Bordeaux Zergev]] and Pivot, Roswaal relayed Sphinx's identity and the threat she bore. Later, he, Wilhelm, Roswaal, Bordeaux, and Pivot all reported to the Kingdom's officials, including [[Miklotov McMahon]], about the threat. For the next three years, Grimm and the rest of the Zergev Squadron, as well as Roswaal and Carol at times, fought in some of the most dangerous battlefields of the war, where they both lost and obtained new members of the squadron. At one point, Grimm alleviated her fears in regards to both Wilhelm and her [[Theresia van Astrea|master]], and afterward, she offered to train him with his shield. Over time, the two would regularly meet so that Carol could train him, and his relationship with Carol also grew. One day, the squad was set to go to Aihiya Swamp, where Valga, [[Libre Fermi]], and possibly Sphinx were. Speaking with Wilhelm, they compared this to Castour Field, with Roswaal confirming his suspicions that their superiors took this into consideration. Carol appeared soon after, and as she spoke with Grimm, she gave Grimm a locket as a good luck charm. Soon after, they met their new commander, [[Leip Barielle]], who struck Wilhelm for being disrespectful. Roswaal managed to pacify the man, and they walked away alongside Carol. With Wilhelm abating any concern for him, conversation soon turned to the locket Grimm received, in which was a flower that was given to Carol by her master. Not noticing Wilhelm's surprise, the squad soon moved to Aihiya Swamp. During the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], Grimm fought alongside the rest of the Zergev Squadron as the fighting progressed, soon deciding to move toward the center of the fighting to remove the root of the war itself. There, they came across Libre, who challenged Wilhelm to a duel. Although putting up a good fight, Libre was able to corner Wilhelm and push him back, and in response, Grimm, Bordeaux, and Pivot surrounded Libre to cut him off. However, they were all put under the effects of a wide spanning magic circle, left at the mercy of the demi-humans. With Libre pointing his blade at Bordeaux, Wilhelm attempted to fight him off, only for Libre to nearly kill him. Pivot, instead, jumped in the way of his blade, and as he lay on the ground, he yelled at everyone not to let Wilhelm die, rousing them to take arms against Libre. However, they were all nearly slaughtered, and Grimm, who was able to defend himself for longer than the others, sustained a wound to his throat. Before he could be finished off, Wilhelm pounced Libre and fell into away from the others. With Pivot dying in Bordeaux's arms, he soon revived as an undead and attempted to strangle Bordeaux. However, the barely conscious Grimm managed to push him away, allowing Bordeaux to put him to rest. After this, the army retreated, with Grimm managing to survive his terrible wound, unable to speak. Within the month that followed, Grimm remained in the Royal Treatment Center. Though he met with Bordeaux once, he was unable to speak with him again since the man found himself busy. Carol visited him and apologized profusely for allowing this to happen, leading to their kiss and their becoming lovers. During one of her later visits, she gave Grimm a new shield as a present for surviving the battle. Later on, because of Carol's insistence, Wilhelm came to visit him, somewhat surprising Grimm. During their conversation, in which Grimm used writing to communicate, after he said that Bordeaux had clearly changed, much to his frustration, Wilhelm questioned why everyone gave their lives for him and why Grimm sacrificed his voice. Grimm responded to him by claiming that his ideals and sword were the squad's as well and that he represented hope. Despite being envious of his abilities and will to push forward where other can't, that was the reason he could not be allowed to die. Afterward, Grimm thanked him for his actions when Tholter had risen as an undead when Wilhelm gave him the push he needed. After returning to duty, uprisings began across the country. With the rebuilt Zergev Squadron wondering where they should go, Wilhelm realized that their enemies were targeting the castle, and Grimm backed him up. Trusting his judgment, Bordeaux led everyone to the castle, and with assistance from Roswaal and Carol, they were allowed into the castle. Shortly after arriving inside, Bordeaux left for the audience chamber while Wilhelm's group left for the chapel. After meeting with Valga and Sphinx, Wilhelm decided to handle Valga while the others chased after Sphinx. The group managed to corner her with Roswaal's techniques and Carol's midair combat, and Grimm even managed to deflect one of her strongest attacks thanks to the shield. After the appearance of Bordeaux and Libre thanks to this, Libre cut off Sphinx's other arm before fading away, and Sphinx ran away, followed by Roswaal. The others went to help Wilhelm, who eventually managed to defeat Valga. In the following year, Wilhelm became much friendlier with everyone, and he would also start sharing drinks with Grimm, even teasing him about his relationship with Carol, while Grimm found it amazing about his changes. However, after Wilhelm left to go save his lands in the [[Battle of the Trias Domain]], Grimm, Theresia, and the rest of the Zergev Squadron made their way to save him. After this, Wilhelm would not be seen with the army until after the Demi-Human War was over. In this time, Grimm received a home of his own, where Carol would often visit. During the ceremony to award the Sword Saint, Grimm attended and bore witness to the battle between Wilhelm and Theresia, and after witnessing his victory and his kissing Theresia, he and the other members of the Zergev Squadron reunited with him. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]]=== After Theresia dragged Wilhelm to her mansion and forced him to take a bath, he spoke with Carol and Grimm, the former of which lashed out at him, and he learned of her position as Theresia's attendant. After this, they informed him that he was unemployed, leading him to finding a way to rejoin. Later, upon Carol and Grimm's return to the mansion, Carol chided Wilhelm for upsetting Theresia and went to speak with her while Wilhelm and Grimm finished all of the food that Theresia prepared. The next day over breakfast, Carol warned him not to do anything that would upset Theresia. The day after that, Wilhelm found himself face to face with the best warriors the country had to offer, including Bordeaux, Carol, and Grimm. With Gionis and Miklotov overseeing the battle, Wilhelm fought and defeated all forty soldiers. However, after Theresia arrived and chided the king for allowing this, it was revealed that she would have been let go of her position if she married Wilhelm, much to everyone's but the king and Miklotov's shock. Wilhelm accepted this, and they embraced, Theresia calling him Wilhelm van Astrea. Three months later, [[Veltol Astrea]] used his authority to move the Zergev Squadron to patrol the towns around the capital, despite there being only three days before Wilhelm and Theresia's wedding. After Wilhelm joined up with Grimm and the rest of the squadron, who all wanted to wrap up the patrols as quickly as possible to let Wilhelm make it in time for his wedding, Bordeaux and Theresia, who had made him food for the journey, saw them off. Though they intended to pass quickly through the towns on Fleur, Millgray, Bonobo, and Cramlin, they faced a setback in Fleur due to Grimm's homecoming for the first time since he joined the army. Despite this, they managed to pass quickly through Millgray and Bonobo, but on the day before Wilhelm's wedding, the squad was tasked with finding the missing children in Cramlin. Though they found them inside the Nest of the Earth Serpent, a cave network beneath Mount Cordor, Wilhelm, Grimm, and the last child were all caved in. Trying to find their way out, the kid, who had passed out, eventually awoke and provided the two with a lagmite crystal, providing them light. However, shortly after, they were set upon by the Earth Serpent, a large earth sandworm. Being forced to confront it, Grimm, who was only able to block one of its strikes, was tasked with taking the kid and running while Wilhelm held it off. Grimm eventually found a hole for the kid to pass through and had him inform the rest of the squad of his location. Afterward, he signaled Wilhelm to rush back to him, where a trap was waiting and triggered when the giant worm punched a hole into the outside world, where the rest of the squadron was waiting, and they successfully killed it. With it being the morning of the day of the wedding, everyone quickly rushed to return back to the capital, [[Conwood Melahau]] and the others feeling guilty for failing to recognize her as a regular girl during their time with her and saying that Theresia should not be on the altar alone, deciding to postpone their after-action report. Though unable to clean themselves or change, they managed to return in time, and afterward, he attended his wedding. With Veltol entrusting her to him, Wilhelm and Theresia were finally married. As the two prepared to leave, Theresia tossed the bouquet to Carol, leaving her flustered. Grimm took this chance to pull her in, take the bouquet, and hold it in the air, showcasing that he and Carol would be next. ===[[Felt-chan Forms a Hooligan Squad]]=== Felt sat with the trio of thugs to discuss with them, and after some talk and a bit of resistance from them, she eventually convinced them to help destroy the country, as she thought they had similar views to her. Later on at night, Reinhard had a secret meeting with Grimm and Carol, commenting how the events that transpired confirmed that his choice to follow Felt was the correct one and that he felt a little guilty that he would use her to make the Astrea family name rise to glory again. Changing the main subject, the old lady asks if they really should allow their master to get near Reinhard's mother, as they feared what could come of the encounter. Reinhard stated that he cannot deny him this, as it was his right, and he mentioned that he would soon leave with Felt to take care of other matters, thanking the both of them for everything they had done. ==Abilities== '''Powerful Instincts''': Aside from his skill with the shield, one of Grimm's most notable traits is his ability to sense danger. According to Grimm, he gets a feeling of fear on the nape of his neck when danger is near. His instincts are the main reason that he has managed to defend himself and survive hopeless situations, such as the Battle of Castour Field. In fact, his ability to sense danger is superior to Wilhelm's, getting bad feelings when Wilhelm initially couldn't until the danger was already at his feet, and this had led to Wilhelm trusting this feeling as something that signifies true danger. '''Equipment''': *'''Great Shield''': Grimm's primary weapon of choice is a large shield with the crest of [[House Remendis]] engraved on it. The shield was given to him by Carol Remendis during the Demi-Human War. He displayed great skill with it, even being capable of deflecting attacks from Wilhelm, an Al Jiwald fired by Sphinx, and even an attack from an Earth Sandworm. His skill with the shield allows him to evenly match the skills of Carol while being manipulated without hurting her. The shield he wielded before this bore the symbol of the Kingdom's flag on it. *'''Sword''': Although he wasn't very effective with it and was considered hopeless with it, Grimm wielded a standard sword in his first few battles. ==Trivia== *In the Comic Alive release of [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 4]], Grimm was said to have been "gifted with a divine protection that allowed him to sense danger". Despite this, Grimm does not actually have a Divine Protection, and any reference to this line was removed in the Ex 6 release. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Knights]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Butlers]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Zergev Squadron]]

Noble |Previous Occupation = Minister |Status = Unknown (presumably deceased) |Relatives = |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|Ex Volume 4]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Gramdart Holstoy''' (グラムダート・ホルストイ) was a High Count and a former minister of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He was one of the main antagonists of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]], where he targeted Emperor [[Vincent Vollachia]]'s life, stole the secret imperial flying dragon tamer technique, and fled the nation. Following his capture, Gramdart was escorted back to the Empire by [[Cecilus Segmunt]] and [[Chisha Gold]] due to his treason. ==Appearance== Gramdart is described to be a middle-aged man. ==Personality== Gramdart was a greedy and ambitious man who allegedly wanted to steal the emperor's throne for himself. He was also mentioned to have stolen the secret Imperial flying dragon taming technique, which would cause great trouble for the entire Empire. Gramdart was also a coward at heart, avoiding a direct confrontation with Vincent at all costs, and fleeing the Empire after his plans were foiled. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly half a year before the start of [[Royal Selection]] in [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]], Gramdart, alongside [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], conspired against the seventy-seventh emperor of the Vollachia Empire, Vincent Vollachia. After his plan ended in failure with Balleroy's death, Gramdart faked his own suicide to serve as a cover for his escape into the neighboring Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. Trying to achieve diplomatic immunity by giving an unspecified souvenir (likely the aforementioned Imperial secret) to the [[Six Tongues]], Gramdart secluded himself in the heart of the kingdom. Not long after, his men spotted Cecilus Segmunt in the [[Royal Capital]], which caused Gramdart to hire fourteen thugs ([[Ton]], [[Chin]], and [[Kan]], among others) to tail the Divine General; however, the group was swiftly dispatched by him. Naturally, it didn't take long for Cecilus to locate Gramdart himself. Slaughtering his guards with ease, Cecilus was about to take Gramdart's head off; however, Chisha Gold intruded just in time to prevent his death. The two Divine Generals then restrained the High Count and took him back to the Empire to be granted punishment for his treason. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Unknown Status]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]
