wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Relationships |tab3 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Groovy Gumlet |Image = Groovy Gumlet Without Sample.jpg |Kanji = グルービー・ガムレット |Romaji = Gurūbī Gamuretto |Alias = Sixth (陸, ''Roku'')
Master of Curse Tools (呪具師, ''Jugushi'') |Race = Hyena Human |Gender = Male |Hair Color = Brown |Eye Color = Brown |Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]]
[[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] |Occupation = Fifth of the Nine Divine Generals |Previous Occupation = Sixth of the Nine Divine Generals |Status = Alive |Weapon = Various |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|Ex Volume 4]] (side story)
[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35|Volume 35]] (main story)}} '''Groovy Gumlet''' (グルービー・ガムレット) is the '''Fifth ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]'''In [[The Land of Nascent Wolves / The Magnificence of the Eminent Emperor of Vollachia 2]] side story, all of the remaining Divine Generals who had not been killed or retired were claimed to receive a promotion except for Groovy. Considering there has been no statement of his removal from the Nine Divine Generals and the fact that his previous position as the Sixth ranking Divine General has been filled by someone else, it can be assumed that Groovy has been promoted to the only vacant spot ranking above sixth, which was the fifth. of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He played a major supporting role in [[Arc 8]], and he also played a small antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]. ==Appearance== Groovy has a small body covered with brown fur with black spots and whiskers on his face. He has cream-colored fur on his chest, his muzzle, and on the tip of his tail. Groovy also wears numerous belts across his body, which he uses to carry his weapons. For defense, he wears a bronze left breastplate and a small shoulder plate on his left shoulder. In addition, Groovy dons both a yellow scarf around his neck and dark olive-green toeless leather pants. ==Personality== Despite his small stature, Groovy is a hothead who speaks in a rather vulgar manner and is very short-tempered. He is loyal to the [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]] and has a sense of camaraderie with his allies, including other Divine Generals like [[Balleroy Temeglyph|Balleroy]] and [[Moguro Hagane|Moguro]]. Despite his temperament, he is not above apologizing to others when he is in the wrong. In his free time, Groovy restores old buildings or ruins with historic value and tended to the gardens of the [[Lupugana#Locations|Crystal Palace]] before its destruction. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly four to five months before [[Arc 1]], a rebellion in Vollachia was started by [[Gramdart Holstoy]] and Balleroy Temeglyph. Together, Groovy and Moguro Hagane were dispatched from the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]] by [[Goz Ralfon]] to retrieve the emperor, Vincent Vollachia, while [[Cecilus Segmunt]] left on his own accord to accomplish the task. Vincent was kidnapped by [[Reinhard van Astrea]], [[Julius Juukulius]], and [[Ferris]], then in the Empire to negotiate a non-aggression pact alongside Council of Wise Men members [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]]. Although Moguro initially took Ferris captive, the Sword Saint later freed him and began turning the tables against the two generals, which allowed for the other two knights to escape with Vincent. Groovy and Moguro were later forced to retreat from Reinhard due to his sheer power, and after running to Cecilus, Reinhard was given a chance to render the Blue Lightning unconscious, forcing the pair into submission and causing them to fall back with the unconscious general. After the rebellion was quelled, Groovy met with Vincent in Lupugana's Crystal Palace alongside Moguro, Goz, and [[Chisha Gold]], where they discussed the incident. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As one of the Nine Divine Generals, Groovy is impressively strong. Although he is aware that he cannot compete with his fellow generals in terms of their respective specializations, his particular strength comes from not only his assortment of weapons, but his sheer willful dedication and methods by which to kill his enemies.''――Groovy excelled in his relentless dedication and method of killing his opponents.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. In fact, in the words of [[Eugard Vollachia]], Groovy is stronger than all of the Nine Divine Generals of his own era.''“――Stand tall. Thou art stronger than all the Nine Divine Generals of mine era.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. ===[[Curse]]s=== '''Extensive [[Curse]] Knowledge''': Groovy excels in the understanding of curses and curse tools. He knows how to make these tools and can even determine how curses work. It was with this knowledge that he managed to uncover the working of the Curse of Thorns. It is precisely because of this knowledge that Groovy was first sought out by Vincent Vollachia to become a Divine General, and it is the reason he is known as the Master of Curse Tools. *'''[[Terminology#Curse Tools|Curse Tool]] Creation''': Utilizing his knowledge of curses, Groovy has learned how to create curse tools.''"Groovy Gumlet is known as the Master of Curse Tools, he is familiar with magic and Curse Arts, possessing the skill to create equipment incorporating these techniques."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 21, Section 2. One such tool is an unnamed black orb-shaped tool that was put into use at the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. It takes the lives of people engraved with a curse mark if they exceed a fixed distance from the orb, although the exact distance is unknown. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Enhanced Strength''': Despite his small stature, Groovy has considerable physical strength. With a single strike, he was able to send a fully grown man of [[Heinkel Astrea]]'s stature flying, his fist creating a shockwave on impact.''Evading in a way such that the sword attack only skimmed the tip of his nose, Groovy took a step, and closed the distance in a single instant as his fist howled; equipped with a gauntlet, it slammed into the side of the red-haired middle-aged man’s torso, the resultant shock wave launching him into the wall.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 21, Section 1. '''Enhanced Durability''': Groovy is also rather tough. Despite being poisoned, taking severe throat damage, going for days on end without food, drink, or sleep, taking the Curse of Thorns into himself, taking a wound to the gut from the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]], and tanking an attack from the Fiend Sword to rid himself of the aforementioned curse, he kept himself alive and still seemed lively despite his heavy injuries. '''Enhanced Olfaction''': Groovy has an enhanced sense of smell that is considered to be the best in Vollachia, allowing him to sniff out the locations of living things or inanimate objects and differentiate between them from a great distance. The one object Groovy cannot smell is the [[Enchanted Sword#Fiend Sword Murasame|Fiend Sword Murasame]], an Enchanted Sword with a will of its own. Out of hatred directed towards Groovy for reforging it into a katana, Fiend Sword used its ability to sever the perceived “point” of its own scent, thereby deterring anyone from being able to track it through scent again.''It meant to get down to the heart of a matter, but in all things there was an appropriate “point”. No matter the object or phenomenon, or even concept, there existed a “point” that signified its essence. The Fiend Sword Murasame, was an Enchanted Sword that severed that perceived “point”―― Murasame hated Groovy, who had melted it down and reforged it in the past, so to never again be hunted for, it cut the point of its “scent”.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. It has even been implied that his nose can pick up on residual mana that has been used against another person.''Of course, it would have been a different story if Cecilus’s shrunken state had actually been part of the opponent’s plan, but regarding that, Groovy’s own sense of smell negated that theory. It was Chisha that had shrunk Cecilus. That he was certain of due to the residual Mana.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 1. ===Intelligence=== '''Anatomical Knowledge''': Groovy has a great understanding of the bodies of humans and [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], and this knowledge complements his usage of curse tools, poisons, and the like. On top of this, he understands even the tiniest aspect of his own body, and he uses that knowledge when handling curses and poisons, knowing when his body becomes incapable of withstanding said detriments.''If it were a matter of his own body, then he had it completely memorized, starting from the number of his beastly hairs without a single fang’s width of inaccuracy. He was able to make even the slightest adjustments thanks to it, but testing the poison on Cecilus or Al would have meant making rough estimates with their lives on the line.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 2. ===Other=== '''Expert Blacksmith''': Groovy has made many weapons while studying curses and curse tools. His skill is great enough that he was able to completely reforge the Fiend Sword from a regular sword to a katana.''"I didn’t buy it. I made it. You’re too fucking stupid to remember, but I also melted down your Fiend Sword and reforged it into a katana."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 39, Section 3. *'''Killing Tool Creation''': Groovy is also capable of creating unique armaments besides swords, such as [[Yae Tenzen]]'s special steel thread rings.''"It’s not like I specialize in swords. I make swords, weave garments, and also tinker with magical tools."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 39, Section 3.''Even among the shinobi, known for their skills far surpassing the human realm, only the Crimson Sakura, Yae Tenzen, had mastered the Steel Thread Technique, an art proper of the greatest illusionists and warriors, which utilized the killing armaments produced by the Master of Curse Tools, Groovy Gumlet.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40]], Chapter 4, Section 3. ===Equipment=== Groovy wields an assortment of weapons and [[Terminology#Curse Tools|curse tools]] in his arsenal.''"Who ever said anything like that? I’ve got a fuckton of Curse Tools left!"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 48. He is described as a walking venerable armory of weapons and is extremely skilled at using them. He possesses much less a traditional fighting style than he does a high level of instinct, natural physical power, and speed, which all work well with his various tools. As a result, he can turn into a nearly literal and lethal whirling blade of death. *'''Blood Hatchets''' (血斧, ''Chi Ono''): These are curse tools that send an intense vibration through the target upon impact. They were originally made to deal with opponents who wore armor over themselves.''To avoid the spread of fire, he had let go of the hatchets the moment they hit the Yang Sword, but the effect of those curse tools―― not cutting them, but forcing an impact through them, was activated.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 48.''Originally, it had been a curse tools created to kill opponents donning thick armor and steel helmets even while still clad in said equipment. The blade of the hatchet vibrated immensely at such a minute scale that it could not be seen; even the slightest contact would cause the vibrations to be sent throughout the opponent’s body, pulverizing their bones and viscera.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 48. They also use their holder’s blood to acquire a target. If a target gets Groovy's blood on themselves or their clothes, the hatchets, when thrown, will proceed to lock on to a target and attempt to land a blow on them.''Using Groovy’s blood as a medium to acquire its target, it was a guided tomahawk application of the curse tools known as Blood Hatchets.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. The hatchets are also capable of exploding if necessary.''As the wolfman had said, the moment the storm of Blood Hatchets had exploded, Eugard had pruned off the entirety of the right arm with blood on its sleeve, and had managed to avoid it.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. *'''Magic Knuckles''' (魔手甲, ''Ma Tekkō''): Groovy's Magic Knuckles are gloves with magic stones embedded within which allow him to use non-elemental spells simply made up of mana. *'''Gauntlets''': Groovy wears a pair of gauntlets on his person. *'''Poison Daggers''': Groovy has several daggers that are covered in a lethal poison.''Immediately, the poison affixed to the edge of the dagger’s blade coursed into his body, rapidly eating away at the petite build of the hyenaperson by flowing through his bloodstream. The deadly toxin ran amok, delighted by the joy brought on from fulfilling its duty of killing a living creature, and as it rushed to put a lethal end to the creature’s vital activity―― the blade was pulled back right before it could do so.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 2. A unique characteristic of this poison is that it will nullify the target’s sense of pain.''A part of his body’s senses had been silenced by the poison. ――His sense of pain had been suppressed.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 2. Sometimes, Groovy uses this poison on himself when he is at risk of being overrun by intense pain caused by others, such as the case with the Curse of Thorns. This allows him to fight for a set period of time before his body can’t handle it. *'''Kusarigama''': Groovy uses a kusarigama with a fist-sized weighted ball at the end of the roughly thirty or so meter chain which is made of unique materials.''It was a weapon difficult to handle, consisting of a wide, single-handed sickle connected to a weight with a chain. Usually, the chain would only be several meters long, and the chain and sickle were supposed to be used in fights that were close-ranged or middle-ranged, but Groovy’s weapon had been fashioned from unique materials. Because of that, the chained weight had easily reached the group of undead, even though they had been nearly thirty meters away from him.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 2.''He swung his sickle-wielding hand in wide arcs, and the chained weight that followed after a moment sang its metallic tunes as it flew towards the ground with tremendous speed. The size of the weight was equal to a fist, but the power behind its acceleration was too enormous to be converted to a mere punch.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 2. The weight is able to knock opponents back with impressive force. The weight is also filled with the explosive “sands” of the Crimson Hills Girall, and the explosion that comes from the weighted ball, which is triggered by absorbing mana from the surroundings, is powerful and has a wide range.''Suddenly, the weight manifested a red hue from within, and the surrounding buildings were caught in the massive explosion that followed. The resulting powerful shockwave engulfed the undead that had narrowly avoided the blast, and just like that, one of the Imperial Capital’s streets had been annihilated.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 2.''The weight connected to Groovy’s chain and sickle contained Fire Magic Stones that had been collected from the Crimson Hills Girall in its interior, able to unleash its exceptionally destructive power in this manner upon absorbing Mana from its surroundings.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 2. *'''Snakewhip Sword''': The waistband that Groovy wears is an urumi, a flexible sword that bends like a serpent, and it was made from the fangs of snake humans.''But, as he was being sent flying, Groovy undid his waistband, swung his snakewhip sword, put together and fashioned from the fangs of snake people, and began to cleave at the head of the pursuing Eugard.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 1. *'''Grappling Hooks''': Attached to Groovy's trousers are cuffs which can fire off grappling hooks. Used against an opponent, they have the capacity to break a person's shoulders.''And as proof of his honor at that evaluation from the strongest emperor in all of history, Groovy aligned his feet, and fired two grappling hooks from the cuffs of his trousers in an attempt to shatter both shoulders of his opponent.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 48. *'''Sonic Magic Crystal''': Groovy has a magic crystal embedded in his throat. After flicking it, Groovy can use it to amplify his roar and bombard his opponent with a blast of sonic pressure.''From the one side of that unfurled cloth, Groovy flicked the Magic Crystal embedded in his throat, and hit Eugard with a surging roar that rumbled the very atmosphere. From an unseeable position, with an onslaught equivalent to sound itself, it was a surprise attack that was impossible to dodge.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 48. *'''Werewolf Cloak''': A cloak made of the skin of werewolves.''"No, this one is just werewolf skin."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 39, Section 3. Due to the method used to make this cloak, it has the Divine Protection of Ambushing built into it, making it harder for one to be detected by others in the vicinity.''The fur cloak that Groovy had prepared was quite the impressive piece of work. Apparently, it was an exceptional item that could be used to prevent the wearer from attracting the attention of others. Rowan, Heinkel, and Groovy had used this fur cloak to slip past the enemy’s radar, and enter the Imperial Capital.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 39, Section 3.''"It’s because they’re fucking hard to find in the first place. The whole race’s under a Divine Protection, just like ground dragons or the Uruha people of the Holy Kingdom. If you skin them alive, the Divine Protection remains on their pelt. It’s an effective use of those sneaky fuckers."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 39, Section 3. ==Trivia== *Groovy was the first person to be appointed as a Divine General by Vincent after Chisha and Cecilus, who were already Vincent's pawns prior to him becoming emperor. Groovy's appointment was mostly thanks to his talent. *An anecdote going around in Vollachia claims that Groovy would be able to catch up to someone in the Empire if they were to flee to somewhere else with just his sense of smell alone,''As one of the Nine Divine Generals, the sense of smell of the hyenaman Groovy Gumlet was preeminent even among fellow demi-humans of beast-human lineage. He could probably catch someone if they fled from one end of the Empire to the other, so much so that that unfunny funny anecdote was circulated about.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Sword Identity Part 3|Sword Identity]], Section 17. though it is just a rumor that is not known to be true or false. ==Note== ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32|Volume 32]] (main story)}} '''Goz Ralfon''' (ゴズ・ラルフォン) is the '''Fourth ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He played a supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. He also played a small antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. Goz is a skilled commander who commands great respect from the [[Imperial Army]] as one of its most charismatic generals, and he is absolutely loyal to the Vollachia Empire and its emperor, [[Vincent Vollachia]], willing to give his life for him should the need arise. It is because of his excellent leadership, charisma, and great command over the battlefield, alongside his tremendous strength, that Vincent decided to name him the Fifth of the Nine Divine Generals. ==Appearance== Goz is a tall, burly man, slightly taller than [[Halibel]] with battle scars covering most of his rough face, brown eyes, and orange-brown hair. He has a beard and clads himself in golden armor that has a red cape attached to the back. In combat, Goz wields a giant golden mace. ==Personality== Despite his intimidating physique, Goz is extremely loyal to the Empire and the emperor himself. So much so that he's willing to risk his life for the emperor's safety, despite Vincent losing his title as the emperor of the Vollachia Empire. From what he has shown, Goz always obeys every word from his emperor, which often irritates him and subjects Goz to a barrage of insults. Similarly, he does not abide listening to other people disrespect his emperor, getting unreasonably angry because of it. Most of the time, he is often compared with a dog or an ape, especially when one takes into consideration his habit of using his voice’s excessive volume when speaking. Of course, with his loyalty comes an excess of pride in being a Vollachian soldier. It is because of this pride that he believes that the country should take care of its own problems, leading him to being heavily against forming alliances with other countries, especially Vollachia’s bitter enemy [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]], even if it means the country might survive. Goz is an honorable man, and he will treat anyone who he recognizes as an ally or his savior with respect. Shortly after [[Rem]] broke him free from his cuffs and gave him food, he expressed great respect for her and even wished to greet her to his family for what she had done.''"Girl, your treatment has saved my life! Normally, I would have liked to invite you to my home as to introduce my savior to my wife and children, but I must now head to His Excellency’s side! I shall repay you for this!!"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 110, Section 3. It has been claimed that in Vollachia, where anyone called to the Crystal Palace's throne room was due to their abilities, if one were to be called for their humanity, it would be Goz.''"If anyone was to be called forth to the Crystal Palace because of their humanity, it would be General First-Class Goz. Aside from him, everyone else would be called due to their abilities. I myself am no exception."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 106, Section 1. As expected from his rank, Goz is well-respected and professional in his work, looking after the Imperial Army by serving as a Divine General and even suggesting replacements for the fallen Divine Generals when asked for feedback. When forced to go against his own soldiers after breaking out of his imprisonment, who were following their own loyalty, he respected their decision and willingly left said soldiers alive because he was aware of the position they were in.''"Very well. Just as I am loyal to His Excellency the Emperor, you lot are loyal to the Prime Minister. I shall certainly see that honor through to the very end!!"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 110, Section 3. He also places great trust in his soldiers, believing that despite whatever hardships there may be that they can crush their foes with combined efforts.''"In the first place! Do not underestimate us officers and our soldiers! No matter how many hardships we may face, the Great Disaster will be crushed by our combined efforts!"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 2. In addition, Goz has a passion for music plays with musical instruments. His love of music led him to meeting his wife at a recital. ==History== At an unknown point in time, Goz's love of music led him to meet his future wife at a recital. The two eventually got married, and they had children. Goz was also a Second-Class General of the Imperial Army, but at some point following the death of [[Lamia Godwin]], he was promoted. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Around seven years before the main story, Goz and [[Arakiya]] were dispatched to the Pendleton estate in an attempt to take custody of [[Jorah Pendleton]] and his wife, [[Priscilla Barielle|Priscilla]], for a scheduled execution. However, Jorah fended Goz and his escorts off for Priscilla's sake, knowing that he would meet his end in just mere moments. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly four to five months before [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s arrival, the seventy-seventh emperor of the Vollachia Empire was targeted by [[Gramdart Holstoy]] and [[Balleroy Temeglyph]]. In the ensuing chaos, the three Lugunican Royal Guards [[Reinhard van Astrea]], [[Julius Juukulius]], and [[Ferris]], who accompanied the two members of the Council of Wise Men, [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]], kidnapped the emperor and fled [[Lupugana]] with him. While the [[Moguro Hagane|Eighth]], [[Groovy Gumlet|Sixth]], and [[Cecilus Segmunt|First]] ranking Divine Generals were dispatched to locate and bring the emperor back to the Crystal Palace, Goz organized the troops, took the two Lugunican diplomats hostage, and kept the Crystal Palace in as much order as possible. Following Vincent's safe return and the departure of the Kingdom's diplomats, Goz took part in a secret meeting between him, Vincent, the Fourth ranking Divine General [[Chisha Gold]], Moguro, and Groovy, with whom he discussed the incident. ===[[Sword Identity Part 1|Sword Identity]]=== About two to three months afterwards, Goz took place in a meeting between some of the Divine Generals, the emperor, and the Imperial Prime Minister, [[Berstetz Fondalfon]]. The group discussed who should be appointed as the next Ninth ranking Divine General following Balleroy Temeglyph's death. Goz suggested a capable Second General from the Insect Cage Clan by the name of [[Kafma Irulux]], but his suggestion was contested by Berstetz, who hoped to give the seat to a Flying Dragon commander by the name of [[Madelyn Eschart]]. When the Empire's [[Ubilk|Stargazer]] prophesized [[Yorna Mishigure]]'s rebellion, Goz accompanied Cecilus and Arakiya in order to awake Kafma from his pupa and also witnessed Madelyn bring her dragons to the Imperial Capital. Goz and Kafma later joined the other generals in assaulting [[Chaosflame]]. While there, Kafma relinquished the idea of becoming a Divine General due to not believing that he was fit enough, putting Goz in a position where he lost credibility due to Kafma's choice. ===[[Imperial Civil War#Imperial Coup|Imperial Coup]]=== Sometime before the events of Arc 7, he learned of the upcoming [[Great Disaster]]. Unfortunately, since his immense loyalty and pride would get in the way of his plans to prevent the disaster, Chisha and Berstetz, the latter of which was unaware of said disaster, had him defeated and locked away beneath Berstetz’s mansion, giving him just enough food and water not to die. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Goz is an incredibly powerful warrior whose strength is among the top of the Empire's hierarchy. He is capable of going toe to toe with combatants on the level of [[Hornet]] and easily dispatch hordes of combatants with ease. What makes him even more dangerous than his combat prowess, however, is his ability to command large forces, which is second only to Chisha among the Nine Divine Generals. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Herculean Strength''': Goz has considerable strength. A single punch from him has the might to create shockwaves and the power to instantly fell a large-sized [[witchbeast]].''The might of the blow gave rise to wind, the violent shockwave making the hair and clothes of the participants flutter. The strike delivered in a fit of rage held the power to slay even a large witchbeast in one shot, reminding all of the strength of the man feared as the Lion Knight, Goz Ralfon.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Sword Identity Part 2|Sword Identity]], Section 5. More than that, however, a strike delivered by Goz is so mighty that not even another one of the Nine Divine Generals can stop it easily.''Possessing unparalleled herculean strength, a strike from Goz using all of his might was not easy to block, even if the opponent was one of the Nine Divine Generals.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 6. It is thanks to his strength that he is capable of wielding his primary weapon, and he has shown to be easily capable of throwing an axe with such ferocity that whoever is stricken by it will be sent flying backward with terrific momentum.''Even so, the battle-axe had always been well-cared for, kept ready to be used on the battlefield, since not displaying weapons that were actually useless was not the imperial way. And thus, it had stopped Lamia on her tracks from her front, blowing her away towards the back of the throne room with terrific momentum.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 2. '''Enhanced Endurance''': Goz has an incredible level of endurance. During his imprisonment, Chisha and Berstetz effectively starved Goz in order to drain his strength. Despite this, Goz was still extremely lively and fighting against the chains binding him, even after months with barely any food. '''Excellent Hearing''': Goz has an incredible sense of hearing, which enables him to recognize sound on a level higher than the average person and to discern even the nuances in the wind.''The fact that he was born with ears able to recognize sounds on a level higher than average could be called one of the few treasures Goz had. '' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Sword Identity Part 3|Sword Identity]], Section 15.''Contrary to his bold and dauntless appearance, Goz Ralfon possessed ears that could distinguish even the nuances in the sounds of the wind, and he had the skill of a genius who could delicately perform with any and all musical instruments.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 7, Section 2. ===Techniques=== '''Howl''' (遠吠え, ''Tōboe''): Using his extraordinary hearing and herculean strength, Goz can discern vibrations that are unique to every organism and strike someone with the very same vibrations that his opponents have in the form of a deadly "howl" that is created with a shockwave of sound from his mace.''Weighing as much as ten men with a single swing, when combined with Goz’s herculean strength and exceptional ears, it realized a technique unattainable for others―― Each and every living organism possessed vibrations unique to themselves, and the “howl”, which could strike one’s opponents with those same vibrations in the form of sound, had been attained by Goz.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 28, Section 2. The "howl" only damages the targets whose vibrations match the sound of Goz's mace. This technique was what led Goz to become known as the Lion Knight.''That deadly “howl” was precisely why Goz was known as the Lion Knight.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 28, Section 2. ===Leadership=== '''Exceptional Leadership''': Among everyone in the Imperial Army, Goz is well-known not just for his attitude, but also for his skills as a leader. Aside from his combat capabilities, his best quality is in being able to command a massive number of forces even while on the frontlines, something which, among the Nine Divine Generals, is said to be second only to Chisha.''Goz Ralfon was a General admired by many others in the troops, second only to Chisha Gold in terms of commanding large armies; but he was also possessed of outstanding individual combat skills in comparison with the latter.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 2. He commands respect from everyone beneath him and can easily boost their morale, and he has an eye for particular talent among his comrades and is willing to vouch for them for better standings both in rank and on the battlefield. Vincent highly values this even over his martial skill. It is precisely because of this quality that Vincent left him to lead the army in [[Garkla]] during the Great Disaster rather than taking him to Lupugana.''"Now with that damned Chisha gone, I cannot entrust the entire army to anyone but you. You must understand the significance of that."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 34, Section 4. ===Equipment=== *'''Large Mace''': Goz wields a large golden mace in combat. This mace can be disassembled via twisting the spear-like shaft from the striking head of the mace. This mace, so heavy that only someone of Goz's size and strength could wield, is unique in that slamming the shaft into the separated head can generate a powerful sound, allowing Goz to use his "howl". *'''Golden Armor''': One of the most distinguishing traits of Goz is the golden armor that he wears in battle. ==Trivia== *Goz's birthday was decided at a talk show held on July 26, 2026. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 34|Volume 34]] (main story) |Manga = |Anime = [[Episode 72]] (mentioned) |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Halibel '''(ハリベル) is a [[shinobi]] of [[Kararagi]] who is known throughout the world as the Admirer, one of the three people said to be on par with the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom's]] [[Reinhard van Astrea]] in terms of overall martial skill, alongside the [[Vollachia Empire|Empire's]] [[Cecilus Segmunt]] and the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom's]] [[Vague Adgard]].''Evaluated as an equal to the Sword Saint, the Mad Prince, and the Blue Lightning, alongside the strongest of each nation he had a track record which one could not be ashamed of.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. He made his main story debut in [[Arc 8]], where he played a supporting role. A member of the reclusive wolf human tribe, Halibel is the only wolf human in the present day who does not hide his identity. With his unmatched skill as a shinobi, he offers his services to those who are able to afford him, often working for clients such as the League of Cities, his own tribe, or even [[Anastasia Hoshin]] of the Hoshin Company. ==Appearance== Halibel is a wolf human with relatively long black fur clad in a disheveled black kimono possessing worn-down purple accents. His large height makes him tower over a fully-grown Subaru like a black statue covered in fur, and his golden eyes are usually narrowed into two slits. He often likes biting on his golden kiseru with his teeth. More often than not, Halibel gives off a rather laid-back air through his appearance. ==Personality== Halibel has a casual behavior and likes the taste of liquor and free alcohol. In spite of the nature of his line of work, Halibel is outwardly friendly towards others and is rarely shown to display anger or disapproval towards other and their opinions of him, and he often makes jokes to keep the mood light. He'll even offer to share candy with children, though he'll also forget that he doesn't have any candy on him. It is because of this positive nature and his habit of bestowing praise unto others that he earned himself the epithet of the Admirer.''Either way, he always relaxedly spoke of his praise for others, and so he had always been called the Admirer. Naturally, this was not the only reason for his nickname; no matter what opponent or action he was faced with, it was Halibel’s way of being to give an objective evaluation.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. In fact, in the rare times that Halibel expresses his disapproval, it is claimed that those who knew him would be surprised to hear such words leave his mouth.''The tone of his voice was slightly lower, making him sound irritated, something that those who knew him would be surprised by as he was rarely ever displeased.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Likewise, he is somewhat whimsical. With his rather free position as a shinobi for hire and his personality, it is Halibel's motto that he will help those that he wants to help while turning his nose from things that do not interest him, something which tends to give other people two different extremes in terms of their impressions toward him.''――He would side with those he wanted to help, and he would turn his nose up at those things which did not interest him. That was Halibel’s motto as one of the strongest, and the owner of such a whimsical nature would naturally cause the assessments of those who knew him to be divided into two extremes.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Although he shows total respect towards others, he can be a bit too serious when talking about his race, since his race is rather rare and on the verge of extinction, often mentioning that he feels like carrying the pride of his kind. Likewise, he also considers himself a masterless ronin and is not under the control of his country.''There was only one difference between Halibel and the other three. He did not belong to any nation, proclaiming himself a masterless ronin.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Although he has gratitude toward his country and is willing to allow himself to be hired by people in power, he is averse to the idea of being owned by the country and being used as a bargaining chip for political negotiations.''Of course, Halibel himself held a sense of gratitude and belonging to his homeland and would sometimes be asked to investigate and resolve serious problems in Kararagi. But, as far as the idea of his existence being owned by someone else was concerned, being used as a bargaining chip in negotiations and transactions was something he was extremely averse to.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Though a friendly man, he takes his job seriously. If someone hires him to do a job, whether that be Kararagi’s League of Cities themselves, a friend like Anastasia Hoshin, or especially from his fellow wolf-human tribesmen, he will do what he can to accomplish his task, listening and respecting the requests of his contractors. Likewise, he also believes that one should not break their promises or oaths, as when he was once tasked by his fellow tribesmen to take the life of [[Ricardo Welkin]] for breaking his oath to them, Halibel believed that he brought it on himself. This being said, he does not enjoy having to take the lives of his friends, and he will show visible relief if he is able to avoid doing so. ==History== Halibel was born in the hidden settlement of the wolf people in Kararagi. He was childhood friends with Ricardo, who he was the same age as. By his teenage years, Halibel's strength among the wolf people in the village was peerless. While he wished to live out his days peacefully, Ricardo, who was unsuited to life in the village, left the village on his fifteenth birthday, making an oath with the village's leader that he would renounce his identity as a wolf person. In the event that he broke his oath, the chief swore to Ricardo that Halibel would come to kill him. Eventually, as the strongest wolf human and the strongest man in Kararagi, Halibel was allowed by his fellow tribesmen to make himself known and proclaim himself as a wolf human. That said, as a member of their tribe, he would oft be requested to handle their requests. Around fifteen years after Ricardo's departure, Halibel was tasked with carrying out his assassination, as the wolf people believed he had broken his oath to hide his lineage. Though he found the task unfortunate, Halibel still accepted it nonetheless, believing that Ricardo brought it upon himself. When he eventually met Ricardo and was prepared to take his life, a young Anastasia protected Ricardo, and she managed to find a compromise to keep Halibel from having to kill Ricardo. Afterward, Halibel maintained friendly relations with Anastasia and Ricardo. At some point in the past, Vollachia’s strongest warrior, Cecilus Segmunt, was given the task of slaying Halibel, as being a wolf human put his head on the chopping block for his race’s involvement in the betrayal of the [[Eugard Vollachia|Emperor of the Briar]] and his [[Yorna Mishigure|lover]]. The two clashed, but rather than killing Halibel, Cecilus returned home. Sometime after this, Halibel lived in [[Banan]]. ===[[Anastasia's Companion Searching Chronicle 1|Anastasia's Companion Searching Chronicle]]=== Sometime around the events of the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], Halibel was hired by the League of Cities to investigate the goings-on of one of the towns that borders Vollachia, Nanou, whose income of food and other such supplies had dramatically reduced. There, he discovered that the living were completely replaced by the undead. Though he found the events strange, as the undead were acting as though they were alive yet without purpose, Halibel dispatched them all and reported to the League of Cities. Though they attempted to pass judgement on him, thinking he had gone too far in his actions, Anastasia and [[Julius Juukulius]] interrupted the mock conference they were holding, with the former using her words to give Halibel the chance to explain his actions in Nanou. She managed to convince the League of Cities to send her and Halibel as emissaries to Vollachia, to which they accepted. As it aligned with his goals to investigate the occurrence, he accepted it as well. Along the way, he spoke with Julius and explained his connection to Anastasia and Ricardo. ===[[Kararagi Reaper Incident 1|Kararagi Reaper Incident]]=== Shortly after the events of the [[Great Disaster]], Anastasia, accompanied by Julius, Halibel, and [[Eridna|Echidna]], returned to Kararagi, where they decided to report their discoveries to the mayor of the Third City Ivada, [[Orgo Hayata]]. Unfortunately, there was yet another problem: the windstorm created by the Slasher, [[Zarestia]], that was thrust upon Banan. After learning of this, she, Eridna, Julius, and Halibel made their way to Banan to meet up with Ricardo. Sometime after Ricardo quelled Zarestia's rage, Anastasia's group arrived and were led to the holding cells in [[Riften Magoji]]'s mansion, where Zarestia was being held. During their conversation, Anastasia learned that Riften went missing, Julius noticed that Zarestia was a Great Spirit and introduced himself, and Halibel unintentionally riled her up by noticing her strange constitution, that something was missing. However, when Anastasia mentioned Zarestia being responsible for other such town-destroying wind cataclysms, Zarestia declared otherwise, saying that she only rampaged in Banan. Shortly afterward, this is confirmed when a massive tornado appeared outside of Banan, not made by Zarestia. After giving her orders and securing Zarestia's assistance, the group made their way to stop the tornado. Although they managed to quell the winds, however, they soon realized that Anastasia and Echidna had gone missing. A full day after being taken, Anastasia and Echidna were brought back to Banan by [[Reize|Black Tia]], their captor, and shortly after, likely due to her exhaustion catching up with her, Anastasia passed out with a fever. Though Julius tended to her and attempted to help heal her with his spirits, he was unable and settled for practicing with Halibel to become stronger. Over the course of the day, Julius fought and lost against Halibel ten times, though after their tenth fight, Halibel mentioned that Julius was definitely improving, claiming that he was likely one of the strongest people in the Kingdom. As evening approached, they decided to have another clash, in which Halibel claimed that he would be able to display his full potential at nighttime. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Halibel is famously known to be one of the few people in the world who is able to employ martial skill on a similar level to the Kingdom's Reinhard, effectively making Halibel one of the strongest people in the world, matched only by a bare few, and the most powerful military asset in Kararagi.''――As the one known as the Admirer, Halibel made full use of his title as the Kararagi City-States’ strongest individual.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2.''Recklessly challenging an opponent without knowing about them was a foolish deed―― Halibel could defeat most opponents by sheer force alone, but this opponent was no such case.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 3. Halibel is highly skilled at using various types of techniques, and as a shinobi, he excels at eliminating his targets. Even without using his myriad techniques, he has many other ways of combatting opponents, both with his physical might and his knowledge of curses, giving him a wide array of methods to fight, even when his opponent is unfavorable towards him. Even when forced into melee combat with a warrior on the level of a polished Eugard Vollachia, he displayed such skill in martial arts that he was able to defend, attack, and counter with ease, even without using special techniques and tricks. Furthermore, by his own claim, he is able to show his full potential at nighttime. Even among shinobi, he is considered exceptional, to the point that [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]] would reluctantly attest it.''Even if one surveyed the entirety of the Four Great Countries, they would have no choice but to say that there were no shinobi who surpassed him, and even the Empire’s strongest shinobi, Olbart, would have to make a bitter expression and admit he was the most powerful.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. ===[[Curse]]s=== '''[[Curse|Curse Arts]]''' (呪術, ''Jujutsu''): Halibel is an expert in curse arts. Killing curses are his trump card, and he fuses pieces of his own fur or nails that he cursed into his weapons to cast a curse that, no matter what, will kill his opponent.''“I’m an expert in curse arts… killin’ curses are my trump card. Stuff like my fur ’n nails are fused into the kunai I have, so if they get stolen, it’ll cast a curse.”'' [[Re:IF]], Chapter 6, Section 4. However, these curses are not compatible with beings that are already dead, such as the [[Undead#Corebug-Based Zombies|zombies in Vollachia]].''“Ya see, the sellin’ point of my attacks’s the fact that they’re killin’ curses; once they hit, it’s lights out for good, so I ain’t compatible with an opponent who sticks ’round even after they kick the bucket, not at all.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 2, Section 1. '''Extensive Curse Knowledge''': As an expert in using curse arts himself, Halibel is quite versed in the workings of curses. It was with this knowledge that he, alongside [[Groovy Gumlet|another curse expert]], was able to determine the inner workings of Eugard Vollachia's [[Curse#Curse of Thorns|Curse of Thorns]]. ===Techniques=== As a shinobi, Halibel has access to numerous abilities and techniques exclusive to shinobi, and his mastery with them is second to none. Most of his techniques center around deception, high lethality, targeting weaknesses, avoiding damage, and movement, giving him many options: *'''Dead Spot''' (死穴): Halibel has shown the ability to perceive the flow of power in various techniques and abilities, and by aiming at these "dead spots", he is able to completely nullify powerful attacks,''"The heat… no, I cut the flow of power. So this is what is known as the “dead spot”?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 15, Section 1. such as a great laser,''Reflected in her beautiful eyes was not the white Death that had been so close at hand, in fact, that had disappeared entirely; and instead reflected was the night sky, covered with thick clouds that had now been hollowed out in the shape of the light.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 19, Section 4. and he is even capable of halting the regeneration of the zombies of the Great Disaster for a time.''The arm that had disappeared from his right shoulder onwards showed no signs of starting to regenerate. He clearly understood. Eugard’s right arm had been the first part of his resurrected body to die anew. The one who had done that was Halibel who stood before his eyes, and it seemed to be the result of the “dead spot” of which he had spoken.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. *'''Cloning''' (分け身): Halibel is able to use his fur to clone himself into four,''“That’s quite the amusing evaluation. But that ain’t it. ――It just ain’t my real body.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2.''Instantly, the four Halibels erupted in flames―― all of them turning into fur.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 50, Section 2. using both physical and hollow clones to confuse his opponent.''“Art thou employing both clones with substance and clones that are hollow?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 7.''Halibel’s “clones” could be divided into two types, those that were merely illusions made of fur, and genuine clones with substance on par with Halibel’s real body.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 7. Perhaps the biggest upside to his cloning ability is that each and every clone is identical to the original specimen, including their strength, meaning that rather than splitting his fighting strength into four "pieces", he quadruples it. The clones are also able to act independently. *'''Swapping''' (変わり身): Used only in the alternate events of [[Re:IF]], Halibel has the capacity to swap his place with an object's place. He utilized this technique in order to swap places with a log and have it sustain the damage of Reize's wind attacks in his place. *'''Unnamed Burying Technique''': During his battle with Eugard Vollachia, Halibel displayed an ability to drag his opponent into the ground.''The cause was a third Halibel, who had grabbed him by both of his legs and dragged him down into the street. Halibel slipped out of the ground, and swapped positions with Eugard who was thus buried up to his waist.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Apparently, the technique leaves the target’s head poking out of the ground, but those of considerable power and resistance do not get dragged into the ground all the way.''It would have been ideal to bury him up to his neck to restrict his movements, but, “It ain’t gonna go so swimmingly, as expected.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Eugard managed to get away with only his lower half being dragged beneath the earth. He is also capable of slipping into the ground himself, using it as a means of evasion.''His opponent evaded it by slipping into the ground, and brushing Eugard’s left hip with his fingertips as he slipped through, a hole around the size of a fist was gouged into his hips.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. *'''Unnamed Walking Technique''': Using a certain walking technique, Halibel is able to leave behind afterimages to confuse his opponents. Unlike his clones, these afterimages vanish like mist.''Combining a peculiar walking technique with an unbelievable movement speed, an optical illusion occurred in a form differing from that of the clones. At the sensation of afterimages being left in his consciousness, Eugard could not help but admire that versatility.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. *'''Unnamed Dissipation Technique''': Halibel is capable of catching attacks with his finger and dissipating the strength of the attack into the ground, making the ground ripple like water in the process.'' Accepting the offered name, Subaru looked back at the man standing behind him, who had only an oddly-developed right arm, and saw Halibel catch the surprise attack with one raised finger. In their contest of strength, the giant did not overwhelm his opponent.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 66, Section 1.''Halibel stood with his heels in the air, the streets rippling like the surface of water beneath his feet before dissipating. That highlighted the difference in status between the still-herculean might of the Monster Arm and Halibel.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 66, Section 1. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== Halibel is highly proficient in melee combat, and thanks to his traits as a wolf human, he has physical capabilities beyond most humans, as well as enhanced senses that most humans do not have. He is also a master of the Flow Method, increasing his already impressive physical might by leaps and bounds. '''Enhanced Strength''': Halibel's physical strength is top notch. He is capable of releasing devastating power with palm strikes which are capable of damaging castle walls or creating a small windstorm that can blow away fire from even the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]],''Halibel’s palms, released in conjunction with a step that caused the cobblestones to explode, moved like battering rams that could blow away a shoddily-constructed castle gate in a single strike. However, these two strikes were stopped just short of the flames simultaneously, and the generated wind turned into a storm, blowing away the fire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 7. while an elbow strike can hit someone with the power of a battle axe,''Instead, from directly above, an elbow strike as powerful as a battle axe smashed Eugard in the head, and the Emperor crashed into the streets of Imperial Capital as he spun vertically, creating a circular crater accompanied by the sound of an explosion.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 7. with whoever got struck potentially leaving a crater in the ground. Even just grazing someone with his fingertips has the potential to leave a fist sized hole in his enemy. '''Enhanced Speed''': Halibel is incredibly fast. When he kicks off of the ground, he can propel himself at such a speed that the ground behind him shatters, and most are incapable of keeping up with him. '''Claws''': As a wolf human, Halibel has sharp claws on his finger, and they are very easily capable of rending flesh. Combined with the Flow Method's enhancement, his claws can become sharp enough to compare to any famed sword.''As a master of the Flow Method, the sharpness of Halibel’s spear hand was more akin to that of a famed sword rather than a mediocre cutting tool. Without missing their aim, they pierced Eugard’s right eye and solar plexus, demonstrating their might which was enough to cause an instant death.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 2. '''Heightened Olfaction''': As a wolf human, Halibel's sense of smell is higher than the average human's. With it, Halibel was able to smell the faint traces of poison with Groovy's blood.''As a shinobi who was familiar with all kinds of poisons, he could surmise what the faint strange odor mixed with Groovy’s blood was.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 3. '''Stealth''': Halibel is a master of stealth and can completely erase his presence, including his scent. He could be sitting in a room filled with a large number of people of Divine General level, and nobody would even realize he was there until he’d either killed everyone or purposefully made himself known. He is also able to prevent those with a keen sense of smell, such as Ricardo, from noticing his scent. During combat, he has a habit of using his clones while scattering his own presence, and if one is particularly observative, they can take advantage of this, assuming they last long enough against.''“Thou plainly scatter thy presence. ――Ergo, the direction bereft of any presence is where thou truly reside.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 3, Section 8. ===Others=== '''Poison Knowledge/Recognition''': Having been trained as a shinobi, Halibel is familiar with all kinds of poisons, and he is able to determine whether a person had been poisoned by the scent in their blood, even if the smell is faint. ===Equipment=== *'''Kunai''': Halibel’s primary weapon of choice are kunai. When thrown, his kunai are described to travel at beyond human speeds. *'''Throwing Daggers''': He uses these alongside his kunai. *'''Kiseru''': Halibel is regularly seen smoking out of a kiseru, burning the special herbs within to keep himself alive. *'''Katana''': Halibel carries a katana. However, as he has yet to draw it, it is unknown how proficient he is with it in combat. ==Trivia== *Before his introduction in the main story, Halibel first debuted in the [[Re:Zero EX|Kararagi IF side story]]. *As a result of the stigma that has surrounded wolf humans and werewolves for nearly 300 years, Halibel is the only one of his kind who publicly professes his identity. *Despite being among the three characters who are said to be on par with Reinhard in terms of martial skill, when the two faced off in Oboreru IF, Reinhard did not draw the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]] against him. *Before Halibel's introduction in Arc 8, the author expressed uncertainty regarding whether or not he would make an appearance in the main story.''“I think that Cecilus will show up, but I'm not sure about Halibel.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1015647458829877248 July 7, 2018 Q&A] *Halibel has claimed that if he eats candy, he will die.''"Golly, after workin’ so dang hard, I kinda want some candy… Ah, oops, I’d die if I were ta eat candy."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 28, Section 8. However, it is unclear if this is true or if he was being serious. *Among those proclaimed as the strongest people within their own countries, Halibel is the only one who does not actively use one of the [[Enchanted Sword]]s. **Despite this, he did briefly wield the [[Enchanted Sword#Fiend Sword Murasame|Fiend Sword Murasame]] during the events of the Great Disaster, though for only one swing. *According to the author, if any of the world's strongest accompanied to the expedition force to the Pleiades Watchtower, the difficulty to complete the tower would increase because of [[Reid Astrea]]. In particular, Reid would take a liking to Halibel.July 26, 2026 Talk Show ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Kararagi Navbox}} [[Category:Banan]] [[Category:Shinobi]] [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[de:Halibel]] [[es:Halibel]] [[pt-br:Halibel]] [[ru:Халибель]] [[zh:角色:赫鲁贝尔]]

House Argyle |Previous Occupation = Maid |Status = Deceased |Relatives = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|Ex Volume 1]]}} '''Hannah Regret''' (ハンナ・リグレット) was the only maid of House Argyle. She played a supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. ==Appearance== Hannah had flax hair and amber eyes much like Ferris. She dressed in an unremarkable maid outfit. From [[Crusch Karsten|Crusch]]'s perspective, she had a resemblance to Ferris. ==Personality== Hannah was a rather solemn person who had a quiet dignity about her. She seemed especially warm toward Ferris, although she tended to mask it with a fairly detached disposition. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== Little is known about Hannah's history with the Argyles and how deep her relationship ran with them. However, she was the only servant to remain with them after the family become fallen nobility out of affection. Hannah did not approve of the dark situation around Biehn and [[Miles]]. Thus, seeking outside aid to deal with it, Hannah had contracted [[House Karsten]] and began acting as a double agent. Later, she met with Crusch Karsten again after the poison had worn off and loosened her restraints so that Crusch could meet Ferris and escape. However, Crusch would question her reasons for helping them, and Hannah returned the query with a question of her own, suggesting it was out of her own love for Biehn. She would also bear witness to Biehn's [[Minor Characters#Hannah Regret|wife]] being revived by Ferris and the killing her husband moments later in the master bedroom. After questioning Ferris and looking strangely relieved, she was the one who told Ferris where Crusch was. Just as Ferris left to go find her, the Hannah told Ferris goodbye and locked herself in the room along with Biehn and his wife's corpses, committing suicide by setting the room on ablaze. ==Trivia== *In the ''Felix Argyle's Curse'' chapter of Ex 1, it is implied that Crusch believes that Hannah could be Ferris's true mother. However, the maid died before she could be questioned about her relationship with Ferris, leaving Crusch's uncertainties regarding the woman unanswered. *In the first physical version of [[Re:Zeropedia]], she was referred to as '''Maid''' (女給, ''Jokyū''), whereas Hannah Regret was said to be Biehn's wife, in spite of the fact that she does not share the same surname as her husband. In a later revision to the physical version of Re:Zeropedia, the maid was instead said to be Hannah Regret, and Biehn's wife also had the name Hannah. However, this error has not been corrected in the digital release of Re:Zeropedia. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Maids]]

wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Kalifa |Image = Kalifa LN character design.png |Kanji = カリファ |Romaji = Karifa |Race = Human |Gender = Female |Age = Around 20 |Hair Color = Grey Brown |Eye Color = Emerald Green |Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]
Hakuchuri |Previous Affiliation = [[Flanders]] |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Ilya]] (daughter) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4|Tanpenshuu Volume 4]]}} '''Kalifa''' (カリファ) is [[Ilya]]'s mother. ==Apearance== Kalifa is a beautiful woman with long grey-brown hair and green eyes. She gives off a gentle aura. ==Personality== Although she cannot speak, making her day-to-day tasks more difficult, Kalifa is a kind and protective woman who cares for the safety of her daughter and, despite her young age, strives to diligently raise Ilya. In the time since she moved to Hakuchuri, she has become close with [[Gaston]]. ==History== Some time in the past, Kalifa became [[Doltero Amule]]'s mistress and birthed their daughter, Ilya, several months before the Royal Selection. Doltero revealed his relationship with them to only one person, his closest and most loyal confidant, [[Safis]]. ===[[Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint Part 1|The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint]]=== Recognizing that Kalifa and Ilya were Doltero's weaknesses, Safis attempted to have them killed out of loyalty to his boss and a desire to remove the "vulnerabilities" he had. As a result, Kalifa was attacked by an assailant Safis sent and had her larynx destroyed, inhibiting her from ever being able to speak again. She and her daughter both survived, and she entrusted Ilya to the Astrea Manor for protection. Doltero sent one of his men after the two, but he was discovered by [[Felt]] and [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] and revealed his affiliation with the Black Silver Coin once the candidate threatened with the Sword Saint. Shortly afterwards, Gaston, [[Rachins Hoffman|Rachins]], and [[Camberley]] located Kalifa and brought her back to the mansion, where they discovered that Doltero was Ilya's father. Deciding to visit Doltero in Flanders, [[Rom]] used his connection to Doltero to hold a meeting with him. When Felt, Reinhard, and Rom, alongside Kalifa and Ilya, met with Doltero, he discovered that his confidant was responsible for ordering the attack on his mistress and daughter. Safis revealed his intentions, preparing to commit suicide to atone for his misdeeds, only for Doltero to suddenly assault him to keep him alive and demote him to a simple lackey position in the Black Silver Coin unless he could work to regain the Pig King's trust. Understanding Safis's argument, he disowned his mistress and his daughter, much to the displeasure of Felt and Rom. Before leaving, Kalifa turned to Doltero and bowed, showing him the face of his sleeping baby one last time, and Doltero murmured Ilya's name once the room was clear of everyone besides him. Following the incident, Felt prepared a sum of money for Kalifa to use for her new life with Ilya in Hakuchuri, and helped secure a live-in job for her at a ranch, having Reinhard speak with the owners about it. [[Flam Remendis|Flam]] and [[Grassis Remendis|Grassis]] prepared household goods for her, while Gaston, Rachins, and Camberley were assigned to move them. As Kalifa and Ilya departed, Felt told the baby to live strong. {{Clear}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Flanders]]

She later joined the [[Felt Camp]] along with her sister. She plays a supporting role in [[Arc 9]]. ==Appearance== Like her sister, she is a short girl and has peach hair with yellow ribbons in her hair. She wears white and pink clothes. Unlike her sister Flam, her fringe is straight. ==Personality== According to [[Ezzo Cadner]], she is very much like her sister in personality, who does not mind speaking of things she does not want to do and has a sharp mouth. She and her sister are also mischievous, habitually teasing others. She and her sister also hold grudges towards those who wrong the members of [[House Astrea]], particularly when it comes to [[Heinkel Astrea]], and they will show no qualms in delivering ruthless beatings towards their enemies. ==History== Born to one of Carol and Grimm's children, servants of House Astrea, she and her sister Flam have been trained by the family they've served since birth. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record|Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record]]=== A short time after the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], members of the Felt Camp, which included Flam and Grassis, were tasked with reaching the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] and investigating it. During their travels through the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] attacked them to protect the tower, leaving [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] to defend the party. Fortunately, [[Meili Portroute]], who was protecting the party from [[witchbeast]]s as they made their way toward the tower, presented Volcanica’s talon, and they were allowed passage into the tower. There, they came across the Books of the Dead, which Meili explained to them, much to the fascination of Ezzo. Understanding their importance, [[Felt]] suggested Reinhard find the book of his [[Theresia van Astrea|grandmother]], and though he was hesitant to do so, when Felt persuaded him to find it at some point, he was grateful. Shortly after, they noticed the same birds that Subaru and [[Eridna]] had witnessed before. With one captured for study, Ezzo quickly discovered its true nature, and the [[Shaula|crimson scorpion]] being carried by Meili killed it in his hands. Realizing the birds were being used to spy, Ezzo and Reinhard set to killing them all. Deciding to return to the capital, they left Ezzo and Flam at the tower. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護 ''Kago''): Grassis and her sister both have the '''Divine Protection of Mindspeak''' (念話の加護 ''Nenhanashi no Kago''), which allows them to speak to each other through their mind. The distance between them does not matter, but it can only be used once a day. According to [[Petra Leyte|Petra]]'s observations, the once-a-day condition seems to be connected to the amount of time that she sleeps rather than a full 24-hour time period. '''Flow Method''' (流法): Despite being young, Grassis is an expert in using the Flow Method, giving her access to increase strength and a greater recuperation speed. She is shown to be powerful enough to beat the three thugs, [[Gaston]], [[Rachins]], and [[Camberley]], with ease. Grassis is also mentioned to be stronger than Felt, [[Rom]], and the other Felt Camp members except Ezzo Cadner and Reinhard van Astrea. '''Stealth''': Like her sister, Grassis is good at stealth. During the conflict with [[Al]], she managed to stay hidden throughout all of his loops, and she even managed to successfully sneak up on him once without his noticing until it was too late. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Royal Selection Navbox}} [[Category:Felt Camp]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Maids]] [[Category:House Remendis]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]]

Moneylender |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10|Tanpenshuu Volume 10]]}} '''Helaine Gatness''' (へレイン・ガットネス) is the former leader of the Golden Beetle's office in [[Flanders]] and a member of the [[Six Tongues]], acting as a subordinate of [[Russell Fellow]]. Entrusted with the role of an intermediary that lent money to the Big Three underworld organizations of Flanders, she was later demoted for overstepping her bounds, instigating unrest between the Big Three, and unintentionally exposing her affiliation in an attempt to gain a foothold within them, receiving comeuppance from her superior for her failures. ==Appearance== Helaine is a small woman with narrow eyes and twin pigtails in her dark green hair that, depending on the light, can look black. Her right eye is covered by a diagonal fringe. She wears a well-made black suit, a black tie, black gloves, as well as black socks and shoes, qualities that make her appear to be an authentic professional. Perhaps most strikingly, Helaine can often seen with a forced, pasted-on smile that conceals her true thoughts and intentions. ==Personality== Helaine has a condescending and audacious demeanor, a lack of humanity and remorse, an unyielding nature, and a stoic exterior that masks her true intentions and emotions from others. She is willing to investigate people's backgrounds or thoroughly research a particular skill in order to excel at it. For example, Helaine thoroughly analyzed all of the games in Flanders' gambling quarter, with her sheer gambling prowess being why nobody from the Big Three could outmaneuver her in bets. Although highly capable, she views her talents with vain, this being what led her to instigate the unrest in Flanders in an attempt to gain a foothold in the Big Three, failing because she gauged herself as more in control of the situation and mistakenly underestimating the shrewdness of her opposition. She exhibits a strong loyalty and captivation for Russell to the point that she would end her own life if he ordered her to. Rather than strictly adhere to his orders exactly as presented to her, however, Helaine had the inclination to disobey her assignment, believing he would be pleased if she achieved success. When an associate of hers is put at risk, she will not hesitate to let them be if it is advantageous for her interest, recommending against saving [[Belmont]] when he was faced with the threat of murder and assessing his life as a tool to ward off the exposure of her side's involvement. Helaine also feels hostile towards [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]'s knights, considering them inefficient compared to the Six Tongues. ==History== ===[[First Mission Part 1|First Mission]]=== Having been the youngest individual among the ranks of the Six Tongues five years before the start of the [[Royal Selection]], Helaine worked alongside [[Bikram Edditz]] and Julius Juukulius to topple [[Reiner Wahrheit]]'s organization, which dealt in several illicit activities, most notably the sale of the illegal drug Hexcel. Under the pseudonym Helena, she introduced Julius to [[Minor Characters#Blau|Blau]], a member of the organization, providing the man a false story about the rookie knight's identity. When they reconvened after Julius's first day infiltrating the group, he spoke of how he pretended to slay Blau and sought to have him healed, only for Bikram to deny his request. Helaine provided a sample of the Hexcel drug they found, with Bikram saying it was her task to identify their source. When Belmont, a spy in the organization and her colleague in the Six Tongues was detained by Reiner's people on suspicion of leaking information, Helaine was against rescuing him. Julius attempted to convince Helaine and Bikram otherwise, and though she resisted, after she confirmed his view that Belmont would be more beneficial to keep than Blau, they hatched a plan to save him. Using the injured Blau, she drugged him with Hexcel of potent quality, sending him on a rampage, ending with his life being cut short by Reiner's hand. With her mission complete, she prepared herself to move to her next task, briefly conversing with Belmont after his reunion with [[Marcos Gildark]]. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 1|Riot in Flanders]]=== Several years later, Helaine was assigned with the task of managing the Flanders branch of the Golden Beetle, a moneylending loan shark organization with strong links to the underworld. Around the start of the Royal Selection, [[Mozolite]], the second-in-command of the Balance, allied himself with Helaine in an attempt to snatch the position of his boss, [[Manfred Madison]], orchestrating attacks on the Big Three and her own Golden Beetle organization with assassins and leveraging his position in his group to do so. Helaine, perceiving Mozolite's ambition and detecting that he could be easily exploited, supported his goal, believing it would be in the interest of the Six Tongues. Two months later, during a meeting with the representatives of the Big Three concerning the attacks that had been taking place, she proposed the one responsible was [[Felt]], the Royal Selection Candidate being housed by the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint of Hakuchuri]], having received reports that she contacted [[Doltero Amule]] and the Black Silver Coin before. As a result, the leaders of the Balance and the Flower Prison Garden, Manfred and [[Toto]], went on to seek courtesy visits from her as a means to verify her intentions, with Doltero sending his former confidant [[Safis]] to inform her of their wishes. On a night following Felt's courtesy visits with Toto and Doltero, a subordinate of Mozolite's with an Excess Mana Circulation Constitution attacked [[Mimosa]], a student of [[Ezzo Cadner]] who worked for the Flower Prison Garden, setting the brothel she was in on fire. Although Ezzo rushed to the scene, he was rendered unconscious and framed for the arson. With the Big Three after him, he escaped from his predicament with Camberley's help and sought Helaine for his safety, offering unpublished magic theories he had created to her in exchange for an abandoned mansion to use as a safe house. Felt, Reinhard, [[Flam Remendis]], and [[Rachins Hoffman]] visited the Golden Beetle to inquire his whereabouts. Hoping to establish a professional relationship with Felt, she willingly divulged Ezzo's location. Acting as a representative of Ezzo, Rachins, accompanied by Flam, paid a visit to the gambling quarter to directly confront Helaine, who revealed she was aware of his origins as the son of the Royal Instructor, [[Rickert Hoffman]]. Initially making a bet with the unreasonable request that the name or power of the Sword Saint be lent to her, she changed her condition to something more relaxed and what was her true goal: to send a single letter to the Hoffman family with the contents of her choosing. Rachins accepted her bet and selected Shatranj as their game of choice. During the game of Shatranj, Helaine easily outmaneuvered Rachins. However, Manfred arrived in the middle of it, calling Helaine by the same derisive Golden Pest nickname that he used to refer to her and what Rachins had said just earlier, making Helaine quickly realizing that her opponent had greeted the Tattoo Face prior to the game, with Ezzo removing the cognitive disruption mask that concealed his identity to verify that his status as a fugitive among the Big Three had been put on hold. Furthermore, she misunderstood that Rachins's condition should he win the game had been to arrange for Ezzo's escape, when in reality he never provided her with any condition. He then made six clicks of his tongue, indicating his awareness of Helaine's allegiance while simultaneously exposing it to Manfred, declaring "Shatzbort" to signal his victory in an off-board game. With her loyalty to the Six Tongues revealed, and Manfred there to ensure that she fulfilled her end of the bargain, her only option was to minimize her side's losses and take accountability for her own failure. As compensation for her loss, she provided Ezzo with the information that would allow him to avenge his fallen student, Mimosa. The Balance took Helaine into custody afterwards, quickly learning the identity of her collaborator, Mozolite, and his betrayal of their organization. Once everything was said and done, the Golden Beetle's influence and reputation in Flanders plummeted, with its place being succeeded by Felt, and in exchange for a large compensation, the Six Tongues managed to retrieve her from the Balance, with her being taken in and imprisoned underground at an unknown location, likely in a building at the Royal Capital. She personally reported the whole situation to Russell and was subjected to torture from her curse mark in response to her insubordination, vowing to herself that she would overcome the intense pain dealt to her in order to serve him again. ==Abilities== ===[[Curse]]=== '''[[Curse#Six Tongues's Curse Mark|Curse Mark]]''' (呪印, ''Juin''): As a member of Six Tongues, Helaine bears a curse mark that is engraved onto her. When her curse mark is touched by a palm, the curse activates, bringing about an intense pain that causes her to scream in anguish. It is likely that this curse mark is also capable of inflicting death onto her if necessary. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Flanders]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Six Tongues]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]
