[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33|Volume 33]] (main story) |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice =}} '''Lamia Godwin''' (ラミア・ゴドウィン) was an Imperial Princess of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] who participated in the Imperial Selection Ceremony. She played an antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]], [[Arc 7]], and [[Arc 8]]. A member of the Vollachian Imperial Family, Lamia, who became infamous for her use of poison, was found to have the qualifications to become the next emperor. In her pursuit of her goal, she was responsible for the majority of her siblings' deaths during the Imperial Selection Ceremony, until the battle at the Abellux Castle, where she was slain by her younger sister, [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]]. During the [[Great Disaster]], Lamia and many of her deceased family members were resurrected as [[Undead#Zombies|zombies]], with Lamia in particular being one of the primary leaders of the disaster. After confronting her [[Vincent Vollachia|brother]] and [[Spica]], however, her name was eaten, and she was finally put to rest. ==Appearance== Lamia had orange hair, glossy drooping eyes, and an alluringly shaped body with large breasts. She wore a long black dress with an outer crimson garment that matched the color of her eyes. The top had long sleeves that extended down from the elbow, and they had a crest on them. Additionally, Lamia had a penchant for accessories. She could be seen wearing a black head accessory and a green necklace. As a zombie, she possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across her body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. ==Personality== Lamia was a confident and self-assured woman who used cunning and manipulative methods to fulfill her ends. She was cruel, ruthless, and vicious, willing to use any means necessary to achieve her goals, including deceit and violence. Her words sounded as sweet as honey while dripping with malice and sarcasm. She was adept at manipulating others with charm and using them as resources when necessary. Lamia was also blessed with great intellect and had a talent for political tact, yet she also had the foresight to listen to the recommendations of her former advisor, [[Berstetz Fondalfon]].''When she was still young, but beautiful and intelligent, Lamia had the flexibility to listen to Berstetz’s recommendations, take them seriously, reflect and digest them, and let them guide her to the right answer.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 2. Likewise, she was gifted with an intelligent mind able to quickly put things together once she understands the concept behind it, as well as to immediately judge roles suited for the abilities for herself and others and duties befitting their positions.''She had not been instructed how to count from one to ten. Yet this individual, once she understood “one”, she would comprehend “one hundred”, and think up “one hundred and one”. She was someone able to judge for herself and others the roles befitting their abilities, and the duties befitting their position.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 27, Section 1. As shown, Lamia, never really had much attachment to her half-siblings and was fine with manipulating them for her own ends. As shown where she lied to her half-brother [[Barthroy Fitts]] in order to give her an edge in the beginning of the Selection Ceremony by pretending that she genuinely hated the idea of killing her half-siblings for the throne, only to then poison him to death when his guard was down. As revealed, the only half-brother Lamia genuinely cared about and admired was Vincent''Before they opposed each other in the Imperial Selection Ceremony, it was said that Lamia had been quite fond of Vincent. Though life and death had separated their paths, her confidence in him remained intact even after death.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 6. and that she had originally wanted to befriend him and team up together with him when she was younger. But upon seeing the close relationship he had with Prisca, Lamia immediately realized she wouldn't be able to gain Vincent's absolute loyalty unless she died first. Although Lamia was thrilled by those who pose a challenge to her, like Vincent and Prisca, she ultimately came to hate Prisca in particular, even laughing with regret that she had not previously killed her younger sister moments before her own death. As Lamia willingly cooperated with [[Sphinx]] after becoming a zombie, her mind was not subject to the manipulation that many of the other [[Undead|undead]] experienced during the Great Disaster.''In any case, excluding such exceptionally strong individuals, and Lamia Godwin, who had displayed the will to take initiative in cooperating with the Witch, the souls of the undead were cruelly being toyed with.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 2. ==History== Lamia was born as part of the Godwin family, a family which held the rank of Counts in the Vollachia Empire. At the age of nine, Lamia turned the tide of an internal rebellion against the Godwin family with her personal force, the Pruning Corps. As a result, she became the head of the family. At the age of sixteen, Lamia took part in the Imperial Selection Ceremony. She perished at the hands of Prisca Benedict after the attempted [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]] failed with [[Cecilus Segmunt]]'s elimination of the Pruning Corps. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Although Lamia is combat capable in her own right, her strength does not surpass that of most accomplished warriors. However, she makes up for this with her genius intellect, something which made her not just dangerous, but also made it so that she wasa one of the people most likely to win the final Imperial Selection Ceremony. As an undead, although her physical capabilities does not improve, it is because of Lamia that the threat posed by Sphinx grew so much. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Lamia had been recognized as a genius since her earliest days, being able to quickly understand concepts after being given the barest of explanations. It is thanks to this that she was able to not only quickly understand the truth of souls and use the Sacrament of the Immortal King's replication ability to her advantage when she was undead, but she was also quick to understand who should be considered the largest threats during large-scale skirmishes like the Imperial Selection Ceremony. In particular, Lamia excels at cornering her opposition with schemes and traps, something that was partially responsible for epithet, Poison Princess.''In the Imperial Selection Ceremony, brothers and sisters were forced to kill each other until a single one remained; yet she had formed an alliance with her other siblings to defeat Vincent, who had been viewed as the one most likely to take the Emperor’s throne, as she excelled in cornering her opposition through the excellent usage of schemes and traps.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 2. ===Other=== '''The Pruning Corps''' (剪定部隊, ''Sentei butai''): Lamia commanded an elite and loyal force known as the Pruning Corps. The Pruning Corps wore black armor from head to toe and wielded a pair of shears as their weapons of choice.''The intruder, covered head-to-toe in black armor and wielding great shears, emanated a malevolent aura―― an undead, it was.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 3. They were renowned for their cruel and feral nature in battle, and only Lamia and Berstetz were capable of commanding them; even as undead, their instinct is to halt at either of their commands, regardless of their respective affiliations. However, the Pruning Corps were single-handedly decimated by a young Cecilus Segmunt in a battle that later engraved the Blue Lightning's name in history. ===Equipment=== *'''[[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]]''' (陽剣ヴォラキア, ''Youken Vorakia''): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Lamia was capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. The sword appears out of thin air when the user wishes to use it, and it cuts and burns whatever the user desires. *'''Poison''': Lamia commonly used poison to eliminate her enemies, and she became known as the Poison Princess because of her association with it. ==Trivia== *In the original Comic Alive release of [[Crimson Afterglow Part 1|Crimson Afterglow]], Lamia's age was stated to be 14 and her hair was described to be dark red. *According to Sphinx, Lamia was closer to the truth of souls than she was.''“Lamia Godwin, it is true that I have learned from her. She possessed a certain observative ability to see the true nature of things. She was much closer to the truth of ‘souls’ than I am.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 8. *On the sleeve of Lamia's outfit is a crest. As it has not been described in Ex 5 or in the main story, it is unclear whether this is the crest of House Godwin or if it holds some other meaning. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Family]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Imperial Selection Candidates]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Enchanted Sword Users]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

The '''Great Rabbit''' (大兎) is one of the [[Witchbeast#Three Great Witchbeasts|Three Great Witchbeasts]] created by the [[Witch]] of Gluttony, [[Daphne]]. It was one of the main antagonists of [[Arc 4]].

A monstrosity created to feed the masses with their inexhaustible numbers, this unquantifiable carnivorous hare, made too powerful under the pretense of fairness, was treated as a natural disaster, as, under the influence of its creator's hunger, it would eat anything and everything in its path, leaving naught but destruction and scavengers in its wake.

During the [[Sanctuary Incident]], where it was lured into the scheme of [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], it ultimately met its match when confronted with the [[Emilia Camp]]. After having its numbers mostly culled and trapped by the efforts of [[Emilia]], [[Natsuki Subaru]], and [[Beatrice]], it was soon sent to an alternate space, where it would continuously devour itself to sate its hunger.

==Appearance==
A typical rabbit of the Great Rabbit closely resembled the rabbits found on Earth and were even similarly named. Just like real-world rabbits, every Great Rabbit had a short fluffy tail, large hind legs, long ears, and a coat of fur. They were adorned with a pair of sharp front teeth that could cleave through flesh and bone with astounding ease. Their fur was as white as snow, and their eyes, that lit up when filled with murderous intent, were red. Although small in size (roughly twice as large as a clenched human fist), the Great Rabbit more than made up for its lack in strength due to the insurmountable numbers. It had several physical traits common to witchbeasts, including a fluorescent pink wheel-like sigil and a horn. The rabbits' sigils were small and located on the lower right side of their backs and their singular horns, which were small and had a drill-like shape, were located on their foreheads.

==Behavior==
When creating the Great Rabbit, Daphne imprinted her own sense of hunger onto the [[witchbeast]], resulting in the creature feeling a constant urge to eat. The Great Rabbit's primary concern at all times was satisfying the insatiable hunger it felt.<ref>''It raised a cry. It clacked its fangs. The maddening hunger was torture--No, it was already mad. For all eternity, it was forbidden from sating its inexhaustible hunger and satisfying its limitless cravings; this was the madness of Gluttony.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Chapter 8, Section 4.</ref> It considered anything or anyone as suitable food and would devour the flesh, bones, and blood of its targets, leaving nothing behind. It was no more intelligent than most animals, and it wasn't capable of making observations about its prey or whatever scenario it was in. Despite being made up of numerous singular rabbits, the Great Rabbit functioned as a singular consciousness. Because of this, the entire collection of rabbits would always stick closely together. The hunger that the Great Rabbit felt was so extreme that, if there was no food to consume within a convenient distance, the individual rabbits would consume each other in an attempt to sate the consciousness' thirst for food. As such, the Great Rabbit was unique in the fact that it would not try to prevent its demise in the event that its life was threatened, as only satisfying its unending hunger mattered to it.

Due to its nature, it is attracted to traces of strong [[mana]], making it quite easy to lure around. It is unknown whether or not it can be influenced by Subaru's scent of the Witch or the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]], but it has been implied by the author that the Witch Factor of Gluttony could still hold sway over its behavior to some extent,<ref>''“The White Whale obeys Daphne’s Witch Factor. The Rabbit, too, might obey to a certain extent.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/494741464396886016 July 31, 2014 AskFM Q&A]</ref> though it is unclear how much influence it would have on the beast.

==History==
Following its birth 400 years ago, the Great Rabbit terrorized the world for centuries, becoming infamous for leaving behind no remains after ravaging various towns and villages. Due to its unstoppable nature, it was treated as a natural disaster, and groups of people called scavengers started to trail after its wake, stealing any valuables left behind by the beast's victims. Nearly four hundred years after its creation, the Great Rabbit's rampage brought it to the Foutour Plains within the lands of the noble [[House Karsten]] in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]. Luckily, the forces of Duke [[Meckart Karsten]] led by the duke's daughter, [[Crusch Karsten]], who employed her One Blow, One Hundred Felled technique to dispatch a number of individual rabbits, were able to drive the Great Rabbit out of the Karsten Duchy with minimum casualties beyond wildlife and environmental damage, with her attendant [[Ferris]] also healing the duke after he received a battle wound. 

==Abilities==
===Overall Power===
Despite its kill count, each individual rabbit is not particularly strong, and combatants can slay individual rabbits rather easily, whether physically or with magic. However, its threat comes with the sheer number that the Great Rabbit produces. The numbers are so overwhelming that most cannot withstand the endless torrent of rabbits, and eventually, they would be eaten. Like the White Whale, this is the reason that they stayed alive for centuries and brought ruin to many, effectively making them closer to a natural disaster than anything else. In fact, even during the incident where it was finally defeated, it required a combined effort just to seal them away, which could only be done after quelling a certain number of them first.

===Physical Traits===
<gallery type="slideshow">
Re Zero Light Novel 11 9.png|The bite of a single rabbit tearing off Subaru's hand.
Great Rabbit and Natsuki Subaru ep.33.png|The Great Rabbit eating Subaru.
</gallery>
'''Powerful Bite''': Despite their small sizes, a single Great Rabbit had enough jaw strength and a sharp enough pair of teeth that it could tear through flesh and bone with minimal effort. A single bite of a single rabbit was enough to completely tear a person's hand from their body, as if the bone had not been there in the first place. If the entire horde were to attack a single person, there would not be a single trace of them left.

===Other===
'''Multiplication''': The Great Rabbit's biology allowed for it to naturally itself multiply instantly and infinitely,<ref>''Its body trembled. As a consequence of its madness, it had subconsciously reproduced, creating a being separate from itself.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Chapter 8, Section 4.</ref> and the collective consciousness would only die when every single rabbit was destroyed. It is for this reason that it was considered practically impossible to kill the Great Rabbit. The highest known limit of individual rabbits that the Great Rabbit seems to be capable of splitting into is 80,000,<ref>''Beatrice’s concern was how to simultaneously strike down the tens of thousands of Great Rabbits.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Chapter 8, Section 2.</ref><ref>''“They’re cute, four-legged rabbits. They’ve got a bit of a mouthful of sharp teeth, and if you think of a face like the lapahns from the Drum Kingdom in One Piece, that’d be just right. About 80,000 of them will rush you at once.”'' August 22, 2014 AskFM Q&A</ref> and it is unknown if the total amount of rabbits at any one time can go higher.

'''Mana Sensing''': In order to find new prey, the Great Rabbit could sense large amounts of mana and tended to follow its to its source. This often led the Great Rabbit discovering living creatures, as living creatures generally had the highest concentration of mana that could be found. Because of this, it was possible for a skilled magician to lure the Great Rabbit to a specific location by providing a strong magic spell for it to follow.

==Trivia==
*Like [[Rui Arneb]], the Great Rabbit was likely inspired by or represents the constellation of [[wikipedia:Lepus (constellation)|Lepus]].
**Rui has also shown a similar multiplication ability to the Great Rabbit with her Witch Factor.
**It is also possible that the Great Rabbit was loosely inspired by the Al-Mi'raj from medieval Arabic literature.
*The Great Rabbit's birthday is June 5, a play on the Japanese word "mugoi" (惨い), which can be translated as "brutal". The date is 6/5 in numerical form, and six (六) and five (五) can be pronounced as "mu" and "go" respectively. This date was chosen for the Great Rabbit's birthday because the author considers it to be responsible for killing Subaru in the most brutal way.<ref name="birthday" />
*According to the author, the other Witches were desperate not to let [[Minerva]] see the Great Rabbit, as they were concerned about whether she would attempt to heal them or not.<ref>''"It is the reason why Witches were so desperate not to let Minerva-tan see the Great Rabbit."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref>
*According to the author, if the horns of the first few rabbits were broken, every rabbit that appeared afterward would be without a horn as well.<ref>''"If you break the horns on the first few, all of them that appear afterwards are hornless."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref>

[[Minor Characters#Picard Aurélie|Picard Aurélie]] (older brother) |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 26|Volume 26]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Jamal Aurélie''' (ジャマル・オーレリー) is a Low Count of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] and the sole Escort General of the [[Imperial Army]], acting as the bodyguard of the emperor and the empress consort. He played both supporting and antagonistic roles in [[Arc 7]] and a supporting role in [[Arc 8]]. Initially appearing as a Private First-Class of the Imperial Army, Jamal was captured by members of the People of Shudrak during the [[Fall of Guaral]] and held under Second-Class General [[Zikr Osman]]'s forces. Eventually, he joined the two groups in helping Vincent Abellux reclaim his throne. During the [[Great Disaster]], Jamal was promoted to a Third-Class General and was appointed as Vincent's personal bodyguard while on the way to [[Lupugana]], maintaining this role after he survived the [[Conquest of the Undead Capital]] and being granted the title of Escort General. ==Appearance== Jamal is a tall and very well-built man wearing an eyepatch with Vollachia's Sword Wolf symbol over his scarred right eye. He has rough blue eyes, messy and unkempt dark brown hair, as well as a small stubble beard. As per all Imperial Soldiers who are not Generals, Jamal could be seen sporting Vollachia's standard military uniform, consisting of a red undershirt with short sleeves, a grey overshirt, black pants, black boots with red stripes, black gloves, and a chest protector and shoulder pads. He retains the same uniform upon his promotion to Third-Class General. He also has two twin swords which are usually stationed on his back when they're not drawn. ==Personality== Jamal tends to be an openly hostile and aggressive man. Likewise, he has a tendency to quickly resort to violence. Despite being initially stopped by [[Todd Fang|Todd]], Jamal continued to with his oppressive and rough attitude towards [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], going as far as to stomp on Subaru's broken fingers and badly beat him, and he even lifted [[Spica]] by the hair and slammed her into the ground in order to "teach her a lesson". Despite these rough traits, however, Jamal has a sense of honor. He can fight alongside his comrades without complaint, and he becomes enraged on their account if someone was responsible for causing them harm, as in the case with [[Rem]]. In a similar way, he has shown willing to take injuries meant for his comrades in battle, and he recognizes when he needs to defend someone because of their importance to the given situation. He pushed Subaru and Spica out of the way of an attack meant for them while taking the injury himself, realizing that they were key for taking down the Great Disaster. Jamal is a loyal man, showing his emperor the utmost respect, and he is even willing to punish those he believes are being disrespectful towards the man. This loyalty even extends to people he is willing to take into his family, such as [[Medium O'Connell]], who became the Imperial Empress Consort. The same can also be said for his own only family. Though he always acts tough in front of his sister [[Katya Aurélie|Katya]], he feels sad when she is hurt, and he is willing to martyr himself during battle so that all of the proceeds of his death would be sent to her, believing that that was the best way to help her aside from being there himself. This side of him also quite characteristic of most Vollachian soldiers, who all wish to fight in meet their end in battle, as Vincent himself attests to. ==History== Five years before the start of the main story, Jamal was stationed in the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]]. After the destruction of the city resulting from the [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]] some years prior, numerous factions of bandits came into the city under one union and interfered with the rebuilding process. However, Jamal fought and slew one of the bandit's leaders in order to make his enemies lose morale at the cost of his right eye. Later, Jamal met Todd, who had quit being a bandit at that point, and introduced him to his younger sister, Katya. ===[[Sword Identity Part 1|Sword Identity]]=== Roughly two to three months before the start of the main story, Jamal and Todd were talking about the revolt that had started at that point in time by [[Yorna Mishigure]], the Seventh ranking Divine General. During this conversation, Jamal talked about how he heard a rumor about testing people in the subjugation of Yorna's rebellion in order to see who would take the place of the [[Balleroy Temeglyph|former Ninth ranking Divine General]]. After Jamal was asked about his source, he revealed that he had heard it from a few people who fled from a fortress that Yorna had attacked. After taking the time to gather more information, the two later captured the fled soldiers to turn them in as prisoners and helped to bring an end to the rebellion, though they received no reward for their contributions. ==Abilities== '''Skilled Swordsman''': Jamal is a dual-wielding swordsman with surprisingly graceful skill. He is easily capable of dispatching strong opponents, be it [[witchbeast]]s, other soldiers, or [[Dragon#Flying Dragons|flying dragons]],''Dexterously handling his two long swords, the man slashed away the wings of a flying dragon and then jumped to the side of the other flying dragon that dropped down at the same time, cutting off its head as it tried to bite him.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 91, Section 2. as well as deflecting a storm of arrows shot at him with high speed and precision.''"One after another, a storm of arrows rained down on them. Stomping and dancing on the ground, he swung his sword, slicing arrows and striking them down. It was a sword dance, the sword dance of Jamal Aurélie."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 27, Section 3 After Subaru led Todd, Jamal, and the rest of their group into the Elgina's ambush, Jamal was the one who fought it almost single-handedly and even decapitated it without much trouble, a feat not many can pride themselves with. Later, he was able to easily dispatch someone as strong as [[Holly Shudrak]] with relative ease. Jamal had risen to his rank as a First-Class Soldier in the Empire for his skill with the sword and fighting prowess, which is said to be on par with roughly ten regular Imperial Soldiers,''"Even Jamal, whose only claim to fame was his tremendous swordsmanship and fighting prowess, was about as good as ten regular Imperial soldiers."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 27, Section 1 and was thought by Todd to be able to reach the status of Third-Class General in time, which he successfully reached by the time of the Great Disaster. However, he still cannot compare himself to truly strong individuals such as the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]]. '''Above-Average Reflexes''': Jamal displayed above average reflexes in battle, as he was easily able to run long distances and deflect incoming arrows with his twin swords without getting hit or even grazed by them. '''Enhanced Strength''': While not possessing even a fifth of the strength of the individuals such as the Divine Generals, Jamal is very strong for a normal person. '''Enhanced Speed''': Jamal is shown to be fast enough to easily outpace a Galewind Horse.''An uncouth yet charming smile emerged on his face, and Jamal accelerated after saying that. He easily overtook Leidy’s speed, and charged right into the group of stone golems directly in front of them.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 96, Section 3. '''Leadership''': Despite his crude demeanor, Jamal is rather charismatic with imperial soldiers, and he is capable of making quick decisions and leading them, giving him the makings of a general.''Jamal was quick to switch gears, and he harshly called to the other soldiers to start assembling―― those in the same situation as him who joined them in the fortified city. His voice was loud, his will was clear, and he boasted some genuine strength. Surprisingly, he might have the makings of a “General”.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 91, Section 2. '''Equipment''' *'''Twin Swords''': Jamal masterfully wields twin swords in battle, using either for offense or defense as needed with surprising skill. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Bodyguards]]

==Appearance==
Korrina wears a green and yellow outfit with a hat, and she has long purple twintails.

==Personality==
Korrina is a mysterious girl who calls herself an adventurer. She has a bright and innocent personality that, and she is able to become familiar with anyone. She speaks in a casual and polite tone, but she has a habit of choosing words and expressions at times.

People of Shudrak |Previous Affiliation = |Occupation = |Previous Occupation = |Status = Alive |Relatives = |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = Hatchet |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 26|Volume 26]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Kuna Shudrak''' (''クーナ・シュドラク'') is a member of the [[Terminology#Races and Clans/Tribes|People of Shudrak]] located in the depths of the Buddheim Jungle, in the Vollachia Empire. She played a supportive role in [[Arc 7]]. Not long after [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent]]'s initial meeting at the start of Arc 7, Kuna was the one who first made contact with the former emperor, and took him to the Shudraks' village, at Vincent's own request. ==Appearance== Kuna is a beautiful, dark-skinned woman with a very slender but well-built stature. She has a stern look on her face as well as long, naturally black hair which she dyed bright green, accordingly to her people's customs. Just like other members of the Shudrak, Kuna usually travels around with a bow, though she rarely uses as she's not very skilled with it. ==Personality== Kuna is shown to be rather hot tempered and rash, often even childish. She easily falls victim to provocations from her fellow people, especially to [[Holly Shudrak|Holly]]'s, who she shares the same day of birth. Furthermore, she's shown to be rather close with Holly, likely due to their shared date of birth. Having said that, Kuna does not act particularly fondly towards Holly, lashing out at her on numerous occasions and throwing a fit when being compared to her. ==Abilities== '''Excelled Tracking Skills''': As Kuna fell behind her fellow people in the art of marksmanship, she more than made up for it with her tracking abilities. She's excellent in tracking prey and setting up traps for them to fall into. '''Enhanced Eyesight''': Kuna also makes up for her lack of marksmanship with her farsighted and dynamic vision. When she pairs up with Holly, Kuna is the one who tells her where and when to aim. At minimum, she could clearly see the escaping Subaru outside of [[Guaral]], and she directed Holly’s shot to hit a falling [[Todd Fang]] despite the short amount of time she would have seen him. '''Equipment''': During the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], Kuna wielded a short hatchet.''Holly shot the stone golems that surrounded them with her bow, Kuna bashed them with her short hatchet as she gave a remark, and in response, Taritta said that with a sharp voice.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 93, Section 1. ==Trivia== *Kuna shares the same birthday as Holly, which is why the two are "soul sisters". ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:People of Shudrak]]

She played a supportive role in [[Arc 7]]. ==Appearance== Holly is a beautiful but rather chubby girl with bountiful breasts, clad in minimal clothing. She has a playful yet teasing gaze, chubby face and short black hair which she dyed yellow, according to the Shudraks' customs. Just like her fellow people, Holly can also usually be seen with a bow. ==Personality== As her appearance dictates, Holly is a rather playful girl, often teasing her friends, especially [[Kuna Shudrak|Kuna]], the girl she shares her birthday with. Despite her teasing nature, however, Holly's words know how to hit the right spots as she's easily able to infuriate the aforementioned woman with a single short remark. As one would surmise from her appearance, Holly is quite fond of food, willing to go to extra lengths in order to catch herself a tasty meal. ==Abilities== '''Skilled Marksman''': Holly is quite skilled with her bow, which she can usually be seen carrying around. Combined with her strength, her shots are extremely precise and powerful, as she was able to easily kill a wild animal with a single precise snipe which pierced the animal's heart. She was also able to destroy one of the [[undead]] [[Valgren]]'s heads with a single arrow.''The two of them combined their efforts to wield the powerful bow, and with a loud sound akin to a star being pierced, they landed a direct hit on the blinded head of the Blight Dragon, blasting everything above the jaw completely away, and reducing the Three-Headed turned Two-Headed even further into the One-Headed.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 6. '''Spearmanship''': Holly has shown some skill with the spear when she clashed with [[Jamal Aurélie]]. '''Exceptional Strength''': Among the Shudrak, Holly’s physical strength is by far the highest among them. With minimal effort, she can lift boulders, and she is even able to pull her bow’s string, which would take the strength of multiple others to pull. '''Equipment''': *'''Bow and Arrows''': Like most of the People of Shudrak, Holly uses a bow as her primary weapon. However, unlike the others', her bow requires incredible strength to draw the string, and the arrows fired are practically ballistae by comparison to the rest of her people. *'''Spear''': She temporarily used this to watch over [[Arakiya|prisoners]] in [[Guaral]]. ==Trivia== *Holly shares the same birthday as Kuna, which is why the two are "soul sisters". ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:People of Shudrak]]

He played a supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. ==Appearance== Jorah was an old man with a decently tall stature, a wrinkled face with sky blue eyes and ashen grey hair. He was usually dressed in fine turquoise clothes and wore a hat of the same color pallet. ==Personality== Jorah was a cowardly man who didn't have the strength nor the ambition to behave as the Vollachian code demands of its denizens. Though he had a weak side, he also had a caring personality when it came to Priscilla despite their age difference, taking care of her for as long as he could until his untimely death. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Around 7 years before the main story, Jorah married Priscila sometime after her fake death and he chose to care for her. Sometime later, [[Serena Dracroy]] sent her servants [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] and [[Miles]] to the Pendleton Estate in order to invite him and Priscilla to the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. While they were there, the gladiators attempted to spark a [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|revolution]] that would render the island independent from the mainland, which later ended up failing thanks to the intervention of the Imperial Army. Soon afterwards, Jorah was accused of attempting to overthrow the emperor of Vollachia, [[Vincent Vollachia]], from his position. As a result, [[Goz Ralfon]] visited his manor in an attempt to take custody of him and Priscilla for a scheduled execution. Jorah fended Goz and his escorts off for Priscilla's sake, knowing that he would meet his end in just mere moments. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Deceased]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|Volume 37]] (main story) |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Hornet''' (ホーネット) was a gladiator at the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. She played an antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame]] and a minor antagonistic role in [[Arc 8]]. One of the Gladiator Island's most powerful warriors, Hornet was famous for her strength and was regarded as the Gladiator Empress. During the insurgence of the island, due to her desire to battle [[Al]], a gladiator who often won his battle through strange methods, she partook on [[Ubilk]]'s side to get a chance to fight him. However, once she did, she was ultimately killed by poison, dying a dishonorable death against her wish. During the [[Great Disaster]], Hornet appeared as a [[Undead#Zombies|zombie]] and faced off against [[Goz Ralfon]] outside the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]]. Following the end of the disaster, it is unknown whether or not she escaped from death. ==Appearance== Hornet is a tall woman over two meters in height, towering over her opponents. She has short black hair with her sides shaved and colored light purple, deep purplish-red eyes, and tends to dress herself in a black and yellow body suit. Finally, before battle, Hornet always put on her two black and light-purple swords which she wears as prosthetics. The blades were so heavy that she was required to have at least two people put them on. As a zombie, she possesses a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that run across her body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. ==Personality== Hornet tended to often tease or flirt with people she either respected or was relatively close with, such as Al and Ubilk. However, in combat, Hornet was a nasty and brutal fighter who disregarded a fair fight. Contrary to expectations, Hornet's most fervent and desired wish was to gloriously die in combat against someone who could overpower her. ==History== At some point in time, Hornet came to the Gladiator Island Ginunhive, where she spent the rest of her life fighting in the arena. In an incident four years prior to the uprising, all of the gladiators on the island fought a large [[witchbeast]]. The only two survivors of this battle were Hornet herself and Al. After the incident, she grew an interest in Al after having initially thought of him as small fry. Right before the uprising at Ginunhive, she joined Ubilk's [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|rebellion]] in the hopes that she would get to fight Al. Although she easily overpowered him when they finally crossed blades, he used [[Al#Abilities|his ability]] in order to cheat death 79 times, nearly bleeding out in the process until Arakiya saved him. In the end, after Al returned and tried to defeat her 713 more times,''“It’s all trial and error, seven hundred thirteen times. You’ve killed me seven hundred thirteen times tonight.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], [[The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame Part 3|The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame]], Section 24. totalling to 792 deaths in all,''“Huh. Actually, if we count that first battle in the arena, I guess it’s seven hundred ninety-two times.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], [[The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame Part 3|The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame]], Section 24. Hornet died a non-honorable death from poisoning after Al asked Arakiya to burn the body of a [[shinobi]] who used a technique known as the Poison Hand. ==Abilities== '''Considerable Strength''': Hornet is an extremely skilled fighter. Before meeting [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], Al described her as the third or fourth strongest person he had met in his life. Her strength was renowned enough that when she revived as an undead, Goz Ralfon considered her a worthy opponent. '''Equipment''': As she had lost her arms during her time on the Gladiator Island, Hornet wielded two giant prosthetic arm swords which she wielded as her main weapons. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Ginunhive]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Gladiators]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]] [[Category:Unknown Status]]

[[Minor Characters#Kafma's Uncle|Unnamed uncle]] |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 28|Volume 28]]}} '''Kafma Irulux''' (カフマ・イルルクス) is the '''Seventh ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He plays both a supporting and antagonistic role in [[Arc 7]] and a supporting role in [[Arc 8]]. Raised in secret from the rest of the [[Insect Cage Tribe]], Kafma came to become a prodigy whose body could withstand taking in far more insects than the rest of his clan. Though regarded as a monster by other members of his clan, he is a righteous and loyal man. In the [[Imperial Army]], he has both the strength and popularity to warrant a potential promotion to Divine General. Following the events of the [[Great Disaster]], he officially took on the role of the Seventh Divine General. ==Appearance== Kafma is an average-sized man with brown skin, yellow eyes, short, bristling yellow-green hair, green tattoos on his arms and torso, a scar on his left eyebrow, and a red jewel-like object or body part on his forehead. Kafma is usually seen in a cropped sleeveless shirt that leaves his entire toned abdomen exposed, a yellow collar piece atop his shoulders, a grey cloak torn around the hem, black loose-fitting pants, a purple sash around his waist, and black shoes that leave the tops of his foot exposed. His facial expressions, physique, and the overall air he gives off have all been described to be as sharp as a wire. ==Personality== Most of the time, Kafma acts professional and follows orders without many complaints. However, his temper is rather short, which makes him appear very tense and quick-to-blow-up, often causing him to make impulsive decisions mere moments after hearing an unwanted reply. When subjected to scenarios he isn't fond of, Kafma doesn't refrain from speaking his mind, be it to someone of a lower rank than him or to the very Divine Generals who command him. This being said, he is not above admitting his faults,''"――I admit my lack of insight."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. and it is for this very reason that he believes himself unworthy of being one of the Nine Divine Generals despite being given the chance. As with most of the other members of the Imperial Army, he is also very patriotic, and he holds the Empire as well as the [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]] in very high regards. Despite his short temper, Kafma is a virtuous man,''Kafma could have ignored the stares he received and continued to live the life he had as an unrelated outsider. However, despite being raised differently from others, Kafma’s character was virtuous.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. and he holds shame as a result of his clan's involvement in a previous rebellion against the emperor and doesn't always hold himself in high regards, and he seeks to atone for his clan's involvement in their rebellion.''"I understand that you still seek to atone for the rebellion orchestrated by your kin, along with that damned Balleroy! But! Atonement may not be achieved through death! You must live!"'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 3. Due to the way he was isolated growing up and considered a monster by everyone around him, Kafma came to understand that he did not want to feel the loneliness that could not be shared or understood by others.''It was not that Kafma wanted to be told that he was not a monster. It was just that he did not want to be in a loneliness that could not be shared or understood by anyone.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. Kafma is also very respectful towards those beneath him, something that made him immensely popular with other soldiers. He has also displayed this quality to people he believed to be citizens of the Empire. Before he realized that [[Natsuki Subaru]]’s group was actually his enemies, he displayed outward frustration on their behalf, stating that having an audience in the same place as the emperor when this ordinarily should not have happened was extremely troubling for them and highly discomfortable. During combat, Kafma typically respects his opponent.''His gaze caught Kafma kneeling on the wall, touching the torn wings on his back, looking at Garfiel with admiration and reverence in his eyes.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. During the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], when he confronted [[Garfiel Tinzel]], despite being on opposite sides, Kafma showed respect towards him, and he even expressed sadness when he was forced to try and implant an insect in him, claiming he did not like doing so but that he couldn't afford to let Garfiel win due to them being at war.''"――. I have no doubt that you are a person of great skill, whether you keep your mouth shut or not. That’s why I’m also regretful."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2.''"If it weren’t for the circumstances, I would’ve liked to have had a straightforward conversation with you."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. He even disliked watching the agony he suffered as a result of his attack,''Garfiel gasped in agony and cursed the result of clawing at his own chest, thinking that he had, in fact, blocked the escape route of the “insects” in his body. His breathing became agonized and his vision turned bright red. Unable to bear the sight of Garfiel’s agony, Kafma stepped forward with a somber look on his face.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. and he told him somberly that he would remember his strength and prowess after he died.''"Your skill and prowess, I, Kafma Irulux, will surely bear them in my heart. ――Sleep valiantly."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. This being said, while duking it out with him and seeing Garfiel survive his deadly attack, Kafma displayed great joy at fighting him like an equal,''Kafma Irulux had enjoyed his battle with Garfiel Tinzel to the fullest.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. and he became elated and smiled at being able to fight with everything he and his insects had.''In the end, he was a military man, and no matter how he may try to pretend, he was a monster, and going along with the “insects” that cheered from within him, before he knew it, a smile had stuck to Kafma’s cheeks and would not come off. The thirty-two “insects”, the beings that had become one with himself and were closer to him than his own family, were delighted that they finally had a chance to show their full heart and soul, and began to rant and rave.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. Likewise, despite him knowing that there are other commendable warriors in the Empire, he prides himself on being the bravest among them when in the face of death, and he will willingly push himself to the brink of death in order to assist his comrades.''The Empire had many other dependable warriors besides him, but Kafma prided himself on being the bravest when faced with death. He had to prove that his pride was real.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 3. ==History== Kafma grew up as a member of the Insect Cage Tribe, a tribe where members would form symbiotic bonds with insects to gain power. Typically, most members of the tribe were meant to train their mind and body until the age of twelve, where they then receive their first insect. However, Kafma's father, the older brother of the tribe's chief who lost his mind due to being inferior to his younger brother,''As the elder brother of the Chief, his father turned mad because he remained inferior to his younger, brilliant brother and directed it towards his own child.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. declared his son dead a few days after birth. In reality, Kafma was forced to take in his first insect a few days after his birth,''The ritual of implanting an “insect” was not supposed to be performed until the twelfth birthday for fear of endangering the vessel’s life, but Kafma had taken in his first “insect” when he was only a few days old.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. and from then on, he was forced to take in one insect a year until he was twelve. At the age of twelve, his existence was discovered, his father was executed,''His real father was executed by his younger brother, the Chief, his true intentions remaining unknown. However, his father had declared his son dead soon after his birth, isolating Kafma, and performing the ritual of implanting an “insect” into him every year.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. and his uncle, the tribe's chief, chose to take responsibility for him.''With his father already dying after he was emotionally executed for breaking the law and cursing his child, the reason Kafma had been able to incorporate over a dozen “insects” was completely unknown――Eventually, his uncle, the Chief, declared that he would take responsibility for Kafma’s existence and allowed him to live.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. Despite being avoided and feared by others his age, he actively interacted with others, learned how to be a warrior from his chieftain uncle, and showed that he was not different from them by being tenacious in his interactions with all generations.''He actively interacted with others, learned how to be a warrior from his chieftain uncle, and showed that he was not different from them by being tenacious in his interactions with all generations.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. Eventually, Kafma chose to take in a fourteenth insect in the face of opposition from tribe's elders, and after three days and nights of suffering, he took in the insect to become recognized as a full-fledged member of the Insect Cage Tribe.''There was some opposition. Since Kafma was unique in the history of the Insect Cage Tribe, who had already taken in thirteen “insects”, there were high expectations for how much growth he would achieve simply by growing up.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1.''But this time, Kafma recklessly took in his fourteenth “insect”, and after three days and three nights of suffering and vomiting blood, he survived. And so Kafma Irulux had finally hatched as a member of the Insect Cage Tribe.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. Thus, he became the strongest member the tribe had ever seen.''Kafma, despite his peculiar birth, was possessed of virtuous spirit and won the outstanding respect of his tribe, making him the strongest in the history of the Insect Cage Tribe.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. Although he tried to show a virtuous sense of camaraderie to his fellow tribe members, they could only see him as a monster, and he left his homeland to escape this perception.''――Kafma Irulux was a “monster” born out of the history of the Insect Cage Tribe. With a virtuous spirit and a sense of camaraderie with his fellow countrymen, he took the initiative to fight the enemy and protect his tribe. However, no matter how much effort he put in, his tribesmen continued to draw a line between Kafma and themselves. Because they knew the difficulty of coexisting with insects, they could not see Kafma as one of them.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. He found the people of the outside world to see him in the same way, and he came to believe that there was nowhere he could escape from being a monster by the time he became a General in the Imperial Army.''Even in the outside world, Kafma’s remarkable true strength was beyond the norm and thereby regarded as heretical. Many that he stood shoulder to shoulder with as regular soldiers feared Kafma’s prowess, and they kept away from his abnormality. That no matter where, he was a monster, that in the end, it was a fate he could not escape, such was as Kafma had thought.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. Despite this, he was told to disregard that he was a monster by a comrade of his who thought of himself the same way,''"――Rise up, General Third-Class Kafma! Together, let us do everything in our power for the glorious sake of His Excellency! What, don’t think too much about it, for just like you, we are all monsters!"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. and he realized that he was okay with being considered one on the condition that he wasn't excluded from being understood by other people. Roughly two to three months after the death of the former ninth ranking Diving General, [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], a meeting was held in order to determine who would take his place. The fifth ranking Divine General, [[Goz Ralfon]], quickly suggested Kafma as a suitable candidate due to his deep loyalty to the Empire and its emperor, as well as his very well-honed skills as a warrior which let him ascend to the rank of a Second-Class General at a very young age. After [[Yorna Mishigure]] began a revolt, Kafma was released from his house arrest in order to handle the rebellion and prove his usefulness against the other candidate, [[Madelyn Eschart]]. However, before confronting the citizens of [[Chaosflame]] with Goz, Kafma ultimately concluded that he was not fit to become a Divine General and gave up his chances of taking the ninth seat after admitting that he was unqualified for the position to the emperor, Vincent Vollachia. ==Abilities== '''Insect Cage Clan Attacks''': As a member of the Insect Cage Clan, Kafma can masterfully use a variety of his Clan's trademark attacks and weapons.''The Insect Cage Tribe could use the power of the “insects” that coexisted within their bodies, and depending on the type of “insects” that were taken in, they could manifest a wide variety of abilities and combat techniques. But, the relationship between the Insect Cage Tribe and the “insects” was always a symbiotic one.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 3. Although he originally had 32,''――And Kafma Irulux was a monster that had taken in thirty-two “insects”.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 1. he now holds a total of 33 different insects inside himself, each with unique abilities. As the relationship between Kafma and his insects are meant to be symbiotic, his insects typically require mana or lifeforce for the use of their power. However, should those prove insufficient, they will begin to eat flesh and blood instead.''Naturally, the “insects” would seek compensation from their host for their work. That would usually be the host’s mana or lifeforce, but if that was found to be insufficient, it would be their flesh and blood.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 3. When being forced to use a vast quantity of insects to fire off thorns, bullets of light, and blades of wind simultaneously over an extended period of time without proper nourishment, he could feel the insects eating away at him from the inside, causing him intense pain.''While striking them with thorns, bullets of light, and blades of wind, Kafma gritted his teeth against the appetite of the “insects” that were eating away at him from the inside, stifling his urge to scream.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 3.''Already, more than fifty hours had passed since Kafma had decided to fight with the resolve to die, and during that time, he had quite literally been forced to go without eating or drinking. Although his consciousness had been sharpened like never before by his awakened fighting spirit, to the “insects” inside his body, the host’s state of mind was irrelevant. They would simply lodge a complaint to the host about the fact that they were hungry, run out of patience if the host refused to lend an ear, and start to devour their flesh.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 3. It is also possible to frighten the insects inside of him, preventing them from continuing to devour him from the inside. However, it is unknown whether or not this can affect Kafma's fighting strength.''Just at this moment, even the “insects” that were eagerly devouring Kafma’s body halted their movements, paralyzed by the fierce aura of Goz standing before them.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 3. *'''Thorns''': Kafma can skillfully fire countless purple thorn-like insects towards his enemies with extreme precision and speed, and the thorns can all be as long as a human arm. With this attack, Kafma easily breaches the distance between him and his enemies, skewering them before they have the chance to retaliate. Likewise, these thorns can come attached to strong vines. Kafma can use these insects both to protect people over a wide area and to grab onto multiple targets at once. He can also create footholds for his allies with this ability. The vines are often used in defense and support rather than for offense, though that doesn't mean they can't be used for offense.''His tattoo-covered dark-brown skin bulged from the inside, and immediately after, an enormous amount of thorns shot out, completely filling Garfiel’s field of view as he charged head-on. The speed of the thorned vines growing countless spines gave the impression of a carnivorous beast leaping at its prey. In other words, it was the fastest attack to reap the life of an opponent.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. In fact, when the vines charge at an opponent, the pressure generated has been compared to an entire forest crashing into an opponent.''Without exaggeration, the pressure was like that of a whole forest crashing into him.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. It even has enough binding strength to hold back a [[Dragon]] of [[Valgren]]'s level for a short period of time.''Along with a courageous voice, bulging thorns reached out to the sky from the city walls, furiously approaching the Blight Dragon of outstretched wings―― an onslaught of Kafma Irulux’s doing. Kafma’s suppressive power, capable of single-handedly upholding the warfront filled with undead as far as the eye could see, entangled Valgren’s entire body, its eyes not in their normal state, binding its wings before they could be torn apart. Of course, it was only a matter of time before the thorns would be torn to shreds by the Dragon’s physical strength.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 6. This being said, as the thorns are part of the insect, if they get damaged, it can hurt the insect, causing them to scream out in pain, and as such there will be backlash.''With one fell swoop of his claws, he mowed down the tip of the thorns in every floor of the rampart, and the sensation of the insect screaming within shook Kafma’s brain. The seemingly endless amount of thorns were part of the “insect” that Kafma had taken in. Naturally, if they were hurt, there would be a proportionate backlash. They just suppressed it through their sheer vitality to make it seem like there is no reaction at all.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 32 2.png|thumb|right|250px|Kafma's wings.]] *'''Wings''': Kafma can sprout six insect wings that enable him to fly.''Thus introducing himself with that, six transparent wings protruded from Kafma’s back, tearing through the cloak he had worn from the inside. Seeing that preparation for war――No, rather than preparation for war, he accepted that as an introduction.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 86, Section 4. By making his speed vary with the movement of his wings, he can confuse his enemy by moving in and out of their awareness.''Momentarily, those wings fluttered so fast they were difficult to see, and at the same time, the sight of Kafma having kicked off the rampart appeared right beside Garfiel. Rather than just being quick, he varied his speed. Via this method, he went around and entered from behind Garfiel’s awareness.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. He can also unleash slashes from his wings.''The howling Garfiel brought his arms down and they fell as vertically spinning golden discs. Kafma raised both arms and decided he could not stop them, so he pushed forward, and decided to go beneath Garfiel’s groin and behind him, aiming for his exposed back, which he could see from the side. However, Kafma unleashed his winged slash without turning back and was knocked away by a rising stone right between them. Just before Kafma’s attack could reach him from beneath his groin, Garfiel placed his outstretched leg on the floor and activated his Divine Protection, blocking the attack.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. *'''Ribs''': By protruding his ribs from his body,''There was a sound of bones creaking with pain, and Kafma’s chest wearing light armor burst open from inside. White ribs opened outwards from inside his body, and they pointed their sharp tips downward while trembling.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 86, Section 4. the golden insect within can create a powerful attack that can hollow out anything his ribs aimed at,''――A moment later, Kafma’s chest opened as the wings on his back flapped powerfully, lifting him off the ground. Beyond his protruding ribs, his eyes caught a glimpse of the golden “insect” within his chest.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2.''――Immediately after, Kafma’s entire body rebounded violently, and the recoil sent his tall figure sliding back. His heels that had been firmly dug in, pared through the rampart, and Kafma looked forward as he endured the tearing pain. Below him, the line of fire that Kafma’s ribs had aimed at was completely hollowed out, and it swallowed up all the Centaur People who should have been on their way, annihilating them.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 86, Section 4. including the top of the reinforced walls of Lupugana's ramparts,''Following the urging of every survival instinct, he abandoned Kafma’s body and leaped directly to the side. It was the correct decision. Right where Garfiel had previously been, the golden insect had gouged out the entire top of the city wall in its line of fire. As short hairs on his body were shaved away, Garfiel felt a chill run his spine.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. and once the attack is done, his ribs close again.''Firmly, he stroked down his torso that had moved the Centaur People aside, and his ribs closed back inside his open chest.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 86, Section 4. This being said, the use of this insect wears on Kafma's mind and body and is not meant for rapid firing.''The new “insect” was powerful, but the backlash was just as great. It was a double-edged sword that completely took away the strength of his mind and body, and it should not be fired rapidly.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 86, Section 4. *'''Carapaces''': Kafma can generate black carapaces one his arms like gauntlets and use them for self-protection like Garfiel's gauntlets.''Along with his roar, the released back-handed blow was striking into Kafma’s face that had appeared beside him. Against that, Kafma threw up his arms in defense――both being covered with black carapaces. Like Garfiel’s gauntlets, it was protection for himself. However, with thorns, wings, ribs, and now carapaces, he already had four abilities. Just how many “insects” did he have in his body?'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. *'''Antennae''': By transforming his shoulder bones into red antennae, he can fire them off like cannonballs that can send a transformed Garfiel flying backward.''The moment he slid to an unguarded side, red antennae shot out from Kafma’s shoulders like cannonballs. Garfiel’s body was blasted off the ramparts with a roar as the tips of the “insects’” horns from Kafma’s transformed shoulder bones pierced through his steel-like abdominal muscles.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. However, doing this causes Kafma an intense amount of pain, as he needs to snap the antennae off at the base to do this.''Kafma’s cheeks tensed up at the bone-numbing pain of having two of the antennae snapped off at the base. If victory came at the cost of pain, it brought Kafma down to his knees.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. *'''Other Insects''': Among his collection of insects, some of them allow him to fire off blades of wind and bullets of light, among other abilities. *'''Insect Implantation''': Aside from the technique he uses to implant insect inside his own body, Kafma can force his target to take an insect egg into their body through a special tube that he uses in close combat. When fighting, this tube allows a white insect to implant an egg through a wound that hatches inside the target's body.''Kafma stuck out his hand to Garfiel, whose teeth were trembling, bitter tears streaming down his face. At the tip of Kafma’s five bent fingers, could be seen a tube holding a white, wriggling “insect”. An “insect” had implanted an egg through these tubes in one of the wounds inflicted by the thorns. It hatched inside Garfiel’s body and crawled around inside him.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. Since most people’s bodies are not capable of withstanding these insects, not to mention the intense preparation time required for the body to be able to adapt to their insect, it is not uncommon for his target to die in agony as the insect transfigures its host.''The ritual of inserting “insects” into the body was the culmination of careful preparation, even for the Insect Cage Tribe. From the time they were newborn babies, their bodies were altered in preparation for the future insertion of “insects,” but the ritual was forbidden until they reached the age of twelve. That was to say, it took at least twelve years of preparation before an “insect” could be inserted into the body. If the process was skipped and an insect was implanted, the subject’s body would not be able to withstand it.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 4. Likewise, healing magic is ineffective against it as, while said magic can heal wounds, it cannot stop the transfiguration caused by the insects.''"The purpose of the insects that circulate inside you is not to wound you, but to make your body a seedbed for their own. ――You can heal the wound, but you cannot heal the transfiguration."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 87, Section 2. He typically avoids using this technique unless he is forced to take his opponent down as quickly as possible. It is possible, however, to burn the insects that were implanted in the target’s body, albeit at the risk of burning oneself. **'''Pupa State''': When Kafma decides to take another insect into his body, he can put himself into a cocoon-like state so that he can adapt to his new insect.''Like the thorns, it was a new “insect” suitable for taking on a large number of enemies at once―― He had been nervous that he would once again be in a pupa state during an essential scenario.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 86, Section 4. It is unknown if this is inherent to Kafma or something shared among all the Insect Cage Clan members. '''Enhanced Physicality''': His body is incredibly durable. Whereas most of his clan can only handle a few of their insects, Kafma not only survived taking in his absurd number of insects, but he also managed to completely adapt to them. He is also highly resistant to pain, capable of withstanding the pain of his ribs bursting through his skin and his antennae being snapped off at the base. Even excluding this and the power that his insects provide him, Kafma has impressive physical might. He is capable of going head-to-head with someone as strong as Garfiel and dealing considerable damage to him. Similarly, he is capable of withstanding a beating from said warrior,''Even though they were both pounding each other’s vitals with such ferocious vigor and might that it would not have been strange if one of them died, and even though there was no room for a proper exchange of words, he heard it.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. even including being dragged through stone and his wings being torn to shreds, as well as withstanding the intense drawback from being forced to fight for more than fifty hours without food or drink and allowing his insects to devour his insides, all while continuously holding back an entire army. *'''Extra Organ''': Kafma has developed an extra organ, not as a result of a particular insect but of the symbiosis between him and all of his insects.''This, Kafma’s trump card, was not the result of introducing a new “insect”, but a new organ created by the coexistence and symbiosis of the thirty-two “insects” that had been inserted up to that point.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. This organ can be exposed by Kafma's chest opening up.''His chest opened, and his ribs spread apart; his reddish organs stored deep within rumbled, and the shockwave emitted from them surged forward straight into Garfiel.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. Once exposed, it can be used to send out a shockwave that is said to reduce any warrior into red mist.''The functions of multiple “insects” were combined to release a shockwave that engulfed and destroyed everything in its path with a ferociously precise vibration, a destructive blow pulverizing everything into pieces. The moment any warrior was exposed to it, invisible to the eye, it turned them into a bloody mist.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 89, Section 2. ==Trivia== *While still a Second-Class General, Kafma was stated to have equal ability when compared to the Nine Divine Generals, though his personality had been the only difference between them.''――Henceforth, barring his character, his ability was on par with that of the Nine Divine Generals.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 29]], Chapter 8, Section 3. *Kafma, along with Madelyn Eschart, was a character derived from random sketches made by the series illustrator, Otsuka Shinichirou. *Kafma has his own named chapter in Arc 7, in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 7: The Land of Wolves|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32|light novels]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30|Volume 30]] (main story)}} '''Katya Aurélie''' (カチュア・オーレリー) is [[Jamal Aurélie|Jamal's]] sister and [[Todd Fang|Todd's]] wife. She is a noble from the Aurélie family and has been prone to illnesses from a very young age. She played a supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. Following the [[Great Disaster]], she and Todd married, and the two eloped, with their whereabouts remaining unknown. ==Appearance== Katya is a fair-skinned woman who possesses a weak and slender body resulting from her poor health. Much like her brother, she has messy and unkempt dark brown hair parted in two pigtails on both sides of her head and a rough blue-eyed gaze. She wears formal grey and white clothes with multiple decorations, including a yellow and cyan triangular emblem just below her neck, patterns composed of the same colors in stripes or diamonds, and a purple floral design at the bottom of her dress. As a consequence of her constitution, Katya is required to use a wheelchair. The wheelchair's primary color is black, its cushions are purple, and the chair itself also has golden motifs alongside its edges. In order to facilitate her forwards or backwards navigation, Katya can turn the rims of the wheelchair in order to move around. ==Personality== Katya's behavior while being held hostage in [[Berstetz Fondalfon]]'s mansion is timid, fearful, and cautious. She appears cold, easily flustered, and quick to anger; often biting her fingernails, chewing on her lips, muttering to herself, and stammering when under stress. She habitually conceals her true emotions behind a mask of arrogant indifference, deliberately trying to appear harsh and cold to those around her. Despite her longing for companionship and love, she tends to distance herself from those who try to get close to her. Hence, it took persistent effort on [[Rem]]’s part to get Katya to become more comfortable and trusting around her. She isn’t bold and is often unsure if her own opinions are valid. She is terrified of death and desperately avoids dangerous situations, always trying to take the safest path. Although Katya cannot be described as a courageous person, her mentality is not one of cowardice but rather that of a kindhearted and peace-loving person who has been traumatized by her circumstances. When she sensed that [[Madelyn Eschart|Madelyn]] might harm Rem in anger, she found the strength to speak up and attempt to de-escalate the situation, despite being terrified of the divine general. Her actions were a testament to her selflessness, as she put herself at risk to protect her friend. Katya is possibly an example of the psychological toll that growing up in the Vollachia Empire, with its fervent belief in strength above all else, can have on an average person who isn’t blessed with physical strength. While in the mansion, she seems to be in a perpetual state of stress and anxiety, and is vigilant against revealing any weakness that could be exploited, especially when talking about those close to her. While her past remains mostly shrouded, her life thus far appears to have been one of great suffering and heartbreak, including the loss of those who were close to her. She attributes these misfortunes to her own terrible luck and incompetence, even blaming herself for any harm that befalls those around her. Her self-esteem is painfully low, viewing herself as selfish, helpless, and undeserving of love and companionship. Despite her fear of death and desire for survival, Katya's actions show compassion and concern for others. Though she refuses to admit it openly, she is deeply in love with Todd Fang and trusts him wholeheartedly. ==Trivia== *Katya has a named interlude in [[Arc 9]] of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 39|light novel]]. *Katya's birthday was decided at a talk show held on April 5, 2026. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Nobles]] [[ru:Катя О'Рейли]]

Pleiades Battalion |Occupation = High-Level Count |Previous Occupation = Governor of the Gladiator Island Ginunhive |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Kurgan]] (relative) |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = |Equipment = Shield |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 31|Volume 31]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Gustav Morello''' (グスタフ・モレロ) is the former governor and Island Chief of the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. He played a supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]] as an advisor of sorts for the Pleiades Battalion. Following the [[Great Disaster]], Gustav was promoted to a position that would keep him situated in [[Lupugana]]. ==Appearance== As a member of the Multi-Arm Tribe, Gustav bears blue skin, black eyes, and white hair in addition to the thick muscles, four arms, and towering height as is typical for his clan. He wears a dark grey uniform which is worn by others on Ginunhive and bears an armband with the symbol of the Empire on his left arm. ==Personality== Gustav is an intelligent man who strives to be honest and transparent over being deceitful. Unlike his kin, who were predisposed to violence, he detests warfare, is nonviolent, and fears that his death will bring about nothing. He is fiercely loyal and grateful to [[Vincent Vollachia]] for his personality rather than his position, causing Gustav to not tolerate disrespect towards the emperor. Befitting of his position, he enforces order and fairness at Ginunhive to fit his assignment of training the minds and bodies to use Ginunhive's gladiators in case if an emergency were to plague the Empire. Unlike the rest of the men in his tribe, which craved violence in emulation of [[Kurgan]], Gustav prefers peace and maintaining said peace. Though most of the men died due to their nature, it was this nature of Gustav's that not only kept him alive but even allowed him to defend the rest of his people. He is also somewhat pacifistic compared to the rest of his tribe. After someone attacked his tribe in an effort to get rid of them, when the man and his subordinates were captured and held in place, despite being given the chance to take revenge for his fallen tribesmen, he decided not to kill him and instead have him sentenced to hard labor, much to the dismay of his people. Gustav also respects old customs such as Sparka, as well as the people he considers his friends. It was for this reason rather than his loyalty that he followed [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] alongside the other gladiators and soldiers in the Pleiades Battalion. ==History== In the past, Gustav resided at the Multi-Arm Tribe's homeland, where he read books, raised livestock, and protected the homes. He was viewed as a coward, for the other men of his tribe all sought valor in combat due to the legacy of the legendary Eight-Arms Kurgan. This path led to Gustav's grandfather, father, siblings, and friends dying for naught whilst sparring with others across the Empire. The tribespeople of the Multi-Arm Tribe increased their harsh treatment towards Gustav, as in their eyes, the one whom they perceived as a coward remained alive while their loved ones had all perished. On one fateful day, “bandits” who had believed all of the tribe's men were slain chose to assault the village. Its houses were burned, belongings were pilfered, women and children were killed for sport, and the tribespeople could do nothing to stop it. Gustav decided to spar with the “bandits” on his own, despite not having the strength to stand a chance against them. Just as he was about to lose his head, the [[Cecilus Segmunt|Blue Lightning]] saved his life. After Gustav's life was saved, he was approached by the emperor of Vollachia, who questioned his beliefs and shared in them. The ringleader of the attack, a local feudal lord that had his private army dress up as bandits to eliminate the Multi-Arm Tribe, was arrested, and Gustav was chosen to decide his fate. Sensing that the lord was frightened of death, Gustav levied hard labor unto the man instead of death, much to the dissatisfaction of his living tribespeople. However, Gustav's dignity was recognized, and the emperor offered patronage to him. Over time, he carried out his duties and increased his court rank, and on the day he became a High Count, the emperor gave Gustav the order to work as the governor of the Gladiator Island Ginunhive. From then on, he began serving his newfound position as the Island Chief honestly, and under Gustav's leadership, the Gladiator Island would be remade from its previous lawlessness into a more orderly place where there were less unnecessary deaths. ==Abilities== '''Enhanced Strength''': As a member of the Multi-Arm Tribe, Gustav's physical strength is much greater than the average person's. Though not a warrior like the rest of his tribe, his physique alongside his shields makes him tough to push back. '''Wise Leader''': As his position demands, Gustav is excellent at commanding order, managing to keep an entire island full of ruffians and soldiers in order by providing them with their needs, invoking Sparka, and using the threat of a curse tool to keep people in check. The only people this does not seem to work on are extreme examples such as Subaru and Cecilus, but it still invokes respect in them. '''Equipment''': *'''Shields''': Gustav has wielded shield that he has used in tandem with his arms in order to block strong blows. *'''[[Curse|Curse Tool]]''': Gustav has a curse tool, created by [[Groovy Gumlet]], embedded in his body that was originally used to curse everyone residing on the Gladiator Island, and anyone cursed by it who left its range would lose their life. It seems that he has some control of the curse it creates, as all those who joined the Pleiades Battalion were freed of the mark. However, even if he were to die, if the curse tool was still active while others were cursed by it, it would still kill them if they left its range or it left theirs. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Ginunhive]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Advisors]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Pleiades Battalion]]
