Gladiator |Status = Alive |Relatives = |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 31|Volume 31]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Idra Missanga''' (イドラ・ミサンガ) is a former gladiator at the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]] and a member of [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s Unit during the latter's stay on the island who later joined the Pleiades Battalion. He made his debut in [[Arc 7]]. ==Appearance== Idra is a man with rust-colored hair, golden eyes, and a pleasant face. He dresses in baggy rust-colored jeans, a white undershirt, and a golden necklace. Moreover, he also wears a matching headband and vest composed of purple and yellow designs. ==Personality== Idra is a socially anxious man who usually stays calm, level-headed, and honest to a fault. However, when he was put into danger at the Gladiator Island, he lied to the other members of his Unit, put up a determined front to look fearless, and attempted to control everyone around him. Despite coming off as a fraud, Idra's wish is to be a man who prevents shame from being brought onto his father and his family. For these reasons, Idra attempts to work hard and repay the debt he feels for those who choose to believe in him. ==History== Hailing from a small farming village in the northwestern part of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], Idra worked at a family mill that had been around since the time of his grandfather's grandfather. He was entrusted by the territory's lord to manage a local waterwheel built alongside a river in his village, and he was also in charge of milling all of the grains from the village. Although his family was privileged, they chose to help fellow villagers in times of need and acted humble, which Idra learned for himself. One day, Idra met a man at a travelling mercenary who would come to the village's local bar and came to know him over time, listening to the man's stories and holding a yearning for the lifestyle of those outside his village. The man eventually expressed his interest in Idra's cousin, and Idra himself chose to set up a meeting between the man and his cousin out of kindness. This kind gesture was short-lived, as the pair would attempt to steal Idra's family business by falsifying the results of his milling to the village. Although he attempted to convince the village of his innocence, they chose to plant preparations for an insurrection within his home because they prioritized profits that the mercenary and Idra's cousin brought, and Idra was brought to a trial before the village's lord. Failing to prove his innocence without anyone to believe in him, Idra was punished and sent to the Gladiator Island by slave traders. ==Trivia== *Idra has his own named chapter in Arc 7, in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 7: The Land of Wolves|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 31|light novels]]. *Idra's name is likely based on the German word "drei", meaning "three". ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Ginunhive]] [[Category:Gladiators]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Pleiades Battalion]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38|Volume 38]] (main story)}} '''Jawsrough''' (ジョズロ) is a former gladiator at the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. He later became a member of the Pleiades Battalion. ==Appearance== Jawsrough is a man with dark skin, thick lips, ashen brown hair, and a single left eye. His right eye is covered by a white scar, and behind the closed eyelid is an artificial prosthetic eye made of wood. However, his replacement eye does not substitute for the eyeball he lost. ==Personality== Jawsrough had an infamous celebrity-like reputation at Ginunhive as a “lone wolf”. He disagreed with the notion of the Gladiator Island being a utopia for savages where physical strength is esteemed, a conception he believed many people possessed. His reputation was not simply because he did not associate with others. Instead of following the established order of trusting other people in a Unit with his life, Jawsrough discarded any gladiator he viewed as a despicable criminal and felt at ease with cutting one down if they were not worth looking out for. Nevertheless, under the surface of Jawsrough's outward cynical attitude, he holds intense expectations for other people regardless of their age or appearance. ==History== ===[[Brotherhood of Pleiades Part 1|Brotherhood of Pleiades]]=== Before being sent to Ginunhive for unknown reasons, Jawsrough was a mason. There, he became known as a lone wolf for his mentality and actions. At an unknown time in the future, [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] arrived at the Gladiator Island, and Jawsrough was the last person who he convinced to become his comrade. In order to help Subaru compete against [[Gustav Morello|Gustav]], Jawsrough used his skills as a mason by creating a board and pieces for the game of Reversi that the two used for their Sparka match. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Ginunhive]] [[Category:Gladiators]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Pleiades Battalion]]

'''Izmail''' (イズメイル) was a member of the Cyclops Tribe. Once considered to be the hope of his tribe, he participated in a [[Battle for the Imperial Capital|battle]] at the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]], but was ultimately slain with a sweeping fire attack from [[Arakiya]].

A few hours after his death, Izmail was resurrected as an [[Undead#Zombies|zombie]] during the [[Great Disaster]]'s emergence in Lupugana, where his body was completely blown away with a dust explosion created by [[Natsuki Subaru]] at a flour mill. Later, he faced Subaru once more when he returned to Lupugana, was reduced to dust by [[Spica]], and received acknowledgement from [[Vincent Vollachia]] before permanently fading away.

==Appearance==
Izmail was a strong man with a large blue-colored eye. As a zombie, he possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across his body, pitch-black sclera, and a radiant golden iris that replaced his sole blue eye. Izmail's form evolved after sustaining lethal damage, causing him to gain tentacle-like fingers, a swelled frame larger than his original physique, and numerous limbs with various lengths that rapidly multiplied across his body.

==Personality==
A prideful and ambitious warrior, Izmail relished honor in combat. He held no favor for people he believed were cowards or fools who desecrated the battlefield and thought of them as enemies. 

==Abilities==
'''Eye''' (眼, ''Gan''): Like the other members of the Cyclops Tribe, Izmail possessed a single eye with multiple abnormal powers. Notably, this allowed Izmail to “switch” his sight and perceive the emotions of people on the battlefield in colors. Individuals with a strong fighting spirit had a red light, those who were abundant in anxiety had a yellow light, and those who harbored panic or fear had a blue light.

'''Equipment''': Izmail wielded an enormous and ardently forged battle axe that was taller than his own body. He carried the axe on his back and used it to eliminate his foes on the battlefront. According to [[Todd Fang]], Izmail's skill was so great that he had the potential to become a Second-Class General in the [[Imperial Army]].<ref>''“There may be exceptions who are evaluated for their military tactics and strategic acumen, but in most cases, it’s their own skill that counts. This guy is one of those… not comparable to a General First-Class, but he definitely has the potential to become a General Second-Class.”'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 4, Section 2.</ref>

==Trivia==
*In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], Izmail initially survived Arakiya's fire attack at the cost of his left arm and encountered [[Todd Fang]], who used a black powdered spice to temporary blind his one eye. A shell from a Magic Stone Cannon proceeded to kill him. When Izmail was resurrected as a zombie during the Great Disaster, he was fueled to persist fighting because of his hatred for Todd.

Each of them depict a different interpretation of how Izmail could look, with the first depicting a young man with light-colored hair, the second depicting a monstrous man with a mohawk, the third depicting a long-haired man with earrings, and the fourth being a cartoonish depiction.

'''Hayden Garo''' (ヘイデン・ガロ) is a [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] separatist in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]].

==Appearance==
Hayden is a wild-looking man with slicked-back, dark blonde hair, a well-groomed beard, and blue eyes. He has a tall, strong frame, as well as sharp nails and teeth. In addition, Hayden has a scar in the form of a claw mark above his left eye that was carved onto him by [[Frederica Baumann|Frederica]]’s fingernails.

==Personality==
Hayden is a conceited and belligerent man who prides himself on his rare blood. He has a rigid, domineering personality, unshakeable beliefs, and the tendency to utilize force when he does not have his way. For unknown reasons, Hayden utterly despises humans, going so far as to dub them “inferiors”. His ambition is to create a country where all humans are exterminated and he is crowned king. He also has a habit of meticulously filing his nails.

After discovering Frederica possessed rare blood and meeting with her, Hayden began to desire her not only for her blood but also for her body, strong-willed spirit, and judiciousness, offering her compliments on each of these traits. In spite of his craving for her, he was unwilling to tolerate when she spoke her mind and disagreed with his mindset toward humans.

==History==
Born as a halfbeast demi-human with rare blood, Hayden would eventually come to determine that humans were inferior beings who needed to be exterminated, and he sought to take the places of the demi-human leaders in the Demi-Human War and create a new nation in his image where he would be king. To achieve this, he started working with [[Leonardo Baroness]] to discover the secrets of rare blood. One day, Hayden found Frederica Baumann, a fellow halfbeast who also had rare blood, and plotted with Leonardo to manipulate the lightbugs of [[Costuul]] and orchestrate an incident in the city that allowed him to kidnap her for his plans.

Hayden briefly met Frederica near of one of Costuul's magicreation tool factories and caused a lightbug within a magicreation tool to go haywire. When Frederica and Garfiel reported the incident to Mayor [[Leno Rex]], he caused the collapse of the city hall with a lightbug using a larger magicreation tool and successfully kidnapped Frederica when she was alone, taking her to a cave he and Leonardo had made as their base. He then divulged both his philosophy his reason for kidnapping Frederica to her and planned to take her back to his “castle” once Leonardo finished working with her blood. However, the duo was interrupted by [[Clind]] and [[Garfiel Tinzel]], who discovered the cave by pursuing a trail of blood Frederica left. Hayden and Garfiel fought, ending in the former’s loss. Following his loss to Garfiel, Hayden escaped from the cave where the two had battled and made himself known to Frederica when she was by herself, admitting to her that although he would retreat for the day, he intended on returning so as long as she continued to participate with [[Emilia Camp|her camp]] in the Royal Selection.<ref>''“Frederica, I’m backing off for today. But ya and I will run into each other again. As long as ya continue to play with the inferiors in that joke of a Royal Selection.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 2|Golden Siblings]], Section 11.</ref> He proceeded to make his escape, but not before allowing Frederica to scar the region above his left eye as a token of gratitude for remembering his name.

==Abilities==
'''Beastification''' (獣化, ''Kemonoka''): As a halfbeast of lion human lineage, Hayden has the ability to transform himself into a large lion beast. 

==Trivia==
*Hayden claims to possess a “castle”.<ref>''“Once we’re ready to leave, we’ll go to my castle for a while.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 2|Golden Siblings]], Section 6.</ref> However, the location of this supposed castle is unknown.
*In the original Comic Alive release of [[Golden Siblings Part 2]], Leonardo hired Hayden as a goon by promising the lionman would receive some of Frederica's rare blood in return for helping him acquire her. Hayden's motivations, position relative to Leonardo, and overall presence throughout Golden Siblings were greatly elaborated, changed, and expanded in [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]]. In the end, rather than escaping before he could be taken into custody like he was in the canon version of the side story, he was defeated by Frederica.

He has long, light-brown hair, gold eyes, an unshaven beard, and a face that could cause him to be mistaken for a woman, if he would shave his chin. ==Personality== Gwain is a man of great tolerance with a keen intuition. When he was younger, he had a more aggressive attitude that was influenced by his circumstances. ==History== ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II]]=== Gwain was born as a werewolf by the name of '''Alagar''' (アラガル, ''Aragaru''). Due to his lineage, he faced peril from [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]'s policy of executing all people of wolf human descent. He came under the service of [[Minor Characters#Galahau Dracroy|Galahau Dracroy]] and was tasked with assassinating his daughter, [[Serena Dracroy]], along with three other assassins. While a fugitive, Alagar singlehandedly managed to vanquish an entire fortress and escaped to Lugunica's [[Royal Capital]], where he was subjugated by [[Marcos Gildark]]. An emissary from the Empire, Serena, was sent to retrieve Alagar and bring him to certain death. However, the group transporting Alagar to Vollachia was ambushed by the other assassins sent to kill Serena. Quickly deducing that Alagar was one of the assassins, Serena made an offer to aid him in faking his death and continue surviving if he chose to spare her life and stop working with Galahau, to which he accepted, making a promise with her and later [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] to not use his Beastification again.''“I understand. I’ll never beastify again, naw… I mean, no. If things can end without me needing to, I swear.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12]], [[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II Part 3|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II]], Section 18. After the incident, Alagar took on the name of his dead father, Gwain, and was employed by the Fellow family. ===[[The Three Idiots Set Out! Cursed Goddess Statue Episode Part 1|The Three Idiots Set Out! Cursed Goddess Statue Episode]]=== In the years following his employment to the Fellow family, Gwain managed to become a representative of Lugunica's Chamber of Commerce. He began to hold lavish auctions for the wealthy to acquire rare items, such as meteors. One night, when holding an auction attended by a crossdressing trio of [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], [[Otto Suwen|Otto]], and [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]], some of the items were stolen. The case was eventually solved, and in the end, [[Clind]] managed to retrieve a statue missing from Gwain's inventory for Roswaal. ===[[Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle / Page 3|Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle]]=== During the events of [[Arc 5]], Gwain took part in the Western Margrave Domain Meeting. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護, ''Kago''): As a half-wolf human, Gwain possesses the '''Divine Protection of Ambushing''' (騙し討ちの加護, ''Damashiuchi no Kago''). Although its exact effects are unknown, it enables werewolves to be difficult to find by other people. '''Beastification''' (獣化, ''Kemonoka''): As a halfbeast of half-wolf human lineage, Gwain has the ability to transform himself into a large dark brown wolf beast, though he does not make use of this transformation due to his promise with Serena Dracroy and Roswaal L. Mathers. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Assassins]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[Category:Human Hybrids]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]]

[[Garkla]] |Occupation = Governor of Garkla |Previous Occupation = Supervisor |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Finale of the Eight Arms]]}} '''Lehare Yvsant''' (レハレ・イヴサント) is the governor of [[Garkla]]. ==Appearance== Lehare's appearance was never described. ==Personality== In the past, Lehare abused the captive workers he supervised and had a sadistic desire to inflict pain on them when he could. He grew a respect for [[Kurgan]] in the years following his defense of the city, despite the Eight Arms having been a prisoner he viewed with scorn and pity. ==History== Lehare was a supervisor of the construction of Garkla's city walls. Unaware of the legend of the Eight Arms due to it fading into obscurity, Lehare saw Kurgan as an easy target to direct his sadism towards. When [[Regulus Corneas]] arrived within the city of Garkla and instantly destroyed a third of it, the then-governor and their aides were caught and killed in the destruction. As a result, Lehare was appointed as the interim governor by [[Vincent Vollachia|a young prince]] known for his wisdom who happened to be in Garkla for an inspection, obeying his instructions. Although bewildered why the prince sought the Eight Arms, he affirmed the old hero's presence in the city. In the aftermath of the incident, Lehare, who officially became the governor of Garkla, as well as the other survivors of the city, passed on that Kurgan had emerged victorious. He restored the Demon Cleavers that had been destroyed in the clash between the Eight Arms and the Sin Archbishop of Greed, displaying them on the top floor of the great fortress as a symbol of the Fortified City's sturdiness. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Leaders]]

title: Hamayal Wesmi
wikitext:
{{Character |Name = Hamayal Wesmi |Kanji = ハマヤル・ウエズミ |Romaji = Hamayaru Uesumi |Alias = |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Age = Over 40 |Hair Color = Unknown |Eye Color = Unknown |Previous Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]]
Vollachia Shinobi Village |Previous Occupation = [[Shinobi]] |Status = Deceased |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12|Tanpenshuu Volume 12]]}} '''Hamayal Wesmi''' (ハマヤル・ウエズミ) was a [[shinobi]] from the [[Vollachia Empire]] who was tasked to assassinate [[Priscilla Barielle]]. ==Appearance== Hamayal's appearance was never described. ==Personality== As a shinobi, Hamayal had been perfected as a puppet who lacked a sense of free will, focusing single-mindedly on tasks assigned to him without question. He regarded the task of assassinating a Royal Selection Candidate as the culmination of his work and something to celebrate at the end of his time as a shinobi. Because he adhered so carefully to the idea of acting with the idealized idea of a shinobi with resolve as he and the others from his village believed, he was enraged upon learning of [[Yae Tenzen]]'s betrayal, which quickly turned to alarm when he realized she had been broken. After his mind was shattered by [[Al]], although he was reduced to a pawn who did as the knight told, he failed to become the same type of loyal pawn Yae was. ==History== In his childhood, Hamayal met and began coexisting with his Phantom Wolf. At some point, he completed his training in the shinobi village and became a shinobi. With his Phantom Wolf at his side, he found prolonged success in the livelihood of assassination. He had known Yae Tenzen while she was developing a reputation as a genius prodigy in their village, lamenting that someone with her temperament had the essence of a shinobi despite her personality deviating from his ideal expectations. After Yae's failure to assassinate Priscilla Barielle, a suicide squad comprised of Hamayal and nine other shinobi were tasked by [[Chisha Gold]] with achieving what the Crimson Sakura could not. Using the nine shinobi as a decoy, he was the one entrusted with the duty of assassinating Priscilla while her knight, Al, was dealing with the others. His plan came to a halt when Al intercepted him in the hidden passages under the Barielle Manor. Realizing his comrades were dead, he set his Phantom Wolf on Al. However, he was then attacked by Yae, who survived her failed assassination attempt, having been made to know "terror" and broken by Al, becoming his pawn in the process. The Phantom Wolf suddenly become subordinate to Al, and feeling anxiety, he attempted to attack the knight, only to fall victim to [[Al#Abilities|the Aggressor side of his Authority]]. On Al's orders, he sent his Phantom Wolf through the letter that was to report how the mission had went. The Phantom Wolf was set on Chisha as soon as he opened said letter, but [[Cecilus Segmunt]], who was in the room with him, eradicated it in a flash, ending Hamayal's life. ==Abilities== '''Phantom Wolf''' (幻狼, ''Genrō''): A shadow beast with a will of its own that Hamayal coexisted with. Having fed his shadow to the beast as a child, it grew up alongside him until it took on the form of a humongous quadruped with the silhouette of a wolf, lacking any proper body parts like eyes or a nose. Losing his own shadow, the Phantom Wolf would fold itself into appearing as Hamayal's shadow and had the ability to break off independently from it to attack a prey or sneak into all sorts of crevices, returning to appearing as his shadow once finished with a task. He cooperated with his Phantom Wolf to easily execute any enemy he came across. However, Hamayal's utilization of the Phantom Wolf came at a price. Because the lives of a shadow beast and a shadow master are connected with each other, if one perishes, the other will follow. When destroyed, a Phantom Wolf disperses as a phantom would. Hamayal's Phantom Wolf was disposed of by Cecilus Segmunt, immediately ending his own life. '''Shinobi Techniques''' (シノビの術技, ''Shinobi no Jutsugi''): As a shinobi, Hamayal was apt in the use of shinobi techniques. The only skill he displayed was a technique of tightening his muscles to stop his body's bleeding. {{Clear}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Shinobi]] [[Category:Assassins]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

{{Expand||[[Nikola Suwen]] (husband) (in ''Sasageru IF'')}} |Magic = Fire Magic |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 8|Volume 8]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 35]] |Anime = [[Episode 22]]}} '''Ia''' (イア) is a [[spirit]] of the fire attribute that is contracted with [[Julius Juukulius]]. Once a quasi-spirit, she managed to evolve into a proper spirit during the events of [[Arc 6]]. ==Appearance== As a spirit, Ia has a small, red spherical form that emanates red light. In the [[Re:Zero EX#Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero|Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero]] IF story, as Lumera, she has taken on a human form, appearing as a tall, beautiful woman with flowing red hair and red eyes, a curvaceous figure, and a flashy, extravagant red dress. ==Personality== As a quasi-spirit, Ia's thoughts are comparable to that of a young child. Although Ia and the other five contracted spirits are unable to understand words, Julius is able to transmit emotions, his impressions of people, and other similar things to them.''“They don’t understand words, but they are at the level where emotions can be sent. His good or bad impressions of other people and such, that can be sent as well.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1015644274883420160 July 8, 2018 Twitter Q&A] As the six spirits became Julius's contracted spirits after a fierce fight with many other lesser spirits, they have almost become like sisters who endured a shared struggle together, and so they only bicker on occasion.''“The six quasi-spirts that he has now were gathered as Julius’s contracted spirits after coming victoriously through fierce fighting, so their relationship is like sisters that have passed through a deadly struggle together. So, they only quarrel occasionally.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1015650844874760193 July 8, 2018 Twitter Q&A] ==History== Because of Julius's Divine Protection of Gathering Spirits, a number of lesser spirits found it easy to like his nature, and they sought to have contracts with him. Unbeknownst to Julius, a fierce fight ensued to decide who would become his contracted spirits, with Ia, Kua, Aro, Iku, In, and Nes being the six lesser spirits who were victorious in the end.''“To begin with, his nature is easy for spirits to like due to his Divine Protection of Gathering Spirits, so there were all kinds of spirits that were looking to form contracts with him. Having said that, spirits aren't deceived by Divine Protections, so the only candidates were young lesser spirits. And, the six that came through the fierce fighting are the ones that are his contracted spirits. Julius is unaware of that battle.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1015648626058514432 July 8, 2018 Twitter Q&A] They proceeded to diligently guard Julius from then on, at some point becoming quasi-spirits. Eventually, when Julius was at the age where he was ready to make contracts with them, with a simple “Nice to meet you”, he formed contracts with the six of them.''“Nothing in particular. Fortunately, the six quasi-spirits that became his contracted spirits were diligently guarding the young Julius. After that, Julius reached the age where he was prepared to make a contract, and with little more than a "Nice to meet you", the six quasi-spirits contracted with him.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1015651498003271680 July 8, 2018 Twitter Q&A] ==Abilities== ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== Ia is a spirit that commands fire [[mana]] and can thus use fire magic. As Julius's contracted spirit, Ia makes use of her magic to aid him when necessary. She and Julius's other spirits each have appropriate crystals for themselves, where they reside when they are not materialized.''“He has appropriate crystals for each of his quasi-spirits.”'' November 15, 2014 AskFM Q&A '''Spells''': [[File:La protect Subaru.gif|thumb|240x240px|Ia creating a barrier to protect Subaru.]] *'''Barriers''': Ia is able to quickly generate barriers to protect against damage such as explosives. While it is unknown just how large her barriers can become or the extent of damage they can withstand, they were able to protect someone as weak as [[Natsuki Subaru]] from a relatively large explosion and left him with only minor injuries. [[File:Julius - Ul Gora.gif|thumb|250px|Julius Using Ul Gora.]] '''Combined Spells''': *'''Ul Gora''' (ウル・ゴーラ): Julius can call on '''Ia''' and '''Aro''' to produce a powerful magical fire storm by combining both fire and wind magic. '''Unique Spells''': [[File:Julius Using Al Clarista.gif|thumb|250px|Julius Using Al Clarista.]] *'''Clarista '''(クラリスタ): Julius imbues his sword with the power of his six spirits, empowering it. Clarista and its different levels are Julius's original magic. **'''Al Clarista''' (アル・クラリスタ): Al Clarista allows Julius to imbue his sword with the power of his six quasi-spirits (after his fight with Reid Astrea, he can do that with his newly bloomed spirits), cladding his blade in a brilliant rainbow light. According to him, when this spell is in use, he can cut almost everything with his sword, no matter the toughness. Julius displayed this ability two times, roughly half a year before the start of the Royal Selection on his diplomatic journey to the Sacred Vollachia Empire. There, he fought the First and Ninth ranking Divine Generals on separate occasions, and managed to break the former's 5th best sword, and kill the latter. Julius is also capable of using the long-range version of Clarista where the spell takes the form of a beam of pure destructive energy. The light is capable of cutting through anything and everything in its path. After Julius reformed his contract with his quasi-spirits, the power and range of the attack greatly increased, surprising even Julius. During his battle with the Ninth ranking Divine General of the Vollachia Empire, Julius used this spell to melt away the General's spear and pierce his chest, killing him. [[File:Julius Using Al Clauseria.gif|thumb|250px|Julius using Al Clauzeria.]] *'''Al Clauzeria''' (アル・クラウゼリア): When Al Clauzeria is casted, six different colored spirits start circling around Julius and join into one whirling rainbow-hued vortex of light which is shot out from the tip of his sword. Immediately following the impact of the rainbow light, the torrent of light explodes in a sizeable shock wave that sends his opponents flying. The wall as well as the vortex are composed of six elements, which are able to repel any sort of magic that is casted against it as well as any and all physical attacks. Furthermore, in the novelization of Julius' duel with Petelgeuse, the rainbow shockwave started expanding directly from his own body, rather being shot out from the tip of his sword, easily purifying away close to a hundred unseen hands that enveloped the Knight from all sides, just seconds prior. Despite the small difference in execution, both versions have the same effect. Following the evolution of his quasi-spirits into spirits, this attack has enough power to completely wipe away one of the heads of a [[Dragon]] the caliber of [[Valgren]].''Ensnared by thorns, Valgren had ceased its movements mid-air. Aiming for one of the Blight Dragon’s writhing heads, an aurora of rainbow ran diagonally across the sky. Vibrantly it seized Valgren’s right head, blowing it away from its base. A graceful, magnificent, dazzling stroke of magic unleashed by the Finest.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 6. By tweaking the spell, Julius can use this spell to create a dome-like barrier around himself and his targets. Ordinarily, this is used for defense, but it can also be used to trap aerial opponents such as Balleroy Temeglyph near the ground. Following the evolution of his spirits, his barrier has shown to be able to extend to cover up to half of the entirety of the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]].''In the blink of an eye, the skies of the Fortified City were engulfed in an aurora of rainbow―― however, the size and extent of that rainbow were enough to defend around half of the extensive Fortified City.'' [[Arc 8]], Interlude, Section 5. *'''Al Cranvel''' (アル・クランヴェル): Al Cranvel is a secret technique Julius developed long ago but never managed to properly utilize due to his lack of experience. After he made new contracts with his newly-bloomed spirits, Julius called upon their power and clad himself in their sixfold power, greatly increasing his speed and overall power. To the other party, Julius appeared as if he was swallowed alive by a rainbow. This sword skill is noted as Julius' ultimate attack. Debuting this trump card during his final duel with legendary Reid Astrea, it played a vital role in helping him overcome the obstacle known as the first generation's Sword Saint. '''Conditional Spells''': [[File:Subaru - Rental Goa.gif|thumb|240x240px|Subaru using '''"Rental Goa"''' against Petelgeuse.]] *'''Rental Goa''' (レンタル・ゴーア, ''Rentaru Gōa''): Not being one of the spells Subaru made after forming a formal contract with [[Beatrice]], this was instead a Goa used on the spot during the former's provisional contract with Ia, hence why he chose to call it a "rental" spell. It was used against [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]] to set him on fire after being doused in oil. ==Trivia== *Ia and Julius's other contracted spirits went from quasi-spirits to spirits during the climax of Arc 6, which the author has affirmed within the supplement for the Sasageru IF. However, within the narration of scenes from Subaru's perspective, they are still referred to as quasi-spirits. *Ia appears as a great spirit with a human form named '''Lumera Ia Juukulius''' (ルーメラ・イア・ユークリウス, ''Rūmera Ia Yūkuriusu'') in the non-canon [[Re:Zero EX#Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero|Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero]] IF story, in which she is a main character. Set 400 years after the events of [[Arc 9]], Lumera and her "sisters", the other five great spirits who were once Julius's contracted spirits, had become lesser lords who ruled the Juukulius Domain within the Unified Empire of Vollachia. The six of them sought to locate the orb that contained Subaru and Beatrice on the other side of the Grand Mogolade Geyser, which brought them to [[Vague Adgard]]'s attention. As a result, the other five sacrificed themselves to divert Vague away from Lumera so she could secure the orb, having Arakiya devour them once they sustained fatal damage in order to repel the Mad Prince. Throughout the story, she acts as an ally to Subaru and [[Nikola Suwen]], fighting against Vague and later being a member of the group that ventured to the Eternal Agzadd Glacier in an attempt to save [[Petra Leyte|the Witch]]. During the 40 year timeskip within the story, Nikola confesses his love to Lumera, and the couple get married. *The birthday of Ia and her sisters was decided at a talk show held on July 26, 2026. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Contract Spirits]] [[Category:Great Spirits]] [[Category:Nobles]]

wikitext:
{{Character |Name = Hogey Marshepo |Kanji = ホギー・マルシュポ |Romaji = Hogī Marushupo |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Hair Color = Unknown |Eye Color = Unknown |Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]
[[Royal Capital]] |Occupation = Painter |Status = Alive |Relatives = Unnamed wife (deceased)
[[Minor Characters#Azla Eastern|Azla Eastern]] |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9|Tanpenshuu Volume 9]] (side story)}} '''Hogey Marshepo''' (ホギー・マルシュポ) is a painter and the father of [[Minor Characters#Azla Eastern|Azla Eastern]]. ==Appearance== Hogey is a thin, middle-aged man with a beard. ==Personality== Hogey is a man who is not above engaging in the creation of forgeries to support his family. He has an interest in forging famous paintings to see if he is capable of recreating them. Having said that, he believes that his reproductions fall short compared to the original works. ==History== When Hogey was younger, he met a woman and had a son, Azla Eastern, with her. However, due to his financial difficulties as an unsuccessful painter, he was unable to support her, and so the couple could not marry. He was eventually approached by [[Minor Characters#Amilét Megis|Amilét Megis]], who requested him to create more forgeries to support her business, to which he accepted. Thus, Hogey was responsible for creating countless forgeries of numerous famous art pieces, and was eventually able to marry his lover and support his family. After Hogey's wife passed away, Azla learned the truth of his father's profession, and was not only angered by the fact that he had been raised by tainted money, but that his father was not using his talent to create his own original works. He attempted to tell Hogey to quit, but failed to make him budge. As a result, Azla began to expose Hogey's forgeries by reporting them to their owners. When this did not give him his desired result, he decided to report it Baron [[Nico Olsen]], the owner of one of the counterfeits. Two years after the death of Hogey's wife, a forgery of the Sleeping Miderine, a distinguished work of art that was painted over a century ago, had arrived in the hands of Baron [[Nico Olsen]]. Though he was initially angered to learn it was a forgery, he respected Azla's plea and became intrigued by Hogey's circumstances. Baron Olsen hatched a scheme to aid Azla, including preemptively staging a kidnapping to protect him from being targeted. Olsen also decided to assess [[Anastasia Hoshin]] by having her evaluate the piece, and she determined that it was a fake. After researching the case, Anastasia, [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]], and [[Joshua Juukulius|Joshua]] found Hogey, who explained his past. Having created forgeries for over twenty years, Hogey did not believe he could change. However, Joshua spoke up and conveyed that Hogey had enough talent to create art that rival renowned works, and that his son wanted him to create his own paintings. Joshua then began to explain that Azla had been abducted, but when he started the story by mentioning Olsen, Anastasia realized that Hogey's son was safe and the baron was the "mastermind" behind the abduction. Afterwards, Hogey and Azla had a reunion. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}}

According to [[Otto Suwen]], it is rumored that Meckart has left his retirement and is currently carrying out services following the successful [[Subjugation of the White Whale]],''“Apparently, His Lordship the former duke has been brought out of retirement and rushed back into service. After successfully subjugating the White Whale, it initially seemed like the Royal Selection had practically been decided… but no one can ever know when calamity may strike.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 2, Section 2. coinciding around the time when Crusch's memories were erased by the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]]. ==Appearance== Meckart has amber eyes. Despite trying to look dignified with his eyes, his drooping eyebrows and gentle looks prevent it. Unlike his wife, [[Minor Characters#Helena Karsten|Helena Karsten]], he has nothing in common with his daughter except for their eye color. ==Personality== Much like his daughter, he is a highly loyal, honest, and dutiful man. However, in contrast to her fiery traits, he is a much more mild mannered individual who often errs on caution. That said, his convictions are no less weaker than Crusch’s which makes his disposition more well rounded than her. He is often seen under a lot of stress, due in part to his daughter’s behavior despite her position, as seen during a conversation with [[Ferris]]. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|Ex 1]]=== Around the time of his daughter’s 17th birthday, Meckart was conflicted about how to get his daughter to attend her party while wearing a dress and acting as a noble daughter’s should, not wishing her to be looked down upon or mocked for her demeanor and habit of wearing men’s clothing. He stated his concerns to Ferris, and soon after, he witnessed a mock duel between Crusch and Prince [[Fourier Lugunica]]. When Fourier won and managed to get Crusch to concede to wearing a dress, Meckart was grateful to him. On the night of her birthday, however, a village in the duchy was under attack by the [[Great Rabbit]]. Deciding to leave his daughter in the dark about the attack, he led a unit to confront the great witchbeast and save as many people as he could. Contrary to his wishes, however, Crusch found out, and she found her way to the battle, where she successfully managed to drive it away, which would end up earning herself the nickname “The Valkyrie”. After this incident, Meckart retired and passed his title onto his daughter, entrusting her his duties. After the Subjugation of the White Whale, it is rumored that Meckart has returned to his post to assist his memoryless daughter in running the duchy. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:House Karsten]] [[Category:Leaders]]

[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Tetsu Inada|Inada Tetsu]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Draft:Chris Tergliafera|Chris Tergliafera]] }} '''Marcos Gildark''' (マーコス・ギルダーク) is the captain of the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]] and the Knight Commander. Although he only played a minor role in [[Arc 3]] during the [[Royal Selection|Royal Selection Ceremony]], he later plays a supporting role in [[Arc 10]]. ==Appearance== Marcos has a chiseled face that is often compared to a boulder or a craggy cliff. He is a large man with an abundancy of muscles which are usually concealed underneath his armor. Thanks to his bulging muscles, his neck and shoulders are impossibly thick, in comparison to an average person's. His eyes are blue, and his green-colored close-cropped hair is cut into the shape of a square. Unlike most members of the Knights of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]], Marcos wears a suit of plate armor with gold trimmings. Transfixed to his waist is a sword he uses in battle. Overall, his appearance exudes the martial spirit of a disciplined warrior. ==Personality== Marcos is a stern and strict man who takes his position as the captain of the Royal Guard seriously. He is composed and brave at all times, allowing him to calmly deal with emergencies. In addition to being an astute thinker, he is also surprisingly thoughtful and perceptive which has allowed him to look for his soldiers on and off the field. He is respectful towards others, shown to apologize for any disrespect shown either purposefully or unintentionally, and he does not allow bias or emotions to cloud his judgment or interfere with his work, even if it includes effectively detaining a person of importance. He is also not unwilling to calmly explain any circumstances in relation to said detainment, though he is also described as being immoveable in this regard. Likewise, though he bears no prejudice towards any of his knights and will treat them fairly, he will not tolerate his knights being disrespectful, especially in tense situations, willing to use his own aura to silence them if necessary. This being said, while he typically acts stoically and with respect and not the type of person to act in blind rage,''Merely, even more so than killing or toying with him, it was a crueler act, one that would make anyone wish to avert their eyes―― had Marcos truly lost himself to a blind rage? He was not supposed to have been the type of person who would so one-sidedly continue to kick the corpse of an opponent he had already beaten down.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. for those he despises, he has no issue glaring at them with a certain level of hostility while holding back his rage, chiding them for their behavior, and if given an appropriate chance, he is not unwilling to unleash a vicious beating upon his target of scorn,''Even for Marcos, it must have been exceedingly difficult to suppress his anger. Or perhaps he had already reached the end of his patience. Until now, there had been times when he had regarded Heinkel with scornful eyes, but it had been quite some time since he had physically beaten him like this.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. and he will keep pummeling that person until they are unwilling to keep fighting.''And yet, why did he still continue to beat, kick, and trample him? Against Heinkel, who had long since, no, from the beginning, had not had even the slightest intention of resisting――, "――Even after enduring all this, you still mean to draw your sword?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1.''As expected, Marcos was not the sort of despicable man who would betray the spirit of chivalry by continuing to beat down upon a helpless, fallen opponent who was no longer able to move. Heinkel was still standing, that was all. Even now, he was still attempting to draw his sword, that was all.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. In particular, he dislikes how people such as [[Heinkel Astrea]] continue to drown themselves in their sorrows and continue to waste away what little they have,''"Just like you, there are plenty of people who face difficult situations, but they keep their heads up without being discouraged. Even though you were born into a more privileged position than them, you’ve even gone and spoiled that through your own actions. ――Tell me, just who in the world would ever take pity on you."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. as well as their willingness to drag others down with them if necessary,''"Say, Heinkel Astrea. ――How many more times, how many more people, how much more disappointment are you going to cause others until you’re satisfied?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. and not only does he show visible disappointment in such people if they refuse to grow up and move past such hardships,''"――. You really haven’t grown in the slightest." It was a remark akin to a sigh, somewhere in between disappointment and despondency.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. but he will actively tell people associated with them to refrain from letting themselves be used by such people.''"Filore-sama, you are being used by this man."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. As one might expect from his neutral and stoic standing, because of his position as the commander of the Royal Guard, he believes that it is undesirable for him to back a single Royal Candidate.''"I never said “no matter what”. It depends on whatever the situation happens to be. Based on my position, it is undesirable for me to support a single Royal Candidate. However, the circumstances are different this time."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 3. This being said, in times where the state of affairs becomes undesirable, Marcos is willing to go against the government if need be and act on his own,''"So you’re saying that even you realized this is a situation where you’ve got no choice but to support us."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 3. working with those very people if need be. Likewise, he believes that if the rot cannot be removed without bloodshed, then one must not shy away from it, and he will even allow himself to leave his station and place his trust in his knights that they know why they swing their swords.''"If the rot cannot be flushed out without spilling some blood, then we ought not shy away from bloodshed. Moreover, the Guard is not an order of Knights that shall collapse on account of my absence alone. I believe each and every one of them to be individuals who know deep down what they ought to raise their swords for."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 3. Roughly 15 years before the events of the main story, Marcos held a strong grudge against the Royal Knights, despite being one of them. According to him, all he did was imprison poor and starving people, and he believed that jail should be a place where people's hearts change for better. The unfairness he was forced to participate in resulted in Marcos joining The Brotherhood, which he was originally ordered to suppress on a mission. This allowed him to give people from the slums hope and help them change their lives. ==History== Before the start of the main story, Marcos was approached by [[Crusch Karsten]] who voiced her request to accept [[Ferris]] into the Royal Guard and make a knight out of him. Due to Ferris' unparalleled healing magic, he accepted him among the ranks of Royal Guards and employed him many times in the following year. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Not long after the collective [[Royal Plague|deaths]] of the entire [[Royal Family]], Marcos assigned [[Reinhard van Astrea]], [[Julius Juukulius]], and Ferris to accompany the two Council of Wise Men members [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]] to the neighboring [[Empire of Vollachia]]. Roughly a month after their return, he arranged a proxy fight between the Lugunican Sword Saint Reinhard van Astrea and the Vollachian First ranking Divine General [[Cecilus Segmunt]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Marcos is currently regarded as the second strongest fighter in Lugunica, only falling behind Reinhard,''"He was called the strongest in the land, a battle-tested, old war dog. The man’s history and his skill with the sword left everyone in agreement that he was the second most powerful fighter in the kingdom. In other words, in terms of sheer strength, Marcos Gildark was one of the last people in the nation whose ire one would wish to arouse."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 1|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]] with strength said to be enough that, if he wasn't overshadowed by Reinhard, his name would be the one that rivals the strongest people from each nation.''But it was for that reason, that there was a certain truth being quietly overlooked. ――The truth that, concealed by Reinhard’s extraordinary existence, there was a person whose renown was being terribly underestimated, a person so truly powerful that, by all measures, it would not have been odd whatsoever for him to be enumerated among the other three. An individual who had no choice but to settle in the shadow of glory of the strongest Sword Saint in history, that person was none other than――, "――Marcos."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. He is powerful enough to make someone of [[Garfiel Tinzel]]'s level wary, and even though he has enough control over his aura to direct it at specific parties, said aura was powerful enough that when he accidentally felt it, Garfiel had to fight off his instincts to beastify and fight.''Suddenly experiencing a hallucination like that of being struck by a colossal, mountain-like palm, was Garfiel. Every pore on his body opening due to the momentary sensation, he was forced into utilizing his rationality to suppress his instinct to activate his beast transformation. At the extraordinary power possessed by the source of that vast aura of swordsmanship, beyond compare to that which had been directed at him by the soldiers of the Kingdom just before, shivers ran through Garfiel’s instincts.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 16, Section 1. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Expert Swordsman''': Although it is unclear just how skilled he is, his skill is such that those who witness it can attest to it to his unbelievable might. '''Incredible Strength''': Marcos's physical strength is incredible. By placing his hand against a sheathed sword, he can easily prevent even a sliver of it from being unsheathed,''The pommel was being suppressed by a palm that had descended from above it. Even if he poured strength into his arm, the sword would not even quiver in its sheath. He was neither able to draw it nor return it. It was a pressure as though the very castle itself had pinned down his sword.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 3. and with just a single strike of his bare hands, he can cause immense damage to whomever he hits.''Without even taking a proper stance, the strike was a gesture as though swatting away something blocking the path, and with just that, Heinkel’s body had been blown away like a slender twig.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. He can easily swing a grown man around like a doll,''As his face was kicked up into the air, Heinkel’s body was launched straight up, crashing into the ceiling. Then, as his body was being buried in the ceiling, his leg was grabbed, and he was vigorously swung back down into the ground. ――No, once again he was uprooted from the floor, swung up towards the ceiling, then back down to the ground again. Ceiling, ground, ceiling, ground, going up and down, he was being swung around in a manner akin to how a child would play with a doll.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. and by simply placing his fist in a person's mouth and opening his hand, he can easily break a person's jaw and remove teeth.''As he opened his mouth in an effort to let out a scream, Marcos’s hand was rammed inside. Then, the hand forcibly expanded within his mouth, dislocating Heinkel’s jaw together with a hard sound. Several of his molars were also fractured, while the back of his head and his temples were repeatedly hammered again and again by the crushing blow of iron fists and elbows.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 1. Even Heinkel Astrea, whose constitution is among the sturdiest, felt himself on the verge of death after being assaulted by his might. ===Techniques=== '''Fa Jin''' (発勁, ''Hakkei''): Marcos can use fa jin, a martial arts technique that deals a single crushing blow to the internal organs behind muscle. Marcos utilized his skill to readily absorb and perfectly replicate this technique from Roswaal after having only seen him use it twice. ===[[Magic]]=== At present, it is unclear what attribute Marcos has an affinity for, and it is unknown how proficient he is with ordinary magic. This being said, he seems to have enough knowledge of magic that he can work together with the likes of [[Ram]] to rewrite spells that prevent magic from being used to spells that can prevent noise from escaping a specified area.''"Working together with Ram, we rewrote the spell placed over this floor that restricts magic. We changed part of its efficacy into a spell that prevents the voices and racket here from leaking outside."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 3. '''Forbidden Art''' (禁術, ''Kinjutsu''): Marcos has an unnamed forbidden art that was attached to him through an El Goa cast by Roswaal during an incident where assassins were targeting the life of an [[Serena Dracroy|envoy]] from Vollachia. It creates a magical armor made of grey, bedrock-like stones that he can use to defend a specific part of his body,''Just then, with his stern face worthy of being called the Boulder, Marcos narrowed his eyes. The sword’s brandish did connect. Marcos made neither the attempt to draw his sword, nor to block with his gauntlets. Merely, the flash of the sword was delivered to Marcos’s thick neck―― and deflected by the ashen bedrock that covered his skin. As thick as a log, his neck was a well-tempered one. Covering it were several layers of a rocky shell that gradually rose up, a bulky rock armor that had been deployed, and easily stopped the steel sword strike.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 28, Section 2. or covers his whole body, increases his height to three meters, and makes him immune to things like poison gas. ===Other=== '''Discerning Eye''': By making his blue eyes glimmer slightly, Marcos can check for dangerous magic reactions and/or any equipment people may have. '''Stealth''': In spite of his hulking frame and the fact the wears heavy armor, Marcos is capable of moving silently and catching experienced fighters like Heinkel Astrea by surprise.''Since when had he been standing there? With that large frame and heavy armor, just how had he been able to completely silence his presence and footsteps?'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 27, Section 3. ==Trivia== *Marcos's birthday was a fan birthday decided at a talk show held on March 30, 2024. *At the 2024 talk show, it was confirmed that Marcos would be active in Arc 10. *During the aforementioned talk show, when someone asked who would make up the Nine Divine Generals of Lugunica if it existed, Marcos was one of the names he listed. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Knights]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[de:Marcos Gildark]] [[es:Marcos Gildark]] [[pl:Marcos Gildark]] [[pt-br:Marcos Gildark]] [[ru:Маркос Гилдарк]] [[zh:角色:马可仕]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|Volume 37]] (main story) (flashback) |Manga = [[Manga Love Song Chapter 6|Love Song Chapter 6]]}} '''Leip Barielle''' (ライプ・バーリエル) was a baron, [[Priscilla Barielle]]'s former husband, and the [[Dragon History Stone]]'s former administrator. Once a triumphant yet conceited commander during the [[Demi-Human War]], he sought to gain control over the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] after his failures in the civil war's [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]] disgraced his name. Later in life, Leip tried using the [[Royal Selection]] to make himself into Lugunica's de facto ruler by abusing [[Sphinx]]'s powers and puppeteering Priscilla's actions during the selection; however, he was permanently incapacitated by [[Al]] after he revealed his true intentions to the knight and went on to die sometime before the Royal Selection began.''“That lecherous old man suddenly went senile a half year ago. He remained unable to tell the difference between dream and reality, and passed away recently.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 3.''Leip Barielle, Priscilla’s husband and the man who died before the days of the Royal Selection, was not exactly incompetent, but he was a coldhearted elderly man who seemed like he had an utter lack of compassion.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]], Section 2.''“To begin with, I was only hired by the Master… although he is now deceased, I was hired by the Master as a waiting maid of the mansion, in order to serve the Mistress?”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]], Section 4. ==Appearance== Leip was an older man with a honed build, slicked back hair, and a moustache. He wore clothes befitting that of nobility. Despite being in his seventies, Leip possessed an energetic body and ambition-filled eyes that reflected the age of someone who was in their fifties. ==Personality== Leip was known to be a strict person to himself as well as to others and was considered to be a competent commander. An ambitious man, he desired to seize the throne of Lugunica for himself and would take any steps necessary to achieve his goal. For example, in an attempt to further his goals, once the inscriptions of the Dragon History Stone revealed the process of the Royal Selection, he found Priscilla before the [[Royal Family|royal family]] [[Royal Plague|died]] and conspired to make her into a mindless puppet he could control. Despite this, he experienced a deep-seated pathological distrust and paranoia of other people, and as a result of this, he prepared contingencies for any possible outcome, creating hidden passageways in his mansions and having hidden hideouts within his domain,''Priscilla’s late husband was said to have been plagued with pathological distrust and paranoia, and had made preparations for any eventuality, not only in the mansion he built in the Royal Capital, but also in his other residences and hideouts within his own domain.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 2, Section 7. such as the abandoned house Sphinx was held in. Because of his self-centered personality, he was not very well liked among his vassals and citizens who struggled under his rulership, and likewise, he was disliked by his subordinates as a commander in the Demi-Human War. He was a ruthless, cunning, and arrogant man who was almost always one step ahead of everyone in his ambition and always sought to remove any thorns in his side. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== Around 43 years before the events of [[Arc 1]], in the midst of the Demi-Human War, Leip served as a successful commander on the battlefield at the age of thirty. However, he was disliked by his subordinates for his cruelty. Upon meeting [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]], he struck the young man for perceived insubordination. During the Battle of Aihiya Swamp, the [[Royal Army]] suffered catastrophic losses due to the enemy's magic circles. As the commander, the failure of the battle was pinned on Leip, and he was branded by some as a war criminal. Although he tried to restore his honor, not only did his actions of tyranny against his subordinates come back to haunt him, but he was also accused of murdering the previous commander, [[Minor Characters#Crumère|Crumère]], leading to the denial of his protests. As punishment for the devastating loss, he was stripped from his position as a viscount and became a baron. By the time of the [[Invasion of the Royal Castle]], Leip would be relegated to the role of a castle guard. After encountering three of the Zergev Squadron's most notable members, [[Bordeaux Zergev]], [[Grimm Fauzen]], and Wilhelm Trias, he was initially apprehensive towards them and doubted their claim that the Demi-Human Alliance's leaders were about to attack the castle. Before he could reject the trio from entering the castle, [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] arrived to join the three of them with [[Carol Remendis]], and she forced Leip to step aside by floundering her rank over him. Soon encountering a few demi-humans who attempted to enter the building, Leip would accordingly chase them down to the underground sewers to finish them off. However, he encountered Sphinx in the sewers, and seizing an opportunity for him to take advantage of, he incapacitated her and took a necklace with a ring in her possession. Shortly afterwards, Leip would encounter Roswaal again, who was pursuing the escaping Witch, and lie about her death. After giving Roswaal the necklace and being left by himself, Leip would subsequently take Sphinx's body and keep her alive for his own ambition.''Saying nothing further, Leip turned back. Lying on the ground in the tunnel behind him was a small form wrapped in rags. He picked it up. Without arms, the body was quite light. He had hidden it in these wrappings, and now he was careful to take a different path out of the underground than Roswaal had. This betrayal was the first act of Leip Barielle’s long-lived ambition.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Sixth Stanza, Section 11. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== Many years later, Leip was entrusted by the Lugunican royal family to have the responsibility of administrating the Dragon History Stone. Having read the stone's inscription regarding the existence of the Royal Selection before the royal family ever succumbed to their sickness, he used the information about the prophecy to his advantage.''Having grasped the fact that the prophetic tablet had been inscribed with information about a calamity that would soon strike the Kingdom of Lugunica―― a disease that would spread through the Royal Family, Leip blazed with aspirations towards the next battle for the throne that would follow thereafter.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 1. He searched for a candidate and found Priscilla, who had lived in Lugunica for several years. With the ambition to seize the throne in the Royal Selection through her, he married Priscilla prior to the announcement of the Royal Selection and attempted to introduce her as the first candidate following the royal family's purported extinction, pretending that the inscription detailing the was brand new. However, after revealing the existence of the Royal Selection to the nobility, [[Crusch Karsten]] was discovered as the first candidate before Leip's scheme could be realized. ===[[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Entertainment Part]]=== Leip rigged a tournament for her to find a knight to have in the selection. She was originally to choose from among the top four, not knowing that in reality the contest had been fixed and all of them were his pawns in order to be used control her unpredictable behavior. However, Priscilla picked a man named Aldebaran, who had made his way to the top four himself, botching part of Leip's machinations yet again. After this event, he would review his plan to take over Priscilla's body with Sphinx.[[Re:Zero Prequel: Camp Formation Stories]], The Bloody Bride and her Amusing Servants, Section 10. In addition, before his incapacitation and eventual death, he hired [[Yae Tenzen]]. ===[[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]]=== As a way to rectify the issue with the knight tournament later, Leip brought [[Gilian Endymion]] to replace Al and to later use him in his plot to make Priscilla into a puppet after the opening ceremony of the selection.''“What, could you not hear me? That girl’s troublesome willfulness is in the way. I was able to overlook it before the start of the Royal Selection, but now that the importance of every single action is increasing, I can’t let it be. Once her debut at the Royal Castle is finished, I’ll take away her will and make her my puppet.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 7.''“In this world, there are many demands for unimaginable dark deeds. I long ago made connections with a handy fellow who acted as an intermediary for a curse arts user.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 7. However, [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] objected to this idea, and Leip attempted to kill him as a result. Thanks to a change of heart caused by Leip's cruelty and his lack of desire to work for a "geezer" who could not see Priscilla how he did, Al used [[Al#Abilities|his ability]] to break the old man's mind, foiling his plans in the end. Leip eventually died sometime before the beginning of the Royal Selection, and as a result, Priscilla assumed his authority and land. ==Abilities== '''Military Prowess''': In his younger days, despite the unsavory rumors surrounding him, Leip was a successful and capable commander who boasted a record of success until the Battle of Aihiya Swamp. He trained his body diligently, allowing him to be powerful enough to catch Wilhelm off-guard, and could have potentially even rivalled Bordeaux in combat prowess.''Grimm looked doubtful about this, and Wilhelm decided his initial judgment of Leip Barielle had been correct. The way Leip had moved when he struck him―― he was clearly a powerful warrior. He had trained himself thoroughly, showing the characteristic strength of a man who had been through bloodshed. His combat ability might have rivalled Bordeaux.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Third Stanza, Section 6. He retained his honed training of his body up until his death. '''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): Leip could use fire magic. *'''Goa''' (ゴーア): Leip could manifest a blaze of fire to incinerate foes. '''Equipment''': Leip had a short tube-shaped [[meteor]] which amplified the power of his spells. ==Trivia== *Leip boasted that his war record in the Demi-Human War was equal to Bordeaux Zergev's.''“Surely you don’t think you can restrain me so easily, youngling. In my younger days, I was nothing to scoff at on the battlefield. My war record is no less than that of Bordeaux himself!”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 7. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:House Barielle]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

If we're speaking about the three’s specialized attributes, Mimi’s is the earth attribute, Hetaro’s is the water attribute, and Tivey’s is the fire attribute.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/993115339654246400 May 6, 2018 Twitter Q&A] |Divine Protection = [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Trisection|Divine Protection of Trisection]] |Weapon = Staff |Light Novel = [[Anastasia's Prosperity Record]] (Side Story)
[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 6|Volume 6]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 5|Arc 3 Chapter 5]] (flashback)
[[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 16|Arc 3 Chapter 16]] (actual) |Anime = [[Episode 16]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Yukiyo Fujii|Fujii Yukiyo]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Erica Mendez|Erica Mendez]]}} '''Mimi Pearlbaton''' (ミミ・パールバトン) is one of [[Anastasia Hoshin]]'s followers and is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary group known as the [[Iron Fang]]. She plays a supporting role in [[Arc 3]] and [[Arc 5]]. ==Appearance== Mimi has aqua green eyes and long orange hair which she ties into two tails. She has orange cat ears along with a tail and wears a white robe. After the [[Battle for Priestella]], she received a large scar on her chest from when she defended [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] from [[Theresia van Astrea]]. ==Personality== Mimi has a bright and optimistic personality with straightforward intentions. Unlike her brothers, she talks in third person. She typically acts like a child, often causing problems for her brothers [[Hetaro Pearlbaton|Hetaro]] and [[Tivey Pearlbaton|Tivey]]. She considers the other members of the Iron Fang to be family and loves them, referring to [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]] as their father, though as it's her own unique way of loving others it tends to cause problems especially for her brothers. Mimi is one of the few people who never had any intentions of betraying or killing [[Natsuki Subaru]] throughout the series. As of the beginning of Arc 5, she has developed feelings for Garfiel, leading her to drag him around [[Priestella]] and claim to "feel weird" while blushing when he patted her head. Mimi has shown a matured and rational side to her, offering to comfort the crying Garfiel after the latter found out about his [[Reala Thompson|mother]]’s amnesia, as well as suggesting to the feisty Garfiel that they should escape rather than engage Theresia and [[Kurgan]] head-on. ==History== ===Early Life=== Sometime in the past, Mimi, Hetaro, and Tivey were abandoned by their parents. When they were two, Tivey was about to be kidnapped. Mimi attempted to fight off the kidnappers, but she was stabbed four times in the process, and Hetaro was also injured.As Mimi recalls, Tivey was about to get caught by the kidnappers and Mimi somehow stopped it but got stabbed in the belly by Mimi’s opponent. Mimi got stabbed four times, and Mimi was still two years old, so Mimi was only at the beginning stage of being the strenghtiest, so even Mimi was in a near death situation. [[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]], Section 2. As they were running away, they ran into [[Roshi Pearlbaton]], who healed them,''While they were running for their lives while Hetaro was dealing with a stomach wound as bad as Mimi’s, an old man suddenly appeared in front of Mimi when her wound started to feel better.'' [[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]], Section 2. and after taking them in, he taught them how to survive.''Roshi, who had picked up Mimi and her siblings, laughed with his dirty clothes and his ugly face with a chipped tooth. After that, the three cat’s and Roshi’s life began somehow. The three of them didn’t know anything, as they were just kittens. The three kitten siblings were taught the means to survive by Roshi, who was very knowledgeable. The energetic Mimi was taught how to fight. The kind Hetaro was taught how to live cautiously. And the wise Tivey was taught knowledge regarding various things. Roshi had always said that it would help the three of them in the future.'' [[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]], Section 2. ===[[Kararagi Girl Meets Cats Part 1|Kararagi Girl Meets Cats]] and [[Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye Part 1|Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye]]=== Mimi and Hetaro attempted to rescue Anastasia, but they were incidentally captured instead by [[Razcrew]]. Razcrew planned to sell them on the slave markets in the north of [[Kararagi]]. However, his plan was thwarted, and he ended up being enslaved himself. Before Ricardo could meet his end by [[Shiroro Tonerico|Shiroro]], Mimi quickly rescued him, the fight ended in a draw, as Shiroro did not intend to involve harming children. After the fight, she and Ricardo stopped and defeated [[Reisel]]. After the defeat of Reisel, Anastasia vowed that if anything happened to Roshi, she would take the Pearlbatons under her care. Eventually, Roshi made a kamikaze attack while on a mission, blowing up with an enemy in the process. A funeral was held for him, and Mimi cried afterwards, which only Anastasia knew. Ever since, the siblings have lived with the Iron Fang under Anastasia and Ricardo's care. ===[[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia]]=== As Mimi, Hetaro, and Tivey had entered his room the moment they realized that there was food, [[Joshua Juukulius]], who was honored to have finally been chosen to do something for Anastasia, was concerned that he had to act as a messenger to invite [[Emilia]] to Priestella, nervous and somewhat fearful of her due to her race and the rumors of her appearance being a match for the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. However, Mimi declared that Emilia wasn't scary, and recalling that Hetaro and Tivey had interacted with the [[Emilia Camp]] for the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], he asked for their opinions. While Tivey claimed that Emilia didn't seem to be scary, Hetaro declared that he only ever talked with her knight, Natsuki Subaru, someone else that Joshua had heard rumors and was wary of, as his origins were unknown and he had no known power. He also recalled the other worrisome rumors about the camp, which only increased his worries, and then, he went ask Anastasia about her intentions directly. ===[[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]]=== After arriving at [[Roswaal Manor]] to invite the Emilia Camp to Priestella, Mimi, who saw Garfiel for the first time, was entranced by him, and she asked for his name while introducing herself. He introduced himself, but she ended up dropping her staff on his foot, and [[Ram]] appeared to tell him not to leave their guests standing at the entrance. Taking a liking to calling him Garf, they were invited inside, and Mimi recalled what Roshi had once told her about the feelings she felt after seeing Garfiel. While she was waiting with Joshua inside and acting like she was trying to stay serious, she couldn't take her eyes off of Garfiel, causing him to ask what if something was wrong. Red-faced, Mimi ran away, and Ram scolded the guys for being inconsiderate. ===[[Kararagi Reaper Incident 2|Kararagi Reaper Incident]]=== Sometime after the Battle for Priestella, the Pearlbatons returned to [[Banan]] in Kararagi. However, at some point after the events of the [[Great Disaster]], the Slasher, [[Zarestia]] set a windstorm on the town, destroying half of it and raising everyone in town sans Ricardo into the sky - an event that would be remembered as the Shinigami Disaster. Believing Ricardo to have stolen her Light Sphere, the two confronted each other, worrying the Pearlbatons. However, after withstanding all of her attacks, she stopped attacking him, made the windstorm dissipate, and lowered everyone to the ground. Sometime after Ricardo quelled Zarestia's rage, Anastasia's group arrived and were led by Mimi to the holding cells in [[Riften Magoji]]'s mansion, where Zarestia was being held. During their conversation, Anastasia learned that Riften had gone missing, Julius noticed that Zarestia was a Great Spirit and introduced himself, and Halibel unintentionally riled her up by noticing her strange constitution, that something was missing. However, when Anastasia mentioned Zarestia being responsible for other such town-destroying wind cataclysms, Zarestia declared otherwise, saying that she only rampaged in Banan. Shortly afterward, this is confirmed when a massive tornado appeared outside of Banan, not made by Zarestia. After giving her orders and securing Zarestia's assistance, the group made their way to stop the tornado. Although they managed to quell the winds, however, they soon realized that Anastasia and [[Eridna|Echidna]] had gone missing. ==Abilities== ===Overall Abilities=== Despite her size, Mimi is capable of combat, and she is said to be the strongest between the Pearlbaton siblings. She is at least adept enough in combat to defend from particularly skilled corpse soldiers for a short time alongside another strong warrior. The full extent of her strength, however, is unknown. ===[[Divine Protection]]=== '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Trisection|Divine Protection of Trisection]]''' (三分の加護 ''Sanbun no Kago''): Her Divine Protection, which she uses in conjunction with her brothers Hetaro and Tivey, enables them to bear each other's physical and emotional burdens and can also be used to split damage between them such as to block death blows. However, as Mimi is the strongest out of the three, her brothers are often stuck with bearing her burdens. In addition, they can launch a destructive interference wave using the Divine Protection and the other siblings, though Mimi is limited to five times and Hetaro and Tivey are limited to two times, so the maximum usage per day is four times. ===[[Magic]]=== Mimi has a natural affinity for the earth attribute, and she is capable of using both earth and water magic. Though it is unclear how adept she is with her magic, she is at least capable of conjuring earthen walls, healing injuries, and creating barriers. '''Spells''': [[File:Mimi summon Multi-barrier.gif|thumb|250px]] *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法): Mimi can use a simple application of healing magic to heal the wounds of herself and others. She used this during the battle against the White Whale to heal soldiers' wounds. *'''Multi-barrier''': Mimi is capable of producing a dual-layered, wind-based barrier that can block physical attacks. However, the barriers can be shattered with sufficient force, as in the case of Theresia van Astrea. ===Other=== Mimi & Hetaro - Resonance Wave.gif.gif|Mimi uses the Roaring Wave against the White Whale Mimi uses Magic.gif|Mimi uses Magic to detonate Petelgeuse's body '''Roaring Wave''' (咆哮波, ''Hōkōha''): The triplets unleash a burst of a violent destructive [[mana]] from their mouths together. Only two of the three of them can do it at a time. This ability was learned from Ricardo as he is the originator of that ability. {{Clear}} ===Equipment=== *'''Staff''': Mimi, like her brothers, carries a staff with her. ==Trivia== *Because Mimi is full of energy, the author decided to make her, Hetaro, and Tivey's birthday fall on Children's Day in Japan. *Mimi is the strongest of the 3 siblings. *The illustrator had an idea for Mimi's liger, but it was later scrapped for being "too cute" and revised to be a normal dog. *In [[Emilia's Royal Capital Tour Book]], when Mimi was originally drawn, Mimi had more cat-like features, such as whiskers. She received a redesign when the side story was adapted into [[Re:Zero Ootsuka Shinichirou Art Works Re:BOX|Shouhenshuu 1]]. *According to the author, both Ricardo and Anastasia tried to teach Mimi to get her to say "I" instead of saying her own name when she's talking, but they couldn't get her to do it, so they gave up on it. *In 2014, the author stated that Mimi was among nine known characters introduced in the story up to that point who had the highest capacity for holding mana. However, he chose to not rank Mimi or any of the other listed characters in order.''“Emilia, Roswaal, Echidna, Typhon, Carmilla, Daphne, Ferris, Priscilla, and Mimi have a large capacity. It’s scary to rank them, considering the future, so I will stop…”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/499581653728378880 2014 AskFM Q&A] It is unknown if the list has changed since then. *[[Wikipedia:Erica Mendez|Erica Mendez]], Mimi's English voice actress, also voices [[Puck]] and [[Petra Leyte]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Kararagi Navbox}} [[Category:Banan]] [[Category:Anastasia Camp]] [[Category:Iron Fang]] [[Category:Mercenaries]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[ru:Мими Перлбатон]] [[de:Mimi Pearlbaton]] [[es:Mimi Pearlbaton]] [[fr:Mimi Pearlbaton]] [[pl:Mimi Pearlbaton]] [[pt-br:Mimi Pearlbaton]] [[zh:角色:蜜蜜]]
