[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Motomu Kiyokawa|Kiyokawa Motomu]] (Season 1) |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:John Snyder (actor)|John Snyder]]}} '''Miklotov McMahon''' (マイクロトフ・マクマホン) is the representative of the '''Council of Wise Men''' who are currently ruling over the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]. Many have considered Miklotov to be the true brains of the Kingdom who, in the event that the royal family were to disappear, would be a suitable replacement ruler. He played a supporting role in the [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]], and a minor supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. He also plays a role in [[Arc 10]]. ==Appearance== Miklotov has long white hair and a long white beard that nearly touches the ground. The glimmer in his eyes has been compared to the sharpness of a blade. He is short and wears the robes of a member of the Council of Wise Men. Roughly 40 years before the events of the main story, Miklotov had grey hair and was a gentle-looking man with mischievous yet intellectual-looking eyes and a warm presence. ==Personality== Miklotov is a highly intelligent and perceptive man, which he displayed when he quickly realized the true intentions behind [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] and [[Puck]]'s performance during the [[Royal Selection]], which even the other members of the Council of Wise Men hadn't.''"Even my heart skipped a beat. Allow me to call this a most amusing presentation."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 5. He is also a believer in the qualities of the Lion King,''"And the intellect does not blossom without proper cultivation. Nor does the blood of the Lion King."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], A Dream's Beginning, Section 2. having asked [[Fourier Lugunica|Fourier]]'s teacher to check if he had the qualities of one, though the teacher failed to notice Fourier's potential.''""And the young lord...? Has he shown any signs of the blood?" "Ahem, he---no, he doesn't appear to... At least, not that I have seen.""'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], A Dream's Beginning, Section 5. ==History== At some point in the past, Miklotov was familiar with [[Emerada Lugunica]] and knew of her ability as a Lion King before her death.''"So you may say, Your Highness, but the blood has not run thin. It is a fact that once every several generations a true master appears in the royal line. Two generations ago..."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], A Dream's Beginning, Section 2. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]]=== During the era of the [[Demi-Human War]], Miklotov played a vital role, greatly assisting the Royal Family as a trusted advisor of King [[Gionis Lugunica]]. He went to great lengths in order to help his friends or people he respected. When [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] was captured, he was held in Miklotov's own manor. Gionis frequently made visits to Miklotov's manor to speak to Cromwell in this period. After Wilhelm returned to the Royal Capital and was intent on finding a way to rejoin the military and allow Theresia to retire, he spoke with Miklotov, who warned him that allowing the latter would be difficult, leading Wilhelm to drag the king into his mess. Afterward, the two oversaw his battle with the Zergev Squadron, and afterward, they informed Wilhelm of the deal that Theresia had made with the king prior about Wilhelm and Theresia being wed to remove her as the Sword Saint. Three months later, Miklotov was the one to officiate their wedding. In the months following the end of the Demi-Human War, [[Stride Vollachia]] launched a series of terrorist attacks, targeting the city of [[Picoutatte]], the Astrea manor, and the McMahon manor. Though Miklotov himself was away during the attack, several of his guards were killed during the event. Many years later, Cromwell escaped his imprisonment through unknown means. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== Not much is known about Miklotov's actions in the following four decades. However, roughly 17 years before the events of the main story, Miklotov spent his days counselling Fourier Lugunica, the youngest Prince of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. After the entire [[Royal Family]] [[Royal Plague|perished]], he, as well as other select members of the Council of Wise Men, took control of the Kingdom, assuming the highest authority in the nation. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly 3–4 months before the events of the main story, Miklotov, alongside [[Bordeaux Zergev]] went on a diplomatic mission to the neighboring [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. They were accompanied by the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint]], the [[Ferris|Blue]], and the [[Julius Juukulius|Finest of Knights]]. Following their failed negotiations with the [[Vincent Vollachia|Emperor]] of the Vollachia Empire, the diplomats were situated in one of the guest rooms, located in the Crystal Palace in the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]]. After an alleged kidnapping of the Emperor, orchestrated by the three Royal Knights, both Miklotov and Bordeaux were held hostage in their room, not being permitted to venture outside. After the dispute was settled, they signed a non-aggression pact between the Kingdom and the Empire, marking their mission as a success. ==Trivia== *Miklotov was described as having brown hair in the text of Sword Demon Love Song. His hair color was changed to grey in the illustrations of Sword Demon Battle Ballad. ==Note== ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Unknown Status]] [[de:Miklotov McMahon]] [[es:Miklotov McMahon]] [[pl:Miklotov McMahon]] [[pt-br:Miklotov McMahon]] [[ru:Миклотов МакМахон]] [[zh:角色:麦克罗托夫]]

Likely other types as well |Divine Protection = |Authority = [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]] |Weapon = Twin Witch Cult Daggers |Equipment = Gospel |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9|Volume 9]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 52|Arc 3 Chapter 52]] |Anime = [[Episode 26]] |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kengo Kawanishi|Kawanishi Kengo]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Erik Scott Kimerer|Erik Scott Kimerer]] }} '''Lye Batenkaitos''' (ライ・バテンカイトス) is a '''[[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop]]''' of the '''[[Witch Cult]]''', representing the '''Gourmet''' aspect of '''Gluttony'''. First introduced in the [[Arc 3]] interludes, he later served as a major antagonist in [[Arc 5]] and one of the main antagonists of [[Arc 6]], alongside his [[Roy Alphard|brother]] and [[Rui Arneb|sister]]. He was one of the most mysterious and overlooked Sin Archbishops, as due to the nature of his Authority, he was not held responsible for any attacks orchestrated by the Witch Cult. Accordingly, he didn't have any actual enemies that would direct their hate towards him alone. Throughout his years as a Sin Archbishop, Lye ate an innumerable amount of people, inherited their memories and skills, and all the while utilized all sorts of abilities and techniques which he would use for his own benefit until his end in the climax of Arc 6, when he fought [[Ram]] and was subsequently decapitated by her. ==Appearance== Lye Batenkaitos stood at four feet and eleven inches tall, making him a fairly short youth, the same height as his younger brother. Like his siblings, he appeared to be roughly twelve or thirteen years of age with a high-pitched voice that denoted his apparent youthfulness. He has straight, unkempt dark brown hair with red tips, and it trails down to his knees, falling over his face in a way that obscured his right eye. His diminutive and slender physique had a surprising amount of musculature to it, and his dark skin was littered with a multitude of grotesque scars that varied from whip to bite marks. His limbs are also covered in dirt and grime. His most distinctive facial features were his repulsive emerald green eyes and fang-like sharp teeth that usually formed a sadistic smile. Like most other Sin Archbishops, Lye's clothing deviated from the religious black habit worn by most Witch Cultists. Much like his body, the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony's clothing was tattered and dirty. His primary piece of clothing was a skin-tight purple bodysuit that exposed his arms, bare feet, and chest and had horizontal pink stripes across it. Over the top of his bodysuit, he wore a tattered black cloak with red patterns that reached down to the ground. A pair of Witch Cult daggers were strapped to his forearms that served as his primary weapons. In Arc 5, Lye fully showed off his body, revealing a multitude of grotesque and horrid wounds, ranging from whip marks to bite and scratch marks. He gave off an unnatural and bizarre aura; completely opposite from what you would expect from a child. After utilizing Solar Eclipse and breaking out of his shell, Lye took on a more monstrous and distorted appearance; an amalgamation of most of his victims. One could see body parts of [[Neiji Lockhart]], [[Beli Hainelga]], [[Dorkell]], [[Rem]], and numerous others. His limbs were of different length, his head was of distorted proportions with a part of it belonging to Dorkell, part of it resembled Rem's, and so on. Lye himself was unaware of this change. ==Personality== Lye believed that everything came down to experiences and the one who manages to get better knowledge is the one who enriches his life and wins over people. Remarking that knowledge is power and memories are bonds, he ultimately concluded that it meant that he and his philosophy were the greatest. Because of that, Lye focused on the quality of the lives he ate, often giving his opponents a chance to "prove" themselves as worthy meals before ultimately eating them and claiming their abilities for himself with his [[Authority|Authority of Gluttony]], which befitted his title of '''Gourmet'''. Unlike Roy, Lye strongly believed that if the number of lives in the world is limited, then the amount of worthy food is limited, and so he would not miss a single chance to eat someone. Due to their differences in how they approached eating, Lye held distaste for Roy's way of fighting, thinking that just trying to eat anything would lead to the loss a "gourmet" platter. Lye also showed to look out for Rui, pointing out how she may be happy if he was to eat [[Otto Suwen|Otto]], [[Felt]], and [[Dynas Trussardi|Dynas]], though he would ultimately abandon her for himself if put in danger. Although his past with his siblings is unclear, Lye seemed to show a strong dislike towards merchants.''Otto continued to watch as Batenkaitos’ eyes became filled with complete disgust and hostility. “You, are a merchant, right? Putting price tags on things, they are people who sell them to line their own pockets. Human values and opinions too, everything, everything! They are dead people who put them on a scale and calculate, aren’t they?”'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 54, Section 1. Lye remarked how [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] was his "savior", as he is able to remember the people who have gotten their names eaten and pointing out how the forgotten feelings of rage and revenge were a source of dissatisfaction for him, but Subaru was an exception. Upon being confronted by Ram within the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], Lye attempted to eat her, believing that both his desire to devour her and the gluttony that he felt were the ultimate form of love, and he directed his warped love toward Ram up to his very end. Additionally, Lye spoke in a collective manner using ''us'' and ''we'' instead of first or third person. When he used Solar Eclipse and changed his form into a person that he had ate, Lye took on the mannerisms and way of speaking that they previously had. ==History== ===Early Life=== Due to the young age of the Gluttony siblings, they were assumedly born less than two decades prior to the beginning of the story. As one of the three children of the previous Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, [[Leilani Alnair]], Lye and his two siblings were kept in the womb by their mother for over three years through sheer force of will.''This too, was the achievement of Leilani's child―― or rather, children, it would seem, whom she kept in her womb for over three years with her own willpower, in order to perpetually be the pitied existence known as a pregnant woman. Although, the important babies themselves, as if unaware of the struggles of their pitiful mother, would foolishly kick her from within her abdomen quite frequently, incessantly begging to be let out.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. After Leilani conquered the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] and became the first person to arrive at the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in hundreds of years, she attempted to overwrite [[Shaula]]'s memories with her Authority, causing the Star Keeper to shoot a white light through her chest and subsequently eject her from the tower. The shot was presumably responsible for killing one of her unborn triplets, this being Rui,''Lye of Gourmet and Roy of Bizarre Eating, twins who shared in the same Witch Factor of Gluttony―― to be precise, they were triplets with Rui, who had died inside their mother’s womb, but contrary to expectations, they were siblings who had not been on the same wavelength with each other.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 6, Section 7. and Leilani was later found by a man with medical knowledge who ascertained that one of her children had died, but the other two were alive.''“One's done for… dead…! But, there's another… no, two are alive!”'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 3. Against Leilani's own wishes, her two surviving children, Lye and Roy, were saved and delivered, and she died a few moments after they were born.''“Birth parent? Or foster parent? The former died upon our birth and took our little sister with them as well, and the latter would surely~ be pretty incompatible with you, uncle.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 1, Section 4. Following Leilani's death, Rui's soul somehow persisted in the Corridor of Memories without being subjected to the soul filtering process, and the three siblings inherited their mother's Witch Factor of Gluttony. Lye bears numerous scars that litter his body, which may indicate that his life prior to becoming a Sin Archbishop was rough and brutal. Likewise, he also seems to have a history with merchants, judging by the grudge and harsh view he seems to bear toward them. At some point after becoming a Sin Archbishop, Lye met his sister Rui when she used Solar Eclipse to take over Roy’s body. It can be implied that the same can be said vice versa, as both brothers are aware of her. ===[[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Second Encyclopedia]]=== In [[Priestella]], as the Witch Cult's [[Battle for Priestella|attack]] began, Lye was attacking guards before confronting [[Joshua Juukulius]], who had stepped in his way when Lye was about to attack a defenseless woman. Though the woman got away, Lye was more interested in Joshua, and he decided to devour his name and memories instead. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Due to his vast collection of abilities given to him through the use of his Authority, Lye is among the most skilled of martial artists in the world, capable of fighting and outclassing most warriors by using a wide variety of physical techniques, magic, and other such abilities alongside his Authority, which could also allow him to instantly defeat any number of strong warriors so long as he touched them and knew their names. What makes him even more dangerous is that, due to the unique aspect of his Authority, he had gone completely unheard until his ability was recognized after the events of Arc 3, meaning that he is not only strong, but he was also more than capable of escaping his enemies without anyone realizing exactly who or what he was. ===[[Authority]]=== Lye was one of the previous holders of the '''Witch Factor of Gluttony''' and could use its respective Authority, which granted him powers relating to consuming the memories, names, and souls connected to [[Od Lagna]]'s Register of Names and replicating their abilities for himself. [[File:Lye using the Authority of Gluttony.gif|thumb|right|250px|Lye using the Authority of Gluttony to eat the name and memories of Hicks Hartmann.]] '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Gluttony]]''' (暴食, ''Bōshoku''): Lye could eat the name and memories of his opponent. To eat a name, he had to touch them with his left hand, then licked the palm of the same hand as well as chant their full name. Things such as experience, talent, and the likes and dislikes of human relationships served as food for him, allowing him to take advantage of any and all abilities or memories his opponents had. Likewise, he can choose whether or not to eat only names, only memories, or both, though Roy claims that it difficult and is like trying to eat only the ingredients in a sandwich without removing the buns. However, if Lye eats a fake name, or if he attempts to eat the previous name of a person who has managed to change their name, such as through marriage or adoption, he becomes plagued with severe nausea. Similarly, attempting to devour the name and memories of someone with a soul too large and powerful puts Lye at the risk being taken over by said spirit, as seen when his brother devoured the name of Reid Astrea. It is possible for Lye to regurgitate the names and memories that he's devoured. According to Roy, anything that the siblings eat goes to the same '''Stomach of Souls''' (魂の胃袋, ''Tamashī no Ibukuro''), from which they can share and pull the same names and memories that their siblings have eaten. Lye claimed that he did not share everything he ate with the others,''“Whoa, no need to get so hasty. Sorry, but we don't share every single thing we eat with the others. We don't even remember you, Mister. That must mean you're looking for Roy, not us, right?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 24]], Chapter 4, Section 3. indicating the possibility that he may have kept some of the names and memories he plundered for himself, but following his death, Roy has since exercised the main three techniques employed by his brother. *Those that had their names eaten had their existences erased from the world, destroying any human relationships along with negating any contracts with [[spirit]]s. Not even the people closest to them could remember a single thing about them. *Those that had their memories eaten became amnesic and any characteristics they may have had are reset, effectively making them into a different person. *Those that had both their name and memories eaten simply became a shell, and although they were alive, they no longer ate, excreted waste, or aged, putting them in suspended animation. *Lye could not eat the same person twice until that individual gained enough new memories to establish a different sense of self from their old one. *Lye could not eat the names or memories of non-humanoid beings, such as different animals, witchbeasts, or earth dragons. '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Eclipse]]''' (蝕, ''Shoku''): Eclipse was considered to be the trump card of Gluttony and it also had two types; '''Solar Eclipse''' and '''Lunar Eclipse'''. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 24 11.png|thumb|200px|Lye using Dorkell's, Beli's, and Neiji's skills via Lunar Eclipse.]] *'''Lunar Eclipse''' (月食, ''Gesshoku''): This allowed the holder to use their victims' memories and harvest their skills and knowledge. Lye used Lunar Eclipse to boost his physical strength and perform numerous techniques, including Palm of the Fist King and Leaper. However, Lye cannot bring forth the true potential of techniques in this manner, only being granted a portion of the technique's power. It is worth noting that by eating a person's name and using Lunar Eclipse, Lye did not gain his victims' [[Divine Protection]]s, spiritual arts, or Authorities. On top of that, Lye could also combine any number of memories and skills which would in turn allow him to create any sort of synthesized super-class technique he desired. *'''Solar Eclipse''' (日食, ''Nisshoku''): This allows the holder to harvest their victims' name and transform their appearance accordingly. Rui, for example, transformed into Neiji Lockhart and numerous other victims she and her two brothers had eaten throughout the years using her sibling's body. By doing so, though he became limited in the number of techniques he could use, the techniques that belong to those who Lye had transformed into can achieve their full potential. Originally, Lye never used Solar Eclipse as he didn't like the side effects of morphing into his victims; according to him, he felt like he was losing himself. After his fierce battle with Ram however, Lye was forced to use Solar Eclipse to morph into Dorkell in order to escape certain death and effectively overcame his fear of using the aforementioned Solar Eclipse by finding a way to retain his own sense of self.''"However, in the battle with Ram, he almost died, and in order to survive, Batenkaitos broke out of his shell the moment he turned into ‘Leaper’ Dorkell using Solar Eclipse. He had found a way to maintain his sense of self while in his Solar Eclipse form that he had originally been afraid of losing."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 83, Section 2 Following that incident, Lye freely started using both Solar and Lunar Eclipse, greatly amplifying his fighting strength as by morphing into the original owner of a specific skill he planned on using, the effect will be much greater; by morphing into Dorkell, Lye was able to leap much farther, and by morphing into Neiji Lockhart, the Palm of the First King was much more devastating. '''Life Creation''': Rui stated she and her brothers can create life with the usage of her Witch Factor of Gluttony, just like how Daphne created the witchbeasts four centuries ago. However, Rui has also stated she and her brothers had no reason to do so, hence they never followed through the idea.''"“You know the Three Great Witchbeasts? It’s said that those, are monsters created by the owner of our Witch Factor long before us. We too, can do something similar. We didn’t do that because there wasn’t really any meaning in doing so…… but, you see.”"'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 75. While all of this was strictly stated by Rui, it's safe to assume Lye was also capable of creating life through his Witch Factor of Gluttony. *'''[[Witchbeast]] Control''': Because Lye, Roy, and Rui each possess the Witch Factor of Gluttony which was previously in [[Daphne]]'s possession, they could direct witchbeasts to attack certain areas. This was why the [[White Whale]]'s attacks were coordinated with those of the Witch Cult. In Arc 6, Lye and Roy were able to get to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in half a day by commanding the witchbeasts in the Augria Sand Dunes and ordered them to attack the Watchtower. The White Whale, as well as, to an extent, the [[Great Rabbit]] can obey the Factor holder's will.''“The White Whale obeys Daphne’s Witch Factor. The Rabbit, too, might obey to a certain extent.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/494741464396886016 July 31, 2014 AskFM Q&A] ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== Lye Batenkaitos vs Rem.gif|Lye easily overpowering Rem, deflecting her attacks with his two daggers. Lye dodges Emilia's attacks.gif|Lye easily dodges Emilia's attacks with her Ice Brand Arts. '''Master Martial Prowess''': Through the accumulation of souls eaten with his Authority, Lye gained any abilities his victims once had, such as martial art techniques and weapon skills by using Lunar Eclipse. In turn, this granted him extraordinary combat strength. He was able to overpower multiple strong opponents at once, as shown in Arc 6. According to the author, Lye Batenkaitos is one of the most skilled Sin Archbishops in hand-to-hand combat. ===Techniques=== '''Palm of the Fist King''' (拳王の掌, ''Ken Ō no Tenohira''): Palm of the Fist King allowed Lye to strike his opponents with an extremely powerful fist, and its destructive force granted him the capability to blast and drill through steel or flesh. This ability originally belonged to Neiji Lockhart. '''Carnivorous Beast''' (肉食獣, ''Nikushoku-jū''): Carnivorous Beast allowed Lye to strengthen his body and gave him two advantages: he could withstand powerful attacks and strengthen his limbs to deliver devastating blows. With this ability, he was able take a hit from Emilia's ice spear and come out unscathed, then deliver a retaliating punch that, from Subaru's perspective, would be as devastating as getting hit by a car. This ability originally belonged to Beli Hainelga. [[File:Lye_Batenkaitos_using_the_Leaper_Technique.gif|thumb|250px|Lye using '''Leaper''' against Rem.]] '''Leaper''' (跳躍者, ''Chōyaku-sha''): Leaper allowed Lye to use a short-range teleportation in quick succession, essentially allowing him to "leap" behind his opponents or avoid extremely precise and quick attacks. He was also capable of utilizing it vertically, making it appear as if he's flying. This ability originally belonged to Dorkell. ===[[Magic]]=== Like with his hand-to-hand skills, Lye was able to utilize various magic abilities after eating people with his Authority. However, this does not affect his mana pool, meaning that he may not be able to use any spell to its fullest potential depending on their respective mana consumptions. '''Spells''': *'''Huma''' (ヒューマ): Lye created a shining water barrier that blocked other projectiles and sorts of magic. However, if the incoming magic was stronger than the shield it would get through it and damage Lye. **'''El Huma''' (エル・ヒューマ): Lye formed and shot multitudes of ice spikes from his hands which easily pierced through human flesh and immediately vanished on impact. '''Unique Spells''': Lye using Ice Brand Arts.gif|Lye using '''Ice Brand Arts''' against Emilia and Julius. Lye - Invisible Wind Blade Technique.gif|Lye using his '''Unnamed Invisible Wind Blade Technique''' against Ram. *'''Ice Brand Arts''' (アイスブランドアーツ): During the events of Arc 6, Lye replicated [[Emilia]]'s Ice Brand Arts. This technique allowed Lye to instantly conjure ice made weapons which he could use and freely manipulate in close-quarters combat. Lye could even conjure weapons known only in Subaru's world by pulling from his memories, which he used to recreate a Pile Bunker. The weapons were very sturdy and were even capable of withstanding heat. However, due to the mana cost of using Ice Brand Arts, Lye cannot use it as freely as Emilia can. *'''Unnamed Invisible Wind Blade Technique''': This ability allowed Lye to hide invisible blades made of Wind Magic in a fixed space of his choosing, making them unable to be blown away by even Ram's Wind Magic. He could launch an attack with a wind blade that could cut through a person's clothes and body, and he could jump atop the blades as footing to move through the air with. This ability originally belonged to an unidentified [[shinobi]]. ===Equipment=== [[File:Lye Batenkaitos daggers.jpg|thumb|right|100px|Lye's Witch Cult Daggers.]] *'''Witch Cult Daggers''': Lye skillfully used two standard Witch Cult daggers that were wrapped around his arms. He was able to masterfully deflect extremely precise attacks, block strikes that would shatter any sword and easily overpower even the strongest knights. *'''Gospel''' (福音): As a member of the Witch Cult, Lye was the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel was a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed [[Echidna]]. The [[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]] would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult were imperfect replicas, meaning that, although they detailed the future of its owner, the events conveyed were subject to change and the information provided was often up for interpretation. The Gospels took the form of small black books that could only be read by their owners. ==Trivia== *Lye, like every other Sin Archbishop (with the exception of [[Stride Vollachia]]), is named after a celestial body. "Baten Kaitos" was the traditional name used for Zeta Ceti, a star located in the Cetus constellation. The word was derived from the Arabic term بطن قيطس (batn qaytus), which translates to "belly of the sea monster". *Before being explicitly confirmed at a talk show held on July 26, 2026, it was heavily implied in the story of Scorpion Tale and by the author's comments in its afterword that Leilani was the mother of Lye, Roy, and Rui. **As Leilani is the mother of the siblings, the "Lei" part of her name is likely a reference to how, in Japanese, the given names of the siblings all share a first syllable beginning with "R" sound and have an "i" sound in the second syllable. Therefore, the "Lei" part of Leilani's name, pronounced Rei (レイ), would mirror Rai (ライ), Roi (ロイ), and Rui (ルイ). *In [[Episode 26]], Lye can be seen using the Leaper technique to avoid Rem's ice spears. In the novels, he was first seen using this technique in Arc 6. *In the Web Novel version of Arc 3, Lye mentioned that he could create a new White Whale if he was given another 400 years. However, this line was cut from the Light Novel. *In a Q&A, the author stated that if Daphne and a Sin Archbishop of Gluttony were to fight, it would most likely end in a draw. It is unknown if this answer was stating that a fight with Lye and his siblings would end in a draw against the Witch of Gluttony if they fought her all at once, nor is it known if the resulting draw would only come from a match with one of them. *According to the author, if Lye was to be transported to modern Japan without his Authority, he would be a shoplifter. *In a Q&A, the author said that Lye did wine tasting in his free time, though this might have been said in a joking manner. *Originally, Lye's brother Roy was the one who devoured the name and memories of [[Joshua Juukulius]] in the shop special release of [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Second Encyclopedia]], but the illustration incorrectly depicted him instead. In [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 11|Tanpenshuu Volume 11]], this was remedied by having the story rewritten to feature Lye rather than Roy. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Cult Navbox}} [[es:Ley Batenkaitos]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Sin Archbishops]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[Category:Arc 3 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 5 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 6 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]] [[de:Lye Batenkaitos]] [[es:Rye Batenkaitos]] [[fr:Ray Batenkaitos]] [[pl:Ley Batenkaitos]] [[pt-br:Ray Batenkaitos]] [[ru:Лай Батенкайтос]] [[uk:Лей Батенкайтос]] [[zh:莱伊]]

[[Episode 34]] (actual) |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Mikako Komatsu|Komatsu Mikako]] |English Voice = Skyler Davenport}} '''Minerva''' (ミネルヴァ) was the '''[[Witch#Witch of Wrath, Minerva|Witch of Wrath]]'''. She formally debuted in [[Arc 4]] as a supporting character. In life, Minerva, with her [[Authority]] of Wrath, healed every injured person in her sight, creating natural disasters in the process. Though she met her end after she was caught in a trap involving the elves and was killed by the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], her soul was preserved by the [[Echidna|Witch of Greed]] in the [[Castle of Dreams]] placed within the [[Sanctuary]]. Following the events of Arc 4, her soul was taken into a glintstone necklace that [[Omega]] wears on her travels. ==Appearance== Minerva was a beautiful young woman who stood at exactly five feet tall. She has been noted to have been in her late teens years and had vivid slightly slanted sky-blue eyes that were almost transparent. Her long gleaming golden hair was tied into a messy ponytail on the left side of her head that rubbed against her face. A pretty pink and blue love heart pin was also fastened to the left side of her head. She had bountiful breasts and a shapely bottom that lent her a fair deal of sex appeal in the eyes of [[Natsuki Subaru]]. Her primary outfit consisted of an extremely short sleeveless form-fitting one-piece purple dress with a cleavage-displaying cut-out, a translucent sleeveless light purple bodysuit worn under all of her clothes, a pair of thigh-high white boots with purple interior, a pair of long white gloves with purple interior, and a long white sleeveless coat with a cleavage-displaying cut-out that allowed a part of her dress-covered breasts to spill out. ==Personality== Minerva was a naive and very kind woman, to the point that, according to the author, she was the easiest to fool both among the Witches and in the world overall, and she was regularly being deceived.''"Please be at ease. It’s far too late for you to worry. She’s pretty much always being deceived."'' AskFM Q&A. Because she was so kind, she hated the despicable actions of other people, which included them hurting other living beings, and she openly disliked conflict, regularly lamenting it. Because of this, she became easily frustrated and brought to tears, which she would mistake for anger and use as an excuse for when she began to cry. Minerva does not like watching people get hurt in front of her, watching other be deceived, or someone choosing suicide to run away from what they do not understand, and she will actively interfere when she sees anything of the like, all of which she did for Subaru. Upon awakening her Authority, she would regularly strike at people and heal them at the same time. She was seen being prideful of her work, and she often acted very hostile by punching people out of nowhere or scolding them for putting their "lives in danger". However, her adorable way of doing so and the notion of helping, made it impossible for people to get offended by her actions. Despite this, although she became aware of the side effects of her Authority causing natural disasters and ending lives elsewhere, because Minerva cared more about healing the people that were in front of her eyes, she completely disregarded the side effects and continued her healing spree. This being said, however, if she encountered someone that she couldn't save or someone with no injuries, she would immediately turn away from them, as she didn't have time to waste,''"Minerva-tan would probably immediately turn away from someone she couldn’t help. She doesn’t have time to waste, after all."'' AskFM Q&A.''"It wouldn’t work. Minerva can only heal wounds; diseases are a different matter. Also, Minerva won’t stop to worry about the life or death of someone with no injuries. She knows that there are a lot of people she needs to hit."'' AskFM Q&A. believing that there was no end to the people in the world mourning the pain and suffering they could do nothing about.''"She doesn’t have any free time to spend with people who aren’t in any pain or suffering. There’s no end to the people throughout the world who are mourning their pain or suffering that they can’t do anything about."'' AskFM Q&A. ==History== At some point in her life, Minerva came into contact with and absorbed the Witch Factor of Wrath. The Witch Factor within her eventually blossomed into the Authority of Wrath, a power that allowed Minerva to heal a person's wounds by striking them. As the possessor of the Witch Factor of Wrath, Minerva was counted among the Witches of Sin, a collection of people who wielded the nine Witch Factors that each correlated to one of the deadly sins. Due to her Witch Factor and her connection to the Witches, Minerva became known as the Witch of Wrath. In the past, people in the world around Minerva were constantly fighting, which greatly angered her. Eventually, she realized that crying wouldn't solve anything and decided to train herself in order to gain enough power to be a deterrent to fighting, though that still didn't change anything. As she fought, she came to understand that she'd been crying out of rage and not sorrow, causing her to start punching people, resulting in their wounds being healed. From that moment on, she traveled the world to heal people wherever she found people in need. Many nations sent troops after her, trying to capture and/or defeat her, but no one was able to successfully catch her.''"Many nations tried but almost no one could follow Minerva-tan when she started to run. She has physical power of shaking ground with her punch."'' AskFM Q&A. Furthermore, for reasons unknown, she seems to share some history with [[Emilia]] based on her interaction with her, though it is unclear what the connection is. At some point in the past, Minerva and [[Daphne]] found themselves in the same location, where they found themselves in an infinite loop of eating and healing, angering each other. However, the context for why this is is unclear.''"It did happen, and they were angry."'' AskFM Q&A. It is claimed that over 400 years ago, someone used a larger group of elves as collateral damage in order to trap Minerva. The elves were sent as a suicide squad, and in order to save them, Minerva ran to their rescue and fell under the influence of said trap, where she eventually went mad and subsequently died by the hands of the Witch of Envy.''"The elves were collateral damage in an effort to make Minerva-tan fall into a trap. The elves were sent as a suicide squad, and in order to save them, Minerva-tan ran, fell into the evil clutches of the powers that be, Witch Time."'' AskFM Q&A. Echidna later located and collected her soul, allowing Minerva to manifest in Echidna's Castle of Dreams, alongside the other Witches of Sin that had perished 400 years ago. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== In terms of sheer power, Minerva is one of the weakest characters in the series. Due to how her Authority works, she is incapable of directly dealing damage. However, despite this, Minerva is still one of the most dangerous characters introduced due to her Authority's side effect, which has given her the highest kill count among the characters introduced in the series. ===[[Authority]]=== [[File:Minerva's Authority of Wrath.gif|thumb|229x229px|Minerva healing Subaru's shattered body with her Authority of Wrath.]] '''[[Authority#Authority of Wrath|Authority of Wrath]]''' (憤怒の権能, ''Fundo no Ken'nō''): As the Witch of Wrath, Minerva was a user of the Authority of Wrath and was a compatible holder of its corresponding Witch Factor.''This phenomenon had a precedent; for instance, having once been compatible with Witch Factors and possessed Authorities, the Witches of Sin still retained the same powers even after being reduced to souls post-mortem.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 4, Section 9. Her Authority gave her powers related to healing. *'''Healing''': Minerva's Authority of Wrath allowed her to drain [[mana]] directly from the [[Od Lagna|soul of the world]] to forcibly rewrite cause-and-effect, and by then attacking her desired target, she could heal any living creature. She could also use weapons, whether it is a melee weapon like a knife or a projectile like arrows and bullets, to administer her striking aid; so long as it was an attack made by Minerva, it would heal.''"If it’s an attack launched by Minerva-tan’s body, it’s impossible. You’d recover even if she shot you with a gun, and a bow and arrow or thrown weapon would be the same. However, something like falling into a pit that she dug and dying would be possible. She wouldn’t dig one, though."'' AskFM Q&A. Although she was never able to demonstrate it, Minerva's Authority was capable of overcoming the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Death God|Divine Protection of the Death God]] used by [[Theresia van Astrea]].''"It’s Minerva-tan’s victory."'' AskFM Q&A. and it could even undo the damage done by [[Typhon]]'s Authority of Pride. Despite this, her Authority worked automatically,''"It’s automatic."'' AskFM Q&A. meaning she would heal everything even if it wasn't her intention to. The properties of her power meant she couldn't even kill an insect by stepping on it, meaning she literally couldn't hurt a fly.''"Just like it says, she can’t even hurt a fly. It’s at the level where a bug she stepped on would say “Thank you very much!”."'' AskFM Q&A. Naturally, this meant that she could not actively kill anyone or anything with her own two hands unless she went out of her way to set up something akin to a pitfall trap, which is technically not an attack by her.''"It wouldn’t work, and I don’t think Minerva-tan would be trying to heal them."'' AskFM Q&A.''"It’s impossible. Personality and disposition are outside Minerva’s juristiction."'' AskFM Q&A. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Enhanced Strength''': Although incapable of dealing any damage, Minerva still contained enough physical power that her punches could cause the ground beneath her to tremble. '''Enhanced Speed''': Minerva's increased physical strength allows her to run at great speeds. Although many nations attempted to chase catch her, once she started running, none of them could keep up with her. ==Trivia== *Like the other Witches (with the exception of Satella), Minerva's namesake matches both an asteroid and a mythological being. [[Wikipedia:93 Minerva|93 Minerva]] is the name of a large asteroid located in the solar system's asteroid belt. The mythological [[Wikipedia:Minerva|Minerva]] was a Roman goddess of wisdom, justice, law, and multiple other areas. *Minerva's birthday was decided as July 20 because the author believes the date gives off a feisty vibe, which was befitting of her as the feistiest character in the series. *Excluding Satella, Minerva was the most dangerous Witch due to the side effects of her Authority. She was often hunted because of the sheer level of damage she was indirectly responsible for, but ultimately always managed to escape unscathed.  *She was physically unable to harm anyone directly, even if she wanted to. According to the author, if she was to unknowingly step on an ant, she'd heal the creature rather than squash it. *Whilst Echidna initially states that she and the other five Witches of Sin were killed by the Witch of Envy, it is later revealed that only Minerva was killed by Satella while the rest have perished in very different ways, all across the land of Re:Zero. *Minerva was the Witch that both saved and killed the most people in the world from among the Witches of Sin. *Echidna, Sehkmet, Typhon, and presumably the other 3 Witches of Sin were Minerva's sisters, in the Vainglory IF. *In the event that Minerva encountered a person who was cursed to continuously obtain injuries, Minerva would abandon them while crying terribly.''"Yes. She’d abandon them while super-crying. Coming up with a situation like that, you’re a real demon."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, the other Witches were desperate not to let Minerva see the [[Great Rabbit]], as they were concerned about whether she would attempt to heal them or not.''"It is the reason why Witches were so desperate not to let Minerva-tan see the Great Rabbit."'' AskFM Q&A. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Witches of Sin]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[pt-br:Minerva]] [[es:Minerva]] [[zh:密涅瓦]] [[de:Minerva]] [[fr:Minerva]] [[it:Minerva]] [[nl:Minerva]] [[pl:Minerva]] [[ru:Минерва]] [[uk:Мінерва]]

She plays a major role in [[Arc 5]]. ==Appearance== Liliana is a petite, brown skinned woman with bright yellow hair tied in two tails and big round eyes of the same color. She is mentioned to have lively features and wears revealing clothes, an orange cape, and decorates her hair and body with ornaments that use nuts and animal bones. ==Personality== Contrary to how she is when she performs, Liliana is shown to be an eccentric person that's constantly excited and her words and actions are mentioned to deviate from the norm. She is interested in famous people, possibly due to her work, and tends to follow new trends. Liliana mentioned herself to be lightheaded and not being made for the mental work. However, she still believes that once she's singing, everyone should be enthusiastic about her and put all their focus on Liliana. She has a habit of saying “Please listen” before singing, and if she is about to sing a song she has come up with on the spot, she exclaims “Inspiration has flashed”. ==History== Liliana was born in a family of poets. She and her parents were extremely poor, and her parents barely cared about her. She always dreamed of becoming a traveling bard with freedom and independence. At the age of thirteen, she decided to run away from home. Her parents barely cared about her leaving, with her father stating that it would result into them having more food, and her mother saying that they could get another kid. But in reality, Liliana saw it as the final gift her parents gave her to support her and sever her connection with them, allowing her to pursue her independence. As she ran away, she could barely get by, and she ended up falling sick after eating bad food. Eventually, she found her talent as a bard with the assistance of her Divine Protection, and she started performing for the public, becoming known as the Songstress. At some point after this, Kiritaka Muse noticed her and became an avid fan of hers. ===[[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 1|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]]=== Between [[Arc 2]] and [[Arc 3]], she visited [[Roswaal Manor]] and played for the [[Emilia Camp]]. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護 ''Kago''): Liliana has the '''Divine Protection of Telepathy''' (伝心の加護 ''Denshin no Kago''), which enables her to tell other people her thoughts telepathically. While it's normally used to tell close friends certain thoughts, she can combine it with her singing to increase the strength and effect range. *'''Bard Domain''' (歌人領域): [[File:Liliana - Bard Domain.gif|thumb|250px|Liliana using her '''Bard Domain''' to nullify the effect of Sirius's Authority on the citizens of Priestella.]] According to Liliana in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], the Bard Domain is a place where people's consciousness resides once they are caught within Liliana's singing effect. She used it during the battle against Sirius, to save everyone who was caught by her [[Sirius Romanée-Conti#Abilities|Soulwashing]]. However, it's also stated that it is impossible to enter the Bard Domain if she has too many worries or is not concentrating, yet it appeared to be powerful enough to cleanse the Authority of Wrath's effects. The explanation of the Bard Domain was removed in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 19|Volume 19]], but its effects are still performed when Liliana uses her Divine Protection of Telepathy to take advantage of Sirius's Authority. '''Equipment''': Liliana performs using a musical instrument known as a lyulyre, which is a cross between a guitar and a ukulele in appearance. ==Trivia== *Liliana is the first and only character so far that has narrated a part of the main story for an extended period of time, narrating in a total of five web novel chapters and two Light Novel chapters. Alongside [[Felt]] and [[Alec Hoshin]]'s narrations in side content, she is one of only three characters who have narrated their own perspectives. *Liliana has her own named chapter in Arc 5 in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 19|light novels]], as well as a named [[Episode 61|episode]] in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (anime)|anime]]. *She is scheduled to make another appearance in the main story, though she likely won't be as active as she was in Arc 5. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Priestella]] [[Category:Bards]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]]

wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Libre Fermi |Image = Libre Fermi LN character design.png |Kanji = リブレ・フエルミ |Romaji = Ribure Ferumi |Alias = Poison Snake (毒蛇 ''Dokuhebi'')
Demi-Human Hero (亜人族の英雄 ''Ajin-zoku no Eiyū'') |Race = Snake Human |Gender = Male |Hair Color = Green |Eye Color = Yellow |Previous Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]
Demi-Human Alliance |Previous Occupation = Leader of the Demi-Human Alliance |Status = Deceased |Weapon = Twin Blades |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Ex Volume 2]] |Manga = [[Manga Love Song Chapter 4|Love Song Chapter 4]]}} '''Libre Fermi''' (リブレ・フエルミ) was one of the three leaders of the Demi-Human Alliance during the [[Demi-Human War]]. He was an influential warrior who was renowned for his prowess in battle and had a reputation as a hero among [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]]. He played an antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]. In the midst of the war, Libre was betrayed and killed by [[Sphinx]], the backbone of the Alliance, became a [[Undead#Corpse Soldiers|corpse soldier]], and was used as a puppet in death until he was defeated by [[Bordeaux Zergev]]. ==Appearance== Libre was a snake human and had a long body with green scales and yellow eyes. He wore a Jiangshi hat, had a black and purple uniform with red ribbons, and carried a twin-bladed weapon with him in combat. ==Personality== As the moral heart and center of the Demi-Human Alliance, Libre was one of its most influential leaders. Compared to [[Rom|Valga]] and Sphinx, Libre sought to use war as a way to force humans to the negotiating table, and not for the destruction of humans or making use of them in experiments. Compared to the extremes of Valga and Sphinx, Libre sought the middle ground of compromise. During his time with the pair, Libre realized that if the Alliance lost the war, it would be because Valga could not quell his rage.''“He was shomething like a friend to me, one I knew for a long time. This is what Libre told me. ‘If Valga doesn’t cool his foolish head down, the Alliance will meet its end when all of us are dead’.”'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 2]], Section 3. Libre was an honorable man who detested unnecessary violence or the desecration of dead humans and demi-humans alike. Among the three leaders in the Demi-Human Alliance, Libre was the one who wanted to reconcile with [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]] the most. However, he believed that he needed to embody the anger of demi-humans, so he went against his wishes and chose to fight. He also enjoyed fighting strong opponents and held commend for warriors that could make him bleed and weep. With his high appreciation for warriors, he recognized [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]]' strong vitality, sought to give him a painless death, and promised to put a flower on the Sword Demon's grave out of respect for the boy's abilities. In addition, he chose to behave femininely, speaking in a feminine style and being willing to take on the role of something like a mother figure for other people. ==History== While Libre's early history is unknown, he saved Valga Cromwell from slavery in the past.''“He was born to the giant species, who are on the verge of extinction. He was born and raised as the slave of a detestable noble, but he was saved from that environment by a demi-human called Libre, and since then he fostered a hatred of humans… Oops, maybe this wasn’t Old Man Rom's story.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/965958052850495488 February 20, 2018 Twitter Q&A] He became Valga's friend, teacher, and mother figure before the Demi-Human War.''“The one called Libre was the benefactor who was his mother, teacher, and friend. Well, he was a man, though.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/965974770423492609 February 21, 2018 Twitter Q&A] ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== As one of the leaders of the Demi-Human Alliance, Libre fought side by side with Valga under a shared purpose of advancing the rights of demi-humans, despite their different goals. The situation between the two changed when Valga found and brought Sphinx into their ranks. As the Witch's methods started to become increasingly questionable, Libre began to grow estranged from Valga over the his support for her. Although Libre continued to argue with Valga and was threatened with death by Sphinx, he continued to work alongside them, as they were indispensable to the Alliance's success. Before dying, Libre entrusted his copy of a glintstone that was necessary for entering Sphinx's Testing Grounds to [[Cragrell Dawson]], the third leader of the Demi-Human Alliance. At the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], Libre ambushed the Zergev Squadron and engaged in combat with them. One by one, the squadron's members fell to him, including [[Pivot Arnancy]], who died and became a corpse soldier, and [[Grimm Fauzen]], who sustained a permanent throat injury to his throat that left him unable to speak. After an intense fight, Libre finally claimed the upper hand against Wilhelm Trias. Before he could deliver a killing blow to Wilhelm, Sphinx arrived to shower Libre with multiple incantations of Jiwald, much to his rage and disappointment at the betrayal. He was murdered by another barrage of Jiwald spells, and she turned him into a corpse soldier to cover her escape. Following the conflict at Aihiya Swamp, Libre's corpse was used as Sphinx's puppet in the [[Invasion of the Royal Castle]], where he fought against the remainder of the Zergev Squadron once more. He battled Bordeaux Zergev until he suffered a severe amount of damage and the remainders of his soul would "return" due to the Sacrament of the Immortal King's effects. In his corpse's last act, Libre turned on Sphinx, cleaved off her arm, and promptly turned into ash. ==Abilities== '''Double-Blade Fighting-Style''': Wielding a fierce and tricky combat-style with his double-blade sword, Libre was a terrible and overwhelming foe on the battlefield. He possessed enough skill that he was capable of defeating even Wilhelm, marking him as one of Sword Demon's greatest challenges in the Demi-Human War. '''Innate Traits''': As a snake human, Libre has access to traits unique traits that are sometimes seen in snakes. *'''Poison''': His lineage allows him to poison his targets with a natural toxin. *'''Regeneration''': Libre is capable of regenerating any wounds his body receives. Though the regeneration is not instant, it is strong, allowing him to regenerate entire limbs that have been lost. This being said, his regeneration is not all-powerful. He cannot recover excessive or instantly lethal damage. When a hole was blasted into his chest by Sphinx, though he was able to survive for a short period of time, his regeneration would have been incapable of saving him after having just had a fierce bout with a warrior of a young Wilhelm's strength and receiving numerous wounds, and when Sphinx shot him in the head, it killed him instantly. '''Equipment''': Libre wielded a sword with both blades at both ends of the hilt. He was extremely proficient with it and was even able to overpower young Wilhelm. He would have easily killed him if it wasn't for Sphinx's interference. ==Trivia== *Libre means “free” in both Spanish and French. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Teachers]] [[Category:Demi-Human Alliance]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Corpse Soldiers]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30|Volume 30]] (flashback) |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Miles''' (マイルズ) was a Private First-Class from the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]'s [[Imperial Army]] and a flying dragon rider who served [[Serena Dracroy]]. Though he did not appear in the main story, Miles played a minor supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]] and antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. During [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]], Miles's death at the hands of [[Reinhard van Astrea]] was the driving force for [[Balleroy Temeglyph]]'s thirst for revenge on him. ==Appearance== Miles had a wrinkled, unattractive rat-like face, grey hair, and jade-colored eyes. He wore the standard uniform for a member of the [[Imperial Army]]. While he was disguised as a merchant, he wore a white cloak. ==Personality== Miles was an unscrupulous and vile man, who delighted in tormenting those he viewed as better than him. However, he had friendly relationships with those that he cared about, such as Balleroy Temegylph. ==History== In the past, Miles, who was a subordinate of Serena Dracroy, visited an orphanage in Averyk, where he tied up the head of the orphanage and provided the children a chance to get payback on them by beating and kicking them. Two of the children that he met here were [[Flop O'Connell|Flop]] and [[Medium O'Connell]], who he ended up bringing back with him to the Dracroy Domain, and he became practically family to them and Balleroy. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Some 7 years before the main story, Serena sent both Miles and Balleroy, who also served Serena, to the Pendleton Estate in order to invite [[Jorah Pendleton]] and his wife [[Priscilla Barielle|Priscilla Pendleton]] to the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. While they were there, the gladiators attempted to spark a [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|revolution]] that would render the island independent from the mainland, which later ended up failing thanks to the intervention of the Imperial Army. Serena, Priscilla, Jorah, Balleroy, and Miles then went back to the Pendleton mansion after this incident. Later, he and Balleroy were sent to find Priscilla after Priscilla managed to escape execution, and after finding her, they and Serena helped smuggle her into Lugunica. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== At some point, Miles was tasked with acquiring information on the Sacrament of the Immortal King,''“All that work, and my only reward is a copy of his spell book… Blasted! These are my just desserts? What am I even going to tell the General back in Vollachia, returning like this…?”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Felix Argyle's Curse, Section 14. an ancient forbidden art that could potentially be used to revive the dead. To complete his mission, Miles posed as a merchant selling corpses to the head of House Argyle, [[Biehn Argyle|Biehn]], who possessed a monopolization on information pertaining to the practice of the spell that Miles sought. Biehn sought to use the Sacrament of the Immortal King to revive his late wife, who he had killed in a fit of rage two years prior. Miles agreed to procure corpses for Biehn while secretly taking note of aspects of the spell. Ultimately, this plan was foiled when [[Crusch Karsten|Crusch]] caught them in the act, forcing Miles and Biehn to kidnap her in the mansion's basement. Upon finding out about Crusch's kidnapping, the [[Fourier Lugunica|Royal Prince]] himself organized a [[Raid of Argyle Manor|raid]] on the Argyle mansion, led by himself, [[Ferris]], and [[Julius Juukulius]]. The attack would later result in the deaths of Biehn Argyle and [[Hannah Regret]]. After Crusch killed his [[undead]] bodyguards and nearly took his life at the same time, Miles, who had personally faced the Duchess, was gravely wounded. He managed to fake his death and flee through a secret passageway to where his Flying Dragon was hidden. Lamenting the fact he was returning empty-handed, grabbing a book of information compiled on the Sacrament of the Immortal King, Miles made his way back to the nearby border with the Vollachia Empire, hoping to turn over what little information he had acquired to his superior, a General. However, this did not last long, as he soon found Reinhard van Astrea standing behind him, on his flying dragon. When Miles refused to surrender and managed to throw the Sword Saint off, the knight took out both him and his dragon on the spot. ==Abilities== '''Flying Dragon Rider''': Miles was able to tame dragons and was skilled at it. He also taught Balleroy Temeglyph how to tame flying dragons.''All of it to repay the one who had taught him how to live, who had helped him forge his connection with his dragon.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 17. His dragon was named [[Minor Characters#Gaius|Gaius]]. ==Trivia== *Miles's design in Ex Volume 5 is incorrectly drawn with blue eyes. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]
