[[Emilia Camp]] |Previous Affiliation = [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]] |Occupation = [[Witchbeast]] User |Previous Occupation = Assassin |Status = Alive |Divine Protection = [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]] |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 3|Volume 3]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 2 Chapter 14|Arc 2 Chapter 14]] |Relatives = [[Elsa Granhiert]] (older sister figure) † |Anime = [[Episode 5]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Eri Suzuki|Suzuki Eri]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Erika Harlacher|Erika Harlacher]]}} '''Meili Portroute''' (メィリィ・ポートルート) is a [[witchbeast]] tamer and a former "child" of [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]]. She was first introduced in [[Arc 2]] as the hidden main antagonist and one of the two secondary antagonists of [[Arc 4]] alongside [[Elsa Granhiert]]. After the events of Arc 4, she was imprisoned, but she later joined the [[Emilia Camp]], serving as a major role in [[Arc 6]] and a supporting role in [[Arc 9]] and [[Arc 10]]. Having been raised by witchbeasts after her seeming abandonment, she was taken in by Elsa, who practically raised her like a sister, and she became an assassin working for Mother. However, this occupation came to an end after her capture at [[Roswaal Manor]], and, following the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], she has earned her pardon and works with the Emilia Camp in earnest. ==Appearance== Meili has refined yellow-green eyes that give off an air of mysticism and an equaled well-formed nose. Her long dark-blue hair is kept out of her face and tied into a triple-braid that flows down to her hips. A pink flower ornament with white outlining, which Elsa used to wear prior to meeting her, is framed to the left side of her head. During her undercover stay in the village, Meili's braid traipsed over her left shoulder so that it rested over her chest and her hair wasn't decorated with an ornament. She looks the same age as [[Petra Leyte]]. When not concealing her true nature, she gave off the foreboding impression of someone who would grow up to be a true demon. The outfit Meili commonly wears is befitting of a girl with her moral character. Her ensemble consists of a long-sleeved black one-piece dress with a frilly white hem and white cone-shaped cuffs, brown tights with vertical-facing lighter brown stripes, a white cravat, and a pair of black boots that have cuffs with purple feathery trimming along their edge. Her dress has a black collar and reaches past her hips. Like Elsa, she wears a long purple-brown cloak that reached down to her ankles and had purple trimmings, although unlike Elsa's cloak, Meili's has a golden pendant serving as a strap and no hood. When she was undercover as a villager, Meili wore a short blue long-sleeved one-piece dress with a flap collar similar to a sailor's. On her feet she wore a pair of brown sandals, and apart from these and the dress, Meili wore no further clothing as a villager. Later, she replaces her hairpin with a small bow near the bottom of her braid. For a short time in Arc 6, she wore a cloak to protect herself from the sands of the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], and while she was being held in a room beneath Roswaal Manor, she wore a gray dress and socks with horizontal purple stripes on them. ==Personality== When she was first introduced, Meili acted like she was shy and meek. She was not usually the center of attention, and she acted overly polite and timid, stuttering as she spoke. However, as this was part of her acting skills in play, this was not her true personality. Despite her young age, Meili is a mature girl who became privy to the ugly side of humanity at an early age. Meili failed to display any semblance of the childish innocence usually exhibited by kids her age. She was perfectly willing to kill people, regardless of whether they were innocent or children like herself. She also had a penchant for deception, such as when she mimicked the behavior of a regular child. According to [[Natsuki Subaru]], she had grown up without having learned the difference between right and wrong. Meili has shown to find witchbeasts to be cute and is very fond of them. If possible, she likes to avoid letting them die when she can, and she will prevent her allies from killing them in her presence unless absolutely necessary. At one point, she had become close with a pet [[Witchbeast#Guiltylowe|Guiltylowe]], and later, she had become attached to [[Shaula]], referring to her with "naked onee-san" and was typically seen hanging over her shoulder. She also has great instincts when it comes to a person's strength or their level of danger; when faced with the Council of Wise Men, particularly [[Miklotov McMahon]], she could sense something strange from his gaze, and after meeting [[Reinhard van Astrea]], whose strength was terrifying to her, she started to panic, barely containing her feeling to attack and attempt to flee from the scene. She also finds it annoying when people around her provide her unnecessary assistance or treat her like a child, such as when Elsa did both after the [[Wolgarm Incident|events]] of Arc 2. Despite this side of her, she still at times acts like the young girl that she is, finding the sewn-together dolls that Subaru made for cute and playing with them while she lived in Roswaal Manor. She also has a habit of stretching out the end of her sentences. She has shown herself to be rather friendly and familiar toward others, even toward her targets. At some point after her birth, when she was seemingly abandoned, she was a feral child who was unable to talk. She was raised by witchbeasts, protected by them, and taught how to survive through them. Because of this, when Elsa first appeared in front of her and killed all of her witchbeasts, she was very hostile and animalistic, even biting at her despite knowing that she would not be able to win against her. However, after Elsa began taking care of her as an older sister figure, she relearned how to speak, the basics of life, how to act, kill and take care of wounds. Elsa had ultimately become the latter's purpose to live, despite sometimes being at odds. She is also shown to be quite terrified of the superior, Mother, having once been turned into frogs by her, and this fear was part of the reason that after she was later defeated, she allowed herself to become the Emilia Camp's prisoner. Following the [[Sanctuary Incident|events]] of Arc 4 and Elsa's death, though she at first cried for her death, Meili was confused about how she should act because of it, as Elsa was the closest thing she could call family despite not quite being family either. Because of this, despite getting along well with the members of the Emilia Camp, when she was given a chance during the events of Arc 6, she attempted to take vengeance on Subaru for Elsa's death in an attempt to quell the emotions that were roiling within her. However, after being stopped and being offered a hand by both Subaru and Emilia, she took them in order to learn from them almost like a daughter figure. Following these events, she seemed to show regret for her actions, and she was willing to speak with people as powerful as the Council of Wise Men and help the next [[Pleiades Watchtower]] expedition team in order to pardon herself so that she wouldn't provide any problems for the Emilia Camp. In particular, she had become somewhat attached to Petra and tended to worry for her, and she often listened to Petra's complaints about the other members of the camp. However, the biggest display of attachment she has displayed toward the other camp members was her willingness to give up her [[Divine Protection]] in order to compensate for the use of [[Clind]]'s [[Authority]] in order to gather everyone to save Subaru, though Petra ultimately stopped her from doing this. At the same time, she also worries whether her being forgiven is too good to be true, as if everything was leading to some form of great retribution for her.''"To be honest, sometimes I think it’s too good to be tru~e… The things I’ve done being overlooked, being forgiven by the Kingdom just because of my Divine Protection… even now, I can’t help but wonder if I’m not due for some terrible retribution before lo~ng."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 10, Section 2. At the same time, because she looks up to the other members of the camp, wants to use them as examples to follow, and wants to live up to them,That, was honestly amazing. I can’t help but admire them. I could never do something like that. Without any example to follow, how could they possibly be capable of that? So, I’ll use them as my examples to follow, and do what must be done. ――Though, they’re sure to get angry with me. Do, what must be done. Because I want to live up to them, following their example, they who are always living every moment of their lives with everything they’ve got――. [[Arc 10]], Chapter 18, Section 6. she is fully willing to throw away her chance at remaining redeemed and cared for little of what happened to other people so long as she could be of help to the people of the camp,''Reinhard had to go, or there would be casualties. ――Meili’s heart would not particularly ache if that were to happen. As long as the ones present here, as well as Subaru, Beatrice, and Emilia, all met no harm, it would be fine. Other than the people who treasured her, the people whom she wished to treasure, then regardless of whoever else died, it would be fine.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 18, Section 6. even if she would shed tears for doing so. ==History== ===Early Life=== Meili was born with a powerful Divine Protection that allowed her to manipulate the behavior of man-eating predators known as witchbeasts. She was seemingly abandoned by her parents and subsequently grew in the wilderness surrounded by witchbeasts that protected her. As a result, Meili was a feral child incapable of basic speech and etiquette. One day, an assassin known as the Bowel Hunter appeared before the feral girl and killed the beasts that protected her. Noticing that the name "Meili" had been sewn into the rags the feral girl was wearing, Elsa decided to call the girl Meili despite being unsure if it was her real name,''“It seems like that’s your name? It was hard to make out, but it was sewn into that rag of yours… perhaps it belonged to someone else, but it’s inconvenient not having a name to call you by.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 24]], Chapter 2, Section 2. abducting the girl and taking her in. Meili was taught many things by Elsa, including how to talk and behave properly. She quickly began utilizing witchbeasts and deceptive youth to execute her targets. She was frequently paired up with Elsa on missions, whom she considered an older sister of sorts. Meili, like other "children", feared their leader known simply as "Mother". On one occasion, Mother turned Meili into a pile of frogs as an example of her power. She was particularly fond of a Guiltylowe that she considered a pet. ===[[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 2|Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain]]=== A short while before the [[Loot House Incident|events]] of [[Arc 1]], she and Elsa were involved in the conflict between [[Viktor Orcos]] and [[Igor Kenash]], in which Meili set a Guiltylowe on Igor and killed him. Soon after, she followed Elsa into the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]. ===[[Elsa and Meili, Assassin Sisters' Dark Diary]]=== Following Elsa's defeat and near death by the hands of Reinhard van Astrea, she escaped so that her wounds could mend themselves. After being picked up by Meili, who was shocked to hear that she was defeated and that her wounds weren't regenerating like they were supposed to, Meili patched up her wounds, and they decided to leave the [[Royal Capital]] in order to escape the people searching for her, leading to Elsa, buck naked, deciding to procure clothes from someone. After causing bloodshed to obtain these clothes, she and Meili used a witchbeast to change their hair colors, and with the help of a guard who didn't recognize them pointing them in the direction of the highway, they left the capital behind. However, Meili had received an objective from Mother, who had told her to stir mayhem in the area around Roswaal Manor, much to Elsa's chagrin. While the two split up, Elsa decided to knit a doll of Reinhard for Meili. Later, as Meili took on her task, Elsa watched from afar the chaos, and as Roswaal lit the forest ablaze to kill all of the [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarms]], Elsa made her way to assist Meili, delighted that their roles were reversed from the incident in the capital. As they ran, Elsa gave Meili the doll of Reinhard, and shortly after, she carried Meili on her back, despite the girl's reluctance and frustration, and ran beyond the mountains. Soon enough, they found themselves surrounded by witchbeasts, which Meili decided to speak with and have them regroup with other witchbeasts to rebuild her numbers. Later on, after the events leading to Roswaal Manor burning down, she was escorted by [[Garfiel Tinzel]] to see the remains of the mansion and possibly Elsa. There, she reminisced over one of their conversations about whether Elsa could die, and with Garfiel looking the other way, Meili cried over Elsa's death. ===[[Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook III]]=== In the Augria Sand Dunes outside the Pleiades Watchtower, shortly after withstanding sniper fire and Subaru's act of using [[magic]]-negation magic, everyone had been separated. [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]], a distance away from the carriage, managed to find it, and [[Emilia]], standing in front of it, said that [[Beatrice]], Meili, and [[Rem]] were all still safe. However, Subaru, [[Ram]], "[[Eridna|Anastasia]]", and [[Patrasche]] had all gone missing. Beatrice noted that Subaru seemed to have gone farther away while Meili mentioned that witchbeasts were on their way. After realizing that the distortion of space like sent the other farther away from everyone, something landed on their [[dragon]] carriage and knocked it over. Julius, who had seen the woman responsible, heard her as she muttered her frustration and realized she had jumped from atop the watchtower. As she was about to leave, Emilia grabbed her leg, causing her to fall and nearly attack her, but when she asked if she knew anything about the friends who had been blown away, the woman lowered her hand and began walking away toward the tower, allowing the others to follow her and muttering "Coming soon". Once everyone gathered together, they chased after her. ===[[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose! In Fact!]]=== The next day, after observing the first trial of the tower, Emilia and Beatrice returned downstairs, where Meili teased them and claimed that they were probably on edge because Subaru hadn't woken up yet. After thinking about her irritation towards Shaula for not answering their question, Beatrice and Emilia decided to check on Subaru and Ram while Meili went to the trial room to see if she could solve it, leaving Beatrice to chide Emilia's carelessness after she claimed that there were no harmful traps within the room. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record|Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record]]=== Following the successful Pleiades Watchtower Expedition, Meili was tasked with reporting to the Council of Wise Men about the tower being conquered, and she was handed a talon that belonged to [[Volcanica]] itself. Along with [[Annerose Miload]], she met the old men and reported this. Soon after, [[Felt]] and her knight arrived and took part in the meeting. Though Meili felt instinctive fear towards Reinhard, who shortly after pointed out the hiding Crimson Scorpion hiding on her person, Felt came to her aid and started talking smack about her knight. Afterward, Meili revealed that she was an assassin, as even if she was a part of the Emilia Camp, her origin would come out eventually, and she could use it as a bargaining chip to assist the next expedition unit to go to the Pleiades Watchtower. Being given a chance to wipe her slate clean, she was tasked to assist the [[Felt Camp]] in making it past the Augria Sand Dunes with her Divine Protection. In the dunes, the group was assaulted by Volcanica, who was tasked with defending the tower. Fortunately, thanks to the talon, Meili was able to prevent any further attacks, and they successfully reached the tower. She showed them the Taygeta Library, and she told them about the Books of the Dead, which prompted Felt to convince Reinhard to find his [[Theresia van Astrea|grandmother]]’s book. Afterward, the group noticed the birds floating around, which Meili had noted were there even during their own stay at the tower. After the crimson scorpion killed the one that they’d caught, Reinhard and [[Ezzo Cadner]] set about slaying the rest, as the birds were being used to spy. Afterward, the group returned to the capital, leaving Ezzo and [[Flam Remendis]] behind, and with the success of the expedition, Meili was pardoned for her crimes. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== While Meili's actual physical abilities make her incredibly weak, she more than makes up for this with her assassination skills and Divine Protection. Her strength comes in the form of her being a '''Witchbeast User''', which allows her to summon and command strong beasts as a veritable army. ===[[Divine Protection]]=== Meili - Demon Beasts Control.gif|Meili controlling a variety of witchbeasts. Meili - Demon Beasts Controls .gif|Meili orders witchbeasts to kill Garfiel, but Frederica kills them. Meili - Demon Beast Control 2 .gif|Meili directing a Sand Earthworm to devour a group of Courtesan Bears. '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]]''' (魔操の加護 ''Masou no Kago''): Meili's Divine Protection allows her to control witchbeasts. Reinhard van Astrea notes that Meili's Divine Protection can only be possessed by one person at a time, with him being unable to use it himself because of this. With the Divine Protection acting in place of the witchbeasts' horns, Meili can control their actions, effectively making them her puppets. As seen with the Guiltylowe, witchbeasts can still retain their reason and will. She can control numerous species of witchbeasts, including powerful ones. There are limits to her power, however. Some witchbeasts, such as Courtesan Bears, are incompatible with her Divine Protection, making them much harder to control. Likewise, exceedingly powerful witchbeasts like the [[Black Serpent]] and the [[White Whale]] are completely immune to her control, although it is possible to influence them and make their movements sluggish. She is able to control at least a hundred witchbeasts, but her control has limits, and some will not listen to her if she tries to control too many.''“…That’s difficu~lt. If it’s ten, twenty, or even if it’s hundred, I ca~n, but a number more than that and there’ll be some children to whom my instructions won’t rea~ch.”'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 10, Section 1. Overusing her Divine Protection, such as using it to halt the movements of the Black Serpent, causes her great pain, as if her blood and soul were on fire. ===Other=== '''Assassin Skills''': To complement her role as an assassin, Meili uses her acting skills to pretend to be a normal child while using that disguise to determine a target, as well as some extent of stealth mastery to erase the sound of her footsteps, though she is not as skilled as Elsa in the latter quality. However, despite this, she has not learned any physical combat skills. '''Aura''': Meili apparently emits a miasma-like aura, which is the reason why the Emilia Camp chose to imprison her underneath Roswaal Manor for a year.''She had an honest smile, but something came from that girl that was so dreadful and disgusting that it couldn’t be hidden. That was the biggest reason Meili was confined here without being released.'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 3, Section 2. It is unknown whether this is because of her Divine Protection or not. ===Equipment=== *'''Fragment of the Divine Dragon’s Talon''': After Emilia became the administrator of the Pleiades Watchtower, she was given a piece of Volcanica’s Talon to use to prevent said dragon from attacking her and her party should she return to the tower. She passed it along to Meili so that she could take the second expedition party to the tower. ==Trivia== *She carries around a Reinhard doll Elsa made for her. *She had a pet Guiltylowe. This same witchbeast saved Subaru from Reinhard in the Ayamatsu IF story. *[[Wikipedia:Erika Harlacher|Erika Harlacher]], Meili's English voice actress, also voices [[Crusch Karsten]] in addition to Ram and Rem's mother, [[Temae]]. *It is implied that she may have a past connection to [[Dynas Trussardi]].''"We know about your hard work, Dynas. It wasn't your fault you couldn't protect Milian and Meili."'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 68, Section 1. *Meili has her own named chapter in Arc 6 in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 6: The Corridor of Memories|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 23|light novels]]. *In the web novel, Meili originally had brown hair,''"She had braided, brown hair, and simple, yet lovely facial features."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 3, Section 1. until it was changed to dark blue in the middle of Arc 6.''"The little girl who had spoken out and lifted her tiny hand up had dark blue braided hair—Meili. She slowly shook her head, still perched on Shaula's shoulders (who had crumpled down to her knees fainted)."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 27, Section 2. *According to the author, Meili learned how to cook since Elsa did not. *According to the author, Meili may receive a second named chapter in Arc 10 as a result of her original named chapter not receiving a reciprocal named episode in [[Season 4]] of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (anime)|anime]].July 26, 2026 Talk Show *According to the author, it is a good thing that Meili is no longer working for Capella in Arc 10 due to her Divine Protection's massive destructive potential. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Beloved Children Navbox}} [[Category:Emilia Camp]] [[Category:Assassins]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[Category:Arc 2 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 4 Antagonists]] [[de:Meili Portroute]] [[es:Meili Portroute]] [[fr:Meili Portroute]] [[nl:Meili Portroute]] [[pl:Meili Portroute]] [[pt-br:Meili Portroute]] [[ru:Мейли Портрут]] [[zh:角色:梅莉·波多尔德]]

[[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 13|Tanpenshuu Volume 13]] (actual) |Anime = [[Episode 64]] (flashback)}} '''Louanna Astrea''' (ルアンナ・アストレア) is [[Heinkel Astrea]]'s wife and [[Reinhard van Astrea]]'s mother. Though not appearing in the main story, she was brought up in [[Arc 5]] and plays a vital role in both Heinkel and Reinhard's character arcs. She is afflicted with the Sleeping Beauty condition, putting her in a state of suspended animation. Desperate to cure his wife, Heinkel joined the [[Priscilla Camp]] in hopes of acquiring the Dragon's Blood. ==Appearance== Louanna is an inhumanly beautiful woman with long blonde hair and blue eyes. ==Personality== Louanna was a kind and easygoing woman. While she was awake, she wholly believed that Heinkel would succeed [[Theresia van Astrea|Theresia]] as the Sword Saint. ==History== ===[[Once Upon a Time in Astrea]]=== Louanna was born into the noble family of House Hartley. However, her parents died in an accident, leaving Louanna to pay off their debts by herself. Eventually, she met Heinkel, and he saved her from a masked man who had been pursuing her for witnessing the scene of an assault by saying that he would marry her. The two eventually got married and Louanna would give birth to Reinhard. When Reinhard was two years old, Louanna was afflicted with Sleeping Beauty, a condition that has similarities to people who are victims of the [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]] but ultimately a separate ailment, and she is still sleeping to this day without any changes to her body. As speculated by [[Felt]] and confirmed by Heinkel, the infant Reinhard was seemingly responsible for her slumber. Sometime later, [[Ferris]] examined her but determined that she did not need to be treated. By the time the Royal Selection begun, she had been in this state for 17 years. ===[[Felt-chan Saw!]]=== During her confinement to the Astrea Manor, [[Felt]] found Louanna's room and Louanna asleep inside. When she got suspicious if Reinhard had kidnapped someone else, Reinhard appeared and said that the woman was his mother, [[Louanna Astrea]], and that due to unknown reasons, she was in the Sleeping Beauty state. When she exited the room, Reinhard asked her not to tell anyone about her and thanked her for her concern. ==Trivia== *Louanna's birthday was a fan birthday decided at a talk show held on March 30, 2024. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Inactive]] [[de:Louanna Astrea]] [[es:Louanna Astrea]] [[pt-br:Louanna Astrea]] [[ru:Луанна Астрея]] [[zh:角色:卢安娜]]

Red (anime) |Birthday = December 10April 5, 2026 Talk Show |Relatives = [[Chap]] (temporary contractor) |Previous Affiliation = [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]
[[Kingdom of Lugunica]] |Previous Occupation = Great Spirit |Status = Deceased |Magic = Fire Magic |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice|Bonds of Ice]] |Anime = [[Re:Zero OVA 2|Bonds of Ice OVA]] |Manga = [[Bonds of Ice Chapter 7]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Tesshō Genda|Genda Tesshō]]}} '''Melakuera''' (メラクェラ) was the '''[[Spirit#The Arbitrator, Melakuera|Arbitrator]]''', a former member of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]. He was a judgmental spirit who viewed [[Emilia]]'s existence as a sin because she possessed the same physical characteristics as the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], leading him to try and exterminate her. Seven years prior to the beginning of the story, he was eliminated by [[Puck]] in a battle that came to be known as the Day of Red Earth and Sky. ==Appearance== Melakuera did not have a true corporeal body, but he had the ability to possess bodies and split his form. In his unadorned form, Melakuera appeared as a red clump of heat and energy. But, when he manifested himself into a familiar form, Melakuera took the form of a winged horse completely covered by crimson flames. All of Melakuera's bodies appeared as fiery horses, even when one of his bodies had possessed [[Chap]]. Melakuera ended up turning him into half a manifestation of a man garbed in flames, and half of a fiery horse. ==Personality == Arbitrator Melakuera cared about nothing more than maintaining peace and order. He cared greatly about the ancient rules he adhered to, as he refused to break them even if they were an inconvenience to him. He neglected to intervene in the sacred contracting between Emilia and Puck despite the problems he likely knew it would cause him. He was willing to go to any lengths in order to protect the world from darkness, even if it meant sacrificing the lives of innocents to do so. Melakuera seemed to only care about inflicting his brand of justice when the world was in danger, as he cared little for minor injustices committed by petty criminals. He was even willing to work with criminals to further his goals, such as when he formed a contract with the bandit Chap. He felt no remorse towards the victims he deemed as necessary losses and would not hesitate to execute those who stood in the way of his warped sense of justice. During his pursuit of the half-elf Emilia, Melakuera mercilessly executed the lesser spirits that came to her defense and released the venom of the [[Black Serpent]], knowing it would wreak havoc upon the entire forest and the innocent people that populated it. The Arbitrator spoke in a very robotic, matter of fact manner, favoring the archaic pronouns '''thou''' (汝 nanji) and '''mineself''' (我 ware). His voice reflects his role as an arbitrator of the world, not wasting any time on connectives or other basic sentence structuring. Despite his long life, Melakuera still suffered from the same blind paranoia that afflicted lesser beings. For instance, he, like the common folk of the world, showed abject fear and revulsion to silver-haired half-elves as he believed they were descendants of the infamous Witch of Envy who destroyed half of the world centuries ago. So firm was his disgust towards silver-haired half-elves that he actively sought them out wherever they appeared and destroyed them under the delusion that he was keeping the world safe from the legacy of the Witch. Even if the half-elf was nothing more than an innocent crying child, Melakuera would show no mercy, such was the case when he tried to kill Emilia. ==History== ===Early Life=== A long time ago in the distant past, a spark from a campfire created an "it" which did not possess any intelligence or self-awareness. Near the campfire "it" was born from, there was a completely average family consisting of a father, a mother, a daughter, and a son. The father of the family passed down the role of managing their campfire on the family's travels, and whenever the boy lit the fire, "it" would appear from the flames. Following the family for decades, the boy eventually became a father, and then a grandfather. However, the man would eventually come to the end of his life, and he would pass away while praying for his family's continued safety. After the man's death, the being which had been following him for his entire life would gain self-awareness for the first time. Remembering how the man called "it" a friend, the being, a lesser spirit, resolved itself to fulfill the final prayer of its friend. Seeing the man's grave, the nameless lesser spirit took the name engraved on it, Melakuera, in order for the man's name to live on until its death. As the sole friend of the man, Melakuera would follow the wishes of its friend by maintaining peace and tranquility, protecting the world from all dangers, and saving all others from suffering. Eventually, Melakuera grew to be one of the four most powerful spirits in the world that were collectively known as the Four Great Spirits. Each of the Four Greats represent one of the four primary elemental attributes. Melakuera, as the bearer of fire, became known as the Arbitrator. ===[[Great Calamity]] Era=== Many years after Melakuera's birth, the Witch of Envy used her terrible power to decimate half of the entire world. Although she was defeated and imprisoned by heroes, Satella's dark deeds ensured that her name was never forgotten. Half-elves, particularly female ones with silver hair and bluish-purple eyes, faced prejudice because the Witch of Envy purportedly fit that description. Many beings, including Melakuera, believed that silver haired half-elves were descendants of the Witch and should therefore be destroyed in case they followed in her footsteps. At some point, Melakuera clashed with another spirit whose might rivalled that of the Four Greats. This beast-like spirit used fire Magic to generate and manipulate ice in stark contrast to Melakuera who summoned actual flames. Their fearsome battle torched an entire city and became well known across the world as an example of what the Four Great Spirits were capable of. The beast-like spirit escaped Melakuera's wrath and later became known as the "Beast of the End" for his capability to rival the Four Greats. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice|Bonds of Ice]]=== Hundreds and hundreds of years later, seven years before the story, Melakuera sent some of his eyes into [[Elior Forest]] to scout the forest in search of Emilia, but they were always defeated by Puck. Eventually, after sensing immense magical power coming from the forest, Melakuera decided to make his appearance there. Puck and Melakuera fought at Elior Forest, ending in Puck's victory. Ironically mirroring the fate of his friend, after Melakuera's death, Emilia felt the need to make a grave with his name on it, despite him leaving no body to bury.''The name of the great spirit of fire was engraved on it, but there was nothing buried there. It was a grave in name only. Making such a thing might not have been any consolation to the great spirit. But for some reason, Emilia felt that she had to do it.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 4, Section 8. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As a great spirit, Melakuera was an incredibly powerful existence within the world. It was so powerful that during its battle with Puck, one of the characters proclaimed as among the strongest of character in the series in the past, not only did the battle destroy part of the terrain it took place in, it took everything Puck had to defeat him, and he still nearly died in the process. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== Melakuera - Great Spirit.gif|Melakuera in full force. Melakuera - Fireballs.gif|Melakuera uses Fireballs against Puck. Melakuera - Wings of Flame.gif|thumb|200px|Melakuera uses his wings of flame against Puck. As the great spirit presiding over fire, Melakuera had a great command over fire magic. Melakuera was able to launch scorching fireballs that reduced everything in their path to ashes, and he was capable of manifesting flaming wings said to be hot enough to burn the soul to launch massive heatwaves that affected a large area, turning everything within the area into scorched remains. ===Physical Traits=== [[File:Melakuera - Cloning.gif|thumb|200px|Melakuera splitting himself against Emilia.]] '''Division''': Melakuera was able to divide his existence into multiple parts. He used this ability to divide himself into seven bodies, each on the level of Puck's normal form, controlling them individually to monitor the world and deter calamity.''The great spirit Melakuera had divided his existence into seven parts, and was controlling each of them individually. Possessing seven bodies, each of which was on par with Puck, he used this overwhelming power to monitor threats to the world, secretly acting as a force to deter any potential causes of calamity.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 4, Section 5. Although the bodies that appeared as separate beings with equal power, the divided Melakeruas were all one being.''All five of these flaming horses were beings equal to the great spirit that had just been defeated―― No, not equal beings. One could believe they were the exact same being.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 4, Section 5. He also used this ability to create small “eyes”. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Melakuera was deceptive and cunning. He deceived others in order to trick the barrier Puck set up over Elior Forest. He also intentionally released the Black Serpent's poison into the forest in order to see if Emilia would use her power. ===Other=== '''Possession''': By forming a contract with someone, Melakuera was able to take control of their body, using it as an anchor.''“You were just used as an anchor, but I don’t really pity you in the slightest.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 4, Section 4. ==Trivia== *Melakuera's birthday was decided at a talk show held on April 5, 2026. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Great Spirits]] [[Category:Four Great Spirits]] [[Category:Contract Spirits]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Relationships |tab3 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Moguro Hagane |Image = Moguro Hagane Without Sample.jpg |Kanji = モグロ・ハガネ |Romaji = Moguro Hagane |Alias = Eighth (捌 ''Hachi'')
Steelman (鋼人 ''Haganehito'') |Race = Meteor |Gender = None |Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]]
[[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] |Previous Occupation = Eighth of the Nine Divine Generals |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|Ex Volume 4]] (side story)
[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32|Volume 32]] (main story)}} '''Moguro Hagane''' (モグロ・ハガネ) is the former '''Eighth ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. They are a living [[meteor]] who governed the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]]'s [[Lupugana#Locations|Crystal Palace]]. They played an antagonistic role in [[Arc 7]] and a lesser supporting role in [[Arc 8]]. They also played a small antagonistic role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]. A meteor built into the Crystal Palace, Moguro acts as a sentient defense system that can only be commanded by the one who sits upon the throne of the Empire, and if necessary, they will act as a veritable army of their own. Because of this, the emperor [[Vincent Vollachia]] decided to make them the Eighth of the Nine Divine Generals. Despite this, following the [[Great Disaster]], the Crystal Palace was destroyed, and Moguro's core was overloaded to the point of exploding. Because of this, their memories were reset to zero. As such, they have been removed from the Nine Divine Generals. ==Appearance== Moguro usually appeared as a large being who is nearly three meters tall. They had a thick body and long limbs that were covered with a hard bronze substance, which was of an inorganic mineral. Their head was a large bronze helmet with green glass in the center and green vertical highlights. They also had several green orbs which resembled mana stones that are attached to the joints around its body and feet. Moguro's true form was the green jewel that acted as the magic core of the Crystal Palace, located in the castle's top floor. ==Personality== Moguro was a reserved individual who spoke in a monotone voice and limited their words, which made it hard to understand their thoughts. Despite that, they were excellent at sifting out essential information and always remained attentive to conversations. They most often expressed themself through combat and even offered words of praise to their opponents. Although Moguro was a meteor who was influenced by the one who sits on the Crystal Palace's throne,''Then, the one to direct Moguro to return from far away had been the one who sat upon the throne possessing the function of exerting influence on the meteor; none other than Chisha Gold could have done so.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 5, Section 2. this did not stop them from being friends with people like [[Groovy Gumlet|Groovy]] and having the wish to bring peace to the Vollachia Empire. Their accumulated personality and memories were completely reset after the events of the Great Disaster. ==History== At an unknown point in time, the Crystal Palace and its meteor, including the '''magic core''' (魔核, ''ma kaku'') that acted as the heart of it, controlling the palace from within, were created.''For those who painted over the picture, the main reason why it could not be swayed, no matter what they did, was Moguro Hagane―― no, it was the meteor which governed the Crystal Palace, the heart of the Vollachia Empire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3. After its construction, due to the high density of mana absorbed by the rare mana stones used in the citadel's makeup, the magic core controlling the Crystal Palace eventually gained a spirit.''The Crystal Palace, the center of the Imperial Capital of Lupugana and the symbol of the entire Vollachia Empire, was not just a fortress of unparalleled offensive and defensive capabilities, but had concentrated so much mana that it had become a sort of spirit in its own right.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 2|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 10. The living meteor would later come to be named Moguro Hagane, and in order to hide their true identity from all but a select few within the Empire, Moguro began to proclaim themself as the Steelman and took advantage of their appearance to appear as a member of the Steelfolk tribe.''However, that was not the case in reality, and Moguro took advantage of their own outward appearance, as well as the special trait of lacking involvement with others from the Steelfolk tribe, and was an existence who merely self-proclaimed themself as the Steelman.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 1. They would eventually meet Groovy Gumlet, who had initially mistaken them for furnishing of the Crystal Palace and attempted to place them into storage, and they ended up becoming close with him. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly four to five months before [[Arc 1]], a rebellion in Vollachia was started by [[Gramdart Holstoy]] and [[Balleroy Temeglyph]]. Together, Moguro and Groovy Gumlet were dispatched from the Imperial Capital of Lupugana by [[Goz Ralfon]] to retrieve Vincent while [[Cecilus Segmunt]] left on his own accord to accomplish the task. Vincent was kidnapped by [[Reinhard van Astrea]], [[Julius Juukulius]], and [[Ferris]], then in the Empire to negotiate a non-aggression pact alongside Council of Wise Men members [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]]. Although Moguro initially took Ferris captive, the Sword Saint later freed him and began turning the tables against the two generals, which allowed for the other two knights to escape with Vincent. Moguro and Groovy were later forced to retreat from Reinhard due to his sheer power, and after running to Cecilus, Reinhard was given a chance to render the Blue Lightning unconscious, forcing the pair into submission and causing them to fall back with the unconscious general. After the rebellion was quelled, Moguro met with Vincent in Lupugana's Crystal Palace alongside Groovy, Goz, and [[Chisha Gold]], where they discussed the incident. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Moguro is incredibly powerful. Due to their unique form as a meteor, they can employ themselves as an army of golems, a colossal titan, and even the Crystal Palace itself. Because the only way to bring Moguro down is to destroy the core, it is effectively impossible to kill Moguro, no matter how damaged they become, allowing access to greater and more numerous methods of attacking and defending that no other person would be capable of utilizing. ===Physical Traits=== '''Colossal Toughness''': Moguro's external bodies possessed enough strength that they could easily kill their opponents with a glancing blow, and their attacks could send shockwaves of earth to crush opponents with ease. It has been said that around the world, Reinhard was the only person who was capable of breaking Moguro's hard metal with his bare hands. '''Whirlwind Fighting Style''': Moguro could drill with both of their hands as well as by spinning their external bodies at incredible speeds.''Moguro gyrated the left arm they had drawn back, and a blow that could drill a hole through the world burrowed through the sky of the Imperial Capital.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 108, Section 2. They could move underground as easily as a fish in water can. Using this technique, Moguro overtakes their opponents by hiding underground. The whirlwind style allowed them to perform techniques that were fatal to humans with colossal strength. Even when their body is enlarged to giant proportions, Moguro is still keen, nimble, and precise.''In addition to protecting Abel from the magic sniping, they had blocked the entirety of the enemy’s attacks until this point. Moguro’s movements were keen, nimble, and precise.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 108, Section 2. '''Reconstruction''': Moguro could alter the shape of their body to various sizes and shapes. They could change the structure of a body part, such as a limb, into something more sharp or dull, they could elongate themself to a colossal size, or they could even change the form of their external body into the bastions surrounding the Imperial Capital. They could even create numerous golems of varying toughness and strength as if they were their own miniature army.''"――. Stone golems seem to be moving there."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 91, Section 1.''"――Ah, yes, well, Abel-sama said that they were the troops of Moguro Hagane, one of the Nine Divine Generals."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 91, Section 1. So long as they have the material to work with, they can even repair their body with ease.''Of course, through the direct hits of those large boulders, Moguro’s construction of the rampart and farmland crumbled, and was broken. However, in order to repair those broken parts, Moguro made the boulders crashing against him into the next materials which formed its massive body, and was certainly offsetting the attacks.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 96, Section 2. As long as Moguro's true body, the magic core of the Crystal Palace of Lupugana itself, is intact, they could not be completely defeated.''Even if that happened, as long as Moguro’s true body of the Crystal Palace was going strong, then neither would the Steelman, Moguro Hagane, be defeated, nor would the third bastion be overcome.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3. '''Giant Magic Crystal Soldier''': Being connected to the Crystal Palace, Moguro can, if necessary, transform the entire palace into a massive soldier that takes a similar appearance to Moguro's usual form.''Having stood up, the Crystal Palace―― that which could have even been called the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier, while it shared similarities with Moguro Hagane as an individual, it exuded an incomparable aura brimming with malevolence.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 73, Section 4. In this state, it wields one of a certain number of giant pillars as large as itself reshaped into a greatsword with a fifty-meter blade,''That act had been performed by a pillar of Magic Crystals held in the arm of the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier. It was one of the pillars that had been constructed around the Crystal Palace, its height matching that of the Giant Soldier’s, and having been transformed into a deadly greatsword with a blade of fifty meters, its scale was such that it would not lose out to the Yang Sword.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 74, Section 2.''In response to that tempest, the Giant Soldier reached out and grabbed a Magic Crystal pillar in each of its arms, and taking a dual-wielding stance of greatswords, its colossal body began to rapidly gyrate above the waist―― it performed a sword dance of destruction, ruination, and pulverization.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 74, Section 2. from its hands, it can fire a blast similar to but weaker than the Magic Crystal Cannon, still bearing enough power to destroy half of the Imperial Capital,''In order to kill Arakiya, the entirety of the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier emitted light, and a fire of destruction was unleashed from what ought to be called its right arm. It might not have been as powerful as the mighty blast of the Magic Crystal Cannon, but it was more than enough to blow away a single life, or half of the Imperial Capital, and targeting Arakiya as she flew through the sky, targeting her, targeting her――.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 73, Section 4. it can emit an undodgeable mist of light from its body,''Through the countless cracks formed throughout its body, it began to shine, and in the next moment, aiming in every direction with quite literally no blind spots, a rain of light―― nay, an undodgeable mist of light was unleashed.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 74, Section 2. and it can gyrate its body to deal with attacks that surround it. However, Moguro is not the only one able to do this. Due to the meteor being directly connected to the palace, others are capable of triggering this form.''The Witch had exploited this. After the Magic Core had been lost, by forcibly activating the defense mechanisms that were no longer able to fulfill their original role, the Steel Giant―― nay, the Magic Crystal Giant, was awoken.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 73, Section 4. Once it entered this state, it was no longer possible to revert the soldier to its palace form.''"As soon as it began to rampage as a golem, even without mine actions being enacted, the recovery of its Palace form was no longer a possibility. As such, mineself used it as a ceremonial flame to herald their send-off, for they had fully carried out the role of Great Disaster."'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 1. ==Trivia== *It has been implied that Moguro's core was necessary to create a connection with [[Muspel]].''"――No, there can be no mistaking that it is at the Crystal Palace. Whatever the Witch’s intentions, if she needed a connection to the Stone, she would require contact with the core of the Crystal Palace… with Moguro Hagane."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 62, Section 1. *Before their reveal as a meteor, Moguro was claimed to be a steelfolk,''She only knew of them from rumors, but Moguro Hagane was a special kind of demi-human called a “Steelfolk”. Unlike the Weaponkin, whose bodies were only partially made of metal, she had heard that they were existences whose bodies were entirely made out of minerals.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 93, Section 1. and the secret that they were not a steelfolk was known only to a select few within the Empire.''That fact that they were not truly a Steelfolk was known to only a select few even within the Vollachian Empire.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 96, Section 1. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]]

{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Melinda |Image = Melinda LN character design.png |Kanji = メリンダ |Romaji = Merinda |Race = Evil Eye Tribe |Gender = Female |Age = Around 23-24 |Hair Color = Ashen Grey |Previous Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]]
Stride Faction |Status = Deceased |Relatives = [[Stride Vollachia]] (husband) |Equipment = Conversation Mirror |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Ex Volume 6]]}} '''Melinda''' (メリンダ) was [[Stride Vollachia]]'s wife and a member of the Evil Eye Tribe. She was one of the secondary antagonists of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]. ==Appearance== Melinda was a member of the Evil Eye Tribe and had long, wavy ashen grey hair. She wore a robe of the same color as her hair that covered her entire body. She kept her eyes tightly shut to obscure her Evil Eyes, but when she opened them, her eyeballs were dyed in black, and a spider web pattern could be seen in them. ==Personality== Melinda had a self-hatred for her Evil Eye ability and called her own blood "cursed". She often spoke with a stutter and was quite mellow. However, she was very quick to become angry when people went against her ideals and placed innocent and unborn babies in danger. She was also willing to go out of her way and put her life at stake just to protect someone's unborn child. ==History== Melinda survived the [[Vollachia Empire|Empire]]'s attack on the Evil Eye Tribe which wiped out almost all of her brethren some time before she met Stride, and she married him sometime later. Their marriage had lasted for 2 years by the time of the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]]. ==Abilities== [[File:Melinda Evil Eye Design.png|thumb|200px|Melinda's Evil Eyes]] '''Evil Eyes''' (魔眼, ''Magan''): As a member of the Evil Eye Tribe, Melinda, rather than having a third eye located somewhere on her body as is common for her tribespeople, was uniquely the owner of two Evil Eyes in the place of conventional eyes. Her right eye was the '''Evil Eye of Pride''', and her left eye was the '''Evil Eye of Vainglory'''.''“――My right eye is the Evil Eye of Pride, and my left eye is the Evil Eye of Vainglory.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 5, Section 6. The effect of an Evil Eye was activated when someone looked into it, forcing her to keep her eyes shut until she was ready to utilize its power, and, according to Kurgan, they could only ensnare the weak.''“The mandate of the Evil Eye may ensnare naught but the weak.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 6, Section 3. *'''Evil Eye of Pride''' (傲慢の魔眼, ''Gōman no Magan''): Melinda's right eye. Activated when someone peered into it, the Evil Eye of Pride forced an iniquitous target to confront their sins in an illusionary world.''“The Evil Eye of Vainglory shows different realities to the rabble, and the Evil Eye of Pride inquires sin of transgressors who bear iniquity… Stride may have taken her as his wife, but I cannot help but feel disappointed that the Sword Demon would fall under such tricks.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 6, Section 3. This is the ability Melinda used to force Theresia to confront her sins. *'''Evil Eye of Vainglory''' (虚飾の魔眼, ''Kyoshoku no Magan''): Melinda's left eye. Activated when someone peered into it, the Evil Eye of Vainglory created hallucinatory illusions, presenting a counterfeit reality to its target. This is the ability Melinda used to induce an illusion in [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]]'s mind, which manifested as a hallucination of [[Pivot Arnancy]], and to control the citizens of [[Picoutatte]]. '''Equipment''': *'''Conversation Mirror''' (対話鏡, ''Taiwa-kyō''): A meteor that allows its user to communicate with others over a long distance by connecting with a separate Conversation Mirror, similar to a cell phone. Melinda used a pair of Conversation Mirrors with her husband, Stride, who had her ensnare Wilhelm with her Evil Eye of Vainglory over a long distance. ==Trivia== *In the Comic Alive version of Sword Demon Battle Ballad, Melinda had the title '''Ashen Bride''' (灰花嫁, ''Hai Hanayome''). It was removed in Ex 6. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Stride Faction]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

Pappelt |Previous Affiliation = Guineb |Occupation = Nurse |Previous Occupation = Citizen |Status = Alive |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4|Tanpenshuu Volume 4]]}} '''Marone Lisbon''' (マローネ・リズボン) is a former citizen of Guineb. She later started to help [[Regin Suwen]] at his hospital. ==Appearance== Marone is the most beautiful woman in Guineb with bright red hair in a ponytail. She has light brown eyes and wears a white ribbon in her ponytail. Like [[Felt]], she has a [[Wikipedia:Yaeba|yaeba]] that becomes prominent when she laughs. She has a golden necklace around her neck, a big chest, and wears a light green and white outfit. ==Personality== Marone is an assertive, impulsive, and emotionally driven person with a big determination to do what she wants. While she is an optimist, she is very perceptive and does not ignore when a situation is not actually favorable. She is also shown to be compassionate and empathic. ==History== ===[[Otto's Peddling Record of Joy and Sorrow]]=== Marone was born and raised in Guineb. One day, [[Minor Characters#Aheem Lavril|Aheem Lavril]], the son of Guineb's mayor, [[Colin Lavril|Colin]], deceived her and gave her to slave traders. Later on, [[Otto Suwen]] was also entrapped by Aheem and locked away with Marone. When she awoke, she explained the situation to him, referred to him as Number Two, and introduced herself. After Otto was given a chance to confirm his [[Dragon#Earth Dragons|earth dragon]] [[Frufoo]]'s whereabouts, he told Marone that he had the "Divine Protection of Guidance" and made an agreement with her. Afterward, when they were put on his dragon carriage, he was told to reveal his path through the mountains. The deal with Aheem was that he would provide the traders women in exchange for not disrupting Guineb. With Frufoo leading the carriage, Otto directed the traders where there was a supposed path that they could use. Then, after calling out to Marone as part of their agreement, they held on tight as Frufoo was signaled to crash the carriage. Otto and Marone had their injuries treated in a hospital in a nearby town, where he revealed that Guineb's mayor and son were likely to be investigated for the incident and Aheem likely arrested. Upon asking if she would return to Guineb, Marone refused. When Marone asked for his name, he said she could keep calling him Number Two and gave her his own savings, enough for her to start a new life anywhere she wanted, lying to her by saying it was a reward for taking down the slave traders. ===[[The Three Idiots Set Out! Earth Spider Episode Part 1|The Three Idiots Set Out! Earth Spider Episode]]=== After separating from Otto, Marone moved to Pappelt, where she became Regin Suwen's assistant. When Otto and his group arrived at Pappelt, Otto and Marone were reunited. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}}

'''Leslie Gabbat''' (レスリー・ガバット) was a former head of a mercenary group until he was killed by [[Ricardo Welkin]].

==Personality==
Leslie felt an immense hatred towards both [[Priscilla Barielle|Priscilla]] and [[Leip Barielle|Leip]] and lusted for vengeance for the humiliation he and his group had suffered at the former's hands. 

==History==
Sometime in the past, Leslie, [[Gilian Endymion]], [[Al]] and 50 other mercenaries and knights fought in Priscilla's tournament to decide who would become her knight. He joined the tournament in accordance with a deal he'd struck with Leip, so to further the position of his mercenary group. However, Priscilla derailed his plans by cutting the tournament short after her interest converged on Al, leading to him feeling humiliated.

===Julius's Contracted Spirits===
'''Kua''' (クア, blue/water), '''Aro''' (アロ, green/wind), '''Iku''' (イク, yellow/earth), '''In''' (イン, orange/white/yang), and '''Nes''' (ネス, purple/black/yin), alongside [[Ia]], are [[Julius Juukulius]]'s contracted [[spirit]]s, each one governing a different element of mana. After a fierce battle with other lesser spirits, they managed to contract with Julius, and they constantly stuck by his side for years, acting as his magical strength. Following the events of [[Arc 5]], when Julius's name was devoured and their contract was in a precarious yet existing state, they stuck by his side yet did not assist him. After Julius severed his contract, however, and reformed it with them, resetting their relationship, they evolved into proper spirits and have become stronger alongside Julius. Exclusively to the Sasageru IF, they evolved into great spirits and took on new names and the Juukulius surname. Whereas Ia took on the name Lumera Ia Juukulius and was the last to become a great spirit, the others donned the names '''Lapicha Kua Juukulius''' (ラピチャ・クア・ユークリウス, ''Rapicha Kua Yūkuriusu''), '''Soyone Aro Juukulius''' (ソヨネ・アロ・ユークリウス, ''Soyone Aro Yūkuriusu''), '''Dorena Iku Juukulius''' (ドレナ・イク・ユークリウス, ''Dorena Iku Yūkuriusu''), '''Kiara In Juukulius''' (キアラ・イン・ユークリウス, ''Kiara In Yūkuriusu''), and '''Sinica Nes Juukulius''' (シニカ・ネス・ユークリウス, ''Shinika Nesu Yūkuriusu''). At a talk show held on July 26, 2026, the birthday of the six spirits was decided to be July 26.<ref name="july2026talkshow">July 26, 2026 Talk Show</ref>

===Julius's Unnamed Grandfather===
Julius's grandfather was a member of Lugunica's knights. According to a story passed down by him in life, after him and his some of his comrades were left behind in a snow storm during a clash between the knights and [[Gusteko]]'s Temple Knights along the borders of the countries, he dragged the bodies of his comrades and struggled to escape the blizzard they were caught in until he found himself in a frozen forest. Within the forest, he met a “phantom”, who said that if they caused any chaos near his beloved daughter, he would never forgive them.<ref>''“――‘If you cause any chaos around my beloved daughter, I will never forgive you’.”'' [[Re:Zero Another Memory Snow]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref> Suddenly, the knights appeared in the middle of a plain, and managed to get back to the knights. Although Julius's grandfather reported what happened, he was not taken seriously,<ref>''“The next instant, my grandfather and his comrades were in an unfamiliar place. But not in a snow storm, they were in an open plain. After this, my grandfather safely linked up with the royal knights and attempted to report the details of what happened, but he was not taken seriously.”'' [[Re:Zero Another Memory Snow]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref> and the tale, known as “The Phantom Father in the Snow”, would come to be seen as a delusion that was induced by the extreme cold and the snow storm.<ref>''Ever since, this story known as The Phantom Father in the Snow was passed down among the knights in scrupulous detail. It was said that it was all a delusion brought about by the extreme cold and frightfully ferocious snow.'' [[Re:Zero Another Memory Snow]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref>

The older brother of the [[Insect Cage Tribe]]'s chieftain who went mad due to his sense of inferiority towards his younger brother and directed his madness towards his son, [[Kafma Irulux]], implanting him with insects once per year and breaking his tribe's law. The chieftain of the Insect Cage Tribe who had taken in eight insects into his body and Kafma's uncle. He was the one who discovered Kafma and executed his father, and he responsibility for Kafma.

After the resolution of an unknown conflict and the defeat of an enemy general, he was engraved into Vollachia's history as the '''Emperor of the Great Defeat''' (大敗帝, ''Taihai Tei'').

===Ludgar===
'''Ludgar''' (ルドガー, ''Rudogā'') is an aide who assisted Vincent Abellux and [[Chisha Gold]] prior to the Imperial Selection Ceremony.

===Madelyn===
'''Madelyn''' (マデリン, ''Maderin'') was a woman who cared for Balleroy Temeglyph when he was younger and gave him his name. The two of them parted ways when he was still a child. Before receiving her surname from Berstetz, [[Madelyn Eschart]] was given her first name by Balleroy, who named her after the person that treated him kindly in the past.

===Radkain Vollachia===
'''Radkain Vollachia''' (ラドカイン・ヴォラキア, ''Radokain Vorakia'') was the sixtieth emperor of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and [[Eugard Vollachia|Eugard Vollachia's]] father. He spawned over 200 children, engraving his name in history as the '''Sowing Emperor''' (種蒔き帝, ''Tanemaki Tei''), though near the time of his death and the commencement of the Imperial Selection Ceremony of 300 years ago, around half of his children were under the age of ten.

===Tigre===
'''Tigre''' (ティグレ, ''Tigure'') was a woman who lived in [[Iris|Iris's]] village.

===Jimuna===
'''Jimuna''' (ジムナ, ''Jimuna'') was an individual who lived in [[Iris|Iris's]] village.

===Gildeo Musik===
'''Gildeo Musik''' (ギルデオ・ムジーク, ''Girudeo Mujīku'') was [[Eugard Vollachia|Eugard Elcanti]]'s half-brother and the final sibling he killed before the end of the Imperial Selection Ceremony of 300 years ago. Gildeo was regarded as the most powerful force in the ceremony.

===Penelope===
'''Penelope''' (ペネロープ, ''Penerōpu'') was a woman who was once loved by a previous emperor of Vollachia. Out of his love for Penelope, he named Lake Penelope after her.

===Rondando===
'''Rondando''' (ロンダンド, ''Rondando''), also known as the '''Monster Arm''' (怪腕, ''Kaiwan'') was a citizen of the Vollachia Empire who was revived as an undead during the Great Disaster.

===Galahau Dracroy===
'''Galahau Dracroy''' (ガラハウ・ドラクロイ, ''Garahau Dorakuroi'') was the father of [[Serena Dracroy]]. After losing his position as head of the Dracroy family to his daughter, he sent four assassins to slay her. When three of the assassins were slain and [[Gwain Merette|the fourth]] was convinced by Serena to turn against them for his survival, foiling Galahau's attempts to force his daughter out of her position, she returned to the Empire and had him killed.

===Elcain===
'''Elcain''' (エルケイン, ''Erukein'') was an assassin of the Insect Cage Tribe hired to assassinate Serena Dracroy by her father, Galahau. A tall, skinny man with compound eyes, he acted as a sniper, making use of his clan's insects as projectiles that parasitized a target's Gate and devoured their mana to eliminate his opponents. He was killed by [[Wilhelm van Astrea]].

===Gwain===
'''Gwain''' (グウェイン, ''Guwein'') was the father of [[Gwain Merette|Alagar]]. When given the chance to start a new life under a different identity in Lugunica by Roswaal L. Mathers and Serena Dracroy, Alagar chose to bear the name of his dead father, becoming Gwain Merette.

===Harlein===
'''Harlein''' (ハーライン, ''Hārain''), also known as the '''Iron Arms''' (鉄腕, ''Tetsuwan''), was a weaponkin who was infamous for brutally killing numerous people in life. He was risen as a zombie during the Great Disaster and was among those who survived following its conclusion. In the end, he was defeated by [[Cecilus Segmunt]] and [[Arakiya]], and eaten by [[Spica]].

===Breznon===
'''Breznon''' (ブレズノン, ''Burezunon''), also known as the '''Iron Legs''' (鉄脚, ''Tekkyaku''), was a weaponkin and the younger brother of Harlein. Like his brother, he was infamous for brutally killing numerous people in life. He was risen as a zombie during the Great Disaster and was among those who survived following its conclusion. In the end, he was killed by [[Volcas]].

===Ranara Ralfon===
'''Ranara Ralfon''' (ラナラ・ラルフォン, ''Ranara Rarufon'') is the wife of [[Goz Ralfon]].

==[[Gusteko|The Holy Kingdom of Gusteko]]==
===Holy King===
The '''Holy King''' (聖王, ''Sei Ō'') is the current monarch of Gusteko. It is known that they are the one who purportedly grants [[Terminology#Powers and Abilities|Blessings]] such as the Blessing of People Repulsion to Temple Knights. As part of their contract with Odglass, they able to be aware of everything that happens within the nation and deal with anything bad that appears.<ref name="july2026talkshow" />

===Gaddogi Guadozeaddo===
'''Gaddogi Guadozeaddo''' (ガッドギー・グアッドゼアッド, ''Gaddogī Guaddozeaddo'') is a [[spirit|great spirit]] not included among the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]. According to the author, it is powerful, and it is sealed at the far end of Gusteko due to its poor behavior.<ref>[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1296095413754138624 Author's Comment]</ref>

===Piditz===
'''Piditz''' (ピディッツ, ''Pidittsu'') was a resident of Limbus.

===Elderly Healer===
The healer was an elderly woman who lived in Limbus as sort of an outcast, and in their youths, she taught Mireille and Nananna her knowledge. After she helped the citizens of Limbus overcome a rampant disease, the healer was the one responsible for making it subside. Although she was at first praised for her efforts, she was soon condemned after a rumor spread that she started the disease, and afterward, she was burned as a Witch, something that started the subsequent Witch Hunts and conspiracies that was speculated to bring an end to all of Limbus.

==[[Kararagi|The Kararagi City-States]]==
===Rajan===
'''Rajan''' (ラジアン, ''Rajian'') is a member of the [[Iron Fang]] and was tasked with spying over the [[Witch Cult]] in Arc 3. He is a fox-human and it was mentioned he speaks in Kansai dialect, similar to [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]] and [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]].

==Others==
==="That Person"===
'''"That Person"''' (その人, ''Sono Hito'') is an unnamed individual who was purportedly supposed to inherit the knowledge left by [[Echidna]] in the Forbidden Library. The historical Echidna's final task to Beatrice was to guard the Forbidden Library until the arrival of "That Person", at which point the knowledge she left would be inherited by the individual. The Echidna in the [[Castle of Dreams]] claimed that her objective had been to see who Beatrice selected to be "That Person". However, in the [[Re:IF Kasaneru|Kasaneru IF]] story, Echidna seemingly unintentionally revealed "That Person" was a man and a real person to Subaru. It is unknown how much of Echidna's remarks on "That Person" are true, although according to her, there is no longer any way of locating him, and even if there were, he would not be aware of his role.

===Oni God===
The '''Oni God''' (鬼神, ''Onishin'') is a historical figure who carved their name into history during the era of Witches. They were a powerful individual revered by the Oni Clan for centuries after their demise. Although the circumstances of their exploits are unknown, it is believed that they once lost in a drinking competition with [[Reid Astrea]],<ref>''“Certainly, there is no time to recite the legend Reid Astrea etched into posterity in all parts of the world. Speaking of things he was famous for… the fight where he slayed a hundred Dragons, or his battle achievement of six thousand undefeated victories recorded in the arena of the Gladiator Island. The victor of a drinking competition with the existence known as the Oni God, such varieties are also there.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 24]], Chapter 2, Section 6.</ref> and according to legend, they were rumored to have been felled by the Dragon Sword Reid at some point.<ref>''It was a legendary object said to have slain Witches, Dragons, and the Oni God. There was no end to the tales associated with it, but the only thing that could be said for sure was――, ――Once the Dragon Sword was drawn, it had never once been sheathed without first cutting something.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 4, Section 2.</ref>

===Sword God===
The '''Sword God''' (剣神, ''Kenshin'') is an entity whose origins are unknown, but is linked to the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint. Although there is some knowledge about this entity among general martial artists, its existence can only be perceived by the current Sword Saint. It is shown to have an arrogant and possessive personality. It's said that the Dragon Sword Reid was blessed by the Sword God itself.<ref>''"It is said to be a sacred blade, bearing a blessing bestowed by the Sword God itself."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Record of the Days Before the Royal Selection - The Silver Flower Dance of the Sword Saint and the Lightning, Section 1.</ref>

===Regulus's First Wife===
Regulus's first wife was a woman who lived in the same hometown as Regulus in his youth. Shortly after Regulus obtained his Authority, he killed everyone around her and made her his first wife, earning her hatred. She ultimately killed herself to escape and spite him, effectively traumatizing him.

===Milian===
'''Milian''' (ミリアン, ''Mirian'') is a character who was mentioned during the fight against [[Lye Batenkaitos]] at [[Priestella]]. When confronting [[Dynas Trussardi|Dynas]], Lye stated that it wasn't his fault he couldn't save Milian or [[Meili Portroute|Meili]].<ref>''"We know about your hard work, Dynas. It wasn't your fault you couldn't protect Milian and Meili."'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 68, Section 1.</ref>

===Melakuera (human)===
[[File:HumanMelakuera.png|thumb|140px]]
'''Melakuera''' (メラクェラ, ''Merakuera'') was a human that once lived in the distant past who journeyed across the world with his family and prayed to the sparks of fire and the "friend" that followed them. Upon dying, his "friend", a lesser spirit, took the name Melakuera for itself, and eventually became [[Melakuera|the Arbitrator, Melakuera]], a great spirit known for exacting his judgement unto others.
{{Clear}}

===Ikeda===
'''Ikeda''' (池田) is a friend of [[Natsuki Kenichi]]. He moved to Thailand somewhere in the past and used to send letters on Christmas, Father's and Mother's Day.

===Sigrum===
'''Sigrum''' (シグルム, ''Shigurumu'') is a man who appears in the Oboreru IF story. He was a man reaching his sixties who had an unspecified job in which he had to deal with many people, having been successful in it for a long time. Additionally, he had a son and grandchildren. He visited Pandemonium to speak with the leader of the Pleiades organization, Subaru, on behalf of those he worked under, and despite being successful in negotiating a partnership between both groups, he was ultimately killed.

===Hemuken===
'''Hemuken''' (ヘムケン, ''Hemuken'') is a man who was mentioned in one of Garfiel's idioms. Otto describes him as a millionaire famous for perishing after taking a wicked woman as his bride.<ref>''"What does the name of a millionaire famous for perishing after taking a wicked woman as his bride have to do with this…"'' [[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 3]], Section 2.</ref>

===Palma Eule===
'''Palma Eule''' (パルマ・エウレ, ''Paruma Eure'') is a character mentioned in Arc 6 when Subaru was looking through the Books of The Dead at the Taygeta Library.

===Coyote===
'''Coyote''' (コヨーテ, ''Koyōte'') is a character mentioned in Arc 6 when Subaru was looking through the Books of The Dead at the Taygeta Library.

===Noah Libertas===
'''Noah Libertas''' (ノア・リベルタス, ''Noa Riberutasu'') is a character mentioned in [[Arc 6]] when [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] was looking through the Books of The Dead at the Taygeta Library.

===Aegon Voller===
'''Aegon Voller '''(エイゴン・ヴォラー, ''Eigon Vorā'') is a character mentioned in [[Arc 6]] when [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] was looking through the Books of The Dead at the Taygeta Library. Aegon is exclusive to [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 22|Volume 22]], as in the corresponding Web Novel scene, [[Libre Fermi]]'s Book of the Dead was pulled out instead of theirs.

===Typhon's Father===
[[Typhon]]'s father was an executioner who lived in the era of the Great Calamity, and it was because of his job that his daughter, Typhon, gained a twisted view of right, wrong, guilt, and justice. He felt guilty for having taken so many lives, and sometime after Typhon obtained the Authority of Pride, he said as much to her. Wanting to help him, she used her Authority on him, which claimed his life.

===Trisha===
'''Trisha''' (トリーシャ, ''Torīsha'') is a character mentioned in Arc 6 by Reid Astrea. According to the first Sword Saint, she was a very strong and capable woman who had a few tricks up her sleeve; some of which were used even by Reid.

===Hauroy Rallior===
'''Hauroy Rallior''' (ハウロイ・ラリオル, ''Hauroi Rarioru'') was a swordsman who was the neighbor of Reid Astrea. Reid introduced himself using this pseudonym when facing [[Lye Batenkaitos]].

===Wilov===
'''Wilov''' (ウィロフ, ''Uirofu'') was a person mentioned in one of Garfiel's idioms. [[Clind]] expressed awareness of who they were.

===Tislow===
'''Tislow''' (ティスロ, ''Tisuro''), also known as the '''Snow Vallum''' (雪喰, ''Yukikui''), is a victim of the Authority of Gluttony. As someone whose body exceeded norms, according to legend, they singlehandedly restrained an avalanche with their power.

===Notah===
'''Notah''' (ノタ, ''Nota''), also known as the '''Blighted Love Balladeer''' (悲恋歌人, ''Hiren Kajin''), is a victim of the Authority of Gluttony. He travelled across lands singing anti-nationalist songs and could employ a power known as a curse ballad.

===Advan===
'''Advan''' (アドヴァン, ''Adovan''), also known as the '''Blood-Weeping Oni''' (血涙鬼, ''Ketsurui Oni''), is a victim of the Authority of Gluttony. They were a magic user who was unable to manipulate anything besides their own blood, allowing them to change the form of it into weapons they could attack others with.

===Matclyma Jordon===
'''Matclyma Jordon''' (マトクリマ・ジョラドーン, ''Matokurima Joradōn''), also known as the '''Lord of Phantasmal Rainbows''' (虹幻公, ''Kōgen Kō''), is a victim of the Authority of Gluttony. They plotted to overthrow the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko by using residual mana within the carcasses of deceased witchbeasts. With their magic technique, they used witchbeast corpses as chrysalides to create rainbow-hued butterflies, which were, at their essence, manifestations of death. Upon contact with something, they exploded. The technique is of a similar breed to Julius Juukulius's rainbow magic.

===Figdour===
'''Figdour''' (フィグドール, ''Figudōru''), also known as the '''Compactor''' (圧搾屋, ''Assaku-ya''), is a victim of the Authority of Gluttony.

===Iyerna===
'''Iyerna''' (イエルナ, ''Ieruna''), also known as the '''Saintess of a Thousand Visages''' (千面聖女, ''Sen-men Seijo''), is a victim of the Authority of Gluttony.

===Yardray===
'''Yardray''' (ヤルドレイ, ''Yarudorei''), also known as the '''Magic Manus Magister''' (魔弄師, ''Ma Rō-shi''), is a victim of the Authority of Gluttony. They had a magic technique that could manipulate multiple magic attributes to cast multiple spells at once, such as by simultaneously creating spears of flame, ice, and earth, which had the capacity to lock onto and fire at a target.

===Remina===
'''Remina''' (レミナ, ''Remina'') was the wife and childhood friend of [[Toska Astrea|Toska]]. Born in Carnattse as the village head's daughter, she was chosen as a sacrifice for the Blight Dragons until she was saved by Echidna.

===Amangam===
'''Amangam''' (アマンガム, ''Amangamu'') was the head of the Silver Dragons who controlled the eastern lands. It was killed by Toska's elder brother, Reid.

===Fargall===
'''Fargall''' (ファルガル, ''Farugaru'') is a Silver Dragon who sought to avenge the death of its leader, Amangam, by killing Toska and his kin. It was defeated by Echidna.

===Magrizza's Crown Prince===
The crown prince of the fallen country of [[Magrizza]]. He had once been enamored with Echidna and attempted to wed her. However, their wedding was called off after a rampage by Reid Astrea and Volcanica. Though his fate is unknown, it is likely that he perished when Magrizza was destroyed by the [[Black Serpent]].

===Hector's Wife===
Hector's wife was a woman who was married to him at some point in his life, and she was the person who first claimed Hector to be the Warlock of Melancholy.
