{{Character |Name = Mozolite |Kanji = モゾリテ |Romaji = Mozorite |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Previous Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]
[[Flanders]]
The Balance |Previous Occupation = Subordinate |Status = Unknown |Divine Protection = [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Far-Sight|Divine Protection of Far-Sight]] |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10|Tanpenshuu Volume 10]]}} '''Mozolite''' (モゾリテ) was a member of The Balance in [[Flanders]] who was [[Manfred Madison]]'s subordinate and confidant. While attempting to escape Flanders once his plan to take Manfred's position was foiled, he was captured by the [[Anastasia Camp]] and delivered back to the city. Afterwards, he was tortured by his former boss while being forced to hold his eyes in his hands. His current status is unknown. ==Appearance== Mozolite is a large man with a flat face reminiscent of a crushed frog. He had tattoos on his eyeballs, each of which were gouged out by The Balance following his betrayal. ==Personality== Mozolite was an ambitious man who craved to lead the Balance and pursued the opportunity to steal the position of his boss, meticulously creating a plan to do so. In [[Helaine Gatness]]'s view, while he had talents beyond his position, he could be easily swayed. ==History== Mozolite hailed from the same hometown as [[Mimosa]]. Around the start of the [[Royal Selection]], Mozolite, who was the second-in-command of the Balance, allied himself with [[Helaine Gatness]] in an attempt to snatch the position of his boss, Manfred, orchestrating attacks on the Big Three and her own Golden Beetle organization with assassins and leveraging his position in his group to do so. Helaine, perceiving Mozolite's ambition and detecting that he could be easily exploited, supported his goal, believing it would be in the interest of [[Six Tongues|the organization]] she served. When [[Felt]] attempted to make a courtesy visit to the Balance after visiting the Flower Prison Garden first, Mozolite and Manfred's men were there to relay their boss's refusal to see her and [[Reinhard van Astrea]]. Felt ultimately accepted the result, and simply by looking around, Mozolite made the men who had surrounded the pair disperse, allowing them to leave. After Manfred's meeting with Felt, he recognized that she had a keen nose and ordered Mozolite to keep a close eye on them. While attempting to escape from Flanders after Helaine exposed Mozolite's involvement in the conspiracy once she lost her bet to [[Rachins Hoffman]] and his subordinate with an Excess Mana Circulation Constitution was defeated by [[Ezzo Cadner]], he was met by the [[Anastasia Camp]]. While attempting to flee from them, Reinhard threw a tometo at him all the way from the city, which landed a blow on him, causing him to faint. When he awoke, his eyes had been gouged out, and he was tortured by Manfred while in the presence of [[Toto]] and [[Doltero Amule]]. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護, ''Kago''): Mozolite had the '''Divine Protection of Far-Sight''' (遠見の加護, ''Tōmi no Kago''), which allows him to see the precise location of a target or closely observe opponents who fulfilled specific unknown conditions. As a result of his eyes being removed, although he can no longer employ this Divine Protection himself, its effects are still active. Mozolite's left eye is currently used by Manfred, while the location of his right eye is unknown. {{Clear}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Flanders]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[Category:Unknown Status]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

Both tails of her hair are wrapped around with gold chains, and she adorns a gold pendant that is the shape of the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]]. ==Personality== As a nun who worked under the [[Divine Dragon Church]], she believes in the Divine Dragon. She is a polite and soft-spoken girl who is always low profile, and she is somewhat protective. Melty is reserved, but she's also very modest and compassionate. She tries her best to do everything, but because she tends to rush, she can be a bit of a screw-up. ==History== Before arriving in Lugunica, Melty lived in Faradar, the village of the Evil Eye Tribe. Ever since she was a child, she intuitively realized that she was different from normal people, but she did not mind because everyone accepted her for who she was, and she accepted that kindness in turn. However, what she had not realized was that her Evil Eye of Bewitchment was the cause of people's kindness toward her. While taking an exam to determine her Evil Eye's strength, she wished for the voices urging her to quit scaring her, and as a result, those around her began to fight each other until they collapsed. Although nobody died, as a result of this, she was imprisoned far away from the village. Although her brother Salum was told to never visit her, he frequently slipped by the tribe's adults to meet with her, bringing her information about her Evil Eye, such as that someone else from hundreds of years ago had possessed the same power as her, for her sake. One day, she met a young boy named Tiga when he was still a traveling entertainer, and the two became good friends. Salum also happened to meet Melty shortly after her first encounter with Tiga. While initially wary of Tiga's presence, he accepted the young boy's assertion that he was Melty's friend and would never leave her side. Due to the effects of her Evil Eye of Bewitchment, she came to believe that she had used her power to change the course of his life and make him into her friend. Unbeknownst to her, however, Tiga's Divine Protection allowed him to resist her power. Nevertheless, Melty felt guilt over her belief that her Evil Eye had ensnared him, and this guilt went on to weigh on her conscience for many years to come. Sometime in the past, Faradar was attacked, resulting in Melty being separated from her family, including Salum. She met [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]], who sealed her Evil Eye and closed her throat, making it so she was unable to eat food. From then on, the only way she could digest food was via injection through the Mana Wasps that are thought to have been created by Mother. Her and Tiga went to Lugunica and joined the Divine Dragon Church, being overseen by [[Sakura Element]], who possessed a power allowing her to control Mana Wasps. ==Abilities== '''Evil Eye''' (魔眼, ''Magan''): Melty has the '''Evil Eye of Bewitchment''' (人誑しの魔眼, ''Hitotarashi no Magan''). It is a very rare ability among the Evil Eye Tribe that is considered to be too dangerous, since it can affect its own kind. For that reason, Melty was locked up. Her eye can manipulate someone unconditionally, just by touching the person. Whoever is touched follows her orders as long as she commands them. It was originally on her hands; however, when she met Mother, her eye was hidden so that no one could see it when used. '''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): Melty has enough skill in magic to use water magic. *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法, ''Chiyu Mahō''): Melty summons water mana to heal the wounds of herself and others. She can also heal someone's illnesses. '''Equipment''': Melty wields a long staff that contains a book of spells within. ==Trivia== *At a talk show held in March 2024, the author stated that he would like to introduce Melty and Tiga somewhere into the mainline story. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Vollachia Navbox}} {{Non-Canon Navbox}} {{Beloved Children Navbox}} [[Category:Divine Dragon Church]] [[Category:Melty Camp]] [[Category:Demi-Human]]

'''Lilac''' (ライラ) is a wandering dream arts user. She, alongside [[Shion]], later joined the [[Omega Party]].

==Appearance==
Lilac has purple and pink eyes with purple pupils, and as the phantom of an elf, she has pointed ears. She has long purple hair with two black Mariposa lily on her hair. Her clothes are almost similar to Shion's; however, unlike Shion, her attire is more revealing as it consists of a short black sleeveless dress. She adorns herself a crimson red rose on her left arm, a dagger wrapped around on her hips, and a small gold locket around her neck with a purple bow as a choker.

Since Lilac shares the same physical vessel as Shion, whenever her personality manifests in their vessel, its appearance instantly shifts to match hers.

==Personality==
Unlike her counterpart, Lilac is slightly more aggressive and stubborn, as well as very protective of Shion, to the point that, despite accidentally taking a whole town hostage, she is willing to keep people asleep to keep them away from her. That said, she does not seem to like dragging unrelated parties into her own mess if she can help it, as shown when she wanted to prevent anyone from coming to harm while in her dream world. Due to being a Dream Arts User, however, her sense of self is somewhat fuzzy, and because she is so synchronized with others, she can find herself becoming influenced by other people's memories, including taking on their speech quirks. It is because of this that she can often be heard speaking with numerous loan words, having picked them up from passing memories of a person who uses them. She is somewhat driven by her goal to find the person who uses these words, even being willing to follow [[Omega]] as part of her party for the chance to learn of the person who uses them.

==History==
At an unknown point in time and for unknown reasons, two separate souls, Shion and Lilac, came to possess the same vessel. When the two souls first confronted each other, they were in conflict and fought for control over their shared body. However, one day, that changed, and they now share their body peacefully, speculating that, having entered another person’s dream, they were deeply affected. As time passed, they came across the dream of a man who spoke with English loan words, and ever since, they have been searching for the person whose dream they entered in order to fill the void that lingered in their hearts.

===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Omega in Wonderland Part 1|Omega in Wonderland]]===
At some point, she and Lilac appeared in [[Gusteko]]. However, they were deemed heretics by the [[Gustekan Church]], causing them to send a [[Mikli Yulitô|Temple Knight]] after them. At some point after entering the town of Sylphoa, they confronted Mikli, and Lilac, having had no time to aim, used her Dream Arts to put her, and accidentally, the entire town, to sleep. Because of this, however, Shion lost contact with Lilac.

Sometime later, after Omega and [[Colette]] appeared in her dream space, she stopped the former from destroying it with Al Shario, and she sealed her magic while within the dream. After getting into a small dispute with Omega, Colette spoke with her about letting all of the townspeople go, and though she was hesitant to do so and seemed standoffish, Omega stated that Colette's words got through to her. However, upon hearing Omega's use of a loan word, Lilac wanted to know where she heard it, leading to negotiations. Despite becoming frustrated with her and even slapping her, she decided to give Omega a chance to take care of the Temple Knight who had come after her, breaking the seal that she'd placed. The fight that followed was short lived as the [[Witch#Witches of Sin|Witches of Sin]] quickly dispatched her, much to Lilac's shock. Shortly after, [[Palmyra]] entered the dream space with a message from Shion.

Following this, after Omega spoke to the [[Zank Metley|other Temple Knight]] who had come for Mikli and had him leave with her and report the death of the heretic, Lilac released the people of Sylphoa from her dream world, and Omega offered Shion and Lilac to join her party. Since she couldn't quite trust the two, having just met them, she would give them a chance to look into her memories with their Dream Arts, giving them a chance to find the person from which the loan words they speak come from. The two accepted her offer and joined the party.

===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 1|Witch Trials]]===
One day, having moved on from Sylphoa, the Omega Party was walking in a snow field, where they encountered a [[Witchbeast#Snow Blight|Snow Blight]]. However, Omega swiftly dispatched it with Minya. Soon after, they arrived at Limbus, where signs claiming it was forbidden to go out at night and to comply with the "vows of the faith". Though slightly concerned about the town's eeriness, as the group was low on supplies, they decided to enter Limbus, where after a few minutes, they found themselves surrounded by the townsfolk who were armed with farming tools. Though they attempted to calm the townsfolk and offer them a gift in the form of the Snow Blight's crystallized head, they instead accuse her of being a [[Witch]] after seeing it, leading Omega to warn Colette against using her bracelet's transformation and Lilac from turning back into Shion, else they be declared Witches. Thanks to the appearance of [[Nananna Pezza]] and speaking with [[Noelle Tuérico]], she was able to vouch for them and clear them of being Witches.

Omega's group finds an inn to reside in where they discussed the issue at present, warning everyone about how easily they could be made into scapegoats whether for their abilities, race, or even the look in their eyes, and Noelle explained about Witch Hunts and Witch Trials being rare occurrences in Gusteko that Itinerant Preachers were sometimes sent to deal with. Although wanting to leave the town quickly, the group decides to stay in the town to help Noelle repay her debt to Nananna, and soon after, they meet with Nananna when she arrived to ask for the group's assistance. That night, the Witch Hunt is for a person named [[Minor Characters#Piditz|Piditz]] who had been tipped off as a Witch, and Nananna wanted him taken into custody only. When they later spotted Piditz and chased after him, Omega split off to corner him, only to find [[Mireille Hetia]] using her [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] to kill Piditz. Thanks to being near the body, Omega was quickly turned into a scapegoat and declared a Witch so that Mireille could cover up her kill and at least prevent her from getting in the way of her and Nananna's revenge, and Omega was taken into custody.

At the inn, the party discusses how if the scale of this event expands, they will be unable to prevent the spread of the news this time, which could result in the party's persecution, even abroad, and their possible extradition back to the church. To clear their names, Colette states that they should find the real culprit for the murders. Lilac and Colette go to gather information around the town, and they meet with Mireille, who explained to them how the hunts started. Likewise, Omega explained this to Palmyra, as she learned it while imprisoned. Shion used her dream arts to peer into the minds of the townsfolk, and she warns Lilac that the "Witch" is just a conspiracy by the council to get rid of political enemies. After learning of this, Lilac informs the Colette and Palmyra, and the elves suggest sowing division in the people to uproot the conspiracy. Though wanting to talk to Noelle, she does not come back that night, and Lilac and Shion decide to use their dream arts to nudge the townsfolk to attend the upcoming.

The next day, the Witch Trial is being held for Omega, overseen by Nananna and the Town Hall, while Palmyra acts as Omega's attorney. Despite her arguments, [[Edmon Quayle]] counters with his supposed knowledge of the Witches and Omega's chatter does not help. Colette speaks up and claims that she believes that things will not go as the council claims, as people will begin to notice that the entire event seems off, which resounds with the townsfolk. Because of this, Palmyra claims that there is a conspiracy, which Edmon fights against and asks for Nananna's assistance. Because she sides with the town, Lilac and Shion believe her to be part of the conspiracy, and they decide to use their dream arts to influence the people's mental states. Palmyra then claims that the council is using the Witch rumors to get rid of inconvenient people, which Edmon also fights against, though is quickly silenced when she states she heard it herself from a council member and declares that there is no Witch. Unfortunately, Omega claims otherwise.

Despite angering Palmyra, Omega decides to clear things up by declaring that there were two conspiracies taking place in town. Despite Nananna trying to prevent her from talking, Omega ignores her and explains that many of the victims were relatives of council members, and she claims that Nananna is the second conspirator, calling her the bastard child of Edmon whose mother was banished from the town, and as a result, she despised the town. Noelle later appears and confirms that her actions were in response to the death of an [[Minor Characters#Elderly Healer|elderly healer]], and she claims that Nananna tried to remove her from the trial by knocking her out since her only ire was with Limbus. Afterward, Noelle declares that the secretary, Mireille, was helping Nananna, as she was a bastard child of Edmon as well, and she stated how the corpses of Piditz and other people connected to the council and other outside officials were already dumped in a hole. Omega also declares that she witnessed Mireille killing Piditz. Enraged, Mireille uses her spiritual arts to char Edmon's arm with blue fire, and with the intent of killing the entire council, surrounds the council with blue fire, and she and Nananna stand against them. Although Omega is fine with leaving things as they are and taking their leave, Colette states she doesn't want things to end like this, and Omega decides to end the fighting in response to her plea, burning through her restraints and declaring herself a Witch.

Later, as Omega's party begins to leave the town, Noelle says her goodbyes to Nananna, and it is declared that the evil spirit accompanying Mireille will be disposed of. Likewise, it is claimed that Edmon's position is under threat with both his severe injuries and the loss of the citizens' trust, and Mireille claims she was mistaken about real Witches. Despite Colette believing that things were settled peacefully, however, Omega thinks to herself that Limbus would soon face its destruction, as since Omega, Nananna, and Mireille were not executed, there would be continuous Witch Hunts and deaths for scapegoats for the whole incident. Although considering telling Colette about this, she decides against it.

==Abilities==
'''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): Lilac is skilled at using dream arts.
*'''Dream Arts''': A type of forbidden art that is all but lost from the world in the present that allows its user to meddle with the mind.<ref>''"Magic that uses dreams as intermediary to meddle with the opponent’s mind, in fact. On top of that, it is a kind of forbidden art, and its users were almost entirely eradicated, I suppose."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 4, Section 1.</ref> It is trained by using people as test subjects. After the person falls asleep, the practitioner must learn to sense and attune themselves to the person's Od before they die. Her proficiency with Dream Arts is considered impressive by Omega, who herself can use Dream Arts, and even surpasses her, being able to put an entire town to sleep for long periods of time and create a dream space larger than the [[Castle of Dreams]].
**'''Hypnosis Magic''': A form of magic that temporarily stops mana from flowing into the target's Od, severing their consciousness from reality. Hypnosis Magic is considered the specialty of Dream Arts Users.
**'''Thought Implantation''': Using Dream Arts, it is possible to place a thought into another person's head and leave them to act on it, such as making a person think of the user as an ally and making them stop any pursuers chasing after them.
**'''Memory Scouring''': As a Dream Arts user, Lilac is attuned to other people and is influenced by their memories. Likewise, if she chooses to, she can look into another person's memories to extract specific information. However, their target may show resistance, preventing her from reaching the memory she is looking for.

'''Possession''': As Shion's phantom, Lilac is able to take over her body in the real world, appearing as she does in the dream world. It is likely that her possession is limited only to Shion.

'''Equipment''': Shion carries a dagger around on her hip. However proficient she is with it is unknown.

==Trivia==
*Both Lilac and Shion initially debuted in the non-canon video game Re:Zero Lost in Memories. However, they were later written to be canon characters in [[The Witch's After Tea Party / Omega in Wonderland Part 1|The Witch's After Tea Party / Omega in Wonderland]].
*Lilac and Shion have a shared birthday on September 9, which is the anniversary of the Lost in Memories game's release.
*Like Shion, whose name shares a similar origin, Lilac's name comes from a flower called [[Wikipedia:Syringa vulgaris|Syringa Vulgaris]], also known as Lilac. However, unlike the flower's name, the name of the character Lilac does not include a hard C sound, and is instead pronounced as "Lyla".

Club |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 26|Volume 26]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Mizelda Shudrak''' (ミゼルダ・シュドラク) is the Chieftain of the [[Terminology#Races and Clans/Tribes|People of Shudrak]] located in the depths of the Buddheim Jungle, in the Empire of Vollachia. She played a supporting role in [[Arc 7]]. A charismatic leader and a prodigal huntress and combatant, Mizelda quickly rose to her position as the Shudrakian Chieftain, and she led them for years. Following her devastating injury she sustained during her fight with [[Arakiya]], Mizelda was unable to fulfill her duties as the Shudraks' Chieftain, thus prompting her younger sister [[Taritta Shudrak|Taritta]] to take her place. However, in the aftermath of the [[Great Disaster]], Mizelda and the Shudrak allowed Taritta to relinquish the role of Chieftain to stay with [[Flop O'Connell]], and after getting used to using her prosthetic leg in combat, she took the mantle of Chieftain once again. ==Appearance== Mizelda is a tall, strong woman with brown skin and green eyes. Her hair is black, but the top is dyed red and parted to one side. Due to the hot and somewhat moist weather, Mizelda, like most of her other people, wears minimal clothes. She also sports a pair of big, round golden earrings. After her fight with Arakiya, it is revealed that she lost a leg and uses a wooden prosthetic leg as a replacement. ==Personality== Mizelda is shown to be rather hostile towards outsiders and especially towards those who trample on their pride as proud hunters. While she does exhibit these traits, she is willing to listen to the pleas of [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent]] and even allow them to take the Ritual of Blood, albeit having them partake in the hardest and most dangerous ritual they have. After Subaru and Vincent successfully complete the ritual, Mizelda treats them as fellow hunters and agrees to help Subaru save [[Rem]] and [[Spica|Rui]]. She is quick to judge how a combatant fights, and she enjoys watching when someone triumphs in battle, such as when she witnessed Subaru's actions in the Lifeblood Ritual. She is also very protective of her tribe and very loyal to people that she considers her allies. She also tends to have some favoritism towards men who she considers has handsome faces, such as Vincent and [[Otto Suwen]]. This being said, she does not allow this to cloud her judgment, and as the chieftain of her tribe, she is willing to let go of her attraction in favor of leading her people within their jungle; this being said, she is not averse to someone she is attracted coming to stay with her people. While she herself would choose this, she is also willing to help her own people should they be conflicted about whether to remain within the jungle or choose life outside of it, as she did for her sister. However, she is particularly brutal towards her enemies. During the events of the [[Great Disaster]], shortly after the defeat of the Witch [[Sphinx]], disliking the deceptive words she was spouting, she took her dagger and slit her throat before repeatedly stabbing her. She also dislikes being treated like someone to be protected simply because of her gender. Like the rest of the Shudrakians, they were annoyed when [[Zikr Osman]] requested them to stay back while the rest of the army was prepared for a massive sacrifice during the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Mizelda is a powerful and prodigal combatant whose strength is renowned among her people. Likewise, she was capable of putting up a fight against Arakiya for a time, and her strength was acknowledged by Vincent to be worthy of the Nine Divine Generals. Even after having lost her leg and replacing it with a prosthetic, her strength does not appear to have diminished. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Melee Fighter''': Mizelda is also highly skilled at using her knife in combat. She used it to effectively fight [[Arakiya]] for a short time in close quarters, and later, she showed such skill with a pair of daggers that she was able to swiftly handle numerous golems created by [[Moguro Hagane]] with ease.''Although she boasted a prosthetic leg in place of the one she had lost, her unfaltering gait gave no sense of deficiency. Mizelda overtook the frontline of the battlefield, the place where the arrows of her allies flew towards mercilessly and, swinging her daggers in both hands, she tore apart the stone golems like a storm, opening a hole in their group.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 106, Section 3. '''Skilled Archer''': As is the case with most other members of her people, Mizelda is extremely skilled with her bow and its usage. '''Enhanced Eyesight''': Mizelda has excellent eyesight, easily surpassing a beastified [[Frederica Baumann]]'s, allowing her to see across a battlefield with ease.''Frederica was struck speechless at the sisters that conversed nonchalantly as they gazed at the rampart in the distance. As a half-beast, Frederica currently had better eyesight than usual in her beast form. Even so, she could see nothing other than the cloud of dust that hung over the wall the pair were gazing at.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 91, Section 1. ===Equipment=== *'''Hunting Tools''': As a hunter, Mizelda is typically armed with a bow and arrows or a knife. *'''Club''': During the Battle for the Imperial Capital, she used a club.''As she shouted angrily, she swung her club held in both her hands, crushing the head and upper body of the stone golem that had leapt towards her, effectively beating it at its own game.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 93, Section 1. *'''Daggers''': During the aforementioned battle, she also used a pair of glossy black daggers.''With glossy black daggers gripped in her hands, Mizelda said this as she raced across the battlefield.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 106, Section 3. ==Trivia== *If Mizelda had not lost her right leg, she would have been considered for an appointment to the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]].[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / The Magnificence of the Eminent Emperor of Vollachia]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia_Navbox}} [[Category:People of Shudrak]] [[Category:Leaders]]

She played a supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. Originally raised in an abusive orphanage with her brother, after having been saved by [[Miles]], she was brought to and raised in the Dracroy Domain, where she grew up with Flop, [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], and [[Carillon]]. Eventually, she decided to act as her brother’s bodyguard when he became a traveling merchant. Following the events of the [[Imperial Civil War]] and [[Great Disaster]], she became engaged to [[Vincent Vollachia]], becoming the Empress Consort of [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. ==Appearance== Medium is a tall woman with long cream blonde hair, which is the same color as her older brother. She wears her hair in a unique style. She is also described to be taller than her brother. She wears clothes that reveal her shoulders and legs, and she carries two barbarian swords on her waist. ==Personality== Medium is a bubbly, cheerful, and overall positive person who has a tendency to try to befriend and help the people around her. She very rarely exhibits sadness, and she is almost always seen smiling and interacting with others, even if some of those people come off as cold and standoffish, like Vincent. She is the type to think with her heart more than her head, and when her brother pointed this out, said words became a guiding light to her.''“Dear sister! We arrive at way better solutions when we think with our hearts, rather than racking our brains. That seems especially the case for you, so keep that in mind!”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 2, Section 10.''Those words that her brother had said a long time ago had served as an important guiding light within Medium, irrespective of her chest being shrunk or not.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 2, Section 10. She is also quick to feel praise, as a single compliment from Flop was enough to give her enough motivation to fight against experienced soldiers. She also believes quite heavily in her brother's dream, and since she wants to make his wish of "revenge" come true, alongside their strong bond built up in their harsh early life, Medium decided to accompany her brother and act as her bodyguard, and the two often worked together to leave strong impressions in the places that they visited, intent on leaving positive marks across the Empire. She also seems to have fun with children, as after she met [[Spica]], who was called Rui at the time, she could be seen fixing her hair and taking care of her. While Medium is usually a positive thinker, on rare occasions, she can be seen with short bursts of particularly strong negative emotions. Following the deaths of Miles, Balleroy, and Carillon, she was so saddened by their deaths that she wouldn't stop crying about it for a little while. She felt the same way after she learned that Balleroy and Carillon were revived in the Great Disaster as [[Undead#Zombies|zombies]]. When she and Flop were saved from the orphanage's caretaker by Miles and were given a chance to take out their grudges, Medium was quick to start stomping and beating on the caretaker alongside the other children out of payback for what the man had done. After she learned of Spica's history as [[Rui Arneb]] of the [[Witch Cult]], she froze and trembled in fear. In fact, in the non-canon Azamuku IF side story, after Flop was killed and his death blamed on the country's usurper, Medium was terribly distraught, angry, and dead set on vengeance. Azamuku aside, despite the tribulations her life has given her, she was able to quickly pick herself back up and keep fighting; in fact, in the case of Spica, she was terribly apologetic and wanted to fix their relationship, while in the case of Balleroy's "revival", it even inspired her so greatly that she experienced the greatest amount of strength she ever had. As stated before, Medium is very quick to offer her assistance to people, just like her brother. Shortly after meeting with [[Natsuki Subaru]], the amnesiac [[Rem]], and Spica, she was immediately friendly and positive with them, leaving a strong impression on them. Likewise, she and her brother were quick to trust and believe in them, as they both assisted the group in escaping [[Guaral]] after they were discovered by [[Todd Fang|one]] of their enemies. Not only did she and her brother assist them with this escape, but she was even willing to join the rebellion on their side after meeting with Vincent after her brother negotiated with the man. Because she is so trusting in her brother, she more often than not goes with his flow and almost always agrees with him when he makes a decision, often neglecting to use her head since her brother is the thinker between the two. That said, she can still be caught off guard by his decisions, especially when the concern her. During a discussion he had with Vincent regarding the future of the country, when he offered his sister's hand in marriage to the emperor, even though she had fallen for the man by this point, she was still stunned and didn't know how to react. This being said, she still went along with his decision out of both trust in Flop and love for Vincent. Medium also has a strong conviction in being a positive influence on people. After meeting the cold and cruel Vincent, she often tried to get through his tough exterior and be more emotional. Likewise, when she met [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and learned of his similar nature, Medium vowed to become a positive influence on the two of them so that they would become friendlier and learn how to be more social and caring, intent on becoming something of a role model.''“That’s why, I’ll make myself a role model for Ros-chin and Abel-chin.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 5. ==History== When she was young, she and her brother Flop grew up in an orphanage in a small town called Averyk, where they were routinely beaten by adults. One day, an imperial soldier named Miles arrived at the orphanage and promptly beat and tied up the adults in charge of the orphanage. Along with the other kids, aside from Flop, she beat the tied-up adults out of rage from her abuse. Soon after, she and Flop were brought to the Dracroy Domain, where [[Serena Dracroy]] resided. Understanding their circumstances, she became an older sister figure to the two of them and allowed them to reside in her domain. A few years after this, they met Balleroy Temeglyph, and they helped him raise the newborn Carillon. At some point, when Carillon lost some of his baby teeth, they were made into a necklace that he started to wear. At some point, Medium fell in love with Balleroy. Some years after this, Flop decided to set out from the Dracroy Domain to become a merchant to achieve his revenge, with Medium acting as his bodyguard. During their travels, however, they heard of the demise of Balleroy, Carillon, and Miles, each of which saddened them and left Medium crying. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 4|Undead Busters]]=== During her time as the new empress, rather than subjecting herself to typical royal behavior, she had been sparring with the imperial soldiers, which Flop had praised her for. However, as she was insecure about how to be a good wife to Vincent, she asked for advice from [[Yorna Mishigure]], Serena, and [[Madelyn Eschart]]. Soon after, [[Cecilus Segmunt]]'s group, who had been tasked to deal with the remaining undead, returned to speak with Vincent about [[Volcas]]. Soon after, Yorna and Volcas, who had recognized her as Iris, engaged in combat, though Volcas mostly did not fight back. Following the events of the battle, Volcas sought to be executed by Vincent with the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]], whereas Yorna obstinately did not want to accept that outcome. Realizing that there was a possibility Yorna could revolt again, Medium, Vincent's new empress consort, suggested to Vincent that Volcas should be chosen to fill the vacancy in the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]]. She believed her proposal would not only cater to Yorna and fill the vacancy left by [[Chisha Gold]], but with Volcas being the direct cause behind [[Eugard Vollachia]]'s decree to execute the wolf people and mole people, forgiving him and having him join their side would show that Vincent was serious about keeping the decree rescinded. Vincent took the proposal seriously, and when Medium accidentally let slip that the suggestion was her brother's, she told Vincent that she just wanted to improve Vincent's view of her as his empress. Regardless, after hearing Medium out, Vincent proceeded to meet with Volcas in person to discuss her proposal with him, walking with Medium hand-in-hand. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護, ''Kago''): Medium possesses the '''Divine Protection of Morale''' (高揚の加護, ''Kōyō no Kago''). The more excited or motivated Medium feels, the more her physical abilities increase in response.''To speak plainly, the Divine Protection of Morale was something that would boost the physical capabilities of one’s body in concert with how roused their spirits and determination were.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 4. At its best, Medium can become strong enough to counter even the magic bullets fired by Balleroy.''――The next moment, a bullet of light was fired after a beat had passed, and Medium cut it down with her unsheathed barbarian sword.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 5. However, the Divine Protection is a double-edged sword, as since it is affected by Medium's mood, it also diminishes her abilities if she feels sad or enters a depressive state. It has been said that usually, she's practically immoveable, yet while she is at her weakest, she can be toppled over with ease.''But, the troublesome aspect of the Divine Protection of Morale was undoubtedly that fluctuations in one’s mood influenced their ability; while the elevation of one’s feelings would enhance their abilities, it was a double-edged sword, to the extent that if their feelings were down, they would become unable to display their capabilities.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 4.''Ergo, it could be called the most suitable Divine Protection for the bright, positive Medium, but it had backfired when events sorrowful to the greatest degree had occurred within her life.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 4. Additionally, Medium is unaware that she owns this Divine Protection.''Medium was unaware of her own Divine Protection, and even her older brother Flop was unknowing that his younger sister was the possessor of a Divine Protection.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 4. Her physical strength is not the only thing affected by her Divine Protection. Her other senses are also improved; her sight, when influenced to its best by her Divine Protection, achieved the same level as Balleroy's scope.''That was not an issue of Roswaal’s eyesight. It was simply a matter of the human eye being unable to do so. However, Medium and the opposing Magical Sharpshooter were both overcoming that limitation through the power of a Divine Protection and through some sort of other technique respectively, and had visually identified each other.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 4, Section 6. '''Equipment''': Medium carries two barbarian swords on her waist which she uses to fight with, and she is talented enough with them to not only delay the [[Imperial Army]] long enough for Flop and Subaru to escape from them, but also to regularly spar with them and come out almost always victorious. ==Trivia== *Medium's birthday, April 10, is the same day as Flop's birthday, but they are two years apart in age. *Medium has her own named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8: Vincent Vollachia|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|light novels]]. *According to the author, Medium would send letters to Subaru and [[Emilia]] in the future.July 26, 2026 Talk Show ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 29|Volume 29]] (main story)}} '''Madelyn Eschart''' (マデリン・エッシャルト) is the '''Sixth ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]]''' of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. She played an antagonistic role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]] and a small supporting role toward the end of the latter arc. A dragonkin created by the Cloud Dragon [[Mezoreia]], she spent the earliest days of her life with her fellow dragons. After meeting and being named "Madelyn" by [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], she eventually desired to venture from her home. However, upon learning of his death, she followed his footsteps, eventually leading her to being offered the same position by [[Berstetz Fondalfon]]. Now with the name Eschart, she continued her search for traces of the man she loved. ==Appearance== Madelyn is a young girl with golden eyes and light blue hair, the tips of which are a darker and tied into two long braids. She has blue wings that sprout out of her back and two deep black horns that rise from her head. Additionally, a bright purple bow is wrapped around her left horn. She wears a bright blue dress with white-colored circles and is usually seen with her Flying Winged Blade, which is folded upon her back when sheathed. ==Personality== Madelyn is childish, prideful, and often emotional. She looks down on most people while expecting them to obey her orders. As a result of viewing herself as superior for being a dragonkin, she expects to be both respected and feared, only seeming to show care to those who abide by her standards. When she is put in a situation where she doesn't get her way, Madelyn lashes out in frustration and sometimes lampoons herself for bringing shame to her tribe. Although she is not fond of humans making so much noise despite their weakness and fragility, as a dragonkin, she also seems to like treasures and human craftsmanship, and she seems to feel the urge to hoard them, even if it means obeying humans to receive them as a reward.''She did not like that humans were so noisy in spite of how weak and fragile they were, but their craftsmanship utilizing gems and gold had an irreplaceable charm. It was not a bad idea to fulfill the tasks assigned to her by humans, so she could receive such things as a reward. Heaping those up in her den, cramming them in, and surrounding herself with them as she slept took an important role in Madelyn’s quality of sleep. ――However, neither gems nor gold could fill the hole in her heart.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 40, Section 2. However, when it comes to the ones she loves, Balleroy, she shows a softer side, and she often refers to them as hers. She also shows this side of herself to [[Carillon]] and is typically friendly with him. Similarly, her love for Balleroy is so strong that she is even willing to change sides during a war if he is on the opposing side, such as during the [[Great Disaster]], and she is willing to kill people who cause him trouble.''"If he’s causing trouble for this dragon’s darling, this dragon will tear him apart with her own hands."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 40, Section 2. Likewise, when it comes to the people connected to Balleroy, although she still exhibits her temperamental attitude, she is not unwilling to ignore an invitation from them; when she was regularly invited by [[Medium O'Connell]] to have tea and snacks with her, she often accepted, and she was even willing to explain her experiences with Balleroy to her when she needed marital advice. ==History== Madelyn was created by Mezoreia, and for many years, she lived alone at the summit of Mount Palzoa with the Dragon.''――Madelyn was born at the summit of Mount Palzoa, the mountain where the Cloud Sea City of Mezoreia was located.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 5, Section 7. After some time, a stranger and his flying dragon, Balleroy and Carillon, found Madelyn and Mezoreia after breaking through the cloud sea, something no other human had done before. Balleroy was surprised to see the girl, and he started coming to spend time with her after this, giving her the name Madelyn after someone he once knew and giving her clothes, other gifts, and teaching her how to speak.''The name Madelyn, was also something Balleroy had given to her. At a loss for what to call her, he asked for her name, and when the young child replied that she had no name, he earnestly wracked his brain, and decided on that name to give her.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 4.''Giving her a name, giving her words, and giving her clothes, he had granted her happiness. Madelyn counted the things Balleroy had granted her, and remembered them all.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 4. Over time, the two became close with Madelyn coming to love Balleroy, and he sought to bring her outside of Mount Palzoa. This resulted in a fight between him and Mezoreia, though they made peace in the end. Balleroy stopped trying to take her away from the mountain, and eventually, he stopped visiting the summit altogether. One day, Madelyn decided to go out of the mountain summit on her own, and after realizing how big the world was, she began searching for Balleroy of her own accord, with Mezoreia flying in the sky to watch over her. Following his scent, she eventually learned of Balleroy’s death through Berstetz, which set her on a path to understand why he was killed and get revenge on the person who did it,''The first, was to act impulsively with her unmanageable emotions, and follow the same path as Balleroy, who had been defeated as an enemy of the Empire.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 5. with Berstetz offering her Balleroy’s position as the Ninth Divine General and the name Eschart after a fallen noble family.''The other, was to accept the endorsement of Berstetz, whom she had just met here, become a member of the Nine Divine Generals like Balleroy once had been, and while tracing back his footsteps, wait for an opportunity for retribution.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 5.''"――Madelyn Eschart. It is an old family name of Vollachia that is no longer around, but it shall be passed down to you. Prestige is quite important, after all."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 5. During a meeting that took place two to three months after Balleroy's death, Madelyn was suggested by Berstetz to inherit Balleroy's position as the Ninth ranking Divine General despite not having any concrete accomplishments and being largely unknown to the other Divine Generals. ===[[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7|Sword Identity]]=== When [[Yorna Mishigure]] began an uprising after the death of [[Tanza]]'s [[Zoey|sister]], Madelyn attempted to confront her and failed to give Yorna or Tanza any damage due to the Soul Marriage Technique. After being unable to achieve any results, Madelyn later reiterated a message that Yorna gave her to the other Divine Generals stating the conditions for ending the ongoing rebellion after surprising some of the other Divine Generals and entering a brief clash with them. After her performance alongside [[Chisha Gold]] in searching for the escaped soldiers and [[Kafma Irulux]]'s resignation from the offer, the [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]] was given no other choice but to accept Berstetz's proposal and appoint her as the Ninth ranking Divine General. From then on, she continued searching for any hints into Balleroy that she could, feeling worse as she felt that she was tainting his memory and the position he once held in the process. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 4|Undead Busters]]=== After Medium O'Connell became Vincent's empress consort, she would sometimes visit Medium due to her connection with Balleroy. Eventually, Medium invited her, Yorna, and [[Serena Dracroy]] to visit her for marital advice. Despite her confusion about why she was invited, she nonetheless gave her experiences with Balleroy to help advise Medium. Before long, [[Cecilus Segmunt]]'s party returned to [[Garkla]], intending to speak with Vincent about how to handle [[Volcas]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Madelyn is an incredibly powerful warrior. Despite being at the bottom of the Nine Divine Generals, she is capable of ignoring most damage and even fighting against incredibly powerful warriors on the level of [[Emilia]] and [[Priscilla Barielle]]. Furthermore, should she find herself desperate, she can summon forth a Dragon and even take over its body, providing her with significantly more power than she would ordinarily possess. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Inhuman Strength''': Madelyn has immense physical strength due in part to her race as a dragonkin. She can effortlessly throw her Flying Winged Blade with ease. By comparison, someone as physically strong as Emilia struggled to lift it and failed to throw it properly. On top of which, she has enough strength to easily break through a glacier-like wall of ice with ease with a simple grip of her hands,''Muttering, Madelyn gently placed her hand on the wall of ice before her eyes. Gazing at that gesture, Emilia reflexively caught her breath with an “Ah”. ――With a crack, the very moment that high-pitched noise reverberated, the entirety of the gigantic ice wall began to fissure with the pattern of a spiderweb. The origin was naturally Madelyn’s palm, so the fissures that extended across the entire ice wall were centered on her.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2.''A violent sound rang out, as Madelyn crushed the ice wall with her grip. There was no other way to describe it than “crushed it with her grip”. She tightened her grip with the hand placed on the wall, and from there, the destruction spread throughout the entire ice wall; it had been shattered in one fell swoop.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2. as well as generate shockwaves while swinging her weapon.''The Flying Winged Blade that struck down hit the ground, and a moment later, a shock wave impacted Emilia’s entire body. Hit by the same force, the Weaponkin that had failed to escape were blown far away. The Dragonkin’s raw strength was absurd, even more so than the already strong Emilia.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2. '''Inhuman Durability''': Madelyn is also incredibly physically tough. During her fights with Emilia, she seemed to take no damage at all despite having had glaciers dropped on her multiple times. Similarly, almost none of Emilia’s attacks seemed to affect her either.''Brandishing a pair of ice swords, she proceeded to rain down attacks on Madelyn, who had not been able to fully halt the momentum of the initial strike. Although, when the pair of swords struck the shoulders of Madelyn, her arms widespread, they shattered into pieces. The tough skin of the dragonkin remained unyielding to the sword slashes of ice. She needed to use even heavier attacks.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2.''As soon as she gripped it tightly, the handle of the ice mallet shattered. ――No, it was not just the handle, the entire thing had been destroyed. The ice mallet that had struck Madelyn’s head was the one unable to bear the opponent’s hardness. Emilia widened her eyes upon seeing that, and simultaneously, the claws below her eyes rose sharply.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2. '''Sharp Claws''': Though she typically doesn't use them in combat, Madelyn has very sharp claws that are easily capable of rending flesh. A single swipe from her claws nearly killed [[Flop O'Connell]] when she hit him, and they were easily capable of ripping through Emilia's ice.''The moment the claws moved within the edges of her vision, a small shield of ice intercepted its trajectory. "Oww!" However, the ice shield was smashed at that instant, and cries of pain erupted.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2. Even a slight graze can cause heavily shake a person and disorient them.''After having poured energy into her body at an earned moment, the side of her head was slashed by the claw tips, and at the slight impact of her silver hair being grazed, Emilia’s vision greatly and violently shook.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2. '''Body Heat Increase''': Madelyn seems to be able to increase her body’s heat to the point that snow instantly evaporates around her. However, what this does for her abilities, if it does anything for them at all, is unknown.''With these words, Madelyn’s body slowly began releasing steam. In the cold air, dyed white by her exhaled breath, her body continued to heat up as it radiated her visibly rising fighting spirit.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2. This being said, it allows her to resist cold-based attacks and fight in spite of it.''Madelyn’s body temperature was so absurdly high that every single snowflake evaporated upon coming into contact with her―― no, that happened before they could even reach her. The same thing was also happening around Mezoreia, the “Puck Copycat” tactic was not really effective on these two.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 1. '''Enhanced Olfaction''': As a dragonkin, Madelyn's sense of smell is greater than a human's. With it, she can follow a person's scent, even after their death.''The location was Balleroy’s residence that remained in the Imperial Capital, which she had discovered by pursuing his scent.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 5. ===Other=== '''Possession''': As a dragonkin, Madelyn has the ability to possess the Dragon who created her, Mezoreia, and by doing so, she gains access to the full power held by it.''“The Cloud Dragon, Mezoreia… is that which resides within, Madelyn Eschart!?”'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 108, Section 2.''――Storing her own mind within the dragonhusk of Mezoreia, she controlled its movements as if it were her own.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 2. However, her original body remains unconscious while doing this, and attempting to disturb it will not end her possession of a Dragon.''Her limbs growing languid, Madelyn collapsed on the spot. Promptly drawing her body towards himself, Balleroy firmly supported the unimaginable weight of her small stature. Then, in his arms, he picked up Madelyn, who had lost consciousness―― No, she had regained consciousness.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 40, Section 2. *'''Shared Senses''': Even when not possessing Mezoreia, Madelyn seems to be able to share senses with Mezoreia. It does not seem that she physically shares one of the five senses, but that she immediately becomes aware when Mezoreia becomes aware of the presence of other beings.''Something had been caught. By Madelyn’s senses―― no, by the senses of the dragonhusk, Mezoreia.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 40, Section 2. '''Wind Strikes''': Madelyn is capable of gathering wind around her claws and firing it off as a projectile alongside a swipe of her claws.''The howling Madelyn raised her claws overhead. The wind of destruction that followed turned over the surface of the ground. She promptly flew backwards as to avoid the claws, but the wind that arrived afterward struck her, and Emilia’s body was flicked away, having been hit in kind. Engulfed by the ground turning over like waves, Emilia’s body bounced, bounced, being blown away.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2. It is unclear if this kind of attack is inherent to her claws, based in her physical strength, or if she can freely manipulate the wind; regardless, it easily has enough strength to damage the ground and send someone of Emilia's caliber flying and bouncing off of the ground. '''Dragon Command''': As a dragonkin, Madelyn has the ability to make emotional connections with dragons. However, she has only demonstrated use of this ability with Flying Dragons in order to give them commands. During the [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm]] in the [[Guaral|Fortress City of Guaral]], Madelyn was able to command a flock of dragons to converge at the city and wreak havoc on it. It is unknown if there is a limit to how many dragons she is able to command at once, and likewise, it is unknown if she is the only dragonkin capable of doing this. However, she cannot command random undead flying dragons, as they will attack her merely for possessing life.''Even if the other deceased flying dragons―― the undead flying dragons, came into contact with Madelyn, they would regard her as someone who had life, and would relentlessly begin attacking her.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 40, Section 2. ===Equipment=== *'''Flying Winged Blade''' (飛翼刃): The Flying Winged Blade is a heavy boomerang-like weapon that can return to its wielder once it is thrown.''Emilia quickly dodged the Flying Winged Blade, which roared furiously as it cut through the wind, but as it circled back the battlefield with its roar, the Flying Winged Blade returned with frightening precision.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2. However, it is a difficult weapon to use and master, as even someone as physically capable as Emilia was unable to throw it right after attempting.''She was trying to return the favor and deal damage, but she was completely unable to handle the Flying Winged Blade well, so it had flown away. On the forehead of Madelyn, who had been angered by that, a vein had begun to bulge very quickly.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 2. ==Trivia== *Madelyn, along with Kafma Irulux, was a character derived from random sketches made by the series's illustrator, Otsuka Shinichirou. *Madelyn has her own named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8: Vincent Vollachia|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|light novels]]. *Though never seen, [[Goz Ralfon]] speculated Madelyn may have a tail. *According to the author, Madelyn has begun making an effort to understand humans better.April 5, 2026 Talk Show. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Generals]] [[Category:Nine Divine Generals]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]]

'''Madara''' (マダラ) is a bear [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] that introduced as a new character in [[Re:Zero Lost in Memories]] when Emilia and the rest of her camp, as well as [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]], were transported into the past while the [[Demi-Human War]] was ongoing. He is also one of the major antagonists in the chapter.

==Appearance==
Madara was a large bear that somewhat resembles of a polar bear. He had golden yellow eyebrows and blue eyes. He had a muscular build with light metal armor on his left shoulder and abdomen with red fur under it.

==Personality==
It isn't clear what was he like when he was alive, but in his undead form, he's known to be so savage that he drools from his mouth.

==Abilities==
'''Demi-Human Physique''': Madara demonstrates a variety of enhanced physique and physiology due to his demi-human blood.
*'''Inhuman Strength''': Due to being a demi-human, Madara is extremely strong.
*'''Enhanced Sense of Smell''': The potency of his sense of smell was also far greater than a regular human's. He can distinguish the scents of separate individuals from a considerable distance.

'''Vespal Rider''': Madara rides a large bee-like [[Witchbeast|witchbeast]] called Vespal.

'''Equipment'''
*'''Lance''': Madara weilds a giant metal Lance during combat.

==Trivia==
*The Madara Squadron was a private military group that was not known to the world.
*Leip was apparently the one who hired the Madara Squadron. However, he wasn't even aware of their existence.

Pink (dyed) |Eye Color = |Height = |Weight = |Affiliation = |Previous Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]]
People of Shudrak |Occupation = |Previous Occupation = [[Stargazer]]
Shudrak Guardian |Status = Deceased |Relatives = [[Utakata Shudrak]] (daughter) |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30|Volume 30]] (flashback) |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Mariuli Shudrak''' (マリウリ・シュドラク) was a member of the [[Terminology#Races and Clans/Tribes|People of Shudrak]] and a former [[Stargazer]]. She was first mentioned in [[Arc 7]] as [[Taritta Shudrak|Taritta's]] soul sister, since both of them were born on the same day, and she was also [[Utakata Shudrak|Utakata's]] mother. Though she loved to raise and care for the Shudrakian children in place of her lacking huntress skills and frail body, as a Stargazer, she was chosen by the observers to complete their commandments. On her deathbed, she entrusted her last commandment - to kill the black-haired individual who would appear in the jungle - to Taritta, before ending her own life before sickness could claim her. ==Appearance == Mariuli was described to be a beautiful woman with black hair of which the tips were died pink. ==Personality== She was said to be a gentle and calm person. Kind at heart, she spent much of her days helping around the village and looking after the kids, singing to them. According to Taritta, her voice was so beautiful that every time the tribe had a feast, everyone would ask her to sing to them, which she happily obliged. Unlike most other Shudrakians, however, Mariuli did not feel at peace by simply living, breathing and dying the Shudrakian way, and sought meaning to her birth and life. When on her death bed, the thing she most lamented wasn't the impending doom or the fact she won't see her child anymore, but the fact she had lived out her life without fulfilling her supposed destiny and killing the one who was supposed to bring the Empire to ruin years following her death. ==History== Having been born on the same day as Taritta, the two have therefore been named soul sisters; an ancient Shudrak tradition dictating that two individuals born on the very same day are connected via their souls. Hence, ever following their birth, Taritta and Mariuli were inseparable. Throughout her early life, however, Mariuli had been plagued by ill health, spending much of her days bedridden and was therefore bestowed the role of a guardian; one of the two jobs widely claimed throughout the tribe, subserving her status amongst the tribeswomen as someone who's in charge of cooking, taking care of the kids and defending the settlement if necessary. At some point in her life, however, Mariuli had been blessed by the stars and was chosen as a Stargazer which granted her a very special task to fulfil, which she kept referring to as her "commandment". Following her revelation, Mariuli started to change according to Taritta; she started singing new songs unfamiliar to her fellow members of the tribe and continuously blessed the village with knowledge inaccessible to someone who was yet to set food outside the jungle and interact with the outside world. At some point, she had a child and gave birth to Utakata. Due to her ill health, however, she soon found herself bedridden, this time however, on death's door. In her final moments, Mariuli conveyed her commandment as a Stargazer to Taritta, asking her to find the black haired and black eyed traveller who was supposedly about to trigger the Great Disaster which will plunge the Empire into ruin, and kill them, before plunging Taritta's knife deep into her chest, dying soon afterwards. ==Abilities== '''Weak Constitution''': Due to her frail body and ill health, Mariuli wasn't a very capable warrior. In fact, she was so incapable with the bow that if she was given one and was told to shoot a hundred arrows towards a target, she'd likely miss all hundred of them. '''[[Stargazer]]''' (星詠み, ''Hoshiyomi''): As a Stargazer, she was given commandments by the observers. It is due to this that she was granted bits of knowledge that she should not have been privy to, such as the songs sung by other stargazers. That said, it is also the cause of her seeming change in personality and nigh fanaticism. {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:People of Shudrak]] [[Category:Guardians]] [[Category:Stargazer]] [[Category:Deceased]]

'''Mezoreia''' (メゾレイア), also known as the '''Cloud Dragon''' (雲龍 ''Unryū''), is a [[Dragon]] that resides in the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], and it is the Dragon responsible for the creation of the dragonkin, [[Madelyn Eschart]]. It played an antagonistic role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]].

==Appearance==
Mezoreia is a colossal Dragon with a white body said to be clad in pure white clouds and black eyes.<ref>''Immediately before this moment, Mezoreia had tried to swing its Dragon arm to obliterate Cecilus. Having stopped moving in midair, its white eyeballs with pupils and irises black stared at a single point.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 106, Section 4.</ref>

==Personality==
As a dragonhusk, Mezoreia has lost most of its personality and capability of speech after creating a [[Dragon#Dragonkin|dragonkin]]. However, because Madelyn is still alive, Mezoreia has not lost its spirit, and it retains traces of its personality. It is shown to be highly protective of Madelyn, treating her as a daughter figure, and it has also shown to be friendly toward any visitors it may receive atop Mount Palzoa, assuming they were not hostile towards it or Madelyn. This being said, it has also shown to be willing to fight anyone who wants to take Madelyn away from it. Even after Madelyn left the mountain, it followed her around, hidden above the clouds, and though it ordinarily did not interfere in actions on the ground, it displayed no issues in following her commands or allowing her to take over its body. Also, similarly to [[Volcanica]], Mezoreia appears to speak in a deific manner.

==History==
At some point, Mezoreia used its power to create a young Dragonkin girl in exchange for becoming a dragonhusk. Alongside its kin, it lived on the peak of Mount Palzoa, and it spent its days caring for the girl.

After some time, a stranger and his flying dragon, [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] and [[Carillon]], found Mezoreia and its Dragonkin after breaking through the cloud sea, something no other human had done before. Balleroy was surprised to see the young girl and the Dragon, and he started coming to spend time with her after this, giving the girl the name Madelyn after someone he once knew and giving her clothes, other gifts, and teaching her how to speak. Despite being initially wary of him, Mezoreia grew used to his presence and allowed him to keep returning to visit. Over time, Balleroy and Madelyn became close, with Madelyn coming to love Balleroy, and he sought to bring her outside of Mount Palzoa. However, disapproving of this, it resulted in a fight between him and Mezoreia. After a grueling fight, they made peace, and Balleroy stopped trying to take her away from the mountain. Eventually, however, he stopped visiting the summit altogether. When Madelyn decided to leave Mount Palzoa, rather than try to stop her, Mezoriea decided to follow her, hiding itself within the clouds above wherever she went.

==Abilities==
===Overall Power===
As a Dragon, Mezoreia is a naturally powerful being, capable of overwhelming the majority of warriors within seconds and bringing an end to a large number of people in an instant. Despite not being as old, nor nearly as powerful, as some others of its kind, it is still incredibly difficult to survive an encounter with Mezoreia, and only some of the most powerful of warriors can pose a threat to its might.

===Physical Traits===
'''Overwhelming Physical Might''': As a Dragon, Mezoreia is incredibly strong and resistant to damage. Its natural physical might and size are powerful enough that it can deal tremendous damage with small movements, and it can even deal enough damage to kill most lesser beings with ease.

'''Talons''': Mezoreia's talons are extremely sharp, said to be sharper than any run-of-the-mill blade.<ref>''The Dragon’s claws were much sharper than any run-of-the-mill sword, able to cleave Emilia’s body in twain with ease.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 1.</ref> It has shown to be easily capable of tearing through [[Emilia]]'s Ice Soldiers, which were made of ice so dense that they could be compared to steel.<ref>''Naturally, the Ice Soldier had been incapable of escaping in time, thus falling prey to the Dragon’s claws, which smashed it to pieces. '' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 1.</ref>

'''Tail''': Mezoreia can use its long tail to rupture the ground beneath it,<ref>''Immediately after, a tail cleaved the snowy ground where Emilia had been just moments before with tremendous speed, instantly rupturing the ground and evaporating the snow.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 99, Section 3.</ref> and it can easily deal enough damage that someone of [[Garfiel Tinzel]]'s strength would feel as if they were on the verge of death multiple times over.

'''Wings''': Although ordinarily meant for assisting it with flight, Mezoreia's wings can easily be used to cause damage over a wide span, including handily dealing with densified ice created by Emilia.<ref>''There was a jerk from its unfurled wings, and the wall of ice Emilia had erected was effortlessly torn apart. Although not quite as solid as iron, she had done her best to harden it. And yet, it had been easily broken, and before Emilia could feel any disappointment or surprise, she was hurriedly dodging bullets of ice hurtling towards her.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 99, Section 3.</ref>

'''Body Heat Increase''': Mezoreia seems to be able to increase its body heat to the point that snow instantly evaporates around her. It allows it to resist cold-based attacks and fight in spite of it.<ref>''Madelyn’s body temperature was so absurdly high that every single snowflake evaporated upon coming into contact with her―― no, that happened before they could even reach her. The same thing was also happening around Mezoreia, the “Puck Copycat” tactic was not really effective on these two.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 1.</ref>

'''Dragon Scales''': Mezoreia's scales are tremendously tough and grant it resistance to physical strikes. Although nowhere near as refined as Volcanica's scales, Mezoreia's are strong enough to allow it to resist the majority of damage dealt its way, including from strikes as powerful as Emilia's kicks armed with her ice weapons,<ref>''The leg Emilia had utilized to deliver this kick had been equipped with footwear made of ice, donning an enlarged spike with extreme sharpness, making it an awfully lethal weapon. Since Emilia had used her foot, she did not pull any punches with this merciless kick―― so an absurdly brutal blow slammed into the side of Mezoreia’s defenseless head.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 1.</ref><ref>''Mezoreia’s huge body did not budge an inch from getting kicked in the face.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 1.</ref> and though he was eventually able to deal significant damage to Mezoreia, it was even capable of reducing how much damage a warrior of Garfiel's standing was able to deal it, such as escaping a powerful strike with only a nosebleed.

'''Dragon Halo''': Mezoreia's halo allows Mezoreia to withstand strikes from magic. Although nowhere near as refined as Volcanica's halo, it provides enough defense to easily protect it from magic as strong as Emilia's.

===[[Magic]]===
'''Heavenly Mana''': The mana held within Mezoreia is so powerful and vast that it is both highly destructive as well as capable of extending its command over the very skies.

'''Flight''': Dragons use their mana to fly while using their wings to assist in their flight. Mezoreia flight speed is rather high, being compared to an arrow shot at full force,<ref>''Once the Dragon had decided to fly and started moving, its speed was extraordinary, turning back and rising into the sky so swiftly, that it was like an arrow being shot with full force.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 106, Section 4.</ref> and moments after taking off, it was able to cross the entirety of the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]] and reach the Crystal Palace from the bastions in mere moments.

'''Dragon Breath''': Mezoreia’s breath creates a white beam of light that can easily alter terrain. Upon hitting its target, the beam creates a powerful shockwave that makes the ground rise and causes buildings to rip from their foundations.<ref>''Perhaps it lasted for less than a second in actuality, but once that burst, the spreading shockwave, originating from the southern portion of the city, engulfed the Fortress City all around, and everything flipped over. Ground rose from the surface, as buildings were ripped from their foundations.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30]], Chapter 5, Section 9.</ref> If necessary, Mezoreia is capable of firing off multiple weaker but consecutive blasts.<ref>''It was not that it had emitted a single breath to mow down the entirety of this block of the Imperial Capital in one go, rather, it had split it up into short bursts. Instead of letting out one long breath, it had released two breaths in quick succession. ――No, not two. Considering it was splitting up one breath, it could do the same thing for a third and fourth time.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 44, Section 1.</ref>

'''Weather Manipulation''': As the Cloud Dragon, it could spread its mana across the heavens in order to generate and manipulate clouds.<ref>''Following the beck and call of the Cloud Dragon, Mezoreia, clouds had gathered from across the entire Empire―― with the Mana that Mezoreia could not keep stored within itself sealed within them, they were a destructive impulse of white.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> It usually uses this to hide its form while it flies in the sky. However, it is also capable of concentrating all of its mana through the clouds and making them converge at one point,<ref>''Following the beck and call of the Cloud Dragon, Mezoreia, clouds had gathered from across the entire Empire―― with the Mana that Mezoreia could not keep stored within itself sealed within them, they were a destructive impulse of white.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref> creating a funnel of thunderclouds that contained enough power to erase both the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]].<ref>''The destructive black clouds acted to entirely veil the heavens, and Garfiel ground his fangs in midair, for he instinctively sensed that they concealed enough power to devastate the Imperial Capital's cityscape.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 5, Section 9.</ref><ref>''However, different from the impression given by the phrasing of “a hail of bullets and a forest of blades”, the clouds of destruction bringing doom upon the world were not widely raining down across all the vast lands of the Empire, but rather, having been centralized in one swoop, they were about to all pierce one concentrated area. ――The vortex of black clouds twisted into a helix, forming an enormous cone that weaved into the heavenly skies.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 5, Section 10.</ref> The full extent of this, however, was not revealed, as it was prevented prematurely.

'''Wind Manipulation''': Mezoreia is capable of manipulating the wind, generating attacks with such force that it can easily gouge out the ground and kill anything caught up in it.<ref>''The next moment, a strong wind raged where Emilia and Cecilus had been, and the shockwave that the Dragon had used the ground as a conduit for gouged that place, making all the soil in a certain range of that spot shoot out.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 104, Section 2.</ref>

==Trivia==
*The Cloud Dragon shares its name with a city in Vollachia. However, there is currently no known connection between it and the Cloud Sea City of Mezoreia.

'''Maqueena''' (マクウィナ) is a bard who previously masqueraded as a con artist.

==Appearance==
Maqueena is a young woman with wavy brown hair.

==Personality==
Maqueena is an eccentric girl who is easily frightened, overly judgmental, and quick to complain or deride people if they are not to her liking. However, she possesses a cunning and shrewd wit, having been the only known individual who discovered [[Coatl|Coatl's]] past profession. She puts her self-interest first, being open to mistreating, blackmailing, and even drugging strangers for her own benefit. Despite trying to be a bard, her singing capabilities are completely lacking.

==History==
===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 1|One Wild Night]]===
To get by as a resident of [[Gusteko]], Maqueena chose to become a con artist. She outwardly pretended to be a bard as a front for her true profession, and at some point, she perceived the connection between Coatl and the Ice Thieves that accidentally caused an avalanche in the town of Leanotte. She blackmailed the man in the wake of her discoverey and extorted money from him countless times, becoming more adjusted to the layout of the church he resided in as well as the route to and from it with each visit. One day, she arrived at the church to seek out Coatl, only to discover that he was nowhere to be found. Over the course of the day, a blizzard would form, and several more people would enter the church; the second to enter was [[Podoso]], the third was [[Admonsah]], followed by [[Omega|Omega]] and [[Omega Party|her group]] with [[Noelle Tuérico]].

After a near death encounter with one of Admonsah's throwing knives, Maqueena acquainted herself with everyone and told the story of Coatl's heroism with her subpar skills as a bard. Since the ongoing blizzard left the group stuck in the church, she attempted to retrieve Coatl's money by herself, but was accompanied by Podoso, much to her reluctance. [[Trellock]] arrived at the church around the time she was entering the church's hidden basement, and shortly afterward, she screamed upon the discovery that Coatl had been murdered, inciting a sense of horror in her and everyone else, and quickly took the key to his safe before the others could arrive. As Omega attempted to piece together the circumstances of Coatl's death, Maqueena was in shock to learn of the recent serial murders and objected to the group's quick acceptance of Admonsah when his background and his killing done in self-defense were deduced.

Shortly after Maqueena heard Omega's supposition that Coatl's murderer had the key to his safe, she used pollen from the sleeping flower, Muskrim, to make everyone fall unconscious and quickly attempted to make a getaway. However, she was pursued by Noelle, a survivor from Leanotte's avalanche who joined the [[Gustekan Church]] as an Itinerant Preacher to seek revenge against the Ice Thieves for their actions. She was under the misconception that Maqueena was one of their members and made an attempt on her life until Omega prevented her from being killed. Omega revealed Maqueena's true profession and gave Noelle an ultimatum while manifesting her true form, ultimately resulting in nobody dying. The next day, Maqueena was bound by a rope for her crimes and taken to Leanotte by Podoso and Admonsah, swearing that she would live a simple life and practice being a bard from then on.

==Abilities==
'''Equipment''': Maqueena performs using a musical instrument known as a '''lyulyre''' (リュリーレ). It is a cross between a guitar and a ukulele in appearance.
