'''Leonardo Baroness''' (リオナルド・バロネス) is a doctor who specializes in working with blood.

==Appearance==
Leonardo is a scrawny bat human with lifeless grey hair, morbidly pale, dry skin, and visible bones, all of which give him the impression of appear like a moving corpse. He has thin fingers and wears a cloak with countless vials of blood within. His erratic eyes contain a sinister gleam that, by intuition, is only held by people who are not sane.

Upon absorbing the vials of rare blood he had on his person, Leonardo was transformed into a monster-like large mass of liquid blood that assimilated its surroundings into its body.

==Personality==
Leonardo is a doctor who obsesses over unravelling the hidden mysteries of blood to bring the world salvation. He prides himself on his research. As a bat human, Leonardo has fondness for sucking blood and dislikes wasting it to the point that he will lick up any drops of blood from the ground without hesitation. 

==History==
===[[Golden Siblings Part 1|Golden Siblings]]===
The Blood Sample Collector Leonardo Baroness dedicated his research to understanding the mysteries quality of rare blood. He eventually started to work closely with [[Hayden Garo]] and discovered how to manipulate the lightbugs of [[Costuul]].

When Hayden brought the kidnapped [[Frederica Baumann]] to their base, Leonardo introduced himself to the woman and openly his feelings on the importance of blood. As a consequence for intimidating Frederica, Hayden grabbed Leonardo's face for a short period of time and rushed the doctor to finish his duty. However, before Leonardo could finish his job and allow Hayden to return to his castle with Frederica, [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] and [[Clind]] arrived to save her. Clind then confronted Leonardo after ensuring Frederica's freedom. As a result of his obsession with acquiring Frederica's rare blood, the doctor was driven to absorb the vials of blood he had collected into his body, transforming him into a giant liquid mass of blood. Following this, Clind caused Leonardo's liquid body to be devoured by space with the usage of his [[Clind#Abilities|his Authority]], leaving neither a trace of the man nor a single drop of blood behind.

==Trivia==
*In the original Comic Alive release of [[Golden Siblings Part 2]], Leonardo's race was never specified.

Teacher |Status = Deceased |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero EX#Iris and the King of Thorns|Iris and the King of Thorns]]}} '''Lynek''' (リネック) was the teacher of [[Yorna Mishigure|Iris]]. A mole person who once obeyed [[Eugard Vollachia]] after he and the pack of [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] he belonged to were forced into servitude, he was attributed as having “assisted” [[Volcas]] in the murder of Iris, leading the emperor to decree the execution of all wolf people and mole people. To avoid his murder as a result of Eugard's decree, he spent the rest of his life in exile on the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. ==Appearance== Lynek was a mole person who had round eyes and a large nose that took up half of his face. ==Personality== Lynek was a knowledgeable man with the skill to act as a tutor and a healer. Greatly considerate of people and their feelings, he regularly made an effort to acknowledge and accommodate them. He downplayed his own expertise and skills, emphasizing that, with his knowledge, other people could easily fulfill his roles. Despite recognizing himself as Iris's enemy, Lynek treated her with the utmost sincerity, feeling gratitude and profound regret towards her as a result of her forgiveness of his and his pack's actions. Over time, he grew concerned for her wellbeing and began to prioritize her and Eugard's happiness over his own pack, going so far as to ask for Iris's forgiveness when he perceived himself as the cause of their rift and to brew what was effectively a poison that would slowly kill her because she wished for it. ==History== Lynek was one of the members of the “pack” led by [[Volcas]]. He was among the bandits who attacked a village within the Elcanti Domain in a retaliatory attack to avenge their comrades that had been slain by the domain's forces. Given the role of directly managing their food supply and stolen goods, he never laid hands on any of the villagers. Rather than facing execution, Iris forgave the pack members and implored Eugard to spare their lives, which he accepted. As a consequence of their defeat, Lynek and the others were bound by [[Meteor#Collar of Subservience|Collars of Subservience]] and conscripted into a disciplinary unit obligated to serve the Elcanti Domain. On top of having the position of a healer in the disciplinary unit, Lynek was given the additional role to act as Iris's teacher, frequently spending his time with her. He educated her in subjects such as proper etiquette. Volcas often abruptly disturbed the two, chiming in by bantering with Iris. After [[Terriola Goldario]] joined their faction, he observed the two women developing a positive relationship with one another. As the Imperial Selection Ceremony began, Iris was afflicted with a fever, leaving Lynek to temporarily act as her nurse while the others he delegated his healing knowledge to took his place in the disciplinary unit. He was ordered by Eugard to contact him with any updates about Iris's status, no matter how trivial. Although he offered her the opportunity to speak with Eugard over a [[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|Conversation Mirror]], she refused because of how they had contributed to his isolation. They were paid a visit by [[Whitaker Goldario]], who had brought valuable medicinal herbs as a gift for Iris, entrusting their use to Lynek. At Whitaker's request, Lynek exited the room, and Iris was given an explanation of the Battle Craze Syndrome she had contracted and that the herbs would be used to cure her. Lynek boiled the herbs to brew the medicine that would cure Iris. Upon being cured, Lynek cried tears of relief, and Iris set her sights on reuniting with Eugard. Unbeknownst to them, the Battle Craze Syndrome had been what prevented Iris from falling victim to Eugard's [[Eugard Vollachia#Abilities|Curse of Thorns]], and she was assaulted by the binding of thorns upon their reunion. Lynek blamed himself for Iris's newfound inability to approach Eugard, earnestly apologizing to her. Some time later, while Volcas and Iris were speaking, Lynek bore news to her, revealing that Whitaker Goldario had launched a rebellion in tandem with the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] against Eugard, intending to murder him by setting fire to the Imperial Residence in the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]]. To return to Eugard's side and encourage him to take arms against Whitaker, who planned to install himself on the throne once the King of Thorns was killed, Iris requested Lynek to use the herbs he had been gifted to create a medicine that would simulate the effects of Battle Craze Syndrome, which he reluctantly accepted after Volcas demanded an explanation from her. With Iris's encouragement, Eugard swiftly extinguished the lives of the Nine Divine Generals and Whitaker, putting a stop to the revolt, and his coronation proceeded as planned, being crowned as emperor by his beloved. Having been within the range of the Curse of Thorns for an extended period of time, Iris began to cough up blood when she returned to her quarters. Lynek warned her that she was pushing herself too hard, feeling guilty for creating a poison that was whittling down her life. Volcas, who was with the two, told Iris he was siding with her above all else, rather than with the [[Vollachia Empire]], and that Eugard had no issue with his loyalties, giving her a cup of water after saying this. Though tolerating her selfishness despite the risk to her life, Volcas expressed genuine concern for her mind and body. Lynek rejected her proposal to teach her how to brew it herself, as she would not have been able to make it even if she had learned how to, yet he also had the responsibility of complying with her selfish request in order to remain with Eugard, placing him in a predicament where he would have had to continue bestowing her with poison out of obligation. Volcas delivered her a gentle insult, and Iris proceeded to rest in order to conserve her energy in order to interact with her beloved Eugard. To prevent Iris from having to suffer from the poison, Volcas murdered her, and he was promptly eliminated by Eugard upon his discovery of the scene. As a result, Eugard would come to decree the execution of all wolf people and mole people, attributing Lynek as having purportedly aided in Iris's murder even though Volcas made his decision alone. Following a conversation with Eugard at Iris's funeral, Terriola spoke with Lynek, whom she had kept hidden to brew poison for her and to protect him from the imminent policy that decreed the execution of all wolf people and mole people. Despite the decree, Lynek had no words of apology for his brethren, as he and Volcas had made their decisions, and he chose to prioritize Eugard and Iris over his pack. She prepared a refuge for him at the Gladiator Island surrounded by Lake Violane and considered turning it into a prison for convicts to act as a distraction for him. Affirming to him that she had not spoken of her feelings for Eugard to him so she would not be a thief like her brother, the Thief Emperor, she wished Lynek well, and he set off for Lake Violane. For the rest of his life, Lynek made various poisons and medicines at the Gladiator Island. ==Abilities== '''Healing Skills''': Although not trained in magic, Lynek had the skill to be considered a healer with an irreplaceable role in the disciplinary unit. He could brew various medicines and poisons and had the knowledge to create even complex brews. With the rare herbs he was given by Whitaker, he was able to brew both a medicine that cured Iris's Batte Craze Syndrome and a poison that simulated its effects. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Teachers]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Deceased]]

wikitext:
{{Character |Name = Mireille Hetia |Image = |Kanji = ミレイユ・ヘティア |Romaji = Mireiyu Hetia |Race = Human |Gender = Female |Hair Color = Blue |Eye Color = Unknown |Affiliation = [[Gusteko]]
Glacia |Previous Affiliation = Limbus |Occupation = |Previous Occupation = Official
Secretary |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Edmon Quayle]] (father)
[[Nananna Pezza]] (half-sister) |Light Novel = [[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 2]]}} '''Mireille Hetia''' (ミレイユ・ヘティア) is a former secretary of [[Edmon Quayle]]. ==Appearance== Mireille is a woman with long blue hair who gives off an intelligent impression. ==Personality== ==History== ===Early Life=== Mireille was born to an affair between the Limbus council representative, Edmon Quayle, and her mother. However, Edmon banished her mother, and she came to despise both Edmon and the town of Limbus. When she was young, she met an [[Minor Characters#Elderly Healer|elderly healer]] who lived on the outskirts of Limbus. There, she received her guidance, similar to her half-sister, [[Nananna Pezza]]. Because of this, she later became a civil official. At an unknown point in time, she received an [[Spirit|evil spirit]]. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 2|Witch Trials]]=== One day, because of an illness that had taken hold of Limbus, numerous people found their lives in danger, but thanks to the elderly healer coming up with an appropriate medicine, lives were saved and the illness vanished. However, a rumor declared that she started the illness in order to provide the solution and increase her reputation. She was then declared a [[Witch]] and burned to death. Following the healer's death, the council members began to get rid of anyone the council considered inconvenient, including the noble who had once taken the healer's cure, and they declared it the response of a Witch, resulting in the subsequent Witch Hunts. At some point around this time, Mireille was appointed to be a subordinate to a government official in Limbus, where she learned of the healer's execution, and she began committing murders with her [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] in the town against relatives of the council members. Later, Nananna was sent to deal with the strange killings in Limbus, where, having heard about the execution of the elderly healer as well, Nananna conspired with Mireille to bring down their father and the people of Limbus for their transgressions, with Mireille getting rid of any other officials who came to the town. On the night that the [[Omega Party]] appeared, they decided to assist in the Witch Hunt for a person named [[Minor Characters#Piditz|Piditz]] who had been tipped off as a Witch, and Nananna wanted him taken into custody only. When they later spotted Piditz and chased after him, [[Omega]] split off to corner him, only to find Mireille using her spiritual arts to kill Piditz. Thanks to being near the body, Omega was quickly turned into a scapegoat and declared a Witch so that Mireille could cover up her kill and at least prevent her from getting in the way of her and Nananna's revenge, and Omega was taken into custody. Later, [[Colette]] visits Omega, and they point out that killings began before the party arrived, which should clear Omega's name, but instead, Mireille decides to have her executed anyway, and [[Palmyra]] objects to Edmon. To clear their names, Colette states that they should find the real culprit for the murders. [[Lilac]] and Colette go to gather information around the town, and they meet with Mireille, who explained to them how the hunts started. The next day, the Witch Trial is being held for Omega, overseen by Nananna and the Town Hall, with Mireille present as well, while Palmyra acts as Omega's attorney. Despite her arguments, Edmon counter with his supposed knowledge of the Witches and Omega's chatter does not help. Colette speaks up and claims that she believes that things will not go as the council claims, as people will begin to notice that the entire event seems off, which resounds with the townsfolk. Because of this, Palmyra claims that there is a conspiracy, which Edmon fights against and asks for Nananna's assistance. Because she sides with the town, Lilac and [[Shion]] believe her to be part of the conspiracy, and they decide to use their dream arts to influence the people's mental states. Palmyra then claims that the council is using the Witch rumors to get rid of inconvenient people, which Edmon also fights against, though is quickly silenced when she states she heard it herself from a council member and declares that there is no Witch. Unfortunately, Omega claims otherwise. Despite angering Palmyra, Omega decides to clear things up by declaring that there were two conspiracies taking place in town. Despite Nananna trying to prevent her from talking, Omega quickly ignores her and explains that many of the victims were relatives of council members, and she claims that Nananna is the second conspirator, calling her the bastard child of Edmon whose mother was banished from the town, and as a result, she despised the town. [[Noelle Tuérico]] later appears and confirms that her actions were in response to the death of the elderly healer, and she claims that Nananna tried to remove her from the trial by knocking her out since her only ire was with Limbus. Afterward, Noelle declares that the secretary, Mireille, was helping Nananna, as she was a bastard child of Edmon as well, and she stated how the corpses of Piditz and other people connected to the council and other outside officials were already dumped in a hole. Omega also declares that she witnessed Mireille killing Piditz. Enraged, Mireille uses her spiritual arts to char Edmond's arm with blue fire, and with the intent of killing the entire council, surrounds the council with blue fire, and she and Nananna stand against them. Although Omega is fine with leaving things as they are and taking their leave, Colette states she doesn't want things to end like this, and Omega decides to end the fighting in response to her plea, burning through her restraints and declaring herself a Witch. Later, as Omega's party begins to leave the town, Noelle says her goodbyes to Nananna, and it is declared that the evil spirit accompanying Mireille will be disposed of. Likewise, it is claimed that Edmon's position is under threat with both his severe injuries and the loss of the citizens' trust, and Mireille claims she was mistaken about real Witches. ==Abilities== '''[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]''': Mireille was capable of using spiritual arts with her evil spirit, which granted her the ability to manipulate blue fire hot enough to instantly char a person's arm. However, this spirit was capable of corrupting her. Following the events in Limbus, she disposed of the evil spirit. ==Navigation== {{Gusteko Navbox}} [[Category:Spiritual Arts Users]]

title: Melty Pristis
wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Relationships |tab3 = Image Gallery |tab4 = Game Canon}} {{Character |Name = Melty Pristis |Image = Melty Pristis main story LN character design.png |Kanji = メルティ・プリスティス |Romaji = Meruti Purisutisu |Alias = White Sheep (白羊, ''Shiro Hitsuji'') |Nickname = |Race = Unknown |Gender = Female |Age = 16-17 |Hair Color = Indigo |Eye Color = Golden |Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]
[[Six Tongues]] |Previous Occupation = |Previous Affiliation = [[Beloved Children]]
[[Divine Dragon Church]] |Status = Alive |Magic = |Weapon = |Relatives = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45|Volume 45]] |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Melty Pristis''' (メルティ・プリスティス), also known by her codename '''White Sheep''', is a member of the [[Six Tongues]] and a defector of the [[Beloved Children]]. She plays a supporting role in [[Arc 10]]. ==Appearance== Melty is a young woman roughly a year or two younger than [[Natsuki Subaru]].''After all, he had hardly expected that the figure that took shape upon the Conversation Mirror passed to him by Clown Mask, would be a girl with childish features. He did not recognize the girl’s face. Her age was likely a year or two younger than Subaru.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. She has indigo hair done up on both sides, large, round, golden eyes emanating a powerful will, a well proportioned face with an air of fragility to it. She wears a black suit with a white collared shirt and a thin tie.''She was a girl, with her long, lovely indigo hair done up high on both sides, and large, round, golden eyes, emanating a powerful will. Within the narrow frame of the mirror, the outfit of the girl with a well proportioned face and an air of a certain fragility was that of a white shirt, its collar tightly adorned by a thin tie, with a pitch-black jacket atop it―― a figure in a black suit prioritizing practicality over ostentation looked at him through the mirror.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. Before joining the Six Tongues, she would ordinarily wear clothes reminiscent of the cognitive disruption cloak.''"That’s… that might be the case. Before Silver Fox took me in… when I was still with Mama, I would wear these kinds of clothes most of the time."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 23, Section 1. Later, she briefly wears a light blue evening dress.''Instead of her usual black suit, she had been wearing a light blue evening dress in order to infiltrate the banquet, and just like Subaru and Crusch, who had played the role of the Schwartz couple, she acted as one of the guests at the feast, and using her good attitude, it seems she had skillfully guided the topic of conversation among the participants in order to lead the imposter “Viscount Moreau” to taking an interest in the Schwartz couple.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 3. ==Personality== Melty is a somewhat timid young woman who is willing to apologize for her comrades behavior.''"Umm, I’m called White Sheep. Black Dog over there… the masked man, I’m afraid he must have caused you considerable trouble… I’m sorry."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. Though she tries to restrain the changes in her expression, she is not suited to it and has a bad poker face, and she is aware of it.''It seemed like she was the type to have a bad poker face. Although it was apparent that she was trying her best to restrain the changes in her expression, her eye movements and facial muscles were clearly not suited to it. And, having to face herself in the mirror every morning, it seemed like she was also aware of this fact, "That is very blunt of you… Don’t you find that scary?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 1. Furthermore, she is quick to worry about the safety of other people,''"Th-thank goodness… what if something had happened to all of you, I was just so worried thinking about that…"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 3. and when people are injured, she wants to assist however she can,''"L-let us chase after Subaru-san and Beatrice right away. For the relief effort, we too, can――"'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45]], Chapter 6, Section 4. agreeing with the sentiments of Subaru that it is best to have as few casualties as possible.''"M-me too! I also think… that Subaru-san’s way of doing things, is good…"'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45]], Chapter 6, Section 7. She does not like conflict, and from the perspective of Subaru, the inherent good nature he perceives her as having is not very suited to an organization like the Six Tongues.''"Having escaped the Beloved Children under Capella’s dominion, White Sheep was now a member of the Six Tongues headed by Russell, but her inherent good nature was certainly not suited to being the subordinate of a villain or being a spy. After all, she was even willing to take responsibility for the time Subaru had been given to make his decision."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 23, Section 1. At times, when Melty becomes excited, she becomes somewhat impatient,''"Ah-, m-my apologies-. I-I started feeling impatient…"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. has a hard time controlling her heightened emotions, and becomes somewhat talkative.''Subaru demonstrated his perplexity, but White Sheep also seemed unable to control her heightened emotions as she spoke somewhat excitedly. Instead of answering Subaru’s inquiry, her eyes glittered as she proceeded to open the lid to a secret she had borne within her for all this time.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. This is particularly the case after meeting Subaru, who was indirectly responsible for allowing her to escape from her oppressor, as she was quick to display her gratitude toward him and started speaking excitedly over what he had done for her. Similarly, she has also been moved by his behavior and decisiveness to assist other people. Despite her kind-hearted nature, Melty has been deeply traumatized by her time serving under [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]], who has not only become the object of terror for her, but also cannot break the habit of calling her Mama, even after escaping from her.''Despite being estranged from the Beloved Children, and having escaped Capella’s reign of control, to still call the object of her terror something like “Mama” to this very day was testament to the magnitude of the crisis she had savored.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. Due to her influence, Melty had low self-esteem. However, though it was forced out of her by Black Dog, she was able to build up her courage to escape from her, something that she wishes she could have recognized sooner.''"――. Yes, it came as a surprise to me as well. To think I had such courage in me… If so, I should have sooner…" [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. Similarly, she is reluctant to use her power on people, having hesitated to use it on Subaru multiple times and feeling guilty afterward.''"Even though it was our own circumstances, I ended up rushing you… that’s the reason. I’m sure you would have wanted more time to make your decision, Natsuki Subaru-san."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 23, Section 1. Because of the way her ability works, it makes her hesitant to touch or get close to people, as she feels as though she is overwriting their will with what she wants. This being said, she is willing to use her power on her own allies if need be in order to help people, having almost attempted to do so against her employer, [[Russell Fellow]], if not for [[Black Dog]]'s interference.''White Sheep's eyes widened at that callousness, and before long, she reached out towards that back with a resolved expression――, "Wait, hold off."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45]], Chapter 6, Section 4. ==History== At an unknown point in time, Melty, alongside Black Dog, became subservient to Capella, who forced them to refer to her as Mama and work as part of her Beloved Children.''"I was formerly one of the Beloved Children. Black Dog was also in the same situation.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. It is unknown how long they worked for her, but Melty was stationed within the [[Divine Dragon Church]].''"I also know about Filore. Aside from whether she is suited to being a Royal Candidate or not, there is no doubt that the Divine Dragon Church is an organization that cannot be fully trusted… Back when I was still part of the Beloved Children, my cover was as a member of the Church. There are surely other――"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 1. However, following the [[Subjugation of Sloth]] led by Subaru, they were provided a chance to escape from the Beloved Children as Mama was panicked.''"Fing…? That is incorrect, but, it did cause Mama to be rattled, and we slipped out amidst the kerfuffle… and here we are."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. Afterward, they joined the Six Tongues, taking on the names of "Black Dog" and "White Sheep", and for the next year, the managed to thwart several of the Beloved Children's plans.''"If that were true, it would have made far more sense for us to have been crushed long ago. It has already been over a year since White Sheep and Black Dog joined us… during that time, we have thwarted the Beloved Children’s intrigues on more occasions than can be counted on a single hand. There would be no purpose to contribute so much.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2. ==Abilities== ===[[Magic]]=== According to Melty, she is capable of performing magic. However, it is unknown what attribute she has an affinity for and how proficient she is with magic. ===Other=== '''Bewitchment''' (人誑し, ''Hitotarashi''): Melty's power allows her to leverage already existing emotions within a person and nudge them toward making a decision in accordance with her wishes or needs. This can allow those she targets to make decisions much faster than they ordinarily would.''"Subaru, your decision to leave the Royal Capital was made far too quickly, I suppose. Both to leave Emilia behind, and to not converge with Otto and the others, ought to have been difficult decisions, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 23, Section 1. In order for her to use her power, she must first place her hands on the target, and then she must speak to them, either casually asking questions or pleading with them her desires.''Then, she walked over to the bedside, and softly clasped Subaru’s hand with both of her own.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 22, Section 2.''It was nothing more than a platitude, an idealism, a canned conclusion that Subaru had already repeated to himself tens, hundreds of times just so that he could accept it. ――Even so, for some strange reason, when spoken to him from the lips of White Sheep, it truly moved his heart.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 22, Section 2. However, her power cannot force a person to do something that they would absolutely refuse to do.''"I'm sure I told you. All I am capable of, is leveraging feelings that are already present... I cannot make him do something he never would have done!"'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45]], Chapter 6, Section 4. Furthermore, it is possible for someone to completely overcome her power's influence through outside stimulus, whether directly or indirectly.''"If he had not glimpsed the back of Blue Snake breaking into a sprint, he would not have even noticed such a thing."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 23, Section 3. ===Equipment=== *'''[[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|Conversation Mirror]]''' (対話鏡, ''Taiwa-kyō''): Melty has a Conversation Mirror on her person which allows her to get in touch with her allies. *'''Cognitive Disruption Cloak''': Melty has been lent a cloak with cognitive disruption built into it, allowing her to obscure her features from others. *'''Staff''': Melty owns a staff that is roughly the length of a baton which she uses for defense. *'''Dagger''': Melty keeps a dagger on her person for self-defense. ==Trivia== *Melty originally debuted an exclusive character from [[Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World: The Prophecy of the Throne|The Prophecy of the Throne]], in the main story. At a talk show held in March 2024, the author stated that he would like to introduce [[Tiga Rauleon]] and Melty somewhere into the mainline story. **Prior to the reveal of her name in the main story, [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45|Volume 45]]'s prologue depicted Melty and Black Dog at an unspecified point in the past. Within the prologue, there was a name obscured by ten black squares (■■■■・■■■■■■). The ten characters of the obscured name align with the name '''Melty Pristis''' (メルティ・プリスティス) in katakana, which is also ten characters long. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Beloved Children Navbox}} [[Category:Six Tongues]] [[Category:Divine Dragon Church]] [[Category:Unknown Race]]

{{Character |Name = Leilani Alnair |Image = |Caption = |Kanji = レイラニ・アルナイル |Romaji = Reirani Arunairu |Alias = Sin Archbishop of Gluttony (暴食の大罪司教, ''Bōshoku no Daizai Shikyō'') |Nickname = |Race = Human |Gender = Female |Age = |Hair Color = Brown |Eye Color = Unknown |Previous Affiliation = [[Witch Cult]] |Previous Occupation = Sin Archbishop of Gluttony |Status = Deceased |Relatives = [[Lye Batenkaitos]] (son)
[[Roy Alphard]] (son)
[[Rui Arneb]] (daughter) |Authority = [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]] |Equipment = Gospel |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]]}} '''Leilani Alnair''' (レイラニ・アルナイル) was a '''[[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop]]''' of the '''[[Witch Cult]]''', representing '''Gluttony'''. ==Appearance== Leilani had brown hair cut to shoulder length, shihaku eyes, and a loose, black robe that concealed her figure. She had a defined bump size as a result of her pregnancy. From the perspective of Shaula, Leilani's appearance was ordinary and she had no physical features that stood out. However, from Leiliani's own point of view, she saw herself as an ugly woman. ==Personality== ==History== At some point in time, Leilani inherited the Witch Factor of Gluttony and was selected to be the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony.''Pity and lament were inseparable from Leilani's life, dregs that stained her very soul. Ergo, even when Leilani Alnair was compatible with the Witch Factor, and was selected to be the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, she still stubbornly believed herself to be an existence who ought to be pitied.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 1. For over 3 years, she was pregnant with her children, preventing them from being born from sheer force of will.''This too, was the achievement of Leilani's child―― or rather, children, it would seem, whom she kept in her womb for over three years with her own willpower, in order to perpetually be the pitied existence known as a pregnant woman. Although, the important babies themselves, as if unaware of the struggles of their pitiful mother, would foolishly kick her from within her abdomen quite frequently, incessantly begging to be let out.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. ===[[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale|Scorpion Tale]]=== At some point, following her gospel, a group of over 900 people crossed the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] with her in an attempt to reach the [[Pleiades Watchtower]]. However, the group faced complete annihilation at the hands of [[witchbeast]]s, leaving only Leilani after she was saved by [[Shaula]]. Afterward, she was brought to the tower, and Shaula would allow her to stay until she gave birth. Although she attempted to dismiss Leilani, she consistently acted self-deprecatingly humble before her, and her [[Authority]] attempted to work its way toward replacing her memories with "Leilani". Over time, once Leilani believed that her Authority had fully consumed her, she attempted to have Shaula listen to her and claimed that she was the most important person in Shaula's life. However, her Authority did not overwrite Shaula's devotion toward [[Flugel]], and as punishment, Shaula shot her with one of her needles in her midsection, killing one of her unborn children. Afterward, she removed her from the tower and left her just outside of the Sand Time barrier with some provisions in an attempt to leave her a chance to survive. When she was found by travelers, she attempted to have them save her by getting rid of her children, believing that she could always just have others if necessary. However, because of her injuries, her words were misunderstood, and the travelers instead saved her remaining two children at the cost of Leilani's remaining life, and she died while continuing to call herself pitiful. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Despite being a Sin Archbishop, Leilani was rather weak, with minimal combat skill and had to rely on outside help to survive against the likes of witchbeasts. However, she was still incredibly dangerous thanks to the brainwashing effect of her Authority, and because of that, she had the capacity to bring ruin to the lives of many just by existing, in a way similar to [[Carmilla]]. ===[[Authority]]=== As the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Leilani was a user of the '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]]''' (暴食の権能, ''Bōshoku no Ken'nō'') and was a compatible holder of its corresponding Witch Factor. '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Overeating]]''' (過食, ''Kashoku''): The prerequisite to trigger Leilani's Authority was for someone to show her pity. Once she was pitied by someone, the Authority of Overeating would activate, continually coercing pity from its victims.''――That was why, Leilani’s Authority of Overeating, coerced that pity from others.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 1. Those who were subjected to Overeating were left with “bite marks” that, little by little, gradually expanded until every single person within the memories of a victim's life was painted over by the existence of “Leilani”.''As the result of being so pitied, Leilani would leave little bite marks in the lives of those people. Slowly, but steadily, those wounds would encroach further, enlarge, deepening the bite marks. Just like a wound inside the mouth, that would forever remain in the person’s soul as a small disorder――, “――Until finally, your esteemed heart, the path walked by your esteemed life, are all painted over by my unworthy self.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 1. That being said, as Leilani's presence only gradually grew within a target, the process of Overeating was required take place over a prolonged period of time.''Leilani’s Authority, so difficult to use that it was pitiful, needed to Overeat a target for a long time. The more the Overeating progressed, the greater Leilani’s presence would continually grow within them, and yet the target never even felt any pity for Leilani, before any of that could happen.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. The process of Overeating began by overwriting a target's memories of an insignificant acquaintance, and over time, it incrementally painted over people with increasing significance in a target's life until “Leilani” replaced the most important people who were connected to a victim's reason for living and whom the victim treasured.''Firstly, the meagre memory of an insignificant acquaintance would be painted over by Leilani’s existence. Following that, the faint memory of an acquaintance with a strong impression would be painted over by Leilani’s existence. On top of that, the memory of an acquaintance who revived many reminiscences and emotions would be painted over by Leilani’s existence. Meanwhile, the memory of an acquaintance who had left a deep mark on one’s life would be painted over by Leilani’s existence. Additionally, the memory of an acquaintance who had been indispensable in one’s path would be painted over by Leilani’s existence. Furthermore, the memory of an acquaintance from whom one had generously poured out their affection would be painted over by Leilani’s existence. And finally, the memory of an acquaintance who was tied to one’s very reason for existing would be painted over by Leilani’s existence.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 1.''The targets whose lives were painted over by Leilani’s Overeating would have all the people they treasured replaced by “Leilani”, overwriting their memories.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 1. By the time the process was complete, “Leilani” painted over every person in a victim's memories, regardless of whether they were someone the victim disliked, someone the victim was close to, or someone whom the victim exhibited love towards. Her existence also replaced every aspect of people from a victim's memories, including their faces, voices, and scents.''Surely, slowly, the memories of the carefree Shaula were being Overeaten by Leilani: the faces, voices, scents, each and every thing about those whom she had met, liked or disliked, formed bonds with, and shared love with throughout her life; all of it was painted over by “Leilani”, and she could tell her attitude towards her had changed.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. Those who were subjected to Overeating saw Leilani as a friend, a mentor, a lover, and the most important person to them,''For the people subjected to Leilani’s Overeating, Leilani was a friend, a mentor, a lover, family, and the most important existence in this world.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 1. and as such, they would unhesitatingly follow her wherever she went, using their bodies as shields and sacrificing their lives to protect her from any danger that came her way.''Ergo, they would not balk at sacrificing their lives for the sake of Leilani. They would all use their bodies as shields to protect her, and throw themselves into danger for her, loving her until their souls burned out.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 1. When the process of Overeating had progressed far enough, the memories within a victim would have every emotion lined with the memory of “Leilani” and likely contained multiple versions of her at once within them,''――The Overeating had progressed, and the repainting of the large majority of Shaula's memories had already been completed. In the memories within her, “Leilani” was present in almost every scene, and every emotion was filled over from top to bottom by “Leilani”. There were probably scenes with multiple instances of “Leilani” existing simultaneously, yet Shaula would not notice.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. but due to the Authority's effects, Leilani's victims failed to notice it, as they never doubted the validity of the precious memories within themselves, even though they had been revised.''It was not because Shaula was particularly foolish. ――It was not only her, such was the case for everyone. No one could notice the effect of Leilani's Authority of Overeating. None could doubt the precious memories within themselves. Much less could they suspect it was brought about by some insignificant, pitiful woman.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. Furthermore, to cause people to pity her as a means to invoke her power, Leilani used her pregnancy to take advantage of people's pity towards pregnant women,''It was a curious thing, but people tended to easily feel an excessive amount of pity towards the creatures known as pregnant women. She was honestly a bit surprised this logic held true even when it came to Shaula, but this time too, Leilani was pitied without any issue, and she was able to invoke her Authority of Overeating.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. going so far as to even prevent her children from being born for over three years through sheer force of will all to maintain her state. However, Leilani found opponents who were not susceptible to words and common sense, such as Shaula, to be the greatest danger to her by nature.''Hence, for Leilani, it was precisely opponents like Shaula, by her very nature, whom were of utmost danger to her, and beings she was a poor match with: those unreceptive to both words and common sense.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. In the case of Shaula, Overeating's ability was unable to overwrite her sheer devotion and love toward Flugel. Once Shaula was separated from Leilani, the Authority's effects came undone, though it is unknown if it was brought about by the user's death or if Overeating's effects stopped when the two were apart. ===Equipment=== *'''Gospel''' (福音, ''Fukuin''): As a member of the Witch Cult, Leilani was the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel was a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed, [[Echidna]]. The [[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]] would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Witch Cult's Gospels are imperfect replicas, meaning that, although they detail the future of its owner, the events conveyed are subject to change and the information provided was often up for interpretation. The Gospels take the form of small black books that can only be read by their owners. ==Trivia== *As is the case with the other Sin Archbishops (excluding [[Stride Vollachia]]), Leilani Alnair's name is derived from a celestial body. Alnair, meaning "the bright one", is the traditional name of the star Alpha Gruis, which is located in the constellation of Grus. This makes Leilani the only character as of now whose star name comes from a southern constellation. Moreover, 870437 Leilani is the name of an asteroid located in the asteroid belt. *Before being explicitly confirmed at a talk show held on July 26, 2026, it was heavily implied in the story of Scorpion Tale and by the author's comments in its afterword that Leilani was the mother of Lye, Roy, and Rui. **As Leilani is the mother of the siblings, the "Lei" part of her name is likely a reference to how, in Japanese, the given names of the siblings all share a first syllable beginning with "R" sound and have an "i" sound in the second syllable. Therefore, the "Lei" part of Leilani's name, pronounced ''Rei'' (レイ), would mirror ''Rai'' (ライ), ''Roi'' (ロイ), and ''Rui'' (ルイ). *Leilani has a named chapter in the [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]] side story. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Cult Navbox}} [[Category:Sin Archbishops]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Authority Users]]

'''Lucierica''' (ルチエレカ) is a member of the [[Beloved Children]]. She plays an antagonistic role in [[Arc 10]].

==Appearance==
Lucierica is a woman with shoulder-length bright blonde hair and eye-catching, gleaming purple irises.

==Personality==
Lucierica has a tendency to affirm that whoever she is speaking to is right about everything they are saying. Despite this, she seemingly often slips her own thoughts about others into her affirmations that others are right, such as by saying that she often wishes [[Reborn]] dead or that [[Bellaris]] is crazy and the other members of the Beloved Children hate her. She has described herself as a doll who does whatever she is told.<ref name="doll">''“It’s fine, Tornel, rest assured. Just now, I simply matched my voice to yours. There’s not a single thought in my head. I’m just a doll who does whatever she’s told. Oh, but, if you want to keep it as you being utterly useless and saying something unnecessary, I think that’s fine too. You are really useless, aren’t you!?”'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>

A former hikikomori, he was transported to [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]] through unknown means, where he was given the [[Authority]] which he calls "Return by Death" by [[Satella]] and became the knight of the Kingdom and the personal knight of the [[Royal Selection]] Candidate [[Emilia]].''"This is a misunderstanding. I merely wished to advise him as his senior. Now that he is a knight of the kingdom, his conduct has an effect on the reputation of all knights."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 2, Section 5. Although he came from another world, Subaru has shown to be mysteriously connected to the history of the new world, having a strange yet deep connection to the Witch of Envy and the other [[Witch#Witches of Sin|Witches of Sin]], knowledge of the stars that are deeply connected to important locations and personages across the world, the strange ability to gather Witch Factors within his body, and most curiously, bearing the candidacy to become a Sage. Following the events of [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|one failed loop]], Subaru is now determined to uncover the world's and the Kingdom's history, as he believes he can no longer remain ignorant of it. ==Appearance== Born and raised in Japan, Natsuki Subaru is a young man in his late teens. He stands at a height of 172 cm with an athletic physique which he maintains both prior to and during his summoning to Lugunica. He inherited a shared mix of physical traits from both of his parents; his medium-length thick black hair bore a striking resemblance to his father as well as his face shape, while his black (brown in the anime) [[Wikipedia:Sanpaku|sanpaku]] eyes which have small irises that made the whites of his eyes stand out, were inherited from his mother although some people find them intimidating, with the exception of some individuals who like them, namely Emilia. Just like his father, Subaru has quite an athletic build, as back in Japan, he was raised as an athlete by his father. Despite his shut-in nature later on, he nevertheless continued to train himself to maintain his physique. In [[Arc 2]], as he was learning to work as a butler, his hands became littered with small scars caused by cooking knives. Subaru's main attire throughout the early parts of the series is his cheap, athletic-theme outfit he was summoned in. The ensemble consists of deep-grey tracksuit bottoms with an orange stripe down the side, black sneakers with vibrant orange laces and soles, and a black t-shirt. Additionally, Subaru has with it a zipped-up white tracksuit jacket with a stand-up collar, deep-grey sleeves with an orange line running down their sides and orange cuffs, and deep-grey shoulders. On the left breast of the jacket is a black brand symbol that is reminiscent of the letter N. During the first trial in [[Arc 4]], he can be seen wearing his school's official uniform, which consists of a blue blazer and trousers and a red tie. Later in the same arc, during his knighting ceremony, he wore the knight's official uniform, and a purple cape with the crest of [[House Mathers]] on its back was draped over his shoulders. In Arc 2 and [[Arc 3]], however, he wore a butler's uniform with an eagle emblazoned in the sleeve. In the Water Plumage Inn in [[Arc 5]], he wears a yukata. Later on, during the [[Battle for Priestella]], Subaru's right arm and leg were affected by [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Capella]]'s cursed Dragon blood, thus he wrapped a bandage around his leg to hide the wound. Following his battle with the [[Witchbeast#Elgina|Elgina]], the cursed blood that was visible on his arm is no longer there, and it appears to be back to normal. During his [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|adventure]] in the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in [[Arc 6]], Subaru wore an outfit better suited for travelling. The outfit in question consisted of an orange scarf that matched the color featured on his track suit, black trousers tucked into lighter brown boots with black lacing, a black shirt that matched the shade of his trousers, a light brown buttoned blazer worn atop the shirt that ensured that only the shirt's collar was visible, a brown belt matching the shade of the boots, and an open green jacket. He also occasionally wore a long black hooded cloak alongside the outfit. However, he has returned to wearing his tracksuit as of [[Arc 10]]. In [[Arc 7]], Subaru was forced to cross-dress and adopt the name Natsumi Schwartz. During the [[Fall of Guaral#Bloodless Siege|Bloodless Siege of Guaral]], Subaru wore a transparent primarily white and orange long dancer's dress adorned with ornaments and gems, and a black wig, as well as a fake chest and a large amount of make-up. Following the group's victory and the departure for [[Chaosflame]], Subaru clad himself in a black wig and a primarily red and black military outfit with a red beretta, disguising himself as [[Vincent Vollachia]]'s female military advisor in order to not garner too much attention. He also briefly dons the appearance of Natsumi Schwartz later in Arc 10, wearing a dark dress,''Her plentiful black hair was elegantly tied up, and the makeup upon her white skin and the evening dress she was wearing were also well put together. The dark dress expanded out progressively as it approached the hem, making her tightly bound waist and bountiful curves stand out all the more.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 1. carrying a holding fan to cover his mouth, and giving the impression of someone who knows how he was being perceived and was acting appropriately.''The woman was holding an open folding fan over her lips, and was engaging in friendly conversation with the elderly noblewoman beside her. The way she carried her gaze and gestured herself were neither too much nor too little, and her scrupulous appearance was not merely beautiful, but seemed to be precisely aware of just how she was perceived, and of how she needed to conduct herself in order to please others.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 1. Later in Arc 7, Subaru took on the form of a 10-year-old child due to [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]]'s infantilization technique. He began wearing an oversized green shirt with rolled sleeves and a yellow collar, as well as a yellow band serving as a makeshift belt for his jeans. However, he eventually returned to his original form towards the end of [[Arc 8]]. Natsuki Subaru LN character design 2.png|Subaru dressed in an attire protecting him from the harsh environment of the Augria Sand Dunes. Subaru Butler Uniform.png|Subaru dressed in a butler uniform during the time he served Roswaal. Natsumi Schwartz.png|Subaru posing as Natsumi Schwartz, during the Bloodless Siege of Guaral. Military Advisor Subaru.png|Subaru as the military advisor of Vincent Vollachia. Light Novel Child Subaru.jpeg|Subaru regressed as a 10-year-old child. Natsuki Subaru in Sloth IF.jpg|Subaru dressed in a dark-blue kimono specific for the [[Kararagi|Kararagi City-States]]. In the [[Re:IF|Sloth What-IF]] story, where Subaru chose to abandon Emilia to run away with [[Rem]], Subaru's hair was longer. Although he kept his basic messy hairstyle, Subaru now had a clump of hair tied up in a ponytail, apparently influenced by the style of [[Wilhelm van Astrea]]. Furthermore, he ditched his signature tracksuit, for a more comfortable and environment-specific dark-blue kimono and a pair of simple wooden zori. In the Gluttony IF, Subaru had given himself a scar on his head that damaged his eye and blinded it, and his hair had also turned white. In the Sasageru IF, Subaru had properly aged during the course of 40 years, and his hair had turned white. ==Personality== Subaru is a playful person who, despite the impression that his eyes and face tend to give off, has a tendency to interact with the people around him with kindness, even if they are not fond of him, something which people like [[Otto Suwen]], Rem, and even [[Petra Leyte]] noticed and found to be one of his best qualities. He also has a tendency to speak before he thinks, with one of his more tactless comments being about [[Frederica Baumann]]'s teeth, and he is a habitual promise breaker, to the point that other have learned to not trust when he makes a promise. Despite speaking before he thinks things through, that trait has apparently helped other people,''"Ya know, Captain. I dunno ‘bout sayin’ this sorta thing, but when ya let yer emotions take over ‘n go off sayin’ this ‘n that, it’s somethin’ like “Garagockle’s Lovesickness”, but――"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 10, Section 1.''"We’ve all been saved by Subaru’s rashness and recklessness, so we’d appreciate you not speaking so negatively about it…"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 10, Section 1. whether to keep calm or to give them courage when they needed it most. This being said, because his self-esteem had been reduced from the time that he was a child and the fact that he was given Return by Death, Subaru has come to harbor a bad habit of trying to carry the burdens of the people around him on his shoulders alone, something which not only worries the people around him but also causes them to scold him regularly.''"Don’t you think that Subaru-oniisan has a really difficult natu~re? Why’s he always trying to shoulder everything by himself, it just makes everyone wo~rried."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 10, Section 2. He is also a fiercely loyal person who treasures his relationships, and though he might not get along well with the people around him at times, especially in cases such as [[Julius Juukulius]], whose impression rubs him the wrong way; Vincent, whose ideals counter his in almost every way; and even [[Todd Fang]], who was his enemy in nearly every interaction they've had and was even responsible for the deaths of the people around him at times; he does not want to see any of those people die, being willing to use his Return by Death to save them if they died around him. This and his Authority have a tendency to confuse the people around him, and in Todd's case, it even caused him to greatly fear Subaru; however, even then, he has still been shown to forgive those who have wronged him, such as [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] or [[Spica]], and even extend his hand to people in need, including trying to assist someone whose mental state was shaken by the events that had assailed them, such as [[Al|Aldebaran]] following the [[Great Disaster]]. His naiveté extends even to people he recently meets, and as such, does not condone sacrifices,''"How important is it to have him front and center, relative to how important it is to keep him at hands’ reach. The latter is not that essential. ――In any case, that naiveté of his cannot condone the sacrifices of others."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 103, Section 2. and he is willing to go out of his way to help others while not showing the same concern for himself.''"Dunno if pamperin’s the right wordin’ here, but both Captain ‘n Ottobro don’t really tend to look after yerselves even tho’ you’re always takin’ care of others. Every once in a while, it’s fine for my amazin’ self to raise ya up high in the air for a bit."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 10, Section 1. Because of this, however, he can also become very shaken if he fails to save the people around him, like with what happened to Rem and [[Crusch Karsten]] in Arc 3, [[Shaula]] in Arc 6, and [[Priscilla Barielle]] in Arc 8. Due in combination to his experiences with Return by Death and his trust in his friends and allies, Subaru is willing to put his faith in the people he knows and is more than willing to put himself in harm's way if it means there is a chance to overcome his and his allies' enemies. In fact, multiple times over, he has purposefully put himself through harsh experiences and came up with plans that revolved around him receiving great injuries, having allowed himself to effectively let [[Sphinx|one enemy]] break his arms and have his nearby comrades wait and put up with his pain until the right moment, or even convincing someone as gentle as [[Melty Pristis]] to stab him for the sake of his plan, as he believed [[Ferris]], who they were going to the location of, would be able to recognize their plot and save him in the nick of time. That being said, this is also a trait that leads to him being scolded by those very people. However, after arriving in Lugunica and experiencing multiple tragedies, Subaru has grown to fiercely detest the [[Witch Cult]], to the point that in one of his failed loops, he had been so angry that his aggression led him to try to gain allies to fight them but failed in each attempt, even having been used for information while he was experiencing his severe tunnel vision and hatred. Of course, while he has been able to curb his hatred of them and act much calmer since then, his hatred for them is still intense, and even being accused of or hypothetically thinking of himself as being associated with them gives him an immense feelings of disgust and goosebumps. In particular, his hatred for and fear of the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin]] [[Roy Alphard|Archbishop]] of [[Rui Arneb|Gluttony]], who was responsible for Rem's comatose state for over a year, was much more severe than the rest. Likewise, he is very liable to become hostile and extremely distrustful towards people that seem like his enemies, such as when he snapped at [[Eridna]] when she revealed herself to be "Echidna", who he already distrusted, and her behavior being so close to the [[Echidna|original]]'s only fed into that distrust, or his initial behavior toward Spica, who was born from one of the Gluttony siblings, Rui, despite her having no memories as Rui. Despite his hatred and distrust for such enemies, Subaru is not unwilling to forgive most of them and is even capable of properly speaking to them. Although he and Sphinx were on opposite sides and the fact that Sphinx was responsible for several of his deaths, when he confronted her at the end of the [[Conquest of the Undead Capital]], he spoke to her about if it could have been possible for her to not have done as she had, and he told her happy birthday, something that she may have never experienced. In the case of Todd, he was willing to put aside their enmity and work together with him, and though he couldn't trust him, he still cried over the fact that they could not reach an understanding and remained enemies. In Spica's case, although he detested her since the start of the events in [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]], after she had repeatedly saved his life and died over and over again to do so, he was willing to vouch for her and help her start anew, giving her a new name in the process. Even in the case of [[Meili Portroute]], because she had fortunately done no harm in the main timeline to his allies, he was willing to harbor her for safety, speak with her freely during her isolation, and trust his life to her. Even after he lost his memories, despite her having killed him, he was still willing to forgive her and give her a proper second chance at life, and after regaining his memories again, choosing to ask her to become a daughter to him. As a child, Subaru was much more confident and often a jokester who always stood out and was the center of attention, and he was often surrounded by friends who would play around with him. However, as time went on, despite initially feeling pride at being compared to him, Subaru became a very insecure person suffering from a severe inferiority complex due to growing up in his [[Natsuki Kenichi|father]]'s shadow. This caused him to develop a fundamental misunderstanding of relationships where he believed he would be abandoned if he wasn't the center of attention. He began acting eccentrically, performing actions in a way he thought was similar to his dad in an effort to try and make friends and not be alone. Even his otaku-tendencies were really just another method he used to stand out. Ironically, though, these desperate attempts to connect to others only caused him to make a fool of himself and push others away, and the more stressed he became, the more he acted out. In the end, however, he started pulling himself away from the public eye, going to school less and less, and eventually, not at all, and he started becoming somewhat distant from his parents, not even telling his worried [[Natsuki Naoko|mother]] goodbye when she told him kindly to take care, as he believed that his parents would be better off without him. After being summoned to a new world, he saw this as a chance to make a fresh start. Then, despite realizing he hadn't been given overpowered abilities typically accompanied by isekai protagonists, upon meeting Emilia and becoming enamored with her, he decided to devote himself to becoming the one closest to her and always saving her. Upon realizing he had been given the unusual ability of Return by Death, despite experiencing the pain accompanying it, he started to realize that he could challenge fate, which led him to believe that so long as he was around, he would be able to stop anything untoward from happening to the people he cared about, something which has led him to problematic situations, including a beating/public humiliation. Ultimately, he did not change as a person, and following his decision to continuously save Emilia, he was eventually exposed for what he was: a person who thought of himself as the hero of his own story and forcing their feelings on someone else, and he realized that his white knighting did not work out in the real world. The world then proceeded to show him how weak he was, that he couldn't save anyone. After facing numerous failures and deaths, witnessing the endless deaths of everyone around him and everyone pointing out all of his flaws, he felt utterly broken, and he wanted to run away. However, following his conversation with Rem, in which he pointed out everything negative about himself and that he hated himself, upon hearing Rem tell him everything she loved about him, including that he wasn't one to give up and that in her eyes he was a hero and that she loved him, he began to see himself in a somewhat better light. This became the turning point for his character; he truly made an effort to change himself rather than expect that as the supposed protagonist, everything would work out. Subaru began reflecting on his actions and taking steps to amend his broken relationships, ultimately learning to become more considerate of Emilia's feelings rather than just forcing his expectation that she would reward him. Now, he tries to live up to the expectations of a hero that Rem had for him. Furthermore, following the [[Sanctuary Incident|events]] of Arc 4, upon experiencing the second trial, speaking with the Witches of Sin, and coming to understand somewhat the love that Satella had for him that she would even give him Return by Death, he resolved himself not only to save her, but also not to abuse his Authority in the same manner he does in the Greed If, only using it when he needs to challenge fate and save the people around him. This, in time, caused Subaru to end up gaining self-harming habits, such as biting his lips or scratching his arms until they bleed, and so that he wouldn’t forget or become used to the feeling of pain that goes alongside his Return by Death, he’d even requested the poison he’d use later to be painful, something which others have questioned. In Arc 6, he started seeing himself in a much better light after witnessing his memoryless self take on every challenge that assailed him in the Pleiades Watchtower, despite being pushed to the brink of despair brought about by Rui Arneb's machinations and mind games. Seeing from the perspective from an outsider boosted his confidence, and it allowed him to see what other people see. After his infantilization in Arc 7, Subaru regained much of his confidence that he’d lost as he aged, which when paired up with his usual habits alongside his Authority, have made him much more of a force to be reckoned with, as well as significantly bolder, allowing him to pick fights with and persuade people as stubborn as [[Gustav Morello]] and [[Jawsrough]] into following him. Likewise, he has shown to be even more charismatic, managing to gain the loyalty and friendships of nearly 1000 people during his travels in Vollachia, as well as the assistance of numerous similarly stubborn people such as the Nine Divine Generals and Vollachian Emperor. After reverting back to his original form, his personality has gone back to how it originally was. Subaru was deeply affected by the events that led to Al's sealing, and because of this, an ambition was born within him to uncover the history of both the Kingdom and the world, as now, he believes he can no longer remain ignorant of it. Thanks to this, he has started to question some of the most base and fundamental aspects of culture, including the Dragon History Stone's prophecies, which he had a less than positive impression of after meeting a [[Stargazer]], as well as the intentions of those behind it, as he suspected foul play, especially when considering the [[Royal Plague|plague]] that took the lives of the [[Royal Family|royal family]]. At the same time, because of Al, and before him, Todd, he refused to lose anyone again without first attempting to talk things through with them, something which led to his decision to plead with and later assist Crusch in her crusade to [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|locate and purge national traitors and corruption]]. ==History== Back in his original world, Subaru was the only son to two odd, but well-meaning parents, Kenichi and Naoko. From a young childhood age, Subaru idealized his dad in particular, a popular man in his community who was highly talented in whatever he did, a loving father who prioritized his family above everything else and had a boisterous personality that charmed anyone he met. Kenichi was everything he wanted to be and growing up around him had a huge influence on Subaru's life. Taking pride in being his son, Subaru worked to live up to the expectations that came with that in his mind. For a time, he achieved this, as Subaru found himself smarter, more physically able, and popular than his peers. When he received praise, Subaru would hear how it was expected of him being Kenichi's son, which made him feel special and entitled to a sense of superiority. However, as the young boy's small world started to gradually expand upon entering middle school, Subaru would come face to face with limits of his own ability. Suddenly, he found people who were becoming smarter and faster than he was and, in general, being better at the things he used to be. He felt as if he was slowly losing his place and began to harbor a deep sense of shame at letting down his parents and fear of everyone leaving him for failures, doubt and self-loathing began to develop in his heart. But rather than prioritizing getting better at those things to combat his anxieties, Subaru instead placed more importance on doing daring and outrageous things to maintain his fragile dignity and keep himself the center of attention. However, the more reckless Subaru's actions became, the fewer people wanted to be around him. Yet Subaru continued to deceive himself and believe his own lies because as the son of his seemly indomitable father, he couldn't be seen as a failure. Eventually, one day, Subaru noticed he no longer had any friends, and, in his loneliness, Subaru realized he wasn't anyone special. From then on, the comparisons between his father and himself turned into a curse that wounded and suffocated him everywhere he went, yet his strong admiration for his dad made it impossible to show that pain to anyone. Eventually, he stopped trying to stand out and when high school came, he found himself in a new environment where no one knew his past. Seizing this opportunity, Subaru tried to build new interpersonal relationships, but he had no idea how to be himself around others and instead only ended up emulating his father, his only frame of reference which instead led to others to treat him as a clown and classmates simply ignored his existence altogether. One day, Subaru skipped a day of school in a week, followed by skipping once every three days, then every two, until within three months, things had snowballed to the point that he had stopped going to school.''“After that, it was just a drag. I skipped one day a week, then it was once every three days, then once every two… It didn’t take even three months before I stopped going to school altogether.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10]], Chapter 4, Section 5. When out of public spaces, Subaru felt liberated, but more than that, his own degradation meant people would start distancing him from Kenichi, and in a twisted sense of hope, he wanted them to acknowledge him as worthless and cast him aside in self-abandonment. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Subaru has at one point been declared among the weakest characters in all of Re:Zero. However, in spite of his overall lack of trained combat skills, Subaru has shown to be extremely crafty in the manner with which he utilizes his various Authorities, is a highly capable leader, and has used everything at his disposal in order to come out of the most dangerous of scuffles with as few casualties as possible. It is thanks to this that Subaru has established himself as a considerably dangerous opponent to have, and numerous people of considerable strength and standing have considered him to be a truly dangerous and considerable threat, one capable of potentially bringing the downfall of entire organizations that have existed for centuries or could be troublesome in the event of a national dispute, or an incredibly reliable ally whose insight and presence are deemed necessary in order to overcome the most hopeless of threats. Within a year and a half of arriving to the other world, Subaru had helped orchestrating the downfall of the Sin Archbishops of [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sloth]], [[Regulus Corneas|Greed]], and Gluttony, the Bowel Hunter [[Elsa Granhiert]], the Witch Sphinx, and two of the Three Great Witchbeasts: the [[White Whale]] and the [[Great Rabbit]]. Furthermore, due to his influence, he has arranged a wide array of allies and friends in high places, and those connections are what exemplifies his "power" the most. ===[[Authority|Authorities]]=== [[File:Subaru - Return by Death.gif|thumb|right|250px|Subaru activating '''Return by Death'''.]] '''[[Authority#Other Authorities|Return by Death]]''' (死に戻り, ''Shinimodori''): Subaru's trump card and the most recognized ability from the series, Return by Death allows Subaru to return to an unspecified, unpredictable, and uncontrollable "save point" that was set some time before his death. It happens instantly after his life is taken, there's no lag between the point of death and the point of resurrection, and there is no known limit to how many times Subaru can "Return by Death", making this ability an effective way of permanently bypassing an unnatural death. In Arc 4, it is revealed by the Witch of Greed that Return by Death is actually an Authority''"Though it vexes me, the Authority that allows you to Return by Death is rooted in the Witch's wild delusions."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 11]], Chapter 5, Section 3. given to him by the Witch of Envy''"The being that made me walk the path of suffering... –The Witch of Envy."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 11]], Chapter 5, Section 3. in order to prevent him from being shackled by mortality, granting him a means to challenge fate itself and beat impossible odds in which he's destined to die in the cruelest of ways.''"What '''it''' seeks is that your fate is not held captive to a dead end."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 11]], Chapter 5, Section 3. However, no actual conclusions of which Sin it represents have been drawn yet. In fact, following the revelation that Authorities can be borne by being influenced by someone who does have a Witch Factor, as well as the fact that, after he had taken both Sloth and Greed, Roswaal had mentioned that he had "two" instead of three, it is entirely possible that Subaru's Return by Death may not have been applied to him by the conventional method of granting him a Witch Factor, though whether this is the case is unknown. When Return by Death is triggered, to Subaru, it looks exactly as if someone switched camera angles inside his head, and the sudden influx of new information and sensations often makes him feel dizzy and confused. Because of the lack of lag between the moment he died and the moment his mind goes back in time, depending on the way he died previously, it may take him time for his mind to recover. For example, when Subaru was initially killed by the Great Rabbit, the intense pain his mind was forced to experience carried over, and if not for the interference by Echidna, his mind would have been in danger of shattering from the phantom pain. Later, in Arc 10, due to the intense spinning brought about by his extended death from a literally endless fall, the spinning sensation and dizziness carried over, leaving him temporarily unable to move or even think properly for a time. Likewise, the Witch seems to have some control over his checkpoints, as when the connection between her and Subaru was temporarily severed in Arc 7, his checkpoints not only became erratic, but they also seemed to reduce in time with every reset. Having said that, Subaru's application of this Authority – namely to use it to save his friends and loved ones from their untimely demises – is something willingly and consciously done by Subaru alone.''"Employing this power to save others is strictly your own doing, your own desire... The Witch of Envy has nothing to do with it."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 11]], Chapter 5, Section 3. This often results in Subaru being given almost absurdly short times between his save points and deaths, and at times, even preventing him from saving some of his friends, such as when Rem's name and memories were eaten by the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, where Subaru was given a save point hours after Gluttony and Greed's attack on Rem's carriage convoy. It should be noted that, although Return by Death can prevent him from facing a permanent death from unnatural causes, it is implied through different side stories that he is not completely immune from a permanent death. In the Pride IF, because Subaru had achieved his goal, he accepted his final death, and by doing so, Return by Death did not trigger, bringing about a permanent demise to him. This is also implied to be the case in the Wrath IF, in which he ultimately chose to allow [[Ram]] to end him for good. Furthermore, Return by Death does not seem to prevent Subaru from aging. In the Sasageru IF, over the course of 40 years, Subaru’s body aged as naturally as any other regular human, so it can be assumed that Subaru can still die of old age. However, as of yet, it is unclear if this is truly the case. *'''Future Recollection''': The trait that makes Subaru so dangerous is without a doubt his ability to recall the futures he had experienced through Return by Death. The fact that he can recall the events of the previous loops he had died in, means that Subaru inherently knows the rough actions the people around him will take, almost like a form of precognition. As he usually tries to do different things every time he returned to life, Subaru is able to gather more intel on how his allies and opponents behave under specific conditions, allowing him to predict their movements and plan strategies accordingly. Although he is average at best in terms of intellect and strategic planning, Subaru's recollections of failed futures as well as his basic problem-solving abilities essentially turned Subaru into someone who expertly manipulates the events around him. His recollection of the future also allows him to forge better relationships with those he considers allies, allowing him to amass an impressive web of political connections and friends in high places. Subaru using his Return by Death penalty to attract mabeasts.gif|Subaru drawing the attention of Wolgarms by attempting to reveal Return by Death. *'''Penalties''': Subaru is unable to reveal his ability to others, either verbally or otherwise. This penalty does not work within the [[Castle of Dreams]] as it is outside of the world. **It will increase the density of the Witch's Scent at least for a short time, drawing any [[witchbeast]]s in the immediate area to him like moths to a flame, which Subaru has used to his advantage. However, it is possible to bypass this consequence if an alternate method was used in a space disconnected from the world and Satella's supervision, such as [[Od Lagna]]'s [[Corridor of Memories]], as Rui managed when she used her Authority of Gluttony on him.
