'''[[Authority#Authority of Sloth|Invisible Providence]]''' (インビジブル・プロヴィデンス, ''Inbijiburu Purovidensu''): When Subaru killed the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, he absorbed the '''Witch Factor of Sloth''' that resided within the madman for the past century, and after being synchronized with the Witch Factor thanks to Echidna, he developed its respective Authority of Sloth. It is a power that allows Subaru to summon a single invisible hand-like appendage from his chest and move and extend it telekinetically. If Subaru focuses enough, he can even make the hand phase through matter as though it wasn't there, giving him the potential to attack a target from inside their bodies. Subaru's version of the Authority of Sloth is far less powerful than both Petelgeuse's and [[Sekhmet]]’s Authorities of Sloth, as although Petelgeuse for instance could summon roughly one hundred hands at his maximum potential with little effort, Subaru can only summon a single hand with minimal range and damage output. At times, however, it seems that this ability can cause significant harm to his target, as he managed to severely damage Todd Fang’s face with it during a failed loop, and he can also use it to disarm an unsuspecting opponent if necessary. *'''Penalties''': As a side effect of calling forth his Authority, Subaru's internal organs begin to flare up, he feels his soul becoming more and more tainted, and he is assaulted by a violent coughing attack accompanied with him throwing up small amounts of blood.''"Organs feeling a pain as if being carved, rushing forth was a sense of despair as if he’d been tainted, Subaru immediately fell upon the ground with both knees. Harsh coughs that were even tinged with blood wracked him."'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 58, Section 2. There are even times when he blacks out because of the severe drawbacks of its use, leaving him unconscious for at least two days, whereas other times, he will get away with just a nosebleed. '''[[Authority#Authority of Greed|Cor Leonis]]''' (コル・レオニス, ''Koru Reonisu''): When Reinhard killed Regulus during the assault on [[Priestella]], the '''Witch Factor of Greed''' latched onto Subaru. Toward the end of Arc 6, Subaru was able to develop his Authority of Greed, which he has dubbed Cor Leonis. Its ability is centered around the redistribution of burdens onto oneself and those who are deemed part of Subaru’s “kingdom”, though it is determined to only work so long as both he and his target(s) perceive each other as a friend, ally, or comrade in some manner. Like with Regulus, his Authority is divided into two separate abilities: Base Shift and Second Shift. *'''Base Shift''': The base shift of Cor Leonis allows Subaru to take on the burdens of people he himself considers allies.''Subaru’s Cor Leonis, which could take on and distribute burdens, had remained connected to all of the members of the Pleiades Battalion, who were located far away from him. It not only enhanced the strength of everyone as a unit, but it also lent a shoulder to anyone who might have been falling behind, pushing them along and distributing the vitality needed to run together.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 67, Section 4. Once he is connected to someone with his Authority, so long as he does not pass out or fall unconscious,''The united battalion was a group with unstoppable enthusiasm, but what held them together was Subaru’s presence―― it was nothing that could be boasted about, Subaru’s Cor Leonis. And this effect, it would be cut off if Subaru were to fall asleep or faint, and so from this point onward, he could not allow himself to carelessly doze off.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 44, Section 2. the connection will be maintained no matter the distance. His power still works even in the event that he is sealed and is in a state of semi-consciousness. **'''Fatigue/Pain Transference''': He is able to shoulder fatal injuries and save his allies' lives by taking on the pain of the wounds they are dealt, but this comes at a cost of potentially receiving the same wounds himself as his body naturally reproduces the sources of pain he suddenly receives, a deadly side effect which can easily kill him if ignored. He can also eliminate issues such as lack of dexterity for his comrades in combat. **'''Ally Tracking''': When using this power, Subaru is able to locate his allies' position and status as he sees pale white dots, wherever they're located. Depending on the movements of these dots, Subaru can determine how far away they are from him, whether they are moving or idle, or whether or not they have entered combat. However, his allies must also consider Subaru their own ally, otherwise Subaru will not be able to sense their location. In the very beginning of Arc 7, Subaru tried to locate Rem's location but was unable to, as due to her loss of memories, she did not recognize him as her ally. It only works on people he recognizes as his friends and allies. Furthermore, in the event that Subaru is trapped by an ability that distorts his sense of direction, it is possible for Cor Leonis to overcome said ability, as its status as an Authority supersedes the majority of other abilities, and he can still make his way toward an ally that he can sense. **'''Empathic Perception''': Using his Authority, Subaru is able to determine the emotional state, the strength of those emotions, and the various violent fluctuations of the people around him, which can give him a rough idea of the events going on around him, even if he is within a seal.''Inside, Subaru’s sense of what was reality or dream was hazy, leaving him unable to say anything for certain. As expected of the adorable Beatrice, she had admirably devoted herself to reverse-engineering the technique behind the forbidden art that had sealed them, but the only thing Subaru could do when he found himself in a state of being consciously aware, was to invoke the Authority of Greed―― Cor Leonis, to gather the presences of his nearby allies, and perceive the intense changes in their emotions. Even so, thanks to the reiteration of longing, desperation, and violent fluctuations in the powerful emotions of his allies, he had been able to perceive the shifts in the extraordinary circumstances through his soul.'' [[Arc 9]], Curtain's Close, Section 5. *'''Second Shift''' (セカンドシフト, ''Sekando Shifuto''): Second Shift, alternatively referred to as '''Division of Labor''' (負担の分配, ''Futan no Bunpai''), works very similarly to Regulus' very own ''Lion's Heart'', in a sense where Subaru can divide the burden between the allies of his choosing, and he can freely regulate how big of a burden he'll employ on each person, kind of like opening or closing a tap. **'''Fatigue/Pain Transference''': By sharing the burden that Subaru has carried from his base shift to other people who are willing to share in that burden, he can divide his burdens equally among them, reducing the load he has to carry. The more people he shares the burden with, the more divided that burden becomes lighter. Naturally, the same side effects will apply to each and every bearer of the shared burden, meaning their lives rest in Subaru's hands for the entire duration. **'''Strength Distribution''': Subaru is also capable of sharing the burdens of positive effects as well, such as a form of enhancement placed upon himself, and by doing so, he can share the excessive strengthening among his allies and collectively make them stronger in a uniform and unburdening manner. During Arc 7 and Arc 8, the war cries of the Pleiades Battalion's members were able to induce an effect similar to that of yang magic in Subaru, which he then distributed to the battalion's members in order to strengthen them.''Only those who accepted Natsuki Subaru―― or rather, “Natsuki Schwartz”, as the center of themselves, those who sincerely thought of him as their comrade, those who sincerely believed in him as their companion, would be able to achieve a miracle. ――The strengthening effect of the Yang Magic would be applied to each of the individuals Subaru shared the effect of Cor Leonis with; that was, all of the allies who worked alongside him. The power of the Little King, originally intended to share wounds and burdens, would now be abused; the power which the King alone could not handle fully, would now be handled together with the comrades that supported him.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 98, Section 4. '''High Witch Factor Compatibility''': Subaru has displayed a strange affinity towards Witch Factors that no other character thus far has shown. While most people would find themselves incompatible with a Witch Factor from which an Authority derives from or at the mercy of said Factor's influence, Subaru is not only compatible with the Witch Factors he currently possesses, but he is also uniquely capable of bearing multiple of them at one time within his body, at one point having held at least three of them simultaneously. Likewise, he has not shown to have any form of change in his personality nor a physical recoil at carrying them or manifesting respective Authorities from them. The reason for this has yet to be explained. '''Unique Authority Interactions''': For reasons unknown, Subaru seems to bear unique interactions with the Authorities of other users. In the case of the Unseen Hands wielded by Petelgeuse, Subaru was able to see all of the hands he emitted from his body, whereas nobody else could see them. He is also resistant to the effects of the Authority of Gluttony held by the three Sin Archbishops of Gluttony. Even when his friends or allies have had their names devoured, he can still remember them. Furthermore, when Rui Arneb attempted to devour his name and memories, though she managed to glimpse into his memories, he was not affected at all, and the only reason he lost his memories in the subsequent events of Arc 6 was due to Rui's scheme locking away his memories of the previous year into the Corridor of Memories. Although it is not confirmed, this apparent resistance to the Authority likely stems from the fact that he is not a native of the new world. ===Intelligence/Leadership=== '''Deductive Ability''': Arguably Subaru's greatest asset, aside from Return by Death, is his own mind. Though he wasn't blessed with particularly noteworthy intelligence, he has always had great deductive ability, something he prides himself on. This works well with his time-looping, as the information it provides would be useless if he wasn't able to think and act on it to find the optimal course of action. Likewise, it is because of his deductive ability that he has been responsible for uncovering the truth behind certain people's and witchbeasts' abilities. If not for this, certain battles, such as with the White Whale and Regulus, would have been lost. Similarly, Subaru is able to quickly piece together when people he knows are acting strange and deduce that said person is an impostor, even if the person in question is someone he has only spoken to in relatively brief periods. It is because of this that he was able to quickly recognize that Eridna had taken over [[Anastasia Hoshin]]'s body following the Battle for Priestella, even if he wasn't aware of the specifics of the possession itself. '''Leadership''': Numerous times throughout the story, Subaru has shown to be an excellent leader, as he has often been seen acting like a general in several battles. Of course, while a big part of this comes from knowledge obtained from his Return by Death, even without it, he has shown to be capable of directing everyone around them to places they need to be, with the Battle for Priestella being one of the most prominent examples of his leading skills. Similarly, he has shown to have great charisma, as he managed to obtain many followers during the [[Imperial Civil War]] and create the Pleiades Battalion, which he promptly led as its commander. '''Skilled Tactician''': Like his leadership, even without Return by Death, Subaru is skilled at coming up with various kinds of strategies during times of tension, and a good number of his strategies have been critical in achieving victory against troublesome opponents, including the likes of the White Whale, Regulus, and [[Bellaris|certain members]] of the [[Beloved Children]]. [[Garfiel Tinzel]], Reinhard, and Vincent have complimented Subaru's strategic ability. '''Astronomical Knowledge''': In his own world, Subaru studied the stars, constellations, the stories surrounding them, and similar subjects. This knowledge has become vital to Subaru, as thanks to it, he is able to determine how the Authorities of other wielders work and discover their weaknesses, as well as uncover the hidden meanings behind puzzles such as the Taygeta trial in the Pleiades Watchtower. As this knowledge has become vital to understanding some of the more key aspects of the world, it is perhaps one of the most important things in Subaru's arsenal. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== Subaru has an affinity for the yin attribute and was once capable of casting basic yin magic, although he was only a novice. According to the author, Subaru could learn how to use other types of magic if he dedicated his life to it. However, after his gate broke, Subaru lost access to his ability to cast magic, and the only way he can do so is through spiritual arts through his contract with [[Beatrice]]. '''[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]''' (精霊術, ''Seirei-jutsu''): Subaru is contracted with artificial [[spirit]] Beatrice, effectively making him one of the few spirit users and the only other '''Spirit Knight''' (精霊騎士 ''Seirei Kishi'') within the Kingdom of Lugunica besides Julius Juukulius. With her aid, they are able to directly bypass his broken gate in order to cast spiritual arts together, and they have even created spells unique to them together. In particular, they each have a strong affinity for the Yin attribute. Likewise, thanks to the contract between them, Subaru does not suffer from an overabundance of mana within his body, while Beatrice will be able to maintain her form by absorbing the mana that builds up within his body. As Beatrice's contractor, Subaru's condition and whereabouts can be sensed by Beatrice via their connection, although Subaru is incapable of sensing her. However, he is capable of remotely calling Beatrice out if he focuses enough on his link with her. This being said, according to Beatrice, he isn't a true spirit user due to the many stipulations of contracting with her. She has a terrible [[mana]] consumption rate and formerly got around this by draining mana from people in the mansion using the library as a medium. Due to her mana consumption rate from Subaru, the two cannot cast spells freely. As she is an artificial spirit, she also has several conditions Subaru is forced to follow: *Subaru cannot form a contract with other spirits. *Beatrice cannot restore mana on her own. *Beatrice cannot use the mana in the atmosphere. *Beatrice can only drain mana from Subaru. '''Spells''': Subaru using Shamac on boss wolgarm.gif|Subaru unleashing Shamak on the leader of a pack of witchbeasts. Re Zero Light Novel 43 11.png|Subaru and Beatrice casting Ol Shamak. *'''Shamak''' (シャマク, ''Shamaku''): One of the most basic yin magic spells, and the only spell Subaru could use until the collapse of his gate, was "Shamak." When cast, a blanket of black smoke would erupt from the user that would cover a significantly large area. Any target engulfed by the smoke would completely lose their spatial awareness. Under the spell's effect, the only thing the target could sense was the ground under their feet and any damage done to their body. AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, if the five Royal Selection candidates were regressed into children, they would all become attached to Subaru.''"It’s frightening, but they’d probably all get attached to him."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, Subaru still retains scars from all of the injuries, including the burns on his hands, he took in Arcs 1, 2, and 4, but he does not retain any from Arc 3 since Ferris healed them.''"His scars from the duel with Julius, the white whale battle, and the fight with Petelgeuse were healed by Ferris, so there’s nothing left, but the cut on his stomach from Arc 1, the bite scars from the witchbeasts in Arc 2, Arc 4’s fight with Garfiel, and the burn scars aren’t too visible, but they’re there. Fortunately, there’s nothing too obvious on his face. He thinks a scar on the cheek would look cool, so he wouldn’t mind having one… but he hasn’t got one."'' He is counted among the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]] as the [[Spirit#The Beast of the End, Puck|Beast of the End]].''“I spent a long time in the Great Elior Forest, a world of permafrost, am served by the great spirit Puck, who governs fire mana, and am a silver-haired half-elf.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 5.''“The Arbitrator Melakuera has been absent ever since. It is said that his now empty position among the Four Greats is filled by the being known as the Beast of the End.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Epilogue, Section 2. He played a major supporting role in [[Arc 1]], [[Arc 3]], and [[Arc 4]], and he played a supporting role in [[Arc 2]]. During the events of the first four arcs, Puck played a pivotal role for Emilia's mental state, supporting her and acting as her parental figure. During the [[Sanctuary Incident|events]] in the [[Sanctuary]], however, Puck forcefully severed the contract with her in order to remove the seal placed over Emilia's memories, giving her a fighting chance in the Witch of Greed's Trials. After using every last bit of power that he was capable of mustering up at that time, Puck entered a long period of sleep inside a glintstone worn by Emilia. With said stone having been replaced by a stronger glintstone, everyone is waiting for his power to build up again so he can awaken. ==Appearance== In his smaller form, Puck stands at nine centimeters tall and is small enough to fit in the palm of a person's hand. Aside from his diminutive stature and the fact that he usually stands on his hindlegs, Puck is fairly physically reminiscent of a common house cat, specifically an [[Wikipedia:American Shorthair|American Shorthair]]. The light grey and white fur that coats his entire body is well-groomed and very soft. His eyes are Bright Aqua blue, and his pink nose is another trait that separates him from a house cat. Puck's tail is abnormally long to the point that it is the length of his body, and his ears are floppy yet extremely soft to the touch. On his left ear, Puck wears a single golden hoop earring that makes his ear droop down. He can also occasionally be seen carrying around a miniaturized magenta handbag that fits his small size perfectly. ==Personality== Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is usually in a very good and happy mood and usually stood at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia" or "my daughter". He occasionally shows his goofy side as well, which can be clearly observed during the events of Arc 2, where Puck nonchalantly teases both [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and Emilia with seemingly no end. Furthermore, Puck gets along especially well with [[Beatrice]]. However, Puck's demeanor greatly changed in loops where Emilia died. When such tragedy struck, he was willing to destroy the world to save Emilia and to fulfill his vows with the [[Witch#Witch of Greed, Echidna|Witch of Greed]].''"In accordance with the pact, I'll be destroying the world now."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 4, Section 7. Despite his seemingly never-ending happy-go-lucky attitude, Puck usually reacts and acts very cold and sometimes even hostile with everyone else besides Emilia, Beatrice, [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]], [[Rem]], [[Ram]], and Subaru. During the [[Royal Selection|Royal Selection Ceremony]] at the start of Arc 3, Puck was mere seconds away from freezing the entire Royal Throne Room, killing everyone inside it; though, it was revealed soon after that the entire exchange was a plan devised by Roswaal in order to have Emilia make a memorable impression on the Council of Wise Men and the other four [[Royal Selection#Candidates & Platforms|Royal Selection Candidates]]. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By|Loving the Days Gone By]]=== Around 400 years ago,''"Age: 420"'' [https://mypage.syosetu.com/mypageblog/view/userid/235132/blogkey/626391/ Narō Blog Post] Puck was a humanoid being,''"This is what I'm like now, but before my arms and legs were just a little longer, and if you can believe it, my face wouldda been handsome."'' [[Arc 4]], Chapter 72, Section 3. but he was turned into an Artificial Spirit by Echidna to watch over Emilia. Roughly three years after his creation, he and Beatrice helped [[Toska Astrea|Toska]] in fending off the Silver Dragons led by [[Minor Characters#Fargall|Fargall]]. At some point during this time, he also became aware of other figures such as [[Hector]], the Warlock of Melancholy, and Altair Mathers. He left Echidna by the time she moved into the Sanctuary to look for Emilia. After having searched for her for hundreds of years, he managed to find her frozen within [[Elior Forest]]. Several decades before the present day, according to a story relayed by [[Julius Juukulius]]'s grandfather, after him and his some of his comrades were left behind in a snow storm during a clash between the knights and [[Gusteko]]'s Temple Knights along the borders of the countries, he dragged the bodies of his comrades and struggled to escape the blizzard they were caught in until he found himself in a frozen forest. Within the forest, he met a “phantom”, who said that if they caused any chaos near his beloved daughter, he would never forgive them.''“――‘If you cause any chaos around my beloved daughter, I will never forgive you’.”'' [[Re:Zero Another Memory Snow]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Suddenly, the knights appeared in the middle of a plain, and they managed to regroup with the Royal Knights. Although Julius's grandfather reported what happened, he was not taken seriously, and the tale, known as “The Phantom Father in the Snow”, would come to be seen as a delusion that was induced by the extreme cold and the snow storm.''Ever since, this story known as The Phantom Father in the Snow was passed down among the knights in scrupulous detail. It was said that it was all a delusion brought about by the extreme cold and frightfully ferocious snow.'' [[Re:Zero Another Memory Snow]], Chapter 3, Section 2. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice|Bonds of Ice]]=== Seven years before the start of the Royal Selection, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her mentor and father figure. Sometime after unfreezing her, Puck and Emilia ended up in a conflict with one of the Four Great Spirits, the Arbitrator, [[Melakuera]]. After defeating the spirit, Puck succeeded him as a member of the Four Great Spirits, and he formed a contract with Emilia, causing both his and her memories to be sealed. For the next seven years, he continued to live with and protect Emilia inside the forest. One day, however, Roswaal L. Mathers appeared in the house that they were using, and because of the suspicion Puck had for the mage, the two wound up in battle. Eventually, Roswaal managed to talk with the Great Spirit, and he offered Emilia the Dragon Insignia, in which the Jewel glowed and determined her worth as a Royal Candidate. Despite Puck’s reservations, when Emilia learned of the Dragon’s blood that the ruler of the Kingdom has access to, she accepted the offer to come to [[Roswaal Manor]], and Puck decided to follow her. There, he reunited with Beatrice, and he became friendly with the maids. ===[[Emilia's Royal Capital Tour Book]]=== During her visit to the [[Royal Capital]], after getting separated from Ram, she and Puck wandered around the capital. She soon saw a [[Mimi Pearlbaton|little girl]] who was struggling to pay for the food she'd eaten. Emilia at first tried to help by paying for it with her own money, only to realize her wallet was missing. She then quickly thought of showing Puck around while doing tricks to earn some change for her. Her plan worked but not as intended as a citizen recognizes Puck as a great spirit and a whole crowd of people flee en masse, leaving their wallets behind due to hysteria, as they thought a half-elf would unleash the great spirit's wrath upon them if they did not pay. The little girl later thanked Emilia for the help she provided. It was a short while after that that her insignia was stolen by [[Felt]]. ===[[Behind the Scenes of Life in Another World from Zero]]=== Shortly after Felt stole her insignia, Emilia attacked her with magic and chased after her. After entering an alleyway, they couldn't find Felt, and nearby, they could hear a guard's whistle in response to the commotion. Though Emilia thought about asking for their help, Puck reminded her that she couldn't do that since she knew she was a Royal Selection candidate and couldn't let anyone else find out. Deciding to escape the area, she created an ice staircase and started running along the rooftops of the Royal Capital. The two talked about how they should proceed, whether to look for Ram and get her assistance or to solve the issue on their own and not owe Roswaal anymore before the Royal Selection started. Thinking about where Felt could be, they concluded that she was probably in the slums. Before heading there, however, Emilia noticed a tearful [[Plum Risch]] who was separated from her parents. Although the timing was bad, Emilia still attempted to help her, getting her to open up with ice sculptures and having Puck dance. Afterward, the two walked through the capital until they arrived at an appa stand, where the girl's [[Kadomon Risch|father]] and [[Raksha Risch|mother]] were. When Kadomon asked her how he could repay her, though she didn't give the full explanation, she asked about Felt and how something she had was stolen, leading him to tell her about the Loot House and warning her not to go there. Emilia still resolved to go there, and before she could go, Plum offered her a red flower ornament as thanks for her help. On her way to the slums, she found herself on the opposite side of [[Gaston|a]] [[Rachins Hoffman|few]] [[Camberley|thugs]]. However, before they could do anything to her, she quickly cornered them. Afterward, she asked them about the Loot House, and they pointed her in the right direction. Eventually, she found the Loot House, where three people inside were talking. When one of them noticed, she heard a young man say not to open the door or that they'd die, leading to Emilia pouting about not being so short tempered and the [[Loot House Incident]]. ===[[Emilia's Starry Sky Classroom]]=== Before the [[Wolgarm Incident]], Emilia visited the Forbidden Library to get Puck back from Beatrice before going to the garden. While at the library, she spoke with Beatrice and asked her if she would like to look at the stars with her and Subaru, mentioning that Subaru had taught her a whole lot about stars, some of them being Altair, Vega, and Betelgeuse, which she mispronounces as Petelgeuse; the last name brought out a reaction from Beatrice, and she kicked Emilia and Puck out of her library. Outside in the garden, she talked with Puck and mentioned that Subaru told her his name was inspired by the stars and could mean "Pleiades" from where he came from. She also said he taught her the story behind the Altair and Vega stars during Tanabata. Shortly after she finished the story, Subaru appeared, meaning that soon after, another sky classroom would begin. ===[[The Head Maid's Unrestful Holiday]]=== Noticing how hard Rem worked, Subaru spoke with the other residents of Roswaal Manor, and he proposed that she take a day off. Despite the slight opposition of the others, he was able to persuade them to agree after saying that she could use the day off to think about what she wanted as her reward for her participation in the Wolgarm Incident, and when Rem herself was reluctant to take a day off, Subaru told her to take the day off directly, and she agreed to his command immediately. Afterward, everyone decided on which jobs they would handle to make up for not having Rem’s help and split up to handle their respective tasks. Anxious, Rem went to see how everyone was faring with their tasks, and she went to the bath, where she expected Puck and Beatrice to be doing the laundry. Concerned due to the number of unique outfits that shouldn’t be cleaned together and worried about whether or not they could properly handle the fabric, she rushed to handle those herself. When she got there, however, she found Puck instructing Beatrice how to deal with clothes while cleaning his own load with magic. Overhearing their discussion about the tedium and necessity of doing laundry and coming to an understanding about why Subaru wanted to give Rem a day off, Rem walked away, grateful to them. ===[[The Great Spirit Puck's Nyan Nyan Nyan Sunny Day]]=== A few days after Puck was caught acting leisurely while in his free time, Puck searched for Subaru asking for help and tips, as Emilia seemed to be rather angry with him over the past few days. Subaru mentioned that it was his own fault for having proven with his actions that he was not the ideal role model he made himself out to be in front of Emilia. Ignoring Subaru's argument, Puck decided that the reason was because he needed to act much cuter. Since he had become much more serious as of late, he decided to go train poses to win Emilia's forgiveness. Much later, while Emilia was talking to Subaru about how she was still mad at Puck for lying to her about what he did in his free time, Puck appeared and did his poses as planned. In the end, Emilia forgave him, and Subaru, slightly annoyed, mentioned that "a pet only misbehaves if the owner spoils it rotten". ===[[Rem's Very Ordinary Happy Day]]=== One night, Rem was summoned by Roswaal and Puck, who requested snacks for their drinks. After she prepared the snacks, she was invited by the two to keep them company. After some small talk about their handling of alcohol and the night of the stargazing party, they began speaking about Subaru’s gate, which had been damaged during the Wolgarm Incident. Intent on bringing the best healer in the capital, [[Ferris]], he had discussed with Puck about using something from within Elior Forest, the magic stones, to bargain with Ferris, who was already a critical part of [[House Karsten]] and the [[Crusch Camp]]. After assigning Rem the task of keeping a close eye on Subaru, she left, having been slightly affected by the smell of the alcohol. ===[[The Great Spirit Puck's Nyan Nyan Tricks]]=== On the way to the castle for the Royal Selection Ceremony, Roswaal, Puck, and Emilia had a small talk in their carriage. Puck mentioned that the [[Volcanica|Dragon]] has a bad habit of choosing only women as priestesses to keep the lineage going. Emilia got confused as to what he meant, leading Roswaal to mention that Puck had a very overprotective nature to Emilia for not telling the whole story about the selection, which Puck replied that Emilia wouldn't become interested in something she isn't aware of. When they finally arrived at the castle, Roswaal asked Puck for a minute of his time for a private talk at a distance from Emilia. As they walked away, Puck noticed the castle was filled with imagery of the tale of the three heroes. Puck considered them works of art with a bad taste for their inaccuracy. Roswaal moved on to the main topic, mentioning that he wanted Puck's help in a little scheme of his, and he asked him to not grow violent inside the castle, revealing that he had a feeling that someone would insult Emilia during the ceremony and that Subaru would try to protect her. Puck immediately said to Roswaal that if he told Subaru to disobey Emilia's request to not come to the castle, then he would fight him right then and there. Roswaal denied his assumption, saying that he merely had a hunch. The conversation ended after Puck reluctantly agreed on the scheme. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== At one point, Puck was declared by the author one of the strongest characters in the series. Despite being an artificial spirit, he was able to defeat the previous member of the Four Great Spirits and even take his place, while he could also fight evenly with Roswaal, whose own magical prowess is among the best in the series, as well as delay his spells for a time. Although he was unable to display his true might because of his contract with Emilia, his strength is so overwhelming that he could very easily make good on his vow to end the world in the case of Emilia's death. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== Puck is very skilled at different types of magic, capable of using most, if not all, attributes of magic. However, he excels the most with the fire attribute. In fact, being the great spirit that presides over fire mana, it can be said that Puck is perhaps among the most proficient fire magic users in the series, and the sheer power of his fire magic even surpasses Roswaal's. However, like Emilia, Puck prefers using fire magic to produce ice. However, being an artificial spirit, he has a terrible mana consumption, and during the time he was contracted with Emilia, the two were actually considerably weaker. As such, to make up for his deficiency as an artificial spirit, should he need power from a source besides a contractor, he will drain it not from the atmosphere but from the surroundings, often leaving things frozen over in the process. '''Spells''': Puck Magic.gif|Puck uses Magic to create icicles and throwing them as projectiles at Elsa. Puck-Fire Magic.gif|Puck conjuring up several icicles to fight Melakuera. Puck using magic to clean Subaru.gif|Puck using Water Magic on Subaru. *'''Shamak''' (シャマク): Puck's target becomes unable to sense where they are. However, they can still feel the ground and sense what is happening to their body. *'''Healing Magic''' (治癒魔法, ''Chiyu Mahō''): Puck utilizes healing magic to give simple first aid to others.''Subaru, who was completely drenched, was getting first aid done on his wounds by Puck. He had no idea Puck could use healing magic, so it was surprising to him.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 2]], [[Ram is Order]], Section 5. However, he does not have an aptitude for it, so he can only lessen someone's pain and is unable to treat major wounds.''“Well, I don’t have much of an aptitude for healing magic, so I can’t treat grave wounds like Betty, but I can do enough to lessen someone’s pain.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 2]], [[Ram is Order]], Section 5. '''Unique Spells''': *'''Ice Flower''' (氷の花, ''Kōri no Hana''): Puck has demonstrated the ability to plant a seed within someone from which flowers of ice can later bloom. The flowers bloom by feeding off of negative emotions and sucking the host's blood and life force.''“Your anger and hatred toward that girl and myself will cause it to grow. Even merely thinking or wishing evil upon us will feed it. ――And in the end, it might even pierce right through you.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 2, Section 9 *'''Absolute Zero''' (絶対零度): Puck can freeze things to absolute zero temperatures, causing the target to quickly crumble to pieces under their own weight. He was also able to release Emilia from being frozen, despite having been frozen at absolute zero by her own power for almost a hundred years, and the fact that only someone with equal power to Emilia could unfreeze her. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== As an artificial spirit, Puck has several drawbacks. He has a terrible mana consumption rate and cannot absorb mana from the atmosphere. Because of this, he requires either a contractor or to draw mana from the surroundings, which can leave behind negative aftereffects. Similarly, thanks to a vow that he made, during his time contracted with Emilia, he broke another vow that led to his temporary loss of memories''"The reason I never spoke of forming a contract with you was because I made a vow."'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 4, Section 8. and other issues, such as when he could appear. Even now, he is struggling to manifest because of the crystal he is being held in, which does not contain enough power to allow himself to appear. Puck - Star Beastification.gif|Puck transforming into the '''Beast of the End'''. Melakuera VS Puck.gif|Beast of the End versus The Arbitrator. '''Star Beastification''' (星獣化 ''Seijuuka''): While normally staying small in size, Puck's true form is a monstrous, 20 meter, glowing yellow eyed (in the anime it's been shown that Puck is able to keep his icy green eye color in that form if he controls his temper) cat-like beast, dubbed "the Beast of the End". As he needs an incredible amount of mana to stay in this form, he forcibly drains it from his surroundings, causing them to freeze. {{Clear}} Pack - Re Zero Anime BD - 9.png|Handheld sized Puck. Subaru and Pack - Re Zero Anime BD - 1.png|Puck enlarged to a human's size. Puck ep.48 (5).png|Puck gigantified. '''Size Manipulation''': Puck is able to manipulate his size somewhat freely. He can be the size of the average cat, smaller than one’s palm, and, in rare cases, the rough size of his Star Beastification. Though he usually has no need for the excessively large size, he can use it to trick his enemies into thinking he is using his full strength to catch them off guard. However, he does not have complete freedom over his size. If he does not have enough mana, he might not be able to do much as maintain his proper size. {{Clear}} ===Other=== '''Curse Removal''': Puck, just like Beatrice, can sense when an individual has been affected by a [[curse]]. He can tell where on a person's body a curse has been placed and can subsequently remove it. However, Puck can only remove a curse if the caster has yet to activate the curse they have placed on a person. Furthermore, he can't tell the effects the curse would inflict on an individual without observing the curse in effect.''"Magic healed them a fair bit, so Betty and I will lift those curses in no time at all."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 3]], Chapter 4, Section 2. '''Mana Drain''': Unlike most spirits, Puck does not absorb mana from the atmosphere. Instead, Puck obtains his mana from living creatures. By touching an individual, Puck can absorb the mana stored in their gate, bolstering his own supply of mana in the process. The individual affected by the technique would become physically fatigued if enough of their mana was drained. He is the only one besides Beatrice that knows this skill,''"In this manor, only Bubby and I can perform such a feat. Even Roswaal cannot."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 2]], Chapter 4, Section 1. though Reinhard displayed a similar ability at the end of Arc 1. '''Pseudo-Telepathy''': Puck is capable of reading the surface thoughts or intentions of individuals he comes into contact with to an extent. He can also communicate telepathically through this with anyone who has an affinity with spirits, even without Emilia being aware. Likewise, Puck is capable of freely and remotely communicating with Beatrice by using something similar to his telepathy.''"While Beatrice was harboring that impression, a voice unexpectedly reached the back of her mind. It wasn't a voice that maintained a distinct form, but due to it being a voice with 'Power', it's intentions were conveyed clearly."'' [[Librarian Beatrice's Log: Restart]], Chapter 1. However, this ability seems to be one-way, as it seems Beatrice cannot reply. The range of this ability is unknown, but it seems to work across different dimensions, as Puck was able to call Beatrice from inside the mansion while she was still in the Forbidden Library with Subaru.''"—Bubby is calling. It would seem this is an urgent matter."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 2]], Chapter 5, Section 7. ==Trivia== *Puck shares his name with [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Puck_(moon) one of the moons of Uranus]. The moon itself was named after a mischievous spirit from William Shakespeare’s play ''[https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Midsummer_Night%27s_Dream A Midsummer Night’s Dream]''. Ironically, Uranus is an ice giant. *According to the author, Puck is scheduled to receive a named chapter some time down the line. *According to the author, if he was a [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu|Re:Zero]] character then he'd want to be Puck. *Puck was severely weakened during the time he was contracted to Emilia. *Lesser spirits are scared of Puck so Emilia couldn't make a contract with them if Puck was present. *Puck decided all of Emilia's hairstyles and clothes. *In the author's character strength ranking in June 2014, Puck was ranked as the 5th strongest character in the series and was said to be able to singlehandedly bring down the [[White Whale]], though the list may have changed since then.''“Reinhard, Ram, Regulus, Sekhmet, and serious Puck. Even though they are like dango under Reinhard, these guys are capable of bringing down the White Whale by themselves.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473455745506476032 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] *During [[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]], Puck can be observed using English words. Roughly three years after his being made into an artificial spirit, during the era of the Witches four centuries ago, Puck used Japanese and English words without having seemingly been informed of their meaning by someone else, something that no other characters apart from Subaru and Al have done as a result of them not having knowledge of Japan. It has not been clarified if Puck was taught these words by someone else or if he already knew of them. *Puck likes mayonnaise; this was noted by Rem after the condiment was introduced to the mansion. *Puck, despite his knowledge of Japanese phrases and culture, was unsure if the mayonnaise that Rem and Subaru invented was safe. *If Emillia died, the world would be frozen in a violent maelstrom. That is a part of his contract with Emilia. *Puck is stated to be the first artificial spirit created by Echidna the witch, [[Eridna|Echidna]] (artificial spirit) being the second and Beatrice being the last.''"Of the artificial spirits that were created by the "Witch" Echidna, in which Beatrice is included, only 3 exist in the world. The first of which is Puck, and the last is Beatrice."'' [[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose]], Section 2. *In the IF chapter commonly referred to as Mimagau IF, Puck makes an appearance as a female cat-shaped spirit named Tinkerbell (ティンカーベル), which is shortened to Tink (ティンク). *[[Wikipedia:Erica Mendez|Erica Mendez]], Puck's English voice actress, also voices [[Petra Leyte]] and [[Mimi Pearlbaton]]. *According to the author, Puck can put more power into fire mana than Roswaal can, while Roswaal is more skillful with it.''"If it’s skillfully, then Roswaal. If it’s strongly, then Puck."''
