Mathers]]. She has played supporting roles in every arc except for [[Arc 1]] and [[Arc 5]]. Originally, Ram was born into the [[Oni|Oni Tribe]] with a single horn and displayed exceptional talent and strength which resulted in the village referring to her as the reincarnation of the [[Minor Characters#Oni God|Oni God]]. However, after an attack orchestrated by the [[Witch Cult]], she lost her horn and, together with her sister, was saved by Roswaal L. Mathers. In return, Ram swore to help Roswaal in his own endeavors, pledging to help him kill the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]], and as she started to fall in love with the Margrave, she harbored the intent to destroy him: his desires, wishes, and feelings, intending to take him away.''“Your desires, your wishes, your feelings──I will destroy all of it. While helping you out with that which means everything to you, I will take you away.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Epilogue, Section 2. ==Appearance== Ram has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish red eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards the right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a black-white floral hairband, which is connected to the ribbon. She looks nearly identical to her sister Rem, apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform. She has a smaller chest compared to her sister, and she has slanted eyes. At times, she also wears a white hooded robe for when she is traveling on her own. She also has a uniform for colder days, which covers her shoulders, has longer sleeves, fluffier cuffs around the wrists, and a pair of pink earmuffs. In [[Arc 6]], [[Arc 7]], and [[Arc 8]] Ram wears a long-sleeved aqua-green dress with white frills at the hem of the long skirt, aqua-green boots, brown corset with three belts (two in the anime), black leggings, and an aqua-green cloak with a white design on the hood to protect her from the sands of the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], while still wearing the hair clips, the ribbon and the hairband. From [[Arc 9]] onward, however, she returned to wearing her maid uniform. When she was young, she wore a white kimono and a pair of zoris, a native dress to the onis, and her hair was the same as in the present day.''She was a very young girl. She had on a white kimono, which was a native dress, and she wore zoris on her feet. Even though the playful age was evident in her short, blue hair, she seemed to be squinting the eyes of her lovely face in a lonely way.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1.''A pink haired little girl was looking at Rem, who turned around as if on demand. She had the same hairdo and clothes as Rem, and she had beautiful, light pink eyes. It was a girl who looked like she was full of dignity and self-confidence.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. After joining [[Roswaal Manor]]'s staff, she started to don a maid uniform that matched her size. At one point, during a Tammuz Festival, she wore a pink dress for her maid uniform, complete with a bejeweled tiara that Roswaal had bought for her.''She wore a pink dress as her maid clothes. She had a tiara with jewels as hair ornaments. Her whole outfit was new, and Ram looked pretty like a fairy. But Ram was displeased with those clothes, and above all, that wasn’t what she was concerned with at this time.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 3. ==Personality== Ram is seemingly self-centered, sardonic, and does things at her own pace. However, in actuality, she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond. Her sardonic remarks are her way of teasing others. While she's cold and snarky outwardly, she is caring of others around her deep down, and she is surprisingly kind and forgiving towards others. At the same time, however, she dislikes being told to stand back by others during battles and instead prefers to fight for herself.''"Men say things like “I’m worried about yooou~” and “You’d better stay baaack~”, but Ram would rather prove them wrong. ――And tell them to mind their own business."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 100, Section 3. Even at a young age, she showed a level of wisdom that was beyond the adults,''Someone still young like Rem could not understand much of what Ram was saying. Rem’s own sister, who was the same age as her, showed a level of wisdom that put adults to shame, and that made her feel worthless.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. which had nothing to do with age or readiness,''“You oughtn’t treat her like a kid only when it’s convenient. Plus, well, in my eyes, it looks like this girl’s nature has nothing to do with age and readiness.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 2. was fully aware of her outstanding position, did not care about the restoration of her tribe,''“It was as boring as always. The reincarnation of an Oni God, the restoration of the race and all that… It’s so stupid.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1.''“I understand that the adults are desperate and that they have expectations in me. I know how outstanding I am. But we can’t go back in time… Those adults don’t understand that.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. felt that it would be troublesome if she was put in a position of importance,''“What do you need from the chief? If you get the chief killed now, the role would be handed over to me and that would be troublesome, so I would appreciate it if you didn’t try that.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. and didn't open up to anyone other than Rem.''Everyone in the village adored and respected Ram. But on the other hand, Ram didn’t open up to anyone in the village, and she thought that expectations and respect and such were troublesome. The younger twin Rem was the only one Ram truly loved from the bottom of her heart. It was the treasure that Rem was most proud of, and at the same time, the most suffocating burden.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. Despite this, she did feel vengeful toward the ones who destroyed her village, and she swore retribution on them,''“Retribution. We have to obtain it. ──We must wreak the grudge of our kind.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 2, Section 5. which she and Rem ultimately achieved. While Ram tends to come off as rather lazy in her work as a maid, often seen taking breaks and doing a shoddy job with whichever task she is given, in truth, her body, which is constantly experiencing pain from the severance of her horn, prevents her from doing too many physical tasks.''In this past month, there was one big problem that became clear to Ram upon living at the mansion. It was the harmful effect of losing her horn, which was the chronic mana deficiency that threatened her body. Currently, Ram’s condition was kept stable because of Roswaal’s treatment every evening. However, originally this was supposed to only take care of the role that a horn should fulfill. It was also a treatment that was solely limited to preventing her rampages, and it was far off from being the ability she had when her horn wasn’t gone. In conclusion, Ram’s body was always in a malnutrition-like condition, and she couldn’t even do activities by the book. She was only able to go on as a result of her tough mental strength, no doubt about it. Of course, there was no way she could accomplish her duties as a maid satisfactorily. Still, Ram stubbornly engaged in roles, and she bestirred herself to try and do the same work as Rem.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Because of this, she does whatever work she physically can, which includes completing documents related to the affairs of the Mathers Domain whenever Roswaal in unable to, though she keeps this a secret from her sister. Also, when she was young, she often experienced impulses driving her to fight and kill, and those impulses only got stronger as she aged and got more powerful. She resisted them for a long time until the day that her horn was severed from her, which effectively ended those impulses. Despite the pain that comes with the loss of her horn and the restraint of most of her strength behind "shackles", however, she actually believed that it was a good thing, which she affirmed during her battle with [[Lye Batenkaitos]], when she realized her impulse to kill would be far too hard to resist if they had remained. Throughout her life, even as early as shortly after her birth, Ram was extremely protective of her sister, Rem. Because of her sheer genius and her position in the Oni Tribe, she recognized Rem's inferiority complex and often did everything she could to include her in various small tasks like cooking, and she did everything she could to protect her. Even as her village was destroyed, her priority was saving her sister over the other members of the clan. Likewise, she even decided to serve Roswaal to protect her, as she was aware of Roswaal's knowledge of the attack on their village and his effective use of her as a shackle to her sister. Initially, she did find him suspicious. As time passed, this hatred eventually shifted to more complicated feelings, which is why she chose to help him achieve his goal while simultaneously claiming to destroy his desires, wishes, and feelings, having even attempted to kiss him after a mere three months of knowing the man. After she lost memories of Rem, everything that complicated their relationship vanished, which transformed those feelings into outright love, and in that love, she would be willing to do everything she could to set the man on the right path, even if it means getting in the way of his dream or exposing herself to danger by his hands. During times of emergency, Ram has a tendency to hide her worry and concern under her usual demeanor, consistently acting as though she was unbothered. Despite this, when information reaches her ears regarding those she is worried about, she has no issue pointing her wand at someone she is friendly with, claiming that if they were to get in her way that she would kill them regardless of who they are, such as when she was confronting [[Serena Dracroy]] when Rem and [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] were in [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. Likewise, in times of extreme stress, she will become very emotional and act in denial. When Subaru, whom she often relies on and places a considerable amount of trust in, and who was the only person who remembered her sister after her name and memories were devoured by Gluttony, lost his memories, she confronted him while not believing him, claiming that it was an act, and even when he told her that it was not an act, she was immensely shaken, yelled at him, and held him against the wall in frustration. In one failed loop, she even flew into a murderous rage when she believed he was an impostor. She herself has acknowledged the flaws of her character in an emotional conversation she had with Rem, once her memories of the latter were restored in a failed loop. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]=== Immediately after their birth, [[Setanta]], the chieftain of the Oni Tribe, decided to kill the Rem and Ram for being born as twins. After Ram displayed her power and prevented him from killing them, however, the onis knelt and saw her as the reincarnation of the oni god. Growing up, Ram was shown to have prodigious talent for combat, mana manipulation, and even excelled in other matters, such as cooking, and the onis showered her in adoration. She would often be taken out on hunts to kill [[witchbeast]]s and participate in meetings with the adults. However, she always found such meetings boring and pointless, and she never let any the attention toward her get to her head, never forgetting her little sister and only opening up to her. One day, when Rem awoke and panicked when she saw that her sister was not with her, Rem raced off and eventually found Ram, who reassured her. Afterward, Ram felt a visitor had approached the village and went to confront him. Meeting an [[Rom|old giant]] who claimed to know and wanted to meet with Setanta, Ram, who was wary of him, took him to meet the chief. After meeting with him, Setanta introduced the man as Cromwell, though the giant claimed he now went by Rom. Though Setanta ordered Rem to go home and Ram to stay behind, Ram harshly refused and left with Rem, leaving Setanta and Rom to talk to each other. Though Rem was concerned if Ram was okay to do that, Ram reassured her, and after using her magic to deal with a chore, the two went to play and collect yams for steamed potatoes, and Rem forgot Ram’s serious expression as she pondered the meaning of the meeting. When they returned to the village, they came across an angry Setanta and Rom, who had apparently declined Setanta’s request. With Rom leaving and telling Setanta not to treat Ram as a kid only when it was convenient, he left the village, telling the girls to be good sisters. Sometime later, the Witch Cult attacked her village, killing everyone and burning it to the ground. During the attack, Ram was the last one standing and slaughtered numerous Witch Cultists, and she went to protect Rem, who had emerged from their house and was about to be attacked. However, as an explosion threatened to kill Rem, Ram grabbed her and leapt away. Taking injuries as she continued fighting, she was eventually faced with one of the men, [[Faust]], who prepared to kill them. As he swung, Ram stood in front of Rem to protect her, and her horn was severed. Rem, who had felt jumbled emotions of both slight joy and extreme guilt, passed out from the shock. Ram, despite her injuries, managed to grab Rem and run, escaping the men. However, they eventually collapsed on the mountain road, where Roswaal L. Mathers discovered them on the way to their village. Upon meeting Ram, who asked to save Rem, Roswaal asked what she could offer him, to which she offered herself, saying that she couldn't make decisions for Rem. When Rem next awoke, she was in Roswaal Manor, and Ram, whose face was pale, was next to her. Recalling what happened to the village, she was despondent. Then, a maid, [[Frederica Baumann]], appeared in the room to retrieve Ram, introducing herself and slightly startling Rem with her teeth, which made them both feel guilty. As Frederica scolded Ram and mentioned her broken horn, the memories of what happened at the end of the attack on the oni village ran through Rem's mind, and in her panic, her horn protruded from her head and she thrashed around, forcing Ram and Frederica to hold her down. After Ram bit down on her horn and made her pass out, Ram passed out beside her, leaving the indignant Frederica to deal with the mess. A little while later, Rem was brought to Ram's room, where she saw Ram writhing in pain as her mana was running wild and locked down to the bed. After being told that Ram had been holding this in until after she saw Rem was okay, Rem ran back to her room, where she begged Roswaal to save Ram. Like with Ram, he asked what Rem could offer him in return, to which she offered herself. Pleased with her response, he muttered that taking the sizes for the maid outfits should be left to [[Clind]], and he went to deal with Ram's rampaging mana. Later, when Ram awoke, she and Rem spoke, with Rem revealing that she offered herself to serve Roswaal. Ram, who realized that they were being toyed with, explained that she did the same for Rem, making Rem happy. Afterward, the two embraced, and with Ram claiming that the men who destroyed their village got away, she decided to claim retribution on them, and Rem, who wasn't particularly sorrowful about the destruction of their village, agreed. Later, Clind prepared maid outfits for Ram and Rem. Ram notes how there are almost exclusively demi-humans working for Roswaal, to which Frederica explained that Roswaal took in demi-humans with nowhere to go, and he gave them a job and an education without asking for anything in return. They notice how it was different for Rem and Ram, which Frederica suspects is because the sisters would have rushed out of the manor otherwise, which Ram could not refute. Over the following month, the two were taught by Frederica and Clind how to speak and act as a servant and a basic education. However, it is also discovered that the loss of Ram's horn interfered with Ram's work. One day, when Ram interrupted a conversation between Rem and Roswaal, she and Rem left the room. Ram noticed Rem's formal speech, which had become a habit, and the two spoke about their relationship with Roswaal. As they walked, however, Rem got lost in her thoughts, and when Ram called out to her, she spoke formally again, something which worried Ram. Another month passed, and in the time the two were at the manor, they had seen numerous servants go to work at other mansions once they were confirmed to have received satisfactory education. One day, Roswaal prepared to set off for the Sanctuary, intent on bringing Ram with him. Soon after, after convincing the two it was for their own good to be separated for a time, he and Ram left for the Sanctuary, Frederica giving a letter to Ram to give to her brother, [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]]. When Roswaal and Ram returned, after they saw the aftermath of the battle between Rem and [[Fogg]], Ram stuck by Rem's side, and when Rem later awoke, Ram asleep nearby, she spoke with Roswaal, claiming that she would act as Ram's horn and substitute. Another month later, Roswaal, Frederica, Ram, and Rem visited the [[Royal Capital]], which was celebrating the Tammuz Festival, to buy a gift to celebrate the birth of child of House Miload. Deciding to split up to search for a gift, Roswaal took Ram with him while Frederica took Rem, and the two decided to meet up again later. During their time apart, Roswaal bought new clothes for Ram and gave her a new wand fashioned from her horn. When the two groups reunited, they discussed the possible plans that the Witch Cult were scheming, as Frederica and Rem discovered magical miasma stones. Deciding to split again, Roswaal and Ram went to alert the capital's guardsmen while Frederica beastified and took Rem with her to look for the scattered stones, which Ram had predicted the locations of. Eventually, Ram noticed [[Sado]] attempting to flee, and connecting to Rem with her Clairvoyance and Synesthesia, she used her new wand to snipe Sado and sever his limbs. Afterward, Roswaal complimented her, though he also showed concern, mentioning their promise. Ten days later, Roswaal brought Rem and Ram to the Miload Manor, where they met the pregnant [[Grace Miload]], Roswaal's excuse for bringing them being that they ought to see childbirth for themselves, and his continued interactions with Grace made Ram grumpy. After a short conversation, Rem and Ram went to another room, where, after a different conversation about being unable to kill time and how Rem did so in the village, interacted with the servants of the manor. Three days later, [[Dudley Miload]] was late in returning to the manor, and when a [[Sergei|young man]] arrived to tell everyone that the carriage broke down, Roswaal and Rem went to retrieve him, leaving Ram to keep Grace company. A short while later, Ram had noticed [[Attack on Miload Manor|something wrong]] and ordered the nearby [[Minor Characters#Limrear|Limrear]] to take Grace and prepare to move just as the manor trembled. Claiming it was the Witch Cult, one that she was familiar with, after looking through the dying eyes of the servants, she led the two to another room while simultaneously using Clairvoyance. Scared, Limrear led the group into a certain room, where they came across several corpses of servants. At the same time, Grace's water broke, so Ram told Limrear to take Grace into the room and help her deliver the baby while she went to hold off the Witch Cultist, Faust. As the man began to smoke his leaf tobacco, Ram attacked him, dodging his explosions by sensing the disturbance in mana. Although she didn't do lasting damage, she used Al Fura try and kill him, destroying the hallway in the process. However, Faust managed to avoid the worst of it with his wind reading skills. Grabbing her by the throat, he intended to throw her into the explosive traps set in the garden, only for Rem to appear and hit him in the head with her morningstar. With Ram on her back, the two avoided the explosions, and Rem struck him. When he attempted a sneak attack, she managed to counter him, and she struck him numerous times while piercing through the upper floors. After pushing through the roof, Rem struck the man and sent him flying into the explosive traps, and when Ram threw his burning leaf tobacco into it, they went off, reducing the man to ash. Later, Roswaal returned, having killed the Witch Cultists and brought Sergei back for the twins to kill. Afterward, Limrear appeared, saying that the baby had been born but that Grace didn't have much time left. In the room she was in, several bloody rags were nearby, and the baby was in the arms of a servant. Waking Grace, she gave her baby the name [[Annerose Miload|Annerose]], and she asked Roswaal to take care of her. Dying, she said that she loved Roswaal, and she laughed when he returned her words, saying he was a bad liar. In the end, she died, leaving the servants to cry. After this, Roswaal became Annerose's guardian, and House Miload was put under his control. Many of the remaining servants who survived resigned, and Roswaal decided to have Clind and Frederica serve at House Miload, with Roswaal choosing to have his hobby of taking care of and training demi-human servants being performed at the Miload Manor and by those two. One night, after giving them this task, he spoke with Ram, who believed that he set up the whole affair to give the girls their retribution, and she asked if the sacrifices of Dudley and Grace was worth it. When Roswaal claimed that he would sacrifice anyone for his goal, Ram told him that she would help him achieve his goal, attempting to kiss him while doing so, only for Roswaal to stop her. Pouting, Ram said that she would destroy him: his goals, desires, and emotions. A year later, Rem and Ram visited the Oni village's grave and performed their funeral rites with alcohol given to them by Roswaal. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Really Really Complicated and Twisted Love Affair ZERO]]=== Shortly after her first visit to the Sanctuary with Roswaal, Ram met Garfiel, who was immediately infatuated and attempted to propose to her twice. However, she rejected him both times, and he continued to have a crush on her. During one of her later visits to the Sanctuary, Garfiel asked why she was working with Roswaal when he didn't really need her assistance. Although she initially joked that Rem was held hostage, she told him that it was more like she had become Rem's shackle. Seeing her sad, Garfiel decided to start studying and reading to help get rid of what made Ram sad. One night, having found an appa, he intended to give it to Ram, but he found Roswaal giving Ram mana. Not understanding what was happening, he unconsciously beastified for the first time and attacked Roswaal but was handily knocked out. When he later awoke to see Ram, she told him what happened and said he needed to get control of it before explaining her circumstances about her severed horn. From then, Garfiel decided to become strong, and afterward, he asked her to marry him many times. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Complicated Love Affair]]=== A short time after Roswaal brought [[Emilia]] to Roswaal Manor, Roswaal and Ram visited the Sanctuary. Garfiel, finding the talk between Roswaal and [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu]] boring, left the conversation to talk to Ram. After a short conversation about Garfiel's willingness to continue chasing after Ram, despite her love being for Roswaal, he asked for an explanation for their unusual visit, to which Ram told him about Emilia being brought to the manor and the potential involvement of the Sanctuary. Ram gave her impression of Emilia as lacking in every manner, though she didn't give a final conclusion since she hadn't been given the chance to learn anything, and Garfiel realized that Roswaal intended to back her in the [[Royal Selection]] for his own schemes, which angered Garfiel and made him question if he'd gone mad. Before he could transform, Ram calmed him down, and soon after Roswaal appeared, saying they wouldn't be staying for long. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Really Complicated Love Affair]]=== One day later on, intending to let her see the "White Snow Sakura", Ram brought Rem to the Sanctuary. After Rem went to speak to Ryuzu, Ram spoke with Garfiel about why she was there without Roswaal. When Rem returned, she sent Garfiel flying away and started talking with Ram. After Garfiel quickly recovered, he and Rem started to argue, and the sisters playfully complained about Garfiel finding out about what they were there for. Ram worried about how Rem rarely got to act herself, though their worry made her dismiss the thought. Eventually, the arrived at their destination, and the twins were mesmerized by the sight of the trees covered in white flowers. They eventually sat down to eat, and after a moment, Garfiel passed out of Ram's shoulder. After learning from Rem that Rem and Garfiel had actually worked together to bring Ram here, she moved his head to her lap and ran her hand through his hair in gratitude. After a few moments, however, she moved Garfiel so that the jealous Rem could lay her head on her lap instead. ===[[Ram's Flirting Refusal]]=== On the day of Subaru's summoning, Roswaal sent Ram with Emilia to the Royal Capital, and shortly after, they got separated from each other, leading to Ram searching for her. As she searched, she met a helmeted man, [[Al]], who was searching for his own master, [[Priscilla Barielle]]. However, the discussion ended quickly, and Ram decided to leave, to which the man replied "Well, goodbye, Ram..." with a nostalgic voice. Though she questioned how he knew her name, the man was gone, and she continued her search for Emilia. Shortly after, she was confronted by the three thugs, [[Gaston|Ton]], [[Rachins Hoffman|Chin]], and [[Camberley|Kan]], who she quickly dispatched. Leaving the area, she bore witness to bright lights coming from the direction of the slums, and with a good feeling, she headed that way. Arriving at her destination at the aftermath of the [[Loot House Incident]], she found Emilia and a teenage boy in her arms. After this, they returned to Roswaal Manor to have the boy healed. ===[[Ram and the Night Study Group]]=== One night, as Ram attempted to teach Subaru the alphabet of their world, Subaru was doing poorly, leading Subaru to complain about the difficulty of learning something new in a short time. Challenging Ram to attempt to do the same, he made a bet with her about who would be able to learn faster during that night, either him learning glyphs or Ram learning Japanese writing, saying that in case he lost, she could be stricter as a teacher. If she lost, Ram would have to be kinder and less strict with him, a bet that she accepted with pride. At the end of the night, Subaru gave her an exam with questions that Ram could easily answer after studying Japanese, much to Subaru's shock and frustration as now she would be harsher in his lessons. After leaving Subaru's room, Ram had a funny feeling that she had already seen all those Japanese characters somewhere else,''“...It feels like I’ve seen it somewhere before.”'' [[Ram and the Night Study Group]] but she quickly dismissed it and went to bed shortly after. ===[[Rem's Latte Art]]=== The next evening, Ram found Rem alone in the dining room still attempting to draw something good with the latte art that Subaru had taught her about earlier that day. Ram picked one cup and, on her first try, drew the symbol of "older sister" in Japanese that she had learned from Subaru the night before. Rem was amazed that her sister managed this and could be so incredible, getting sad that she failed as well. Before leaving, Rem tasted the coff and found out it is really bad, deciding to teach Subaru how to brew it properly first before playing with it next time. ===[[The World Petra Saw]]=== The day after Subaru saved [[Petra Leyte|Petra]] and the other children from the [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarms]], Ram was the one who met them when they visited the manor to see Subaru. She escorted them to his room, where he was still unconscious from his injuries and bore witness as they wrote on his bandages and as Petra froze before running off in guilt. ===[[Ram's Older Sister Heart is Complicated]]=== After the [[Wolgarm Incident]], Rem started to become very attached to Subaru, something that began to disturb Ram over time. She grew harsher toward Subaru due to this. Although she had always wished that someone would appear to curb Rem's insecurities and make her truly smile again, she felt disgusted to think that person as being Subaru. While inspecting the work Subaru had been dealing with while being annoyed by these thoughts, she overworked herself in an effort to be better than Subaru, resulting in her collapsing in front of him. This caused Subaru to take care of Ram in her room since Rem was too busy to do so, much to Ram's annoyance. In the end, Rem visited after finishing her chores and noticed that Ram slept while holding Subaru's hand, saying that this rare scene must be because she finally accepted Subaru, with Subaru replying that he wasn't so sure since she had insulted him from the beginning to the very last minute until she asked to hold hands before sleeping. ===[[The Head Maid's Unrestful Holiday]]=== Noticing how hard Rem worked, Subaru spoke with the other residents of Roswaal Manor, and he proposed that she take a day off. Despite the slight opposition of the others, he was able to persuade them to agree after saying that she could use the day off to think about what she wanted as her reward for her participation in the Wolgarm Incident, and when Rem herself was reluctant to take a day off, Subaru told her to take the day off directly, and she agreed to his command immediately. Afterward, everyone decided on which jobs they would handle to make up for not having Rem’s help and split up to handle their respective tasks. Despite the time off, Rem became anxious at essentially doing nothing, and deciding to check in on everyone, she snuck out of her room. Particularly concerned about her sister, Rem arrived at the kitchen, where she overheard Ram complaining to Roswaal about Subaru’s idea to have him participate in the housework. However, Roswaal was fine participating and even claimed that Subaru’s idea wasn’t misguided. As Rem decided to leave, she noticed Roswaal had noticed her and quietly thanked him for not saying anything. The next morning, as she cared for Ram, she noticed that Rem was rather happy, which she attributed to her day off. After greeting Subaru when he awoke and some small banter, when he asked if she had an idea for her reward, she claimed she already got it, which she believed was everything that happened the day prior. ===[[Emilia and Ram's Bumpy Master-Servant Relationship]]=== One night, Ram found Emilia trying to sing with a bucket over her head in the silent of the night, much to her confusion. Emilia asked Ram if she remembered her singing from a meal that they had a little while prior, and Emilia sadly admitted that she needed a bit of improvement when singing, so she mentioned that she was using the bucket on her head to hear her own voice better and notice where she was failing, as per Subaru's suggestion. Ram, at first, did not take Emilia seriously and was annoyed by her ingenuity, but she remembered that these characteristics reminded her of Rem, and she offered to help Emilia until she got better. Later that night, Ram stated that Emilia's singing improved a bit, deserving a 9 out of 100, and her prior attempts were too bad to give a rating at all. Regardless, Ram said she would keep her word and attempt to help Emilia as a teacher night after night in this very long road of learning how to sing. ===[[Emilia and Ram's Very Bumpy Master-Servant Relationship]]=== During one of their singing lessons in a soundproof room, Ram noticed that Emilia was not performing well at all and asked what was disturbing her. Emilia mentioned that she wished to find a way to properly reward Subaru for all he had done and asked Ram what should she do, since she didn't believe that the rewards he asked for were enough. The girls started to gossip about what the best reward to give would be. The next day, Ram brought Subaru to the dinner table, and Emilia presented steamed potatoes made with mayonnaise to him, a dish she proudly announced as the efforts of herself and Ram, much to Ram's annoyance, as she didn't want Emilia to reveal she helped at all. Later that night, Rem spoke with Ram about this event and said she was a bit jealous of being left out. After Rem left, Ram angrily comments while grinding her teeth that Subaru was unforgivable. ===[[Some Like it Cold]]=== One morning, due to the excessive cold, Ram had slept in, and over the next couple of days, it continued to drop in temperature. After discovering that the cold was due to Puck, a meeting was then held in the dining room, where it was explained that the cause for the cold weather was because of Puck's [[Magic#Organs and Conditions|magical release period]]. Due to Subaru's ignorance of the concept of [[Magic#Organs and Conditions|Od]], [[Beatrice]] elucidated the subject to him. When asked about the sudden surge in cold weather, Puck answered that it was due to the fact that he figured he could get away with upping the magical exertion. After formally apologizing to Subaru, Emilia asked Puck how much longer this cold weather will last. Puck answered that it would be another two days before it ended. Emilia also revealed that due to having a contract with Puck, she had become immune to cold temperatures. Though Subaru attempts to come up with ideas to order to pass the cold, each of his ideas was refuted. Back in the dining room, Subaru and Ram huddled by the fireplace. When Roswaal and Beatrice were asked about how they dealt with their surplus of Od, they revealed their respective methods. It is also revealed that Rem doesn't have enough magical energy the needed to have a magic release period, while Emilia maintained hers quite easily thanks to Puck. Subaru then asked when the last time Puck used his energy to his heart's content, which Puck claimed was during the fights with Elsa and Roswaal months prior, something of which Roswaal and Puck reminisced on. Sometime later, Subaru, Rem, and Emilia left to collect firewood. During this, Subaru comes up with the idea to hold a snow festival to help squander Puck's abundance of mana, something that was inspired by Hokkaido in Japan. The next day, Subaru explained to the residents of [[Arlam Village]] and the manor that whoever manages to create the best snow sculpture would be rewarded with a prize, something which leads to everyone working on their respective sculptures, and the judges turn out to be Subaru, Roswaal, and [[Rasphum]]. As Subaru and Roswaal observed the sculptures, Subaru eventually came to Rem and Ram, whose sculpture was hidden behind a curtain. When they reveal their sculpture, it turned out to be what they called the Wonderful Subuwaal-sama Sculpture, a sculpture with characteristics of both Subaru and Roswaal. When Roswaal walked up and saw the sculpture, he was left despondent, and the low ratings given by the two judges flabbergasted the twins, leading them to discuss what went wrong with it. In the end, the winner was Petra. ===[[Alcohol Panic]]=== One day, Subaru and Ram were in the basement of the manor, Subaru cleaning while Ram was taking a nap. After a short argument, Subaru found a hidden door, and after Ram decided to run off in the event things were dangerous, Subaru discovered alcohol. Two nights after that, the residents of the manor held a party. After a speech from Subaru, everyone partook from the food and alcohol available. During the party, Emilia and Rem both got drunk, Rem in particular becoming drunk off of the mere smell of the alcohol without having drunk any, attached themselves to Subaru, and teased him until they both fell asleep on his lap. Ram, meanwhile, easily held her own liquor. She and Subaru spoke lightly about the alcohol tolerance of onis, and Ram mentioned that she and Rem had grown up with special circumstances. Seeing Beatrice by her lonesome outside on the balcony, Subaru decided to join her. Before he made it to her, Subaru's gaze had landed on Emilia and Rem, who were embracing one another while asleep, and Ram said that she would etch the image into her eyelids. ===[[Rem's Very Ordinary Happy Day]]=== One morning, a month after Subaru’s arrival at the manor, Rem set about her daily routine of watching Subaru’s sleeping face for a while and waking her sister. During her conversation with Ram, she muttered about whether she should grow out her hair, which Ram pointed out was because Emilia’s hair was long, implying it was for her to grab Subaru’s attention. Despite her grumbling about Subaru not being worthy of Rem, Rem was happy that Ram did not dislike Subaru. Later that morning, as she watched Subaru and Emilia in the garden, Beatrice appeared nearby and started speaking with Rem, having been keeping an eye on her to make sure she did not overwork herself with the excuse that she did not want to be dragged into another one of Subaru’s ideas. The two discussed how his presence changed the twins and Beatrice, and as Beatrice left for the Forbidden Library, Rem stated she would call for her when breakfast was ready, something that Beatrice started to participate in over the past month. That afternoon, Rem sent Subaru and Ram to Arlam Village to shop in an effort for them to become better friends. The next morning, Ram found Rem asleep in Subaru's arms and gave Subaru a thrashing. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Really Really Complicated and Twisted Love Affair]]=== In response to the upcoming [[Subjugation of Sloth]], half of the Arlam Villagers were escorted by Ram to the Sanctuary, where Garfiel was waiting and questioned her. After being told about the evacuation, he told the villagers to behave themselves while they were there before leaving to inform the other residents of the Sanctuary. When [[Milde Arlam]] asked about whether they'd be safe, Ram reassured her, but she also wondered how far he would take protecting the Sanctuary. Although the villagers were given a place to stay in, Garfiel made it known that they were not welcome. However, at seeing the villagers slowly unpacking the carriages while gloomy, Garfiel eventually decided to help them. After teasing Garfiel about it, she spoke with Milde again and said she would be tending to Roswaal, leaving them to choose their own rooms. From then on, Garfiel continued to "harass" the villagers before helping on his own. When he was done, Milde thanked him for his help, though Garfiel claimed it wasn't for the villagers but that it was bad for his heart if he didn't help, to which Milde replied her gratitude was in kind. Because he couldn't accept the gratitude so easily, Ram proceeded to reward him. ===[[The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting]]=== Following the [[Sanctuary Incident]], Annerose and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the Sanctuary to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to Garfiel that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and [[Otto Suwen|Otto]], who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the [[Emilia Camp]], surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia. Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where [[Puck]] slept and called everyone there precious to her. ===[[Poltergeist Story]]=== Two months after the Sanctuary Incident, Roswaal called for the maids of Roswaal Manor. Intending to begin making allies with other nobles with Emilia for the Royal Selection, he set his sights on first targeting Viscount [[Minor Characters#Torion Aruz|Torion Aruz]], he tasked the girls with cleaning a villa that was once the workshop of his father, [[Roswaal K. Mathers]]. Two days later, the girls arrived in the evening, birds attempting to steal their luggage having delayed their arrival. There, they found that the workshop was covered in ivy and vines and was practically falling apart from disuse. As nighttime approached, despite Frederica starting to panic over the workshop's creepy atmosphere, they decided that they would have to stay the night there. While Ram remained out front for a while, Frederica and Petra went to the back of the workshop, which is in even worse condition than the front. However, after a hole just large enough for the two to slip into, Petra walked inside, followed shortly after by Frederica. Unable to see Petra, she instead saw a doll in the darkness, shortly before the lights came on. Soon after, she reunited with Petra and Ram, afraid of the doll. Despite Ram's insistence that it was Frederica's imagination, Frederica and Petra heard an explosion-like noise in the distance while Ram heard nothing. Wanting to leave, Frederica clung to Ram as they headed for the front door, only to find that it was storming outside, and Petra had to stop Frederica from beastifying and running away. Deciding they would investigate the strange sounds and dolls, Petra headed upstairs, hoping to catch sight of a hollow. Frederica, still sticking with Ram, tried to follow after her, only to fall through the floor of the stairs. Shortly after, Frederica became a target of harassment for the doll, and before long, she ended up latching onto one in fear, having mistaken it for one of the other two. In a panic, she beastified and ran off, the doll gripping her tail. She eventually smashed it away with her tail on the roof, only to find others that made her fall. Ram, who recognized what they were, ordered the dolls to catch her. Shortly after, Frederica, her clothes destroyed, and Petra were told that the dolls had been magicreation tools that were defending the manor, and they treated Petra and Frederica as intruders, treating them differently because due to their different sizes. First claiming the dolls could help them clean the place up with them, Petra then thought to dress up the dolls and fix their makeup before calling Roswaal to the workshop. Before long, Roswaal had flown over to the workshop and wondered how long it had been since he'd been there. Meeting up with the maids, he found 111 of those dolls dressed up and fixed. Surprised that they were still, having created more of themselves to continue protecting the place until the master could return, he thanked them, causing them to bow and finally shut down. Afterward, facing the confused Petra, he thanked them for allowing him to right a wrong, upsetting Petra for his attitude. With Roswaal deciding to help them, Frederica told Petra she could work him hard, while Ram had knelt down and gently thanked the dolls for their service. ===[[Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion]]=== After arriving at Roswaal Manor to invite the Emilia Camp to [[Priestella]], [[Mimi Pearlbaton|Mimi]], who saw Garfiel for the first time, was entranced by him, and she asked for his name while introducing herself. He introduced himself, but she ended up dropping her staff on his foot, and Ram appeared to tell him not to leave their guests standing at the entrance. Taking a liking to calling him Garf, they were invited inside, and Mimi recalled what [[Roshi Pearlbaton]] had once told her about the feelings she felt after seeing Garfiel. While she was waiting with [[Joshua Juukulius]] inside and acting like she was trying to stay serious, she couldn't take her eyes off of Garfiel, causing him to ask what if something was wrong. Red-faced, Mimi ran away, and Ram scolded the guys for being inconsiderate. ===[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle]]=== After the decision to visit the Watergate City of Priestella was made, after taking a bath, Otto was met by Ram in his room. After a bit of back and forth, Otto asked her if she had come here to talk to him about Priestella as well, to which she replied that she did, telling Otto that he had an extremely important duty as Emilia's adviser. This was because Roswaal's greatest wish would depend on Emilia's actions being carried out. Otto asked Ram if she was worried about him too, which Ram denied. ===[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 2]]=== One night, before having left for Priestella, Otto was staying up all night doing paperwork, drinking Coff to stave off his sleepiness. Ram was awake along with Otto. The two of them conversed a bit, as Ram prepared some tea for him. Ram seemed to understand that Otto had not forgiven Roswaal for his transgressions in the Sanctuary. They talked about it a bit, with Otto pledging he would strive to protect the environment around him no matter what. Ram surmised that Otto would protect it by doubting Roswaal, whereas she would do so by believing in Roswaal. Just as Otto was about to leave the room, Ram asked him what would need to happen for him to want to forgive Roswaal. To which Otto replied that he'd probably never be able to forgive him, but, if he had the opportunity, he could maybe think about clearing away his distrust of him. ===[[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose! In Fact!]]=== The day after Ram's group were brought back to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] after their separation from the main group, Ram awoke and exited the [[dragon]] carriage. After asking about Rem, she asked for the details about their current circumstances, only to learn that Subaru had been holding her tightly. [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 6. While she's usually able to synchronize her vision with anyone she wishes to, there are a few exceptions, one of which being "high-ranking" individuals such as Roswaal. If such people close off their heart, Ram is unable to use Clairvoyance on them. Also, even if she can connect to them, if they have their eyes closed or cannot see, she will not be able to see through their eyes. Although she is unable to defend herself while using it, it allows her to continuously switch between people. However, the side effect of the ability causes her veins to become prominent, shed tears of blood from one eye, and legs to shake uncontrollably. '''Synesthesia''' (共感覚, ''Kyōkankaku''): An ability that she shares with her sister. It allows them to share their feelings and emotions with each other through telepathy.''The feelings I am picking up from Sister are partly unease and largely… anger."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 5]], Chapter 2, Section 2.''Synesthesia─ A rare transmission between twins and siblings where emotions went from one person to another. Rem was struck by that lightning, and she looked up at the sky with wide eyes. She felt like her sister told her to not take her eyes off of it──'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 5. Ram is even able to borrow Rem's horn and use it to greatly amplify her own fighting strength.''The sharing of the horn's might utilizing Synesthesia had already been undone, so no horn was present on her forehead.'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 86, Section 5. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Aside from her combative abilities, Ram is incredibly intelligent. Having received a formal education thanks to the patronage of Roswaal, both Ram and Rem excelled academically. She has excellent observational skills, having been quick to realize the danger of a plan from the Witch Cult and figuring out the likely locations where magical miasma stones could be placed after seeing a map,''“I figured it out with a map when I was walking around town. Considering how big the capital is and how many areas the magical miasma stone could affect… Worst case scenario, there are 24 more places with traps. That’s what I would do.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 3. and is a strong judge of character. Unlike her sister, Ram is able to discern that Subaru is not a threat, despite the scent of the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] that rests on him. She was also able to understand that Subaru wanted Garfiel's necklace from observing his line of questioning, even though Subaru didn't convey this information to her. ===Equipment=== [[File:Ram's_Wand.png|thumb|150px]] *'''Wand''': Ram usually uses a wand that Roswaal fashioned from her horn when fighting.''"I will be selfish if I want to. That's why I made a wand out of your horn."'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 6. It helps her better channel her mana to reduce the burden of using magic. During the events of [[Arc 3]], Ram uses the wand while fighting Wilhelm and Ricardo in close combat. ==Trivia== *In the author's character strength ranking in June 2014, Ram (with her horn) was ranked as the 2nd strongest character in the series, though the list may have changed since then.''“Reinhard, Ram, Regulus, Sekhmet, and serious Puck. Even though they are like dango under Reinhard, these guys are capable of bringing down the White Whale by themselves.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473455745506476032 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] *According to Lye Batenkaitos, Ram would be able to contend with the likes of [[Regulus Corneas]] in terms of power.''"At most, if she couldn't kill him then she wouldn't have killed him, but ended it by just dropping him down the Great Waterfall or something."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 83, Section 3. *In [[Ram and the Night Study Group]], it is revealed that Ram (and likely Rem) attended something similar to kindergarten in their home village.''"It seems it would be a school where children around the age of four or five would attend; Ram had gone to something similar back in her home village."'' [[Ram and the Night Study Group]] *Ram guessed Subaru hailed from the upper class of a small kingdom due to not knowing his origins.''It was only conjecture, but it seemed likely that Subaru’s place of birth had been in the upper class of a small kingdom, separate from the four great kingdoms.'' [[Ram and the Night Study Group]] *After Subaru taught her hiragana, Ram noted she felt like she saw that type of writing somewhere before. *Ram has her own named chapter in Arc 6, in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 6: The Corridor of Memories|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 25|light novels]], as well as a named [[Episode 84|episode]] in the [[anime]]. *Although there were days of celebration in the oni village, most of them celebrated Ram's birth.''Rem, who got informed about festivals, understood the flamboyant atmosphere of people passing by the capital. She sure was getting glimpses of faces that were more or less carefree. The oni village also had customs for days of celebration. ──Although, they were mostly days where Ram’s birth was celebrated.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 1. *Ram's favorite food is Rem's steamed potatoes.''The steamed potato Ram talked about was a simple dish Rem made by borrowing the kitchen from her mother, and it would only be made whenever they’d harvest yams like this. It wasn’t complex enough to be called a dish, but Ram was happy with Rem’s steamed potato more than she was with anything else. The village would put their best efforts into making various things for Ram if she wished for it, and yet what Ram wanted was Rem’s steamed potato.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 2. *The first witchbeast Ram ever killed was a Guiltylowe. *From among those affected by Al's Aggressor in Arc 9, Ram was the one who lasted the longest.April 5, 2026 Talk Show. ==References== {{References}} ==Note== ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Maids]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Teachers]] [[Category:Emilia Camp]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:House Mathers]] [[de:Ram]] [[es:Ram]] [[fr:Ram]] [[it:Ram]] [[pl:Ram]] [[pt-br:Ram]] [[ru:Рам]] [[uk:Рам]] [[zh:角色:拉姆]] [[ko:람]]

Unnamed mother |Magic = Fire Magic |Weapon = Two knives |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1|Volume 1]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 1 Chapter 1|Arc 1 Chapter 1]] |Anime = [[Episode 1]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Genki Muro|Muro Genki]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Lucien Dodge|Lucien Dodge]]}} '''Rachins Hoffman''' (ラチンス・ホフマン), commonly known as '''Chin''' (チン), is a runaway noble who was one of the three thugs that attacked [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] at the very start of the story. He later joined the [[Felt Camp]] when [[Felt]] employed him after the [[Royal Selection]] began. He plays a supporting role in [[Arc 9]] and [[Arc 10]], a minor supporting role in [[Arc 5]] and an antagonistic role in [[Arc 1]] and [[Arc 3]]. ==Appearance== Rachins is a man who has an unusual white complexion, black [[Wikipedia:Sanpaku|sanpaku]] eyes, and long, unkept grayish blue hair that has pink at its ends. He dresses in a tattered uniform, wears chains around his wrists and throat, maintains a large yellow earring on his left ear, and often sticks out his elongated tongue, which has a silver ring ornament on its right side. In Arc 10, he briefly wears a black and white waiter's outfit reminiscent of a bartender and has his hair fixed, and his cleaned-up appearance made him surprisingly popular with women.''As Subaru pressed a handkerchief to his eyes, enduring the feelings moving him to tears in his Natsumi Schwartz state, the one to jeer him from the side was Rachins, clad in a waiter’s uniform. He wore black and white attire that gave the impression of a bartender or a garçon, so to speak, and even his hairstyle was tidied up nicely, giving him the appearance of a fine young man. In fact, even amidst the dinner party they had infiltrated, his presence seemed to have been quite popular among the ladies.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 29, Section 2. ==Personality== As a thug, Rachins acted cowardly, lewdly, and impolite. He generally is prone to anger and is often viewed as a blockhead and hooligan. He tried to mug people with his two friends to get by when they resided in the slums, but they found a way to escape when a situation became unfavorable. He was also not above being lecherous and harassing [[Priscilla Barielle|Priscilla]]. Although Rachins makes the most decisions between him and his other two friends, he is also quite easy to sway.''Presumably, Rachins was the one who made the most decisions out of the three. However, he was also the easiest to sway, so it seemed like the other two provided him with their support. Such was the nature of their relationship.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 4. In spite of Rachins’s many personality defects, he is a shrewd and clever man with some degree of bravery. As a runaway noble who was raised in the Hoffman family, he learned the broad knowledge of a royal advisor and is skilled at deceiving others into getting a desired outcome. Likewise, he is willing to take on managerial tasks out of concern for letting others handle him, making him both the administrative type and the type to shoulder everyone's burdens, something he seems to be unaware of.''Rachins snarled back with an “Ahhhn?”, seemingly unaware of his own hardworking nature, but there was no doubt that this disposition of his was the precise reason why Russell was expecting all these things from him. He had a rough way of speaking, but likely, he was the serious internal-affairs officer type. Subaru was not aware of all the details, but perhaps it also had something to do with his surprising origins of actually being born to a reputable family.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 1. However, he scorns his father and chose to cut ties with his family because of it,''“You’re one talkative woman alright. How’s it feel to be so fuckin’ condescendin’ talkin’ about someone else’s family he cut ties with?”'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 4]], Section 6.''“And even if we end up losin’, I couldn’t give two hoots ‘bout which way the house leans, so long as that bastard of a father is there.”'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 5]], Section 1. even though he considers Rickert “respectable”. Rachins is also willing to take extreme measures to bring down his enemy, and his will to accomplish his tasks is strong. Just to take down [[Al]] and his comrades, Rachins was willing to use a trick Al Goa to not only incinerate all of his surroundings to ash, but also himself. Even when it was seen through and he was being beaten in order to force him to stop, he continued to try and cast the spell until he was rendered unconscious. ==History== Rachins Hoffman was born as a noble from the [[Royal Capital|Royal Capital of Lugunica]], to [[Rickert Hoffman]] and an unnamed woman. However, after unknown events, he left his family and began living in the slums. According to [[Gaston]], he found Rachins in a back alley. Thinking he was like a ragged piece of cloth at the time, Gaston chose to extend Rachins a hand after being convinced to do so by [[Camberley]].''“...To think I’ve been convinced by you. That hasn’t happened since I picked up Rachins from the back alley. He was like a ragged piece of cloth back then.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 4. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly 3 to 4 months before Subaru's arrival, Rachins, Gaston, and Camberley met an [[Gramdart Holstoy|Imperial traitor]], who paid the trio and fifteen other thugs a fair amount of gold coins in order to tail a [[Cecilus Segmunt|Divine General]] who was after his head. The thugs disobeyed the orders and lured the swordsman into a dark alley, wanting to attack, beat and rob the man. However, as they were dealing with Cecilus Segmunt, the strongest person from the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] and one of the three men who are about as skilled as [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]], they were defeated within a second and left beaten half to death. Following their arrest by the Knight guards who rushed the scene soon after, the three thugs were then approached by [[Julius Juukulius]], [[Ferris]], and [[Chisha Gold]], who wanted to know about Cecilus' location. Upon being promised freedom, they spilled the beans and were subsequently freed, with the money they would have gotten from Gramdart. ===[[Behind the Scenes of Life in Another World from Zero]]=== A short while after harassing Subaru and being scared off by Reinhard, he, Gaston, and Camberley, attempted to corner [[Emilia]], who was looking for Felt. However, before they could do anything to her, she quickly cornered them. Afterward, she asked them about the Loot House, and they pointed her in the right direction. ===[[Ram's Flirting Refusal]]=== Later, they attempted to ambush [[Ram]], who was searching for Emilia throughout the capital. However, she easily dispatched them. ===[[Felt-chan Gathers Thugs]]=== While Felt inspected the slums with her camp, she found Gaston, Rachins, and Camberley running away and badly injured. They decided to attempt to rob her to make enough money to get away from Lugunica, as they had attempted to trick [[Russell Fellow]] into a shady business that did not end well for them, and they were now marked for death by him. Reinhard easily defeated one of them as the others attempted to run, but they were intercepted by Felt while she was scolding Reinhard, as letting them run away would mean they would be dead by Russell's capable henchman the next day. She then recruited the trio for her camp in hopes of using their help for ruining the country. Since then, Reinhard van Astrea started to train all three of them so they would grow stronger with his help. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Rachins is not a very strong person, having been easily defeat by Subaru at one point and various other characters. However, after joining the Felt Camp and being trained in magic, Rachins is much more capable of combat, and he is also very crafty in the way he fights. ===[[Magic]]=== Although it is unclear what attribute he has an affinity for, Rachins is able to use fire magic. After training under [[Ezzo Cadner]], he became capable of changing the size of his spells to disguise them as other spells: by expanding a regular Goa in size, he can make it appear as if it was an Al Goa; conversely, by thinning an Al Goa as much as possible, he can disguise it as a flame even weaker than a regular Goa, tricking his enemy into attacking it and setting off an incredibly powerful explosion in the process. '''Spells''': *'''Goa''' (ゴーア): Rachins manifests a blaze of fire which incinerates a foe, though the flame was noted to be rather underwhelming when he first used it. He primarily uses this attack like a signal flare meant to summon Reinhard to his location, but he has learned to use it better by Arc 9. **'''El Goa''' (エル・ゴーア): Rachins produces a larger flame with a larger explosion than Goa. **'''Ul Goa''' (ウル・ゴーア): The third level of Goa in which the caster fires many bullets of flame that incinerate foes over a large area. It has enough power to shake the earth. **'''Al Goa''' (アル・ゴーア): Rachins lets loose a massive fireball, scorching away everything in its path. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Despite his general attitude and sloppy actions, Rachins is much smarter than he seems. He is shown able to corner [[Helaine Gatness]] in a game of wits by distracting her in a game of Shatranj while his allies were moving in real time. Likewise, he was quick to realize that the [[Six Tongues]] was a legitimate organization based off of rumors and the minimum amount of knowledge provided to him. In other occasions, he is shown to be a quick thinker, using his magic in deceptive ways or using his environment around him to help his allies to either fight or escape. ===Equipment=== *'''Knife''': Rachins carries a knife with him that he uses to threaten people, though he is inexperienced in using them properly. *'''Conversation Mirror''': A [[meteor]] that was duplicated by the Felt Camp. Anyone who has a mirror is capable of speaking to the other person who has one. *'''Cognitive Disruption Cloak''': During the events of Arc 10, Rachins was provided a cloak with cognitive disruption embedded into it. ==Trivia== *The nicknames of Ton, Chin, and Kan are a play on the Japanese word tonchinkan, which means irrelevant or inconsistent. *According to the author, Ton, Chin, and Kan don't play an active role after Arc 1 until [[Arc 8]].[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/433963345868103680 2014 Q&A] **As the original plan for [[Arc 7]] changed and it was split into two separate arcs, it can be assumed that this statement about Arc 8 now applies to Arc 9. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Felt Camp]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Arc 1 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 3 Antagonists]] [[es:Chin]] [[fr:Rachins Hoffman]] [[pl:Chin]] [[pt-br:Rachins]] [[ru:Чин]] [[uk:Чін]] [[zh:角色:阿珍]]
