[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Yukari Tamura|Tamura Yukari]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Faye Mata|Faye Mata]]}} '''Priscilla Barielle''' (プリシラ・バーリエル) is an exiled imperial princess of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], the Matriarch of House Barielle, and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. While only a supporting character in [[Arc 3]] and [[Arc 5]], she had a major role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. She was also one of the main protagonists of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. Originally born in Vollachia as one of the many children of the country’s previous [[Drizen Vollachia|emperor]], she attempted to secure victory in its Imperial Selection Ceremony. Despite having become one of the frontrunners, she ultimately lost when her [[Vincent Vollachia|brother]] and [[Arakiya|closest aide]] faked her death. Afterward, following the death of her [[Jorah Pendleton|first husband]], she was smuggled into Lugunica, went through several husbands, and ended up married to the late [[Leip Barielle]], who discovered her as one of the [[Royal Selection]] Candidates. During the [[Great Disaster]], Priscilla was imprisoned by [[Sphinx]] and forced to watch as her home nation was slowly led to ruin. Rather than standing idly by, she took advantage of the resurrection magic in order to escape her imprisonment by becoming an [[Undead|undead]]. A day following the victory, she peacefully faded away before the eyes of [[Natsuki Subaru]] and her knight, [[Al|Aldebaran]], making her the first to drop out of the Royal Selection.''No falsehood in those words, the figure of the woman who was loved by the world, and returned said love to the world to an even greater degree, faded. Extolled as the Sun Princess, having lived her life in a manner becoming of a flame, was Priscilla Barielle. ――Amongst the candidates for the Kingdom of Lugunica’s Royal Selection to decide the next Monarch, she was the first to drop out.'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 7. ==Appearance== Priscilla's long orange hair shone radiantly like the sun itself and flowed through a single barrette before spilling down her back. Her crimson eyes had a glimmer of strong will that betrayed her commanding personality. She had pale, white skin and faintly pink lips. She was considered a woman of true divine beauty. Additionally, her dainty figure possessed noticeably bountiful breasts and other shapely features. She stood at 164 centimeters (5'5"), the same height as [[Emilia]]. Priscilla wore exquisite clothing that matched the crimson color of her eyes. The dress she most frequently wore was an opulent black and red aristocratic dress with wrapped off-the-shoulder sleeves, a wide-hemmed heel-length red skirt, a black petticoat, a large black ribbon with red striping attached to the right side of her waist, and a black flowery ornament with red edging and emerald jewels decorating each petal that was adorned on the opposite side of Priscilla's waist. The dress was also backless and prettified by various emeralds fastened to the skirt. Under her dress, she wears translucent reddish-brown holdup stockings with a black elasticized band at the top. She also had a black choker, a pair of red high-heel shoes, and a pair of long black fingerless opera gloves. She often carried a crimson handheld folding fan that she claimed from a [[Lamia Godwin|half-sister]] she felled. Finally, her middle fingers ware bedecked with a single emerald ring each and similarly colored teardrop-shaped earrings dangled from her earlobes. The jewels enriching Priscilla's figure were all of such fine craftsmanship that anyone could tell they were incredibly expensive at a glance. Natsuki Subaru estimated that her full outfit from top to bottom was worth at least a hundred times his own money. When she was inside her mansion, she wore a red outfit that highlighted her body a bit. She had a small coat with a black bow in the center and has a black clip on her hair, in which she had a ponytail. She also wore a pair of black studs. She kept her fan between her breasts. ==Personality== Priscilla was an arrogant, proud, and absurd woman, and she held the conviction that the world, which she extolled as beautiful, worked for her convenience.''This was Priscilla Barielle; a triumphant expression brimming with confidence and pride, the lack of any hesitation to declare all things in this world as her own, a beauty who painted the very picture of arrogance. Her radiance scorching the eyes of all, the Sun Princess whose presence could not help but make itself known to others――.'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 7.''"The world is truly so beautiful. Henceforth―― the world is made for mine convenience."'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close. She classified people according to their interests; if someone was not of her interest, she would not remember their names and would not pay attention to them anymore. This happened with Subaru a few days after meeting him,''Priscilla's word were neither joking nor mocking. That is to say, she was being genuine. Priscilla had completely forgotten about Subaru's existence.'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 16, Section 2 though despite this, she later spoke of him as if she had still been paying attention to him. Her biggest enemy was boredom, so the things she did were to avoid it. She repeatedly hit Al or ordered him to do something to entertain her. She was also able to position herself in situations unimaginable to any gentleman, such as leading a dangerous expedition simply because she was curious.''"At first, I thought the disorder of such a grimy place held promise, but now that I am accustomed to it, it has nothing to draw my eye. It is quite useless for assuaging my boredom."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 2, Section 7. In her speech during the Royal Selection Ceremony, she declared that under her command, everyone would be able to get what they wanted.''"Serving me means siding with the winner. You may have anything you desire; I allow it."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 3. She was, according to Aldebaran, very volatile and very dangerous when she was angry, and she also had a habit of purposefully antagonizing others merely because she believes it would be entertaining, as she showed by bringing [[Heinkel Astrea]] with her to instigate the other members of [[House Astrea]] in [[Priestella]] at the time. Despite her self-centered attitude, Priscilla valued ​​people who keep their pride, as seen when, in a failed loop, she kicked Subaru for choosing to abandon his pride to get what he wanted, or when she was amused when she spoke to [[Felt]], where Felt refused to take an easy way out of a situation she was in. Priscilla showed confidence in her actions since she typically always came out on top. She was also not afraid to fight since she knew how to fight and defend herself, and she was not intimidated when she had to face [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sirius]], when she encountered zombies in her territory, or when she went to search for the thieves within her domain. Even in the face of one who wanted revenge on her, she showed no fear as she looked them in the eyes, and despite her opponent's goals to inflict despair on her, she stood proudly, entirely unaffected by that enemy's efforts. Though she was well known for being a woman who over the years ended up being a widow, Priscilla did not seem to mind at all. She considered her last husband, Leip, to be an old pervert and did not care for her marriage with him. She also displayed a seeming lack of care for the predicaments of the people around her. Despite seeming lack of care for people, however, Priscilla is able to understand other people after meeting them for a mere few moments. With extended conversations with other people, she can even glean an insight into the truth of their personalities and conflicts, even when the words conveyed were few. She also imitates her brother's habit when she enters contemplation, and she admires his attitude as well upon weighing his responsibilities, though she believes that such actions are excessive, that there were some that one could meet only by closing their eyes.''Ever since childhood, she had imitated her older brother when entering contemplation. Vincent understood all too well the weight of the responsibility he bore, and never closed his eyes, not even when he slept. That attitude was admirable, but excessive. ――Sometimes, there were those whom one could only meet upon the back of their eyelids.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 2. True to her self-centered demeanor, she had no need to deceive others, nor did she like to.''However, that was Priscilla’s genuine intention. In the first place, Priscilla did not prefer to act or speak in ways that conspire and deceive others. She would never wish such a way of life upon her own self.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 2. She respected everyone's freedoms, and though she claimed that everything would become hers should she become the country's monarch, she had no intentions of hoarding everything nearby her, as she believed doing so would be akin to locking a bird in a cage and depriving it of the beauty of flight and freedom. She loved when people attempted to reach for an objective outside of their capacities, and whether the person succeeds or fails in reaching their goal, she loved it regardless.''However, the fact remained that for the sake of a desired outcome, confronting things while expending all of oneself was always beautiful.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 2.''She wanted to love the way of life of the fool who sought what was beyond the capacity of their caliber, who went on a path that may lead to ruin, who aimed for the sun only for their wings to melt, regardless of whether they succeeded or failed in their challenge.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 2. Despite her apparent lack of love for others, she actually does love other people, as evidenced through her Soul Marriage Technique, which affects everyone she loves and those who harbor emotions for her, which reflected her love through the gifts her husbands gave her; her love seemed to encompass all of life as well,''All those who took up arms on this battlefield, lent their shoulders to others, shed their blood, and burned their souls, regardless of whether they were alive or dead, were to be loved.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 2. as her Soul Marriage Technique not only affected those in a [[Lupugana|city]] she was in at one point, but also the people in an entirely [[Garkla|different city]] that was more than a day away, effectively both strengthening and protecting them all.''All those in the aid station, except for Rem and Katya, who had been caught in the collapse, stood up with only minor scratches and no serious injuries. She could see a flickering flame in one eye of every person. That flame, the power that came from it, brought forth strength to Rem. And that was because――, "――Priscilla-sama?"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 3. Priscilla has shown to be willing to sacrifice herself for others as well, which she did when she once acted to remove poison directly from Arakiya by ingesting said poison herself and dividing the effect, when she believed that her [[Yorna Mishigure|mother]] and Arakiya were both in danger at the start of the Great Disaster, and, not fearing death, she even later willingly burned away her body and ended her life to fight alongside her allies. She was also not shy of complimenting other people for their accomplishments, even if others were unable to see exactly what those accomplishments were, and such words of acknowledgement and gratitude were some of the very last words she spoke.''"The both of you have arrived at this junction by doing so many a time, this I know. Never placing yourselves above others, you have lived till today. Hence, it may be that neither of you has ever received due recompense. I shall thus bestow that upon you."'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 7. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Priscilla was born in the Vollachian Empire as one of the many children of the then emperor Drizen Vollachia and Sandra Benedict, one of the many reincarnated lives of Iris. Her birth name was '''Prisca Benedict''' (プリスカ・ベネディクト, ''Purisuka Benedikuto''). Sandra died in childbirth, leaving Priscilla alone until, for unknown reasons, her father decided to gift her with Arakiya, who became her foster sister and later her sworn sword. Prisca took part in the Vollachian Empire's Imperial Selection Ceremony at the age of 12 after witnessing her father burned by the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] and being deemed worthy by it. Despite not liking the system of succession forcing her to kill her siblings, she participated in it anyway, personally felling one of the frontrunners, her older half-sister Lamia Godwin, during her [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]], as well as a descendant of the Evil Eye Tribe, [[Palladio Manesque]]. With the only other candidate, Vincent Abellux, remaining in the selection, Arakiya ended up betraying her, fearing she would be killed by her half-brother and agreed to a deal of his that would involve setting up a plot to fake her death, ingesting poison that Prisca took a portion of from her to save her life.''"Prisca-sama has passed away. However, your princess yet lives."'' [[Crimson Afterglow Part 3]], Section 8. The plot succeeded, and Prisca was regarded as dead. As a result, Vincent won the ceremony and became the emperor whilst Prisca took the name Priscilla, a name belonging to one of her deceased body doubles.''"She was a girl that really resembled me... but she's certainly come in handy twice."'' [[Crimson Afterglow Part 3]], Section 9. After escaping certain death, Priscilla married her first husband, Jorah Pendleton, and she changed her name to '''Priscilla Pendleton''' (プリシラ・ペンダルトン, ''Purishira Pendaruton''). Sometime later, [[Serena Dracroy]] sent her servants [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] and [[Miles]] to the Pendleton Estate in order to invite Jorah and Priscilla to the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. While they were there, the gladiators attempted to spark a revolution that would render the island independent from the mainland. Priscilla feigned being Serena and was taken captive by the gladiators and their ringleader, a member of the Evil Eye Tribe named [[Ubilk]]. However, rather than seeking independence, Ubilk's true plan was to bring the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] to the Gladiator Island for unknown reasons. After Priscilla used a broadcast to reveal Ubilk's plan, the rebellion ended up failing thanks to the intervention of the Imperial Army and a gladiator named Aldebaran. After the group left Ginunhive and returned to Serena's estate, Priscilla thanked her for the invitation in the stead of her resting husband. Soon afterwards, Jorah was accused of attempting to overthrow Vincent Vollachia, from his position. As a result, [[Goz Ralfon]] visited his manor in an attempt to take custody of him and Priscilla for a scheduled execution. Jorah fended Goz and his escorts off for Priscilla's sake, knowing that he would meet his end in just mere moments. This bought time for Priscilla to escape until she had a chance meeting with Arakiya on the way. In the end, Arakiya let Priscilla escape and announced that she had committed suicide. At an unknown point in time after Jorah's execution, Serena ordered Balleroy and Miles to look for Priscilla, as there was a rumor going around about some bandits who kidnapped a girl looking like her. The duo successfully found her and managed to bring her to the estate. From there, Serena found a way to smuggle Priscilla out of the Empire and into the Kingdom of Lugunica. She was married six to six different men for a period of several years, but every husband of hers fell into ruin and met unnatural deaths, earning her the moniker “Bloody Bride”. Priscilla eventually married Leip Barielle, the baron of the Barielle Domain. Leip, who had found that she was one of the candidates for the Royal Selection, sought to use her as a tool to achieve his dream of power, but Priscilla proved to be much harder to manipulate than he thought and decided to make her into a puppet by using the abilities of a curse arts user he was acquainted with.''“What, could you not hear me? That girl’s troublesome willfulness is in the way. I was able to overlook it before the start of the Royal Selection, but now that the importance of every single action is increasing, I can’t let it be. Once her debut at the royal castle is finished, I’ll take away her will and make her my puppet.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 7.''“In this world, there are many demands for unimaginable dark deeds. I long ago made connections with a handy fellow who acted as an intermediary for a curse arts user.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 7. He also planned to prepare a knight who would look good alongside Priscilla as a sort of public relations strategy to improve her standing among citizens.''“The people love picturing a master and servant with a knightly knight as the servant. Since things have turned out such that someone who is not of the Royal Family will be taking the throne, the support of the citizens will not be unconditional as it has been up to this point.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 7. Around this time, Priscilla met a starving, impoverished, orphaned, and nameless boy from a farming village in her domain. Despite being on the brink of death, he caught her interest because they shared the same eye color. She decided to call him [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] and she took him back to her manor so he could become a butler. ===[[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Entertainment Part]]=== One day, Leip organized a tournament to decide who Priscilla's knight would be. She quickly got bored with the fighting while viewing the tournament, causing her to ask Schult for his thoughts. Schult decided to recommend Al, as he believed that the man showed care for Priscilla, unlike the other combatants.[[Re:Zero Prequel: Camp Formation Stories]] Priscilla thought Al was entertaining enough and that his fighting style was interesting, and she consequently selected him as her “clown”. This infuriated Leip, as he had tried to fix the tournament so that a winner would be under his control. ===[[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]]=== A few days later, Leip attempted to bring Al and Schult under his control, but he was refused when he revealed his intentions to make Priscilla into a puppet. Al clashed with Leip by using [[Al#Abilities|his ability]], which resulted in the baron being incapacitated. In due time, Leip passed away before the commencement of the Royal Selection, leading Priscilla to take over as the governing lord of the Barielle Domain.''And thus, his young wife, Priscilla, took over from her ill husband as the governing lord.'' [[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Drunk Father Part]], Section 2 Under her rule, the land, which was previously ravaged by severe poverty, quickly got back on its feet, and its people started to live much happier and better lives all thanks to Priscilla's leadership of the territory.''Her excellent skills purged the Barielle lands from their stagnant atmosphere in a flash.'' [[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Drunk Father Part]], Section 2. ===[[Sunlight Illuminating the Water's Surface]]=== One day, Priscilla wanted Al to entertain her, though this resulted in her flicking him into a fountain on the grounds. With Schult worried about him and mentioning his helmet, Al mentioned that it wouldn't be destroyed so easily, after which he revealed to Priscilla he had acquired his helmet from and lost his arm at Ginunhive. With Priscilla becoming bored of listening to him, Priscilla told Schult to entertain her, leading him to tell her of a rumor that heading toward the spring near the town of Ladrima would allow one to see the deceased. Her interest piqued, she took them and headed toward the forest near Ladrima. There, Al questioned whether she wanted to see someone who had died, whereas she questioned his being against seeing the dead due to not wanting to see someone. Shortly after, Al was separated from his companions. After ordering Schult to take care of the fog, Priscilla dispelled the illusion assailing Al, and shortly after, the fog was lifted from the spring. This resulted in a short-lived fight with an [[Spirit|evil spirit]]. Sometime later, when she was brought Kurenai flowers by a villager at her manor, Al realized that the actions Priscilla took were just so that she could see those flowers, and she ordered Al and Schult to decorate the manor. ===[[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]]=== After the Royal Selection's commencement, a man named [[Minor Characters#Array Denkuts|Array Denkuts]] came to the Barielle Manor in order to plead Priscilla to go to his home village, Coffleton, and eliminate the undead that had appeared there. Together with Al and [[Yae Tenzen]], Priscilla went to Coffleton and discovered that the undead had some sort of parasite within them. The men of the town had all turned into undead who looked exactly as they did in life, while the women and children housed the parasites yet were still alive. Priscilla used the Yang Sword to remove the parasite from them, she gathered her private army, the Crimson Battlefront, to visit two other villages among the Tenrill River to eliminate any undead, and she brought Yae and Al with her to an unaffected village to investigate why there were no undead there. They visited a watermill and found that the manager there, [[Edda Rayfast]], had become the leader of the undead, and she opened a trap door that led Al into a wastewater treatment plant. On Priscilla's order, Yae retreated to search for Al. In the meantime, Priscilla conversed with Edda and discovered her plan to create a "paradise" for her "maker". When Yae found Al, he had cleared through waves of numerous undead and decided to save Priscilla from Edda. He went back to the watermill, successfully defeated Edda, and rescued Priscilla. With the undead's leader defeated, they returned to the Barielle Manor. However, at midnight, Yae made an attempt to visit Priscilla's room, as she was an assassin who made an attempt to kill her supposed mistress. She was stopped by Al, and after losing to him in a short-lived fight, she decided to “resign” due to “familial matters”. ===[[Lugunican Papers Part 1|Lugunican Papers]]=== In the year following the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], she was requested an interview by [[Shorty Megan]] and [[Lululala]]. Already having a meeting with [[Anastasia Hoshin]], the interview was scheduled on the same day. There, they discussed their opinions on the Royal Selection and the other candidates. In particular, both Anastasia and Priscilla claimed that Emilia didn’t stand a chance, as public discrimination against her was heavy as she was a perfect resemblance and of the same race as the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. Even with the slaying of the [[White Whale]] and the [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]] under her belt, they claimed that it was an achievement the reflected more on her knight than her, which even Anastasia’s knight [[Julius Juukulius]] agreed with, though Al argued that his achievements also reflect on her. Eventually, the interview came to a close. ===[[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Drunk Father Part]]=== At some point later that year, Priscilla made her way to a bandit den, where she found Heinkel Astrea, who had slaughtered all of the bandits in an effort to collect a cup rumored to have been capable of restoring anyone who drank out of it to full health. Though this turned out to be a sham, after bringing him back to a town and hearing his story, Heinkel offered his service to her as a means to counter the [[Felt Camp]], who had the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint]] in it. Ultimately, Priscilla accepted him into her [[Priscilla Camp|camp]]. ===[[Priscilla-sama's Cheers for Me! Declaration of War Part|Priscilla-sama's Cheers for Me!]]=== Not long after returning from the [[Battle for Priestella]], Priscilla’s camp returned to the Barielle Domain. However, not long after arriving, Priscilla was confronted with assassins sent by [[Chisha Gold]]. Realizing they came from Vollachia, she swiftly dispatched them and decided to leave for her home country. However, Al was heavily against this, leading to him using his Authority to try and stop her. Though he died over 1000 times, in the end, he was unable to convince her, and the rest of her camp decided to go with her. Before setting out, however, Priscilla wrote her will to adopt Schult in the event of her death and name him as the heir to House Barielle, speaking aloud as she was being watched by Yae while hiding her will in a place only Yae knew of. Sometime later, with the assistance of Serena Dracroy, she managed to smuggle herself into Vollachia. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Priscilla was an accomplished fighter whose skills are considered equal to or superior to [[Crusch Karsten]] at one point. Her skill with the blade allowed her to easily repel most enemies, and combined with her signature Soul Marriage Technique, she was an incredibly difficult person to bring down, having even been capable of fighting and defeating the likes of the Sin Archbishop of Wrath, the Second of the Nine Divine Generals, and even the Witch Sphinx. ===[[Divine Protection]]=== '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Sun|Divine Protection of the Sun]]''' (日輪の加護, ''Nichirin no Kago''): Priscilla's Divine Protection increased the effects of buffs,''“Yang magic is basically buff effects, and Priscilla's Divine Protection of the Sun makes those effects far stronger than they are for regular people, so she's ridiculously strong by herself.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1038432385602281473 September 9, 2018 Twitter Q&A] in addition to boosting her abilities while she is under the sun.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/2096963959215788282 Author's 2026 Priscilla Barielle Birthday Commemoration] ===Techniques=== '''Soul Marriage Technique''' (魂婚術, ''Konkon-jutsu''): Soul Marriage is a long-lost secret technique of the old world that has been forgotten by most people. By dividing her own Od and bestowing it onto someone of her choosing, Priscilla imbued them with power more or less reflective of her own, and she greatly boosted their healing capabilities to the point someone acting under her Soul Marriage can receive multiple fatal wounds and be healed completely in a few short moments. However, in order for Soul Marriage to work, Priscilla must have not only loved the receiver of this ability, but she must have also be loved by that person in return. If this condition isn't met, Soul Marriage will not work. During the [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm]] in [[Guaral]], Priscilla used this ability to protect Schult from being harmed by ensuring that he'd be healed from against any attack towards him. By kissing Liliana in Priestella, Priscilla was able to place her under the effects of Soul Marriage, freeing her from Sirius's [[Sirius Romanée-Conti#Authority|Soulwashing]]. Furthermore, due to her love seeming to encompass life, the distance of her reach seems to be eliminated, as it managed to affect every living person in Lupugana and Garkla, which was more than a day away, simultaneously during the [[Conquest of the Undead Capital]]. The proof of being under that protection is in the painless fire that burns from their eyes.''The flame of Priscilla Barielle’s soul blazed within the eyes of those she deemed worthy of love.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 73, Section 4. She can use this ability on herself, with her commenting that items like jewelry were bestowed to her by her past husbands and could be used to defend herself. Soul Marriage could also be used to block a lethal attack on the user by sacrificing one of the recipients of the user's Od, which typically results in her beloved articles receiving damage meant for her and being destroyed. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Despite her rather carefree demeanor, Priscilla had an unusually high level of insight, and she was able to come with the correct answers towards various matters despite being given limited information within a limited environment. Even Sphinx had admired her insight, as Priscilla was able to glean Sphinx's true intentions and limitations through little more than Sphinx's attitude and behavior and no outside perspectives.''That was because it was a stratagem that had been formulated under the assumption that Priscilla would have seen through their intentions from the start, correctly guessing them. The one that had verified Priscilla’s answer was just the one facing her, but Sphinx could not help but admire her abnormal insight, having guessed almost everything correctly.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 70, Section 4. Likewise, because of this, she was able to learn that Subaru and Aldebaran each wielded an Authority that allowed them to fight against fate,''――Aldebaran and Natsuki Subaru. Priscilla's laudable clown and the Knight of the half-devil who, despite being somewhat loathsome, had been named as a Royal Selection Candidate. Like Sphinx's perceived threat, Priscilla also understood their struggle―― She understood the very fact that they twisted the destiny of the stars that could only be described as something more than a trivial matter.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 2.''"The Authorities held by yourself and Al may possess the power to warp even the laws of fate. But, you ought to remember this. Regardless of what use you make of your powers and prayers, there are some who desire that things remain unchanged."'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 7. with Priscilla even once mentioning how Subaru always seemed to have "good timing" in a similar manner to how [[Ram]] did during the events of Arc 5. Furthermore, she was able to easily discover the gathering of the Royal Selection candidates in Priestella despite not being invited, see through the facade of the artificial spirit, [[Eridna|Echidna]], when she took over and attempted to pose as Anastasia, to understand who sent assassins after her and the potential reason as to why, discover Sphinx's identity as the one who instigated the incident in Coffleton despite having never met her, and it was implied that she saw clear through her head chamberlain, Yae, as an assassin meant to watch over and potentially kill her, even apparently purposefully allowing her actions to be seen by her when she should have had no reason to believe she was being watched. ===[[Magic]]=== Priscilla has an affinity for the yang attribute. However, although she exhibited the ability to cast yang magic in the early web novel, she is not shown using magic at all in the light novel. As such, it is unclear if she retained the ability to use yang magic. Furthermore, according to the author, she has neither reached the pinnacle of using magic, nor has she put any effort into it.''"She hasn’t really reached the pinnacle of magic. Actually, she’s never put any effort into it."'' AskFM Q&A. '''Non-Canonical Spells''': *'''Akra''' (アクラ): Priscilla produced pale colored light around the target that enveloped them in a veil of golden light. The veil presumably strengthened the target, allowing them to use their body more freely while at the same time making them more sensitive to pain. This magic was cut from the Light Novel. ===Other=== '''Great Intuition''': Priscilla had great intuition, which allowed to guess the right and safest path towards the lost Schult during their stay in Priestella. She claimed that it didn't matter what choice she makes, since she'd always be right and it would always be positive for her. '''Private Army''': The '''Red Plates''' (赤拵え, ''Aka Koshirae''), originally called the '''Crimson Battlefront''' (真紅戦線, ''Shinku Sensen'') in Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, are a private army that was owned by Priscilla. ===Equipment=== Priscilla summons Yang Sword Vollachia.gif|Priscilla summoning the '''Yang Sword Vollachia'''. Priscilla using the Yang Sword against Demi-Beasts.gif|Priscilla using the Yang Sword to eliminate a group of Demi-Beasts. Priscilla using the Yang Sword to cut down what she wants.gif|Priscilla cuts through Sirius's chains, leaving Tina unharmed but injuring Sirius. *'''[[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]]''' (陽剣ヴォラキア, ''Youken Vorakia''): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Priscilla was capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. She mentions that it has a terrible mana consumption rate and therefore had it dissipate back into the atmosphere when she was not using it. Priscilla's Yang Sword could incinerate anything upon contact and could also throw and extinguish at will some white flames which are said to be inextinguishable, as those ignited even water. The Yang Sword seems to have its own will which tends to obey its wielder, as it cut down and burn those that it wishes to cut down and burn,''"My Yang Sword cuts down those that it wishes to cut down, and burns those that it wishes to burn."'' [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]], Section 5. rendering the slashes and fire harmless to everyone bar the desired target or targets, which was how Priscilla managed to destroy the parasites nested inside of the villagers with a swing of her Yang Sword, without harming their hosts. However, the Yang Sword's will doesn't necessarily always follow its wielder's will as Priscilla stated so,''"The sun has been obscured, it seems. As usual, this sword does not abide by my will."'' [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 2|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]], Section 8. resulting in the Sword losing its shine which then can come back with time; while the drawbacks are not clear, Priscilla mentioned that the sharpness disappeared,''"When I gave the final blow, the Yang Sword clouded over and its sharpness disappeared."'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 78, Section 2. but also said that the Yang Sword was still able to burn upon contact.''"Even supposing that the sun is obscured, the smoldering heat will not die out." [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 2|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]], Section 13.'' *'''Fan''': Priscilla could use the fan that she claimed from Lamia as a weapon. It has been shown to easily sever flesh while in Priscilla's hands. *'''Beloved Articles''': As a user of Soul Marriage, gifts that were loved by Priscilla and were given with love become viable substitutes for lethal damage. Many pieces of her jewelry and hair ornaments, which she received from past husbands or a Vollachian jeweler, fall into these criteria, and they will receive damage in her place. ==Trivia== *Priscilla liked most animals, but if she had to choose her favorite, it would be a white wolf.''“Something like a white wolf, probably. If it's animals, Priscilla likes pretty much anything. Pets or livestock, each of them has their good points.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1038432930089979905 Priscilla Birthday Q&A] *According to the author, Priscilla had the biggest breasts in all of Re:Zero. *In a one-on-one fight between Crusch Karsten and Priscilla Barielle, the most likely winner would have been the latter, even though it would be a good fight depending on the conditions, according to the author. *In 2014, the author stated that Priscilla was among nine known characters introduced in the story up to that point who had the highest capacity for holding [[mana]]. However, he chose to not rank Priscilla or any of the other listed characters in order.''“Emilia, Roswaal, Echidna, Typhon, Carmilla, Daphne, Ferris, Priscilla, and Mimi have a large capacity. It’s scary to rank them, considering the future, so I will stop…”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/499581653728378880 2014 AskFM Q&A] It is unknown if the list has changed since then. *Priscilla had her own named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] and the [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38|light novel]]. *According to the author on a talk show held on April 6th, 2025, Priscilla and Vincent are so familiar with Shatranj, a chess-like named after a fallen country, they both play the game without moving a single piece, only making moves in their heads, baffling any spectators. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Priscilla Camp]] [[Category:House Barielle]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Imperial Family]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Royal Selection Candidates]] [[Category:Imperial Selection Candidates]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[Category:Enchanted Sword Users]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[de:Priscilla Barielle]] [[es:Priscilla Barielle]] [[fr:Priscilla Barielle]] [[nl:Priscilla Barielle]] [[pl:Priscilla Barielle]] [[pt-br:Priscilla Barielle]] [[ru:Присцилла Бариэль]] [[zh:角色:普莉希拉]]

Mark Whitten (Geuse)}} '''Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti''' (ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ) was a '''[[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop]]''' of the '''[[Witch Cult]]''', representing '''Sloth'''. In addition to his position as a Sin Archbishop, he was a [[spirit]] who lived for four centuries and a co-founder of the Witch Cult. He was the primary antagonist of [[Arc 3]], and he is regularly referenced in many of the following arcs in one way or another. Petelgeuse was a spirit with mysterious ties to the Witch Cult, the [[Witch]]es, the [[Flugel|Sage]], and the elves of [[Elior Forest]]. Initially a kind man, he provided care for the elves while harboring a family-like relationship to [[Fortuna]] and [[Emilia]]. However, during the battle preceding the [[Permafrost of Elior Forest]], he lost his mind after taking in the Witch Factor of Sloth and obtaining its respective [[Authority]]. After being manipulated by the Witch of Vainglory, [[Pandora]], his mind became warped, and he became an evil spirit and the new Sin Archbishop of Sloth, solely devoting himself to reviving [[Satella]] and becoming one of the most proactive and feared of the Witch Cult. Petelgeuse's [[Subjugation of Sloth|final campaign]] was his attempted raid on [[Arlam Village]] and [[Roswaal Manor]] which ultimately ended in failure thanks to the efforts of [[Natsuki Subaru]]. Using his final breaths, he attempted to slay Subaru as someone who could bring down the Witch Cult, but thanks to Subaru, he lost his life beneath the wheels of a [[dragon]] carriage. ==Appearance== The vessel that Petelgeuse possessed was a thin man who stood at 180 centimeters tall, slightly taller than Subaru. His cheeks were gaunt and the skin on his bones was unusually thin. If it weren't for the twinkle of madness in his grey eyes, the Sin Archbishop would appear completely devoid of vitality. His complexion and lips, mirroring the rest of his figure, were deathly pale and had a sickly green tint to them. Sloth's deep-green hair was fairly short but still long enough to catch someone's eye. Despite his madness and general lack of social decorum, Petelgeuse's hair was stylized neatly into a bowl cut. In the anime adaptation, Petelgeuse's eyes were black instead of grey. According to Subaru, Sloth's breath and body both smelled repugnant. He did have a strange and twisted sense of fashion as he could usually be seen sporting a pair of crimson-red teardrop-shaped earrings, similar to that of Regulus, with a small exception of Petelgeuse's being a tiny bit smaller and, of course, of different color. Out of the Sin Archbishops, Petelgeuse's outfit was the most similar to the standard dark-purple Witch Cult robe. He wore a clerical cassock that had a green stripe down the front and baggy sleeves with peach-coloured frills. Over the top of his [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cassock cassock], Petelgeuse wore a purple cloak with an upturned collar, red seams, and pinkish interior. The cloak had a hood attached to it in the traditional Witch Cult style although Sloth was never seen wearing it, with the only exception being when he possessed his fellow fingers, but even then, it was rare to see him so. Lastly, a purple [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zucchetto zucchetto] with a grey ring around its edge rested atop his head. About one hundred years ago, Petelgeuse could be seen as a much more normal member of society, sporting a rather tall and somewhat thin physique and sane and lively brown eyes. His hair bore perhaps a bit lighter shade of green, was much longer, and was evenly cut and tied to a small ponytail. His face wasn't as crazed and devoid of life, with his manner of speech being more calmed down and normal. He also did not harm himself, meaning his fingers were not as disfigured as in the years prior to his demise. Emilia described him as very tall and skinny, but in a leaner way than frail. It is also worth mentioning that due to his nature as a spirit that took human bodies as anchors out of necessity and his ability to possess non-contracted people who had an affinity for spirits, Petelgeuse often shifted between bodies. At some points, he even possessed women. ==Personality== Petelgeuse was the general depiction of insanity, preferring to talk while in weird positions, such as tilting his head or bending his waist, and also liked to engage in self-harming activities, such as crushing his own fingers, pulling his hair out, smashing his head onto nearby walls of the cave he was situated in, etc. Despite him being the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, he adhered to principles of living consisting of diligence and love. His love for Satella was the largest among the Sin Archbishops. He diligently followed and carried out orders from his Gospel, always acting first in various situations, causing his name to be known as the most active Sin Archbishop, who was responsible for more than half of all the Witch Cult's activities and attacks. Prior to losing his mind, Petelgeuse carried himself as a moderate, upright, and rational man. He was a close friend of Fortuna and Emilia, enough to be described as being like family to them. He could be emotional to the point of being moved to tears, as he did when he cried out of relief and happiness when he first met Emilia. He was also very respectful toward certain people, such as the elves of Elior Forest and the Sage Flugel. He was willing to sacrifice himself for the safety of Fortuna and Emilia, a trait which Pandora commended, and one which he would pass on to his future mad self. However, when [[Regulus Corneas|Regulus]] and Pandora attacked their village, he accidentally killed Fortuna through Pandora's power, which combined with the damage he received when taking in the Witch Factor of Sloth, which he lacked compatibility with, causing him to go insane. It is worth noting that both in his past and present, the members of the Witch Cult held him in high regard and carried out his orders diligently and without question. ==History== ===Early Life=== Born 402 years ago, Petelgeuse started his life as a lesser spirit of earth.''“Yes, that’s right. He was originally a lesser spirit of earth.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/532466181106851840 November 12, 2014 AskFM Q&A] Roughly 400 years ago, alongside either one or multiple other founders, Petelgeuse participated in co-founding the Witch Cult for an unknown reason.''“You might have been one of the founders of the Witch Cult, and you may have your seat because of a few past services you contributed, but if the question of who deserves it more was to come up now, that seat would be mine!”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 3, Section 1. In the following centuries, Petelgeuse acted as the leader of the Moderate Faction of the Witch Cult, carrying out different tasks. Even without having an Authority, he was appointed the title of Archbishop, though he was not entrusted with Sloth until much later. Going by the name Geuse, he was acquainted with the Sage, Flugel, who he expressed reverence to, and the Witch of Greed, [[Echidna]], who he had a cordial relationship with, going so far as to tutor her "daughter", the artificial spirit [[Beatrice]]. At some point, he met Fortuna, befriended her, and learned of the elves of Elior Forest and the seal they guarded through her. A bit over a century ago, Petelgeuse started to involve himself with Elior Forest and its residents, periodically bringing them new clothes, accessories and sometimes even food from the outside of the forest. In the following months, he met Emilia who was, for an unknown reason, of great importance to him, causing him to break down in tears, due to happiness. ===[[Elior Forest Team, Waiting for the Thaw]]=== After meeting Geuse for the first time, Emilia wanted to be friends with him. However, Fortuna kept her away from him. Thinking that Fortuna would panic if she faked stomach pains, she believed that Fortuna would ask what she wanted and let her see Geuse. However, when she committed to her act, Fortuna seemed to panic more than she expected, and she brought her to the village square and asked for help. [[Archi Elior|Archi]] asked if she was acting, getting him into an argument with Fortuna since Emilia had never fallen ill even when the entire village had when they all ate rotten appas. Geuse decided to pray for her since she had helped him before, causing the whole village to lower their heads in silence. Feeling guilty, Emilia began to cry and said that her stomach had stopped hurting, causing everyone to rejoice, and Geuse told her that instead of apologizing when she troubles someone to instead say thank you. Afterward, walking back the way she came, Geuse held the sleeping Emilia on his back while Fortuna thanked him for going along with her act. Fortuna recalled how she worried for her, even after Archi became her guardian, and after Emilia called her a crybaby in her sleep, Geuse claimed that Fortuna was just like Emilia when she was younger with her brother, to her annoyance. ===[[Permafrost of Elior Forest]]=== After that first meeting, he started to bond with Emilia and Fortuna even more; however, the trio's happy times didn't last long. To his horror, Regulus Corneas and Pandora made their appearance in the forest, bringing with them the wrath of the [[Black Serpent]] as well as the Radical Faction of the Witch Cult who engaged in combat with the Moderate Faction. In dire need for a power strong enough to stop Greed and Vainglory and allow Fortuna and Emilia to escape, Petelgeuse resorted to his trump card: the Witch Factor of Sloth. Apologizing to Flugel, Petelgeuse took in the Witch Factor which immediately started ravaging through his body, making him suffer excruciating pain and crying tears of blood. As a side effect, however, he gained the Authority of Sloth which he named the Unseen Hands. This caused Pandora to grant him the seat of Sloth, which he turned down, expressing his disinterest in it. He then proceeded to fight Regulus. However, no matter how many times he pummeled the white-haired Sin Archbishop, he wasn't able to overpower and defeat him. Soon, Regulus had enough of it and with a single wave of his hand, cut Petelgeuse's right arm off by the shoulder and well as decimating his legs by throwing dirt and gravel at him. Just as he was about to curb stomp his head, Pandora stopped him, causing Regulus to get unreasonably angry at her, killing her on sight. Upon using her Authority of Vainglory to erase her death from the past, Pandora removed Regulus' presence from the forest, reverting all the damage done by him which effectively healed Petelgeuse's near destroyed body. What followed was an intense battle between Pandora and a duo consisting of Petelgeuse and Fortuna. Their battle concluded in the very depths of the forest, next to the Seal Pandora wanted to open; with her Authority of Vainglory, she tricked Petelgeuse into thinking Fortuna was Pandora, causing him to tear out her chest with his Unseen Hands. After realizing what he had done, Petelgeuse's mind utterly shattered, plunging him into the depths of insanity and utter despair. After realizing there was no way to convince Emilia to open the Seal, Pandora urged Petelgeuse to accompany her from the Elior Forest while Emilia slowly pushed the land into an everlasting permafrost. ===Life as the Sin Archbishop of Sloth=== In the following century, Petelgeuse accepted the seat of Sloth, joining the Radical Faction of the Witch Cult. He became notorious for his cruelty, frequently slaughtering entire towns and villages, acting strictly according to his Gospel's writ. At some point, Petelgeuse came across [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]], telling her on the day they met that if hope can pull on one's hands, despair can push on one's back.''“I cannot become your hope. However, it is possible to become your despair. If hope pulls on one’s hands, then despair should push on one’s back!”'' [[Re:Zero Visual Complete]] Petelgeuse also encountered [[Stride Vollachia]], giving him a Gospel of his own and assisting him with the handling of his [[Stride Vollachia#Abilities|Hubristic Ten Commandments]], with the latter becoming the Sin Archbishop of Pride.''“It is not like I hold any foolish beliefs towards that Witch, but emulating the diligent knave who handed this book to me and contributed in the way of handling my Authority… the Hubristic Ten Commandments, I shall say this.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 6, Section 4. Decades later, Petelgeuse was lured by [[Al|Aldebaran]] to meet him, and he questioned why Al did not appear in his Gospel. Afterward, Al used his Authority to fight Petelgeuse and drag information out of him. After succeeding in that, Al escaped, much to Petelgeuse's displeasure. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Petelgeuse is a powerful spirit who had caused havoc for over a century and was among the most destructive members of the Witch Cult, could easily escape death due to his nature as an evil spirit, and was capable of easily defeating numerous warriors with ease. Despite this, however, this is primarily due to the nature of his Authority being invisible to nearly everyone. When faced with a person capable of seeing or at least seeing through his Authority, his overall power is at least equal to a warrior of [[Julius Juukulius]]'s caliber before his strength increased. ===[[Authority]]=== Petelgeuse using the Unseen Hands for the first time..gif|Petelgeuse using the Unseen Hands to attack Pandora. Petelgeuse Using Unseen Hand flying.gif|Petelgeuse using the Unseen Hands to glide through the air. '''[[Authority#Authority of Sloth|Unseen Hand]]''' (見えざる手, ''Miezaru Te''): Petelgeuse was the previous holder of the '''Witch Factor of Sloth''' and could use its respective Authority. The Unseen Hands was an ability that allowed Petelgeuse to summon numerous invisible hand-like appendages from his body that he could move and extend telekinetically. An Unseen Hand was strong enough to tear through flesh, bend and break bones, and shatter rock. The Hands could be combined together to create larger and more powerful hands. While all ten of his fingers were alive at any give time, the maximum number of hands Petelgeuse could conjure was limited to seven, but when all of the pieces the Witch Factor he bestowed to his fingers returned to his body, he was able to summon over a hundred of them.''“In normal conditions, Petelgeuse can only summon up to 7 Unseen Hands. However, if you pay attention, you’ll understand why he could summon a higher quantity near the end. That was because the Factor that Petelgeuse had imbued in his fingers to prepare them for Possession returned to him, augmenting his power.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/775011145035894784 Re:Zero Episode 24 Commentary]''The evil hands rushing toward them exceeded a hundred, resembling a tsunami capable of covering the whole world.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9]], Chapter 3, Section 4. At his maximum potential, the Unseen Hands and the force behind each one was akin to a cannonball. Save for Subaru, Petelgeuse was the only person who could see the Unseen Hands. Petelgeuse also displayed the ability to propel himself forward through the air using the Unseen Hands, making it appear as if he's flying, though in reality, he's simply playing catch with his body being the thrown object. '''Non-Canon''': *'''Mental Contamination''' (精神汚染, ''Seishin Osen''): Petelgeuse could let out a black wave toward his surroundings, corrupting the minds of those who have no knowledge of spiritual arts. Those affected experienced hallucinations, auditory hallucinations, and severe pain, then exposed the whites of their eyes, foamed at the mouth, and were nearly driven mad. It has been described as a “slothful cancellation of the actions of others”. He used this ability as a test to determine potential candidates he could possess. Though grouped up as falling under Petelgeuse's Authority in the text of the web novel versions of Arc 3 and [[Arc 5]], it is unrelated to his Unseen Hands. '''This ability was cut out of the light novel'''. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== As an evil spirit with command over earth mana, Petelgeuse was capable of using earth magic. Since his absorption of the Witch Factor of Sloth, however, Petelgeuse opted not to use magic in combat, instead relying on his Authority of Sloth. That being said, he still used it as a fallback for when his Authority failed him or when he was backed into a corner. '''Spells''': [[File:Petelgeuse using Ul Dona (1).gif|thumb|250px|Petelgeuse using "'''Ul Dona'''" to defend against Julius Juukulius.]] *'''Ul Dona''' (ウル・ドーナ, ''Uru Dōna''): Petelgeuse could use this spell manipulate the earth around him to create a large protective dome. ===Other=== '''Possession''' (憑依, ''Hyōi''): As a spirit, Petelgeuse took control of humans that were compatible with spirits and had no preexisting contracts.''“Forcing a contract onto a human being qualified to be a spiritual arts user and taking over their bodies. That’s the truth behind your possession. Sin Archbishop… no, spirit, Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti!”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9]], Chapter 4, Section 1. Because Petelgeuse differed from the norm as a spirit, he was required to use human bodies as anchors out of necessity,''“Petelgeuse attached himself to humans out of necessity, and Beako was designed by Echidna, as well.”'' August 13, 2014 AskFM Q&A and he could not exist otherwise.''"Also, as Petelgeuse is an irregular spirit, he’s not able to exist in the state where he’s not possessing someone. If he could do that, he wouldn’t have done something like pursuing in a body that was nearly a corpse."'' AskFM Q&A. He was usually accompanied by special followers, called the '''fingers''' (指先, ''yubisaki''), ten Witch Cultists who acted as sub-commanders and spare bodies for Petelgeuse, with each one leading a group of several lower-ranking cultists. The fingers themselves had positions that corresponded with the names of fingers on the human body. Up until he took in the Witch Factor of Sloth, Petelgeuse's followers were willing to serve as vessels for him. After becoming the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, Petelgeuse needed to share a part of his Witch Factor in order to successfully possess a finger.''“It’s not so much stagnant Gates as having weird clumps of mana. I think the presence or absence of this sets the fingers apart from the regular cultists, and that the Sin Archbishop can only transfer into the ones with this planted in them.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9]], Chapter 3, Section 2.''“It is YOU, an ideal believer, who should be truly exalted! With the favor so rich within you, should you intend to join the fingers. I shall bestow the Factor upon you without DELAY!”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9]], Chapter 3, Section 3. Although he was able to continue using his Authority within their bodies upon possessing them, this decreased the amount of Unseen Hands he was able to manifest until he regained all of the parts of his Witch Factor he shared to them.''“As the Witch Factor you handed out comes back, the number of hands you can control increases.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9]], Chapter 3, Section 4. Because Petelgeuse was incompatible with his Witch Factor and, accordingly, was unsuited to using his Authority, his body would break down quickly, forcing him to replace it often.Narō impression response on June 21, 2014, at 22:38 JST Before becoming a Sin Archbishop, a long time ago, he also privately discussed the possibility of being able to possess a dragonhusk with his possession.''In particular, an evil spirit whom Clind knew harbored the power to possess the bodies of others, and he had also discussed the possibility of such a power being capable of seizing a dragonhusk in private with his allies. ——Geuse, it had been an awfully long time since he had seen the evil spirit who went by that name.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6. '''Miasma-Attuned Olfaction''': Petelgeuse has the ability to smell the scent of the Witch. It is unknown why he has this ability. ===Equipment=== [[File:Petelgeuse - Witch Cult Gospel.gif|thumb|250px|Petelgeuse's Gospel.]] *'''Gospel''' (福音, ''Fukuin''): As a member of the Witch Cult, Petelgeuse was the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel is a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed, Echidna. The [[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]] would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult are defective replicas, meaning that, although they detail the future of its owner, the events conveyed are subject to change and the information provided is often up for interpretation. The Gospels take the form of small black books that can only be read by their owners. ==Trivia== *Petelgeuse, like every other Sin Archbishop (with the exception of Stride Vollachia), received his namesake from a celestial body. Betelgeuse is the name of a variable star in the constellation of Orion. It was known as the "the Hand of Orion" due to its location in the constellation. This could possibly be a reference to Petelgeuse's Unseen Hands. In Japan, Betelgeuse is known as the "red star". *According to the author, the basis of his actions, his relation to the Witches, his past 400 years ago, and why his name is intentionally spelled as Petelgeuse are important plot points scheduled to be revealed in a future arc. *A man who was one of Petelgeuse's fingers during the incident in Elior Forest 100 years ago identified himself a member of the “'''Romanée-Conti family'''” (ロマネコンティ一族, ''Romanekonti Ichizoku'').''“W-Wait! I am one of Lord Archbishop Romanée-Conti’s ‘fingers’!”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 3, Section 3.''“…I shall accompany you. Old as I might be, I am still part of the Romanée-Conti family.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 14]], Chapter 3, Section 3. Per the author, the Romanée-Conti family is a group of Petelgeuse's followers who have been devoting their bodies to him for generations.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/901819479503527936 August 27, 2017 Author's Comment] **Furthermore, in the Aganau IF from the mobile game [[Re:Zero Lost in Memories]], the Romanée-Conti family was said to have modified their bodies to become suitable vessels for their lord and had been bred for that purpose. It is unclear whether the inner workings of the Romanée-Conti family mentioned in Lost in Memories are the same as the one depicted in the actual story. *Petelguese's last name is named after a famous wine under the same name that originated in the French Revolution. *The author asked his readers on "Let's become a Novelist" about whether he should change the surname Romanée-Conti to something else in the Light Novel version. However, most readers told him to keep it as is, thus his surname was not changed. *According to the author Petelgeuse was the "nicest" Sin Archbishop compared to the others, but after he went mad, he lost every ounce of dignity and morals, frequently going on rampages all across the world, becoming responsible for more than half of all attacks orchestrated by the Witch Cult, being known as the most active Sin Archbishop of the aforementioned cult. *The author has stated that Petelgeuse used to be a lesser spirit of earth.''“Yes, that’s right. He was originally a lesser spirit of earth.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/532466181106851840 November 12, 2014 AskFM Q&A] *The author mentioned that Petelgeuse was unable to possess a spiritual arts user who already had a contract with another spirit. *Before he lost his mind, Petelgeuse was shown to have a rather intimate and close relationship with Fortuna. Their relationship lasted for decades if not centuries. **According to the author, there were times where Petelgeuse was forced to use a female body. Despite that, Fortuna still loved him. *According to the author, the reason why Petelgeuse introduced himself as Geuse can be found by researching the star Betelgeuse.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1356976716233641986 Season 2 Episode 18 Commentary] *Petelgeuse and Fortuna's Japanese voice actors also voice [[w:c:swordartonline:Yuuki Asuna|Yuuki Asuna]] and [[w:c:swordartonline:Kirigaya Kazuto|Kirigaya Kazuto]], a well-known and popular couple from the anime series ''Sword Art Online'', another series published by Kadokawa under its subsidiary ASCII Media Works, respectively. *According to the author, the method that Petelgeuse uses to check whether they are compatible enough for him to possess is by using the [[miasma]] of Sloth.''"The only people Petelgeuse is able to possess are those who are suited to being possessed and controlled by him. A trained spirit arts user, or someone who is simply physically resilient. The method of checking is using the miasma of ‘Sloth’; someone who fails their sanity point check is no longer able to fight against Petelgeuse. "'' AskFM Q&A. *If Petelgeuse were to possess someone with a [[Divine Protection]], his Witch Factor would strip it away from the body.''"That’s not the case, however at the moment he possessed them, the effect of the Divine Protection would be removed by the Witch Factor."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, Petelgeuse's gospel may be sitting in Subaru's room.''"It’s probably on a bookshelf in Subaru’s room."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, he did not expect Petelgeuse to become popular.''"I didn’t expect him to become popular, but he was going to have a complex background from the start, so things are going as planned. Not like Rem!"''
