[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Marika Kouno|Kouno Marika]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Erica Mendez|Erica Mendez]]}} '''Petra Leyte''' (ペトラ・レイテ) is a former inhabitant of [[Arlam Village]] who currently lives and works at [[Roswaal Manor]] as a maid. She plays a major role in [[Arc 4]] and [[Arc 9]], a supporting role in [[Arc 7]], [[Arc 8]], and [[Arc 10]], and a lesser supporting role in [[Arc 2]] and [[Arc 3]]. Originally just a young village girl, she became a maid in order to stay close to [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], who had helped her shed her self-centered demeanor. Learning magic, politics, and maid duties, she helps the [[Emilia Camp]] in many aspects, whether that be assisting in making connections with other nobles and [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], using her smarts to assist in battles, or even attempt to become a [[Witch#Witch of Melancholy, Petra Leyte|Witch]] if necessary. ==Appearance== During her life as a village child, Petra wore common clothes that consisted of a pair of brown shoes, green leggings with horizontal stripes that were shorn just above the ankles, a white long-sleeved shirt, an open short-sleeved cream-colored cardigan with red outlining, and a red ribbon fastened to her collar. She has medium length reddish brown hair that, as time progressed, has grown to reach her shoulder in Arc 9, she has cyan eyes, and she has continued to grow taller since her introduction. In Arc 4, Petra switched to a maid uniform for her job, keeping her ribbon tied in her hair. During Subaru's knighting ceremony, Petra wore a light green dress with a ribbon of the same shade in her hair along with her red ribbon. From Arc 7 and on, she wore a long-sleeved yellow and white shirt, a green skirt with white frills, a green cloak held together by a red ribbon, a red ribbon in her hair, white leggings, and brown boots. By Arc 9, she has also fashioned part of her hair into a braid. ==Personality== Petra is a pure-hearted, innocent young girl who often tries her best to help and nurture others, regardless of whether doing so was detrimental to her. Her sweet personality is enough to mellow the hearts of those who interacted with her, particularly Subaru and [[Frederica Baumann|Frederica]], whose moods brightened just from talking with her. Unlike many people in [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]], Petra harbors no xenophobic tendencies towards demi-humans, instead judging people off of their deeds and personalities. Alongside the other children in Arlam Village, Petra held no prejudice against [[Emilia]]. In a similar vein, Petra is able to fairly judge a person's abilities and is unable to unfairly demean a person she doesn't like.''Being unable to unfairly demean a person because she did not like them was Petra’s nature, even though she was not willing to admit it.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 109, Section 1. For someone so young, Petra is incredibly brave, choosing to prioritize the lives and wellbeing of others above her own in situations of crisis. When the disguised Wolgarm fled into the Wolgarm-infested woods, Petra, who was unaware of the creature's true identity, steeled her nerves and traversed into the forest to rescue the animal from danger. When [[Elsa Granhiert]] took her hostage and brought her before Subaru and her fellow maids, Petra, although terrified at the prospect of dying, told her friends to flee and save themselves rather than rescue her. Similarly, she is even willing to put her life on the line if it means helping others, as shown when she placed an oath bound curse mark on herself as a promise to let [[Musica]] meet Emilia while negotiating to let them pass into [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]] to save Subaru. She was even willing to read a Book of the Dead, despite knowing the risks involved, in order to understand her opponent's possible goals, as well as use a Witch Factor in spite of the risks. Originally, Petra was a rather self-centered young girl, believing the world to be small and simple.''To Petra Leyte, the world was very small and simple.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 1. Being rather smart for her age and having known that she was cute,''A little girl's self-awareness was not to be taken lightly. Because not only was Petra better-looking than most, she was also more intelligent. On the other hand, that intelligence could be called cunning.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 1. she fully exploited that fact and used it as a means of getting out of trouble,''Petra believed that being born with good looks was equal to being born with a Divine Protection or talent. So it was only natural that she should exploit her own good looks to make her marks in life.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 1.''And every time the adults got angry with her, Petra slyly made use of her beauty and charm. If she let her eyes fill with tears, peered down at her feet, and muttered an apology, that was enough to convince the adults not to be mad. And it was only natural that once they stopped scolding Petra, they would have to stop scolding the other children, too.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 1. believing that apologies were essentially just a tool to obtain forgiveness.''Petra fell silent, sensing she had just been asked a very difficult question. Wasn't that what apologies were for? To be forgiven? That's what apologies had always been to Petra――a tool; a means to an end. Even if she felt genuine remorse when she said she was sorry, in the end, the words 'I'm sorry' were primarily a way to get people to forgive her.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 4. Likewise, this gave her an excuse to be slightly mischievous.''The only adults who could scold Petra――her parents――were thoroughly fooled by the good-girl facade she maintained around. So Petra spent her days acting like a mischievous little devil.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 1. Because she was adored by the adults, admired by the boys, and relied on by the girls, she had become excessively spoiled and her ego had bloated sharply,''Admired by the boys, relied upon by the girls, and doted on by the adults, Petra watered her flower of self-worth until it was in full bloom.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 1. and she had begun to harbor rather harsh opinions of other people.''Naive. Simple-minded. A pushover――that was how she thought of people all the times she used her prettiness as a weapon to mess with adults and children alike.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 6. This also led to her feeling a sense of loneliness when she realized nobody seemed to approve of her dreams of becoming a tailor,''That was when Petra had her first real taste of loneliness. The other children relied on Petra, but Petra had no friends to rely on. And talking to the adults about her dream without them laughing at her was a struggle.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 2. and her not getting her way simply by her appearance became her first real setback.''To Petra, who had gotten everything she wanted just by being pretty, this was a hard truth to swallow. Finding a hurdle that could not be cleared with prettiness was Petra's first major setback in life.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 2. However, after she was saved during the [[Wolgarm Incident]] by Subaru and seeing what became of him because of her actions, she felt tremendous guilt, to the point that she was crying about what she had done,''But she pretended not to hear them, shutting herself inside until eventually, unable to bear the mounting waves of guilt, Petra finally stumbled into her parents' room, sobbing.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 4. and after speaking with her parents and apologizing to Subaru, she came to understand that she misunderstood everyone's kindness,''Suddenly, Petra realized them that she had lived her whole life under a gross misapprehension. Whenever the adults forgave Petra for playing pranks or stealing food or ditching her chores, she'd assumed it was because she was pretty. But she was wrong. What a horrible misunderstanding. That was never it at all. The adults forgave her because they were kind, too.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 6. and because of this, she mellowed out. Thanks to Subaru, she began to admire kind people and strived to be kind herself, no longer wanting to take the kindness of others for granted, while she came to dislike herself and believe being sly was inappropriate.''In the past, there was a time when she had taken that sort of attitude often. As a result, she now disliked her old self, and renewed her stance that being sly was inappropriate.'' [[Re:Zero Ootsuka Shinichirou Art Works Re:BOX 2nd|Shouhenshou Volume 3]], [[Frederica and Petra's Maid-san Days II]], Section 2. Following the [[Sanctuary Incident|incident]] in the [[Sanctuary]], Petra has become somewhat bolder, aspires to the ideal that she must at all times achieve what is expected of her,''However, she must, at all times, achieve what was expected of her. That was Petra’s approach to thinking about things, or at least that was the immature ideal she aspired to.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 3. and speaks her mind more often, especially when it comes to the safety of her friends and, in particular, Subaru, who often worries her with his constant recklessness of turning head-first into danger. That said, she has shown to be quite harsh with those that she cannot stand. Because of the actions that [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] took that nearly led to the death of not only everyone in the Emilia Camp but also the villagers of both the Sanctuary and Arlam Village, she has shown to be very critical and unforgiving toward him, often using blunt and cruel statements when talking with him or even wringing out dirty rags in his drinks. Of course, she doesn’t go too far with her resentment, and she is even willing to work with him at times if it means victory, but alongside [[Otto Suwen]], she refuses to trust him, and she makes sure that she stays an anchor in the camp in the case that Roswaal does something suspicious again. Because of everything he had done for her, saving her, forgiving her, and showing her the error of her original attitude, Petra has come to harbor a deep crush on Subaru. Because of this, Petra changed her wish of wanting to be a seamstress at the [[Royal Capital]] to being a good wife,''At twelve years old, Petra Leyte had a dream. It had been to become a first-rate seamstress and open the best clothing shop in the capital――but not anymore.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 6.''"When I grow up, I want to marry a good and kind man."'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 6. and in an effort to place herself in a position from which she could provide her help to Subaru, when Roswaal Manor was putting up a notice for new servants, Petra went out of her way to ask the other villagers to turn down the offer so that she could become one herself. It is for the goal of assisting Subaru and remaining by his side that she is now learning maid duties, politics, and magic, and though she has times in which she feels like she is powerless compared to the other members of the camp, she is willing to trust those people to help and keep an eye on Subaru in her place. Petra is often shown to be anxious over Subaru and his reckless actions as well, pouting when he actively decided leave for the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], which even the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint]] was unable to reach and was in one of the most dangerous locations in the world, and even felt frustrated with his decision to accept [[Spica]] in spite of her [[Rui Arneb|past]]. However, she looks up to him for being willing to take such risks, and she has taken after him somewhat in taking similar risks. When she feels anxious, she even calls his name to rid herself of said anxiety, which allows her to take action when necessary.''Calling out the name of the one she loved to scatter the surplus of anxiety, she simply gritted her teeth.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 3. However, although this is exclusive to the events of Arc 9, after reading Subaru's Book of the Dead, despite becoming incredibly upset after learning his secret, her boldness, confidence, and willingness to stay by his side and help him was greatly amplified, to the point that she was willing to give up something precious of hers to [[Clind]] in order to use his [[Authority]] to gather everyone to help save him, as well as to take on his Witch Factor and proclaim herself a [[Witch]], despite the negative connotations of Witches around the world, in order to both help and be like Subaru, who she recognized as essentially being a Warlock by bearing his own Authority, and Petra was willing to sacrifice many possible futures in order to use her Authority in order to assist Subaru, including returning to her original home or various other sacrifices, so long as she could stay by and help him. Petra considers herself to be quite mentally strong as well, as despite knowing that his eyes were on Emilia and Rem, who practically shone so bright that they were all he could see, she did not give up her love for him and intended to make herself stand out just as much to get his attention. On top of being intelligent and headstrong, the love she feels for Subaru also allows her to maintain her sense of self and resist the temptations brought about by a Witch Factor, which Petra described as being highly attractive. Exclusively to the events of Arc 9, because she read Subaru's Book of the Dead, she started to understand Subaru significantly better, and she could feel herself being influenced by him, began thinking in a similar manner to him, speaking with his loan words, and when she is around Emilia and [[Rem]], the influence is even stronger thanks to Subaru's immense passion for desperation for them, leading her to speak to them in a somewhat similar fashion to Subaru. Likewise, she was willing to break any promises to people she didn't like. ==History== ===[[The World Petra Saw]]=== Petra is a young girl who formerly lived in Arlam Village, a small rural village located in the lands of the noble Margrave Roswaal L. Mathers. As she grew up, she came to realize that she was cute and was willing to use that to get out of trouble, and in the process, she was practically the center of attention in the village. However, she also came to harbor the feeling that the people around her were terribly simple-minded and naive. Even after meeting the margrave in charge of the area, she came to find talking to him a complete waste of time. When she turned ten, a merchant stopped by the village. Upon seeing the fabrics he was selling and buying some for herself, she had started to aspire to move to the Royal Capital and become a tailor when she grew up.''When she grew up, she would move to the Royal Capital and make clothes for a living.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[The World Petra Saw]], Section 2. Over the next two years, Petra started to realize that she felt somewhat lonely when the other children didn't seem to approve of her dream and merely talked about their own dreams. At one point after becoming enthralled with fabrics, Frederica, who was still working with House Miload, had been summoned to the manor and asked to deliver a message to the mayor of Arlam Village. There, Petra, who she asked for directions and was taken by her cuteness. There, she claimed that she would have liked to be Frederica's friend, though unbeknownst to Frederica, she was thinking of her pinafore as reference rather than thinking too much of Frederica. Afterward, she led her to the mayor. One day, two years later, a new butler in training, Subaru, visited the village. Upon his visit, while the other kids played with him, Petra was wary of his demeanor, especially as he knew her name despite not introducing herself. Leading him to the village, she decided to lead him to [[Rasphum]], intending to prank him by making him believe that he was the village head. That same day, she met [[Meili Portroute|Meili]], who claimed to have been visiting for a short time, and she showed Petra a small dog that did tricks. The next day, when Subaru appeared, more relaxed than the day before, she gained a slightly better impression of him, though that was drowned out when he dragged the village into doing radio calisthenics. Later, she and the kids were playing with the dog, which had bitten Subaru earlier that day. When the dog ran off, she and the other children followed Meili when she went to retrieve him. However, after an hour without finding the dog and worrying about the other children, Petra, still afraid, decided to try and turn everyone around, only for Meili to use a [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarm]] to knock them out. When she woke up the next day, she learned that she and the kids were saved by Subaru, who got hurt in the process, and that Meili had supposedly left the village, which she instinctively knew to be a lie. Along with the other kids, she went to the manor to show her gratitude to him. After the maid [[Ram]] led her to his room, however, upon seeing how badly injured he was, she recalled what she had asked of him and realized that her actions led to this. After freezing up, she ran back home and locked herself away in her room in guilt to cry. That night, after she calmed down, she spoke with her parents about her actions that led to Subaru's injuries, and though slightly scolded for it, they told her that she should apologize. Two days later, the day after the incident was fully resolved, Subaru visited the village again, and though the kids pulled him around, Petra, who scolded them for it, ran away when Subaru looked at her. After he caught up, he and Petra sat down, and despite Subaru nearly misunderstanding that she might have gotten injured because of the whole mess, she apologized and sobbed to him. Ultimately, Subaru forgave her, which led to her to reconsider why she was forgiven, at which point she realized that it was because Subaru, as well as everyone else she wrote off as naive, were just kind. A short time later, Petra showed off an outfit that she made with fabrics she had bought, wanting to hear Subaru's thoughts. After hearing his positive opinions and how he believed that she would make an excellent tailor when she told him about her dream, her dreams of becoming a tailor changed to wanting to be a good wife to a kind man, and she had begun to harbor a crush on Subaru. ===[[Some Like it Cold]]=== One day, while the village was feeling the effects of [[Puck]]'s [[Magic#Organs and Conditions|magic release period]], Subaru and the residents of Roswaal Manor visited the village, and Subaru announced that they would be having a competition during this snow festival. Whoever was able to make the best snow sculpture would win a prize, and the judges were Subaru, Roswaal, and Rasphum. As the kids were playing in the snow, Petra made a snow sculpture of a rabbit. Subaru, though impressed, touched it up, and he was reprimanded by Petra for it. In the end, Petra was the one who won the competition. ===[[Frederica and Petra's Maid-san Days]]=== A couple of months after the Wolgarm Incident, Petra decided to give up her dream of becoming a tailor, instead choosing to look for work in Roswaal Manor when posters asking for new maids at the manor were posted, where she could be closer to Subaru. After pleading with the other village girls not to take on the request, Petra went to accept the request. Though Frederica, who was conducting her interview, wanted to turn her down due to the lack of time to trains new maids in the basics, she received favorable responses from Petra that made Frederica want to hire her. Warning Petra that her behavior would reflect on Roswaal, Frederica accepted when she was told that Petra would not give up for the person she cared for, and afterward, had Petra refer to her as her big sister. After being hired, Frederica began instructing her, only to find that Petra was already excellent at completing her tasks. Commenting on how a young Ram could have learned from Petra, the two headed to the village. While there, Frederica shopped for what she could while the half of the villagers were still gone, while Petra spoke with her friends. On their way back to the manor, however, Petra was in a bad mood, having been defending Frederica after they said her mouth was scary. Moved, Frederica urged her to speak with her friends again, who looked like they wanted to apologize. One night, she and Frederica shared a bath, in which Frederica told Petra about Clind and warned her to stay away from him due to his proclivities. Recognizing the complicated emotions in Frederica's voice, she asked to stay the night in her room. Later, after leaving food out for [[Beatrice]], she appeared in Frederica's room, where she learned of one of Frederica's old bad habits. After laughing about it, the two went to bed, hoping that by the next morning, the food left for Beatrice would have been gone. The next morning, as Frederica was preparing breakfast, Petra spoke to her, apologizing for her behavior on the day that the two first met. Though Frederica said there was nothing to apologize about since she had almost forgotten, she recalled Petra mentioning wanting to be friends, and now they were. Asking Petra what made her think of apologizing, Petra claimed that something had been bugging her and she had remembered. Believing she believed what caused her to remember, Frederica began to panic, only for Petra to say it was because of something she had said the night before. Afterward, she helped Frederica prepare breakfast. ===[[The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting]]=== Following the Sanctuary Incident, [[Annerose Miload]] and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the Sanctuary to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and Otto, who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia. Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where Puck slept and called everyone there precious to her. ===[[Poltergeist Story]]=== Two months after the Sanctuary Incident, Roswaal called for the maids of Roswaal Manor. Intending to begin making allies with other nobles with Emilia for the [[Royal Selection]], he set his sights on first targeting Viscount [[Minor Characters#Torion Aruz|Torion Aruz]], he tasked the girls with cleaning a villa that was once the workshop of his father, [[Roswaal K. Mathers]]. Two days later, the girls arrived in the evening, birds attempting to steal their luggage having delayed their arrival. There, they found that the workshop was covered in ivy and vines and was practically falling apart from disuse. As nighttime approached, despite Frederica starting to panic over the workshop's creepy atmosphere, they decided that they would have to stay the night there. While Ram remained out front for a while, Frederica and Petra went to the back of the workshop, which is in even worse condition than the front. However, after a hole just large enough for the two to slip into, Petra walked inside, followed shortly after by Frederica. Unable to see Petra, she instead saw a doll in the darkness, shortly before the lights came on. Soon after, she reunited with Petra and Ram, afraid of the doll. Despite Ram's insistence that it was Frederica's imagination, Frederica and Petra heard an explosion-like noise in the distance while Ram heard nothing. Wanting to leave, Frederica clung to Ram as they headed for the front door, only to find that it was storming outside, and Petra had to stop Frederica from beastifying and running away. Deciding they would investigate the strange sounds and dolls, Petra headed upstairs, hoping to catch sight of a hollow. Frederica, still sticking with Ram, tried to follow after her, only to fall through the floor of the stairs. Shortly after, Frederica became a target of harassment for the doll, and before long, she ended up latching onto one in fear, having mistaken it for one of the other two. In a panic, she beastified and ran off, the doll gripping her tail. She eventually smashed it away with her tail on the roof, only to find others that made her fall. Ram, who recognized what they were, ordered the dolls to catch her. Shortly after, Frederica, her clothes destroyed, and Petra were told that the dolls had been magicreation tools that were defending the manor, and they treated Petra and Frederica as intruders, treating them differently because due to their different sizes. First claiming the dolls could help them clean the place up with them, Petra then thought to dress up the dolls and fix their makeup before calling Roswaal to the workshop. Before long, Roswaal had flown over to the workshop and wondered how long it had been since he'd been there. Meeting up with the maids, he found 111 of those dolls dressed up and fixed. Surprised that they were still, having created more of themselves to continue protecting the place until the master could return, he thanked them, causing them to bow and finally shut down. Afterward, facing the confused Petra, he thanked them for allowing him to right a wrong, upsetting Petra for his attitude. With Roswaal deciding to help them, Frederica told Petra she could work him hard, while Ram had knelt down and gently thanked the dolls for their service. ===[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle]]=== Shortly after the decision to visit the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]] was made, Petra was being extremely petulant because she was not one of the people who would be going to the Watergate City and was instead accompanying Roswaal. Otto listened to her complaints for a bit, even suggesting he would talk to the Margrave himself about it, which Petra refused. Otto asked Petra to baby-sit Roswaal whilst he was away, to which Petra agreed, saying she would have done that even if he had not asked. In return, she asked him to take care of Subaru and the others. Otto asked if Petra was worried about him, to which Petra replied that she saw no need to do so. ===[[Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle / Page 1|Petra’s Emilia Camp Struggle]]=== Occurring simultaneously with the [[Battle for Priestella]], Petra took part in the meeting with the western nobles alongside Roswaal, Annerose, Frederica, and Clind. After a short confrontation with the renowned chef, [[Dias Fatsbalm]], she witnessed as Roswaal attempted to convince the other nobles into backing Emilia of their own accord. Shortly after the meeting began, Roswaal had Petra speak on his behalf regarding Emilia, as if he were to do so, it may sound insincere or manipulative. She did as she was asked and gave her opinion and facts on Emilia, and she successfully managed to convince the other nobles to back her. Later, after learning some dishes from Dias, they returned to Roswaal Manor. ===[[Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose!]]=== After returning to Roswaal Manor, Beatrice was invited by Petra to sleep in her room. Having tea together, Beatrice told the curious Petra what happened in Priestella, to which Beatrice described the battle. Eventually, she asked about how Beatrice was during that fight, as she had barely brought herself up during the explanation, and she said that she was worried as Beatrice had started to imitate Subaru lately. Petra then dragged Beatrice into the bed with her, and they fell asleep. ===[[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]] and [[The Dragon Nation / Missing Child Search Chronicle 1|Missing Child Search]]=== Following the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], the expedition team returned to Roswaal Manor, carrying the news of Subaru and Rem’s disappearance. Following the revelation, [[Anastasia Hoshin]] and [[Julius Juukulius]] decided to enter Vollachia through [[Kararagi]], and Roswaal decided to have Clind use his Authority to take everyone else where they needed to be. Leaving Meili in the Royal Capital with Annerose, the rest of the camp arrived in [[Picoutatte]]. After settling an issue between Otto and [[Diadora Regundra]] and making a deal with the Suwen Company, the group decided to pass through the Everlasting Darkness with the assistance of the mole people. As they passed through the area, however, they were forced to speak with the representative of the mole people, Musica, who expressed concerns on behalf of his people about the emergence of a second Demi-Human War because of Emilia’s partaking in the Royal Selection. Since Emilia was disguised as a bodyguard while wearing her recognition obstruction robe and Petra was acting like a noble lady being escorted into another country on the camp’s behalf, Musica and Petra entered discussions, where she deduced his true intentions to sacrifice their race in order to bring down Emilia. Musica agreed to back off from the mole people's preexisting plan to meet and discuss things with Emilia when their business in the Empire was concluded, willingly bearing an oath bound curse mark in the process to show her intentions were genuine. Afterward, they were brought into Vollachia. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Petra has once been declared one of the weakest characters in the series. However, she makes up for her lack of physical strength with her intelligence, cunning, will, and adaptability. Despite her youth, she has shown herself to be a formidable enemy whose tactical and political prowess, despite her youth, are not to be underestimated. Although it is exclusive to Arc 9 and the Sasageru IF, Petra was once a formidable enemy as a Witch. Although in Arc 9 she pushed the limits of what she could do and sacrificed everything about her life to achieve victory, in the Sasageru IF, she held enough strength to contend with [[Vague Adgard]] and was feared as a centuries old Witch in a similar manner to the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Despite her youth, Petra is intelligent and a fast learner. As a child, she was quick to realize that she could use her cute appearance to get others to do as she wanted, and later on, when Subaru first appeared, she immediately recognized that something was different about him, which gave her a sense of caution that neither the other kids nor adults of the village had. Later on, after joining the Emilia Camp, she was quick to learn maid duties, magic, and politics, and she, alongside Otto, with their intelligence and realistic views of the world and the people around them, became an important anchor in the camp filled with idealists. Her intellect has shown itself the most when interacting with Musica and [[Vincent Vollachia]], where, in the case of the former, she was able to negotiate and come to a compromise with him, while in the case of the latter, she was able to see through his attempts to manipulate the camp with both his words and lack of words. Later on, during the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], she showed exemplary display for strategies, to the point that while working alongside Otto, their presence was perhaps the most significant on the battlefield, while during the [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict]], she was not only able to see through [[Al]]'s Authority after taking in Subaru's memories for the arc, but she was able to discover and overcome his weaknesses, come up with various applications for the Authority of Melancholy, and even completely direct people to the point that they could force Subaru to use Return by Death. According to Otto, her inclusion into the camp might have been the most significant and was perhaps Subaru's greatest achievement.''For the Emilia Camp, Petra’s inclusion might have been the most significant. At the very least, Otto took it as Subaru’s greatest achievement that Petra was here now.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 3. ===[[Magic]]=== Petra has an affinity for the yang attribute. She has learned magic techniques from Roswaal, which she has used for offensive purposes in the form of Jiwald and support purposes to boost one’s physical resilience. However, she is inexperienced with magic, making it inferior to the magic used by others. '''Spells''': *'''Jiwald''' (ジワルド): Using yang magic, Petra is able to conjure and manipulate visible light into beams of scorching heat that attack whatever stands in its way. Due to her inexperience in magic, her version of Jiwald is underwhelming, producing enough heat to leave small burns on the skin or ignite fire magic stones.''It was one of the few offensive spells Yang Magic boasted, a spear of light that pierced anything in its path―― but only when wielded by a first-rate master, and Petra, inexperienced as she was, did not meet that standard. Petra’s Jiwald would inflict a burn at best, rather than killing a living target.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 3.''Its purpose was not to burn the man. ――The aim was to ignite what had been prepared.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 3. This being said, it does seem to have enough power to pierce through someone's body at point blank range. *'''Healing Magic''': Petra has claimed to be able to heal others.''"I’ll cast a healing spell on you later, okay?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 3. However, she has yet to display this ability. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Self-Defense''': Frederica gave Petra lessons in physical combat in order for her to learn how to defend herself. ===[[Curse]]=== [[File:Oath Curse Mark on Petra.png|thumb|150px|An oath bound curse mark carved onto Petra’s chest]] '''[[Curse#Oath-Bound Curse Mark|Oath Bound Curse Mark]]''' (誓約の呪印, ''Seiyaku no Juin''): Following a confrontation with Musica and the mole humans in [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 4|Stand by me Pleiades]], Petra upheld her oath and had a curse mark carved onto herself. According to her oath, if she is to ever break her promise and not allow them to meet Emilia, she shall be engulfed in a purifying flame, scorching her body and tainting her soul, never allowing it to return to Od Lagna.''“Should I renounce this oath, my soul shall be tainted and my flesh enveloped and burned away by purifying flame. And my soul shall fall into the void, never to return to Od Lagna again.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Closing Chapter, Section 5. Petra's curse mark appears as a light circle with a carving of the crest of [[House Mathers]] displayed in the circle's center. ===[[Authority]]=== Exclusively to the events of Arc 9, before its events were undone by Return by Death, Petra bore the '''Witch Factor of Melancholy''' and its respective Authority during Arc 9. Clind, the other user of Melancholy and the person who assumed the responsibility of managing it, bestowed to Petra a black box containing the Witch Factor from which she has employed the Authority. Although she was incompatible with Melancholy, Petra did not succumb to the Factor's mental corruption, and she was limited in making use of its full power unless it is in exchange for a price. '''[[Authority#Authority of Melancholy|Compression]]''' (圧縮, ''Asshuku''): Using this Authority, Petra possessed the power to compress space, time, sensations, processes, and concepts. She primarily wielded Compression as a form of teleportation by compressing the distance that would be required to travel from one point to another, or to compress intangible things such as the time of thought and discussion processes or the sensations of agony within people in order to support her allies. As any individual besides Hector is incompatible with Melancholy due to its nature,''“No. Refutation. I am not compatible with the Witch Factor of Melancholy. Consequently, I necessitate compensation in order to draw out the Authority of Melancholy. Inadequate. By nature, those compatible with a Witch Factor do not require compensation in order to exercise the Authority. It is the right to rewrite the world, as recognized by Od Lagna. Official.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 3. Petra was required to bypass [[Od Lagna]] to wield Compression. In order to do this, she had to take from people something with the possibility to influence the world as compensation to offer to Od Lagna in order to use the Authority, whether that is the existence of a spell that could open up many futures or something else with a similar influence.''“The potential influences that may be brought upon the world, upon Od Lagna, those serve as the price. That is the condition to utilize the Authority of the Witch Factor of Melancholy, in my possession. ――Confession.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 5, Section 2. Likewise, compensation can be given by different parties depending on one's intention. If one wanted the user of the Authority to move them, then that person would give compensation; alternatively, if the user decided to use the Authority on a different person of their own accord, the user would offer compensation.''If Emilia desired a Compression to move herself, it was possible for it to be invoked with compensation from Emilia, but if Petra thought Emilia was in danger and used Compression to move her, it would have been Petra who paid the compensation.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 5, Section 6. Though the totality of the compensation that the Witch Factor's custodian, Clind, has exchanged to wield Melancholy is unknown, he has been provided compensation by Roswaal L. Mathers, who gave up "four magics" to allow him to use his power,''“Three… no, four magics is what I’ll provide in compensation. And so, I ask to borrow the power of your Authority.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]], Section 2. and in one failed loop, Petra, who gave up the possibility to become Subaru's bride.''Considering the peculiarities of the Witch Factor of Melancholy, it would be more accurate to say that Petra had offered up part of her ability to exert influence over the world, specifically, “the efforts she would have needed to make in order to secure a future in which she married Subaru”.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Interlude. She also forfeited various sacrifices, including to never imbibe, pen a missive, clutch a stuff toy, and so on. When she invoked the Authority, despite claiming during the battle between [[Roy Alphard]] and the Aldebusters that the people of the Royal Capital had offered compensation for them to use, Petra was later shown to have offered a great deal or all of the compensation on her own. Once the price was paid, an incompatible user of the Witch Factor could unrestrainedly exercise Compression until the provided compensation was used up. *'''Instant Teleportation''': With this utilization of Compression, Petra could seemingly instantaneously transport herself and other people alongside her if necessary in the blink of an eye from a place she started at to another place of her choosing by compressing the time and distance that would be required to travel from one point to another. In Clind's case, it can be employed so long as it is within the Kingdom of Lugunica,''“Now I understand the circumstances. As well as the reason why you want to borrow Clind’s power, Uncle. …However, he can only use it to reduce the distance between places within the Kingdom of Lugunica.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]], Section 2. while in contrast, Petra was not forced to abide by the same limitation, being able to transport people to the Agzadd Canyon in Kararagi. However, using this form of Compression becomes significantly more difficult on wary and resistant opponents, and it is considered a herculean task to perform it on foes such as a Sin Archbishop or the Divine Dragon. To use this manner of Compression effectively, either the target must give their consent, or the opponent must be caught off guard.''If the opponent was cautious of Compression, then the difficulty of applying the Authority’s effects would rapidly increase. Not to mention, against such foes as the Divine Dragon and a Sin Archbishop, even just taking them away was a herculean undertaking. Unless it was used on a person who consented to its effects, or a person who was caught off guard, the possible applications of Compression were extremely narrow; such was its weakness.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 2, Section 8. *'''Compress Agony''' (コンプレス・アゴニー, ''Konpuresu Agonī''): As opposed to Clind, who never innovated on the way he utilized the Authority of Melancholy, only employing it for instant teleportation and going on the offensive to attack opponents, Petra developed her own original applications of Melancholy to use on conceptual things. These applications, which she had collectively given the name Compress Agony to, allowed her to compress the time it took for her targets to experience various mental faculties, emotional problems, discussions, sensations, and other similar things. **'''Process Compression''': Petra was able to compress the time it took for people to gather their thoughts together and discuss with each other. Doing this eliminated the time that it would ordinarily take for people to think over a situation and talk to each other, as well as the time it would take to speak with their allies, effectively making it to where any such talks and discussions were immediately understood by each person affected and allowing them to respond to things with the most optimal course of action immediately.''As she responded so, having Compressed all the thought processes of her allies present there, in addition to all the processes of discussion in order to share that information amongst themselves, the Witch of Melancholy closed a single eye and winked.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 9. From the perspective of someone whose thoughts have been compressed, it appears as if they instantly reach a judgement and they are left in the dark as to why they attained said judgement.''As for why his ardent thoughts had terminated upon such a conclusion, not even Old Man Rom himself was aware. Only, with his thought process to arrive there condensed to the utmost extremity, he exclaimed.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8. While typically seen in an advantageous light, using this could have the opposite effect on someone who was forced to push their minds far beyond the norm, such as someone like Aldebaran, whose Authority essentially already pushes his mind into overdrive. By using this against such a person, it can cause that person's mind to practically overheat, making it so that they are unable to respond or react appropriately to their surroundings. However, this also provided the risk that the target would be able to adapt to the compression and use it to their own gain, making it a double-edged sword. **'''Sensation Compression''': Petra was able to compress the time it took for one to experience things such as pain, trauma, hesitation, and other such sensations like unconsciousness. By doing so, she could force her target to go through all of their emotions, even if they tried to suppress them in the back of their minds or hearts. Every such feeling would be felt in a mere instant and all at once, seemingly amplified due to how long it would ordinarily have taken to process such feelings. Trauma could be overcome in an instant; pain became a momentary passing that would not hold back or stall those experiencing it, which she displayed against Roy Alphard's [[Roy Alphard#Abilities|Eclipsing Binary]]; and, though it was not shown, it was implied that Petra could even use this compression to awaken anyone who had fallen unconscious by having the time it took for them to ordinarily wake up pass in an instant. ==Trivia== *According to the author, Petra's birthday is February 14, which also happens to be Valentine's Day. *She was able to see who Subaru truly was when he was wearing one of Roswaal's anti-recognition cloaks. *On February 14, 2018, responding to a question asking which arc that Petra would “shine the brightest” in, the author concluded it would likely be Arc 8.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/963786284891226112 April 14, 2018 Twitter Q&A] **As the original plan for Arc 7 changed and it was split into two separate arcs, it can be assumed that this statement about Arc 8 now applies to Arc 9. *Petra once wished to become a tailor. She displayed quite remarkable sewing skills, which she learned from her mother. *Petra's favorite color is red. *Petra played hide and seek in Roswaal Manor before becoming a maid, which allowed her to remember all of the rooms there. *In order to become a maid and get close to Subaru, Petra pleaded with and convinced the other village girls to not apply for the open maid position at Roswaal Manor.''“…Actually, about the recruitment, Petra pleaded so much with the other village girls that they decided against applying for the job.”'' [[Frederica and Petra's Maid-san Days]], Section 3. *Originally, the author said that Petra's latent magic attribute was the water attribute that she did not have a strong aptitude for, and that Emilia originally tried to tutor her in magic, but due to her teaching methods relying on instinct, she went on to receive lectures from Ram.''“She doesn’t have much of an aptitude for it, but it’s the water attribute.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1104657838046031872 March 10, 2019 Twitter Q&A]''“It’s the water attribute, but she's not that good at magic. She dislikes being taught by Roswaal, so she secretly tried learning from Emilia, but since Emilia is the sort that works on instinct, she’s entirely unable to teach. Since then, she’s been learning from Ram.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1104653829889388544 March 10, 2019 Twitter Q&A] This was changed to the yang attribute in Stand by me Pleiades, with [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 39|Volume 39]] adding that Roswaal had taught her magic techniques. *Petra has been ranked among the five weakest characters in Re:Zero.''"Subaru, Petra, Anastasia, original Ryuzu, Ferris."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473461952275288066 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] *[[Wikipedia:Erica Mendez|Erica Mendez]], Petra's English voice actress, also voices Puck and [[Mimi Pearlbaton]]. *According to the author on a talk show held on April 6, 2025, Petra was not originally written to be the first person to learn of [[Natsuki Subaru#Abilities|Return by Death]]. As the events of Arc 9 were undone, she is no longer the first person to learn of it. *Petra has a named chapter in Arc 9 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43|light novels]]. *Exclusively to the Sasageru IF, Petra managed to both extend her lifespan and obtain such great power as the Witch of Melancholy that she was not only feared as a Witch in a similar manner to the Witch of Envy, but she was even able to contend with the likes of Vague Adgard. She also erased everything about herself so that the Witch of Envy would not chase after her, something which resulted in her original name being forgotten to nearly everybody. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Witch Navbox}} [[Category:Emilia Camp]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Maids]] [[Category:House Mathers]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[de:Petra Leyte]] [[es:Petra Leyte]] [[fr:Pétra Leyte]] [[pl:Petra Leyte]] [[pt-br:Petra Leyte]] [[ru:Петра Лейт]] [[uk:Петра Лейт]] [[zh:角色:佩特拉]]

Zergev Squadron |Previous Occupation = Deputy Commander of the Zergev Squadron |Status = Deceased |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Ex Volume 2]] |Manga = [[Manga Love Song Chapter 1|Love Song Chapter 1]]}} '''Pivot Arnancy''' (ピボット・アーナンシー) was the first Deputy Commander of the Zergev Squadron and a knight of the [[Royal Army]]. ==Appearance== Pivot was a man with long brown hair and a monocle. He usually wore his Royal Guard uniform. ==Personality== A capable, sophisticated, and intelligent man. Despite his quiet personality, stronger adherence for discipline, and sharp countenance being quite the contrast to [[Bordeaux Zergev|Bordeaux]]'s more boorish temperament, they got along quite well and were longtime friends. Furthermore, he was well liked among the troops. ==History== Pivot was one of the old guards of the Zergev Squadron whose dependable and shrewd nature kept the somewhat ragtag squad running smoothly behind the scenes. He was one of few people who could handle Wilhelm's standoffish behavior when he was younger without losing his cool. He would take part many battles in war with the Zergev Squadron until the fateful [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]] where he and most of the squad would be killed by [[Libre Fermi]] when defending an injured and immobile [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]] with their lives while under the effects of one [[Sphinx]]'s magic circle spells. He and the fallen Zergev Squadron were later revived as [[Undead|corpse soldiers]] in that very same battle, used by Sphinx to help her escape, and were ultimately finished off by Bordeaux. ==Abilities== '''Skilled Swordsman''': Pivot was skilled enough to be a member of the royal guard. {{Clear}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Knights]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Zergev Squadron]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Corpse Soldiers]]

[[Natsuki Subaru]] (son) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 2|Volume 2]] (mentioned)
[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10|Volume 10]] (actual) |Manga = [[Manga Arc 4 Chapter 5|Arc 4 Chapter 5]] |Anime = [[Episode 28]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kohsuke Toriumi|Toriumi Kohsuke]] |English Voice = [[wikipedia:Kellen Goff|Kellen Goff]]}} '''Natsuki Kenichi''' (菜月 賢一) is [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s father and [[Natsuki Naoko|Naoko]]'s husband. Though a minor character overall, he is pivotal to Subaru's story. ==Appearance== Kenichi is a good-looking, relatively tall, middle-aged man with short, combed-back black hair similar to Subaru's. He has drooping black eyes with angled eyebrows, and for his age, he's surprisingly well built and athletic. Most of the time, he's seen wearing average-looking, rectangular glasses that complement his usual laid-back smile and positive demeanor perfectly. One could immediately recognize his blood connection with Subaru. ==Personality== Kenichi is sociable, usually talking with acquaintances while outside, and, coupled with his good looks, tends to get the email addresses of high school girls. He is usually in high spirits, but can be moody at times, and also enjoys teasing his son Subaru when he wakes up. As a mayonnaise lover, he collects the caps of empty mayonnaise bottles. ==History== At some point, Kenichi met Naoko when she was being tricked by a bad adult and skillfully talked her out of the situation. When he discovered her being tricked the same way the next day, he realized that just a warning wouldn't be enough, which set off his instincts and caused him to grow attached to her.''"Naoko was being tricked by a bad adult, and Kenichi managed to skillfully talk her out of the situation. The next day, when Kenichi found the same person was about to trick Naoko in exactly the same way, he saw that just giving her a warning wouldn’t suffice, and thought 'If someone’s not looking out for her, she’ll get sold off to a tuna fishing boat……!'; that set off his motherly instincts, and he grew attached to her."'' AskFM Q&A. Kenichi married Naoko and had a son with her: Subaru. Kenichi was something of a local celebrity in their community, getting along with everyone from high schoolers to the elderly, resulting in his phone having thousands of contacts. Subaru idolized his father and wanted to be like him. However, after this proved to be impossible, he went through a downward spiral that ultimately resulted in him becoming a shut-in. While the self-hating Subaru wanted his parents to reprimand him, the couple saw that their son was just going through something and instead subtly encouraged him to go back to school every day. Kenichi also saw that Subaru was using exaggerated gestures in his attempts to be noticed, which only caused him to make a fool of himself; a bad habit his son inherited from him that he knew he had to correct. According to the author, after Subaru went missing (was transported to [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]), a police investigation was launched but ended up empty-handed. As a result, Kenichi and Naoko now spend their days praying for their son's safety. ==Trivia== *'''[https://www.behindthename.com/name/natsuki Natsuki]''' means "vegetables, greens" (菜) ('''na''') and "moon" (月) ('''tsuki'''). *'''Kenichi''' means "wise" (賢) ('''ken''') and "one" (一) ('''ichi'''). *In the time since Subaru's summoning, neither a younger brother or a younger sister to him have been born.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/2090079195728904379 Re:Zero Episode 79 Commentary] ==References== ==Navigation== {{Individual Parties Navbox}} [[Category:Japanese]] [[de:Natsuki Kenichi]] [[es:Natsuki Kenichi]] [[uk:Нацукі_ Кенічі]] [[pl:Natsuki Kenichi]] [[pt-br:Natsuki Kenichi]] [[ru:Нацуки Кеничи]] [[zh:角色:菜月贤一]]

{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Image = Natsuki Naoko ep.29 2.png|Anime Natsuki Naoko.png|Light Novel |Name = Natsuki Naoko |Kanji = 菜月 菜穂子 |Romaji = Natsuki Nahoko |Race = Human |Gender = Female |Hair Color = Brown |Eye Color = Brown |Affiliation = Japan |Occupation = Mother |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Natsuki Kenichi]] (husband)
[[Natsuki Subaru]] (son) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10|Volume 10]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 4 Chapter 6|Arc 4 Chapter 6]] |Anime = [[Episode 29]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Ryoka Yuzuki|Yuzuki Ryōka]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Laura Post|Laura Post]]}} '''Natsuki Naoko''' (菜月 菜穂子) is [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s mother and [[Natsuki Kenichi|Kenichi]]'s wife. Though a minor character overall, she is pivotal to Subaru's story. ==Appearance== Naoko is a middle-aged woman of average height. She has brown eyes along with shoulder length brown hair which she ties into a sideway ponytail with an orange ribbon. Naoko is described to have an evil gaze which makes her seem like a careless person. ==Personality== Despite having an evil gaze that makes her look like she is in a bad mood, Naoko is actually the type of person that doesn't really think of anything, and her compassion toward others is generally off the mark and irrelevant; however, she always prioritizes her son Subaru. Both Kenichi and Subaru agree that she is the most slow-witted person in the world at least on the surface, but later in Subaru's Trial, Naoko shows she is more perceptive than she appears. The version of her that appeared in the Trial claimed that the reason she gave birth to Subaru was not because she wanted something from him, but because she wanted to give him love.''“You know, I didn’t give birth to you because I wanted something from you. I gave birth to you because I wanted to give. Subaru, your mother gave birth to you because she wanted to give you love.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10]], Chapter 4, Section 8. Like her husband, she is a mayonnaise lover. ==History== At some point, Kenichi met Naoko when she was being tricked by a bad adult and skillfully talked her out of the situation. When he discovered her being tricked the same way the next day, he realized that just a warning wouldn't be enough, which set off his instincts and caused him to grow attached to her.''"Naoko was being tricked by a bad adult, and Kenichi managed to skillfully talk her out of the situation. The next day, when Kenichi found the same person was about to trick Naoko in exactly the same way, he saw that just giving her a warning wouldn’t suffice, and thought 'If someone’s not looking out for her, she’ll get sold off to a tuna fishing boat……!'; that set off his motherly instincts, and he grew attached to her."'' AskFM Q&A. Naoko married Kenichi and had a son with him: Subaru. Naoko would take notice of how her son idolized his father and wanted to be like him. However, after this proved to be impossible, he went through a downward spiral that ultimately resulted in him becoming a shut-in. While the self-hating Subaru wanted his parents to reprimand him, the couple saw that their son was just going through something and instead subtly encouraged him to go back to school every day. According to the author, after Subaru went missing (was transported to [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]), a police investigation was launched but ended up empty-handed. As a result, Kenichi and Naoko now spend their days praying for their son's safety. ==Trivia== *'''[https://www.behindthename.com/name/natsuki Natsuki]''' means "vegetables, greens" (菜) ('''na''') and "moon" (月) ('''tsuki'''). *'''Naoko''' means "vegetables, greens" (菜) ('''na'''), "grain" (穂) ('''o''') and "child" (子) ('''ko'''). *Naoko dislikes all small and round foods such as peas. *In the time since Subaru's disappearance, neither a younger brother or a younger sister to him have been born.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/2090079195728904379 Re:Zero Episode 79 Commentary] ==References== ==Navigation== {{Individual Parties Navbox}} [[Category:Japanese]] [[de:Natsuki Naoko]] [[es:Natsuki Naoko]] [[pl:Natsuki Naoko]] [[pt-br:Natsuki Nahoko]] [[ru:Нацуки Наоко]] [[uk:Нацукі Наоко]] [[zh:角色:菜月菜穗子]]

Benevolent Mother (慈母, ''Jibo'') |Nickname = Virtuous Monster (善意のお化け, ''Zen'i no Obake'') (by [[Echidna]]) |Race = Spirit |Gender = Female |Affiliation = [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]

Sacred Mountain Pardochia |Occupation = Great Spirit |Status = Alive |Magic = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice|Bonds of Ice]] (mentioned) |Manga = [[Bonds of Ice Manga Volume 2|Bonds of Ice Volume 2]] (mentioned)}} '''Odglass''' (オドグラス) is the '''[[Spirit#The Sacred Beast, Odglass|Sacred Beast]]''', one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]. She is known as the mother of [[Gusteko]] and the Benevolent Mother of the [[Gustekan Church]]. ==Appearance== Odglass is said to have the appearance of a large, white bear.''“They say they’re reaaally big white bears. Doesn’t that sound like the Holy Beast Odglass of Gusteko?”'' [[Two Witches' Eventful Journey]], Section 4. ==Personality== Odglass is a spirit who, unlike most other spirits, interferes with the world by watching over the people of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, where she resides, with affection and benevolence from her abode, the Sacred Mountain Paradochia.''The Sacred Beast, Odglass, who watches over mankind with affection and benevolence from atop the Sacred Mountain.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Prologue.''Normally, spirits did not interfere with the way of the world, but Odglass was an exception among them, and she continued to take a friendly position toward humans. The Great Spirit called all the lives in the harsh land of Gusteko her own children, yet she spared little mercy for them.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 3. She is a powerful great spirit who has scores of spirits and lesser spirits under her control, which she uses to help humans live in the permafrost-covered nation.''The simple fact that humans were able to live in Gusteko, which was covered by permafrost, was primarily due to the help of the myriad of spirits and lesser spirits under the control of Odglass.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 3. As the Benevolent Mother, Odglass is the one responsible for causing Gusteko's perpetual snow. She knows everything that happens within the snow's reach, and as part of her contract with the Holy King, the monarch is able to be aware of everything within the nation and deal with anything bad that appears.July 26, 2026 Talk Show According to [[Beatrice]], it is also said that the Sacred Beast is the one who does not really listen among the Four Great Spirits,''“By the way, among the Four Greats, the one which just doesn’t really listen the most is the Sacred Beast, and the one which should not be talked to the most is the Slasher. The one that is most futile to talk to is the Arbitrator, in fact.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 3. and she claimed that [[Echidna]] called Odglass a virtuous monster.''“Mother used to call the Sacred Beast a virtuous monster, I suppose.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 3. ==History== When the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko was founded, Odglass exchanged a contract with a [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] user who followed her, bestowed the title of Holy King onto them, and from then on, she was involved in choosing successive Holy Kings, who were selected out of the citizens regardless of their bloodline or origin.''At the founding of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, Odglass bestowed the name Holy King and exchanged a contract with a spiritual arts user who followed her, and since then she has always been involved in choosing the Holy King, who is the head of the nation. The Holy King who leads the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko is determined, regardless of bloodline or origin, by being chosen by the Sacred Beast Odglass from one selected out of the citizens to lead the next generation.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 1. This process created an established and long relationship with Odglass and Gusteko, as the tradition to select the Holy King is something she has held from the beginning of the country’s history. Because of this, she is heralded as the Gustekan Church’s Benevolent Mother.''Due to this, Odglass and the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko had a long and profound friendship. The authority to decide the head of the Holy Kingdom and the Church, the Holy King, had been delegated to Odglass, and this tradition had been passed down from the beginning of the history of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko. That format was unbreakable. Odglass had always been, and would always be, the Benevolent Mother of the Church.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 3. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As one of the Four Great Spirits, Odglass has tremendous power that puts her on a similar level to others of her kind. Though, the full extent of her power is unknown, as the one responsible for Gusteko's permafrost, her reach seems to be immense. ===Other=== '''Climate Manipulation''': It has been stated by the author that Odglass is the one responsible for covering Gusteko in snow and leaving it permanently cold. Although her snow does not cover the country from one tip of the country to the other, it still has immense range, and since the Gustekan Church's goal is to cover the world in her snow, it is implied that she can extend her reach even farther. *'''Limited Omniscience''': It has been stated by the author that Odglass is aware of anything that takes place under the falling snow. While the exact specifics are unknown, this implies that Odglass is able to perceive the majority of events in the country. This being said, it is unknown if she requires people to directly be beneath the snowy skies or if this allows her to perceive events within buildings and vehicles such as carriages as well. **'''Shared Omniscience''': Through her contract with the [[Minor Characters#Holy King|Holy King]], she is able to share her ability to perceive the nation with them, allowing them to act however they see fit in response. ==Trivia== *In [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], a side story released with [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1|Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], and [[Two Witches' Eventful Journey]], an event exclusive side story, Odglass's title was mistakenly serialized as '''Holy Beast''' (聖獣, ''Seijū''). ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Gusteko Navbox}} [[de:Odglass]] [[es:Odglass]] [[Category:Great Spirits]] [[Category:Four Great Spirits]] [[Category:Contract Spirits]] [[Category:Gustekan Church]]

title: Muspel
wikitext:
{{Character |Name = Muspel |Image = Muspel.jpg |Kanji = ムスペル |Romaji = Musuperu |Alias = Stone (石塊, ''Ishikure'') |Race = Spirit |Gender = Unknown |Status = Alive (within [[Arakiya]]) |Affiliation = [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]
[[Vollachia Empire]] |Occupation = Great Spirit |Magic = Earth Magic |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice|Bonds of Ice]] (mentioned) |Manga = [[Bonds of Ice Manga Volume 2|Bonds of Ice Volume 2]]}} '''Muspel''' (ムスペル) is the '''[[Spirit#The Stone, Muspel|Stone]]''', one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]. It was said to roam freely within the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], but in actuality, the spirit was secretly granted convicts to use as anchors by Vollachia and distributed across the country to provide a number of regions with its benefits. Despite not making an official appearance, Muspel's influence played a major role during the events of [[Arc 8]]. Muspel and its mana were used in the [[Great Disaster]] by [[Sphinx]] to revive [[undead]] throughout Vollachia. In an attempt to delay the destruction of the Empire, Muspel was devoured once again by [[Arakiya]]. Although the power of Muspel ought to have burst Arakiya, with a strike of [[Cecilus Segmunt]]'s [[Enchanted Sword#Dream Sword Masayume|Dream Sword Masayume]], she assimilated the Stone with herself. ==Personality== Muspel is thought to have no will, words, or philosophy,''The Stone, Muspel, a sanctum that merely exists, possessing no will, words, or ideology.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Prologue. and appears to exist solely as a deific being. Records from the Empire state that Muspel moves on a grand scale every 12 years, leading to various earthquakes after its movement.''“And given that the records of major activity were twelve years apart, we can anticipate a large-scale earthquake in six years.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 8]]. However, when Arakiya devoured the rest of Muspel, it temporarily gained a sense of self-preservation, which resulted in Arakiya’s uncontrolled rampage in the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]]. ==History== Sometime around the events of Vollachia's most recent Imperial Selection Ceremony, [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent Abellux]] found a method to trap Muspel within its territory. By using Muspel's power, he was able to fend off the [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]] carried out by one of his younger half-sisters, [[Lamia Godwin]]. When [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca]] and Vincent's lives were in danger due to Lamia's artillery, Arakiya devoured a small portion of Muspel in order to defend her princess. According to Vincent, at least throughout his time as emperor, convicts were used to connect to Muspel and preserve its connection to the Empire.''“After all, Natsuki Subaru and the half-elf spiritual arts user are both utterly opposed to even the appearance of injustice. ――It would be troublesome if they knew that we have been using convicts sentenced to death as the Stone’s contractors, disposing of them upon their deaths.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 4. The effects of the contract made convicts experience death of the mind while the Stone remained at its contractor's location; Vollachia took advantage of Muspel's tendency of being at its contractor's location in order to move it around and distribute its positive effects on the land to various areas in the nation where it was needed while continually replenishing their supply of convicts so as to prevent the possibility of losing track of it.''In exchange for inescapable death of the mind, the Stone’s nature was to abide by the contractor’s current location. Therefore, the Empire kept the Stone and the forcibly contracted death-row convicts in lands where the Sanctum was required, and distributed the benefits of the Sanctum to various regions. As it was a next-to-impossible task to track down the Stone once its location had been lost, the replenishment of the death-row convicts was a matter of utmost importance.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 4. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As one of the Four Great Spirits, Muspel has a tremendous amount of power and mana, and its power is embedded into the very earth of Vollachia. By Vincent's description, the land upon which it rests receives its protection, providing fertile lands and a positive impact on the recuperation of those who land on those lands.''“To put it plainly, the Stone is a great spirit that governs the earth attribute. Therefore, the land it uses as a resting place naturally receives the protection of its special qualities. In addition to cultivating fertile soil, it also yields a positive impact on the recuperation of those who live on that land.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 3. On the other hand, precisely because its power is so deeply connected to the country’s lands, if its connection was suddenly removed, Vollachia would cease to exist, and the land would become uninhabitable.''“No vows have been made with the Stone. Yet, it continued to reside within the territory of the Empire. That is why we made use of our relationship with it, but… at the same time, it continued to move into the Empire’s bowels, spreading its roots.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 3.''“Think of it as the roots of a tree. A tree with thick, long roots may strengthen the ground it is affixed to, but conversely, if that tree were to be uprooted, what shall become of the land?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 3.''“Wait, so when you say that it would be the end of the line for Vollachia if Muspel were to die, you mean it would literally be the end of Vollachia!?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 3. Similarly, though it is possible to make a contract with humans, its power is so great that it robs its contractor of their mind.''The simplest way to detain the Stone was through a contract between the Spirit and a person. However, the Stone did not have self-consciousness, and had no room or window for negotiation regarding the contract. Therefore, the cost of contracting with the Stone was consistently the burden of the enormous amount of nothingness that flowed into the contractor. The sensation of sharing one’s body around the clock with a preposterously large entity with which mutual understanding was impossible would very easily break the human mind, driving it into a state where it could no longer retain its original form.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 4. In fact, it has been stated several times that Arakiya, who had devoured the Stone on two different occasions, should have exploded from the sheer amount of power flowing through her body. Due to its unique state of having no presence of mind and never having been shown in combat, it is currently unclear exactly how powerful Muspel is in its entirety. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== As the great spirit presiding over earth mana, Muspel is capable of using earth magic. However, as it has not shown sentience, it is unclear how proficient it is in casting magic. '''Spells''': *'''Restoration Magic''' (復元魔法, ''Fukugen Mahō''): A type of magic that can recover objects to their original state. Although Muspel never consciously cast restoration magic of its own accord, its mana was siphoned by Sphinx during the Great Disaster in order to cast this spell as a means of creating vessels for the undead resurrected across Vollachia. ==Trivia== *Like other spirits, Muspel is capable of forming contracts with people, though as a great spirit, a person who makes a contract with it is incapable withstanding the full brunt of its power, and they are often left in a vegetative or otherwise unresponsive state. Uniquely, however, the Vollachia Empire consistently contracted death row prisoners to Muspel in order to keep it connected to the Empire. This all came to an end after Arakiya devoured the Stone in its entirety, though Muspel is still connected to the Empire's land. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Great Spirits]] [[Category:Four Great Spirits]]
