[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38|Volume 38]] (main story)}} '''Palladio Manesque''' (パラディオ・マネスク) was an Imperial Prince of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He played an antagonistic role in both [[Arc 8]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. During the Imperial Selection Ceremony, he partnered with his younger half-sister, [[Lamia Godwin]], to defeat [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent Abellux]]. He fell to [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]]'s [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] near the ceremony's end. During the [[Great Disaster]], he resurrected as a [[Undead#Zombies|zombie]], marked several people with his Evil Eye, and served as the commander of the undead army's forces on their siege of [[Garkla]]. He was finished off by [[Todd Fang]]. ==Appearance== Palladio was a man with long, wavy green hair. His Evil Eye was located on his forehead.''Sneering at Lamia’s disgraceful behavior, Palladio, with gold pupils that bore witness to his undead nature―― the third eye on his forehead included, narrowed his three eyes, fixing his gaze upon the battlefield.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 1. As a zombie, he possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across his body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. ==Personality== Palladio was a timid and foolish person who lacked the intelligence and supporters to make the most of his Evil Eye throughout the Imperial Selection Ceremony.''Palladio’s Evil Eye abilities were the standout feature of his faction, but he lacked either the wits or the supporters to make the most of it.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 17. He was unable to realize that Lamia had planned to use him and his abilities as an asset to help dispatch Vincent and Prisca,''She had the plan to use Palladio’s special abilities brewing ever since the ceremony had begun.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 14.''Vincent and Prisca—they were the only ones with any hope of besting Lamia. ――And Palladio was helping head off that possibility himself. The absurdity was that Palladio didn’t even notice it—he was little different from Barthroy, who had died a dog’s death by the maneuvering of his own little sister.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 14. and he believed that he could defeat her when it was impossible for him to do so.''Sadly for him, Palladio simply could not beat Lamia. He could try to rally the other siblings against her as she had done against Vincent, but it would not get him anywhere.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 14. He was also quite arrogant and looked down on his siblings, particularly Lamia, who had died without having left behind any lasting accomplishments, and Vincent and Prisca, who he referred to as cowards and weaklings who only engaged in collusion and schemes. Palladio was inspired by the rule of a previous emperor, [[Eugard Vollachia]], and he believed that his rule with fear was extremely effective and intended to walk in his footsteps.''As for the manner of his rule, it would be modeled after the one Palladio had long regarded as the greatest Emperor of all time, one who ruled the Vollachian Empire by way of pain and fear, the Emperor of the Briar―― Eugard Vollachia, would be the example he would follow. Making the authority of the Emperor known far and wide, the regency of Eugard, who was said to have bound the hearts of his own people with thorns, was precisely Palladio’s ideal.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 1. However, he despised the works of fictions with "foolish" rumors that the Emperor of the Briar lived for the sake of a [[Yorna Mishigure|village girl]], believing they were false. Even as an undead, he intended to take over his country and incinerate every written account of Eugard's loving side so that only his rule of fear would be remembered.''In later works of fiction, there were accounts of foolish rumors concerning the Emperor of the Briar living for the love of a mere village girl, all of which were to be incinerated and buried upon Palladio’s ascension to the throne.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 1. ==History== Palladio was among the eleven children of [[Drizen Vollachia]] that possessed the qualifications to use the Yang Sword, earning him the right to participate in the Imperial Selection Ceremony. He made an alliance with Lamia to kill their brother, Vincent Abellux, on the condition that she give away a body part of hers for him to pursue her with if their plan succeeded. At the beginning of Lamia's [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]] spurred by Lamia, he briefly spoke to Prisca, and she swore to take his head. After the attack failed and his alliance with Lamia crumbled when Prisca killed her, Palladio retreated to his castle. Two months after Palladio and Lamia failed to take Vincent's life, he was confronted at his castle by Prisca, who came to fulfill her promise of taking his head. He tried to attack her with his Yang Sword, but Prisca swiftly defeated and decapitated him with her own Yang Sword, turning his corpse into ashes. ==Abilities== '''Evil Eye''' (魔眼, ''Magan''): As a descendant of the Evil Eye Tribe, Palladio's Evil Eye gave him the unique ability to enter the mind of others,''Entering directly into the mind of another was Palladio’s own uncanny skill, but he seemed to have no comeback.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 10. enabling him to telepathically communicate with and track people with incredible accuracy, so long as he possessed a part of a target's body.''Palladio kept it a secret from their other siblings that he carried the blood of the Evil Eye Tribe and that his abilities allowed him to track a given target with incredible accuracy. He required some part of the target’s body in order to do this, and while Lamia had not been able to obtain any such thing from Vincent…'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 14.''This, too, was an innate power of Palladio as a member of the Evil Eye Tribe―― telepathic communication, which allowed him to project his voice to any person whose hair, nails, or body parts he had taken, regardless of the distance that separated them.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Prologue 1, Section 1. Anyone targeted by Palladio's eye experiences a sharp pain in their chest and are branded with an eye-shaped mark.''What had appeared on Subaru’s chest was a mark roughly the size of a child’s palm―― a deformed design that appeared to depict an eye.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 2. According to Vincent, Palladio had grown complacent with his ability in life,''Among his siblings competing for the seat of Emperor, Palladio had been in a particularly formidable class, but the cause of his defeat had ended up being that he had grown complacent about the power of his Evil Eye, and thus been unable to make full use of that ability.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 4. but his precision seemed to have improved after his death.''“Back then, it was something that allowed him to transmit his voice to somebody whose location he knew, but its precision seems to have improved after his death.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 6, Section 4. The telepathic communication made it hard for one to conceal their emotions, and the more fragile one's mind was, the more obvious their thoughts were. However, this applied to Palladio too.''This mode of speaking utilized the voice of the heart, which made it difficult to conceal emotions—a clear drawback. And the more fragile the user's mind was, the more obvious their thoughts when using telepathy. Palladio was no exception.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5]], Crimson Afterglow, Section 10. He was also able to observe precise surroundings of other locations from a distance, though the extent to which he was able to do this is unknown. By closing his eyes, he is also able to view a large area around him as if looking down from the perspective of the sun.''Closing both of his eyes, he focused his attention to the third eye that rested upon his forehead, his Evil Eye. Instantly, Palladio’s field of vision no longer was simply a narrow view of the battlefield before him, but a vast, heavenly gaze that grasped the expansive space of the surrounding area in its entirety. It was truly the viewpoint of the sun―― Palladio’s third eye integrated his own field of vision with that of the sun, providing the perspective of a ruler looking down upon the world at large.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 1. '''Equipment''': *'''[[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]]''' (陽剣ヴォラキア, ''Youken Vorakia''): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Palladio was capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. The sword appears out of thin air when the user wishes to use it and it cuts and burns whatever the user desires. ==Trivia== *Palladio has a named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]]. In the [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38|light novel]], it was adapted as a prologue. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Family]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Imperial Selection Candidates]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Human Hybrids]] [[Category:Enchanted Sword Users]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Podoso |Image = Podoso LN character design.png |Kanji = ポドソ |Romaji = Podoso |Alias = |Nickname = |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Hair Color = Green |Eye Color = Unknown |Affiliation = [[Gusteko]]
Leanotte |Occupation = Guard |Status = Alive |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10|Tanpenshuu Volume 10]]}} '''Podoso''' (ポドソ) is a guard in the town of Leanotte. ==Appearance== Podoso is a stern-looking middle-aged man with short, green hair. ==Personality== Podoso is a responsible and friendly man who carries out his guard duties with diligence. He is genuine with his work and people, showing empathy and kindness. ==History== As a guard who has worked in Leanotte for some time, Podoso is familiar with the town and [[Coatl|Coatl's]] deeds to assist the townspeople during the avalanche that occurred ten years prior. Although it is not known if Podoso was a resident of Leanotte at the time of the avalanche, he knew of Coatl's actions and found him admirable. While dutifully fulfilling his role as a guard, seven serial murders occurred over the span of several weeks. Recognizing the danger of Coatl's solitude life, Podoso decided to visit the church to warn the pastor of the murder, only to discover that he was nowhere to be found and that a young woman, [[Maqueena]], had entered before him. Later in the day, [[Admonsah]] arrived at the church, a blizzard began to form, and a party of four girls, consisting of [[Omega|Omega's]] group and [[Noelle Tuérico]], also entered. Podoso acted respectfully to the other visitors in the church, openly discussing topics such as Coatl's deeds or the Ice Thieves. He accompanied Maqueena when she attempted to go to another part of the church by herself, with [[Trellock]] arriving during their absence. Podoso and Maqueena were the first to discover the church's hidden basement and that Coatl had been murdered there. He proceeded to participate in the discussions revolving around the murder, revealing the serial murders of victims who had their faces ripped to the rest of the group and admitting that he had came to the church to warn Coatl. He also divulged that the circumstances of the seventh murder was different and was quick to accept Admonsah for his background as a slave, understanding that his murder was in self-defense. When Maqueena was close to having her true profession exposed, she used Muskrim to escape the church, rendering everyone apart from Noelle unconscious. In the end, Maqueena was exposed for her crimes as a con artist, Trellock was revealed to be the serial killer, Podoso offered Admonsah to become his assistant, and he left was unaware that Noelle, who purportedly took custody of the serial killer, was Coatl's true murderer. He and Admonsah parted ways with Omega's group on friendly terms, taking Maqueena with them to Leanotte. ==Navigation== {{Gusteko Navbox}} [[Category:Guardians]]

He provided his gratitude to Anastasia upon hearing the results. However, his voice and facial expression did not reflect his words, which Anastasia questioned. He revealed that, in [[Banan]], large-scale wind damage had assaulted the city, with members of the [[Iron Fang]] being among the people who had been sent there as a precaution, and that nobody in the city could be contacted or escape from it because it was completely enveloped by wind. ==Navigation== {{Kararagi Navbox}} [[Category:Leaders]]

'''Myonmyon''' (ミョンミョン) was a historical magician. Known as the Original Magician, she wielded [[magic]] with immense power and made a legacy by instructing others on how to use magic.

==Appearance==
Myonmyon's appearance is unknown.

==Personality==
Although Myonmyon has never been depicted in the story, [[Echidna]] once relayed that she had students whom she had instructed.

==History==
Existing before the birth of the Witch of Greed, Myonmyon made a name for herself at a time when magic had not been systemized.<ref>''“Oh, that. It would seem that, before I was born, there was a magic user who made quite the name for herself in an era when magic had yet to be systematized.”'' [[Re:IF Kasaneru]], Talk Pages.</ref> She also took people as students and instructed them in the ways of magic. When her students casted magic, they would chant “myon” several times in quick succession to remember their teacher's words.<ref>''“So, when those who received her instruction would use magic, they would chant this to remember the words of their master…”'' [[Re:IF Kasaneru]], Talk Pages.</ref>

==Abilities==
'''[[Magic]]''' (魔法, ''Mahō''): Myonmyon's command of magic was beyond compare to the majority of magicians. Throughout all of history, she was one of the few people who could manifest powerful hyper magic.<ref>''Prior to this, the only ones who had ever materialized great magic―― no, hyper magic to this degree, were the Witch of Greed, Echidna, and the Original Magician, Myonmyon.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref>
*'''Attribute Determination''': Myonmyon was able to determine which magic attributes people had an affinity for. This technique was used to determine [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s affinity for the yin attribute by [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] and [[Puck]], with both of them using the “myon” chant to ascertain the result.
*'''Memory Reading''': Myonmyon could read and inherit a person's memories. Echidna, who used this technique in the non-canon [[Re:IF Kasaneru]] story, described it as a way of “downloading” memories,<ref>''“Myon myon… do not worry. I can certainly read them. Phrasing it in your style, I suppose it feels like firmly downloading memories.”'' [[Re:IF Kasaneru]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref> and said the “myon” chant that accompanied it was a crucial ritual to read one's memories.

==Trivia==
*At a talk show held on April 6, 2025, the author revealed that Myonmyon will likely appear in a story depicting the events of about 400 years ago.

title: Nananna Pezza
wikitext:
{{Character |Name = Nananna Pezza |Image = |Kanji = ナナンナ・ペッツァ |Romaji = Nananna Pettsua |Race = Human |Gender = Female |Hair Color = Dark Blue |Eye Color = Unknown |Affiliation = [[Gusteko]]
[[Gustekan Church]] |Previous Affiliation = |Occupation = Itinerant Preacher |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Edmon Quayle]] (father)
[[Mireille Hetia]] (half-sister) |Light Novel = [[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 1]]}} '''Nananna Pezza''' (ナナンナ・ペッツァ) is an Itinerant Preacher of the [[Gustekan Church]]. ==Appearance== Nananna is a petite woman with short, dark blue hair. Her face and her frame may cause her to be mistaken for someone who is fourteen or fifteen years of age, but in reality, she is years older. ==Personality== ==History== ===Early Life=== Nananna was born to an affair between the Limbus council representative, [[Edmon Quayle]], and her mother. However, Edmon banished her mother, and she came to despise both Edmon and the town of Limbus. When she was young, she met an [[Minor Characters#Elderly Healer|elderly healer]] who lived on the outskirts of Limbus. There, she was taught some medicinal knowledge, and she received her guidance, similar to her half-sister, [[Mireille Hetia]]. Later in life, she became an Itinerant Preacher, where she met [[Noelle Tuérico]], who saved her life with medicine, and later, she even came to help in regard to Noelle's home of Leanotte. ===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 1|Witch Trials]]=== One day, because of an illness that had taken hold of Limbus, numerous people found their lives in danger, but thanks to the elderly healer coming up with an appropriate medicine, lives were saved and the illness vanished. However, a rumor declared that she started the illness in order to provide the solution and increase her reputation. She was then declared a [[Witch]] and burned to death. Following the healer's death, the council members began to get rid of anyone the council considered inconvenient, including the noble who had once taken the healer's cure, and they declared it the response of a Witch, resulting in the subsequent Witch Hunts. At some point around this time, Mireille was appointed to be a subordinate to a government official in Limbus, where she learned of the healer's execution, and she began committing murders with her [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] in the town against relatives of the council members. Later, Nananna was sent to deal with the strange killings in Limbus, where, having heard about the execution of the elderly healer as well, Nananna conspired with Mireille to bring down their father and the people of Limbus for their transgressions, with Mireille getting rid of any other officials who came to the town. One day, having moved on from Sylphoa, the [[Omega Party]] appeared in Limbus, where the townsfolk aimed their weapons at them. Though they attempted to calm the townsfolk and offer them a gift in the form of the [[Witchbeast#Snow Blight|Snow Blight]]'s crystallized head, they instead accused [[Omega]] of being a Witch after seeing it, leading Omega to warn [[Colette]] against using her bracelet's transformation and [[Lilac]] from turning back into [[Shion]], else they be declared Witches. Thanks to Nananna's appearance and speaking with Noelle, she was able to vouch for them and clear them of being Witches. That night, the group assisted in the Witch Hunt, as the group wanted to help Noelle repay her debt to Nananna. The Witch Hunt is for a person named [[Minor Characters#Piditz|Piditz]] who had been tipped off as a Witch, and Nananna wanted him taken into custody only. When they later spotted Piditz and chased after him, Omega split off to corner him, only to find Mireille using her spiritual arts to kill Piditz. Thanks to being near the body, Omega was quickly turned into a scapegoat and declared a Witch so that Mireille could cover up her kill and at least prevent her from getting in the way of her and Nananna's revenge, and Omega was taken into custody. Wanting the clear Omega's name, the group split up to take on different tasks. Noelle joined Nananna, who had been speaking with Edmon about finding Piditz. As she is intent on finding out about the real culprit, Nananna knocks her out and hides her in a pit where all the bodies of the dead "Witches" were dumped. The next day, the Witch Trial is being held for Omega, overseen by Nananna and the Town Hall, while Palmyra acts as Omega's attorney. Despite her arguments, Edmon counter with his supposed knowledge of the Witches and Omega's chatter does not help. Colette speaks up and claims that she believes that things will not go as the council claims, as people will begin to notice that the entire event seems off, which resounds with the townsfolk. Because of this, Palmyra claims that there is a conspiracy, which Edmon fights against and asks for Nananna's assistance. Because she sides with the town, Lilac and Shion believe her to be part of the conspiracy, and they decide to use their dream arts to influence the people's mental states. Palmyra then claims that the council is using the Witch rumors to get rid of inconvenient people, which Edmon also fights against, though is quickly silenced when she states she heard it herself from a council member and declares that there is no Witch. Unfortunately, Omega claims otherwise. Despite angering Palmyra, Omega decides to clear things up by declaring that there were two conspiracies taking place in town. Despite Nananna trying to prevent her from talking, Omega quickly ignores her and explains that many of the victims were relatives of council members, and she claims that Nananna is the second conspirator, calling her the bastard child of Edmon whose mother was banished from the town, and as a result, she despised the town. Noelle later appears and confirms that her actions were in response to the death of the elderly healer, and she claims that Nananna tried to remove her from the trial by knocking her out since her only ire was with Limbus. Afterward, Noelle declares that the secretary, Mireille, was helping Nananna, as she was a bastard child of Edmon as well, and she stated how the corpses of Piditz and other people connected to the council and other outside officials were already dumped in a hole. Omega also declares that she witnessed Mireille killing Piditz. Enraged, Mireille uses her spiritual arts to char Edmon's arm with blue fire, and with the intent of killing the entire council, surrounds the council with blue fire, and she and Nananna stand against them. Although Omega is fine with leaving things as they are and taking their leave, Colette states she doesn't want things to end like this, and Omega decides to end the fighting in response to her plea, burning through her restraints and declaring herself a Witch. Later, as Omega's party begins to leave the town, Noelle says her goodbyes to Nananna, and it is declared that the evil spirit accompanying Mireille will be disposed of. Likewise, it is claimed that Edmon's position is under threat with both his severe injuries and the loss of the citizens' trust, and Mireille claims she was mistaken about real Witches. ==Abilities== '''Medicinal Knowledge''': In her youth, Nananna was given knowledge in of medicines from the elderly healer in Limbus, which she later used this knowledge to save lives. ==Navigation== {{Gusteko Navbox}} [[Category:Gustekan Church]]

[[Regin Suwen]] (ancestor) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero EX#Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero|Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero]]}} '''Nikola Suwen''' (ニコラ・スーウェン) is the descendant of [[Otto Suwen]] who realizes the Suwen family's 400 year wish to free [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Beatrice]] during the events of the [[Re:Zero EX#Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero|Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero]] IF story. ==Appearance== Upon his introduction, Nikola, much like Otto, dressed in green, wears a green hat, has grey hair, and appears with androgynous traits. However, he was slightly younger than Otto, appeared to be more of a slender man, and had longer hair that was tied near the middle of his back, which gave him an air closer to that of a scholar than a merchant. As a consequence of trespassing onto the territory of the Eternal Agzadd Glacier, the [[Petra Leyte|Witch of Melancholy]] removed Nikola's left leg below the knee, forcing him to employ a prosthetic leg. By the time forty years passed, Nikola grew a beard and had long since become accustomed to and mastered using the prosthetic magic tool. ==Personality== From Subaru's point of view, Nikola's nature is much like Otto's. By Nikola's own claim, he is an eccentric member of the Suwen family. Compared to his siblings and relatives, he considers himself as someone who seems to be unsuited to the mature way of thinking that they have. As such, he was told that he would either die successful or penniless. Unlike Otto, he does not have the courage to stay unfazed while under pressure, as in the case of when he first faced off with [[Vague Adgard]]. Having said that, he was crafty enough to expect his arrival and utilize a means to bring the Witch of Melancholy to the battlefield, even being readily willing to suffer the consequences of doing so in order to fend the Mad Prince off. Similarly to Otto, Nikola has a habit of snapping his fingers as a signal to trigger a scheme. Although he is not shown to have as much of an interest in history as [[Rosalind Vollachia|Rosalind]], he has knowledge of a variety of things, ranging from the aftermath of [[Al|Aldebaran]]'s successful attempt to seal Subaru away, to Vague's status as the world's one and only spirit human, and even to quotes from [[Alec Hoshin|Hoshin]], despite how they have fallen out of use. He can be careless and accidentally break a promise, as he did with the promise he made to the six Juukulius sisters to not reveal the deaths of the [[Minor Characters#Julius's Contracted Spirits|five spirits]] other than [[Ia|Lumera]] to Subaru and Beatrice. Furthermore, due to believing that he accomplished something of value by fulfilling the Suwen family's long-cherished wish, Nikola stresses to Subaru that he is not in debt and has no reason to pay anything in return. Ever since he was a child, Nikola was in love with Lumera, who was acquainted with the Suwen family, and he wished to become a man who was worthy of being with her. However, as her promise with her [[Julius Juukulius|master]] took precedence, he dedicated himself to ensure it could be resolved within ten years and made the necessary arrangements to save Subaru and Beatrice for his own interests, rather than a sentimental desire to fulfill the Suwen family's long-cherished wish. Despite being driven by his love for Lumera, Nikola strived to genuinely help Subaru and Beatrice after their rescue, going so far as to provide a house for them and willingly staying by their side for over 40 years. ==History== Following the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]'s downfall, the Suwen family established itself in the [[Vollachia Empire|Unified Empire of Vollachia]] and was given the special position of a purveyor for the imperial family. Born as the eldest son of the family, Nikola was expected to inherit their business. As a child, he fell in love with Lumera Ia Juukulius, who often visited his family, and confessed his love to her. In response, she told him that she could not reply to his confession until her promise with her master was fulfilled. As a result, a fire lit within Nikola and he resolved himself to fulfill the long-cherished desire of his family to recover Subaru and Beatrice from the Grand Mogolade Geyser, swearing that he would achieve it within ten years. Motivated by his love for Lumera, he relinquished his right of succeeding the family business to his younger brother, managed to eventually finish all of the necessary preparations to recover the orb, and made a direct appeal to Rosalind Vollachia, who was amused by his actions and accepted his proposal in accordance with [[Vincent Vollachia]]'s promise to an [[Rem|oni girl]] that the imperial family would aid Subaru. When the time came, the “Grand Mogolade Geyser Black Orb Recovery Plan” was sprung into action. As locating the black orb within the geyser required time and effort from Lumera, and the process of searching for it would cause Vague Adgard to notice, they decided to set up a diversion to draw the Mad Prince's attention elsewhere. While Lumera would be accompanied by Nikola, Rosalind, and [[Madelyn Eschart]], [[Arakiya]] and Lumera's sisters engaged Vague in combat, which resulted in Lapicha, Soyone, Dorena, Kiara, and Sinica allowing Arakiya to devour them once they each sustained fatal damage, thereby sacrificing their lives while fulfilling their promise with Julius in the process. Their sacrifices allowed Arakiya to repel Vague and gave Lumera the time she needed to recover the black orb. Once she found it, Rosalind used the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] to break it open, freeing Subaru and Beatrice. However, due to the aftereffects of being trapped within the orb for 400 years, Subaru was on the verge of death upon waking up. While Nikola and Lumera were left in shock, unable to assist him, Rosalind noticed that Beatrice could be of help to him. Waking up again soon, an immobile Subaru found himself in another room, where he was able to speak with Beatrice. Nikola spoke up and proceeded to introduce himself to Subaru as Nikola Suwen, a man with many titles, with the title of merchant being the most familiar to him. He then informed Subaru that 400 years had passed since Aldebaran sealed him and Beatrice away, and conveyed a message from his ancestor, Otto, which had been passed down in his family. After learning of the Suwen family's 400 year old undertaking, how Otto's unyielding determination had allowed him to achieve his goals in the end, and realizing that he would never be able to speak with his friend again, Subaru began to sob, understanding that the majority of people he knew no longer existed in the world. He asked Nikola about [[Emilia]], who confirmed she was alive, but that he did not know if she was safe because she had encased the Agzadd Valley in ice, freezing herself and Aldebaran in the process, and that the [[Petra Leyte|Witch of Melancholy]] had settled at the glacier and attacked anyone who encroached on the territory. Later on, Nikola provided Subaru and Beatrice with a house, telling the two that he could help them with anything they needed and that he did not believe Subaru had to repay any debt to him, as it was because his own hard work paid off and he was able to fulfill the Suwen family's 400 year wish by saving them that he had accomplished something of value. Believing an attack from the Mad Prince, Vague Adgard, was bound to happen, Nikola preemptively prepared a spell that could be remotely activated to create an interference within the bounds of the Eternal Agzadd Glacier, cognizant that the Witch of Melancholy would pursue him. Sure enough, Vague intruded into Subaru and Beatrice's provisional home while Nikola, Lumera, and Arakiya were over for dinner. Over the course of many loops, Subaru, despite still being immobile from the aftereffects of his sealing, was able to influence the situation enough to the point that he and the other three combatants managed to prevent Vague from killing any of them. Once enough time had passed, Nikola raised his right hand and snapped his fingers, invoking the same gesture Otto used when enacting a plan. A few moments later, a voice spoke up, stating their request that no one was to meddle with the glacier, and white lights surrounded the house in all directions, completely obliterating it. As Subaru and the others were protected by EMM, they withstood it, and he and Beatrice recognized the source of the white lights, which had been the [[Shaula|Crimson Scorpion]]'s needles. The Witch of Melancholy then made her appearance, activating [[Petra Leyte#Authority|Compress Agony]] on Vague, allowing the needles of the Crimson Scorpion, which was fighting alongside her, to pierce him. Despite this, he was unscathed by the ensuing explosion because he switched to his mana body, and he exchanged words with the Witch of Melancholy, before instantly vanishing from the scene. Once he disappeared, the Witch's attention turned to Nikola, as she had determined he had intruded on the glacier through his magic signature, and pointed to his left leg, which had been severed at the lower half, and then attempted to leave. Subaru tried to call out to her, but discovered that he was unable to pronounce her name, and as he continued trying to speak with her, she activated Compress Agony on him. Following Vague's attack, Nikola began to employ a prosthetic leg. Subaru was finally released from Compress Agony's effects two weeks later and spoke with Nikola about what had happened. From Nikola's perspective, it was a stroke of luck that he only lost a leg and hardly found his prosthetic leg an inconvenience due to the advancement of magic tools since Subaru's time 400 years ago. He conveyed that the Witch of Melancholy did not kill people and that he trespassed into the region of the glacier to attract her attention, having done so to preemptively counter Vague. Moreover, he explained that Vague commenced his objective to purge the world of [[spirit]]s by murdering [[Odglass]], followed by [[Zarestia]], has trying to target [[Arakiya]], and was even responsible for killing Lumera's sisters. However, he realized he had made a mistake by telling them that Lumera's sisters had been eradicated, asking Subaru and Beatrice to pretend that they had not heard him, which the former of the duo rejected. Nikola then disclosed that Vague killed Lumera's sisters, who had been fully aware of the potential outcome and that they made a diversion to lure the Mad Prince away from the others when they were enacting their plan to rescue Subaru. Suddenly, Lumera entered the room, declaring that it had been a natural decision for them. She then admonished Nikola for not abiding by the final plea of her sisters, though she quickly understood that he would want to mention what they had achieved to Subaru and Beatrice and gently stroked his head while he remained dejected for having revealed it. Over the course of forty years, Subaru recovered from the aftereffects of his sealing and prepared to confront the Witch of Melancholy and the Mad Prince, Vague Adgard. During this period, Lumera continued to not reciprocate Nikola's feelings for her because she was concerned about Subaru's recovery process. However, once Subaru had recovered his spirit and he bluntly told them that they should get together, Nikola and Lumera began a relationship. With the backing of the unified emperor of Vollachia, the couple had a grand wedding ceremony held for them, although it was interrupted by Vague, forcing Subaru to repeatedly utilize [[Natsuki Subaru#Authorities|Return by Death]] in order to deal with him. Nikola also managed to master using his prosthetic leg. Once the time came for Subaru and Beatrice to set off for the Eternal Agzadd Glacier, Nikola checked to see if they were ready. Lumera joined them, also asking if their preparations were complete, as she was accompanying the duo to the glacier. Once the four of them exited the house they had been in, they were met by Rosalind's daughter, who had succeeded her mother after she succumbed to illness. The unified emperor voiced her intent to lend two of her daggers, the Nine Divine Generals, to Subaru. With the additions of the Diamond Princess, Arakiya, and the Cloud Dragon, Madelyn Eschart, to the group, Subaru called out everyone's names and set off for the glacier with his allies. ==Trivia== *Nikola's birthday was decided at a talk show held on July 26, 2026. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} {{Non-Canon Navbox}} [[Category:Merchants]]

'''Reborn''' (リボーン) is a member of the [[Beloved Children]]. He plays an antagonistic role in [[Arc 10]].

==Appearance==
Reborn is a youth with spiky, bright blue hair that is swept to the side on the top of his head while the sides are buzzed short, red eyes that have a nasty look in them, and a small frame. His outfit consists of a sleeveless blue top with a high collar that reaches his chin and a vertical red stripe on the right side and matching blue trousers. His detached sleeves and boots are a darker shade of blue with red straps on them, he wears a pair of red X-shaped earrings, he has an ornament with the Mark of the Beloved Children pinned to his collar, and he carries his oversized weapon on his back. He gives off the atmosphere of a small, hot-blooded animal.

==Personality==
Reborn is described as having a big attitude and a loud voice for his small build who gives off the atmosphere of a small hot-blooded animal, and he has a vulgar manner of speech, unwilling to praise others. He can be restless, as seen when he repeatedly and roughly hit his feet around the meeting table made by [[Arbalest]].<ref>''It was a youth with nasty looking eyes, and bright spiky blue hair. He had a big personality, a loud voice for his small frame, and for some reason, he gave off the atmosphere of a small hot-blooded animal. It was only amplified by the fact that he kept restlessly banging his heels against the table in a rough manner.'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> Moreover, he is prone to anger and will not hesitate to take it out on his own comrades, whether by trying to kill them, threatening them, or by using his power of silence on them. He is equally quick-tempered when fighting enemies and becomes easily infuriated when put on the back foot or when things do not go his way. Furthermore, he has complained about generally everything being far too noisy and wanting to silence everything.

==Abilities==
===Overall Power===
Although it is unclear exactly how powerful he is, it has been stated that Reborn is the strongest member of the Beloved Children. Even without his primary power, he is still a force to be reckoned with, and the other members of the Beloved Children recognize that they stand no chance against him.<ref>''“Then I’ll just shut everyone up when that time comes. Is there anyone here who can beat me?”'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref><ref>''“Hypothetically speakin’, not a chance. There’d be a better shot in a fair open duel, but if it’s anything goes, we’d be doomed.”'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref> At present, he is known to at least be capable of clashing with the likes of a emotionally disrupted [[Crusch Karsten]], though ultimately, she is still stronger than he is.

===Physical Traits/Flow Method===
'''Expert Swordsman''': Reborn is an excellent swordsman who can easily fight against Crusch with large blades.

'''Heightened Agility''': During combat, Reborn has a habit of fighting three-dimensionally, kicking off of the walls and ceiling while attempting to attack from various angles.

===Techniques===
'''Silence Generation''': Reborn is capable of stopping sound from escaping a specified area.<ref>''He placed a hand on his throat, and a hand on his cheek, opened his mouth wide, and shouted out so that it would reach the ears of his surroundings. Even after doing all that, his voice produced no sound. Even though his voice was coming out, it did not make any sound. ――And, his voice was not the only thing making no sound. There was no sound of him slapping his cheek. There was no sound of him gritting his teeth. There was no sound of his faltering footsteps. And there was no sound of the broad blade piercing out of his abdomen as it skewered him from behind.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 33, Section 2.</ref> It is capable of preventing any speech from reaching one’s allies, even when they are close to each other, or preventing the sounds of a battle from reaching anyone’s ears. Furthermore, by alternating between using silence on specified targets and deactivating it, the audio discord can disrupt and break the concentration of his opponents. This being said, it does not necessarily stop sensory type abilities, as [[Natsuki Subaru]] was still able to detect Crusch’s battle with him through his [[Natsuki Subaru#Authorities|Cor Leonis]]. Furthermore, the area afflicted with silence is limited to everything within his line of sight. As such, if someone is out of his vision, they will not be affected. This also means that if he is blinded, he cannot use his power.

===Equipment===
*'''Shear-like Greatswords''': Reborn uses a giant pair of shears as his primary weapon. The shears can separate into two blades, and he can easily use them like greatswords. At present, he has only used one of them, so it is unclear if he is capable of dual wielding them or using them while they are attached. They are easily sharp enough to carve right through stone with little apparent resistance.
