[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Takehito Koyasu|Koyasu Takehito]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Ray Chase (voice actor)|Ray Chase]]}} '''Roswaal L. Mathers''' (ロズワール・L・メイザース) is the lord of [[Roswaal Manor]] and the Mathers Domain, the current head of [[House Mathers]], the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica's]] Head Court Mage, and the margrave of the Kingdom's western territories. Since the age of 14, Roswaal has been possessed by the soul of his ancestor, '''Roswaal A. Mathers'''. He set up the [[Loot House Incident|events]] of [[Arc 1]], played a supporting role in [[Arc 2]], [[Arc 3]], [[Arc 7]], [[Arc 8]], and [[Arc 9]], and he was the main antagonist of [[Arc 4]]. Although supporting [[Emilia]]'s quest for the throne, he was actually using her, [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], and [[Ram]] for his own goals, which involved killing the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] and resurrecting [[Echidna|his mentor]]. However, in Arc 4, he made a bet with Subaru and subsequently lost, forcing him to truly support Emilia, though he hasn't given up on his ambitions. ==Appearance== Roswaal is a rather tall man standing at 186 centimeters, making him taller than Natsuki Subaru by at least half a head. His well-toned body is slender and appeared delicate despite its impressive musculature. His very handsome face is ghastly pale which gives him the impression of a classic pretty boy. However, his physical beauty is somewhat concealed by his peculiar makeup and getup. Like previous generations, Roswaal had the same [[Wikipedia:Heterochromia iridum|heterochromatic eyes]] in the same arrangement. His straight indigo blue hair is long enough to cover his whole back and is usually tucked behind his ear on the left side of his head. His face is usually decorated with a light-lavender powder, purple lipstick, and purple eye shadow that is adorned on his right eyelid. His yellow left eye is also bedecked with eye shadow that is more elaborate than the right's eye shadow and covers the whole area around the eye rather than just the eyelid and accompanies his unusual outfit comparable to those similar to a clown or jester, consisting of a black hat, a top and bottom with different shades of purple, along with red and black boots and a cape. He also has a chain surrounding his right ankle. Although rarely, Roswaal sometimes does make an appearance without his signature make-up. His skin complexion is noted to be very ghastly and pale, and his eyes give off a gentle and rather welcoming expression, a polar opposite of what they give off when he's wearing make-up. When the situation calls for it, Roswaal also dons a more formal outfit, consisting of a long black coat that covers his entire body. His initial incarnation, originally named ''Altair Mathers'', and later, ''Roswaal A. Mathers'', was male. His long, straight indigo hair flowed freely down his back and both his eyes were blue. At the age of sixteen, Roswaal had a wicked charm about him that was only possible for a blooming young man of his age. He was also rather tall, towering over [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu Meyer]] by a full head despite still having room to grow. Despite his youth, Roswaal possessed a natural elegance befitting of his lineage as a noble. He could usually be seen wearing rather well-suited black robes. Many of his physical traits, such as his hairstyle and color, would be adopted by the descendants he possessed. Though, following [[Hector]]'s attack on the [[Sanctuary]], Roswaal started to use a cane to walk, and as the years passed, his chin started showing the smallest of stubbles. ==Personality== Roswaal comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his [[Roswaal J. Mathers|grandmother]]. He often comes off as a friendly enough person, if weird, to speak with, usually behaving light-heartedly with the people around him. Roswaal cares about Ram and [[Rem]] a great deal and holds them in high regard among his staff. However, he is unusual among the nobility for having such close relations with [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], to the point that he will hire and educate demi-humans with nowhere to go in his own manor and in Miload Manor without asking for anything in return,''“Master invites demi-humans with no place to go into the mansion, and he gives them work and education. That’s how he gives, and he doesn’t ask for anything in return. It’s all purely Master’s good will.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 1. and he has come to be known as the Demi-Human Lover because of it.''“Indeed, everyone in this mansion is a demi-human. Among the gossip that goes around, there are also voices that call Master ‘Demi-Human Lover’.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 1. This has led to unsavory rumors that have suggested he has a fetish for them. That said, [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] speculates this is actually because he's been gathering half-bloods to the Sanctuary. He has also shown to become uncomfortable when dealing with positive talk about himself, such as when he got caught in the middle of such talk between Ram and [[Serena Dracroy]]. He has also at one point been told that if changes in the environment were for the better, then it was something to be happy about, and that he should not curse the events that led there. As such, he has never regretted nor cursed his environment as one blessed by it and his meetings.''“If the environment changes you for the better, then that would be something you should be happy about. No matter what, do not curse the events. That would be a sin and a whole different matter.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 2.''“Someone said something similar to me before too. In actuality, I do believe it. If the environment is a part of life’s journey, then meetings are, too. I was blessed with an environment. I was blessed with meetings. I’ve never regretted that, nor have I ever cursed it.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 2.Despite his apparent eccentricities, as his position demands, he harbors a far more calculating, scheming reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well. He is shown to be able to manipulate others to his whims through wordplay and displays of power, and he is nigh unbendable on the political battlefield, willing to take drastic actions to get his way, such as manipulating the environment of the [[Royal Selection]] Ceremony to ensure Emilia's position as one of the candidates in spite of her appearance. He has a habit of not talking to another person without being in a superior position, intent on grasping the other party's intentions, seizing their weaknesses, and if necessary, take hostages to secure his advantage, making him a formidable negotiator as well, while simultaneously displaying his cautious, even cowardly, nature. He has personally claimed to be famous for being unable to understand the emotions of others even if he speaks with face to face.''“Right? It is going to be veeeery difficult. After all, I am famous for not being able to understand feelings even with those whom I talk with face to faaaace.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 1. He has also said that he believed that when a person relies on something, that they should die by what it is they rely on, whether that is the sword, magic, fire, etc.; it is because of this that he told Ram that he would allow himself to die by her hand should the future ever deviate from his Book of Wisdom's predictions as penance for allowing her village to meet its destruction for his own ends. In Roswaal's original incarnation of Roswaal A. Mathers, he was much brighter and more prideful, and he often found himself amused during his playful interactions with [[Beatrice]]. He had been mischievous, messing with Beatrice in the same way that she would mess with Ryuzu by using his yang magic to loop a room endlessly against her, and he tended to tease her, much to her annoyance. He also held great pride in his knowledge of magic, which only increased over time. However, the part of him that most dominated his personality was his love for Echidna, his teacher. Despite his condition causing him problems with his own relatives, she was the one who not only taught him magic but even saved his life, even having gone out of her way to kiss him when they first met to relieve him of the pressure of the mana assailing his body. Because of this, he was heavily dedicated to her, and he was willing to use himself to fight for and protect her when necessary. Following the attack on the Sanctuary by Hector and the death of Echidna, his psyche was greatly wounded. He had become more depressed and would often pore over all of the knowledge in the Forbidden Library, continue mastering magic, and research methods of revival. He believed that his purpose was to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that meant sacrificing himself or those close to him, making Echidna from the [[Castle of Dreams]] to describe him as being "a little too earnest." This made him rely heavily on his Gospel, believing that so long as he followed it, he would one day see his teacher again. Likewise, as a result of the strong emotions engraved into him following his encounter with the Warlock of Melancholy. he started mimicking Hector's mannerisms, including his eccentric way of speaking and his clown makeup. He has stated that even without his makeup, he was a clown. Over the centuries, Roswaal had a certain darkness to him, making it to where not only had he become entirely incapable of using healing magic, a magic he believed was a gentle type of magic, but he started to become more ruthless in his goal to revive his teacher, allowing tragedies to occur or even set them up so that his goal could be met. This has led him to ignore the [[Witch Cult]]'s attack on the [[Oni|Oni Tribe]]'s village, waiting until only Rem and Ram remained as he need Ram in particular for his goals. Likewise, upon learning of Subaru, the other person who was required to revive his teacher, he began setting up numerous schemes in order to make Subaru a Sage and become like himself, believing he had a sort of kinship with him. This has led to him forcing his will on Subaru by hiring an [[Elsa Granhiert|assassin]] and summoning the [[Great Rabbit]] to kill everyone involved with Emilia just to have things go his way. However, after his Book of Wisdom was burned during the events of the Sanctuary and having nearly killed Ram, he became lost and did not know what to do, becoming nearly despondent, even in the face of danger, with his only thought to be to infuse mana into Ram's severed horn. Following the loss of his bet with Subaru, Roswaal had an [[Curse#Oath Bound Curse Mark|Oath Bound Curse Mark]] placed on himself, with the condition that, were he ever to bring harm to anyone in the camp or those Subaru cares for again, his soul would burn and never again return to [[Od Lagna]]. Likewise, after witnessing his plan fail so utterly, witnessing Ram's courage and being told of her love for him, and seeing Emilia overcome her past and trauma, something he did not believe she could overcome, something he himself could not even do, he became softer and started earnestly backing her, and he became much more lenient with the members of the [[Emilia Camp]], often putting up with the heavy distrust of [[Otto Suwen]], harassment from his own maid, [[Petra Leyte]], and the somewhat mouthy [[Frederica Baumann]]. He has become much less ruthless, and he has even shown to be willing to guide those around him, such as when he provided Garfiel combat advice which allowed him to become stronger. Despite this, he keeps his primary goal in mind, and he expects Subaru to live up to the words that he had given him about not letting anyone die or come to harm's way, threatening to force him to use his [[Authority]] should he ever make a mistake burning everything and everyone dear to Subaru. When Subaru returned from [[Priestella]] with another Witch Factor, he realized that things were still going his way when he realized that Subaru had obtained another Witch Factor, which Beatrice scolded him for. Likewise, if Subaru were to find himself in a predicament that left him separated from everybody, even if it means illegally crossing country borders, Roswaal has shown to be willing to do anything he needed to in order to retrieve him, including giving up multiple magics to compensate [[Clind]] to use his Authority. Despite the threat that he gave to Subaru, following the events of Arc 8, he became confused in how he should be, as he was conflicted over how he and Subaru should interact regarding his own dream, Subaru’s Authority, and other such issues. Likewise, Subaru noticed that Roswaal did not decide to act on the words he’d given after the Sanctuary events, which Subaru speculated was either due to him becoming softer or because Priscilla did not count amongst those Subaru was meant to keep alive. Likewise, because he knows his own nature very well, he harbors a sense of guilt toward his comrades for keeping secrets, despite being surrounded by many kind-hearted people, which in turn compels Roswaal to deliver results with tasks they might entrust to him, as if trying to live up to his comrades' expectations. In fact, this sense is so strong that, during the Arc 9 loop, much to his own surprise, he decided to, rather than face an opponent he should have been content with merely stalling through underhanded tricks, stand back up in spite of his own great injuries and push himself to his limits. Later, after speaking with and working alongside [[Ezzo Cadner]], he came to the realization that he did not walk his path alone. ==History== ===[[Kremaldy Forest Team, Days Forever Lost]]=== Altair Mathers was born into the Mathers family, a noble house active within the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. The wealthy family owned, governed, and occupied large portions of populated land in the northeast region of the nation. The era in which Altair was born into had a distinct ignorance regarding magic, which was unfortunate for Altair who possessed incredible latent magical talent. In his youth, Altair became known for his magical potency, although he struggled to comprehend the power within him. At a certain point he began suffering inexplicable burning sensations that would last for hours or even days and could not be explained by any doctor. As he tended to thrash and moan during these random moments of pain, no one ever dared comfort the boy. In fact, his family considered him a burden because of his unexplainable condition. As time went on, he became more accustomed to the pain to the point that he could behave normally whilst under the burning sensation. One day, when Altair felt that the pain was on its way, he rushed to his room to have some privacy. However, upon entry he discovered a beautiful white-haired woman sitting on his bed in black clothes. The woman stood up and approached Altair as she praised him for his capability to resist his pain. Just then, a jab of pain struck Altair, causing him to vomit onto himself and the woman. Feeling shame at what he had done, Altair tried to apologize to the woman. However, she approached him before he could utter his words and kissed him on the lips. After holding the kiss for a few seconds, the woman backed away and explained that she had extracted the magical energy in his body, as the excess energy within his body was poisoning him. From the woman, Altair learned that mages with high quantities of magical energy in their bodies were susceptible to great pains and even death if they didn't get rid of the excess magic their bodies absorbed. The way to do this was to either use magic on a regular basis or release a large quantity of magic at once. The woman explained she knew this because she had suffered similar problems in her childhood. After breaking into tears because someone finally understood him, Altair asked the woman her name. She introduced herself as an "evil Witch" whose name was the Witch of Greed, Echidna. Altair introduced himself to her in turn and eventually went on to become her loyal apprentice. Altair fell deeply in love with the Witch to the point that she mattered to him more so than anyone else including himself. Eventually, Altair would come to expel his parents and siblings from his house, and due to his family's tradition where each head succeeded the name Roswaal, he changed his name to Roswaal A. Mathers after becoming the family head.''“Ah, it refers to me. In our house, generation after generation, the head of the household succeeds the name Roswaal. Before I expelled my parents and siblings, my name had been Altair.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]], Chapter 2, Part 9. Throughout the years, Roswaal slowly began to unravel his magical talent and honed his abilities to near perfection although he was never able to achieve the same magical prowess as his mentor Echidna. By the time he was sixteen, Roswaal was already considered to be one of the top mages in the kingdom. One day, he visited the Sanctuary of Kremaldy, where he met Beatrice and Ryuzu Meyer for the first time. Over time, he became closer to the girls, to the point that when he was asked by Ryuzu how he met Echidna, he told her his story, and he could tease Beatrice to the point that she was chase after him in annoyance. ===The Warlock's Attack=== Eventually, however, the Warlock of Melancholy successfully located Echidna at the Sanctuary located in the Kremaldy Forest. Roswaal confronted Hector in order to buy Echidna some time, but he ended up swiftly defeated and almost killed. In the last second, Echidna came to the rescue, fending off Hector and saving Roswaal's life. But the defeat Roswaal suffered was demoralizing and he was never able to fully heal himself again. Instead of achieving the pinnacle of Arcane Arts, he spiralled down the dark path of sinister magic, and over time, his mind had utterly changed. After Echidna died, Roswaal started to possess his descendants, with the purpose of bringing her back. Shortly after his thirtieth birthday, Roswaal A. Mathers died and possessed the body of his son, Roswaal B. Mathers. ===Following Generations=== However many years later, Roswaal and Clind clashed against Hector together, ending in the Warlock's defeat and the steward's inheritance of the Witch Factor of Melancholy. Similarly, Roswaal became enemies with the lone failure of the [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu clones]], [[Sphinx]]. At some point after becoming Roswaal D. Mathers, he and [[Toska]] made an effort to bring Beatrice out of the Forbidden Library. However, the unfortunately failed in doing so. Likewise, at some point, he began making preparations for the Royal Selection, which Roswaal implied was being prepared for for generations. ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica]]=== Roughly 15 years before the events of the main story, His Majesty [[Randohal Lugunica]] held a ceremony in honor of the then-14-year-old Roswaal L. Mathers inheriting his father’s, [[Roswaal K. Mathers]], name after the latter met a premature end. On his way back from the Royal Castle, Roswaal was robbed by a small kid. After successfully cornering the kid in a dark alleyway and demanding the return of his stolen golden-feathered ornament, Roswaal was interrupted by a large man who introduced himself as the kid's boss. Not wanting to shed blood, Roswaal moved in for a one-hit knockout, however, due to recently switching bodies and not yet being fully accustomed to the new body, the so-called boss took the hit and retaliated with his own, knocking Roswaal out instead. Upon waking up, Roswaal quickly noticed a man standing next to him. He introduced himself as [[Russell Fellow]] and explains that Roswaal was likely mugged by [[Terminology#Organizations|The Brotherhood]], an organization running rampart in the [[Royal Capital]], stealing from the rich and demanding rights and equality for the poor. After teaming up with Russell and starting their search for the stolen ornament, Roswaal and Russell soon stumble across a 5-year-old boy who urged them not to continue down the street as his father is currently working. Sensing the boy's peculiarity and noticing something's off, the pair complied to the boy's request, asking the boy who his father is, to which, the child stated it was [[Heinkel Astrea]]. After Heinkel's business with Marcos (Heinkel's "work" was trying to convince [[Marcos Gildark]] to rejoin the Royal Army), Roswaal interjects, starting a banter with Marcos, which quickly turns into a fist fight. After both giving their all, Marcos finally surrenders and admits defeat, to which Roswaal doesn't take too happily, demanding the continuation of their fight as he could not accept his given victory. It is only after Russell interjects, that Roswaal dropped the lust for battle. After further debate, Marcos calls the young boy who robbed Roswaal a couple of hours ago, demanding him to return the stolen badge and apologize, to which, the boy, [[Belmont]], reluctantly complies. Roswaal, Russell and Marcos then discuss Marcos' involvement with The Brotherhood, asking him why he abandoned the Royal Knights. It is only after Marcos states that he's repulsed by the class discrimination, that Roswaal smirks and requests Marcos to be his accomplice. Not long after, Roswaal arranged a meeting between 5 highest-ranking members of both The Brotherhood and the [[Terminology#Organizations|Golden Wing Faction]], including Marcos and [[Fareed Impusen]], urging the two factions to form an alliance under Roswaal's supervision, as he, too, wants to make a change in the Kingdom, just like the two factions. After a bit of discussing things through, they agreed and formed an alliance. ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II]]=== Sometime after the events with Marcos, Roswaal was responsible for helping save Serena Dracroy from assassins sent by her father, [[Minor Characters#Galahau Dracroy|Galahau Dracroy]]. Afterward, after they dealt with three of the assassins and convinced the fourth, [[Gwain Merette|Alagar]], to switch sides. Serena returned to Vollachia afterwards, where she took care of her father, while Roswaal saw to it that the assassin, now going by Gwain Merette, followed through on his promise to never beastify again. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]=== Approximately ten years prior to the story’s beginning, Roswaal became aware of the Witch Cult’s attack on the Oni Tribe's last village. He ultimately allowed it to happen so that he could pick up Ram and Rem, who he had planned to assist him in his goals after seeing that Ram was designated as important to his plans by his Book of Wisdom. On the night of the attack, he rushed in after the attack was underway, and he found Rem and Ram on the mountain path, Ram begging him to save Rem and offering her service in exchange. On that same night, Roswaal also found and captured [[Fogg]], and after bringing them back to the manor, he left the girls in their rooms while he imprisoned Fogg in the basement. After Rem awoke for the second time, Roswaal greeted her, and after he bluntly told her that her village was destroyed, he picked at her emotional scars until she snapped, giving him the response that Roswaal was looking for from the despondent girl. After she demanded to see her sister, though he and the nearby Frederica were seemingly against it, Roswaal had Frederica lead her to Ram. After she saw, Rem ran back to Roswaal and begged him to save her sister, claiming that she would serve him in exchange when he asked what she could give him. Afterward, he easily dealt with Ram's rampaging mana, and the two girls would start serving the manor the next day. About a month later, the girls were becoming accustomed to being servants in the manor, though Ram's constitution interfered with her work, and every night, Roswaal would provide her with mana. One day, Rem spoke with Roswaal about her life in the manor, and the weight of her conscience about living there. The conversation moved to how Rem noticed the Witch Cult was responsible for the village's destruction, which Roswaal unintentionally confirmed. Roswaal discouraged her from vengeance, and Rem said she would speak to Ram about it. Afterward, Ram came to retrieve Rem, and they left the room, Ram suspicious about their interaction. One day, another month later, Roswaal prepared to set off for the Sanctuary, intent on bringing Ram with him. With Frederica going to take the majority of the servants away the day after they were to leave, Roswaal gave Clind a key to the basement and ordered him to give it to Rem and have her go to the basement to clean it. Soon after, after convincing the two it was for their own good to be separated, he and Ram left for the Sanctuary, Frederica giving a letter to Ram to give to her brother, Garfiel. For three days, he and Ram had been gone from the manor, and when they returned, the basement was destroyed, and Rem was injured, much to Ram and Frederica's rage. Ram stuck by Rem's side, and when Rem later awoke, she spoke with Roswaal, claiming that she would act as Ram's horn and substitute. That night, Roswaal spoke with Clind, who wanted an explanation for Roswaal's order but didn't get one. Clind then then scolded Roswaal in an effort to get him to marry, which he considered, but Roswaal effectively denied to find someone to marry since he did not want to remove the face paint, and Clind left the room. Another month later, Roswaal, Frederica, Ram, and Rem visited the Royal Capital, which was celebrating the Tammuz Festival, to buy a gift to celebrate the birth of child of House Miload. Deciding to split up to search for a gift, Roswaal took Ram with him while Frederica took Rem, and the two decided to meet up again later. During the few hours they were apart, Roswaal had gifted Ram clothes, accessories, and her wand. When they met up again with Rem and Frederica, however, they discovered that the Witch Cult was preparing to cause chaos during the festival, and after contemplating the plan in play or if there were other stones, they decided to split up again, Roswaal and Ram going to alert the capital's guardsmen while Frederica beastified and took Rem with her to look for the scattered stones, which Ram had predicted the locations of. A little while later, Ram used her Synesthesia to connect to Rem, and thanks to that, Ram was able to snipe the escaping [[Sado]] midair, impressing Roswaal, who mentioned their promise. Ten days later, Roswaal brought Rem and Ram to the Miload Manor, where they met the pregnant [[Grace Miload]], Roswaal's excuse for bringing them being that they ought to see childbirth for themselves, and his continued interactions with Grace made Ram grumpy. After a short conversation, Rem and Ram went to another room. Three days later, [[Dudley Miload]] was late in returning to the manor, and when a [[Sergei|young man]] arrived to tell everyone that the carriage broke down, Roswaal and Rem went to retrieve him, leaving Ram to keep Grace company. After arriving at his carriage, the young man brought Rem forward to witness the bloody corpses. When she brought out her horn, she was nearly incapacitated by the man's poisoning of mana. When the man blew away the carriage Roswaal was in, the young man, Sergei, summoned several Witch Cultists before attempting to strangle Rem to death, only for Roswaal to appear and blast them all with magic and retrieve Rem. Deciding to handle them, Roswaal sent Rem back to the manor, blowing away the cultists that got in her way. Later, Roswaal returned after the [[Attack on Miload Manor|attack]] was over, having killed that cultists and broke Sergei's limbs, who he had brought with him for the sisters to kill. Afterward, [[Minor Characters#Limrear|Limrear]] appeared, saying that the baby had been born but that Grace didn't have much time left. In the room she was in, several bloody rags were nearby, and the baby was in the arms of a servant. Waking Grace, she gave her baby the name [[Annerose Miload|Annerose]], and she asked Roswaal to take care of her. Dying, she said that she loved Roswaal, and she laughed when he returned her words, saying he was a bad liar. In the end, she died, leaving the servants to cry. After this, Roswaal became Annerose's guardian, and House Miload was put under his control. Many of the remaining servants who survived resigned, and Roswaal decided to have Clind and Frederica serve at House Miload, with Roswaal choosing to have his hobby of taking care of and training demi-human servants being performed at the Miload Manor and by those two. One night, after giving them this task, he spoke with Ram, who believed that he set up the whole affair to give the girls their retribution, and she asked if the sacrifices of Dudley and Grace was worth it. When Roswaal claimed that he would sacrifice anyone for his goal, Ram told him that she would help him achieve his goal, attempting to kiss him while doing so, only for Roswaal to stop her. Pouting, Ram said that she would destroy him: his goals, desires, and emotions. A year later, Rem and Ram visited the Oni village's grave and performed their funeral rites with alcohol given to them by Roswaal. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice|Bonds of Ice]]=== Several months prior to the story’s beginning, Roswaal decided to release the staff of his manor in preparation for the chaos of the Royal Selection, save for Ram and Rem. A short time later, he confronted Emilia and [[Puck]] in [[Elior Forest]]. Due to Puck’s wariness of Roswaal, the two ended up in a battle that spanned for half a day. Ultimately, he managed to get Puck to listen, and he placed the Dragon Insignia in Emilia’s hand, signifying her potential as a Royal Candidate. With the promise of the Dragon’s blood should she win to unfreeze the Forest, Emilia accepted, and he brought her back to the manor to be taught about the country and her other duties. ===A Few Months Later=== A few days before the story’s start, aware of Subaru’s sudden appearance in the Royal Capital, the time traveling aspect of his Authority, and his infatuation with Emilia, Roswaal gave a magic-protection cloak to and hired Elsa Granhiert to attack Emilia, who would be sent to the Royal Capital, as a means to bring Subaru into the camp and achieve his goals, thus leading to the events of Arc 1. ===[[The Head Maid's Unrestful Holiday]]=== Noticing how hard Rem worked, Subaru spoke with the other residents of Roswaal Manor, and he proposed that she take a day off. Despite the slight opposition of the others, he was able to persuade them to agree after saying that she could use the day off to think about what she wanted as her reward for her participation in the Wolgarm Incident, and when Rem herself was reluctant to take a day off, Subaru told her to take the day off directly, and she agreed to his command immediately. Afterward, everyone decided on which jobs they would handle to make up for not having Rem’s help and split up to handle their respective tasks. Despite the time off, Rem became anxious at essentially doing nothing, and deciding to check in on everyone, she snuck out of her room. Particularly concerned about her sister, Rem arrived at the kitchen, where she overheard Ram complaining to Roswaal about Subaru’s idea to have him participate in the housework. However, Roswaal was fine participating and even claimed that Subaru’s idea wasn’t misguided. As Rem decided to leave, she noticed Roswaal had noticed her and quietly thanked him for not saying anything. ===[[Rem's Very Ordinary Happy Day]]=== One night, Rem was summoned by Roswaal and Puck, who requested snacks for their drinks. After she prepared the snacks, she was invited by the two to keep them company. After some small talk about their handling of alcohol and the night of the stargazing party, they began speaking about Subaru’s gate, which had been damaged during the [[Wolgarm Incident]]. Intent on bringing the best healer in the capital, [[Ferris]], he had discussed with Puck about using something from within Elior Forest, the magic stones, to bargain with Ferris, who was already a critical part of [[House Karsten]] and the [[Crusch Camp]]. After assigning Rem the task of keeping a close eye on Subaru, she left, having been slightly affected by the smell of the alcohol. ===[[The Great Spirit Puck's Nyan Nyan Tricks]]=== On the way to the castle for the Royal Selection Ceremony, Roswaal, Puck, and Emilia had a small talk in their carriage. Puck mentioned that the Dragon has a bad habit of choosing only women as priestesses to keep the lineage going. Emilia got confused as to what he meant, leading Roswaal to mention that Puck had a very overprotective nature to Emilia for not telling the whole story about the selection, which Puck replied that Emilia wouldn't become interested in something she isn't aware of. When they finally arrived at the castle, Roswaal asked Puck for a minute of his time for a private talk at a distance from Emilia. As they walked away, Puck noticed the castle was filled with imagery of the tale of the three heroes. Puck considered them works of art with a bad taste for their inaccuracy. Roswaal moved on to the main topic, mentioning that he wanted Puck's help in a little scheme of his, and he asked him to not grow violent inside the castle, revealing that he had a feeling that someone would insult Emilia during the ceremony and that Subaru would try to protect her. Puck immediately said to Roswaal that if he told Subaru to disobey Emilia's request to not come to the castle, then he would fight him right then and there. Roswaal denied his assumption, saying that he merely had a hunch. The conversation ended after Puck reluctantly agreed on the scheme. ===[[The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting]]=== Following the [[Sanctuary Incident]], Annerose and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the Sanctuary to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to Garfiel that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and Otto, who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia. Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where Puck slept and called everyone there precious to her. ===[[Poltergeist Story]]=== Two months after the Sanctuary Incident, Roswaal called for the maids of Roswaal Manor. Intending to begin making allies with other nobles with Emilia for the Royal Selection, he set his sights on first targeting Viscount [[Minor Characters#Torion Aruz|Torion Aruz]], he tasked the girls with cleaning a villa that was once the workshop of his father, Roswaal K. Mathers. Two days later, the girls arrived in the evening, birds attempting to steal their luggage having delayed their arrival. There, they found that the workshop was covered in ivy and vines and was practically falling apart from disuse. As nighttime approached, despite Frederica starting to panic over the workshop's creepy atmosphere, they decided that they would have to stay the night there. Later, after Petra called him over, Roswaal had flown over to the workshop and wondered how long it had been since he'd been there. Meeting up with the maids, he found 111 of those dolls dressed up and fixed. Surprised that they were still, having created more of themselves to continue protecting the place until the master could return, he thanked them, causing them to bow and finally shut down. Afterward, facing the confused Petra, he thanked them for allowing him to right a wrong, upsetting Petra for his attitude. With Roswaal deciding to help them, Frederica told Petra she could work him hard, while Ram had knelt down and gently thanked the dolls for their service. A little while later, while they were cleaning, Frederica asked what Roswaal was going to do with the dolls since they had broken down, concerned about hollows potentially possessing them, to which Roswaal claimed that he would reuse the dolls, replace the aged parts, and even potentially create a pseudo-gate,''"That’s right," he replied, tracing a line in the dust on an old book with his finger. "After all, you and the others put so much effort into tidying them up. A lot of the dolls have broken and aged parts, but if we replace those then we should be able to mend them. It might even be possible to replicate a gate in a pseudo-fashion if we can fiddle with the formula or improve the quality of the magic stone used inside them."'' [[Poltergeist Story Extra]]. something which Frederica is shocked to learn as attempting to do so is the same as attempting to create a new heart. Roswaal treats it as entirely possible, and though Frederica claims that doing so is implausible by comparing him to his father, Roswaal brushes it away by questioning whether she thinks his knowledge is inferior to his father's. Knowing that he is speaking with full knowledge he can do it, she muttered that it was like he was saying he could recreate anything with magic, which he claimed could be done and that magic was something that existed to fulfill one's wishes, saying that achieving one's goal was the most important part of extending one's bloodline, to pass down knowledge and ideals. She mentions that she isn't sure whether he cares or not about his dolls after claiming to want to use them in his experiments, while he replies that doing so could help to relieve the burden on everyone else as the dolls could keep up with maintenance even when everyone is gone. When Frederica doesn't understand the word "maintenance", as it's a loan word from Subaru's home, she questions whether the artificial gates were for the sake of Subaru and Beatrice, as Subaru's gate had been broken.''Frederica was thinking of complaining to Subaru, although it wasn’t his fault at all, when her breath suddenly caught in her throat after having realized something in the middle of that thought. Lifting her head, she looked over at Roswaal. "By any chance, you wouldn’t be recreating the artificial gate…for the sake of Subaru and Beatrice, would you?"'' [[Poltergeist Story Extra]]. He claims to want to agree and deny her statement, as while it is true, it was his grandmother who had started this research due to her incapacity to use magic, to which Frederica realizes that this is his way of making amends for causing the Sanctuary Incident. Ultimately, she accepts what he says while making sure to warn him to take care of his body, though Roswaal claims that he already has the formulas for the dolls ready in his head and could finish in a couple of days. Afterward, he tells Frederica that if they wanted, he could help Frederica and Garfiel looking into their bloodline if they wanted, but she declines, as her only family were her brother, the Ryuzus, and her [[Reala Thompson|mother]], and telling him to ask Garfiel directly if he wanted to know. With Frederica taking over for him, she tells Roswaal to go deal with the dolls, while he leaves coming up with the names for them to Frederica and the others. ===[[Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle / Page 1|Petra’s Emilia Camp Struggles]]=== Taking place at the same time as the [[Battle for Priestella]], Roswaal, accompanied by Petra, Frederica, Clind, and Annerose, met with the western nobles in an effort to convince them into backing Emilia. After giving his own opinions and having Petra do the same, they successfully managed to bring the nobles to their side, and they returned to the manor. ===[[Stand by me Pleiades Part 1|Stand by me Pleiades]] and [[The Dragon Nation / Missing Child Search Chronicle 1|Missing Child Search]]=== After the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], the group returned to Roswaal Manor to report Subaru and Rem’s disappearance to [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. Realizing the danger, he had Clind use his Authority to take everyone where they needed to be, leading him and the other members of the camp, Annerose, Clind, and [[Meili Portroute]] excluded, to arrive at [[Picoutatte]]. After settling a dispute between Otto and [[Diadora Regundra]] and getting the assistance of the Suwen Company, they decided to reverse through the Everlasting Darkness. After a short confrontation with the representative of the molepeople, [[Musica]], they managed to reach Vollachia. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Roswaal is said to be the strongest magic caster in Re:Zero and also has one of the biggest [[mana]] supplies, most likely falling only behind Emilia or his teacher, and he is one of the strongest combatants from the Kingdom. Roswaal L. Mathers was in fact created with the intention to make a child with the greatest suitability for magic. Apart from healing magic, it was a success as he is the most powerful mage in Re:Zero. According to Puck, Roswaal's power is on par with the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]],''"It would be no idle boast to say you possess power on par with the Four Greats."'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Epilogue: The Meaning of Happiness, Section 2. and he proved that by fighting Puck himself to a draw. His level of power can likely be attributed to having studied magic under Echidna and his inborn talent for magic, having obtained over 400 years worth of experience, and having trained himself in preparation for his eventual fights with Hector, Sphinx, and the Divine Dragon Volcanica. Similarly, having acquired centuries of knowledge and power, he is also skilled in a melee battle, making the likes of a similarly skilled martial artist, [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], wary of him. ===[[Magic]]=== Roswaal is a mage capable of using magic of all six elements, whose skill had reached the pinnacle of human possibility. There is almost no magic that he cannot use or has difficulties acquiring, apart from healing magic, which he can't use as, according to himself, he lacks the necessary care for life. His control over mana is so immaculate that he is capable of providing Ram with the mana she requires with seeming ease and in a short period of time.''Roswaal made the enormous amount of mana Ram pulled in harmless, and at the same time he did work that sent in the mana necessary to maintain Ram’s body. He was practically using multiple magic all at once, and it was basically a feat that could only be pulled off by someone that was far more skilled than others.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 2, Section 5. The original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, was known as the most talented mage of his era, basically mastering all six forms of magic, though still falling behind Echidna in terms of overall magical knowledge and Beatrice in terms of Yin Magic knowledge. His twelfth body, Roswaal L. Mathers, had magical potency that eclipsed the already impressive might of the original Roswaal. It has been stated that with the considerable magical power at Roswaal's disposal, he could single-handedly defeat a whole army's worth of soldiers. His skill was so impressive that he earned the titles the "'''Yellow'''", the "'''Green'''", and the "'''Red'''" that were bestowed upon the one considered the most skillful at utilizing earth, wind, and fire magic respectively, and he has shown to be capable of giving someone a forbidden art via magic. Due to his insane magical talent and a wish to improve himself, Roswaal modified and created a lot of spells. Most of the spells he uses are at least heavily modified if not created by him from scratch. Despite that, he never bothers naming these new and/or modified spells. Roswaal's magical knowledge is, in fact, so advanced, that he's able to cast six different spells at the same time. His mastery was so incredible that he could fight both Ram and Puck simultaneously, using multi-fold magic spells and rearranging the magic construction of an incoming attack, while manipulating the weather on the sly from a distance. It was noted that the technique of conjuring three or more spells at the same time is something that verges on the realm of gods. When working with other powerful mages, he is even capable of creating powerful shield-type magic, like he did with Beatrice,''An amethyst glow appeared around Priscilla as she continued to descend through the blast of light. It was a disk-shaped crystal, acting as a shield to intercept the approaching balls of light, that was created by the combined efforts of both Spirit and mage to protect and defend Priscilla.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 4. or conjuring spells as unimaginably powerful magic like Al Sextet, like he did with Ezzo. '''Extensive Arcane Knowledge''': Roswaal's knowledge on magical practices was quite probably unrivalled, save for possibly his former master Echidna. Over his four-hundred years of life, Roswaal learnt numerous magical techniques and concepts from across all Four Great Nations, giving him a humungous stockpile of knowledge. He also spent time to read every single book inside the Forbidden Library that contained all of the important knowledge his master had accumulated during her life. Presumably, Roswaal knew of many spells and magical rituals forgotten by civilization due to the passage of time. In addition to harboring an impressive understanding of pre-existing magical information, Roswaal was a keen inventor of new magical practices that were often known only to him. One creation of his was a magical theorem that allowed a mage to imbue objects with yang magic enhancements. A majority of the magical spells Roswaal made active usage of were invented by or heavily modified by him. However, as he saw no point in it, Roswaal never allocated names to his techniques. [[File:Roswaal using an unnamed fire spell.gif|thumb|250px|Roswaal using '''fivefold magic''' against Puck.]] '''Multiplefold Magic''': Roswaal is one of the few people in existence to be capable of casting multiple spells at the same time. By casting multiple spells at once, Roswaal can attack from multiple different directions and easily break through other magics, making the spells very difficult to neutralize. He can typically cast these spells from each limb and his mouth, or he can cast multiple magic circles in the air around him in order to cast multiple spells from. Ultimately, Roswaal is capable of casting as many as six spells at once, and casting this sixfold magic is typically considered to be his trump card, and this very trump card was what allowed him to contend with a being as powerful as the Beast of the End. This being said, he can cast multiplefold magic using different levels of spells. As of yet, by his own admission, he has so far failed to be able to cast six Al level spells simultaneously. *'''Al Duet''' (アル・デュエット, ''Aru Dyuetto''): Roswaal casts two Al level spells simultaneously. His only example of this has been to trap his opponent in a massive sphere of water and then boil it in conjunction with an ally's use of electricity to create a steam explosion. *'''Al Trio''' (アル・トリオ, ''Aru Torio''): Roswaal casts three Al level spells simultaneously. His only example of this has been to create a storm of fire, ice, and wind to buffet his target. It has enough power to wipe out a town. *'''Al Quartet''' (アル・カルテット, ''Aru Karutetto''): Roswaal casts four Al level spells simultaneously. His only example of this has been to use the four main elements to create a torrent of destruction. It has enough power to wipe out a city. *'''Al Quintet''' (アル・クインテット, ''Aru Kuintetto''): Roswaal casts five Al level spells simultaneously. His only example of this has been to use the four main elements alongside yang magic to create a powerful magical ray that could counter the Divine Dragon's fully charged breath, as well as erase both sound and color. Its level of power is of the kind that if multiple people could use it that it would face erasure by Od Lagna.''In the sense of destroying the equilibrium of the world, that technique was already on a level which rivaled the numerous forbidden arts whose existences had been erased by Od Lagna. The reason why this had never had its existence extinguished as a forbidden art, was none other than because there had been nobody capable of using it to make it worth prohibiting.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6. *'''Al Sextet''' (アル・セクステット, ''Aru Sekusutetto''): By combining his magic with Ezzo's, they cast six Al level spells simultaneously, creating an aurora pillar with enough power to rewrite the laws of heaven and earth. A target caught within can have its own strength used as fuel for the magic and increase its density. It has enough power to shatter Volcanica's dragon halo. It is considered to be a miracle of magic that even Echidna and [[Myonmyon]] were unable to use. '''It should be noted that while Roswaal is capable of casting six spells simultaneously through sixfold magic and has done so once before, that was not Al Sextet, as Al Sextet requires six Al level spells, meaning that ordinary sixfold magic, by comparison, requires the use of at least one or several spells of differing levels.''' As the loop in Arc 9 has been undone, however, Roswaal cannot achieve this yet. '''Magic Composition Rewriting''': Roswaal has the capacity to rewrite a spell's composition, to completely disassemble it, and to absorb its mana through his own Gate. He does so by using his own Gate to interfere with the magic cast by an opponent, without coming into contact with their own Gate. Roswaal can rewrite the composition of a smell either simply touching magic with any part of his body or by rewriting magic when it is in his vicinity, such as when a magic attack is approaching him. This skill is mentioned to be extremely hard to pull off and completely unheard of to use by touch during an ongoing battle, as it would require the user to have next to no regard for their own life; a small mistake would most certainly result in the caster's death. '''Spells''': [[File:Roswaal using Al Goa.gif|thumb|250px|Roswaal casting '''Ul Goa''' against Puck.]] *'''Goa''' (ゴーア): Roswaal manifests a blaze of fire, which incinerates a foe. **'''El Goa''' (エル・ゴーア): Roswaal rains fire down on an opponent. **'''Ul Goa''' (ウル・ゴーア): Roswaal fires a large number of powerful fire bullets. A powerful flame scatters when the bullets land. **'''Al Goa''' (アル・ゴーア): Roswaal lets loose a massive inferno. Al Goa is mentioned to be one of his most skilled spells, falling behind only his threefold, fivefold and his trump card–sixfold magic spells. *'''El Huma''' (エル・ヒューマ): Roswaal creates multiple shards of ice to impale his opponent. He can combine this with El Fura to both cut through his opponents and make their blood freeze, causing the splash of the blood to be able to injure other opponents in the vicinity.''The swirling wind carried slashes of ice, cutting up the dark shadows throwing themselves at the girl carelessly. The blood gushing out froze, and the slashing blood cut up another dark shadow.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 3. *'''El Fura''' (フーラ): A powerful blast of wind that can easily tear through flesh. Roswaal can combine it with El Huma to both cut through his enemies and freeze their blood, the splash of which can be used to harm other opponents in the vicinity. *'''Unnamed Earth Pillar Spell''': Roswaal is able to create pillars of earth that he can use as a midair foothold for himself or others. *'''Jiwald''' (ジワルド): Using Yang Magic, Roswaal is able to conjure and manipulate visible light into beams of scorching heat that attack whatever stands in its way. *'''Magic Bullets''' (魔弾, ''Madan''): Inspired by [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], Roswaal is able to fire off bullets made of light in order to pierce his target. *'''Cognitive Disruption''' (認識阻害, ''Ninshiki Sogai''): A spell effect that can be woven into objects, such as cloaks or masks. It inhibits people from being able to recognize the person wearing the object that the spell is enchanted into. *'''Infinite Corridor''' (無限の回廊, ''Mugen no Kairō''): Like with Beatrice's use of Yin Magic, Roswaal can use Yang Magic to manipulate the fabric of space and create a loop in space that ensured an individual walking through a structure would move in a loop, meaning that, if they were walking down a corridor, it would seem endless. The target of this spell can break out of the loop by finding the correct door and/or pathway to walk through. The only time Roswaal has shown to use this, however, was to pull a prank on Beatrice four centuries ago. *'''Unnamed Foothold Spell''': Roswaal is able to hold objects in the air by using this spell. It is capable of withstanding the sheer weight of a massive iceberg. '''Combined Spells''': [[File:Roswaal-Flying Magic.gif|thumb|250px|Roswaal leaves the mansion using '''Flying Magic'''.]] *'''Flying Magic''' (飛行魔法, ''Hikō Mahō''): By combining the magical power of the Earth, Wind, and Yang elements, Roswaal could float in the air, or, if he wished to do so, fly. He can reach speeds over 100 km/h, which is faster than an earth dragon and roughly on par with a flying dragon. *'''Weather Changing Magic''': Roswaal is capable of casting weather changing magic. To be more specific, Roswaal could alter the state of the weather within a large radius, manipulating the temperature, moisture, and various other factors. Doing so created a large pulse of magical energy. As the spell is extremely advanced and needs a lot of mana to be casted, Roswaal has to arrange preparations before casting it, as well as using a catalyst in form of a mana crystal, to even be able to cast it in the first place. During Arc 4, he casted this magic to attract the Great Rabbit, as the snow is made out of mana and the witchbeast is attracted to it. *'''Unnamed Multi-Element Barrier''': Roswaal is able to create a barrier using all six elements over a large area, taking inspiration from [[Julius Juukulius]]’s own spiritual arts. However, according to Roswaal, unlike Julius’s use of the spell in which the spirits bear the burden of combining the elements separately, being able to create this barrier took a lot of mana, effort, and mental strain, meaning it is a spell he cannot use freely. *'''Lightning Magic''': According to the author, Roswaal is capable of casting lightning magic; a type of magic that allows the user to cast lightning by combining Wind Magic and different attributes. So far, Roswaal hasn't been observed casting such a spell, though. It also should be mentioned that there is no Lightning affinity, and Lightning Magic is simply a combination of already-explained attributes. '''Unique Spells''': *'''Soul Transcription''' (魂の転写, ''Tamashī no Tensha''): A lost magic technique that allows a person to transcribe their own soul over another's. By doing this over and over to extend their life indefinitely, the user can achieve what Beatrice termed as "subjective immortality". However, it has one major restriction in that for it to work, the person whose soul is overwritten must usually be of blood-relation to the caster. The spell was originally created by Echidna to gain immortality, but she could not complete it before her demise. Instead, it was finished by Roswaal who had been using it to survive until the present era. [[File:Roswaal L Mathers using the Four Coloured Mana Orbs.gif|thumb|250px|Roswaal casting four '''Colored Mana Orbs'''.]] *'''Four Colors of Mana''': Roswaal is capable of conjuring four mana orbs of different colors, an original and extremely destructive spell which he didn't bother naming. Each color represents their respective element, and upon making contact with the target, they burn, freeze, crush, and tear through them with fire, water, earth, and wind magics.''Roswaal snapped his fingers, and the four colored lights raced through the darkness of the night at arrow-like speeds, piercing into the distant group of undead, each light displaying their own powers. One of the undead burst into flames, and another was encased in ice. One had its limbs severed by a blade of wind, and one was pierced through the groin by a block of rock that rose up from the ground.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 17. ===Physical Strength/Flow Method=== [[File:Roswaal easily destroying two large icicles with martial arts.gif|thumb|250px|Roswaal easily destroying two icicles sent flying towards him.]] '''Martial Arts''': During Roswaal's life as Roswaal J. Mathers, due to the issue of her gate not producing enough mana for her to cast magic, as well as attempting to find a way to get around the magical prowess of a mortal enemy, Roswaal was forced to learn how to wield martial arts, making her a devastating killing machine. Roswaal maintained this prowess after taking over his next two bodies, having it at the ready in case his magic should fail him. It is not his primary focus in combat due to his preference for magic, but he will not hesitate to use it if necessary. His proficiency with martial arts and the use of weapons is enough to make him capable of fighting on par with Olbart, and his experience allows him not to be deceived by the shinobi's tricks. '''Enhanced Strength''': Roswaal has greater physical strength than his build and preference for magic might belie. With a single strike, he is capable of destroying icicles with his bare hands and feet, he could easily punch his hand straight through two people, and a single kick was enough to completely destroy the head of a distracted Garfiel, all of which while he was injured at that. Even at the peak of his health, he was able to easily defend against the physical might of someone as strong as Olbart Dunkelkenn with relative ease. '''Yellow Eye''': Roswaal is able to use a yellow eye to break magic apart. However, this ability does not seem to be instant, as when he was in a previous body, Roswaal J. Mathers, when he used it to destroy a powerful magic circle, he first had to slightly tamper with the circle and then concentrate for a short time to allow his eye to cancel it. When it cancels magic, it seems to flicker slightly. ===Techniques=== '''Fa Jin''' (発勁, ''Hakkei''): Roswaal can use fa jin, a martial arts technique that deals a single crushing blow to the internal organs behind muscle. He learned this technique as Roswaal J. Mathers. *'''Fire Magic Imbuement''': During his fight with Marcos Gildark, roughly 15 years before the events of the main story, Roswaal used a fa jin imbued with fire. The strike has the power of a regular fa jin and, due to it being imbued with fire magic, can scorch his opponents' internal organs. '''Unnamed Shinobi Technique''': Following an encounter with an unnamed shinobi from the west a long time ago, Roswaal learned how to unleash long range shockwaves from palm strikes. The shockwaves are said to be able to bypass defenses and can cause severe internal damage toward the target. ===[[Curse]]=== [[File:Oath Curse Mark on Roswaal.png|thumb|250px|An oath bound curse mark carved onto Roswaal’s chest]] *'''[[Curse#Oath Bound Curse Mark|Oath Bound Curse Mark]]''' (誓約の呪印, ''Seiyaku no Juin''): Following the events of Arc 4 and losing his bet with Subaru, Roswaal upheld his oath and had a curse mark carved onto himself. According to his oath, if he is to ever break his promise and harm Subaru in any way, he shall be engulfed in a purifying flame, scorching his body and tainting his soul, never allowing it to return to Od Lagna.''“Should I renounce this oath, my soul shall be tainted and my flesh enveloped and burned away by purifying flame. And my soul shall fall into the void, never to return to Od Lagna again.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Closing Chapter, Section 5. Roswaal's curse mark appears as a dark blue circle with a pale-blue carving of the crest of House Mathers displayed in the circle's center. ===Equipment=== [[File:Roswaal's Book of Wisdom.png|thumb|right|250px|Roswaal's Book of Wisdom.]] *'''[[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]]''' (叡智の書, '' Eichi no Sho''): Just like Beatrice, Roswaal was given one of the two imperfect replicas of the Book of Wisdom Echidna created before her ultimate demise. It allows Roswaal to use a limited version of the original Book of Wisdom, as it shows him a detailed path to his desired future. For four centuries, Roswaal strictly acted upon the Book's writ, doing exactly as it was written. The Book was destroyed by Ram at the end of Arc 4. The ashes were later collected by Otto Suwen, in an attempt to repair the book and hopefully read about Roswaal's plans. Unbeknownst to Otto, however, his actions would prompt the Witch Cult into action, in the very next story arc. *'''Roswaal's Black Gloves''' (ロズワールの黒手袋, ''Rozuwāru no Kuro-Tebukuro''): The gloves are a special piece of equipment supposedly left behind by Roswaal's ancestors. They are said to be able to stop the cutting edge of a holy sword. *'''Sais''': In Arc 7, due to the necessity that he restrain his use of magic, Roswaal donned a pair of sais in combat, which he used to excellently defend against Olbart’s attacks.''What had stopped that reckless clash from becoming a reality was a distinctively shaped dagger cutting between Garfiel’s neck and Olbart’s kicking foot―― Rather than having blades, however, the weapon possessed parts to strike with. Called a sai, it was an obscure weapon often employed in the western country of Kararagi, and even Garfiel was now seeing it for the first time.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 105, Section 1. ==Trivia== *All Roswaals' middle names follow the English alphabet thematically. **Starting with his original body, Roswaal has been changing his middle initial every time he possesses a new descendant. His first incarnation was named '''Roswaal A. Mathers''' (ロズワール・A・メイザース ''Rozuwāru A Meizāsu''), making his current body his 12th one. **His name at birth before changing it to Roswaal was '''Altair Mathers''' (アルタイル・メイザース ''Arutairu Meizāsu''). [[Wikipedia:Altair|Altair]] is the name of the brightest star in the constellation of Aquila and the twelfth brightest star in the night sky. The name Altair is Arabic in origin and has the same meaning as the name of the constellation Aquila in Latin; that is, they both mean simply "eagle". The association between the Mathers family and their crest, the hawk, may be a potential reference to Altair's name. *In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], Roswaal originally possessed the '''Divine Protection of Sorcery''' (魔導の加護 ''Madō no Kago''), which made him compatible with all six elements of magic. However, although this Divine Protection was removed in the Light Novel, Roswaal still retains this power. *According to the author, Roswaal's birthday is September 16. *Roswaal L. Mathers stated he has no sense of taste since a long time ago, a secret which only Clind and Annerose knew of before he revealed it to Petra at a banquet during [[Arc 5]].''"Hmm? It's very siiimple. ...After all, I have no sense of taste. It is only natural that I can't enjoy the taste of cooking."'' [[Petra's Emilia Camp Struggle / Page 4]], Section 2. *He has a habit of putting the crest of his family, a Hawk, into possessions and in clothes of people who live with him. It can be seen clearly in the sleeves of Emilia's outfit and in the cape of Subaru's knight outfit. *In the novelization of Arc 4, Roswaal is crueler than in the web novel, according to the author. *Despite having hired Elsa Granhiert in Arcs 1 and 4, he did not hire Meili Portroute in Arcs 2 and 4. *Roswaal has read every single book in the Forbidden Library. *The author has stated that even if Roswaal were to learn that Echidna from the Castle of Dreams resurrected as [[Omega]], he would still need to kill the "Dragon" to fulfil his goal of resurrecting his teacher Echidna from 400 years ago, those two things being unrelated.''“He totally does. It's unrelated.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1041278658827059201 Roswaal Birthday Q&A] *Wilhelm van Astrea is one of the few people Roswaal harbors genuine respect for their way of living and their convictions. *According to Roswaal K. Mathers, it's an unspoken agreement that after accepting the family name "Roswaal", the current head will not share their personal name with anyone.''"It’s an unspoken agreement for us to hide our former names after we change them."'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Curtain's Close]], Section 1. *According to Toska, Roswaal's mansion was identical to Echidna's, implying he modelled it after his teacher's.''According to the 150-year-old Toska, Roswaal's mansion looks exactly like Echidna's mansion. In other words, Roswaal built his mansion on the model of Echidna's.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]] *The author once stated that if Roswaal wished to, he'd likely be able to defeat the Great Rabbit, as long as he wouldn't pay any attention to his surroundings. He also added that there's a very small chance he'd get overwhelmed by their numbers, or he'd run out of mana. *In the web novel, the original Roswaal was mentioned to have "dark-gray" hair and yellow eyes by Echidna.''"The Roswaal you are talking about, does he happen to be a someone with long, dark grey hair? His eyes would be... yellow, I think, if I remember correctly."'' [[Arc 4]], Chapter 12. His hair color was then changed to "navy" later on his first appearance.''"Facing the youth who practically skated up to her to stop her basket from dropping, Ryuzu quickly bowed her head. Seeing this, the boy raked his fingers through his long navy hair."'' [[Arc 4]], Chapter 101, Section 2. However, he still had yellow eyes in contrast of his blue eyes seen in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 13|Volume 13]].''"At the sight of the sad smile rising onto Roswaal's lips, Ryuzu shuddered, wondering if she had upset him. But before she could say anything to salvage the situation, Roswaal blinked his yellow eyes as if having spotted something."'' [[Arc 4]], Chapter 101, Section 2. *Roswaal never once managed to have the aptitude for healing magic through all of his incarnations. Even introducing [[Garitch Fabless]]'s bloodline didn't remedy this fact, as mentioned in [[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica]]. *In 2014, the author stated that Roswaal was among nine known characters introduced in the story up to that point who had the highest capacity for holding mana. However, he chose to not rank Roswaal or any of the other listed characters in order.''“Emilia, Roswaal, Echidna, Typhon, Carmilla, Daphne, Ferris, Priscilla, and Mimi have a large capacity. It’s scary to rank them, considering the future, so I will stop…”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/499581653728378880 2014 AskFM Q&A] It is unknown if the list has changed since then. *At a talk show with the author held on March 30, 2024, when someone asked who would make up the Nine Divine Generals of Lugunica if it existed, Roswaal was one of the names he listed. *Roswaal A. Mathers's birthday was decided at a talk show held on July 26, 2026. *According to the author, the only other weakness that Roswaal possibly has besides healing magic is that he is bad at communicating since he believes nobody will like him no matter what he does, and he dresses like a clown to leave a bad impression so that it is easier to deal with their fixed impression of him.''"Hmm, Roswaal’s weak point… He can do pretty much anything, but probably communicate with others. He can tell the good and bad in interests and disadvantages in negotiations, but he can’t understand other people’s emotions or how others feel towards him. He wants to control other people and thinks that nobody will like him for any reason. Subaru also has a similar trait. This also includes the fact that he is always dressed up as a clown. Dressing up in such a weird appearance gives the other person a bad impression. Subaru also acts like that and is often looked down by others. He does that because it’s easy to treat them when their impression is fixed. Subaru and Roswaal are pretty similar in that they are bad at communicating. They often try to progress things in fields they are good at. That’s why they get confused when someone does something different from their expectations. That’s probably Roswaal’s weak point. Probably worse than Healing Magic."'' Re:Zero 10th Anniversary Space. *According to the author, Puck can put more power into fire mana than Roswaal can, while Roswaal is more skillful with it.''"If it’s skillfully, then Roswaal. If it’s strongly, then Puck."'' AskFM Q&A. *According to the author, the compatibility between Roswaal and [[Carmilla]] couldn't be worse.''"Roswaal would hate being forced to love Camilla despite having no interest in her, and Carmilla would dislike Roswaal for not loving her, so it pretty much couldn’t be worse."''
