[https://7dsgc.fandom.com/wiki/Red_Reinhard Seven Deadly Sins Grand Cross] (As Re:Zero Crossover Collab event character) |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Yuichi Nakamura (voice actor)|Nakamura Yuichi]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Robbie Daymond|Robbie Daymond]]}} '''Reinhard van Astrea''' (ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア) is the current Sword Saint, the strongest being in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], a member of the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]], and [[Felt]]'s knight. Though absent for the majority of the main story, he played major roles in [[Arc 1]], [[Arc 5]], [[Arc 9]], and [[Arc 10]], and a lesser supporting role in [[Arc 3]]. He was also one of the main protagonists of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]], and he played a lesser supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. Born to [[House Astrea]], Reinhard mastered the sword at a young age following the untimely death of his [[Theresia van Astrea|grandmother]] and succeeded her as the next Sword Saint a few years later. However, due to his immense power and various problems in his own family, Reinhard lives a rough life estranged from his family. Despite this, he is a knight willing to use his power to protect the Kingdom of Lugunica. After fending off the [[Elsa Granhiert|Bowel Hunter]] during the [[Loot House Incident]], he discovered the last of the [[Royal Selection]] Candidates, Felt, and he subsequently pledged his loyalty to her as her knight. ==Appearance== Reinhard stands at exactly six feet tall, making him several inches taller than [[Natsuki Subaru]]. His most striking feature is his distinct flaming red hair that shines as brightly as Felt's crimson eyes. His sparkling blue eyes portray a sense of confidence and recklessness. His slender frame features an array of well-toned muscles, although they're usually hidden by his clothing. The Sword Saint exuded an aura of gallantry, and, at a first glance, he gave off an intimidating air that indicated him as someone who is above the norm. His extraordinarily handsome face, beyond average looks and his open, calming and approachable personality makes him very popular with people, which catches the eye of many women, further exemplifying his magnificence. As a member of House Astrea, Reinhard's flaming red hair and sky-blue eyes were traits passed down from the first Sword Saint [[Reid Astrea]], and, in Reinhard's case, inherited from his father [[Heinkel Astrea]]. However, the visual similarities between Reinhard and his father more-or-less ended there. Instead, many of Reinhard's features were taken from his mother, [[Louanna Astrea]]. The two of them share the same jawline, cheek bones, nose, and eye shape. Felt once commented on the striking visual similarities between Reinhard and the Sleeping Beauty. Reinhard's casual attire is nearly as regal as the uniform he can be usually seen wearing as a member of the Kingdom's Royal Guard. It consists of a well-made black shirt that he also wears as part of his uniform, white trousers with lilac cuffs, black shoes, black gloves, and a double-breasted white long coat with a cutaway front, rolled cuffs, lapels, and lilac lining. The crest of the House Astrea can be seen proudly pictured on the upper part of Reinhard's left sleeve, and a black belt is fastened tightly around his waist. With it, Reinhard fastens his esteemed [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword]] whenever he has to go out. ==Personality== As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard acts with a high degree of chivalry and elegance, addressing everyone with an unnaturally high level of respect. He is fair, clean, brave, and willing to go out of his way in the name of justice no matter if he's in the line of duty or simply strolling through the [[Royal Capital]]. Of course, Reinhard does not believe himself worthy as the current Sword Saint, and often, rather than introducing himself as the Sword Saint, he will instead call himself a descendant of the line of Sword Saints. He is known as the Knight Amongst Knights and is widely trusted among the people of the Royal Capital of Lugunica. As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the [[Witch Cult]]. Having said that, when Reinhard is truly needed, he swiftly deals with every threat in a matter of seconds. Most of the time, his presence and name alone are enough to send normal thugs running away, and according to [[Garfiel Tinzel]], there is even a saying that no one can run from him. He mentioned that his specialty is fighting monsters, but his power is so great that upon unleashing just one of his attacks, Subaru already considered him another monster. Reinhard considered this as an offensive comment, implying that he does not like being judged as someone dangerous even when he has good intentions. Despite not being fond of being referred to, with degrading titles and nicknames, Reinhard is a daily target of scorn and annoyance for his fellow members of the [[Felt Camp]], including Felt, [[Gaston|Ton]], [[Rachins Hoffman|Chin]], and [[Camberley|Kan]]. Despite that, he always brushes it off with a gentle smile, which usually pisses off the group even more, subjecting the knight to even more scorn than before. Despite such unfriendly relationships, however, Reinhard is always prepared to go an extra mile and help them out when in trouble, even when they don't explicitly ask for it. As their mentor and knight, however, Reinhard can also be pretty stern. Chin, for example, will refrain from using his Fire Magic to call Reinhard as, if the Sword Saint doesn't deem the situation dire, he will not hesitate to scold him and apprehend him if necessary. This strict attitude is often aimed at his mistress as well. Reinhard expressed dissatisfaction and even anger, on multiple occasions, such as when Felt carelessly entered the room where Louanna Astrea sleeps, in the Astrea Manor located in the Royal Capital. He is always looking for a way to solve things, even to the point of giving a Sin Archbishop the opportunity to surrender while hoping he will not have to take extreme measures, such as being forced to kill him. In his fight against [[Regulus Corneas]], he even went as far as asking him to stop and leave the city, even after the Sin Archbishop had already killed him and decimated everything in their vicinity. He also respects the decision of his friends, despite the fact that sometimes they criticize him for engaging in matters that do not correspond to him. Due to his unparalleled strength, however, Reinhard is usually the one people turn to when trouble calls, no matter what their relationship with him is. Although hesitant, Reinhard was willing to practice lethal force on his opponents in the event it was absolutely necessary. An example of this was when he killed the Imperial spy [[Miles]] for trying to escape the Kingdom atop a Flying Dragon after Reinhard had ordered him to disembark. On the other hand, however, he is heavily against tactics that revolve around suicidal attacks, and he will do what he can to prevent the assailants' deaths. Despite the role his paternal grandparents played in the [[Demi-Human War]], as well as the general anti-demi-human policy employed by citizens of Lugunica, Reinhard held no discrimination against those of demi-human ancestry. Reinhard respects the rules of duels and will usually accept them if offered, such as when Regulus offered to duel a "knight" while he was attempting to goad Subaru or when [[Cecilus Segmunt]] challenged him to a duel. However, he finds it disrespectful and insulting when such a duel is reneged upon, and in the case of criminals like Regulus, he will immediately attack in response. Despite being aware of his own immense strength, Reinhard is still vulnerable to matters that concern the people he is close to or has a particular fondness for. Upon Felt being held hostage by Heinkel, Reinhard obeyed his command not to move because he did not want to take any risks. When his father was claimed to be taken hostage by [[Al|Aldebaran]], he was willing to halt his attacks temporarily in order to secure the safety of his father, which led to his confrontation with an [[Satella|ancient Witch]] that was set up prior. When an unknown threat was levied upon [[Rom]], Reinhard, though extremely reluctant, allowed himself to be used by the corrupted government so as to avoid said threat, something which resulted in the ruination of potential friendships. Even in the Gluttony IF, after Subaru began to go on a rampage, Reinhard was deeply saddened by how his friend had fallen and provided support to those who had fallen victim to Subaru. As a five-year-old child, Reinhard was a very sweet and timid kid, stuttered a lot, and easily got shocked or surprised. As he deeply loved his father, he was willing to do everything in his power to help him, even going as far as obtaining a Divine Protection of Mind-Changing in order to help Heinkel convince [[Marcos Gildark]] to rejoin the Royal Knight Order; however, after the Astrea Manor was attacked by a group of men led by then-fourteen-year-old [[Russell Fellow]], Heinkel pleaded to Reinhard to never use the Divine Protection again. Reinhard fell in a state of shock and immediately locked off and erased his newly gained Divine Protection. Considering his monstrous power, however, Reinhard, even as a child, was easily capable of sending shivers down grown and battle-hardened men's spines, by simply looking into their eyes and voicing a demand with a somewhat intimidating voice. ==History== ===Early Life=== Reinhard was born the son of Heinkel Astrea and Louanna Astrea. He was loved by everyone. His grandmother's first thought upon seeing him was that he was "a child loved by the world". Two years after his birth, his mother fell into a Sleeping Beauty state, which shook the whole Astrea family to its core. ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica]]=== Roughly 15 years before the events of the main story, Reinhard helped his father, who was trying to convince Marcos Gildark to re-join the Royal Knights. After the latter failed in verbally convincing him, Reinhard took it upon himself to help out his father through any means necessary. He immediately received the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing, which he used to change Marcos' mind, resulting in the latter to swiftly re-join the knights. However, by doing so, he proved to be a threat and alerted a third party to the use of the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing. That night, a group of disguised individuals entered the Astrea Manor located in the Noble District of the Royal Capital. Initially suspecting Heinkel for insurrection on the grounds that he had seemingly used the Divine Protection, after they explained why they came, Heinkel quickly realized it was Reinhard's doing, running to find his son in his room. Heinkel embraced his son and told him he not to use the power again, pleading to the intruders not to take his son away. Reinhard, now scared, immediately deactivated and removed his Divine Protection. After the masked men had already left the mansion, however, he saw a man through a window who mouthed to him a sentence that stuck with Reinhard ever since: “If you care about your family, do your best to serve the kingdom.". ===Post-[[Great Conquest]]=== One year later, at the age of five, while hoping to become the Sword Saint for his father's sake, he obtained the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, and subsequently, the title, while his grandmother Theresia van Astrea lost the protection while she was fighting a fierce [[Great Conquest|battle]] with the [[White Whale]], leading to her demise. His grandfather, [[Wilhelm van Astrea]], blamed Reinhard for her death after Reinhard told him that she did not lose as the Sword Saint since he was now the Sword Saint, causing their relationship to plummet, leaving only his father who still cared about him. Sadly, his relationship with his father gravely deteriorated as well. After he gained the aforementioned Divine Protection, his father became an alcoholic and supposedly gradually started to blame him for Theresia's death as well. At some point, he also defeated [[Rickert Hoffman]] in a duel. At age 8, Reinhard was responsible for repelling the forces of all of the other three of the Four Great Nations.''Once, when the Sword Saint was even younger than Petra was now, there had been a plot by the three other Great Nations besides Lugunica to attempt to simultaneously infiltrate the Kingdom. His achievement in singlehandedly crushing their ambitions had filled the hearts of many of the Kingdom’s citizens with hope, driving home the grandeur of the current generation Sword Saint into the populace.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 18, Section 2. As a result, he received his honorary title of “van”, and later that same year, the “Reinhard Law”, deeming him a national threat, was passed, effectively rendering the young boy unable to travel and move outside the Kingdom.''"The 'Reinhard Law' was passed when Reinhard was eight years old. It was the same year that Reinhard changed his name to Van."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/774557124936413185 Author Tweet]. ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]=== Around three months after the destruction of the [[Oni]] village, a 9-or-so-year-old Reinhard came across [[Rem]] and a beastified [[Frederica Baumann]] facing off against Witch Cultists. Stepping in, he offered to deal with them so that the girl could chase after the escaping [[Sado]]. After the ran off, he easily dealt with the cultists and captured them alive, and after leaving them with the guards, he chased after the girls. Deciding to watch over the scene of Sado's corpse, the girls left so Frederica could revert back to her original form. ===[[First Mission Part 1|First Mission]]=== When Reinhard was fourteen, a certain organization that produced and distributed the Hexcel drug ran rampant in the Royal Capital. Due to the suspicion that he was providing the organization information on the knights' activities, Heinkel was put under house arrest to be investigated, which resulted in Reinhard deciding to cross-dress and go undercover to infiltrate the organization. Going by the name Adelheid, he successfully managed to infiltrate the organization, and with help from [[Julius Juukulius]], [[Reiner Wahrheit]] and his [[Minor Characters#Easley Oruon|accomplice]] were arrested, resulting in their organization being brought down. Afterward, Reinhard spoke to the [[Six Tongues]] to promote Heinkel to Deputy Commander of the Royal Knights. Later, after Heinkel was informed of his promotion, suspecting the Reinhard was the reason for it, he confronted him in a tavern and questioned his involvement. However, Reinhard denied his involvement and convinced Heinkel to take the promotion for Louanna. Deciding to take it, Heinkel gave Reinhard permission to join the knights when he became of age. Reinhard went on to relay this to [[Belmont]], an operative of the Six Tongues, and swore to him that he would never swing the sword for the sake of the organization the young man belonged to. One year later, Reinhard joined the knights, becoming the strongest weapon in the Kingdom's arsenal. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]=== During a [[Raid of Argyle Manor|rescue mission]] involving [[Crusch Karsten]] and the House of Argyle, Marcos Gildark tasked Reinhard to keep an eye on [[Fourier Lugunica|Fourier]] and the knights accompanying him. While Julius and the rest of the knights were disposing of the [[Undead|reanimated corpses]], Miles, who was the culprit behind the incident, tried to make his escape, ignoring Reinhard's warnings, and refusing to surrender. After his attempt to get rid of Reinhard had failed, the latter was forced to incinerate him along with his Flying Dragon as he could not allow the valuable information to reach the [[Vincent Vollachia|Vollachian Emperor]]. ===Months during the Royal Family’s plague=== After the entire Royal Family fell victim to a [[Royal Plague|mysterious disease]] which slowly killed them off one by one, Reinhard was tasked to reach the [[Flugel|Sage]] in order to find a cure for the incurable illness. When approaching the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], however, he was unable to pass through the Sand Time and was forced to retreat. Due to the mission's failure, every member of the Royal Family succumbed to the illness,''"He had been ordered to seek out the Sage, famously said to be all-knowing, in hopes of finding some way to counteract the plague that was devastating the Lugunica Royal Family"'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 6. subsequently resulting in Reinhard blaming himself for their deaths.''"Both of them felt that the kingdom, the royal line, had died out because they hadn't been strong enough."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 6. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly 4 to 5 months prior to the events of the series, a couple of months after the entire Lugunican royal family died, Emperor Vincent Vollachia invited Reinhard to the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] alongside two members of the Council of Wise Men in order to negotiate a non-aggression pact. In order to at least partially suppress Reinhard's power, he was forced to wear a so-called [[Meteor#Collar of Subservience|Collar of Subservience]], a [[Meteor|meteor]] which suppresses its wearer's powers.''Reinhard let his fingers fall to his neck and brush the Collar of Subservience. So long as he wore it, he would be unable to make use of his full strength.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed, Section 9. The three of them would by accompanied by Julius and [[Ferris]]. After the initial negotiations ended on a rather negative note, Reinhard wad summoned to the Emperor's chambers, where he suddenly found himself surrounded by corpses of the guards and one of the Nine Divine Generals, [[Balleroy Temeglyph]]. Having been accused of attacking the guards, Reinhard had no other option but to take Vincent hostage and escape with Julius and Ferris. While they were running away from the whole Vollachian army, the Sixth and Eighth Divine Generals, [[Groovy Gumlet]] and [[Moguro Hagane]], attacked the trio in an effort to retrieve the kidnapped Emperor. While Ferris and Julius were preoccupied with securing the Emperor's life, Reinhard fought the two Generals barehanded and defeated them without suffering any damage whatsoever. Not long after, Cecilus Segmunt himself made his debut and attacked Julius, almost managed to decapitate him when Reinhard returned, used Cecilus' broken katana to deflect all of Blue Lightning's strikes and delivered a devastating kick, knocking the famed Divine General out instantly. After the three Generals made their retreat, the three Royal Guards were attacked by 30 highly skilled and feared Vollachian assassins from the [[Insect Cage Tribe]]; Reinhard made quick work of them as well, defeating all 30 of them without killing a single one or taking a hit. After Reinhard's awe-inspiring display of power, Vincent was able to safely return to the Crystal Palace where he apprehended the culprits and officially signed the non-aggression pact between the Kingdom of Lugunica and the Vollachia Empire. Roughly one month after the Empire incident, Reinhard was sent off on an escort mission to the Kingdom's border with the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom of Gusteko]]. When he returned to the Royal Capital, Cecilus Segmunt was waiting for him, requesting a rematch, though, this time, he had the [[Enchanted Sword#Fiend Sword Murasame|Fiend Sword]] and the [[Enchanted Sword#Dream Sword Masayume|Dream Sword]] with him, setting on showing him just how powerful he is. After Marcos arranged a proxy match between the Sword Saint and the Blue Lightning, Reinhard was finally able to fight the famed Vollachian General for real, and after both drew their blades, they fought. Both of them have survived the duel, Reinhard with next to no injuries and Cecilus with relatively notable gashes all over his body, and they resolved to claim the end of the fight as a draw. ===[[Felt-chan's Imprisonment Life]]=== After the Loot House Incident, Felt woke up to find herself naked in an unfamiliar room. Reinhard appeared and said that her clothes were currently being washed and that they would be returned soon. In her frustration, she asked where they were and why Reinhard brought her there, to which he revealed that he brought her to the rarely used Astrea Manor in the Royal Capital. Afterward, he gave her another insignia, and after it shined in her hand, he explained that it meant that she was chosen by fate and needed to appear at the castle. This angered her, and though when she attempted to deceive him by asking for a pair of clothes to wear, she attempted to escape, only to easily be caught. Reinhard claimed that if she was able to escape the manor, then he would not go after her. However, he and the servants would attempt to prevent her from doing so. Inside, the [[Carol Remendis|maid]] had prepared a dress for her in place of her ordinary clothes, and Reinhard asked her to wear what they had at the manor while she was there. ===[[Felt-chan Saw!]]=== Ten days after being brought to the manor, Reinhard went to the guardhouse to check on Rom. When he returned, he found Felt in his mother's room, and when she got suspicious if Reinhard had kidnapped someone else, Reinhard appeared and said that the woman was his mother, Louanna Astrea, and that due to unknown reasons, she was in the Sleeping Beauty state. When she exited the room, Reinhard asked her not to tell anyone about her and thanked her for her concern. Afterward, he informed Felt that Rom ran away from the guardhouse during his treatment, to which she claimed he was fine. Looking at him, she claimed that Reinhard did look like his mother, which seemed to make him happy, though Felt was still annoyed by him keeping her there. ===[[Felt-chan Rises to the Center Stage]]=== On the way to the Royal Castle, Felt, who had lost a bet to Reinhard, started to kick at him in annoyance. She ultimately failed to hit him even once, and she asked once more where they were headed. Though Reinhard wanted to keep it a secret, they reached the castle, much to her frustration. Inside the castle, Reinhard left her side for a time. ===[[Felt-chan Gathers Thugs]]=== Felt, Reinhard, and Rom were on a carriage on their way back from the Royal Selection Ceremony. Rom and Reinhard had a cryptic conversation regarding a kidnapping that happened years ago and the incident of the old royal guards being restructured. Felt asked the carriage to stop at the Loot House in the slums, as Felt wished to see what remained of it. While Felt inspected the slums with her camp, she found Gaston, Rachins, and Camberley running away and badly injured. They decided to attempt to rob her to make enough money to get away from Lugunica, as they had attempted to trick Russell Fellow into a shady business that did not end well for them, and they were now marked for death by him. Reinhard easily defeated one of them as the others attempted to run, but they were intercepted by Felt while she was scolding Reinhard, as letting them run away would mean they would be dead by Russell's capable henchman the next day. She then recruited the trio for her camp in hopes of using their help for ruining the country. ===[[Felt-chan Forms a Hooligan Squad]]=== Felt sat with the trio of thugs to discuss with them, and after some talk and a bit of resistance from them, she eventually convinced them to help destroy the country, as she thought they had similar views to her. Later on at night, Reinhard had a secret meeting with Grimm and Carol, commenting how the events that transpired confirmed that his choice to follow Felt was the correct one and that he felt a little guilty that he would use her to make the Astrea family name rise to glory again. Changing the main subject, the old lady asks if they really should allow their master to get near Reinhard's mother, as they feared what could come of the encounter. Reinhard stated that he cannot deny him this, as it was his right, and he mentioned that he would soon leave with Felt to take care of other matters, thanking the both of them for everything they had done. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 1|Riot in Flanders]]=== Following the events of Arc 3, Reinhard, alongside Felt, visited [[Flanders]] to meet with the heads of the city's Big Three. Finding [[Ezzo Cadner]] along the way and preventing a conflict between Camberley and the dwarf, they decided to allow him to go along with them as they went to greet the proprietress of the Flower Prison Garden, [[Toto]]. On one night a few days later, a lackey of a [[Mozolite|high-ranking member]] of The Balance murdered one of Ezzo's students, [[Mimosa]], and set fire to the building they were in, framing Ezzo for arson. Investigating the incident, Reinhard and company obtained information that he was in an abandoned mansion that was provided to him by [[Helaine Gatness]]. After arriving there, the two confronted each other. Though Ezzo did succeed in bypassing Reinhard's unique constitution, he was unable to defeat him. Afterward, Ezzo informed them of the truth of the fire at the brothel and requested their help in his pursuit of revenge for Mimosa's death. When they were surrounded at the mansion, he made a mask and wove a Cognitive Disruption spell within it so Reinhard could fend off their attackers, while he, wearing a similar mask, accompanied [[Flam Remendis]] and Rachins to confront Helaine. In the end, they successfully took down the arson, indebted the leaders of the Big Three to the Felt Camp, and managed to get Ezzo to join the camp. ===[[Lugunican Papers Part 2|Lugunican Papers]]=== In the year that followed the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], Felt was requested an interview by [[Shorty Megan]] and [[Lululala]]. Meeting at the Astrea Manor, Shorty witnessed the usual interaction between Felt and Reinhard, which he felt was peculiar. Likewise with the other candidates, Felt gave her opinion on the Royal Selection and the other candidates. Having both grown up in the slums of the Royal Capital, they both understood the plight of the people there and were able to agree on numerous things. In the end, Lululala drew an image of Felt and Reinhard, which Felt felt dismayed about. ===[[Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 4]]=== Following the [[Battle for Priestella]], after hearing Garfiel's resolve not to lose to Reinhard when he was speaking to [[Otto Suwen]], Felt visited the injured Otto with Reinhard in tow and teased him. Though Otto found it funny thinking that he used to call himself a humble merchant and that he seemed to have gone pretty far from that ideal, Felt sympathized, but she claimed that duty called and she had to fight. Afterward, though she joked that she was there to visit him to help eat the fruits he'd been gifted, she was there to thank him for his assistance, both in the battle with [[Lye Batenkaitos]] and Heinkel before that, and Reinhard agreed with her gratitude. Felt also claimed that they had a debt towards Otto now, which made Otto twist his expression unconsciously. Then, Felt and Reinhard took their leave, leaving Otto thinking about work. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 1|The Lion’s Ferocity]]=== Later, Reinhard and Felt were tasked with escorting the [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Wrath]] to the Royal Capital. Though the journey was to last no more than a month, due to Sirius’s abnormal attraction of trouble, their arrival was delayed by a month. Upon arriving, Reinhard took it upon himself to bring Wrath into the Prison Tower, asking Felt to remain behind due to the nature of what was within the tower being rather disturbing. After coming out, he and Felt attended dinner with Russell Fellow, where they showed their abnormal relationship. There, they also discussed the increasing heretic hunts of Gusteko, the declining balance of power between [[Kararagi]]’s mayors, and signs of a [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] in Vollachia. ===[[The Dragon Nation / Meili's Witchbeast Observation Record|Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record]]=== A short time after the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], Reinhard appeared with Felt to take part in a meeting with the Council of Wise Men, [[Annerose Miload]], and [[Meili Portroute]]. Naturally, his presence set Meili on edge, but he was able to move past it rather quickly. After hearing of the prospects of a second expedition with Meili’s guidance in exchange for being pardoned, Reinhard and several other members of the Felt Camp were tasked with reaching the Pleiades Watchtower and investigating it. During their travels through the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] attacked them to protect the tower, leaving Reinhard to defend the party. Fortunately, Meili presented Volcanica’s talon, and they were allowed passage into the tower. There, they came across the Books of the Dead, which Meili explained to them, much to the fascination of Ezzo. Understanding their importance, Felt suggested Reinhard find the book of his grandmother, and though he was hesitant to do so, when Felt persuaded him to find it at some point, he was grateful. Shortly after, they noticed the same birds that Subaru and [[Eridna]] had witnessed before. With one captured for study, Ezzo quickly discovered its true nature, and the [[Shaula|crimson scorpion]] killed it in his hands. Realizing the birds were being used to spy, Ezzo and Reinhard set to killing them all. Deciding to return to the capital, they left Ezzo and Flam at the tower. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== On numerous occasions, Reinhard has been proclaimed to be the strongest character within the series, both by the author and by the characters within the story. Reinhard's level of strength, skill, and survivability are so ridiculously absurd that it is effectively impossible to defeat him no matter how much one plans, with the only ways to deal with him being to take hostages to force coercion or by providing him with a threat that he is incapable of ignoring; even throwing him to the moon and killing him cannot spell his defeat. His strength is such that he could fight against any of the world's other strongest combatants and always come out victorious, including the Blue Lightning, the [[Halibel|Admirer]], the [[Puck|Beast of the End]], and even go toe to toe with the Sin Archbishop of Greed and Witch of Envy, and it is because he is so impossibly powerful that the other three of the Four Great Nations had a law specifically made to keep Reinhard within the country. Furthermore, with his numerous and ever-growing list of Divine Protections, he is effectively incapable of having his strength inhibited and can become stronger through all kinds of methods, though even without his Divine Protection, he would still be impossible to defeat. ===[[Divine Protection]]s=== '''Divine Protection Acquisition''': Reinhard has the ability to request any Divine Protection he feels like he needs in a specific situation and permanently keep them. This gives him access to a [[Divine Protection#Reinhard’s various Divine Protections|wide array of Divine Protections]]. His requests may be granted to him by [[Od Lagna]], which is even capable of creating new Divine Protections that have never existed before, but sometimes there may be an error in conveying his intention, and Reinhard does not receive a proper Divine Protection. Furthermore, it should be noted that Reinhard has not been stated to receive any ability he wishes as a Divine Protection, meaning that any desired abilities must first exist as a Divine Protection. '''Divine Protection Erasure''': He can also erase Divine Protections from his possession, as seen when he gained and erased his Divine Protection of Mind-Changing when he was a five-year-old child, before he even became the Sword Saint. However, while he is able to request a Divine Protection if only one of it can exist at a time and another individual is already in possession of it, as is the case with Meili Portroute and her [[Meili Portroute#Divine Protection|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]], he chooses not to request such a power after he accidentally took the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint from his grandmother, as taking it left her without it. '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Sword Saint|Divine Protection of the Sword Saint]]''' (剣聖の加護 ''Kensei no Kago''): As the current generation's Sword Saint, Reinhard is the current possessor of the title's respective Divine Protection, which he inherited when he was 5 years old after the passing of his grandmother, the previous generation's Sword Saint Theresia van Astrea. This Divine Protection allowed Reinhard to instantly reach the very zenith of his swordsman potential. Immediately after receiving it, the five-year-old boy swiftly defeated the current Deputy-Commander of the Royal Knights and his father, Heinkel, in a duel. The Divine Protection also allows Reinhard to see the trajectories of incoming attacks in form of white rays, be it sword or axe slashes, or incoming arrows or knives; by simply following the optimal path showed to him by the Sword God, Reinhard will parry every single incoming attack, hit every weak spot of enemies and come out victorious. According to the author, even if he didn't have this Divine Protection, Reinhard's sword skills would be the same.''"In the end, even without the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, Reinhard would be pretty much the same."'' '''[[Divine Protection#Reinhard's various Divine Protections|Various Divine Protections]]''': Reinhard holds an insanely rich arsenal of Divine Protections. While he has numerous combat-oriented protections, he also has apparently useless or variably specific protections as well: being able to cook various things well, perform art perfectly, having lightning not strike him, having his view unobstructed by fog, revitalizing plant life around him, dress fashionably for any occasion, tell apart salt from sugar, etc. In total, Reinhard is said to possess at least 251 Divine Protections, as calculated by Al,''――Based on Aldebaran’s prior knowledge and what he had identified after eight-thousand clashes, Reinhard possessed at least two-hundred-and-fifty-one Divine Protections.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40]], Chapter 1, Section 3. and the amount of them will not stop growing as long as he feels like he needs them. *'''Revival''': Due to having the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Phoenix|Divine Protection of the Phoenix]], Reinhard is capable of coming back to life even after he has been killed, recovering from any and all wounds that were inflicted upon him.''The important thing was that through the activation of this Divine Protection, Reinhard van Astrea, as its holder, would be resurrected from his lost life, and when that occurred, all of his injuries, fatal or not, would undergo a complete recovery.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 6, Section 10. With each revival, he obtains another version of this Divine Protection, essentially preventing him from dying at all. Also, he can choose the location in which he revives, and he can use this aspect to effectively teleport to any location in the world at the temporary cost of his life.''That was the other extraordinary effect carried by the Divine Protection of the Phoenix, the flames of rebirth that allowed the deceased holder to resurrect at any location they desired.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 6, Section 10. *'''Projectile Repulsion''': Thanks to one of his Divine Protections, the majority of attacks that revolve around firing a projectile at Reinhard will curve around him as if a barrier were wrapped around him. *'''Excellent Teacher''': Reinhard is shown to be an excellent teacher, and with the assistance of a teaching and training related Divine Protection, he can dramatically improve a person's fighting capabilities. His teaching has allowed someone such as Gaston to discover how to utilize the Flow Method, and in the non-canon Greed If, he was even responsible for training Garfiel, who he had claimed was improving by the day. *'''Superhuman Stealth''': All of Reinhard's movements are completely silent due to a Divine Protection he received at birth. The ability is passive, meaning Reinhard doesn't have to think about acting stealthily to do so. Individuals with an enhanced sense of hearing cannot detect Reinhard's approach, even if he isn't trying to be unnoticed. Ferris, who has a greatly enhanced sense of hearing due to his demi-human ears, noted that Reinhard was the only person who had ever successfully snuck up on him. *'''Powerful Resistances''': Thanks to a few Divine Protections, he can reduce the effectiveness of every element of magic by 80%, and he can even resist the effects of explosions and natural (non-magical) fire or water damage. He is immune to magical buffs, debuffs, [[Curse|curse arts]], diseases, toxins/poisons, drugs, alcohol, and becoming sick from other methods, he is heavily resistant to abilities that influence the mind or behaviors such as the [[Sirius Romanée-Conti#Authority|Authority of Wrath]] or reading a Book of the Dead, and he can sense and resist miasma. However, while he can resist miasma, being within a place filled with miasma, such as the Augria Sand Dunes, puts him at his weakest. While this is negligible considering his own immense level of power, he will not receive the assistance of [[spirit]]s in such an environment, and weathering attacks while in this environment means that he cannot rely on them coming to heal him. *'''Various Strengthening Methods''': Several of his Divine Protections provide Reinhard with additional strength when certain criteria are reached: standing beneath blue skies, rainy skies, night skies, morning skies, when he bleeds, etc. *'''Instant Weapons/Item/Riding Mastery''': Thanks to one of his Divine Protections, Reinhard can obtain mastery of any weapon that he gets ahold of, even if he has never seen or heard of the weapon before. However, aside from his hands or swords, Reinhard is uncommonly seen with any other weapon. This also applies to any item he comes across or how to ride vehicles and animals. *'''Anti-Ambushing''': Thanks to some of his Divine Protections, he is unable to be ambushed. Likewise, he is unable to be hit by the first or following strikes at the start of combat unless either he allows it or is unable to avoid the attacks. In a similar manner, he is also able to instinctively know how to avoid taking damage from such attacks, even if he'd never seen them before. *'''Divine Protection Awareness''': During the events of the Battle for Priestella, Reinhard obtained the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Judgement|Divine Protection of Judgement]] that allowed him to learn the Divine Protections that others hold. *'''Empathic Resonance/Telepathy''': During the events of the Battle for Priestella, Reinhard obtained the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Telepathy|Divine Protection of Telepathy]]. With this, he was able to share his thoughts with his friends or allies. *'''Hyper Precision''': Thanks to one of his Divine Protections, any ranged attack that he unleashes will hit its target. *'''Air Dashing''': One of his Divine Protections allows him to kick off of the air a dash through the skies, giving him pseudo-flight. He can move at intense speeds while in the air, as if he were running full speed on the ground. *'''Balancing''': With assistance from his Divine Protections, Reinhard can maintain his balance in various environments, and they also help prevent him from sinking into terrains such as desert sands. He is even able to walk on clouds, and he can walk on water without sinking. He can also use these Divine Protections to walk or run on things that were not meant to be traversed on, such as one of the stars of the Al Shario spell. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Master Swordsman''': Reinhard was born with an inhuman sword talent. He was 5 years old when he received the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint and immediately defeated his father Heinkel Astrea in a duel. At that age, Reinhard was already stronger than the average Royal Knight, only being bested by exceptional and renowned knights such as Julius Juukulius, [[Bordeaux Zergev]], and Marcos Gildark.''"Then he was already strong enough to defeat most of the knights of the Royal Guard."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/947859172619517952 Reinhard Birthday Q&A]. Although not as skilled as the legendary Reid Astrea, Reinhard's skill with the sword is undoubtedly among the most impressive in the current days, perhaps only being rivalled by Cecilus Segmunt. By the time Reinhard turned 8, he was already regarded as a potential national threat, requiring the so-called "Reinhard Law" to keep him within Lugunica. According to the author himself, by that age, Reinhard van Astrea already was among the strongest characters in the series. [[File:Reinhard using the Swordplay of Astrea Family.gif|thumb|275px|Reinhard using an immensely powerful slash to decimate Elsa.]] *'''Maximum Power Sword Slash''': Reinhard unleashes a devastating attack that destroys everything around him and splits space in half. When Reinhard decides to perform the attack, the [[mana]] surrounding him is sucked from the atmosphere and the temperature of the air is noted to drastically drop. His blade begins to give off a brilliant white light and upon slashing down on the opponent, the area in front of him is blown apart, as seen when he blew up the Loot House in Arc 1 and the church in Arc 5. Coupled with his Divine Protection which allows him to always land his first attack, this attack is devastating for the opponent if used as an opening move. Reinhard usually uses it as his opening attack on extremely strong foes like Regulus Corneas. And though strong individuals like Elsa have been able to survive this attack, it is generally capable of vaporizing human beings as shown in the [[Re:Zero EX#Re: Drowning Life in Another World From Zero|Oboreru IF]]. A downside to this technique is that Reinhard requires a weapon in order to perform it, but said weapon, even if of astounding craftsmanship, will be destroyed immediately thereafter. The sole exception appears to be the Dragon Sword Reid, which is said to be indestructible. [[File:Reinhard van Astrea using the Dragon Sword Reid against Beast of the End.gif|thumb|275px|Reinhard using the Dragon Sword Reid to defeat the Beast of the End with one devastating swing.]] *'''A Slash of the Dragon Sword Reid''': Reinhard unsheathes his blade whenever the sword deems Reinhard's opponent worthy of its divine power. Reinhard will take an offensive stance, usually lifting the blade far above his head, preparing himself to end it with a single strike. Similarly to his mana-sucking sword technique, the blade will slowly start to emit a dazzling white light which will soon enough engulf the entire battlefield, blinding the opponents and passers-by. If he's aiming to cleanly dispose of the unlucky foe, he'll swing the blade, cutting everything along its arc, as seen when he fought the previous Sword Saint's reanimated corpse. In his simulated battle against Puck, however, Reinhard used the Dragon Sword in combination with his aforementioned sword skill; with a single swing, the Sword Saint unleashed a destructive wave that incinerated everything in its path, including the Beast of the End. Along the blade's slash the sky split in half, leaving cracks running across it, the ground crumbled and the mana swirled in a vortex, completely destroying the world itself. In the next instant, the world was born anew without any consequences or anomalies left behind. Both attacks are the very peak of what Reinhard van Astrea is capable of doing and what he will do if the situation calls for it. '''Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant''': Due to the Dragon Sword being useless for most of the fights he has to take, Reinhard is most of the times forced to use his bare hands to fight. With his Divine Protection of Unarmed Combat, Reinhard mastered hand-to-hand combat at early age; his hand is more often than not more effective than a sword and can easily bisect a person in half with a single swing of his bare arm. Reinhard skill combined with his inconceivable physical strength makes a deadly opponent to contend with melee combat even without the use of his sword, he utilizes devastating kicks and punches to send opponents flying, along with chops to cleave his opponents or weapons that get in his way. '''Superhuman Strength''': Reinhard's physical strength is immense, surpassing even that of a Dragon's.''In the Empire, Garfiel had even resisted a blow from the Cloud Dragon square-on. Of course, he had not escaped unscathed, but he had managed to withstand it nonetheless. ――But this toughness, he could not endure.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 18, Section 3. He is capable of easily pushing back and defending against opponents as powerful as Elsa Granhiert or a partially transformed Garfiel with ease. He is even able to combat the Divine Dragon's abilities with his pure might. With the various enhancements provided by his Divine Protections, this strength can be enhanced further. Reinhard could also swing the sheathed Dragon Sword hard enough to create a torrent of wind that parted the air around it. Even as a child, merely jumping onto the ground generated enough force to knock down numerous people.''Something was coming down onto the ground from the gigantic outer wall that surrounded the capital. The moment its feet reached the ground, a producing shock wave traveled through the ground, and the crowding black clothed beings went flying.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 5. Reinhard's natural strength was far above that exhibited by regular human beings. With his bare hand he is capable of casually bisecting a human in half with a single swipe. In his mighty grip, sturdy materials like steel would bend and shatter, and on his journey to the Vollachia Empire, he even cut Moguro Hagane's steel limb off with a single swing of his bare hand,''"In all the world, Reinhard might have only been the only person who would ever be capable to sever a solid-steel appendage with an empty-handed technique like that."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 9. whose body possessed the durability to endure attacks from Julius Juukulius's sword without suffering any kind of injury. He is also capable of delivering devastating kicks that shatter the floor on impact and are able to send even a stone golem that weighs a couple hundred kilograms flying without much resistance. '''Superhuman Durability''': It is incredibly difficult to damage Reinhard, whether with one's physical or magical might, due to both his physical enhancements provided by his Flow Method and resistances provided by his Divine Protections. As of yet, the only times he has taken damage were via attacks provided by someone on a similar level to himself like Cecilus, an [[Authority#Authority of Greed|Authority]] that can ignore defenses, or extremely powerful magic such as Al Karum or Magia Railgun. '''Superhuman Speed''': Reinhard is easily able to traverse long distances in mere seconds, navigating through the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]] with ease and swiftness, responding to cries of help in mere 30 seconds, despite him being located on the other side of the city. This ability proves especially effective during fights, as he's easily able to reduce several tens of meters worth of distance between him and his enemies in the blink of an eye. One Divine Protection also boosts his speed, and another allows him to ignore air resistance, giving even greater speed. '''Superhuman Reflexes''': Reinhard can respond to threats in less than a second by moving reflexively, and these reflexes are further improved by his Divine Protections. '''Superhuman Leaping''': With the power of his leg muscles, Reinhard is easily able to leap incredible distances in a single bound. [[Arc 10]], Chapter 18, Section 6. ===[[Magic]]=== '''Defective Gate''': According to Eridna, Reinhard's gate is unable to release the mana inside of his body back out into the atmosphere, though she mentions that he is able to absorb an incredible amount and that it doesn't cause any harm to his body as he uses all of his mana to boost his physical abilities, i.e. the '''Flow Method'''. Because of this, he can make others unable to use any magic or spiritual arts while he's absorbing mana. Also, Reinhard has no affinity with magic, making him unable to use it at all. Furthermore, according to the author, the exact state of Reinhard's Gate at birth is considered a spoiler. [[File:Reinhard putting Felt to sleep.gif|thumb|275px|Reinhard putting Felt to sleep by draining her mana.]] '''Excess Mana Circulation Constitution''' (マナ過剰循環体質, ''Mana Kajō Junkan Taishitsu''): Ever since birth, Reinhard's gate was defective, which means he is unable to use any kind of magic. He can also channel mana into a weapon, increasing its overall strength and durability. Whenever Reinhard absorbs mana, everyone within a certain vicinity of him is unable to use magic through the usage of external mana, as all mana from the atmosphere diverts to him. People aren't the only creatures affected by the diversion of mana Reinhard causes, as spirits are also unable to draw from it. Reinhard can also drain energy from people directly. After years of having to control his own power, Reinhard can control the amount of mana he drains from a person. By draining a small amount of it, Reinhard can induce a state of sleep in his target as shown when he easily put Felt to sleep. He can also potentially absorb enough energy from a person or a spirit to kill or permanently affect/harm them. ===Other=== '''Pseudo Spirit Affinity''': Despite being unable to control them or use magic/spiritual arts, Reinhard is highly attractive towards spirits. The rate at which they heal him is tremendous, and he can even recover entire missing limbs that have been completely destroyed. His attraction of spirits is on par with Julius's Divine Protection of Gathering Spirits, and it is so strong that [[Beatrice]], a great spirit, preferred avoiding him as much as possible, during the events of Arc 5. '''Superhuman Intuition''': Reinhard's intelligence is stated to be average, but his intuition is incredible, meaning he will always take the most optimal decisions,''"His intelligence is normal, but his intuition is incredible, so even when taking a test, he’ll get full marks from giving answering normally. Upon being defeated, Reinhard will simply leap backwards off the field. *According to the author, Reinhard's favorite food is chocolate. *In the [[Re:Zero EX]] chapter commonly referred to as Mimagau IF, Reinhard makes an appearance as a red-haired swordswoman named Adelheid. In the main canon, Reinhard uses the Adelheid persona while crossdressing in the [[First Mission Part 1|First Mission]] side story. *According to the author, Reinhard's favorite snack is similar to and an equivalent of chocolate in the Re:Zero world.''“Uhh, then Reinhard likes chocolates. Reinhard doesn’t particularly dislike sweet things, so I guess this alternative chocolate will do.”'' Re:Zero 10th Anniversary Twitter Space. *Reinhard can sense miasma, although it is unknown if this is separate from being able to smell it.''“A hint of miasma… No wonder the guards were running around the Royal Capital.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 7. *At a talk show with the author held on March 30, 2024, when someone asked who would make up the Nine Divine Generals of Lugunica if it existed, Reinhard was one of the six names he listed. *The first Divine Protection that Reinhard consciously received was the Divine Protection of Salt Reasoning,[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/753910997300056065 Author's Comment]. which was bestowed to him while he was trying to make porridge for his father, Heinkel, who was feeling sick after a hangover.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/731207250585341952 Author's Comment]. *According to the author in a talk show held on April 6th, 2025, among the knights of the Royal Selection candidates, Reinhard is the most popular among them. *When Theresia was still alive, the House's flowerbed was attended to, though they fell to ruin following her demise. After becoming Felt's knight, Felt pushed him to maintain the garden once again, which he does with the aid of a Divine Protection.July 26, 2026 Talk Show *According to the author, if any of the world's strongest accompanied to the expedition force to the Pleiades Watchtower, the difficulty to complete the tower would increase because of Reid. Reinhard doesn’t have the Divine Protection of the Soul of Language."''
