[[Re:Zero Forbidden Book and the Mysterious Spirit]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Inori Minase|Minase Inori]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Brianna Knickerbocker|Brianna Knickerbocker]]}} '''Rem''' (レム) is a maid in service of Margrave [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] alongside her sister, [[Ram]]. She is one of the main supporting characters of [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu|Re:Zero]], with major roles in [[Arc 2]], [[Arc 3]], and [[Arc 7]], and a supporting role in [[Arc 8]], [[Arc 9]], and [[Arc 10]]. During the first half of Arc 2, she was the secondary antagonist. Born the younger twin of Ram, Rem, having an inferiority complex, was attached to and only relied on her sister, caring for no other. Following her sister after the destruction of her home with the [[Oni|Oni Tribe]], she became a maid of the [[Roswaal Manor]], working hard to bear the burden that her sister no longer can with the intent of becoming her horn in her place.''To prove how right Ram was, to wipe away Ram’s shame, the one who was the hope of the Oni Tribe, Rem would be her hands and legs, her sister’s horn── She would fill Ram’s shoes.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 6. However, she began to open up after [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s arrival to the mansion, falling for him. At the end of Arc 3, she had her name and memories eaten by [[Lye Batenkaitos]] and subsequently fell into suspended animation. She later awoke at the end of [[Arc 6]] bearing amnesia. ==Appearance== Rem has medium-length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards the left side of her hair, a flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a black-white floral hairband, which is connected to the ribbon. She looks nearly identical to her sister apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. She has a uniform made for cold times, which has warmer cuffs around the wrists and covers her shoulders, and she also has one that she wears for her days off, that has more black than white, covers her shoulders, has shorter sleeves, and is closer to being a regular dress. In Arc 6, Rem was dressed in a long-sleeved pink dress with white frills at the hem of the long skirt, pink boots, brown corset with three belts (two in the anime), black leggings, and a pink cloak to protect her from the sands of the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], while still wearing the hair clips, the ribbon and the hairband. She continues to wear this uniform until her return to [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. When she was young, she wore a white kimono and a pair of zoris, a native dress of the onis, and her hair was styled the same as in the present day.''She was a very young girl. She had on a white kimono, which was a native dress, and she wore zoris on her feet. Even though the playful age was evident in her short, blue hair, she seemed to be squinting the eyes of her lovely face in a lonely way.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. After joining Roswaal Manor's staff, she began to don her maid uniform. In the [[Re:IF|Sloth IF]] side story, Rem had grown her hair out long, had a flower shaped hair piece on her head, and wore a white kimono. ==Personality== Rem is a competent, loyal person who always tries her best. Initially, in public, Rem is someone who maintains an emotionless expression, not displaying feelings like sadness or anger to maintain formality. She speaks politely to others, even if she dislikes them internally. Additionally, she possesses a sharp tongue and can unknowingly say blunt or critical things to the people she interacts with. While calm on the surface, in intense situations, Rem often gets tunnel vision and locks onto a singular objective. She tends to try to do everything on her own, bearing the burden of everything on her shoulders. Initially, from her perspective, only Ram and things directly related to Ram were important. This leads Rem to make rash decisions to protect her community, without needing to think twice about the situation. Working at Roswaal Manor, she also holds respect for its master, having been thankful for his actions towards demi-humans.''He educated demi-humans, gave them work, and sent them off to different places. This wasn’t the first time Rem saw off travelling coworkers like this as someone who has been at the mansion for two months. She felt thankful that so many demi-humans were saved by Roswaal.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 4. More than anything, due to the way she grew up, Rem harbored excessive feelings of attachment, gratitude, and respect towards her older twin sister, Ram. Because she was always alone, her sister's care became a source of comfort, yet at the same time, something that caused her to feel as if she was suffocating.''Everyone in the village adored and respected Ram. But on the other hand, Ram didn’t open up to anyone in the village, and she thought that expectations and respect and such were troublesome. The younger twin Rem was the only one Ram truly loved from the bottom of her heart. It was the treasure that Rem was most proud of, and at the same time, the most suffocating burden.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. She is fully aware of how extraordinary her sister is, which she looks up to her for, but at the same time, not being able to understand the things that she can have made her feel worthless.''Someone still young like Rem could not understand much of what Ram was saying. Rem’s own sister, who was the same age as her, showed a level of wisdom that put adults to shame, and that made her feel worthless.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1. Throughout her life, she constantly put herself down while propping her sister up, which, combined with the fact that she was born with one horn and was significantly weaker than her brethren, has led to an inferiority complex, and this complex deepened as a result of her guilt from feeling the slightest hint of joy after her sister's horn was severed, leading her to aim for becoming a perfect servant to atone for what she felt she had robbed from Ram.''Rem had an inferiority complex from having only one horn, so she had a habit of looking at other people’s horns in detail. Thus, she was the only one who would never mistake one horn for another for her race in the village. And it became a pain that fell onto Rem. There couldn’t be any pain that would be harder to endure.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 3. This also leads her to understand others who have a similar complex, like [[Frederica Baumann]] has about her teeth.''She was an adolescent girl. Frederica had her own inferiority complex because of her mouth. And Rem also knew how it felt to worry about having a hopeless nature. She knew the feeling so well that it hurt.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 2, Section 2. Burdened by a sense of atonement toward Ram, she overworks herself, doing things in a way she believes her sister would. Despite what happened to her village, though she was saddened by their deaths, she harbored little sorrow for the deaths of her kinsmen, having been grateful that she still had her sister,''The village burned away, her parents and race were killed, and yet she didn’t feel any deep sorrow. So many things were taken from her, but she was saved by the fact that Ram would still stay by her side.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 2, Section 5. and the only reason she initially agreed to take revenge with Ram was for Ram's sake rather than her own. During her time at Roswaal Manor, though her sense of inferiority and guilt never diminished, she felt more fulfilled than she ever did in her village, which weighed heavily on her conscience, as she was aware the only reason this was the case was because her kinsmen were killed.''“The oni village burned down, and your parents and kind were all killed. And yet, here you are starting a new life… Is that weighing on your conscience?”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 2.''──She came here after the village was ruined, and yet she felt more fulfilled than before it fell into ruin. If that was the case, then it was as if she was happy now because of the village being destroyed.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 2. Simultaneously, her anger and attachment toward getting the revenge that her sister desired also diminished, as she was becoming happier while living at the manor.''During this time that passed while she engaged in the mansion work, Rem became uneasy because of her heart, which was diminishing her anger that was supposed to be in her chest. Her race’s revenge, her attachment towards getting revenge she promised with Ram faded every day, weakening. That wasn’t happening because she was always going after them every day; it was related to the feeling of happiness she had living in the mansion and Ram’s condition that looked like it wasn’t going to get better at all.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 3. That being said, her sense of hatred will resurge when put into said environment. Because of this incident, she has a deep sense of hatred for the [[Witch Cult]] and believes that nothing good can come from the Witch’s scent, and upon smelling it in her youth, she became quick to act, vengeful, and highly aggressive, to the point that she was willing to torture a [[Fogg|man]] to death to draw out information about his co-conspirators.''“──I will break it, and then heal it, break it, and then heal it, over and over until you tell me everything you’re hiding.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 5. Even in the present day, that loathing led her to suspect, torture, and even kill Subaru on one occasion, as she suspected him to be a member of the Witch Cult because of his strange behavior and the scent wafting from him. Thanks to the assistance of Subaru, Rem’s narrow worldview began to expand. No longer thinking of herself as her sister’s substitute, she started developing stronger bonds with the people around her. Rem felt grateful to Subaru for helping her move forward and developed a deep love for him, becoming one of his most loyal followers, to the point that she always believes in him as her "hero" no matter what, even if Subaru himself for some reason loses faith in his abilities, thereby serving him as an important emotional support even when she is not around, though she still maintains a low opinion of herself and can fall back into self-deprecation when comparing herself to Ram. It is because of this that she started to understand [[Garfiel Tinzel]]'s behavior when he was around her sister, which she at first did not understand. After her confession, she becomes more open and honest about her feelings for Subaru. She boldly declares her love to the people around her. Her heart opened in a true sense, and she diminished the emotional restrictions she once had. Likewise, Rem displays great protectiveness, healing and defending [[Crusch Karsten|Crusch]] against [[Regulus Corneas|Regulus]] and Lye, two Sin Archbishops, even though her loss was certain. After having awoken from her year and a half slumber, Rem acquired amnesia which left her in a state similar to that of Crusch at the end of Arc 3. In this state, rather than referring to herself by her name as she had before, she referred herself with '''I''' or '''my''' (私, ''watashi''), and she tended to refer to Subaru as '''that person''' (あの人, ''ano hito''). She was very wary of everyone, especially Subaru, even going as far as trying to strangle him twice and set up decoy paths and traps in order to get away from him, as she considered him dangerous due to a combination of the overwhelming [[Witch]]'s Scent seeping from him after his numerous deaths, as well as his resentment for [[Spica]] and refusal to help her in her current state, as Rem saw her as just an innocent child. After some time, she became less wary of those around her, and she came to accept her name as her own, despite initially not feeling as though it was. She often showed kindness to people like [[Katya Aurélie]], acting similarly to how Subaru was to her as Katya tried to push her away, and she has shown to similar fondness to Ram as she used to. Thanks to Subaru's influence, she became willing to take gambles during times when her situation was uncertain,''However, she absolutely could not let down her guard. Since she could only say that winning the gamble had paid off once these actions started leading to some kind of results. Going out of one’s way to gamble would become meaningless unless it turned into a win. In the first place, Rem had been trying not to think about just whose influence had made her take a risk as she was doing.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 103, Section 1. including taking irrational options when provided with rational options,''She did not even need to think to know what the rational option was. ――And yet, Rem chose the irrational option.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 103, Section 1. and thanks to [[Priscilla Barielle]], her sense of self became stronger. Though she still acts particularly harsh towards Subaru, she has also shown her protective side as well, going out of her way to attack [[Todd Fang|Todd]] when he was in danger, as well as a slightly envious side, which she displayed numerous times when he interacted with [[Emilia]]. She has shown to dislike how he takes on burdens by himself, and she still feels guilt about the way she acted around him, to the point that she feels she must make up for it before she can truly apologize.''"I have no choice but to pay the compensation for that pridefulness within myself. Until that debt is settled, I believe I do not even have the right to face him."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 10, Section 2. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]=== Rem lived with her [[Quark|father]], [[Temae|mother]], and her elder sister Ram in an oni village. Initially, because they were born with one horn each, it meant they were defective in the view of the Oni community, who believe in individual strength above all else, and were despised for it. They were to be killed as part of the custom of Oni to protect their pride as the strongest of the [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]]. However, just before the execution, Ram displayed the potential of her power to protect them both, which shocked the community and caused them to kneel. Being allowed to live thanks to her older sister, who had an aptitude that had not been seen since the era of Witches, Rem spent the rest of her days in her shadow. Despite the presence of her sister also raising expectations for herself in the community, she could never meet them or surpass her sister in any area, which earned her disappointment from the other villagers. However, Rem loved her sister and accepted her place behind her and her parents still cared for them both deeply, even if she herself found it difficult to believe in front of the brilliance of her older sister. One day, Rem awoke and panicked when she saw that her sister was not with her. Deciding to go and find her, she left her house, meeting her neighbor, who showed her concern and called Ram’s name with an honorific. Her heart slightly hurt, Rem raced off and eventually found Ram, who reassured Rem. Afterward, Ram felt a visitor had approached the village and went to confront him. Meeting an [[Rom|old giant]] who claimed to know and wanted to meet with [[Setanta]], Ram, who was wary of him, took him to meet the chief. After meeting with him, Setanta introduced the man as Cromwell, though the giant claimed he now went by Rom. Though Setanta ordered Rem to go home and Ram to stay behind, Ram harshly refused and left with Rem, leaving Setanta and Rom to talk to each other. Though Rem was concerned if Ram was okay to do that, Ram reassured her, and after using her magic to deal with a chore, the two went to play and collect yams for steamed potatoes, and Rem forgot Ram’s serious expression as she pondered the meaning of the meeting. When they returned to the village, they came across an angry Setanta and Rom, who had apparently declined Setanta’s request. With Rom leaving and telling Setanta not to treat Ram as a kid only when it was convenient, he left the village, telling the girls to be good sisters. Sometime later, Rem awoke to find that Ram was missing. Deciding to find her, after burning her hand on the doorknob, she realized her house was on fire, and she bust down the door to find Ram. She eventually made it outside, only to find the village ablaze and littered with oni corpses, including her parents and neighbor. She also bore witness as Setanta fought off strange, robed men until he was eventually killed. When the men decided to kill Rem, Ram appeared, slaughtering the men. However, as an explosion threatened to kill Rem, Ram grabbed her and leapt away. Taking injuries as she continued fighting, she was eventually faced with one of the men, who prepared to kill them. As he swung, Ram stood in front of Rem to protect her, and her horn was severed. Rem passed out from the shock. Ram, despite her injuries, managed to grab Rem and run, escaping the men. However, they eventually collapsed on the mountain road, where Roswaal L. Mathers discovered them on the way to their village. Upon meeting Ram, who asked to save Rem, Roswaal asked what she could offer him, to which she offered herself, saying that she couldn't make decisions for Rem. When Rem next awoke, she was in Roswaal Manor, and Ram, whose face was pale, was next to her. Recalling what happened to the village, she was despondent. Then, a maid, Frederica Baumann, appeared in the room to retrieve Ram, introducing herself and slightly startling Rem with her teeth, which made them both feel guilty. As Frederica scolded Ram and mentioned her broken horn, the memories of what happened at the end of the attack on the oni village ran through Rem's mind, and in her panic, her horn protruded from her head and she thrashed around, forcing Ram and Frederica to hold her down. After Ram bit down on her horn and made her pass out, Ram passed out beside her, leaving the indignant Frederica to deal with the mess. Later, Rem woke up, and Ram wasn't beside her. Instead, Roswaal was, and he bluntly told her that everyone had died, picking at her emotional scars and at her bond with Ram, frustrating her to the point that she snapped at Roswaal, which was his goal, to make her more responsive. Afterward, she demanded to see her sister, and though Roswaal stated that it would not be good for either of them, he ultimately allowed her to see Ram, and Frederica led her to Ram's room, who claimed that Roswaal wasn't a bad person despite the way he speaks. Upon arriving at Ram's room, she was surprised to see it covered in numerous locks and a magic circle, which Frederica unlocked. Despite Rem's instincts urging her to back away, she entered the room, only to see Ram writhing in pain as her mana was running wild and locked down to the bed. After being told that Ram had been holding this in until after she saw Rem was okay, Rem ran back to her room, where she begged Roswaal to save Ram. Like with Ram, he asked what Rem could offer him in return, to which she offered herself. Pleased with her response, he muttered that taking the sizes for the maid outfits should be left to [[Clind]], and he went to deal with Ram's rampaging mana. Later, when Ram awoke, she and Rem spoke, with Rem revealing that she offered herself to serve Roswaal. Ram, who realized that they were being toyed with, explained that she did the same for Rem, making Rem happy. Afterward, the two embraced, and with Ram claiming that the men who destroyed their village got away, she decided to claim retribution on them, and Rem, who wasn't particularly sorrowful about the destruction of their village, agreed. Later, Clind prepared maid outfits for Ram and Rem. Ram notes how there are almost exclusively demi-humans working for Roswaal, to which Frederica explained that Roswaal took in demi-humans with nowhere to go, and he gave them a job and an education without asking for anything in return. They notice how it was different for Rem and Ram, which Frederica suspects is because the sisters would have rushed out of the manor otherwise, which Ram could not refute. Over the following month, the two were taught by Frederica and Clind how to speak and act as a servant and a basic education. However, it is also discovered that the loss of Ram's horn interfered with Ram's work. The need for retribution within Rem also began to wane, and one day, she spoke with Roswaal about her life in the manor, and the weight of her conscience about living there. The conversation moved to how Rem noticed the Witch Cult was responsible for the village's destruction, which Roswaal unintentionally confirmed. Roswaal discouraged her from vengeance, and Rem said she would speak to Ram about it. When Ram appeared for Rem, the two left the room, and Ram noticed her formal speech, and the two spoke about their relationship with Roswaal. As they walked, however, Rem got lost in her thoughts, and when Ram called out to her, she spoke formally again, something which worried Ram. Another month passed, and in the time the two were at the manor, she had seen numerous servants go to work at other mansions once they were confirmed to have received satisfactory education. One day, Roswaal prepared to set off for the Sanctuary, intent on bringing Ram with him. Soon after, after convincing the two it was for their own good to be separated, he and Ram left for the Sanctuary, Frederica giving a letter to Ram to give to her brother, Garfiel. The next day, Clind tasked her with cleaning the basement on Roswaal's orders, and he left. Having to take the other servants to take on new posts, Frederica also left, leaving Rem behind at the manor alone. With the key to the basement, she made her way there, where she noticed a horrid but familiar stench. Led by her nose, she found herself in front of a sealed door, and despite her caution, when she heard the clicking that she heard the night her village was destroyed, she busted through the door and came face to face with one of the men responsible for attacking that night, Fogg, and he set off an explosion and sent her flying. Despite receiving a heavy blow, Rem was able to stand back up and keep fighting, getting hit by numerous explosions. Noticing that their bad scent appeared before the explosions, she used that to avoid the worst damage, and she assaulted her enemy. Eventually, she grabbed a magic stone and tossed it towards one of the man's explosive traps, setting it off. She attacked once again, but he set off all of the explosions, destroying the room. Protected by a collapsing shelf, the man managed to escape the room, only for Rem, now holding her morningstar, to appear behind him and take off his arm. Hitting him numerous times, she decided to use healing magic, which she used instinctively, on him, torturing him for his name, Fogg, and the names of his comrades, Sergei, Sado, and Faust. Then when she killed him, she passed out. She was later found by Clind, beaten and bloody, and he took her to her room. When Roswaal and Ram returned, Ram stuck by Rem's side, and when she later awoke, she spoke with Roswaal, claiming that she would act as Ram's horn and substitute. Another month later, Roswaal, Frederica, Ram, and Rem visited the Royal Capital, which was celebrating the Tammuz Festival, to buy a gift to celebrate the birth of child of House Miload. Deciding to split up to search for a gift, Roswaal took Ram with him while Frederica took Rem, and the two decided to meet up again later. As the two looked at the stores, Frederica asked about the kinds of gifts that Rem and Ram would give to each other, setting off Rem to go and buy a gift for Ram now that she had the chance. However, Frederica stopped her, and having been inspired by Rem's answers and responses, they looked through various shops. Eventually, however, Rem's nose caught a whiff of the same scent that came off of Fogg, and she followed it, leading to a bag containing a magical miasma stone. Deciding to reunite with Roswaal and Ram, the former of which had bought gifts for the latter, they discussed the possible plans that the Witch Cult were scheming. Deciding to split again, Roswaal and Ram went to alert the capital's guardsmen while Frederica beastified and took Rem with her to look for the scattered stones, which Ram had predicted the locations of. After dealing with the stones, the two came across [[Sado]], the man planting them. Having been prepared to escape at a moment's notice, he dodged Rem's morningstar, which she had been training with, and summoned other Witch Cultists to hold them off while he flew away. Although the two were cornered and were nearly forced to retreat, much to Rem's outrage due to knowing that she would never come across the man again, a young [[Reinhard van Astrea]] appeared and offered to hold off the remaining Witch Cultists, allowing for Frederica and Rem to chase after Sado. However, as the two approached more heavily populated areas and Sado was off in the distance, the two were forced to stop. However, thanks to her Clairvoyance and Synesthesia, Ram was able to see through Rem's eyes, and using her new wand fashioned from her horn and gifted to her by Roswaal, she used her magic to sever Sado's limbs from afar, effectively defeating him. Rem and Frederica chased after Sado. After meeting him, Rem attempted to question him, but the man merely said that he pitied her and gave his name before he died, giving her no answers and frustrating her. Afterward, Reinhard appeared, having successfully captured all of the Witch Cultists alive, and after deciding to preserve the scene to allow Frederica to revert back and clothe herself, she and Rem left, with the intent to explain things to the guards. As they left, Rem solidified her resolve before mentioning they would have to find a gift for House Miload now. Ten days later, Roswaal brought Rem and Ram to the Miload Manor, where they met the pregnant [[Grace Miload]], Roswaal's excuse for bringing them being that they ought to see childbirth for themselves, and his continued interactions with Grace made Ram grumpy. After a short conversation, Rem and Ram went to another room, where, after a different conversation about being unable to kill time and how Rem did so in the village, interacted with the servants of the manor. Three days later, [[Dudley Miload]] was late in returning to the manor, and when a [[Sergei|young man]] arrived to tell everyone that the carriage broke down, Roswaal and Rem went to retrieve him, leaving Ram to keep Grace company. After arriving at his carriage, the young man brought Rem forward to witness the bloody corpses. When she brought out her horn, she was nearly incapacitated by the man's poisoning of mana. When the man blew away the carriage Roswaal was in, the young man, Sergei, summoned several Witch Cultists before attempting to strangle Rem to death, only for Roswaal to appear and blast them all with magic and retrieve Rem. Deciding to handle them, Roswaal sent Rem back to the manor, blowing away the cultists that got in her way. When she eventually returned to the manor, which was [[Attack on Miload Manor|under attack]], she found [[Faust]], the last of the men who attacked her village, grabbing Ram by the throat, intending to throw her into the explosive traps set in the garden. Seeing this, Rem hit him in the head with her morningstar. With Ram on her back, the two avoided the explosions that followed them, and Rem struck him. When he attempted a sneak attack, she managed to counter him, breaking his weapon with her teeth, and she struck him numerous times while piercing through the upper floors. After pushing through the roof, Rem struck the man and sent him flying into the explosive traps, and when Ram threw his burning leaf tobacco into it, they went off, reducing the man to ash. Later, Roswaal returned, having killed the Witch Cultists and brought Sergei back for the twins to kill. Afterward, [[Minor Characters#Limrear|Limrear]] appeared, saying that the baby had been born but that Grace didn't have much time left. In the room she was in, several bloody rags were nearby, and the baby was in the arms of a servant. Waking Grace, she gave her baby the name [[Annerose Miload|Annerose]], and she asked Roswaal to take care of her. Dying, she said that she loved Roswaal, and she laughed when he returned her words, saying he was a bad liar. In the end, she died, leaving the servants to cry. After this, Roswaal became Annerose's guardian, and House Miload was put under his control. Many of the remaining servants who survived resigned, and Roswaal decided to have Clind and Frederica serve at House Miload, with Roswaal choosing to have his hobby of taking care of and training demi-human servants being performed at the Miload Manor and by those two. A year later, Rem and Ram visited the Oni village's grave and performed their funeral rites with alcohol given to them by Roswaal. ===[[Garfiel and Ram's Really Complicated Love Affair]]=== One day later on, intending to let her see the "White Snow Sakura", Ram brought Rem to the Sanctuary. After Rem went to speak to [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu]], Ram spoke with Garfiel about why she was there without Roswaal. When Rem returned, she sent Garfiel flying away and started talking with Ram. After Garfiel quickly recovered, he and Rem started to argue, and the sisters playfully complained about Garfiel finding out about what they were there for. Ram worried about how Rem rarely got to act herself, though their worry made her dismiss the thought. Eventually, the arrived at their destination, and the twins were mesmerized by the sight of the trees covered in white flowers. They eventually sat down to eat, and after a moment, Garfiel passed out of Ram's shoulder. After learning from Rem that Rem and Garfiel had actually worked together to bring Ram here, she moved his head to her lap and ran her hand through his hair in gratitude. After a few moments, however, she moved Garfiel so that the jealous Rem could lay her head on her lap instead. ===[[Rem Meets Subaru]]=== Following his victory against [[Elsa Granhiert]], it was decided that Natsuki Subaru would be brought back to Roswaal Manor to be treated. Rem, who was responsible for his treatment, expressed doubt at his presence, as his features were strange, and his purpose was unknown. It is unclear if she noticed the scent of the Witch on him. Later, she went to inform [[Beatrice]] of the situation with their injured guest. ===[[Emilia's Starry Sky Classroom]]=== Shortly after his arrival at the manor, Emilia, while walking towards the garden, met with Rem. She mentioned that she needed to go to the garden to talk with the [[Spirit|spirits]] since the commotion Subaru made interrupted her last attempt. Rem offered to "deal" with Subaru and asked if she should not say where Emilia went if she found Subaru. Emilia replies that such action was not needed and said that Rem could tell him where she went if he asked. ===[[Rem's Latte Art]]=== During one of the days immediately after Subaru was brought to the manor, Rem found him playing with coff. After he told Rem that what he was doing, latte art, was something that came from his homeland, he explained that he used fire stones to make the milk foam and showed her that he could draw [[Puck]] in it with milk. After being convinced by Subaru to try, Rem tried, but her drawing was bad, and in her frustration, she ordered Subaru to get back to work. A little while later, Ram found her alone in the dining room still attempting to draw something good. Ram picked up one of the cups and drew the characters for "older sister" in Japanese that she had learned from Subaru the night before. Rem was amazed that her sister can be so incredible, getting sad that she had failed. After Ram left, Rem tasted the coff, which was bad, and she decided to teach Subaru how to brew it properly first before playing with it next time. ===[[Ram's Older Sister Heart is Complicated]]=== After the [[Wolgarm Incident]], Rem started to become very attached to Subaru, something which began to disturb Ram and make her treat Subaru harshly. A short while later, after Ram had overworked herself and Subaru helped to take care of her, Rem visited after finishing her chores and noticed that Ram slept while holding Subaru's hand, saying that this rare scene must be because she finally accepted Subaru, with Subaru replying that he wasn't so sure since she had insulted him from the beginning to the very last minute until she asked to hold hands before sleeping. ===[[The Best Day of Rem's Life]]=== A week after the Wolgarm Incident, Rem met up with Subaru, and she was going to act on the promise she made with him to cut his hair. Though nervous, she felt honored to be able to do so. ===[[Rem's Maiden Heart is Super Complex]]=== A little while later, Rem discovered Subaru sleeping in the garden and slacking off instead of doing housework. Quickly performing the rest of her tasks, Rem eventually grabbed a chair so that she could rest near Subaru and watch his sleeping face. ===[[The Head Maid's Unrestful Holiday]]=== Noticing how hard Rem worked, Subaru spoke with the other residents of Roswaal Manor, and he proposed that she take a day off. Despite the slight opposition of the others, he was able to persuade them to agree after saying that she could use the day off to think about what she wanted as her reward for her participation in the Wolgarm Incident, and when Rem herself was reluctant to take a day off, Subaru told her to take the day off directly, and she agreed to his command immediately. Afterward, everyone decided on which jobs they would handle to make up for not having Rem’s help and split up to handle their respective tasks. Despite the time off, Rem became anxious at essentially doing nothing, and deciding to check in on everyone, she snuck out of her room. Particularly concerned about her sister, Rem arrived at the kitchen, where she overheard Ram complaining to Roswaal about Subaru’s idea to have him participate in the housework. However, Roswaal was fine participating and even claimed that Subaru’s idea wasn’t misguided. As Rem decided to leave, she noticed Roswaal had noticed her and quietly thanked him for not saying anything. Next, she went to the bath, where she expected Puck and Beatrice to be doing the laundry. Concerned due to the number of unique outfits that shouldn’t be cleaned together and worried about whether or not they could properly handle the fabric, she rushed to handle those herself. When she got there, however, she found Puck instructing Beatrice how to deal with clothes while cleaning his own load with magic. Overhearing their discussion about the tedium and necessity of doing laundry and coming to an understanding about why Subaru wanted to give Rem a day off, Rem walked away, grateful to them. Deciding to check up on Subaru and Emilia, who were dusting the west wing, she overheard as they spoke about how clean it was already and about Emilia recalling her misunderstanding shortly after arriving at the manor. Shortly after, Subaru recalled an important task he needed to do and headed for the front gate, leaving Emilia to finish her tasks. Realizing what his intentions were, Rem met Subaru in front of the gate, intent on going with him to check [[Arlam Village]]’s barrier. On the way to the village, Subaru asked if his actions that morning had bothered her, and though she teased him about it, she was grateful to him for giving her the chance to hear everyone’s opinions of her, and she thanked him. The next morning, as she cared for Ram, she noticed that Rem was rather happy, which she attributed to her day off. After greeting Subaru when he awoke and some small banter, when he asked if she had an idea for her reward, she claimed she already got it, which she believed was everything that happened the day prior. ===[[Beatrice and Rem's Cumbersome Cleaning]]=== One day, Rem entered the forbidden library and witnessed Beatrice holding a bucket over her head. Beatrice, having noticed her, was surprised by her arrival. Though Rem said to Beatrice to give her best as Emilia had improved her singing with this method, Beatrice angrily denied this and claimed that she only had the bucket to clean the library, to which Rem had been aware that there was no water in it. Taking the opportunity to clean the library, Rem taught Beatrice how to do so properly. Wanting to participate instead of only listen, Beatrice asked to join her. However, because her attempt to clean a bookshelf led to the destruction of one of the books, Rem scolded her, with Beatrice pouting that her being treated in such a way was Subaru's fault. ===[[Beatrice and Rem's Cumbersome Service]]=== A short while later, Beatrice was spooked when Rem entered the library with an angry expression. Checking the bookshelves, she noticed that they were still full of dust, and she proceeded to scold Beatrice harshly for not being able to clean her own library properly. After a while, Rem revealed that her true purpose in coming was not to check on the cleanliness of the library but to ask Beatrice for a favor. She wished to create a dish, specially made for Subaru just as Ram and Emilia had done in the past, since last time she felt quite left out, and she mentioned that Beatrice had a similar taste in food as Subaru did. Though Beatrice was initially unwilling to cooperate since, in the end, it would be something to please Subaru, the smell of the food and Rem's persuasion made her start tasting and rating every dish Rem presented to her. A few days later, Rem was pleased by the results of her efforts, having not told Subaru about Beatrice's help. ===[[Some Like it Cold]]=== One morning, Subaru awakened in his room from a bad dream and was astonished by Rem's presence, her reason for being there being in his room was because she was restoring her energy by watching over him. When Rem asked about his dream, he confessed that it was really a nightmare and refused to talk about it as it could have come true if he did. Getting out of bed, Subaru noticed that the temperature in the room was rather cold. Rem confirmed that it was cold most likely due to the weather and complimented Subaru's astute insight, whereas he downplayed it. In the mansion's kitchen, Subaru peeled potatoes while Rem tended to the cooking. As they worked on their respective tasks, Subaru mentioned that the cold weather was strange and asked about Rem's inadequate clothing. While Rem did have more appropriate clothing for the winter, she claimed that she and her sister were fine with the cold weather. At the same time, she mentioned that Ram was sleeping in late due to the cold, which caused Subaru to snap as Rem's statement contradicted her prior one and went off to give Ram a piece of his mind. The next day, Subaru performed mopping duties with Rem in the foyer. They talked about how the date with Emilia was not canceled but postponed due to the frigid weather, something that seemed to have left her relieved. Reflecting on this, Subaru noted how Emilia's relieved expression bugged him. Rem then noted that it was a wise choice for Subaru to cancel the date, as they could have become stranded in a mountain because of the weather. Initially, Subaru agreed with this, but then gets an epiphany how the two of them stranded in the mountains in a cabin would be a perfect romantic experience. However, Subaru downplayed that scenario ever occurring as a snowstorm would never happen. At that moment, however, Subaru accidentally broke his mop that was somehow stuck in the mop's water, which had been frozen over. The following day, after waking up to a frozen room, Subaru was served by Rem in the kitchen area. Soon after, Roswaal appeared and noted the ineptness of how Subaru was unable to deal with the cold. As the conversation continued, Roswaal revealed that the cold weather was only affecting the area in the manor's vicinity. Furthermore, there were already people investigating the issue. The three then headed to Emilia's room, where they discovered that the cause of the weather was because of Puck. A meeting was then held in the dining room, where it was explained that the cause for the cold weather was because of Puck's [[Magic#Organs and Conditions|magical release period]]. Due to Subaru's ignorance of the concept of [[Magic#Organs and Conditions|Od]], Beatrice elucidated the subject to him. When asked about the sudden surge in cold weather, Puck answered that it was due to the fact that he figured he could get away with upping the magical exertion. After formally apologizing to Subaru, Emilia asked Puck how much longer this cold weather will last. Puck answered that it would be another two days before it ended. Emilia also revealed that due to having a contract with Puck, she had become immune to cold temperatures. Though Subaru attempts to come up with ideas to order to pass the cold, each of his ideas was refuted. Back in the dining room, Subaru and Ram huddled by the fireplace. When Roswaal and Beatrice were asked about how they dealt with their surplus of Od, they revealed their respective methods. It is also revealed that Rem doesn't have enough magical energy the needed to have a magic release period, while Emilia maintained hers quite easily thanks to Puck. Subaru then asked when the last time Puck used his energy to his heart's content, which Puck claimed was during the fights with Elsa and Roswaal months prior, something of which Roswaal and Puck reminisced on. Sometime later, Subaru, Rem, and Emilia left to collect firewood. During this, Subaru comes up with the idea to hold a snow festival to help squander Puck's abundance of mana, something that was inspired by Hokkaido in Japan. The next day, Subaru explains to the residents of Arlam Village and the manor that whoever manages to create the best snow sculpture would be rewarded with a prize, something which leads to everyone working on their respective sculptures, and the judges turn out to be Subaru, Roswaal, and [[Rasphum]]. As Subaru and Roswaal observe the sculptures, Subaru eventually came to Rem and Ram, whose sculpture was hidden behind a curtain. When they reveal their sculpture, it turned out to be what they called the Wonderful Subuwaal-sama Sculpture, a sculpture with characteristics of both Subaru and Roswaal. When Roswaal walked up and saw the sculpture, he was left despondent, and the low ratings given by the two judges flabbergasted the twins, leading them to discuss what went wrong with it. In the end, the winner was [[Petra Leyte]]. ===[[Alcohol Panic]]=== Two nights after Subaru had found a stash of alcohol beneath the manor, the residents of the manor held a party. After a speech from Subaru, everyone partook from the food and alcohol available. During the banquet, Emilia and Rem both got drunk, Rem in particular becoming drunk off of the mere smell of the alcohol without having drunk any, attached themselves to Subaru, and teased him until they both fell asleep on his lap. Seeing Beatrice by her lonesome outside on the balcony, Subaru decided to join her. Before he made it to her, Subaru's gaze had landed on Emilia and Rem, who were embracing one another while asleep. ===[[Rem's Very Ordinary Happy Day]]=== One morning, a month after Subaru’s arrival at the manor, Rem set about her daily routine of watching Subaru’s sleeping face for a while and waking her sister. During her conversation with Ram, she muttered about whether she should grow out her hair, which Ram pointed out was because Emilia’s hair was long, implying it was for her to grab Subaru’s attention. Despite her grumbling about Subaru not being worthy of Rem, Rem was happy that Ram did not dislike Subaru. Later that morning, as she watched Subaru and Emilia in the garden, Beatrice appeared nearby and started speaking with Rem, having been keeping an eye on her to make sure she did not overwork herself with the excuse that she did not want to be dragged into another one of Subaru’s ideas. The two discussed how his presence changed the twins and Beatrice, and as Beatrice left for the Forbidden Library, Rem stated she would call for her when breakfast was ready, something that Beatrice started to participate in over the past month. That afternoon, having sent Subaru and Ram to Arlam Village to shop in an effort for them to become better friends, Rem brought Emilia her tea. When Emilia invited her to sit with her, though at first Rem was quiet and didn’t know what to talk about, they began to talk about how they had to learn a lot due to their circumstances. With Rem thinking about how she had never tried to interact with Emilia, the two started to talk about what they had learned about each other in the past month, and having come to the conclusion that a lot had changed thanks to Subaru’s appearance, Rem claimed that she hoped Emilia would win the Royal Selection, and she would help however she could. Later that night, Rem was summoned by Roswaal and Puck, who requested snacks for their drinks. After she prepared the snacks, she was invited by the two to keep them company. After some small talk about their handling of alcohol and the night of the stargazing party, they began speaking about Subaru’s gate, which had been damaged during the Wolgarm Incident. Intent on bringing the best healer in the capital, [[Ferris]], he had discussed with Puck about using something from within [[Elior Forest]], the magic stones, to bargain with Ferris, who was already a critical part of [[House Karsten]] and the [[Crusch Camp]]. After assigning Rem the task of keeping a close eye on Subaru, she left, having been slightly affected by the smell of the alcohol. Visiting Subaru’s room, something that was a part of her routine as to glimpse his sleeping face, she got up close to him, close enough that she could feel his breath. However, as she considered giving in to her impulses, she pulled herself back, having sobered up. Despite thinking to leave the room, she found herself placing a finger on his lips, which closed around it. After a struggle with her impulses again, she then found herself wrapped in the sleeping Subaru’s arms, which, after some more struggles, she accepted, and she fell asleep. The next morning, Ram found the two like this and gave Subaru a thrashing. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Rem's strength is such that she could easily hunt down and slay [[witchbeast]]s without coming to harm, and against average opponents, she is likely to win. However, her strength is limited, and she can easily be overwhelmed by superior opponents or greater numbers of experienced fighters. Although she can cook with alcohol, stating that she is able to shut out the smell while in situations where she focuses.''"When I'm cooking, I cut out all unnecessary distractions──it's a matter of focus. But when I'm at the dining table, there's no sense of urgency, so..."'' Richard Brown (False King Candidate) }} '''Valga Cromwell''' (バルガ・クロムウェル), commonly known as '''Old Man Rom''' (ロム爺), is a member of the [[Felt Camp]] and the former owner of the Loot House. He played a supporting role in [[Arc 1]], [[Arc 9]], and [[Arc 10]], and a minor supporting role in [[Arc 3]]. He was also one of the main antagonists of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]], and he played a minor background supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]. Born a slave, Valga was a leading figure of the [[Demi-Human War]], feared as the Great Strategist who held deep hatred for humanity. Although reported to have died during the war, he was taken captive by the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] in secret, and, after escaping his imprisonment decades later, he took on the name Rom, eventually finding himself in the [[Royal Capital]]'s slums, where he raised [[Felt]]. He joined Felt's camp following the announcement of her candidacy as one of the Royal Selection Candidates at the Royal Selection Ceremony. ==Appearance== Rom sports a bulky figure. As a giant, he stands at a towering 220 cm (7'3"), though his hunchback-like style of walking makes him look shorter. He has white strands of hair lining his eyebrows and is bald. He wears a sleeveless vest and possesses a crimson symbol across the left side of his head. His primary weapon is a massive club that he uses to smash opponents. When he was young, he was much leaner, and his eyebrows stood up in addition to having more hair. He wore black pants, a red cape, bracelets with bones on them, and a necklace. ==Personality== Rom is good-natured, intelligent, and wise. He is a known alcoholic who frequents the enjoyments of drinking. Despite having lived in the slums for over a decade, he comes off as friendly, though he has no issue with living a criminal life, having been perfectly fine with selling off stolen goods that Felt brought him from the Loot House. This being said, he will also be fair towards his patrons. If someone comes to negotiate in order to retrieve a stolen item, he will give them a chance to provide them with a better deal than other buyers, and if they succeed, he will allow said person to buy said item. Due to his past, he has a high awareness of hostility, and though not quite skilled in combat, he will fight back against his aggressor. He is also highly protective of Felt, to the point that he will lose his cool, give in to his anger, ignore the risk towards himself, and attack the person who presents a risk towards Felt. He was even willing to break into the Royal Castle just to retrieve her from the [[Royal Selection]], despite the room she was in holding a large number of knights and nobles, including the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint]] himself, showing a rare moment of carelessness and recklessness. In his younger days, due to having grown up as a slave, Valga Cromwell held an intense hatred towards humans, to the point that he wanted to exterminate every single one of them. On the other hand, he felt a strong sense of camaraderie with his fellow [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], who suffered discrimination and hatred from humans for generations. During the Demi-Human War, he had great charisma, and his anger resonated with his fellow demi-humans, though he did acknowledge that what he had paled in comparison to his comrade-in-arms and mother figure [[Libre Fermi]]. Despite that, Valga was remembered as the one who strengthened the weak ties of the demi-human tries, connecting them through negotiations and virtue. Because of this, he was able to command respect and fear from both his enemies and allies, and combined with his excellent and nigh unbeatable strategies, he was able to ignite the seeds of war and rebellion, as well as unite the chaotic warfront, into a properly organized army. After the war was over and he was imprisoned, he displayed willingness to provide his knowledge to humans if he believed it would help prevent unnecessary demi-human deaths. In time, however, he came to find himself bearing a level of gratitude towards a certain man who not only seemingly freed him from imprisonment but also entrusted the infant Felt to him. Because he did not want a debt to go unpaid, despite said debt being to a human, he reluctantly accepted the man's request. In the next few years, he grew to love the child, and because of his parental love toward Felt, he became softer over time, and he believed that she saved his way of life.''“I already made that vow a long time ago. That girl saved my way of life, ye know.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 6. Because of this, to some degree, he now seems to regret the extent to which his past rage had influenced him. He became so soft that he even admonished [[Setanta]] for the way he viewed [[Ram]] as a means to an end despite how she was just a child, and told her and her twin sister [[Rem]] to never forget their bonds as sisters. However, despite becoming softer, his mind and ruthlessness in battle has not waned. In fact, he is still willing to get his own hands dirty when necessary. During the [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|events]] of Arc 9, he was willing not only fight using his own hands against the threat of the [[Authority]]-wielding [[Al|Aldebaran]], who had just defeated a veritable army of 500 people, but he was even willing to sacrifice himself to defeat the man. ==History== ===Early Life=== Rom was born as Valga Cromwell of the nearly extinct giant race, and he was raised as a slave of an unnamed noble. While being a slave, he experienced a living hell until he was one day saved by a man named Libre Fermi; Valga would begin to foster a hatred of humans as a result of the environment he lived in.''He was born to the giant species, who are on the verge of extinction. He was born and raised as the slave of a detestable noble, but he was saved from that environment by a demi-human called Libre, and since then he fostered a hatred of humans...'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/965958052850495488 2018 Rom's Birthday Q&A] Libre soon became Valga's friend, teacher, and mother figure after freeing the giant.''The one called Libre was the benefactor who was his mother, teacher, and friend.'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/965974770423492609 2018 Rom's Birthday Q&A] In addition, he became acquainted with [[Doltero Amule]] and Setanta around this time, likely as a result of his negotiations among the demi-human tribes in order to bring them together during the civil war. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== During the Demi-Human War, Valga was one of three leaders in the Demi-Human Alliance, serving as the Alliance's strategist. Valga was the one responsible for turning the entire group of demi-humans from a mob to a proper coalition. At some point, he found [[Sphinx]], brought her into the Alliance as an ally, and they set up a hidden base at testing grounds in Shamrock Valley. According to unconfirmed reports from the [[Royal Army]], Valga personally utilized his forces during the [[Battle of Castour Field]] and contributed to the Kingdom of Lugunica's defeat there. Following this, he was responsible for planning the ambush that took place during the Kingdom's investigation of the battlefield. After the usage of Sphinx's magic circles and the corpses she was gathering became known to Libre, the two of them disagreed over her methods and they began growing estranged as a result. Three years later, at the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], Libre was personally killed by Sphinx and turned into a corpse soldier, though the Witch would hide the Poison Snake's manner of death from Valga. Without Libre's charisma to continue leading the Demi-Human Alliance, Valga chose to invade Lugunica Castle in an attempt to attack the Kingdom at its heart. During the [[Invasion of the Royal Castle]], Valga was accompanied by Sphinx and the corpse of Libre. Although he was too weak to fight on his own, he had magic circles engraved on his body to increase his power, and alongside them, a bone from an ancestor of his. Sphinx then used Sacrament of the Immortal King in tandem with the bone, which increased Valga's size to a 10-meter-tall giant. He fought against the Sword Demon, [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]], but he ultimately lost the battle and fell into the large hole he created during the battle, supposedly dying. However, in reality, his continued survival was left a concealed fact, and he was taken to the main McMahon Manor as a captive, with only select individuals such as [[Gionis Lugunica]] and [[Miklotov McMahon]] knowing this fact. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]=== A few years after the Demi-Human War ended, [[Stride Vollachia]] was moving across Lugunica with unseen aims. He somehow found his way into Sphinx's Testing Grounds in Shamrock Valley and found a forbidden art there that was left by Sphinx. This forbidden art had the ability to nullify the covenant that the Kingdom had with the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]]. Valga, who knew about the magic circle's effects, opted to disclose what it did to Gionis. After Stride's death, Valga told Miklotov that he only chose to divulge the information because Stride's faction would have killed his fellow demi-humans. ===Post Captivity=== An unknown number of years later, Valga started calling himself Rom, escaped from his captivity either by force or with permission, was given custody over Felt by a man with golden hair and crimson eyes, and he raised her as his granddaughter. On one occasion in the years following his captivity, Rom visited the [[Oni]] Village to see Setanta for unknown reasons, and the two had a disagreement. Before leaving, he told Ram and Rem to never forget to be close sisters.''Rom responded quietly to Setanta’s hateful sounding remark, and he turned his back on him. Stepping hard on the ground, the old man sought to leave the village as he went down the mountain path. As he passed through Rem and Ram’s side, he said――, “Always be close sisters. Don’t forget that.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 2. About seven years before Arc 1, Rom gained ownership of the Loot House and began selling illicit items that Felt stole from other people in order to get by. ===[[Felt-chan Gathers Thugs]]=== Felt, Reinhard, and Rom were on a carriage on their way back from the Royal Selection Ceremony. Rom and Reinhard had a cryptic conversation regarding a kidnapping that happened years ago and the incident of the old royal guards being restructured. Felt asked the carriage to stop at the Loot House in the slums, as Felt wished to see what remained of it. While Felt inspected the slums with her camp, she found [[Gaston]], [[Rachins Hoffman]], and [[Camberley]] running away and badly injured. They decided to attempt to rob her to make enough money to get away from Lugunica, as they had attempted to trick [[Russell Fellow]] into a shady business that did not end well for them, and they were now marked for death by him. Reinhard easily defeated one of them as the others attempted to run, but they were intercepted by Felt while she was scolding Reinhard, as letting them run away would mean they would be dead by Russell's capable henchman the next day. She then recruited the trio for her camp in hopes of using their help for ruining the country. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Despite his size, Valga is not a particularly adept combatant and would lose more often than not to most combatants in the series. However, what makes him dangerous is not his physical prowess but his mind. His intelligence and strategical knowledge are so great that he was feared as one of the most dangerous people in the Demi-Human Alliance, having led to the majority of their successes. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Rom was once feared during the Demi-Human War, not for his physical strength, but for his strategical mind. His strategies were so impressive that he was considered one of the most dangerous threats alongside Sphinx. He has since taken up a position similar to that of a strategist in the Felt Camp, and as of Arc 9, he does not seem to have lost his touch. This intellect even allowed him to corner Al, who had only ever been truly cornered once before, and Al went as far as to consider Rom as more dangerous than Reinhard van Astrea. Likewise, due to his vast experience, he has a wide knowledge of the various types of powers in the world, such as [[Divine Protection]]s and Authorities, and because of this, he is able to plan accordingly around such powers should the need arise. '''Keen Observation''': Rom is skilled at drawing out a person's true abilities and nature through endless trial and error. Because of this, he has been able to spot and identify a vast number of Divine Protections, leading to him becoming the man who has killed the most Divine Protection users in the world. It is because of this that Rom managed to almost completely ascertain the true nature of even Al's Authority. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Immense Physical Strength''': Even without the enhancements he had during his battle with Wilhelm, Valga had enough physical strength to completely decimate the floor of the Kingdom's chapel floor and shake the entire castle along with it. ===Equipment=== *'''Ancestral Bones''': During the Demi-Human War, he had the bones of his ancestors which, when combined with a magic circle, allowed him to increase his size, physical strength, and toughness. However, he ultimately lost these bones during his battle Wilhelm. *'''Spiked Club''': Rom wields a Spiked Club in combat. He can casually swing it around with one hand and crush wood with ease. The one he wielded during the [[Loot House Incident]] was destroyed by [[Elsa Granhiert]]. *'''Gauntlets''': Rom wore gauntlets on both of his arms that he used to hold multiple Conversation Mirrors. **'''Conversation Mirrors''': [[Meteor]]s that are used to converse with anyone who has another of its kind. They were duplicated by the Felt Camp for usage. Rom has shown to have several, which he uses to direct large numbers of people at once. *'''Hexcel''': A drug produced with a bokko fruit that generates excess mana through the activation of the gate. With Rom's usage, it causes his physique to grow. The drug has a narcotic effect, however, and its usage can cause its user to bleed from their eyes and nose, their veins bulge, and their insides will be torn apart. *'''Night Banishing Magic Stone''': Originally used alongside a Night Banisher, this stone is used to temporarily overwrite the appearance of the battlefield, giving the illusion of night having turned to day. Though he is not a man of great magic, when he is enhanced by Hexcel, he can control the blast created by crushing one of these stones. ==Trivia== *In the first section of [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], it is implied that Rom has a debt to an unknown group of people affiliated with a man who has golden hair and crimson eyes.''“I’m indebted to ye all. If I can return what I owe, then I don’t mind taking on this job.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 1.''Inside the box where she could only see the ceiling, her gaze met with someone’s face when they peeked in. For some reason, a shadow was cast upon the face, and she could not see it because it was smudged black. However, she knew the person was the owner of golden hair and crimson eyes.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 1. These physical characteristics are shared by Felt and all members of the Lugunican [[Royal Family]]. *Rom has a named chapter in Arc 9 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40|light novel]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Felt Camp]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Advisors]] [[Category:Demi-Human Alliance]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]] [[de:Rom]] [[es:Rom]] [[fr:Rom]] [[pl:Rom]] [[pt-br:Rom]] [[ru:Ром]] [[uk:Ром]] [[zh:角色:罗姆爷]]

12 (Arc 5+)[[Re:Zeropedia 2]], Chapter 1: Character Profile, Priscilla Camp, Page 71. |Hair Color = Pink |Eye Color = Crimson Red |Height = 130 cm (4'3") |Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] |Previous Affiliation = [[Priscilla Camp]] |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Priscilla Barielle]] (adoptive mother) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 6|Volume 6]] |Manga = [[Daisanshou Chapter 16|Arc 3 Chapter 16]] |Previous Occupation = Butler |Anime = [[Episode 12]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Maki Kawase|Kawase Maki]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Sarah Anne Williams|Sarah Anne Williams]]}} '''Schult Barielle''' (シュルト・バーリエル) is a former member of the [[Priscilla Camp]]. He was a loyal and close attendant to [[Priscilla Barielle]]. Although he has a minor role in the story as a whole, he plays a lesser supporting role in [[Arc 7]]. An orphan from a farming village, after he caught her eye, Priscilla decided to make him her servant, giving him the name Schult and making him her closest attendant besides [[Al|Aldebaran]]. Following the Priscilla Camp's journey to Vollachia, it was discovered that Priscilla had arranged to officially adopt him before they left, leaving him as the successor to the Barielle family.''“――The head of House Barielle, Priscilla Barielle, hereby declares that when it comes time for her official successor to be determined, the following personage, Schult, is to have his name altered to Schult Barielle, and he is to be ushered in as the legitimate son, and rightful heir to House Barielle.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 1. ==Appearance== Schult is a young boy with big red glistering eyes and medium length fluffy and curly, peach-pink hair. He has a thin body which resembles a girl's and wears a butler's outfit over his still-developing body. The butler's attire primarily consists of a light purple long sleeved jacket with six gold buttons and shorts which are of the exact same color as the jacket. The cuffs and the collar have a pink accent with white stripes creating a caro pattern. Accompanying his elegant yet child-like attire, he can be seen sporting a large red ribbon. Perhaps one of the most unique assets of his attire are his white knee-high socks which give his appearance a bit of an out-of-fashion spin. His appearance is said to somehow give off an immoral feeling. ==Personality== As his body is still developing, Schult's voice is high-pitched, like that of a child, making him come off as a bit younger than he actually is. Though his personality has not much seen in the story, as he normally stays quiet for most of his screen-time, he's shown to harbor deep respect for both Al and Priscilla, being prepared to even subject himself to danger just so he'd be able to finish the task given to him. Just like Al, he also deeply cares about Priscilla's well-being as shown when he was the only one protesting against the Princess' decision to personally check the zombie outbreak in one of the villages under her domain. Schult doesn’t like it when people around him get hurt, and he will jump in the way of dangerous enemies who very well could kill him in order to prevent them from doing his comrades harm. He has also displayed a lack of discrimination towards those of other races, even going so far as to request someone like [[Emilia]] for help when necessary and without hesitation. After Priscilla’s passing, though Schult was saddened, his resolve was strengthened dramatically, and he decided to live as someone Priscilla would be proud of. ==History== Schult was a small, thin orphan without a name who grew up in a small farming village within the Barielle Domain. Despite being impoverished and starved, he caught Priscilla's eye, and she decided to take him in as a servant. After taking him in, she gave him the name Schult. ===[[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Entertainment Part]]=== One day, [[Leip Barielle]], Priscilla's then-husband, organized a tournament to decide who Priscilla's knight would be. She quickly got bored with the fighting while viewing the tournament, causing her to ask Schult for his thoughts. Schult decided to recommend Al, as he believed that the man showed care for Priscilla, unlike the other combatants. Priscilla thought Al was entertaining enough and that his fighting style was interesting, and she consequently selected him as her “clown”. This infuriated Leip, as he had tried to fix the tournament so that a winner would be under his control. ===[[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]]=== A few days later, Leip attempted to bring Al and Schult under his control, but he was refused when he revealed his intentions to make Priscilla into a puppet. Al clashed with Leip by using [[Al#Abilities|his ability]], which resulted in the baron being incapacitated. In due time, Leip passed away before the commencement of the [[Royal Selection]], leading Priscilla to take over as the governing lord of the Barielle Domain. Under her rule, the land, which was previously ravaged by severe poverty, quickly got back on its feet, and its people started to live much happier and better lives all thanks to Priscilla's leadership of the territory. ===[[Sunlight Illuminating the Water's Surface]]=== One day, Priscilla wanted Al to entertain her, though this resulted in her flicking him into a fountain on the grounds. With Schult worried about him and mentioning his helmet, Al mentioned that it wouldn't be destroyed so easily, after which he revealed to Priscilla he had acquired his helmet from and lost his arm at [[Ginunhive]]. With Priscilla becoming bored of listening to him, she told Schult to entertain her, leading him to tell her of a rumor that heading toward the spring near the town of Ladrima would allow one to see the deceased. Her interest piqued, she took them and headed toward the forest near Ladrima. There, Al questioned whether she wanted to see someone who had died, whereas she questioned his being against seeing the dead due to not wanting to see someone. Shortly after, Al was separated from his companions. After ordering Schult to take care of the fog, he went to break the crystal responsible for the fog, lifting it from the spring. This resulted in a short-lived fight with an [[Spirit|evil spirit]]. Sometime later, when she was brought Kurenai flowers by a villager at her manor, Al realized that the actions Priscilla took were just so that she could see those flowers, and she ordered Al and Schult to decorate the manor. ===[[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Second Encyclopedia]]=== In [[Priestella]], after [[Anastasia Hoshin]] gave him a letter to pass along, [[Joshua Juukulius]], who had dropped it at some point, encountered Schult, who had given him the letter, much to his gratitude. Wanting to thank him, he asked what the boy, Schult, wanted in return, to which Schult said he was lost. Walking together, Schult gave an explanation of his history and the respect that he shows to the members of his camp, and he asked Joshua if there was someone he respected, to which Joshua replied that that person was his [[Julius Juukulius|brother]], though after recalling something in the past, his feelings became a little complicated. Schult looked forward to meeting him, and Joshua claimed that Julius would treat him kindly, but soon after, they noticed a commotion ahead. Realizing the danger, Joshua gave Schult his letter and told him to run, telling him to convey it Schult's master to pass along to his brother. After Schult ran, Joshua stepped in the way of [[Lye Batenkaitos]] as he was about to attack a defenseless woman, allowing her to escape while Lye became interested in him and devoured his name and memories. ==Trivia== *According to [[Re:Zero Prequel: Camp Formation Stories]], Schult's favorite color is red. *Schult is illiterate.  *Schult was the one who handled Priscilla's change of clothing, despite him being a little boy. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Priscilla Camp]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Butlers]] [[Category:House Barielle]] [[Category:Nobles]]
