[[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 24|Arc 3 Chapter 24]] (actual) |Anime = [[Episode 19]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kenji Nomura|Nomura Kenji]] |English Voice = Imari Williams}} '''Ricardo Welkin''' (リカード・ウェルキン) is a member of the [[Anastasia Camp]] and the captain of the mercenary group known as the [[Iron Fang]]. He played a supporting role in [[Arc 3]] and [[Arc 5]]. A member of the wolf human tribe, he left his hidden village and found himself as a slave. After a chance encounter with [[Anastasia Hoshin]] and his eventual freedom from slavery, he started up the Iron Fang, and he, alongside the Pearlbaton triplets, decided to follow Anastasia as she ran her company and joined the [[Royal Selection]]. ==Appearance== Ricardo is a large wolf human with a full set of sharp teeth. He has green eyes, a muscular build and is covered with short brown body fur with an oblong, dark-brown mane which he adorns as a [[Wikipedia:Mohawk Hairstyle|mohican]] with two small red braids coming from the sides of his mane. He has tan-color fur on his chest, biceps, mouth, and palms, and he has a dark-brown beard. Ricardo wears long, black toeless pants, black arm guards, and white wrappings under his dark-colored clothes on his arms and waist along with an orange belt. He also wears a shoulder guard that has a logo representing the Hoshin Company. In the web novel, Ricardo's fur was originally reddish brown, and he had black eyes. However, his fur was changed to regular brown, and his eyes to green in the light novel so that he camouflaged better with the environment. In the anime, his eyes are turquoise and the wrapping on his shoulder guard is made from leather instead of being a chain like in the light novel. He was also given paws on the soles of his feet in the anime unlike in the light novel. In Anastasia's flashback in the manga, Ricardo legs were covered with a white wrapping on his ankles, and he wore [[Wikipedia:Waraji|waraji]] on his feet, rather like [[Al]]'s design. This garb is not worn by Ricardo in Arc 3. During the [[Battle for Priestella]], [[Roy Alphard]] sliced off Ricardo's right arm at the elbow. As a result, he now has a prosthetic hook fitted to his stump. ==Personality== Ricardo is usually laid back and outgoing, and he talks in a loud voice which sounds like a heavy wind blowing by. As the captain of the Iron Fang, he usually calms his teammates down right before battling, such as making jokes to make others laugh. Like Anastasia, Ricardo speaks with a Kansai dialect. Not only that Ricardo is the strongest member of the Iron Fang, but he's also the greatest tactician. He carefully thinks before he plans out for an attack. However, he tends to be rash as he has a habit of heading straight into battle; he usually listens to [[Hetaro Pearlbaton|Hetaro]]'s orders during battle. ==History== Ricardo grew up with his fellow wolf human tribesmen, and before setting out on his own, he made an oath never to reveal himself as a wolf human, as doing so could put the entire race at risk due to the stigma that has lasted for 300 years. If he were to break this oath, [[Halibel]] would be the one sent to kill him. As such, Ricardo referred to himself as a dogperson rather than a wolf human. ===[[Anastasia's Rising in Life Memorial Day]]=== Before Ricardo worked with Anastasia, he was formerly a slave. He was passing by down an alleyway, where he spotted four slave traders trying to capture a young girl with purple hair. Ricardo successfully prevented them from stealing off with the girl and killed all four of them. During that time, he decided that he would take her from the streets and get her a job. He secured her a job and the two of them had a last conversation before parting for a while. She pledged that she would remove his collar one day, which had been left as a reminder of what he had been. Ricardo would remember her pledge from that moment on. ===[[Anastasia's Kararagi Merchant Path]]=== Around a month later, Ricardo returned to the bar as he liked to check up on Anastasia every so often to make sure she was getting on well, but to his dismay, he did not find Anastasia there. He learned that she had joined a company called the Chuden Company in the east side of [[Banan]]. Ricardo knew that he had to check on Anastasia at once, worried that the company could be a pretext for one that dealt with slaves. Ricardo immediately headed to the Chuden Company, where he met [[Chuden Agri|Chuden]] at the reception, as well as Anastasia. Ricardo demanded to know what he wanted with Anastasia, suspecting foul play, but Chuden assuaged his fears and told Ricardo he had hired the girl because he had been astonished at how talented she was. Ricardo eventually accepted Anastasia working for Chuden, and he offered his services as a mercenary to him. Chuden accepted and hired Ricardo to work at the company as his personal bodyguard. He was given a new collar that marked his status as the "hound" of the company, though the collar had its control gem removed. ===[[Kararagi Girl Meets Cats Part 1|Kararagi Girl Meets Cats]] and [[Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye Part 1|Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye]]=== Sometime later, Chuden put him in charge of hunting down thieves and bandits in the outskirts of Banan. During his hunt, he encountered with the multi-armed [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] named [[Didorii]]. Didorii threw insults at Ricardo because his race was on the verge of extinction. Ricardo denied that he was a wolf human and insisted he was a dogperson, but Didorii didn't buy it, proclaiming that wolf humans taught themselves to tell lies in order to survive. Later, Ricardo, along with his mercenary group, ambushed the slave trading company and challenged Didorii in a one-on-one combat. He won the battle against Didorii and killed him. Later on, for breaking his oath to his people, Halibel was sent to slay Ricardo. However, thanks to Anastasia’s interference, the conflict was settled, and Halibel and Ricardo went their separate ways, remaining friends. ===[[Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook]]=== As [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]] was lamenting having forgotten even his own [[Joshua Juukulius|brother]], apologizing to him for it at his bedside, Ricardo came into the room and confirmed that the two were related through his sense of smell. Though he had forgotten Julius, he claimed that in spite of that, he could tell that he was still one of them, and he patted his head. Julius's gaze sank to Ricardo's severed arm, and Ricardo scolded him for it, stating that it was his own problem. The lack of change in the man gave Julius a sense of relief, and Ricardo mentioned that thinking in such a way naturally comes to someone who live for a long time, including Julius. Afterward, Ricardo entrusted Anastasia to Julius, as he was aware of their next [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|journey]], and he claimed he would not forget it and that Julius must not forget either. After accepting his trust and entrusting Joshua to him in return, Julius pulled out a notebook, which he claimed that he would be writing his experiences and words he's spoken with in, that way he wouldn't forget again, which brought relief to Ricardo. ===[[Those Remaining in the Watergate City, Priestella Reconstruction Journal|Priestella Reconstruction Journal]]=== Following the Battle for Priestella, Ricardo partook in a mission to retrieve the [[Typhon|Witch]]’s remains from the catacombs of [[Priestella]] alongside [[Garfiel Tinzel]], [[Ezzo Cadner]], and [[Liliana Masquerade]], which was a success. ===[[Kararagi Reaper Incident 1|Kararagi Reaper Incident]]=== Around the time of the end of the [[Great Disaster]], Ricardo found himself in Banan. Unfortunately, he was caught up in a windstorm brought about by the Slasher, [[Zarestia]], who had come searching for her stolen Light Sphere. With all of the townspeople and the Pearlbatons being held in the air like hostages and Zarestia believing Ricardo to be the thief, the two confronted each other. Bruised, injured, and realizing that he would be unable to defeat, stop, or reason with her, Ricardo decided to sit down and take her attacks. By doing so, she focused all of her power on him in an attempt to make him give her the location of her Light Sphere. However, because of his tenacity to endure it, he was able to withstand it, and Zarestia decided released the windstorm that was ravaging the town. Releasing her hostages, the two decided to talk and introduced themselves. Afterward, in order to watch over her, Ricardo brought her to [[Riften Magoji]]'s mansion and sat her in a cell. As for Riften himself, he had gone missing. Sometime after Ricardo quelled Zarestia's rage, Anastasia's group arrived and were led to the holding cells. During their conversation, Julius noticed that she was a Great Spirit and introduced himself, while Halibel unintentionally riled her up by noticing her strange constitution, that something was missing. However, when Anastasia mentioned Zarestia being responsible for other such town-destroying wind cataclysms, Zarestia declared otherwise, saying that she only rampaged in Banan. Shortly afterward, this is confirmed when a massive tornado appeared outside of Banan, not made by Zarestia. After giving her orders and securing Zarestia's assistance, the group made their way to stop the tornado. Although they managed to quell the winds, however, they soon realized that Anastasia and [[Eridna|Echidna]] had gone missing. ==Abilities== ===Overall Abilities=== Ricardo mainly fights hand to hand using both instinct and intuition that has been honed over many years, and he has also shown experience in wielding his large sword in combat. He is a strong warrior capable of holding his own against a superior warrior such as Roy Alphard for a short time. After his hand was severed from his body, he got it replaced with a prosthetic hook. It is unclear if this affects or impairs him in any way, but he is still shown capable of fighting even with the prosthetic. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== [[File:Ricardo Strength - 2.gif|thumb|250px|Ricardo flinging Wilhelm to the sky.]] '''Enhanced Strength''': Ricardo has greater strength than the average person. With a single swing of his blade, he was capable of sending a full-grown man flying many meters into the sky. Likewise, he was also capable of keeping himself planted to the ground while being assaulted by the winds of the Slasher, despite her attempts to send him flying. '''Enhanced Endurance''': Alongside his strength, Ricardo has considerable endurance. He is capable of withstanding a non-stop barrage of damage from someone as powerful as the Slasher and maintain his consciousness without even a single sound of complaint. '''Demi-Human Senses''': Due to his demi-human blood, Ricardo has heightened senses, such as excellent eyesight, incredible hearing, and a keen sense of smell. ===Other=== '''Roaring Wave''' (咆哮波, ''Hōkōha''): Ricardo can unleash a burst of violent destructive mana from his mouth. As the creator of the technique, he can unleash the attack on his own without assistance, unlike the Pearlbaton triplets. However, compared to Mimi, who can reduce the burden by sharing it with one of her brothers, a Roaring Wave used by a single person is a huge burden to the body. He can unleash a powerful force from the attack as many times as he wants to, but if he uses it too often, he can sustain significant backlash, such as vomiting blood and creating large cuts from the edges of his mouth. '''[[Iron Fang]]''' (鉄の牙, ''Tetsu no Kiba''): Ricardo is the leader of the mercenary group Iron Fang. The group is filled with highly skilled combatants, and their duties vary depending on their assignments. The group is most commonly associated with Anastasia Hoshin and the Hoshin Company. ===Equipment=== *'''Sword''': Ricardo wields a large, hatchet-like greatsword. *'''Prosthetic Iron Hook''': Following his battle with Roy Alphard in Arc 5, Ricardo permanently lost his right arm, as it was tossed into a nearby water canal and was unable to be located and reattached. Due to this devastating injury, Ricardo has lost a significant degree of his former strength. However, even with this debilitating injury, he is still able to fight and even implements it as a means of inflicting damage to others. ==Trivia== *Ricardo likes to make jokes and imitates a dog as it is a part of his hobby. *Similarly to Anastasia, Ricardo likes to drink alcohol-based drinks, most presumably Sake. *The reason why Ricardo refers to Anastasia as "Ana-bo" is likely because when he had met her, he had taken her for a boy. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Kararagi Navbox}} [[Category:Banan]] [[Category:Anastasia Camp]] [[Category:Iron Fang]] [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Mercenaries]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[de:Ricardo Welkin]] [[es:Ricardo Welkin]] [[fr:Ricardo Welkin]] [[pt-br:Ricardo Welkin]] [[ru:Рикардо Велкин]] [[zh:角色:里卡多]]

Unnamed wife |Divine Protection = [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Evaluation|Divine Protection of Evaluation]] |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 6|Volume 6]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 3 Chapter 16|Arc 3 Chapter 16]] |Anime = [[Episode 16]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Tōru Ōkawa|Ōkawa Tōru]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Chris Cason|Chris Cason]]}} '''Russell Fellow''' (ラッセル・フェロー) is the chairman and treasurer of the Commerce Guild in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]].''Bearing the title of chairman of the Royal Capital’s Commerce Guild, it was Russell Fellow who was present here.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 20, Section 3. However, behind the scenes, he works as the current Director of the mysterious defense organization known as the [[Six Tongues]]. He played a supporting role in [[Arc 3]] and [[Arc 10]]. Debuting in Arc 3, Russell made a deal with [[Natsuki Subaru]] to participate and cooperate in negotiations with [[Crusch Karsten]] on the condition that he relinquish his cell phone once he had finished hunting the [[White Whale]].''“You were a big help, Russell. Just like I promised, I’ll give you my cell phone after we’re done hunting the White Whale.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7]], Chapter 1, Section 3.''Once he got ahold of Russell, whose negotiations with Crusch had similarly failed during Subaru’s third time through the loop, they agreed to help each other during the meeting. That cooperation rested on the condition that Subaru would eventually hand over his cell phone.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7]], Chapter 1, Section 3. At some point after the end of the arc, Subaru forfeited his cell phone to Russell under Crusch's supervision.''“After the results of Arc 3, it was handed over under Crusch’s supervision.”'' July 31, 2014 AskFM Q&A ==Appearance== Russell is a tall man with dull blond hair and blue eyes. He wears a good quality suit with a limited number of adornments as to not look crude, giving off the impression of an able man. ==Personality== Russell is a realist that is shrewd with money. He tends to decide on things based on profits and losses and, in his capacity as the treasurer of the Commerce Guild, is only interested in figuring out how he can earn the most, leading to him being described as a mosquito that tries to drain as much money as possible from his opponents. He has a notable reputation in the underworld of the [[Royal Capital]], including in the slums, and although he is married, his marriage was purely for political purposes, therefore he has no love for his wife. Likewise, he is not the kind of person to spread rumors without there being any gain in return, and he would use whatever information was at his disposal to achieve his goals.''What could be gleaned from speaking with him was that Russell was the kind of guy that would never spread rumors without gaining anything from it. It would not be right to describe him as being a good person. However, he wasn’t necessarily evil, either. He was the type of person who would use the information at his disposal in order to guide others towards fulfilling his own plans.'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 3]], Section 2. However, beneath this image lies a very cunning and ruthless man. Heavily loyal to the Kingdom, he is willing to do anything to maintain the authority of the Kingdom, including having people threaten members of [[House Astrea]] after learning the danger that a young [[Reinhard van Astrea]]. Furthermore, he has no qualms in using curses to torture his subordinates who fail him, and he is indifferent to their suffering so long as it means. Furthermore, due to his jobs as both a merchant and leader of an intelligence organization, Russell is distrusting by nature, which may lead him to question his allies when necessary.''But, from Subaru’s perspective, this was a pointless quarrel. After all, Subaru and Beatrice did not have any way of contacting Roswaal either, and being distrustful was just Russell’s own bad habit. Perhaps it was a symptom of his career choice.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 1. This being said, Russell is not incapable of compromise when necessary, and he is understanding when it comes to his allies keeping secrets if need be.''"It is an exceedingly natural precaution and arrangement to have, so I would not blame you."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 1. ==History== Russell was born as the second son to the Fellow family. With his family's influence and connection to the Commerce Guild, he often had the chance to do business that allowed him to visit the castle grounds in place of his father and older brother. From a young age, he was involved with the Six Tongues, quickly acquiring a role that allowed him to act as a supervisor. As the son of a merchant who frequented [[Fareed Impusen]], a noble who felt burning patriotism for Lugunica, Russell found himself in the position to give advice to the man, guiding him in a direction that led him to founding the Golden Wing Party while having him believe he made all of his choices of his own volition. ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica]]=== Roughly 15 years before the events of the main story, at the age of 14, Russell Fellow set up [[Roswaal L. Mathers]]'s mugging, right after the latter left the Royal Castle after the ceremony where he inherited the family name of Roswaal. By having his subordinate [[Belmont]] steal Roswaal's golden plume, which coincidentally resembled the symbol of the Golden Wing Faction, he aimed to insure that the man had no ill plans with the Kingdom. He accompanied Roswaal in reclaiming his plume from The Brotherhood, led by [[Marcos Gildark]], a knight who deserted his position to support the residents of the slums, and witnessed the two fight. Later, he teamed up with Roswaal and helped him form an alliance between two rivalling groups: The Brotherhood, led by [[Marcos Gildark]], and the Golden Wing Faction led by Fareed Impusen. In their conversation afterwards, Roswaal insinuated to Russell that he had caught on to how the Golden Wing Faction had been truly founded. That same night, Russell met with Belmont, ordering him to accompany Fareed and the Brotherhood to [[Costuul]]. When asked about Roswaal, he said that the noble had caught on to more than he had bargained for, having perceived Russell's involvement with the Golden Wing Faction. Belmont also informed Russell that the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing had been detected from the Astrea Manor. The mansion was then invaded by multiple unknown assailants, and Heinkel suspected of and questioned for potentially holding intentions of insurrection by means of the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing. Quickly realizing that his son was the only person who could have used it, having so in an attempt to aid his father with convincing Marcos to rejoin the Royal Guard, he rushed to Reinhard's room and scolded for his actions, and the young boy, who had erased the Divine Protection forever, saw a figure outside of the mansion's window who mouthed to him a threat: that he must protect the Kingdom for his family. ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II]]=== Happening on Marcos some time later, Russell revealed that he had been aware of the knight's unrequited feelings for [[Theresia van Astrea]], choosing to keep them hidden. Afterwards, dropped by the Royal Magic Research Institute as was Roswaal conducting an experiment, and [[Serena Dracroy]], a noble from the [[Vollachia Empire]] who was visiting Lugunica as an envoy on official business, showed up, requesting a tour of the facility. When Roswaal left with Serena to educate her on magic, [[Minor Characters#Ilzea|Ilzea]], who had been a researcher in the Royal Magic Research Institute, was ordered by Russell to keep an eye on Roswaal's activity, worried that his enthusiasm to teach educate a noble from Vollachia in magic could lead to them using it in the future. However, Roswaal had been preemptively aware that Ilzea was affiliated with Russell and had a means of contacting him. Detecting a wavelength of mana that resembled Serena's magic stone earrings as she was leaving Lugunica with [[Gwain Merette|Alagar]] in custody, Roswaal, realizing she had been put in a situation where the magic stones needed to be used, requested Ilzea to get in contact with Russell. Roswaal decided to to trace Serena's magic and contact them himself, and was given a Conversation Mirror by Russell, which he used later to contact him when notifying him of the situation with the assassins and seek his opinions. Once the situation was resolved, Alagar was allowed to remain in Lugunica so long as he hid his lineage, assuming the new identity of Gwain Merette, and being employed by the Fellow family. At some point within the next five years, Russell succeeded [[Orphe]]'s position as the Director of the Six Tongues, and at an unknown point in time, he also became the treasurer and representative of the Kingdom’s Commerce Guild. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 5|Riot in Flanders]]=== Following the failure of [[Helaine Gatness]]’s plan to replace the [[Manfred Madison|leader]] of The Balance with [[Mozolite|a pawn]] who was easier for her to manipulate and manage, she was taken into custody by the Six Tongues. Russell interrogated her, outlining that she disobeyed her orders by attempting to act on her plan and the balance of power in [[Flanders]] was satisfactory the way it was. Though he concluded that the incident was effective in measuring the abilities of the [[Felt|Golden Lion]] and the [[Rachins Hoffman|Hoffman family's son]], once Helaine finished her explanation, he punished her with torture via a curse mark engraved on her back, inflicting intense pain to her when he placed his palm on it. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 2|The Lion’s Ferocity]]=== Following the [[Battle for Priestella]], Felt and Reinhard escorted the captured [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Wrath]] to the Royal Capital’s Prison Tower. As Reinhard took her into the tower, Russell met Felt outside of the tower and invited her to dinner at his home. Later that night, she and Reinhard attended his dinner, where Russell was left starstruck by their relationship. Shortly after, they began discussing the intensifying heretic hunts of the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom]] amidst rumors of a Witch appearing there for the first time in over a hundred years, the balance of power between the ten mayors of the [[Kararagi|City-States]] showing indications of an upcoming collapse, and signs of a [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] brewing in the [[Vollachia Empire|Empire]]. Russell also mentions that big waves of change are rolling, one that hasn’t been seen in 400 years, which Felt attributes to Subaru and [[Emilia]]. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Evaluation|Divine Protection of Evaluation]]''' (目利きの加護, ''Mekiki no Kago''): This enables Russell to determine the value of an item,''"Well, that is not entirely incorrect. It is a Divine Protection. The Divine Protection of Evaluation, so it is called, allowing me to ascertain the value of the items I lay my eyes upon."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 1. and if the item is in front of him, he can evaluate its condition and quality with perfect accuracy. However, if he is evaluating an item he has never seen before, he can only know if it is of good or bad quality, and he gains no knowledge of how it is used or how much it is worth. He is also able to apply it to determine the superiority or inferiority of earth dragons, or even the abilities and competence of people. Furthermore, the value of an item that he observes can change depending on certain conditions: although he determined the value of Subaru's cell phone to be of high quality, the value he sees is only exhibited when in Subaru's hands, otherwise its value drops.''"Only when that meteor is present in your hands, Natsuki-dono, does it shoot up in value."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 1. '''[[Six Tongues]]''' (六枚舌, ''Roku-mai Jita''): Russell is the current Director of the Six Tongues, a secret organization that acts as the backbone of Lugunica from the shadows. At his command, they take on numerous missions, whether it is to maintain order, to quash illegal organizations, or to subdue anyone who threatens the Kingdom. ==Trivia== *At a talk show held on March 30, 2024, it was confirmed that Russell would be active in Arc 10. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Treasurers]] [[Category:Six Tongues]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[de:Russell Fellow]] [[es:Russell Fellow]] [[pt-br:Russell Fellow]] [[ru:Рассел Феллоу]] [[zh:角色:拉塞尔]]

Mendoza}} '''Roy Alphard''' (ロイ・アルファルド) is a '''[[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop]]''' of the '''[[Witch Cult]]''', representing the '''Bizarre Eating''' aspect of '''Gluttony''', and he is the brother of [[Lye Batenkaitos]] and [[Rui Arneb]]. He was one of the main antagonists of [[Arc 5]] and [[Arc 6]] as well as a secondary antagonist in [[Arc 9]]. During the events of Arc 5, he ate [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]]'s name, causing everyone but [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] to forget about him. In Arc 6, however, when he tried to devour [[Reid Astrea]], his body was taken over by his abnormally large soul. While he regained control of his body after Reid's soul shattered due to it being incompatible with Roy's body, the fatal wound rendered him unconscious, and he was sealed with the usage of Yin Magic and later locked away in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]’s Prison Tower. ==Appearance== Roy has long, disheveled red-tipped, dark brown hair tied into a braid behind his head, along with emerald green eyes that are yellow in the center and have a poisonous glimmer to them. He also has a young look, a mischievous smile, and wears a ripped, green cloth reminiscent of a men's cheongsam around his body. Like his siblings, his teeth are all pointed like fangs. ==Personality== Like his siblings, Roy speaks using in a collective manner, speaking with terms like "we" or "us" rather than third or first-person speech; he also thrives on devouring the lives and memories of his opponents in a manner reminiscent of Lye and Rui. However, unlike his siblings, Roy does not care about what specifically he eats. As Bizarre Eating, Roy has no preferences and craves and "loves" all people equally, and as such, he desires to devour every last person in the world. Accordingly, he does not share Lye's fastidiousness with his meals, lacking the meticulousness with proving opponents' worth and distinct likes and dislikes his brother had. As he initially devoured his enemies, he placed his hopes on the chance that one of his dishes would one day fill him, and that he could find his own course to appease his hunger like his siblings did. His failure to find his desired meal often led him to feeling dispirited, despondent, and disappointed. As such, he did not place any special emphasis on the quality of his meals nor who it was he ate, which led to multiple criticisms by his siblings. It was also for this reason that he kept one of the heads of the [[Black Serpent]] hidden away, since it could effectively immobilize his meals without killing them, giving him the chance to devour their names and memories. He is even willing to expose the Serpent in a heavily populated area in order to do this. After devouring Reid Astrea, however, who filled him to nearly literally bursting, his perspective changed. Understanding that his hunger may never be sated, Roy came to believe that, rather than wanting to sate his hunger, like his siblings attempt to do with their respective methods, what he wanted was a real feeling of living, and he was given a true purpose to devour his enemies. Likewise, whereas before, he would find no worth in many of the names and memories that he had devoured and kept stored away, forgotten, because of his change in perspective, he came to realize that even that which he had forgotten and saw no worth in did, in fact, carry worth, and he began to harbor gratitude toward every single thing he had eaten, believing that not a single thing in the world that he could eat was a foul ingredient. As such, during the temporary events of Arc 9, he came to the conclusion that even that which he had forgotten about could be useful and carry worth, something which led to him creating a new form of Eclipse, using the dregs from among what he had eaten. Even if he comes across powerful enemies upon whom he cannot devour, he is willing to throw away his will to devour them and push his life to the brink and fight with everything he has available to him, even if it means he has to regurgitate some of his past meals or burn his soul. Compared to Lye, who would flee or postpone his dishes to prioritize his own life, Roy believes that if he allows someone to escape him, he may never again get a chance to devour that person, and his meal will be lost on the high chance that the two will never again meet. Furthermore, he thinks if he does not exert his maximum effort, it would be a disservice his enemy who went out of their way to bring out their full potential to fight and counter him, and that unless he invests his entire being into what he desires, he cannot truly express love, an ideology he shares with his “[[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]]”. He also seems to display a seeming joy for battle as well, actively choosing not to heal himself in favor of choosing methods of attack, even if it means using up his life force. ==History== Due to the young age of the Gluttony siblings, they were assumedly born less than two decades prior to the beginning of the story. As one of the three children of the previous Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, [[Leilani Alnair]], Roy and his two siblings were kept in the womb by their mother for over three years through sheer force of will.''This too, was the achievement of Leilani's child―― or rather, children, it would seem, whom she kept in her womb for over three years with her own willpower, in order to perpetually be the pitied existence known as a pregnant woman. Although, the important babies themselves, as if unaware of the struggles of their pitiful mother, would foolishly kick her from within her abdomen quite frequently, incessantly begging to be let out.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. After Leilani conquered the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] and became the first person to arrive at the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in hundreds of years, she attempted to overwrite [[Shaula]]'s memories with her Authority, causing the Star Keeper to shoot a white light through her chest and subsequently eject her from the tower. The shot was presumably responsible for killing one of her unborn triplets, this being Rui,''Lye of Gourmet and Roy of Bizarre Eating, twins who shared in the same Witch Factor of Gluttony―― to be precise, they were triplets with Rui, who had died inside their mother’s womb, but contrary to expectations, they were siblings who had not been on the same wavelength with each other.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 6, Section 7. and Leilani was later found by a man with medical knowledge who ascertained that one of her children had died, but the other two were alive.''“One's done for… dead…! But, there's another… no, two are alive!”'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 3. Against Leilani's own wishes, her two surviving children, Lye and Roy, were saved and delivered, and she died a few moments after they were born.''“Birth parent? Or foster parent? The former died upon our birth and took our little sister with them as well, and the latter would surely~ be pretty incompatible with you, uncle.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 1, Section 4. Following Leilani's death, Rui's soul somehow persisted in the Corridor of Memories without being subjected to the soul filtering process, and the three siblings inherited their mother's Witch Factor of Gluttony. According to Reid Astrea, Roy got involved in unknown circumstances because he did not have a “stance” of his own. Sometime after becoming the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Roy met his younger sister, Rui Arneb, for the first time when she possessed Lye's body. He later gained access to Eclipse after discovering it alongside Lye and began utilizing it to devour as many people as he wanted. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Due to his vast collection of abilities given to him through the use of his Authority, Roy is among the most skilled of martial artists in the world, capable of fighting and outclassing most warriors by using a wide variety of physical techniques, magic, and other such abilities alongside his Authority, which could also allow him to instantly defeat any number of strong warriors so long as he touched them and knew their names. What makes him even more dangerous is that, due to the unique aspect of his [[Authority]], he had gone completely unnoticed until his ability was recognized after the events of Arc 3, meaning that he is not only strong, but he was also more than capable of escaping his enemies without anyone realizing exactly who or what he was. Furthermore, unlike his brother, his level of danger is further exacerbated by the indiscriminate nature of his point of view over his food. ===[[Authority]]=== Roy was one of the previous holders of the '''Witch Factor of Gluttony''' and could use its respective Authority, which granted him powers relating to consuming the memories, names, and souls connected to [[Od Lagna]]'s Register of Names and replicating their abilities for himself. '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Gluttony]]''' (暴食, ''Bōshoku''): Roy can eat the name and memories of his opponent. To eat a name, he touches them with his left hand, then licks the palm of the same hand. Things such as experience, talent, and the likes and dislikes of human relationships serve as food for him, allowing him to take advantage of any abilities or memories his opponents had. Likewise, he can choose whether or not to eat only names, only memories, or both, though he claims that it difficult and is like trying to eat only the ingredients in a sandwich without removing the buns. However, if Roy eats a fake name, or if he attempts to eat the previous name of a person who has managed to change their name, such as through marriage or adoption, he becomes plagued with severe nausea. Similarly, attempting to devour the name and memories of someone with a soul too large and powerful puts Roy at the risk being taken over by said spirit, as in the case of Reid Astrea. Even after killing Roy, the names and memories of his victims will not return to their original owners. However, he can regurgitate specific names and memories in order shake those who were at some point attached to certain people. According to Roy, anything that the siblings eat goes to the same '''Stomach of Souls''' (魂の胃袋, ''Tamashī no Ibukuro''), from which they can share and pull the same names and memories that their siblings have eaten. *Those that have had their names eaten have their existences erased from the world, destroying any human relationships along with negating any contracts with [[spirit]]s. *Those that have their memories eaten become amnesic and any characteristics they may have had are reset, effectively making them into a different person. *Those that have both their name and memories eaten simply become a shell, and although they live, they no longer eat, excrete waste, or age, putting them in suspended animation. *They cannot eat the same person twice until that individual gains enough new memories to establish a different sense of self from their old one. *Roy could not eat the names or memories of non-humanoid beings, such as different animals, [[witchbeast]]s, or [[Dragon|earth dragons]]. '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Eclipse]]''' (蝕, ''Shoku''): Eclipse is considered to be the trump card of Gluttony. It is split into two types: '''Solar Eclipse''' and '''Lunar Eclipse'''. Furthermore, as a result of his change in perspective in the wake of devouring Reid Astrea, during the struggle for the Grand Mogolade Geyser, Roy developed '''Eclipsing Binary''', a new form of Eclipse, before its events were undone with Return by Death. *'''Lunar Eclipse''' (月食, ''Gesshoku''): This allows the holder to use their victims' memories and harvest their skills and knowledge. Roy used Lunar Eclipse to boost his physical strength and speed in his fight against Julius and [[Ricardo Welkin]]. On top of that, Roy could also combine any number of memories and skills which would in turn allow him to create any sort of synthesized super-class technique he desired. However, Roy cannot bring forth the true potential of techniques in this manner, only being granted a portion of the technique's power. It is worth noting that by eating a person's name and using Lunar Eclipse, Roy does not gain his victims' [[Divine Protection]]s, spiritual arts, or Authorities. *'''Solar Eclipse''' (日食, ''Nisshoku''): This allows the holder to harvest their victims' name and transform their appearance accordingly. Rui, for example, transformed into [[Neiji Lockhart]] and numerous other victims she and her two brothers had eaten throughout the years using her sibling's body. By doing so, though he becomes limited in the number of techniques he can use, the techniques that belong to those who Roy has transformed into can achieve their full potential. Roy does not like using Solar Eclipse because he does not like the side effects of morphing into his victims, as he feels as though he loses his sense of self. *'''Eclipsing Binary''' (蝕連星, ''Shoku Rensei''): In the events of the Arc 9 loop, Roy was able to manifest a new ability of his Authority that allowed Roy to extract and blend specific memories from the Stomach of Souls, then cast them towards his opponents. However, as the memories sent to his opponents were foreign to them, rather than experiencing the memories gathered by Roy, the memories hurled towards an opponent would incite them to recall the experience of the most similar memories they had. Roy utilized this power to take the concept of memories of agony and send it at his opponents, prompting each of them to experience a harsh feeling of agony they once underwent. '''Life Creation''': Rui stated she and her brothers can create life with the usage of her Witch Factor of Gluttony, just like how Daphne created the witchbeasts four centuries ago. However, Rui has also stated she and her brothers had no reason to do so, hence they never followed through the idea.''“You know the Three Great Witchbeasts? It’s said that those, are monsters created by the owner of our Witch Factor long before us. We too, can do something similar. We didn’t do that because there wasn’t really any meaning in doing so…… but, you see.”'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 75. While all of this has been strictly stated by Rui, it's safe to assume Roy can also create life through the usage of his Witch Factor of Gluttony. *'''[[Witchbeast]] Control''': Because Roy, Lye, and Rui each possess the Witch Factor of Gluttony previously owned by [[Daphne]], they can direct witchbeasts to attack certain areas. This was why the [[White Whale]]’s attacks were coordinated with those of the Witch Cult. In Arc 6, Lye and Roy are able to get to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in half a day by commanding the witchbeasts in the Augria Sand Dunes and order them to attack the Watchtower. In Arc 9, Roy shows that he can command one of the heads of the Black Serpent, having it fight alongside him. The White Whale, as well as, to an extent, the [[Great Rabbit]] can also obey the Factor holder's will.''“The White Whale obeys Daphne’s Witch Factor. The Rabbit, too, might obey to a certain extent.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/494741464396886016 July 31, 2014 AskFM Q&A] ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Master Martial Prowess''': Through the accumulation of souls eaten with his Authority, Roy gains any abilities his victims once had such as martial art techniques and weapon skills by using Lunar Eclipse. In turn, this grants him extraordinary combat strength. He was able to overpower both Julius and Ricardo, who are noted to be very strong. ===Techniques=== [[File:Roy - Lunar Eclipse (Ultimate Palm).gif|thumb|250px|Roy employing '''Lunar Eclipse''' to apply '''Ultimate Palm''' against Julius.]] '''Ultimate Palm''' (絶掌, ''Zettenohira''): Ultimate Palm is a powerful palm strike granting Roy the sheer power to push people flying back with the force of a car and to destroy physical objects like swords by merely colliding with them. This ability is implied to originally belong to an individual who claimed to slay eighty-eight “pretty boys”.''“This strike has slain eighty-eight other pretty boys… Did you feel it in the marrow of your bones, nii-sama?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Prologue, Section 3. '''Serpent of the Twin Swords''' (双剣の蛇, ''Sō Ken no Hebi''): With Serpent of the Twin Swords, Roy has the technique to swiftly use his daggers at high speeds, granting him the skill to direct a flurry of slashes at an opponent. '''Carnivorous Beast''' (肉食獣, ''Nikushoku-jū''): Carnivorous Beast allows Roy to strengthen his body and gives him two advantages: he can withstand powerful attacks and strengthen his limbs to deliver devastating blows that, from Subaru's perspective, would be as devastating as getting hit by a car. With it, he could prevent himself from being beheaded by point blank wind magic from [[Ram]]. This ability originally belonged to [[Beli Hainelga]]. '''Palm of the Fist King''' (拳王の掌, ''Ken Ō no Tenohira''): Palm of the Fist King allows Roy to strike his opponents with an extremely powerful fist, and its destructive force grants him the capability to blast and drill through steel or flesh. This ability originally belonged to Neiji Lockhart. '''Leaper''' (跳躍者, ''Chōyaku-sha''): Leaper allows Roy to use a short-range teleportation in quick succession, essentially allowing him to "leap" behind his opponents or avoid extremely precise and quick attacks. He is also capable of utilizing it vertically, making it appear as if he's flying. This ability originally belonged to [[Dorkell]]. '''Snow Vallum''' (雪喰, ''Yukikui''): A technique that allows Roy to enhance his physical might and grappling strength, and by doing so, he can stop the charge or attack of a beast larger than himself, such as a [[Witchbeast#Guiltylowe|Guiltylowe]]. The technique originally belonged to [[Minor Characters#Tislow|Tislow]], and it is fabled to have enough strength to stop an entire avalanche. '''Compactor''' (圧搾屋, ''Assaku-ya''): An ability that allows Roy to, by closing their hands together, manipulate the earth around him as if moving sand, and by doing so, everything from the edges from his vision can be gathered in one spot and crushed by the earth. By only partially using this technique can allow Roy to obstruct his opponents' line of sight by raising the earth. The technique originally belonged to [[Minor Characters#Figdour|Figdour]]. '''Saintess of a Thousand Visages''' (千面聖女, ''Sen-men Seijo''): A technique that allows Roy to see three hundred and sixty degrees degrees around himself from both left to right and top to bottom. The technique originally belonged to [[Minor Characters#Iyerna|Iyerna]]. '''Blighted Love Balladeer''' (悲恋歌人, ''Hiren Kajin''): A technique that allows Roy to use his voice to freeze an opponent in place. It is unclear whether this falls under magic, as it is described as a curse ballad. The technique originally belonged to [[Minor Characters#Notah|Notah]]. ===[[Magic]]=== Like with his martial prowess, due to having eaten numerous names and memories, Roy has obtained access to numerous magic abilities. However, this does not increase his mana pool, meaning that he might not be able to use spells to their fullest potential depending on the spells' respective mana consumptions. [[File:Roy - Lunar Eclipse (Twilight Mage).gif|thumb|250px|Roy employing '''Lunar Eclipse''' to apply '''Twilight Mage''' against Ricardo.]] '''Twilight Mage''' (逢魔術師, ''Ōmajutsu-shi''): Twilight Mage grants unique magical abilities to Roy, such as manipulating a stream of water into a pair of massive serpentine water dragons that can tear someone's body apart or countering the effects of others' magic by nullifying it with his own. This ability is implied to originally belong to an insignificant sorcerer who was a social outcast unloved by even their family.''“We are but a poor, insignificant, unknown mage. A social outcast unloved even by our family. Was that how it went?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Prologue, Section 3. '''Magic Manus Magister''' (魔弄師, ''Ma Rō-shi''): A technique that allows Roy to manipulate multiple magic attributes to cast multiple spells at once, such as by simultaneously creating spears of flame, ice, and earth, which had the capacity to lock onto and fire at a target. The technique originally belonged to [[Minor Characters#Yardray|Yardray]]. '''Unique Spells''': [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 42 10.png|thumb|180x|Roy employing Blood Weeping Oni and Lord of Phantasmal Rainbows simultaneously.]] *'''Blood-Weeping Oni''' (血涙鬼, ''Ketsurui Oni''): Blood-Weeping Oni allows Roy to manipulate his own spilt blood to bind and attack his enemies. He can also make his blood coagulate and return to his body, essentially allowing him to halt his own bleeding. This originally belonged to [[Minor Characters#Advan|Advan]]. *'''Lord of Phantasmal Rainbows''' (虹幻公, ''Kōgen Kō''): By using the residual mana of the corpses of witchbeasts as catalysts, Roy can create rainbow butterflies that create prismatic explosions upon contact with the target. Though, they can be made to detonate early by using the environment or magic in place of oneself. The technique is reminiscent of the prismatic spiritual arts of Julius Juukulius,''Amidst the devoured memories, a throbbing sensation arose as he delightfully recollected a sword clad in a rainbow aurora―― fundamentally, the special technique deployed by the Finest of Knights was of the same ilk as the rainbow butterflies. That which the Finest made manifest through his talents and the powers of his contracted spirits, the Lord of Phantasmal Rainbows conjured in exchange for the dried up dregs of life, such was the entirety of the matter.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 2, Section 11. meaning that the butterflies are likely made up of all six elements. These butterflies can also be used as mana tanks, from which Roy can absorb into his own body to maintain his mana stores.''The butterflies that emerged from mana leftover in carcasses exhibited destructive might despite being of simple chemical construct, but they were also capable of sequestrating magic as external tanks of mana. For Roy, who wished to subsist the Flow Method in his dying body with his own mana expense, they were automated reinforcements who would only be supplemented the more the Black Serpent slaughtered.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 9. This originally belonged to [[Minor Characters#Matclyma Jordon|Matclyma Jordon]]. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Despite coming off as a depraved lunatic, Roy is also deceptively smart and devious. After witnessing the display of a strange Authority, he was able to quickly deduce [[Petra Leyte|who]] was using it, despite lacking any prior knowledge of it, as well as realize that its ability was related to the shortening of events, despite the intangible nature of her Authority. Likewise, he is shown to prepare traps and plan for certain eventualities; when he was held captive by Aldebaran and had his [[curse]]'s restrictions loosened, he was quick to form an alliance with [[Felt|another captive]] and had already prepared "insurance" in the eventuality that she would inevitably betray him, all the while planning for a massacre in the near future. On top of this, having devoured so many names and memories, he also has a vast stockpile of knowledge at the tips of his fingers, and the only thing he needs to do to access it is unearth it from his stockpile. ===[[Curse]]=== '''Oath Bound Curse Mark''' (誓約の呪印, ''Seiyaku no Juin''): Upon being freed from his prison by Al in Arc 9, Roy had an oath bound curse mark carved onto him. According to his oath, if he was to ever break his promise and consume anyone with his Authority of Gluttony besides the one person Al has told him to eat, he would be engulfed in a purifying flame, scorching his body and tainting his soul, never allowing it to return to [[Od Lagna]].''“Should I renounce this oath, my soul shall be tainted and my flesh enveloped and burned away by purifying flame. And my soul shall fall into the void, never to return to Od Lagna again.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]], Closing Chapter, Section 5. However, Al repeatedly loosened the curse mark's conditions in order to allow for Roy to eat the memories of other people or his own name depending on the situation. In the end, Roy defied the conditions of the curse mark to devour [[Witch#Witch#Witch of Melancholy, Petra Leyte|a Witch]], and was thereafter scorched by blue flames and killed by [[Reinhard van Astrea|someone else]] before said flames could take his life. Following Subaru using Return by Death and undoing the events of the arc, Roy's death was reverted, and as such, he no longer has this curse. ===Equipment=== *'''Claws & Daggers''': Roy wields two claws from his hands that he uses with his speed and lightness. He also wields daggers that were hidden inside of his clothes. *'''Gospel''' (福音): As a member of the Witch Cult, Roy is the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel was a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed [[Echidna]]. The [[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]] would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult were imperfect replicas, meaning that, although they detailed the future of its owner, the events conveyed were subject to change and the information provided was often up for interpretation. The Gospels took the form of small black books that could only be read by their owners. ==Trivia== *Like the other Sin Archbishops (with the exception of [[Stride Vollachia]]), Roy received his namesake from a celestial body. Alphard, meaning "the individual", is the name of the brightest star in the Hydra constellation. The star's meaning is also known as "the backbone of the serpent". *Before being explicitly confirmed at a talk show held on July 26, 2026, it was heavily implied in the story of Scorpion Tale and by the author's comments in its afterword that Leilani was the mother of Lye, Roy, and Rui. **As Leilani is the mother of the siblings, the "Lei" part of her name is likely a reference to how, in Japanese, the given names of the siblings all share a first syllable beginning with "R" sound and have an "i" sound in the second syllable. Therefore, the "Lei" part of Leilani's name, pronounced Rei (レイ), would mirror Rai (ライ), Roi (ロイ), and Rui (ルイ). *Roy, like Lye, dislikes using Solar Eclipse. According to him and his brother, it seems to make him experience the victims' thoughts which make him feel like he's being damaged. He describes this feeling as unbearable. *It is hinted that Roy is working for Mother, being one of her "children", just like [[Elsa Granhiert|Elsa]] and [[Meili Portroute|Meili]].''“If it’s just us, then that’s still something, but if guys like Regulus or Sirius, and even Mama on top of that, have shown up, then hell would be more preferable anyway.”'' [[Malice Before the Theater]], Section 3.''“Onii-chan has been defeated decisively, and even nii-sama is that woman’s yes-man. It doesn’t matter whether it’s Gourmet or Bizarre Eating for us. ――Really, neither of them understand.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 6. *In a Q&A, the author stated that if Daphne and a Sin Archbishop of Gluttony were to fight, it would most likely end in a draw. It is unknown if this answer was stating that a fight with Roy and his siblings would end in a draw against the Witch of Gluttony if they fought her all at once, nor is it known if the resulting draw would only come from a match with one of them. *Roy was sealed off in the same way as the Witch of Envy; with the usage of a complex application of Yin Magic, rendering him stuck in time. *Originally, Roy was the one who devoured the name and memories of [[Joshua Juukulius]] in the shop special release of [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Second Encyclopedia]], but the illustration incorrectly depicted his brother Lye instead. In [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 11|Tanpenshuu Volume 11]], this was remedied by having the story rewritten to feature Lye rather than Roy. *According to the author, Roy has devoured far more names and memories than Lye has. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Cult Navbox}} {{Beloved Children Navbox}} [[Category:Sin Archbishops]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[Category:Arc 5 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 6 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 9 Antagonists]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[de:Roy Alphard]] [[es:Roy Alphard]] [[fr:Roy Alphard]] [[pl:Roy Alphard]] [[pt-br:Roy Alphard]] [[ru:Лой Альфард]] [[uk:Рой Альфард]] [[zh:角色:罗伊]]

Unnamed father (deceased) |Magic = Likely all 6 types of magic |Divine Protection = |Authority = [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]] |Weapon = |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20|Volume 20]] |Manga = |Anime = [[Episode 66]] |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Konomi Kohara|Kohara Konomi]] |English Voice =}} '''Rui Arneb''' (ルイ・アルネブ) is a '''[[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop]]''' of the '''[[Witch Cult]]''', representing the '''Satiation''' aspect of '''Gluttony'''. First introduced in [[Arc 5]], she later served as one of the main antagonists of [[Arc 6]], alongside her brothers, [[Lye Batenkaitos|Lye]] and [[Roy Alphard|Roy]]. After a chance encounter with [[Natsuki Subaru]], she learned of Return by Death and attempted to steal his existence. However, Subaru managed to defeat her and eject the clone of her that was attached to him, leaving said clone to confront her original self in the [[Od Lagna#Corridor of Memories|Corridor of Memories]]. While it is unknown what became of them in their clash, a new version of Rui with a dramatically different personality appeared at the end of the arc, eventually becoming [[Spica]]. ==Appearance== In contrast to her brothers, Rui has large blue eyes, light skin, and extremely long blonde hair that can cover the floor like a golden sea. However, as is the case with Lye and Roy, she has fang-shaped teeth which help her smile look to be one more reminiscent of a menacing smirk. She normally wears an elegant white dress that nearly looks transparent. It comes with a jabot that has two small red lines along the leftmost side. She is physically in her mid-teens, although her exact age is unknown. Rui's debut in Arc 5 featured her in her brother Lye's black cloak. It was tied just below her neck, and it had uneven tears along the lower portion. As Rui's physical self had been trapped within the Corridor of Memories until Arc 6's climax, she occasionally took over the bodies of her brothers in order to experience the outside world. ==Personality== Subaru describes her as a girl that'd look good with a smile, yet he describes her "smile" as a smirk and gave off the feeling that she made light on the lives of many people. She is also described to be evil intent in the shape of a child. Rui doesn't care much about what she eats, putting more emphasis on who she wants to eat with, befitting of her role as '''Satiation'''. Also, the three speak in a collective manner using us and we instead of first or third person. Being the youngest sibling, Rui initially​ gave off the impression of being respectful and loving towards her brothers, but she later reveals that she found them idiotic for blindly eating lives for her just because she was unable to exit the Corridor of Memories. Rui believed that life was unfair in a manner similar to that of a conveyor belt, without having the ability to choose the family, environment, and future to be born into. Because of these beliefs, Rui developed a goal of searching for, devouring, and becoming someone else all in the name of happiness, which would have allowed her to live with her head held high in a life she considers "ideal". In her desire to achieve a happy life for herself, Rui was very shrewd, claiming that Subaru helped his friends out of pity and that he did it all for his own gratification as part of her plan to get him to reject the existence of the ‘Natsuki Subaru’ and start thinking of himself as a separate individual from the original him. When she experienced [[Natsuki Subaru#Authorities|Return by Death]], the Rui that had entered Subaru as a Witch Factor became traumatized and got into a fight with the Rui within the Corridor of Memories, who retained her original personality. The end result of this confrontation was that Rui lost her original mind, regressing into an infant-like state. ==History== Due to the young age of the Gluttony siblings, they were assumedly born less than two decades prior to the beginning of the story. As one of the three children of the previous Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, [[Leilani Alnair]], Rui and her two siblings were kept in the womb by their mother for over three years through sheer force of will.''This too, was the achievement of Leilani's child―― or rather, children, it would seem, whom she kept in her womb for over three years with her own willpower, in order to perpetually be the pitied existence known as a pregnant woman. Although, the important babies themselves, as if unaware of the struggles of their pitiful mother, would foolishly kick her from within her abdomen quite frequently, incessantly begging to be let out.'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 2. After Leilani conquered the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] and became the first person to arrive at the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in hundreds of years, she attempted to overwrite [[Shaula]]'s memories with her Authority, causing the Star Keeper to shoot a white light through her chest and subsequently eject her from the tower. The shot was presumably responsible for killing one of her unborn triplets, this being Rui,''Lye of Gourmet and Roy of Bizarre Eating, twins who shared in the same Witch Factor of Gluttony―― to be precise, they were triplets with Rui, who had died inside their mother’s womb, but contrary to expectations, they were siblings who had not been on the same wavelength with each other.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 6, Section 7. and Leilani was later found by a man with medical knowledge who ascertained that one of her children had died, but the other two were alive.''“One's done for… dead…! But, there's another… no, two are alive!”'' [[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale]], Chapter 5, Section 3. Against Leilani's own wishes, her two surviving children, Lye and Roy, were saved and delivered, and she died a few moments after they were born.''“Birth parent? Or foster parent? The former died upon our birth and took our little sister with them as well, and the latter would surely~ be pretty incompatible with you, uncle.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 1, Section 4. Following Leilani's death, Rui's soul somehow persisted in the Corridor of Memories without being subjected to the soul filtering process, and the three siblings inherited their mother's Witch Factor of Gluttony. Ever since her physical body's death, Rui's existence persisted as a soul, and she was confined in the Corridor of Memories without a body. For years, despite being the younger sister of Lye Batenkaitos and Roy Alphard, they were unaware of her existence. Due to her confinement, she only found satisfaction in the occasional "meals" that she was able to receive from her brothers which came from the effects of the Authority of Gluttony. Later, she found a way to temporarily escape by controlling the bodies of her brothers, which made them aware of her existence. She later gained access to Eclipse after her brothers discovered it and used it to devour people in her search for happiness. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Due to her vast collection of abilities given to her through the use of her Authority, Rui is among the most skilled of martial artists in the world, capable of fighting and outclassing most warriors by using a wide variety of physical techniques, magic, and other such abilities alongside her [[Authority]], which could also allow her to instantly defeat any number of strong warriors so long as she touched them and knew their names. What makes her even more dangerous is that, due to the unique aspect of her Authority, she had gone completely unheard until her ability was recognized after the events of Arc 3, meaning that she is not only strong, but she was also more than capable of escaping her enemies without anyone realizing exactly who or what she was. At the same time, due to her usually being trapped in the Corridor of Memories, she was in such a position that if she hadn't made her presence known, nobody would have known that she existed at all. ===[[Authority]]=== Rui was one of the previous holders of the '''Witch Factor of Gluttony''' and could use its respective Authority, which granted her powers relating to consuming the memories, names, and souls connected to [[Od Lagna]]'s Register of Names and replicating their abilities for herself. '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Gluttony]]''' (暴食, ''Bōshoku''): Rui can eat the name and memories of an opponent. To eat a name, she touches them with her left hand, then licks the palm of the same hand. Things such as experience, talent, and the likes and dislikes of human relationships serve as food for her, allowing her to take advantage of any abilities or memories her opponents had. Likewise, she can choose whether or not to eat only names, only memories, or both, though Roy claims that it difficult and is like trying to eat only the ingredients in a sandwich without removing the buns. However, if she eats a fake name, or if she attempts to eat the previous name of a person who has managed to change their name, such as through marriage or adoption, she becomes plagued with severe nausea. Similarly, attempting to devour the name and memories of someone with a soul too large and powerful puts Rui at the risk being taken over by said spirit, as seen when her brother devoured the name of Reid Astrea. Even after killing Rui, the names and memories of the forgotten will not return to their original owners. According to Roy, anything that the siblings eat goes to the same '''Stomach of Souls''' (魂の胃袋, ''Tamashī no Ibukuro''), from which they can share and pull the same names and memories that their siblings have eaten. *Those that have had their names eaten have their existences erased from the world, destroying any human relationships along with negating any contracts with [[spirit]]s. *Those that have their memories eaten become amnesic and any characteristics they may have had are reset, effectively making them into a different person. *Those that have both their name and memories eaten simply become a shell, and although they live, they no longer eat, excrete waste, or age, putting them in suspended animation. *She cannot eat the same person twice until that individual gains enough new memories to establish a different sense of self from their old one. *She could not eat the names or memories of non-humanoid beings, such as different animals, [[witchbeast]]s, or [[Dragon#Earth Dragons|earth dragons]]. '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Eclipse]]''' (蝕, ''Shoku''): Eclipse is considered to be the trump card of Gluttony. It is divided into two types: '''Solar Eclipse''' and '''Lunar Eclipse'''. *'''Lunar Eclipse''' (月食, ''Gesshoku''): This allows Rui to use her and her brothers' victims' memories and harvest their skills and knowledge. Lye, for example, used Lunar Eclipse to greatly boost his physical strength and perform numerous martial art techniques, including the Palm of the Fist King and Leaper techniques. However, Rui cannot bring forth the true potential of techniques in this manner, only being granted a portion of the technique's power. It is worth noting that by eating a person's name and using Lunar Eclipse, Rui does not gain her victims' [[Divine Protection]]s, spiritual arts, or Authorities. [[File:Rui - Solar Eclipse.gif|thumb|right|250px|Rui, transformed as a man, reverts back to her original form using '''Solar Eclipse'''.]] *'''Solar Eclipse''' (日食, ''Nisshoku''): This allows Rui to transform into any of the victims that she and her brothers have eaten. When transformed, she can only use the abilities of the person she transformed into, but she can use their skills to a significantly better effect than if she'd used Lunar Eclipse. She also had a tendency to use this technique when possessing her brothers to introduce herself properly. Both Lye and Roy dislike having Solar Eclipse used on them. According to them, Solar Eclipse made them feel as if their selves were being damaged, making it unendurable. Unlike Lye and Roy, Rui tends to primarily use Solar Eclipse as she doesn't share the same fear as her two brothers. According to Lye, when he and Rui switch and she takes control of his body, he claims that it's like watching over your sibling when playing a video game, and if he wakes up and he needs to take his body back, he "takes back the controller". '''Life Creation''': Rui stated she and her brothers can create life with the usage of her Witch Factor of Gluttony, just like how Daphne created the witchbeasts four centuries ago. However, Rui has also stated she and her brothers had no reason to do so, hence they never followed through the idea.''"You know the Three Great Witch Beasts? It’s said that those, are monsters created by the owner of our Witch Factor long before us. We too, can do something similar. We didn’t do that because there wasn’t really any meaning in doing so… but, you see."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 75 *'''[[Witchbeast]] Control''': Because Rui, Lye, and Roy each possess the Witch Factor of Gluttony which was previously in [[Daphne]]'s possession, they can direct witchbeasts to attack certain areas. This was why the [[White Whale]]'s attacks were coordinated with those of the Witch Cult. The White Whale, as well as, to an extent, the [[Great Rabbit]] can obey the Factor holder's will.''“The White Whale obeys Daphne’s Witch Factor. The Rabbit, too, might obey to a certain extent.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/494741464396886016 July 31, 2014 AskFM Q&A] [[File:Rui Arneb Splitting.gif|thumb|right|250px|Rui splitting into two copies of herself.]] '''Splitting''': Similarly to the Great Rabbit, Rui can split and create a copy of herself whenever she separates her Witch Factor of Gluttony into multiple pieces. With a copy, Rui can attach her existence as a Witch Factor to someone else. In Arc 6, she used this ability to attach a copy of herself to Subaru, which allowed her to forcibly trap his memories up to that point within the Corridor of Memories. Rui can split and create at least two copies of herself, but it is not known if there are limitations in the number of copies that she can create. '''Possession''': Rui has also shown the ability to take over the bodies of others who carry the Witch Factor of Gluttony. She has used this to take control of her brothers at times and utilize their bodies to interact with the world, and at times, to help them escape from their enemies. This technique bared its fangs in Arc 6, when Rui split herself and her Witch Factor and placed it in Subaru, subsequently taking over his body while trying to mentally attack him. Although she did not control Subaru for the full duration of his amnesiac state, she did possess him for up to a few minutes on several occasions. She carved words into his arm, wrote words on the walls of the Pleiades Watchtower, and even murdered others to further her plan of separating his identity from the original "Natsuki Subaru" by instilling distrust and paranoia in him. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Master Martial Prowess''': Through the accumulation of souls eaten with her Authority, Rui gains any abilities her victims once had such as martial art techniques and weapon skills by using Lunar Eclipse. In turn, this grants her extraordinary combat strength. ===Techniques=== '''Carnivorous Beast''' (肉食獣, ''Nikushoku-jū''): In the web novel, Rui displays the aforementioned ability which allows her to strengthen her body which gives her two advantages: She can withstand powerful attacks, and she can strengthen her limbs to deliver devastating blows. With this ability, she was able take a hit from Emilia's ice spear and came out unscathed. She was also able to deliver a retaliatory punch that was said to be as devastating as getting hit by a car. This ability originally belonged to [[Beli Hainelga]]. '''Unnamed Ability''': In her first appearance, while transformed into a certain man, she displayed the ability to fire a blast of energy with enough power to easily erase the flesh of whomever it strikes. [[Otto Suwen]], when grazed by it, had the majority of his shins seared off nearly to the bone. Whether this ability is exclusively hers or belongs to the person she was transformed into is unknown. '''Leaper''' (跳躍者, ''Chōyaku-sha''): This technique allows Rui to use a short-range teleportation in quick succession, essentially allowing her to "leap" behind her opponents or avoid extremely precise and quick attacks. She is also capable of utilizing it vertically, making it appear as if she's flying. This ability originally belonged to [[Dorkell]]. ==Trivia== *Like the other Sin Archbishops (with the exception of [[Stride Vollachia]]), Rui received her namesake from a celestial body. "Arneb" was a former name for Alpha Leporis, the brightest star in the Lepus constellation. The word was derived from the Arabic term أرنب (arnab), which translates to "Hare". *Before being explicitly confirmed at a talk show held on July 26, 2026, it was heavily implied in the story of Scorpion Tale and by the author's comments in its afterword that Leilani was the mother of Lye, Roy, and Rui. **As Leilani is the mother of the siblings, the "Lei" part of her name is likely a reference to how, in Japanese, the given names of the siblings all share a first syllable beginning with "R" sound and have an "i" sound in the second syllable. Therefore, the "Lei" part of Leilani's name, pronounced Rei (レイ), would mirror Rai (ライ), Roi (ロイ), and Rui (ルイ). *In a Q&A, the author stated that if Daphne and a Sin Archbishop of Gluttony were to fight, it would most likely end in a draw. It is unknown if this answer was stating that a fight with Rui and her siblings would end in a draw against the Witch of Gluttony if they fought her all at once, nor is it known if the resulting draw would only come from a match with one of them. *Rui has her own named chapter in Arc 6 of both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 6: The Corridor of Memories|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 25|light novel]]. *Thus far, Rui is seemingly the only character in the series able to exist as just a soul. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Cult Navbox}} [[Category:Sin Archbishops]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Unknown Status]] [[Category:Arc 5 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 6 Antagonists]] [[de:Louis Arneb]] [[es:Rui Arneb]] [[fr:Rui Arneb]] [[pl:Louis Arneb]] [[pt-br:Ruy Arneb]] [[ru:Луи Арнеб]] [[uk:Луїс Арнеб]] [[zh:角色:鲁伊·阿内芙]]
