Wrath (憤怒, ''Fundo'') |Race = Unknown |Gender = Female |Age = Unknown |Hair Color = Silver |Eye Color = Amethyst Purple |Height = 168 cm (5'6")[[Re:Zeropedia 2]], Chapter 1: Character Profile, Sin Archbishops, Page 92. |Weight = |Affiliation = [[Witch Cult]] |Previous Affiliation = |Occupation = Sin Archbishop of Wrath |Previous Occupation = |Status = Alive (sealed) |Relatives = |Magic = Fire Magic |Divine Protection = |Authority = [[Authority#Authority of Wrath|Authority of Wrath]] |Weapon = Golden Chains |Equipment = Gospel |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16|Volume 16]] |Manga = [[Manga Arc 5 Chapter 5|Arc 5 Chapter 5]] |Anime = [[Episode 51]] |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Chika Anzai|Anzai Chika]] |English Voice =[https://animevoiceover.fandom.com/wiki/Jennifer_Sun_Bell Jennifer Sun Bell] }} '''Sirius Romanée-Conti''' (シリウス・ロマネコンティ) is a '''[[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop]]''' of the '''[[Witch Cult]]''', representing '''Wrath'''. She was one of the main antagonists of [[Arc 5]] alongside her fellow Sin Archbishops, leading an [[Battle for Priestella|assault]] on the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]]. Sirius was taken into the Kingdom's custody after losing a battle against [[Priscilla Barielle]] and [[Liliana Masquerade]], which led her to be delivered to the [[Royal Capital]] by [[Felt]] and [[Reinhard van Astrea]]. She is currently being held in its Prison Tower, where she remains locked away with the help of Evil Sealing Stones. ==Appearance== Sirius is covered head-to-toe in white bandages, with only her mouth and left eye left unobscured, though some breaches in her bandages allow part of her full head of long silver hair to seep out. The visible eye is amethyst purple with a blue pupil, and her ears seem to be pointed. Around her neck, she bears a steel choker with the Witch Cult's coat of arms attached. Additionally, something similar to a red teardrop is constantly affixed below her left eye. Her long golden steel chains are wrapped around her arms and trail along the ground as she moves. These chains have hooks on their edges which allow Sirius to wield them lethally in close combat. Other than her bandages and chains, the only other thing Sirius wears is a long purple cloak. The inside of the cloak is sky blue with several vertical red decorative lines. Although not visible, she carries the Gospel of the Witch Cult around in her cloak. ==Personality== As shown by her position, Sirius can be wrathful when she becomes angry, though normally she gives off a disgusting aura. She is also [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Petelgeuse]]'s stalker and is his self-proclaimed wife, arbitrarily adopting the madman's surname. She speaks in an intimate, rational manner, but with an off-putting attitude. Sirius has a distinct way of speaking, repeatedly apologizing to everyone about nothing or small things. She does not stand people who belittle her relationship with Petelgeuse as seen when she tried to kill [[Regulus Corneas|Regulus]] for saying that she was disgusting for clinging to a deceased person. Strangely enough, she harbors hatred towards the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], going as far as promising [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] (who she thought was Petelgeuse) that she would burn her before him if he ever managed to revive the Witch, and naturally, this hatred extends to [[Emilia]], who bears the Witch’s resemblance. Sirius despises any woman that's too close to her beloved Petelgeuse, as seen when she expressed her hatred towards [[Beatrice]] for simply standing next to Subaru and asking him what he found so appealing about her, before threatening to burn her alive. Sirius also seems to have no qualms with doing whatever she can to win in combat against opponents she dislikes, even going so far as to take a [[Tina|child]] hostage to protect her from particularly powerful combatants like Emilia and Priscilla. On the other hand, for those she holds no hatred for and are still superior to her, such as Reinhard, she does not seem to feel the need to do so. Instead, she will drag down everyone nearby while accepting her death. Sirius demonstrated a twisted and freakish view of love. In her opinion, the best representation of love is to become one. To her, love is a prayer for becoming one, seeing the same things, feeling the same emotions, living the same life, and ending the same death. She also has a habit of excessively thanking and immediately thereafter apologizing to other people. After losing to Priscilla and Liliana in Priestella, Sirius began believing songs were wonderful despite misunderstanding the feelings behind songs. Even though she resultingly picked up the habit of humming, Sirius' songs are out of tune, out of pitch, without rhythm, and dissonant. Subaru and Felt found their sound irritating. ==History== Currently, little is known about Sirius' past including how she became the Sin Archbishop of Wrath and how she obtained the Witch Factor of Wrath. However, according to her, her hometown was destroyed by a Witch Hunt long ago.''"It was harder to live back then compared to now, way tougher... My hometown was destroyed by a Witch Hunt. Back then, I was still really young..."'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 1]], Section 2. Presumably, since Sirius's Authority is thought to grant her extreme longevity, she has lived for a very long time, though it is unknown how long. Also, according to herself, Petelgeuse is the one who gave Sirius her name and her Wrath. According to Petelgeuse, during the events of [[Arc 3]], she was on a mission outside of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. At some point following the arc, Sirius retrieved Petelgeuse's remains, cremated them, and systematically found and slew all of his fingers with the hope she would find him. ===[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 1|The Lion's Ferocity]]=== Following the Battle for Priestella, Sirius was escorted by Felt and Reinhard van Astrea. Though the traveling was expected to last for a month at best, due to the unnatural trouble and misfortune that seemed to plague Sirius, such as bandit or [[witchbeast]] attacks or damaged pathways, their arrival was delayed. Despite this, however, not a single member of the Witch Cult came to retrieve Sirius, and Wrath was left to speak with Felt, successfully creeping her out. In the end, she was brought to the Prison Tower, where she was to be held by Evil Sealing Stones, much to the Sin Archbishop’s chagrin. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Sirius is an incredibly powerful warrior capable of fighting against skilled fighters of Priscilla's and Emilia's caliber and even defending herself from Reinhard for a time. What makes her truly dangerous, however, is that she is capable of unleashing untold damage to a large number of people at once, and by connecting everyone to herself, she can force even the strongest warriors to hesitate to injure her. ===[[Authority]]=== Sirius - Soulwashing.gif|Sirius using her Authority to control a crowd of citizens in Priestella. Sirius using her Authority on Lusbel.gif|Sirius driving Subaru mad by transmitting her and Lusbel's feelings to him. '''[[Authority#Authority of Wrath|Soulwashing]]''' (洗魂, ''Arai Tamashī''): Sirius is the current holder of the '''Witch Factor of Wrath''' and can use its Authority. In a large but currently unspecified area of influence, Sirius can share or transmit her and other's emotions and senses to others. After polarizing emotions such as anger, sorrow, joy, or ecstasy, she can transmit it to any person in her vicinity, either taking control of them or resonating a certain emotion between a certain amount of people to raise it to the point of madness. Also, since she can share senses such as distress or pain, if anyone is injured or dies within the area of effect, she can force others within the same area to die or receive the same injuries, in the same way. On the other hand, if she is healed with others under the effects of her Authority, the effect will be transferred to everyone afflicted.''"For “Wrath”, once Minerva-tan realized that punching Sirius heals everyone nearby, she’d embark on a journey around the world, punching Sirius all the way and healing everyone."'' AskFM Q&A. The Authority's intensity seems to fade the further the range and extension, and the effectiveness can vary drastically between people. Sirius also possesses the ability to exclude people from the effects of her Authority. Her Authority can, however, be resisted by creating emotions intense enough to break them free from its influence. In the case of Priscilla, it was her excessive pride, whereas with Liliana and an entire affected crowd, a combination of roused emotions through Liliana's music and Priscilla's Soul Marriage Technique managed to free them. Likewise, other people can use her Authority against her: when an entire city was at its lowest and most desperate while under the Authority's influence, Subaru took advantage of her Authority to give those very same people hope and morale, to the point that the people were ready to take up arms and were no longer scared of their attackers. According to Subaru's observations, he believes that the more people there were, the more effective her Authority becomes, and if this is the case, the opposite is likely true, to the point that just having Reinhard to escort her alone would be plenty to not affect their surroundings.''According to what that dodgy Natsuki Subaru, who was oddly versed in the Witch Cult, had said, the more targets Sirius’ authority had, the more effective it would become ― or so he’d surmised. In that sense as well, when it came to the least amount of people required—— You could probably say that just having Reinhard escort her would have been adequate enough.'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 1]], Section 2. At the very least, there does seem to be a prerequisite for her Authority to affect people, as even when she was being escorted by Felt and Reinhard, it did not seem to take effect on them. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Inhuman Strength''': She is said to have the highest physical strength among the Sin Archbishops. Sirius can easily withstand strong attacks by simply blocking them with her bare hands. During her confrontation with Reinhard in the 3rd failed loop of Arc 5, Sirius displayed inhuman strength and resilience by blocking one of his kicks, which are powerful enough to send stone golems flying. Sirius - Chain Control.gif|Sirius controlling the trajectory and direction of her chains against Priscilla Sirius using her chains to attack Liliana.gif|Sirius summoning chains from various parts of her body to unleash a widespread attack on Liliana. '''Chain Wielding Mastery''': Sirius wields long golden chains made out of solid metal with razor-sharp hooks at the ends, which she tends to wrap around her entire body. The length of the chains seems to be infinite, and she stores them away in her black coat's sleeves or materializes them from thin air. When entering combat, Sirius shoots them out and freely controls their path of flight – it was mentioned that her control over her golden chains was unnatural and superhuman, as she could seemingly telepathically change their trajectory mid-air and home them on her target.''"Sirius exhibited incredible skill as she freely manipulated the flight path of her chains in midair. There was no mistaking that Sirius' mastery was beyond the ability of any ordinary human."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 1, Section 6 The chains are incredibly sturdy and powerful, being capable of easily shattering stone walls with a single strike. Combined with her superhuman strength, incredible mastery of fire magic, and her ruthlessness, Sirius is easily able to overpower even the strongest of foes by repeatedly slashing at them with her golden chains with such force, that the sky was described to be just about ready to split in half. Furthermore, Sirius can also use her chains to propel herself to higher places, as was shown seconds before she was cut down by Reinhard in one of the failed loops; by extending her arms wide, she shot out her golden chains and hooked them to nearby buildings, launching herself up in the sky. Lastly, it should be worth mentioning that when serious, Sirius clads her golden chains in fire which burns so hot that it can easily shatter Emilia's ice spells which can resist even the highest of heat. As demonstrated when she fought Priscilla, Sirius can seemingly produce these chains from her own body; when she first made several of them appear, they erupted from her shoulders and knees, causing massive bleeding to her body, to deliver a widespread attack. '''Longevity''': Sirius possesses an abnormally long lifespan, though the specifics behind her longevity have yet to be revealed. It is unknown if her Authority of Wrath causes it. ===[[Magic]]=== Sirius is a master of fire magic, though her application of the fire affinity is a bit different than most others'. Sirius - Fire Magic.gif|Sirius showing her prowess in '''Fire Magic'''. Sirius cladding her chains in fire.gif|Sirius enveloping her chains in fire to unleash a powerful attack against Priscilla. '''Fire Magic''': Sirius exhibits an uncanny mastery of fire magic, being capable of easily enveloping her arms or objects in a scorching-hot fire that can melt even Emilia's sturdy ice. By simply holding an object in her hands, Sirius can clad it in flames and greatly amplify her damage output. Having said that, the most common application of this technique can be seen with Sirius' golden chains; by wrapping them around her arms and igniting them, Sirius effectively turns her hands into flaming swords that can easily deflect sword or spear attacks and deal massive amounts of damage. Additionally, Sirius can perform ranged attacks using her fire magic; by enveloping her chains in fire, she can hit distant opponents not just with strikes capable of severing a human being in half, but she can also scorch them to death. Furthermore, if she uses her chains to peel off portions of her flesh, she is able to turn the blood that flies off from her body into greater flames that spew towards an enemy. During her confrontation with Regulus in Arc 5, Sirius managed to envelop Regulus in a vortex of apocalyptic flames that rose above the giant Time Tower and even melted the stone tiles on which Regulus was standing. Mere minutes later, Sirius proceeded to split the earth between Subaru and Regulus open and create a sea of flames between the fighting duo. Her fire control has been described as supernatural. ===Other=== [[File:Sirius - Spatial Manipulation.gif|thumb|right|250px|Sirius warping space to keep Tina hostage.]] '''Spatial Manipulation''': Sirius can warp space to some extent, allowing her to obscure people or objects behind a distortion in space. She employed this skill to keep Tina as a hostage.''The moment the blade reached Sirius, the space in front of the Sin Archbishop’s chest warped unnaturally. Immediately after, what appeared on the other end of the distortion was a girl whose whole body was bound by Sirius’s gold chain.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 19]], Chapter 4, Section 5. '''Velocity Manipulation''': Sirius displays a power that seemingly allow her to manipulate the speed at which a person or an object flows at. When Priscilla was approaching the Sin Archbishop, everything except her continued to progress at a normal speed while her velocity and momentum were unnaturally slowed, giving Sirius time to attack her while she was defenseless.''Priscilla had closed in so fast, but her momentum slowed, as if time itself had turned against her. It was a common trope that time seemed to move slowly just before death, and Liliana had experienced it herself more than a few times when she had been on the verge of starving, but this time it affected only Priscilla. As a result, Sirius suddenly had a chance to leisurely pull back her chain and hit Priscilla while she was defenseless.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 19]], Chapter 4, Section 1. ===Equipment=== *'''Gospel''' (福音書, ''Fukuinsho''): As a member of the Witch Cult, Sirius is the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel is a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed [[Echidna]]. The [[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]] would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult are imperfect replicas, meaning that, although they detail the future of its owner, the events conveyed are subject to change and the information provided is often up for interpretation. The Gospels take the form of small black books that only their owners can read. *'''Conversation Mirror''': A [[Meteor|meteor]] that allows the user to get in contact with people who hold other such mirrors. ==Trivia== *Sirius' name comes from the star Sirius, which is part of the Canis Major constellation and also the brightest star in the Earth's night sky. Due to Sirius being the brightest star, it is commonly called "the shining" or "the scorcher", the latter of which may be a reference to her usage of fire magic. *While the author has confirmed that Sirius has some sort of longevity, the statement in which he said so claims that her, Regulus, and Petelgeuse's long lives are all related to their Authorities. While true with Lion's Heart in Regulus's case, due to Petelgeuse's nature as a spirit, his Authority is not related to his longevity, and therefore, it is unknown if Sirius's Authority will ultimately be the cause of her long life. *Sirius claims that misfortune has followed in her wake ever since her hometown was destroyed in a Witch Hunt. While en route to the Royal Capital with Felt and Reinhard, the dragon carriage transporting her was attacked by numerous bandits, was exposed to many rare inconveniences, and was even forced to take a detour due to a sudden witchbeast migration.''"It feels like my presence attracts misfortune, or well… It feels like I have a disposition for calling disaster to me. That’s why all these things keep happening. I’m sorry? Thank you."'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 1]], Section 2.''"Ever since then, misfortune has followed me around no matter where I flee to… So that’s why I thought that ― that misfortune is following in my wake. It appears like it tangles everyone up in it but me."'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 1]], Section 2. *Sirius has stated that her duty and name were gifts she received from Petelgeuse.''“That is the treasure that I received from my most precious person! This duty, this name—everything I have was a gift from my precious!”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 2, Section 2. Despite this, the two were never married. *According to the author, the reason why Sirius was aware of the stories of Iris and the King of Thorns, The Rose Knight of Tieros, and Magrizza's Guillotine will be explained in the future.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1889690135203098681 Re:Zero Episode 60 Commentary] ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Cult Navbox}} [[Category:Sin Archbishops]] [[Category:Unknown Race]] [[Category:Inactive]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[Category:Arc 5 Antagonists]] [[ru:Сириус]] [[zh:席里乌斯]]

[[Episode 34]] (actual) |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Rie Takahashi|Takahashi Rie]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Kayli Mills|Kayli Mills]]}} '''Satella''' (サテラ) is the '''[[Witch#Witch of Envy, Satella|Witch of Envy]]'''. Once a member of the [[Witch Era Party]], she became a Witch and perpetrated the [[Great Calamity]] 400 years ago. In reality, the '''Witch of Envy''' is a separate personality that formed when she took in the incompatible [[Authority|Witch Factor of Envy]]. Satella formally debuted in [[Arc 4]] as a supporting character, whilst the Witch serves as an overarching antagonist throughout the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu|series]], appearing in most arcs so far, one way or another. Satella is currently sealed in the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine, located somewhere in the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], close to where the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] is currently standing. She possesses a yet-unexplained connection to both [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and [[Emilia]]. Throughout the series, the Witch's Taboo silences Subaru whenever he attempts to talk about his Authority. Satella herself did not debut until Arc 4, where she and the other Witches helped Subaru accept himself and change his views on Return by Death. ==Appearance== Satella, according to legend, is a half-human/half-elf [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] woman with silver hair and eyes that are amethyst with a bluish tint to them. As a half-elf, Satella's ears are noticeably pointed. When she manifested before [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Petelgeuse]] in a realm devoid of light, the details of her face and the shape of her body were both obscured by pitch-black veils made out of mist. The mist that engulfed her form was so impossibly dark that it blotted out the darkness of the realm. In this state, Satella's eyes can be seen glowing brightly in contrast to the rest of her form. Beyond the shadows that obscure her appearance, Satella wears black thigh-high socks with orange frills on the top, a black one-piece mini-dress with orange flower decorations, and a long dark veil that covered a part of her face. Additionally, she also has a pair of earrings and an orange and black eight-pointed star hairpiece. When she attacked the [[Sanctuary]] in Emilia's body,''In other words, Garfiel had seen the Witch possess Emilia. That was why he hadn’t given a clear answer as to whether Emilia was dead or alive and why he’d apologized to Subaru for striking down both the Witch and Emilia-turned-avatar.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 12]], Chapter 1, Section 6. Satella's form was once again obscured. Although the contours of her body were difficult to ascertain, the shadows surrounding her made her seem as though she wore a dress of darkness and had long raven-black hair. Her voice was muffled to the point that it was difficult to distinguish whether it belonged to a man or a woman. When Subaru encountered her at [[Echidna]]'s tea party, she wore a black dress made of shadows that seemed to wave in accordance with her heartbeat. Initially, he was unable to see her face because of a black shadow covering her above her neck, which was created out of his reluctance to accept her. However, he later accepts her and becomes able to see her face, mentioning afterwards that she looks exactly the same as Emilia. ==Personality== Contrary to popular belief, Satella and the Witch of Envy are separate personalities, formed when she took in an incompatible Witch Factor. The two personalities tend to fight each other. Both personalities love Subaru, though the Witch of Envy personality is much more aggressive about it, while Satella is much more reasonable and cares deeply about his well-being, with the love both feel for Subaru being the reason they gave him Return by Death, to prevent him from truly dying. According to [[Beatrice]], the Witch of Envy was starved for love before her imprisonment. For unknown reasons, the Witch is obsessively in love with Subaru, who, to his knowledge, had never met her before in his life. In the shadow world she calls home, Satella would simply sit idly and monotonously repeat the words "I love you" over and over again, seemingly swamped by her own obsessive feelings of love towards Subaru. She is incredibly possessive over Subaru, as she won't allow him to tell anyone else the secret of Return by Death. The Witch seems to have no remorse, nor does she pay attention to anyone other than Subaru, as she didn't hesitate to execute Emilia when Subaru told her about Return by Death, and when she later saw Petelgeuse within the world meant solely for Subaru and herself, her rage swelled, and she was quick to violently banish the [[spirit]] from their world. If the secret of Return by Death is revealed to another person, the Witch will find a method of bypassing her imprisonment and slaughter all of Subaru's allies in that timeline, presumably as a form of strong reprimand fueled by her possessiveness. Although she usually pays no heed to the words of anyone, including Subaru's, she once took noticeable offense after Subaru told her that he preferred the other Witches of Sin over her. [[Alec Hoshin]] described Satella as an earnest, reckless, pure, and honest girl in spite of being burdened with a rough destiny, and according to the author, Satella apparently lacks common sense, and the situation is so serious that her dictionary doesn't even have the word common sense. When she later appeared in the [[Castle of Dreams]] as Satella instead of the Witch of Envy, though she still proclaimed her love for Subaru repeatedly like the Witch does, her kind and gentle nature was shown when she displayed extreme concern and panic for him when he willingly bit off his own tongue to avoid listening to her, cried while questioning what it is he saw in his trials, and listened to him patiently as he spoke to the other Witches, unlike the aggressively envious Witch. She has trusted and requested Subaru to one day kill her. ==History== In the years predating the Great Calamity, Satella travelled alongside Echidna, [[Flugel]], [[Reid Astrea]], [[Farsale Lugunica]], and Alec Hoshin for unknown reasons, though according to Alec, it was a journey to save the world. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of [[Magrizza]]. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. The nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and [[Volcanica]] went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the [[Black Serpent]] destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent. 400 years ago, Satella absorbed the Witch Factor of Envy, which she had no compatibility with, resulting in the creation of her Witch of Envy personality. However, this alternate personality was not the reason for her subsequently going out of control and killing countless innocent people and nearly destroying the world. Despite the efforts of many, including the Divine Dragon, the First Sword Saint, and the Sage, Satella was unable to be killed and was instead sealed in a shrine that was watched over by [[Shaula]] until the end of [[Arc 6]]. Currently, the Pleiades Watchtower and Evil Sealing Stone Shrine are being watched over by the Divine Dragon itself, Volcanica. Despite being physically imprisoned near the Great Waterfall, Satella somehow maintains a link to Subaru's body and is constantly aware of his actions, even managing to manifest in the shape of a shadowy figure of varying sizes multiple times throughout the story. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== In her era, Satella was one of the most powerful people alive whose defeat could only be attained by the combined efforts of the strongest heroes of the time. Among the Witches of Sin who were reviled by the world, Satella was easily the mightiest. She was able to swallow up half of the world and was said to eclipse the might of all of the other Witches combined. If not for the interference of the Sage and the Divine Dragon, Satella would have overwhelmed and defeated the first Sword Saint, despite his own overwhelming strength. Even within the modern era, the Witch remains almost completely unrivaled. The only two individuals who are said to counter Satella in some form are the current generation's Sword Saint, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], and his legendary ancestor, Reid Astrea, who contributed to her defeat four hundred years ago. According to the author, if Satella and Reinhard were to fight like in Arc 9, it would end in a stalemate as she wouldn't be able to land a finishing blow, whereas Reinhard couldn't bypass her immortality. It is noted that the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine that officially serves as Satella's prison is unable to completely seal her due to reasons currently unknown and is constantly surrounded by a lethal miasma. In fact, during the [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|events]] of Arc 9, she manifested outside of her seal without the need to possess Emilia, albeit incompletely. ===[[Authority]]=== '''[[Authority#Authority of Envy|Authority of Envy]]''' (嫉妬の権能, ''Shitto no Ken'nō''): Satella is the current holder of the '''Witch Factor of Envy''' and can use its respective Authority. *Although the abilities of the Authority of Envy have yet to be revealed, in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], [[Minerva]] mentioned during the Witches' Tea Party that Satella might direct her jealousy (妬み ''Netami'') towards her if she stepped in between her and Subaru, suggesting that it's something that affects people remotely. This ability has been removed from the Light Novel, hence should not be considered as canon. ===[[Magic]]=== Satella is said to be a master of yin magic. According to [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]] and Beatrice at the beginning of [[Arc 7]], a shadow that was the product of the yin attribute with similar qualities to Shamak was what swallowed Subaru, [[Rem]], and [[Spica]]. Beatrice speculated that it was trying to bring them to another location, but failed. While Subaru was within the shadows of the Yin Magic clump, he heard the Witch of Envy's voice, signaling that she has some sort of connection to it. ===Other=== Most of the abilities that Satella has shown to be capable of are of unknown origin. Her primary abilities are focused on the manipulation of miasma and magic, but at the same time, since it is unclear exactly which abilities fall under the scope of her Authority, her magic, or possibly other abilities, the following abilities cannot be properly classified. '''Limited Omniscience''': For unknown reasons, despite being sealed, Satella is aware of the happenings in the outside world. That being said, however, this seems to be limited towards everything surrounding or related to Subaru, likely due to some form of connection between them, and it is unclear just how much she can be aware of. Though she rarely reacts to anything he does or anything that happens around him, she is aware of whenever he attempts to speak about his Authority to others, which she does respond to. Furthermore, she seems to be aware of the people around him and connected to him, as she had once killed Emilia in front of his eyes, went to kill the sleeping Rem during one failed loop despite her not being told about her, and responded to when [[Rui Arneb]] attached herself to Subaru. Likewise, she is aware of his words when speaking in dream worlds, such as the Castle of Dreams, and she will immediately respond whenever someone manages to read his [[Pleiades Watchtower#Books of the Dead|Books of the Dead]], even if Subaru is sealed away and not immediately present within the area. This being said, there are times when she is unable to perceive the happenings around Subaru, those times being when his connection with her is severed or when he is speaking within the [[Od Lagna#Corridor of Memories|Corridor of Memories]]. That being said, in the case of the former, she is able to reform the connection between them if he calls out her name. '''Shadow Manipulation''': Satella is able to generate and control shadows on a gargantuan scale. In Arc 7, the shadow that appeared at the watchtower was thought by to be the product of the yin attribute and had similar qualities to Shamak, while in [[Arc 9]], the shadow were claimed to be kneaded from her miasma.''At the very eastern edge of the world, even further east than the Tower inhabited by the Sage, coming forth from the sealed shrine that caused all beings alike to turn away, laid a symbol of upheaval, and of ruination―― ferociously surging forth like a tidal wave of black, were the Witch’s magic hands, kneaded from her miasma.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40]], Chapter 1, Section 8. Whether this is a part of her Authority, however, is unknown. [[File:Satella shooting at Garfiel.gif|thumb|251x251px|The Witch projecting a massive number of shadows at Garfiel Tinzel.]] *'''Shadow Tendrils''': Satella is able to create shadow tendrils, which she uses to capture, impale, and decimate her enemies. The tendrils are strong enough to hold a transformed [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] in the air and incapacitate him. She is also able to slip the shadows into someone's body through wounds and disperse them outwards, effectively destroying the opponent from the inside out. *'''Devouring Shadows''': In the instances in which she has appeared, even though she is still sealed, just showing up causes the entire area she is in to be completely enveloped in shadows. After covering the area in shadows, the Witch of Envy then begins absorbing everything around her–the more she absorbs, the more mass her vortex of shadows gains. During a failed loop in Arc 4, the entire Sanctuary was enveloped in shadows and everyone else was swallowed by the shadows. *'''Physical Attack Nullification''': By creating a veil of shadow over her person, Satella can seemingly nullify physical damage directed at her. Even the mighty blows of Garfiel Tinzel merely dissipated upon making contact with the Witch of Envy. [[File:Satila holds the heart of Subaru.gif|thumb|250x250px|Satella holding Subaru's heart.]] *'''Shadow Hands''': In some instances, she can also be seen creating hands from her shadows, similar to the '''Unseen Hand''' that came from the [[Authority#Authority of Sloth|Authority of Sloth]] belonging to [[Witch Cult]]'s Sin Archbishop of Sloth Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti. She often uses a shadow hand to grip Subaru's heart whenever he speaks about his ability to anyone who isn't her. According to [[Puck]], Satella is capable of manifesting over two-thousand shadow hands at once. She can also make the hands go intangible, such as when one hand phases through Subaru's chest to squeeze his heart in Arc 3. According to one passage from Chapter 58 of Arc 5's [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], Satella's shadow/magical hands and the Unseen Hands produced by the Authority of Sloth share similar properties, such as being able to phase through objects, but are not the same ability.''"When the taboo was triggered, the witch’s magical hand easily passes through Subaru’s body and only hurts his heart. This was an application of that principle. Unseen Hand and the Witch’s magical hand sharing that property, was the only path left to gamble on."'' [[Arc 5]], Chapter 58, Section 2 '''Time Manipulation''': Though the Witch of Envy has yet been seen to freely manipulate time in her favor apart from stopping time around Subaru whenever he speaks about Return by Death or anything connected to it – though even that isn't confirmed to be thanks to her ability to manipulate time to certain extent – she was the one who gave Subaru his Authority, which he named '''Return By Death''' (死に戻り, ''Shinimodori''), in order to prevent him from dying. It should also be noted that the Witch of Envy supposedly didn't grant Subaru this ability in order to save his friends, but rather, in order to challenge fate head-on without any restrictions, such as death. Furthermore, the true purpose for her granting Subaru his Authority is yet to be explained and all the information above was only speculated by Echidna in Arc 4. '''Witch's Scent''' (魔女の香, ''Majo no Ka''): The Evil Sealing Stone Shrine where Satella is sealed is covered in her scent, which is so thick that it distorts everything in one’s view. It invades the minds of anyone it touches, annihilates their flesh, and corrupts their soul. '''Possession''': During a failed loop of Arc 4, Satella was capable of leaving her seal and possessing Emilia's body so as to physically interact with Subaru.''The Witch had probably manifested in the Sanctuary through taking possession of Emilia’s body. Petelgeuse, a Sin Archbishop, had been an evil spirit able to possess the bodies of others. Knowing of that madman, Subaru could easily accept the possibility that the Witch could take over other people’s bodies as well.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 12]], Chapter 1, Section 6.''For the plan to use the barrier, Garfiel had been absolutely certain the Witch had a physical body. Subaru’s memory was also fresh that he had said he was “sorry in advance” just prior to the decisive battle against the Witch. In other words, Garfiel had seen the Witch possess Emilia. That was why he hadn’t given a clear answer as to whether Emilia was dead or alive and why he’d apologized to Subaru for striking down both the Witch and Emilia-turned-avatar.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 12]], Chapter 1, Section 6. In a similar manner, after she lost sight Subaru in Arc 7, when she regained sight of him, she managed to semi-possess his body, producing an incredible mass of shadows from his body which responded to his emotions. The process which she does this by is unknown. '''Immortality''': One of Satella's most troublesome and dangerous abilities is her seemingly flawless immortality. Although she can be injured and defeated, Satella's body can't be destroyed by any external force. Even the Great Sage Flugel, who was said to be all-knowing, could not conceive a method to bring about Satella's death. Her immortality couldn't be bypassed by even Reid Astrea, the first Sword Saint, Volcanica, the Divine Dragon, and Flugel, the aforementioned Great Sage, eventually resulting in her being sealed away. It is unknown whether her immortality is part of her Authority of Envy or a completely different ability. By the time of Subaru's summoning, Satella has been alive for over four-hundred years while still sealed, though this inhuman longevity of hers is most likely due to her half-elf blood. ==Trivia== *There is a popular fan theory asserting that the Emilia who was seen in the first loop was actually Satella. However, in a side story by the name of [[The Awkward Duo]], Emilia's perspective of the first loop up to her apparent death is depicted, thereby disproving the theory. *According to the author, the meaning of Satella's name will be revealed in the [[Arc 12|final arc]].[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/476712575561125888 2014 AskFM Q&A] **Despite her name not seeming to bear any connection to any celestial body, her name is similar to "Stella", the Latin word for star. *In the anime, Satella received a redesign by Otsuka Shinichirou. *The author once stated that Satella is the second tallest of the Witches. *Although Beatrice and Echidna initially stated that the other six Witches of Sin were all killed by the Witch of Envy, who "used them as sustenance", it is later revealed that their deaths, with the exception of Minerva, were supposedly uninvolved with the Witch of Envy. It is currently unknown if the Witch of Envy was actually involved with the other five Witches' deaths in any way. **It is claimed that over 400 years ago, someone used a larger group of elves as collateral damage in order to get Minerva trapped. The elves were sent as a suicide squad, and in order to save them, Minerva ran to their rescue and fell under the influence of said trap, where she eventually went mad and subsequently died by the hands of the Witch of Envy. *It is heavily implied that Satella is the one who summoned Subaru to the [[World|world of Re:Zero]]. *In the web novel, during Subaru’s second Trial in the Sanctuary, specifically the potential future of the timeline in which Subaru committed suicide in order to try and prevent the erasure of Rem’s existence at the hands of the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]], his corpse was apparently overtaken by shadows deriving from either Satella or the Witch of Envy and began attacking everyone nearby. This, however, was cut from the light novel. *Satella is the only Witch of Sin who wasn't succeeded by a Sin Archbishop, discounting [[Pandora]] and [[Hector]]. This was likely because, unlike the other Witches, Satella didn't perish, meaning her Witch Factor wasn't inherited by anyone. *In the IF chapter commonly referred to as Mimagau IF, Satella makes an appearance as a male silver haired half-elf named '''Luna''' (ルナ, ''Runa'') and he is known as the '''Warlock of Envy''' (嫉妬の魔人, ''Shitto no Majin''). ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Navbox}} [[Category:Inactive]] [[Category:Witch Era Party]] [[Category:Witches of Sin]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Human Hybrids]] [[Category:Arc 6 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 9 Antagonists]] [[de:Satella]] [[es:Satella]] [[fr:Satela]] [[it:Satella]] [[nl:Satella]] [[pl:Satella]] [[pt-br:Satella]] [[ru:Сателла]] [[uk:Сателла]] [[zh:角色:莎缇拉]]

[[Episode 37]] (actual) |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Mai Nakahara|Nakahara Mai]] |English Voice = Nicole Gose}} '''Sekhmet''' (セクメト) was the '''[[Witch#Witch of Sloth, Sekhmet|Witch of Sloth]]'''. She formally debuted in [[Arc 4]] as a supporting character. In life, Sekhmet, with her Authority of Sloth, clashed with those who could interrupt her unending rest, and also attempted to quell the [[Typhon|Witch of Pride]] when she went on her rampages. Though she met her end falling off of the Great Waterfall in a battle with [[Volcanica]], her soul was preserved by the [[Echidna|Witch of Greed]] in the [[Castle of Dreams]] placed within the [[Sanctuary]]. Following the events of Arc 4, her soul was taken into a glintstone necklace that [[Omega]] wears on her travels. ==Appearance== Sekhmet was described as a beautiful yet languid woman in her mid-twenties with absurdly long, unkempt, magenta hair that went down to her toes. She was usually dressed in a sultry outfit that was primarily black and complemented her voluptuous and feminine physique rather perfectly. Her skin was described as pale, to the point one would consider it unhealthy; her face gave off an extremely debilitated and apathetic look. When Subaru first met her, he mistook her for a big ball of magenta fur. ==Personality== True to her position as the Witch of Sloth, Sekhmet's personality could be summed up in one word: lazy, as could also be seen through her appearance. She was also lazy enough that she once even found breathing to be a pain and gave off a gloomy atmosphere. As expected from her age, Sekhmet was rather mature and even philosophical at times. She usually remained neutral in arguments. However, if she deemed someone right, she always jumped on their side and assisted them as much as she could. ==History== Before she was born, Sekhmet's clan, the [[Demi-Human#Closest to Humans in Shape|Giants]], expected things from her, wanting to bring back their founder known as God. However, after she was born, she disappointed them, causing them to hold her in disdain and abandon her as punishment. Many years later, upon hearing of a wild woman in the mountains, men came and captured her, taking her down to the city. While there, she gained knowledge, a way of life, and emotions. Eventually, not understanding at the time that what she felt was gratitude and obligation, she snapped the necks of the men in the place she lived in and left. Returning to her homeland, she proceeded to kill her entire clan, not understanding at the time that what she felt was hatred and a desire for revenge. She then returned back to her previous home to give the men she killed a proper burial, and once she was alone, she felt a peace of mind, which she felt happy about. Over 400 years ago, in a land away from the eastern lands, Sekhmet was partially responsible for driving the [[Dragon]]s past the Great Waterfall just so she could rest. One day, for unknown reasons, she would enter into battle against Volcanica, ending with Sekhmet ironically falling from the Great Waterfall and dying. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Sekhmet has at one point been called among the strongest characters in the series, and among the [[Witch#Witches of Sin|Witches of Sin]], she was considered the strongest, not including Satella. Her strength was such that she was not only sent to stop Typhon's campaigns,''"She’d go to stop Typhon’s rampage, and cause the damage to spread."'' AskFM Q&A. but she was also capable of contending with Volcanica for a time. ===[[Authority]]=== '''[[Authority#Authority of Sloth|Authority of Sloth]]''' (怠惰の権能, ''Taida no Ken'nō''): As the Witch of Sloth, Sekhmet was a user of the Authority of Sloth and was a compatible holder of its corresponding Witch Factor.''This phenomenon had a precedent; for instance, having once been compatible with Witch Factors and possessed Authorities, the Witches of Sin still retained the same powers even after being reduced to souls post-mortem.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 4, Section 9. [[File:Sekhmet - Unseen Hands.gif|thumb|230x230px|Sekhmet using her Authority of Sloth to stop Minerva]] *'''Crushing Force''': Sekhmet is seen manipulating an invisible force that allows her to hit and crush things without moving a muscle. This ability seems to be far stronger than her [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|successor]]'s Authority of Sloth, as apart from being completely invisible, the force seems to have a bigger radius, vastly superior speed, and a bigger area of effect. With it, Sekhmet clashed and drove away a number of Dragons past the Great Waterfall in life, and even managed to hold her own with the Divine Dragon, Volcanica, despite it coming out victorious in the end. According to Echidna, she is capable of killing the other five Witches of Sin in the Castle of Dreams in an instant,''“For example, if Sekhmet, the Witch of Sloth, was of a mind to do just that, I have no chance of victory. Though in the first place, if I made an enemy of her, she could slaughter me and the other four of us put together in an instant.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 12]], Chapter 6, Section 3. though despite being considered the strongest Witch in generations, she had shortcomings outside of her strength that could be taken advantage of, which Echidna speculated as possibly being due to her lineage as a giant.''“Ah, yeah, she was like the strongest Witch in generations, right?”'' [[No Stella No Life 3]].''“There is no doubt about that evaluation. But then again, Sekhmet had major shortcomings outside of her strength which could be taken advantage of. Perhaps because of her lineage as a giant, she was sloppy in many things.”'' [[No Stella No Life 3]]. ==Trivia== *Sekhmet's birthday was decided to be August 13 because it coincides with the most common start date for [[Wikipedia:Obon|Obon]], around which the author felt that the desire to not work soars. *Like the other Witches (with the exception of Satella), Sekhmet's namesake matches both an asteroid and a mythological being. [[Wikipedia:5381 Sekhmet|5381 Sekhmet]] is the name of an Aten asteroid situated between the Earth and the Sun. The mythological [[Wikipedia:Sekhmet|Sekhmet]] was a warrior goddess from Egyptian mythology. *In the author's character strength ranking in June 2014, Sekhmet was ranked as the 4th strongest character in the series, though the list may have changed since then.''“Reinhard, Ram, Regulus, Sekhmet, and serious Puck. Even though they are like dango under Reinhard, these guys are capable of bringing down the White Whale by themselves.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473455745506476032 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] *Despite her being the most inactive out of all the seven Witches, she dealt considerable damage, mainly from the times when Echidna and the other Witches sent her to calm Typhon down and stop her rampages; instead of stopping the Witch of Pride, Sekhmet ended up doing way more harm than good. Hence, she was regarded as a calamity. *According to the author, Sekhmet doesn't smell good.''"She’s unmarried. She smells worse than you can imagine."'' AskFM Q&A. *Sekhmet is the tallest of all the Witches. *If she didn't have the Authority of Sloth, Sekhmet might not have become so lazy.''"That’s right. But, if she didn’t have the Authority of Sloth, I don’t think she’d have become so lazy. Sloth’s Authority is a little too convenient for Sekhmet."'' AskFM Q&A. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Witches of Sin]] [[Category:Authority Users]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[de:Sekhmet]] [[es:Sekhmet]] [[fr:Sekhmet]] [[it:Sekhmet]] [[nl:Sekhmet]] [[pl:Sekhmet]] [[pt-br:Sekhmet]] [[ru:Сехмет]] [[uk:Сехмет]] [[zh:角色:塞赫麦特]]

Unnamed Wife |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4|Volume 4]] |Anime = [[Episode 13]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Yutaka Aoyama|Aoyama Yutaka]]}} '''Rickert Hoffman''' (リッケルト・ホフマン) is the former Royal Instructor of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] and the central figure among the noble civil officials. Debuting in [[Arc 3]]'s early stages, Rickert has yet to play a pivotal role in the main story. ==Appearance== Rickert is a middle-aged man with a thick beard, a small moustache, short slick-back grey hair, and black [[Wikipedia:Sanpaku|sanpaku]] eyes that have bags under them. He can usually be seen wearing a nobles' attire, befitting of his position in the Kingdom. ==Personality== Rickert is a man prone to emotionally voicing his own opinions. He disagreed with the Council of Wise Men's decision to select any [[Royal Selection]] candidate who happened to be found and instead sought to select people who were suitable for the throne.''“Someone should be selected who is suitable for the crown. We cannot simply lay our hands on whoever happens to walk be—”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 1. Rickert was particularly discriminatory of [[Emilia]] for being a “half-devil” and [[Felt]] for being from the slums, although he later visited the latter to apologize to her once he learned of the possibility that she was the kidnapped daughter of [[Ford Lugunica]]. According to his son [[Rachins Hoffman|Rachins]], despite the strain in their relationship, Rickert is a man worthy of respect. Likewise, according to the author himself, he is a "very nice person". Also, he apparently enjoys to talk about the history of sword techniques. ==History== In the past, Rickert was a knight and acted as the master of Julius Juukulius. He became the Royal Instructor, a position he inherited from his family, at an unknown age. He had a son, Rachins, who later left the Hoffman family when he was older and went to the [[Royal Capital]]'s slums. At some point before the [[Great Conquest]], Rickert and [[Marcos Gildark]] knew each other, and at one point, he was responsible for teaching swordsmanship to [[Julius Juukulius]] and [[Crusch Karsten]].''"Well, look, I ain’t in any position to talk freely with people of haughty high-class status like you, Duchess, but you would’ve been one of them who learned the sword from my old man. If you’re gonna say that you ain’t got a clue about that, then I guess my dad must not’ve done a very good job."'' [[Arc 10]], chapter 19, Section 1. Although he taught others, after losing to a young [[Reinhard van Astrea]], Rickert chose to retire and become a civil official.July 26, 2026 Talk Show By the time the Royal Selection had begun, Rickert was the central figure amongst the country's civil servants. ==Abilities== '''Swordsmanship''': Rickert was skilled enough with swordsmanship to be able to teach a young Julius and Crusch. However, it is stated that he is better at teaching others to use a sword than he is increasing his own skill with it. ==Trivia== *According to the author, Rickert is supposedly a "very nice person", and he will also be receiving his own named chapter sometime in the future.''“Rickert is a very nice person, and also has a named chapter; he's not a minor character.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/786124458306080768 Author's Comment] *In the Comic Alive version of Sword Demon Battle Ballad, during the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]], Rickert was visiting the city of [[Picoutatte]]. He was saved from an impending death by [[Razak Gildark]]; however, Razak himself died in the process. As a result, Rickert decided that he wanted to inherent Razak's will. This was cut from the [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Ex 6]] version of the aforementioned story, and therefore, it is unknown if Rickert had the same experience when he was younger. *Rickert was cut from the Arc 3 manga. *Both the anime and the author confirmed that Julius's unnamed master was Rickert. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Knights]] [[Category:Teachers]] [[de:Rickert Hoffman]] [[es:Rickert Hoffman]] [[pt-br:Rickert Hoffman]] [[ru:Рикерт Хоффман]] [[zh:角色:李凯尔特]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10|Volume 10]] (mentioned) |Anime = [[Episode 68]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Fairouz Ai|Fairouz Ai]] |English Voice = Anjali Kunapaneni}} '''Shaula''' (シャウラ) is the apprentice of the Sage, [[Flugel]]. Mentioned throughout the series due to being confused for her master, she formally debuted in [[Arc 6]] as a secondary antagonist for the beginning and climax as well as a supporting character throughout the majority of the arc. Living for over 400 years, she was tasked with guarding the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] by Flugel, attacking anyone who approached it, including [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and his companions. She later followed Subaru's word because she believed he was her master and became an ally to his group while they were within the tower. However, due to being bound to the tower's rules, she transformed into her [[witchbeast]] form against her will once the rules were violated, attacking Subaru and the others. In the end, she was turned into a tiny scorpion and is currently in [[Meili Portroute|Meili]]'s care, as she is instinctively attracted to her Divine Protection. ==Appearance== Shaula has green eyes with three additional red dots around her pupils and long blackish brown hair which she wore tied together in what she referred to as a scorpion tail. She was tall and had a model physique along with a large chest, all in all, being a very attractive woman. She only wore a black bikini-bra, a bowtie, a necklace, black hotpants accompanied with an orange belt, a tattered black-and-orange cloak, and knee-high boots each with orange pinstripe cuffs and a star emblem; which were of the same color pallet as Subaru's outfit. When she took the form of a colossal scorpion, Shaula had a jet-black body, glowing red eyes and sharp pincers, which could be detached at-will. She also had a long tail with a stinger at the end of it. When entering her Attack Hue phase, her color gradually shifted from jet black to blood red. Shaula has mentioned that Flugel and her mother were the ones who blessed her with her "design". After her defeat in Arc 6's climax, Shaula transformed into a small crimson red scorpion. As of the end of Arc 6, it remains unclear whether or not the change is permanent though it is stated that at this point, she retains no human traits whatsoever, effectively making her a tiny witchbeast. ==Personality== Shaula is described to be like a girl at the bottom of a girls' caste who runs errands for others. Though friendly with certain people, she tends to be thoughtless, so she is unfit for mental work. Also, she is unable to tell people apart and therefore refers to Subaru as her master based on smell alone, as he appears to smell the same as Flugel. Despite her usual empty-headed, unconcerned manner, Shaula has been shown to be deeply devoted to and fully loves her master, making him the most important person in the world to her. Whenever certain situations arrive on her doorstep, Shaula will recall his teachings and do her best to act on them; one such to show concern for and treat pregnant women with care, which she remembered even after 400 years. This being said, she tends to act dismissively towards strangers, and if someone attempts to take his place as the most important person to her, then she will not hesitate to attack even a pregnant woman for the transgression, though she would at least possibly provide said person a chance to survive. Her devotion and love for Flugel completely takes up all of Shaula's mind and heart, to the point that she would kill others for him, and after mistaking Subaru for Flugel, all of this devotion has been pushed onto him. If he asked her to die for his sake, she would not hesitate;''"Does Master, want me to die? Hmm, if it's Master's request then I'll listen to anything, and I'm perfectly fine with it personally, but again, isn't it quite a weird timing for such a thought?"'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 70, Section 2. in fact, while she believed Subaru was Flugel, she even ordered him to kill her so that she wouldn't kill him.''"Please tell me to die... If you do that, I will, for Master..."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 70, Section 2. Upon leaving her to care for the Pleiades Watchtower, she waited diligently for centuries and counted the days while obeying Flugel, fully believing in his return. Her devotion was so great that it was unable to be painted over by the [[Authority]] of [[Leilani Alnair]]. Upon Subaru's approach to the tower, after coming to believe that her master had returned, she attempted to act on a certain command he gave her that she had forgotten, she became so excited to see him again that she left the tower to retrieve him personally, and she claimed that she would love him no matter how many centuries passed. At the end of Arc 6, Shaula completely lost her humanity and became a small red scorpion witchbeast. She acts solely according to her instincts, as seen when she instinctively latches herself onto Meili, as a result of being heavily attracted to her [[Meili Portroute#Abilities|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]], which calms the small scorpion down. ==History== ===[[Great Calamity]] Era=== Shaula was created in the distant past and travelled alongside the [[Witch Era Party]]. Although she is a witchbeast, it is currently unknown if she was a product of [[Daphne]]. Her appearance was designed by [[Echidna]], her mother figure, and the Sage Flugel, whom she would serve as the apprentice of. During this time, Echidna made a deal with [[Reid Astrea]] to train her, and though he trained her, he also regularly touched her, much to Shaula's frustration and annoyance. At one point, the two sieged a fortress together. At another point, Shaula was at a banquet with the party and spoke to [[Farsale Lugunica]], who claimed he did not want to be royalty. At another point, she spoke with [[Alec Hoshin]], who told her of his dream to build a [[Kararagi|nation]] and invited Shaula to be its first citizen, though she refused in order to remain with Flugel. After the triumphant battle against [[Satella]], Flugel decided to give all his credit to Shaula for an unspecified reason, causing people to believe that she was the Sage. She later remained at the Pleiades Watchtower for 400 years, acting on Flugel's orders and watching over the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine. Over time, Shaula continued to train her Hell's Snipe so that she could impress Flugel upon his return, and she carved the number of days she waited into the wall of one of the tower's rooms, intending to tell Flugel that she waited patiently, just like he asked. She was also forced to fight off the numerous leaders of the [[Witchbeast#Hungry Horse King|Hungry Horse Kings]] that attempted to challenge her multiple times. ===[[Re:Zero Ex: Scorpion Tale|Scorpion Tale]]=== At some point, a group of over 900 people crossed the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] in an attempt to reach the Pleiades Watchtower. Shaula had noticed and watched as the group steadily died off, save for one: a pregnant woman. Recalling the teachings she was given by Flugel about how to treat pregnant women, Shaula chose to kill the witchbeasts that were about to attack her and brought her to the tower, deciding she could stay there until the woman gave birth. Although she attempted to dismiss her, the woman, who introduced herself as Leilani Alnair, consistently acted self-deprecatingly humble before her, and her Authority attempted to work its way toward replacing her memories with "Leilani". Over time, once Leilani believed that her Authority had fully consumed her, she attempted to have Shaula listen to her and claimed that she was the most important person in Shaula's life. However, her Authority did not overwrite Shaula's devotion toward Flugel, and as punishment, Shaula shot her with one of her needles in her midsection. Afterward, she removed her from the tower and left her just outside of the Sand Time barrier with some provisions in an attempt to leave her a chance to survive. Shortly after this, all of her memories were reverted to normal, and she continued to wait for Flugel. ===[[Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook III]]=== Following her attack on Subaru's group and the destruction of the Sand Time barrier, Shaula became excited at the thought of her master returning to the tower and went to retrieve Subaru personally. Shaula jumped and landed on their [[dragon]] carriage, knocking it over. After looking over the area and realizing Subaru wasn't there, she muttered her disappointment. As she was about to leave, however, [[Emilia]] grabbed her leg, causing her to fall and nearly attack her, but when she asked if she knew anything about the friends who had been blown away, Shaula lowered her hand and began walking away toward the tower, allowing the others to follow her and muttering "Coming soon". Once everyone gathered together, they chased after her. After bringing them to the tower, she left to retrieve Subaru's group. In the Sand Palace, upon witnessing Subaru fighting against a Hungry Horse King, and though she believed that her master would win, she chose to kill the witchbeast herself to receive Subaru's praise. After he passed out with [[Ram]] clutched in his arms, though she was a little annoyed that he was holding another woman, she dismissed it as a great man attracting women, and she brought him to the tower, claiming that she would love him no matter how many centuries passed. A few hours later, she brought the others to the tower, and she kept her eyes on the unconscious Subaru the entire time. When [[Julius Juukulius]] reunited with "[[Eridna|Anastasia]]", she mentioned that something seemed to have happened between her and Subaru, like a one-sided negotiation, as she had originally only intended to bring Subaru to the tower until she managed to convince her to guide the others there. Shortly after, they approached Shaula, and though Julius attempted to thank her and ask for her name, she turned her back to him, as she only intended to speak if Subaru had been involved. Nearby, Emilia and [[Beatrice]] were trying but failing to pry Subaru's arms off of Ram, as he had been holding her tight to protect, and though Julius went to help them, he questioned if Subaru was more worthy of the title of Knight, as he was trying to protect others even while unconscious. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As a unique witchbeast created by the Witch of Gluttony, Shaula is mentioned to be strong enough that she can even force Reid Astrea to use both hands while in combat once every ten times. Subaru also mentioned she could potentially be more difficult to deal with than the Sin Archbishops themselves. She also stated she'd easily kill Emilia and others if Subaru said so. According to the author, Shaula is perhaps one of the strongest characters in the series at mid to long range, though she is much weaker at close range by comparison. ===Humanoid Form=== Shaula using Hell's Snipe on a Sand Earthworm.gif|Shaula using '''Hell's Snipe''' to blow a Sand Earthworm's head clean off. Shaula using Hell's Snipe to destroy a Hungry Horse King.gif|Shaula using Hell's Snipe to obliterate a Hungry Horse King. Shaula - Infinite Hell's Snipe.gif|Shaula using '''Infinite Hell's Snipe''' to protect the tower from witchbeasts. '''Hell's Snipe''' (ヘルズ・スナイプ, ''Heruzu Sunaipu''): Shaula is able to connect her needles and her target together with [[mana]] and release it as if it's gravitating toward them. It is fast, powerful, and is able to be fired rapidly, and via what appeared to be a red dot, Shaula was capable of aiming it like a sniper. The immense power is easily able to snipe a person's head clean off, erase a Hungry Horse King's entire body from existence by showering it with projectiles, and blow people's limbs off without them even being aware of the incoming attack. It is worth mentioning that the needles are stated to be enchanted with magical powers and to carry high heat, meaning that Hell's Snipe may be a spell of Yang magic nature, though not confirmed.''"I don't know the small details, but it was firing long and narrow needles enchanted with magical powers. The needles carried high heat, probably the effect of firing magic."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 13, Section 4. *'''Infinite Hell's Snipe''' (インフィニティッド・ヘルズ・スナイプ, ''Infinitiddo Heruzu Sunaipu''): An advanced version of Hell's Snipe, Shaula is able to summon countless white magical circles, which can then be used to simultaneously shoot many needles in rapid succession towards her desired target(s). '''Immense Physical Strength''': As a witchbeast, Shaula's physical might is typically greater than a person's. She is shown to be able to lift an earth dragon and a dragon carriage with ease and both carry them around and move them up and down a layer of the Pleiades Watchtower. ===Witchbeast Form=== Shaula transforms into the Crimson Scorpion.gif|Shaula transforming into her Crimson Scorpion form. Re Zero Light Novel 23 3.png|Shaula transformed in the Pleiades Watchtower. '''Crimson Scorpion''' (紅蠍, ''Benisasori''): Any time a rule of the tower is broken, Shaula automatically becomes aware of it and is then forced, due to her contract, to unwillingly transform herself into her original form: a colossal scorpion witchbeast known as the Crimson Scorpion. During the process of her transformation, she loses her own will, and then she will then instinctively act and try to eliminate everyone in the tower as a "cold-blooded killing machine"''"Yeah, yeaaah! I'm the Star Keeper! If a rule violation happens, I will become a cold-blooded killing machine who you will all be scaaared of!"'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 37, Section 1. without paying attention to the damages done. *'''Stinger''': While in this form, Shaula can use her large stinger to fire at people in a similar manner to her Hell's Snipe. They fire at roughly the same speed and have power equivalent to said technique. She can fire her stinger in rapid succession, allowing her to easily kill a massive Earth Worm. *'''Pincers''': Using her pincers, she is easily capable of snipping a person or witchbeast in half. *'''Carapace''': Her carapace provides her with a good defense against physical attacks. Even when being attacked by [[Witchbeast#Feathered Mole|Feathered Moles]] with their weight and mass being amplified via El Vita, her carapace was capable of withstanding it, and she came out practically unscathed. *'''Regeneration''': Shaula is also capable of regeneration. Even should she lose her tail, it can regrow in a relatively short period of time. *'''Strong Legs''': With her multiple scorpion legs, she can easily climb up vertical walls, like those of the Pleiades Watchtower. She can also use these legs to latch herself onto hard surfaces, and by doing so, it makes her difficult to move from where she's latched onto. Likewise, she also has great speed thanks to this. She can easily keep up with an [[Patrasche|earth dragon]] while being assaulted by witchbeasts without slowing down or falling behind. [[File:Shaula's pincer explodes.gif|thumb|right|250px|Shaula's pincer explodes after a loose piece of rubble touches it.]] *'''Explosive Body Parts''': While she typically doesn't need it, if she is forced to lose a part of her body, she can leave that part behind as a trap for anyone chasing after her. If someone is nearby, the part that was lost swells and expands, and afterward, it unleashes a hail of light, like her stingers and her Hell's Snipe, that will assault everyone nearby. This attack can typically kill anything near it. *'''Attack Hue''': If she is pushed, Shaula will also enter her Attack Hue, in which her dark carapace will shift from black to red. In this state, she becomes more aggressive, and her strength is amplified. '''Tiny Scorpion''': After her defeat in Arc 6 as the Crimson Scorpion, Shaula's form was reduced to that of a small red scorpion that could fit into a person's hands, and she lost her intelligence as a witchbeast, acting on instinct alone. She lost the majority of her power by being in this state, but she still remains lethal. *'''Stinger''': Shaula still remains capable of firing her stinger in this form. It still retains enough power that it can easily pierce flesh and kill small animals, but how far, fast, and strong her stinger is now remains unknown. ==Trivia== *Shaula, also known as [[Wikipedia:Lambda Scorpii|Lambda Scorpii]], is the second-brightest star in the southern constellation Scorpius. In Arabic, Shaula (شَوْلَة) means stinger, which also refers to the star's position on the Scorpius constellation. *Shaula's birthday references the release date of the song "Sasoriza no Onna" (Scorpio Woman) by [[Wikipedia:Kenichi Mikawa|Mikawa Kenichi]], which was also on December 20. *Shaula was familiar with slang only known by people from modern-day Earth, as she can be observed using terms such as "Ok Google" while fighting invading witchbeasts. It's currently unknown how she's familiar with these phrases, though it is likely that she learned them through Flugel, who is also said to hail from Japan. *She survived all those excruciating four centuries solely on witchbeast meat. The meat is stated to have a disgusting taste and is nigh inedible, so when she ate Emilia's cooking, she confessed that it was better than witchbeast meat and was impressed by Shaula's words about her cooking. *According to the author, Shaula was almost the last of the main characters to appear.''"She was almost the last main character ..."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/663280469564243968 Author's Comment] *Shaula has her own named chapter in Arc 6, in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 6: The Corridor of Memories|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 25|light novels]], as well as a named episode in the [[Season 4|anime]]. *Shaula is unable to read and write.''"Kukkukku, I can’t even read or write. So that's all some mumbo jumbo to me."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 23]], Chapter 1, Section 6. *According to the author, Shaula had already forgotten about her command of not talking by the time she first appeared, but at the joy of thinking her master had returned, she remembered it and tried to do her best to follow it strictly.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/2049490529700958530 Re:Zero Episode 70 Commentary] *According to the author, because she treated it roughly, the [[Minor Characters#Green Room Spirit|Green Room Spirit]] does not like Shaula.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/2049491763656876042 Re:Zero Episode 70 Commentary] *According to the author, when asked about whether a long-range attacker would appear in the story to kill Subaru, he claimed that such a character would spell deaths for him that he could not avoid.''"If I put in an expert at long-range attacks, Subaru would have nothing but a future where he couldn’t avoid being killed…..."'' AskFM Q&A. It is unclear if he had already come up with Shaula at this point or if she was being hinted at. ==References== {{References}} ==Note== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Witch Era Party]] [[Category:Guardians]] [[Category:Apprentices]] [[Category:Inactive]] [[ru:Шаула]]
