[[Episode 71]] (actual) |Game = |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Tomokazu Sugita|Sugita Tomokazu]] |English Voice = Mick Lauer}} '''Reid Astrea''' (レイド・アストレア) was the first Sword Saint, a member of the [[Witch Era Party]], and a key figure in the sealing of the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] 400 years ago. Mentioned throughout the series, he formally debuted in [[Arc 6]] as a secondary antagonist. Throughout Arc 6, his soul acted as the overseer of the second trial of the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] and was a major obstacle preventing [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and his companions from conquering it, particularly toward [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]]. He later achieved rebirth by taking over [[Roy Alphard]]'s body, but the latter proved to be an unsuitable vessel, and his soul shattered during his final duel with Julius, thus marking the end of the first Sword Saint. ==Appearance== Reid had waist length, fiery red hair, sky blue eyes, and was mentioned to be a head taller than Subaru with a muscular body. He wore a half a crimson kimono, which only covered the left side of his torso, a white sarashi wrapped around his waist, and a black eye patch over his left eye. He often put his eyepatch on his right eye as well, since it was merely aesthetic. ==Personality== Reid was shown to have a very frank and rather crude personality, as Subaru was easily able to imitate his method of speech, and tended to speak in short sentences, frequently ending them with '''you''' (オメエ ''omee''). He had no interest in titles, stating that he was himself, others were themselves, and that he was strong not because he wielded a sword, but simply because he was strong. He was also lustful, mentioning that he would have had [[Emilia]] in bed if he was still alive. Despite being somewhat frank and abstract, Reid was quite clever. In addition to this, he also had a great amount of knowledge regarding how to fight with the sword and once spent three months lifting nothing but his sword. His effort led him to be the first person in history who attained the Heavenly Sword. In ''[[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]]'', it was revealed that Reid did not discriminate against those he pointed the tip of his sword at. Be it an [[Spirit|evil spirit]], a [[witchbeast]], or a [[Dragon|Blight Dragon]], Reid cut them down one by one. Due to his campaigns against Dragons in particular, some of them retaliated and decided to avenge their fallen brethren to no avail. They were either cut down by Reid himself or by other powerful individuals of that era. ==History== Reid Astrea was born around 400 years ago. Throughout the years, he trained relentlessly and soon achieved the very zenith of swordsmanship, becoming the only person in history who reached a level of swordsmanship known as the Heavenly Sword. He became famed for a plethora of his activities, such as slaying one hundred Dragons in a fight, his achievement of 6,000 undefeated victories at the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]] in the [[Vollachia Empire]], his victories in drinking competitions, and other varying exploits.''"Certainly, there is no time to recite the legend Reid Astrea etched into posterity in all parts of the world. Speaking of things he was famous for… the fight where he slayed a hundred Dragons, or his battle achievement of six thousand undefeated victories recorded in the arena of the Gladiator Island. The victor of a drinking competition with the existence known as the Oni God, such varieties are also there."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 24]], Chapter 2, Section 6. In the years predating the [[Great Calamity]], Reid travelled alongside Satella, [[Echidna]], [[Flugel]], [[Farsale Lugunica]], and [[Alec Hoshin]] for unknown reasons, though according to Alec, it was a journey to save the world. At an unspecified point in time, he also met the Divine Dragon [[Volcanica]]. Reid was known in history for being the one responsible for the eradication of the Blight Dragons which used to roam the world back then. According to legends, he cut down numerous dragons with a single swing of his [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword]], having primarily done so because Dragon meat was his favorite meal. He had even battled with Volcanica at least once before in order to eat it, having left a wound on its neck in that battle that would later become Volcanica's inverted scale. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of [[Magrizza]]. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. The nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and Volcanica went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the [[Black Serpent]] destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent. Later in Reid's life, in his middle years, once Satella, the Witch of Envy, suddenly went out of control and went on a rampage across the world, he is said to have met with the Dragon and the Sage in the city of [[Flanders]], forming an alliance with the other two.''"According to legend, Flanders is also where the Divine Dragon Volcanica was bound in friendship to the first Sword Saint, Reid, and the Sage, Shaula."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5. The heroes set their goals on defeating the rampaging Witch who mercilessly killed thousands and thousands of innocents and toppled one country after another. After realizing they were unable to kill her, Reid and the others managed to defeat her and seal her away in the [[Augria Sand Dunes]], located in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]'s easternmost region. It is not known what Reid did after the Great Calamity, but after an unspecified amount of time, the first Sword Saint died. According to the author, a child of Reid's younger brother succeeded him, becoming the second Sword Saint and the first person to bear the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1884613612549087600 Re:Zero Episode 58 Rerun Commentary][https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1884615846959673743 Re:Zero Episode 58 Rerun Commentary] ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Reid has been noted as one of the most powerful people to exist in Re:Zero, capable of killing others who have been called among the strongest with ease, only being outclassed by [[Reinhard van Astrea]] in sheer overall power. According to the author, Reid was such a genius that he surpassed every swordsman in the world after only three months of wielding a sword. Even when he was barehanded, he was already the world's strongest. He was easily able to defeat Julius and [[Eridna]]. He was one of the only beings in the world capable of going toe to toe with Satella, though like with Reinhard, he would have been unable to kill her due to their incompatibility. Combined with his prideful and arrogant personality, his soul was capable of overwriting Roy Alphard's Authority of Gluttony, effectively hijacking his body and achieving complete rebirth 400 years after his death; although in his fight against Julius, his body began to "crack" because Roy's body couldn't contain Reid's soul. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== Reid attacking Julius.gif|Reid outclassing Julius's swordsmanship with chopsticks. Reid cutting through Eridna's Jiwald.gif|Reid cutting through Eridna's Jiwald with his chopsticks. Reid slaying Hungry Horse Kings with his chopsticks.gif|Reid effortlessly slays several [[Witchbeast#Hungry Horse King|Hungry Horse Kings]] with his chopsticks. '''Master Swordsman''': Reid was known for having peak sword mastery and the martial arts of his time. As a testament to his peerless skill, Reid was said to be the first person to reach the "Heavenly Sword". To this day, he is the most powerful swordsman that has ever lived, as he alone reached the zenith of swordsmanship. According to himself, he doesn’t even need an actual sword to use techniques or cut through things, and he repeatedly demonstrated as much by using primarily his own hands or a pair of chopsticks rather than the sword that was available to him during his fight against Julius and Emilia. His sheer sword skill is said to surpass even that of the current generation's Sword Saint, Reinhard, who's stated to be the most powerful character in the series. A swing of his weapon is capable of unleashing torrents of light that can blow away or vaporize anything caught up in it, and he is even capable of slashing through the intangible: light, the atmosphere, space, [[magic]], and even concepts manipulated by [[Authority|Authorities]]. Such attacks are considered beyond understanding and a true testament of the first Sword Saint. '''Inhuman Strength''': Even ignoring his swordsmanship, Reid's physical strength was still tremendous. In one display of his strength, he was able to hold up a block of ice so massive that it covered the entire ceiling of the Pleiades Watchtower's second floor, Electra. '''Inhuman Durability''': Reid was also considerably tough. Though he rarely ever seemed to let an attack reach him, when they did, they did minimal damage. When Emilia struck him with a weapon made from her Ice Brand Arts, which are said to be denser than steel, he seemed to take no damage, merely complaining that she hit him instead. ===Techniques=== '''Energy Channeling''': Reid was capable of a technique where he channeled the full power of his opponents' attacks harmlessly out of his body. It is hinted at that he could channel it out of any part of his body but had only done it through his feet. This technique effectively made him immune to attacks from clubs, hammers, punches, kicks or anything blunt.''"You let all Miss Ram's attacks escape onto the floor with the bottom of your feet, huh."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 69, Section 1. ===Other=== '''Excellent Intuition''': Reid is rather adept when it comes to combat involving things besides swinging his sword. In one failed loop, he was able to recognize that some ability was keeping [[Ram]] active despite her condition, and he immediately recognized what it was, deciding to slash through it to sever its influence. ===Equipment=== DragonSword.png|Dragon Sword Reid with its sheath. Dragon Sword Reid blade unsheathed.png|Unsheathed Dragon Sword Reid. *'''[[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]]''' (龍剣レイド, ''Ryūken Reido''): Four centuries ago, Reid received a special sword which was dubbed the Dragon Sword after Reid often went on rampages with it, killing numerous Dragons with a single swing. The sword is said to be unbreakable and is supposedly able to cut through any material, no matter the toughness or density. According to some legends, the sword even brought the Witch's end. After Reid's death, the Sword was given to his offspring who inherited the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint. As a tribute to the achievements Reid had achieved with this legendary weapon, the Sword inherited his name. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 23 12.png|thumb|180x|Reid taking on Julius Juukulius with nothing but a pair of chopsticks.]] *'''A pair of chopsticks''': In Arc 6, Reid can be seen with a pair of chopsticks. In his hands, the chopsticks are extremely durable and are able to withstand repeated sword slashes without chipping or breaking despite being made of ordinary wood. Reid even cut Subaru's Authority of Greed with them. *'''The sword in Electra''': Reid temporarily used the available sword in the Pleiades Watchtower’s second floor, Electra, during his fight with Julius. {{Clear}} ==Trivia== *Reid's birthday, October 1, falls on Sake Day. *Despite being a former Sword Saint, Reid did not possess the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint. *The two "patterns" on Reid's attire are characters of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siddha%E1%B9%83_script Siddhaṃ script], which is today primarily used by practitioners of Japanese esoteric Buddhism. **His eyepatch reads "tiṃ". **His kimono reads "kha". *His eyepatch is purely decorative.''"In short, his words had been completely true, he understood that his eyepatch was really only an item for doing something because he wants to."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 51, Section 1. Both of Reid's eyes are in perfect condition.''"As Reid said that, he turns over the eyepatch covering his right eye using his fingers. And there below his eyepatch, there are no wounds; his eye is in good health exactly as he had stated. And of course, there are no signs of injuries in his uncovered left eye."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 51, Section 1. *After Reid, every member of the Astrea family was born with fiery red hair. *When asked who is stronger between Reinhard and Reid, the author stated that it depends on the conditions, though Reinhard is mostly stronger. *Reid would lose to Reinhard in a serious fight if both fought with chopsticks.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1080655602236309504 Author's Comment] *The author once mentioned that there's a very high chance Reinhard would not be able to draw the Dragon Sword if he ever was to face off against the first generation's Sword Saint. *In reference to an answer he had given the prior day,''“Reinhard, Ram, Regulus, Sekhmet, and serious Puck. Even though they are like dango under Reinhard, these guys are capable of bringing down the White Whale by themselves.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473455745506476032 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] the author said that Reid could behead Ram, [[Regulus Corneas]], [[Sekhmet]], and [[Puck]], four of the five strongest characters who had appeared in the series up to that point.''“Yesterday, I gave the power rankings of the five people among the current characters, but with the exception of Reinhard, he can behead all of them.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473616808612999168 June 3, 2014 AskFM Q&A] Furthermore, in 2025, it was said that Reid would be the strongest character in the series if it were not for the presence of Reinhard, who is akin to a glitch or a bug.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1973365536450027878 Author's Comment] *Some 400 years ago, Reid had an apprentice who he says had a very similar personality to Julius Juukulius.''"Appearances, appearances, appearances… yeah, appearances aye. You really do be speakin' shit like my follower."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 85, Section 1. *There is a series called The Legend of Reid Astrea about Reid's deeds. Spread across fifty volumes, it was supposedly written by someone who was very familiar with him. The contents of the book are so incredible it is considered more fiction than fact. *Reid was acquainted with an Emperor from the Sacred Vollachia Empire.Re: Zero 10th Anniversary Space Q&A *Reid is depicted on the gold coins exchanged within the Kingdom of Lugunica, where he appears as a middle-aged man. This is because the deeds that led him to be counted among the Three Great Heroes were accomplished later in his life. *Despite being from House Astrea, it is unknown if he was ever given a noble title. *According to the author, if any of the world's strongest accompanied to the expedition force to the Pleiades Watchtower, the difficulty to complete the tower would increase because of Reid. In particular, Reid would take a liking to [[Cecilus Segmunt]] and [[Halibel]], [[Vague Adgard]] would have no reason to fight him, and he is most inclined to pick a fight with Reinhard.July 26, 2026 Talk Show *According to the author, if any other character had challenged Reid with the same concessions as Emilia, they would not have succeeded unless they all worked together in a fierce, life-risking battle. In fact, even Emilia should not have been able to succeed one on one if not for her being a special case. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Sword Saint]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Witch Era Party]] [[Category:Gladiators]] [[Category:Enchanted Sword Users]] [[Category:Arc 6 Antagonists]] [[de:Reid Astrea]] [[en:Reid Astrea]] [[es:Reid Astrea]] [[fr:Reid Astrea]] [[pl:Reid Astrea]] [[pt-br:Raid Astrea]] [[ru:Рейд Астрея]] [[zh:角色:雷德]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33|Volume 33]] (main story) |Manga = [[Manga Love Song Chapter 2|Love Song Chapter 2]]}} '''Sphinx''' (スピンクス) is the first [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|copy]] of [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu Meyer]] who was created in the [[Sanctuary]] by the [[Witches of Sin#Witch of Greed, Echidna|Witch of Greed]], [[Echidna]]. Initially serving as a main antagonist of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]], she made her first main story debut in the final scene of [[Arc 7]] and later became the main antagonist of [[Arc 8]] as the culprit behind the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire's]] [[Great Disaster]]. Born as a failed receptacle from Echidna's attempts at replicating her existence, Sphinx betrayed her creator's intentions and became responsible for countless deaths. During the [[Demi-Human War]], she gained infamy in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] for being a “[[Witch]]” who utilized [[undead]] soldiers, as well as one of the Demi-Human Alliance's most crucial members. After Sphinx fell in the war, she was secretly confined in the Barielle Domain by [[Leip Barielle]], where she spent four decades before she planned and commenced an attack on the Vollachia Empire. Soon after commencing the Great Disaster, she was killed and turned into an undead herself. Later, after confronting and losing a battle against [[Vincent Vollachia]], her soul avoided certain death by changing to match the form of her creator, and she continued in her attempt to destroy Vollachia until she was stopped by [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Spica]], though not before indirectly forcing [[Priscilla Barielle]] to become a zombie to end the Great Disaster. ==Appearance== Although she was around four hundred years old as a result of her artificial existence and mana body, for the majority of her life, Sphinx perpetually maintained the body of a girl who was twelve years of age. As she was a copy of Ryuzu Meyer, she shared her long, fluffy pink hair, dark cyan eyes, and distinctively pointed ears with the other clones. Despite her innocent and girlish physical appearance, Sphinx radiated an abominable aura that denoted her as a wicked monster.''That made it all the more unsettling to know that a horrible fiend was lurking under the girlish guise. She radiated an overwhelming heinous aura, so strong she couldn’t hide it, so strong one could detect it almost instantly.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Second Stanza, Section 5. Originally, she displayed a lack of expressiveness as a result of her incomplete emotions. Sphinx wore a black robe with large sleeves that were too long for her arms and a high collar that partially concealed her face. Due to the long length of the sleeves, they each have holes that allowed her to extend her arms out. However, after the Demi-Human War, Sphinx lost her arms and legs, barely escaping death with only her head, torso, and robe. File:Sphinx Undead design.png|Sphinx in an undead form. File:Re Zero Light Novel 37 12.png|Sphinx after completing her soul and taking on the Witch of Greed's appearance. By the time of the Great Disaster, Sphinx regained all of her limbs via unknown means and came into possession of a staff with a glowing orb.''Hoisting a staff with a glowing orb, the Witch stepped forth without hesitation―― no, followed by those who were resurrected from the vast lands of blood, the queen of the undead began her march.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Interlude. Following her demise at the hands of [[Cecilus Segmunt]], she became a [[Undead#Zombie|zombie]]. In this form, she possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across her body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. Her lack of expressiveness began to change as well, with her face beginning to display various emotions. Upon being brought to the brink of death by Vincent's [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] and managing to complete the missing parts of her soul, Sphinx took on the Witch of Greed's physical appearance, gaining long white hair that stretched to her back, black eyes that housed an intellectual spirit, and porcelain-like white skin, while continuing to don her black cloak that had become too small to cover her full body. ==Personality== As a result of being created from one of the Witch of Greed's failed experiments and not fully inheriting a complete soul, Sphinx, although possessing a distinct self-identity from Echidna, was born with a mostly emotionless demeanor and little attachment to her own life, only primarily inheriting the greed to understand and learn things. A self-proclaimed Witch, Sphinx could not understand emotions from birth because of her defective personality and desired to gain a "complete" soul like Echidna, who she originally viewed as a mother figure. She viewed herself as a vehicle whose sole purpose of creation was to attain completion in order to fully recreate the Witch of Greed and replace her incomplete self with that of the complete Echidna, in accordance with the original desire her creator had for her. As such, she had no desires that she could call her own, believing she would become Echidna once she completed herself. For most of her life, Sphinx lacked the ability to properly feel and comprehend emotions, struggling to understand outcomes in which attachment and irrationality triumphed over rationality.''“Attachment is a mysterious phenomenon. It is too heavily influenced by elements that are contradictory to rationality. Regardless, I have struggled to understand outcomes where irrationality had prevailed over rationality at times.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 5, Section 6. Although she attempted to speak kindly or tried to maintain an air of courteousness when talking to other people, she sounded disinterested and robotic, often manipulating or exploiting other people for her own interests. No matter who she faced, as long as it advanced her goals, Sphinx showed little concern in murdering others or gathering corpses to guarantee her own safety or use for her own experiments. This, alongside her use of the Sacrament of the Immortal King to raise numerous corpse soldiers, led her to be branded a Witch by the human faction during the Demi-Human War. Despite this, she had already introduced herself as a Witch to the Demi-Human Alliance in an attempt to become the “[[Terminology#Story Specific|Witch of the Kingdom]]”, a disaster prophesized to bring ruin to Lugunica in the future. Following her failures at Priscilla's hands, unknowingly to her, she began to harbor a desire for vengeance against the woman, to the point that she decided to scheme the destruction of the entire Vollachia Empire to get back at her.''――She had correctly surmised the two ultimate goals of the Witch, Sphinx: to recreate the Witch of Greed through transformation of the soul, and to enact her revenge upon Priscilla Barielle.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 1. During the Great Disaster, when she had captured Priscilla, Sphinx often came to speak with Priscilla as an undead. During this time, there was a visible shift in her personality.''In this clear reaction, Priscilla could distinctly sense the rhythm of life―― The presence of emotions within the young girl. They were something that had not existed in the young girl until now.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 42, Section 1.''Regardless of whether she was aware of it or not, as Sphinx continued to speak with Priscilla in this place, there was a rapid increase in the human-like qualities of her speech. The water that was her conversation with Priscilla had been poured onto her budding humanity, bringing a significant growth into existence.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 42, Section 2. Whereas she was initially quite stoic, she began displaying more expressions, and the more she talked with Priscilla, the more that she realized the emotions that she was feeling such as frustration, anger, confusion, curiosity, and fixation. While her stoicism was not completely gone when confronting people other than Priscilla, the range of her emotions rapidly expanded nonetheless. Furthermore, this understanding of emotions expanded to include other people; due to her increased understanding of attachment and emotions of both herself and others, she was even able to determine how to use the emotions of other people to her advantage.''"By gaining an understanding of emotion and attachment, for the first time, I have discerned the methodology regarding their uses. She is commendable, is she not? If it is for your sake, she does not take herself into account. ――Deliberation: Required."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 42, Section 2. Even after her vessel changed into the form of the Witch of Greed, she began recognizing more and more of her emotions. In her final moments, when Priscilla managed to escape the space of her prison, Sphinx became convinced that her plans had come crumbling down. However, she refused to give up her desire to exact revenge upon Priscila as she fell from the sky and finally displayed her full wrath for the first time as she shouted the name of the Sun Princess and directed all of her selves to attack her. Due to the ambiguous nature of her identity as the one born as Sphinx and the soul born from the Witch of Greed, she was not able to fully grasp her identity until Subaru and Spica confronted her.''That smile, perceiving it as proof that Sphinx was celebrating her very own sense of self, Subaru could no longer oppose her standpoint.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Chapter 5, Section 12. She also claimed in this time that she believed that no matter what path she took, things would have always turned out this way for her, as she had achieved an objective of her own will, outside of what her creator intended for her.''“Are you suggesting that we could have avoided fighting? That would not have been possible. Reconsideration: Required.” [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Chapter 5, Section 12.''“Because there was a motive other than the reproduction of my creator, certainly present within myself.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Chapter 5, Section 13. In the end, after being recognized by Priscilla as her enemy despite her own failure, Sphinx let go of her sternness and asserted that Priscilla was her enemy,''At her answer, Sphinx lowered the edges of her eyebrows, and heaving a sigh with an expression that had lost its sternness, “Priscilla Barielle. ――The fated foe of myself, the Great Disaster, Sphinx.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Chapter 5, Section 13. finding her own purpose and affirming her own desire rather than following the purpose of creation she had been intended to fulfil, and smiled at her enemy as she met her end.''As a being who had found meaning in her existence differing from the original reason for which she had been created, she smiled. ――That was the conclusion between the Sun Princess, Priscilla Barielle, and the Great Disaster, Sphinx.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Chapter 5, Section 13. Sphinx had a habit of saying "'''required'''" (要 ''you'') with a verb in accordance to something she believed was necessary, such as using "'''observation: required'''" (要・観察 ''you: kansatsu'') when observing other people's actions, "'''deliberation: required'''" (要・熟考 ''you: jukkō'') when pondering something, or other a variety of other words that reflect what she believed she must have done in the moment. Once she took on Echidna's form, she attempted to discard this way of speaking, but as she met her end and accepted her individuality, she used it one final time. ==History== ===Early Life=== Ryuzu Meyer was a young half-elven girl who became indebted to the Witch of Greed, Echidna. The Witch, with Ryuzu's permission, began experimenting on her in a secret laboratory. Echidna sought to unlock immortality by cloning Ryuzu and transferring her consciousness to the copy, meaning she could live forever via a long line of copies. She was able to create the first five copies of Ryuzu, the first of which she decided to transfer her consciousness into. However, Echidna chose to shave off parts of her soul in order to fit in the receptacle, resulting in an emotionless girl with a body made of mana, a fractured mind, and a vast amount of magical knowledge, albeit not at the level of Echidna herself, as the receptacle of Ryuzu Meyer hindered the girl from wielding the Witch's techniques. Bestowed the name of an impure monster, Sphinx, the Witch of Greed's failed creation, managed to escape being disposed through some twist of fate.''The result born from this outright mishap, was the failure of the Witch of Greed, an existence that would mark the world with many misfortunes for years to come, Sphinx. That being, bestowed the name of an impure monster, “Sphinx”, was about to be disposed of due to its unsuitability for its original purpose, but by a twist of fate, it survived.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 4. She wandered throughout the world to fulfill the purpose of her creation, replicating the Witch of Greed, while Echidna's disciple, [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]], pursued her.''Suspecting the existence of Sphinx, the product of the Witch of Greed’s research, the person who claimed to be her disciple pursued her tenaciously.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 6. The body of Ryuzu Meyer was unfit for surviving in the harsh conditions of the world; whether it was with bad weather, extreme temperature changes, or encounters with malicious [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]] or humans, Sphinx was often threatened by circumstances outside of her control.''The body of Ryuzu Meyer, which had served as the basis of the replicant, lacked the aptitude for surviving in this harsh world; her life often came into jeopardy due to extremely bad weather, changes in temperature, and sometimes by Witchbeasts or malicious humans, and lacking the means to counteract that, there had been far too many deficiencies at the time this receptacle had been selected.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 3. The discrepancy between receptacle and soul had required her to exert effort akin to learning how to walk, breathe, and beat her heart again.''For Sphinx, who harbored the flaw of discrepancy between receptacle and soul, things like how to walk, how to breathe, and even how to beat her heart had required her to exert effort akin to relearning it anew.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 5. Her body of mana could not allow her to grow or train,''Since concepts such as growth and training were also meaningless for a mana body, she could not even hope for things to improve.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 5. so she pursued knowledge and skills that did not depend on the state of her body while facing persecution for appearing as a half-elf,''Though it was possible to acquire knowledge and skills that were not dependent on the body, there would be many opportunities for her life to be threatened along the path to learning them, so those days had always been accompanied by danger. In addition, the base model of Ryuzu Meyer was a half-elf, and since Sphinx had also inherited those physical features, she would often be exposed to persecution and odd looks.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 3. choosing not to alter her appearance to not run the risk of being unable to fulfill her purpose.''However, she was hesitant to make any large alterations to the external features of the original form. Those were the first things that had been given to Sphinx, and she feared that if she altered the preconditions too much, she would become unable to fulfill her own purpose of creation. Therefore, Sphinx did not consider the idea of disguising herself to be acceptable, and instead sought a different way to survive.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 3. To continue living, Sphinx reduced herself to the status of a spectacle, a slave, and the servant of a lavish master.''As long as she could remain alive, there were times when she had even degraded herself to being a spectacle and a slave. And since the appearance of Ryuzu Meyer was a refined one, there was also a time when she had been the servant of a lavish master.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 5. Taking advantage of her memory and her greed to understand and learn more, for one hundred and fifty years, Sphinx made her abilities into a utility that allowed her to gain the protection of and live under various people who could provide her safety until she attained the means to protect herself.''In order to travel the world with a weak body, lacking the power to survive, it was best to create value for oneself, to offer it to those who sought it, and to gain their protection. By doing so, Sphinx chose the means of continuing to live under the umbrella of others, until she was able to protect herself on her own. Those days, lasted for approximately one-hundred and fifty years.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 3. To avoid suffering Roswaal's fury or extreme persecution due to sharing the same race as the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], she did not opt to stay in one location for too long. Becoming a magician required Sphinx to exert nearly one hundred times the effort it would take someone of average ability to.''To become a mage, it would take her nearly one-hundred times longer than what it would take for someone of average ability.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 6. The first spell she cast unleashed naught but a small, flickering flame at her fingertips, disappointing her greatly. There were no sudden changes to her life upon gaining the capabilities to use magic. After using one spell, Sphinx stabilized using the gate of her mana-based body and was successful in reproducing the majority of magic attained by the Witch of Greed's soul.''――Even though she had become capable of using magic by herself, there was no sudden change in Sphinx’s way of life. By successfully invoking magic once, she was able to stabilize the method of utilizing the Gate of Ryuzu Meyer’s mana body, and succeeded in reproducing the majority of magic grasped by the Witch of Greed’s soul.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 7. She continued to conceal herself, using her magical prowess to make the job easier. For the next one hundred years, she devoted her time to learning about Echidna, but the [[Witch Cult]]'s efforts at erasing the existence of Witches other than the Witch of Envy hindered her progress and made results difficult to acquire.''So, in order to learn about the Witch of Greed who had already been dead for a long time, she set out on a journey to follow the legends and books in various places, but there was an organization known as the Witch Cult that was attempting to erase the Witches from history―― that did not seem to be the original objective of its founding, but their activities served as hindrances, so results were very slow to come by.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 7. [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 7. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== When the opportunity conveniently presented itself after the tensions between humans and [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] and Lugunica reached a boiling point, Sphinx joined the Demi-Human Alliance, a large insurrectionist force based within the Kingdom of Lugunica. With her appearance as a half-elf being the only justification she needed to ally with their cause,''The environment of persecution suffered by demi-humans, regardless of their participation in the civil war, entirely eliminated the unnaturalness of Sphinx making contact with the Demi-Human Alliance. [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 1. ===[[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]]=== Several months before the beginning of the main story, Leip formulated a plan to gain control over Lugunica. After the beginning of the [[Royal Selection]], Leip aimed to take away the will of his wife, Priscilla Barielle, who was a candidate to become the country's next monarch. [[Arc 8]], Chapter 73, Section 2. ===[[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]]=== A few months later, after the Royal Selection had begun, she attempted to take over Priscilla's body again by luring her to a trap. Using parasites that she had created, Sphinx would spread an infection from a waterwheel along a river in the Barielle Domain in order to coax Priscilla into showing up there. However, this tactic would also come to fail when the infected waterwheel manager and host of the parasites' queen, [[Edda Rayfast]], was put out of commission by Al, who would remove a parasite within Priscilla after she burnt Edda to ash. After this event, Sphinx began waiting in silence for time to pass while deliberating on her next course of action.''Understanding the unexpected chaoticness of her dear children such as that, however, the girl continued to wait in silence for the passing of time. Eventually, driven by her failure and wishing to take revenge on Priscilla, Sphinx decided to set her sights on Priscilla's homeland, Vollachia, as both a part to complete herself and to attain her revenge. At an unknown point in time after this, she managed to regain all of her lost limbs, experimented with the town of Nanou in [[Kararagi]], and she set forth toward Vollachia, creating various different countermeasures to ensure her victory. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Although she was initially considered a failure and was so incredibly weak that she had to scrape by as being used as a tool or slave by others, after having lived for centuries, Sphinx became an incredibly competent and dangerous magician. By the time of the Demi-Human War, ~360 years after her birth, her magic, widespread use of forbidden arts, ability to create an instant army from the dead, knowledge, and ruthlessness were enough to classify Sphinx as a Witch and one of the most dangerous people in the war, having been among the reasons that the war lasted so long and so many casualties had built up over the decade. Four decades later, despite having been locked away without her limbs, her danger level grew tremendously by somehow learning the Flow Method and martial arts, and by the time of the Great Disaster, she had become so dangerous that she almost managed to wipe out Vollachia and threaten its neighboring countries. Even after becoming undead, her strength and threat level was enhanced much further by her inability to die and her ability to gather knowledge, as well as by connecting to the mana stores of the Crystal Palace. ===[[Magic]]=== By utilizing the knowledge she inherited from Echidna, Sphinx could make use of spells from multiple affinities, as well as the Sacrament of the Immortal King, a powerful forbidden art she uses to create undead. She has also mastered magic to such a degree that she can create multiple variations of different kinds of spells, and she can use spells from different parts of her body besides the hands, such as from her eyes.''Spilling out pathetic cries of pain, Spica fell to her knees, as her left thigh had been pierced by white light. ――Unable to use either of her hands, that had been done by a blow fired from Sphinx’s undead golden right eye.'' Designed by Sphinx herself, it went unused by her in her lifetime. It could create a blind spot in Od Lagna, invalidating its constraints. This was effective for nullifying the effects of Divine Protections and the Kingdom of Lugunica's covenant with Volcanica. In the period ensuing the Demi-Human War's end, Stride Vollachia acquired the means to replicate it and unleashed it during the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon. '''Combined Spells''': *'''Flying Magic''' (飛行魔法, ''Hikō Mahō''): Sphinx could use flying magic, a spell executed with a combination of the earth, wind, and yang affinities, allowing her to float in the sky. She can also use the winds from this magic to protect herself from a certain level of strength from attacks.''The Witch of Greed squinted slightly at the approaching debris and did nothing. There was no need to do anything. The flying debris deflected off the floating Witch of Greed, as if avoiding her by itself. Al’s attack could not even break through the lingering winds that the Witch of Greed wore to fly.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 2. '''Unclassified Spells''': Sphinx has used spells that have not been classified under any category or magic, nor have they been deemed forbidden arts. *'''Spatial Distortion''': Sphinx could alter the space around her person, and if she was attacked and killed by her opponent, the distortion of space would explode outward, killing everyone in the vicinity in a bright flash of white light.''From that single comment, the Witch seemed to have realized that Al had seen through her trap―― a technique that distorted space, blowing away an entire area as it recoiled. As soon as Cecilus would cut off the Witch’s head, causing the power maintaining the twisted space to cease, a dead man’s switch would be triggered―― rather than detonating upon the press of a button, it was a trap with the same mechanism as a bomb that would be triggered by the release of a button.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 2. *'''Unnamed Dimensional Spell''': Sphinx was able to take a certain part of the world and place it within a pocket dimension, where it would remain completely unaffected from events in the outside world. She used this spell to separate the dungeon from the Crystal Palace and hold Priscilla prisoner.''The very space of the dungeon itself has been relocated to a place unrelated to the destruction of the Vollachian Empire―― a kind of different dimension, with Priscilla placed as an observer of the battle-torn Imperial Capital.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 70, Section 3. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Martial Arts''': Following her loss to Roswaal J. Mathers during the Demi-Human War, Sphinx began training in martial arts.''That elegant movement and technique were not something that had been acquired through half-hearted training. As the Witch had confessed herself, she had used her former defeat as a resource to learn from. It would make anyone think that it was unnecessary to mention the person who had beat the Witch in a fist fight in the past.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 7. She interlaced her magic with an elegant martial art technique.''As Spica desperately swung around blows, Sphinx utilized smooth technique as if to say “the soft controls the hard”, and sometimes, she would interweave magic fired from her fingertips into her counteroffensive.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 7. However, according to Sphinx, there was a limit to the level of enhancement that the Flow Method could yield for her replicant body when she was an undead.''“There is a limit to the enhancement of abilities that can be yielded through the Flow Method for this replicant body.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37]], Chapter 7, Section 7. *'''Wind-Based Destructive Grip''': By enshrouding wind magic on her palm and combining that with martial arts, Sphinx can catch attacks with her hand and use the intense vibrations of the wind to shatter anything caught within her grip.''The stone dao which Al had thrusted forth as he lunged, was crushed in the palm of the Witch. The wind enshrouding that palm had vibrated immensely, a combination of magic and martial arts capable of shattering its target.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 65, Section 5. '''Undead Physiology''': After Sphinx met her demise, thanks to having used Sacrament of the Immortal King prior, Sphinx had risen as one of the undead herself. In this state, she could receive damage and easily repair it so long as the corebug within did not break. Furthermore, with the assistance of Lamia Godwin, she was able to multiply herself with undead copies by spreading out her soul, making it almost impossible to permanently end her. Similarly, because of this, if one of her copies died, the knowledge that one obtained would be shared with each other copy. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Strategist''': Sphinx is incredibly thorough when creating her plans. Throughout the Great Disaster, simply to prevent her plan from collapsing, she created numerous strategies and counterstrategies that she could put into play in the event that any prior strategies collapsed: using the undead against the country least compatible with life, using Muspel's mana stores up to ensure the country's collapse, using the core of [[Moguro Hagane]] as a bomb, using the Crystal Palace itself as a back-up power source, nudging [[Arakiya]] to take in Muspel and potentially using her death to trigger the country's collapse, etc.''Sphinx, the mastermind behind the Great Disaster, was not half-hearted in the numerous artifices she had laid out. The undead army created with the Sacrament of the Immortal King, the use of the Stone Muspel to realize them, her advent as the Witch of Greed who managed to evade the flame of the Yang Sword once before, the murderous intent toward Arakiya who shared her destiny with the lands of the Empire, the starlight and the Magic Crystal Cannon, the subsequent overload of the Magic Core, the deployment of the magic circle to utilize the magic crystals, and the staging of the plight of the Fortified City――.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 2. Likewise, she is not above using the unused strategies once proposed to her by Valga Cromwell. ===Other=== '''Zombie Creation''': To create zombies, Sphinx used two kinds of lifeforms as a base from which [[Undead#Parasite-Based Zombies|two]] [[Undead#Corebug-Based Zombies|different]] zombie types were made. She has been described as the creator of one of them, while her relation to the other type is unknown. Similarly, it is not known if they were produced by magic or other means. *'''Corebug Creation''': Sphinx could utilize '''corebugs''' (核虫, ''kaku mushi''), small, round red bugs that appeared similar to caterpillars, which served as the core of a "zombies" and kept them intact.''As he stated this, in Roswaal’s hand was a small block of ice being pinched between his fingers, about the size of a coin; inside, there was a red, round object. Upon closer inspection, he understood that it was a small round bug that looked like a caterpillar――.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 3, Section 2.''“This corebug is lurking within the body of every zombie. And, this worm is the zombie’s lifeline… in other words, it is undoubtedly their core.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 3, Section 2. A corebug acquired the data of a deceased person to turn them into a zombie, and reproduced the victim's original form with a vessel of earth.''“We will be working to unravel more about the technique, but this corebug acquires the data of the target that is to turn into a zombie, and then reproduces the original form by making a vessel out of earth…”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 3, Section 2. This process could be finished near instantaneously, meaning that someone who died could immediately become a zombie following their own demise.''“It seems that when a soldier who was fighting with them died, that same soldier would immediately turn into a zombie and attack them, I suppose.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 2. The corebug, which could be located in a variety of body parts, impacted the durability of a zombie; they could be impervious to damage if stricken in areas that the corebug was not present in,''It did not seem like the difference in toughness was based on where the arrows pierced them, either. There were some undead that were fine even when pierced in the eye, and some that would shatter when pierced in the shoulder.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 1, Section 4. but if the corebug itself was destroyed, the zombie broke apart and was immediately destroyed.''“So, the true nature of Garfiel’s perceived discrepancy was the difference in the points at which an arrow killed the corebug within the zombie’s body.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 3, Section 2.''An undead’s weak point was neither their heart, nor their cranium. Operating within the vessels of earth, were the corebugs discovered by Beatrice and Roswaal. As long as that remained intact, the activity of an undead would not come to a halt.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 7, Section 3. *'''Parasite Creation''': Sphinx could create parasites that took over a living target's body and turned them into "zombies".''“So, this is the essence of the zombies. They’re parasites… no, parasitic creatures?”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, Section 5. While their manner of creation is unknown, they completely followed the will of their creator, Sphinx, and sought to create a "paradise" for her.''“Well, that’s because our creator is our creator. Our real parent… to be exact, our creator is the incentive that allowed us to be reborn. To make a paradise where our creator could be at peace―― that is the mission that has been bestowed upon us.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, Section 10. They initially formed in a host's body as a living tentacle-like appendage that was capable of physical movement. Upon taking control of a host's body, the host was killed, and the parasites were able to use the leftover brain's intellect and thought processes.''“Ah, who knows. The speed of our growth is very fast. At first, we may be corpses that are only able to move once the brains are rotted, but that leaves hosts that have their intellect and thought process intact…”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, Section 10. Though it is not known if their process of taking over human hosts was selective, they were only observed to take over adult males despite being able to nest themselves within women and children, with the exception of one female host who was established as the parasites' queen. They also had the ability to take over non-human animal hosts, such as rats. Similarly to the Sacrament of the Immortal King's effects, the zombies' bodies slowly decomposed over time after being taken over.''“They were trying to stick their rotting arms and feet back on to their bodies, trying to restore it to the way it was before.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, Section 3. Although it was unknown if there was a limit on how many parasites can be created, it was possible for more than two thousand of them to exist at the same time,''Exceeding the likes of a hundred, two hundred, a thousand, and two thousand, the mice that surrounded the captive girl in the dark were tremendous in numbers, standing still without letting out a single cry.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, Section 15. with each one loyal to Sphinx's desires.''If anything, it was the opposite. ――The mice did not view her as prey, but they were venerating her as something special. That was the loyalty that was directed towards a queen, what could only be established by the dominance of their instinct, which was an impossible evil that was brought to fruition. The mice, having lost their free will, gazed at the girl with eyes that were identical to a corpse.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, Section 15. ===Equipment=== '''Staff''': Sphinx held a black staff with red accents that was slightly longer than she was tall. The jewel inlaid in the main part of the staff can shine with bluish-white light and act as a light source,''Chained up in a basement, Priscilla was flashed by a staff that shone a bluish white, and holding that staff was a young girl with long pink hair―― with cracks running through her skin and horrifying eyes, she was an undead.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 42, Section 1. and should she choose to do so, she can use this jewel to project images of distant locations and events, similar to the functionality of a [[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|Conversation Mirror]].''She said, then struck the end of her glowing staff against the floor once more. The staff, with a glorious jewel inlaid into it, grew glaringly brighter, and during the moment, a change had occurred to the surface of the jewel. ――The view of the Imperial Capital, outside of the dungeon, had been projected onto the pale, transparent jewel. Perhaps its principles were similar to how a Conversation Mirror would emulate the reflection on the other side over the face of the mirror. Priscilla felt that such a formula seemed rather grandiose to only be used for gazing at something from a distance, narrowing her eyes through the light.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 42, Section 2. ==Trivia== *Like the other Witches (with the exception of Satella), Sphinx's namesake matches both an asteroid and a mythological being. [[Wikipedia:896 Sphinx|896 Sphinx]] is the name of a background asteroid situated in the asteroid belt. The mythological [[Wikipedia:Sphinx|Sphinx]] was a guardian creature in both Greek and Egyptian mythology. *Sphinx's first appearance in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]] predated the initial appearances of the original Ryuzu Meyer and any of her other replicas in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10|Volume 10]] by roughly ten months. *There are visual inconsistencies between the description of Sphinx provided in Ex 2 and the colored illustrations that accompanied it. Within the light novel, Sphinx's robe was referred to as white, yet a colored illustration displayed it as black. In [[Re:Zero Prequel: Camp Formation Stories]], the description of its color was changed to accommodate for her black robe in the aforementioned novel. Additionally, the manga adaptation presented the robe as black. *Although it is unknown if it has any connection to the aura that Wilhelm felt from her, Sphinx was noted to have miasma by Roswaal J. Mathers in [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 2|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]].''Cragrell slowly shook his head and Roswaal took the crystal from the tip of his tongue. She could feel a sinister aura faintly emanating from it as soon as she set it on her palm―― that aura was the miasma of that diabolical Witch which seemed to almost be telling her “Part of me has lingered behind in this world, even after death”.'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 2]], Section 3. *Sphinx has a named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|light novels]] and [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8|web novel]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Witch Navbox}} [[Category:Human]] [[Category:Half-Elf]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Demi-Human Alliance]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

Metal Throwing Balls |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Ex Volume 2]] |Manga = [[Manga Love Song Chapter 1|Love Song Chapter 1]] |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Roswaal J. Mathers''' (ロズワール・J・メイザース), formerly known as '''Julia''' (ジュリア), was the grandmother of [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], the mother of [[Roswaal K. Mathers]], and the head of [[House Mathers]] two generations before the current Roswaal, and she was a key figure in making the study of magic prevalent within [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. She played major roles in the [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]]. ==Appearance== Like previous generations, she had [[Wikipedia:Heterochromia iridum|heterocromatic eyes]], with the left eye being yellow and the right eye being blue. Her long straight indigo hair was partially tucked behind her left ear and reached down past her shoulders. Roswaal's skin was as fair as porcelain and her bust was considerably large. Despite the fact that this iteration of Roswaal wore little makeup, her astounding beauty was still enough to captivate men. Although her clothing was fairly different from previous and succeeding generations, she still stayed true to the general taste maintained by every Roswaal. Her ensemble, that was a uniform of sorts in deference to the [[Demi-Human War]] that was ongoing at the time, consisted of a pair of long black boots, white tights, a white long-sleeved shirt, and a purple jacket with golden lining and rolled cuffs that was worn over the shirt, essentially obscuring the white garment from view. Her cleavage was not covered by the shirt nor the jacket, essentially meaning that it was exposed. Like her grandson, Roswaal wore a long black cloak that nearly trailed along the ground and had a red interior ==History== Julia was born with a Gate that could only hold and produce a small amount of mana, leaving her incapable of casting magic, unlike her previous bodies. However, Roswaal still took this chance to learn martial arts. At some point in time, Julia had a child, Karl, with [[Garitch Fabless]] in an attempt to bear a child who was apt in healing magic. Though she had siblings in this incarnation, they and their parents had all perished around the time of the Demi-Human War's end, if not earlier. At some point, she started researching how to create artificial gates in order to overcome gate problems, inspired by her maximum mana capacity being minimal and leaving her with subpar magic capabilities as a result. However, she never managed to accomplish this feat. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== Following the [[Battle of Castour Field]], Julia was called in to examine the magic circles used. Accompanied by [[Carol Remendis]], the two joined the Zergev Squadron out into Castour Field. Accompanied by [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]], [[Grimm Fauzen]], and a few other members in a small group, they made their way into the field, with Roswaal speaking to Wilhelm while Grimm kept Carol company. After arriving at the site, she muttered that the Kingdom was certainly at threat, and soon after, the undead [[Tholter Weasily]] fired an arrow at her, which Wilhelm defended against. Though he managed to take care of most of the undead, he came face to face with [[Sphinx]], who Roswaal decided to help fight against. However, Sphinx decided to retreat, leaving them with the undead to fight. Roswaal mentioned that one of the corpse soldiers should stand out as the main one to defeat, and with a push from Wilhelm, Grimm was able to slay that one soldier, Tholter. Soon after, Roswaal informed the others of Sphinx's identity and the threat she bore. They later reported the same to the Kingdom's government, and later, she claimed that she would likely being seeing the Zergev Squadron often moving forward as the war progressed. For the next three years, she often found herself fighting alongside the Zergev Squadron on the frontlines, in order to pacify any magic circles. Before long, their sights were set on Aihiya Swamp, which Wilhelm compared to Castour Field. Roswaal appeared and confirmed his suspicions that the Kingdom did take into consideration that this was a trap, but they figured that the other side would surely fatigue. Accompanying her was Carol, who spoke with Grimm and gave him a good luck charm. With the arrival of [[Leip Barielle]] as their new commander, he struck Wilhelm for his disrespect, leaving Roswaal to pacify him and take him elsewhere alongside Carol. Later, during the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], she went to investigate a certain magic circle, only for it to activate right before her. Though she could have handled it with ease, Sphinx appeared and got in her way, killing a few of the nearby knights in an effort to get Roswaal to join her. However, this failed, and instead, Roswaal cornered her with her martial arts skill, forcing her to retreat. Afterward, Roswaal destroyed the magic circle, giving her allies a chance to retreat. About a month later, she had the [[Gionis Lugunica|king]] hide elsewhere besides the castle while she went to assist the Zergev Squadron to corner the attackers. After allowing them into the castle, she went with Wilhelm's group and confronted [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] and Sphinx in the chapel. With Wilhelm taking care of Valga, she, Carol, and Grimm chased after Sphinx, who they managed to successfully corner and sever one of her arms. When the ceiling was destroyed by one of her deflected attacks, Bordeaux and the undead Libre appeared. After Libre cut off her other arm and disintegrated, Roswaal chased after Sphinx and struck her back to the ground. However, using the secret passageways, Sphinx managed to escape her. As Roswaal searched for her, she encountered Leip, who claimed to have completely incinerated her, showing Roswaal a ring on a string as proof of her demise. Asking for the ring, she promised Leip his credit for killing Sphinx, while she smiled that things would be going according to plan to her [[Echidna|teacher]]. When Wilhelm vanished to train himself, Roswaal would be the only one to manage to find him, and because of her, he managed to learn about the ceremony to award the Sword Saint [[Theresia van Astrea]] for her contributions to the war. On the day of the ceremony, Roswaal provided her with a ceremonial sword and gave her words of advice as she left. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]]=== A couple of days after the ceremony, Roswaal appeared in the auxiliary Astrea Manor, where she assuaged the jealous Theresia's fears. Deciding to interfere one last time, Roswaal brought Theresia to the castle, despite Wilhelm requesting her not to come. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]=== Julia sacrificed her life to save Carol, even though she hadn't expected to die at that point in time since it was not written in her Gospel. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Despite lacking in the magic that each previous Roswaal had, Julia was still incredibly knowledgeable of magic and powerful in combat, having extensively trained herself in martial arts in order to fight and defend herself. Thanks to this, she was able to fight and easily overwhelm the likes of Sphinx and shinobi, making her one of the key figures in winning the Demi-Human War and the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Master Martial Artist''': In order to counter the powerful magical abilities of Sphinx, Roswaal cultivated the body of Roswaal J. Mathers to be a master martial artist rather than a master mage. From a young age, Roswaal painstakingly trained her body in the martial arts. Over twenty years, her training coupled with her natural talent forged her into a true fighting genius. Anyone who saw her in combat could tell that she was an accomplished practitioner with a flawless technique. Her style was based around landing lightning quick and precise punches that sowed ruin upon the bodies of her enemies. Although his later bodies like Roswaal L. Mathers probably weren't as physically powerful as Roswaal J. Mathers, they still maintained the fighting techniques Roswaal had coalesced during that particular life, meaning Roswaal remained a true master of the martial arts. '''Superhuman Strength''': The physical strength of Roswaal J. Mathers vastly surpassed that which was accepted as possible for a human being. Her mighty blows were powerful enough to snap bones, rupture internal organs, shatter boulders, and split large trees in half. She could throw small-yet-heavy steel balls with enough force to shatter bones and organs. ===[[Magic]]=== As she carries the knowledge of every previous Roswaal that came before her, Julia is has extensive knowledge in regard to magic, having made numerous headways in magic theory, recognizing the intricacies of spells and magic circles used by others, making the Royal Magic Research Institute, and being named as the country's court mage. However, due to her gate being inferior to every previous Roswaal, she is incapable of using her magic. '''Yellow Eye''': Roswaal is able to use a yellow eye to break magic apart. However, this ability does not seem to be instant, as when she used it to destroy a powerful magic circle, she first had to slightly tamper with the circle and then concentrate for a short time to allow her eye to cancel it. When it cancels magic, it seems to flicker slightly. '''Spells''': '''Soul Transcription''' (魂の転写): A lost magic technique that allows a person to transcribe their own soul over another's. By doing this over and over to extend their life indefinitely, the user can achieve what [[Beatrice]] termed as "subjective immortality". However, it has one major restriction in that for it to work, the person whose soul is overwritten must usually be of blood-relation to the caster. The spell was originally created by Echidna to gain immortality, but she could not complete it before her demise. Instead, it was finished by Roswaal who had been using it to survive until the present era. ===Equipment=== *'''[[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]]''' (叡智の書): Just like Beatrice, Roswaal was given one of the two complete copies of the Book of Wisdom Echidna created before her ultimate demise. It allows Roswaal to use a limited version of the original Book of Wisdom, as it shows her a detailed path to her desired future. For four centuries, Roswaal strictly acted upon the Book's writ, doing exactly as it was written. *'''Steel Mittens''': Alongside her pugilistic fighting style, Julia wore a pair of black steel mittens to enhance the damage that she could cause to her enemies. *'''Enchanted Cloak''': Roswaal wore a cloak that ensured that any offensive magical attack that struck the cloak would dissipate and leave its wearer unharmed. However, it is only effective for singular usage, as after negating an attack the cloak would dissipate. *'''Metal Throwing Balls''': A type of projectile Julia specifically used for fighting Sphinx. Despite their small size they contained a lot of mass that allowed them to penetrate deep into the target's body, dealing significant damage. ==Trivia== *Starting with his original body, Roswaal has been changing his middle initial every time he possesses a new descendant. His original initial was A, making his current body his 10th one. *In the original release of [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 6]], Roswaal said that her black gloves were a weapon left to her by her ancestors that could withstand the sharpness of a Holy Sword. However, any reference to this line was removed in the Ex 6 release. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:House Mathers]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Mages]] [[Category:Leaders]]

'''Setanta''' (セタンタ) was the chief of the [[Oni]] Village [[Ram]] and [[Rem]] lived at when they were young, and the last chief of the onis.<ref>''“Spare me from having it happen 1000 times. ──I came to see an old friend, Setanta. He should still be the chief. I haven’t heard of him dying, after all.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref>

==Appearance==
Setanta was elderly in appearance with brown eyes and grey hair that goes down to his neck, a large build, and an intimidating presence.<ref>''Setanta was the Oni Tribe chief, as well as an old person that was this hidden village’s mediator. He had grey hair, a large build, an awfully strong sense of intimidation, and he was someone Rem couldn’t deal with very well. Although, Ram and her parents were just about the only people she was fine with.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref> He tended to wear a montsuki haori jacket similar to many of the other members of the tribe. Like other members of his tribe, he was capable of producing two horns from his forehead.

==Personality==
He strictly followed the law in the village and was shown to be willingly (albeit grimly) take the responsibility of removing the taboo of twins as an Oni himself.<ref>''“Quit it! There will be no mercy! There are no exceptions to the law, even if that means going into ruins as a result of protecting the law. Bending the law is unforgivable.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref> However, he changed his view when Ram unveiled her powers with just a single horn in order to protect Rem. He saw Ram as a child prodigy and ultimately accepted the Oni twins as members of the village, and he would often remind Rem that the only reason she wasn't killed was because of Ram's power. The only time he would treat Ram as a child was only when it was convenient.<ref name="convenient">''“You oughtn’t treat her like a kid only when it’s convenient. Plus, well, in my eyes, it looks like this girl’s nature has nothing to do with age and readiness.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> He seems to have a certain unique view on strength as well; when he met with his old friend, [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]], he seemed to respect his mentality from when he was younger, and he spat at how he had gotten weak and soft with age.

==History==
At an unknown point in time, Setanta met and befriended Valga Cromwell.

===[[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]===
Immediately after the birth of Rem and Ram, Setanta decided to kill the two for tainting the oni bloodline, rebuking their mother, [[Temae]] for birthing them and trying to protect them. Ordering to have her held back, he took his blade and prepared to kill them, only to be stopped by the infant Ram's power. Seeing her power, he and the rest of the onis knelt, calling her the reincarnation of the [[Minor Characters#Oni God|Oni God]]. Over the years, he had Ram join the onis on hunts and in various meetings. Some years later, Valga came to visit, and after being escorted to Setanta's house, he called himself Rom. Though Setanta told Ram to stay for the discussion and Rem to go home, Ram declined his order and left with Rem. A few hours later, he and Rom were leaving the village, having come across the twins. As he spoke to Ram, Valga scolded him for treating Ram as a child only when it was convenient.<ref name="convenient" /> After Rom told the twins to be good sisters and left, Setanta spat that he had gotten weak with age before returning to his home. Sometime later, when the village came under attack by the [[Witch Cult]], Setanta fought them off for a long time, until he was the last man standing, and in the end, he was set ablaze and killed.

==Abilities==
'''Oni Bloodline''': As that chief of the Oni Tribe, he had access to the same traits that the rest of his tribe had. His strength was exceptional enough that, aside from Ram, he was the final oni standing during the Witch Cult's raid on his village.

'''Equipment''': Due to his strength, Setanta was the only among the Oni Tribe who could wield an incredibly heavy, dulled, and over 2 meter long sword that had mainly been used as a decoration.<ref>''The sword was a decoration for the venue, and it was considered a super heavy object that only Setanta could handle. It had lost its sharpness for a long time, but it would still be appropriate to call this piece of iron a dangerous weapon as it was longer than two meters.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref>
