400+ (chronological) |Hair Color = Pink |Eye Color = Dark Cyan |Height = 135 cm (4'5")[[Re:Zeropedia 2]], Chapter 1: Character Profile, Emilia Camp, Page 50. |Affiliation = [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] |Previous Affiliation = [[Sanctuary]] |Previous Occupation = |Status = Deceased (body sealed in a mana crystal)Since the author has stated that she has a Book of the Dead, this confirms that Ryuzu died when she sealed herself in the crystal. |Relatives=[[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu copies]] (clones)
[[Omega]] (clone)
[[Sphinx]] (clone) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 12|Volume 12]] |Anime = [[Episode 35]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Aimi Tanaka|Tanaka Aimi]] |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Lizzie Freeman|Lizzie Freeman]]}} '''Ryuzu Meyer''' (リューズ・メイエル) was a half-elf girl who lived in the [[Sanctuary]] during the era of the [[Witch|Witches]], four centuries ago. She was used by [[Echidna]] in order to activate the Barrier and protect the Sanctuary from the [[Hector|Warlock of Melancholy]]. ==Appearance== Ryuzu was a petite girl with long, fluffy light pink hair that curved outward at the ends. She wore a large black robe that dragged along the ground and was too big for her hands to show completely through the sleeves. Due to her race, she had a pair of pointy ears which were usually concealed by her pink hair. Her face was very adorable and innocent. Due to the high collar of her attire, her mouth was usually blocked from view, giving the girl a shy and timid air. ==Personality== Ryuzu acted similarly to how her copies acted during the events of [[Arc 4]], but more lively. She was a diligent girl who was always happy to give a helping hand to everyone in the Sanctuary who needed some help. Despite her timid and shy appearance, she was perfectly capable of forming bonds with people even as troublesome and hard-to-come-close-with as Beatrice. According to [[Echidna]], the girl's Od possessed great compatibility with the Sanctuary, making her a perfect candidate to use as the core for the Sanctuary's barrier. Sadly, however, her Od first needed to get accustomed to the environment. Before she could get the chance to do so, the [[Hector|Warlock of Melancholy]] began his attack on the Sanctuary, forcing the Witch of Greed to find other solutions. In such times of peril, Ryuzu showed immense courage and volunteered herself to physically merge her Od with the catalyst which would allow Echidna's plan to work. In her final moments, she confessed her fondness of [[Beatrice]] and merged with the mana crystal which acted as the catalyst for the barrier. ==History== In the years predating Hector's attack on the Sanctuary, Ryuzu was somehow saved by Echidna, who brought her to the Sanctuary in order to test her compatibility with the land. On the day of Hector's attack, she established contact with a high-grade magic crystal, which allowed her Od to sync with the lands of the Sanctuary and set up an impenetrable barrier which effectively fended off the intruder. She spent the next four centuries encased in the same magic crystal, until [[Emilia]] overcame the three trials and lifted the barrier. Her current status or location remain unknown. ==Trivia== *The original Ryuzu has been ranked among the five weakest characters in Re:Zero.''"Subaru, Petra, Anastasia, original Ryuzu, Ferris."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473461952275288066 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] *In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], Echidna renamed herself as [[Omega]], stating that this is how Subaru named her, which implies Echidna's new vessel is the original Omega Ryuzu copy who may have merged with the real Ryuzu Meyer sealed in the crystal, similar to how Shima sacrificed herself by vanishing with the crystal and became her new body in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15]]. *[[Wikipedia:Aimi Tanaka|Tanaka Aimi]], the Japanese voice actress of the original Ryuzu and her copies, also voices [[Plum Risch]]. *According to the author, Ryuzu has a [[Pleiades Watchtower#Books of the Dead|Book of the Dead]].July 26, 2026 Talk Show ==Note== ==References== ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Sanctuary]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[de:Ryuzu Meyer (Original)]] [[pl:Ryuzu Meyer]] [[pt-br:Ryuzu Meyer (Original)]] [[ru:Рюдзу Мейер (оригинал)]] [[zh:角色:琉兹（本体）]]

wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = Rowan Segmunt |Image = Rowan Segmunt character design.png|Light Novel (Living) Rowan Segmunt Undead design.png|Light Novel (Undead) |Caption = |Kanji = ロウアン・セグムント |Romaji = Rouan Segumunto |Alias = Undead Swordmaster (屍剣豪, ''Shi Kengō'') |Nickname = |Race = Human |Gender = Male |Age = Around 50 |Hair Color = Navy Blue |Eye Color = Blue |Height = |Weight = |Affiliation = |Previous Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]] |Occupation = |Previous Occupation = The [[Vincent Vollachia|Emperor's]] Bodyguard
[[Stargazer]]
Mercenary |Status = Deceased |Relatives = 8 unnamed children (deceased)
[[Cecilus Segmunt]] (son) |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = Onibami |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 27|Volume 27]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice =}} '''Rowan Segmunt''' (ロウアン・セグムント) was a mercenary-for-hire from the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], the former bodyguard of the [[Vincent Vollachia|Emperor of Vollachia]], and the father of First ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]] [[Cecilus Segmunt]]. Initially debuting as a minor character during one of [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s failed loops in [[Arc 7]], he later reappeared with both a supportive and antagonistic role in [[Arc 8]]. A [[Stargazer]] tasked by the Observers to find a way to reach the Heavenly Sword,''――Rowan Segmunt was a Stargazer.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 1.''After all, the commandment bestowed upon Rowan Segmunt was to reach the Heavenly Sword. ――And that, was none other than the great ambition Rowan himself had harbored even before the commandment had been bestowed upon him.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 1. Rowan was responsible for numerous deaths, including those of his own children, until his son Cecilus was born. Though abandoned by the Observers, he kept his goal of reaching for the Heavenly Sword, continuously refining his skill and turning himself into a mercenary and criminal in the process. During the [[Great Disaster]], Rowan committed suicide to become an [[Undead|undead]] in an effort to combat [[Yorna Mishigure|Iris]] and reach the Heavenly Sword in death. In the end, however, his soul was incinerated by [[Eugard Vollachia]]'s [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]], being completely reduced to cinders after a final duel with his son that ended in his failure. ==Appearance== Rowan was a tall and grizzled-looking middle-aged man with blue eyes, greying navy blue hair styled in a bun and a bit of shaven facial hair covering his face. He was a self-proclaimed rōnin and dressed like one, wearing a rather large kasa-style hat, a lilac kimono, a black cloak which was decorated with vertical stripes of gold color on the outside and a darker lilac on the inside, as well as hot pink sandals. He had a katana at his white waist, which had a black scabbard and a hot pink rayskin. Due to him being an alcoholic, he also stunk of booze. As a [[Undead#Zombie|zombie]], Rowan possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across his body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. He also discarded his hat. ==Personality== Rowan was shown to have been quite a drunkard, usually spending his time and money in different pubs, drinking copious amounts of alcohol. He could hold his alcohol surprisingly well, as he was able to easily cut down [[Gaoran Peitiet]] despite being drunk. As expected from a mercenary, Rowan sought money, and he is prepared to do nearly anything for an appropriate compensation. However, Rowan was willing to offer praise to his opponents in battle. He was also noted to be rather rough but straight to the point. Rowan's dearest wish was to attain the Heavenly Sword, something he was obsessed with doing before, during, and after his time as a Stargazer. He lived a life full of bloodshed and slaughter with the hopes of attaining his long-cherished desire. Whether they were a stranger, a family member, or even himself, Rowan would unhesitatingly extinguish the life of anyone standing in his way if it had allowed him to proceed further on the path to the Heavenly Sword, and even his own son believed that he did not have any human emotion left within him.''“If you had human emotions like that left in you, Dad, then you wouldn’t have killed five or six of your own children until one with talent, me, was born.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 3, Section 6. As his son was reaching the Heavenly Sword, Rowan was even willing to tempt him to slay the emperor so that the entire country would become his enemy, intent on having his son polish his sword skills with the endless assault of the numerous soldiers coming at him without end.''"Hahaha, ya say such silly, silly things, redhead. My goal’s mighty simple. If my son were to do away with His Excellency the Emperor, the whole of the Empire’d become his enemy."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 37, Section 2.''"That’s my goal. A situation where those Imperial Soldiers are gonna keep on attacking without sparing any time to eat or sleep… There’s no better environment than that to polish his sword skills between life and death!"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 37, Section 2. He was even willing to extinguish his own life and become an undead to use the endless revival and a worthy enemy to polish his skills and reach the Heavenly Sword himself once he believed it was achievable for him again.''"Even if I die, I’m go――"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 43, Section 4.''"――I’m gonna reach the Heavenly Sword."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 43, Section 4. Due to his goal of reaching the Heavenly Sword, Rowan also believed that he was born in the wrong era. He had even pondered about life during the era of the [[Great Calamity]], when all things feared the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]].''The more chaotic the world got, the more ruined that peace fell, the more the era would demand the overwhelming might of the strong. With the path to reach the Heavenly Sword having become so distant and steep, he wondered just how good it would have been to live in the era of four-hundred years ago, when all living things feared the Witch.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 2. Likewise, he was also of the belief that chaos and disaster should be widespread, as such an environment was ideal for improving his own skill. As such, he did not care whether or not a country would fall, and he would only focus on his own goals.''The world was estranged from peace, and the more chaotic the state of the world got, the more the way of steel would be refined.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 2.''That which he had told Heinkel was no lie, it really did not matter to Rowan in the slightest whether the Empire was saved or not. His perception was that it was better for chaos and disaster to be widespread.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 4. ==History== In the distant past, Rowan fervently desired to improve his skills with the sword to attain the Heavenly Sword. With his sword, he systematically slayed those who sought to improve their skills like him, formidable [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]], the people in villages destroyed by witchbeasts, scourges who terrorized others, and saintly people that provided charity, producing few results.''Strong individuals who strived to master their techniques just like Rowan, fearsome Witchbeasts that attacked villages, people of the villages destroyed by those Witchbeasts, scoundrels who tyrannized others, saints who donated to others; he had systematically slain everything that could be useful for tempering his steel with reckless abandon, but he had not produced many results.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 3. He then studied and learned techniques from sword schools, eventually going on to murder their heads and attempt to combine all their techniques together, but he abandoned this path too when it threatened the balance of his own skills.''In various schools, he had studied, acquired techniques, then went on to cut down the heads of the schools; he had tried to unify the many techniques he had absorbed, but when he understood that it only led to the equilibrium of his own skills crumbling, he abandoned that as well.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 3. Striding on a trail of blood and failing to achieve the deep-rooted conviction he obsessed over, right when Rowan began to contemplate suicide, he was chosen to become a Stargazer and was bestowed with the commandment to produce a being who could reach the Heavenly Sword.''Quite literally, he had continued to walk and walk and walk a path of blood, but the path to the Heavenly Sword was still unreachable; craving that from the bottom of his heart, he had even considered ending his own life―― and it was at that moment. That was when Rowan was bestowed with a commandment, and became a Stargazer.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 3.''The Heavenly Sword must be reached no matter what, such had become Rowan’s destiny. That did not mean that he himself was to reach the Heavenly Sword, but that he was to pursue trial and error in order to produce a being qualified to reach the Heavenly Sword.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 3. Rowan believed he may have been able to achieve his commandment by producing a being qualified to attain the Heavenly Sword, but he gave up on the path of fostering and growing hidden talent.''At first, he could do nothing else but try and do everything systemically. He immediately gave up on the path of finding those who had talent, and fostering them to reach it.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 3. He continued to butcher person after person in hopes of achieving his goal. However, once Rowan came to the conclusion that he could not reach it, he determined that his progeny should be the one to do so.''Thinking that, he tried to aim for the Heavenly Sword on his own once again, but when it remained an unreachable path even after recklessly endeavoring, and recklessly slaying people, he relinquished it. That was not it. For Rowan himself, it was not meant to be. ――Rowan’s lineage, ought to reach it instead.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 3. Over the next several years, after much trial and error of raising eight children and murdering them when they were not talented enough, Cecilus, however, refused this offer because it was something that only a villain would do, told Vincent of Rowan's plans, and endeavored to slay his own father on the emperor's behalf.''At the time Rowan attempted to quickly make the entirety of the Empire into an enemy, so that he could have Cecilus reach the Heavenly Sword, Cecilus had refused it because “That’s typical of a crude villain” of all things, taking Vincent’s side as he tried to slay Rowan.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 4. Gravely injured from his son's attack, Rowan promised that when Cecilus reached the Heavenly Sword, he would come to kill the Blue Lightning. This proposal caused Cecilus to turn a blind eye to Rowan's survival, dropping him in a river to allow his escape.''Then, in order to have Cecilus turn a blind eye, Rowan had made a promise. That eventually, once Cecilus reached the Heavenly Sword, Rowan would definitely come to kill him. Accepting that, Cecilus dropped a gravely-injured Rowan into a river, allowing him to escape. Having survived through the verge of death, Rowan continued to improve his skills as he awaited the promised time.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 38, Section 4. Following this incident, Rowan continued to hone his skills with the hope that, one day, he could cut down his son. This eventually led to him becoming a mercenary, and a bounty was put on his head. ==Abilities== '''Master Swordsman''': Rowan was very skilled with his katana, having been mentioned by the barista to be by far the strongest individual from the pub Subaru and Flop found him. Subaru also noted that Rowan's sword technique was similar to that of a martial art style known as "iai", a real life Japanese-specific martial art that involves quickly drawing one's blade to attack and then immediately resheathing it right after. In his earlier days, Rowan frequented many schools of swordsmanship and attempted to blend the techniques together with his own swordsmanship, but he ultimately abandoned doing this when it threatened his balance as a swordsman; regardless, due to this experience, he is a master of numerous sword styles and has masterfully blended them to improve on his own skill. After becoming an undead and fighting with Yorna Mishigure, his skill with the blade improved dramatically, leaving even his son impressed.''This was honest admiration. A few hours prior, when he had parted with the yet-living Rowan, as far as Cecilus’s eyes could see, his father had not reached this domain. However, now that they had been reunited, with him having become an undead, Rowan’s skill with the sword had rapidly developed, and his talents were finally beginning a posthumous bloom.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 64, Section 4. It should be noted that his skill could be considered the peak of what an ordinary person can achieve without being what Rowan considers “transcendental”.''As an opponent to whom these statements ought be given, Rowan was a terribly troublesome person. ――He was not weak. Yet, neither was he strong. If she was forced to put it to words, he would be the apex of the common man.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 43, Section 4. *'''Cloud Cutting''' (雲切, ''Kumokiri''): Rowan could use a technique called Cloud Cutting, a powerful slash of the sword so lightning-fast that it leaves no sound behind and creates a force that can rise to the sky, literally allowing it to cleave clouds in two.''In a flash of lightning that left even the sound behind, the force from that blade rose to the sky, and the thick clouds above the pair of them were cleaved in two right down the middle.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Sword Identity Part 1|Sword Identity]], Section 4. For people who lack uncommon courage, the sheer strength of the technique is enough to make them feel as if their own flesh has been cleaved.''A light flick of the wrist that emitted a flash of the sword, it was the technique called Cloud Cutting that Cecilus had shown in sport. But few could laugh at it as a street performance. In particular, those with uncommon courage such as Arakiya’s master, and Vincent. For those without it, it would be enough to give them a sensation like that off their own flesh being cleaved in two.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], [[Sword Identity Part 2|Sword Identity]], Section 8. Rowan created the technique himself, having spent his lifetime to devise it.''That, was the divine miracle of empty sky that Rowan Segmunt had spent his lifetime devising―― for those who were transcendent monsters, it was comprehended as naught more than being dubbed a flashy performance.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 6, Section 3. Although considered something of a parlor trick by other practitioners of the blade, it is still capable of slashing at aerial opponents. '''Excellent Teaching Abilities''': While Rowan's skill with the blade was top-class, he was also an extremely good tutor who was capable of producing beings with extreme skills with the blade.''"His attitude was not very pleasant, but he was too valuable to be executed merely on the grounds of disrespect. Although his own skill was first-class, his observations and teachings could create beings far above that level."'' [[The Land of the Wolves / Death unto the Weak, Mercy be None Zero Vincent]], Section 3. '''Equipment''': Rowan wielded a katana called the '''Onibami''' (オニバミ, ''Onibami''). It was unnamed in the light novel. ==Trivia== *Rowan has his own named chapter in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8: Vincent Vollachia|web novel]] of Arc 8. In the [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36|light novel]], it was adapted as an interlude. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Mercenaries]] [[Category:Bodyguards]] [[Category:Stargazer]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]]

[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32|Volume 32]] (main story) |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Serena Dracroy''' (セリーナ・ドラクロイ) is a High Countess hailing from the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. She is one of the most prominent nobles in the Empire, and she helped [[Priscilla Barielle]] into the Empire following the events of [[Arc 5]]. She played an important role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. She played a supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. Taking her seat as a noble after ending her father with her own hand, Serena took command of the country’s famed Flying Dragon Squadron, one of the most elite units in the nation. She is also responsible for raising the [[Balleroy Temeglyph|Magic Bullet Sharpshooter]] and the current [[Medium O'Connell|empress consort]] and her [[Flop O'Connell|brother]]. ==Appearance== Serena is a tall woman with a stocky physique. Her hair is of rust red color, and she has a big scar on the left side of her face, which she received from an assassin sent to kill her in the past. She bears a long coat as her nobles' attire, but she prefers to place it atop her shoulders rather than wearing it normally. ==Personality== The embodiment of the word fierce, Serena is a bold woman that talks with a kick to her voice. She is strong, prideful, and enjoys talking with others, and by her own claim, she is greedy when it comes to attaining victory.''"Being greedy for victory is a virtue. ――You’re the same as I am, aren’t you?"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 61, Section 5. She is fierce, progressive, and courageous, and when necessary, she would even snap at her [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]],''She was a fierce, progressive, and courageous general who was willing to snap at the Emperor when necessary―― exactly what her moniker, the Scorching Lady, suggested.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 99, Section 2. and she is smart, quickly able to discern things from minimal information.''But exactly as he had stated, her abilities to discern things were impressive. It was only natural to think that Abel’s goal was to win this rebellion and seize the throne of the Vollachian Empire.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 103, Section 2. Though she typically assumes an approachable demeanor, during stressful situations, such as being held at wand-point by [[Ram]], she remains calm and composed, and during battle situations, she remains wary and keeps her guard up, and she will not hesitate to cut down an unarmed man depending on the circumstances.''"Being unarmed is no reason for me to let my guard down. Go ahead and give me a reason to remove my hand from the hilt of my sword. Just to let you know, I don’t hesitate to cut someone unarmed."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 104, Section 1. She is also rather prideful of her Flying Dragon Squadron, to the point that their removal from the [[Imperial Army]] due to a farce schemed by the emperor led her to joining the rebel army during the [[Imperial Civil War]] in order to get back at him.''"To think that my Flying Dragon Squadron would be valued to that extent, when the Imperial Capital’s given me the cold shoulder."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 99, Section 2.''Shrugging her shoulders, Serena gave that sarcastic remark; but despite the content of her words and the expression on her face, her reaction showed that her blood was boiling due to that very fact.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 99, Section 2.''The existence of the Flying Dragon Squadron in the hands of High Countess Dracroy was the core reason why the Dracroy Domain was revered and respected throughout the Vollachian Empire, where the strong were held in high esteem. In other words, for Serena Dracroy, it was a source of pride that ought not be wounded. Even if someone from the Dracroy territory were to commit an evil act―― in other words, even if they were to act against the Emperor himself, no doubt ought to be brought forth against their capabilities.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 99, Section 2. ==History== ===[[Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II Part 1|Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II]]=== When she was a teenager, Serena became the head of her family. Her business required her to travel to the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], where she sought to resolve a dispute. However, assassins were sent to follow her to Lugunica in a targeted attempt to kill her. Before she could be killed, she was saved by several people, among them [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], who found out that the assassins were sent by her father, [[Minor Characters#Galahau Dracroy|Galahau Dracroy]], who wanted revenge for losing his position. In the resulting conflict, she received her characteristic scar from one of the assassins. Upon defeating three of the assassins and convincing [[Gwain Merette|the fourth]] to turn against them for his survival, she would eventually return to the Empire, where she confronted her father. In the resulting conflict, it is said that Galahau carved a large scar onto her face, but she ultimately proved victorious and proceeded to burn him alive, which led her to be known as the "'''Scorching Lady'''"; because she received her scar from one of the assassins who attempted to murder her, the extent to which this story is true is unknown. Sometime after these events, [[Jorah Pendleton]] helped her bring her family together as she was having a hard time doing so by herself. Sometime later, one of her subordinates, [[Miles]], brought Flop and Medium O'Connell back to the domain with him, and they befriended Serena, viewing her as a benefactor. Some years after Flop and Medium befriended Balleroy Temeglyph when he decided to start raising the flying dragon [[Carillon]], the two decided to depart from Serena's domain to fulfill their goal of "revenge". Balleroy opted to stay in Serena's domain and became one of her subordinates alongside Miles. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Seven years before the main story, Serena sent her servants Balleroy and Miles to the Pendleton Estate in order to invite Jorah and his wife, Priscilla, to the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]. While they were there, the gladiators attempted to spark a [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|revolution]] that would render the island independent from the mainland, which later ended up failing thanks to the intervention of the [[Imperial Army]]. After the group left Ginunhive and returned to Serena's estate, Priscilla thanked her for the invitation in the stead of her resting husband. At an unknown point in time after Jorah's execution, Serena ordered Balleroy and Miles to look for Priscilla, as there was a rumor going around about some bandits who kidnapped a girl looking like her. The duo successfully found her and managed to bring her to the estate. Afterwards, Serena found a way to smuggle Priscilla out of the Empire and into the Kingdom of Lugunica. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 4|Undead Busters]]=== After Medium became [[Vincent Vollachia]]'s empress consort, she sought marital advice from her, [[Yorna Mishigure]], and [[Madelyn Eschart]] to visit her. Before long, [[Cecilus Segmunt]]'s party returned to [[Garkla]], intending to speak with Vincent about how to handle [[Volcas]]. ==Abilities== '''Excellent Strategist''': Serena has shown to be an excellent tactician during battle. During the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], she kept her allegiance hidden from the heads of state and claimed that she would not participate in the rebellion or the army so that she could catch them off guard and act as a trump card for the rebels, and during [[Great Disaster#Defense of Garkla|Defense of Garkla]], she easily outsmarted the [[Palladio Manesque|enemy commander]] and was able to fully counter his sneak attack. '''Flying Dragon Squadron''' (飛竜隊, ''Hiryūtai''): The Flying Dragon Squadron is an attack force owned by Serena. It is comprised of an elite group of flying dragons and dragon riders that possess complete mastery over the air, and their strength is the reason the Dracroy Domain is revered in Vollachia. The current squadron under Serena is said to be the strongest it has ever been.''Surpassing the trend that has been going since before the previous generation Count Dracroy, Serena Dracroy’s era is considered to have the strongest Flying Dragon Squadron.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 82, Section 1. '''Equipment''': Serena keeps a sword at her hip. ==Trivia== *It has been claimed that the crest of High Countess Dracroy is a flying dragon with a scar on its cheek.''It sported neither the crest of High Countess Dracroy, that of a flying dragon with a scar on its cheek, nor the national emblem of the Vollachian Empire, the wolf pierced by swords, but an entirely different flag.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 97, Section 2. However, it is unclear if this crest represents House Dracroy or the Flying Dragon Squadron. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Nobles]] [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Leaders]]

[[Zoey]] (older sister) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 28|Volume 28]]}} '''Tanza''' (タンザ) is a servant of [[Yorna Mishigure]] who once resided within [[Chaosflame]]'s Crimson Lapis Castle. She plays a supporting role in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. She was originally just a normal village girl until her village was razed and her parents were killed. Traveling with her sister [[Zoey]], they eventually stumbled upon Chaosflame, where Zoey became Yorna's attendant. After her death, however, Tanza took her place by Yorna's side, growing vengeful of the [[Vollachia Empire|Empire]] and swearing her loving loyalty to Yorna. ==Appearance== Tanza is a young girl with pale skin, purple eyes, and tan hair. Due to her lineage as a deer human, she sports a pair of antlers and has one decoration below each antler. She dons a blue and purple kimono with a floral pattern with its collar, sleeves, and bow being a bright shade of green, reminiscent of Yorna's kimono. ==Personality== Tanza was initially presented as a doll-like girl who does not show her emotions. Despite her cold exterior, she holds immense love for Yorna and is herself cared for by the residents of Chaosflame. She often appears reserved, but she is able to understand the thoughts and feelings of those around her. Although she mostly shows respect to the people around her, Tanza is straightforward, supportive, and honest, to the point of speaking bluntly when asserting her opinion.''Tanza did not flatter anyone by choosing words that were pleasing to the ear, but rather asserted her honest opinion.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 24, Section 1. In reality, though she is highly intelligent for her age, she has always been highly self-deprecating and often thinks of herself as selfish, bearing no confidence in herself.''Tanza, had once been a girl without confidence in herself. Incredibly intelligent and capable for her young age, and yet, the child had evaluated herself as being completely lacking, an evaluation that was far too low of herself. Back when she was the same age as Tanza in the truest sense, she had not been nearly as capable as her.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 62, Section 2. At times, she felt glad that it is not in her nature to show her emotions on her face, and because of the way that her country stole the lives of her family away, she came to hate the Empire.''――This was a complex feeling, but just like Natsuki Schwartz, Tanza hated the Vollachian Empire.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 1.''She hated the Empire that had taken her mother and father; the Empire that, for some incomprehensible reason such as the Imperial Way, had tortured her sister to death; the sister who had assiduously raised Tanza; the sister who had been relieved upon finally finding a place where they could live in peace; the sister whom Tanza should have been able to finally repay for everything she had done for her.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 1. She has also shown great loyalty to those she follows. For Yorna, who she is highly protective of, she was willing to go against someone as dangerous as [[Vincent Vollachia|Abel]] and even set a large number of citizens on his party so that they would leave and not involve Yorna in his [[Imperial Civil War|war]], willing to give up her own life so that Yorna would not be punished or involved, and she later entered an extremely dangerous [[Conquest of the Undead Capital|battlefield]] just to reunite with her. She even displayed her deep loyalty to [[Natsuki Subaru]] during the events in [[Ginunhive]], willing to sacrifice her life to make sure he lived. Likewise, despite her own retorts to his apparent non-serious behavior, she did not abide by others mocking him, and she often sulked when he unknowingly upset her, displayed a competitive streak with [[Beatrice]] when it came to wanting to assist him, and was even willing to threaten anyone who she thought wanted to hurt him.''"Is that not a bit of an imprudent statement? Barusu… I suppose that is referring to Schwartz-sama. But, if you lay your hands on Schwartz-sama, I and the rest of the battalion will not show mercy."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 22, Section 4. Thanks to her travels with Subaru, she has been able to gain more confidence in herself, to the point that it shocked Yorna when they reunited,''Far more agile and powerful than the Tanza she knew, it was a fight brimming with confidence.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 62, Section 2.''Someone apart from herself. They had gotten close to Tanza, pushed her, and made her stronger. She could feel it within Tanza’s intense gaze, in her gait, and in the fist that she had slammed into the swordsman’s face.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 62, Section 2. and despite rarely showing emotion on her face or camaraderie, she seemed to be proud to be a member of the Pleiades Battalion.''Dusting off her kimono, she was the sort of girl whose facial expression would barely ever stir; however, on this occasion, she seemed to be just a little proud of herself. Even though she did not show much camaraderie, she had recognized herself as a member of the Pleiades Battalion. Otherwise, she would not have been affected by the “Power of Unity”.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 105, Section 2. ==History== The birthplace of Tanza and her sister, Zoey, was ravaged and destroyed by bandits who sought to earn profits when the spread of a superstition claiming that boiling the antlers of deer humans could create a panacea.''The reason Tanza’s birthplace had been destroyed was because of the prevalence of a superstition that boiling the antlers of the deerpeople tribe would create a panacea, causing them to be attacked by bandits who aimed to sell the antlers at a high price.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. Their parents were murdered by the bandits, and the two of them barely escaped with their lives.''With both her mother and father killed, the still-young Tanza had been pulled by the hand of her sister, and they were able to barely escape with their lives.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. From that point onward, the sisters lived a harsh life of suffering while attempting to evade those who sought to kill them for their antlers or to prey on their weakness, as has been customary for the Vollachia Empire.''But, the sufferings of the two sisters did not end there. Many times, the evil clutches of those hunting their antlers had caught up to them, and even ignoring that, it was customary in the Vollachian Empire to prey on the weak.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. Zoey put herself through harsh circumstances to even obtain a plate of soup for her and Tanza, who detested her reliance on her older sister and felt the desire to end her own life.''Many a time, their lives had been in danger, and the extent to which her sister had gone through harsh experiences in order to obtain one plateful of soup, was something Tanza could only conceive of after a few years had passed. At the same time, she had detested being entirely dependent on her sister, unable to do anything, so much so that she had wanted to kill herself.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. After they had continued to flee for a long time, the two of them eventually heard rumors of a paradise called Chaosflame.''They were always fleeing, fleeing, continuing to flee, and when they had become fatigued from all the fleeing, what caught the ears of the two sisters, was a rumor of the Demon City of Chaosflame. It was told that in that place, many demi-human tribes lived together, that it was a paradise for the ostracized.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. Despite Tanza's doubts toward its existence, Zoey managed to lead her there.''The mistress who ruled there was said to be strong, filled with compassion, and a wonderful person who did not tolerate the weak being oppressed. ――Such a prospect was ridiculous, Tanza thought with her childish heart. There was no way such a person existed. It was impossible for such a convenient person to exist. Even if such a person did exist, then why had her mother and father died? Why was her sister, so emaciated and ragged as she was, leading Tanza by the hand like this?'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. Yorna greeted the sisters when they arrived at Chaosflame and embraced them. Although Zoey had not cried when her parents died, when a spectacle was made of her so she could obtain soup, or when Tanza levied curses towards her, she began to sob as she embraced Yorna. Tanza, too, cried at this scene, thinking that she must never lose Yorna or her paradise.''Finally, having reached the paradise that should not have existed, when the woman in the beautiful kimono brought the two ragged, dirty sisters up to the castle and embraced them as they clumsily introduced themselves, Tanza heard her sister raise her voice and cry for the first time. Even on the day their mother and father died, even on the days that a spectacle was made of her for a plate of soup, even on the days when an unreasonable Tanza would curse at her with inconsiderate words, Zoey had never cried. Seeing Zoey shed tears and sob as she clung to the woman’s chest, Tanza also raised her voice and cried, and as she did so, she had a thought from the bottom of her heart. She thought that she would never lose the paradise created by this woman―― no, that she would absolutely never lose this woman, Yorna Mishigure; her childish heart firmly believed so.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. In Chaosflame, the sisters were provided with suitable meals and a bedroom.''――They were provided with meals and a bedroom, and the kimono-clad Zoey was beautiful. She was Tanza’s pride.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. Being the most hardworking of Yorna's servants, Zoey carried out her responsibilities dutifully.''There were many who adored Yorna and earnestly wished to serve her. Among them, Zoey was the most serious and hardworking, and Yorna came to appoint her to a responsible post.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. However, two years after arriving at Chaosflame, while Zoey was guiding demi-human tribes into the city, she passed a fortress of [[Imperial Army|Imperial Soldiers]] who were conducting a military exercise.''Her sister died. Two years after that life had begun. Outside of the Demon City, there had been a group of [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] tribes that sought the protection of Chaosflame. While passing by a fortress of Imperial Soldiers conducting a military campaign, her sister had been in contact with the group as Yorna’s representative, and was in the middle of guiding them to the Demon City.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. They attacked the demi-humans under the guise that they were potential enemies. Zoey was unfortunately be murdered and tortured for sport by the soldiers, who would then disgrace her corpse.''The Imperial Soldiers had attacked the group of demi-humans under the guise that they were potential enemies, and her sister was abruptly killed. Tortured to death for a reason unrelated to the antlers of deerpeople, her corpse was subjected to disgrace.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. Following this incident, Tanza, who had begun to hate the Empire, requested to take on Zoey's old responsibilities, which Yorna accepted.''After the rebellion that clashed directly against the Imperial Capital when Zoey lost her life, Yorna had gotten revenge for Tanza’s older sister, and Tanza had requested to serve in her sister’s place. It was a request akin to the height of impudence, and she was extremely insufficient for the role, but Yorna had accepted it with pleasure.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. She was also comforted by Yorna while feeling rage, sorrow, and anguish stemming from Zoey's murder, while Yorna told her that she also hated the Empire.''"Do you happen to hate this country?"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 1.''"I do, too."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 1. As a direct result of Zoey's death, Yorna attacked the fortress and killed a majority of the soldiers there for revenge, and when a few of them escaped, she carried out a full-scale rebellion against the Empire to retrieve the escaped soldiers. During this rebellion, [[Madelyn Eschart]] arrived at Chaosflame and attempted to hold Tanza hostage, though this ultimately failed with Yorna's use of the [[Yorna Mishigure#Abilities|Soul Marriage Technique]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== At present, it is unclear how strong Tanza is without her being subject to outside techniques. However, with the enhancement she received from Yorna's Soul Marriage, Tanza had the power to defeat large-sized [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]]. Furthermore, when her power was increased with Subaru's [[Natsuki Subaru#Authority|Cor Leonis]], she was the strongest combatant within the Pleiades Battalion,''To be precise, the reason for that was―― because she was the strongest attacker in the Pleiades Battalion.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 105, Section 2. able to defeat common [[Undead|undead]] with her feet and bare fists and create shockwaves that broke through the bastions of [[Lupugana]] reinforced with [[Magic|earth magic]],''Flying like a bullet, Tanza spun in midair, and following that the geta she wore on her feet pierced the ramparts. One moment later, the robust rampart had been shattered, Tanza’s figure running through it. The shockwave created a crack in the fourth bastion of the city walls, fissures spreading across its entirety.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 105, Section 2. as well as the walls of the [[Berstetz Fondalfon|Prime Minister's]] mansion that were reinforced with a [[Divine Protection]]. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Augmented Physical Capabilities''': Tanza typically fights by using the physical might given to her by Yorna's Soul Marriage Technique, and instead of using weapons, she usually uses her hands and feet in combat. When exerting the fullest extent of her strength enhanced by the Soul Marriage Technique and Cor Leonis, she is even capable of catching the masterful sword swings of people as skilled as [[Rowan Segmunt]],''That must have been so. There was no doubt that he had not expected for the attack he had unleashed with all of his strength to be caught by such a small child. With her raised hand, Tanza had caught and intercepted the flash of silver that scorched the atmosphere.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. crush his blade in her hand, completely decimate his undead head,''Putting strength into her hand and crushing the katana grasped within, with an astonished reaction to her front and rear, Tanza aimed at the face of the nuisance before her, and drove the fist that had shattered the katana right into it. Giving a strike that went through his nose, and caved it into the inside of his head, Tanza made a declaration.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 47, Section 3. and later, kick him into the ground with such force that she left a crater in the ground.''Tanza, having stopped the katana with the sole of the geta adorning her raised foot, had leapt upwards using the same raised foot as a starting point, and spun vertically in mid-air―― slamming down the icy geta of the opposite foot onto the head of the immobilized Undead Swordmaster, she drove him into the ground. Then, with the head of the undead felled to the ground as its center, a crater of nearly five meters was caved into the street, and as the powerful blow turned her opponent to dust, Tanza waved the hem of her kimono.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 62, Section 2. ==Trivia== *At her introduction in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 28|Volume 28]], Tanza is said to be a half beast person. *Tanza has her own named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8: Vincent Vollachia|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 37|light novels]]. *According to the author, Tanza would regularly write Subaru letters in the future.July 26, 2026 Talk Show *Tanza is said to be one of the characters from Vollachia who the author would like to bring back in the main story later on. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Chaosflame]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Gladiators]] [[Category:Slaves]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[Category:Pleiades Battalion]]

Unknown (actual) |Hair Color = Transparent Golden Blonde |Eye Color = Blue |Height = 140 cm (4'7") |Weight = |Affiliation = [[Natsuki Subaru]]
[[Rem]] |Previous Affiliation = |Occupation = |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Lye Batenkaitos]] (older brother, as Rui)
[[Roy Alphard]] (older brother, as Rui) |Magic = Likely all 6 types of magic |Authority = [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]] |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 25|Volume 25]]}} '''Spica''' (スピカ) is a companion of [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Rem]]. Her previous identity was '''[[Rui Arneb]]''', a '''[[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop]]''' of the '''[[Witch Cult]]''', representing the '''Satiation''' aspect of '''Gluttony'''. She was introduced at the end of [[Arc 6]], and she played major roles in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]]. Bearing the soul of Rui Arneb, Spica has inexplicable memory loss, developing a shift in attitude from her previous self as a result. Her relation to the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony made a confused Subaru wary of her, despite her attachment to him. However, as the two grew significantly closer, Subaru renamed her Spica, and she now works to clear her name from the sins she committed as the Sin Archbishop she once was.''To be neither a Sin Archbishop, nor Rui Arneb, a new way of life. Having been a Sin Archbishop, having been Rui Arneb, a past that could not be erased. Taking that upon herself, she would need to walk a thorny path, the girl―― “Spica”, he held her hand so tightly and firmly, as if to never let go.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 23, Section 2. ==Appearance== Like Rui, Spica has large blue eyes, light skin, fang-shaped teeth, and extremely long blonde hair that can cover the floor like a golden sea, though she usually has her hair tied back in a long ponytail. She has fang-like teeth which help her smile look to be one more reminiscent of a menacing smirk. She wears an elegant white dress that nearly looks transparent. It comes with a jabot that has two small red lines along the leftmost side. ==Personality== After mysteriously gaining a physical body, Spica became incapable of forming speech and displayed a mind driven by instinct similar to an animal's. She seems to have an amicable attachment towards Subaru and would even go as far as to affectionately lick his face and protect him when others threatened his life, as was the case when she tackled [[Rem]] when the [[Oni]] girl tried to strangle him. Even after Subaru treated her badly, Spica continued to act friendly towards him. As time went on, Spica grew increasingly respondent towards Subaru and other people, appearing to recognize words being said or people's negative feelings towards her despite being unable to vocalize complex speech in return. She became more aware of herself and the situation she was in, she became hypersensitive to changes in her environment, and she also began to act more emotional, such as when she expressed anger at [[Vincent Vollachia|Abel]] upon being told that she could not find Subaru in [[Chaosflame]], or when she began to panic and cry as [[Beatrice]] was about to disappear at [[Lupugana]]. If one did not know of her previous life as Rui, she would likely have been regarded as a normal child.''A child who was simply hypersensitive to changes in her surroundings―― other carefree people, who were unaware of the threat of Gluttony, would have inadvertently regarded them as a normal child.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 94, Section 1. She has only been able to vocalize vowel sounds, which she uses to express herself. However, Subaru notes that she appears to use the phrase “Uau” to refer to him,''“It’s fine to take that as you calling my name, right?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 1, Section 3. while with others, she often uses the vowels of their names to refer to them by. Spica has also shown to be rather dutiful. When she realized that her power works well on the undead during the [[Great Disaster]], she was fully prepared to use her Authority to bring it down. Later, in the beginning of [[Arc 9]], she decided to temporarily remain in [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]] to help take care of the remaining undead scattered across the country. She even makes sure to keep in mind both titles that she bears - that of the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony which denotes her past sins, and the name Spica given to her by Subaru, which denotes a chance for a new start and redemption. In doing so, she makes sure to understand the great burden thrust upon her shoulders so that she can overcome her sins. Similarly, she looks to Subaru as a role model, which leads her into taking dangerous actions in order to settle disputes. ==History== Presently, it is unknown how Spica was truly born, as whatever happened to Rui Arneb following the events of the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]] is unknown. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 1|Undead Busters]]=== Following the Great Disaster, Spica was resolved to end the undead problem that remained in Vollachia, and Abel assigned her bodyguards in [[Cecilus Segmunt]], who Subaru warned could only be trusted in his strength rather than his eccentric behavior and personality, and [[Arakiya]], who she had only encountered once as an enemy. Unfortunately, shortly after meeting both of them for the task, she was forced to witness a large-scale battle between the two, which she personally ended by using Leaper on Arakiya. Afterward, they reported back to Vincent. After a turbulent conversation caused by Cecilus's rambling and Arakiya's aggression, the group finally set off on their mission, with Spica being in charge of keeping Arakiya in check. After setting forth, they encountered several undead, including [[Minor Characters#Harlein|Harlein]], who the three dispatched with ease. After sitting down for food, they soon encountered the undead [[Volcas]], who clashed with and was defeated by Cecilus. However, because he did not want to let Spica eat his name just yet, this led to an argument between him and Arakiya, while Spica attended to Volcas. Afterward, they returned to [[Garkla]] with Volcas, intent on letting Volcas speak with Vincent. Shortly after their arrival, however, [[Yorna Mishigure]] took Volcas away, and the two engaged in combat, everyone else standing to bear witness. Eventually, the battle stopped, and Volcas mentioned that he recognized Yorna as Iris. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Due to her recent "rebirth" as Spica, she currently has enough strength to hold her own against accomplished martial artists such as [[Sphinx]] and easily beat the average person in combat, even if their strength has been enhanced. Since she also has the capacity to pull from the '''Stomach of Souls''', she also has access to a plethora of other abilities, but since she does not have much experience in combat, she has yet to put many of those techniques to use. ===[[Authority]]=== It is presently unclear whether Spica possesses the '''Witch Factor of Gluttony'''. However, she still has access to its Authority, which allows her to replicate what abilities already exist within the '''Stomach of Souls''' (魂の胃袋, ''Tamashī no Ibukuro'') and devour something unknown from her target(s). '''[[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Eclipse]]''' (蝕): Eclipse is considered to be the trump card of Gluttony. For the three siblings, it was divided into two types; '''Solar Eclipse''' (日食, ''Nisshoku'') and '''Lunar Eclipse''', though Spica does not use the former. Furthermore, as a result of her change in personality, Spica developed '''Astral Eclipse''', a new form of Eclipse. *'''Lunar Eclipse''' (月食, ''Gesshoku''): This allows Spica to use the Authority's victims' memories and harvest their skills and knowledge. [[Lye Batenkaitos|Lye]], for example, used Lunar Eclipse to greatly boost his physical strength and perform numerous martial art techniques, including Leaper and an earth throwing technique. It is worth noting that by eating a person's name and using Lunar Eclipse, Spica does not gain her victims' [[Divine Protection]]s or spiritual arts. *'''Astral Eclipse''' (星食, ''Seishoku''): This is a new form of Eclipse that Spica developed. Its exact effects remain unclear; however, she has used it to combat the [[Undead#Corebug-Based Zombies|undead in Vollachia]], eating the connection between the target and the source of their revival, and preventing them from being resurrected.''"My, that is quite the way to speak to your elder sister. But, indeed. After all, my connection to the empty box has been severed… No, it is more like the connection has been eaten."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 28, Section 5. While Spica does not seem to devour the name of her target, it seems that the alignment of the target's face and name are still necessary.''When she had succeeded in using her Star Eating on the Imperial Family member named Lamia Godwin, it seemed Spica did not eat her Name, as no one had forgotten her. Nevertheless, the alignment of face and Name appeared to be the key to that Authority.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 35, Section 1. '''Life Creation''': While she has not put it into practice, Spica can create life with the usage of her Witch Factor of Gluttony, just like how Daphne created the witchbeasts four centuries ago. *'''[[Witchbeast]] Control''': Because Spica possesses the Witch Factor of Gluttony that was previously in [[Daphne]]'s possession, she can direct witchbeasts to fight for her, though she has not displayed the usage of this technique. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Master Martial Prowess''': Through the accumulation of souls that Lye, [[Roy Alphard|Roy]], and Rui originally ate with the Authority, Spica gains any abilities that were once eaten by the sibling trio, such as martial art techniques and weapon skills by using Lunar Eclipse. In turn, this grants her extraordinary combat strength. She displayed such skill by easily overpowering many Chaosflame residents empowered by Yorna Mishigure's Soul Marriage Technique and having the potential to kill them in spite of their durability and regeneration. Her agility has been compared to a cat's while her strength has also been compared to a lion's, and it was claimed to be capable of dealing severe damage to the undead of the Great Disaster.''With an agility that resembled the hunting style of a cat, Spica closed in on the Witch, but rather than the claws of a cat swinging its paws, she had the might of swing from a lion, or a tiger, or perhaps even a bear. It was the kind of blow that, if received directly, would make a mess of even an undead warrior in a single hit; without sparing any quarter, Spica had pummeled that into Sphinx’s slender body――, "I am surprised. It seems that you have specialties that lie outside the realm of meddling with souls."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 9. ===Techniques=== '''Leaper''' (跳躍者, ''Chōyaku-sha''): This technique allows Spica to use a short-range teleportation in quick succession, essentially allowing her to "leap" behind her opponents or avoid extremely precise and quick attacks. She is also capable of utilizing it vertically, making it appear as if she's flying. She can also teleport others with her,''Right before the fatal light was fired, Subaru forgot about his pain and yelled out. Receiving that, one of the bewildered Sphinxes disappeared from there. ――She had been forcibly taken along by Spica’s teleport.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 11. though after the first few times, they tend to feel extreme nausea, their insides feel terrible from the sudden teleport, and they’re left on their knees and vomiting. While this is primarily a support type technique, she can use this on her opponents as well, which she can use to temporarily incapacitate even someone as powerful as Arakiya. Though, not everyone feels these effects, as stated by [[Petra Leyte]], who claimed to have been relatively unaffected compared to someone like [[Garfiel Tinzel]], who felt all of the side effects. Using this ability repeatedly in a short period of time strains her organs and makes them feel as if they are being squeezed.''Midair, the distance that she could leap at a time was about ten meters; using it over and over again in a sequence placed a strain on her organs, like they were being squeezed, but she did not care.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 96, Section 7. This ability originally belonged to [[Dorkell]]. '''Unnamed Earth Throwing Technique''': In Arc 7, Spica utilizes an unnamed earth throwing technique to repel a group of horned [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]]. When peeling off chunks of nearby walls or concrete, it’s mentioned that the earth takes on a softer texture and is peeled away as easily as lifting up a carpet.''Her limbs on the ground like an animal, she pulled the ground from both of her hands as is and pared its surface. An act like that of violently pulling a carpet spread on the floor―― of course, a carpet couldn’t possibly be spread atop a street in the middle of a town. However, it seemed like the ground shifted.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 47, Section 3. When thrown, it regains its usual hardness.''Rui threw the ground’s surface she had pared mere moments ago at the young man. The moment the young man immediately scythed it aside with his arm, the ground frictionlessly returned to its former state.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 47, Section 3. ===[[Magic]]=== Like with her hand-to-hand skills, Spica is also capable of utilizing various magic abilities collected by from the Authority's victims. However, this does not affect her mana pool, meaning that she may not be able to use any spell to its fullest potential depending on their respective mana consumptions. As of yet, she has not shown any magic, but she was able to reawaken the magical abilities of a fellow magic user, Rem, to allow her to use healing magic. ==Trivia== *[[Wikipedia:Spica|Spica]], also designated as Alpha Virginis, is the brightest star in the constellation of Virgo. It is known as the "ear of grain", which comes from the Latin phrase "spīca virginis", meaning "Virgo's ear of grain". In Japan, Spica is known as the "pearl star". *Despite Witch Cultists supposedly having the scent of the Witch according to Rem's unique sense of smell, Rem claimed that the scent coming off of Subaru, which is identical to the Witch Cultists', was not coming from Spica, who was somehow born from a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult. *Though it was before she donned the name Spica, she had a named chapter as "Rui" in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35|light novels]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Individual Parties Navbox}} [[Category:Authority Users]]

He is described as giving the impression of being like a carnivorous bird. ==Personality== ==History== ===[[First Mission Part 1|First Mission]]=== A former mercenary who was favored by Count [[Minor Characters#Easley Oruon|Easley Oruon]], Reiner managed to join the knights thanks to his sword skills. His behavior was said to have not been cut out for the knights, however, resulting in an incident where he supposedly killed one of Easley's servants, causing him to be stripped of his knighthood and avoiding severe punishment thanks to the count's assistance. In truth, the real culprit was [[Minor Characters#Wyatt Edditz|Wyatt Edditz]], and Reiner took the fall for him. He was court-martialed, but beat by [[Marcos Gildark]] before facing justice. Both Reiner and Easley went on to spearhead an organization operating in several activities, including the management of gambling dens, illegal moneylending, and the distribution of the Hexcel drug, the last of which drove in the most profits for the duo. He also expressed familiarity with the dealings and customs of The Balance, a Lugunican criminal organization. In the end, [[Julius Juukulius]], after invading Reiner's organization, battled with him and contributed to capturing him alive. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Knights]] [[Category:Royal Army]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

She made her first appearance in [[Arc 10]]. ==Appearance== Sakura has shoulder-length purple hair, reminiscent of flowers blooming in the rainy season.''A gentle-looking man with bright-green colored hair, and a beautiful woman with short purple hair, reminiscent of flowers blooming in the rainy season. She boasts an appearance similar to that of a scribe or a maid serving someone of high status, with her collared, button-up, business-like uniform, hat, and high heels being crimson like ripened fruit, with black striped leggings, and her red eyes appear sleepy and drowsy.''Clothes coated in deep crimson like a ripened fruit, a hat of similar hue tilted upon her head, the woman boasted an appearance and atmosphere that resembled that of a scribe, or perhaps a maid serving someone of high status. However, the way she unreservedly closed the distance with others, and her sleepy, drowsy red eyes, made it difficult to pin her down.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. Likewise, attached to her waist seems to be a pouch which carries a feather or feather-quill in it. Put simply, her appearance and attitude give her the impression of someone not easily dealt with.''If said bluntly, she gave the impression of being someone not easily dealt with. '' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. ==Personality== Although Sakura can speak in a somewhat friendly manner, she gives off the impression of someone not easily dealt with. Though she seems to have a slightly playful attitude when she speaks, the way she speaks also has a tendency to make enemies of other people, as implied by [[Tiga Rauleon]].''"Then all the more reason not to increase our enemies. First impressions tend to linger, you know. Especially since right now, we are in a position where we aren’t exactly welcome… right?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. In fact, she is not above toying with the person she talks to and giving them biting remarks.''Felt stuck out her tongue at Sakura, who, despite her sweet manner of speaking, laced her attacks with poison.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1. She also has a habit of drawing out some of her words in a slow drawl. ==Abilities== {{Clear}} ==Trivia== *Sakura was originally introduced as a non-canon antagonist in the game [[Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World: The Prophecy of the Throne|The Prophecy of the Throne]] before her introduction in the main story. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Royal Selection Navbox}} [[Category:Filore Camp]] [[Category:Divine Dragon Church]]

[[Lyra]] (creation) |Weapon = Dagger |Game = [[Re:Zero Lost in Memories]] |Japanese Voice = [[Wikipedia:Reina Ueda|Ueda Reina]]}} '''Shion''' (シオン) is a character from the video game [[Re:Zero Lost in Memories]]. However, it was revealed that Shion was not her real name. Her real name is unknown. She is the dream arts user who appears in the Remembrance Village, a world that was created by [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s memory. She is the navigator who helps Subaru recover his lost memories. She was later revealed to be the true antagonist of the game. ==Appearance== Shion has long green hair with a ponytail on her right side. Her attire consists of a short white cloak with a green diamond-shaped pattern in the inside, a white and brown dress similar to what a huntress wears, and white high-end boots. She also adorns an orange rose on her left shoulder, a dagger wrapped around on her hips, and a small gold locket around her neck. ==Personality== The only word that Subaru could only describe her with was mysterious. Shion has a very lighthearted and carefree personality, despite the dangers that are surrounding both her and Subaru. Whenever Subaru asks her a question about herself when she acted as though she somehow knew about him already, she avoided the question and moved on. ==History== When Shion was young, she was born on a remote island with only her mother and father because elves were hated back then. She often made tea and rice for her family. She didn't have any friends to have tea with her, so she mostly drinks tea alone. When she was fifteen, she was taken a test to see if she could summon a phantom. But unfortunately, she couldn't. Sometime later, she was captured by a group of men and trapped her behind iron bars, planning to execute her. She whispered and created [[Lilac]] and manipulated one of the men to free her. As she was about to be executed, she saw her village destroyed and burnt corpses laying on the ground. The man who captured her freed her and she successfully ran from the men, trying to survive. ==Abilities== '''[[Magic]] User''' (魔法使い ''Maho Tsukai''): Shion is very skillful with magic, however, she uses an unusual magic that is not from this world. *'''Musa''' (ムーサ): Shion uses some sort of a non-elemental magic in the game. She uses it to break barriers that were protecting opponents. **'''El Musa''' (エル・ムーサ): A stronger version of Musa. She discharges a giant grey ball from her hands and fires them. '''Phantom User''': Shion has an ability where she can create and manipulate phantoms. It was an ancient ability that was lost long time ago. The ability allows the user to steal the person's memories and manipulate their consciousness. ==Navigation== {{Non-Canon Navbox}}

[[Palladio Manesque]] (ancestor) |Weapon = [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]] |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero EX#Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero|Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero]]}} '''Rosalind Vollachia''' (ロザリンド・ヴォラキア) was the unified emperor of the [[Vollachia Empire|Unified Empire of Vollachia]] in the events of the [[Re:Zero EX#Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero|Re:Sacrificing Life In Another World from Zero]] IF story. ==Appearance== Rosalind bore a strong resemblance to the O'Connell siblings, having round, blue eyes and blond hair. Upon her introduction, she was described as looking very similar to [[Medium O'Connell]]'s young appearance while she was subject to [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]]'s Infantilization technique. ==Personality== Rosalind spoke arrogantly and expressed a corresponding temperament, easily becoming frustrated by disrespect and being willing to deride others. While her words were sharp, her actions and behavior suggest that she was not as harsh as she may seem. Though she recognized that [[Vincent Vollachia]]'s reign as emperor was excellent, she considered his talent beneath hers. In spite of her young age, she had abilities on part with Vincent's and a keen insight. Rosalind expressed a fascination with [[Cecilus Segmunt]], requesting [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] to tell her stories about him, in addition to being interested in other tales from the past, such as the Sparka matches at the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island]]. ==History== In accordance with Vincent Vollachia's promise to an [[Rem|oni girl]] 400 years ago, which swore that the imperial family would aid Natsuki Subaru, Rosalind complied with [[Nikola Suwen|Nikola]] and [[Ia|Lumera]]'s request to cooperate with them. When the time came, the “Grand Mogolade Geyser Black Orb Recovery Plan” was sprung into action. As locating the black orb within the geyser required time and effort from Lumera, and the process of searching for it would cause [[Vague Adgard]] to notice, they decided to set up a diversion to draw the Mad Prince's attention elsewhere. While Lumera would be accompanied by Rosalind, Nikola, and [[Madelyn Eschart]], [[Arakiya]] and [[Minor Characters#Julius's Contracted Spirits|Lumera's sisters]] engaged Vague in combat, which resulted in Lapicha, Soyone, Dorena, Kiara, and Sinica allowing Arakiya to devour them once they each sustained fatal damage, thereby sacrificing their lives while fulfilling their promise with Julius in the process. Their sacrifices allowed Arakiya to repel Vague and gave Lumera the time she needed to recover the black orb. Once Lumera located the orb containing Subaru and [[Beatrice]], Rosalind employed her [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] to destroy it, freeing the two. However, due to the aftereffects of being trapped within the orb for 400 years, Subaru was on the verge of death upon waking up. While Nikola and Lumera were left in shock, unable to assist him, Rosalind noticed that Beatrice could be of help to him. Afterwards, while Subaru was recuperating from Ol Shamak's aftereffects, he received a handful of visits from Rosalind, learning of the imperial family's promise to Rem and affirming his intention to confront the [[Petra Leyte|Witch of Melancholy]] during one of her visits. Over the course of forty years, Subaru recovered from the aftereffects of his sealing and prepared to confront the Witch of Melancholy and the Mad Prince, Vague Adgard. During this period, Rosalind succumbed to illness and died, leaving behind a legacy as an emperor who made many accomplishments and who had been loved by her people. Once the time came for Subaru and Beatrice to set off for the Eternal Agzadd Glacier, Rosalind's daughter, having succeeded her mother, decided to lend two of her daggers, the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]], to Subaru. With the additions of the Diamond Princess, [[Arakiya]], and the Cloud Dragon, [[Madelyn Eschart]], to the group, Subaru called out everyone's names, including Rosalind's, which was answered by her daughter in her stead, and set off for the glacier with his allies. ==Abilities== '''Equipment''': *'''[[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]]''' (陽剣ヴォラキア, ''Youken Vorakia''): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Rosalind was capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. The sword appears out of thin air when the user wishes to use it and it cuts and burns whatever the user desires. Rosalind was capable of using her Enchanted Sword to break Subaru and Beatrice free from the orb created by [[Al|Aldebaran]]'s Ol Shamak. ==Trivia== *Rosalind's birthday was decided at a talk show held on April 5, 2026. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} {{Non-Canon Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Family]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Enchanted Sword Users]] [[Category:Deceased]]
