[[Wikipedia:Kikuko Inoue|Inoue Kikuko]] (adult) |English Voice = [[Wikipedia:Xanthe Huynh|Xanthe Huynh]]}} '''Theresia van Astrea''' (テレシア・ヴァン・アストレア) was [[Wilhelm van Astrea]]'s wife and the previous generation's Sword Saint who fought and single handedly brought an end to the [[Demi-Human War]] roughly 40 years before the start of the main story. Though a minor character overall, she is pivotal to the character arcs of her relatives and later serves as a secondary antagonist in [[Arc 5]]. She also plays major roles in the [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Demon]] [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Trilogy]]. After dying during the [[Great Conquest]] 14 years before the story began, Wilhelm vowed to avenge her by killing the [[White Whale]], which he does in [[Arc 3]]. Unbeknownst to everyone, though, the [[Pandora|Witch of Vainglory]] was involved in her death. Following her death, the [[Witch Cult]] reanimated her as a [[Undead|corpse soldier]] and she was controlled like a puppet during the events of Arc 5. In the end, her grandson, [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]], put her out of her misery, an act that completely shattered his relationship with Wilhelm. ==Appearance== She was fairly short and had long red hair with flowers attached to it, tying it in two ponytails, while a big part of her hair stayed loose. She had blue eyes and a fair complexion. In her free time, she wore a long green and white off-the-shoulder dress with shoulder straps decorated with flowers. Theresia's common outfit had white trimmings and pink patches on the dress in a form of bows, with one of them being on her chest. She also used to wear small red shoes. When operating as a knight of the Royal Guard, she used to wear a short white dress with armor and a white cloak over it, with a pair of dark purple gloves and tights of the same color. In her uniform, she wore high white boots and tied her hair in a high ponytail. ==Personality== Theresia was a very social, open-minded, overly kind person who often found herself very worried about others, to the point that she would push aside her own personal feelings in favor of others'. She loved flowers, and she cared very deeply about life, to the point that despite being the next Sword Saint, she could not bring herself to raise a sword to harm another. She was even fearful of her own ability to harm others. Thanks to one of her [[Divine Protection]]s, these feelings were even greater amplified, and if she ever did hurt someone, she would cry and apologize profusely for having done so, even if it was reflexive. Oftentimes, she would find herself confused as to why she was chosen as the Sword Saint, and those feelings only grew over time. During the era of the Demi-Human War, these feelings were particularly relevant, as despite others wanting her to take up the sword and fight, she could not do so, resulting in the deaths of several family members who fought in her place, much to her terrible sadness, causing her to cry often and lose her smile for years. After she met Wilhelm, her feelings began to change. She began to smile more often, looking forward to meeting him, despite his rude demeanor. Aware though she was that she had fallen in love at first sight, she did not fight these feelings, and as she met with him, she found herself influenced by the way he diligently devoted himself to the sword, often asking why he did so. Eventually, sometime after he claimed his reason to fight was to protect others, she started reflecting on the reason she was given the title of Sword Saint again. It wasn't until she learned that Wilhelm was in danger that she finally found the resolve to raise her sword and do harm unto others: to protect Wilhelm. Despite this, she effectively pushed aside all of her feelings and took part in the war, despite the fact that doing so hurt her terribly. This said, when Wilhelm took her reason to wield the sword away from her, she finally started acting like her true self in front of others again: cheerful, easily flustered, strong willed, annoyed by others' when they acted rudely or foolishly, jealous to and pouty of matters revolving around Wilhelm, who she trusted and loved implicitly. ==History== ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== Theresia was born to her father, [[Veltol Astrea]], and her mother, [[Tishua Astrea]]. Since she was born with a Divine Protection, she refused to use a sword, fearing that she would hurt others. However, at the age of twelve, she obtained the powers of the Sword Saint from her uncle, [[Fribal van Astrea]]. Eventually, House Remendis offered [[Carol Remendis]] to attend her. Though initially she found herself dismayed by Theresia's attitude towards wielding a sword, after an incident where Carol found herself swiftly defeated by Theresia and caused the Sword Saint to cry, the two became much closer. In the following year, the Demi-Human War broke out, and in the year that followed, Theresia was taken to her first battle, where she was expected to draw her sword for the first time. However, she could not bring herself to do it, caring far too much for life to bring harm, and as a result, one of her brothers died, leaving Theresia heartbroken and unable to smile anymore. As the years passed, her other brothers and even her uncle were killed during the war, wounding her heart further, and because she didn't have the heart to raise her sword, Carol would take her place in assisting [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] throughout the war. One day, Carol told her that instead of being stuck inside and having to deal with people trying to convince her to join the army, she should go outside somewhere, leading to Theresia finding an isolated spot in the slums where she could be by herself, and eventually, she planted flowers there. Later on, she one day met another young man who had come to this place to train on his own. Intrigued by the young man and having fallen for him at first sight, she spoke with him, showed him her flowers, and asked if he liked them, to which he replied negatively. Annoyed by this, she scared him off. Despite this, when Carol came to pick her up later that day, she was genuinely smiling, saying that she met a rude boy that day. For the next several weeks, the two continued to meet each other here, and Theresia would ask the same question, only to retrieve the same answer. In the month following the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], during one of her meetings with the young man, they exchanged names for the first time, her lack of fear at hearing his name surprised him, and she asked for the reason he wielded his blade, to which he replied that it was all he had. After this, those two questions would be something she asked every time they met, each with the same answers. He continued to ignore this request and kept one with his duties and training, answering the very same questions from Theresia every time. Sometime after this, he met with Theresia again, where he was once again made to question why he wielded his sword, even though he claimed that he would continue to wield his sword, even if it caused him pain, and she hoped to him that he would find that reason one day. After the [[Invasion of the Royal Castle]] was over, he went to meet Theresia again, where Wilhelm claimed he no longer hated flowers, and his reason for the sword was to protect others. At some point during or after this time, she learned exactly who he was and even congratulated him. Within the following year, she and Wilhelm would meet more often, using their sword and flowers as excuses to see each other. However, one day, after Wilhelm learned that his lands were in trouble, he walked towards the flower garden that night and spoke with Theresia, who had been there all day. After a conversation and walking back with her in the direction of the main road, she inspired him to fight, albeit unintentionally. Later, having been told by Carol that Wilhelm had gone on his own to fight for his lands, Theresia, for the first time, willingly picked up the sword, and with the resolve to protect Wilhelm, she left with the Zergev Squadron to retrieve him. Upon arriving, Theresia began slaughtering the demi-human attackers who destroyed the Trias Domain, despite the immense heartbreaking pain it caused her, and after racking up over 1000 kills, everyone returned to the [[Royal Capital]]. A few weeks later, the two confronted each other in the flower garden, where she swiftly and easily defeated him. Saying that she would not return, she claimed to have found a reason to swing her sword, to protect others, and as she walked away, having borne a sad expression, Wilhelm claimed that he would take that sword away, as he regretted having given her a reason to have to swing her sword. Thanks to this, Wilhelm was not seen fighting with the Royal Army again until after the Demi-Human War was over. Thanks to Theresia joining the war efforts, she was given the auxiliary Astrea Manor for her triumphs in the [[Battle of the Trias Domain]], yet due to her fighting, she often did not find herself returning to the building. Though starting out on bad terms with [[Bordeaux Zergev]], she fought together alongside him, and after two years, she managed to deal great damage to the Demi-Human Alliance, gathering more than ten thousand kills, much to her sadness. With the war over after [[Cragrell Dawson]] met with the [[Gionis Lugunica|king]], Theresia was to be awarded for her contributions. After being given a ceremonial sword from Roswaal, she made her way to the ceremony hall, and soon after, Wilhelm, who had been training himself for two long years, appeared to challenge her. Happy to see him again and that he had gotten so strong, she displayed her immense strength to all of those present, completely erasing any doubts of her skills. However, she ultimately lost to Wilhelm. Claiming to be stronger than her, he said that she no longer had a reason to fight, that he would fight in her place in order to protect her. After sharing a kiss, he was reunited with the Zergev Squadron on one side and dealing with a pouting Theresia on the other, saying that he'd tell her he loved her when the mood hit him. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story: Their Later Tale]]=== Following the ceremony, Wilhelm was taken to the Prison Tower. Meanwhile, speaking with the king about her reward, she decided to use it to free Wilhelm, and after that, they made a deal that Theresia would be allowed to retire from the military if she managed to marry Wilhelm. Shortly afterward, she reunited with Wilhelm outside of the Prison Tower. After dragging him to her mansion and forcing him to take a bath, Wilhelm spoke with Carol and Grimm, the former of which lashed out at him, and he learned of her position as Theresia's attendant. After this, Theresia informed him that he was technically unemployed, leading to him to go and find a way to get his job back. While he was gone, Theresia prepared food for him, Grimm, and Carol for that night, which he saw when he returned to the mansion. In the conversation that followed, he told her about how the only person he talked to during the two years he was gone was Roswaal, who would often find him, and out of jealousy and irritation, she threw him to the ground and locked herself in her room. Upon Carol and Grimm's return to the mansion, Carol chided him and went to speak with Theresia while Wilhelm and Grimm finished all of the food that Theresia prepared. The next day, after an argumentative breakfast with Carol and Grimm, Wilhelm informed Theresia of where he was going and left her breakfast. While he was gone, though still pouting about his interactions with Roswaal, she prepared food for the two of them. When he returned to the mansion, he told her about his returning to the army and for her not to go to the castle the next day. The next day, after Wilhelm left, Theresia found herself fretting over whether or not to go to the castle. As she did, Roswaal appeared, assuaged her jealous doubt, and decided to bring her to the castle. However, after Theresia arrived and saw what was going on, she chided the king for allowing this, and it was revealed that she would have been let go of her position if she married Wilhelm, much to everyone's but the king and Miklotov's shock. Wilhelm accepted this, and they embraced, Theresia calling him Wilhelm van Astrea. ===[[Sword Demon Love Story: The Bride's Father]]=== After the two decided to get married, Wilhelm and Theresia left for the Astrea Domain so that Wilhelm could ask her parents for her hand in marriage. After arriving there, Wilhelm was nervous to meet them, which made Theresia happy. Soon after, Veltol and Tishua arrived in the meeting room, and Veltol immediately put pressure on Wilhelm. The four sat down and spoke, Theresia talking about some things with her mother while Veltol decided to determine if Wilhelm was worthy of Theresia. Despite the man's apparent disapproval, Wilhelm was about to ask for Theresia's hand, but Veltol was quick to explode, resulting in him and Theresia getting into an argument. Tishua apologized for it and noticed his tea was empty, and though she was about to offer to refill it, Veltol did instead. However, Theresia stopped him, as Veltol had drugged his tea. Cornered, Veltol mentioned that it wasn't poison but a drug that made one lose control of their bladder, leading to Theresia snapping at him. After Tishua told him the way to the bathroom, she asked if Wilhelm would be able to adjust to their family, to which he answered by calling them mother and father and saying that it would probably be hard to get along with Veltol. Receiving a positive response from Tishua, he left to use the bathroom. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story: Wedding Day]]=== In the three months that followed, Theresia brought Wilhelm to meet her parents. However, thanks to Veltol, their upcoming wedding faced numerous setbacks and obstacles. Thanks to his interference, three days before their official wedding date, he used his authority to force the Zergev Squadron to patrol a few towns around the capital, knowing full well that it would take three days to accomplish. Suspicious that this was her father's fault, she asked Bordeaux to look into it. Later, despite her frustrations, Wilhelm decided to take on this challenge, and as he prepared to leave, Theresia, who had fixed him food for on the road, saw him off. Afterward, speaking with Bordeaux, he confirmed her suspicions, and she resolved to meet with and scold her father. Two days later, she and Carol went to confront Veltol. When they met, Theresia was quick to chide her father for his actions, and she even threatened to leave [[House Astrea]] because of him. Even Carol and her mother joined in to chide him. However, she believed in Wilhelm, and she knew that he would arrive on time for their wedding, despite her father's meddling. The next day, wearing her wedding dress, she waited patiently for the return for the Zergev Squadron with Carol and her parents. Eventually, Bordeaux arrived and informed her of the squad's return, and soon after, her wedding took place. Despite Wilhelm being unable to clean himself off after the mess he went through, the wedding went off perfectly, and the two were married. In the month that followed, Veltol made numerous appearances, much to Theresia's frustration, and eventually, he even suggested going along on the honeymoon as well, leading to another argument. However, with help from Tishua, they were able to get him to leave. Given two months for their honeymoon, they prepared to leave, taking Carol as Theresia's attendant, and they decided to visit the cities to the south of the capital. ===[[Sword Demon Love Story: Earth Dragon Capital, Flanders]]=== After their marriage, Wilhelm and Theresia went on their honeymoon with Carol accompanying them, and they first visited [[Flanders]], the Earth Dragon Capital, where Theresia was going to ride an earth dragon for the first time. After experiencing one for a moment, Carol interrupted them after Wilhelm got a little intimate with Theresia, to which Theresia scolded Carol. Though Carol was heavily reluctant, partially due to her own misgivings and Veltol's request to not let him take things too far with her, she entrusted Theresia to Wilhelm's care. As they rode atop one earth dragon, Theresia told Wilhelm about how the different species of earth dragons were named after flowers, which Wilhelm was curious about. As they rode, Wilhelm was reminded of his family, and after Theresia grabbed his attention, she described them to her. After a few hours time, Theresia improved her riding to the point that she surpassed Carol, and she and Carol ran around on their respective earth dragons. Wilhelm, watching them from a distance as a rancher watched approached him and said the earth dragon she was riding became attached to her. After he offered it to Wilhelm, he was told its name was [[Minor Characters#Diana|Diana]], which Wilhelm laughed at. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story: Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]]=== After leaving Flanders, because Theresia insisted they not visit her home in Hakuchuri, they made for [[Picoutatte]], where her father was waiting, leading to another argument. However, with his reason for visiting to collect the present for his wife, they accompanied him to the Suwen Company. With Veltol asking Wilhelm and Carol to allow him and Theresia to shop together, they left to observe the town. Inside the shop, however, they were met by a disrespectful [[Stride Vollachia]], who was targeting the Sword Saint. Leading Veltol to challenging him to a duel, he introduced [[Kurgan]], who would serve as his champion, as Theresia had noticed Stride's apparent illness. After further insulting him, her, and Wilhelm, Veltol struck Stride for his remarks, leading Kurgan to ruthlessly beat him down and Stride to curse him. Taken to the hospital, she met with Wilhelm and was informed of Veltol's condition by the healer [[Garitch Fabless]]. Accordingly, the only way to remove the curse was to cut it off at the source. Soon after, [[Yaktol Suwen]], who ran the shop, informed the group of the message given by the Stride that they would be waiting at a great bridge in Picoutatte's west district with the source of the curse. Impatient, Carol ran off with Yaktol in search of the man while Theresia resolved herself to go to the bridge with Wilhelm. The next morning, Carol returned, unable to find Stride. After Yaktol then provided Wilhelm with his new sword that Veltol picked out for him, he and Theresia left for the bride where Stride and Kurgan were waiting. Despite Stride's annoyance with Wilhelm's appearance, Theresia challenged him, and the two chose their champions, Wilhelm and Kurgan, on their behalf. Stride was further annoyed at learning that the rumors of what happened at her ceremony were true and that Wilhelm showed as much dangerous fighting spirit as Kurgan. Soon after, the fight began on the bridge. Although both sides took great damage, Stride decided to step in when he realized that Kurgan was in danger. Not wanting to lose his pawn, he declared the duel his loss, tossed them one of his rings, and then used something to turn the bridge into sand, dropping everyone on it into the river and allowing for him and Kurgan to escape. Destroying the ring and allowing others to help the people out of the water, they left for the hospital where Carol informed them that Veltol was better, and Wilhelm was admitted. At some point after this, she informed her mother, who decided to visit Picoutatte herself, and she and Carol went and bought the accessory that Veltol wanted to buy her as a present. However, after getting into an argument with her father later, she went to go meet her mother alongside Carol. ===[[Sword Demon Love Story: The Other Side of the Honeymoon]]=== Following the [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Theresia and Carol wandered the streets of Picoutatte while Wilhelm and Veltol were recovering from their injuries. As they walked, they came across Garitch and spoke with him. Theresia apologized to him for having destroyed the bridge and creating more work for him, but he waved it off. Still worried about it, Carol tried to pin the blame on the one responsible for the challenge while Garitch said that Veltol could pay for the damages and treatment and nobody would be upset. However, he also asked her if she could get Veltol to reconsider his recommendation of Garitch to the Royal Capital, as he did not want to go to the capital since the mother of his [[Roswaal K. Mathers|son]] was there. Though he believed that it would probably be for the best that he didn't go, Theresia claimed that happiness was up to the individual to choose, which ultimately cemented that Garitch did not want to go, saying it wasn't the right time yet, and the girls left his going to the capital to Veltol. Afterward, they asked about the mother, which he described, leading to Garitch telling her that someone so immoral should not be recommended and telling her that Wilhelm was fastidious, so she didn't have to worry, triggering an emotional response from Carol. After he recommended the sherbet, he left, and the two had a bowl for themselves. ===[[Great Conquest]]=== In the years after Heinkel's birth, Theresia remained outside of the Royal Guard while Wilhelm served as its captain. Eventually, Heinkel joined the ranks of the knights, married [[Louanna Astrea|Louanna Hartley]], and their son, [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]], was born. After five years had passed since Reinhard's birth, the Kingdom of Lugunica's effort to bring down the White Whale, the Great Conquest, was being prepared for. Since Wilhelm was tasked with another mission, Theresia took the place of Heinkel, who refused to join the subjugation, to lead a group of knights to defeat the [[witchbeast]] once and for all. However, during the Great Conquest, she lost her powers as the Sword Saint, encountered [[Pandora]], and passed away. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護, ''Kago''): Theresia possessed two Divine Protections: the '''Divine Protection of the Death God''' (死神の加護, ''Shinigami no Kago'') she was born with and the '''Divine Protection of the Sword Saint''' (剣聖の加護, ''Kensei no Kago''), which she gained when she was twelve. With the former, slashes imbued with the Divine Protection's power left curse wounds that were unable to be healed. It also increased the closer she was to the target and she could even reopen wounds others have if they were close enough and were originally inflicted by her. If the wound expanded, so did the effect of the protection. If the wound was a light cut on the finger and the target cut off said finger, this new wound became the target of the protection. The effects disappeared if she died. [[File:Thearesia fight.gif|thumb|209x209px|Theresia's swordsmanship.]] * '''Sword Saint''' (剣聖, ''Kensei''): The power of the Sword Saint gifted her with inhuman intuition and insight while maximizing her latent swordsmanship talent and knowledge of combat towards a level that only a few could reach. This allowed Theresia to break down any kind of technique or attack directed at her while simultaneously showing gaps in them for the most optimal counter. These manifested as spectral "white lines" that only she could see, which were implied to be guidance from the "[[Minor Characters#Sword God|Sword God]]". However, if someone possessed equal or greater skill relative to hers, the lines would distort, making her opponent's attack paths difficult to read. '''Master Swordsman''': Theresia was highly skilled at using the sword. Contrast to Wilhelm's defter and measured style, her swordplay was more momentum based, employing a lot of acrobatic flourish. It was described as if she was doing a beautiful deadly dance. '''Equipment''': As the Sword Saint, Theresia wielded the '''[[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]]''' (龍剣レイド, ''Ryūken Reido''). The sword could only be drawn against opponents it deemed worthy for it to be used against, and it was later given to her grandson, Reinhard. After her death and being revived as a puppet of the Witch Cult, Theresia used a different sword in combat. ==Trivia== *Theresia's birthday was decided to be June 12 because it is the day of Dia dos Namorados, or Lovers' Day.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1899833834847481961 Re:Zero Episode 64 Commentary] *When she was young, she never bothered with studying magic. However, the author has stated that she most likely had an affinity with Yang Magic. *Theresia's first words when she first met Reinhard were: "You are Reinhard, a child that's been blessed by your family. Please remember that before you learn about the world." *Theresia van Astrea killed roughly ten thousand people during the Demi-Human War.''"Theresia had taken up her sword as the Sword Saint in the Demi-Human War and reaped countless lives. Hadn’t the number of people she’d killed neared ten thousand?"'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 7]], Section 1. *Theresia has her own named chapter in Arc 5 in both the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 5: The Stars that Engrave History|web novel]] and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20|light novels]], as well as a named episode in the [[Episode 64|anime]]. *Theresia is one of the few people that Reinhard has ever drawn the Dragon Sword Reid for. *According to the author, the cause of most of Wilhelm and Theresia's quarrels were because Wilhelm didn't talk enough.''"Wilhelm didn’t talk enough."'' [[Episode 83]] (main story) |Japanese Voice=[[Wikipedia:Daisuke Ono|Daisuke Ono]]}} '''Volcanica''' (ボルカニカ), also known as the '''Divine Dragon''', is a key figure in the sealing of the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] 400 years ago. Mentioned throughout the series, it is the guardian of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] and is worshiped by its inhabitants as it is the very symbol of hope and trust for the entire nation. It plays both a minor antagonistic and supporting role in [[Arc 6]] and an antagonistic role in [[Arc 9]]. It also played a pivotal supporting role in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]. During Arc 6's climax, it acted as the overseer of the third trial of the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] and the final obstacle preventing [[Emilia]] from conquering it. Following the creation of its [[Clind|dragonkin]], Volcanica has become a dragonhusk, leaving it as a shell of its former self. ==Appearance== Volcanica is an enormous [[Dragon]] who is covered in shiny pale blue scales which are said to gleam like jewels and seem sharper than a forged treasured sword. Its thick paws are equipped with black, rock-like claws. Volcanica's face greatly resembles that of an earth dragon with two large milky-white horns sticking out of each side of its head. Finally, Volcanica has a pair of intelligent looking gold eyes which emit a wise and awe-inspiring aura. Its presence is so great that one feels like he isn't even allowed to breathe without the Divine Dragon's permission. Another notable feature is the presence of a mysterious white scar located directly underneath Volcanica's jaw. When touched by someone other than Volcanica, the Divine Dragon will fall in a state of shock and will desperately try to kill whoever touched it. In its crouched position, it is said to be about 16 meters in height, but its actual size is unknown, though it is much larger than [[Valgren]] who was about 10 meters tall. ==Personality== Volcanica was described as a benevolent and wise entity, one which defended Lugunica from many threats in the past and brought peace to the Kingdom. It bore a strong envy towards those with unrealized potential. Having been born among the race of what could be considered the absolute strongest, it highly esteemed the potential held within humans as radiant as they could grow and develop themselves as they reach for their goals, thus validating their existences. In complete contrast to its reputation, by the events of Arc 6, Volcanica has fallen into a dragonhusk state, operating purely on instinct. [[Beatrice]] and [[Eridna]] speculated that Volcanica in its current state exerted about 10% of its former strength even though its condition is nothing physical, but rather a "spiritual death". The Divine Dragon has lived for so long that most things have lost its meaning, though it still feels obliged to uphold the covenants it forged with Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica and [[Flugel]] respectively. Before falling into a dragonhusk state, Volcanica was mentioned to be a cynic by [[Shaula]]. During its fight with Valgren, about four decades before the main story, it was mentioned to feel pity for the state in which the Dragon had ended up in, implying it had a strong sense of pride. After temporarily awakening in Arc 6, Volcanica has shown to be rather fond of those it has formed a good relationship with, such as Satella, Flugel, or [[Farsale Lugunica|Farsale]]. Likewise, it even hesitated to harm Satella as she started to become the well-known Witch of Envy. It also feels tremendous regret for allowing itself to falter in the past and allowing such a tremendous disaster to occur on its watch, and upon remembering the disaster, Volcanica was likely to become violent and agitated. When coming into contact with [[Felt]] on her trip to the Pleiades Watchtower with [[Meili Portroute]] and several other members of her camp, it became docile and willingly abided by her requests because it conflated her with Farsale. During the Arc 9 loop, [[Al|Aldebaran]] used his Book of the Dead on Volcanica, filling its empty dragonhusk with his own consciousness and effectively turning it into a second version of himself. Due to Volcanica's latent soul and vessel differing from that of Aldebaran's, the Dragon "Aldebaran" had a more optimistic outlook and other personality differences compared to its counterpart and retained residual feelings acquired from its time as "Volcanica". The strongest of these feelings were its favor for Farsale and dislike of Reid, and the remainder of it was blurred. With its personality differences, it was able to determine the cause behind [[Heinkel Astrea]]'s unusual durability and piece together the truth behind Clind's abilities, whereas the original Al did not reach either conclusion immediately. It was strongly attached to Felt and also conflated her with Farsale, maintaining the same attachment Volcanica's dragonhusk exhibited towards her. As such, its loyalty towards Al and Felt was split half and half. In the end, Aldebaran's overwriting of Volcanica's dragonhusk was undone alongside the rest of Arc 9's events, returning the Divine Dragon to its normal self before it was ever hijacked. Volcanica speaks in a deific manner favoring the archaic pronouns '''thou''' (汝, ''nanji'') and '''mineself''' (我, ''ware'') and its voice conveys its omnipotence. Its gender is also unknown, as it uses a neutral pronoun (我, ''waga''). When Al's consciousness overwrote it, Volcanica spoke exactly like he did. ==History== ===[[Great Calamity]] Era=== Volcanica is a Divine Dragon who several centuries ago made a covenant with Farsale Lugunica to help safeguard and guide the country in times of turmoil. For this reason, it is worshiped as a national deity and became the symbol of Lugunica's [[Royal Family]]. Over 400 years ago, [[Sekhmet]] drove Volcanica past the Great Waterfall just so she could rest. The two eventually had a major fight, and at its conclusion, Sekhmet fell to her death from the Great Waterfall. At an unknown point in time, it also fought against [[Reid Astrea]], who wanted to eat its flesh, and their bout, Reid left Volcanica with a wound on its neck, which later became its inverted scale. According to [[Echidna]], at the time of their travels, her party needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of [[Magrizza]]. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. The nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and Volcanica went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the [[Black Serpent]] destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent. Later, Volcanica sealed Echidna off in her tomb within the [[Sanctuary]] as a deterrent to Satella. Volcanica was said to have met with Reid and the Sage in [[Flanders]].''“According to legend, Flanders is also where the Divine Dragon Volcanica was bound in friendship to the first Sword Saint, Reid, and the Sage, Shaula.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5. Around the same time, the Divine Dragon supposedly used an unknown type of blessing ability to create earth dragons.''“Yeah, I think I’ve heard that the first earth dragons were born as some kind of blessing from the Divine Dragon about the same time.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5. When the [[Great Calamity]] began, the three heroes set their goals on defeating the rampaging Witch of Envy, who mercilessly killed thousands and thousands of innocents and toppled one country after another. After realizing they were unable to kill her, Volcanica and the others managed to defeat her and seal her away in the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] at the very east of Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. At some point in the era 400 years ago, Volcanica's dragonkin, Clind, whose time of creation is unknown, began to serve [[Roswaal L. Mathers]]. Volcanica has also seems to have history with [[Patrasche]] as well, even knowing her name despite her being named in the present day. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]=== Roughly 40 years before the Royal Selection, and about a year after the end of the [[Demi-Human War]], [[Stride Vollachia]], with the skull of a three-horned dragonkin, summoned Valgren, who proceeded to ravage through [[Picoutatte]]. When [[Gionis Lugunica]] arrived at the city, Volcanica arrived not long afterwards, possessed by Clind. Recognizing that Valgren was a mere dragonhusk, Volcanica scorched the Black Dragon to nothing with its purifying breath, healed all of the citizens and combatants who had been injured, and put out the fires that were spreading through the city, confirming the validity of the four centuries long covenant that had been into question before. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As the Divine Dragon and the safeguard of the Kingdom of Lugunica, Volcanica has considerable power. It was able to defeat Sekhmet, the second strongest Witch after Satella, and is stated to even be able to put up a competitive fight against [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] while the latter uses the Dragon Sword. While being 90% in a hibernating state and operating purely on instincts, Volcanica was easily able to overwhelm Emilia and her Ice Soldiers, scorch away Satella's Shadows within seconds, and contend with the full power of both Roswaal and Clind at the same time, emerging completely unscathed in a practically one-sided battle. Even against other Dragons, such as Valgren, Volcanica’s strength is on another level. According to [[Garfiel Tinzel]], its strength and presence are significantly greater than that of the Cloud Dragon [[Mezoreia]]. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Overwhelming Physical Might''': Although it is unclear if Volcanica uses the Flow Method or even needs it, all of its physical capabilities are immeasurably powerful. The slightest of attacks can easily crush a man and most likely kill them. '''Talons and Fangs''': Volcanica's talons are said to be much harder and much sharper than the majority of swords in existence. Likewise, its fangs are said to be even sharper than that, and combined with its jaw strength, anything bitten by the Divine Dragon is unlikely to survive. There also seems to be power embedded in its fangs, even when removed from its body. When Aldebaran used one of them, he was able to easily destroy certain devices in Lugunica's Prison Tower with seemingly minimal effort. However, what exactly this power is or what it does precisely is unknown. '''Wings''': On Volcanica's back is a massive pair of wings that it uses both for its flight and in offense. By unfurling and flapping its wings, Volcanica can unleash a powerful gust of blade-like winds that can carve through a large area at once. '''Tail''': Volcanica can also use its long and powerful tail to attack. A single swing is enough to cause great damage to the environment around it, and most people would not survive being struck by it. '''Dragon Scales''': Volcanica's scales are immeasurably hard, surpassing even the toughness of diamonds.''The mightier and longer-lived the Dragon, the more robust and tenacious they grew; henceforth, in regards to the Divine Dragon who reigned supreme over all others, its draconic scales were of a hardness that surpassed even diamond.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 3, Section 4. As a Dragon, these scales provide Volcanica an incredible physical defense, and the only known weapon said to be able to ignore this defense is the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]], according to Clind. Even the might of the [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Sword Demon]], one of the most renowned swordsmen in the world, cannot easily pierce its scales. '''Dragon Halo''': The halo atop Volcanica's head provides it with immeasurable magical defense. Spells of the Al level are incapable of bypassing its defense, and even with [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] using his multiplefold magic with multiple Al level spells combined together, up to five simultaneous spells, he could not injure Volcanica at all, and it always came unscathed. Like with its scales, the only known weapon that can ignore this halo is the Dragon Sword. ===[[Magic]]=== '''Divine Mana''': Volcanica has an enormous amount of mana in its body, and it is even able to "cleanse" the world with it. By exerting its mana, it is able to extinguish great flames or heal the injured all at once over an area at least as wide as the city of Picoutatte. Likewise, though it is not seen doing so of its own will, it is capable of casting incredibly powerful magic that would otherwise be inaccessible to most, and the sheer power of the magic that it can cast is much greater when compared to a human's. '''Dragon Breath''': The Divine Dragon's breath, which when let loose, rushes straight towards its target and envelops it in a white and bluish light. When the light envelops its opponents, they are instantly turned into dust, as if they had been purified. It is so powerful and hot that it instantly destroyed Emilia's Ice Soldiers, which were said to be tougher than steel, and, according to Emilia, it even killed sound itself. Using this, even the Blight Dragon Valgren was completely erased from existence. It can also change the type of breath it has depending on the circumstances; it has shown to be able to generate a large watery mist from its breath which can then be used to freeze its wet targets.''The Dragon’s mighty maw gaped wide open, and it unleashed a breath that shone with a light of destruction, reducing all to naught―― such was not the case; instead, unleashed was a mist of fresh water manifested from the Dragon’s vast mana.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 2, Section 6. Likewise, it can generate both fire and water together in this manner to create a devastating shockwave with immense destructive force. '''Flight''': As a Dragon, Volcanica is capable of flight. According to Emilia's observations, however, it actually uses the ability through magical energy rather than its wings which help it to fly. By channeling magical power throughout its body, Volcanica can make itself float in a similar way as [[Puck]] and Roswaal do. It uses its pairs of wings to help it glide and control the direction of its flight in a manner similar to a rudder. ===Other=== '''Elemental Manipulation''': Although the extent of the manipulation is unknown, Volcanica seems to be able to manipulate multiple various elements. It is unknown whether this is merely a trait of its as a Dragon or if this is magic. By manipulating the wind, Volcanica can keep any person who rides its back from being affected by the wind as it moves, and it can fasten them in place so that they do not fall off due to its immense speed. It also makes it to where being at higher altitudes than the body is meant to handle becomes moot for the people on its back. It has also shown to be able to generate massive fists made of earth and control them with ease. '''Spatial Rupturing''': Volcanica is able to twist space and cause it to rupture, destroying anything or anyone caught in it, completely ignoring defenses.''"That instant, the air before Emilia’s eyes burst open. Not an exaggeration, quite literally, the space constricted, then subsequently swole and burst open. The phenomenon of unknown principle was queer as though space itself had rolled over, and had she been in its location she would’ve gotten twisted regardless of the strength of her defense."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 87. Volcanica can seemingly do this at will, with immense accuracy, and without warning. '''Life Creation''': Through unknown methods, Volcanica was apparently responsible for the creation of earth dragons. However, at one point, it was mentioned that they were made via a blessing. ==Trivia== *Despite common knowledge, Farsale was not the one who directly made a covenant with Volcanica. He used a young maiden as a mediator between the Divine Dragon and the Lion King. The maiden was known as the Dragon Maiden. *Volcanica's power has been compared with [[w:c:godzilla:King Ghidorah (disambiguation)|King Ghidorah]] from the Godzilla franchise. *Volcanica is depicted on the holy gold coins exchanged within the Kingdom of Lugunica. *According to Reinhard van Astrea, Volcanica's strength was significantly weaker after Aldebaran took control of it compared to when he fended off its attacks previously. *The [[Divine Dragon Church]] was made in response to the faith and worship of Volcanica. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Witch Era Party]] [[Category:Guardians]] [[Category:Arc 6 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 9 Antagonists]]

title: Witchbeast
wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}}
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 14 1.png|thumb|right|300px]]
'''Witchbeasts''' (魔獣, ''Majū'') are any number of organisms that are able to sustain themselves off of [[mana]] and have origins of creation by the [[Daphne|Witch of Gluttony]]. Under most conditions, they are larger and stronger than regular fauna and typically possess often hazardous magical abilities.

==Information==
===Creation===
In folklore, witchbeasts are creatures rumored to have been created by the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] with the purpose of wiping out humanity. In actuality, witchbeasts were artificial beings created by the Witch of Gluttony in a benevolent attempt to eliminate starvation from the world. "Born" from her "thoughts", they were made to consume mana as to not require nutrients, habitats, ecological niches, or anything else that could strain the world's preexisting resources. The reasoning for their unusual physical sizes, at the fundamentals, is the thinking of "bigger = more meat = less hungry people."

In theory, artificially created animals with no needs for sustenance and larger biological masses for higher yields of meat would've been a truly groundbreaking for the world had a little more foresight been put into their creation. Because of these two traits, witchbeasts unfortunately ended up becoming a plague of their own on the world, only exacerbating the threat they were created to end, not to mention their taste is vomit inducing, meaning they could not be consumed even if one is about to starve to death.

===Traits===
Witchbeasts are known to follow [[miasma]], and they are also known to be the only creatures known to thrive in environments filled with miasma, such as the [[Augria Sand Dunes]]. As they were thought to be attracted to the miasma of Witches, witchbeasts were long thought to have a connection with the [[Witch Cult]]. Despite this claim, however, and the fact that they follow beings who exude miasma, [[Eridna]] claims that witchbeasts actually try to avoid miasma because they loathe it.<ref>''"I apologize for bringin’ this rumor forward too, but it seems like there’s many misconceptions about the miasma too. For example, the relation between the witchbeasts and the miasma is the exact opposite than what is known, in that the witchbeasts loathe it."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 17, Section 1.</ref> The [[White Whale]] who is under the control of the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]] is the sole exception as the Witch Cult's activities often intertwine with its appearance in order to keep interferences away.

A common trait shared most, if not all, witchbeasts, is the existence of the horn. The horns are such prominent aspects of the monsters that they affect the beasts' behavior. In the event that a witchbeast does not have a horn or it is broken off, they will be rapidly lynched by other witchbeasts.<ref>''"Witchbeasts with broken horns are rapidly lynched by witchbeasts with horns. “Hey, isn’t that one different from us? Should we get him?”, then they get surrounded and beat."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref> Furthermore, if a hornless witchbeast gives birth, the resulting offspring would kill the parent.<ref>''If hornless witchbeasts had children, they’d be lynched by their own horned children.'' AskFM Q&A.</ref> Not only does the horn have a prominent effect among witchbeast "culture", for lack of a better word, they also have an effect on beings other than themselves. Among [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], those with horns have been ridiculed and attacked for having horns, being unfairly compared to the witchbeasts.

Witchbeasts that have their horns broken follow whoever broke it. There are numerous witchbeasts on the [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]] that are tamed in this way to work like prison guards. Likewise, someone who bears the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]], such as [[Meili Portroute]], can use it to act as a surrogate horn for said witchbeasts and control them, and it is potent enough to work on witchbeasts as strong as a Guiltylowe. That said, while it would have at least some small effect on them, the [[Divine Protection]] would be unable to control witchbeasts like [[Shaula]] and the Three Great Witchbeasts, and attempting to control them or affect them will have appropriate backlash.

In addition, some witchbeasts have also been shown to possess a state known as an '''Attack Hue''' (攻撃色, ''Kōgeki-iro''), which amplifies their ferocity and bloodlust, rendering them several times more aggressive and dangerous. A prime example of this would be the Crimson Scorpion; when it "activates" its Attack Hue, the scorpion changes color to a bloody red hue, becomes several times more aggressive and explodes in a white luster, blowing everything in its vicinity away. Another example would be the Hungry Horse Kings; when entering their Attack Hue state, they start to produce red flames on their backs and as mentioned with the Crimson Scorpion, they enter a more aggressive state. 

===Habitats===
Witchbeasts are supposedly uncommon in most countries, and because of how dangerous they come across as, countries such as the [[Vollachia Empire]] are willing to take extreme measures to avoid or deal with them, with the [[Imperial Army]] willing to burn down the entire Buddheim Jungle in response to learning about Elginas in one failed loop. Conversely, many witchbeasts can be located in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], causing certain people to think of the Kingdom as a nation of witchbeasts.

Among the currently known habitats that witchbeasts reside in, one is the previously mentioned Buddheim Jungle, which is home to, at minimum, Elginas, and the People of Shudrak, who live in that jungle, are capable of hunting them and living in the forest without fear of them. Also previously mentioned, a great quantity of witchbeasts live in the Augria Sand Dunes, and many of them are bigger, far more powerful, and much more vicious compared to the rest of their brethren. There are also several types of witchbeasts that have made their home in the frozen [[Elior Forest]]. Uniquely, the forest around [[Arlam Village]] is also filled with numerous types of witchbeasts, such as Wolgarms, Misfortune Birds, One-Horned Rats, and Dual-Headed Serpents, which all compete for territory.<ref name="multi-beasts">''“With the Wolgarms gone from the forest, the Misfortune Birds, Knickerbockers, the One-Horned Mice, Dimril, and the Two-Headed Serpents, Abonsconda, are competing for territory. There are non-witchbeast animals as well.”'' [https://ask.fm/nezumiironyanko/answers/114129782197 June 8, 2014 AskFM Q&A]</ref> Despite being located somewhere so dangerous, the villagers typically do not worry about the witchbeasts, as the village is regularly surrounded by a barrier. Of course, this also makes Arlam Village look strange to outsiders.

Just like how many witchbeasts dwell on the land, there are also numerous types of aquatic witchbeasts which are known to reside in certain bodies of water.<ref>''"There’s no ocean, so you can’t strictly call them ocean-dwelling, but there are water-dwelling witchbeasts and creatures."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref> This being said, not every water source has witchbeasts swimming through them, with one primary example being the massive lake that [[Priestella]] was built over. As of yet, the only known bodies of water as of yet known to carry witchbeasts within them are Lake Violane, which surrounds the island of Ginunhive, and the Godlait Waterfall, which is also in Vollachia.

==Three Great Witchbeasts==
Not all witchbeasts were of the same type, as there were at least three that were completely one of a kind, colloquially known as the '''Three Great Witchbeasts''' (三大魔獣, ''Sandai Majū''). Each of the three known unique witchbeasts were created by Daphne for a specific purpose of ending world hunger. Although not an ironclad rule, the unique witchbeasts tended to be more imposing than their non-unique counterparts. The Three Great Witchbeasts were the '''White Whale''', the '''Black Serpent''', and the '''Great Rabbit'''. Each one is a title given to three witchbeasts that caused the most damage to humanity and were feared around the world for their unstoppable rampages that rarely left any witnesses. Additionally, these beasts were known to possess an eternal lifespan, although this may have just been a trait shared by all witchbeasts. They are recognized to be a type of disaster and are given special caution when they appear.

===White Whale===
{{Main|White Whale}}
[[File:Hakugei Anime.png|thumb|300px]]
The '''White Whale''' (白鯨, ''Hakugei''), infamously called the '''Witchbeast of the Mist''' (霧の魔獣, ''Kiri no Majū''), was one of the Three Great Witchbeasts. The White Whale was a ginormous whale-like beast capable of flight, and it was created by Daphne to feed the starving with the sheer quantity of meat it could provide. The Witch Cult often used the witchbeast as a way to cover the evil deeds committed by them. Lye Batenkaitos was so fond of the White Whale that he considered it a pet. Whenever the White Whale wasn't being used by the Witch Cult, it would rest in the Great Waterfall located at the edge of the world. The White Whale ultimately met its demise by the hands of [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] during the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] 400 years after its creation.

===Great Rabbit===
{{Main|Great Rabbit}}
[[File:Great Rabbit ep.33.png|thumb|300px|A single Great Rabbit.]]
The '''Great Rabbit''' (大兎, ''Ōusagi'') is one of the Three Great Witchbeasts. The Witch of Gluttony created the Great Rabbit to act as a food source for starving people, believing the large number of rabbits garnered from the replication ability of the Great Rabbit was capable of would provide a bountiful meal for anyone talented enough to defeat the Great Rabbit. Because it was imprinted with its creator's endless hunger, the Great Rabbit's primary concern at all times was satisfying the insatiable hunger it felt. It considered anything or anyone as suitable food and would devour the flesh, bones, and blood of its targets, leaving nothing behind. Despite being made up of numerous singular rabbits, the Great Rabbit functioned as a singular consciousness. Because of this, the entire collection of Rabbits would always stick closely together, and it was so difficult to get rid of all of the rabbits that it became almost impossible to kill entirely. During the [[Sanctuary Incident]], 400 years after its creation, it was drawn to the [[Sanctuary|Sanctuary of Kremaldy]], where the combined efforts of [[Emilia]], [[Natsuki Subaru]], and [[Beatrice]] resulted in the entirety of the Great Rabbit was sealed away in a separate dimension via Al Shamak, where it endlessly continues to devour itself.

===Black Serpent===
{{Main|Black Serpent}}
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 42 9.png|thumb|200px|The Black Serpent.]]
The '''Black Serpent''' (黒蛇, ''Kurohebi''), alternatively known as the '''Vilest of Witchbeasts''' (最悪の魔獣, ''Saiaku no Majū''),<ref>''Worthy of being crowned the Vilest of Witchbeasts beyond any shadow of a doubt, that was a being whose very existence tolled the warning bells of life.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> is one of the Three Great Witchbeasts and is currently the only one of the three that is still roaming the [[World|world of Re:Zero]]. It is considered the worst of the Three Great Witchbeasts, as, unlike the other two, it was almost completely uncontrollable, its actions were usually unpredictable, and its kill count was astronomically higher than either of the other two Great Witchbeasts. As such, even among the Three Great Witchbeasts, the Black Serpent is a being that could be referred to as the singular Great Witchbeast.<ref>''As stated previously, the Three Great Witchbeasts were beings that wrought frighteningly more harm than any other Witchbeasts. ――If that condition were to have been strictly obeyed, then the Black Serpent, rather than having been listed among the Three Great Witchbeasts, would have instead been worthy of reigning as the sole Great Witchbeast.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> Unlike the other two Great Witchbeasts, the Black Serpent was created solely to kill rather than to eventually become a food source. It was created under the logic that if there were less humans, starvation rates would drop, and as such, it was given abilities that would result in anyone who touched it being inflicted numerous diseases and any land it traverses becoming corrupted and uninhabitable.<ref>''Arboreal watchers of wood and bark withered, flora festered in rot, and waters seethed with blight. Nary a hue of life was left behind by the Black Serpent’s foul tongue following its tarnish; instead, it engulfed aught in its path, extinguishing all embers of life without discrimination.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 8.</ref> At present, its current location is unknown.

==Unique Witchbeasts==
Besides the Three Great Witchbeasts, there are two other unique witchbeasts known as the '''Crimson Scorpion''' and the '''Centipede Coffin'''. The Coffin was only partially alive and acted as the obedient method of transportation for its creator Daphne who fueled the witchbeast with secretions from her own body. The Crimson Scorpion had the power to take the form of a human and exhibit an actual intellect whilst doing so. The Crimson Scorpion was even capable of complex feelings like love and was able to maintain its human form indefinitely, only transforming back when it was forced to.

===Crimson Scorpion===
{{Main|Shaula}}
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 23 3.png|thumb|230x230px|Shaula as the Crimson Scorpion]]
The '''Crimson Scorpion''' (紅蠍, ''Benisasori'') is a unique, powerful witchbeast created by Daphne. Unlike the other four unique witchbeasts, the reason why Daphne created the Crimson Scorpion is currently unknown. However, it is stated that the [[Flugel|Sage]] created the Crimson Scorpion alongside Daphne. The Crimson Scorpion was a scorpion-like witchbeast with a black carapace and orange underbelly. It had the power to regenerate, project beams of light from its tail, and self-destruct certain parts of its body. It was far larger than any ordinary scorpion, having a large profile around the size of an elephant but shorter. Although not as formidable as the Three Great Witchbeasts, it was more powerful than any known ordinary species of witchbeasts. It was also uncontrollable to the likes of Meili Portroute despite her power to control most witchbeasts. Through unknown methods, the Crimson Scorpion was able to take the form of a human woman who called herself Shaula. Notably, the Crimson Scorpion was capable of complex thoughts and emotions while in human form and felt none of its natural impulses to devour living creatures, and the time that she could remain in this human form was seemingly without limit. Though, upon returning to her original form, all semblance of her intelligence was gone.

As Shaula, the Crimson Scorpion became the apprentice of the wise Sage Flugel. She was tasked with overseeing the Witch of Envy's imprisonment in the following years. For four hundred years, Shaula dutifully guarded the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] that overlooked Satella's prison while awaiting her beloved master's return. Eventually, members of the Emilia and Anastasia Camps made their way to the Watchtower, and she instantly mistook Subaru for her master. After one of the rules of the tower was broken during the soon-ensuing [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|attack]], Shaula was forced to turn back into her scorpion form, at which point her consciousness was lost. Following her defeat at the hands of Subaru and his group, her massive scorpion body was reduced to little more than a small and instinctive scorpion, and she instinctively latches herself onto Meili, as she is heavily attracted to her by her Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation. While in this form, she is still capable of lethal attacks with her stinger.

===Centipede Coffin===
{{Main|Daphne#Appearance|Centipede Coffin}}
[[File:Centipede Coffin.gif|thumb|250px|Daphne and Centipede Coffin debut]]
The '''Centipede Coffin''' (百足棺, ''Mukade Kan'') was easily the most unique one-of-a-kind witchbeast, as it was the only known witchbeasts that was completely incapable of thinking. The only actions the Coffin could complete were those that were mentally commanded by Daphne herself, and it had no desires to consume or anything of the sort. Unlike the other four unique witchbeasts, the Centipede Coffin was not suited to combat and hunting as its sole purpose for existence was to act as a method of transportation for the Witch of Gluttony. The reason that Daphne employed the Coffin was because of her insatiable hunger. She believed that movement expended too much energy that made her hungrier, so she used the Coffin to move around. As it had no real cognizance, the Coffin was immune to the Authority of Pride used by the Witch of Pride [[Typhon]].

Physically, the Coffin resembled a black iron maiden with purple and pink decorations. The Coffin could open and close its doors to reveal the Witch inside, who rested within the padded pink interior bound by black chains. Perhaps the most peculiar and unnerving feature of the Coffin was the set of crab-like legs that would sprout from the Coffin's base on the command of its operator. The Coffin, thanks to its legs, could move surprisingly fast. Daphne used the Coffin during her life, however the fate of the witchbeast after her demise is unclear. A copy of the witchbeast existed in the dream world of the Witch of Greed [[Echidna]] where it was operated by the soul of its owner. Its primary source of sustenance were the bodily fluids that Daphne secreted including sweat, spit, and urine.

==[[Augria Sand Dunes]]==
Due to its close proximity to the Witch's Shrine, the Augria Sand Dunes has a high concentration of miasma, making it an ideal place for witchbeasts to live. Witchbeasts that live here are larger than normal, tend to become violent, and some only live in the area. It is due to this fact that the Augria Sand Dunes are considered one of the most dangerous places in the world.

===Unicorn===
'''Unicorns''' (一角獣, ''Ikkakujū'') are rumored to be an endemic species that live in the Augria Sand Dunes. They have only been mentioned by a bartender in Mirula.

===Hungry Horse King===
[[File:Hungry Horse King.png|thumb|200px|Hungry Horse King]]
'''Hungry Horse Kings''' (餓馬王, ''Gabaō''), dubbed '''Centaurs''' (ケンタウロス, ''Kentaurosu'') by Natsuki Subaru, are an endemic species located underground in the Augria Sand Dunes and are one of the strongest species that live there. They are six to seven meters in length. They are described to be similar to a deformed centaur: they have the body of a horse with a humanlike torso instead of a head, the human torso in turn has a curved horn growing where the head should be and a mouth stretching vertically from chest to belly, with no eyes, and a cry similar to a human baby's. In exchange for not having sight, their hearing is above average, using echolocation to see their surroundings. The fur on their back is constantly burning and keeps on burning even if it is pulled out, allowing them to launch fireballs at their prey or create weapons for close combat.

Unlike other witchbeasts, Hungry Horse Kings are able to regenerate a broken horn, making them unable to be tamed, and can also regenerate any lost body parts in addition to adding limbs or hardening their body, effectively enabling them to make themselves stronger after they meet their opponents. Despite their strength, one of them was easily defeated by Shaula when its internal organs were completely obliterated. Its regeneration is also limited in that cauterized wounds cannot be healed, which becomes a problem if it accidentally burns itself with its own fire attacks.

Though they usually reside within the sands, another one appeared under Meili's control during the events of Arc 9.

[[File:Courtesan Bears.png|thumb|180px|Courtesan Bears]]
'''Courtesan Bears''' (花魁熊, ''Oiranguma'') are bear-shaped witchbeasts. They have flowers all over their bodies and live in flower gardens that exist in certain areas of the Augria Sand Dunes. Courtesan Bears are two to three meters in length and have short legs in exchange for long arms, black fur, and hook-like claws. The flowers on their bodies are actually parasites that suck moisture and nutrients from their hosts, and any places that don't have any flowers have withered. Their faces are mummy-like.

Though there are native ones as well, the endemic ones are mentioned to be up to several thousand times larger. They have no backbone, no eyes, no arms or legs, and has a body that is made to live under the surface. Their mouths are capable of swallowing four to five people whole at once and have teeth that help distribute saliva that melts their victims.

Meili kept one on hand during the events of Arc 6, though it was ultimately killed by Shaula. Later on in [[Arc 10]], she had several of them travel beneath the ground as insurance, though it is likely that they were slain by [[Reinhard van Astrea]] after Meili used them to distract him.

===Feathered Mole===
'''Feathered Moles''' (羽土竜, ''Hanemogura'') are an endemic species located in the Augria Sand Dunes. They are covered in something which resembles bird wings, and the greater part of their head has transformed into a horn. Feathered Moles can fly with their wings, but when their horn breaks, they die.

==Trivia==
*Like the three Sin Archbishops of Gluttony, the Three Great Witchbeasts are each likely inspired by or represent the respective constellations that the Sin Archbishops are named after, with Lye Batenkaitos and the White Whale coming from the constellation Caelus, Roy Alphard and the Black Serpent coming from Hydra, and [[Rui Arneb]] and the Great Rabbit coming from Lepus. Likewise, Shaula's name and shape are inspired by the constellation Scorpius.
**The White Whale may also have been loosely based off of Moby Dick, the white whale from the book of the same name by Herman Melville.
**The Great Rabbit may also have been inspired by the Al-Mi'raj from medieval Arabic literature.
**The Black Serpent having multiple heads is also likely inspired by the Nemean Hydra, a beast in Greek mythology that is said to have multiple heads.
*The author stated that when the White Whale wasn't rampaging throughout the land, it was situated near the Great Waterfall.
*In [[Elsa and Meili, Assassin Sisters' Dark Diary]], Meili uses the body part of a witchbeast to change their hair colors for a time and claims this could only be used while a witchbeast was alive. It is unknown what kind of witchbeast she used, however.
*Both the author and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7|Volume 7]] denote that the White Whale has two types of mist, and both consistently use "annihilation". However, the mist types of "mental contamination" and "diffusion" were different between sources. Despite this, each of the mists' effects are present among the White Whale's abilities.
*There is a theory that animals that take in magical miasma stones become witchbeasts.<ref>''“Only the criminals themselves know who the real targets are. Still, if the miasma slips by for too long, people will go mad. Animals are no exceptions either. Plus, there is a theory which says that they become witchbeasts by taking in magical miasma stones. Surprisingly, they might actually be going for animals.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 3.</ref> However, this has never been proven.
*According to the author, there are no orcs.<ref>''"There aren’t any orcs, so..."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref>
*According to the author, in terms of their power relationship, Black Serpent > White Whale > Great Rabbit.<ref>''"If that happened, it’s probably the Great Rabbit that would be wiped out. In terms of their power relationship, it’s Black Serpent > White Whale > Great Rabbit, after all. It’s not so much that they don’t interact, as that the Black Serpent isn’t very active. I think you’ll understand when the Black Serpent makes an appearance."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref>
**This being said, the author claimed that if the three were to fight, it is unclear which ones would live or die, as the White Whale has the most combat strength, the Great Rabbit is the hardest to kill, and the Black Serpent is the most troubling. Furthermore, the author stated that a lot would depend on timing.<ref>''"When it’s these three, it’s difficult to say; honestly, a lot depends on timing when saying which one lives and which one dies. Comparing just their fighting strength is pointless. The White Whale has the most fighting strength, the Great Rabbit is hardest to kill, and the Black Snake is the most troubling."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref>

He ws described as being "blessed with an excellent physique". ==Personality== Tholter was a social, easy-to-befriend kind of person, judging by storytelling ability, young age, and his constant trips to the tavern. As his background is very common, he is relatable to most of the people around him. Even in his last moments, he was always enthusiastic and encouraging. Grimm described him as "certainly brave", with the qualities to be a hero. ==History== Tholter was born as the second son of a shopkeeper. He joined the Lugunican army seeking freedom and a better future, becoming good friends with Grimm due to their similar backgrounds and shared aspirations. His and Grimm's first battle was the [[Battle of Redonas Plateau]]. Tholter handled the events during and after better emotionally than Grimm did. However, he didn't begrudge Grimm and became a source of moral support for him. Tragically, Tholter would become one of many causalities of the Royal Army at the [[Battle of Castour Field]] where the main army would fall to [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] forces' large-scale magic after choosing to obey the orders of Grimm's old squadron leader instead of following Grimm and Wilhelm. During the investigation at Castour Field, the Zergev Squadron would encounter him again, but he would now appear as a revived corpse soldier among numerous others brought back by the Witch responsible for much of the magic used during the battle, [[Sphinx]].
