[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 26|Volume 26]] (main story)}} '''Vincent Vollachia''' (ヴィンセント・ヴォラキア), also temporarily known by the alias '''Abel''' (アベル), is the seventy-seventh emperor of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. He played major roles in [[Arc 7]] and [[Arc 8]], and he played supporting roles in both [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]. Living his life as a prince of the Vollachia Empire with foreknowledge of the [[Great Disaster]] and later learning its trigger was his death, Vincent became a powerful emperor who changed the nation, not with his strength but with his mind, reforming the nation in various manners with numerous strategies, such as the revival of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals system]] and the forming of a non-aggression pact with Vollachia's bitter enemy, the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], leading to an unprecedented era of peace for the Empire. ==Appearance== Vincent is a young and very handsome man in his mid-twenties. He has relatively short black hair and almond-shaped brown eyes which emit an aura of high intelligence. With a pale complexion, Vincent gives off a sense of fragility if one were to quickly glance at him, but when one is in his presence, his charisma emits an overpowering sense of dread and power that makes even the finest of soldiers cower in fear. As noted by Subaru, when first laying eyes on him, one cannot help but to feel like kneeling down before him. Vincent is dressed in a long, red elegant coat with its collar and the front edges being black. The coat's edges are gold in their color, just like the buttons on the front and on the coat's sleeves. On its left side, there's an insignia with a wolf impaled by swords, the symbol of Vollachia. Underneath his coat, Vincent can be seen wearing a grey tuxedo, and underneath that, a white long-sleeved shirt can clearly be visible. Vincent does not wear any special ornaments or jewelry as he doesn't seem to like being seen as ostentatious. Additionally, there are black feathers with red tips on his left shoulder. When he and [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] first met one another at the start of Arc 7, Vincent covered his face with a rag, which he used to conceal his face and identity. Only his dark brown eyes were visible underneath them. After removing the rag and revealing his true identity to Subaru, he donned a red mask that resembled an [[Oni]]. It covered the top half of his face and had two large horns protruding from the top of it. The Oni mask was woven with a cognitive disruption spell that prevented him from being recognized by those who were familiar with him but unaware he had been deposed from the imperial throne, making it a far more effective way of hiding his identity than the tattered rags he resorted to using before obtaining it. Abel Wearing Rags.png|Vincent's face covered by a rag. Oni Masked Abel.png|Vincent donning an Oni mask while using Abel as an alias. Female Vincent.png|Vincent crossdressing as a dancer named Bianca to capture Guaral. Child Vincent.png|Vincent as a 12-year-old child. While he participated in the [[Fall of Guaral#Bloodless Siege|Bloodless Siege of Guaral]], Vincent dressed as a dancer while under the alias Bianca with Subaru's help. He wore crimson and black clothing, black and golden ornaments, a light purple cloth wrapped around his waist, makeup and nail polish applied by Subaru and fine-tuned by himself, and used a long, black braided wig adorned with a floral decoration. In addition, he wore several pieces of jewelry across his upper body, including a gold face chain and gold earrings. ==Personality== Vincent is shown to be extremely prideful, fastidious, and perfectionistic. He is shown to be cold and has little superficial compassion and mercy for the people who haven't earned it, but despite that, one cannot call him a bad leader as he's loved by some and feared by a majority of his subjects, and he is even capable of turning terror into admiration and servitude into adoration. Even when visibly worn out, wounded and on death's door, his people bowed their heads and kneeled before him, and no one dared to look at him with even a hint of pity or any other negative emotion.''"But the citizenry soon recovered, kneeling before the emperor as he walked along at a casual pace. The impulse spread, person by person, until everyone in the vicinity of the main street had come to bow their head or bend their knee."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 19. Perhaps one of his most important virtues is his rationality and his ability to make very quick decisions which almost always turn out in his favor, no matter the odds. As mentioned above, Vincent is very cold and lacks unnecessary compassion for his soldiers as in Vollachia, everything and everyone is owned by the emperor. Despite the overwhelming political power he has, he's very resourceful and does not treat people's lives as possessions. Having said that, he had no problems in ordering one of his guards to chop off his own head''"I am compassionate; I shall repeat myself. Take your sword and chop off your own head. Can't you do that?"'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 4. (despite [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] later explaining how the knight would not have left the hall with his life as he showed weakness which strictly goes against the core teachings of Vollachian Empire). Likewise, he is not above using death to inspire fear in others to prevent rebellions,''"If you are referring to the latest rebellion, I made an example of that family because it was necessary. You ought to collar any wight who might be aspiring to attempt the same deed. Fear produces the best effects for that."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. and he believes that if one must die, that death should be efficient and exploited to the utmost.''"If a life must be ended, then you had better exploit it to the utmost first. People should die in an efficient manner."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. This being said, despite not being above having people killed, he seems to detest killing to a certain degree, which he displayed upon coming across the [[undead]] [[Viva]], an infamous serial killer responsible for countless murders and dismemberments in his search for the soul, and in response, Vincent showed a rare display of outrage by purposefully burning his soul when he had the option to pass on peacefully.''"Both in life and in death, your deeds are unbearable to witness. Therefore, though I may know your name, I shan’t bestow upon you any choice save being scorched."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 66, Section 2.''However, the fact that he used the Yang Sword to cut down an opponent who could have been defeated without causing them to suffer was a clear indication of Abel’s anger towards the other person.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 66, Section 3. He's shown to be extremely smart and capable of making the entire Empire dance in the palm of his hand. He's easily able to manipulate people, even those who are a cut above others in intelligence. At the end of Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed, it's revealed that Vincent stood behind the coup itself, tricking the High Count, [[Berstetz Fondalfon|Prime Minister]], the Divine Generals, the Lugunican diplomats and the whole [[Imperial Army]] into an elaborate and stretched-out plan all for the sake of signing the non-aggression pact with the Kingdom of Lugunica, as he had no desire to start a war but due to the Empire's age-old teachings, he couldn't allow himself to hastily accept the treaty.''"The emperor didn't actually want a war between the kingdom and the empire. It would have been in his interest to grant the nonaggression pact we were requesting. But... there was a reason he couldn't do so too readily."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 20.''"Without it, peace with the kingdom could have not been bought."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 21. His is likewise skilled at wordplay, even being capable of outsmarting [[Miklotov McMahon]] in a verbal battle''"Poorly advised wordplay will do you little good here. Be careful that a slip of the tongue does not sully your reputation in your twilight years."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], Diplomacy by Bloodshed, Section 4. and making a fool out of [[Bordeaux Zergev]], deceiving him into thinking he's simply belittling him when in fact, he was just citing a passage from ''Magrizza's Guillotine''. He's easily capable of manipulating people to fall into his traps, using them for his own goals and plans. He's normally calm but does not shy away from showering his subordinates with insults or straight up ordering them to commit suicide or to not speak a word. Vincent was also noted to emit a strong presence, different from anything [[Julius Juukulius]] has ever felt; it was neither joy nor terror but something far more sinister. According to [[Cecilus Segmunt]], Vincent has a way of seeing the true potential of the people that he meets, usually even better than the person themself does, and when giving orders, he does so "recklessly", making it difficult for others to keep up with his ideal of them. He tends to have certain expectations of the people he meets or commands, typically criticizing one as slothful if they are unable to meet those expectations. However, he does not disrelish solely for being incompetent;''Beneath Vincent’s drastic initiative and resoluteness hid his fastidious side, contrasting with his expectations towards others and, as an underlying factor, inclining him to criticize those unable to meet them as slothful. Vincent was no meritocrat, though; he did not disrelish people solely for being incompetent.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. in his own words, one ought to perform the vocation that corresponds to their own caliber,''"――One ought to perform the vocation that corresponds with their caliber."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. and he believes that everyone must live with all of their might without respite.''He wished for everybody to live with all their might, no respite.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. Likewise, Vincent strongly believes in rewarding or punishing people for their deeds. Everyone should give their all and be treated accordingly. Even though it was more than 8 years after being a crucial benefactor in squashing [[Ginunhive|Gladiator Island Ginunhive]]'s [[Ginunhive Armed Rebellion|uprising]], upon learning of that he was the one who participated against the rebels, Vincent swore to reward [[Al]] for his outstanding work all those years ago.''"I heard that there was a gladiator who labored on the Gladiator Island Ginunhive during the uproar immediately after my accession. I also heard that he did not ask for a reward for his work... So that was you, clown."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 39, Section 3.''"It was a great deed. ―I will reward you for your service. No matter what."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 39, Section 3. Vincent also has a hatred and disgust for the [[Stargazer]]s. Though he understands that their prophecies are true, he is disgusted by how they are twisted into fanaticism and abandon their “selves”, not to mention how their words lead people down paths that they do not want, such as his own prophecy regarding the Great Disaster. This is most clear in his interactions with [[Ubilk]], and because of how he mistakenly understood Natsuki Subaru as a Stargazer after noticing the effects of Return by Death, combined with Subaru’s emotional attitude and decisions, that hatred and disgust slipped into his view of Subaru. Ordinarily, because he tends to take a tolerant approach to digesting and evaluating things, it is rare to see Vincent display truly genuine negative emotions,''Vincent generally took a tolerant approach when digesting and evaluating things. He went through said thought process with impressive speed, which, for better or for worse, almost made it seem like he judged without prior deliberation. It would strike anybody as unusual to witness that same Vincent displaying such negative emotions.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. with the rare few moments being when discussing things related to the Stargazers or [[Stride Vollachia]]. After the death of [[Chisha Gold|Chisha]], Vincent reveals that while he was prepared for his life to end, which is why he kept people at a distance regardless of who they were, he was not prepared to lose someone dear to him. Because of this, Vincent became colder and more emotional for a time, getting into a brawl with an infantilized Subaru after refusing to listen to what he had to say. He also claims to hate arguments based in emotion, as they have the least potential,''It was a baseless, emotional argument that merely spoke of hope. In a place of discussion, that was something Vincent loathed from the bottom of his heart, for it harbored the least potential.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 3. and yet, after his temporary ousting from the throne, he had been both tormented and rescued by those very arguments time and again.''――Such loathed arguments of emotion; since he had been ousted from the throne, just how many times had he been tormented by them, and rescued by them?'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 3. ==History== ===Early Life=== '''Vincent Abellux''' (ヴィンセント・アベルクス, ''Vinsento Aberukusu'') was born as the son of [[Drizen Vollachia]], the seventy-sixth emperor of Vollachia. As a child, Vincent discovered Stride Vollachia's journal in the Crystal Palace's library,''"Yes, Stride Vollachia’s journal. It was concealed in the Crystal Palace’s library, where I found it. Shame that such an intriguing tome turned out to be full of unreadable, nonsensical inscriptions."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. where he learned of the madman's delusions,''"I shall not show it to you. ――Not that anthology of worthless delusions about the Observers and things akin."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter Section 3. the possibility of him being a Stargazer,''"The likelihood of that is high, in my view. But, he differed from the others who proclaimed themselves to be Stargazers. Were you to analyze the contents of his journal, you would notice the hostility of Stride Vollachia towards the Observers."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. and his knowledge of a coming Great Disaster which would occur following the death of the emperor of Vollachia.''When commandment and forewarning were received, it was foretold that upon the death of the Emperor who had ascended to the throne, the Great Disaster, which was to bring about ruin, would commence.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 108, Section 1. Because of this, believing that the Empire would not be saved if the emperor were anyone else, Vincent resolved himself to become the emperor and make preparations to prevent the destruction of the Empire.''It was not as though he himself had been mentioned by name. However, once he laid eyes upon that forewarning, he had been convinced that he would be the one to ascend to the seat of Emperor. He had been convinced that, were it not him, the Vollachian Empire could not be saved. To his other brothers and sisters, he could not entrust that great duty. Putting the entirety of his capabilities and his potential into it, Vincent Abellux would take the seat of Emperor, and as Vincent Vollachia, he would take measures for the Empire to not be undone.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 108, Section 1. The wisdom he acquired at a young age allowed him to quickly establish a reputation for himself in the time he was only about ten years old. Around this time, Vincent witnessed the fall of [[Garkla]], spurring on the legendary hero [[Kurgan]] to take up arms one last time to give the surviving residents in the Fortified City enough time to evacuate from the [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]]'s rampage. After the Eight Arms succeeded in his mission and died in the process, Vincent spent years restoring the heroic reputation he had before the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon|circumstances]] that led him to becoming a slave. Before his birth, the Abellux family was one that was neither high-ranking nor prestigious, and they began to have ambition after his birth. When Vincent was eleven, a rebellion against his family was started by a vassal of theirs who conspired with a separate family. Despite their brilliant tactics, Vincent was able to trounce them and eliminated every conspirator, and he had the advance troops dismembered and displayed on the road to inspire fear and prevent further rebellions. The incident became infamously known as the Miracle of Abellux.''“Miracle of Abellux” was the name given to a rebellion that had begun with a vassal of the House of Abellux betraying their long-lasting patronage by conspiring with another family. But albeit their tactics had been brilliant, they had suffered defeat at the hands of an eleven-year-old commander. In the end, all conspirators had been massacred. His household’s members and soldiers having given in to distress and disarray, Vincent, whose name remained unsung back then despite his princely status, had devised a plan for them without delay. By exercising his prodigious finesse, he had thus achieved victory. The vassal behind the rebellion had underestimated Vincent as an enemy, judging him to be an easy prey whom they could behead for a trophy. Those presumptuous delusions had become the cause of their demise.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2.''"And is that also why you had the instigating servant’s advance troops dismembered and put on display on the road?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. Because of this incident, Vincent himself had rumors spread about him,''"――Are those rumors of your own creation, perhaps?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. and his reputation became feared by the public.''Facts came to light, as did apocryphal rumors, giving him quite the outrageous reputation.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. By the age of twelve, he took over his own household, which had fallen into disarray during the rebellion, and they were eventually eliminated too. When he was twelve,''Chesha, fourteen years old at the time, had believed himself to be mature for his age, but meeting that boy, two years younger than himself, forced him to reconsider.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. as he was traveling along in his carriage, it got stuck in a ditch. Thanks to the nearby Chesha Trim, they were able to free the wheel with the young man's calculative skills. As a means to thank him for his assistance and to bring him to the mansion, Vincent had Chesha board the carriage.''Chesha reminisced on his course of action heretofore, seeking to solve one doubt: how had he ended up encountering such an outstanding lad, not to mention riding the same carriage as him? All had begun with a simple act of assistance. He had come across a stranded carriage, its wheel stuck in a ditch on the highway. Pushing and pulling, many attempts were being made in vain to release it. He approached the scene and freed the lurched carriage from the deep ditch by inserting a board and utilizing it as a lever.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2.''In the first place, he had been invited aboard for two reasons: to thank him for releasing the wheel, and to bring him into the mansion.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. Afterward, Vincent asked him Chesha if he would die for him,''"Chesha Trim, would you be willing to die for my sake?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. which Chesha declined on impulse. Despite expecting to be executed for his insolence, his answer impressed Vincent, and telling him to keep that outlook, decided to hire him.''"Perfect. Maintain that outlook, for you shall be serving me hereafter."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. His confusion led him to question Vincent's decision, as he was aware of the events of the Miracle of Abellux, to which Vincent merely replied that his actions were to prevent any future rebellions through fear. As Vincent asked what Chesha thought he expected of him, Vincent claimed that the road he walked was one filled with ditches, and he believed he would need Chesha's abilities to get out of such problems.''"Correct. The road I am traversing is fraught with ditches, and I cannot avoid all of them. However, I cannot stay in a ditch waiting for the issue to solve itself; otherwise, death shall come for me. And that means, I shall need a method to pull myself out whenever I get stuck."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 2. After being hired, Chesha started to go by the name Chisha Gold, adopting the surname of a certain house that Vincent had exterminated.''Funnily or not, the surname Gold pertained to a family exterminated by Vincent as a punishment for treachery.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. Thanks to the adoption of the Gold name, rumors began to spread that Vincent left one descendant from the family alive to serve him in order to condemn the family to endure the humiliation to escape his control, further reinforcing his own reputation.''Perhaps it had been a little jape of revenge from Vincent towards Chesha’s rudeness; but that aside, it misled the public into rumoring that he had spared one descendant of Gold, while condemning them to endure the humiliation of failing to escape his control, which reinforced his standing as the Sanguinary Prince.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. From then forward, Chisha helped Vincent get out of various "ditches", and once he was well learned about the flood control systems, he decided to finally be rid of the administrator and have him executed for embezzlement.''"Chisha, you have educated yourself well on the flood control system. Now, I must discharge that incompetent administrator from his post. I shall adduce his charges of embezzlement heretofore and have him decapitated."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 3. As more time passed, Vincent eventually told Chisha about Stride Vollachia and his journal. However, he did not tell him what he read within it. At an unknown point after this, Vincent picked up Cecilus.''The boy, named Cecilus Segmunt, was of the same class as Chisha years ago: somebody whom Vincent had sensed potential in and thus picked up.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 4. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 5|The Tale of the Scarlet Princess]]=== Roughly 7 years before the events of the main story, Drizen Vollachia became incapable of ruling the nation, which was confirmed when he drew the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] and burned to ash in an instant. In the following year, Vincent waged war against his half siblings in an event known as the Imperial Selection Ceremony. Two months before its conclusion, his younger half-sister [[Lamia Godwin]] laid [[Siege on the Abellux Castle]], which Vincent successfully repelled, ending in her demise. Vincent won the Imperial Selection Ceremony by slaughtering a majority of his siblings. The only one he spared was [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]], who he kept alive after he convinced her servant and foster sister, [[Arakiya]], to betray her. After successfully faking Prisca's death, he became the seventy-seventh emperor of the Sacred Vollachia Empire. ===Post-Imperial Selection Ceremony=== Following his coronation, Vincent scrubbed clean Vollachia's corruption, purging nobles who had clung onto their power only by their history despite becoming a shell of themselves,''By purging those who had become a mere shell of their former selves and enjoyed high status because of history alone, the way of the Vollachian Empire, which flew the national flag of a “wolf pierced by swords”, was enforced inside and outside its borders without exception. The way of doing things that had lasted till the previous Emperor, who had unthinkingly believed the unwritten rule that the strong were absolutely right and had let the Empire fall to ruin internally, was completely disavowed and the initial principle that the strong were to be respected was scrubbed out.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. and despite the initial similarity of his changes to other previous emperors, it was quickly recognized that Vincent had entirely reformed the Empire in a manner quite different from any previous emperor.''From the outside, Vincent Vollachia’s reign would have perhaps seemed no different from the history of the Empire thus far. However, its reality was quite different. Those who knew what was going on behind the scenes experienced it firsthand. Before long, it became something that many in the Empire, and even those outside in other countries, would likely come to know. About the grandeur of Vincent Vollachia’s remaking and reforming of the Empire.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. Thanks to his actions, unnecessary bloodshed and conflict ceased, fights to the death would no longer be applauded, and proof of strength was no longer determined solely by the person's respective overall strength, giving those with ambitions the drive to strive with their lives to achieve them.''Useless conflicts would cease, and absurd fights to the death would no longer be applauded. Proof of strength was no longer based on an individual’s military prowess, and those who held ambitions not suitable for their stature would prove with their lives the difficulty of truly fulfilling those ambitions. It was as if they were watching the process of completely painting over the criteria for what was “strong”.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. Vincent also revived the Nine Divine Generals system, deciding that Cecilus would be ranked as first, Arakiya second, [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]] third after his retrieval, and Chisha fourth, and he already had an eye on others he wanted for the other positions. He had also given positions to the servants of his fallen siblings, including making Berstetz Fondalfon, the most direct follower of one of his greatest rivals in the Imperial Selection Ceremony, Lamia, the Prime Minister. ===[[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy ZERO Vincent|Death unto the Weak, No Mercy ZERO Vincent]]=== One day, Ubilk, who had become a Stargazer, appeared before Vincent, forewarning him of an attack from [[Gaoran Peitiet]], a High Count of Vollachia. Thanks to this, Vincent successfully led his defeat, and his personal bodyguard at the time, [[Rowan Segmunt]], cut him down. Afterward, he gave Ubilk the official title of Stargazer in the Crystal Palace, and since then, his commandments have been useful in quelling numerous problems.''"Ubilk-dono, I have no doubts about your authenticity as a Stargazer. On numerous occasions, you have been able to anticipate insurrections, cataclysms, and matters that were liable to occur within our country. In many cases, your prophecies have helped to limit the damage, Ubilk-dono."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4|The Travelogue of the Finest]]=== Roughly six months before the beginning of the story, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], Julius Juukulius, and [[Ferris]] escorted Miklotov McMahon and Bordeaux Zergev on a diplomatic mission to the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]]. They met Vincent in the Crystal Palace, but after an unfortunate turn of events, the trio of knights and the emperor had to flee to a nearby forest in order to save their lives. Soon after their battle with the Divine Generals who were trying to retrieve the emperor, the squad realizes that the perpetrators were after Vincent's life. After successfully defeating the traitors who turned out to be [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] and [[Gramdart Holstoy]], the Lugunican diplomats manage to secure a non-aggression treaty. On their way back, they came to the conclusion that Vincent was the one who perpetrated the entire coup in order to create a scenario in which he'd be "forced" to sign the pact with the Kingdom of Lugunica. ===[[Imperial Civil War#Imperial Coup|Imperial Coup]]=== During one of Ubilk's visits to the castle, he spoke with Chisha and Vincent, saying that the Great Disaster had been foretold by the stars,''"――The coming of the Great Disaster has been passed down in a commandment. It is regrettable, Your Excellency."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. something that he brought up with the intention of informing Chisha about.''"I know, I know. Buuut~, if His Excellency has trouble speaking about the matter, I thought it’d be better if I did. That’s why I’m present together with General First-Class Chisha, isn’t that so?"'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. When Chisha began questioning him, having not heard of this Great Disaster, Ubilk claimed that it would bring ruin, also mentioning Yang Sword's glow, implying he knew about what went down with Prisca and resulting in Chisha nearly killing him for it. Afterward, he claimed that it would be the death of Vincent Vollachia that would trigger the Great Disaster.''"――The death of His Excellency Vincent Vollachia, that will be the signal for the beginning of the commandment."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 6. After Ubilk left the room, Vincent and Chisha discussed why he kept it secret from Chisha, which Vincent claimed was futile and something that Chisha could not prevent anyway, something that Chisha disagreed with and claimed his intentions to go against, which Vincent refuted. When asked for how long he had known about the Great Disaster and its trigger, Vincent brought out the journal, and he stated that everything he had done was to minimize the damage, including preparing Chisha for the future.''"――After my death, the ruin caused by the Great Disaster must be minimized. This is the purpose of the reform, that of the Nine Divine Generals."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 7.''"――Your purpose, Chisha Gold."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 107, Section 7. Later, after Chisha started working behind the scenes to take Vincent's place as the one to die, he and Berstetz initiated a coup which resulted in [[Goz Ralfon]] being defeated and captured and Vincent retreating to the Buddheim Jungle that linked him near the graveyard of nameless monarchs, which contained several bare necessities for survival. Deciding to take a stand, Vincent decided to search for the People of Shudrak, obscuring his face with bandages to hide his identity. ===[[The Land of Nascent Wolves / Undead Busters 1|Undead Busters]]=== With the Lugunicans returning home, Vincent tasked [[Spica]], Cecilus, and Arakiya with exterminating the remaining undead left behind by the Great Disaster. However, due to Priscilla's death leaving Arakiya to ignore Vincent's summons, he had them retrieve her. Afterward, they returned to report to Vincent. After a turbulent conversation caused by Cecilus's rambling and Arakiya's aggression, Vincent finally sent the group off on their mission, and he decided to leave keeping Arakiya in check to Spica, having learned that she could do so. After Spica's group encountered [[Volcas]], they brought the wolf man to where the emperor and the Nine Divine Generals were. Following the events of the battle that Volcas had with [[Yorna Mishigure]], who he was able to recognize as Iris, Volcas sought to be executed by Vincent with the Yang Sword, whereas Yorna obstinately did not want to accept that outcome. Realizing that there was a possibility Yorna could revolt again, [[Medium O'Connell]], his new empress consort, suggested to Vincent that Volcas should be chosen to fill the vacancy in the Nine Divine Generals. She believed her proposal would not only cater to Yorna and fill the vacancy left by Chisha, but with Volcas being the direct cause behind [[Eugard Vollachia]]'s decree to execute the wolf people and mole people, forgiving him and having him join their side would show that Vincent was serious about keeping the decree rescinded. Vincent took her proposal seriously, and when she accidentally let slip that it was originally her brother [[Flop O'Connell|Flop]]'s suggestion, she told Vincent that she just wanted to improve Vincent's view of her as his empress. Regardless, after hearing Medium out, Vincent proceeded to meet with Volcas in person to discuss her proposal with him. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Originally, Vincent was primarily a non-combatant, and it was his mind and extraordinary strategic sense that made him dangerous. However, this changes upon drawing the Yang Sword. Once drawn, his combat skills increase dramatically, allowing him to fight alongside powerful warriors on the level of his sister, ancestor, and the Nine Divine Generals. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': Rather than using physical strength as his strong point, Vincent displays an impressive intellect and the capability to come up with complex and interluded plans to outsmart, outplay, and win against his opponents. Coupled with extremely strong individuals such as Cecilus Segmunt, Vincent easily won the Imperial Selection Ceremony by outsmarting and slaughtering his enemies, eventually crowning himself as the seventy-seventh emperor of the Vollachia Empire. '''Excellent Memory''': Vincent has such a great memory that he could recognize the names and faces of a vast majority of the citizens of his nation,''"I shan’t say it thrice. ――As far as I can ascertain since I took the seat of the Emperor, I can match the faces and names of all of the Imperial citizens."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 35, Section 1. including all of his subordinates and people of interest who could pose a threat to or become a valuable asset of the throne,''"What are you angry at, that’s already dumb enough!? Because essentially, that means you remember all your subordinates, the Imperial Soldiers, right?"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 35, Section 1. despite not having met them before. As such, only people who have remained in obscurity, such as the People of Shudrak, are impossible to grasp the names and faces of for him.''"Do not misunderstand me, I do not mean every single citizen of the Empire. Just like the People of Shudraq who continue to dwell in the forest, the identities of those who remain discreet and unexposed are impossible to grasp. As such, it is futile to try to fully grasp all of the citizens in the Empire."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 35, Section 1. It was because of this that he was able to provide names to the undead in the Great Disaster, despite the fact that several of the undead died before his time. ===Equipment=== *'''[[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword Vollachia]]''' (陽剣ヴォラキア, ''Youken Vorakia''): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Vincent is capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. The sword appears out of thin air when the user wishes to use it, and it cuts and burns whatever the user desires, including magic or souls.''The flash of crimson ran diagonally, and without any resistance, it burned away Sphinx’s ten white lights that had immediately tried to intercept Abel. It was illogical for light to burst into flames, but the supernatural power that could make one believe it was natural was contained within the Yang Sword’s radiance, and therefore the following conclusion was inevitable.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 11. The flame of the Yang Sword is also stated to protect the emperor from anyone deemed unworthy by the sword. Although typically considered not so capable of combat, once he draws his sword, he is given the strength necessary to wield his sword, allowing him strength and speed incomparable to his normal state.''That was the dash of one who possessed definite strength, incomparable to the Abel up until this point. As the owner chosen by the Yang Sword itself, he was propelled to a dimension befitting that status.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 59, Section 11. *'''Cloak of Concealment''' (姿隠しのマント, ''Shikakushi no Manto''): A [[Meteor|meteor]] that, when worn, allows a user to temporarily conceal their presence by tricking others' sense of sight. However, it cannot mask things like sound, odor, footsteps, or anything else like it.''His Meteor could ultimately only trick other people’s sense of vision. It could not mask things like sound, odor and footprints. For that reason, he could not put too much stock into it.'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 1]], Section 2. *'''Two Rings with the Emperor's Crest''': Following his escape from the Crystal Palace, Vincent took two rings with the emperor's crest with him. Both rings were meteors, with one of them being able to cast fire spells and the other one's effects remaining unknown. The first ring was blown to pieces during the Rite of Blood Subaru and Vincent had to go through in order to gain the People of Shudrak's trust, and the other ring was destroyed by Vincent during their battle with Arakiya in [[Guaral]], which resulted in the entire room getting flooded by copious amounts of mana which inflicted temporary mana sickness to Arakiya, allowing the group to drive her off. *'''Recognition Obstruction Mask''': This mask, in shape of an oni face, was given to Vincent by the members of the People of Shudrak and allows him to obstruct anyone from perceiving him, making his identity completely unrecognizable to anyone save for the individuals Vincent himself wishes to reveal his identity too, and to people who possess absolutely certainty about Vincent's true identity.''In rough terms, with the exception of those whom the wearer intended to reveal his true identity, and those already possessing absolute certainty regarding the true identity of the one donning it, no one was able to see beyond the effects of the mask.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 54. [[Taritta Shudrak|Taritta]] stated the mask was used a long time ago by one of the previous emperors of Vollachia who formed a partnership with the Shudraks, in order to visit the forest without being recognized. ==Trivia== *Due to always having to be aware of his surroundings in case of an assassination due to his position as an emperor, Vincent developed a habit of never blinking with both eyes at the same time. *In the past, there were times when Vincent had to dress up as a woman in order to conceal his gender and protect his identity. *Across the entirety of the Vollachia Empire's history, the years under Vincent's rule were the most peaceful. *Vincent's birthday was chosen to be December 23 because it is the date of birth for the Emperor Emeritus [[Wikipedia:Akihito|Akihito]], who previously served as the 125th emperor of Japan. *Vincent has his own named arc in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]]. This also makes Vincent the first and only character featured in the story thus far to have an arc named after them. **While he does not have his own individual named chapter, in Arc 8, he shares a named chapter with Subaru. *The sobriquet "Sanguinary Prince", by which Vincent was known during his teenage years, was coined and proclaimed to the public by Chisha as a spiteful prank.''Furthermore, Chisha informed his hometown about the House of Abellux's involvement in this donation and thereby executed another vengeful scheme against his troublesome master: proclaiming the name of the ‘Sanguinary Prince.'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 8]]. *According to the author on a talk show held on April 6th, 2025, Vincent and Priscilla are so familiar with Shatranj, a chess-like named after a fallen country, they both play the game without moving a single piece, only making moves in their heads, baffling any spectators. *Per the April 6, 2025 talk show, if Vincent had lived on Earth, he would be a young businessman. *According to the author, Vincent would write letters to the Lugunican cast in the future, though he'd write it in a very formal manner similar to that of AI.July 26, 2026 Talk Show ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Imperial Family]] [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Royalty]] [[Category:Leaders]] [[Category:Imperial Selection Candidates]] [[Category:Enchanted Sword Users]]

[[Re:IF]] (side story) |Manga = [[Bonds of Ice Manga Volume 2|Bonds of Ice Volume 2]] (mentioned) }} '''Zarestia''' (ザーレスティア) is the '''[[Spirit#The Slasher, Zarestia|Slasher]]''', one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]. She dwells at [[Kararagi#Locations|Zarestia's Bed]]. Though she has yet to appear in the main story, she first appears in the [[Kararagi Reaper Incident 1|Kararagi Reaper Incident side story]]. ==Appearance== Zarestia is an inhumanly beautiful woman with white skin. She has milky-white shaggy hair with a lime strand, white eyebrows, and sharp almond-shaped eyes with a bright yellow color. She wears an immaculate pure white kimono with a lime sphere and the right side over the left, giving the impression of burial clothes, but with the skirt shortened to the mid-thigh and freely exposing her long, slender legs. ==Personality== At her core, Zarestia is childish and temperamental despite both her apparent and actual age. She has a foul-mouthed and arrogant manner of speech, often referring to people as if they were animals, and she greatly prizes her freedom. Despite this, Zarestia has been known to compromise her desires for the sake of others. She enjoys the company of others, helping them, and making them happy, as well as receiving their gratitude and praise. Even in the event that she loses her '''Light Sphere''', which contains the bulk of her power, and must retrieve it, though she is not above destroying entire towns to retrieve it, she is resistant to killing others during such an attack, to the point that she will raise the residents above a town to avoid hurting them during her rage. Meanwhile, for those she assumes to be such a thief, if they do not return her Light Sphere, then she is willing to become violent and unwilling to listen to them, even if the person she faces is not the thief and is merely the victim of a misunderstanding. Despite her regular demeanor, when Zarestia wields the power of her Light Sphere, she becomes a compulsive murderer who thinks of nothing but killing and has a constant desire to kill anything and everything. Everything leads back to murderous intent, regardless of target, mood, time, reason, or circumstance. Even when she doesn't want to kill, she wants to kill. However, when stripped of her Light Sphere, her bloodlust and incessant impulse to kill are removed. Despite this, she will still seek to reclaim it if separated. She also has a deep trauma and hatred towards alcohol, and coming into contact with it is enough to put her into shock. ==History== ===Early Life=== Zarestia predates both the [[Satella|Witch]] and the [[Volcanica|Dragon]]. Stories of those times describe her as a great beast. Her head would raise the wind, her hands would add fire, her tail would hoist up the water, and her feet would dig up the soil, all of which she enjoyed and would do repeatedly. She rejoiced in her freedom, undisturbed by anyone, and was praised and admired by all. In turn, she began listening to their requests and would usually lend them her aid whenever she was awake, though sometimes she missed her former freedom and would ignore them. Eventually, people began bringing gifts for her when they came to ask for favors, though she had little interest in them. However, she appreciated their feelings and was glad they were happy with her doing what she liked. Over time, requests became increasingly more specific, and her followers began asking for more and more from Zarestia. Though she enjoyed her freedom, she also enjoyed how they would praise and pamper her. Before long, she had grown accustomed to doing as everyone told her. One day, they came to her with a particularly odd request. They asked for fire and nothing else. She initially found the request disagreeable and asserted her freedom by turning it down, only for everyone to leave her. Finding her freedom to be lonesome, she went to them and agreed to their request for fire. However, she secretly raised the wind as well, as only the wind was indispensable to her as the symbol of her freedom. After Zarestia returned, the people invited her to a party where she was given alcohol for the first time, and she fell asleep away from her nest for the first time as well. While she slept, the people removed her limbs, stripping her of all elemental powers besides wind. Confused, she asked for an explanation, and they accused her of burning their towns and villages as her wind had caused the flames to spread. They bathed her in alcohol and lit her ablaze, and she saw they were pleased to watch her burn as she screamed in pain. Realizing she still had her head and power over wind, she resolved to kill them all and slew each and every one of them. Since then, Zarestia has been filled with bloodlust, and to express her freedom she would kill anything and everything. She took for herself the title of the '''Most Beautiful Reaper''' (最も美しい死神), after how the people called her "shinigami" when she killed them in the end and how they had once called her "beautiful". ===[[Kararagi Reaper Incident 1|Kararagi Reaper Incident]]=== A short time after the [[Great Disaster]], in Kararagi, angry and looking for a thief who had apparently stolen her Light Sphere, she attacked [[Banan]] with a windstorm - an incident that would come to be known as the Shinigami Disaster - destroying half of the town, holding its residents in the air like hostages, and she confronted [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]], who she believed was the thief. Bruised, injured, and realizing that he would be unable to defeat, stop, or reason with her, Ricardo decided to sit down and take her attacks. Because of this, she used her wind to try and force him to give up the location of her Light Sphere, but due to his tenacity, she stopped attacking him, released the windstorm that was ravaging the town, and released her hostages. Afterwards, they decided to talk, introducing themselves to each other. Sometime after Ricardo quelled Zarestia's rage, [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]]'s group arrived and were led to the holding cells in [[Riften Magoji]]'s mansion, where Zarestia was being held. During their conversation, [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]] noticed that she was a Great Spirit and introduced himself, while [[Halibel]] unintentionally riled her up by noticing her strange constitution, that something was missing. However, when Anastasia mentioned Zarestia being responsible for other such town-destroying wind cataclysms, Zarestia declared otherwise, saying that she only rampaged in Banan. Shortly afterward, this is confirmed when a massive tornado appeared outside of Banan, not made by Zarestia. After giving her orders and securing Zarestia's assistance, the group made their way to stop the tornado. Although they managed to quell the winds, however, they soon realized that Anastasia and [[Eridna|Echidna]] had gone missing. A full day after being taken, Anastasia and Echidna were brought back to Banan by [[Reize|Black Tia]], their captor, and shortly after, likely due to her exhaustion catching up with her, Anastasia passed out with a fever. Though Julius tended to her and attempted to help heal her with his spirits, he was unable and settled for practicing with Halibel to become stronger. At some point, Anastasia woke up from the sound of clashing steel to find Zarestia waiting for her. Zarestia, who wanted to talk with Anastasia about Black Tia, told her that Black Tia was currently in a cell and that her attitude and speech were due to the Light Sphere's influence on her. Afterward, Anastasia asked Zarestia to gather the others. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As a great spirit, Zarestia holds tremendous power. She can easily and casually destroy towns and defeat the likes of a warrior of Ricardo's strength with complete ease. Likewise, when she has her Light Sphere on her, she becomes more bloodthirsty and lethal, making her much more dangerous. This being said, in the present day, she is significantly weaker than she was in her much earlier days when she could command other affinities. At present, the full extent of both her current and previous strengths remain unknown. ===[[Magic]]/[[Magic#Spiritual Arts|Spiritual Arts]]=== While Zarestia once exerted great control over the four primary magic affinities, her current self retains only her extremely powerful wind magic. Her control over wind magic is exceptional. When she attacked Banan, she simultaneously used her magic to destroy the town around her, hold all of the town's residents high in the sky with her wind and kept them from harm, and concentrated attacks on Ricardo with ease. ===Physical Traits=== '''Enhanced Olfaction''': Zarestia has a heightened sense of smell, particularly when it comes to blood. With it, she can determine her enemies or people who she has met before. However, she can be mistaken with at times: she mistook Ricardo and Halibel for the one who stole her Light Sphere due to a similar scent coming off of both him and the thief. ===Equipment=== *'''Light Sphere''' (光珠, ''Mi Tama''): The gem that serves as Zarestia's anchor and the source of her power. Without it, Zarestia exists as only a portion of herself, less than half, and loses her desire to kill. Tishua apologized for it and noticed his tea was empty, and though she was about to offer to refill it, Veltol did instead. However, Theresia stopped him, as Veltol had drugged his tea. Cornered, Veltol mentioned that it wasn't poison but a drug that made one lose control of their bladder, leading to Theresia snapping at him. After Tishua told him the way to the bathroom, she asked if Wilhelm would be able to adjust to their family, to which he answered by calling them mother and father and saying that it would probably be hard to get along with Veltol. Receiving a positive response from Tishua, he left to use the bathroom. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Song]]=== In the three months that followed, Theresia brought Wilhelm to meet her parents. However, thanks to Veltol, their upcoming wedding faced numerous setbacks and obstacles. Thanks to his interference, three days before their official wedding date, he used his authority to force the Zergev Squadron to patrol a few towns around the capital, knowing full well that it would take three days to accomplish. When Theresia and [[Carol Remendis]] went to chide Veltol, even threatening to leave [[House Astrea]], Tishua was quick to join in, claiming his actions were petty. The next day, Theresia waited patiently for the return for the Zergev Squadron with Carol and her parents. Eventually, [[Bordeaux Zergev]] arrived and informed her of the squad's return, and soon after, her wedding took place. Despite Wilhelm being unable to clean himself off after the mess he went through, the wedding went off perfectly, and the two were married. In the month that followed, Veltol made numerous appearances, much to Theresia's frustration, and eventually, he even suggested going along on the honeymoon as well, leading to another argument. However, with help from Tishua, they were able to get him to leave. Despite this, Veltol was still set on joining them, and Tishua was against his meddling. This being said, he had official business in [[Picoutatte]], and he left. Later, Tishua was informed of the incidents that took place there, and she made her way to the city. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[de:Tishua Astrea]] [[es:Tishua Astrea]] [[ru:Тиша Астрея]] [[zh:角色:提修雅]]

[[Reinhard van Astrea]] (great grandson) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Ex Volume 3]]}} '''Veltol Astrea''' (ベルトール・アストレア) was the father of [[Theresia van Astrea]]. He played supporting roles in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]] and [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]. Veltol was the former head of [[House Astrea]], and he loved his family dearly, Theresia in particular. However, he ultimately lost his life during one of [[Stride Vollachia]]'s campaigns, who used his [[Authority]] to control [[Carol Remendis]] and kill him. ==Appearance== Veltol had relatively long hair along with a red beard and a red mustache. He wore bordeaux colored clothes, those representing of nobility. ==Personality== Veltol was considered to have an overprotective personality towards his daughter, Theresia, his wife, [[Tishua Astrea|Tishua]], and his three sons. Though this facet of his personality sometimes went too far, the love he held for his family was what truly distinguished him as a person. He went to extreme lengths to protect his family despite being unskilled with the sword. He sometimes acted pettily around the people he disliked, but in the end, once they got to know them better, he would warm up and treat them as family. This said, as the head of a noble house, Veltol can play that role perfectly, often exuding a noble aura when faced with others besides his family. Despite his less than average talent with a sword, he is willing to challenge someone to a duel if they insult the people he cares for. ==History== ===[[Sword Demon Love Story: The Bride's Father]]=== After the two decided to get married, [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]] and Theresia left for the Astrea Domain so that Wilhelm could ask her parents for her hand in marriage. After arriving there, Wilhelm was nervous to meet them, which made Theresia happy. Soon after, Veltol and Tishua arrived in the meeting room, and Veltol immediately put pressure on Wilhelm. The four sat down and spoke, Theresia talking about some things with her mother while Veltol decided to determine if Wilhelm was worthy of Theresia. Despite the man's apparent disapproval, Wilhelm was about to ask for Theresia's hand, but Veltol was quick to explode, resulting in him and Theresia getting into an argument. Tishua apologized for it and noticed his tea was empty, and though she was about to offer to refill it, Veltol did instead. However, Theresia stopped him, as Veltol had drugged his tea. Cornered, Veltol mentioned that it wasn't poison but a drug that made one lose control of their bladder, leading to Theresia snapping at him. After Tishua told him the way to the bathroom, she asked if Wilhelm would be able to adjust to their family, to which he answered by calling them mother and father and saying that it would probably be hard to get along with Veltol. Receiving a positive response from Tishua, he left to use the bathroom. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]]=== In the three months that followed the start of her engagement, Theresia brought Wilhelm to meet her parents. However, thanks to Veltol, their upcoming wedding faced numerous setbacks and obstacles. Thanks to his interference, three days before their official wedding date, he used his authority to force the Zergev Squadron to patrol a few towns around the Royal Capital, knowing full well that it would take three days to accomplish. Suspicious that this was her father's fault, she asked Bordeaux to look into it. Later, despite her frustrations, Wilhelm decided to take on this challenge, and as he prepared to leave, Theresia, who had fixed him food for on the road, saw him off. Afterward, speaking with [[Bordeaux Zergev]], he confirmed her suspicions, and she resolved to meet with and scold her father. Two days later, Theresia and Carol went to confront Veltol. When they met, Theresia was quick to chide her father for his actions, and she even threatened to leave House Astrea because of him. Even Carol and her mother joined in to chide him. However, she believed in Wilhelm, and she knew that he would arrive on time for their wedding, despite her father's meddling. The next day, wearing her wedding dress, she waited patiently for the return for the Zergev Squadron with Carol and her parents. Eventually, Bordeaux arrived and informed her of the squad's return, and soon after, her wedding took place. Despite Wilhelm being unable to clean himself off after the mess he went through, Veltol entrusted his daughter to him, the wedding went off perfectly, and the two were married. At some point after this, Veltol ordered a sword for Wilhelm, the sword that would later be named the Holy Sword Astrea. In the month that followed, Veltol made numerous appearances, much to Theresia's frustration, and eventually, he even suggested going along on the honeymoon as well, leading to another argument. However, with help from Tishua, they were able to get him to leave. Given two months for their honeymoon, they prepared to leave, taking Carol as Theresia's attendant, and they decided to visit the cities to the south of the Royal Capital. However, after arriving in [[Picoutatte]], having left from [[Flanders]], they found Veltol waiting there, leading to another argument. However, with his reason for visiting to collect the present for his wife, they accompanied him to the Suwen Company. With Veltol asking Wilhelm and Carol to allow him and Theresia to shop together, they left to observe the town. Inside the shop, however, they were met by a disrespectful Stride, who was targeting the Sword Saint. Leading Veltol to challenging him to a duel, he introduced [[Kurgan]], who would serve as his champion, as Theresia had noticed Stride's apparent illness. After further insulting him, her, and Wilhelm, Veltol struck Stride for his remarks, leading Kurgan to ruthlessly beat him down and Stride to curse him. Taken to the hospital, she met with Wilhelm and was informed of Veltol's condition by the healer [[Garitch Fabless]]. Accordingly, the only way to remove the curse was to cut it off at the source. The next day, the curse receded after the destruction of the ring that caused it. However, he got into an argument with Theresia, and after she left to greet Tishua, who was informed of the incident and decided to visit the city, he spoke with Wilhelm, who gave him the accessory Theresia and Carol bought for him to give to Tishua. During their conversation, Wilhelm learned that Veltol's arm lost all function as an after-effect of the curse, and Veltol swore him to secrecy. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]=== At a later time when Stride Vollachia attacked the Astrea Manor again, Veltol protected a pregnant Theresia and Tishua from the assassin's blade of Carol as she was controlled by Stride, resulting in his death. ==Abilities== '''Pseudo-[[Curse]]''': Before the beginning of the [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Veltol was placed under the effects of Stride's [[Stride Vollachia#Abilities|Ten Hubristic Commandments]], giving him a sort of curse different from typical ones. While under this curse's influence, he was left bedridden, and after the destruction of the ring responsible, it left his left arm permanently unusable. '''Sword Skills''': Veltol was below average with a sword. ==Trivia== *Wilhelm regards Veltol as the greatest swordsman he had ever met, not because of his own power, but because of his tenacity. *[[Reinhard van Astrea]] once used Veltol's name when he went undercover. *Veltol was the one who came up with [[Heinkel Astrea]]'s name. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:House Astrea]] [[Category:Nobles]] [[de:Veltol Astrea]] [[es:Veltol Astrea]] [[ru:Бертоль Астрея]] [[zh:角色:贝尔托]]
