[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40|Volume 40]] (main story)}} '''Yae Tenzen''' (ヤエ・テンゼン) is a former member of the [[Priscilla Camp]] and presently a maid working at the Barielle Estate. Debuting as both a supporting and a twist antagonistic character in [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4|Tanpenshuu Volume 4]]'s [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]] story, she plays a secondary antagonistic role in [[Arc 9]]. A [[shinobi]] from the [[Vollachia Empire]], she played the role of [[Priscilla Barielle|Priscilla]]'s Grand Chamberlain after being tasked by [[Chisha Gold]] to keep an eye on her, and later, to assassinate her. She disappeared after a brief fight with [[Al]], seemingly having been killed. In truth, however, Yae survived her encounter with Aldebaran, having been traumatized into forcibly becoming his servant. After Al's sealing, however, she decides to serve [[Schult Barielle]], awaiting the day for Aldebaran's return. ==Appearance== Yae is a fair-skinned beautiful young woman around the age of twenty whose aura of charm and flexibility is akin to that of a cat. She has long, tied up pale red hair, cat-like jet black eyes, and slender, supple arms and legs. She wears a maid uniform adopted from a Japanese style, having a base of red with black and white mixed in, as well as black leggings and boots and a white headpiece. ==Personality== An eccentric, gifted prodigy with excellent learning capabilities since childhood, Yae gained a reputation in the shinobi village as a girl who embodied the very essence of a shinobi. Due to her talent, she never knew fear during her training and easily overcame any difficulties in her path. In spite of her training, however, Yae believed that she did not fit the mold of the idealized image of a shinobi that the others in her village did, feeling it was troubling to have the expectation that she would placed onto her. As such, in betrayal of the expectations of her teacher, [[Fujirou Tenzen]], she intentionally distanced herself from that image and acted counter to it, choosing to put on a frivolous attitude with an affable yet not intimate demeanor, speaking and conducting herself in such a way that was impossible to grasp.''Hence, Yae deliberately distanced herself from the image of the ideal shinobi that everyone seemed to be placing their hopes and expectations in. That was the exact opposite of the ideal shinobi image that Fujirou Tenzen had staked his life attempting to complete―― a frivolous attitude, speech and conduct impossible to grasp, and an affable but never intimate demeanor. Yae Tenzen coordinated herself to be that facetious kind of a person.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 4.''“I get that Hamayal-san and everyone else at the village has an idealized image of shinobi, y’know? But, I just never fit that image, and it was troubling for people to expect that I would. For the most part, I just do what I can, so isn’t it the people who can’t do that who are worse?”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12]], [[Guardians of the Crimson Flame]], Section 6. Bereft of aspirations typical of the shinobi, she unabashedly did not treat most things in life seriously, whether it concerned her interpersonal relationships, killing a target, or the possibility of her own death, having used this nature as a way to conceal her true intentions from the people around her in accordance with her training of suppressing her own emotions. With her sharp mind, she has learned and exemplified mastery in various shinobi techniques in under a year, researched and studied anything from potential future targets or threats, including those in a foreign nation, to miscellaneous subjects such as the identities and number of people in a small village or the [[Undead#Corpse Soldiers|corpse soldiers]] of the [[Demi-Human War]], and she can easily recall said information at a moment's notice. Because of her prodigal skill, [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]] has proclaimed that she was like himself, that having been so good everything made it seem as though everything around her had lost its spark and became uninteresting to her, something that often led to Olbart attempting to push her towards finding something to hold dear.''“Hey, yer like that, ain’t’cha? Same as me, ya can do just about anythin’ without so much as a second thought, ‘n so life kinda loses its spark, don’t it? Wouldn’t it be fine ta keep at least a single somethin’ in yer heart, then?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 1. However, Yae herself did not want to find anything precious to her due to her strong beliefs in the ways of a shinobi, as well as the fact that Yae despises being treated as if she was special, something which has influenced most of her personality, including not wishing to have expectations thrust on her. It is this part of her that she wanted to betray the expectations of those who considered her a prodigy in her own village, acting in behavior opposite of what should be considered the "typical" shinobi. She also agreed to the philosophy once stated by Olbart, in which she believed that she neither needed nor wanted any form of attachment, as if such attachment would make her "special" or for others to hold expectations for her. In fact, her feelings for this were so strong that when Olbart encouraged her to go against those teachings, she felt disgusted, and when pressed on the fact that she had become attached to and fallen in love with Aldebaran, she refuted this repeatedly. Likewise, despite her rebellious behavior toward her village elders, Yae often leaned on the shinobi teachings, keeping her emotions suppressed,''Even if she was of an unserious disposition, Yae had received the shinobi training of suppressing emotions, having acquired a spirit that would never reveal anything, no matter the level of torture; thus, her statement was bloodcurdling, and by no means could it be taken as a falsehood.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12]], [[Guardians of the Crimson Flame]], Section 2. not asking questions where they weren't necessary, and remaining obedient to her employer,''The essence of the shinobi was to obey commands without asking too much, and Yae considered that a preferable trait. The only one who would brazenly disobey was the village chief, and since Yae was not the same as him, she remained obedient.'' [[Arc 9]], Chapter 51, Section 4. something which ironically made her exemplify the very expectations of her fellow villagers. Having never found anything she experienced in the past scary, Yae was first made to know "terror" by Al upon being placed in the position of the [[Al#Abilities|Aggressor of the Domain]], which pierced her heart, broke down her will, and shattered her mind and prior way of being. The programming of her soul as a shinobi that once dictated that she suppress her emotions or commit suicide upon failure was overwritten by a severe feeling of terror and the absolute submission of her soul to Al, whom she views as a monster. As a result, Yae's attitude has changed from the unserious attitude she bore before, developing a distorted obsession towards Al and vowing to him that she will do anything to serve him so long as he refrains from frightening her the way he did before again. She remains unflinching in the face of those other than Al who threaten her safety, be it the [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Sword Demon]] or the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]]. Despite Yae's submission to Al, she often mixes her words with malice or an intent to verbally wound him, as well as to other people such as [[Heinkel Astrea|Heinkel]]. Furthermore, she frequently attempts to propose that he use her for "comfort", whether for her abilities, her body, or anything else, offering herself as an outlet to relax his mind, vent his frustrations, and fulfill any desire he may have, as insurance that he can persist long enough to fulfill his goal. Her motivation for supporting Al is to ensure that, once he fulfills his purpose, he dies, fervently convinced that she will never be able to feel safe again as long as he is alive. This being said, unbeknownst to her, her attachment and devotion towards Al was recognized in a failed loop as her love for him, which she had displayed by not wanting to forget him. ==History== ===Early Life=== Like the other shinobi trainees in Vollachia's shinobi village, when Yae was a toddler, she was kidnapped from her parents, and she was put through the shinobi memory disposal process by Fujirou Tenzen, causing her to forget everything about her original parents and hometown. Being labelled '''Red Number 8''', she went without a name for a good portion of her early life. In her days as a trainee, Yae was forced to go through intense training, regularly being forced to shed bled and experience excruciating pain, as well as overcoming various other obstacles and arts. Eventually, on the day she qualified to become a genin, Fujirou, having become her instructor, bestowed the girl with the name Yae, with the reason she received the name being unknown to her, and she also inherited his family name, Tenzen. Fujirou, having come to realize how exceptional Yae was as a shinobi, began to want to bring out all her latent potential, with his obsession leading him to organize the Kodoku, an event similar to the Empire's Imperial Selection Ceremony in which Yae and thirty other genin were taken to a forced and ordered to kill each other until one was left standing. Ultimately, although she let a single genin who pleaded for his life escape, Yae was the last survivor, simultaneously betraying the expectations of Fujirou and his allies, yet increasing those very expectations. Having been displeased with their actions and their desire to repeat the Kodoku until she could meet them. Fujirou and his allies were all slain by Yae, with the previous Tenzen's last words to her being that she would overturn the very way of what a shinobi ought to be. By the time the village chief, Olbart Dunkelkenn, happened upon the scene, their blood had stained the sakura petals around them. As a result, Olbart gave Yae the epithet Crimson Sakura. Though she would wonder why she had been named Yae, due to Fujirou's death, she had lost her chance to ask him. While her age was in the single digits, Yae completely mastered how to manipulate her body's latent mana with the Flow Method. In less than a year, she acquired more than ten techniques that would have taken most shinobi several years to learn. She even managed to master the Steel Thread Technique, which no shinobi had achieved in centuries.''While her age was still in the single digits, she had mastered the Flow Method, a technique which allowed her to manipulate her body’s mana, and in less than a single year, she had acquired ten-odd techniques which would each take most shinobi several years to learn. And, her greatest renown was the fact that she had even mastered the Steel Thread Technique, which nobody had attained in centuries.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12]], [[Guardians of the Crimson Flame]], Section 6. Developing a reputation as a genius girl, she began to adhere to the philosophy of the shinobi chieftain, Olbart, becoming his most treasured apprentice in the process.''Rather than blindly honing one’s own special skill, thoroughly training in strategies to thwart the strong points of the opponent, and learning techniques of guiding the battle so as to bring about that situation. But then again, this change did not readily bear fruit. Those who had been properly shaped by it were few, with the last being a genius girl who had appeared in the village four or five years prior.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Chapter 3, Section 7. ===[[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 13|Death unto the Weak, No Mercy]]=== Years later, she met with Chisha Gold at his request to carry out the task of infiltrating [[Leip Barielle]]'s staff due to his wife, Priscilla. He received her evaluation of her own skills and tasked her to stand by and closely observe Priscilla once hired and await the possibility of being given new instructions depending on the situation. In [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]], she was hired as a maid in the Barielle Manor by Leip shortly before his incapacitation,''“To begin with, I was only hired by the Master… although he is now deceased, I was hired by the Master as a waiting maid of the mansion, in order to serve the Madam?”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]], Section 4. though she never met him in person before his death.''Yae had never met Leip and felt nothing but disgust and contempt at him for forcibly marrying such a young and beautiful wife like Priscilla, only to try to use her as a puppet to control the country’s government; however, she sympathized with Leip’s attitude of wanting to be prepared for any potential disaster and was grateful to take advantage of the opportunity he had inadvertently given to her.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 2, Section 7. In time, she worked her way up in the mansion and was appointed to the role of Grand Chamberlain by Priscilla. ===[[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]]=== Yae worked alongside Priscilla and Al in the zombie infestation in Coffleton and the waterwheel among the Tenrill River. Confronting [[Edda Rayfast]], the trio was ambushed, and Yae and Al were caught in a trap that the former escaped by kicking the latter's shoulder to grab ahold of the ceiling, causing him to fall into a large pit. Priscilla ordered Yae to retreat and search for Al. Happening upon Al in the underground water treatment facility several hours later, she followed his request to bring the Crimson Battlefront to slay the undead while he ventured to rescue Priscilla. The undead were successfully slain following this, and Al saved Priscilla. However, around this time, Yae had been given the order to assassinate Priscilla. On the same night of the zombie incident, Al revealed he knew that Yae was an assassin who had been sent to kill Priscilla. She rejected his offer to abandon her goal, and the two confronted each other in a brief fight. Yae disappeared following their encounter, and according to Al, she had decided to “resign” because of “familial matters”. In reality, he used the Aggressor side of his Authority to instill "terror" into Yae, traumatizing her. As a result, she became his servant, motivated by the sole wish to ascertain his death in the future. ===[[Guardians of the Crimson Flame]]=== Despite his claim to the contrary, in reality, Al used the Aggressor side of his Authority to instill “terror” into Yae, traumatizing her. As a result, she became his servant, and he ordered her to lay low elsewhere. They would meet up regularly in secret, and because she believed that a certain "suggestion" would come into play if she returned to Vollachia,''――She was an unparalleled genius of a ninja produced by the Vollachia Empire’s shinobi village, granted a mission of utmost importance, an existence promised to carry it through to fruition. In the one in ten thousand possibility that she were to fail, it was engraved into her soul to commit suicide without leaking any bit of the Empire’s information whatsoever.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12]], [[Guardians of the Crimson Flame]], Section 2. she remained within Lugunica. A short time later, a suicide squad comprised of ten shinobi was tasked by Chisha to kill Priscilla, which Yae failed to accomplish. Discovering there were signs of people visiting the base she had previously used, she determined that they intended to assassinate Priscilla during the upcoming Masquerade Night she was going to hold. During the night of the event, Al and Yae worked together to kill the nine shinobi around the mansion who were to be used as sacrificial distractions. Meanwhile, [[Hamayal Wesmi]], the shinobi entrusted with carrying out the assassination, was met by Al in one of the hidden passageways to the Barielle Manor that were constructed under Leip's supervision. Hamayal sent his Phantom Wolf on Al, expecting it would defeat him, but he was met with one of Yae's steel threads and realized she was alive, sending him into a fury. However, Yae told Hamayal that she had not betrayed the shinobi to save herself, but rather because she had submitted to “terror”, and that the harbinger of it was getting up. Before Hamayal's eyes, Al had risen and overcome his Phantom Wolf, forcing it to submit to him by using the Aggressor side to his Authority. Being ordered to stand back, Yae watched as proceeded to use Al used his Authority against Hamayal to break his mind in a similar way to how hers was. Following the incident, after Hamayal's Phantom Wolf was eradicated, thereby ending his own life, Yae and Al spoke with one another. Once they finished reviewing the aftermath of the Masquerade Night, including Hamayal's death, Yae revealed to Al that she viewed him as a monster, that her sheer terror of him was why she obeyed him, and that she would do anything for him to not be frightened by him. Internally deriding himself, Al affirmed to Yae that she would do nothing so long as she continued to obey his commands, with her voicing her understanding in response, having resigned her soul and submitted to him completely. ===Prior to Aldebaran's Scheme=== At some point before returning to Vollachia for the [[Imperial Civil War|events]] of [[Arc 7]], Al spoke to Yae in secret, and during this time, Yae, who had still been keeping an eye over Priscilla, bore witness as she wrote her will. Although Yae did not know if Priscilla had noticed she was there when she hid the will and mentioned Schult's safety, Yae remembered this event. Later, following Priscilla's death, Yae was somehow contacted by Aldebaran, who had decided to set forth to act on his purpose. ===[[Yae Tenzen's Crimson Sakura State of Affairs]]=== Following the reveal of Priscilla's will, Yae, who had every confidence that despite his defeat, Al was still alive, decided that, since it was the members of the [[Emilia Camp]] who had been there when he was defeated, she would attempt to gather information from [[Frederica Baumann]], who was at the manor with [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], so that she could come up with countermeasures for when Al returned and decided to finish his goal. Meeting with Frederica in the hallway, she asked the maid to be friends and brought her to have tea in her room. As they spoke, Yae got the sense that she could have genuinely become friends with Frederica if she hadn't had ulterior motives. After Frederica mentioned that she saw the members of the Emilia Camp like family, something that was foreign to Yae, she asked Yae if her relationship with Schult was anything like that, to which Yae wasn't certain how to define their relationship. As they spoke, Frederica mentioned that she was nervous about being invited by Yae and felt on guard, so to be friends with her, she proposed talking about less intrusive topics. Doing so led Frederica to point out Yae's use of loan words, which she had picked up from Al, though Yae decided to keep it a secret who she learned those words from. Realizing that she was having fun, Yae continued to talk with Frederica. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Although her abilities are more suited to killing rather than fighting, Yae is considered a genius among the shinobi. Both her employer, Chisha, and Olbart, the shinobi chieftain and second-most powerful shinobi in the present day, believed it was possible she could succeed the role of chieftain.''“I can agree to her being called a genius… supposing General First-Class Olbart retired due to his advanced age, she might even become his successor as chieftain of the village, hmmm.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 13]], Section 2. She gauged that her skill was enough to assassinate the head of [[House Mathers]] or [[House Astrea]], though not both, as she surmised that she would have needed to give her life to successfully eliminate one of them.''“Doing both is impossible, but if it was just one, I think I could do it if I gave up on returning home alive.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 13]], Section 2. In fact, in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], she was proclaimed to have had so much raw talent as a shinobi that, with more experience, she had the potential to surpass Olbart,''Given his years of experience, he was likely stronger than her overall. But, her raw talent far exceeded his own, so with enough years of experience, she would easily transform into the strongest shinobi, untouchable by anyone. Hence, he could somewhat understand why some might have had big dreams for Yae.'' [[Arc 9]], Chapter 51, Section 10. and furthermore, even rival [[Kararagi]]'s [[Halibel|Admirer]].''Those around her had lauded her as possessing the greatest talents the shinobi village had seen since its founding, loudly voicing their admiration that her potential might even rival that of the Admirer of the Kararagi City-States.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 2. While she recognizes that her skill is inferior to Olbart's experiences, Yae has mastered the art of drawing her opponent's attention and clouding their mind, something crucial for a shinobi to do their jobs.''The ultimate technique of a shinobi was to steal their opponent’s attention, cloud their mind, immobilize them, and take their life. Yae was an excellent student in the art of clouding the mind, but she knew that she was no match for the village chief’s years of experience.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 2, Section 7. Before her disappearance, Al accused her of being the woman who would kill Priscilla, having already done so once, and he regarded her capabilities vital for his own plans. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Martial Arts''': As a shinobi, Yae was taught in the art of melee combat. With her prodigal talent, she was able to master any martial art after experiencing it only once, and she would use those very techniques to defeat people of higher rank than herself. Likewise, she was able to master any shinobi tool shortly after first picking one up. '''Extreme Muscular/Sanguine/Motor Control''': Thanks to her training, Yae has mastered the ability to control her body so finely that she can focus her blood flow and completely and freely manipulate her body's muscles, allowing her various abilities that would ordinarily be considered impossible for the human body to be capable of. *'''Enhanced Dexterity''': Yae is able to move her body so precisely, down to her smallest digits, including her tongue, that she is capable of using the Steel Thread Technique, a technique that requires the user to have full control over the smallest of movements of their body in order to use. Likewise, she is agile and a highly skilled acrobat, and when combined with her Steel Thread Technique, she is able to move at swift speeds, even allowing her to narrowly avoid deadly attacks brought about by people such as the Sword Demon. *'''Night Vision''': After having been subject to training to improve her night vision, Yae has mastered manipulating the blood flow around her eyes so that she can see in the dark as if it was daytime.''This was the result of training to become accustomed to the darkness of night, a type of physical manipulation that altered her blood flow around the eyeballs to adjust vision.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 2, Section 7. *'''Impact Redistribution''': Yae is able to reduce impact damage done her by redirecting the force into her limbs, allowing her to avoid all but the most severe damage. This being said, doing so can cause her limbs to go numb if the impact is strong enough, and it is likely that if hits even stronger than that were to strike her, the damage could still be worse. This ability is said to be a shinobi survival technique.''Receiving a direct kick from the horned girl named Rem, Yae maneuvered her creaking body to disperse the impact through her arms and legs, a shinobi survival technique that transmitted one’s will down even to their muscles and internal organs.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 1, Section 2. *'''Organ Manipulation''': Yae is able to shift the position of her internal organs in order to avoid fatal damage.''But, she had avoided damage to her vital organs by shifting them aside. Through the inhumane shinobi modifications to her flesh, Yae could shift the positioning of her internal organs.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 9. *'''Muscle Compaction''': If a weapon manages to pierce her body, Yae can compress her muscles tightly, preventing the weapon from being pulled out. '''Various Resistances''': During her days training to become a shinobi, Yae was forced to experience numerous hardships in order to gain resistances to them. *'''Poison Resistance''': As part of her training as a shinobi, Yae was forced to experience poisoning repeatedly until she was no longer affected by it.''Destruction and correction of the bones in order to achieve mastery over a soft body and acrobatics surpassing human understanding; training to build up a resistance to poison by gradually advancing from small doses to lethal ones; daily routines comprised of learning the dangers of martial arts and shinobi tools by the pain they inflicted upon the body; and being tasked with meeting a quota of broken bones, torn-up flesh, and shed blood.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 2. However, she is vulnerable to Jiranme, a highly lethal poison that can even kill a shinobi.''“A super lethal poison which can kill even the shinobi who are trained to resist poison, Yae-chan’s special Jiranme mixture.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 12]], [[Guardians of the Crimson Flame]], Section 2. *'''Extreme Pain/Exhaustion Resistance''': Yae was forced to experience excruciating pain throughout her life, including having her entire skeleton broken multiple times over. Because of this, Yae can force her body to act even when going through pain so dreadful that most people would either have already died or been unable to move. Thanks to this training, she can force herself to move and fight even when her body is numb or in a near-death state. ===Techniques=== '''Shinobi Techniques''' (シノビの術技, ''Shinobi no Jutsugi''): Yae has mastered a number of shinobi techniques despite her young age and excels with them so much so that she was regarded as a genius prodigy who followed Olbart's doctrine of being a shinobi. Her signature skill is the Steel Thread Technique, a secret technique that no shinobi other than her has been able to wield in centuries, and not only has she mastered the technique, but she even managed to improve upon it. Re Zero Light Novel 40 8.png|Yae using the Steel Thread Technique to stand in the air. Re Zero Light Novel 43 5.png|Yae's threads ignited. *'''Steel Thread Technique''' (鋼糸術, ''Kōshi-jutsu''): A technique which Yae uses steel wires to bind and trap her targets or bind things such as debris or fallen trees in the air, launch said debris like a cannon (with assistance), kill her enemies, rescue her allies, to close her wounds, or even to stand on midair. The greatest advantage to using this, however, is that it allows her to attack her opponents from every angle and hit enemies even when they are hiding somewhere out of Yae's vision while keeping herself at a distance safe from harm. Using this technique requires that she wears rings with steel wires within them. Yae is the only shinobi in the present day capable of using this technique,''“How perceptive. Of course, this isn’t just any~ old sewing thread, y’know? This is what’s known as a shinobi technique. Though, I’ve never seen anyone else who can use it except me.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40]], Chapter 3, Section 11.''Even among the shinobi, known for their skills far surpassing the human realm, only the Crimson Sakura, Yae Tenzen, had mastered the Steel Thread Technique, an art proper of the greatest illusionists and warriors, which utilized the killing armaments produced by the Master of Curse Tools, Groovy Gumlet.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40]], Chapter 4, Section 3. and according to Al, due to how much strength and proper control is required to use even one of these rings, the fact that she can use ten so masterfully is nothing short of incredible. On top of this, she is capable of using another ten with her toes and one with her tongue. **'''Steel Thread Iaido''': A technique based off of the art of iaido, a quick draw technique used by katana wielders, Yae gathers several of her strings, compresses her strings together, and swings her strings extremely swiftly, moving at an opponent fast enough that most would be unable to defend against. Even among the few shinobi who were able to use the Steel Thread Technique in the past, only Yae, a genius among geniuses, had the capability to create this technique. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Observation''': Thanks to her knowledge of the human body, Yae is able to determine how someone will behave based on the slightest motions of their muscles, allowing her to respond appropriately and quickly. However, for opponents who are able to move and act faster than her, such as Wilhelm, or artificial creations that do not have muscles, such as [[Emilia]]'s Ice Soldiers, she has a harder time avoiding or countering them. ===Other=== '''Stealth''': Yae is a master of stealth. According to herself, aside from the chief of her village, there shouldn't have been many people who could notice her presence while concealed.''“Aside from the old village chief, there shouldn’t be many people who are able to notice my presence concealment―― Felt-sama, might you have done something mischievous?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 2, Section 5. ===Equipment=== *'''Kunai''': Yae carries several kunai on her person. Despite the knives being relatively short, not even being able to cleanly pierce a person's hand through, she is easily able to dispose of any enemy she faces by utilizing her precise throwing skills and masterfully targeting their weak spots, such as their heart or their forehead, killing them in seconds. *'''Steel Thread Rings''': Yae carries with her twenty-one rings with wire-like steel threads within them, ten on her fingers, ten on her toes, and one on her tongue. They are strong enough that, with enough pressure, they can easily cut through flesh and bone and sever limbs from the body or even allow her and others to stand on them without breaking. She can also make the threads divide themselves and make themselves finer than before and near invisible to the eye, and by kissing her rings, she can ignite all of her threads at once. The rings themselves were killing armaments made by [[Groovy Gumlet]]. ==Trivia== *In her first appearance, Yae's eye color was originally described as jet-black. It was changed to crimson in both the text and illustrations starting in [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40|Volume 40]]. *Yae has a named chapter in Arc 9 of the web novel and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43|light novels]]. *In Yae's initial appearance in Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, it was claimed that Yae held numerous weapons within her maid uniform.''A black knife―― the same kunai that was sticking up in the man’s forehead, was held firmly in her hand. Kunai were daggers that were unique to the west, and she had many more weapons that were hidden under her red maid uniform.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Pride and Prejudice and Zombies Part 1|Pride and Prejudice and Zombies]], Section 4. However, as it is unknown if her role was to be expanded on from that story at the time, with her apparent "demise", it is unknown if this statement still applies. *Yae's birthday was decided at a talk show held on April 5, 2026. *Olbart has suggested that if she was not already presumed dead, Yae would have been considered to become one of the Nine Divine Generals. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Royal Selection Navbox}} {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Priscilla Camp]] [[Category:Servants]] [[Category:Shinobi]] [[Category:House Barielle]] [[Category:Maids]] [[Category:Assassins]] [[Category:Arc 9 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

Black Dragon (黒龍, ''Kokuryū'') |Race = Dragon |Gender = Unknown |Hair Color = Black |Height = Over 10 meters (32'+) |Previous Affiliation = [[Stride Vollachia]] |Status = Unknown |Relatives = Unnamed dragonkin (creation) (deceased) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Ex Volume 6]] (side story)
[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35|Volume 35]] (main story)}} '''Valgren''' (バルグレン) was a [[Dragon]] that was summoned by [[Stride Vollachia]] roughly four decades before the start of the series during the events of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]. It was reduced to ash by the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon Volcanica]]. In the events of [[Arc 8]], Valgren was resurrected as an [[Undead|undead]] during the [[Great Disaster]]. Following the end of the disaster, it is unknown whether or not it escaped from death. ==Appearance== Valgren was a black-scaled three headed Dragon. Each of its heads were lined by rows of sharp fangs, and its wings had claws on them. Its size spanned over tens of meters. It had two short legs compared to its size and arms with wings attached to them. ==Personality== Valgren was a vicious, blood-crazed Dragon, consumed by hatred. Its three heads are mentioned to fight with each other when tearing apart its prey. As a Dragonhusk, it can be presumed to have lost most of the personality it had before the creation of its dragonkin. ==History== At an unknown point in time, Valgren created a dragonkin, becoming a Dragonhusk in the process. Its dragonkin would go on to perish, leaving only a skull behind. ===[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]=== Around 40 years before the main story, Valgren was summoned near the southern [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunican]] border with [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]], in the city of [[Picoutatte]], by Stride Vollachia. In order to summon the Black Dragon, Stride used the skull of its dragonkin and soaked it in the blood of numerous sacrifices, alerting the Dragon of the location of its dragonkin's remains through its survival instincts. He then proceeded to use three of his [[Stride Vollachia#Abilities|rings]], corresponding to Valgren's three souls, to bind the Dragon to his will. Out of the 500 knights sent to kill it, 50 were killed and 200 were annihilated before Valgren itself died. To cover up the fact that a Dragon was controlled by someone in Lugunica, Valgren was referred to as a Blight Dragon. Once Valgren broke free of Stride's control, it ate him and his wife, [[Melinda]], with its three heads tearing them both to pieces and feasting on their bodies. After his body was devoured, Stride's curse rings continued to influence Valgren.''“It’s no Dragon. ——It’s that bastard Stride.”'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 8]], Section 7.''Stride’s manner of evil had been to bind other’s souls with his curse tools and make them into his puppets. So, in the last of the last, that man had gotten his hands on the biggest, baddest puppet of the lot.'' [[Sword Demon Battle Ballad: Act 8]], Section 7. It was confronted by a young [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] and [[Grimm Fauzen]], who both dealt a great deal of damage to the Dragon. During combat, Grimm and Wilhelm were both seriously wounded and could barely continue the fight. Just as the battle was about to close on a disastrous end, the fortieth King of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, [[Gionis Lugunica]], appeared in the city, and with him, the Divine Dragon descended from the skies above. In a couple of minutes, Volcanica scorched Valgren away, put out the raging fired and healed all the damage the Blight Dragon had done, marking the end of the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]]. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== As a Dragon, Valgren was incredibly strong, capable of pushing a young Wilhelm to his limits while fighting it. However, compared to other Dragons introduced, its strength has not been fully explored or is not as expansive as others of its kind, having shown neither the immense range of physical nor mana-based abilities as other Dragons have. ===Physical Traits=== '''Immense Physical Strength''': Valgren was able to use a combination of its fangs, tail, and claws in close-quarters combat. Because Valgren's attacks were so powerful, even Wilhelm van Astrea attempts to parry them caused both of his shoulders to creak and some of his muscles to rupture, and just one of its blows was able to incapacitate Grimm Fauzen. ===[[Magic]]=== '''Dragon Breath''': The most common ability that Valgren had shown was its ability to breathe fire. It burned with a pale green light, and it was hot enough to burn stone. '''Flight''': As a Dragon, Valgren could use its mana to fly. ==Trivia== *According to Volume 4, Valgren was a "blight dragon", with the kanji used to refer to it denoting it as a "lesser" dragon as opposed to a more powerful Dragon counterpart, and its arrival was prophesied by the [[Dragon History Stone]]. Valgren went on to be written as a Blight Dragon, and no mention of its purported prophesied arrival was made in Sword Demon Battle Ballad, potentially meaning it may no longer be canon. *Because dragonkin did not exist during the original Comic Alive release of Sword Demon Battle Ballad, Valgren was instead summoned with the use of a fang that used the sacrifices of twenty "heaven-sent children", people with Divine Protections, to call it through unknown means. *According to Stride, Valgren had three souls, one for each head. This makes Valgren the only known lifeform in the series to have been born with multiple souls. *There is a song called the '''Subjugation of the Black Dragon''' made by [[Liliana Masquerade]] that describes the incident of the same name. She sang it for the first time during [[Arc 5]]. *Although Valgren died in Lugunica, in Arc 8, it made an appearance as a zombie, something that the undead [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] believed was only possible if one died in Vollachia. Even with the official release of Ex 6, the circumstances of Valgren's resurrection were left unanswered. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Undead]] [[Category:Zombies]] [[Category:Unknown Status]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]] [[Category:Side Story Antagonists]]

After defeating [[Wolf]] and [[Pooka]], he fled from the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] and went with Melty, [[Salum Pristis|Salum]], and Pooka to pay a visit to the group of travelling entertainers he came from. ==Appearance== Tiga's attire consists of a long violet suit with gold highlights and black pants and boots. He adorns himself with a jet-black bowl-shape hat, a purple rose on his coat, and a gold pendant that is in the shape of the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]]. ==Personality== Tiga is a young man who acts as Melty's knight. He gives off a somewhat flirtatious vibe. Even though he is a knight, he is not from the [[Royal Army]], but a guard of the [[Divine Dragon Church]] that Melty designated to accompany her. Due to not being susceptible to the effects of Melty's Evil Eye, he is with her and loves her of his own volition. However, when it comes to Melty, the atmosphere is completely different from usual, and similar to Subaru when he shows affection towards [[Emilia]], Tiga shows affection towards Melty as more than a knight as he tells his feelings towards her, though she doesn't take him seriously due to his casual demeanor. ==History== Before Tiga became a knight, he was an orphan until he was adopted by the ringleader of a group of traveling entertainers. As he was traveling, he met and befriended a girl named Melty, falling in love with her at first sight. He decided to leave the group of travelling entertainers and stay with her. Coincidentally, as the location of Faradar, the village of the Evil Eye Tribe, was intended to be a secret, he was prevented from leaving the village. Due to his Divine Protection of Insensitivity, Tiga was immune to the effects of Melty's Evil Eye of Bewitchment, but he never revealed this to her, leading her to believe that his decision to be at her side was caused by her. He stayed by Melty's side even after her village was attacked and she was separated from her family, including her brother, Salum, as well as after she started being overseen by [[Sakura Element]]. ==Abilities== '''[[Divine Protection]]''' (加護, ''Kago''): Tiga has the '''Divine Protection of Insensitivity''' (鈍感の加護, ''Donkan no Kago''). It prevents his body and mind from being interfered with by any outside influences, whether that be magical enhancements or impairments. As such, this grants him the ability to see through a cognitive disruption spell and to be immune to Melty's Evil Eye of Bewitchment. He can also maintain his sense of calm with his power, allowing him to resist negative emotions such as fear, worry, anger, and sorrow. '''Skilled Swordsman''': Tiga is considerably skilled at using a sword in combat. ==Trivia== *At a talk show held in March 2024, the author stated that he would like to introduce Tiga and Melty somewhere into the mainline story. ==Navigation== {{Lugunica Navbox}} {{Vollachia Navbox}} {{Non-Canon Navbox}} [[Category:Melty Camp]] [[Category:Divine Dragon Church]]

{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}} {{Character |Name = White Whale |Image = Hakugei Anime.png |Kanji = 白鯨 |Romaji = Hakugei |Alias = Witchbeast of the Mist (霧の魔獣, ''Kiri no Majū'') |Race = Witchbeast |Gender = |Age = 400+ |Hair Color = White |Eye Color = Yellow
Red (Attack Hue) |Height = |Birthday = |Previous Affiliation = [[Witch Cult]] |Previous Occupation = |Status = Deceased |Relatives = [[Daphne]] (creator) |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 6|Volume 6]] |Anime = [[Episode 16]]}} The '''White Whale''' (白鯨), infamously called the '''Witchbeast of the Mist''', was one of the [[Witchbeast#Three Great Witchbeasts|Three Great Witchbeasts]] created by the [[Witch]] of Gluttony, [[Daphne]]. It was one of the main antagonists of [[Arc 3]]. A monstrosity created to feed the masses with its excessive amount of meat, it has terrorized the world for centuries since the era of the [[Great Calamity]]. A menace towards merchants and travelers alike, the [[witchbeast]], commanded by the [[Witch Cult]], has overcome numerous subjugations and claimed many lives. The White Whale eventually met its end by the combined efforts of the [[Emilia Camp]], [[Anastasia Camp]], and [[Crusch Camp]] during the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], where [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] personally put an end to its life out of vengeance toward his fallen [[Theresia van Astrea|wife]]. ==Appearance== The White Whale was an enormous witchbeast that took the shape of a massive airborne whale, and it is estimated to be around fifty meters long, if not larger. It had snow-white skin and was covered in tiny hairs. Like all witchbeasts, the White Whale had a large, curved horn protruding from its forehead. It had a glowing pinkish wheel-like sigil on its back that assisted its ability to fly. Its eyes, that were usually yellow, turned into red filled with rage when it felt threatened. ==Behavior== The White Whale tended to cover an entire area around it when it floated through the sky, and it would pick off its prey quite leisurely, usually with its mist. It is also quite intelligent; rather than kill [[Natsuki Subaru]] when it had the chance after having killed the others in his escort, it instead followed after him after he ran towards the Mathers Domain, though it is unclear why. Like other witchbeasts, it can be influenced by the scent of the Witch on Subaru's person, and though it cannot be controlled by the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]], since even the [[Black Serpent]] seemed to feel its influence, albeit not by much, it is possible that the whale could feel the same influence. When threatened, it will enter its Attack Hue, create clones, and hide far in the sky, watching from a safe distance while they kill its prey. Unlike the other Great Witchbeasts, however, it is shown willing to listen to the commands of certain individuals. [[Lye Batenkaitos]], who saw it as a pet, was capable of making it obey him with the use of his Witch Factor.''“The White Whale obeys Daphne’s Witch Factor. The Rabbit, too, might obey to a certain extent.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/494741464396886016 July 31, 2014 AskFM Q&A] The Witch Cult often had it use its mist and reputation to cover up their deeds, which was never uncovered until the whale's demise. Whenever it was inactive, it would be hidden around the Great Waterfall.''“It was at the Great Waterfall.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/594856741839450112 May 3, 2015 AskFM Q&A] ==History== Following its birth approximately 400 years ago, the White Whale terrorized the world for centuries, becoming infamous for devouring merchants, entire armies sent to kill it, and even whole towns and cities. Around 385 years after its creation, the [[Great Conquest]] was organized in hopes of bringing down the White Whale once and for all. It was led by the Sword Saint of the time, Theresia van Astrea. Due in part to her [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Sword Saint|Divine Protection of the Sword Saint]] leaving her during the attempted subjugation as well as [[Pandora|outside interference]], Theresia unfortunately died, and the conquest ended in failure. Only a few survivors of the failed subjugation squad had returned relatively safely, such as [[Conwood Melahau]], who returned the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword]] to the [[House Astrea|Astrea family]] after Theresia's death.''“I didn’t depict it, but I’m sure Conwood, who represents the old men, has been apologizing to Wilhelm ever since he brought back Theresia’s sword.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/764859766657003521 Re:Zero Episode 20 Commentary] ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== The White Whale is an incredibly powerful witchbeast, so powerful that it managed to successfully evade subjugation for centuries and bring about an end to a large number of people, including the likes of a retired Sword Saint. In fact, if Subaru was not involved with its final subjugation, not only would it have entirely annihilated the entire force gathered to kill it, including Wilhelm and [[Crusch Karsten]], it would have continued to threaten the world. ===Physical Traits=== '''Thick Skin''': The White Whale had tough skin that allowed it to survive numerous physical assaults. Although not impenetrable, it could withstand being attacked by numerous strong fighters while taking relatively small damage. It also allowed it to survive being crushed by the massive weight of a fallen [[Flugel's Tree]], though it was still trapped beneath it. However, this did not provide it a perfect defense. Warriors on the level of Wilhelm van Astrea could still deal unto it great harm and make it feel threatened. Likewise, it could use its massive body to crush its enemy under its weight as well, although it usually had no need to do so. '''White Hairs''': Across the White Whale's body were white hairs that scattered magical energy from incoming [[magic]] attacks. By doing so, it could reduce the force and the amount of damage it could sustain from magic. It was because of this that it could survive an entire magic bombardment and survive a strike from [[Crusch Karsten]]'s magic and still survive and remain in the air. This being said, it did not provide the beast a perfect defense against magic. It still received damage and shed blood after being attacked with an entire onslaught of magic, and the damage accumulated was enough to make the White Whale feel threatened. '''Large Maw''': Although not usually necessary for the White Whale to attack, the beast has a massive mouth that can easily tear through the ground, and while it did not attack often in this manner, it could easily swallow any warrior unfortunate enough to fall in its path. '''Pores''': Across the White Whale's entire body, it had pores that allowed it to generate its signature mist. ===Other=== '''Mist Manipulation''': The While Whale is able to freely manipulate the mist that it generates, utilizing it both for offense and for other purposes. *'''Mist of Diffusion''' (拡散型の霧, ''Kakusan-gata no Kiri'')/'''Mist of Mental Contamination''' (精神汚染する霧, ''Seishin'osen suru Kiri''):Both the author and [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7|Volume 7]] denote that the White Whale has two types of mist, and both consistently use "annihilation". However, the mist types of "mental contamination" and "diffusion" were different between sources. Despite this, each of the mists' effects are present among the White Whale's abilities. By releasing its modified [[mana]], the White Whale produced a mist that it could use to freely swim around in. This ability essentially provided the beast with the ability of flight, giving it free reign over the skies, and the speed granted to it allowed it to easily keep up with and nearly outpace an [[Dragon#Earth Dragons|earth dragon]]. By expanding the range of its mist, it can increase the area from which it can swim.''The White Whale, called the Witchbeast of the Mist, had mist that broadly fell into two varieties. The first was the Mist of Diffusion it scattered to expand its own swimming area, such as what it had used to cover the highway. And the second was the Mist of Annihilation, which had erased a good chunk of the ground before his eyes just then.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7]], Chapter 3, Section 5. People who are exposed to the mist that has been spread by the White Whale receive an experience akin to mana poisoning. Likewise, those people also experienced mental pain, such as hearing the sounds of pain on a chalkboard.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/764860081762545664 Re:Zero Episode 20 Commentary] Some people would experience it worse than others, with some people tearing at their own faces. Others, meanwhile, could resist it but visibly grimace at the pain. *'''Mist of Annihilation''' (消滅型の霧, ''Shōmetsu-gata no Kiri''/消滅する霧, ''Shōmetsu suru Kiri''): The White Whale was capable of weaponizing bursts of its mist with enough power to tear chunks out of the ground. Anyone stricken by this attack is not just physically erased, but even their names and memories are wiped from existence, leaving them forgotten to the world, akin to the victims of the [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]]. [[File:Re Zero INFINITY CG 48.png|thumb|right|250px|The White Whale using its clones.]] *'''Mist Clones''': When it felt that its life was in danger and entered its Attack Hue, the White Whale would create two clones of itself from its mist while it rose higher to the sky and out of danger. The clones lacked the original's full power, splitting its power and weight, but they were still strong enough to take down any opponents. Regardless of how much damage the clones received, they did not reflect onto the original's body. However, once the Whale itself died, the clones completely vanished. '''Sky Swimming''': The White Whale's biology allowed for it to naturally swim in the sky. ==Trivia== *Like Lye, the White Whale was likely inspired by or represents the constellation of Caelus. **The White Whale may also have been loosely based off of Moby Dick, the white whale from the book of the same name by Herman Melville. *According to the author, [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]], [[Ram]], [[Regulus Corneas|Regulus]], [[Sekhmet]], and [[Puck]] are capable to taking down the White Whale by themselves.''"Reinhard, Ram, Regulus, Sekhmet, and serious Puck. Even though they are like dango under Reinhard, these guys are capable of bringing down the White Whale by themselves."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473455745506476032 June 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A] As [[Reid Astrea]] is also said to have the capacity to behead all of the aforementioned characters besides Reinhard,''"Yesterday, I gave the power rankings of the five people among the current characters, but with the exception of Reinhard, he can behead all of them."'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/473616808612999168 June 3, 2014 AskFM Q&A] he could assumedly also slay the White Whale singlehandedly. *The White Whale was not in the original plan for Arc 3's story.''"Even for Arc 3, the White Whale wasn't in the original plan but I added it afterward, so I change and rewrite it each time."'' Re:Zero 10th Anniversary Twitter Space. *According to the author, after its head was used to confirm its death, it was rendered to bone and stored away in a corner of the [[Royal Castle]].''"The head was used when their claim was evaluated, and afterwards it was rendered to bone and stored in a corner of the royal castle. After a while, if they make a museum, it might get put on display. The main body was burned, and the great tree became lumber."'' AskFM Q&A. ==References== {{References}} ==Note== [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Arc 3 Antagonists]]

Throwing Knives |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 26|Volume 26]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Todd Fang''' (トッド・ファング) is a former soldier in the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] who held the rank of Private First-Class and [[Katya Aurélie]]'s husband. Debuting in the beginning of [[Arc 7]], Todd, alongside [[Jamal Aurélie]], originally played a supporting role. However, he grew to be a recurring and bitter enemy of [[Natsuki Subaru]], even into the beginning of [[Arc 8]]. Todd lives his life in fear and paranoia on account of his hidden background, exacting whatever means necessary to ensure his perceived welfare. Throughout Arc 7, he engaged in various skirmishes with Subaru, including after he was appointed as [[Arakiya]]'s subordinate. At the beginning of the [[Great Disaster]], he made one last attempt to defeat Subaru and failed, resulting in him being defeated by [[Emilia|two]] [[Rem|of]] his foe's [[Emilia Camp|comrades]] and subsequently washed away in a flood. Despite this, it seems that he managed to emerge from the flood, and following the disaster, he married and eloped with Katya. ==Appearance== Todd is a young man with short, bright, and spiky orange hair that is kept in place with a headband with armor attached beneath it.''That hard sound had probably been from armor that he had placed under his bandana. That was how he had taken Medium’s blow. Of course, he was not completely unscathed.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 110, Section 2. He possesses green eyes and noticeably sharp canine teeth. He is noted to likely be a bit older than Subaru. As per all Imperial Soldiers who are not Generals, Todd can be seen sporting Vollachia's standard military uniform issued to members of the Imperial Army, consisting of a red undershirt with long sleeves, a grey overshirt with short sleeves, and black pants as well as black boots, black gloves, a chest protector, and shoulder pads, all of which have small, red stripes on them. His head is adorned with a headband of the same red and black color pallet as the rest of his army attire. On his left side, Todd also straps a small red and black battle axe, which he uses instead of a standard sword seen being used with most other lower-ranked soldiers. Todd Bowl Cut LN.png|Todd's hair in a bowl cut. Todd Beast form LN.png|Todd's beast form after utilizing Beastification. Without his headband on, Todd keeps his hair worn in a bowl cut that covers the sides and back of his head, only having parts of his bangs cut in front of his eyes to allow him to see. As Todd is a halfbeast, when he utilizes the Beastification given to him by his half-wolf human blood, he can become a giant wolf beast with orange and while fur all across his body, a round, black nose, large ears, sharp white teeth, deep green eyes, as well as a large maw. ==Personality== Todd initially presented himself as a very friendly and open individual, who faithfully follows orders and is extremely kind, friendly, and outgoing towards people around him. However, it soon turned out that Todd was a far more ruthless, sinister, and twisted individual than he appeared. He will manipulate or order everyone to get what he wants and needs, including from Jamal, who he has a close relationship with, and Arakiya, a superior who outclasses him in both rank and power. He is observant and meticulous, going as far as to stab Subaru in the shoulder because he didn't like his gaze and correctly concluded Subaru was trying to deceive him. Even though he originally acted very kindly towards Subaru, it was revealed that Todd was in fact always suspicious of Subaru from the very second the two met.[[The Land of the Wolves / Death unto the Weak, Mercy be None 2]] Todd is also prepared to go to extreme lengths in order to get his way, as seen when he tested if a slaughtered [[witchbeast]] was poisonous enough to kill someone and giving it to the other soldiers after mixing it in water, killing said soldiers in order to avoid repercussions, and brutally slaughtering numerous innocent civilians in the [[Guaral|Fortress City of Guaral]] while targeting Subaru's life in numerous failed loops. He was even willing to sacrifice his friend and future brother-in-law so that he could make a successful escape from his enemies, as well as kill every resident of an island and ruthlessly murder children without remorse. Todd has claimed that he hates the way Vollachians behave,''"You’re the only one who does things according to the way of the Empire. It’s absolutely sickening."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 3. as he believes that giving up one's life, and especially so for another person, is a pointless endeavor, despite the fact that he also behaves in a survival of the fittest way. He has personally admitted to Subaru that some degree of his actions are based out of fear. If Todd finds himself in an unfavorable position, then he will often run away out of cowardice or choose not to act, such as when he initially attempted to escape from Guaral after its seizure. However, even if Todd is internally frightened, he will attempt to appear externally stronger in order to match the way of the Empire. At times when things terrify him, he will either attempt to kill that thing as soon as possible or avoid it at all costs, as he treats Subaru, whose existence completely terrifies him.''It was terrifying. So, the only thing he could think about afterwards was to kill that man at any cost whenever the opportunity arose. However, once it had become clear that said goal was unobtainable, Todd immediately abandoned his plan to exterminate him, instead choosing to stay away from that pest. It was best not to get involved.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 1. Subaru has appraised Todd as scum comparable to the [[Witch Cult]]'s Sin Archbishops.''From what he recalled, Sin Archbishops were not good people either but when compared to Todd, they still had some charm, was what it seemed like. No, it did not seem like that. No matter what they were compared to, scum remained scum.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 72, Section 2. Despite his cautious and cowardly nature and his habit of probing every possible loophole that could be exploited, he does not consider himself to be particularly cautious or meticulous.''――Todd Fang did not consider himself to be particularly cautious or meticulous. The result of him single-mindedly probing things as if were “a matter of course” was to close every conceivable loophole, to cover all potential outcomes, and to assume the worst in order to reduce missteps to the extent of one’s capabilities.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 1. His primary motivator to safely return home to Katya, who he believes is the one thing he cannot risk losing. Todd does not wish to neglect Katya, yet he finds her to be a flawed and loveable "item". ==History== Five years before the start of the main story, Todd was a bandit in the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]]. After the destruction of the city resulting from the [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]] some years prior, numerous factions of bandits came into the city under one union and interfered with the rebuilding process. Todd, being one of their leaders, wanted to quit being a bandit and join the Imperial Army as a respected soldier from the very start of his tenure by gathering all of the other bandit leaders and turning them in. However, Jamal Aurélie, a soldier who was stationed in Garkla at that time, ended up slaying one of the other leaders, causing the bandits to lose their morale and end their assault on Garkla. Todd, having quit being a bandit after his plan was foiled, later met Jamal. At some point in the future, Todd was introduced to Jamal's younger sister, Katya, and she became his fiancée a year later. ===[[Sword Identity Part 1|Sword Identity]]=== Roughly two to three months before the start of the main story, Todd and Jamal were talking about the revolt that started at that point in time by [[Yorna Mishigure]], the 7th ranking Diving General. During this conversation, Jamal talked about how he heard a rumor about testing people in the subjugation of Yorna's rebellion in order to see who would take the place of the [[Balleroy Temeglyph|former 9th ranking Divine General]]. After Jamal was asked about his source, he revealed that he had heard it from a few people who fled from a fortress that Yorna had attacked. After taking the time to gather more information, the two later captured the fled soldiers to turn them in as prisoners and helped to bring an end to the rebellion, though they received no reward for their contributions. ==Abilities== ===Overall Power=== Todd is weak, and he is aware of it. Precisely because he is weak, Todd is ruthless, and he is willing to take any action to preserve his life or to kill anyone or anything that threatens his life. This makes him incredibly dangerous and easily capable of becoming responsible for large numbers of civilian, combatant, and even ally deaths, which he has shown in several failed loops. Furthermore, with his intelligence, he is able to strike at dangerous elements plaguing him and the side he chooses with ease, and because he is aware of his weakness, he does not take any unnecessary actions, willing to flee if necessary. ===[[Divine Protection]]=== '''[[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Ambushing|Divine Protection of Ambushing]]''' (騙し討ちの加護, ''Damashiuchi no Kago''): Although its exact effects are unknown, this Divine Protection enables werewolves to be difficult to find by other people, effectively making them vanish right before another person's eyes upon use. It is capable of allowing Todd to silently bypass [[Otto Suwen]]'s Divine Protection,''While his channel was focused, he had remained vigilant. So how had this man managed to avoid Otto’s monitoring of “voices”?'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 3. and in the Azamuku IF, it even allowed him to sneak up on and ambush someone as powerful and proficient in stealth as [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]]. However, even without his Divine Protection, Todd has shown himself to be excellent at hiding his presence. ===Intelligence=== '''Keen Intellect''': The ability that makes Todd so dangerous is his intellect. He is extremely attentive and calculative, always approaching a situation while using logical reasoning and being two steps ahead of both his enemies and allies, which him to devise deadly traps and strategies to dispatch his foes without being forced to personally cross weapons with them. Depending on the target's supposed threat, Todd isn't afraid of causing collateral damage. During one failed loop, he sent a rogue dragon carriage zooming down the streets, killing tens of innocents as well as Subaru. In the following loop, he set a pub ablaze, once again killing innocents, just so he could kill Subaru. After joining forces with Arakiya, he managed to scare lesser spirits into his submission through under the threat of being devoured, expressing zero hesitation in exerting his will over them in order to use their abilities to his advantage in combat when necessary.''"There’s more than one way to get them to comply. If they don’t want to be eaten, that is."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 23. He is also quite observant, able to determine the hiding spots of traps based on the feeling of the earth beneath his feet, the smell of smoke, and the location of a previous explosion.''Ascertaining the feeling of the ground beneath his feet, where the explosion had occurred, the man sniffed the black smoke rising from the burnt grass, and spoke, "There, and there. And then, over there."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 102, Section 3. '''Keen Orientation''': Todd has been mentioned to easily be able to memorize a place or building's layout and geography by simply being there once. With this skill, Todd is very proficient at infiltrating places he's already been to and planning ambushes on his own soil. ===Physical Traits/Flow Method=== '''Beastification''' (獣化, ''Kemonoka''): As a halfbeast of half-wolf human lineage, Todd has the ability to transform himself into a large orange wolf beast. '''Enhanced Senses''': Todd has displayed above average proficiency with multiple senses, presumably because of his half-wolf human blood. *'''Enhanced Vision''': Todd possesses extremely enhanced eyesight. When Subaru was burning the Imperial flag after having captured Guaral, Todd was able to pick out his face from the other side of the city and see through his crossdressing disguise to determine that the Imperial Soldiers have been taken in by the “dancers” by using his unique ability.''Unlike Todd, Jamal was unaware of the identity of the person who had set the Imperial Flag on fire. Due to the distance, his eyes could not perceive any details on the roof of the City Hall. Todd could see it only because of his special eyes. And it was because he could see them, that he was holding Jamal back.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 24, Section 3. Todd also seems to use this ability when hunting Subaru prior to the [[Fall of Guaral]], as if he is able to see and track Subaru consistently from completely out of sight. *'''Enhanced Olfaction''': Todd possesses an extremely advanced sense of smell. Although Todd is not able to smell miasma, he possesses the ability to pinpoint someone's specific body odor.''“Miasma? Ah, no, that’s not it, that’s not it, don’t get the wrong idea. It really does smell, your body odor. I have a bit of a good nose. That’s why it’s so strange.”'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 73, Section 3. He has been able to use this in order to pinpoint an individual who he believed was related to Subaru at the time, despite not knowing the two were one and the same. ===Equipment=== *'''Battle Axe''': Todd can usually be seen wielding a short battle axe and is stated to be very skilled with it, more-so than the average Imperial Soldier. With it, and the small quantity of enhanced physical strength he receives from his half-wolf human lineage, he is able to swiftly dispatch foes with deadly accuracy and surprising amount of force. Despite perhaps not appearing as menacing as some other soldiers, Todd's proficiency in killing others with his axe is not to be underestimated. *'''Throwing Knives''': As demonstrated during the witchbeast ambush, Todd is capable of quickly and accurately throwing knives, even when under heavy pressure. ==Trivia== *Originally, Todd's rank in the Imperial Army was lower than the rank Jamal held.''"Sorry, but I outrank that guy. I listened to his request as a favor, but there’s no reason I gotta comply."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 8, Section 2. However, Todd's rank was later changed to be a Private First-Class, the same as Jamal's.''"...It’s Private First-Class, Todd Fang, General First-Class Arakiya."'' [[The Land of the Wolves / Death unto the Weak, Mercy be None 3]], Section 1.''“Sorry? Oh, you mean the social standing of my family or my army title? Well, I wasn’t born into a great family, and I’m the lowest ranking soldier. But, I suppose this promotion would make me a Private First-Class, don’t you agree?''" [[The Land of the Wolves / Death unto the Weak, Mercy be None 5]], Section 3. *Todd has his own named chapter in Arc 8 of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)#Arc 8: Vincent Vollachia|web novel]], which is also the shortest chapter written to date. In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (light novel)|light novel]], it was adapted as an interlude, though it was not listed on [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 34|Volume 34]]'s table of contents. *Although it is not confirmed if the identity of the individual in question is Todd, during the Kodoku, a deathmatch between thirty-one [[shinobi]] with the low rank of genin in which only one person was to survive at its end, a participant spoke in a manner of speech resembling his.''“――My bad, my bad.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 3. Of the genin who participated, only his life was spared by the Kodoku's victor, [[Yae Tenzen]], a fellow genin. He suggested the possibility of escaping alongside her, to which she denied, believing that she the future she died in would be at his side.''That peer had suggested “Ahh, in that case, you also gonna flee with me?” to her, but Yae firmly refused his offer. It was not that she had wished to remain in the village, but that she simply had not wished to stand alongside him. In terms of skill, Yae was vastly superior. And yet, her instincts were alarming her. ――If death were to ever come for Yae, it would be when she stood by his side.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 3. Though the genin wished to eradicate her for knowing about his survival, he rationalized that his goal was infeasible and escaped by himself, becoming a runaway shinobi,''And so, when that peer of hers took his leave and gave those parting words, she sensed his desire to eliminate every person who knew of his existence, but thanks to him being rational enough to abandon that goal, Yae and that fellow genin made it out of this “Kodoku” as the final survivors.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 2, Section 3. while Yae claimed that he had been killed along with the other shinobi who participated in the deathmatch. Furthermore, the traits of Todd's speech in question resemble not only the aforementioned genin, but also those of Olbart Dunkelkenn. ==References== {{References}} ==Note== ==Navigation== {{Vollachia Navbox}} [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Imperial Army]] [[Category:Demi-Human]] [[Category:Beast Human]] [[Category:Human Hybrids]] [[Category:Divine Protection Holders]] [[Category:Unknown Status]] [[Category:Arc 7 Antagonists]] [[Category:Arc 8 Antagonists]]

Purple (dyed) |Eye Color = Green |Height = |Weight = |Affiliation = [[Vollachia Empire]]
People of Shudrak |Previous Affiliation = |Occupation = |Previous Occupation = |Status = Alive |Relatives = [[Mariuli Shudrak]] (mother) |Magic = |Divine Protection = |Authority = |Weapon = Bow |Equipment = |Light Novel = [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 26|Volume 26]] |Manga = |Anime = |Game = |Japanese Voice = |English Voice = }} '''Utakata Shudrak''' (ウタカタ・シュドラク) is a member of the [[Terminology#Races and Clans/Tribes|People of Shudrak]] located in the depths of the Buddheim Jungle, within the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. She played a lesser supporting role in [[Arc 7]]. ==Appearance== Utakata is a small child with brown skin and green eyes. Her hair is black with tips that are dyed a peach color. She's noted to be about ten years of age. ==Personality== Utakata was shown to be rather wary of outsiders, likely due to being taught not to interact with people who are not part of the People of Shudrak. She displayed interest in both [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent]], observing them from a distance while they were incarcerated. After the duo passed the Ritual of Blood by defeating the Elgina, Utakata warmed up to Vincent and especially to Subaru. Later on, she showed to be able to quickly befriend other children, [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] and [[Spica]], with ease. Likewise, she is willing to help her friends by achieve their goals; she helped Spica sneak onto a carriage heading to [[Chaosflame]] because she wanted to stay with Subaru. She also views life and death similarly to the rest of her people; she is not averse to combat, and despite her own [[Mariuli Shudrak|mother]]'s death, which she witnessed with her own eyes, she not only accepted that it happened without a shred of sadness, but she even helped one of her people, [[Taritta Shudrak]], from being accused of killing her. ==History== Utakata was born to the [[Stargazer]], Mariuli Shudrak. As a Shudrakian, she was raised as a hunter. When Mariuli killed herself through Taritta's knife, Utakata was there and saw the whole debacle, and she was the one to defend Taritta by saying that her mother did it to herself. ==Abilities== '''Marksman''': Despite her age, Utakata is very skilled with the bow. Due to her lack of strength, however, she's opted to use poisonous arrows rather than normal ones. Despite this "handicap", she was easily capable of dispatching Subaru in a failed loop with one single shot. Utakata is also stated to be more skilled with the bow than [[Kuna Shudrak|Kuna]]. ==Navigation== {{Vollachia_Navbox}} [[Category:People of Shudrak]]
