title: White Dragon's Scales
wikitext:
[[File:White Dragon's Scales Light Novel Design.png|thumb|225px]]
The '''White Dragon's Scales''' (白竜の鱗, ''Hakuryū no Uroko'') are a mercenary group currently employed by [[Kiritaka Muse]]. The group debuted in [[Arc 5]].

==Information==
The White Dragon's Scales are a veteran mercenary group of around ten men that is currently working to gain funds for their homeland, which is affected by the [[Black Serpent]]'s poison.<ref>''An endemic disease had broken out several years ago where they’d been born, with the contamination in the soil being pinned as the cause behind it. They needed a lot of money to mend the soil. The endemic disease was a strange kind, in which the bodies of people afflicted by it would gradually turn into something like stone, until finally, completely turning into actual stone ――It was a diabolical endemic that occurred in lands defiled by a certain Witchbeast.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 17.</ref><ref>''“The aftereffects of the Black Serpent spreading its pestilence.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 17.</ref> One day, they were betrayed by a member of the group, who stole the funds they had for himself. At [[Liliana Masquerade|Liliana]]'s suggestion, Kiritaka decided to hire them to protect his wealth, and in return, he would use the Muse Company to provide funds for mending their homeland's contaminated soil.<ref>''“So, how about this, I’ll employ everyone from the White Dragon's Scales. As for the contaminated soil in their homeland, the Muse Company shall take care of all the funds and materials required.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 17.</ref>

Each member wears white robe-like coats with the design of a dragon's horn on its hood, and they are all armed with two short swords. Although the group is made up of expert fighters, they were no match for [[Lye Batenkaitos]], which resulted in at least four members becoming the victims of the Sin Archbishop. Following Lye's death at the end of [[Arc 6]], the status of the four men still remains unknown.

==History==
The White Dragon's Scales had amassed a fortune in an effort to restore their homeland from the effects of the Black Serpent's pestilence. However, the man responsible for safekeeping what they owned stole it for himself and built a mansion in the town of Warwar, where he hid the fortune. The mercenaries located his whereabouts and were planning to get their money back until he discovered their intentions and hid the money in a cave behind a [[meteor]] door, teaching Liliana Masquerade, a bard who was visiting the village, the song that was the key to open the door, and with the meteor's effects, made it so that nobody who sung the song other than her could open the door. As a result, the mercenaries pursued Liliana for some time before her visit to [[Roswaal Manor]] in an attempt to reclaim their money.

===[[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 1|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]]===
While Liliana, alongside [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Rem]], was attempting to retrieve luggage that she had left in [[Arlam Village]] while visiting the mansion, they encountered four men wearing white clothing blocking the entrance to the village. They approached Subaru with weapons in hand and attempted to launch an attack, but Rem easily sent the men flying with her fists. The men, carrying the comrades who had been rendered unconscious, retreated afterwards. With [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]]'s approval, she took temporary refuge at the mansion afterwards. For three days, an unrelated group of thugs launched over thirty attacks, and each time they were repelled by Rem, until the white-clothed men attacked them again and were also defeated by the maid. After Subaru and [[Beatrice]] resolved the issue with the thugs and captured them and their employer, [[Kiritaka Muse]], he and Liliana went to prepare the latter's things, only for the white-clothed mercenaries to knock the two out. As they came to, their representative, [[Dynas Trussardi]], who did not name himself to them, apologized for the rough treatment the two faced and introduced their group, the White Dragon's Scales. 

Dynas revealed the circumstances that led them to needing Liliana. However, when they reached the door, she refused to abide by their wishes because she did not want to sing a song in a context different from how she believed they were meant to be enjoyed. Resisting attempts at persuasion from the other mercenaries, Subaru proposed to Dynas that his restraints be loosened so he could talk to Liliana. Dynas accepted, and Subaru had the man come with him to speak to Liliana. He ended up agreeing with Liliana's logic, rousing anger in the mercenaries other than Dynas, who was panicking over the reactions of his comrades, until suggesting that they dig around the wall instead. Eventually, [[Ram]] came to inform them of the results of her investigation, confirming the identities of the mercenaries, that the old man who betrayed them had died of illness a few days ago, and that the locations of two items he purchased had yet to be confirmed. The first was the door meteor, but before she could say what the second was, a roar shook the cave, and she said that it was the second thing the old man bought, a [[Witchbeast#Sturdy Ape|Lauda]] [[witchbeast]] he had procured from the black market.

Dynas ordered a retreat due to their inability to engage with the Lauda. As he was fleeing the cave, he caught sight of Subaru and Liliana, with the latter of whom wanting to retrieve the Lyulyre case from her mother still near the door, and told them it was still in there. Though Subaru managed to retrieve it for Liliana, after [[Emilia]] arrived at the scene and [[Puck]] slew the Lauda, the cave began to collapse due to the witchbeast, with the fortune still inside. Without the chance to reclaim their lost funds, the White Dragon's Scales were left at a loss, unable to provide aid to their families in their homeland that was affected by the Black Serpent. At Liliana's suggestion Kiritaka decided to hire them, offering to have the Muse Company be responsible for removing the contamination of the soil. Liliana offering to do something to thank Subaru for retrieving her Lyulyre case, so he requested her to sing a song. She chose to perform The Sky Overtaking the Morning Glow, causing the people around her, including the mercenaries, to be moved to tears. Once everything was said and done, Kiritaka and the White Dragon's Scales set out for Priestella, with Liliana deciding to join them until she had a clear idea when the mercenaries' debts would be paid.

===[[Battle for Priestella]]===
The White Dragon's Scales continued to serve Kiritaka for the following year. During the [[Battle for Priestella]], [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]] invaded the Muse Company to retrieve Kirtaka, and he abided by her request, entrusting [[Anastasia Hoshin]] with the defense of the city while he and the mercenaries stayed behind. Kiritaka was abducted by Sirius, but she did not harm the mercenaries who had been with him. Several of the White Dragon's Scales members also gave Otto the chance to escape when he initially came across Gluttony. Later, while searching for Kiritaka, five of the White Dragon's Scales members encountered and engaged in combat with Lye Batenkaitos alongside Otto, [[Gaston]], [[Felt]], and Beatrice. Four of them were eaten, with the fifth one, Dynas, escaping with substantial injuries.

title: Roswaal Manor
wikitext:
[[File:Roswaals_Mansion_HQ.jpg|thumb|300px]]
'''Roswaal Manor''' (ロズワール邸, ''Rozuwāru-tei'') is the name given to two mansions owned by [[Roswaal L. Mathers]]. One of them, dubbed the '''old Roswaal Manor''' (旧ロズワール邸, ''Kyū Rozuwāru-tei''), was a reserve mansion located near [[Arlam Village]], and it was a primary setting for the events of [[Arc 2]], [[Arc 3]], and [[Arc 4]]. The second manor, dubbed the '''new Roswaal Manor''' (新ロズワール邸, ''Shin Rozuwāru-tei''), is the main residence of [[House Mathers]], located near the [[Costuul|Industrial City of Costuul]].

In the [[Sanctuary Incident|climax]] of Arc 4, the old manor burned to the ground after [[Otto Suwen]] and [[Petra Leyte]] poured oil all over the kitchen floor and set it on fire in order to get rid of a fearsome [[Witchbeast|witchbeast]]. Following the destruction of the mansion, Roswaal and the other inhabitants of the mansion temporarily moved to Miload Manor, located close to Roswaal's auxiliary residence, before proceeding to move to his primary one.

==Information==
===Overview===
Roswaal Manor is the shared name between the two manors owned by House Mathers, and is owned by the House's current patriarch, Roswaal L. Mathers. Modelled after a mansion owned by [[Echidna]], they are practically identical to each other, sharing minimal, if any, differences besides their locations. The mansions are typically cared for by numerous servants, usually [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] servants because of Roswaal's peculiarities, though despite its size, it can be looked after with just a mere few servants at a time. As could be expected from a building so large, the majority of the rooms go unused, save for certain bedrooms, the kitchen, dining area, and the main study.

===Forbidden Library===
[[File:Roswaals Mansion - Forbidden Library 2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Forbidden Library.]]
Unique to the old Roswaal Manor, Echidna had built a room that could only be accessed only be accessed to via the Door Crossing spell utilized by [[Beatrice]]. This room, dubbed the '''Forbidden Library''' (禁書庫, ''Kinshoko''), was a massive library that was technically separate from the manor and located in the alternate Door Crossing plane. It was built with the purpose of housing Echidna's vast amount of knowledge that had been converted into Magical Books, and it came to be known as the most knowledgeable place in [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]. Appearance-wise, the library is a huge two-story space with a spiral staircase in the center of the room. The second floor consists of a large balcony which is filled to the brim with bookshelves. Tasking her to wait in the library until the arrival of [[Minor Characters#"That Person"|"That Person"]], Echidna made Beatrice the library's keeper, and she maintained this role for four centuries.

The books that were contained in the Forbidden Library varied greatly, most of which were not truly forbidden. Although it is unknown what kinds of knowledge the room possessed, things such as a recipe made by [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu Meyer]] were known to be stored here.<ref>''"Even if it is called the Forbidden Library, it is not as if absolutely everything in there was a forbidden book, I suppose. There was even a book for the meatpie recipe that Ryuzu taught Mother, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 2.</ref> However, Echidna did not leave behind records of her soul and immortality experiments in the library,<ref>''"In fact. ――Even if Mother’s research could serve as a clue, Betty has never seen any books relating to that in the Forbidden Library, I suppose. Not even a single volume, in fact."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 2.</ref> speculated by [[Natsuki Subaru]] to be out of consideration for Beatrice's loss of her first friend.<ref>''The reason why she had not left contents worthy of classifying as forbidden books in Beatrice’s Forbidden Library, that was――, "――Because of what happened with Ryuzu-san, or something."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 2.</ref><ref>''"Just maybe, your Mother wanted to hide any materials that might remind you of what happened from your sight, or something like that."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 2.</ref> According to Beatrice herself, she claims it is likely said records were left in their original home instead. Regardless, the books stored here had built-in mechanisms that would erase the knowledge from every book in the library, should Beatrice abandon her role as the Forbidden Library's librarian. This was done so people wouldn't kill Beatrice in order to get their hands on the infinite knowledge hidden in the Forbidden Library.

Ultimately, the library burned to the ground alongside the rest of the manor during the Sanctuary Incident, causing all of the knowledge stored here to be lost.

==Appearance==
The manor is a giant white house with five watchtowers, the fifth of which is standing in the center, a giant garden, and a black roof. It has a massive basement that is almost as big as the surface of the mansion itself. At the end of Arc 4, the old mansion burned down, and Roswaal, along with the members of the [[Emilia Camp]], moved to his main mansion. The new mansions closely resembles the old one that had burned down.<ref>''Viewed from the outside, the new Roswaal Manor looked just like a European-style mansion, closely resembling the old one that had burned down.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> As the main residence, it was constructed more recently, is more grandiose, and occupies more space when compared with the previous mansion.<ref>''This mansion was actually considered the main residence, and it had been constructed more recently than the one that had been lost in the fire. Accordingly, it was more grandiose and occupied more space than the countryside mansion, which likely made maintaining the grounds all the more arduous for the servants like Petra.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref>

In the web novel, its floor layout and formation is described as being roughly identical to that of the previous manor and maintained the same spaciousness, except for the basement part of the eastern wing that is starkly different. In the central building, there is a main wing that concentrates the facilities needed for daily life. The west wing contains multi-purpose facilities, such as the maids’ rooms and the guest’s rooms. The eastern wing acts as a storehouse or safe for the history and heritage of the ancient Mathers bloodline, containing items such as books.<ref>''In the central building of the mansion, there was the main center wing that concentrated the facilities needed for daily life. The west wing contained multi-purpose facilities, such as the maids’ rooms and the guest’s rooms. And then there was the eastern wing, a place that acted as a storehouse/safe for the history and heritage of the ancient Mathers bloodline, such as books.'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 3, Section 1.</ref>

===Rooms===
*'''Entry''': Upon entering, it was noted that the mansion retains great elegance. There are two pillars with a pair of lamps each. In addition to having high class designs, there are lights near each door, as well as vases with flowers. On the road, there are two routes to the sides, right and left, and stairs to go up to the next floor.
*'''Kitchen''': In that place the servants of Roswaal prepare breakfast, lunch, and dinner. It is full of plates, pots, jars, rollers, knives and other things that can be used to prepare food. In case someone needs to buy more food, they go to a market and transport the products by putting them in a barrel.
*'''Bathroom''': The bathroom can be used as a sauna and has few marble pillars in it. It has a bath in the center of the room with a golden pillar in the center of the bath.
*'''Washbasin''': It is used for personal hygiene, and it contains the same white washbasin, a toilet with a brown lid, and a mirror decorated with a golden frame.
*'''Guest's Room''': It is the place where the margrave invites their visitors to talk. It has three green pieces of furniture and a small rectangular table in the center. There are also windows with light green curtains. There is a fireplace, and above it is a portrait.
*'''Dining Room''': In the dining room, all the people in the mansion gather to eat. There is a large table covered with a white tablecloth, with chairs on each side, and regardless of the time, lights are placed on the table. The wall is green with white spaces. Behind the table is a figure in a painting, possibly a relative of the Roswaal family.
*'''Forbidden Library''' (禁書庫, ''Kinshoko''): The Forbidden Library was a massive library built by the Witch of Greed with the purpose of housing her vast knowledge converted into Magical Books, exclusively in the old Roswaal Manor.
*'''Garden''': The garden is located on the outskirts of the mansion. There are several paths one can walk along. On the sides are small fields full of flowers, as well as some trees and bushes, and several rest areas.
*'''Dungeon''': After going down a staircase that leads beneath the new manor, there is a dungeon. Though called a dungeon, after [[Meili Portroute|Meili]] was imprisoned in it, it became closer to a young girl's room rather than a real dungeon, containing various decorations, including numerous stuffed animals.

==History==
===Old Roswaal Manor===
The manor was originally created by Roswaal A. Mathers, basing it off of the appearance of his teacher’s original manor. Similarly, the Witch of Greed Echidna created the Forbidden Library and stored most of the knowledge she had gathered here. Beatrice, who had been created by said Witch, was left responsible for its maintenance and protection until the day "That Person" arrived. With the passage of time, the mansion’s ownership was passed along to each successive margrave, until eventually, Roswaal L. Mathers took over the title. During this time, he took in numerous demi-humans, gave them a job and education, and when their training ended, he would send them to work at another mansion.<ref>''Just like Rem and the others, they were found by Roswaal with no place to go, and they were trained to work as maids at the mansion. Their training ended, and these girls, who were deemed to have adequate skills as maids, were now being sent out to service at another mansion.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 3, Section 4.</ref> He eventually hired [[Frederica Baumann]] as his maid, and he brought in both [[Ram]] and [[Rem]] to work as his maids and to accomplish his future goals after having saved them from their burning village. At one point, two months after bringing in the twins, he left Rem alone at the manor, where she confronted one of the attackers of the village that Roswaal had imprisoned in the basement, [[Fogg]], who she ultimately killed. Following the deaths of [[Dudley Miload|Dudley]] and [[Grace Miload]] about a month later, [[Clind]] and Frederica were sent to serve the newborn [[Annerose Miload]] and continue Roswaal's hobby of training servants there, leaving only Rem and Ram as his servants.<ref>''The Miload family, which lost the married couple who were the head of it, stayed alive thanks to Roswaal becoming a guardian. However, because of the incident that happened, many servants died and many resigned, and as a result, Clind and Frederica were to be sent to the Miload residence so that it could be maintained. On top of that, the job training for demi-humans that was carried out at the Mathers residence would have to take place at the Miload residence from now on. Thus, the Mathers residence would be left with the bare minimum number of workers ── in other words, Rem and Ram would stay with Roswaal as his attendants.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Epilogue, Section 1.</ref> In this time, he seemingly took in other servants to work for him. Later, he took [[Emilia]] under his wing as his [[Terminology#Story Specific|Book of Wisdom]] had stated her necessity. While here, she would study for the [[Royal Selection]] to become the future monarch. A couple of months before Emilia [[Loot House Incident|lost her insignia]], many of the servants of House Mathers were let go, with only Rem and Ram remaining once again.

When Emilia brought Natsuki Subaru to the manor as a guest after he helped her with her lost insignia and saved her life, he opted to work as a butler, helping the maids with the activities. Though Ram kept an eye on him, she did not believe him to be a spy. Meanwhile, Rem was hiding her hostility towards him. As for Beatrice, she was often left annoyed with him with as often as he visited her. Naturally, everyone was unaware that Roswaal orchestrated the events that would lead Subaru here. A few days after Subaru’s arrival, Roswaal went to attend some business, leaving the responsibility of taking care of the manor to the boy. Meanwhile, Subaru and Beatrice learned of the existence of some form of curse arts user, which appeared to be a dog, through the curse that was placed on Subaru. Armed with his knowledge, he, with the help of the maids, managed to fight off the pack of Wolgarms until Roswaal’s arrival to finish them off. This allowed Subaru to gain the maids’ trust.

After a visit from [[Ferris]], and after having held a conference in the [[Royal Capital]], Subaru stayed at the Karsten mansion. Rem decided to accompany him. Roswaal once again attended some affairs at the [[Sanctuary]]. Beatrice stayed longer in the library, Ram had to do double work due to the absence of her sister, and Emilia was by herself. A few days later, Subaru returned with some merchants in order to evacuate half the people from the nearby village to the Royal Capital and the other half to the Sanctuary, all to face the [[Witch Cult]]. Due to her contract, Beatrice remained in the mansion. Meanwhile, Ram called Frederica to take care of things in her absence.

There was a series of consequences as a result from Rem being erased from existence, such as the girl’s belongings vanishing from the room she slept in and the residents’ memories of her being completely erased. When Subaru returned accompanied by Emilia and Otto Suwen, Frederica acted as the head maid, and Petra Leyte accompanied her in her work as an apprentice. Soon after, Subaru’s group left for the Sanctuary, leaving the sleeping Rem under the maids’ care. A few days later, Subaru, Otto, and [[Garfiel Tinzel]] returned from the Sanctuary to the mansion, where they confronted [[Elsa Granhiert]], as well as a few witchbeasts controlled by Meili Portroute, unleashing a chaotic battle that little by little damaged the manor. Subaru’s group was even forced to use fire to fend off the Guiltylowe, causing the manor to burn. With Meili captured, Elsa killed, and Subaru making a contract with Beatrice, everyone left the burning manor. 

===New Roswaal Manor===
Ever since the destruction of the old manor, the Emilia Camp has primarily resided at the new Roswaal Manor. A year after the previous manor’s burning, the Camp met with a representative of the [[Anastasia Camp]], [[Joshua Juukulius]], who invited Emilia to the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]]. While Emilia’s group left for the city, Roswaal took Petra to a conference with the other nobles of the Mathers Domain. Approximately a month later, everyone returned, with Emilia’s group bringing along [[Anastasia Hoshin]], who was controlled by [[Eridna]] at the time, and [[Julius Juukulius]], who had his name eaten. Informing Roswaal of their intentions, Emilia, Subaru, Beatrice, Ram, Rem, Meili, Julius, and Eridna left for the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], leaving Roswaal, Petra, and Frederica to watch over the manor.

Shortly after the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|events]] at the Watchtower, everyone in the group sans Subaru and Rem had returned to the manor to inform Roswaal of the missing Subaru’s predicament. Taking this matter with the utmost seriousness, everyone left the manor to prepare to leave for [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]], leaving Meili with Annerose Miload to go to the Royal Capital and having Clind take his group to retrieve Otto and Garfiel. Meanwhile, [[Sylphy Elmart]] and the other former wives of [[Regulus Corneas]], who had become maids for Roswaal Manor, were left to attend to the residence while everyone was away.

After the events of the [[Great Disaster]], Rem and Ram returned to the manor while the others went elsewhere. Though, a couple of days after Subaru [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|sealed Al away]], he was brought to the manor by [[Reinhard van Astrea]] to pick them up. Afterward, despite being summoned to the castle, Roswaal, Frederica, the Ryuzus and the servants all vanished from the residence, leaving it effectively empty.

[[File:Emilia Camp in Priestella S3 anime PV2.png|thumb|250px]]
The '''Emilia Camp''' (エミリア陣営, ''Emiria Jin'ei'') is a [[Royal Selection]] team that is led by [[Emilia]].

==Information==
Emilia wants to be the monarch in order to melt the frozen lands of the [[Elior Forest|Great Elior Forest]]. In addition to that, she has stated that she has no desires except equality in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] if she becomes king. After the trials hosted by [[Echidna]], Emilia learns that she might be unable to melt the ice without killing the inhabitants. Despite this, she has still resolved herself to become the next king.

Due to her existence as a silver-haired half elf whose appearance resembled the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], she was heavily discriminated against by those around her, including the nobility. That said, in the time that she took part in the Royal Selection, she started becoming more recognized as herself rather than the Witch, and public opinion about her and her camp has seemingly improved.<ref>''It had been more than a year since the Royal Selection began, and in the Kingdom of Lugunica, those unaware that one of the candidates was a silver-haired half-elf with amethyst eyes were few. To put it Subaru-style, Emilia, as Emilia, had become a household name.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 1.</ref>

==History==
The camp was formed when [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] approached Emilia while she was still living at the Elior Forest with [[Puck]] and revealed to her that she had the necessary qualities to partake in the Royal Selection, having likely learned of her through his Book of Wisdom. As the Kingdom's resources might be used to restore the frozen forest, Emilia agreed to participate and moved to [[Roswaal Manor]], despite Puck's protests, seeing that Roswaal likely had alternate motives. Thus, the camp was formed with Emilia, Roswaal, Puck, [[Ram]], and [[Rem]] as its founding members.

As Puck expected, Roswaal had a hidden motive for approaching Emilia. Through his book, he learned of a boy named [[Natsuki Subaru]], who would receive an [[Authority]] to rewind time and was destined to fall in love with Emilia. Seeing Subaru's ability as a priceless asset, Roswaal set up the [[Loot House Incident|events]] of their meeting by hiring [[Elsa Granhiert]] to kill Emilia. In the end, just as Roswaal intended, Subaru managed to stop Elsa and Emilia brought him into the faction, where Roswaal immediately set up a working relationship. However, Rem was initially suspicious of Subaru because of the Witch's scent lingering on him. This changed after he proved himself by saving the [[Arlam Village]]rs from a [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarm]] [[Wolgarm Incident|attack]] and saving the children who were kidnapped by [[Meili Portroute]], ultimately gaining her trust.

Once the Royal Selection officially began, the Emilia Camp started out in the worst possible position. On top of facing prejudice, Emilia failed to gain the nobles' support. Even worse, Subaru antagonized said nobles in a misguided attempt to stand up for her. In the midst of this, Roswaal began to set his plans for Subaru into motion. Knowing that the [[White Whale]] would appear at the Lifaus Highway and the [[Witch Cult]] was preparing to assassinate Emilia, he stepped back and allowed Subaru to handle them, while making sure he had the resources to overcome both obstacles. In the end, Roswaal's gamble paid off, as Subaru managed to defeat both the White Whale and the [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]] by forging an alliance with the [[Crusch Camp]] and [[Anastasia Camp]]. Also, since he played leading roles in both battles, Subaru, and by extension, the Emilia Camp, received most of the credit.

In the aftermath of the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], the camp gained several new members. Subaru recruited a merchant he befriended, [[Otto Suwen]], while Roswaal re-hired his old maid, [[Frederica Baumann]], as well as a new apprentice maid, [[Petra Leyte]]. For Subaru’s efforts during the subjugations, he took [[Patrasche]], who had allowed him to ride her, with him. However, the Emilia Camp suffered a loss when Rem had her existence eaten by the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]] and became afflicted by the condition known as Sleeping Beauty, rendering her in a state of suspended animation.

With the camp in a comfortable position, Roswaal set up his most ambitious plan yet. He divided the camp up by luring one half to the [[Sanctuary]] while the other stayed at Roswaal Manor. At the Sanctuary, the residents forced Emilia to take a trial to undo the barrier that kept them in. Meanwhile, Roswaal set up an incident to happen at both the Sanctuary and the manor at the same time. He once again hired Elsa, and unintentionally Meili, to attack the mansion whilst he lured the [[Great Rabbit]] to the Sanctuary. Roswaal's goal was to further Subaru's development by forcing him to sacrifice one to save the other. During this time, Puck forcibly broke his contract with Emilia, allowing her to start recalling the memories from her past, enabling her to tackle and overcome the three Trials from the Echidna's Tomb.

After overcoming the hurdle that was [[Garfiel Tinzel]], he managed to successfully have him join their camp, and he proceeded to bring him to fight off the two assassins that had appeared at the manor while leaving the care of Roswaal to Ram and Puck. The ensuing battle between them and their pets Guiltylowe and Rock Pig resulted in the manor being set on fire and burning. With the capture of Meili, Garfiel’s victory against Elsa, and the deaths of the Guiltylowe and Rock Pig, Subaru managed to convince the Great Spirit of the Forbidden Library, [[Beatrice]], to contract with him and leave the burning mansion, and the two went on to fight and defeat the Great Rabbit alongside Emilia, who successfully managed to overcome the Sanctuary’s trials and destroy the barrier.

After the [[Sanctuary Incident|events]] at the Sanctuary, Subaru officially became Emilia's Knight. Because of this, Roswaal brought [[Annerose Miload]] and [[Clind]] into the camp so that the latter could train him.

Sometime after Subaru’s knighting ceremony, Frederica and Garfiel, who were on an outing in [[Costuul]], discovered a man named [[Hayden Garo]] who could manipulate the city's magicreation tools and reported the incident to Costuul’s [[Leno Rex|mayor]]. With Hayden causing City Hall’s collapse by sending a giant magicreation tool haywire and kidnapping Frederica after she and her brother rescued everyone from the collapsing building, Garfiel and Clind ventured to retrieve her and put the incident to rest while Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice took care of the haywire Lightbugs in Costuul. Frederica's kidnapper, Hayden, intended to make Frederica into the queen of a new nation where [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] were dominant and humans were exterminated by unlocking the secrets of rare blood, which he and the kidnapped maid both possessed. Present with him was one of his subordinates, a researcher of rare blood, [[Leonardo Baroness]]. The duo of Garfiel and Clind found Hayden and Leonardo's hideout due to Frederica leaving a trail of blood behind. Clind took care of rescuing Frederica, fending off Leonardo when he absorbed his vials of rare blood and transformed into a liquid blood monster. Garfiel successfully defeated Hayden, however, he managed to escape before being captured. He briefly met with Frederica before his escaping, swearing to her that they would meet again, and he allowed her to deal him a scar as remembrance of their encounter.

Roughly a year after the events in the Sanctuary, the Anastasia Camp contacted the Emilia Camp and invited them to the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]], promising Emilia a glintstone capable of capturing the Beast of the End's presence, which would allow Puck to eventually awaken quicker. During their stay in the Watergate City, the other Royal Selection Camps arrived, as it turned out that [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]] planned to get to know each other better and possibly forge some alliances. Sadly, the laid-back times soon ended, as the day after they arrived, the Witch Cult made their grand appearance. The [[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishops]] of [[Regulus Corneas|Greed]], [[Sirius|Wrath]], Gluttony (Lye and [[Roy Alphard|Roy]]), and [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Lust]] besieged the city, taking control of it and apparently flooding one of the districts. The Camps were forced to work together to defeat the vile presence in the city. After a long and arduous battle with the Cult, the Royal Selection Candidates managed to prevail, in no small part due to the Emilia Camp's struggles and contributions in the form of Subaru masterminding large portions of retaliation. 

After the death of the Sin Archbishop of Greed and the capture of the Sin Archbishop of Wrath, the Emilia Camp set their goals on the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], located in the far east of the country. They planned to locate the "[[Shaula|Sage]]" and somehow find a solution that would allow them to revert the damages done by Lust and Gluttony. Meanwhile, other members of the camp would remain in Priestella to help in the city’s recovery.  

During their time there, Garfiel and Otto became involved in a mission to retrieve the remains of a [[Typhon|Witch]], working alongside [[Ricardo Welkin]] of the Anastasia Camp, [[Ezzo Cadner]] of the [[Felt Camp]], and [[Liliana Masquerade]]. They successfully managed to overcome the obstacles and retrieve the remains, though Garfiel also realized the existence of certain “glyphs” that were the same as what Subaru sometimes wrote with. Not long after, Otto retrieved the repaired Tome of Wisdom from [[Dartz]]. 

On their way, the Emilia Camp decided to take Meili Portroute with them in order to resolve the possible [[Witchbeast|witchbeast]] danger. Select members of the Anastasia Camp also accompanied them, as both Anastasia and her knight [[Julius Juukulius]] had suffered unconventional damages: Julius had lost his name in a deadly fight with Gluttony and Anastasia's body had been possessed by her Artificial Spirit, [[Eridna|Echidna]], who was unable to return the body to its rightful owner. While at the Pleiades Watchtower, the two camps found themselves in an unprecedented [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|situation]], as they were forced to deal with five obstacles as well as Subaru's sudden loss of memories due to the reappearance of Gluttony. 

The two camps successfully managed to overcome all of the Gluttonies, with Lye Batenkaitos spitting up all of the names and memories he had previously devoured before he was beheaded, Roy Alphard being sealed, and [[Rui Arneb]] being left behind in the Corridor of Memories. Simultaneously, with the conquering of the Pleiades Watchtower, Emilia ultimately became the tower’s administrator. However, Subaru, alongside an unconscious Rem and [[Spica|Rui]] is teleported to the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. Shortly after, after over a year of being in a vegetative state, Rem finally regained consciousness.

Due to the circumstances, while Subaru was forced to attempt to return to Lugunica, he was forced to assist [[Vincent Vollachia]] in retrieving the throne from his [[Chisha Gold|aide]]. Meanwhile, the camp tasked their new addition, Meili, with assisting the next expedition team with reaching the watchtower, while the majority of the camp left for [[Picoutatte]] in order to find a way to smuggle themselves into Vollachia in order to retrieve Subaru and Rem. While there, Otto managed to patch things up with [[Diadora Regundra]], and with her and his family’s help, the camp traversed through the Everlasting Darkness. Due to some issues, Petra met with the representative of the mole people, [[Musica]], using an oath bound curse mark to promise that she would allow them to meet with Emilia when their business was finished. Around this time, Annerose hired [[Sylphy Elmart]] and the other former wives of Regulus as maids to care for Roswaal Manor.

Soon after arriving in Vollachia, the rest of the camp also assisted Vincent after preventing the destruction of [[Guaral]], as Subaru and Rem had been separated from him. This led to their partaking in the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]]. This fight was interrupted by an unexpected enemy, forcing everyone to retreat, though not before Emilia recovered Subaru and Rem.

Once everyone was reunited, Vincent officially requested Emilia for her assistance in quelling the [[Great Disaster]], knowing full well what this would mean for her standings in the Royal Selection. Emilia accepted this request, signifying the first time in history that Vollachia and Lugunica ever put their differences aside and joined forces. Meanwhile, Subaru managed to gain the backing of most of his camp with allowing Rui, now named Spica, to remain in their care, despite her identity as a former Sin Archbishop.

Assisting the Vollachian forces, the Emilia Camp once again teamed up with the members of the Anastasia Camp and [[Priscilla Camp]] in the fight against an old [[Sphinx|remnant]] of the [[Demi-Human War]], ultimately coming out victorious in the end, though at the cost of [[Priscilla Barielle]]’s life. A few days after the end of the Great Disaster, it was decided that Spica would remain in the Vollachia Empire to assist in cleaning up the remaining undead, hoping to improve her standing and reduce the chances of her being killed when she returns to Lugunica. Afterward, the Emilia Camp, accompanied by the other members of the Priscilla Camp, returned to Lugunica.

Shortly after returning to Lugunica, the camp split up, with Subaru taking Petra, Garfiel, Beatrice, Patrasche, [[Al]], and Meili, who was brought by Clind, to the Pleiades Watchtower. Emilia and Otto returned to the Royal Capital to report the entire debacle in Vollachia as well as the death of Priscilla. Ram and Rem returned to Roswaal Manor, and Roswaal, Frederica, and [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] went to the Barielle Domain to minimize the confusion brought about by their lord’s death, where [[Yae Tenzen]] later appeared and revealed Schult as Priscilla's successor. Meanwhile, on the first night of the stay at the tower, Al began his [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|scheme]] to remove Subaru from the world. However, he failed due to Subaru using Return by Death, and instead, Al was sealed away. Afterward, the group in the tower returned to the Royal Capital, with Subaru intent on forcing Gluttony to spit up all of the names and memories in his stomach and deciding not to remain ignorant of the Kingdom's and world's history.

Due to the appearance of [[Filore]] and her future induction to the Royal Selection, [[Reinhard van Astrea]] and [[Rom]] retrieved Subaru's group from Mirula, and after gathering Rem and Ram, returned to the capital, where they discovered that Roy Alphard was apparently killed, [[Crusch Karsten]] was healed by Filore, [[Ferris]] had resigned as her knight because of his actions, and of Crusch and Ferris's connection to [[Fourier Lugunica]] and their vow to sever the contract with [[Volcanica]]. This led to Subaru questioning the circumstances of the [[Royal Plague]] and the connection between it and the fact that the Dragon History Stone had seemingly not foretold of their demise. Furthermore, Emilia was also the one to convince Filore to accept her role as a Royal Selection candidate, and in their conversation with [[Miklotov McMahon]] that followed, learned that she would choose Heinkel as her knight.

The next day, having secured the chance to speak to Miklotov, Subaru and Beatrice, alongside [[Tiga Rauleon]], visited his mansion, where they were forced into a fight with Crusch who had seemingly killed Miklotov. Because of Tiga's actions nearly killing Subaru, however, they escape together, and after waking up and hearing Crusch's goal, they decide to follow after her, becoming criminals alongside her. The rest of the camp was also affected, as Emilia and Ram were isolated in the castle while the rest of the camp were forced to flee, confronting and escaping from Reinhard with the assistance of [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] and Rom. After Subaru's group managed to converge with the [[Six Tongues]] and learned that their enemy, the [[Beloved Children]] and Capella Emerada Lugunica, had infiltrated and replaced members of the government, they chose to flee the capital, and simultaneously, the rest of the camp made the same decision.

==Achievements==
*Jointly defeating the White Whale.
*Jointly defeating the Sin Archbishop of Sloth.
*Defeating the Bowel Hunter.
*Defeating the Great Rabbit.
**Due to the fact that only members of the camp and residents of Arlam Village and the Sanctuary bore witness to its defeat, the fact that Beatrice was temporarily unable to recast her magic, and that there were no remains left behind, its defeat cannot be confirmed without the passing of time without any attacks. As such, for the time being, the Great Rabbit's defeat cannot be officially credited to the Emilia Camp, though stories of it have spread throughout the world.
*Repelling the Witch Cult during the [[Battle for Priestella]].
**Natsuki Subaru acting partially as a general against the invaders throughout the event and giving a motivational speech to stop riots from breaking out under the effects of the Authority of Wrath.
**Defeating the Sin Archbishop of Greed.
*Reaching and conquering the Pleiades Watchtower.
**Emilia becoming the caretaker of the Pleiades Watchtower, forming a contract with Volcanica to safeguard the tower.
**Defeating the three Sin Archbishops of Gluttony.
***Forcing Lye Batenkaitos to regurgitate numerous names he devoured.
*Reforming an assassin.
**Having her assist in the second expedition to investigate the Pleiades Watchtower.
*Forging a temporary alliance with Vollachia, a millennium-long enemy of Lugunica’s.
*Putting an end to the Great Disaster, a threat that could have consumed Lugunica as well.
**Defeating Sphinx, a remnant of Lugunica’s Demi-Human War.

wikitext:
[[File:Priscilla Camp.png|thumb|250px]]
The '''Priscilla Camp''' (プリシラ陣営, ''Purishira Jin'ei'') was a [[Royal Selection]] team that was led by the late Baroness [[Priscilla Barielle]]. The camp was disbanded after Priscilla's death following the [[Great Disaster]].

==Information==
Priscilla stated that the heavens chose her way to royalty, thus she felt the most appropriate to assume the throne, since her exceptional luck and attention to the commoners had led her to gain great popularity, and she affirmed that everyone would be safe with her whenever they decided to obey her. Priscilla said that she would reward the people who supported her and was always willing to comply with the requests of others.

During the events of the Great Disaster, Priscilla gave her life to defeat the enemy, and thus, with her death, she and her camp were the first to drop out of the Royal Selection.

==History==
Priscilla was initially discovered to be one of the Royal Selection Candidates by [[Leip Barielle]], who took her on as her eighth husband in order to use her as a tool to achieve his dream of power. However, Priscilla proved to be much harder to manipulate than he thought and decided to make her into a puppet by using the abilities of [[Sphinx|a curse arts user]] he was acquainted with. He also planned to prepare a knight who would look good alongside Priscilla as a sort of public relations strategy to improve her standing among citizens. Around this time, Priscilla met a starving, impoverished, orphaned, and nameless boy from a farming village in her domain. Despite being on the brink of death, he caught her interest because they shared the same eye color. She decided to call him [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] and she took him back to her manor so he could become a butler.

One day, Leip organized a tournament to decide who Priscilla's knight would be. She quickly got bored with the fighting while viewing the tournament, causing her to ask Schult for his thoughts. Schult decided to recommend [[Al]], as he believed that the man showed care for Priscilla, unlike the other combatants. Priscilla thought Al was entertaining enough and that his fighting style was interesting, and she consequently selected him as her “clown”. This infuriated Leip, as he had tried to fix the tournament so that a winner would be under his control. A few days later, Leip attempted to bring Al and Schult under his control, but he was refused when he revealed his intentions to make Priscilla into a puppet. Al clashed with Leip by using [[Al#Abilities|his ability]], which resulted in the baron being incapacitated. In due time, Leip passed away before the commencement of the Royal Selection, leading Priscilla to take over as the governing lord of the Barielle Domain. Under her rule, the land, which was previously ravaged by severe poverty due to Leip's tyranny, quickly got back on its feet, and its people started to live much happier and better lives all as a result of Priscilla's leadership of the domain.

One day, Priscilla wanted Al to entertain her, though this resulted in her flicking him into a fountain on the grounds. With Schult worried about him and mentioning his helmet, Al mentioned that it wouldn't be destroyed so easily, after which he revealed to Priscilla he had acquired his helmet from and lost his arm at [[Ginunhive]]. With Priscilla becoming bored of listening to him, Priscilla told Schult to entertain her, leading him to tell her of a rumor that heading toward the spring near the town of Ladrima would allow one to see the deceased. Her interest piqued, she took them and headed toward the forest near Ladrima. There, Al questioned whether she wanted to see someone who had died, whereas she questioned his being against seeing the dead due to not wanting to see someone. Shortly after, Al was separated from his companions and was forced to face illusion of Leip despite him being alive, gladiators and guards he knew from Ginunhive, including [[Ghajit]] and the guard who gave him his helmet, even though the former of whom was the only one he knew who had died, and even a shadowy figure who he could not bring himself to hurt, even 100 million tries. Soon after, however, Priscilla dispelled the illusion, and shortly after, the fog was lifted from the spring. This resulted in a short-lived fight with an [[Spirit|evil spirit]]. Sometime later, when she was brought Kurenai flowers by a villager at her manor, Al realized that the actions Priscilla took were just so that she could see those flowers, and she ordered Al and Schult to decorate the manor.

After the Royal Selection's commencement, a man named [[Minor Characters#Array Denkuts|Array Denkuts]] came to the Barielle Manor in order to plead Priscilla to go to his home village, Coffleton, and eliminate the undead that had appeared there. Together with Al and [[Yae Tenzen]], Priscilla went to Coffleton and discovered that the undead had some sort of parasite within them. The men of the town had all turned into undead who looked exactly as they did in life, while the women and children housed the parasites yet were still alive. Priscilla used the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] to remove the parasite from them, she gathered her private army, the Crimson Battlefront, to visit two other villages among the Tenrill River to eliminate any undead, and she brought Yae and Al with her to an unaffected village to investigate why there were no undead there. They visited a watermill and found that the manager there, [[Edda Rayfast]], had become the leader of the undead, and she opened a trap door that led Al into a wastewater treatment plant.

On Priscilla's order, Yae retreated to search for Al. In the meantime, Priscilla conversed with Edda and discovered her plan to create a "paradise" for her "creator". When Yae found Al, he had cleared through waves of numerous undead and decided to save Priscilla from Edda. He went back to the watermill, successfully defeated Edda, and rescued Priscilla. With the [[undead]]'s leader defeated, they returned to the Barielle Manor. However, at midnight, Yae made an attempt to visit Priscilla's room, as she was an assassin who made an attempt to kill her supposed mistress. She was stopped by Al, and after losing to him in a short-lived fight, she decided to “resign” due to “familial matters”.

A short time later, a suicide squad comprised of ten [[shinobi]] was tasked by [[Chisha Gold]] to kill Priscilla, which Yae failed to accomplish. Despite this, with Yae's assistance, Al confronted the shinobi, and they killed them, with Al using his Authority to break [[Hamayal Wesmi]] and his Phantom Wolf in the same way as he did to Yae. Afterward, on Al's orders, he sent his Phantom Wolf through the letter that was to report how the mission had gone. The Phantom Wolf was set on Chisha as soon as he opened said letter, but [[Cecilus Segmunt]], who was in the room with him, eradicated it in a flash, ending Hamayal's life.

A while after the undead incident, Priscilla encountered [[Heinkel Astrea|Heinkel]] at a bandit den near the Barielle Domain. Heinkel had found himself in the bandit den, to try and recover an opaque silver cup which was rumored to cure any incurable diseases when drank from, causing him to believe it was capable of awakening his [[Louanna Astrea|sleeping wife]]. He cut down all of the bandits in the den, before Priscilla restrained him. However, the cup turned out to be just a dud. After Priscilla correctly identified he had been there for the cup, she burned it in front of him. Just as she was about to leave, Heinkel gave her an offer. Heinkel offered that he could do something about the whelp who was [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]]'s [[Felt|mistress]]. Thus, he gave his backing to Priscilla and in return asked that if she were to become king, to let him get his hands on the blood of the Dragon, which was kept in the castle. He asked it because he needed a miracle to get Louanna to awake, which resulted in an alliance between them.

Later, Priscilla arrived in [[Priestella]], interrupting the gathering of the other camps through Heinkel. Though her presence was unwanted, she ended up playing major part in the events that followed, as the [[Witch Cult]] began to rampage in the city. Though initially absent from the gathering of the Royal Candidates, Priscilla was proceeding through town with [[Liliana Masquerade]] in tow, searching for Schult while have the bard perform her music to calm the people who were under the effects of the Authority of Wrath.

During the final stages of the [[Battle for Priestella]], she and Al played major roles in removing the Witch Cult from the city. Al remained behind to act as a defensive measure against anyone who came to attack their base while everyone was gone, resulting in his battle with the [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop of Lust]]. Meanwhile, Priscilla took Liliana with her to fight off the [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Wrath]]. Due to their efforts, Lust retreated while Wrath was defeated and arrested.

Upon returning to her domain, she was attacked by assassins sent by Chisha who were promptly defeated. Realizing the assassins were somehow involved with her home country of [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]], after settling an issue with Al, they made their way into the country, where they assisted her [[Vincent Vollachia|brother]] in reclaiming his throne, with Al playing a heavy part in [[Chaosflame]] and herself taking part in the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]]. However, with the start of the Great Disaster, Priscilla was temporarily captured by its orchestrator: the Witch, Sphinx. Despite this, she managed to escape and played a major role against the Witch’s final stand.

With the end of the Great Disaster, Priscilla spent a day in [[Garkla]]. However, with her life having been cut short, Priscilla faded away. As such, Priscilla Barielle was the first to drop out of the Royal Selection. Afterward, Al and Schult returned to the Kingdom with the [[Emilia Camp]], and Heinkel moved separately with an ally of Al's: Yae. However, as Al's [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|scheme]] failed and he was sealed, Yae decided to stick with Schult, who was named Priscilla's successor, and Heinkel later joined [[Filore]] as her knight. Ultimately, the camp was completely disbanded.

==Achievements==
*Improving relations along the border of Vollachia.
*Improving the Barielle Domain’s economy and standard of living.
**United the nobles across the domain that were confused and uncertain following the death of Leip Barielle.
*Repelling the Witch Cult during the Battle for Priestella.
**Defeating the Sin Archbishop of Wrath.
*Assisting Vollachia as a part of the temporary alliance.
*Putting an end to the Great Disaster, a threat that could have consumed Lugunica as well, at the cost of Priscilla’s life.
**Defeating Sphinx, a remnant of Lugunica’s [[Demi-Human War]].

The '''Felt Camp''' (フェルト陣営, ''Feruto Jin'ei'') is a [[Royal Selection]] team that is led by [[Felt]].

==Information==
Felt stated and affirmed her hatred for the nobility, the [[Royal Army|knights]], the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|kingdom]], and all classes. Possibly influenced by her life in the slums, added to the lack of actions of the politicians who could have helped her and the people in need, Felt swore that she would turn everything into ashes to, according to her, bring fresh air to the country. 

She has put together a camp made up of Reinhard, two servants of [[House Astrea]], as well as people of the lower class like herself and [[Rom]], [[Gaston|Ton]], [[Rachins Hoffman|Chin]], and [[Camberley|Kan]], giving them the possibility to reverse the political situation of the kingdom where the lower social class can govern over the current.

It should be noted that due to her striking resemblance to the Lugunican [[Royal Family]] and her age roughly matching the number of years since the child of [[Ford Lugunica]], Filore Lugunica, was kidnapped, she is heavily suspected to be Filore, thus making her a potential Royal and leaving various thoughts and insights into her identity amongst the nobility and knights. However, any effect this has on her standings is as of yet unseen.

==History==
Following the [[Loot House Incident|fight]] with the [[Elsa Granhiert|Bowel Hunter]] in the Loot House, [[Reinhard van Astrea]] noticed the Insignia shining in Felt's hand and took her into custody for the time being. The next morning, Felt woke up in the auxiliary Astrea Manor at the Royal Capital, where she found Reinhard. He explained to her that she had the necessary qualities to become a monarch. For the next two months, she made consistent escape attempts, but she was always foiled by [[Grimm Fauzen]], [[Carol Remendis|Carol Fauzen]], and Reinhard. During this period, Felt discovered that Reinhard's mother, [[Louanna Astrea]], has been afflicted by the Sleeping Beauty condition and contained in the Astrea Manor ever since he was an infant.

During the Royal Selection Ceremony, Rom intentionally tried to nudge Felt away from the ceremony because she hated being there, but this backfired when she decided to become a candidate anyways with Reinhard as her knight, leading him to join as well. After the ceremony, they happened across three thugs: [[Gaston]], [[Rachins Hoffman|Rachins]], and [[Camberley]], who had found themselves on the receiving end of [[Russell Fellow]]'s ire. Felt recruited the three of them to join her camp. A couple of days later, after Grimm and Carol verify that Rom did not have any negative intentions, Felt and Reinhard parted ways with the elderly couple and traveled to the main Astrea Manor in Hakuchuri.

At Hakuchuri, [[Flam Remendis]] and [[Grassis Remendis]] were in waiting for their arrival. Felt began getting acclimated to living at the Astrea Manor and Hakuchuri until suddenly, a baby named [[Ilya]] was left at the mansion's gate, along with a message asking the family to take care of her. For a few days, the Felt Camp struggled but managed to take care of the baby girl. An assassin from the Black Silver Coin organization in [[Flanders]], who was ordered to find Ilya, was caught snooping around the area by Felt and captured by Reinhard before promptly admitting his identity to them. The three former thugs also succeeded in finding Ilya's mother, [[Kalifa]], learning that she was the mistress of [[Doltero Amule]], the Black Silver Coin's leader and the father of her child. Together with Reinhard and Rom, Felt travels to Flanders to meet Doltero and resolve the situation. Doltero had no desire to make an attempt on the lives of his lover and child, realizing that the only person who could have done so was his confidant, [[Safis]], who admitted he had attempted to murder them because they were threats to the organization and its boss's security. Safis prepared to commit suicide to atone for his disloyalty, only being forcefully stopped by Doltero. Taking his confidant's words to heart, the Pig King disavowed his family for the sake of his organization, much to Felt's indignation, and was told by his old acquaintance Cromwell that he would one day regret his decision. Following the incident's resolution, Kalifa and Ilya began living in Hakuchuri.

Sometime later, the camp visited Flanders to meet with the heads of the city's Big Three. Happening upon [[Ezzo Cadner]] along the way and preventing a conflict between him and Camberley, he introduced himself as a bodyguard for the Flower Prison Garden before they greeted the organization's proprietress, [[Toto]]. One night a few days later, a lackey of [[Mozolite]], the right-hand man of The Balance's leader, [[Manfred Madison]], murdered one of Ezzo's students, [[Mimosa]], and set fire to the building they were in, framing Ezzo for arson. Investigating the incident, Reinhard and company obtained information that he was in an abandoned mansion that was provided to him by [[Helaine Gatness]]. After arriving there, Ezzo and Reinhard confronted each other. Though Ezzo did succeed in bypassing Reinhard's unique constitution, he was unable to defeat him. Afterward, Ezzo informed them of the truth of the fire at the brothel and requested their help in his pursuit of revenge for Mimosa's death. When they were surrounded at the mansion, he made a mask and wove a Cognitive Disruption spell within it so Reinhard could fend off their attackers, while he, wearing a similar mask, accompanied Flam and Rachins to confront Helaine. In the end, Ezzo successfully took down the arson, the Anastasia Camp captured the arson's superior, Mozolite, as he was escaping Flanders, and Helaine was exposed by Rachins for being a member of the [[Six Tongues]] and having facilitated the betrayal of Manfred's right-hand man. The Big Three became indebted to Felt and her camp for their contributions in resolving the incident, agreeing to pledge allegiance to her in the Royal Selection, and Ezzo joined the camp.

Approximately a year after the start of the Royal Selection, Felt was invited by [[Anastasia Hoshin]] to visit [[Priestella]] so that the two might learn more about each other. Naturally, she brought Reinhard, Rachins, and Gaston with her. Unfortunately, a day after they arrived, the [[Witch Cult]] arrived and held the city hostage until their demands were met. Thanks to the actions of Reinhard’s father, [[Heinkel Astrea]], neither Felt nor Reinhard were able to take action, and Rachins was quickly taken out of the fight thanks to the [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Wrath]] and the [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]].

With the help of the [[Emilia Camp]]’s [[Otto Suwen]], they were fortunately able to make a return and assist in the repelling of the Witch Cult. While Reinhard assisted [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Emilia]] with taking care of Greed, Felt and Gaston found themselves in the crosshairs of the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]]. Ultimately, both sides were victorious in their battles, but thanks to the appearance of Gluttony’s [[Rui Arneb|sister]], he was able to escape. Soon after, Reinhard finished the fight by slaying his [[undead]] [[Theresia van Astrea|grandmother]].

With the Witch Cult defeated and pushed back, Felt and Reinhard were responsible for transporting Wrath to the [[Royal Capital]]’s Prison Tower, a trip that took two months due to Wrath’s attraction for trouble, while Ezzo took part in recovering the remains of a [[Typhon|Witch]] that were beneath the city. After having Wrath sealed away, she and Reinhard were invited to dinner by Russell Fellow. During their conversation, they discussed how the times were facing a massive change, with Felt correlating it to Subaru and Emilia’s influences. In the same conversation, they also discussed the disturbances in the other three countries, which involved [[Gusteko]]’s increasing Witch hunts, the declining balance of power between [[Kararagi]]’s mayors, and the signs of a [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] brewing in [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]].

A short time later, a good portion of the camp traveled with [[Meili Portroute]] to the conquered [[Pleiades Watchtower]], where they investigated the tower and the Taygeta Library’s Books of the Dead. After a short investigation, as well as having determined that the birds that flew to the tower were spies, the majority of the team returned to the Royal Capital, leaving Ezzo and Flam to continue investigating the tower.

While at the tower, Ezzo and Flam greeted Subaru’s group after they arrived, and subsequently, they were involved [[Al]]’s [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|scheme]] to remove Subaru from the world. Fortunately, thanks to Subaru's use of Return by Death, they were able to seal Al and prevent the disaster he would have brought. Afterward, Ezzo and Flam, who were to remain at the tower, saw the group off.

In the capital, Felt and Reinhard were both present when [[Filore]] was at the castle, and after she healed [[Crusch Karsten]] of her maladies, Felt was the one who tossed her an insignia, which glowed in her hands. Because of this, she had Rom and Reinhard retrieve the Emilia Camp members who had left for the Pleiades Watchtower. Shortly after this, however, problems arose: Reinhard witnessed the apparent corpse of [[Roy Alphard]], and a couple of days later, Crusch had apparently killed [[Miklotov McMahon]] and was on the run with Subaru and [[Beatrice]]. In response, Felt sent members of her camp to find the members of the other camps, intent on assisting them after coming to the conclusion that they were all being attacked, while she was isolated in the castle. Meanwhile, Reinhard was forced to assist in capturing the other camps under the coercion of the government, and the members of her camp were forced to flee the Royal Capital with either the Six Tongues or the other camps.

==Achievements==
*Quelling the unrest plaguing the Big Three underground organizations of Flanders, acquiring their backing for the Royal Selection in the process.
*Repelling the Witch Cult during the Battle for Priestella.
**Reinhard’s part in defeating the Sin Archbishop of Greed.
*Investigating the conquered Pleiades Watchtower with the help of Meili Portroute of the Emilia Camp.

The '''Anastasia Camp''' (アナスタシア陣営, ''Anasutashia Jin'ei'') is a [[Royal Selection]] team that is led by [[Anastasia Hoshin]], the head of the Hoshin Company.

==Information==
As the current head of the Hoshin Company, Anastasia’s influence is wide and vast, and as one of the Royal Selection Candidates, she is one of the ones the people believe is most likely to succeed. During the ceremony in the beginning, Anastasia stated that she wants to be king because she is greedy. She wants the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]] so everyone can be in her possession.

==History==
Anastasia was initially discovered to be one of the Royal Selection Candidates by [[Julius Juukulius]] during her visit to the Juukulius Estate to discuss the potential expansion of her business, the Hoshin Company, into Lugunica. When [[Mimi Pearlbaton]] happened to find the Dragon Insignia and Julius noticed the glow coming from the Jewel within it as Anastasia was proceeding to return it to him, he offered her a chance to look closer at the working of the Lugunican government, and they headed to the Royal Castle to reveal Anastasia as a candidate to the nobles.

Initially, the nobles were discontent with her, a foreigner, being a potential ruler for Lugunica. In fact, Anastasia nearly pulled away from the Royal Selection on her own until Julius offered to become her knight. Thus, he has been a member of her camp since. Similarly, due to their connection to the Hoshin Company and how close they were, Anastasia kept the [[Iron Fang]] under her wing as part of her camp. As such, [[Ricardo Welkin]], Mimi Pearlbaton, [[Hetaro Pearlbaton]], and [[Tivey Pearlbaton]] became a part of her camp. Meanwhile, respecting his brother’s decision, [[Joshua Juukulius]] also became a part of her camp. The artificial spirit [[Eridna|Echidna]] was also a member of the camp, but her presence remained secret from everyone, and she continued to act as an advisor of sorts to Anastasia.

By the time that the Royal Selection truly began, Anastasia was considered by many to be one of the two most likely to win, being roughly on par with [[Crusch Karsten]]. A few days after the beginning of the Royal Selection, she and [[Russell Fellow]] entered negotiations with [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Rem]] of the [[Emilia Camp]] to forge an alliance in an effort to take down the [[White Whale]] and the [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]], with the promise of Subaru to hand over his phone, which he claimed to be a [[meteor]], to Russell. Between this, the fall of the menace of all merchants, and the potential to instigate sales via her own company through this hunt and potential success, she agreed to assist in the battle.

With the negotiations being successful, the Iron Fang, alongside members of the [[Crusch Camp]], an army of soldiers, and Subaru and Rem, brought down the Great Witchbeast. Soon after, the Iron Fang’s assistance became critical in hunting down the Sin Archbishop’s fingers while Julius had a personal hand in bringing down Sloth, fighting alongside Subaru to do so.

Over the course of the next year, Anastasia continued to make numerous connections within the country and expanded her company’s influence within the nation. As a result, her standings in the Royal Selection never diminished, and they had perhaps even strengthened.

Approximately one year after the defeat of the White Whale and Sloth, Anastasia invited members of the Emilia Camp, Crusch Camp, and [[Felt Camp]] to [[Priestella]] in order to get to know everyone better. For the Emilia Camp, she used the offer of a precious glintstone to use as bait, as they needed it for [[Puck]] to wake up. Meanwhile, the potential whereabouts of the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony was used to lure in the Crusch Camp.

Unfortunately, a day after the three camps arrived, the Witch Cult arrived and took the entire city hostage until their demands were met, one of which included handing over Echidna herself. As a result, the four camps, plus the [[Priscilla Camp]], which had arrived uninvited, became the central figures to repel them.

Throughout the fight, Anastasia, alongside Subaru, were the acting generals who masterminded the counterattacks against the [[Witch Cult]], with Anastasia coming up against both [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Wrath]] and [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Lust]]. Meanwhile, Julius and Ricardo helped to fight off the [[Demi-Beast|demi-beasts]] that were running rampant throughout the town, and they even fought against [[Roy Alphard]], one of the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony. Unfortunately, the camp did not escape the incident unscathed, and they were perhaps the camp most affected. Mimi was left with a nearly life-threatening injury, and the sharing of the injury’s burden was shared between her brothers, leaving them hurt as well. Ricardo lost his arm against Roy, Julius’s name was devoured, leaving him forgotten to all but Subaru. Both Joshua’s name and memories were eaten by [[Lye Batenkaitos]] near the start of the battle, leaving him in the same state as Rem.

Perhaps the most devastating hit to their camp was Anastasia’s decision to lock herself in her Od, leaving Echidna to control her body, confused and not knowing what to do. It is because of this that she offers the decision to go to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], claiming that the [[Shaula|Sage]] might have answers in regard to the victims of Lust and Gluttony, though her real goal is to discover the reason why she can’t return Anastasia’s body to her.

With Echidna and Julius gone, the Anastasia Camp remains in Priestella to help in the city’s recovery. While they are there, Ricardo partakes in the mission to retrieve the remains of a [[Typhon|Witch]] from beneath the city, going with [[Garfiel Tinzel]] of the Emilia Camp, [[Ezzo Cadner]] of the Felt Camp, and [[Liliana Masquerade]].

Meanwhile, Erida and Julius travel with the Emilia Camp to the tower, where once again, they are faced with the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony. While they are unable to force Roy to spit up the names due to the circumstances, Julius is able to defeat and seal him while also becoming stronger by resetting his contract with his spirits, helping them evolve. Meanwhile, Echidna is finally able to return Anastasia’s body to her, allowing her to restart her relationship with her knight.

Shortly after, Subaru, alongside the unconscious Rem and [[Spica|Rui Arneb]], were teleported to [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]] after being engulfed in a massive shadow. Wishing to repay their debts, Anastasia, Julius, and Echidna decided to sneak into Vollachia through [[Kararagi]] in order to help the Emilia Camp retrieve him once they left Roy in the hands of the Lugunican government. In Kararagi, she met with the leaders of the League of Cities and decided to act as an envoy in uncovering the reason for the undead incident, which was related to Vollachia in some way. 

After arriving in Vollachia, she assisted them in taking part in the temporary alliance with Vollachia against the [[Great Disaster]] and its orchestrator, a remnant of the [[Demi-Human War]], the Witch [[Sphinx]], having brought [[Halibel]] to assist as well. After the victory over the Great Disaster, which cost the life of [[Priscilla Barielle]], Anastasia decided to return to Lugunica through Kararagi. 

In Kararagi immediately after, Anastasia reported the incident to the mayor of Ivada, [[Orgo Hayata]]. However, despite this, they were confronted with yet another problem: a powerful windstorm brought about by [[Zarestia]] in [[Banan]], who had come there in search for her Light Sphere. Thanks to Ricardo's efforts, he was able to calm her down enough so that she would make the windstorm subside. After Anastasia's group arrived and met with Zarestia, they learned that [[Riften Magoji]] was missing, that Zarestia was a Great Spirit, and that her Light Sphere was missing. After she also claimed to not be responsible for the wind cataclysms outside of her rampage in Banan, a massive tornado unconnected to Zarestia appeared outside of town, and they decided to prevent it from harming the townsfolk. Once the tornado was dealt with, however, Anastasia and Echidna were kidnapped by the one who stole Zarestia's Light Sphere, [[Reize]]. Thanks to some negotiating on Anastasia's part, however, in exchange for returning the Light Sphere, she chose to assist Reize in her goal of revenge against the one who destroyed her home and people, Capella, and she negotiated with Zarestia about receiving her assistance a little over a day after returning to her camp.

==Achievements==
*Improving the flow of the country’s economy by introducing the Hoshin Company’s business.
*Jointly assisting in the defeat of the White Whale with the Iron Fang.
*Assisting in the defeat of the Sin Archbishop of Sloth and his fingers.
**Julius’s part in defeating Petelgeuse himself.
**The Iron Fang capturing the Sin Archbishop’s fingers.
*Repelling the Witch Cult during the [[Battle for Priestella]].
**Anastasia acting partially as a general during the event.
*Reaching and conquering the Pleiades Watchtower.
**Defeating the three Sin Archbishops of Gluttony.
***Julius defeating and sealing Roy Alphard.
*Formed good relations with the Kararagi League of Cities.
*Assisting Vollachia as a member of the temporary alliance.
*Putting an end to the Great Disaster, a threat that could have consumed Lugunica as well.
