The '''Crusch Camp''' (クルシュ陣営, ''Kurushu Jin'ei'') is a [[Royal Selection]] team that is led by Duchess [[Crusch Karsten]].

==Information==
Crusch stated that the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] is too dependent on the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon Volcanica]], and that everyone forgot to fight on their own as of right now. Because of this, she is willing to break the contract between [[Farsale Lugunica]] and the Divine Dragon, although she continues to recognize the contributions made by the Dragon over the years.

Crusch believes that the kingdom must learn to fight for itself, become independent, and plan to form a government well-structured enough not to require the help of the Dragon again. On the other hand, she constantly moves the economy of the country with the purchase of iron products for the manufacture of arms and armor in order to strengthen the defenses of Lugunica and preserve security against potential threats, true to her word.

==History==
Shortly after the [[Royal Plague|extinction]] of the [[Royal Family]] of Lugunica, [[Leip Barielle]], the man responsible for the care of the country’s [[Dragon History Stone]], revealed to all of the nobles present the means chosen by the stone to determine the country’s next ruler. When the Dragon Insignia reached Crusch, the Jewel embedded within shined brightly, displaying her right to vie for the right to rule the country. Having just seen the weakness of the nobility due to their reliance on the Dragon, her resolve to sever the contract with it strengthened dramatically. Armed with the dream once carried by the late [[Fourier Lugunica]], she proceeded to knight her dear friend [[Ferris]], and the two went on to become the first of the five camps vying for the throne.

Over the course of the following year, she maintained and increased the country’s economy, utilizing the iron products that were manufactured in the strengthening of the country’s military, stocking up on various armaments and armors. Similarly, the military is also being trained to a greater extent to ward off the potential threat of an attack or invasion. Close to the start of the Royal Selection, she even managed to recruit [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] into her camp with the promise of helping him slay the [[White Whale]].

By the start of the Royal Selection, she had already cemented herself as the favorite candidate among the nobility and populace, already having a great reputation as both an extremely competent Duchess and a powerful soldier with the epithet of The Valkyrie. A few days after the start, she entered negotiations with [[Natsuki Subaru]] of the [[Emilia Camp]], and with the promise of rights to the magic stones that were within the lands of [[Elior Forest]], they made an alliance to work together to slay the coming White Whale.

The next evening, she brought along with her an army of knights, former members of the units involved in the [[Great Conquest]], mercenaries of the [[Iron Fang]] (allies involved with the [[Anastasia Camp]]), Wilhelm and Ferris, and Subaru and [[Rem]] to [[Flugel's Tree]] on the Lifaus Highway. After a long and drawn-out battle, they successfully managed to bring down the Great Witchbeast, allowing Crusch to fulfill her promise with Wilhelm.

After shaking hands with Subaru and offering the assistance of some of her knights, including Wilhelm and Ferris, to defeat the [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]], she and Rem decided to return to the [[Royal Capital]] with the wounded. Unfortunately, along the way, their convoy was attacked by the [[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishops]] of [[Regulus Corneas|Greed]] and [[Lye Batenkaitos|Gluttony]]. After being quickly defeated, Crusch’s memories were devoured by Gluttony. Despite this, the alliance between her camp and [[Emilia]]‘s was maintained.

Over the course of the next year, due to having lost the gravitas she once had, her standings in the Royal Selection have diminished as nobody was made aware of her memory loss besides the parties involved. According to [[Otto Suwen]], it appeared as though [[Meckart Karsten]] has returned to help govern the Duchy while she struggled with her memories. However, there is no confirmation whether he officially joined her camp or only appeared to help the Duchy in her place. She also met and had an interview with [[Shorty Megan]] and [[Lululala]], where she states that the Emilia Camp is the one to watch.

Eventually, [[Anastasia Hoshin]] invited her and members of her camp to [[Priestella]] so that the two could know each other better, using the potential whereabouts of Gluttony as a way to draw her in. Soon after began the [[Battle for Priestella]], in which the Witch Cult attacked and held the city hostage. Crusch was one of the people involved in the battle to reclaim City Hall, but after she was defeated, she was left cursed by the [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop of Lust]]’s cursed Dragon’s blood, and she was forced to remain bedridden. Meanwhile, Wilhelm continued to fight against the Witch Cult, being partially responsible for the defeat of his [[Undead|undead]] wife, [[Theresia van Astrea]].

Following the Battle for Priestella, Wilhelm and Ferris continued to care for Crusch, whose condition did not improve, at the Karsten Estate in the Royal Capital, and Wilhelm underwent vigorous training to return himself to nearly the level of his prime. After hearing of the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|conquering]] of the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], Wilhelm and Ferris visited the [[Royal Capital]] in an effort to learn more about it and help with the investigation, and there, Ferris met a nun of the [[Divine Dragon Church]] claiming her name to be [[Filore]], who stated the church could save Crusch. After some time, Ferris allowed Filore to heal Crusch, which resulted in her curse being removed and her memories being restored. Because of this, Ferris resigned as her knight, and after their respective meetings with Subaru's group, Ferris subsequently made a deal with [[Russell Fellow]] to assist him and the [[Six Tongues]].

A couple of days later, seeking his advice, Crusch snuck out of her residence and met with [[Miklotov McMahon]] in his residence. However, shortly after arriving, thanks to their suspicious behavior and her Divine Protection, she recognized everyone in the manor as a traitor to the Kingdom, even suspecting Miklotov himself of having manipulated Ferris, and she cut down everyone inside. Shortly after, she was forced to battle a newly arrived Subaru, [[Beatrice]], and [[Tiga Rauleon]]. Ultimately, however, because she realized that Subaru was not her enemy and because of Tiga's actions resulting in Subaru getting injured and nearly killed, Beatrice assisted Crusch in escaping with Subaru, and they became wanted fugitives. Meanwhile, Wilhelm assisted the other Emilia Camp during their attempted escape from the government as well. Ultimately, after Subaru learned of the reason behind her actions, he willingly decided to assist her or stop her if need be.

Subaru's group ultimately found themselves being assisted by [[Rachins Hoffman]] of the [[Felt Camp]], and shortly after Crusch passed out from the strain of her new Dragon Eye, they were approached by "Black Dog" of the Six Tongues and attacked by [[Clarissa]] of the [[Beloved Children]]. After the group escaped to a temporary Six Tongues base, they were informed of their enemy and made the choice to escape the Royal Capital. Although they were met by resistance from the knights near the gates following an accident that Subaru and Ferris were assisting with helping, after Crusch gave the ultimatum to Russell that she would not help the Six Tongues without Subaru being there, they managed to escape together.

**Ferris and Wilhelm van Astrea assisting in the subjugation of the Sin Archbishop’s fingers.
*Repelling the [[Witch Cult]] during the Battle for Priestella.

[[File:Watergate City of Priestella Anime design.png|thumb|300px]]
'''Priestella''' (プリステラ, ''Purisutera''), also known as the '''Watergate City of Priestella''' (水門都市プリステラ, ''Suimon Toshi Purisutera'') or the '''Capital of Water''' (水の都, ''Mizu no Miyako''), is one of the Five Great Cities in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]. It is located near the western border with [[Kararagi]] and the Tigracy River in the far western part of the country. The city of Priestella was formerly led by the Priestellan Council of Ten until nine of them were slaughtered by an unknown perpetrator during the [[Battle for Priestella]], leaving only [[Kiritaka Muse]] alive. It is the primary setting for the events of [[Arc 5]].

==Information==
Priestella is a large, upside-down shaped dome-like walled city, located directly at the Kingdom's border with the Kararagi City States. It was built approximately four centuries ago, using four centuries old combination of technologies. Furthermore, the city was said to have been built by none other than [[Alec Hoshin|Hoshin of the Wilderness]], and throughout history, the city itself was a cause of considerable territorial disputes between the two nations, though it currently belongs to Lugunica. Due to Kararagi's influence, the city has notable traces of the so-called ''Kararagi-style'' and ''Jabanees-style'' architecture and overall culture; inns that are extremely similar to the traditional Japanese-style inns both [[Al]] and [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] are familiar with from Japan, can be visited all across the city, with one of them even being the location of the initial meeting of four of the [[Royal Selection]] Candidates' camps at the start of Arc 5.

Priestella is the closest city to Kararagi, with the Tigracy River separating the two. It is a beautiful city and a famous tourist location that is built in the middle of a large lake, with waterways running through the city. The waterways divide the city into four blocks called '''City Districts''' which are numbered clockwise from the main gate. According to Subaru, the city sees most of its traffic in the First and Second Districts.<ref>''"A stonework structure, the Muse Company stood between Priestella's First and Second Districts. From what he'd heard, most of the traffic in the city was concentrated in these two districts."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 2, Section 9.</ref>

The city itself is built like a sports arena with a basin at its center. In the event of a flood, the center would be instantly submerged. In order to have water canals in which people could travel via water dragons, Hoshin used an intricate magical mechanism which stand at each of the four cardinal points–the control towers. These towers are massive stone pillars, and according to Emilia, they all are some sort of complex [[Meteor|meteors]].<ref>''"Those are the control towers that regulate the flow of water inside the city. Apparently, the towers themselves are complex meteors that use the power of water magic crystals to control the current. It seems the city's huge water gates are also operated from there."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 2, Section 6.</ref> They are used to regulate the flow of water throughout the entire city, either lowering or rising the water levels. Their main purposes, however, are so to prevent the water from building up in one specific spot (in this case, in the center of the city), send the water through water canals and creating some sort of artificial rivers (as mentioned above) and to flood the city if necessary. The magical mechanism is even capable of making half of the water from one single waterway flow in one direction while the other one flows in the other direction, effectively making Priestella's waterways flow in both directions.

Priestella was governed over by the Priestellan Council of Ten, a group of ten powerful and wealthy individuals, with Kiritaka Muse acting as their leader of sorts. Due to the influx of Kararagi's culture at Priestella's border, it was inspired by Kararagi's League of Cities,<ref>''“Rather, Priestella’s Council of Ten is probably modelled after the League of Cities. As is the case with the Water Plumage Inn, there is a large influx of Kararagi culture in Priestella along the border.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> which is made up of ten representatives from each of Kararagi's ten major cities. During the Witch Cult's attack on the city in Arc 5, everyone in the council save for Kiritaka were slaughtered, presumably by the Witch Cult; however, according to [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]], they were uninvolved, and she theorized that the one who killed them was Al.

During said attack, a large portion of Priestella was destroyed. When one of the water gates was shortly opened, it allowed the water to flood the district for a short time. While the Muse Company took considerable damage, City Hall was completely decimated during the fight against Capella. Meanwhile, the Third District, where the fight against Regulus took place, left many buildings crushed, destroyed, and erased, numerous holes were left in the ground, and portions of the district were flooded with water, among other damages. After the fight, the residents began to rebuild upon the damages.

==History==
Priestella was built as a trap mechanism for extremely dangerous individuals and creatures, specifically the [[Witch|Witches]] and strong [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]]. The control towers were designed so that they could flood the entire city when the flood gates are all released. This mechanism was successfully used in the past to kill [[Typhon]].

Around 100 years prior to the story’s beginning, Lugunica and Kararagi fought for the rights over Priestella. Though it was within Lugunica’s domain, due to its proximity to Kararagi and the fact that Alec Hoshin was responsible for the city’s creation, Kararagi demanded rights over the city. In the end, however, after a drawn-out economic conflict, Lugunica maintained rights over Priestella.<ref>''According to Otto, the two nations had gone to war over it about a hundred years in the past. Geographically, Priestella was part of Lugunica’s territory, but the fact that its formation was influenced by the prestigious state head of Kararagi, Hoshin, had loomed large, and the the current-day arrangement was born after a drawn-out economic conflict.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 2, Section 5.</ref>

A year after Subaru's arrival in Lugunica, [[Anastasia Hoshin]] decided to organize a party in Priestella for the camps participating in the Royal Selection. As they arrived, most of the [[Witch Cult]]'s Sin Archbishops arrived in the city for various reasons and took control of it, with their demands being the Book of Wisdom, an artificial spirit, a Witch's remains, and from [[Regulus Corneas]], to not interrupt his forced wedding with [[Emilia]]. Because of this, all five Royal Selection Camps were required to work together in order to quell the incident.

As the fighting came to its conclusion, Regulus Corneas was killed by [[Reinhard van Astrea]] and Natsuki Subaru, and [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]] was captured with the help of [[Liliana Masquerade]] and [[Priscilla Barielle]]. Despite their triumph, various people were transformed into different forms by Capella Emerada Lugunica, and several, including [[Crusch Karsten]], were afflicted by the curse within her Dragon's blood. The Sin Archbishops of Gluttony also erased the existence multiple people, including [[Julius Juukulius]], who only lost his name, and [[Joshua Juukulius]], who was robbed of his name and memories. To look for answers, Anastasia Hoshin suggested visiting the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], which resulted in her camp and the Emilia Camp leading a group to visit there.

With that group gone, [[Garfiel Tinzel]] helped with the reconstruction efforts, and later, he helped retrieve the remains of the Witch that were within the city’s catacombs.

==Locations==
*'''Tigracy Bridge''' (ティグラシー大橋, ''Tigurashī Ōhashi''): A stone bridge that sits over the Tigracy River on the Lugunican side which leads to the front gates of Priestella.
*'''Water Plumage Inn''' (水の羽衣亭, ''Mizu no Hagoromo-tei''): A Kararagi style inn located in Priestella's first avenue.
*'''Muse Company''' (ミューズ商会, ''Myūzu Shōkai''): The Muse Company is a large building primarily built out of stone. It's strategically situated between Priestella's First and Second Districts–an area which holds the most traffic in the entire city and is therefore the most ideal place for merchants to have their offices. The building itself is the base of operations for Muse Company, the most powerful and influential merchant company in Priestella, ran by Kiritaka Muse. He hires the [[White Dragon's Scales]] to protect his goods. The building was temporarily used as a headquarters during the Battle for Priestella, and it took heavy damage during the fight.
*'''The Great Temple '''(大神殿, ''Daishinden''): A temple located underneath Priestella, where the Witch of Pride's remains are said to be kept. It can be accessed through a secret door in the area under the canals, that masks a trapdoor. The Temple is protected by a Guardian, with a grotesque appearance. It's described to not be a witchbeast, and to have an appearance that looked like it had been formed by a lot of rats coming together, with heads coming out of its torso.
*'''The Four Control Towers''': At all four sides of the city–north, south, west and east–there lies one massive stone tower. As mentioned above, the towers themselves are complex meteors housing water magic crystals, and server as regulators of the water channels' flow and amount of water. Furthermore, one can open up the floodgates and flood the entire city. During Arc 5, one of the floodgates was opened, and the result was a total submersion of one of the four districts. During the Battle for Priestella, one of the control towers collapsed from the might of the Sin Archbishop of Wrath.
*'''City Hall''': The City Hall is a tall building in the center of the city. It houses a large communication device used to broadcast all over the city. During the Battle for Priestella, it was completely destroyed.
*'''Time Towers''': All across Priestella, several Time Towers can be found scattered around. These Time Towers are usually built out of stone and are rather tall, with a tall spire at its peak. At its upper portion, one can see a magic crystal clock, which works similarly to normal clocks from Earth. In truth, the point of Time Towers is to help people track the time of day. One of these Time Towers was the location of Sirius' original introduction in the city, and it was damaged at the start of the battle against her in the Battle for Priestella.
*'''City Park''': Priestella has its very own city park, filled with meticulously maintained flower beds, a large green lawn and at its center, there's a dazzling water fountain, which could only be described as perfect for its location. According to Subaru and Beatrice, the park is perhaps the most beautiful and relaxing location in the entire city.
*'''Church''': Priestella's branch of the [[Divine Dragon Church]], located in the Third District. It received heavy damage from the battle with Regulus.

The '''Sanctuary of Kremaldy''' (クレマルディの聖域, ''Kuremarudi no Seiiki''), also known as the '''Witch of Greed's Graveyard''' (強欲の魔女の墓場, ''Gōyoku no Majo no Hakaba'') is a village created by [[Echidna]]. It was protected by the [[House Mathers]] throughout generations. It was one of the two primary settings for the events of [[Arc 4]].

==Information==
[[File:Sanctuary_village_ep.28.png|thumb|260px]]
The Sanctuary is a poor village located within Roswaal's territory which has been taken care of by the various Mathers over the years. The village itself is a group of buildings located in a clearing within the forest and only [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] with mixed half-bloods lived there. It is surrounded by a short fence with an old stone gate at the entrance. The Sanctuary's original purpose was to keep the [[Hector|Warlock of Melancholy]] away from Echidna.

==History==
Many years ago, Echidna, alongside [[Beatrice]], [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu Meyer]], and her student [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal A. Mathers]], often visited the Sanctuary. In her experiments with immortality, Ryuzu often helped her. Over time, she even made [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|numerous clones]] of Ryuzu. One day, however, Hector located her and entered the Sanctuary. In an attempt to ward him off, Roswaal and Echidna faced him down, and Ryuzu offered herself up to become the core of the Sanctuary's barrier. This barrier, while successful in pushing away Hector, trapped all half-blooded demi-humans within. Echidna's soul was later sealed by [[Volcanica]], becoming a part of the Sanctuary's barrier and trials. After this, the copies of Ryuzu administered the Sanctuary, and the House Mathers chose to protect the cemetery for several generations.

One day, Roswaal L. Mathers took the homeless family of [[Reala Thompson|Reshia Tinzel]] to the Sanctuary to live there, and in the future, she left her two children, [[Frederica Baumann|Frederica]] and [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]], alone. After some years, Frederica decided to leave the Sanctuary to find a place for the demi-humans to live after the Sanctuary's barrier eventual fall, deciding to become a maid for House Mathers and Miload Manor.

At some point, Garfiel tested the trials and failed, witnessing his mother's death, refusing it, and becoming an Apostle of Greed. Ryuzu Shima went to rescue Garfiel, which Echidna, who was responsible for the trials within the [[Castle of Dreams]], took advantage of to create a path to eventually bring herself back to life. Afterward, Shima lost her position as one of the administrators, and she lives separately from the other Ryuzus.

Eventually, Roswaal returned in an apparent attempt to complete Echidna's tests to free the demi-humans, ending up seriously injured in the process. Thus, he could not return to his [[Roswaal Manor|mansion]]. Later, the villagers of [[Arlam Village]] were brought to the Sanctuary after being evacuated by some merchants associated with [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], who soon arrived with [[Emilia]] to help them return to the village that had already saved from the [[Witch Cult]]. With his plan in motion, Roswaal convinced the two to carry out the trials in his place.

Unfortunately, things did not go according to his plan, as Subaru had gone through several loops and made a bet to defeat him. Though Subaru had gone through the first and second trial and met with the [[Witch#Witches of Sin|Witches of Sin]], he refused to go along with Roswaal's plan and started making countermeasures. He spoke with [[Puck]] and convinced him to temporarily leave Emilia's side to protect her from the threat of Roswaal and to restore her memories. Then, after breaking a promise to Emilia, causing her to hide, he found her, made up with her, and gave her the strength she needed to take on the trials. Later, after fighting and defeating Garfiel with the help of [[Ram]], [[Otto Suwen]], and [[Patrasche]] and enlisting his assistance, Subaru, Garfiel, Otto, and Patrasche left for Roswaal Manor to face off his [[Elsa Granhiert|hired]] [[Meili Portroute|assassins]], and Emilia started taking on the trials.

After completing the first trial, she spoke with Ram and Roswaal, the latter of whom was trying mentally attack her. After he failed, she took on and overcame the second trial. Meanwhile, Roswaal went to cast a great magic to summon the [[Great Rabbit]], though he was temporarily interrupted by Ram and Puck, and they entered battle. After losing his Book of Wisdom to fire and severely injuring Ram, snow began to fall, and Puck went to protect the villagers while Roswaal attempted to save Ram. After Emilia conquered the third trial and severed the spell attached to Echidna's deceased body, she left to find a large field of snow and the villagers protected by ice. She then went to go to the crystal that held the original Ryuzu's body, and the barrier was brought down with the sacrifice of Shima. On her way back, after she confronted Roswaal, they were assailed by the Great Rabbit, and they retreated to the tomb. Soon after, Subaru and Beatrice arrived, and they and Emilia defeated the Great Rabbit.

With the Sanctuary no longer "protected" by the barrier, the villagers decided to leave the Sanctuary with the [[Arlam Village]]rs. Soon after, a convoy led by [[Annerose Miload]] and [[Clind]] arrived, and everyone was escorted out of the Forest of Kremaldy. A short time later, however, Shima appeared, bearing the soul of Echidna and holding a glintstone carrying the souls of the other Witches. Deciding to go by the name [[Omega]], she left the Sanctuary behind.

==Trials of the Tomb==
In order for the barrier surrounding the village to come down, one must take on the '''Trials''' (試練, ''Shiren'') of the Tomb. The trials take place within Echidna's Tomb at nighttime. In them, those that choose to challenge the trials must confront their past, present, and future, and only then will one have access to the depths of the tomb and the core of the barrier that lies within: the corpse of the Witch of Greed. In order to take the trials, the challenger must enter the tomb and reach the large room within. Once there, after hearing the objective of the trial echo in their head, the trial begins, forcing their body to lose consciousness while the mind experiences the trials. From the outside, one can tell that the trial is underway by the tomb glowing with a blue light, and if that shine disappears, it means that the trial is over. In order to retake a failed trial or to start the next trial, the challenger must exit the tomb after the previous attempt, and after a short amount of time, reenter the tomb.

However, only a very specific few types of people are allowed to take on the trials. In order to enter the tomb without backlash, they must have demi-human blood mixed with human blood or a Witch Factor. Anyone else would be barred from entering the tomb, and the greater the capacity one has to hold mana within their gate, the greater the backlash of attempting to enter becomes; Roswaal, whose gate is one of the greatest in the series, was left heavily injured upon attempting to enter the tomb, while Subaru, whose right to take on the trials was revoked and had a less than average gate capacity, felt incredible nausea just by lingering in the entrance which only got worse the longer he stayed inside or farther in he went.

It is possible for anyone with a Witch Factor or mixed blood descent to have their rights to take the trials and enter the tomb revoked. Ultimately, the choice to have it revoked falls solely on the shoulders of Echidna, who watches over the trials from her Castle of Dreams and will even appear during the trials. As there has only been one case of having one's right to take the trials revoked, it can be assumed that this rarely happens unless one gets one Echidna's bad side or due to her whims.

It is also possible for Echidna or one of the other connected Witches of Sin to interfere with the trial. Echidna can use the trials to harass the challenger if she chooses, whereas other Witches might interfere to stop this harassment or to prevent the challenger from having a mental breakdown caused by the anguish. Like with Echidna's choice to revoke one's rights to challenge the trials, it is down to the personality and whims of any of the individual Witches to choose whether or not they will interfere.

===First Trial===
''"First off, face your past."''

In '''the First Trial''' (第一の試練, ''Dai Ichi no Shiren''), the trial considered the hardest of the three, the challenger is shown the illusion of their past. No matter whether they have forgotten their past, refused to accept it, or if that past took place foreign to the world, the trial shows them everything that they experienced in their youths. In order to complete this trial, the challenger must accept their past. On the other hand, if they refuse to accept the past, the challenger will fail, and they will be forced to retake the trial if they wish to proceed. There are no limits to how many times the challenger can take on this trial, but in immense mental duress, it can cause extreme emotional and mental distress on the challenger, and if one has become unstable, it can cause the challenger to risk losing their mind, depending on exactly what they see in the trial.

===Second Trial===
''"See the unimaginable present."''

In '''the Second Trial''' (第二の試練, ''Daini no Shiren''), the challenger is shown an illusion of an alternate timeline of what could have been the present day. Those futures could be happy, or those futures could be sad. Regardless, in order to overcome this trial, one must choose to accept reality over this dream. Uniquely, in Subaru's case, he was shown timelines of what could have happened after each of his individual deaths in previous failed loops assuming that they continued after he died. Because of this aspect, Subaru was forced to take this trial multiple times in a row until he went through each timeline.

===Third Trial===
''"Face the impending disaster."''

In '''the Third Trial''' (第三の試練 ''Dai San no Shiren''), the challenger is shown the illusion of many potential, but not necessarily destined, futures in which both good and bad things will happen. In Emilia's case, she was shown almost exclusively bad futures, but once [[Minerva]] interfered, she claimed that that was because Echidna was attempting to harass her. In order to overcome this trial and complete them all, the challenger must choose to keep moving forward, even if they know that a tragic future might await them.

Once this trial is complete, the challenger has completed the trials in their entirety. Upon awakening, the challenger will be able to enter the room in the back of the tomb. There, they will find Echidna's corpse and the numerous magic connections that it held that was keeping the barrier in check. If the challenger chooses to break those magical connections, not only will the barrier come down, but the trials would ultimately come to an end for good.

==Locations==
*'''Sanctuary Barrier''' (聖域の結界 ''Seiiki no Kekkai''): A barrier created by Echidna that prevents half-bloods from leaving it. Any half-bloods that come close to it start to lose consciousness and feel as if their existence is being disturbed. Even if someone takes an unconscious half-blood out of the barrier, they will never wake up as their spirit is trapped within it.<ref>''"But, unconscious halves taken outside of the barrier won’t wake up. Their minds are left behind inside the barrier."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref> The barrier checks the blood of those that go near it and only affects those it clearly determines as half-bloods. It also causes those who are not permitted to enter the Sanctuary to get lost. With the completion of the Sanctuary’s trials, the barrier has been removed.
*'''Echidna's Tomb''': Echidna's final resting place and where the trials needed to lift the barrier are conducted at night. During the day, miasma bars entry to anyone except to those without the qualifications to enter. In order to meet the tomb's requirements, one must either be a mixed blood demi-human or own a Witch Factor.
*'''Residency Area''': The place where denizens of Sanctuary live. The buildings are largely dilapidated which give the whole area a run-down look. There is farmland for growing some crops, but residents otherwise rely on Roswaal for gathering and delivering necessities from the outside.
*'''Cathedral''': A large building where the citizens of Arlam Village stayed during their captivity.
*'''Laboratory''': A strange white building that belonged to Echidna, situated away from the village area of Sanctuary and deeper into the forest. It is made of a strange material that does not wear or tear from the elements and an odd smell exudes from the structure.

[[Volcanica]] |forces3= |forces4= |casual1 = Entire force wiped out apart from Kurgan |casual2 = Heavy losses among the Subjugation Force with heavy civilian casualties |casual3= |casual4= |civilian=}} The '''Subjugation of the Blight Dragon''' (邪龍討滅戦) was a battle that took place between 38 and 39 years before [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s arrival in the world, and it is the primary conflict of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]]. Following an attack on the Astrea Manor and the McMahon Manor, [[Stride Vollachia]], who had kidnapped the pregnant [[Theresia van Astrea]] and cursed [[Carol Remendis]], led his followers to the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]]'s [[Picoutatte|Commercial City of Picoutatte]], where he summoned a powerful and dangerous [[Dragon|Blight Dragon]]: the black, three-headed Dragon [[Valgren]]. Chasing after his mortal enemy, accompanied by the [[Royal Army#Zergev Squadron|Zergev Squadron]], the [[Royal Army]], and [[Roswaal J. Mathers]], [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] led an assault against the man, the [[Witch Cult]]'s Sin Archbishop of Pride, and intended to save his wife and bring an end to Stride's schemes. Ultimately, despite the loss of Roswaal, the Stride Faction collapsed, with Stride and his [[Melinda|wife]] being devoured by Valgren, Shasuke being sliced in two by Carol, and Kurgan being defeated in battle by Wilhelm. Valgren, manipulated by Stride's [[Authority#Authority of Pride|Authority of Pride]] following his death, went on a rampage, leading to its epic confrontation with Wilhelm. The battle finally came to an end when the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] made its appearance to uphold the covenant to the Kingdom, annihilating Valgren and reaffirming the people's faith in the Kingdom's covenant. The events here were later immortalized in a song called the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon. ==Prelude== A short time after the [[Demi-Human War]] ended, Stride Vollachia had set his eyes on the Kingdom as part of the show he wanted to create. His incursions against the Kingdom had resulted in [[Veltol Astrea]] being left disabled as well as countless other damages. His transgressions reached a boiling point when he cursed Carol Remendis and made her kill Veltol before the both of them made off with the Sword Saint, Theresia van Astrea. Wilhelm, who'd already been trying to track Stride down, was informed of those events by Bordeaux. He found out from Tishua, who'd been made a mouthpiece by Stride using his curse rings, that Stride was awaiting them in Picoutatte. As a result, [[Bordeaux Zergev]] quickly rallied a subjugation force together which numbered approximately 1000 strong. The subjugation force consisted of soldiers and knights who revered Theresia for her role in ending almost a decade-long Civil War. The force also included the Zergev Squadron, now commanded by Wilhelm, as well as Roswaal J. Mathers. The force set out from the Royal Capital and rushed towards Picoutatte. ==Battle== Prior to the arrival of the Kingdom's Subjugation Force, Stride made his preparations by getting Melinda to find people with Divine Protections to be sacrificed for the purpose of summoning the Black Dragon. As well as that, he instated the forbidden art he obtained from [[Sphinx]]'s Testing Grounds around the city so that the area there would be cut off from the world, meaning that Divine Protections would stop working there, as well as disabling the "magical alert system" set up by the Divine Dragon, which would notify him in case of an attack. Meanwhile, Melinda helped set up the defenses by using her Evil Eyes to control all the citizens of Picoutatte, turning them into a swarm to be launched against the Kingdom's Forces. Finally, Stride ordered Carol to kill the sacrifices with his Dragon Fang, and completed the process of summoning the Black Dragon Valgren. As the Kingdom's Subjugation Force approached the gates of Picoutatte, they were met by a head on volley of flame from Valgren's breath. This devastating pre-emptive blow caused serious damage to their forces, killing many and injuring many more. Despite that, the Kingdom's Forces managed to rally their strengths again and pressed on into the city after sending their injured back to nearby towns. The rallied forces pressed into the city, and were met by the effects of Sphinx's forbidden art, which Stride had implanted. As a result, they dismounted from their Dragon Carriages and continued on foot. However, they were soon met by the swarm of citizens, Melinda was controlling with her Evil Eyes. Their offensive battle quickly turned to a defensive one so that they weren't crushed in the stampede. The Kingdom's Forces tried to defend themselves against the swarm without killing any of the citizens, however reinforcements soon arrived from Stride's faction in the form of [[Raizo|one of the ''Twin Shura'']]. Raizo quickly cut his way through the Kingdom's defensive formation, attacking the trapped Knights from behind, threatening to collapse their line. His challenge was quickly met by Wilhelm, and then Roswaal, however, Vollachia's strongest warrior quickly came to bolster the Stride faction's defenses. In the confusion, Raizo was able to use his ability to transport Grimm Fauzen and Roswaal to the Spire rooftop where Stride was waiting at with Valgren above. ===Battle on the Streets of Picoutatte=== Back on the streets of Picoutatte, the weakening Royal Forces continued to hold their defensive line against the controlled citizens whilst Wilhelm fought Kurgan and Bordeaux fought Raizo. The tide of battle started to turn when Bordeaux, though sustaining heavy injuries, defeated Raizo. Wilhelm, in turn, managed to defeat Kurgan, leaving him mortally wounded as the citizens of Picoutatte began to come back to their senses thanks to Melinda's Evil Eye being defeated by Theresia. ===Battle on the Spire Rooftop=== Taking place simultaneously with the battle in Picoutatte, Roswaal fought against the [[Shasuke|other Twin Shura]] whilst the cursed Carol was forced to fight against her lover, Grimm. Contrary to expectations, Grimm was able to hold his ground, so Stride commanded Shasuke to kill Carol. However, he was thwarted by Roswaal who sacrificed herself for her friend. The tide of battle changed after this, with Grimm causing Stride to summon his Yang Sword Vollachia, which ultimately led to him being forced to cut his own left arm off, losing half of his curse rings and as a result, control on Carol and Valgren. The ensuing fight led to both his, Melinda and Shasuke's death. ===The Subjugation of Valgren=== In death, Stride's curse tools continued to bind Valgren to his will, and made it unleash its fiery breath down at the streets of the prematurely celebrating Royal Forces. Heavy losses were incurred amongst the Subjugation Force and the Picoutatte citizens. Wilhelm and Grimm challenged the Dragon, and were successfully able to wound it. However, the tide of battle shifted completely in their favour when Gionis Lugunica stirred, having been able to use the help of [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] to destroy the forbidden art that prevented him from calling for Volcanica's assistance. As a result, Volcanica appeared and destroyed Valgren and healed the world around them of their wounds and the dragonfire. ==Aftermath== The battle was a major victory for the Lugunican military, despite incurring heavy losses among their forces and the non-combatants of the city. Volcanica's appearance reaffirmed Lugunica's might thanks to the covenant binding them, reaffirming itself as a deterrence to any enemy invaders. Furthermore, the victory allowed them to seize the political upper-hand with their negotiations for compensation and culpability with the [[Vollachia Empire]], extraditing their political prisoner Kurgan back to the Empire in the hope of trying to get them to acknowledge Stride's existence. However, Stride was effectively erased from history by Vollachia, and according to [[Vincent Vollachia]], who later discovered his journal, anyone who learned of him could have been punished for it. After his extradition to Vollachia, Kurgan was sentenced to slave labor in the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]], and although he could have used force to resist his fate, he chose to accept it, performing labor in Garkla for the rest of his days. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Picoutatte]]

title: Imperial Army
wikitext:
[[File:Crystal Palace Guards and the Prime Minister.jpg|thumb|275px|Crystal Palace guards escorting the Prime Minister, [[Berstetz Fondalfon]].]] The '''Imperial Army''' (帝国軍, ''Teikoku-gun'') are the armed forces of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], most commonly dispatched under the direct command of the emperor. It is tasked with maintaining relative peace in the Empire, protecting the emperor, squashing any major rebellions that periodically appear throughout the nation, and patrolling its major border checkpoints. ==Information== Among the Four Great Nations, the Sacred Vollachia Empire is noted for having the largest and strongest army. Due to the Empire's code of the strong rule over the weak, each and every member of the army is a strong and capable individual, willing to give their life for the emperor. If one does not display the resolve to die for the emperor, they're subjected to harsh and cruel punishments. For example, among the guards tasked with guarding the Royal Chamber, it is forbidden to display even a hint of cowardliness or hesitation. When one of the guards' swords trembled for but a mere second upon facing [[Bordeaux Zergev]], he was swiftly forced to cut his own throat in front of the emperor. In case he would have refused to take his own life, another guard would. According to [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], cowardliness is a disease that can easily shake the very core of an army, hence it must be eradicated the very second it reveals its foul head. Due to a massive military failure surrounding the use of Yang Magic centuries ago by the emperor [[Minor Characters#Murkia Vollachia|Murkia Vollachia]], the army has shied away from the use of [[magic]], instead favoring the utilizations of various forms of martial arts, unique traits related to specific [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], powerful equipment, and creative, strange, and even lost techniques. As such, when it comes to pure skill among the army, the Imperial Army easily has some of the most physically powerful soldiers when compared to the other nations. It is precisely for this reason that people like [[Kurgan]] and [[Cecilus Segmunt]] stand out among the military. However, because of the lack of magic rampant through the nation, healing magic is considered a precious commodity that the army lacks. Because of their lack of healing magic, the army has to use cruder methods of mending injuries, such as stitching wounds shut or using medicines that may or may not work. This being said, even in the case of this, due to the views of how the strong trample the weak, it is not unlikely that the soldiers of the army would ignore their injured comrades in favor of continuing to fight. The Imperial Army typically has two sets of positions consisting of '''Imperial Soldiers''' (帝国軍人, ''Teikoku Gunjin'') and '''Generals''' (将軍, ''Shogun''). They can be further divided into five ranks, listed in order from lowest to highest: '''Private''' (兵卒, ''Heisotsu''), '''Private First-Class''' (上等兵, ''Jōtō-hei''), '''Third-Class General''' (三将, ''Sanshō''), '''Second-Class General''' (二将, ''Nishō''), and '''First-Class General''' (一将, ''Isshō''). According to the previous Ninth ranking Divine General, Balleroy Temeglyph, there were nine First-Class Generals in total at the time, and those nine were collectively referred to as the '''Nine Divine Generals''' (九神将, ''Kyūshinshō''). According to [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], as of the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], there were fifty Second-Class Generals.''"Listen here, you, why do ya think there are fifty Second-Class Generals and only nine First-Class Generals? ――It’s ‘cause we’re so stupidly strong."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 95, Section 1. Those who reach the rank of General are no longer required to wear armor. Furthermore, the Divine Generals are equivalent to the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica's commander of the Royal Guard in how much authority they possess. Following the [[Great Disaster]], the unique, special position of '''Escort General''' (親将, ''Shinshō''), the personal guard of the emperor and the empress consort, was established and assigned to [[Jamal Aurélie]] by reason of his contributions during the aforementioned disaster. At present, due to the [[Imperial Civil War]] and the Great Disaster, much of the army has been wiped out. ===Nine Divine Generals=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 28 1.png|thumb|250px|right|The Nine Divine Generals as of Volume 28.]] There exists a group of elite soldiers within the Vollachian military dubbed the '''Nine Divine Generals''' (九神将, ''Kyūshinshō'') who consists of strongest or most accomplished members in the army and enjoy a considerable amount of influence within the country. The Nine Divine Generals consist of all nine First-Class Generals, and sit on the upper echelon of the military, having supreme authority over the Imperial Army and work directly under the emperor's orders. They have their own sub-hierarchy numbering from one to nine with a lower number denoting a higher rank. As mentioned above, with the title of a Divine General, one gets significant authority in the nation. However, lower ranks don't always denote higher authority. An example would be the First ranking Divine General Cecilus Segmunt. Despite being the nation's strongest individual and fully capable of taking out all other Divine Generals combined, Cecilus is not well-liked and has miniscule influence, compared to individuals such as the Fourth ranking Divine General [[Chisha Gold]], who is among the weakest of the Divine Generals, but greatly excels in tactics and planning, acting as the emperor's tactician and decoy. According to [[Berstetz Fondalfon]], the system known as the "Nine Divine Generals" was not always present in the Imperial Army. Centuries ago, the Nine Divine Generals system was active, but prior to [[Eugard Vollachia]]'s coronation, [[Whitaker Goldario]] and the Nine Divine Generals of the era betrayed him before he could ascend to the throne. As a result, the nine of them and Whitaker were personally purged by him, and he demolished the system. Ever since, the system has been on again and off again as part of the military. As per Berstetz's word, [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent]] was the one who reinstated the system after years of it not being a fully-fledged rank in the army, and before Vincent's coronation, the highest rank one could achieve in the Imperial Army was a First-Class General. Likewise, Vincent's Nine Divine Generals seem to be considerably stronger than the generals of the past. According to Eugard, [[Groovy Gumlet]], who previously ranked sixth among the current Nine Divine Generals, surpassed the strength of all of the Nine Divine Generals of his era. ====Pre-Arc 7 Members==== {|class="wikitable" align="center" width="100%" |- ! width="15%"|Ranking ! width="25%"|Name ! width="30%"|Title ! width="30%"|Specialty |- align="center" |First |[[Cecilus Segmunt]] |Blue Lightning |Swordsmanship

[[Dragon#Flying Dragons|Flying dragons]], used by these riders, are a subspecies of dragons, and are the only subspecies capable of flying. They are native to Vollachia and are nigh impossible to domesticate. Even among the Imperial Army, rarely do people with an innate ability to mount and fly these beasts, show up. Due to the dragons' prideful personality, they refuse to wear any kind of a saddle or reins, meaning the riders are completely left to the mercy of the beasts. If mastered, however, a soldier can maneuver the skies of a battlefield and if equipped accordingly, rain down death from above. One of such examples was the Ninth ranking Divine General Balleroy Temeglyph, who was, with his usage of Yang and Wind Magic, able to bend the light around him and his dragon, as well as diffuse their aura, rendering them completely invisible, at a cost of not being able to hear anything while in this state. With his magical colorless sniper shots, he was able to rain precise shots at his enemies. The Flying Dragon Riders are directed by the head of House Dracroy, who, at present, is [[Serena Dracroy]]. Due to a failed attempt at insurrection partially led by Balleroy, the Flying Dragon Riders were removed from the military. However, they were not disbanded, and Serena continues to train her riders. Despite the removal of the Flying Dragon Riders from the military, with the induction of [[Madelyn Eschart]], a [[Dragon#Dragonkin|dragonkin]], into the Nine Divine Generals, flying dragons have remained a constant for the Imperial Army's usage. However, unlike the Flying Dragon Riders, who work in tandem with each other and have greater mastery of various military techniques and coordination, the flying dragons that Madelyn commands are not coordinated, and although they listen to Madelyn's orders, they attack where and how they see fit, meaning that if they were to attack a settlement, they would not discriminate with their targets, and civilians can very easily get caught in their rampage. Furthermore, the Empire is capable of utilizing so-called flying dragon ships; large airships suspended between two flying dragons. However, these ships are sparingly used. ===[[Shinobi#Vollachia Shinobi|Shinobi]]=== With the induction of Olbart Dunkelkenn into the Nine Divine Generals, the army has access to the assistance of [[Shinobi#Vollachia Shinobi|Vollachia's shinobi]]. While not directly under the command of the emperor, as the shinobi follow Olbart's commands, their ability to gather information, slay their enemies, and prevent enemy armies from approaching certain strongholds, such as the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]] itself, has dramatically improved the army's power and reach. title: House Astrea
wikitext:
[[File:Reinhardemblem.png|thumb|125px|The emblem of House Astrea as worn by Reinhard, bearing [[Volcanica|the Dragon]].]]
'''House Astrea''' (アストレア家, ''Asutorea-ke'') is a noble house in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], currently headed by patriarch [[Heinkel Astrea]]. They are the direct descendants of the [[Toska Astrea|brother]] of the [[Reid Astrea|first Sword Saint]], contributing to the Sword Saint role and title which they have continued to pass down through generations.

==Information==
===Overview===
The House of Astrea is among the most acclaimed Houses in the Kingdom of Lugunica, and they are easily recognized by their heavily distinctive features of flaming red hair and blue eyes. Four hundred years before [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s arrival, Reid Astrea, the forerunner of the Astrea bloodline, aided the [[Flugel|Sage]], his [[Shaula|apprentice]], and the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] in defeating and sealing the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. Ever since then, House Astrea has produced generation after generation of Sword Saints who protected the Kingdom.

A noble house that regularly produced many accomplished knights, it is a custom to give the title of "van" to any swordsman in House Astrea who has managed to accomplish significant feats with the blade. Thus far, every Sword Saint born into the family has borne the name of van, as becoming the Sword Saint is in and of itself an achievement. Furthermore, it is possible for those who marry into the family to receive the title of van, albeit rarely. The typical requirement for an achievement to take on the title of van is to claim a victory in a major war or something else that is tangible and visible. As such, it is actually quite rare for anyone else to receive the name of van; neither [[Theresia van Astrea]]'s brothers nor son received the title, for example.<ref>April 5, 2026 Talk Show.</ref>

House Astrea possesses an auxiliary residence in the [[Royal Capital]]'s Noble District which matches the grandeur of the other mansions located there. In contrast to the appearance of their side mansion, the family itself is not particularly wealthy, nor is their domain grand. The main Astrea Manor is located in the small southeastern town of Hakuchuri, the only fiefdom within the Astrea Domain.<ref>''The Astrea domain comprised only of a small fiefdom, with one small town named Hakuchuri, which was centered around the main Astrea residence.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint Part 1|Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint]], Section 3.</ref> It has a modest size compared to the Royal Capital's mansions, the iron gate at its entrance shows signs of age and rust, and the mansion itself reflects the gate's signs of age. 

Some members of the household have heavily involved themselves in the ongoing [[Royal Selection]]. [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] is a member of the [[Crusch Camp]]. The Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard, Heinkel Astrea, was a backer of the [[Priscilla Camp]] and a candidate to become [[Filore]]'s knight; conversely, the Sword Saint [[Reinhard van Astrea]] is the primary benefactor of the [[Felt Camp]], personally working as [[Felt]]'s knight and protector. As a result of the ideological split, Reinhard and Felt live in the Astrea Manor, whilst Heinkel formerly resided in the Barielle Estate.

===Sword Saint===
Ever since the era of the [[Great Calamity]], one member of House Astrea per generation has been chosen as the next '''Sword Saint''' (剣聖, ''Kensei''), a knight who inherits the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Sword Saint|Divine Protection of the Sword Saint]], which can only be inherited by a member of the Astrea family. Sword Saints are regarded as the Kingdom's greatest weapons and are only called in action when the situation is at the most desperate. Many Astreas and Sword Saints have been killed in action in service of the kingdom, in most recent memory being Theresia, who was lost in the disastrous [[Great Conquest]]. The current generation's Sword Saint is Theresia's grandson, Reinhard, most powerful Sword Saint in history whose strength surpassed even Reid's.

<gallery type="slideshow">
DragonSword.png|The legendary Dragon Sword Reid.
Dragon Sword Reid blade unsheathed.png|The legendary Dragon Sword Reid unsheathed.
</gallery>
Everyone who is ever chosen to become the Sword Saint automatically takes on the name of van, and they become the only person in the world capable of drawing House Astrea's heirloom, the strongest of the Ten [[Enchanted Sword]]s, the '''[[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]]''' (龍剣レイド, ''Ryūken Reido''), which has been passed down since the death of Reid. Even the Sword Saints rarely were forced to draw this blade as the requirements for it to be drawn are rarely met. However, while it can be used even when sheathed, the moment it is drawn, it is claimed that it has never gone back into its sheath without first shedding blood.

==History==
*Note: The characters within the story rarely describe historical events within helpful context, so the unit BA, “Before Arrival”, and AA, “After Arrival”, will be used to place moments in time with the best available knowledge. Both are in reference to Natsuki Subaru’s arrival in the new world. Also note that the units are not official.

===Before 400 years BA===
*Reid Astrea and his younger brother, Toska, are born.

===400 years BA===
*Reid Astrea received the Dragon Sword, a legendary sword passed through generations, only being able to be drawn by the Sword Saints.
*Reid travels together with Flugel, [[Echidna]], Satella, [[Farsale Lugunica]], and [[Alec Hoshin]] on a journey to save the world.
*Toska, together with [[Puck]] and [[Beatrice]], attempt to save [[Minor Characters#Remina|Remina]] from the Silver Dragons. The Dragons are defeated by Echidna.
*Reid teamed up with Volcanica and Flugel in order to stop the Witch of Envy's rampage.

===After 400 years BA===
*Flugel uses Reid’s soul during the creation of the [[Pleiades Watchtower]].
*Toska and Remina marry.
*Reid Astrea dies of unknown causes.
*The first holder of the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, who is the child of Reid's younger brother,<ref>[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1884615846959673743 Re:Zero Episode 58 Rebroadcast Commentary]</ref> becomes the second Sword Saint.<ref>[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/1884613612549087600 Re:Zero Episode 58 Rebroadcast Commentary]</ref>

===Roughly 265 BA===
*Roswaal D. Mathers permits a 150-year-old Toska to visit Beatrice in the Forbidden Library in an attempt to convince her to leave it. Toska's attempt ultimately ended in failure.

===48-40 BA===
*[[Fribal van Astrea]] loses his Divine Protection of the Sword Saint and senses that Theresia, his niece, had inherited the Divine Protection. This occurs shortly before the outbreak of the [[Demi-Human War]], and even though he is left significantly less able, Fribal takes up arms to fight for the kingdom.
*At some point, Theresia was brought to her first battlefield, and she was unable to bring herself to wield a sword. In her place, the Sword Saint and her brothers fought in the war, and each of them was slain, and Theresia was left traumatized by their deaths.
*[[Carol Remendis]] was chosen to be Theresia's attendant. After a short-lived fight that she instigated and promptly lost to, Carol decided to serve Theresia for life and fought in her place during the Demi-Human War.
*Theresia met Wilhelm Trias at a flower field she frequented, and the two continued to meet for the next few years, their meetings slowly healing her emotional scars. She also begins to question the reason why he holds the sword and her own reason to hold one.
*Two years before the end of the war, Theresia was forced to overcome her disgust of fighting and killing and participated in the [[Battle of the Trias Domain]] in order to save Wilhelm, finding her reason for wielding the blade to be protecting Wilhelm. In her first battle, she accumulated 1000 confirmed kills.
*Over the course of following 2 years, the Sword Saint Theresia van Astrea single-handedly turned the tide of the war which eventually concluded in the Kingdom's total victory.
*Wilhelm fought and defeated her on her own celebration hosted by the King himself. She gave up the title of the Sword Saint, and later, she and Wilhelm married.

===40 BA===
*During their honeymoon, when they visited [[Picoutatte]], [[Veltol Astrea]] was beaten and cursed by [[Kurgan]] and [[Stride Vollachia]], who were targeting Theresia. The next day, in response to a duel, Theresia brought Wilhelm, who had been given the Holy Sword Astrea, to the bridge at which the duel would take place, and Wilhelm fought Kurgan in her place, in a battle that would be remembered as the [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]]. Stride determines the battle as his loss, and he retreats with Kurgan after turning the bridge to dust.

===39-38 BA===
*Sometime later, Wilhelm and Theresia are involved in the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]].
*Sometime after the Subjugation, Heinkel Astrea was born to Wilhelm and Theresia.

===19 BA===
*Reinhard van Astrea is born to [[Louanna Astrea]] and Heinkel Astrea.

===17 BA===
*Louanna Astrea suddenly falls into a comatose state. She was repeatedly examined by numerous healers but to no avail. Her "disease" was referred to as the sleeping beauty state. By Felt's speculation and Heinkel's confirmation, Reinhard was responsible for her slumbering state.

===15 BA===
*Heinkel was tasked with attempting to convince [[Marcos Gildark]] re-join the knights. Though he failed to do so, Reinhard, who had accompanied his, requested the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing from [[Od Lagna]] to convince Marcos to do as Heinkel had requested, resulting in the rouge knight deciding to rejoin the knights and the auxiliary Astrea Manor being targeted by the [[Six Tongues]] once the power was detected.
*The following night, disguised assailants infiltrated the auxiliary Astrea Manor, suspecting Heinkel for treason against the nation by means of the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing. Initially taken aback by the false allegations levied against him by one of the assailants, he quickly realized that his son had been the culprit and ran to scold him for his actions. Though confused, Reinhard erased the Divine Protection he used, quelling the hostility of the assailants. As they left, Reinhard saw a man beyond a nearby window, mouthing to him, “If you care about your family, do your best to serve the kingdom."

===14 BA===
*On the night of the [[Royal Abduction Incident]], in which the daughter of [[Ford Lugunica]] was kidnapped, Heinkel committed an unspecified grave sin, having perpetrated an unknown betrayal and a terrible mistake that rendered said betrayal pointless.
*The King of Lugunica orders a squad of elite soldiers led by Heinkel Astrea to eliminate the [[White Whale]]. Out of fear, Heinkel declined the order, and instead, Theresia took his place.
*In response to the Royal Abduction Incident, Wilhelm is tasked with searching for her, though he fails in the end.
*Reinhard van Astrea becomes the next generation's Sword Saint at the age of 5.
*Amidst the fearsome Great Conquest, Theresia suddenly lost her Divine Protection of the Sword Saint and encountered [[Pandora]], perishing shortly after. At some point afterward, her body is recovered by the [[Witch Cult]] and used as a [[Undead|corpse soldier]].
*In response to Theresia's death, Wilhelm's relationship with his son and grandson breaks down, he leaves the Royal Guard, and he devotes all of his efforts into finding a way to kill the White Whale and avenge his wife.
*Heinkel becomes the House Astrea patriarch and inherits the responsibilities associated with it. Sometime after this, he loses a duel with his son, and their relationship deteriorates, resulting in unsavory rumors that ruin his reputation.

===11 BA===
*At age 8, Reinhard made an unspecified achievement with the sword, receiving his honorary title of "van" as a result.
*In response to his immense strength, the "Reinhard Law" was passed, limiting his movements to only within the Kingdom.

===Between 17-6 BA===
*[[Garitch Fabless]] was tasked with trying to heal Louanna, but he continuously failed until his demise.

===5 BA===
*While [[Reiner Wahrheit]]'s drug operation was running rampant, Heinkel was placed under house arrest on suspicion of aiding and abetting in the former knight's organization.
*In an attempt to clear Heinkel's name, Reinhard decided to cross-dress and take up the identity of a young girl named Adelheid to infiltrate and bring down Reiner's organization, resulting in the incarceration of Reiner and his collaborator, Count [[Minor Characters#Easley Oruon|Easley Oruon]].
*After Reinhard discussed it with the Six Tongues, the organization pulled strings to promote Heinkel to the Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard. Marcos personally notified Heinkel that the Council of Wise Men had decided to promote him to the role, much to his bewilderment and vexation. After a conversation with Reinhard in an attempt to confirm his suspicions of Reinhard's involvement, he accepted the position so that he could use it to save Louanna, and he told his son to join the knights when he turned fifteen.

===4 BA===
*After turning fifteen, Reinhard joined the knights.

===Over 9 months BA===
*The King of Lugunica, [[Randohal Lugunica]], sends Reinhard to the Pleiades Watchtower in order to make contact with the Sage and ask him for the cure of the illness that had plagued the [[Royal Family]]. Unfortunately, Reinhard was not able to break through the Sand Time and was forced to return empty-handed.

===4-5 months BA===
*Reinhard, [[Julius Juukulius]], and [[Ferris]] escort Council of Wise Men members [[Miklotov McMahon]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]] to the Crystal Palace, located in the [[Vollachia Empire]]’s [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]]. After an unfortunate turn of events, the three knights find themselves in a situation in which could escalate into a war between the two nations. They managed to resolve the issue and prevent a bigger conflict.
*About a month later, Reinhard van Astrea crosses swords with Vollachia's Blue Lightning, [[Cecilus Segmunt]], in possession of two of the ten Enchanted Swords. The Dragon Sword, unprecedented in history, recognized Cecilus as a worthy opponent and so Reinhard was able to fight Cecilus with the unsheathed Dragon blade. The duel resulted in a tie.
*At some point after this, [[Crusch Karsten]] witnessed Wilhelm being temporarily imprisoned following an argument with Bordeaux, and afterward, she recruited him as part of her camp in exchange for fighting the White Whale.

===0-2 months AA===
*After taking part in the [[Loot House Incident]] in the Royal Capital's slums, Reinhard locates the fifth and final Royal Selection Candidate, Felt.
*Two months after, the Royal Selection Ceremony takes place. Reinhard swears his sword to the fifth candidate, Felt.
*Wilhelm takes part in the successful [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], having delivered the blow to said beast and avenging his wife.
*Wilhelm takes part in the successful [[Subjugation of Sloth]].

===Between 2 months AA and 1 year, 2 months AA===
*Heinkel goes to a bandit city and wipes out all of the bandits there in an effort to retrieve a cup rumored to restore one’s body. Though the cup turned out to be a sham, after a chance encounter with [[Priscilla Barielle]], Heinkel joined her camp.

===1 year and 2 months AA===
*The Felt and Crusch Camps, alongside the [[Emilia Camp]] were invited to the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]] by [[Anastasia Hoshin]]. The Priscilla Camp, now joined by Heinkel, also arrives in Priestella. Soon upon arrival, the city is [[Battle for Priestella|sieged]] and taken over by the Witch Cult. Both Reinhard and Wilhelm play a key role in the liberation of the city.
*Reinhard takes part in the battle against Regulus Corneas alongside Natsuki Subaru and [[Emilia]], and they successfully kill him.
*Theresia van Astrea's corpse soldier is used to siege the Watergate City. It was later defeated by Reinhard after a fight with Wilhelm.

===1 year and 4 months AA===
*After a two-month travel, Reinhard, with other members of the Felt Camp, takes the arrested [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]] to be sealed in the Prison Tower.

===1 year and 5 months AA===
*Reid Astrea appears as one of the trial proctors for the Pleiades Watchtower, though his soul shatters after a battle with Julius Juukulius.
*Reinhard, alongside [[Meili Portroute]] and other members of the Felt Camp, take on the second expedition to the Pleiades Watchtower, after the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|expedition]] led by the Emilia Camp.
*Heinkel, alongside the Priscilla Camp, left for the Vollachia Empire.

===1 year and 6 months AA===
*Heinkel takes part in the [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm]].

===1 year and 8 months AA===
*Heinkel takes part in the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], though he was subsequently left behind in the Capital following the beginning of the [[Great Disaster]].
*Heinkel takes part in the [[Conquest of the Undead Capital]], in which he assists [[Garfiel Tinzel]] in the defeat of [[Madelyn Eschart]] and the Cloud Dragon [[Mezoreia]].
*Following the death of Priscilla, Heinkel joins [[Al|Aldebaran]] in his coming [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|scheme]], vanishing for a short period of time. However, after the scheme failed and he was abandoned by [[Yae Tenzen]], he disappeared.
*Reinhard and Felt bore witness to Filore becoming a candidate of the Royal Selection.
*As a result of a [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|conspiracy]], Reinhard was forced to obey the corrupted government as they started to crack down on the Royal Selection camps. Meanwhile, Wilhelm aided the camps in their escape, effectively becoming a wanted fugitive.
*Heinkel became Filore's knight in the Royal Selection.

===1 year and 10 months AA===
*Heinkel and Filore conspired to break out Emilia, [[Ram]], and Felt from the Royal Castle. Despite a conflict between Marcos and Heinkel, they all successfully escaped.

==Trivia==
*At a talk show held on April 6, 2025, it was stated by the author that the name Astrea was derived from the [[Wikipedia:5 Astraea|5 Astraea]] asteroid.<ref>April 6, 2025 Talk Show.</ref>
*In Greek mythology, Astraea was a goddess representing the concepts of justice, innocence, purity, and precision. The author of the series likely garnered inspiration from Astraea when naming the House of Astrea, as the family exemplified many of the traits exhibited by the goddess. Reinhard in particular personified the traits of justice and purity almost perfectly.
*Ever since Reid Astrea, every member born into the family has had flame-red hair.
*Despite technically being a member of House Astrea by blood, it is unconfirmed whether Reid was ever given a noble title.
*Despite Reinhard being stronger than Reid, the first generation's Sword Saint is more skilled with a blade than the current generation's Sword Saint.
**This is shown in how every sword with which Reinhard uses his family's sword technique shatters after use, except the indestructible Dragon Sword, whereas Reid could use even harmless items as deadly weapons.
*In the Sasageru IF, the bloodline of House Astrea came to an end.
*When Theresia was still alive, the House's flowerbed was attended to, though they fell to ruin following her demise. After becoming Felt's knight, Felt pushed him to maintain the garden once again, which he does with the aid of a Divine Protection.<ref>July 26, 2026 Talk Show</ref>
*According to the author, each generation of Sword Saint tends to last for about fifty years, making Reinhard about the seventh or eighth Sword Saint.<ref>''"The first one was 400 years ago, and if they’re around 50 years each, he’s the seventh or eighth, perhaps."'' AskFM Q&A.</ref>
