title: House Karsten
wikitext:
[[File:House Karsten emblem.png|thumb|200px]]
'''House Karsten''' (カルステン家, ''Karusuten-ke'') is a noble house in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], currently headed by matriarch [[Crusch Karsten|Duchess Crusch Karsten]], who is also currently participating in the [[Royal Selection]] as a candidate to become the 42nd Monarch of Lugunica. The family holds the court rank of Duke.

==Information==
Throughout centuries, the noble House of Karsten found itself as one of the most faithful supporters of the Lugunica monarchy, dutifully serving them without fail. Due to their unyielding loyalty, the House has been recognized as the King's most loyal subjects and was in turn, granted the crest of a lion baring its fangs: a symbol which once belonged to none other than the Lugunican [[Royal Family]] itself, which served as the Kingdom's coat of arms.

After the covenant with the [[Volcanica|Dragon]] was made, the old crest, the lion crest, gave way to the new crest; that of the Dragon. The gift of the lion crest to the Karsten house is a consistent reminder of the House's greatest accomplishment, that being its many centuries of loyalty to the crown and is pridefully displayed in all manners by its members and associates.

[[File:KarstencapitalEstate-day.png|thumb|300px]]
As expected of a house so highly regarded, the Karsten family is fabulously wealthy as well; able to sport the finest estates in some of the best lands in the kingdom. For example, within the Noble District in the [[Royal Capital]], the one villa that stands above every other is in possession of none other than the Karsten family. Despite it being as luxurious and extravagant as the main Mathers domain, it is only used when the House's patriarch has important business in the Royal Capital. In that case, it is large enough to act as a military base. Its estate front lawn itself is vast in size, about to field a makeshift camp and hospital. The main mansion is located in the very south of the Lifaus Plains. It's stated to be much more spacious and luxurious than the one in the Royal Capital.

==History==
Note: The characters within the story rarely describe historical events within helpful context, so the unit BA, “Before Arrival”, and AA, “After Arrival”, will be used to place moments in time with the best available knowledge. Both are in reference to [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s arrival in the new world. Also note that the units are not official.

===Roughly 400 years BA===
*[[Farsale Lugunica]] creates a covenant with the Divine Dragon. Once the covenant was established, the Kingdom became known as the '''Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica''' and the royal family coat of arms shifted from a symbol of the Lion to that of the Dragon. The king decided to pass the insignia down to a noble family which helped the Kingdom out the most, and so the emblem of the lion baring its fangs was passed to the House of Karsten.

===20 BA===
*Crusch Karsten was born to [[Meckart Karsten|Meckart]] and [[Minor Characters#Helena Karsten|Helena Karsten]]. Sometime after Crusch's birth, Helena passed away due to unknown reasons.

===Between 20-11 BA===
*Crusch met [[Fourier Lugunica]] in the gardens of the castle, where they became friends and where Fourier inspired her to live how she wanted.
*At some point, Crusch began practicing with her sword skills.

===11 BA===
*After hearing disturbing rumors of House Argyle's [[Biehn Argyle|patriarch]] abusing and torturing his [[Ferris|son]], Meckart and Crusch launched an investigation into them, and as a result, they had the House stripped of their territories, assets, and nobility, and Felix was adopted into House Karsten.

===6 BA===
*Ferris assists Fourier in escaping from a political marriage with the [[Tiriena|daughter]] of a [[Gusteko|Gustekan]] archbishop, resulting in her marrying [[Minor Characters#Misère|Misère]] instead.
*Ferris learns under [[Garitch Fabless]] for three months in the Royal Treatment Center to use Healing Magic until the man's death. At some point after, Ferris took over Garitch's title of the '''Blue'''.

===3 BA===
*The Foutour Plains located in the Karsten territory is ravaged by one of the [[Witchbeast#Three Great Witchbeasts|Three Great Witchbeasts]]: the [[Great Rabbit]]. Crusch fended off the calamitous [[Witchbeast|witchbeast]] and immediately afterward took part in the party to celebrate her birthday, where after showing both her beauty and her strength in combat, she earned the nickname of the '''Valkyrie'''.
*A couple of months after the incident, Crusch took her father's position to become the matriarch of House Karsten.

===1 BA===
*Ferris was recommended for the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]] by the Royal Treatment Center and Prince Fourier, leading to his joining the military.
*After hearing of new rumors of Biehn Argyle, Crusch investigated him once again, deciding to meet with him without Ferris's awareness, where she discovered Biehn's collusion with [[Miles]], a [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachian]] soldier, to take in slaves for human experimentation in an effort to perfect the Sacrament of the Immortal King. However, she was drugged by Biehn and placed in a cell in his estate.
*After learning of Crusch's predicament, Ferris and Fourier lead an assault alongside the Karsten militia on the Argyle estate and their numerous [[Undead#Corpse Soldiers|corpse soldiers]].
*With help from [[Hannah Regret]], Crusch was able to free herself and cut through him and the corpse soldiers with him, and she escaped and reunited with [[Julius Juukulius]] and Ferris. Immediately after, they escaped the burning building and met up with the prince, who soon after collapsed from his disease.

===8-9 months BA===
*Fourier dies of his disease in Crusch's lap.
*Crusch shows qualifications for participating in the Royal Selection, making her one of the five candidates for the throne of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. Immediately after this discovery, she knighted Ferris and decided to participate in the Selection in order to end the contract with the Divine Dragon and lead to the country's independence from greater powers.
*Sometime after, Crusch begins a greater distribution of iron weapons and armor, and she improves the training of the military.

===2-4 months BA===
*Ferris travels to the Vollachia Empire alongside Julius, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], Bordeaux, and [[Miklotov McMahon]] in an effort to secure a non-aggression pact throughout the Royal Selection. Despite a conflict that led to a battle with the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]], particularly one of the supposed masterminds of the rebellion, [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], they ultimately succeed and return to the Kingdom.
*After meeting with [[Cecilus Segmunt]] and later [[Chisha Gold]] in the Royal Capital, Ferris and Julius accompany them until the capture the Vollachian traitor [[Gramdart Holstoy]]. Their task to accompany them ended after the Royal Guard commander, [[Marcos Gildark]], set up a proxy match between Reinhard and Cecilus.

===Before 0 AA===
*Sometime after creating the [[Crusch Camp]], Crusch and Ferris witness an argument between [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] and [[Bordeaux Zergev]] regarding the [[White Whale]]. After he was temporarily arrested, she offered him a chance to kill the whale if he joined her camp, and after he agreed, the two regularly practiced swordsmanship together.

===2 months AA===
*Crusch signs an alliance with [[Emilia Camp]]. Using [[Anastasia Hoshin]]'s help, they first defeat one of the Three Great Witchbeasts known as the White Whale during the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and soon after aid in defeating the [[Witch Cult]]'s [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]] in the [[Subjugation of Sloth]].
*On her way back, Crusch's convoy was attacked by the Witch Cult's [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]] and [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]]. The convoy got completely annihilated. Casualties were high, with Crusch temporarily losing her right arm and getting her memories eaten by Gluttony.

===Between 2 months and 1 year, 2 months AA===
*[[Shorty Megan]] and [[Lululala]] visit the Karsten estate and have an interview with Crusch and Ferris, where they give their opinions on the Royal Selection and whose camp to watch.
*According to rumors, Meckart returns to assist Crusch with running her territory.

===1 year and 2 months AA===
*Alongside the other camps participating in the Royal Selection, Crusch is invited to the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]] as Anastasia Hoshin promises her info regarding the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony. Soon after their arrival, the city is besieged and taken over by the Witch Cult. The camps are forced to work together in order to defeat and drive off the 6 Sin Archbishops who simultaneously made their appearance in the city, Gluttony included.
*Crusch is cursed by the [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop of Lust]] and is left bedridden. After the end of the [[Battle for Priestella]], Ferris and Wilhelm continue to care for her in the manor in the Royal Capital with no improvements.

===1 year and 8 months AA===
*After hearing of the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|conquering]] of the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], despite their worry about not hearing of the status of those who partook in the expedition, Wilhelm and Ferris go to learn what went down.
*[[Filore]] of the [[Divine Dragon Church]] meets with the Crusch Camp and offers her assistance to them. With Ferris's agreement, Filore uses her sacraments to free Crusch from her curse, leaving Crusch with a draconic eye. However, this later results in Ferris resigning from his position as her knight and being subsequently taken in by [[Russell Fellow]].
*After a conversation with Subaru and Emilia, Crusch snuck out of the manor while others were distracted and visited the manor of Miklotov McMahon to seek his advice. However, thanks to her Divine Protection, she recognized his hostility and cut him and his retainers down under suspicion of treason. After a confrontation with Subaru, [[Beatrice]], and [[Tiga Rauleon]], Crusch is forced to escape from the manor along with Beatrice and an injured Subaru as the manor caught flame, and they flee from the Royal Army under suspicion of murdering Miklotov and attempting to overthrow the Kingdom.
*Crusch and company are assisted by [[Rachins Hoffman]] and the [[Six Tongues]] to escape the Royal Capital.

title: Picoutatte
wikitext:
[[File:Picoutatte ep.40.png|thumb|300px]]
'''Picoutatte''' (ピックタット, ''Pikkutatto''), also known as the '''Commercial City of Picoutatte''' (商業都市ピックタット, ''Shōgyō Toshi Pikkutatto''), is one of the Five Great Cities in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]. It is located in the southernmost part of the country, on the border with the [[Vollachia Empire]].

==Information==
Picoutatte is a large city of trading and commerce filled with energy and tumult.<ref>''It was a large city filled with energy and tumult that lived up to its name as the Commercial City.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 2|Stand by me Pleiades: Return of the Good-For-Nothing Son]], Section 5.</ref> Its streets are filled with stores and stalls open during the daytime, giving it the energy of a marketplace. Greedy merchants are prevalent and cut-throat in the city, making favorable results a requirement to sustain a business within it.<ref>''Greedy merchants were cut-throat and prevalent in Picoutatte―― sustaining a business that had been in the area for generations demanded favorable results.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 2|Stand by me Pleiades: Return of the Good-For-Nothing Son]], Section 6.</ref> As a vital trading hub with the Vollachia Empire, A flow of merchants tend to cross over the border between nations, and people and merchandise are regularly move in and out of the city. The city itself is divided into five districts. There are four districts in each of the cardinal directions and a central district with facilities that cater to the wealthy and the city's visitors; each district has its own differences in the merchandise they handle or unique rules.<ref>''Picoutatte was another of Lugunica’s Five Great Cities, a place that flourished thanks to its trade with other nations. The city was divided into five districts, one for each cardinal direction and a central district, and each had its own differences in the merchandise they handled and unique rules. Hence, it seemed as if each of the five districts was a city or indeed a land unto itself. Among them, the central district was particularly crowded with facilities aimed at the wealthy and visitors.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 6.</ref> No matter what it is, everything in the Commercial City, whether it is cargo, people, or even information, is considered tradable.<ref>''“In this Commercial City, everything is tradable. Cargo, people, and information as well.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 8]], [[Stand by me Pleiades Part 2|Stand by me Pleiades: Return of the Good-For-Nothing Son]], Section 6.</ref>

==History==
Picoutatte has historically been the subject of several disputes with Vollachia. Following the conclusion of the [[Demi-Human War]], while the newly married [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]] and [[Theresia van Astrea|Theresia]], accompanied by [[Carol Remendis]] and [[Veltol Astrea]], were on a honeymoon trip to Picoutatte, [[Stride Vollachia]] and [[Kurgan]] arrived in the city to encounter the Sword Saint. Stride visited the Suwen Company, left [[Yaktol Suwen]] petrified, and met face-to-face with Theresia and her father. Veltol offered to duel Stride, but the arrogant nobleman forced him to face [[Kurgan]], resulting in his loss and a “curse” being placed upon him. The next day, Wilhelm faced Kurgan in a [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte|duel]] and was successful in defeating him, earning the right to obtain the curse ring that had cast a curse on Veltol and destroy it. With [[Garitch Fabless]]'s healing magic, the effect of the curse on Veltol was only concentrated on one place, lessening the damage dealt to him in exchange for his right arm's mobility.

After kidnapping Theresia and cursing Carol several months later, Stride would once again visit Picoutatte, where he would be responsible for a series of events leading up to the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]]. A forbidden art which nullified the effects of [[Divine Protection]]s and the Kingdom's covenant with [[Volcanica]] was placed around the city, the citizens of Picoutatte were placed under the control of Stride's wife, [[Melinda]], with one of her Evil Eyes, and Carol, who was cast with a curse that compelled her to obey Stride's will, was forced to slay numerous sacrifices. By soaking the skull of a deceased dragonkin with the blood of the sacrifices, Stride summoned its parent, [[Valgren]], to the city. A subjugation force consisting of capable fighters, including the Zergev Squadron, was sent to Picoutatte in hopes of ending the situation. In the end, [[Shasuke]], one of the “Generals” accompanying the Destruction Wish, was killed, Stride and Melinda were eaten and torn to shreds by the maws of Valgren, and that very Dragon was obliterated by the Divine Dragon Volcanica, who had arrived at the city at the same time as [[Gionis Lugunica]] in accordance with the covenant. The sole surviving member of the Stride Faction, Kurgan, was healed by Volcanica along with everyone else present in the city after losing his duel with Wilhelm, and taken captive to be extradited back to Vollachia.

During [[Arc 7]], the [[Emilia Camp]] travelled to the Commercial City of Picoutatte to smuggle their way into Vollachia in their search for [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Rem]]. With a referral from [[Diadora Regundra]], they acquired [[Musica]] as their guide to take them to the Empire through the Everlasting Darkness beyond Shamrock Valley.

==Locations==
*'''Suwen Company''' (スーウェン商会, ''Sūwen Shōkai''): The headquarters of the Suwen Company, located just within the entrance of Picoutatte's western district. It is a large building that deals in everything from textiles to foodstuffs.
*'''The Gold Wolf's Cup''' (金狼の酒杯, ''Kinrō no Shuhai''): A top-class inn located within the central district of Picoutatte. It is considered to be the finest inn in the central district.
*'''Spire''': A spire in the central district that is recognized as the symbol of Picoutatte.
*'''Regundra Mansion''': The mansion where the powerful, wealthy Regundra family resides.

title: Chaosflame
wikitext:
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 28 14.png|thumb|225px]]
'''Chaosflame''' (カオスフレーム, ''Kaosufurēmu''), also known as the '''Demon City of Chaosflame''' (魔都カオスフレーム, ''Mato Kaosufurēmu''), is a major city located west of the massive Buddheim Jungle in the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] and roughly falls under the eastern half of the nation. It is governed by the Seventh ranking [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine General]], [[Yorna Mishigure]].

==Information==
Chaosflame is a large Imperial city located at the very south of the Empire, west of the Buddheim Jungle. It got its name as the Demon City, due to a vast variety of different cultures and architectures mixed together as one, making it look like it is in total disarray and chaos, leading people to often term it the '''Chaotic City''' (混沌都市, ''Konton Toshi''). When walking through the city streets, one will find old ruins placed right next to new dazzling buildings, an abundance of tall spires sprouting forth from seemingly random locations, rows of somewhat out-of-place living quarters, lush parks and right next to them, sandy deserted areas reminiscing of long-abandoned parks. Above the streets, one can spot an indescribable mess of wooden scaffoldings that have no apparent purpose and give off a feeling that someone arbitrarily spliced them together and put them up just for show. From a distance, the city looks like it's covered in cobwebs. At the very center of the city, a large glossy-red castle called Crimson Lapis Castle can be observed reaching for the clouds, which also happens to be Chaosflame's widely recognized symbol. All around it, the city streets expand in a circular motion, almost reminiscing that of the [[Royal Capital|Royal Capital of Lugunica]].

Another thing that would quickly catch the eyes of a visitor, is the abundance of strange races of [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]]. Unlike in other areas such as in the Royal Capital, these demi-humans also do not hide their appearances and are not a subject of ridicule and inferiority. They proudly assert their own species in a melting pot of diversity that is the Demon City of Chaosflame. Due to the nature of the city and its inhabitants, Chaosflame also does not hold any majorly limiting laws. According to Vincent, "the place is a city of vices that ridicules the nature of order". The city realistically follows only one order: disorder. 

==History==
Originally built over the desolate lands ravaged by non-stop warfare, the Demon City of Chaosflame was established in order to house a great variety of different races persecuted by the Empire. Having nowhere to go and no one to rely on, a grand city was built, and in the middle, a large symbol in form of the Crimson Lapis Castle was erected, constructed by none other than the city's inhabitants themselves. At some point in time, Yorna Mishigure became Chaosflame's ruler through her lineage. The city would also become home to [[Zoey]] and [[Tanza]].

When Zoey, who became Yorna’s closest attendant, was killed, the Divine General started a rebellion that wouldn’t end until she had the heads of the soldiers involved in the girl’s death delivered to her. This resulted in a short-lived battle between Yorna and [[Madelyn Eschart]]. Their fight coming to a standstill, Yorna conveyed to Madelyn her demand for the soldiers' lives, and she ventured to the Imperial Capital to inform the Divine Generals. Soon afterwards, a great battle between the inhabitants of Chaosflame and the [[Imperial Army]] began. Yorna engaged two Divine Generals: [[Cecilus Segmunt]] and [[Arakiya]], while [[Goz Ralfon]] and [[Kafma Irulux]] clashed with the citizens. During the fight, a portion of the city was destroyed by Arakiya’s flames, though fortunately, nobody died thanks to Yorna’s usage of the Soul Marriage Technique over the inhabitants. Eventually, the rebellion was quelled when the capture and deaths of the soldiers were relayed to her.

Shortly after the [[Fall of Guaral]], the [[Vincent Vollachia|ousted emperor]], going by the name of Abel, visited the town while accompanied by five others. At the same time, the [[Chisha Gold|false emperor]], accompanied by three others, was also there. After a short meeting, Yorna made sure to keep any fighting among the two groups pacified. Of course, thanks to her current attendant Tanza and the Divine General [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], this did not go so well, as Abel’s group was on the receiving end of the inhabitants' grief and rage thanks to the aforementioned persons’ interference. Eventually, when Olbart’s involvement was revealed to Yorna, the two fought against each other, damaging the tower beneath them temporarily, until it was put a stop to by the infantilized [[Natsuki Subaru]].

This victory was short-lived after a [[Satella|great shadow]] burst forth from Subaru’s body and engulfed the Crimson Lapis Castle. With everyone having retreated, Yorna destroyed the devoured castle in an effort to destroy the shadow, though she failed. With the threat of the entire city being devoured, everyone joined together in an effort to quell it. Eventually, everyone was forced to retreat, allowing Yorna to completely level the city to push it back, with Tanza’s apparent sacrifice putting in the finishing blow.

==Locations==
*'''Crimson Lapis Castle''' (紅瑠璃城, ''Beniruri-jō''): At the very center of the city, circularly surrounded by the city streets, stood a giant red castle called the Crimson Lapis Castle. As the name suggests, the castle was dyed entirely in red. Having said that, according to Subaru, the building is more similar to a traditional Japanese castle than a western/European castle design, though the building materials are different. The building's foundations and framework were made out of blue lapis lazuli, which emitted a deep blue hue. Furthermore, the gems tended to switch colors and emit a bloody-red shade, uncharacteristic for lapis lazuli, making the castle frequently shift colors between deep blue and blood red. According to Yorna Mishigure, the castle's design wasn't her idea, but rather a collective decision from Chaosflame's inhabitants, as they believed their leader shouldn't live in a shabby-looking castle. The servants, who also tended to dress up in [[Kararagi]]-styled kimonos, served to further drive the point of the building giving a more traditional Japanese-esque air. As it was home to the Seventh ranking Divine General Yorna Mishigure, the castle was entirely guarded by Yorna's private army, though it was noted that the security was weirdly lax. Upon entering the castle, visitors were escorted to a massive waiting chamber with a wooden floor, where they're left to wait for the lord's presence. There was also a warehouse next to the castle where Galewind Horses were stored. The castle was destroyed during the [[Destruction of Chaosflame]].

[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 32 2.png|thumb|300px]]
'''Lupugana''' (ルプガナ, ''Rupugana''), also known as the '''Imperial Capital of Lupugana''' (帝都ルプガナ, ''Teito Rupugana'') or simply the '''Imperial Capital''', is the capital city of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. It is administered by the emperor of Vollachia, [[Vincent Vollachia]]. It is one of the primary settings for the events of [[Arc 8]].

Having been at the center of both the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]] and the [[Great Disaster]], the city faced great damages, with numerous parts of the city having been erased.

==Information==
===Overview===
Lupugana is a large city located near the center of the Empire. It is surrounded by star-shaped ramparts, a moat, and various forests situated in between each of the five bastions. Thanks to this, it makes it difficult to attack the city, yet easy to defend.<ref>''"Lupugana, the Imperial Capital, is surrounded by star-shaped ramparts. It is a city that is hard to attack and easy to defend. The only way to conquer the city is to capture the five bastions."'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 92, Section 2.</ref> The bastions are protected by earth magic and will not collapse with normal attacks. The city can normally be accessed through a bridge located at the first bastion, which gives a direct path to the center of the city. Each bastion is numbered, with the first bastion located in the south, the second bastion located in the southeast, the third bastion located in the southwest, the fourth bastion located in the northeast, and the fifth bastion located in the northwest. To the city's north is a reservoir, which was formerly an area of the Imperial Capital. The architecture within the city itself varies little in quality from one part of the city to another. At the heart of Lupugana lies the Crystal Palace, which is considered to be the city's symbol.

During the Great Disaster, the walls containing the reservoir were heavily damaged, causing the Imperial Capital to experience unprecedented flash flooding. This necessitated the evacuation of the city's citizens. The Crystal Palace, too, was also completely destroyed. According to [[Priscilla Barielle]], the damage done to the city was so immense that recovery might take a century.<ref>''"The Crystal Palace, once extolled as the most beautiful in the world, is now naught but ash, and the water yet contained within the reservoir still threatens to cascade forth and sweep away the city. As things stand, it shall take a century to restore the Imperial Capital."'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 1.</ref>

===Crystal Palace===
The Crystal Palace was a massive, elaborately designed, red and white castle from which the emperor ruled from, also recognized as the symbol of the Imperial Capital and the heart of the nation. There are countless rooms within, including a throne room, library, treasury, cathedral, and dungeons, and it is guarded by a large number of [[Imperial Army]] soldiers. Countless civil servants and even high ranked members of the Imperial Army worked here, and an untold number of items, formerly including the [[Enchanted Sword#Fiend Sword Murasame|Fiend Sword Murasame]] and [[Enchanted Sword#Dream Sword Masayume|Dream Sword Masayume]], could be found hidden away in the treasury. Likewise, the cathedral was used for the sacrifices meant to anchor [[Muspel]] to the country. As for the palace's throne, it was built with a mechanism that could teleport the emperor to the Graveyard of Nameless Monarchs in case of emergency.

[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 38 3.png|thumb|right|250px|The Crystal Palace as the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier.]]
The Crystal Palace was constructed using exceptionally rare magic stones, causing a high density of mana to flow within it. Thanks to this, [[Moguro Hagane]], a living [[meteor]] who gained their spirit from the high density of mana gathered around the castle,<ref>''The Crystal Palace, the center of the Imperial Capital of Lupugana and the symbol of the entire Vollachian Empire, was not just a fortress of unparalleled offensive and defensive capabilities, but had concentrated so much mana that it had become a sort of spirit in its own right.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 1|Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 10.</ref> was born, and they became responsible for governing and defending the Crystal Palace.<ref>''For those who painted over the picture, the main reason why it could not be swayed, no matter what they did, was Moguro Hagane―― no, it was the meteor which governed the Crystal Palace, the heart of the Vollachian Empire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3.</ref> Due to the way Moguro worked, they had full control over the entire palace, could create their own golems from both the palace and the walls of the Imperial Capital, and if need be, they could even turn the entire Crystal Palace into a '''Giant Magic Crystal Soldier''', granting them incredible might that rivalled the might of the Nine Divine Generals. So long as Moguro's core existed, Moguro would not die, making the palace incredibly difficult to bring down, and making it a symbol of the Empire's mighty defense.

Outside of the palace's function via Moguro, it also had great offensive capabilities. Supposedly, the palace could amplify magic thousands of times beyond its normal power.<ref>''“I’ve heard that at times of need, a single stone from the Crystal Palace can amplify magic to thousands of times its usual power… Is it true?”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 1|Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 3.</ref> Thanks to this, the Magic Crystal Cannon, a cannon adorned with magic stones which sits at the highest point of the palace, in tandem with the castle's mana and the magic stones used across the entirety of its structure, could have its power amplified to the extreme, enough so that it could wipe an entire city, army, or even the likes of the spell Al Shario away in an instant.<ref>''The mana stored within the palace could be passed through the magic crystals located everywhere in the building to amplify it, and then be released through the Magic Crystal Cannon installed on the highest layer of the Crystal Palace.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3.</ref> Similarly, if one sets up the appropriate magic circles, mages could take advantage of the immense store of mana to cast limitless amounts of magic from. This being said, due to the country's extreme lack of mages, this aspect was not utilized, and likewise, it could even be taken advantage of by enemy mages if they set everything up beforehand.

During the Great Disaster, when the capital faced its destruction, the Crystal Palace found itself at the center of said destruction. After having its halls and rooms distorted heavy by magic circles and separating the dungeon through magic, it received immense damage from the numerous battles that were held within, including from warriors of [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]]'s caliber. After being manipulated by the enemy and turned into the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier, it was ultimately destroyed by the combined efforts of the Nine Divine Generals and the Imperial Family, both past and present, leaving barely a trace behind. Although their memories were ultimately reset due to the core overloading, Moguro's core, which doubled as the palace's core, was fortunately saved.

==History==
Throughout the Empire's history, the reigning emperor has historically ruled Vollachia from Lupugana's Crystal Palace. At an unknown point in time, the Crystal Palace and the meteor within it, which would eventually become Moguro Hagane, were created. Sometime after its creation, the Magic Crystal Cannon sitting atop the palace would come to be used in the past to destroy a large city, and according to legend, it was used against a [[Great Disaster#Trivia|Great Disaster]].<ref>''That power was able to bring about enough destruction to wipe out the entirety of a large city, and in the past, when it had been used hundreds of years prior―― legends say that its target had been a Great Disaster.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3.</ref>

During [[Eugard Vollachia]]'s reign, the bastions of the city were refashioned into the shape of a star in honor of his beloved [[Yorna Mishigure|Iris]] after her death. 

The reservoir located to the north of Lupugana formerly contained portions of the city. However, it was burned down by [[Arakiya]] during one of her skirmishes with [[Cecilus Segmunt]]. The area was later reused as a reservoir at [[Chisha Gold]]'s suggestion.

During the [[Imperial Civil War]], the Imperial Capital acted as the base for Chisha and [[Berstetz Fondalfon|Berstetz]]’s forces, and eventually, the Battle for the Imperial Capital took place outside the bastions. The fight that broke out resulted in many casualties on the Rebel Army’s side, but their efforts also allowed for the walls of both the fourth and fifth bastions to be broken. Shortly after, they were interrupted by the arrival of the Witch [[Sphinx]] and her undead army. This hidden army, known now as the Great Disaster, forced everyone to retreat to [[Garkla]].

Later, a specialized team returned to the Imperial Capital to defeat the Witch and her army. The battle here resulted in significantly more damage. A massive area around the second bastion was burned completely to ash, a large area surrounding the first bastion was utterly destroyed by a [[Mezoreia|Dragon]]’s might, numerous areas beyond the third bastion were crushed underneath a rain of shattered ice, and other areas in the vicinity of the fourth bastion received severe damage from the swinging of the Fiend Sword. There were even entire buildings uprooted from the ground and weaponized, as seen in both [[Garfiel Tinzel]]’s and Arakiya’s fights. Even the Crystal Palace was unable to escape the destruction, as it was weaponized and promptly destroyed by the emperor and his entourage. The numerous chunks that had come off of the Crystal Palace as well as its great swings prior to its destruction left far greater damages to the city. The damages left to the city following the end of the fight was immense, and as such, nobody has taken up residence in the town again yet.

==Locations==
*'''Crystal Palace''' (水晶宮, ''Suishō-kyū''): The Crystal Palace was the castle where the emperor of Vollachia reigned from. It was considered the symbol of Lupugana and the heart of the Empire itself as a result of its unparalleled offensive and defensive capabilities. Due to the presence of the emperor, it was guarded by a large amount of soldiers from the Imperial Army.
**'''Throne Room''': The throne room was located in the most elevated and prestigious room of the Crystal Palace. It had a great door leading into it and a blood-red carpet laid before the national flag of the Sword Wolf.<ref>''The throne room was located in the most elevated, most prestigious room in the castle. With the national banner of a wolf pierced by swords hoisted on the wall behind it, and a blood-red carpet laid out before it, present there was the throne upon which all the authority of this Empire was concentrated; and upon it, the Emperor sat.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 105, Section 3.</ref> The throne itself had a mechanism that allowed the emperor to instantaneously teleport to the Graveyard of Nameless Monarchs should they require an immediate escape.
**'''Guest Chambers''': The guest chambers were on a high floor of the palace. They were comprised of elegant rooms that contain furnishing of the highest quality.
**'''Spire''': The highest floor of the Crystal Palace where the battery to fire the Magic Crystal Cannon was installed.<ref>''The battery of the Magic Crystal Cannon was installed on the highest floor of the Crystal Palace, and within the spire where it was operated, a battle had broken out.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 68, Section 2.</ref>
**'''Library''': The library of the Crystal Palace, where Vincent Vollachia discovered [[Stride Vollachia]]'s concealed journal when he was a child.
**'''Treasury''': The treasury of the palace, which contains the core of Moguro Hagane, the nucleus of the Crystal Palace.<ref name="palace">''"Since the Stone is being utilized for the forbidden technique, the treasury where the core of Moguro Hagane, the nucleus of the Crystal Palace, is kept, or perhaps the underground cathedral where sacrifices are offered to anchor the Stone. There is also the dungeon next to the cathedral… No, disregard that."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 66, Section 1.</ref>
**'''Underground Cathedral''': A cathedral near to the dungeons in which sacrifices are made to anchor the Stone.<ref name="palace />
**'''Dungeon''': A dimly lit underground dungeon where prisoners were thrown into. The dungeon was accessed through a staircase. 
*'''Imperial Residence''' (離宮, ''Rikyū''): The official residence of the emperor of Vollachia, located in the vicinity of the Crystal Palace to the north. It was known to have an office and a balcony from which the Crystal Palace could be viewed. About 300 years ago, it was set ablaze by [[Whitaker Goldario]] just prior to Eugard Elcanti's coronation as emperor in an attempt to assassinate him. It was reconstructed later during Eugard's reign and it became his home for the rest of his life. 
*'''Berstetz's Mansion''': The official residence of Vollachia's current Prime Minister, Berstetz Fondalfon. It was a spacious mansion with a majestic atmosphere where even the rooms made for prisoners of war were lavishly designed. The mansion is overseen by Berstetz's own private army, which guarded areas both within and around the premises. Most notably, there was a hidden tea chamber serving as a fortress for the sole purpose of private conversations; it was said to cost enough to buy an entire city by itself. Additionally, Berstetz's mansion possessed a courtyard, a garden, and a hidden compartment that could only be accessed from the roof of the mansion.
*'''Reservoir''': A reservoir for storing water located north of the Crystal Palace. It used to be comprised of the northern section of Lupugana until it was destroyed during a fight between Cecilus and Arakiya. As of the Great Disaster, the amount of water within the reservoir has been greatly diminished by the damage dealt to the walls containing it, causing the water to flood the city for a temporary period of time.
*'''Flour Mill''': A mill that contained wheat and flour. It was annihilated with a dust explosion triggered by [[Natsuki Subaru]].

Unspecified number of soldiers killed |casual3 = |casual 4 = |civilian = Unspecified, likely massive}} The '''Great Disaster''' (大災) was one of the [[Terminology#Story Specific|four mass-scale disasters]], which took place in the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] approximately one year and eight months after [[Natsuki Subaru]] was summoned to the [[world]]. It was an armed conflict where the deceased citizens of Vollachia were resurrected as [[undead]] by the [[Witch]], [[Sphinx]]. Its prognosis was a driving force behind the [[Imperial Civil War]] in [[Arc 7]], and it was the primary conflict that took place during [[Arc 8]]. Directly preceding the disaster was the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], a battle for control over [[Lupugana]] between the [[Imperial Army]], the Pleiades Battalion, and the so-called Rebel Army. Its stopping point was marked by [[Chisha Gold]]'s death and the rise of countless undead throughout the Imperial Capital of Lupugana. In order to quell the Great Disaster, [[Vincent Vollachia]] took a specialized group with him to retake Lupugana, instigating the conclusive [[Conquest of the Undead Capital]]. The disaster came to an end after Subaru and [[Spica]] successfully used the [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]] on the Witch. ==Background== ===Stride's Journal=== More than 40 years before Subaru's arrival to the world, a member of Vollachia's Imperial Family named [[Stride Vollachia]] fell ill from poisoning and spent three months on the border between life and death. After conquering his illness at the cost of his body beginning to resemble a living corpse's, Stride began to believe in entities known as the “Observers”. He wrote a journal containing contents about them and the signs of a future Great Disaster to come. Stride soon concealed the journal inside the Crystal Palace's library, and for undisclosed reasons, his name was erased from the records of the Imperial Family and the Vollachia Empire. When he was a child, Vincent Abellux discovered the hidden journal of Stride Vollachia, which contained foreknowledge of the Great Disaster. He used it before and after becoming emperor in an attempt to minimize the ruin it caused after ascertaining that it could not be stopped and believing his death was inevitable. Many of the actions Vincent had chosen throughout his life, including his recruitment of Chisha Gold and [[Cecilus Segmunt]], saving [[Priscilla Barielle|Prisca Benedict]]'s life, his reforms to the Empire after becoming the emperor, and the reestablishment of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]], were all for the purpose of minimizing the Great Disaster's ruin. ===[[Demi-Human War]]=== In the same era, the future bearer of the Great Disaster, Sphinx, was taking part in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]'s [[Demi-Human War]]. She had once been used in a failed immortality experiment by [[Echidna]], but after acquiring parts of the Witch of Greed's soul, she found her way into the world and happened upon [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] nearly 350 years after her creation. She joined the Demi-Human Alliance at his beckon and gained infamy as the only “Witch” besides [[Satella]] whose name was engraved into the history of the Kingdom, infamously known for her massive use of the Sacrament of the Immortal King and the corpse soldiers generated by it. However, during the [[Invasion of the Royal Castle]], Sphinx was forced to retreat and found herself taken captive by [[Leip Barielle]], who she would be held prisoner by for over 40 years. ===Undead Experiments=== During her time imprisoned in a Barielle Domain cell, Sphinx furthered her experiments with her magic. With Leip intending to use her to further his own schemes as well as her intrigue in his plans, she eventually learned of Priscilla Barielle, who was at the crux of Leip's plans. However, following Leip's defeat and subsequent death at the hands of Priscilla and her knight [[Al|Aldebaran]], those schemes came to an end, and at this point, unknowingly to herself, Sphinx started quietly pining for revenge. As she furthered her experiments with her magic, she made improvements to the Sacrament of the Immortal King, and she decided to use three villages along the Barielle Domain's Tenrill River, including the village of Coffleton, as the center of her experiments. However, these too ended in failure, as Priscilla once again appeared and burned away all of the parasites that turned the village's residents into undead. Driven by her failure, Sphinx eventually decided to set her sights on Priscilla's homeland, Vollachia, as both a part to complete herself and to attain her revenge. At an unknown point in time after this, she managed to regain all of her lost limbs, experimented more in [[Kararagi]], and she set forth toward Vollachia, creating various different countermeasures to ensure her victory. ===[[Imperial Civil War]]=== Eventually, [[Ubilk]], a Stargazer of the Empire, received a commandment that foretold that the Great Disaster could only begin with “Vincent Vollachia's” death in front of Chisha Gold and Vincent himself.''“――The death of His Excellency Vincent Vollachia, that will be the signal for the beginning of the commandment.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 4, Section 6. This greatly upset Chisha, who discovered that Vincent had known about the Great Disaster since he acquired Stride Vollachia's journal. In a later conversation with Ubilk, Chisha had the idea to replace Vincent's role in the commandment by using [[Chisha Gold#Abilities|Noh]]. Before the events of Arc 7, Chisha began cooperating with [[Berstetz Fondalfon]]'s plan to rebel against Vincent, forced him away from the Imperial Capital, imprisoned [[Goz Ralfon]], who had helped the emperor escape Lupugana and gained knowledge of the Great Disaster, and became the acting emperor by taking on his appearance. Throughout the arc's events, Chisha acted as the emperor in Vincent's place. He visited the [[Chaosflame|Demon City of Chaosflame]], witnessed the city's destruction by a mass of shadows, ordered members of the Nine Divine Generals and [[Kafma Irulux]] to guard Lupugana's bastions, and waited for Vincent to arrive at the [[Lupugana#Locations|Crystal Palace]] during the Battle for the Imperial Capital. Concurrently, Sphinx set five magic circles across the Empire to resurrect undead once the Great Disaster began. When Vincent arrived at the Crystal Palace's throne room, during the Battle for the Imperial Capital, he and Chisha had a short confrontation. Suddenly, the latter was killed by [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], a dead man who had formerly been the Ninth among the Nine Divine Generals. The deceased citizens of Vollachia began being brought back by the bearer of the Great Disaster, Sphinx, and the Great Disaster began without Vincent Abellux dying, as Chisha's death while in the form of Vincent Vollachia fulfilled the prediction of Ubilk's commandment.''“First-Class General Chisha Gold has unquestionably fulfilled the role of Vincent Vollachia. His Excellency himself, of all people, had molded General Chisha Gold to do so.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 5, Section 6. ==Disaster== ===Retreat from Lupugana=== Following Chisha’s demise, [[Moguro Hagane]] took the emperor outside, where they encountered the undead Balleroy flying around on his dragon, [[Carillon]]. Though confused over why he was alive, Moguro engaged in battle with Balleroy, nearly coming out victorious against him. However, having recognized Balleroy’s presence, [[Madelyn Eschart]], possessing the Dragon [[Mezoreia]], attacked Moguro and sided with Balleroy. The fight resulted in one of Moguro's arms flying off and damaging the reservoir, and Vincent flying off of Moguro’s shoulder and being caught by numerous extended sheets, each one held out by the [[Stargazer]]s, with Ubilk among them. Realizing what the Great Disaster truly was, he interrogated Ubilk, and he learned that this was merely one of the four mass-scale disasters that would affect the world. Meanwhile, Divine General Goz Ralfon, who managed to escape from his prison with the help of [[Rem]], charged his way to the throne room to confront the traitors who dethroned the emperor. When he made it there, he found Berstetz, who had been shocked to see the revived [[Lamia Godwin]], and the deceased Chisha. On top of this, despite having attacked Lamia with a lethal attack, she not only survived but regenerated. Then, with the force of the other revived Imperial Family members, Goz and Berstetz were forced to retreat outside. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 33 11.png|thumb|left|180x|Vincent calling for retreat.]] On the ground, Goz and Berstetz encountered Vincent with his mask still on. Similarly, [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], who had retreated from the fifth bastion, and Cecilus, who was chasing after the Dragon, also arrived there. Deciding it was time to retreat, Vincent removed his mask and ordered as such, though Cecilus ended up going off on his own. Simultaneously, the forces outside of the walls began their retreat as well, whether the Rebel or Imperial Army. Elsewhere, beyond the fourth bastion, as Subaru’s group were heading through the Imperial Capital towards the Crystal Palace, they came across other undeads, forcing them to wonder what was going on. When [[Spica|Rui]] sensed the presence of someone she knew nearby, they changed their path in that direction, where they came across Rem and [[Flop O'Connell]] facing off against undead soldiers. After saving them, they came across [[Todd Fang]], who had rescued his fiancé, [[Katya Aurélie]], and offered a temporary alliance to leave the city. After freeing the imprisoned “black-haired crown princes”, they prepared to leave. At the same time, Cecilus encountered the orchestrator of the disaster by the reservoir walls. Along the way, they encountered minimal interference. However, they eventually came across the undead [[Izmail]], forcing them to take action. Though they were temporarily victorious, when [[Tanza]] was injured, Subaru and Todd lured the undead away, and they blew it up inside of a flour mill. Unfortunately, this was soon followed by Todd attempting to kill Subaru out of his paranoia. The resulting fight revealed Todd’s true race as a werewolf via his beastification. Thanks to the arrival of [[Emilia]] and Rem, who had met up shortly before, Todd was repelled, and Subaru was saved before the reservoir walls came down. With one last attempt on Subaru’s life, Rem shoved Todd’s own axe into his body, and she knocked him into the rushing water. With Subaru passing out, they retreated. Thanks to Emilia’s act of creating pathways for escape on her way towards Subaru, many civilians and soldiers caught up between the undead and the fighters were able to escape. At the reservoir, Cecilus had even successfully managed to kill the Witch, Sphinx. However, even with her death, the disaster had not ended. ===Evacuation to Garkla=== The majority of each of the living armies retreated from the Imperial Capital in the direction of the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]]. While the Pleiades Battalion, the People of Shudrak, and the armies held back the undead, the coupled dragon carriages were used to escort the people of import, the injured, and citizens who were able to escape. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 34 3.png|thumb|250px|Lugunica and Vollachia forge an alliance.]] With the awakening of Subaru, Vincent confronted him about Chisha’s death and Subaru’s apparent identity as a Stargazer. After Subaru rejected Vincent’s accusation and they settled their differences, the two took part in a meeting that would determine how everyone would treat the disaster moving forward, where it was revealed that Priscilla Barielle, [[Yorna Mishigure]], Al, and Cecilus were forced to be left behind, their current predicaments unknown. Despite both sides having issues that needed to be handled, Vincent ultimately requested the assistance of the [[Emilia Camp]], signifying the first time that Lugunica and Vollachia ever put aside their differences and worked together. Soon after, they received reinforcements in the form of [[Anastasia Hoshin]] and [[Julius Juukulius]] of the [[Anastasia Camp]], and the strongest man in the Kararagi City-States, [[Halibel]]. With the alliance formed, [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] and [[Beatrice]] temporarily joined the battle with everyone against the undead in order to determine the makeup of the spell used to revive the undead, now dubbed zombies. Here, they encountered Sphinx, who was now an undead herself after being killed by Cecilus, and with the help of [[Garfiel Tinzel]] and [[Mizelda Shudrak]], they were able to defeat her. However, another Sphinx appeared at the coupled dragon carriages. Fortunately, Subaru was able to prevent its destruction with the help of Emilia, Julius, and Halibel. With these two incidents halted, everyone convened again, where the spell’s makeup and the zombies’ weaknesses were discussed with everyone. This led to Subaru and Vincent meeting with the shackled Ubilk, where they learned of the two lights necessary to prevent the Great Disaster: a girl who couldn’t speak brought by a Stargazer of the Kingdom and a [[Groovy Gumlet|beastman of the nine summits]] who was the most well-versed person in the Empire on curses. With the meeting concluded, Subaru discussed how Rui should be handled with the Lugunican party, with regards of everything that had happened in Vollachia up until now, which ended with Rui being renamed Spica. Meanwhile, Vincent spoke with Flop, who revealed vital pieces of information left behind by Chisha, and who offered his sister, [[Medium O'Connell|Medium]], to be his bride. Soon after came the undead Blight Dragon [[Valgren]], accompanied by Lamia Godwin and her resurrected Pruning Corps. On top of this, Vincent, Subaru, Beatrice, Roswaal, and Ubilk were all marked by another member of the imperial family, [[Palladio Manesque]]. Lamia managed to discover how to spread her soul across numerous undead receptacles, effectively paving the way for her to create a plethora of replicas of herself. Though battles with the various Lamias broke out all across the coupled dragon carriages, thanks to the efforts of Berstetz, an opening was created for Subaru and Spica to utilize the Authority of Gluttony on her. After Vincent landed the final blow against her, Balleroy appeared and took the last crumbling zombie of Lamia and retreated. In the end, Halibel defeated Valgren on his own, and the Pruning Corps were apparently wiped out. ===Launching an Opposition=== After arriving in Garkla, Vincent confirmed his suspicions and relayed them to his allies: the Stone, [[Muspel]], was no longer within the confines of the Fortified City, having been plundered by the Witch. With this stated, it was concluded that it was being used as a battery to power the version of Sacrament of the Immortal King that was being used to revive the dead. Should the Stone’s immense amount of mana be used up, then the very earth of Vollachia would become uninhabitable, and the people on it would die as well, as Muspel was directly connected to all of the land of the country. With their goal of retrieving the Imperial Capital as soon as possible being set in stone, a special unit was made to complete this task. Meanwhile in the outskirts of Lupugana, Al, who had been saved from the undead [[Viva]], was traveling with Cecilus while heading in the direction of the Imperial Capital. Despite Cecilus’s actions of toying with Al, they managed to make progress, until they were interrupted by the arrival of an invisible, flying Balleroy. With the appearance of Cecilus’s father, [[Rowan Segmunt]], they managed to repel the dead general. Nearby, Divine General Groovy Gumlet and [[Heinkel Astrea]] also appeared. The group had gathered together when Groovy stumbled on Heinkel and Rowan drinking away at a tavern despite the crisis, and by this point, they had decided to make their way towards the city as well. With everyone having converged, they continued forward until it was time to split their forces. Having determined that the zombies had their smallest number of forces at two of the bastions, Rowan went off on his own while Al directed Heinkel to the first bastion, fully aware of the trap he was leading him into. Meanwhile, Al, Groovy, and Cecilus made their way through the fourth bastion. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 36 11.png|thumb|left|180x|Groovy confronting the Emperor of the Briar.]] Rowan confronted Yorna somewhere beyond the fifth bastion, and though she was holding back so as not to kill him, since he saw it as a way to reach the Heavenly Sword, he took his own life and became an army of zombies with their sights set on battling Yorna and improving themselves in undeath. Al’s group eventually ended up being ensnared by the Curse of Thorns, forcing Groovy to split up from the pair to challenge the one controlling the curse, while Al and Cecilus left to find the [[Enchanted Sword#Fiend Sword Murasame|Fiend Sword]] and the [[Enchanted Sword#Dream Sword Masayume|Dream Sword]]. However, in an unfortunate turn of events, Groovy confronted [[Eugard Vollachia]], who wielded not only the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] but also the Fiend Sword, and Al and Cecilus were forced to confront [[Arakiya]], who couldn’t control her own body after devouring the Stone. During the battle against Eugard, Groovy resorted to self-poisoning in order to counteract the pain being caused by the curse being exuded from Eugard, and with extreme tenacity, Groovy used countless tools to catch the former emperor off guard, assaulting him from every direction. That said, due to the power of the Fiend Sword, Groovy took great damage and struggled, leaving him in a dangerous position. As for Heinkel, he confronted the Cloud Dragon Mezoreia, controlled by Divine General Madelyn Eschart. With their lives in danger, they were fortunately saved by the arrival of Garfiel and Halibel. ===Defense of Garkla=== As the fight in the Imperial Capital began, an army of zombies were brought forward to bring down the Fortified City. The zombies, led by Palladio Manesque, proceeded to engage in battle with the army defending the town, as well as with the Pleiades Battalion. Meanwhile, the people within the city were preparing for the battle, with Serena, alongside Berstetz, Otto, and Anastasia, leading the charge, and people like Rem joining the healing units to care for the injured. On the frontlines, Divine General Goz confronted the undead Gladiator Empress [[Hornet]] to reduce the casualties produced. Simultaneously, Julius and the People of Shudrak fought from atop the walls of Garkla, preventing the undead from climbing the walls. Though some were initially worried for the appearance of former Divine General Balleroy, Flop, who provided weapons and arrows to the people atop the walls, assured them that he would not appear. Meanwhile, Palladio had a force prepared to infiltrate the city from above, abusing the undead’s revival and regeneration mechanisms to scale the nearby mountain and attack from both behind and above. That said, the allied forces were prepared for this, leaving a special unit from the Pleiades Battalion, led by [[Gustav Morello]], to ambush the ambushers. Thanks to this, Serena was free to deploy her Flying Dragon Squadron into the battle. With other strategies failing, Valgren reappeared to destroy the city. However, through the combined efforts of Julius, the People of Shudrak, and [[Ram]], they were able to sever and destroy Valgren’s three heads, and the Dragon’s body soon crumbled. With all of his strategies being deterred, Palladio grew frustrated, until a transformed Sphinx, now calling herself the Witch of Greed, appeared on the battlefield and cast Al Shario. However, even this was stopped, having been destroyed by a stocked blast from the Magic Crystal Cannon unleashed by Subaru and Beatrice. The aftershock affected everyone on the battlefield, causing collapses in the city as well. That said, minimal casualties were caused thanks to the effects of Priscilla’s Soul Marriage Technique reaching everyone in the allied forces. After the terminus of the Conquest of the Undead Capital resulted in the undead being unable to resurrect, Palladio and his forces were cut down and finished off by Todd Fang. ===[[Conquest of the Undead Capital]]=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 37 1.png|thumb|250px|The conquest begins.]] Before arriving in the Imperial Capital, Subaru gave everyone their directions, having already made his “preparations”. As such, Garfiel went to the first bastion, Roswaal and Medium went to the third, Halibel went to the fourth, Emilia and Tanza went to the fifth, Subaru’s group went elsewhere beyond the fifth, and Olbart went to investigate the Crystal Palace. When Tanza and Emilia arrived at their destination, they saved Yorna from the undead Rowan, and they fought his many duplicate receptacles together. At the same time, Halibel confronted Eugard while saving Groovy from demise. Together, they discovered the true nature of Eugard’s curse. Thanks to Halibel’s strength, Eugard decided to discard the Fiend Sword and solely used Yang Sword against the wolfman. However, this decision is what led to the man’s defeat, as Groovy managed to get the sword to Halibel. After Halibel severed Sphinx’s influence on the Emperor of the Briar, he temporary reverted to a human form that ran on “embers”, and the Curse of Thorns came into Groovy's possession. In the skies above the third bastion, Roswaal and Medium handled Balleroy, as his presence was the most important on the battlefield. Resorting to using Medium as a shield, dropping a massive glacier that Emilia made beforehand, and the usage of a spell that Julius specialized with, Roswaal was ultimately able to come out victorious against Balleroy, albeit after taking a powerful hit himself. Meanwhile, Garfiel was entrusted with defeating the Dragon at the first bastion. Despite taking a beating himself, Garfiel was able to not only give the Dragon a nosebleed, but he also flipped it by its tail and withstood a breath attack from it. When Mezoreia went into the skies to unleash its last powerful attack, Heinkel assisted Garfiel in reaching it and brought Mezoreia down. As for Al and Cecilus, the two struggled greatly against Arakiya, as her body was being forced to defend itself with the power of one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]. That said, with Al throwing the Blue Lightning his sword, he was able to wipe out a good portion of her attacks, and soon after, he summoned the Dream Sword, using it in combination with the Soul Marriage Technique that was being used on the Spirit Eater to settle the Stone’s power within her and keep her alive. Finally, Subaru’s group confronted numerous zombies, and eventually, Sphinx herself. Though they managed to defeat one of her, multiple zombies of Sphinx appeared and pinned everyone down. However, thanks to Subaru’s strategy, several of the clones were destroyed, and Vincent used his own Yang Sword to burn Sphinx’s very soul. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 37 12.png|thumb|left|180x|Sphinx becomes the Witch of Greed.]] Despite their victory, Sphinx’s form changed into the appearance of the Witch of Greed, and she had several of her zombies scattered, with one appearing outside of Garkla. Meanwhile beyond the fifth bastion, Eugard appeared to help Yorna, leading to the swift defeat of Rowan. His very soul burning, Rowan rushed to confront Cecilus one last time, where he ultimately lost. Shortly after his defeat, Cecilus and Al confronted Sphinx, who had come to kill Arakiya, as her survival had become synonymous with the Empire’s survival. As their confrontation continued, Sphinx cast Al Shario, leading Cecilus to return to his original form and cut it down, while Al caught the surprised Witch off guard and sealed her with Ol Shamak. Though she was unable to fight, another version of her prepared to fire the last shot of the Magic Crystal Cannon at Al and Cecilus. Despite Cecilus being prepared to slash it, it was ultimately devoured by an Al Shamak cast by Subaru and Beatrice, who had been making their way to the Crystal Palace themselves. Inside the Crystal Palace, after Olbart destroyed all of the magic circles altering the castle's internal structure and ending Viva's soul experiments, Olbart confronted another Sphinx, who was overloading the core of Divine General Moguro Hagane. In the confrontation, Sphinx destroyed herself and nearly killed the Vicious Old Man. That said, thanks to this, Olbart was able to call for the emperor, who was just beneath the Palace alongside Eugard, Yorna, and Tanza, and he reached the room they were in. Realizing Moguro could not be saved and that their overloaded core could destroy the Imperial Capital, he prepared to sacrifice part of his life to end Moguro’s soon-to-be exploding core. Before he could, Medium, accompanied by Balleroy, arrived. Flying the magic core into the sky, Balleroy and Carillon were caught in its explosion above the city, taking both their undead lives and the life of Moguro, the core itself. In the sky, Subaru and Beatrice were saved by Roswaal when Valgren appeared, and soon after, both Halibel and Cecilus appeared and quickly dispatched the Blight Dragon. That said, death was soon upon them, with Sphinx splitting herself up to attempt to complete a magic circle, and the undead were attempting to kill Arakiya. With Emilia, Eugard, Cecilus, Halibel, and Garfiel holding off the five zombies, everyone else prevented the undead from reaching Arakiya. That said, even this was not the end, as Sphinx generated a massive mirror of water in the sky to reveal Al Shario being cast at Garkla. Despite this, Subaru and Beatrice released the Magic Crystal Cannon shot they absorbed at it, and when the deadly water Magic above threatened to tear everyone apart, Priscilla, who had been imprisoned in an extradimensional space, managed to escape and annihilate the spell in its entirety, with others destroying the Sphinxes coming to attack her. Unbeknownst to everyone, however, Priscilla only managed to escape by becoming an undead herself. Having used her Soul Marriage Technique in Lupugana and Garkla and entrusting Sphinx to Subaru and Spica, Priscilla went with Vincent and Eugard to stop the final trump card up Sphinx’s sleeve: the Crystal Palace itself activating and preparing to kill everyone. As they burned down the Crystal Palace, Priscilla fought and defeated the remaining Sphinxes heading her way. Meanwhile, Subaru and Spica, being protected by everyone, spoke to Sphinx. Regaining his body’s original form in the process, he and Spica managed to devour her name, putting her to rest and ending the Great Disaster. ==Aftermath== The defeat of Sphinx marked the collapse of the undead army's central forces in Lupugana, resulting in the surviving undead retreating and concealing themselves from the living. The number of casualties has not yet been fully ascertained. Naturally, the places within Vollachia that became battleground also have yet to be identified, but it is known that Garkla and Lupugana, two major cities within the Empire, were afflicted. Garkla's walls received considerable damage from the undead army, and civilians and soldiers alike began working to reconstruct them. Meanwhile, the destruction wrought to Lupugana caused the destruction of the Crystal Palace, and since the reservoir had not completely broken, it was at risk of being destroyed at any time. According to Priscilla, the state Lupugana was left in could very well take a century to restore. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 38 12.png|thumb|right|250px|Priscilla fading away.]] In the immediate aftermath of the Great Disaster, the elite force that had participated in the Conquest of the Imperial Capital returned to Garkla along with those who had remained in the city prior. Subaru found Priscilla and took stroll with her, happening across various people while going around Garkla. Along the way, he learns that the undead Eugard, who had a humanoid form, has limited time left. Using the time he had, Eugard requested to the current emperor to put an end to the slaughter of wolf humans and mole humans. Eventually, the pair made their way to top of the city's walls, where Al was. Priscilla had already asked Berstetz to clear the guards from the area they were at. For a brief period, the trio drank some alcohol, and as Subaru sung, the master and servant duo of Priscilla and Aldebaran danced. However, this short-lived period came to an end when Subaru and Al realized that Priscilla was fading away, learning that she had become an undead at the climax of the Great Disaster. Subaru made his way to jump off of the wall, but he was stopped by Priscilla, and he quickly realized she could not be saved after she congratulated him and Al for their services. The Sun Princess imparted her final words to the two knights and dissolved entirely, becoming the first of the five candidates to drop out of Lugunica's [[Royal Selection]]. Furthermore, Moguro’s core was recovered, having fallen near the injured Groovy, yet due to the lack of the Crystal Palace and their memories having been reset, Moguro was removed from the Nine Divine Generals. The Curse of Thorns, which Groovy had taken onto himself, was erased by a slash from the Fiend Sword, leaving the general with yet another injury. Eugard, having imparted his love to Yorna, faded away. With a vacancy among the Nine Divine Generals, Kafma was unable to refuse a promotion to First-Class General and one of the Nine Divine Generals. Due to the loss of his arms and his old age, Olbart retired from the Nine Divine Generals. Word of Vincent taking Medium’s hand as the future empress spread throughout the country. Mizelda took her position as Chieftain of the People of Shudrak back, and Taritta decided to accept Flop’s proposal for marriage. Mezoreia returned to its home, and Madelyn remained one of the Nine Divine Generals. Those who remained as one of the Nine Divine Generals were promoted. Jamal became Vincent’s permanent bodyguard. Vincent pardoned Berstetz for his actions with Cecilus’s backing and protection. The members of the Pleiades Battalion, who had originally been gladiators due to past crimes, were also pardoned for their services to the country. As for the Royal Selection Candidates’ Camps, Anastasia decided her future departure through Kararagi while Emilia would return to Lugunica a few days later. The remaining members of the Priscilla Camp followed the Emilia Camp home. Spica remained in Vollachia to take care of the remaining undead with the assistance of Cecilus and Arakiya. As for Katya, she married Todd and eloped. Lastly, Al decided to act on the purpose that he was given by his sensei: to [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|remove Subaru from the world]]. At some point later, during Spica's mission to quell the remaining undead, they came across [[Volcas]], who had also been revived as an undead. After bringing him back to Garkla to meet with Yorna, it was decided that Volcas would be given a chance to fill a vacancy among the Nine Divine Generals, further cementing the decision to forgive the wolf and mole humans. Afterward, Vincent made the decision to abolish the Imperial Selection Ceremony. ==Trivia== *The name “Great Disaster” is not exclusive to the modern incarnation of the disaster. Long ago, at an unknown time in the past, Lupugana's Magic Crystal Cannon once destroyed a large city, and according to legend, it was used in an incident also known as a Great Disaster.''That power was able to bring about enough destruction to wipe out the entirety of a large city, and in the past, when it had been used hundreds of years prior―― legends say that its target had been a Great Disaster.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3. **Similarly, the [[Destruction of Chaosflame]] was also temporarily referred to as the Great Disaster until Abel and [[Taritta Shudrak]] determined otherwise. *According to the talk show held on April 6, 2025, although the Great Disaster would have been quelled in every IF route, the main story's route is the one that would have had the fewest casualties. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Terminology]] [[Category:Vollachia Empire]]
