title: Omega Party
wikitext:
[[File:Re Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 14 13.png|thumb|225px]]
The '''Omega Party''' (オメガ一行, ''Omega Ikkō'') is a group consisting of [[Omega]] and her various companions who travel together.

==Information==
The Omega Party travels throughout the world per Omega's whims on an aimless journey.<ref>''“I’ve told you this many times, but my journey is an aimless one. I cannot promise you that it’ll be a spectacular all-action grand adventure like you both desire.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6]], [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch]], Section 8.</ref> Originally, her only companions were the five [[Witch#Witches of Sin|Witches of Sin]] whose souls are housed within her glintstone anchor, but as she visited more places, she came across multiple individuals who joined her party for one reason or another. Omega has decided to travel alongside others to prevent herself from being discovered by a currently unknown individual who is a shared enemy of the Witches in hopes of not standing out,<ref>''All of the Witches here in the Castle of Dreams knew that. It was not just Echidna after all. This someone was an enemy all of the Witches had in common.'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]], Section 2.</ref><ref>''“Anyways, that’s why I don’t want to stand out. So rather than wandering around on my own and bringing about modern Witch-related legends, I’ll…”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]], Section 2.</ref> although this approach brings other risks.<ref>''“There’s a chance I’m inviting different kinds of dangers, but there’s no way anyone would think that a Witch would be moving about with other people.”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]], Section 2.</ref>

At the recommendation of other Witches, Omega is mindful of causing too many deaths for the sake of [[Colette]] and [[Palmyra]], the two children she travels with.<ref>''“Some friends of mine told me. For the sake of the young children I travel with, I’ve made it my policy to not cause too many deaths.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10]], [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 2|The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night]], Section 11.</ref> In addition, she has been given a deadline of two years by [[Minerva]] to reacquire her original powers.<ref>''“I see… Then your deadline is two years.”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]], Section 2.</ref>

==History==
===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch|Formation]]===
Following her reincarnation, Omega left the [[Sanctuary]], taking with her a glintstone anchor that housed the souls of [[Typhon]], [[Daphne]], [[Carmilla]], Minerva, and [[Sekhmet]]. She unintentionally burned down a forest when using a fire magic spell to heat herself up. Later, she encountered a group of thieves, killed them with her miasma by projecting her true appearance, and stole their clothes for herself.

[[File:Re Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6 3.png|thumb|right|250px|Omega reveals herself as a Witch to Palmyra.]]
Sometime later, Omega accidentally fell into a river and was saved by Colette, a young girl who lived by herself just outside of a local village in the forest. The two of them spent several days together, getting to know one another and exchanging stories from their pasts When Omega decided to take a walk on another day, Colette informed her to not travel to the eastern side of the forest to avoid a [[witchbeast]] that had been attacking people there. Omega went anyways and met Palmyra, who also warned her of a "Beast". That night, she travelled to the eastern side of the forest and attempted to murder the beast herself until Palmyra came and revealed that it was Colette. Learning of the young girl's ostracization as a Witch for being the only survivor caused by a "Beast", Omega came to the conclusion that Colette had accepted the discrimination she faced and decided to try and "become" a Witch by killing the girl she had only recently met. Omega took off a bracelet that Colette had owned since she was very young, the [[Meteor#Beast Protection Bracelet|Beast Protection Bracelet]], the [[meteor]] that was behind her transformation into a beast. Manifesting her true form to Palmyra and an unconscious Colette, Omega set off for the village in hopes of setting things straight with the villagers. However, this only made things worse for Colette, as she was forced to leave the area as a consequence for being acquainted with a "Witch". Seeing as how Colette had nowhere else to go and Palmyra had used up all of her courtesy for the village, the two of them were invited by Omega to join her, officially forming their party.

Once the Omega Party was formed, in the [[Castle of Dreams]], the six Witches had a meeting together where they discussed [[Echidna]]'s reasoning for allowing Colette and Palmyra to travel with her. To avoid being found by an unnamed enemy of the Witches, Echidna chose to blend in with other humans and avoid being discovered by them. As a result of this reasoning, Minerva set a two-year deadline for Echidna to regain her full powers. It is decided by Echidna they should leave [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. Believing [[Gusteko]] was out of the question, between [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]] and [[Kararagi]], she set her sights on the latter.

===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 1|Murder Mystery]]===
[[File:Re Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10 11.png|thumb|left|180x|Coatl is murdered.]]
Ironically, the trio then proceeded to cross over into Gusteko. On one day, they were caught in a severe blizzard and rescued by [[Noelle Tuérico]], an Itinerant Preacher of the [[Gustekan Church]], after Omega launched a fire spell into the distance. They wait for Omega to regain her energy in a makeshift snow house Noelle created and speak with her in the meantime, learning about the term Silver Blessing, her position in the Gustekan Church and the nearby church building they can use as a refuge. They visit the church once Omega is rejuvenated and acquaint themselves with [[Podoso]], [[Admonsah]], and [[Maqueena]], each of whom had come to the church to meet the pastor who lives there, [[Coatl]]. The trio learned of Coatl's history of having saved a local town from the effects of an avalanche unintentionally caused by the Ice Thieves and how he took up a position of the town's watcher following his charity towards its people, becoming known by the moniker Saint of the Avalanche. Maqueena and Podoso split off from everyone else to visit another part of the church, and another visitor named [[Trellock]] arrives while they are out. Eventually, Maqueena discovers something and screams, prompting everyone else to follow after her to find what has caused her fear. They all stumble upon Coatl's corpse, prompting Omega to say that there was a cold-blooded killer among them.

Omega took charge of the situation, using detective work to determine the killer's identity. She heard from Podoso that there had been a string of serial murders, with Coatl being the eighth known victim. The other victims were peddlers and travelers. Querying him about the seventh victim, Omega then sets her sights on Admonsah, whom she was certain was associated with them. They learn Admonsah was a former slave who unexpectedly killed his owner in self-defense. He was unequivocally forgiven by a majority of the group. Omega tries to ascertain why Coatl would be murdered, searching for any hidden savings. Suddenly, everyone but Maqueena in the room fell asleep to the effects of the Muskrim flower, and she made her getaway with Coatl's collection of magic stones, not wanting to stay and fall victim to his murderer. She was stopped outside by Noelle, who says she could not be affected by such a simple drug and had killed Coatl out of revenge for his former membership of the Ice Thieves and his part in causing the avalanche that devastated Leanotte, her town. Omega arrives to stop Noelle before she could kill Maqueena, outlining that she was only a con artist who perceived Coatl's connection to the Ice Thieves rather than an outright member before giving the ultimatum that she would die if she caused another death, yet again manifesting her true form while saying so. Meanwhile, the culprit responsible for the serial murderers, Trellock, attempted to murder Colette, but her Beast Protection Bracelet activated, severely injuring him. In the end, they pretended that Noelle had apprehended Trellock and left, Podoso decided to take in Admonsah, and Maqueena was forced to stop conning people. With her revenge foiled, Noelle was left aimless. Colette proposed for her to join their group to which she accepted upon Omega's approval.

Later, the party decided to head to the town Podoso had told them about. Eventually, they set up camp, and while Colette and Noelle set up the camp, Palmyra decided to talk with Omega about including Noelle in their travels, worried about getting her involved in their troubles, which included Omega being a half-elf Witch and Colette's bracelet. Omega believed that there was nothing to worry about, and shortly after, Noelle, who had heard part of their conversation appeared and said that she already knew about Omega's secret and chose to follow them regardless. Though Palmyra asked if she had a thing for odd people and Noelle's joking reply that she did, just like Palmyra, she claimed to be just as odd, as she was an itinerant preacher from the Gustekan Church who had decided to leave. Though Palmyra thought it wasn't as bad as Omega's secret, Omega told her that she was underestimating the Church and what they bestowed Noelle, and the two claimed that they would not be amicable toward her effectively breaking a contract, something which might end up leading to them falling into her mess. Though Palmyra told Omega to be prepared to fight, when Noelle told her to feel free to kick her from the party if she ever became a burden, to which she replied by saying not to underestimate her and spoke of her own circumstances, basically unintentionally cornering Noelle into staying in the party after saying not to use Colette as an excuse. Colette arrived shortly after, and the group decided not to talk to her about their conversation. Instead, they ate, and Noelle explained repairs that she had made to their equipment and offered her knowledge of how to use their equipment and how to survive in Gusteko, including knowledge on the Gustekan Church, to which Palmyra and Omega realized that they wouldn't be able to survive in Gusteko without Noelle.

===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Omega in Wonderland Part 1|The Dreaming Town of Sylphoa]]===
The party continued to trudge through the snows of Gusteko, with Palmyra and Omega becoming exhausted. Attempting to give Palmyra some more energy, Colette attempted to let her use her bracelet, but when Palmyra tried, it left her weak and vomiting. Omega explained the reason for this, claiming she allowed it to happen because she wanted to see the look on her face. Afterward, she had Noelle carry Palmyra while Colette carried her. As the got closer to the town of Sylphoa, Omega dispelled a barrier, and eventually they reached the town, where she and Colette fell subject to the Dream Arts spell that had been cast over the town. Impressed with the size of the space and likening it to her Castle of Dreams, even claiming it as superior to herself, Omega cast Al Shario in order to lure out the caster. The caster, [[Lilac]], appeared shortly after, erasing the star Omega summoned and questioning who they were. Meanwhile, Noelle and Palmyra, who were unaffected by the spell, came across the Temple Knight [[Zank Metley]], who claimed to be there to kill the heretics, and they followed behind him, carrying the two unconscious girls with them. However, after arriving in a tent and explaining what was going on, he got into conflict with Palmyra, who did not follow the teachings of the Gustekan Church. With Colette's bracelet detecting danger, her body transformed to help Palmyra and Omega escape, with Zank claiming them as heretics. Noelle, however, stood in his way, asking him to take care of his priorities and forge a short-term alliance with her to end the dreams. Having escaped from Zank, Palmyra soon met with [[Shion]], who, after introducing herself and explained what was going on from her side, asked for Palmyra's assistance.

[[File:Re Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 14 11.png|thumb|right|180x|Omega confronts Lilac.]]
After a small dispute with Lilac, Omega left convincing her to take down the spell to Colette. Despite her standoffish attitude, Omega claimed that Colette's words were getting through to her. However, upon hearing Omega's use of a loan word, Lilac wanted to know where she heard it, leading to negotiations. Despite becoming frustrated with her and even slapping her, she decided to give Omega a chance to take care of the [[Mikli Yulitô|Temple Knight]] who had come after her, breaking the seal that she'd placed. The fight that followed was short lived as the Witches of Sin quickly dispatched her, much to Lilac's shock. At the same time, Noelle confronted Shion, who had used her Dream Arts to send a message to Lilac in an effort to remove her spell. Not listening to her, Noelle threatened violence until Shion pointed out that Zank had killed his allies shortly after arriving and claimed that he might do the same to her. This was followed by a small scuffle between Zank and Noelle and the beastified Colette. However, Palmyra soon woke up and claimed that Mikli was still alive.

In reality, Zank had come to Sylphoa to save his fiancée and had killed his allies when that threatened to kill her along with the residents of Sylphoa to be rid of the heretic, which they claimed was in accordance with the teachings and Holy Will. Speaking with Omega, she told him to leave the Church after confirming the death of the heretic with them, and to take Mikli with him, as she would likely also lose her position after having already lost her blessing. With his leave, Lilac released the people of Sylphoa from her dream world, and Omega offered Shion and Lilac to join her party. Since she couldn't quite trust the two, having just met them, she would give them a chance to look into her memories with their Dream Arts, giving them a chance to find the person from which the loan words they speak come from. The two accepted her offer and joined the party. Afterward, Omega realized that they must have skimmed across [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s memories at some point, and she claimed that combing through those memories would be dangerous for them, assuming they could see them after bypassing all six Witches' resistance.

===[[The Witch's After Tea Party / Witch Trials Part 1|Conspiracy in Limbus]]===
Having moved on from Sylphoa, the Omega Party was walking in a snow field, where they encountered a [[Witchbeast#Snow Blight|Snow Blight]]. However, Omega swiftly dispatched it with Minya. Soon after, they arrived at Limbus, where signs claiming it was forbidden to go out at night and to comply with the "vows of the faith". Though slightly concerned about the town's eeriness, as the group was low on supplies, they decided to enter Limbus, where after a few minutes, they found themselves surrounded by the townsfolk who were armed with farming tools. Though they attempted to calm the townsfolk and offer them a gift in the form of the Snow Blight's crystallized head, they instead accuse her of being a Witch after seeing it, leading Omega to warn Colette against using her bracelet's transformation and Lilac from turning back into Shion, else they be declared Witches. Thanks to the appearance of [[Nananna Pezza]] and her speaking with Noelle, she was able to vouch for them and clear them of being Witches.

Omega's group finds an inn to reside in where they discussed the issue at present, warning everyone about how easily they could be made into scapegoats whether for their abilities, race, or even the look in their eyes, and Noelle explained about Witch Hunts and Witch Trials being rare occurrences in Gusteko that Itinerant Preachers were sometimes sent to deal with. Although wanting to leave the town quickly, the group decides to stay in the town to help Noelle repay her debt to Nananna, and soon after, they meet with Nananna when she arrived to ask for the group's assistance. That night, the Witch Hunt is for a person named [[Minor Characters#Piditz|Piditz]] who had been tipped off as a Witch, and Nananna wanted him taken into custody only. When they later spotted Piditz and chased after him, Omega split off to corner him, only to find [[Mireille Hetia]] using her [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] to kill Piditz. Thanks to being near the body, Omega was quickly turned into a scapegoat and declared a Witch so that Mireille could cover up her kill and at least prevent her from getting in the way of her and Nananna's revenge, and Omega was taken into custody.

Later, Colette visits Omega, and they point out that killings began before the party arrived, which should clear Omega's name, but instead, Mireille decides to have her executed anyway, and Palmyra objects to [[Minor Characters#Edmon Quayle|Edmon Quayle]]. As part of Omega's plan, Noelle persuades Nananna to speak up, and Nananna insists on the town holding a Witch Trial for Omega, and Palmyra declares that if she is a Witch that she would burn with her. At the inn, the party discusses how if the scale of this event expands, they will be unable to prevent the spread of the news this time, which could result in the party's persecution, even abroad, and their possible extradition back to the church. To clear their names, Colette states that they should find the real culprit for the murders. Lilac and Colette go to gather information around the town, and they meet with Mireille, who explained to them how the hunts started. Likewise, Omega explained this to Palmyra, as she learned it while imprisoned. As for Noelle, she joined Nananna, who had been speaking with Edmond about finding Piditz. As she is intent on finding out about the real culprit, Nananna knocks her out and hides her in a pit where all the bodies of the dead "Witches" were dumped. Meanwhile, Shion used her dream arts to peer into the minds of the townsfolk, and she warns Lilac that the "Witch" is just a conspiracy by the council to get rid of political enemies.

After learning of this, Lilac informs the Colette and Palmyra, and the elves suggest sowing division in the people to uproot the conspiracy. Though wanting to talk to Noelle, she does not come back that night, and Lilac and Shion decide to use their dream arts to nudge the townsfolk to attend the upcoming. The next day, the Witch Trial is being held for Omega, overseen by Nananna and the Town Hall, while Palmyra acts as Omega's attorney. Despite her arguments, Edmon counter with his supposed knowledge of the Witches and Omega's chatter does not help. Colette speaks up and claims that she believes that things will not go as the council claims, as people will begin to notice that the entire event seems off, which resounds with the townsfolk. Because of this, Palmyra claims that there is a conspiracy, which Edmon fights against and asks for Nananna's assistance. Because she sides with the town, Lilac and Shion believe her to be part of the conspiracy, and they decide to use their dream arts to influence the people's mental states. Palmyra then claims that the council is using the Witch rumors to get rid of inconvenient people, which Edmon also fights against, though is quickly silenced when she states she heard it herself from a council member and declares that there is no Witch. Unfortunately, Omega claims otherwise.

Despite angering Palmyra, Omega decides to clear things up by declaring that there were two conspiracies taking place in town. Despite Nananna trying to prevent her from talking, Omega quickly ignores her and explains that many of the victims were relatives of council members, and she claims that Nananna is the second conspirator, calling her the bastard child of Edmon whose mother was banished from the town, and as a result, she despised the town. Noelle later appears and confirms that her actions were in response to the death of the [[Minor Characters#Elderly Healer|elderly healer]] who was declared a Witch, and she claims that Nananna tried to remove her from the trial by knocking her out since her only ire was with Limbus. Afterward, Noelle declares that the secretary, Mireille, was helping Nananna, as she was a bastard child of Edmon as well, and she stated how the corpses of Piditz and other people connected to the council and other outside officials were already dumped in a hole. Omega also declares that she witnessed Mireille killing Piditz. Enraged, Mireille uses her spiritual arts to char Edmon's arm with blue fire, and with the intent of killing the entire council, surrounds the council with blue fire, and she and Nananna stand against them. Although Omega is fine with leaving things as they are and taking their leave, Colette states she doesn't want things to end like this, and Omega decides to end the fighting in response to her plea, burning through her restraints and declaring herself a Witch.

Later, as Omega's party begins to leave the town, Noelle says her goodbyes to Nananna, and it is declared that the evil spirit accompanying Mireille will be disposed of. Likewise, it is claimed that Edmon's position is under threat with both his severe injuries and the loss of the citizens' trust, and Mireille claims she was mistaken about real Witches. Despite Colette believing that things were settled peacefully, however, Omega thinks to herself that Limbus would soon face its destruction, as since Omega, Nananna, and Mireille were not executed, there would be continuous Witch Hunts and deaths for scapegoats for the whole incident. Although considering Colette about this, she decides against it.

'''House Mathers''' (メイザース家, ''Meizāsu-ke'') is a noble house in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], currently headed by patriarch [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], who is also currently participating in the [[Royal Selection]] by sponsoring [[Emilia]] as a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. The family holds the court rank of Margrave.

==Information==
House Mathers is a longstanding noble house within Lugunica. It has had a history of producing mages for at least four centuries. Per tradition, the head of the family changes their name to Roswaal,<ref>''“Ah, it refers to me. In our house, generation after generation, the head of the household succeeds the name Roswaal. Before I expelled my parents and siblings, my name had been Altair.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]], Chapter 2, Part 9.</ref> and they also currently serve the role of the margrave of the west. The Mathers Domain is comprised of a vast amount of territory in Lugunica's western and northern regions, including the [[Costuul|Industrial City of Costuul]], the [[Elior Forest|Great Elior Forest]], [[Arlam Village]], and the [[Sanctuary]], among other locations. The main mansion is located near Costuul, and an auxiliary mansion used to be near the village of Arlam until it was burned to the ground in the climax of [[Arc 4]]'s [[Sanctuary Incident|events]]. It is known that a golden plume is one of their family heirlooms.

For generations, the Roswaal of each era has been given the role of Court Mage. Some Roswaals are also known to have furthered the development of the craft of [[magic]], such as [[Roswaal J. Mathers]], who founded the Royal Magic Research in the [[Royal Capital]] in the wake of the reevaluation of magic after the [[Demi-Human War]], and [[Roswaal K. Mathers]], known for being the father of magicreation tools. However, it is unknown if the current Roswaal has made similar contributions other than by disseminating his predecessor's magicreation tools, and from the perspective of the magician [[Ezzo Cadner]], he and [[Ferris]], the two holders of Lugunica's titles of color, are indifferent to the development of magic.

==History==
*Note: The characters within the story rarely describe historical events within helpful context, so the unit BA, “Before Arrival”, and AA, “After Arrival”, will be used to place moments in time with the best available knowledge. Both are in reference to Natsuki Subaru’s arrival in the new world. Also note that the units are not official.

===Roughly Between 416 and 400 BA===
*Altair Mathers was born into the Mathers family to unnamed parents. He was naturally gifted in magic and underwent Magic Release Periods due to his latent magical power. This caused his family to view him as a burden for many years, until one day, he was visited by [[Echidna]], who solved his issues and educated him about his predicament. From then on, he would become smitten with the Witch of Greed for centuries to come.
*Over the course of a few years, Altair managed to usurp House Mathers from his parents and siblings by expelling them from the house and estranging himself from them. He had full control over House Mathers at the age of sixteen and, following the family tradition of the house's head, changed his name to Roswaal A. Mathers.

===Roughly 400 Years BA===
*At just sixteen years old, Roswaal, while learning from Echidna at the Sanctuary, confronts the Warlock of Melancholy, [[Hector]], who attacks the area in his pursuit of the Witch of Greed. Roswaal attempts to hold the Warlock back, just barely managing to hold on long enough for [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu Meyer]] to become the core of the Sanctuary's barrier. This came at the cost of his gate being crushed and his body suffering severe damage that made day-to-day life arduous for him, even requiring the usage of a cane to walk. He receives a copy of Echidna's Book of Wisdom.
*Echidna's life was lost during the [[Great Calamity]]. Henceforward, Roswaal dedicated his very existence to return his teacher's life to her.

===After 400 BA===
*A man named [[Clind]] formed a contract with Roswaal to protect his property. The price of the contract was to defeat an unnamed enemy that the two of them shared. After the enemy's defeat, Clind faithfully abided by his contract with Roswaal, even after his soul was transcribed onto his descendants' bodies. 
*House Miload, a branch family of House Mathers, was formed at an unknown point in time.
*Roswaal begins to pursue [[Sphinx]], an incomplete receptacle who could not manage to fully inherit the Witch of Greed's soul with Soul Transcription, acquiring a defective personality as a result.

===Roughly 385 BA===
*On the verge of his thirties, Roswaal A. Mathers perishes. House Mathers is inherited by his son, Roswaal B. Mathers.
*Following the death of Roswaal A. Mathers, each successive Roswaal began to introduce themselves to [[Beatrice]] upon taking the mantle of head of the Mathers family.

===Roughly 265 BA===
*Roswaal D. Mathers permits a 150-year-old [[Toska Astrea|Toska]] to visit Beatrice in the Forbidden Library in an attempt to convince her to leave it. Toska's attempt ultimately ended in failure.

===46-41 BA===
*[[Roswaal J. Mathers]], the then-head of House Mathers, made her entry into the [[Demi-Human War]] as part of her three-and-a-half-century long pursuit of Sphinx. Accompanied by her bodyguard, [[Carol Remendis]], they investigated Castour Field with members of the Zergev Squadron, encountering Sphinx and her [[Undead|undead]] [[Undead#Corpse Soldiers|corpse soldiers]] there. Sphinx escaped, her existence was reported to the King, and she was granted the title of "Witch", much to Roswaal's displeasure.
*A series of small skirmishes with Sphinx's magic circles served as the buildup to the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], which had Sphinx unleash her deadliest magic circle yet. However, Roswaal J. Mathers was completely incapable of utilizing magic into practice, placing her in the perfect position to slay Sphinx with martial arts. She was again unsuccessful, as Sphinx made another escape.
*With Carol and [[Grimm Fauzen]], Roswaal had one final [[Invasion of the Royal Castle|clash]] with Sphinx at Lugunica Castle in the wake of the [[Royal Army]]'s disastrous loss at Aihiya Swamp. Carol removed Sphinx's left arm, and an undead [[Libre Fermi]] removed her right arm not long after. As was customary for Sphinx, she fled to the area underneath the Royal Castle, only to supposedly be reduced to ash by [[Leip Barielle]]. Roswaal found Leip and received a ring kept on Sphinx's person from him, finally satisfied that she had finally finished her centuries-long pursuit. Unbeknownst to Roswaal, however, Leip kept Sphinx alive to utilize her for his ambition of making Lugunica his.
*When the Demi-Human War threatened to reach the Trias Domain, Roswaal notified [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]], telling him to make sure he would not regret whatever decision he made.

===Roughly 39-38 BA===
*In the wake of the Demi-Human War, the Kingdom of Lugunica began reevaluating the importance of magic. Roswaal founded the Royal Magic Research Institute as a research facility for magic.
*At Roswaal's tavern, she, Clind, and Wilhelm were attacked by [[shinobi]]. The three of them made quick work of the assassins. 
*Roswaal and several other people entered Sphinx's Testing Grounds in Shamrock Valley, where they discovered a forbidden art with unknown effects in addition to evidence that [[Stride Vollachia]] had visited it before them.
*Roswaal examined Carol when she was cursed by Stride's [[Stride Vollachia#Authority|Amethyst Thumb]].
*When Stride enacted his grand plan in [[Picoutatte]], calling forth [[Valgren]] and commencing the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]], Roswaal added herself to the subjugation force that was to be dispatched to put an end to his terror. She recognized that the effect of the forbidden art taken from Sphinx's Testing Grounds, which had been confirmed to nullify the covenant with [[Volcanica]], had the side effect of nullifying [[Divine Protection]]s.
*Roswaal was stabbed by [[Shasuke]] and died before Carol.
*Following the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon, the right to inherit House Mathers was given to Roswaal J. Mathers's son Karl Mathers, who was not old enough to become the family's head. He attended his mother's funeral with Clind.

===38-15 BA===
*Karl Mathers changed his name to Roswaal K. Mathers and became the head of House Mathers.
*The Mathers family became benefactors to Costuul with Roswaal's development of magicreation tools. As a result, the Mathers family's main mansion was moved to the vicinity of Costuul.

===15 BA===
*Roswaal K. Mathers suddenly dies. House Mathers is inherited by his son, Roswaal L. Mathers. A ceremony was held by [[Randohal Lugunica]] at the Royal Capital to commemorate the succession.
*A string of events occurs following the ceremony, beginning with Roswaal's golden plume being stolen by [[Belmont]], and culminating in him striking a deal with two groups in the Royal Capital, The Brotherhood and the Golden Wing Faction, to move their members to Costuul. He also befriends [[Russell Fellow]] and [[Marcos Gildark]].
*Roswaal meets [[Serena Dracroy]] and assists in the defeat of her attackers. He later helps her in defeating her father and taking over his territory.

===10-9 BA===
*[[Frederica Baumann|Frederica]] began working as a maid for Roswaal.
*[[Ram]] and [[Rem]]'s village was attacked by the [[Witch Cult]]. With the exception of the sisters, the Oni were all massacred. Roswaal took the sisters in, and they began to serve him as maids, learning from Clind and Frederica.
*Sometime after the attack on the Oni Village, the surviving Witch Cultists from the village attack proceeded to make assassination attempts on Ram and Rem, culminating in a battle at House Miload that killed [[Dudley Miload]] and gravely injured his wife, [[Grace Miload]]. Following the elimination of the Witch Cultists, Grace Miload died shortly after giving birth to her daughter, [[Annerose Miload]].
*Ram discovers that Roswaal had been aware of the Witch Cult's attacks and decided not to save those who were caught up in them. She continued to serve him despite knowing this.

===4 BA===
*By this point in time, Roswaal had received the color titles of Red, Yellow, and Green.

===10-9 months BA===
*Around a month before the Lugunican [[Royal Family]] perishes from their illness, Roswaal arrives at Elior Forest to meet Emilia, but he gets in a skirmish with Puck for a half day. Afterwards, Roswaal requests Emilia to join him and offers her a method of potentially unfreezing the citizens of the forest from the ice. 
*Emilia was initially brought to the Miload Manor and mistaken for a new maid by Annerose, becoming acquainted with Roswaal's relative, as well as Frederica and Clind, in the process. Roswaal arrived two days later, clearing up the misconception that had briefly led Emilia to become a maid, and the two of them travelled to his residence.

===Before 0 AA===
*With Roswaal as her sponsor, Emilia was recognized as a candidate for the Royal Selection.
*The majority of Roswaal's servants were released from his service, including Frederica.

===0 AA===
*Roswaal hired the Bowel Hunter, [[Elsa Granhiert]], to plunder Emilia's insignia while she and Ram visited the Royal Capital. She was [[Loot House Incident|assisted and saved]] by the newly summoned [[Natsuki Subaru]].
*After Subaru is brought back to [[Roswaal Manor]], he requested to begin working as a butler for Roswaal and was accepted into House Mathers.
*A [[Wolgarm Incident]], in which several children of the Mathers Domain were kidnapped by [[witchbeast]]s, was resolved through the combined work of Ram, Rem, and Subaru. This came at the expense of Subaru receiving copious [[Curse#Wolgarm Curse|Wolgarm curses]] from [[Witchbeast#Wolgam|Wolgarm]], prompting Rem to attempt to slay the Wolgarm who bit him. In the end, the Wolgarm were eradicated by Roswaal, who had just returned from a trip to the Sanctuary.

===2 months AA===
*Roswaal visited the Royal Selection Ceremony with Emilia and manipulated events in advance, knowing that Subaru would find a way to enter the ceremony and be accepted in by bearing the Mathers' hawk crest, to display [[Puck]] to the Council of Wise Men. A short time later, Subaru had an outburst at the ceremony, leading to him being separated from Emilia. Before Emilia and Roswaal left the Royal Capital, the latter informed Rem of a deal to negotiate the sale of magic crystal mining rights within Elior Forest to the [[Crusch Camp]]. Subaru learned this information from Rem and used it to successfully negotiate with [[Crusch Karsten|Crusch]].
*At the auxiliary mansion, the demand that Emilia and Crusch confer together is purportedly given to Ram by Roswaal.
*Subaru and Rem participate in the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]]. Once the [[White Whale]] was felled, Subaru proceeded to the Mathers Domain. Rem returned to the Royal Capital with Crusch due to the injuries she faced.
*When Arlam Village was under attack by [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]] and the cultists following him, half of the citizens are evacuated to the Royal Capital, and the other half are evacuated to the Sanctuary, as per Ram's proposal.
*Subaru defeats Petelgeuse once and for all and makes up with Emilia. However, around the same time, Rem and Crusch encounter [[Regulus Corneas]] and [[Lye Batenkaitos]]. The Sin Archbishop of Gluttony steals both of their memories and plunder's Rem's name, erasing her from the world.
*Subaru returns to the Royal Capital with Emilia, discovering that nobody besides him remembers Rem. Although the situation with the Crusch Camp is rocky with Ferris's proposal to call off their alliance, it is ultimately sustained in the face of Crusch's memory loss. Taking Rem with them, Subaru and Emilia return to Roswaal Manor in the Mathers Domain.
*[[Petra Leyte]] is hired into the mansion as a maid near this time, and Frederica, too, returns as a maid. Subaru, Emilia, and the merchant [[Otto Suwen]] briefly meet the two before travelling to the Sanctuary together.
*The ensuing [[Sanctuary Incident|incident]] at the Sanctuary had Subaru meet the spirit of Echidna within the Witch's Tomb and discover Roswaal's true intention to force him to choose between saving the mansion or the Sanctuary and his knowledge of Subaru's [[Natsuki Subaru#Abilities|time-rewinding Authority]]. Deciding to work against Roswaal after losing his qualification to continue speaking to Echidna, he trusted Otto and Ram with defeating [[Garfiel Tinzel]] and encouraged Emilia to retain hope and determination. He defeated Garfiel with [[Patrasche]]'s aid.
*Conversing with Roswaal again with Otto and Garfiel at his side, Subaru resolved himself to counter Roswaal's plan by leaving Emilia to conquer the Trials and Ram to confront her master. He took Otto and Garfiel to the mansion, where the two of them and Frederica contributed to defeating [[Meili Portroute]]'s [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]] and Elsa Granhiert. Ram and Puck engaged with Roswaal, reaching its finale when the copy of the Book of Wisdom he received from Echidna 400 years ago was scorched by flame. Emilia conquered the Trials of the Sanctuary and prepared to engage the [[Great Rabbit]] by her lonesome when Subaru and Beatrice arrived together as backup and, with her help, the duo sealed it in another dimension with Al Shamak.
*With Roswaal's plan overturned, he received an [[Curse#Oath Bound Curse Mark|oath bound curse mark]] as proof he could not go against his word anymore. As promised by Roswaal before, with the achievements of the Subjugation of the White Whale and the Subjugation of Sloth behind him, Subaru was appointed as Emilia's knight.

===1 year and 2 months AA===
*During the time Subaru, Emilia, Beatrice, Otto, and Garfiel are at [[Priestella]], Roswaal, Frederica, Clind, Annerose, and Petra visit the Western Margrave Domain Meeting.
*Three of the five who went to Priestella returned with [[Anastasia Hoshin]], [[Eridna]], and [[Julius Juukulius]] of the [[Anastasia Camp]] alongside them. They took Ram, Meili, and the sleeping Rem with them for their journey to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]].

===1 year and 6 months AA===
*The [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]] ends with Subaru and Rem's disappearance from the tower. The members of the Emilia Camp send a letter to Roswaal, who, upon receiving it, travels to the Miload Manor to request Clind transport everyone divided between the tower and Priestella to the Mathers Domain with [[Clind#Abilities|his Authority]]. They make a plan to covertly travel into the southern [[Vollachia Empire]], where the missing duo was sent to, and do so by entering Picoutatte and receiving a contact with the assistance of [[Diadora Regundra]], who made up with Otto.
*In the meantime, Clind took Annerose and Meili to the Royal Capital, where they had a discussion about pardoning the former assassin. [[Felt]] and [[Reinhard van Astrea]] of the [[Felt Camp]] joined the discussion midway, which prompted them to offer to take Meili to the Pleiades Watchtower with them.
*At some point, [[Sylphy Elmart]] and the other wives of Regulus were hired as maids for the manor by Annerose and were responsible for its care while everyone was away.
*Along the way, Roswaal's group encounter the molepeople of the Everlasting Darkness who are worried about Emilia's involvement in the Royal Selection leading to further consequences for demi-humans and plan to offer their lives as scapegoats who slaughtered the one that bears the same appearance as [[Satella|the Witch]], not realizing that their target was among the group they captured. Petra makes an oath with the molepeople's representative, [[Musica]], to allow them a chance to properly discuss their predicament with Emilia, taking on the same kind of curse mark Roswaal did as proof she would follow her promise through.
*Roswaal and Ram split up from the others who entered Vollachia to visit an old acquaintance of the former. The others were caught up in a conflict within the town of Mozotto involving [[Minor Characters#Jacques-Rosé Blau|a batperson]] who sought a "blood bride" and dealt with him. They heard news of "Natsumi Schwartz" from [[Guaral]] and travelled down there in hopes of locating Subaru and Rem.

===1 year and 7 months AA===
*Roswaal visited Serena with Ram. Once rumors of a black-haired crown prince spread to the Dracroy mansion, Ram took Serena hostage. After a prolonged discussion, Serena joined the rebel faction, and Roswaal and Ram were at her side.

===1 year and 8 months AA===
*Roswaal and the servants of House Mathers in Vollachia involve themselves with the rebel army in the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], and once the battle is stopped by the attack of the [[Undead#Zombies|zombies]] raised by Sphinx, they work to end the [[Great Disaster]], having finally reunited with Subaru and Rem.
*After the victory against the Great Disaster, Roswaal takes Frederica and [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] to the Barielle Domain to quell the unrest that would be caused by their [[Priscilla Barielle|lord]]’s death; Ram and Rem returned to Roswaal Manor; Emilia and Otto traveled to the Royal Capital to report on Priscilla’s death and the events in Vollachia; and Subaru, Garfiel, Petra, and Meili go the Pleiades Watchtower with [[Al]], where attempts and fails to [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|seal]] Subaru, who had used Return by Death and instead sealed him.
*Most of the Emilia Camp are brought to the Royal Capital, where they witnessed the upheaval brought about by the supposed death of [[Roy Alphard]], the healing of Crusch, and the rise of [[Filore]].
*Due to the apparent murder of [[Miklotov McMahon]], Emilia and Ram are brought to the castle and effectively isolated there while the rest of the camp escape the capital with the other camps as wanted fugitives.

==Trivia==
*Roswaal has a habit of sewing his family crest, the hawk, into things that he possesses.<ref>''“Fortuuunately, I do. I have looong been in the practice of marking that which is mine. My family crest should be sewed into the liiining~ of his uniform.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 3, Section 6.</ref> For example, he has embroidered the crest of the hawk into Subaru and Emilia's clothes.<ref>''Under her gaze, Subaru turned up the sleeve of his coat and saw that there was indeed something resembling an embroidered hawk in the lining.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 3, Section 6.</ref><ref>''When he immediately pulled the material away, he realized it was the white robe with an embroidered hawk that Emilia had been holding in her hands and that she had struck him with it.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 5, Section 6.</ref>
*In addition to being seen on the clothing of characters affiliated with the Emilia Camp, the hawk seems to appear on [[Fortuna]] and [[Archi Elior]]'s clothes.
*The birth name of Roswaal's original incarnation was '''Altair Mathers'''. [[Wikipedia:Altair|Altair]] is the name of the brightest star in the constellation of Aquila and the twelfth brightest star in the night sky. The name Altair is Arabic in origin and has the same meaning as the name of the constellation Aquila in Latin; that is, they both mean simply "eagle". The association between the Mathers family and the hawk may be a potential reference to Altair's name.
