Nine members of the Council of Ten killed}} The '''Battle for Priestella''' (プリステラ攻防戦) was a conflict that took place roughly one year and two months after [[Natsuki Subaru]]’s arrival into the world, and it was the primary conflict that took place in [[Arc 5]]. After [[Anastasia Hoshin]] invited the other Royal Candidates to [[Priestella]] in order to cultivate friendships and create alliances, the [[Witch Cult]] made its presence known in the city and held it hostage until their demands were met. The Witch Cult’s Sin Archbishops took command of City Hall and the four control towers with the help of their corpse soldiers and numerous [[Demi-Beast|demi-beasts]] that [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]] created from the citizens of the city that they had killed. They demanded the remains of a [[Typhon|Witch]] that rested somewhere within the city, an artificial spirit, the Book of Wisdom, and for [[Regulus Corneas]], not to interrupt the wedding between him and his [[Emilia|silver-haired bride]]. Not allowing them to do as they pleased, the [[Royal Selection]] candidates and their camps, including [[Priscilla Barielle]] and her [[Priscilla Camp|camp]] who arrived uninvited, moved into action. The fight ultimately resulted in a victory for the Royal Selection candidates, but the effects of this battle were the trigger for the events that followed over the next several months. ==Background== ===Birth of Priestella=== Four hundred years ago, Priestella was made by [[Alec Hoshin]] over a lake, and rumor had it that its intended purpose was to act as a trap to capture and kill something. This rumor turned out to be true, as the Witch of Pride met her end here, drowning in a “flood”. Afterward, her remains were left beneath the catacombs of Priestella, acting as an integral piece of the city. ===[[Permafrost of Elior Forest]]=== Approximately one century ago, the Sin Archbishop of Greed took part in the battle preceding the [[Permafrost of Elior Forest]]. His goal was simple: to find a suitable candidate to become his 79th wife. Though he found [[Fortuna]] to be suitable for this role, because of the actions of an [[Pandora|associate]] of the Witch Cult, he was removed from the battle, and Fortuna was killed, leaving the “79th wife” role vacant. ===Acquisition of the Corpse Soldiers=== Around fifteen years prior to the attack, the [[Great Conquest]], led by [[Theresia van Astrea]], took place in order to defeat the [[White Whale]]. However, having lost her Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, she was left severely weakened. Soon after, she witnessed the Witch of Vainglory. Though she decided that she was an enemy, Theresia met her end soon after raising her blade. More than a decade before Subaru's arrival, an item claimed to be made by a [[Witch]] was up for auction in [[Garkla]] in the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. As a result, Regulus was sent to search for something, and he killed the country’s strongest warrior, [[Kurgan]] during the attack. Their bodies would be retrieved by the Witch Cult and turned into corpse soldiers. ===The Artificial Spirit Echidna=== For over ten years, the Sin Archbishop of Lust had been in search of a certain [[Eridna|artificial spirit]] for reasons unknown. Said artificial spirit eventually found her way to Anastasia in her youth. With the two deciding to keep her existence a secret, Echidna remained with Anastasia for the next decade. ===[[Subjugation of the White Whale|The]] [[Subjugation of Sloth|Subjugations]]=== Two months after Subaru’s arrival, the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and the [[Subjugation of Sloth]] took place, resulting in the deaths of the White Whale and the [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]]. However, there were numerous other issues to contend with as well: Theresia’s [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Death God|Divine Protection of the Death God]] reappeared on [[Wilhelm van Astrea]]’s shoulder despite Theresia’s death; the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]] attacked the convoy returning to the [[Royal Capital]], resulting in [[Rem]] being left in the Sleeping Beauty state and [[Crusch Karsten]] being left without her memories; and Subaru had taken the Witch Factor of Sloth for himself. This likewise affected Capella, who began to panic and was betrayed by of her Beloved Children, and she began to plot a way to keep the [[Six Tongues]] off of her trail. ===[[Sanctuary Incident]]=== A few days later, the [[Emilia Camp]] went through their own [[Sanctuary Incident|struggles]] in the [[Sanctuary|Sanctuary of Kremaldy]], where they were forced to fight through numerous trials. Because of this event, [[Puck]] was left in a deep slumber, unable to form with the weak glintstone being used as his anchor, and the two Books of Wisdom belonging to [[Beatrice]] and [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] were burned, the former’s to ash alongside [[Roswaal Manor]]. However, [[Otto Suwen]] managed to find Roswaal’s burnt Book, and believing he’d be able to determine Roswaal’s plans, he decided that he would eventually take the book to be recovered in secret to [[Dartz]]. ===Invitation=== One year after the Royal Selection’s beginning, Anastasia invited the other camps, save for Priscilla’s, to Priestella in order to cultivate friendships and forge alliances, using the location of Gluttony and a special glintstone to lure in two of them. The day after they arrived, Priscilla had brought her camp into the city as well, causing conflict for her own amusement. ==Battle== ===The Witch Cult Arrives=== [[Joshua Juukulius]] made his way towards one of the control towers to receive a letter for Anastasia. However, along the way, he encountered Lye Batenkaitos. Shortly after, he had his name and memories devoured. Meanwhile, Otto Suwen, who had been on his way to meet with Dartz, a restoration magic user, witnessed the other Sin Archbishop of Gluttony at the second district’s tower, and he watched as the boy slaughtered everyone there protecting it. With this knowledge, Otto left the area. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 16 3.png|thumb|right|250px|Sirius makes her appearance.]] Meanwhile, Subaru, who was at first accompanied by Beatrice, Emilia, Priscilla, and [[Liliana Masquerade]], encountered [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]], who had gathered an audience, gave a speech about love, and used her Authority of Wrath to connect everyone together before tossing a [[Lusbel Kallard|boy]] off the roof of a time tower, resulting in the deaths of many, including Subaru. After his Authority triggered, he eventually went to confront her with both Beatrice and Emilia. Though they could have tried to summon [[Reinhard van Astrea]] through [[Rachins Hoffman]], who happened to be in the vicinity they were heading, they could not make such a risk, else Beatrice would be left helpless, and people could still end up hurt or dead, as Subaru had once experienced. The battle began with Emilia firing an ice pillar at Sirius, which garnered her rage. As Emilia brandished her newfound Ice Brand Arts against Sirius’s chains and flames, Subaru and Beatrice attempted to sever Wrath’s Authority from the people. This failed, however, when Beatrice learned how fundamentally different it was from her preconceived conjecture. Deciding to put severing the connection on hold, the two fended off the nearby enraged citizens until they could reach and save Lusbel in the time tower. And though they succeeded in this regard and had him run away, Emilia was defeated after Sirius summoned a [[Tina|hostage]] to catch her off guard. Soon after arrived Regulus, who saved and protected Emilia from Sirius. However, since Regulus's goal was to take her as his bride, Subaru attempted to fight him. Outmatched, Subaru tried to use his Invisible Providence, which had a different effect than intended: Sirius’s attention and love was directed at him, as she confused him for the late Sin Archbishop of Sloth. This distraction ultimately saved Subaru’s and the citizens’ lives as it wasted the Sin Archbishops’ time and forced them to retreat. However, as the two left with the unconscious Emilia, Regulus kicked a tile straight through Subaru’s thigh, nearly severing it. This resulted in the injury reflecting onto the nearby citizens who were connected to him, and a desperate Beatrice used what magic she could to save all of their lives. Soon after, Lusbel returned with [[Al]], and they were able to bring the injured to a shelter. Meanwhile, [[Garfiel Tinzel]] and [[Mimi Pearlbaton]], who had just left the company of [[Reala Thompson]], heard the voice of Capella over a city-wide broadcast, who stated that the Witch Cult had taken over the city, mocked everyone, demanded to be handed the remains of a Witch that resided somewhere in the city, and that nobody should fight back. Not willing to take this lying down, Garfiel and Mimi went to confront the Witch Cult, leading them into a fight with the corpse soldiers of the War God and previous Sword Saint. Unfortunately, the two were outmatched and forced to retreat. That said, Mimi took a nearly lethal blow from Theresia, and Garfiel rushed in the direction of Subaru’s scent as fast as he could. Having heard the same announcement, [[Heinkel Astrea]] held [[Felt]] hostage in order to force his son to remain where he was and protect him, forcing Reinhard to sit out of the majority of the battle. ===Recovery of City Hall=== When Subaru woke up, he found himself in the Muse Company, which [[Kiritaka Muse]] had decided to make a temporary headquarters for the resistance, and he saw Al and [[Ferris]] nearby. Al had managed to have people brought somewhere safe to be healed, and Ferris had been busy using his skills to heal others. Fortunately, thanks to the efforts of Subaru and the now unconscious Beatrice, the lives of the people in the square were saved. Despite being worried about Beatrice, Subaru went upstairs with the other two to speak with the other camps’ members. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 17 9.png|thumb|left|180x|Garfiel arrives with the injured Mimi.]] In the meeting room, Subaru noticed the various members of the [[Anastasia Camp]] and [[Crusch Camp]], but besides them, other camps’ members were scattered across the city. With the meeting started, Subaru was caught up to speed, and he then informed the others that the Sin Archbishops of Greed and Wrath had infiltrated the city. Meanwhile, the others had also mentioned the presence of the Sin Archbishop of Lust in the city, with her having made a broadcast demanding a Witch’s remains, which Al seemed to recognize quickly. After this, Lust began another broadcast, the group was contacted by [[Hetaro Pearlbaton]] and [[Tivey Pearlbaton]] to warn them that their sister was hurt, and Garfiel entered the room with a heavily injured Mimi. With Ferris taking Mimi, whose wound would not close, downstairs, the others continued to listen to the broadcast, during which Capella gave three more demands in recompense for fighting back against the Witch Cult: an artificial spirit, the Book of Wisdom, and to not interrupt Greed’s wedding. Once everyone noticed the strange sound of buzzing in the background, Capella mocked them for only just noticing and cut off the broadcast. Ferris soon returned to the room, having stalled the wound’s progression with surgery and the help of Mimi’s brothers utilizing their Divine Protection. Deciding they needed to recover the City Hall as quickly as possible, a team composed of Subaru, who had his leg’s sense of pain nullified by Ferris, [[Julius Juukulius]], Crusch, Wilhelm, [[Ricardo Welkin]], and Garfiel was made to complete the task. After Al warned them not to speak their names in front of Gluttony, who may also make an appearance, they soon took their leave. Meanwhile, Al also took his leave, deciding to take on a separate task elsewhere in the city. As the team marched on towards City Hall, they realized the bodies of those who died in front of the building were all completely missing. Instead, they came across the Witch Cultists that Garfiel and Mimi had fought before. After the battle began, the melee fighters distracted them while the ranged fighters tried to attack their blind spots. However, Lust, who was transformed into a dragon, made her appearance. Despite her mocking, Subaru decided to distract her by mocking her back, buying enough time for Julius to attack her with a full powered Al Clauzeria to the face, though she quickly healed. After Crusch jumped to move Subaru out of the way from her black dragon breath, which Ricardo managed to counter, Capella hid away inside the building. Wilhelm, Garfiel, and Ricardo decided to hold off the Cultists while allowing the other three to raid the building. Taking them up on the offer, they charged forth. After Julius used Spiritual Arts to make everyone lighter, Subaru picked up Crusch, and he and Julius jumped to the top of the building, where they encountered [[Roy Alphard]]. After a short fight with him, Julius, whom Roy seemed to recognize, decided to hold him off alone so that Subaru and Crusch could go on ahead. After that, Subaru picked up Crusch again, and after using his whip to latch onto the building, they busted through a window and entered. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 17 13.png|thumb|right|180x|Capella defeats Crusch.]] When they entered the broadcasting room, they encountered the [[Garek Thompson|dragon]] with its foot atop a girl. As Subaru got the girl out of harm’s way, Crusch quickly attacked the dragon, knocking it out of the building and forcing it to fall to the ground. As Crusch kept an eye on the dragon, Subaru found the other building staff all transformed into giant flies. Then, as they were both distracted, the girl revealed herself to be the real Sin Archbishop of Lust, knocked out Crusch, and confronted Subaru. She assaulted him while using her Authority of Lust, spouting out her beliefs about what love is, and eventually severed his leg from his body. With Subaru defeated, Capella decided to use her cursed Dragon’s blood on Subaru and Crusch. After this, however, the dragon appeared and grabbed Crusch and Subaru and attempted to fly away. Capella tried to prevent this, but instead, the nearby water gate was opened briefly, allowing for a large amount of water to flood the streets, distracting her long enough to force her to let go of the dragon. As the people below were washed away, the unconscious Subaru fell into the water. ===Attack on the Muse Company=== After the assault team left, Anastasia hung back with Kiritaka and the members of the [[White Dragon's Scales]] that were there. Anastasia decided to have the injured patients moved to nearby shelters in case they were attacked, and having believed the same, Kiritaka had already ordered for them to be moved beforehand. Soon after, Sirius burst through the door, using her chains to attack everyone in the room. Fortunately, everyone managed to dodge the attack, and soon, Hetaro and Tivey jumped into the fray. Though injured, they resolved to fend off Sirius alongside the White Dragon's Scales and Kiritaka to buy time for Anastasia to escape. Angry at being forced to retreat, she ultimately escaped and headed towards the direction of City Hall. ===Preparing for a Counterattack=== After Subaru woke up, he realized he had been saved by Priscilla and Liliana, who had been traveling together and noticed him floating in the water. Similarly, he also noticed that his leg had healed, though now it was black, and thanks to Priscilla’s test, he realized his leg had the ability to heal. As they spoke, they were attacked by a new type of monster created by Lust, which Priscilla had dubbed a demi-beast, as it was neither dead nor alive, and neither human nor beast, killing it with her [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]]. The group then walked to a nearby shelter together, where Subaru realized the people, including himself, were under the effects of the Authority of Wrath, and thanks to Liliana’s song, its effects were reduced. Priscilla, in her search for her butler [[Schult Barielle|Schult]], had been going from shelter to shelter with Liliana and having her do the same for them as she had done for this shelter. The two split up immediately after this. Meanwhile, Emilia had woken up and spoken with Regulus, who had decided to take her as his bride as a replacement for Number 79, being met by another one of his wives, [[Sylphy Elmart|Number 184]], after he left. At first, Emilia tried to talk things out with him and glean answers from him, but after seeing a bout of his rage nearly kill Number 184, who she jumped at to push out of the way, she realized he could not be reasoned with. Instead, she decided to sneak around the chapel while Regulus wasn’t looking to gather information, where she overheard his conversation with Lust over a contact mirror. After he left, she grabbed ahold of it and tried to use it, successfully managing to contact Al and giving him the location of both Regulus and Capella to pass on to Subaru. With her mission complete, she returned to the room she was made to use to prepare for the fight to come. Around this time, Otto had managed to discover the situation surrounding Felt, and by distracting Heinkel, Felt and Reinhard managed to defeat him and tie him up. After leaving him in a nearby shelter, Reinhard left with Otto for City Hall. Felt, who was asked to stay behind and watch Heinkel, soon left, deciding to also fight back. As Subaru was trying to make his way back to the Muse Company, he ended up surrounded by demi-beasts, though Julius managed to find and save him. Afterwards, he led Subaru not to the Muse Company but to City Hall, which had been abandoned by the Witch Cult after the flash flood. There, he recognized that everyone was also affected by the Authority of Wrath and acting far more emotional. He also learned that Crusch was cursed and was asked not to look at her for the time being, as what he’d see would greatly upset him. Having learned of Subaru’s arrival, Anastasia spoke to Subaru in private, where he informed her of the current situation around the city and that Beatrice was an artificial spirit and likely the target of the Witch Cult, even going as far as to say that keeping secrets would just help the enemy. Anastasia also informed him of the attack on the Muse Company, and she relayed that Kiritaka and the others had gone missing, not to mention that the other members of the Council of Ten were dead. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 18 8.png|thumb|left|180x|Subaru speaks to the citizens of Priestella.]] The two resolved themselves to take back the city from the Witch Cult, and then they made for the broadcasting room, intending to use it to take advantage of Sirius’s Authority and boost the morale of the citizens to keep them from tearing out each other’s throats. When Julius happened upon them, Anastasia attempted to snap Julius out of his stupor, saying that Subaru was willing to do what it takes to win. After Subaru learned that the broadcasting meteor was still working, however, he corrected her by saying they would not sacrifice the citizens for a victory, as that would make them just as bad as the Witch Cult. Then, Garfiel and Al also appeared, and Al passed along Emilia’s message. Afterward, they decided that someone needed to speak to the citizens, though when it was decided that Subaru should be the one to speak, as he had already fought and defeated the Witch Cult once before, as well as two of the Three Great Demon Beasts, he was unsure of what to do. This led to an argument by Al in a way to keep Subaru from taking on the burden of being a hero, but this resulted in Subaru deciding to give the speech, which boosted everyone’s morale to a much higher degree than expected and even reached the ears of Emilia, who was encouraged by her knight. After the speech, Otto and Reinhard, as well as Priscilla and Schult appeared. Though frustrated by Reinhard’s absence, thanks to Subaru, they accepted that he was there and gave them pieces of their mind. Meanwhile, he spoke with Otto about the Book of Wisdom, which he had brought with him to be prepared for whatever Roswaal might have planned, having lost any semblance of trust in the man after the events at the Sanctuary. After this, Wilhelm was requested by Crusch to bring Subaru to her. On the way, they discussed the presence of his wife as a corpse soldier and the connection to a certain [[Sphinx|Witch]] that appeared during the [[Demi-Human War]]. After Wilhelm asked Subaru not to tell Reinhard, Subaru met with Crusch, who he saw had the same curse as himself, which left her bedridden, and Ferris, who was emotionally unstable, was unable to heal her. Having heard Crusch’s worry for him, he attempted to hold her hand, which resulted in the discovery that he could transfer her curse to himself. However, she requested that he not do so yet, as they wouldn’t know what would happen if he did so, and the people needed him more than herself anyway. Crusch then requested he reassure her like he did for the city, and when he obliged, she passed out, and Subaru had Ferris prepare himself to heal more of the injured. When Subaru returned upstairs, discussions of a counterattack continued. Having learned of the locations of Lust and Greed from Emilia and Gluttony from Otto, they deduced Wrath’s location, and Subaru decided the teams. Priscilla and Liliana, who was discovered to have a Divine Protection, would face off against Wrath; Reinhard and Subaru would go to confront Greed; Wilhelm and Garfiel would confront Lust and the corpse soldiers; Julius and Ricardo would confront Gluttony; Otto would retrieve the Book of Wisdom by himself; and Anastasia and Al would remain behind as home defense. ===The Crusade Against Greed=== At the chapel, Emilia and Regulus began the marriage ceremony, attended by all of Regulus’s wives, including Number 184. When Regulus began making his demands for after they were wed, Emilia rejected them while claiming she would not be happy, as well as saying that she already knew who she would love. Subaru and Reinhard soon arrived, with the latter kicking the door off its hinges into the newly enraged Regulus. This triggered Emilia to try and freeze Regulus, but he casually broke out of the ice and held her by the throat. Regulus then recognized Subaru and spoke with Reinhard, mocking him while holding his wives hostage. Stating that he would let them go if Reinhard withstood one of his attacks, Reinhard accepted and was killed by Regulus. Despite this, Reinhard revived, and when Emilia created a weapon and tossed it to him, Reinhard struck Regulus down. This was short-lived, however, as Regulus survived the attack completely untouched. Reinhard went to confront him with another ice sword that Emilia made. With Emilia and Subaru unable to convince the wives to run away, they also went to fight. Though Regulus was clearly unskilled in martial arts, he took no damage at all from the Sword Saint, and everything he threw left devastating damage to the surroundings, even grasping a massive amount of water and practically creating a tsunami against him. Eventually, he even stopped reacting to the attacks completely. With Subaru’s various strategies failing, which also included Regulus’s own attacks against him, Regulus, who was endlessly enraged by Reinhard, who had monstrous strength yet was unable to draw his sword against his “unworthy” foe, eventually managed destroy Reinhard’s leg and send him flying away at tremendous speed. Subaru and Emilia ran away from the man, freezing the river that he was walking on and Emilia, who realized her hatred for the man, threw numerous other attacks at him, though they all failed. Eventually, Reinhard returned and confronted Regulus again, completely healed. As the unstoppable force and immovable object clashed, Subaru asked Emilia for anything she noticed about Regulus, and with the information he was given, he pieced together that Greed’s name and power correlated. After Reinhard checked for Greed’s heartbeat, Subaru’s suspicions were confirmed, and Regulus, in his frustration, threw Reinhard upward while applying his power to him. With the Sword Saint gone, Subaru told Emilia about Regulus’s power and told her where his weakness was, and he had her leave to handle it, though she left him with a spirit to help him. As Subaru taunted Regulus, he began running around the city, doing his best to lead his enemy in directions away from the shelters. Realizing how simple of a man Regulus was, Subaru managed to easily escape damage, as while he was fast, he was linear, and he was very weak to simple traps like pitfalls. As he led the Sin Archbishop around by the nose, Emilia confronted the wives again, and after getting through to everyone, including Number 184, who introduced herself as Sylphy, they realized that Regulus’s heart was literally within them. In order to prevent them from killing themselves while also ridding them of his heart, Emilia froze everyone in the chapel, and then she found her way to Subaru and Regulus. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 19 12.png|thumb|right|180x|Regulus defeated.]] With Regulus enraged yet not weakened, Subaru realized his heart was within Emilia, and he used Invisible Providence to crush it. With Regulus being susceptible to damage again, Emilia pummeled him with all of her strength and her ice, severely damaging him. As a way to try and survive and kill them, Regulus challenged Subaru, a knight, to a duel. However, Reinhard, who kicked himself off of the moon and returned to the ground, accepted the duel in his stead. As Regulus tried to back out of it, Reinhard promptly beat him into the sky and into the ground. Unable to use his power properly, Regulus took endless damage from the fall and the water that came to drown him. With the victory against Greed, Emilia unfroze the wives, and Reinhard left to fight on another battlefield. Meanwhile, the Sin Archbishop’s Witch Factor found its way to Subaru, confirming his death. ===The Sun Princess and the Songstress versus Wrath=== Heading to the second district was Priscilla and Liliana, where they encountered Sirius and an army of bewitched people, which included the missing Kiritaka. Sirius started spouting her beliefs to Priscilla, yet she did not care for Sirius’s views, showing off her immense pride and clearly remaining unaffected by her enemy’s power. However, with Liliana freaking out while also being affected by the Authority of Wrath, Priscilla kissed her to snap her out of it, and then she stepped forward. Drawing her Yang Sword, Priscilla challenged Wrath, leading her to draw out her chains and flames. Priscilla was easily able to handle the flames, and she showed clear mastery of her sword while clashing with her enemy. However, Sirius was able to find an opening and strike back at the Sun Princess. Having taken a serious hit, one of Priscilla’s beloved articles shattered from the damage transfer. Priscilla and Sirius continued their clash. However, with the people still underneath the effects of Wrath’s Authority, Priscilla demanded the bard to play her songs and shatter their illusions. This led to Liliana proceeding up the nearby control tower, which Sirius set ablaze. Reaching the top, Liliana was able to play her music, and her song managed to free the masses. Soon the tower collapsed, and Liliana landed somewhere beneath the rubble. Angry with Liliana’s and Priscilla’s interference, she summoned a massive flaming snake to try and fend off Priscilla, but this failed. She then resorted to using her previous hostage when Priscilla moved in to attack. However, this also failed, as Priscilla was able to use her blade to pass through Tina and slash at Sirius. Then, Priscilla landed one last attack on the Sin Archbishop, sending her flying unconscious into the waterways. Defeated, Sirius was then captured and tied in her own chains. ===The Finest and the Hound versus Bizarre Eating=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 19 1.png|thumb|left|250px|Julius and Ricardo encounter Roy.]] Having been directed towards the second district, Julius and Ricardo dashed as quickly as they could to confront the Sin Archbishop who commanded it. However, Ricardo noticed Julius’s confused expression and asked him what he was thinking, to which Julius states his unease about the words of Roy, who spoke to Julius as if he knew him beforehand. Soon, they encountered Roy, who expressed joy at meeting Julius and Ricardo. Understanding what Julius said, he prepared to fight. After Roy began speaking of fond memories and feelings with Julius, he pounced at his opponents. It didn’t take long for Roy to outmatch Ricardo and Julius, using his refined skills in martial arts, magic, and weapons mastery to get the jump on them. Neither of them could land a hit on Roy, and soon, the Sin Archbishop attacked them one more time. Guarding Julius, Ricardo lost his arm, and soon after, Julius had his name devoured. ===The Battle Against Gourmet=== As Otto snuck around the city on his way to retrieve the Book of Wisdom, he came across Felt, [[Gaston]], [[Dynas Trussardi]], and members of the White Dragon's Scales, who were confronting an unexpected opponent: one of the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony, Lye Batenkaitos. Having been noticed, Lye turned his attention to Otto, and he asked to be led to Subaru, who he was claiming to be his hero who was meant to bring an end to him. Remembering that he was with the Sword Saint, Otto attempted negotiations, to the confusion of the others nearby, in order to lead Lye to Subaru and Reinhard. However, negotiations broke down when Lye saw pity in Otto’s eyes, and as he prepared to attack, Otto summoned water dragons to attack the Sin Archbishop. This attack bought enough time for the group to regain their bearings to fight against Lye, who had promptly slaughtered the water dragons. Realizing that a certain weapon would be effective against Lye, Felt left the area to retrieve it. Afterward, Dynas led his men to attack Lye. Gaston even managed to break one of Lye’s blades with his body via the Flow Method. After playing around with them, Lye devoured the names of those he knew, placing them in the Sleeping Beauty state and erasing their existences. Realizing what was happening, Otto warned them not to mention his name, and soon after, he attempted to tackle Lye, using the fire magic stones sewn into his clothing to damage him. Unfortunately, Lye escaped the blast practically unscathed. Soon, Beatrice arrived and attacked Lye, using the power of certain magic stones that were lent to her from the Muse Company. Though Otto was grateful to Beatrice for arriving despite her wanting to have gone to Subaru’s side, Lye expressed genuine shock that she left the Forbidden Library, even calling her name as if he knew her. Beatrice quickly recognized that he had many souls amassed in his body, and when Lye introduced himself as Rem, both Otto and Beatrice were enraged, deciding that Subaru should not be allowed to meet with Lye. Beatrice used several powerful magics against Lye, including Ul Minya, while the people nearby continued to assault him. Unfortunately, Lye managed to continuously evade their attacks, and he managed to defeat several of them including Gaston. Soon, Felt arrived while holding onto the meteor staff that belonged to the Witch of Greed, [[Echidna]]. Since she didn’t know how to properly use it, Felt was left wide open for Lye to try to devour her name. However, this failed, causing severe backlash against him, and when Gaston grabbed his foot, this allowed Beatrice to use the meteor staff with Felt to defeat Lye. Their victory was short lived, however, when Lye vanished, and in his place a strange man appeared, gouging out the fronts of Otto’s legs. After some teasing, the man turned into a young girl who introduced herself as the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, [[Rui Arneb]], and she revealed to Felt that her name was not the one she was born with. With everyone unable to fight, Rui decided to take her leave with her brother in tow. ===The Ambush at City Hall=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 19 13.png|thumb|right|180x|Al confronts Capella.]] After everyone left for battle, Anastasia had everyone that was injured moved to one of the nearby shelters. Afterward, she decided to pose as the cursed Crusch with Ferris by her side, expecting someone to attack them. This foresight proved accurate as Capella had made her way into the building. Believing that Anastasia was Crusch, she teased and mocked Ferris who was holding a sword against her, even transforming into Crusch’s image in an effort to mentally damage Ferris by making him stab her. After enough teasing, she pinned Ferris to the wall, though this was a mistake as Ferris used his magic to make her arm wither, and Anastasia used hers to strike Capella and make her fall through the floor, where Al was waiting to confront the Sin Archbishop of Lust. As Ferris and Anastasia escaped City Hall, Capella expressed her intrigue of Al, teasing him in a similar manner to Ferris by slowly transforming into Priscilla. However, the two still clashed, with Al managing to avoid everything she threw at him and even recognizing that her blood was not the same cursed poison she used before. Eventually, realizing he wouldn’t be able to defeat her as they were terribly incompatible, he triggered the explosion of the pillars beneath City Hall, causing it to collapse on Lust while her escaped the catacombs. When Al resurfaced outside the destroyed City Hall, he met with Ferris and Anastasia, who were talking about their trump cards. This, however, led to Al suspecting that “Anastasia” was not Anastasia, as she couldn’t use magic, and he held his sword at her throat. Ferris was forced to calm him down, and immediately after, Lust appeared, completely unharmed. Deciding to retreat after bringing out her Gospel, she set her demi-beasts on the group, forcing them to run away as she cackled and retreated. ===Bout Between Tiger and God=== Soon after arriving at the first district’s tower, Garfiel and Wilhelm encountered numerous monstrosities that seemed to be large blobs of meat. Despite being caught off guard, the two were quickly drawn into battle against their respective opponents: Garfiel to Kurgan and Wilhelm to Theresia. After Wilhelm knocked the hood off of Theresia’s head, Garfiel was ambushed by the meat blobs and was dragged away from the area, with Kurgan following after him. Their fight dragged out across the district, with Garfiel combining his partial beastification, shields, and Divine Protection to defend against Kurgan’s eight arms. Unlike last time, Kurgan even drew out all of his Demon Cleavers, believing Garfiel to be a worthy opponent. That said, Garfiel remained mostly on the losing side, having taken severe beatings repeatedly from the War God and using his Divine Protection to heal himself. Eventually, their fight was dragged into the water, where Garfiel was at a severe disadvantage. Not allowing his opponent to die of drowning, Kurgan punched a hole into a nearby building, allowing the two of them to fight on the ground again. The building they found themselves in was one of the shelters, filled with numerous citizens. Despite the audience, Kurgan prepared himself to fight Garfiel again. With his family and all the nearby bystanders cheering him on, Garfiel utilized his beastification and clashed with Kurgan again. Though Garfiel still took damage, he successfully managed to shatter one of the Demon Cleavers, and after withstanding a pounding, he managed to bite out Kurgan’s throat. Calling the fight magnificent, Kurgan faded into dust, and Garfiel was left lying on the ground. With the fight over, his younger [[Fred Thompson|brother]] and [[Rafiel Thompson|sister]] came over and helped him speak into his conversation mirror. ===Sword Dance of the Demon and Saint=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 20 2.png|thumb|left|250px|Reinhard appears to defeat Theresia.]] Separated from Garfiel, Wilhelm continued to fight Theresia, in a dance reminiscent to the one they had in their youth. Naturally, the Sword Demon struggled against his wife, the Sword Saint. He was eventually able to take the upper hand against her, and he nearly brought her down. However, when Heinkel appeared and recognized his mother, she slashed her distracted husband, and she ran to attack her son. Her attack was able to be prevented by the arrival of her grandson, the current Sword Saint. Then, with a swing of the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]], he cut her down. With her defeat, Theresia and Wilhelm shared their final moments together, and she turned to ash in Wilhelm’s arms. Unfortunately, this death wreaked havoc on the relationships of the three Astrea men, and they all decided to leave the area. ==Aftermath== With the fight over, Subaru, Emilia, Sylphy, and the wives made their way to City Hall, only to find rubble. However, thanks to Liliana playing her music for the crowd that had gathered, she was able to soothe everyone who had been afflicted with Sirius’s Authority. Anastasia soon made her appearance and led Subaru and Emilia to the shelter that they were using. There, they discovered that Mimi and Garfiel, who were previously heavily injured, managed to recover to proper form. Though they’d need more time to rest. Otto’s legs were also damaged during the fight. After meeting with the other members of their camp, Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice went to visit Sirius, who was guarded by Al. There, they learned that the Witch Cult is not completely aligned in its goals, and in fact, the Sin Archbishops did not care whether the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] was revived, nor did they care about whether their comrades survived or not. As Subaru decided to leave, Sirius realized that he was not Petelgeuse, though she did say for him to keep his body intact for the day that his spirit resurges within him, warning him to make sure to kill the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 20 11.png|thumb|right|180x|Julius was forgotten.]] Shortly after, Subaru happened upon Wilhelm, who received few injuries, and he carried the remains of his wife, wishing to give her a proper burial. Subaru asked to come see her grave when it was ready, which Wilhelm agreed to. However, Subaru soon noticed Julius hanging around outside the shelter, and he chased after him. Here, it was revealed that Julius’s name was devoured, and Subaru was the only one who could remember him. In the meeting that followed, it was revealed that the people who were transformed by Capella could not be returned to normal through healing. Similarly, there were many people who had lost their names and memories, such as Julius’s brother Joshua, who was among the forgotten. Meanwhile, Crusch also remained cursed, though because Subaru knew he could do something about it if there was no other solution, she wasn’t as bad off. With Emilia deciding to put Lust’s victims into cryostasis until they could be reverted back, Felt and Reinhard took responsibility for escorting Sirius to the Royal Capital’s Prison Tower, and Anastasia made the offer to travel to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], where they could meet the Sage known as [[Shaula]] and potentially learn of a way to fix Lust and Gluttony’s victims. The incident and the numerous victims claimed by it would later push the [[Divine Dragon Church]] into action. Meanwhile, Regulus's victims, Sylphy and the rest of his wives, were later hired by [[Annerose Miload]] to work as maids for Roswaal Manor. Shortly after, Subaru confronted “Anastasia” while Reinhard waited outside the door. Realizing that the girl in front of him was someone else, he questioned her, and she revealed herself to be Echidna, an artificial spirit, the one the Witch Cult was most likely targeting. Her name and attitude set him off, but she was able to calm him down while explaining her reason for suggesting going to the watchtower. Having switched places with Anastasia before the fight’s conclusion, she was unable to return it to its original owner, and the Sage was her best chance of finding a way to give it back. Because of this, she and Julius would be tagging along with the Emilia Camp on their expedition to the Watchtower. With Subaru deciding to take his leave, he thanked Reinhard and asked him to keep what he heard a secret. Reinhard told him to be careful on this expedition, as even he could not make it to the tower. Months after this, Sirius's recognition of Subaru's use of the Authority of Sloth and belief that Petelgeuse had slipped into his body, Subaru once again being involved in a stand against the Witch Cult, his trait of being able to recall Gluttony victims, and his lack of backlash from Capella's curse would serve to levy further suspicions on Subaru that would result in the accusations that he potentially held connections to the Witch Cult in a manner to a Sin Archbishop or was possessed by Petelgeuse. Meanwhile, the knowledge of Capella's Authority allowed the Six Tongues to uncover her identity as the leader of the Beloved Children. However, this was entirely to Capella’s plan, as, because she purposefully put her name and face out for other to see, she could use fakes to distract the Six Tongues while she silently made her moves. ==Trivia== *Originally, in the shop special release of [[Joshua Juukulius's Careful Second Encyclopedia]], at the commencement of the battle, Roy was the one who devoured Joshua's name and memories, but the illustration in the release incorrectly depicted his brother Lye instead. In [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 11|Tanpenshuu Volume 11]], this was remedied by having the story rewritten to feature Lye rather than Roy. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Priestella]] [[Category:Terminology]]

Numerous undead vanquished
Numerous undead scattered |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Conquest of the Undead Capital''' (屍都攻略) is the largest battle that took place during the [[Great Disaster]], taking place during the latter half of [[Arc 8]]. Set roughly one year and eight months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, the battle that took place here was the battle that would decide the fate of [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. With the [[Witch]], [[Sphinx]], setting out to complete the crux of her plan, she tormented Vollachia and the destroyed [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]] while intending to attack the mind of [[Priscilla Barielle]], the target of her revenge. Meanwhile, a specialized task force was created in the [[Garkla|Fortified City of Garkla]] to counter and defeat the Witch and crush her schemes. Fighting alongside the warriors who were paving a path into the city, major clashes occurred beyond every bastion, and even within the [[Lupugana#Locations|Crystal Palace]] itself. The Conquest ultimately ended with the victory of the task force, and in turn, they managed to quell the Great Disaster. However, among the losses were one of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]], [[Moguro Hagane]], as well as Priscilla herself, who had given her life to fight as one of the zombies against Sphinx. ==Background== Having weathered through the attack on the coupled dragon carriages by [[Lamia Godwin]] and her Pruning Corps, the retreating team arrived in Garkla, where [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent]] discovered that the [[Muspel|Stone]] was likely in the hands of their enemy. With this revelation, the members of the [[Emilia Camp]], the [[Anastasia Camp]], and the [[Imperial Army]] created a specialized unit with only one goal: invade the undead-controlled Lupugana, and completely end the country-spanning Sacrament of the Immortal King. Leaving Garkla in the hands of [[Goz Ralfon]] and several other notable figures, the “Rescue the Vollachia Empire from Destruction Squad” left for the Imperial Capital. Meanwhile in the capital, [[Al]] and [[Cecilus Segmunt]], who had teamed up while wandering the vicinity of the city, came across numerous undead, including [[Balleroy Temeglyph]] and [[Viva]], and before long, they joined together with [[Heinkel Astrea]], [[Rowan Segmunt]], and [[Groovy Gumlet]], who had previously joined together in a bar some distance away from the capital. Deciding to create way for the eventually coming specialized unit, Al set plans in motion to allow for the coming invasion. ==Battle== ===Confronting the King of Thorns=== After seeing off Rowan and Heinkel Astrea, Al, accompanied by Groovy and Cecilus, made their way beyond the fourth bastion, using a werewolf cloak to cover themselves with the Divine Protection of Ambushing. However, despite this cover, the three were suddenly stricken with the Curse of Thorns, causing them intense pain until they moved away. Realizing that the curse would get in the way and that Cecilus needed to recover his prized swords, the three split up, with Groovy heading out to take care of the one casting the curse. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 36 11.png|thumb|right|180x|Groovy confronts the Emperor of the Briar.]] After splitting up, Groovy used one of his poison daggers on himself to numb his sense of pain and keep fighting regardless of the curse. Eventually, he managed to find his way to the one casting the curse: [[Eugard Vollachia]], Emperor of the Briar, wielding both the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] and the [[Enchanted Sword#Fiend Sword Murasame|Fiend Sword]]. Cursing his luck, the two introduced themselves and entered battle. With his kusarigama out, he unleashed several attacks against the emperor, though they failed, and he unleashed the explosive weighted ball on him, attempting to catch him with the blast. As an undead, however, Eugard quickly recovered. Simultaneously, Eugard had been unleashing long range attacks with the Fiend Sword and the Yang Sword. Though the Yang Sword’s attacks failed to reach Groovy, several attacks from the Fiend Sword managed to strike him. At a stalemate, Groovy drew his blood hatchets and attacked Eugard. Despite the attack being blocked, the vibrations from the hatchets still managed to cause damage to Eugard, and Groovy backed away. With his blood on Eugard, Groovy tossed his hatchets, causing them to begin tracking Eugard, even after being deflected. To put on further pressure, he brought out even more hatchets and threw them, entering a long range fight. The hatchets managed to hit Eugard, but he still managed to recover. Soon, Groovy attempted to use a sonic scream against the man, though the Fiend Sword damaged his throat and destroyed the “point” of his sonic magic crystal. Damaged heavily, Groovy was on his knees, unable to move. Similarly, he was still suffering from the poison still in his system. With Eugard praising his strength, he moved in to unleash one final attack. One that was stopped by the arrival of the Admirer [[Halibel]]. With Halibel having moved Groovy out of the way, he greeted the emperor of old, though the man did not like the sight of a wolfman before him. It didn’t take long for Halibel to realize that the curse was not affecting him, leaving him somewhat conflicted. With Eugard unleashing an attack with his Yang Sword in an attempt to burn Halibel, the Admirer used his clone to take his place while he dragged the man into the ground by his feet. Despite this, Eugard managed to escape and unleash more attacks. With several clones and swipes of the emperor’s swords, Halibel eventually managed to cause significant damage to the emperor. Despite this, he was unable to defeat him, and he soon retreated with Groovy. At a safe distance, the two determined how the Curse of Thorns worked how to take care of it. With Halibel returning to fight Eugard, he used his cloning techniques to create several clones. Using various techniques and methods to avoid the various swings of Eugard’s sword, he managed to hit the man several times. Deciding to use his proper strength, Eugard tossed aside the Fiend Sword and decided to solely use the Yang Sword, even abusing its unique sheathing method to catch him off guard. As the battle continued, Halibel eventually found the “dead spot” on the emperor’s body and struck it, causing it to shatter and stop regenerating. In retaliation, Eugard struck the Admirer with the hilt of his sword, and with the explosive force of his sword behind it, he sent the wolfman flying. Despite this, Groovy soon made his appearance aiming for the Fiend Sword. Not allowing him to reach it, Eugard tossed his Yang Sword, successfully managing to pierce through the hyenaman’s abdomen. Despite this, Groovy successfully completed his task. Due to the sword’s hatred for Groovy, it flung itself away from him, and it reached Halibel’s hands. Creating an opening against Eugard, Halibel struck the emperor, releasing the influence of the Witch that was on him. Soon after, Groovy successfully managed to transfer the Curse of Thorns to himself with an unnamed method, allowing Eugard and Halibel to move onto another battle. Meanwhile, Groovy remained where he was, unable to continue fighting. ===Clash Against the Undead Swordmaster=== Shortly after Al’s group entered the Imperial Capital, Rowan came across [[Yorna Mishigure]], using her original name Iris, beyond the fifth bastion. Though she attempted to persuade him to leave and live another day, since he had a chance to fight against someone transcendent, something he’d never been given a chance to before, Rowan attacked her anyway. However, she was able to quickly subdue him multiple times, hoping that he would back down. However, this had the opposite effect, and he soon found hope that by fighting against Yorna would allow him to reach the Heavenly Sword. And with this hope in hand, Rowan slashed his own throat. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 36 12.png|thumb|left|180x|Iris versus the undead force of Rowans.]] With Rowan having given his life, numerous receptacles of Rowan appeared like an army, using their countless numbers to try and reach the Seventh Divine General. With her incredible might, Yorna succeeded in crushing many of them, displaying a clear difference in their strengths yet again. However, with her morale having been drastically reduced due to the conflict around her and her failure to turn Rowan back while he was still alive, the swordsman’s blade managed to reach Yorna several times. Eventually, he was prepared to swing his sword at her neck. Reinforcements came soon after in the form of [[Tanza]], who took the blow meant for her while covered in armor made of ice, and [[Emilia]]. With the latter holding off the numerous undead, she bought time enough for Tanza and Yorna to speak. Though Yorna attempted to push Tanza back by claiming she didn’t need her anymore, the deer girl saw through her lie as the Soul Marriage Technique flowed strong within her, and she proceeded to use the strength given to her to crush one of the Rowans who slipped past Emilia. Shortly after, Tanza continued forward to back up Emilia. Despite their strengths, the sheer number of Rowan duplicates was too much, and one of them managed to get close to Yorna. However, when Eugard, free of Sphinx’s influence, arrived and deflected the blade meant for her. No longer with the Curse of Thorns, he met with his Star again. Not understanding his role there, Tanza attempted to attack him. With her attack avoided, Yorna dissuaded her from attacking Eugard, as he was no longer an enemy, with Emilia asking him as much. With his confirmation, he confronted the many Rowans again and introduced himself. With his next attack, he used his Yang Sword to strike a single receptacle of the swordsman, causing his soul to ignite. Shortly after, with his bodies collapsing, Rowan retreated to find his son. ===Bout Against the Cloud Dragon=== Having been directed towards the seemingly less defended first bastion, Heinkel entered the place on Al’s suggestion. Unfortunately, Heinkel was aware that this was likely to be a trap, which was confirmed by the appearance of the Cloud Dragon [[Mezoreia]], being controlled by the Divine General [[Madelyn Eschart]]. Considering Heinkel nothing more than a fly, she swatted him away with her tail. However, Heinkel survived, and he was pulled from the rubble by [[Garfiel Tinzel]], who was given the task of handling the Dragon. Of course, Madelyn did not care for his appearance and decided to attack him. Garfiel managed to strike the Dragon in the sky, but she took minimal damage from the attack, and she tried to crush him with her two large hands. When this failed she struck at him with her tail. Getting back up, he struck her in the face, giving her a nosebleed with a tremendous crack. Unfortunately, having been caught midair, he was sent flying into the ground, having nearly been killed. Getting back up almost immediately thanks to the effects of his Divine Protection healing him. Continuing to challenge the Dragon, she was extremely enraged and attempted to strike him with her tail again. However, having grabbed it mid-swing, he threw her backwards against her wall of the bastion, leaving her upside down and confused. With Madelyn baffled and annoyed, she unleashed her Dragon Breath on Garfiel in an attempt to erase him completely. Despite this, not only did he manage to withstand the Dragon’s Breath with the combination of his strength, shields, and Divine Protection, he even managed to deflect it into the sky, shocking Madelyn, and causing Heinkel to fall on his behind, muttering that that attack would have wiped away everything behind him. Hearing this left Madelyn confused and panicked, and she flew into the sky. In her confusion, Madelyn gathered up all of the mana that was spread across the sky, creating intensely powerful thunderclouds and preparing the most powerful attack she could muster, intending to release it on an unspecified target. Needing his help, Garfiel called to Heinkel for assistance. Using his sword, he swung it after Garfiel jumped on it, and with their combined strengths, Garfiel managed to reach Madelyn in the sky, and he brought her down, resolving to speak to her after this fight was over. On the ground, he and Heinkel protected her from the numerous undead, who were all intending kill the Dragon and turn her into a zombie. Eventually, they left the first bastion. ===The Magician and the Sharpshooter=== Shortly after Madelyn took over Mezoreia, Balleroy and [[Carillon]] took off into the skies above the third bastion. Wanting to end the conflict as soon as possible, they decided to continue searching for Vincent, as they believe sniping the leader would end the fight fastest. However, before they could try, a large number of fireballs came flying towards the Imperial Capital from the sky, causing Balleroy to have to shoot down every fireball. Using his scope to see the cause of the flames, he saw [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and [[Medium O'Connell]] high in the air. Intending to keep Medium alive he began firing shots at her arms and legs, which she managed to deflect with her swords. Convinced of his motives, the two flew into action. Roswaal cast numerous other wide range spells, forcing Balleroy to deal with them. Simultaneously, Balleroy was firing accurate shots of his magic bullets at Roswaal, who was forced to dodge as he flew, leaving the magician impressed. Deciding to unleash his own trump card, Roswaal let fall a massive iceberg that was prepared beforehand by Emilia, and he let it crumble into massive chunks of falling ice debris. Knowing that it would be suicide fighting against someone like Balleroy in the terrain where he fights best, he use this to gain cover while he flew around and threw in his own attacks. He was also able to shoot down the attack aiming for his back. Attempting to escape from the falling debris, he was nearly stopped by yet another spell Roswaal had prepared: a barrier made of all six elements. However, though this was meant to stop the sniper, he managed to punch through the barrier and escape, and he even managed to ricochet a shot of his off of the falling ice and hit Roswaal. Left with no other option available, Roswaal created a large ice trap beneath them on the ground, and he threw Medium towards it, forcing Balleroy to make a decision: save Medium or kill Roswaal. Choosing the former, Balleroy flew as fast as he could towards Medium’s direction and destroyed the ice trap, leaving Balleroy open to be struck by a magic bullet made by Roswaal. Fortunately, Medium was able to be saved, and with Balleroy defeated, Roswaal left for another battlefield. On the ground, Balleroy had a conversation with Medium about her having fallen in love with someone, and soon after, he decided to help her save the one she fell for. ===Blue Lightning, The Follower, and The Spirit Eater=== With Al and Cecilus retreating towards the area of the second bastion, they decided on their goal to retrieve Cecilus’s sword, the Fiend Sword and the [[Enchanted Sword#Dream Sword Masayume|Dream Sword]]. However, instead, they came across the Spirit Eater [[Arakiya]]. Having tried to take in the Stone in an attempt to prevent its further abuse by Sphinx’s hands, numerous crystals burst forth from her body, giving her crystalline wings and protrusions, and she cried blood as her body was barely able to withstand the power of one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]]. Unable to control herself due to the immense power flowing through her body and the awakening survival instincts of the Stone, her body began acting on its own, attacking Al and Cecilus with flames and crystals. Defending themself, Al set up his [[Al#Abilities|thought experiment]], and Cecilus flew around the battlefield, avoiding the intense flames and rocket-like crystals being fired towards him. While Al was barely able to keep himself alive against the intense and dramatic firepower, Cecilus was able to cut through the crystals, though not without taking some damage himself. Arakiya, unable to bear the intense suffering and wishing to use her death to scare the Stone into action, asked for Cecilus to kill her. However, because her death by his hands like this would not play well with Cecilus’s ideals, he refused to kill her and decided to defeat her while keeping her alive. The battle continued and intensified. With the area around them having been reduced to not but ash and spots of lava, Cecilus, who had expected an opening to appear, raised his hand to the sky. Al, who had been through numerous over twelve thousand “loops”, desperately attempted to figure out what this posture meant, until finally, he threw his liuyedao towards Cecilus. Catching the sword, Cecilus swung it downward, recreating an intensely powerful slash reminiscent of the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint’s]], erasing most of the attacks heading his direction. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 37 8.png|thumb|right|180x|Cecilus subdues Arakiya.]] Unfortunately, this did not end the fight, and Arakiya unleashed yet another attack. In the moments before the attack could land, Cecilus managed to retrieve the Dream Sword from his memories, and he cut through the attack. Simultaneously, as Cecilus spoke to her, she realized that she was under the effect of her princess’s Soul Marriage Technique, the flame burning brightly in her eye and preventing her from self-destructing from the Stone’s power. Cecilus then rushed forward, and with a powerful downward swing, he both bypassed her last attack and struck her down. With the combination of the Dream Sword’s ability to accomplish one’s dreams and the Soul Marriage Technique, Arakiya’s body managed to perfectly assimilate with the Stone, and she survived, her life now connected to Vollachia’s. ===The Arrival of Sphinx=== After vanquishing numerous undead soldiers, including the malformed [[Izmail]], beyond the fifth bastion, Sphinx, whose instincts were telling her that Subaru was involved with her plans going awry, made her appearance before his group. Despite not having encountered her in previous loops, Subaru decided to take advantage of the surprise to take her down for good. However, when he tried to do so, Sphinx interrupted him and pointed out Spica’s use of the Authority of Gluttony, leaving Subaru shocked enough that he and [[Spica]] were wide open for Sphinx to attack. After [[Jamal Aurélie]] pushed the two out of the way and took the attack himself, Sphinx attempted to inquire into whether Vincent was related to Priscilla. Subaru answered in his stead, having gone through several bouts of Return by Death, and he got everyone into action. Leaving [[Beatrice]] to heal Jamal, Spica entered hand to hand combat with Sphinx. Despite excelling in magic, Sphinx showed tremendous skill at close combat, and she prevented Spica from damaging her or using her Authority. Meanwhile, Subaru also went into action, using his whip as a means to distract her. Despite this, Sphinx managed to grab ahold of it after she pushed back Spica, and she dragged him to herself. Though he took injuries from this, this was a part of his plan, and while lying on his back and facing Sphinx, he fired Minya into her eye, causing it to crystallize. This left her open to attack by Jamal, who threw his sword, and Beatrice, who hit her with more Minya arrows. With Sphinx left unable to move, Subaru and Spica attempted to use her Authority again. However, this failed when three more zombies of Sphinx appeared and destroyed the immobile one. Despite putting up a fight against them, Jamal was left unconscious, Spica and Subaru were held down by two of her zombies, and Beatrice was left on the ground. With things going her way, Sphinx attempted to negotiate to bring Vincent to the Crystal Palace with her alive. When he didn’t give her the answer she wanted, she attempted to use the lives of those around as hostages, even going so far as to break Subaru’s arm. This also failed, however, and she decided to kill them all. As Sphinx zombies each charged a Jiwald to kill them all, Subaru gave the signal for Spica to teleport with her respective Sphinx, putting her directly into the line of fire of one of her own attacks and destroying said zombie. Meanwhile, Beatrice used Minya to crystallize the one holding down Subaru, complaining to Subaru about cutting things too close. With two of the zombies of Sphinx destroyed, Vincent finally drew his Yang Sword, and when he charged at her, though she barely dodged a direct hit, when he cut off a small lock of her hair, her soul began to burn, as well as her body along with it. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 37 12.png|thumb|left|180x|Sphinx becomes the Witch of Greed.]] Despite this victory, many of the remaining zombies of Sphinx, desperate to find a way to survive, destroyed themselves to coalesce the knowledge they acquired into one. In this process, Sphinx was finally able to cast off her “shell” as Sphinx, and taking on the appearance of her creator, [[Echidna]], she started to refer to herself as the Witch of Greed before the bound Priscilla. {{Clear}} ===Duel of the Swordsmen=== With his soul burning, Rowan dashed his way through the capital, using various receptacles to keep going, until he finally reached Cecilus, who had just finished his confrontation with Arakiya. With Rowan wishing to overcome his son and reach the Heavenly Sword, he and Cecilus prepared their swords. After a few moments of silence, they each unleashed a single slash, and Rowan was defeated. With his body collapsing and his soul burning to naught, Cecilus commended his father. ===The Witch's Last Stand=== Shortly after Cecilus defeated his father, the Witch, donning her new form, floated to the ground, coming to kill Arakiya, who successfully assimilated with the Stone and whose life became synonymous with the life of Vollachia. Though confused by her appearance, Cecilus quickly pieced together her identity as Sphinx. Meanwhile, an enraged Al attacked her, believing her to be his old teacher. However, Sphinx easily dealt with his magic physically, dispelling his impressions of her identity, leading to Cecilus to inform him of her identity. Sphinx then took an interest in Al for the first time, but because of the danger posed by Cecilus, she cast a spell around her that would detonate should she be killed. With Al having realized this, he stopped Cecilus’s charge against her, and a larger battle took place. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 38 6.png|thumb|right|180x|Cecilus slashes through a star.]] With Al incapable of reaching the Witch, she began assaulting Cecilus with numerous spells. Blasting him with various spells of water, fire, and light, even combining the elements in various manners, the Blue Lightning cut through every spell she sent his way. Eventually, she decided to cast Al Shario. However, Cecilus decided to take on this immeasurable spell, and with his body returning to normal in the process, he slashed through and destroyed the falling star, leaving Sphinx left shocked. Al took advantage of this to thrust himself at her. Though she still expected this and attempted to attack him, he caught her off guard with a false prosthetic arm to the face, and he cast Ol Shamak, sealing her in contradictory black light. Meanwhile, Vincent’s group, now accompanied by Halibel, who split up from Eugard, made their way to the Crystal Palace, fighting through numerous zombies, both normal and malformed. Eventually coming across Viva, who had been performing soul experiments and creating the stronger and malformed zombies, Vincent burned away his soul and ended the experiments. However, the Magic Crystal Cannon soon activated, its aim directed towards Al’s group with the intention to kill Arakiya. Not allowing this to slide, Subaru had Vincent defend them with his Yang Sword, while he had Spica and Halibel help him and Beatrice reach the skies above the cannon. There, they cast Al Shamak, successfully absorbing the shot. Shortly after, the undead [[Valgren]] appeared in the sky, attempting to kill the two floating in the air. Fortunately, they were saved by the arrival of Roswaal, who had caught them midair, and Halibel and Cecilus, who wasted no time in dispatching the Dragon. Meanwhile, [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], who had been responsible for investigating the Crystal Palace, successfully managed to destroy all of the magic circles that was warping the inside of the palace. Having seen the Magic Crystal Cannon shot been erased by Subaru, Olbart laughed as he faced off against Sphinx, who had managed to successfully bypass all of Moguro’s defenses and utilize the great [[Meteor|meteor]]. The battle was short, and Olbart managed to pierce straight through Sphinx, but taking advantage of her status as an undead, she blew herself up, successfully taking Olbart’s other arm and leaving him on death’s door. Meanwhile below, Vincent reunited with Yorna, Tanza, and his new ally, Eugard, and they fought side by side. Emilia, who had split off from the group because of her instincts, came across one of the other Sphinxes as she was heading to complete a magic circle. Though the two confused each other for the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] and Witch of Greed respectively, they quickly realized that they were not the same. With Emilia looking for Priscilla, the two ended up in battle. Beneath the palace, Vincent noticed the explosion from Olbart’s battle, and when the old man appeared and warned him about Moguro, Vincent used the strength boost granted to him by his Yang Sword to jump inside the opening given to him. It didn’t take long for him to realize that Moguro’s core had been overloaded and set to blow up. Needing to quell the explosion, he was prepared to expend his life force to do so. However, he was stopped by the arrival of Medium, who was carrying Madelyn’s unconscious body, and Balleroy. Deciding to save everyone with the life he had left, Balleroy and Carillon flew him into the sky with Moguro’s core, and it blew up, visible to everyone. Meanwhile, Sphinx continued to keep her plan in motion. Sending out several of herself towards the magic circle’s corners in the city, she intending to blow up the city, though Emilia’s actions keeping one of them in place halted her plan. Meanwhile, the Sphinx captured by Al intended to anger him by speaking of his incomplete purpose, and in turn, he would kill her, allowing the information she had gathered to spread to the other Sphinxes. However, Subaru, who had experienced numerous failures, managed to prevent these outcomes, and he had everyone protect the nearby unconscious Arakiya, who was also one of the targets to destroy Vollachia., from the army of zombies that were going to attempt to kill her. Simultaneously, he had Cecilus, Garfiel, Halibel, and Eugard confront the Sphinxes at the corners of the magic circles, who were attempting to utilize the mana stored within the Crystal Palace to strengthen both the circle and herself. Deciding to put everyone in despair, Sphinx created a water screen high in the air that displayed the predicament that Garkla was in. Despite this, Subaru and Beatrice destroyed even this plan by firing the stored cannon shot at the Al Shario falling towards Garkla, simultaneously causing the water screen to shatter in the air. However, even this was part of Sphinx’s plan, as she intended to turn the falling water into blades that would tear apart her enemies. This plan was also destroyed when, having decided to give her life to burn down the alternate space, Priscilla emerged in the sky and burned away all of the water. With Priscilla falling from the sky, her Soul Marriage Technique spread to everyone, both in Garkla and Lupugana. Her presence was felt by Sphinx, and many of her receptacles jumped to attack her in the air, though nearly all of them were stopped by the group from below. Caught in the air by Al, she made her way to the ground, where she met with Subaru and entrusted him to do with the nearby Sphinx what he needed to. Taking Arakiya, who had awakened, with her, she left Al to help Subaru. With Spica by his side and surrounded by his allies, Subaru attempted use the Authority of Gluttony to defeat her. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 38 3.png|thumb|left|250px|The imperial family confronts the giant magic crystal soldier.]] Meanwhile, another one of the Sphinxes landed within the Crystal Palace, and sitting upon the throne, she activated the meteor that was still inside, turning the Crystal Palace into the Giant Magic Crystal Soldier. Needing to face it down was Vincent. However, reinforcements arrived in the form of Priscilla, Eugard, and the Nine Divine Generals, including Mezoreia through Madelyn. Working side by side with three Yang Swords, they fought against the colossus, and eventually, they managed to destroy it completely, with Priscilla even defeating the Sphinx inside. With Subaru confronting Sphinx with Spica, his body reverted to normal. Unfortunately, the two realized that they would always have been enemies. Subaru told her “happy birthday” before successfully managing to use the Authority of Gluttony on her with Spica. With that, Sphinx acquired awareness of her identity as “Sphinx”, realizing and being content with it, while a remaining undead duplicate of hers had one final confrontation and conversation with Priscilla. All of Sphinx's duplicates faded to ash, ending the Great Disaster. ==Aftermath== The defeat of Sphinx marked the collapse of the undead army's central forces in Lupugana, resulting in the surviving undead retreating and concealing themselves from the living. The number of casualties has not yet been fully ascertained. The destruction wrought to Lupugana caused the destruction of the Crystal Palace. The reservoir, although not completely broken, was left at risk of being destroyed at any time. According to Priscilla, the state Lupugana was left in could very well take a century to restore. The aptly-named “Rescue the Vollachia Empire from Destruction Squad” returned to Garkla, where the citizens and soldiers began to rebuild the city's outer walls following the disaster's conclusion. Eugard and Priscilla, as a result of returning to their human appearances and burning out all of their remaining “embers”, dissipated into thin air, content with their ends. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Terminology]]
