Seven soldiers killed |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Fall of Guaral''' (''unofficial name'') was a battle that took place roughly one year and five months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, and it is one of the first conflicts in [[Arc 7]]. This is one of the earliest battles that took place during the [[Imperial Civil War]], where the dethroned emperor [[Vincent Vollachia]], using the name Abel, initiated a takeover of the [[Guaral|Fortress City of Guaral]] in an effort to establish a new base of operations. With Subaru needing to return to [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]] with both [[Rem]] and [[Spica|Rui]] in tow, Abel led him into a trap that would force his hand to become an ally to retake the throne of the Empire. Successfully making him realize the dire straits that he was in, Abel and Subaru were forced to come up with a way to take the city most efficiently and with the least casualties, leading to Subaru’s idea to take the city over while undercover. Ultimately, the idea was a success, and they managed to put the city under their control, though not without a confrontation with the Second Divine General, [[Arakiya]], and receiving reinforcements in the form of [[Priscilla Barielle]] and her [[Priscilla Camp|camp]]. Despite Arakiya managing to escape with the assistance of [[Todd Fang]], this fight granted Abel new allies, and the Rebel Army, basing themselves in the newly conquered Guaral, was formed. ==Background== ===The Military Encampment Attack=== Having gained an ally in the People of Shudrak through the Lifeblood Ritual, Abel launched an attack on the military encampment just outside of Buddheim Jungle. Successfully killing a large number of soldiers, he forced them to retreat to the nearby Fortress City. At the same time, they were successfully able to recover Rem and Rui, who in turn were able to heal Subaru, despite his grievous, life-threatening injuries. The following day, when Subaru awoke, he prepared to leave for the very same city, unaware that his enemies had retreated there as well. Rem, on the other hand, was warned of this by Abel, and she was convinced to allow this to happen in order to force Subaru’s hand and make him ally with Abel. Escorted by [[Kuna Shudrak|Kuna]] and [[Holly Shudrak]], they arrived at the edge of the jungle, where the girls said they’d be watching. ===Battle in the Fortress City=== Shortly after arriving at Guaral, Subaru befriended the merchant, [[Flop O'Connell]], and his sister, [[Medium O'Connell]], and the two helped him into the city. Arriving at an inn that Flop was familiar with, Rem, Rui, and Medium decided to remain within their room. Meanwhile, Subaru and Flop were going to shop for necessities before they could leave the city. Unfortunately, however, Subaru was spotted by an imperial soldier, Todd Fang, who he had become an enemy of shortly before the attack on the military camp. Going through several loops, Subaru yelled at Todd that he knew he was there, successfully warding him away for long enough that Subaru could collect his bearings and prepare to retreat from the city. Returning to the inn, Subaru had the girls prepare to leave. Jumping aboard their carriage, Medium led them all towards the entrance that they had come through. However, as they made their way that direction, they noticed a roadblock of imperial soldiers led by [[Jamal Aurélie]], who had been warned by Todd. To distract them, Medium attacked them while their carriage made its way through the entrance. Though she struggled with handling Jamal, thanks to Subaru throwing out a rope to grab onto, Medium managed to board the carriage and escape with them. However, just when they thought they’d escaped, Subaru grabbed one of Medium’s swords and raised above their heads, successfully blocking an aerial strike from Todd, who he predicted would attack while their guard was down. After a short struggle and with some help from Rui, they managed to push Todd out of the carriage, and, realizing the meaning of Holly and Kuna’s words, he called for them to help. With Todd midair, he was unable to dodge as an arrow flew through the air, and he was struck. Though he survived, Subaru’s group managed to escape. ===Preparing for a Raid=== With Subaru’s group having escaped, Todd started making preparations within the city. Believing that Subaru’s bold entrance was as a scouting mission prior to a coming raid, he and Jamal started sealing up any hidden entrances they were aware of within the city, meaning to block off any paths to enter with. Successfully closing off the majority of them, only the city’s main entrances were left to be used, and they were left under heavy security. However, the soldiers there continued to feel increasingly tense and stressed by their situations. At the Shudrakian village, everyone ultimately reconvened, though Subaru was less than pleased about it. However, because of this, Subaru was forced to ally with Abel until he’d be able to return to Lugunica. With Flop and Medium as allies, the group were forced to collude together. Though Abel praised Flop’s intelligence, he looked down on his idealistic views of wanting to take Guaral with no casualties. After a short conversation with Rem, Subaru managed to find a compromise between both parties, and he came up with a plan that could take the city without any bloodshed. ==Siege of Guaral== ===Bloodless Siege=== With the idea for Subaru, Abel, and Flop to cross dress, they, alongside Kuna and [[Taritta Shudrak]], decided to sneak into the city by disguising them as performers. Though the security was heavy, they managed to sneak into the city successfully. After repeatedly practicing and performing for the span of a week, they were eventually invited by the man in charge of the soldiers, Second Class General [[Zikr Osman]], to perform for the soldiers, who wanted to help relieve the tension building up in his soldiers. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 27 10.png|thumb|right|180x|Zikr defeated.]] Though they successfully managed to get inside of City Hall where the soldiers were, they had a close call when Jamal and Todd appeared before them. That said, after Jamal and Todd left, they were able to perform for the soldiers, completely ensnaring them in their performance. They were so ensnared, in fact, that Zikr even handed his own sword to the dancing Abel, who in turn pointed that very blade at his throat. Successfully keeping the soldiers there from attacking with the commander at blade point, Abel was soon revealed to be their emperor, and they bowed before him. With their objective reached, Abel tasked Subaru with burning the flag atop the building. Upon doing so, they took Guaral under their control. ===The Spirit Eater’s Arrival=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 27 12.png|thumb|left|180x|Arakiya appears to kill Abel.]] With Guaral taken, the remaining forces within Abel’s group filed into City Hall. With Zikr now under his command, he had the soldiers go on their way. With the exception of Subaru, who had been running left and right, Abel’s group returned to their ordinary outfits. However, as they were trying to settle things down, Rui began throwing a fit out of fear, much to the shock of everyone in the room. The reason for this turned out to be the arrival of the Spirit Eater, Arakiya, who had been sent to Guaral by the prime minister, [[Berstetz Fondalfon]]. Despite being aware that Abel was the emperor, she still attempted to kill him. In an attempt to defeat her, [[Mizelda Shudrak]] assaulted her. However, she was left severely burned and defeated. Rem and others attempted to attack her as well, but everything they threw was ineffective. Arakiya directed an attack at Rem, to which Subaru jumped in the way of, attempting to take the attack for her. However, the attack was intercepted by Priscilla Barielle, who had arrived in Vollachia following an attack in the Barielle Domain, much to the shock of both Subaru and Abel. Though Arakiya was shocked by her appearance, she was still prepared to attack her. [[Al]], who had accompanied Priscilla, also jumped in on the fight, and though he recognized her, she failed to recognize him thanks to his helmet. As the battle ensued, Priscilla and Al failed to land any lasting damage against her, as she often turned herself into fire to let damage pass through her, as well as fly. Intending to attack Abel, she unleashed a large gust of wind, blowing the roof off of the building and knocking both Abel and Al, who defended the emperor, off of the floor, leaving them to hang off of a curtain. Priscilla continued to attack Arakiya, and eventually, she landed an attack on Arakiya’s back, successfully leaving a large burned scar. With Arakiya defeated, Al and Abel returned to the room, and Arakiya was taken to the prison cells beneath the building, leaving Holly to watch over her. ===Escape from Guaral=== Having been outside the building, Todd and Jamal continued making their rounds, making sure to seal any secret passages leading into the city that they may have missed. Despite Todd’s worry, Jamal soon pointed out the burning flag atop City Hall, leaving them both completely shocked. With his enhanced vision, Todd noticed one of the dancers burning the flag, and he pieced together that it was Subaru. With Jamal attempting to return, Todd stopped him, claiming that everyone in the building was already dead, and they proceeded to try and escape. However, when the roof of the building was blown off by Arakiya, Todd changed his plans and made for City Hall with Jamal. With Arakiya having been defeated, she was left imprisoned in the cells below the building. Sneaking inside, Todd killed several imperial soldiers before arriving at the cells. With Jamal confronting Holly, Todd grabbed Arakiya. Having defeated Holly, Jamal tried to kill her, but Todd said to leave her, and they made for their escape. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 28 5.png|thumb|right|180x|Todd escaping with Arakiya while Jamal becomes a decoy.]] Having heard of the Spirit Eater’s escape, the People of Shudrak began searching for her, and they found Todd with Arakiya in his arms. They began firing arrows at them, leaving Todd no room to breathe. Ducking into a nearby alley, he made a plan with Jamal. Deciding to use him as bait, Jamal was left to defend against all of the arrows being fired, and eventually, he was brought down and imprisoned. Meanwhile, Todd successfully escaped from Guaral. {{Clear}} ==Aftermath== With Guaral now as the Rebel Army’s base for the war, Abel set to obtain Priscilla’s assistance for the coming battles. As for Subaru, due to Todd’s actions, he was devastated by the loss of life he’d brought with him, and after speaking with Rem, that feeling got worse, as she claimed he was not a hero, a statement that felt to him as though she were taking back what she’d told him before her memory loss. However, with some assistance from Al, he was able to resolve himself to become her hero again, and he went to speak with Abel and Priscilla. During their discussion, Priscilla refused to give her assistance until Abel managed to gain more insurance for the war effort, namely obtaining the assistance of several members of the Nine Divine Generals. Realizing the task would be difficult, they decided to set their sights on [[Chaosflame]] and its ruler, the Seventh of the Nine Divine Generals, [[Yorna Mishigure]]. Afterward, Abel, Subaru, Al, Taritta, and Medium, and unbeknownst to them, Rui, set off for their journey to the Demon City, while Rem remained with Priscilla. As for Todd, having spun his lies around Arakiya, he managed to sway her to help him return to the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]], where Berstetz promoted him for rescuing Arakiya, making him her direct subordinate and setting him on his new task in [[Ginunhive]]. Following the Fall of Guaral, rumors regarding the person responsible for orchestrating the city's capture, the black-haired maiden "Natsumi Schwartz", began spreading throughout the Empire. Guaral's fall served as a precursor to the [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm]] spearheaded by [[Madelyn Eschart]] at Prime Minister Berstetz's instruction. ==Trivia== *In the Azamuku IF, the Fall of Guaral concluded very differently. Due to Subaru's absence and the burning of the Buddheim Jungle, resulting in the deaths of nearly all of the People of Shudrak, Vincent obtained Todd and Jamal's assistance, and they managed to break into the city after unleashing poison unto the city, killing both Zikr and Flop in the process. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Vollachia Empire]]

As Subaru and [[Vincent Vollachia|Abel’s]] group are handling business in [[Chaosflame]], [[Berstetz Fondalfon]], the prime minister of [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]], ordered the Ninth ranking Divine General, [[Madelyn Eschart]], to attack [[Guaral]] with her army of [[Dragon#Flying Dragons|flying dragons]]. Madelyn’s dragons caused devastating damage to the Fortress City, as despite its incredible fortitude when handling armies, its weakness towards aerial combat left it wide open for attack. Fortunately, with the assistance of the members of the [[Priscilla Camp]] that were within the city, as well as the members of the [[Emilia Camp]], who had come to Vollachia to retrieve Subaru and [[Rem]], they were successfully able to minimize the damage as much as possible. Due to the efforts of [[Emilia]] and [[Priscilla Barielle]], who fought off the general, she was forced to retreat elsewhere. After an encounter with [[Flop O'Connell]], who she injured, and Rem, who could heal him, Madelyn retreated with her flying dragons, taking Flop and Rem with her. ==Background== ===[[Fall of Guaral]]=== Having made an ally of Subaru, Abel decided to [[Fall of Guaral|infiltrate Guaral]] with the assistance of Subaru, the Shudrakians, and [[Flop O'Connell]], a merchant Subaru had befriended during his retreat from the city. After disguising themselves as dancers and successfully occupying the city, and after the defeat of [[Arakiya]] and her escape by the hands of [[Todd Fang]], negotiations took place between Abel and Priscilla, who had arrived with her camp, for how to obtain her assistance in the coming [[Imperial Civil War|battle]]. They ultimately settled on obtaining the assistance of one of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]], [[Yorna Mishigure]]. Taking Subaru, [[Medium O'Connell]], [[Taritta Shudrak]], and, initially unbeknownst to them, [[Spica|Rui]], they left for [[Chaosflame]], where she resided. Meanwhile, the members of the Priscilla Camp, Imperial Army, and Rem stayed behind in Guaral. Meanwhile, in response to the Fall of Guaral, Berstetz ordered Madelyn Eschart, the Ninth of the Nine Divine Generals, to attack the city with an army of flying dragons. ===Infiltrating Vollachia=== Following Subaru's abduction during the [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], the members of the Emilia Camp made their preparations to infiltrate Vollachia through [[Picoutatte]] and Everlasting Darkness, while [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], who would be taking on the name Dudley, and [[Ram]] decided to split off from the group to speak with [[Serena Dracroy|someone else]]. Following a confrontation with [[Diadora Regundra]], the [[Musica|representative]] of the molepeople, and a certain group of bat humans, the camp successfully managed to enter Vollachia. Shortly after, noticing a group of flying dragons above a certain city, Emilia, going by the name Emily, took the camp to assist in the city's defense. ==Battle== ==Aftermath== ==Trivia== *The name “Flying Dragon Cataclysm” is not exclusive to the name of this incident. Typically, in Vollachia, Flying Dragon Cataclysms are incidents in which flying dragons completely destroy a settlement during their breeding season.''Occasionally called Flying Dragon Cataclysms, there were instances where flying dragons would completely devastate a settlement when they met for breeding season.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], Sword Identity, Section 12. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Terminology]] [[Category:Vollachia Empire]]

Taking place halfway through [[Arc 7]], Subaru and company came to the [[Chaosflame|Demon City of Chaosflame]] in an effort to recruit [[Yorna Mishigure]] into [[Vincent Vollachia|Abel]]'s faction, and in turn, gain the support of [[Priscilla Barielle]]. Having arrived in the city, they confronted Yorna in her Crimson Lapis Castle, where they came face to face with the leader of the opposing side of the war, [[Chisha Gold]], taking the form of his former emperor. This led to a successful declaration of war and the potential for Yorna’s assistance. However, due to the schemes of [[Tanza]] and [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]], numerous battles broke out across the city, leading to an all-out fight between two [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Divine Generals]]. Things took a tremendous turn when Subaru, who had been infantilized by the Vicious Old Man, was found by the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], who had lost him after their connection was severed, leading to her shadow spilling out of his body and consuming the city. With both sides, alongside the citizens of the city, working together, they successfully managed to repel the shadow, at the cost of the entire city, and with both Subaru and Tanza being flung far away. ==Background== Having weathered through the [[Fall of Guaral]], Abel made the decision to head to Chaosflame in an effort to bring one of the most unique of the Divine Generals to their side: Yorna Mishigure. By doing so, they intended to bring Priscilla, who had arrived during the Fall, to their side and gain her support. With a team composed of Abel, Subaru (posing as Natsumi Schwartz), [[Medium O'Connell]], [[Al]], and [[Taritta Shudrak]], they left for the Demon City. Later, they realized that [[Spica|Rui]] had also snuck aboard the carriage they were on. Unable to turn back, she was taken along with them. ===Meeting in the Crimson Lapis Castle=== Shortly after arriving in Chaosflame, the group decided to stay at an inn. After making preparations, Abel handed Subaru a letter meant for Yorna. Deciding that Subaru, Medium, and Al would go to deliver it, Abel remained in the inn with Rui and Taritta. Shortly after arriving at the Crimson Lapis Castle, they were led by Yorna’s assistant, Tanza, to an open space, where Abel’s enemies laid in wait. Also seeking an audience with Yorna were Abel’s lookalike, Divine General Olbart Dunkelkenn, General Second-Class [[Kafma Irulux]], and the [[Stargazer]] [[Ubilk]], much to the shock of the others. Soon after, the two groups were met by Yorna. With Kafma complaining for the sakes of both parties, Yorna did not care. Abel’s lookalike, Chisha, pleaded his case, intending to keep her from joining the fight. However, Yorna soon after revealed the intentions of Subaru’s group, much to the irritation of Kafma. Olbart spoke up to calm him for a moment, leading to Al speaking up in an attempt to use his “reward” from the events in [[Ginunhive]] approximately a decade ago to finish his business with Yorna. This allowed Subaru to hand the letter to Yorna, who promised that she would read it if they successfully escaped the Crimson Lapis Castle. With this in mind, Subaru turned around and declared war against Chisha. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 28 12.png|thumb|right|180x|Subaru and company escape the Crimson Lapis Castle.]] This led to Kafma’s attempt to kill the group, though thanks to Al, they managed to survive. Similarly, Olbart also made his move, yet he was also thwarted by Al. With a hole in the wall nearby, the group attempted to jump out of it, though not before Olbart managed to strike them with a strange technique. After Subaru and Medium jumped, Al soon jumped with them, and they landed in hay in the ground beneath them. With this, they successfully escaped, and Tanza assured them that Yorna would make sure that nobody would attack them while they were in Chaosflame. At the same time, Yorna stated as much to Chisha’s group. Sometime later, Subaru’s group returned to the inn. They reported their results to Abel, and afterwards, though Rui was making a fuss about them, they went to bed. As they slept, Olbart’s technique finally sunk in, turning the three into children. ===Chaos in Chaosflame=== At some point, Tanza met with Chisha’s group, and with the assistance of Olbart, she made a scheme to prevent Subaru’s group from having Yorna take part in the upcoming war. After awakening, Subaru, Al, and Medium found themselves in their young bodies, much to the frustration and bewilderment of Abel and Taritta. Shortly after, Tanza arrived at their inn, wanting to meet Abel and the group that had come to the castle the day prior. Though surprised at Subaru’s appearance, Tanza soon left after confirming they would make an appearance, and she managed to sneak into Chisha’s inn without being spotted. Shortly after, however, Olbart made his presence known to the group. Though surprised that Subaru was a guy, he otherwise did not care, and he began negotiating with the group. As they did, Subaru, who had been through a loop already, accurately stated his intention of wishing to kill the emperor for posthumous fame. Slightly agitated by this, he ultimately decided to play a game with the group. At first proposing tag, he decided to play hide and seek with the group to see if they were worth picking a fight with the emperor. After giving the group a riddle, he left, leaving the group to go along with his game. After leaving their room, they quickly found Olbart, who made his first hiding spot the start. Impressed, Olbart left for his next hiding spot, leaving behind the next clue. However, Subaru, who had gone through yet another loop, was reluctant to go outside, as their lives were in danger. Looking outside, the group found numerous horned [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] blocking their path. Ordering Taritta to hold the group off, everyone else left and hid in the alleyways. In trying to determine exactly who their enemies were, Subaru felt himself pushed and ran out to the crowd, where he was flung into the sky by a child. After being saved, they found themselves surrounded by people who wanted to know what happened to Tanza. With Subaru in danger, Rui jumped in the way of an attack and was left injured beneath a broken stall. Meanwhile, Medium was struggling to hold off the citizens, and Al was left terrified and laying on the ground, having lost his Authority. Despite this, Rui awakened her skills again and made quick work of the attacking citizens. With the attack over, Subaru was questioned over Rui’s identity, which he responded with the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony. With Medium afraid, Al enraged, and Abel declaring the empire’s statute on [[Witch Cult|Witch Cultists]], Subaru and Rui ran away. Deciding to leave them for later, Abel made his way towards Chisha’s inn, where he determined Tanza would be. Arriving there, Tanza revealed what she had planned and why, and though she was willing to take punishment for it, neither Chisha nor Abel thought to do so. Meanwhile, as Subaru and Rui made their way through town, handling numerous citizens along the way, they were assisted by Ubilk, allowing the other citizens to move on by. With further assistance from the Stargazer, they determined Olbart’s next hiding spot, and the proceeded towards the Crimson Lapis Castle. Teleporting inside with Rui’s Leaper, they ran into Yorna, who had noticed them prior. With Subaru noticing her fondness for children, he decided to ask her for help regarding Olbart. ===The Flamboyant versus The Vicious Old Man=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 29 9.png|thumb|left|180x|Olbart found.]] After telling Yorna part of their story, they made their way to the roof, where Olbart was waiting. Yorna scolded the old man for his behavior, and shortly after, Subaru attempted to negotiate with him to put a stop to the game. However, this only managed to anger the old man, and Yorna attacked him for refusing a child’s request. This led to an all-out battle between Yorna and Olbart above the Crimson Lapis Castle. Unable to withstand the force of the battle, Subaru and Rui had jumped somewhere stable enough to hold them, and they watched as the battle unfolded. Yorna managed to hold off Olbart with her strength and the area around them, utilizing her Soul Marriage Technique to push Olbart into using up his tricks. Despite this, Olbart eventually brought out a set of compressed fire stone bombs, intending to force Yorna into defending the town around them. Due to this, Subaru was forced into his “ten seconds of despair.” He eventually overcame this, and with Rui’s help, they teleported above Olbart and landed on top of him. Though he was irritated with this, when Subaru claimed he beat him in his game of tag, Olbart relented, and the fight concluded. In the castle below, the group spoke for a time, with Subaru and Yorna both speaking in contempt. Because he won the game, Olbart then attempted to return Subaru’s body to normal. However, in the moment, the Witch of Envy “found” Subaru. ==The Overflowing Shadow== With his arm devoured by the shadow pouring out of Subaru’s body, Olbart was forced to retreat. Shortly after, the shadow exploded outward, forcing everyone to flee. It took little time for the shadow to burst out from the castle and attempt to swallow it. Despite Rui’s worry for Subaru, Yorna used her powers to attack the shadow and force it to recede, being forced to dodge as numerous shadow hands stretched out for her and Rui. Meanwhile, those at the inn Chisha was using saw the shadow take over the castle. Though most were confused by its appearance, Al screamed, recognizing the shadow and asking why she appeared here. Despite this, Chisha and Abel quickly took charge and decided to prepare to fight back. Elsewhere, Taritta, who had finally managed to push back her attackers, confronted Ubilk, who called her by the degrading name she was once called. Though confused by how he knew, once he revealed himself as Stargazer, Taritta threatened him. That said, when the shadow appeared, Taritta was confused by its appearance, and Ubilk stated that this was a problem for the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]] and was out of his jurisdiction. With Yorna struggling to hold it back, she decided to use the consumed Crimson Lapis Castle to attack the shadow, and she promptly blew it up. Though she caused some damage, she failed to completely push it back, and it quickly got back to consuming the city. The nearby citizens also began throwing rubble at it. Soon, reinforcements arrived in the form of Kafma, helping to protect the citizens and push back the shadow. On a nearby building, Abel stood observing the fight with Medium by his side, and Yorna and Rui made their way his direction. When Rui tried to tell him that Subaru was in the shadow, he showed no concern, and she struck him for it. With Rui teleporting away to attack the shadow, Abel and Yorna started talking about this Great Disaster. After revealing his identity to her, the two discussed the shadow. Noticing that the shadow was reaching out to those Subaru was connected to while ignoring those he didn’t, Abel decided that he would be safe as Subaru would never reach out to him. Yorna then returned to the battle. Elsewhere, Olbart spoke with Al, and after a short conversation, Al demanded Olbart return his body to normal so he could regain his Authority. Soon after, Taritta arrived at Abel’s location, referring to the shadow as the Great Disaster. With Abel questioning her about her knowledge and the commandment she was given and revealing that Subaru was at the center of the shadow, he revealed that she was also requested to take the emperor’s life to stop the Great Disaster. However, when they came to the conclusion that this disaster was not what, Abel turned to fight it. Al soon appeared in his grown body and resolved to fight. With them going to fight, they left Taritta to ponder what she was supposed to do. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 30 5.png|thumb|right|180x|Tanza stops the shadow.]] As everyone struggled to hold off the shadow, Al appeared and began giving out orders, allowing everyone to avoid being struck by the shadow. That said, they were unable to stop the shadow’s creeping, and in the end, they had to make the decision to completely retreat so that Yorna could blow up the town to push the shadow back. Though frustrated at having to do so, Al knocked out Rui so that she wouldn’t get hurt, and everyone retreated. Soon after, Yorna blew up the entirety of Chaosflame and dealt significant damage to the shadow. However, this wasn’t enough, leading to Tanza to use herself to push back the remnants of the shadow. Though Yorna tried to stop her, Taritta fired an arrow into her leg to prevent this, and with Tanza entering the shadow, she triggered the final explosion to finally push the shadow back. ==Aftermath== Having helped all that he needed to, Kafma quickly returned to Chisha’s side, who had already made his escape with Ubilk and Olbart. With Chaosflame destroyed, though everyone survived the ordeal, the citizens no longer had a home to return to. Realizing this, Abel quickly took advantage of their plight and spoke with Yorna, telling her to assist him. Though she was angered by his indifference, he pointed out that the citizens needed somewhere to go, and at present, [[Guaral]] was their best option. Similarly, Yorna would fight to defend them, and she would have to join his side to do so. Elsewhere, while Al, Taritta, and Medium were overlooking the devastation, Rui was digging at the ground, desperately trying to find Subaru. Abel appeared shortly after and chided her, stating that her actions were pointless, angering both Rui and Medium. After discussing what would happen from that point forward, they talked about Subaru. Though Rui and Medium were hopeful that he was alive and Taritta doubted it, Al claimed that he was indeed alive, as the world had not ended. Though taking it as an emotional response, Abel claimed that he believed Subaru was alive, as he likely had yet another role to play. With this in mind, Abel decided to spread rumors of a “black-haired crown prince” being behind the rebellion. This would both incite the country to start rising up and force the government to capture Subaru alive if they found him. Afterward, everyone made their way to Guaral. Meanwhile, Subaru and Tanza washed ashore on Ginunhive on the other side of the country, where they met the infantilized [[Cecilus Segmunt]]. ==Trivia== *The events that took place here was originally referred to as the [[Great Disaster]]. However, Vincent and Taritta determined that this was not the event. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Chaosflame]]

Pleiades Battalion |forces3 = |forces4 = |casual1 = Unknown number of losses |casual2 = Unknown number of losses |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = Unknown number of losses}} The '''Imperial Civil War''' (''unofficial name'') is a large-scale civil war that took place within the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. The war started one year and five months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, and it was forcefully ended by the [[Great Disaster]] in one year and eight months AA. It is the primary conflict of [[Arc 7]]. Though both the emperor [[Vincent Vollachia]] and his aide [[Chisha Gold]] were aware of a coming disaster that would be triggered by the former’s death, the two had different approaches to handling it. Vincent would gladly give his life so that his army and Divine Generals could handle it. On the contrary, Chisha believed that Vincent was necessary for the survival of the Empire. In an attempt to prepare everyone for it, Chisha incited a coup alongside the Imperial Prime Minister, [[Berstetz Fondalfon]], who had also been troubled by his emperor’s behavior. Forced off of his throne, Vincent took steps to reclaiming it, including ensuring that Subaru, who had been brought to the Empire unwillingly, assisted him, allying with the reclusive People of Shudrak, and even forging alliances with dangerous people, including the Divine General [[Yorna Mishigure]]. At the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital|Decisive Battle for the Imperial Capital]], the two armies fought for control over [[Lupugana]]. However, with everything in place, Chisha gave his life to protect his emperor, and the Great Disaster began. ==Background== ===The Stargazer of Buddheim=== Years ago, the People of Shudrak had a [[Stargazer]], [[Mariuli Shudrak]], among them. Though having befriended [[Taritta Shudrak]] as a soul sister and even having a daughter, [[Utakata Shudrak]], her role as the Stargazer took up her thoughts, and her prophecies and knowledge she was given by the stars were what she worshipped. On her death bed, she made Taritta promise to carry out her missive: to kill the black-haired man who would appear in the jungle at a specific time in order to prevent the Great Disaster. After having Taritta kill her with her own hand and staining her blood with her hands, she passed away. Taritta, having been protected by Utakata’s words, made it her mission to carry out Mariuli’s last request, and she waited for the day that man would arrive. ===Imperial Coup=== One day, one of the Stargazers, [[Ubilk]], made an appearance before the Vincent, before he became the emperor, intending to reveal to him the future that needed to be prevented. Due to the accuracy of the prophecies he held, once Vincent took the throne, he was given a position within the castle as their Stargazer. However, among those prophecies was one of the approaching Great Disaster, and it was set to be triggered by the death of Vincent Vollachia. While Vincent was willing to accept this outcome and had been making appropriate measures to counter the event, Chisha, who learned about it after Vincent had become the emperor, was not so content and confronted Ubilk about the prophecy. Realizing he could use his ability to take Vincent’s place, Chisha started making his own measures. The measures he took included investigating the [[Muspel|Stone]], who was supposed to remain in [[Garkla]], sending the Divine General, [[Groovy Gumlet]], to go to the border of [[Kararagi]] with a small army, and even recreating [[Olbart Dunkelkenn]]’s infantilization technique, using it on [[Cecilus Segmunt]], and sending him to [[Ginunhive]] so that he wouldn’t get in the way. Afterward, he allied with Prime Minister Berstetz, who had been discontent with Vincent’s lack of taking any brides and producing any heirs, and they staged a coup. Vincent was blindsided by Chisha’s actions, and Divine General [[Goz Ralfon]], who had been present when Chisha began the coup, held off the forces the two had brought with him, allowing Vincent to use a certain device to teleport himself to the Buddheim Jungle. When Goz was defeated, he was imprisoned beneath Berstetz’s mansion. Having known the location in which his emperor landed, Chisha sent a small force of his army to search the jungle. Meanwhile, he took on the face and mannerisms of Vincent, and he made a statement to the citizens of Vollachia, keeping them unaware of the circumstances. Meanwhile, Vincent went to visit the graveyard of nameless emperors by the Great Waterfall, and resolving himself, he set his sights on searching for the People of Shudrak, wrapping his face in bandages to hide his identity. ===[[Priscilla-sama's Cheers for Me! Shadows of Conspiracy Part|The Failed Assassination]]=== In [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]], upon returning to the Barielle Domain following the [[Battle for Priestella]], [[Priscilla Barielle]] was confronted by assassins sent by Chisha, whose intent was to lure her to Vollachia. After easily dispatching the assassins, she declared to the members of her [[Priscilla Camp|camp]] that they would be leaving for Vollachia. However, this led to a fight between herself and [[Al]], who was heavily against returning to the Empire. Their fight resulted in Al backing down after failing to convince her despite “dying” approximately 1000 times. Afterward, with the assistance of [[Serena Dracroy]], she and her camp arrived in the Empire and made their way to the [[Guaral|Fortress City of Guaral]]. ===[[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]]=== Having just weathered through the Battle for Priestella, the [[Emilia Camp]] and some members of the [[Anastasia Camp]] traveled to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in order to find a way to fix those affected by the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony and [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Lust]] with the assistance of the [[Flugel|Sage]]. At the tower, the group faced various opponents, including the tower’s guardian [[Shaula]], the siblings Gluttony, an army of [[Witchbeast|Witchbeasts]], the soul of [[Reid Astrea]], and even the Divine Dragon [[Volcanica]]. After a long and drawn out battle, the group ultimately emerged victorious. The even successfully managed to purge [[Lye Batenkaitos]] of the names and memories that he had devoured. With their victory, Subaru, [[Ram]], [[Meili Portroute]], and [[Patrasche]] were left in the Green Room to recover, alongside the still unconscious [[Rem]]. After a short conversation about the effects of Gluttony, a bright light shone in the room, and once it faded, an unconscious [[Spica|Rui Arneb]], who was meant to have been left trapped within the Corridor of Memories, was there. After Meili was sent to inform everyone, a [[Satella|shadow]] suddenly emerged in the room. Sending Ram and Patrasche out of the room, Subaru, Rem, and Rui were all taken by the shadow. In the process of being taken away, they were struck by a light from the Divine Dragon, and they were left in the Buddheim Jungle. ==Battles== ===Buddheim Jungle Investigation=== Just outside of the jungle, the army created an encampment, using the excuse of a training exercise as justification in order to appease those who live in the jungle. Their commander, [[Zikr Osman]], remained behind in the nearby Guaral. Meanwhile, Subaru awoke to find Rui acting strangely and Rem awake. However, due to the scent of the witch emanating from him and his treatment of Rui, Rem knocked him out and left with Rui. When Subaru awoke, he left in the direction that Rem wanted him to believe she went, and having gone through one loop already after encountering the “Hunter”, he quietly made his way to a small camp site, hoping to find at least a knife. When Vincent held a sword to his neck, the two engaged in conversation before he led Subaru in the right direction, leaving with him a knife so that Subaru would used as bait. Then Vincent, having been warned by Subaru about the “Hunter”, made his way towards their direction, growing curious about Subaru, whose name he was already aware of. Subaru eventually managed to catch up with Rem thanks to Rui leaving marks behind, and after a small skirmish and argument, the two were forced to jump into a nearby pit to avoid the arrows of the “Hunter”. Though Rem reflexively broke his fingers shortly afterward, the two were still able to run away, taking Rui along with them. Coming across a cliff, they were left with no choice but to jump. Washing ashore, they were surrounded by imperial soldiers led by [[Jamal Aurélie]]. Defending herself, Rem caused the group significant damage before she and the others were captured. Subaru was awakened in cuffs by Jamal, and the first person he saw was [[Todd Fang]]. Due to a previous loop, he was aware that he was in Vollachia and wanted to try and befriend Todd so that they would be safe. However, when Todd saw the look in his eyes, he stabbed him in his shoulder, believing Subaru was trying to manipulate him. Desperate, Subaru claimed to be from the People of Shudrak, and he offered to take the soldiers to them. With no other choice, Todd, Jamal, and several other soldiers took him into the jungle, to the worry of Rem and Rui. After some time, Todd grew suspicious of Subaru, and soon after, a large Elgina appeared, chasing after the scent of the witch. While the soldiers were distracted, Subaru attempted his escape, with Todd hot on his trail, having believed Subaru responsible for this. Subaru successfully managed an escape after jumping off of another cliff, landing in a trap. Meanwhile, the soldiers successfully fought off the Elgina, though they were all killed shortly after by Todd, who was testing the beast’s poison. Subaru later awakened by Vincent, who was also imprisoned. After a short conversation, they met with the People of Shudrak’s leader, [[Mizelda Shudrak]]. They ultimately managed to negotiate to perform the Lifeblood Ritual. Taken to a battleground nearby, they were watched from above as they were made to fight an Elgina. Given a fire stone ring, Subaru made it their goal to destroy the Witchbeast’s horn, which would turn it docile and obey them. Taking advantage of the giant snake’s heat sensors, they were able to blind and trap it. With Vincent unable to cut its horn off, Subaru used his ring to instead blow its head off, blowing his arm off in the process. With Vincent getting him to say his wish for having won, the People of Shudrak made their way to the encampment, where they killed many of the soldiers and rescued Rem and Rui. Subaru, who awoke with his arm having regrown from a curse, passed out shortly after meeting with Rem again, and thanks to her and Rui’s efforts, he was saved, and they were brought back to the Shudrakian’s village. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 26 13.png|thumb|right|180x|Vincent declares war on Chisha.]] Vincent was impressed with the results of Subaru’s actions and that he managed to stay alive with Rem’s healing magic. Mistaking him for one of the Stargazers, Vincent decided to take him along the path to reclaiming the throne, intending to use him as a strategist of sorts. ===[[Fall of Guaral]]=== Once Subaru was awake, he took Rem and Rui and made his way to Guaral, unaware that the survivors of the encampment attack had made their way there. Upon reaching the town, he befriended [[Flop O'Connell|Flop]] and [[Medium O'Connell]]. Shortly after, he was forced to encounter Todd and retreat with the others in tow. Upon returning to the Shudrakian’s village, Subaru came up with a plan to take over Guaral without any bloodshed. Meanwhile, the soldiers continued closing up any hidden entrances into Guaral. Returning to Guaral while crossdressing, he, Vincent, Flop, Taritta, and [[Kuna Shudrak]] acted as a dance troupe and walked right through the entrance. Captivating the citizens, they were eventually invited to the main building of the town, where the soldiers were gathering, to perform for them. Having successfully infiltrated, they performed once more before successfully holding a sword at Zikr’s neck. With their victory, Subaru burned the flag atop the building. Not long after, Divine General [[Arakiya]] appeared to take defeat Vincent’s forces. Though she left Mizelda severely injured, she was countered, however, when Priscilla and Al arrived and defeated her. With Arakiya imprisoned, Todd decided to infiltrate the prisons and retrieve her. Leaving behind several bodies and using Jamal as bait, Todd managed to successfully escape with Arakiya. Because of the actions taken here, Vincent made it his priority to gain allies from among the Divine Generals in order to gain assistance from Priscilla and her camp. Deciding to take on one of the most eccentric of the generals, his goal was to make Yorna his ally. Taking Subaru, Medium, Taritta, who had become the Shudrakian chieftain, Al, and Rui, who had snuck aboard their carriage, Vincent made his way towards [[Chaosflame]]. Simultaneously, Chisha decided to take a group of his own to Chaosflame, intending to meet with Yorna before Vincent could and potentially dissuade her from becoming their ally. ===[[Destruction of Chaosflame]]=== When Vincent’s group made it to Chaosflame, they took up a room at an inn before Subaru, Medium, and Al made their way to the Crimson Lapis Castle. Managing to meet with Yorna, they also had the misfortune of meeting with Chisha and his entourage of Ubilk, Olbart, and [[Kafma Irulux]]. After successfully handing the letter to Yorna, they managed to successfully escape from the castle, having taken only a single hit each from Olbart. That night, Subaru’s group returned to the inn while Yorna’s assistant, [[Tanza]], schemed with Olbart. The next day, Subaru, Medium, and Al found themselves infantilized, and they met shortly after with the cause of it. After proposing a game when Subaru called him out on his wish for posthumous infamy, he went to hide. After finding him the first time, they were forced to handle an ambush lying in wait by the Chaosflame citizens. This eventually resulted in Rui’s abilities awakening and Subaru being forced to reveal her identity. Because of their reactions, Subaru and Rui ran away. Having an idea of where to find Tanza, who they speculated to have masterminded the event, Vincent’s group made their way toward the inn Chisha was waiting in. Meanwhile, Subaru and Rui, after handling several more citizens, left to find Olbart, having been assisted by Ubilk. Inside the castle again, they encountered Yorna, and they managed to obtain her help. Atop the castle, they accidentally instigated a fight between Yorna and Olbart, and after weathering the “ten seconds of despair”, they managed to quell the fight. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 30 2.png|thumb|left|250px|Vincent goes to engage the shadow.]] Unfortunately, after Olbart tried to return Subaru to normal, Satella found Subaru again, and a shadow spilled from his body, managing to remove Olbart’s arm. This forced Yorna, the city’s residents, Kafma, and Vincent’s group to fight it off. Fortunately, thanks to Al returning to normal, Yorna’s act of blowing up the castle and town, and Tanza’s apparent sacrifice, they were able to push it back. However, Subaru and Tanza were flung across the country. Deciding to use his small state their advantage, Vincent began spreading rumors about a black-haired crown prince in order to instigate uprisings across the country and maybe keep Subaru safe. In the end, they got Yorna to ally with them, and they returned to Guaral. ===[[Flying Dragon Cataclysm]]=== Simultaneously occurring with the events in Chaosflame, the Ninth of the Nine Divine Generals, [[Madelyn Eschart]], was tasked by Berstetz with taking her dragons and attacking Guaral, as that was the city’s only true weak spot. As they rampaged throughout the city, Madelyn encountered both [[Heinkel Astrea]] and [[Schult Barielle|Schult]], intending to kill both of them. Despite this, she was interrupted by Priscilla, who intended to take the dragonkin on herself. Shortly after, [[Emilia]] arrived to assist her, and the other members of her camp helped out around town, having arrived there to retrieve Subaru and Rem. Pushed to the point of needing to use [[Mezoreia]]’s power, Madelyn managed to escape to the town’s active medical station, where Rem was using her healing magic. Mistaking the girl as an innocent, Rem went to heal her, forcing Flop to get between them when the girl reflexively attacked. When she noticed something and tried to interrogate him, Flop had Rem use this to negotiate the end of the attack. Ultimately, the dragons pulled back, and Madelyn took Rem and Flop with her back to Lupugana. ===March of the Gladiator Island=== With Todd’s feat of having managed to save Arakiya from imprisonment at Guaral, he was taken on as Arakiya’s subordinate, where he was help her improve her techniques and even direct her as needed. Similarly, with the uprisings set to begin soon, Berstetz was worried about how the gladiators on Ginunhive might be used, and as such, he sent Todd and Arakiya to deal with the entire island, and if possible, offer Gustav a promotion. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 31 13.png|thumb|right|180x|The Pleiades Battalion is formed.]] Having been flung to Ginunhive with Tanza, Subaru, having gone through a tumultuous and rough mass loop, made the decision to use his Return by Death, alongside a very potent poison made by [[Null]], and the rumors of a black-haired crown prince to ally with everyone on the island. In doing so, he befriended the members of his unit, [[Hiain Yatz]], [[Weitz Rogen]], and [[Idra Missanga]], the governor of the island, [[Gustav Morello]], all of the soldiers, all of the gladiators, and even the infantilized Cecilus, and he formed the Pleiades Battalion. Scaring off Todd and Arakiya, the Battalion started its march toward the Imperial Capital. ===The Uprisings=== When Vincent’s team arrived with the citizens of Chaosflame, the members of the Emilia Camp, Vincent’s group, and the upper ranks of the soldiers in Guaral arrived at city hall. Despite issues surrounding Rui’s presence, once Priscilla arrived, Vincent stated his intentions. Spreading the rumors of the black-haired crown prince, he would start revolts across the city. In doing so, he forced the hands of the Emilia Camp, as the people they were looking for would end up in Lupugana by the time they were ready to fight. Following the rumors that a black-haired crown prince began leading an army to reclaim the throne from his father, Vincent, the entire country rose up, using their own figureheads as excuses to rise up and fight. Under pressure of the coming war, the Divine Generals and [[Imperial Army]] were sent out to put a stop to the fights and capture the figureheads, as Vincent predicted. One such battlefield included a rebellion being quelled by Todd and Arakiya, where they completely annihilated the enemy in short order. That said, they were unable to stop the entire country’s uprising, and all of the army was forced to retreat and defend Lupugana. In the Dracroy territory, [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and Ram met with Serena Dracroy, intending to get her assistance or deal with a hindrance depending on the circumstances. Fortunately, they managed to secure her help once they heard of which side Subaru was on. Meanwhile, Subaru himself continued his march towards the Imperial Capital, stopping at numerous other settlements and expanding his Pleiades Battalion, and even obtaining new weapons and supplies to use as they traveled. ===[[Battle for the Imperial Capital]]=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 32 3.png|thumb|left|250px|The battle begins.]] Eventually, all of the rebels decided to attack the Imperial Capital. To defend them, Berstetz left Arakiya and Todd, Madelyn and Mezoreia, [[Moguro Hagane]], Olbart, and Kafma to defend the five bastion of the city. Though a massive chunk of the random races were wiped out by Olbart, Kafma, and Arakiya, eventually, the main force led by Vincent arrived. Priscilla and Yorna confronted Arakiya while Todd escaped to handle an oddity on the battlefield; Emilia confronted Madelyn and had the weaponkin retreat; a force led by the People of Shudrak, Jamal, and Heinkel fought the golems of the third bastion alongside the winged people; and [[Garfiel Tinzel]] assisted the centaurs by battling with Kafma. Garfiel ultimately managed to beat Kafma and rip a hole through the wall, but Olbart, who had managed to completely defeat the glow people, left the fourth bastion to fend off Garfiel. Simultaneously, Todd confronted the support group, fighting against [[Otto Suwen]], Medium, Al, and [[Petra Leyte]]. With everyone in a standoff, [[Frederica Baumann]] was able to inform Vincent of the situation, and he had Zikr lead the majority of his forces to the third bastion, intending to force Berstetz into firing the Magic Crystal Cannon. Not long after said forces arrived did Heinkel force Moguro’s official appearance, and Chisha gave permission to fire the cannon. This was countered, however, by the efforts of Rui and [[Beatrice]], shocking both sides. Taking advantage of the situation, Vincent called on their awaiting reinforcements and pushed the fight forward. Roswaal appeared to assist Garfiel, Ram allied with the Shudrakians, Serena appeared with her Flying Dragon Squadron, and Subaru arrived with his Pleiades Battalion. Cecilus, meanwhile, had run off, defeating several soldiers on his own and going to assist Emilia against Mezoreia. With Subaru reuniting with Beatrice and Rui and saving the spirit from vanishing, the marched toward the fourth bastion defeating the army along the way and busting through the bastion. With a new hole to enter, Subaru took Tanza, Beatrice, Rui, and Idra infiltrated the capital, leaving half his force to defend the bastion and the other half to assist in the battle. At the same time, Rem freed Goz from his imprisonment. Back at the camp, Ubilk arrived to assist Vincent in reaching the throne room, where he confronted Chisha. At the same time disturbances were felt across the battlefield. Moguro retreated to the Crystal Palace, and Mezoreia flew the same direction. After fighting off Todd and Olbart, Otto and Garfiel noticed something strange from the insects and earth. Finally, Arakiya was ultimately defeated before something appeared before them. In the palace, however, Chisha was killed by the [[Undead|undead]] [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], triggering the start of the Great Disaster. ==Aftermath== Because of the Great Disaster, everyone was forced to move. Moguro helped Vincent escape and fought Balleroy, though he was interfered with by Mezoreia, who came to assist Balleroy. Goz and Bertetz confronted the undead [[Lamia Godwin]], but they were forced to leave when faced with the other deceased Imperial Family members. On the ground, Vincent called for a mass retreat from the city on both sides. Elsewhere, Subaru had found Rem and the other black-haired crown princes. However, Todd was also there for his fiancée, [[Katya Aurélie]]. Though they decided to work together to escape, Todd ultimately decided to kill Subaru after a fight with the undead [[Izmail]]. Thanks to Rem and Emilia, the latter of which helped the citizens escape the city, Todd was defeated, and they retreated. Elsewhere, however, Cecilus came face to face with the leader of the Great Disaster, [[Sphinx]], in front of the damaged reservoir. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Vollachia Empire]] [[Category:Lupugana]] [[Category:Chaosflame]] [[Category:Ginunhive]]

[[Sphinx]] defeated and abducted |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Invasion of the Royal Castle''' (''unofficial name'') is a battle that took place during the [[Demi-Human War]] 43 years before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world. This battle marked a serious change for the entire war, as the three major commanders, including the [[undead]] [[Libre Fermi]], attempted to take the Royal Castle for themselves. However, despite their efforts, they were unable to do so. Libre was completely destroyed, [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] was defeated and was imprisoned beneath the mansion of [[Miklotov McMahon]], and [[Sphinx]] lost her limbs and escaped, only to be secretly captured by [[Leip Barielle]]. Despite this battle being so major, the war did not end, and the Demi-Human Alliance continued fighting under the banner of [[Cragrell Dawson]]. ==Background== Due to the mass of casualties caused by the [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], a large number of warriors, both human and [[Demi-Human|demi-human]], were risen as corpse soldiers. Because of this and the massive loss of their army, the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]]'s [[Royal Army|forces]] were forced to retreat. Though Valga and the Demi-Human Alliance kept relatively quiet over the following month, they obtained new allies from the various demi-humans who had previously remained neutral, and the Kingdom remained vigilant as they reorganized their military, with the Zergev Squadron also being rebuilt. Leip was punished and demoted to a baron, being tasked with guarding the castle, and [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]] was tasked with patrolling the [[Royal Capital]], which at times led to him being forced to slay any dissenters, one of which claimed that the capital would also face destruction. Eventually, fires and fights began popping up across the nation, and the regional lords were forced to contend with their rebellions on their own with their own forces since the army's numbers had not recovered. Although [[Bordeaux Zergev]] expected this was a part of Valga's plan, he was surprised at how underthought it was, allowing his spite to sway his thoughts. However, remembering what one of the dissenters he slayed said, as well as Valga's victories at both the [[Battle of Castour Field]] and Aihiya Swamp, Wilhelm deduced that the uprisings all over the country were just a distraction and that the capital and castle were the real targets. Trusting this judgment, Bordeaux led the Zergev Squadron to the castle to defend it. Meanwhile, Valga's company had already breached the castle, having used secret tunnels in the sewers to enter, and they killed several knights that were left to guard the castle. Just before the Zergev Squadron reached the castle, they were stopped by the castle's knights, which included Leip, who chastised them for their actions. However, thanks to the assistance of [[Roswaal J. Mathers]], she ordered the knights to stand down and for the Zergev Squadron to defend the castle. As such, the Zergev Squadron split up to defend the castle, and Wilhelm left Grimm with Roswaal to defend her alongside [[Carol Remendis]]. Shortly after entering the empty castle, Wilhelm realized where the enemy might strike, and he and Bordeaux split up, Wilhelm taking Roswaal's group with him. ==Battle== ===The Battle in the Audience Chamber=== [[File:Re Zero Ex Volume 2 8.png|thumb|right|180x|Bordeaux clashing with Libre's corpse.]] Shortly after arriving in the audience chamber, Bordeaux came across the undead Libre, who succeeded in drawing the first blood. Although disappointed by not being able to fight Sphinx, being given a chance to avenge Pivot's death, he readied his halberd and clashed with Libre. Throughout the fight, Bordeaux found himself marked with wounds, and he realized that if Libre had still been alive, he would have been terrifying to fight. Still, he eventually managed to push through Libre's attacks, and he struck at Libre. However, instead of being able to finish him off, a blast from an Al Jiwald broke through the floor, and the two fell beneath. ===The Battle in the Chapel=== Shortly after arriving at the chapel, Wilhelm's group came across signs of battle and several headless knights, evidence that the enemy had already appeared in the castle. Opening the chapel, the group encountered Valga and Sphinx. Valga claimed to not be surprised that Wilhelm killed Libre, having not been told the truth, and Sphinx, seeing Roswaal determined that the [[Gionis Lugunica|king]] would not be appearing, Roswaal having already ensured that the king would be elsewhere. With Wilhelm and Valga claiming they knew how to arrive at the castle, everyone prepared to fight, with Valga using the magic circle, the bones of his ancestors, and a massive amount of mana to greatly increase the size of his body. After swinging his fist and knocking Grimm and Carol away, Sphinx left through the broken ceiling of the chapel, and Wilhelm to Roswaal to take the others and chase after her while he battled Valga. As they fought, Wilhelm narrowly avoided Valga's strikes and found that he couldn't pierce through his skin, and eventually, Valga landed a critical hit on him. Despite this, Wilhelm emerged from the rubble and managed to slash into Valga's eye, and immediately after, damaged joints in his fingers and his lip. Despite this, Valga managed to land another hit on him. Soon after, Valga's injuries began healing. Striking Wilhelm once more, he prepared to finish him off, only for Grimm to appear and stop Valga's strike while Carol and Bordeaux attacked, breaking Valga's fingers. His life saved, the fight continued without anyone interfering. [[File:Re Zero Ex Volume 2 10.png|thumb|left|180x|Wilhelm tearing the ancestral bones out of Valga.]] As Wilhelm continued to dodge Valga's endless swings, he eventually managed to reach his blade that was lodged in the giant's lip, and he tore it out. After slashing his fingernails off, Wilhelm targeted Valga's chest, tearing it open and removing the bones that had increased Valga's size. With his body shrunk to normal size, Wilhelm and Valga clashed one last time, with Valga causing massive damage to the chapel and Wilhelm dealing untold damage onto Valga. With the floor of the chapel collapsing, Valga fell into the hole. ===The Witch Hunt=== Chasing Sphinx onto the ground floor, Roswaal managed to deftly evade her attacks, leap into the air, and bring the [[Witch]] back to the ground, where Carol and Grimm were waiting. However, taking a strike from Grimm, Sphinx was sent flying into a wider space, where she had greater room to move. As the other chased after her, she unleashed another large spell at them. However, thanks to Roswaal's magic protection cloak, she was able to cancel the spell and prevent it from harming them. In response, Carol attacked her, evading an attack while midair, and cleaving Sphinx's left arm off. Back on the ground, Sphinx was then faced with Roswaal, who struck her from below and caused her great internal damage. However, as Carol and Roswaal came to finish her, Sphinx removed her robe, revealing a magic circle, and fired Al Jiwald at her enemies, which Grimm deflected with his shield. The blast was deflected into the ceiling, causing it to fall apart, and both Bordeaux and Libre, who were above, fell to the floor. Despite the sudden arrival and apparent reinforcement, Libre, who had regained some of his mind, cut off Sphinx's remaining arm. Immediately after, Libre's body turned to dust. With Sphinx flying away, Roswaal chased after her while the others went to assist Wilhelm. Using her steel balls, she managed to bringing Sphinx back to the ground, and she attacked with another steel ball, dealing even greater damage to Sphinx. Despite this, Sphinx managed to escape Roswaal by entering into the secret passageways beneath the castle. Having successfully made her escape, Sphinx ran until she encountered Leip, who intended to use her in his schemes. Taking her for himself, he later encountered Roswaal, who he told that he had personally finished Sphinx off and burned her remains, passing Roswaal a ring on a string as proof. With Roswaal gone, he took Sphinx back to the Barielle Domain. ==Aftermath== Due to the invasion's ultimate failure, the various uprisings across the country subsided. The Zergev Squadron were once again credited for their great achievement, and much of the cleanup was left on their shoulders. With the discovery of the passageways beneath the castle, there would need to be future studies into it and determining exactly where they lead. As for Wilhelm, he finally came to realize the meaning that he held his sword for, and eventually, he became the vice commander of the Zergev Squadron. Without their main leaders, the Demi-Human Alliance were in shambles, leading them to rely on their last remaining leader, Cragrell Dawson. Because of this, the war did not come to an end. Valga, who survived the ordeal, was discovered by [[Miklotov McMahon]] beneath the castle, and he was imprisoned beneath the McMahon Manor, where he would remain for decades. Likewise, Leip brought Sphinx back with him, intending to use her for his own plots, which would later lead to his own demise, the undead incidents in his domain, and finally, the [[Great Disaster]]. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Demi-Human War]]

title: Garkla
wikitext:
'''Garkla''' (ガークラ, ''Gākura''), also known as the '''Fortified City of Garkla''' (城塞都市ガークラ, ''Jōsai Toshi Gākura''), is a major city of the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]]. It is located in the northern part of the nation, near the country's borders with [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]] and [[Kararagi]]. It is one of the primary settings for the events of [[Arc 8]].

==Information==
Situated at an integral position alongside Vollachia's borders with the Kingdom of Lugunica and the Kararagi City-States, the Fortified City of Garkla is designed around defense, having the neighboring Mount Gildray at the back of the city and a plethora forts within, as well as large protective ramparts that envelop the city.<ref>''Garkla essentially resided alongside the national border of two countries, the neighboring being the Kingdom of Lugunica and the Kararagi City-States; with a large mountain at its back, with the numerous robust forts lining the insides of its defensive walls, the city had become an important location of mighty defenses.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref> In addition to its numerous forts, the city also has various spacious shelters that are amply stocked in case of catastrophe.<ref>''The city had plenty of shelters that were amply stocked and sufficiently spacious, which now accommodated the soldiers and refugees who had barely escaped the Imperial Capital with their lives, finally allowing them to welcome the sensation of relief. Below, several forts erected during this lifetime were used to realize that scene, but not even a single one of those buildings were under construction.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref> Despite having fully recovered from an incident leading to Garkla's destruction more than a decade before the events of the story, the completion of the reconstruction effort has intentionally not been publicized in the event of an enemy attacking on the assumption it was still being rebuilt,<ref>''Let alone citizens of other countries, the true state of affairs in the Fortified City was not even well known to the people of the Empire. If any country had taken action on the information that the Fortified City was incomplete, it would have been greeted by the perfect structure imposed by the Empire. As expected, the Empire utilized its own scandal for the sake of war; he was more impressed than he was initially surprised.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref> which Prime Minister [[Berstetz Fondalfon]] attributes to Vollachia's information control.<ref>''“If even the famous number one mage of the Kingdom was not aware, then it seems that our information control has functioned quite well.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref>

In the time between its destruction at the hands of [[Regulus Corneas]] and its reconstruction, Garkla was subject to daily attacks by several allied factions of bandits.<ref>''“The city that was destroyed by a Sin Archbishop, the place where the Eight Arms met his demise. It’s been completely rebuilt now, but it used to be under reconstruction back then, and bandits had joined forces across factions to attack it each day.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 2.</ref> It gained a reputation for being a hazardous area due to this, even after the bandit alliance was vanquished, until around one or two years before the events of [[Arc 7]].<ref>''And from then on, the Fortress City was deeply ravaged by the aftereffects of that. Its reconstruction began, but plodded along slowly, partially thanks to repeated assaults by bandits who were active in the vicinity. It was pretty much like Todd had stated, Garkla had only become seen as a city again in the past one or two years; they kept hearing about it as being a dangerous place that had not gotten any better for so long.'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 2.</ref> While under assault from the [[Undead|undead]] army in the late stages of the [[Great Disaster]], the city's ramparts, having sustained extensive damage, began undergoing repair work once the invasion had been repelled, spearheaded by army members and citizens alike.<ref>''――Presently, the place in which Subaru and Priscilla were walking together, was within the walls of the Fortified City of Garkla. The greatest fortress within the Empire, its ramparts had become extensively damaged by the advance of the undead hordes, with the citizenry and army unquestioningly working day and night to move forward the repair work.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Curtain's Close, Section 1.</ref>

==History==
The city of Garkla has been prominent for its solid defenses for many years. More than a decade prior to the events of [[Arc 5]], the [[Witch Cult]]'s [[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishop of Greed, Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]], [[Regulus Corneas]], conquered the Fortified City, single-handedly subjugating it despite the presence of thousands of stationed soldiers and the large defensive walls surrounding the city on all sides.<ref>''“The Fortified City of Garkla―― found in the south of the world map, it was known as the Vollachia Empire's most solidly defended large city along the border regions. It had thousands of standing soldiers, and multiple defensive walls enveloped the city. It was a place truly worthy of the name Fortified City, but… Greed conquered it. Single-handedly, no less.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 8]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref> The losses in the one-sided annihilation included several thousand soldiers, the destruction of several forts, and Vollachia's national hero, [[Kurgan]],<ref>''The damage to the Fortified City included the death of several thousands in the standing army, the death of the one who was considered the strongest warrior in the Vollachia Empire, Eight Arms Kurgan, and finally, the annihilation of several forts, leaving it as one of the worst losses in the history of the Empire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref><ref>''“The Fortress City was manned by such soldiers, but it fell to a single Sin Archbishop who called himself Greed. It is said that even Eight Arms Kurgan, the hero of Vollachia, was slain in that battle.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 8]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref> who gave his life to buy time for the city's people, and in particular, [[Vincent Vollachia|a young prince]] who reminded him of his [[Stride Vollachia|foster son]], to escape Regulus's rampage.<ref>''From what they stated, back then, a man of the multi-arm clan, who had been hailed as a hero some decades prior, had defended the Fortified City. The hero had bought enough time for the people of the city to escape, dying majestically in battle.'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 2.</ref> Rumors in the aftermath of the event attributed the emergence of a [[Meteor|meteor]] related to a [[Witch]] other than the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] as a possible reason for the attack, though it is unknown if this is true.<ref>''“In the Vollachia Empire to the south, rumors spread of the name of a Witch besides the Witch of Envy. A meteor supposedly related to the Witch emerged, but there is no telling whether it was true or false.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 10]], Chapter, Chapter 3, Section 1.</ref> Unbeknownst to history, however, Kurgan would go on to be resurrected as a [[Undead#Corpse Soldiers|corpse soldier]] utilized by the Witch Cult.

Around six years before Arc 7, [[Jamal Aurélie]] and [[Todd Fang]] were active in Garkla.<ref>''“It’s already been six years since I first met Jamal. It was around the time I took part in the campaign in the Fortified City of Garkla.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 2.</ref> It was under constant assault by allied bandit forces following Regulus's decimation of the city, until Jamal acted to change the situation.<ref>''“The city kept being attacked over and over again by bandits, there were many who thought about abandoning it. However, one of the key figures who broke the deadlock was Jamal.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 2.</ref> He slew a bandit leader in exchange for losing his right eye, diminishing the bandit alliance's morale and paving the way for Imperial Soldiers to subdue them.<ref>''“He slew one of the leaders of the bandits, killing the enemy’s morale. After that, the Imperial Soldiers pressed in right away and wiped them out… He managed to get that victory at the cost of one of his eyes.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 2.</ref> In spite of his achievement, Jamal sought no prize for his work,<ref>''“He seemed to think it was cool to not go around talking about it, even though what he accomplished was exceptional. And because of that, he didn’t covet any prizes for his work. To think that he could have been a General if he’d felt like it.”'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 2.</ref> as opposed to Todd, who had become one of the bandit alliance's leaders with the intent to betray them at the right moment and join the [[Imperial Army]] with a substantial accomplishment under his belt.<ref>''However, Todd had not been part of the Imperial Army then, instead he had been one of the chiefs of the bandits, who had allied with each other. His plan had been to round up all of their leaders once the alliance had grown enough and join the Imperial Soldiers having performed that great deed. But, Jamal’s heroic actions had made it all come to naught.'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 2]], Section 3.</ref> Having his scheme foiled by Jamal, Todd decided to enlist in the Imperial Army anyways after the bandit invasion's resolution.

Following its reconstruction, the Fortified City became the primary refuge for those displaced by the undead army's devastation of the [[Imperial Capital of Lupugana|Lupugana]] in the midst of the Great Disaster. [[Muspel]] of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]] had been arranged by [[Chisha Gold]] to be within Garkla during its events, but the bearer of the disaster, [[Sphinx]], had preemptively located and plundered the Stone to use as a conduit for reviving hordes of undead across the Empire. A unit dubbed the “Rescue the Vollachia Empire from Destruction Squad”, consisting of Emperor [[Vincent Vollachia]], several formidable Vollachian fighters, several [[Emilia Camp]] members, [[Spica]], and the Admirer of [[Kararagi]], [[Halibel]], was organized and ventured towards Lupugana to end the disaster, while the remainder of the combatants and non-combatants remained in the city to defend it from the advancing undead army led by [[Palladio Manesque]]. Facing total annihilation at numerous turns, Garkla ultimately managed to remain intact due to the combined efforts of the defenders. In the wake of Sphinx's demise, the remaining commander of the Garkla front, Palladio, attempted to levy a retreat, but was eradicated by Todd Fang, bringing about the total collapse of the undead army.

The sheer damage wrought to Lupugana during the Great Disaster, predominately throughout the [[Conquest of the Undead Capital]], as well as the preceding [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]], led Garkla to be selected as a substitute temporary command post. With [[Priscilla Barielle]] fading away before [[Natsuki Subaru]] and [[Al]]'s eyes atop the city's ramparts, Vincent was left as the final surviving member of Vollachia's imperial family. After saying their farewells to their Vollachian acquaintances and allies, [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]] and her companions returned to Kararagi to report on the disturbances, and the Emilia Camp departed with Al and [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] back to Lugunica, leaving behind Spica, who willingly chose to remain in the Empire to assist in chastening the lingering undead, and [[Heinkel Astrea]], who had seemingly vanished following his failed request to join [[Emilia]]'s faction.

==Locations==
*'''Great Fortress''': The largest fortress in Garkla, it is carved into the side of Mount Gildray, the mountain which neighbors the city.<ref>''In the deepest part of the city, a large fortress had been carved into the side of the adjacent Mount Gildray.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 36]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref> The fortress has multiple stories and is exceptionally spacious, with rooms such as a conference room, a command room, and an office room that Vincent has made into his primary workspace away from Lupugana.

Just back then, some of my relatives were caught up in the city when it happened. It has been more than fifteen years now; I was just a child back then, so it did not have much to do with me.”'' [[Arc 4]], Chapter 8, Section 1.</ref> and a speculated reason why he came to the city was as a result of rumors that Witch-related items had appeared on the market.<ref>''“The details of what happened are excessively boorish and leave a thin impression, but the reason the Witch Cult did such a thing was terrifying. It was the single most flourishing city of business in the insular Volallchia, however… it appears some rumors came about that Witch-related items were appearing on the market.”'' [[Arc 4]], Chapter 8, Section 1.</ref> These details were cut or changed the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (light novel)|light novel]], and the official estimates for when the incursion took place are “more than a decade ago” as of the present day and “nearly thirty years” since Kurgan had lost his reputation as of the attack.<ref>''However, the legend of the city extolled for such sturdiness had come crumbling down by hand of the Witch Cult’s Sin Archbishop of Greed, who had assailed Garkla by his lonesome over a decade prior.''
