title: Guaral
wikitext:
'''Guaral''' (グァラル, ''Guararu''), also known as the '''Fortress City of Guaral''' (城郭都市グァラル, ''Jōkaku Toshi Guararu'') is a heavily fortified Vollachian city, located near the Buddheim Jungle.

==Information==
When it was first visited by [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], the Fortress City of Guaral was surrounded by large, protective walls, only able to be entered in the east or west through large gates, and guards that conducted inspections of everyone entering and exiting the city.<ref>''Guaral was surrounded on all four sides by a protective wall, and entering or exiting to the east and west was limited by means of large gates. Even from a distance, stern guards could be seen conducting a rigorous inspection.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 27]], Chapter 2, Section 1.</ref> It could not be said to be brimming with life and its population was in the thousands; in spite of the city's population likely not reaching above ten thousand, an appropriate number of soldiers and checkpoints were within its confines.<ref>''――It was hard to say Guaral was brimming with life for a city. The queued checkpoints, and the boorish dark colors of the streets stood out. Altogether, the place’s impression was a far cry from gorgeous. The size of the city too, appeared to be in the thousands.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 27]], Chapter 2, Section 1.</ref><ref>''The scale of the city probably did not reach 10,000 people in size, but there should be a suitable number of soldiers protecting the city’s law and order to match.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 27]], Chapter 4, Section 3.</ref> Compared to the cities of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]], Guaral's aesthetic had been more rustic, devoid of color, and prioritized utility over flashiness.<ref>''So to speak, compared to the parallel fantasy world noble-like feel of the Kingdom, the stores and houses in the streets of the Empire seemed more rustic and devoid of color. It gave an impression of valuing utility over showiness.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 27]], Chapter 2, Section 1.</ref> In the event of an enemy attack, alarm bells would be rung.

In the immediate aftermath of the [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm]], the destruction that the flying dragons had rained unto the city from the heavens destroyed the defensive wall around the city's perimeter, left countless boulders scattered around, and demolished numerous buildings, leaving less than half of them left.<ref>''The splendid defensive wall that surrounded the city had been destroyed, and the numerous boulders that had been dropped from on high were still scattered around the city. The damage to the buildings was extensive, less than half of them having survived unscathed. A fair number of people had died, and the house where Emilia and her group were sleeping, with its second floor collapsed, was one that no longer had residents to return to it.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref> Although work to repair the city's demolition was commenced as quickly as possible, Guaral's defensive capabilities had been significantly diminished, with its western wall being in a grim state and its southern wall having been razed to the ground, and a fair number of its residents had died.<ref>''Having been assailed by countless flying dragons, the walls of the famed Fortress City of Guaral had been severely damaged. The damage yielded by the boulders thrown from a high altitude had been extensive, and although the crumbling, demolished walls were being repaired as fast as possible, the city’s defensive abilities were considerably lowered.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref><ref>''In particular, the city’s southern wall had been the one to suffer the greatest damage. The western wall, which had borne the first attack, was also in a rather horrible state, but that was nothing compared to this. Forget about the wall, the entire area had been razed to the ground.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref>

==History==
As a city with a storied history, Guaral has faced many occurrences of people finding ways to bypass its outer walls, resulting in there being a number of hidden entrances scattered throughout it.

Subaru first arrived in Guaral with [[Rem]] and [[Spica|Rui]] when he was attempting to leave Vollachia, with [[Kuna Shudrak]] and [[Holly Shudrak]] as escorts outside of the city. He met and quickly befriended [[Flop O'Connell|Flop]] and [[Medium O'Connell]]. His short-lived peace was interrupted when the Imperial Soldier he had crossed paths with before, [[Todd Fang]], discovered his presence in Guaral and attempted to eliminate him. Overcoming several death loops to overcome Todd, he was forced to retreat with Rem and Rui and bring the O'Connell siblings to prevent Todd from murdering Flop, just barely escaping from the soldier, his cohort, [[Jamal Aurélie]], and the unit called to hinder their escape by calling for Kuna and Holly's aid.

Anticipating a surprise attack, the acting General administering Guaral, [[Zikr Osman]], made efforts to rigorously locate and seal all of the Fortress City's hidden entrances. A group consisting of Kuna and [[Taritta Shudrak]], as well as the crossdressing trio of Subaru, Flop, and [[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent Abellux]], infiltrated the city from the front gate by posing as dancers. They used this tactic to make their way into the City Hall, where Vincent put an unsheathed sword to Zikr's throat, completing the [[Fall of Guaral]] with a bloodless siege. The rest of their group made their way into the city and Subaru burned the flag on the roof at Vincent's request, catching the attention of Todd and Jamal. However, [[Arakiya]] suddenly appeared, injuring the leg of [[Mizelda Shudrak]] in the process, and aiming to assassinate Vincent. However, [[Priscilla Barielle]] descends from the sky to confront Arakiya, and [[Al]] enters City Hall not that long after. In the end, Arakiya was beaten and taken prisoner in City Hall's basement.

Their victory and proceeding discussion was short-lived, however, as once Jamal perceived Arakiya's identity and he and Todd realized she lost, they slipped into City Hall to retrieve her and make their escape. Once they had no other way out, Jamal left Arakiya's getaway to Todd, and “sacrificed” himself to save the two, falling in battle and becoming a captive in the process. With several Divine Generals already against Vincent's plan to return to the throne, he made it his goal to acquire more Divine Generals than the enemy faction, led by [[Berstetz Fondalfon]]. Mizelda's injury forced her to pass on the position of chieftain of the People of Shudrak to her sister, Taritta. The fatalities of seven soldiers hurt Subaru, who had proposed the bloodless siege plan to avoid causing any casualties. Rem lambasted Subaru for his mindset, telling him that he was not a hero, breaking him until Al helped pick him back up. To start with, Vincent charted a course for the [[Chaosflame|Demon City of Chaosflame]], intending to recruit Divine General [[Yorna Mishigure]] to his faction. A group consisting of him, Subaru, Al, Medium, and Taritta set course for Chaosflame, oblivious that Rui had joined them with [[Utakata Shudrak|Utakata Shudrak's]] assistance.

Following Guaral's fall, rumours concerning the person responsible for orchestrating the city's capture, the black-haired maiden “Natsumi Schwartz”, began spreading throughout the Empire. At the behest of [[Berstetz Fondalfon]], [[Madelyn Eschart]] arrived to lay waste to Guaral from the skies in order to impede Vincent's counterattack, instigating what would come to be known as the Flying Dragon Cataclysm. She was directly confronted by [[Heinkel Astrea]], with Flop, [[Schult Barielle|Schult]], and Utakata on the side. Making quick work of Heinkel and failing to maim Schult due to the usage of the Soul Marriage Technique, the one responsible for using it on him, [[Priscilla Barielle]], arrived to challenge her. The two began to clash, only for Priscilla to be joined by [[Emilia]], whose arrival with the [[Emilia Camp]] coincided with the Flying Dragon Cataclysm. The two fended off Madelyn together and pressured her to resort to calling for [[Mezoreia]] to attack them, making her escape from the duo in the process. She then happened upon Rem and Flop, attempting to attack the Oni girl on what seemed to be defensive instinct rather than actual killing intent, and Flop pushed her out of the way, receiving a fatal injury from Madelyn. When she noticed the fang of [[Carillon]] hanging around his neck, she allowed Rem to activate healing magic on him, but at Flop's request, he was not healed fully. Realizing his intent, Rem gave Madelyn the ultimatum to either completely suspend the attack on Guaral and have her heal Flop, or stay and allow him to die, to which she accepted the former option, ending the invasion.

Once the group from Chaosflame arrived at the devastated Fortress City, a meeting between them, the parties already present in Guaral, including several of the Emilia Camp's members, who had arrived in response to the rumours of Natsumi Schwartz's involvement in Guaral's fall, was held, where it was determined that they were to launch an [[Battle for the Imperial Capital|invasion]] on the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]]. Madelyn's assault on Guaral had tremendous shockwaves throughout the country, as the rumour of a rebel army repelling a Divine General triggered various uprisings across Vollachia all at once, kicking the [[Imperial Civil War]] into full gear.<ref>''Ironically, what had ended up triggering those rebels’ simultaneous uprisings was the battle at the Fortress City of Guaral, which also caused the abduction of Rem and many others―― the Imperial Army’s all-out offensive, with even a Divine General having been dispatched, had been narrowly staved off by the hodgepodge rebel army.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 3, Section 4.</ref><ref>''There even was a rumor praising an indomitable city which splendidly repelled the merciless attack led by the Flying Dragon General, further boosting the belief that there was naught to fear from an Imperial Army helplessly driven away.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 3, Section 4.</ref>

==Locations==
*'''City Hall''': The City Hall of Guaral. It was requisitioned by the [[Imperial Army]] regiment during the occupation of the city, later becoming a provisional base of operations for Vincent and his allies. It has multiple stories, a basement where prisoners are ordinarily held while awaiting trial by the mayor, a treasury where money is stored, and an office intended for the city's mayor. Zikr used the office during his occupation, and Vincent took it over once he gained control of the city. The roof and upper areas of the building were destroyed in Arakiya's attack.
*'''Large Mansion''': The largest mansion in Guaral. Second in size to City Hall, it could accommodate twenty to thirty people. Due to its luxurious bathhouse and her unwillingness to stay at a small lodging or in solders' barracks, Priscilla seized the mansion by force, much to its original owners' dismay, to use as a temporary residence while in the city.

title: Oni
wikitext:
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 3 3.png|thumb|250px]]
The '''Oni Tribe''' (鬼族, ''Onizoku'') were a manufactured race of [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] designed to smell miasma. Though they existed for a long time, they have nearly been wiped out by the [[Witch Cult]].

==Information==
[[File:Rem-Oni mod.gif|thumb|left|250px|Rem's horn protruding from her head.]]
A demi-human race manufactured in the ancient past, the Oni Tribe was created with the ability to smell miasma.<ref>''Created in ancient times to oppose a lone Witch who charmed all, whom even the wordless great spirit obeyed, they were beings devised for the purpose of fighting, much like the Oni Tribe that could sense miasma.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 2, Section 5.</ref> Despite this, for unknown reasons, most modern oni were unable to smell miasma, and very few manifested the ability to catch its scent. While mostly identical to humans, the primary characteristic distinguishing oni from humans were their two inborn mana-absorbing horns, organs that differed in appearance from oni to oni that they could manifest from and retract into their foreheads at will.<ref>''A horn: it was an organ unique to the Oni Tribe, and proof that she was an Oni. Of course, everyone in this place had a horn. However, everyone had two of them.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref> They rapidly drew mana from the atmosphere, greatly enhancing an oni’s physical strength and magic capabilities, heightened sensitivity to mana and emotions or intentions hidden in mana, the sharpness of their nails,<ref>''Ram roared, jumping right and left with her small body, and she fatally gouged the black clothed beings’ bodies with her own nails. Their heads, faces, and chests were torn up like paper, and the black clothed beings fell mercilessly before the unbelievable difference in power.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> and limited regeneration.<ref>''Her white kimono was torn into pieces, and the intense bleeding was creating a pool of blood at her feet. Her delicate body had a painful laceration──however, the wound healed within an instant in response to the radiance of Ram’s horn. The regenerating flesh emitted extremely hot heat, and the wound generated red steam. Taking all the mana in the atmosphere and changing it into power to fight was a special characteristic of the oni’s horn. Ram had an outstanding horn, so she could easily heal non-fatal wounds. However, it was never something that could help with pain and fatigue.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 1, Section 1.</ref> However, in this state, an oni could lose control of themselves, acting only on instinct. In order to stop an oni in a rampaging state, striking or biting the horn can cause such elicit sensations that the oni will fall unconscious.<ref>''The next moment, her arms that she uncontrollably shook stopped, and Rem lost the strength in her body. The cause was the horn──the organ that was the source of an oni’s strength, and the thing that had to be what made Rem go out of control. Ram, having responsibility for that horn, bit on it as she stimulated it to caress it with her tongue. Rem gave in to that electrifying, sweet feeling, and she broke down. Because of that and her chaotic state of mind, Rem fell onto the bed sideways.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> At one point, with their high mana potency, they were considered the mightiest of demi-humans.<ref>''Onis and humans looked like two peas in a pod with their appearances, but they were unmistakably true demi-humans. They had the best body and mental strength for demi-humans, and they earned the title as the world’s strongest race.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref> Their strength made the onis prideful, giving them the mentality that they were superior to all other races.<ref>''The Oni Tribe valued their pride and strength more than anything. That made the Oni Tribe what it was today.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref> As a way to maintain purity and pride in themselves, the onis lived isolated from other races.

Without a horn, an oni was made weaker and frailer without the use of their full power, derided as '''hornless''' (ツノナシ, ''tsunonashi''), and acquired difficulties with taking mana into their bodies, requiring supplementary mana from another person directly sent into the location of their broken horn in order to survive. Attempting to use their power for more than a few seconds while in this state also left them bleeding from the strain. If twins were born, they would have one horn each, and thus be typically weaker than a typical oni. Because of this, having one horn is seen as cursed and abominable,<ref>''“One horn… They’re cursed children after all.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref><ref>''On that baby’s forehead, there was only one horn. It was only a single horn, something abominable to the Oni Tribe. It was proof of being damaged, a symbol of being incomplete, an absence that defiled pride, the lack of a horn──and yet.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref> and as such, it was ritual to murder twins after birth as a way to maintain the tribe’s place as the strongest of demi-humans. They also revered the [[Minor Characters#Oni God|Oni God]], a powerful oni from the era of Witches, lauding them as the exemplar of their clan. Led by their chieftain [[Setanta]], the Oni Clan believed, after seeing her strength after birth, that [[Ram]] was the Reincarnation of the Oni God,<ref>''The Reincarnation of the Oni God, the Oni Tribe's old pride whose name was engraved in the same age as that of the Witch―― such was the wish which the last Oni chieftain, whose people had forsaken the battlefield, prayed to see fulfilled in the child prodigy named Ram.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 25]], Chapter 7, Section 1.</ref> and her strength only increased with age. Moreover, when Ram still had her horn, she often had the impulse to attack others, and after it was cut off, this impulse stopped afflicting her.

<gallery type="slideshow">
Rem - Synesthesia.gif|Rem's Synesthesia.
Ram - Clairvoyance.gif|Ram's Clairvoyance.
</gallery>
Uniquely, there is a case in which twins were able to share their power with each other. After Ram lost access to most of her power after losing her horn, she was able to draw on her comatose sister’s power via '''Synesthesia''' (共感覚, ''Kyōkankaku''), an ability that she shares with her sister that allows them to share their feelings and emotions with each other through telepathy,<ref>''"The feelings I am picking up from Sister are partly unease and largely… anger."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 5]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref><ref>''Synesthesia─ A rare transmission between twins and siblings where emotions went from one person to another. Rem was struck by that lightning, and she looked up at the sky with wide eyes. She felt like her sister told her to not take her eyes off of it──'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 5.</ref> to access her own power, [[Rem]]’s own horn protruding from her head in response.<ref>''"The sharing of the horn's might utilizing Synesthesia had already been undone, so no horn was present on her forehead."'' [[Arc 6]], Chapter 86, Section 5.</ref> As an oni herself, her body was better built for handling the power. However, as the power Ram had was excessive even for a member of her tribe, the backlash left her sister unable to walk without assistance, as the sharing of her power interrupted the mana flow within her body. This power also allowed the two to alert each other of danger, as well as let them feel each other when they are apart. They also possessed certain secret arts that were passed down through the tribe, one such ability being '''Clairvoyance''' (千里眼, ''Senrigan''),<ref>''Ram started using Clairvoyance, a secret skill of the onis.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 5, Section 4.</ref> which allows the user to synchronize with the vision of other living beings, which, while leaving the user defenseless, allows the user to surveil areas over a wide range.<ref>''"Clairvoyance" was a secret skill that only onis could use. The person putting it into practice can see scenes far away by synchronizing with someone’s vision if they are within perception range and their mana wavelengths match. By synchronizing with another person in that field of vision and increasing the range over and over, it’s possible to literally see 1000 miles away.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref>

Despite their recognition as the strongest of demi-humans, they were eventually feared for their strength by the other races, being persecuted in a manner similar to the elves and giants for the fear of the return of the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]].<ref>''For many people, the Oni Tribe’s power that overwhelmed other races became something to fear and drive out. To put it appropriately, for the people afraid of the return of the Witch of Envy, it seemed really close to how the Elves became persecuted. Similarly, it’s said that in ancient times there was also a similar type of rejection towards giants.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref> With their excessive strength and their extremely low reproductive ability,<ref>''The Oni Tribe’s downfall──there were two causes that stood out noticeably above the rest for the impending historical demise.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref><ref>''First of all, there was the fact that the Oni Tribe was too strong.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref><ref>''And then there was the second cause, the Oni Tribe’s reproduction ability. Onis were strong as individuals, but on the other hand, their ability to bear children was remarkably poor, and they couldn’t increase their numbers like other races could.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref> their population decreased rapidly, they disappeared from the center stage of history, and they had to live in villages in the mountains.<ref>''The Oni Tribe population decreased rapidly as a result of that and the rejection from other races. They disappeared from the center stage of history, and they had to live in villages in the mountains. And so, even after that, the Oni Tribe’s numbers continued to decrease slowly──the destruction of the Oni Tribe’s final village was also now in front of their eyes.</ref> Eventually, the onis were effectively wiped out by the Witch Cult before the events of the story, with the final village, the home of Rem and Ram, being slaughtered by Witch Cultists, leaving the twins as the two lone survivors of their race. According to [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], the onis’ demise was due to natural selection rather than discrimination or prejudice, as they refused to accept new ideals and were left in the past as a result.

==Trivia==
*Non-canonically, [[Reize]], a survivor of a [[Kararagi]]an oni village destroyed by the Witch Cult, awakened her ability to smell the scent of the Witch after [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|someone]] poured a strange liquid into her ear. Whether this unlocked this ability from within her or gave her the ability artificially is unknown, and the purpose this was done for is unknown.
*After Ram’s horn was severed from her body, it was fashioned into a wand.<ref>''"I will be selfish if I want to. That's why I made a wand out of your horn,"'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref>
*The Oni Tribe seemed to have something akin to kindergarten within their village; Ram, and maybe Rem, had apparently once taken such classes.<ref>''"It seems it would be a school where children around the age of four or five would attend; Ram had gone to something similar back in her home village."'' [[Ram and the Night Study Group]]</ref>
*It is believed that the Oni God once lost in a drinking competition with [[Reid Astrea]],<ref>''“Certainly, there is no time to recite the legend Reid Astrea etched into posterity in all parts of the world. Speaking of things he was famous for… the fight where he slayed a hundred Dragons, or his battle achievement of six thousand undefeated victories recorded in the arena of the Gladiator Island. The victor of a drinking competition with the existence known as the Oni God, such varieties are also there.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 24]], Chapter 2, Section 6.</ref> and according to legend, they were rumored to have been felled by the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]] at some point.<ref>''It was a legendary object said to have slain Witches, Dragons, and the Oni God. There was no end to the tales associated with it, but the only thing that could be said for sure was――, ――Once the Dragon Sword was drawn, it had never once been sheathed without first cutting something.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 4, Section 2.</ref>
*Although [[Minor Characters#Advan|Advan]] is referred to as the Blood-Weeping Oni, it is unknown whether they were truly an oni.
*The People of Shudrak have a recognition-obscuring mask that is based on the Oni Clan.<ref>''A mask that took after the Oni Tribe, a clan created for the sake of killing the most terrifying existences in the world, making those gazing upon it to avert their eyes in fear of what laid on the other side of the mask.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 105, Section 3.</ref>
*In [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Ram is called the final Oni God, implying that there had been more than one in history. As there is only one known historical Oni God, it is unknown if this statement is true.<ref>''This was the day when the Oni Tribe, which had their slow destruction right before their eyes, witnessed the birth of the final Oni God.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Prologue.</ref>
*The onis' funeral rites include taking alcohol and pouring it over the grave of the deceased.<ref>''While still feeling deep emotions lingering inside, Rem took out a sake bottle from the hand luggage as instructed by Ram. They combined their pay and chose the most valuable alcohol to Roswaal. Ram took it, removed the cork without hesitation, and poured alcohol on the cenotaph as an offering. ──Oni funerals were kind of inappropriate, but no adults were there to criticize them. That’s why they brought what was the most important gift for a funeral, used to put souls to rest.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Epilogue, Section 3.</ref>
*Although there were days of celebration in the oni village, most of them celebrated Ram's birth.<ref>''Rem, who got informed about festivals, understood the flamboyant atmosphere of people passing by the capital. She sure was getting glimpses of faces that were more or less carefree. The oni village also had customs for days of celebration. ──Although, they were mostly days where Ram’s birth was celebrated.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]], Chapter 4, Section 1.</ref>
*Due to the tribe’s stance on purity, it is unclear how they viewed a child between the union of an oni and another race.
**Although not canon, [[Natsuki Rigel]] and [[Natsuki Spica]] are the only examples of oni half-breeds.

[[Reinhard van Astrea]] |forces2 = [[Elsa Granhiert]] |forces3 = |forces4 = |casual1 = [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and [[Rom]] heavily injured |casual2 = [[Elsa Granhiert|Elsa]] heavily injured |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Loot House Incident''' (''unofficial name'') is an event that took place on the very day that [[Natsuki Subaru]] was summoned to the world. It is the primary conflict of [[Arc 1]], and it is the event that marked the start of the story of [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu|Re:Zero]]. On the day of his summoning, a young girl named [[Felt]] stole a certain item from one of the [[Royal Selection]] Candidates, a certain [[Emilia|silver-haired half elf]]. In an attempt to save her, Subaru, who had learned of the power of Return by Death and knew of the fate that awaited both the thief and the girl, confronted them in the Loot House, located in the slums of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]’s [[Royal Capital]], and they fought with their would-be assassin, the infamous [[Elsa Granhiert|Bowel Hunter]]. Although it required the assistance of the Sword Saint, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], they were able to emerge victorious. This incident would be the start of many major changes across the world; as a result of this major incident, Subaru would come to be heavily involved with the Royal Selection, while Felt would be recognized as its fifth and final candidate. ==Background== ===The Fourth Candidate of the Royal Selection=== One day, Margrave [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] had learned through his Book of Wisdom of the existence of a boy who would one day appear in the Royal Capital with the power to challenge and overcome fate and that he was destined to fall in love with a silver-haired half elf named Emilia. Realizing that this boy was necessary to accomplish his goal of reviving his long deceased teacher, [[Echidna]], Roswaal began making preparations to retrieve him. One day, several months after the deaths of the [[Royal Family]] of Lugunica and the beginning of the Royal Selection, Roswaal traveled to [[Elior Forest]], where Emilia resided, with the intent to involve her in the Royal Selection as its fourth participant. Upon meeting her, he was faced with the [[Spirit#Great Spirit|Great Spirit]] [[Puck]], also known as the Beast of the End, who was acting as both Emilia’s contracted [[spirit]] and her guardian. Suspicious of the man’s intentions and refusing to let him take Emilia, Puck fought with Roswaal for half a day. After their battle, however, when Roswaal dropped the Dragon Insignia in her hand, causing its jewel to glow, signifying her worthiness to become a Dragon Maiden and the Kingdom’s monarch, and enticed her with the [[Dragon]]’s Blood that was stored away in the castle, which was said to have very potent healing properties which could potentially melt away the ice coating Elior Forest, Emilia decided to accept his offer, and she and Puck followed him back to his [[Roswaal Manor|manor]] so that she could be educated about the world around her. ===The Theft of the Dragon Insignia=== [[File:Re Zero Felt-chan's Job SS.png|thumb|right|180x|Felt stealing the Dragon Insignia from Emilia.]] A few months later, with the arrival of Subaru imminent, Emilia and one of Roswaal's maids, [[Ram]], were sent to the Royal Capital. Afterward, Roswaal hired Elsa to have the Dragon Insignia stolen from Emilia, giving her a cloak that could completely nullify one burst of [[magic]]. In the capital, Elsa then hired a young girl named Felt, an expert thief, to retrieve the insignia for her, and they agreed to meet in the Loot House. Meanwhile, Emilia and Ram were split up from each other, resulting in Emilia wandering around town with Puck. At one point, Felt managed to find a good opportunity to snatch the insignia, and she escaped, Emilia chasing after her. ===[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1|The Tumultuous First Day]]=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 1 7.png|thumb|left|180x|Subaru’s first experience with death.]] Shortly before the theft, Natsuki Subaru, who had bought some things from a convenience store near his home, found himself summoned from his world to the Royal Capital, much to his shock. As he wandered around, realizing that he wasn’t given any kind of special ability typically granted to isekai protagonists, he was assailed by a group of thugs, who he later refers to as [[Gaston|Ton]], [[Rachins Hoffman|Chin]], and [[Camberley|Kan]]. Shortly after that, Felt, escaping from Emilia, ran past them, and Emilia and Puck, who had arrived shortly after, helped and healed Subaru. Smitten at first glance and given by her the false name of [[Satella]], he started to accompany her after she explained her circumstances, eventually leading them towards the Loot House, where Felt was likely to have gone. Inside, Subaru, instead of finding Felt, found signs of conflict, a large amount of blood, and the corpse of an [[Rom|old giant]] on the floor. Immediately after, he was fatally wounded by the giant’s killer, and when “Satella” came inside, she was killed. As he promised to save her, however, he died. Despite experiencing his death, however, Subaru awoke in front of an [[Kadomon Risch|appa seller]] he stood in front of earlier that day. Shortly after, he was confronted by Ton, Chin, and Kan, but unlike before, he knocked each of them out. Confused but realizing that something bad was about to happen, he rushed to the Loot House, where he encountered the old giant, Rom, still alive, and shortly after, Felt. Intending to give back the insignia they stole, he entered negotiations with them, when Elsa appeared. With Elsa joining the table, she offered her compensation to buy the Insignia from them, but because Rom had determined that Subaru’s phone, which was claimed to be a [[meteor]], would fetch a higher price, Subaru won at the negotiations. However, after he replied to Elsa about his intentions, Elsa revealed herself to be an assassin, and she killed everyone in the Loot House. After this, Subaru awoke in front of the appa seller again and saw “Satella”, who he called out to. However, insulted, she rejected him for using the name of the Witch of Envy, resulting in Felt stealing from her, and shortly after, Subaru’s death by the hands of Chin. Awaking again in front of the appa seller, he realized what he was experiencing and dubbed it Return by Death. Again, like in each of the previous loops, he met Ton, Chin, and Kan, and instead of ignoring them or beating them up, he called for help, summoning Reinhard van Astrea to the scene and scaring them off. After thanking him, Subaru made for the slums, leaving Reinhard, who was curious, behind. On the way, he encountered Elsa, and after separating from her, he met with Felt. After a short conflict with her, he managed to get her to listen to him, and they made their way to the Loot House once again. ==Battle== Inside the Loot House, Subaru used his knowledge from the future and used his phone as a bargaining chip to try and obtain the Insignia, attempting to get the group out of danger before Elsa could arrive. However, before he could make a deal with them, Emilia appeared in front of them, her magic at the ready as she demanded her insignia back. Subaru was surprised by her presence and realized that she had gotten to the Loot House much sooner compared to when he met her in his first loop. This led to a misunderstanding on Felt’s part that this was a trap he had set up. However, before the conversation could go any further, Subaru noticed Elsa’s attack and called out to Puck to shield her, allowing him to block Elsa’s attack with a shield of ice. As Elsa resolved to kill everyone, Subaru distracted her long enough to allow Puck to use his magic against her, which she shielded with the cloak she received from Roswaal, using up its one and only use. Afterward, Emilia and Puck attempted to land several strikes on her, and after she was able to evade or block the attacks, her feet were frozen to the ground, allowing Puck to land a larger barrage of attacks all at once. However, she had cut the soles of her feet off to escape, and as his time ran out, Puck was forced to pull back as a condition of his and Emilia’s contract. Forced to defend herself from Elsa’s onslaught of attacks, she was eventually knocked off balance and pushed back, which allowed Rom to act and attack Elsa with his club. However, she was able to deal with him easily, and if not for Felt throwing a blade at her, she would have killed Rom. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 1 12.png|thumb|right|180x|Felt receiving Reinhard’s assistance.]] As she decided to attack Felt, Subaru jumped and pulled her out of the way, and Emilia soon returned to face Elsa. Afterward, Subaru grabbed Rom’s club and helped distract Elsa for Felt to escape, kicking away an attack that Elsa had aimed at her. As the two distracted her, Felt ran through the slums calling for someone to help when came across Reinhard in a flower field. Offering his assistance, the two returned to the Loot House, and busting through the roof, Reinhard stopped Elsa from killing Subaru. As he took over the fight, he left Rom’s care to Emilia and Subaru, distracting Elsa long enough that Emilia could heal him and save him from danger. Eventually, once she fully healed Rom, Reinhard used up the proxy sword he was using to devastate both Elsa and the Loot House. Just as things were starting to calm down, however, Elsa emerged from the rubble intent on killing Emilia, and Subaru, still holding Rom’s club, blocked her attack. As she threw a blade at Reinhard and made a threat to everyone in the room, she made her escape. Afterward, after Subaru assured her that he was fine, he introduced himself to Emilia, and as a reward for what he did, he asked for her name, which he received. However, just a moment later, the wound in his stomach that he received when he blocked Elsa opened, and Subaru blacked out. ==Aftermath== After Subaru fell unconscious, Emilia healed him just enough so that his life wasn’t in danger. This prompted Reinhard to question their relationship, but she claimed to not know him, much to both of their shocks. Though Reinhard offered to take him back to his place, Emilia decided to return with him to Roswaal Manor to understand what his intentions were. After discussing what would happen with Felt and Rom, Felt decided to return the Insignia as thanks for saving them. However, after witnessing its glow in her hand and realizing her features were a rough match for the Lugunican Royal Family’s, Reinhard knocked her out and decided to take her back to the Astrea Manor, where he intended to hide her in secret until the day she would be revealed as the fifth and final Royal Selection Candidate. Soon after, Ram found her way to the Loot House, and Emilia and Reinhard went their separate ways. Meanwhile, Elsa retreated elsewhere in the Royal Capital, intending for her wounds to recover. However, as they weren’t recovering like they should have, [[Meili Portroute]] had to retrieve her and patch up her wounds at their makeshift hideout. After she recovered, she went out into the town and caused bloodshed to gain some new clothes, and with Meili’s help to change their hair colors with part of a [[witchbeast]], they were able to escape the Royal Capital without being caught by the knights, who were out looking for Elsa. Meanwhile, Meili revealed that she had received a task from [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]] to [[Wolgarm Incident|cause havoc]] near Roswaal Manor. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Royal Capital]]

[[Meili Portroute|Meili]] captured |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Sanctuary Incident''' (''unofficial name'') was an event that took place roughly 2 months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world. It is the primary conflict of [[Arc 4]]. Following the return from the [[Royal Capital]] after the successful [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and [[Subjugation of Sloth]], the [[Emilia Camp]] discovered that the half of the villagers that had been sent to the [[Sanctuary]], as well as [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and [[Ram]], had yet to return to the [[Arlam Village]] or [[Roswaal Manor]]. Deciding to chase after them, Subaru, [[Emilia]], and the merchant [[Otto Suwen]] made their way to the Sanctuary, where they found themselves involved in a long, convoluted scheme set up by Roswaal. After a long battle with assassins who had come to attack the manor, an army of [[witchbeast]]s accompanied by them, the desperate mage who wanted Subaru to become like him, the extensive and traumatic trials holding up the Sanctuary's barriers, and even the [[Great Rabbit]], one of the [[Witchbeast#Three Great Witchbeasts|Three Great Witchbeasts]], Subaru managed to solidify the bond of the Emilia Camp, obtain new supporters for the camp, and force Roswaal's hand to help Emilia in earnest. However, unbeknownst to everyone, because of these events, a [[Omega|Witch]] was once more set upon the world. ==Background== ===The Barrier of the Sanctuary=== In the era of the [[Great Calamity]] lived a noble of [[House Mathers]] named Altair Mathers, who experienced mana poisoning due to his inability to manipulate mana or cast magic, and his mana continued to build up in his body. After meeting the Witch of Greed, [[Echidna]], she fixed his problem, kissing him, and soon after, took him as an apprentice. Sometime later, in the Sanctuary of Kremaldy, Echidna had brought [[Ryuzu Meyer (original)|Ryuzu Meyer]] to take part in her experiments and to help create the barrier of the Sanctuary. Alongside her daughter figure, [[Beatrice]], the group spent their days in relative peace. However, things changed when the [[Hector|Warlock of Melancholy]] appeared. With Altair and Echidna having to hold him off, Beatrice and Ryuzu made their way to the large mana stone, which was made to act as part of the core of the Sanctuary's barrier. With no other choice remaining, Ryuzu was forced to sacrifice herself and become part of the core, resulting in the barrier being made and Hector being repelled. After these events, after giving a Book of Wisdom to both Altair and Beatrice, Echidna entrusted the Forbidden Library to Beatrice. She was to wait and watch over the library until the day that "[[Minor Characters#"That Person"|That Person]]", who was to be entrusted with Beatrice and the library's knowledge, arrived. Meanwhile, the [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|copies of Ryuzu Meyer]] became the administrators of the Sanctuary, ordered to not enter the Witches' Graveyard for any reason. At some point following this, Echidna died, and, having collected the souls of the other [[Witch]]es to join her in her [[Castle of Dreams]], her body became part of the trials that connected to the barrier, and she and the other Witches continued to reside in the graveyard for four centuries. Roswaal, wishing to bring her back to life, continued his research into magic and followed his Book of Wisdom, even mastering the Soul Transcription spell and taking over each successive generation of House Mathers. Beatrice, however, did not leave the Forbidden Library, and she waited for "That Person" to arrive, faithfully following her own Book of Wisdom until one day, the book went blank. ===[[Permafrost of Elior Forest]]=== Approximately 100 years ago, a young Emilia experienced a vast change in her life when the [[Witch Cult]]'s radical faction, led by the Sin Archbishop of Greed, [[Regulus Corneas]], the Witch of Vainglory, [[Pandora]], and the [[Black Serpent]], appeared. Alongside the other cultists, they launched an assault on [[Elior Forest]]'s elves and the moderate faction led by [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Geuse]]. The battle that followed resulted in Geuse taking in the Witch Factor of Sloth, [[Archi Elior]]'s death, and [[Fortuna]]'s death by the hands of a manipulated Geuse. In shock and rage, Emilia's magic ran out of her control and started freezing over the entire forest and its residents, and she killed Pandora over and over again. Realizing that she could not accomplish her goal, she wiped Emilia's memory of the incident, and she left her to freeze, while she twisted Geuse and turned him into the Sin Archbishop of Sloth who would become the most active member of the Witch Cult. ===Garfiel's Trial=== When he was young, [[Garfiel Tinzel]] and his sister [[Frederica Baumann]] were left in the Sanctuary while their mother, [[Reala Thompson|Reshia Tinzel]], left to go find their father. Unknown to them, she ended up falling victim to a landslide, and she nearly lost her life. Years later, after Frederica had left the Sanctuary to find a place for the Sanctuary's residents, Garfiel found himself entering the Witches' Graveyard, and after taking the first trial, he witnessed what happened to his mother. Following this, he gave himself a permanent scar and resolved to protect the Sanctuary from all threats. Meanwhile, Shima, who had gone to retrieve him, had been removed as one of the Sanctuary's administrators for breaking the rules, and simultaneously, Echidna, who continued to exist in the Castle of Dreams, had started in her attempt to take over Shima's body. ===The Day of Red Earth and Fire=== Seven years after unfreezing Emilia from the ice, the [[Spirit#Great Spirit|Great Spirit]] [[Melakuera]] started a conflict in Elior Forest in an effort to kill Emilia, believing that her existence threatened the world. This led to a fight between Melakuera and [[Puck]] that resulted in the former's death. On the verge of dying, despite his contract with someone prior, he made a contract with Emilia to become her contracted [[spirit]], saving his life but sealing his memories away. ===The [[Loot House Incident]] & The [[Wolgarm Incident]]=== After learning of the existence of Subaru through his Book of Wisdom and having collected Emilia for the [[Royal Selection]], Roswaal hired [[Elsa Granhiert]] to steal the insignia from her, leading to a conflict that caused her to retreat and Subaru to be brought back to the manor. However, shortly after that, [[Meili Portroute]] was ordered to cause havoc near the manor, leading to another incident. Thanks to Subaru's efforts, she was repelled, and she started acquiring more witchbeasts to rebuild her numbers for the next time she attacked. Sometime later, Elsa and Meili were given orders to kill the maids residing in Roswaal Manor from [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]]. ===Roswaal's Preparations=== Around the time that Roswaal was returning to the Manor with Emilia and Puck, taking advantage of her weakened mental state, Roswaal used his magic to tamper with the contract between the two, causing Puck to find it harder for him to come out, directly affecting Emilia's mental state. After returning to the manor, Roswaal re-hired Frederica as a maid and handed her a letter directing everyone to the Sanctuary. He also had a cryptic talk with Beatrice regarding visiting the Sanctuary. Roswaal mentioned that she should know full well what this should mean and left. After hiring an assassin to attack the maids, he left for the Sanctuary, where he entered the Witches' Graveyard to purposefully allow himself to be injured, and he waited for everyone to return so that his scheme for Subaru could begin. ===[[Subjugation of Sloth]]=== Following the Subjugation of the White Whale, as Rem's group returned to the Royal Capital, they were ambushed by Regulus and the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, [[Lye Batenkaitos]]. This resulted in [[Rem]]'s name and memories being eaten, which caused Ram to put a notice out to hire a new maid from among the Arlam Villagers. Meanwhile, Subaru, in preparation for his coming battle with the Sin Archbishop of Sloth and in order to prevent any damages being done to the villagers, requested that they be transported somewhere else. However, the villagers were forced to split into two groups: the group traveling to the Royal Capital and the group led by Ram to enter the Sanctuary, where they were essentially taken hostage by the Sanctuary residents. After Sloth's defeat and Subaru taking the Witch Factor of Sloth for himself, he and all those in the Royal Capital, returned to the manor. ===Trials of the Sanctuary=== After returning to the village, Subaru's group realized that the other villagers had yet to return, and after returning to the manor, they met Frederica, who had been re-hired by Roswaal, and [[Petra Leyte]], who had decided to become one of the new maids for Roswaal Manor in order to support Subaru. After discussing a while over what they would do and meeting with Beatrice who pointed them toward the Sanctuary, Subaru decided to take his group to the Sanctuary. The next day, he entrusted the unconscious Rem to their care, Frederica gave him a glintstone necklace to assist him with Garfiel, and Petra gave him her handkerchief for good luck. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 10 7.png|thumb|right|180x|Subaru meets the Witch of Greed.]] Heading to the Sanctuary, Subaru's group found themselves approaching its barrier, which caused Emilia to pass out, and through the glintstone, Subaru found himself teleported elsewhere. Seeing a young girl with pink hair, he followed her to the Witches' Graveyard, where he met Echidna in the Castle of Dreams, learned about the Witches, became her Apostle of Greed, and had his memories of her wiped from his mind. After leaving the tomb, he encountered Garfiel, who was ready to attack him. Having defeated [[Patrasche]], who attacked him after deeming him a threat, he attempted to attack Subaru, who managed to calm him down through Frederica's name, where he learned they were siblings. Afterward, his group was led further into the Sanctuary, where the injured Roswaal waited for them. With Subaru learning his situation, that the villagers were being held hostage, and that the Sanctuary residents wanted the trials to be completed so that the barrier could come down, Emilia was entrusted with taking the trials. Later that night, Emilia entered the Witches' Graveyard, which started to glow in response, intending to take on the first trial. However, the lights seemed to dim quickly. Worried about her, Subaru rushed into the graveyard without any consequences, much to the surprise of the others, and found the unconscious Emilia on the ground. However, Subaru was then thrust into the first trial to face his past, which he managed to complete, which Emilia failed. ===The Bet with Roswaal=== Subaru waking up after the first trial turned out to be his checkpoint, and he experienced a few loops, in which he experienced that assassins, accompanied by witchbeasts, attacked the mansion; Roswaal had tampered with Emilia's contract with Puck; he and Beatrice had their own Gospels, just like the Witch Cult; Garfiel did not trust Subaru due to the scent wrapped around him that Shima picked up; the facility where the original Ryuzu was located; the other Witches were in the Graveyard, and after meeting [[Typhon]] and [[Minerva]], he made a bet with [[Daphne]] to kill all of the [[Witchbeast#Three Great Witchbeast|Three Great Witchbeasts]]; Echidna awakened the Witch Factor of Sloth within him, and he was even allowed to retain his memories; the Great Rabbit had been summoned; [[Satella]] could possess Emilia body as part of the penalties of mentioning Return by Death; and Roswaal was aware of his ability to challenge fate. In the main timeline, he spoke with Roswaal again, where Roswaal verbally cornered him and stated his intention for wanting Subaru to be like him. Shortly after, Subaru went to take on the second trial, which showed him the possible futures that would have followed each and every one of his deaths. After experiencing all 17 alternate presents, [[Carmilla]] appeared in an effort to try and save his mind, though she only managed to anger him after taking Rem's appearance and saying things she wouldn't have said, and he was once again invited to Echidna's Tea Party, where she tried to convince him to enter a contract with him to use his Return by Death with Echidna supervising him. However, the other Witches, including [[Sekhmet]] appeared to stop it from taking place. After hearing of the negative side of the contract and Echidna's long drawn speech, Subaru rejected her hand, and shortly after, Satella appeared before them all. Because of this, he learned that Satella and the Witch of Envy were separate entities caused by the Witch Factor of Envy. Rejecting Satella's love, he bit off his tongue, which Typhon and Sekhmet respected, despite Minerva's aggression, and Satella, on the verge of tears, questioned what the trial made him see. Afterward, Carmilla made it to where Subaru could understand her feelings, and Daphne prevented Typhon from interfering as Minerva healed him. After this, he rejected Echidna's contract, resulting in him having his right to take the trials revoked, and after claiming that he would save Satella, he left the graveyard. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 13 8.png|thumb|left|180x|Roswaal accepts Subaru's bet.]] After waking up to Patrasche, who had Otto release and chase after her, had dragged Subaru out of the tomb, and was bruised up from entering it in the first place, he decided to take the trial again, only to find that he couldn't anymore, much to his great frustration. A short time later, he went to confront Roswaal again about ways to overcome the trial, where Roswaal revealed that he was the one who hired the assassins, and Subaru revealed that he couldn't take the trials anymore. Outside, he spoke with Emilia, and after being calmed by her and hearing about her resolve to take on the trials without shortcuts, frustrated that he realized that he didn't put his trust in her, Otto met with him and struck him, wanting him to trust his friends and stop trying to take on everything himself. After a discussion about the things to come, he went back to Roswaal and made a bet with him that he would succeed in a way different from Roswaal's intentions, with Roswaal accepting it and preparing something that would bind the loser of the bet to a [[curse]]. After leaving and having a short conversation with Ram, Otto went to prepare for taking on Garfiel, obtaining Ram's assistance and setting up traps, while Subaru went to the facility where the original Ryuzu was located to confirm that he was still an Apostle of Greed, as well as speak with Ryuzu Alma about Roswaal's plans to confirm whether she might be an enemy, and he learned of the difference between Shima and the other copies and partially why Garfiel was against the Sanctuary's liberation. Afterward, he met with Emilia, who couldn't get sleep, learned about part of her past, including Roswaal's actions, and helped her sleep. Meeting with Puck immediately after, he spoke about the circumstances, which led him to later sever his contract with Emilia so that they could both regain their memories. Heartbroken, she asked Subaru, who had come to visit her again, to promise to hold her until morning. However, after she woke up and saw that Subaru wasn't there, as he'd gone into the tomb to carve words of encouragement into the tomb, she called him, Puck, and even Fortuna liars and ran away to hide. The next day, with the Ryuzus hiding away and Emilia missing, while Subaru went to find Emilia, Garfiel ran off to the Ryuzu facility, where he fell for Otto's trap. Because he had dropped him in a hole filled with Zodda Bugs and stole his glintstone, Otto ran through the forest, with Garfiel hot on his trail. With Ram assisting him in holding off Garfiel, Subaru found Emilia in the tomb and spoke with her, where she unloaded all of her beliefs and negative feelings onto him. Despite the argument that followed and being told that she was loved by Subaru, because she didn't believe him, he kissed her and told her again, and after telling her that he'd kick all of her worries to the side, the two left the tomb together, Subaru suffering from its kickback. Outside, he met with Garfiel, who had been waiting for them to finish and was heavily injured from his previous fight. After discussing his reason for keeping the Sanctuary from being liberated, Garfiel attempted to attack Subaru in his beastified state, but with Puck's help inside of the glintstone necklace he had, he managed to revert him back, and after a fist fight with him, he defeated Garfiel by using his newly awakened Authority of Sloth, with Patrasche knocking him out at the end. Though, as a result of the fight, Subaru's Gate was destroyed. Later, he awoke and was convinced by Ram and Subaru to face his trial, and after accomplishing it and coming to terms with his past, he decided to assist Subaru. Afterward, once Emilia entered the tomb to take the first trial, Shima, supported by Delma, told the group what happened 400 years ago so that everyone could understand why the Sanctuary was created. Afterward, Subaru, Garfiel, and Otto went to speak with Roswaal to show that things were already going in Subaru's way, and after leaving, Subaru gave Ram the glintstone necklace with Puck in it, and they left for the manor. ==Battle== ===The Burning of the Old Roswaal Manor=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 15 2.png|thumb|right|250px|Garfiel battling Elsa.]] At the manor, Frederica told Petra to leave as the assassins had entered the manor. Though she did run, remembering that Rem was there and that Subaru had trusted Petra with her care, she ran to retrieve her, putting her in Elsa's sights again. Fortunately, Frederica appeared and stopped her attack. With Elsa revealing that they alongside Beatrice were her targets, Frederica ordered Petra to run. Hoping that Beatrice might be able to help, Petra ran around to try and find her but failed to. Desperate, she asked for Subaru's help, and to her surprise, he appeared before her. Meanwhile, he had Garfiel, armed with his gauntlet shields, assist his sister in taking on Elsa, taking over the fight for her and leaving her to take Rem out of the mansion. As he took care of Elsa, Subaru gave a barrier crystal to prevent any witchbeasts from coming near Petra and left her care with Otto, while he found and confronted Beatrice in her library, wanting to drag her out of the manor. However, realizing that she was bound to die thanks to Roswaal having leaked information to Elsa about her Door Crossing, she had accepted that she was going to die. Though Subaru disagreed with her acceptance, when she asked if Subaru would be "That Person" for her, he denied, causing her to kick him out of the library. Shortly after, he was reunited with Otto and Petra, who revealed that there was one witchbeast, a [[Witchbeast#Guiltylowe|Guiltylowe]], that the crystal did not work on. Then, as they fell through the floor, Frederica brought the three out of the mansion. Shortly after, they were confronted with Meili, riding atop a [[Witchbeast#Rock Pig|Rock Pig]]. With Frederica staying behind to hold them off, Subaru and company ran off. Heading for the hidden escape route in Roswaal's office, they came across numerous dead witchbeasts and the Guiltylowe. [[File:Roswaal's mansion burning ep.49.png|thumb|left|250px|Roswaal Manor alight.]] After they ran from the Guiltylowe, they found themselves in the kitchen, where Subaru decided to make a trap for the Guiltylowe. However, despite luring it there, he failed to create a dust explosion, leaving Otto and Petra to toss Otto's oil at it and ignite it. Though this failed to kill it, the flames managed to deter it, and the manor was set ablaze. Entrusting Rem to Otto and Petra, he had them leave for the escape route while he went to find Beatrice. The flames, meanwhile, as well as his sister's fight, spread to Garfiel's fight. Using his [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Earth Spirits|Divine Protection of Earth Spirits]] to knock Meili onto the ground and threaten her, he continued his battle with Elsa while Frederica slaughtered the army of witchbeasts. With Garfiel landing another fatal blow on Elsa, Meili set the Rock Pig on him, though he managed to gut it using his beastification. With Garfiel recognizing her as a vampire, claiming one of the Witches was one and still died, and Elsa retelling her story to him, their fight continued. Despite nearly having the upper hand, Elsa was distracted by Meili nearly being crushed by the burning mansion and then saved and taken away by Frederica, and Garfiel pounced her, allowing them to land severe injuries on each other. Finally, Garfiel successfully managed to kill Elsa by crushing her with the body of the Rock Pig, and Garfiel left the mansion. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 15 10.png|thumb|right|180x|Subaru offering his hand to Beatrice.]] Meanwhile, Subaru found Beatrice, and he kept trying to persuade her to leave with him, still claiming not to be That Person, and stating he wanted to stay with her regardless, Beatrice threw him out of the Forbidden Library, evacuating him out of the front door to make sure he didn't burn in the fires of the mansion. Going back inside, Subaru continued searching for her, only to be chased down by the reanimated corpse of Elsa, and soon after, the Guiltylowe. Though Elsa's corpse tore through the witchbeast, she continued chasing after him as he ran for the last door in the manor, the one leading to the escape route. Despite threatening the backdraft explosion that would follow, he managed to enter the library while the backdraft incinerated Elsa's corpse. Inside the library, Subaru and Beatrice spoke further as the space of the library starting to break. Not knowing what else to say, he asked her to save him and to go with him so that she wouldn't be alone any longer, claiming that he would leave such a powerful impression on her that she would always remember him, even long after he died. Telling her to let go of the notion of a person that she wouldn't even know appearing to rescue her, he asked her to choose him and not fear the future where they would be separated, and in response, she accepted his hand, made a contract to be his spirit, and left with him with magic to the Sanctuary, calling his name all the while. ===The Oni, The Great Spirit, and The Mage=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 14 13.png|thumb|left|180x|Ram and Puck confronting Roswaal.]] Deciding to actively take part in his bet rather than wait in the shadows for things to go his way, Roswaal dressed himself in his usual attire and left to confront Emilia, who was taking the trials. Coming across her and Ram, Roswaal proceeded to mentally attack Emilia, but this instead backfired, and she was resolved as she left to take on the second trial. Deciding to speed up his plans, Roswaal ordered Ram to wait for Emilia as she completed the trial as he left to make snow fall over the Sanctuary. However, just as he started preparing, Ram had followed him and resolved herself to stop him from doing so, with Puck at her side. The battle soon spilled out of the Ryuzu facility, and Roswaal displayed the reason for which he was the greatest mage living in the present day, using three-, four-, and even fivefold magic to corner his opponents. As a lull in their battle emerged, Puck questioned Roswaal about the spell he placed on Emilia and tampered with her contract, which he replied with honesty and even claimed that Subaru was the last key he needed for his wish to come true. He also guessed that Puck's memories of before the contract had returned, and Puck claimed to remember someone with mannerisms and fashion akin to Roswaal's, going as far as to claim that Roswaal was stuck in the past. Afterward, the battle continued, with Roswaal claiming that he was disappointed in Ram for being unable to take is life for her brethren. However, she instead claimed to love him, much to his great confusion and frustration, and after denying it, only to be refuted, the fight continued. Surrounded by ice showing off the reflections of Ram, as well as statues of ice, Roswaal used his flames to destroy them, only to be caught off guard by an oversized Puck, leading him to believe that he'd turned into the Beast of the End. However, Puck merely grew bigger and hurled more ice at him, which he used his martial arts skills to defend against, and wiped away the massive Puck with magic. However, this provided an opening for Ram to steal his Book of Wisdom, and as she threw it in the flames, Roswaal struck her with an Al Goa. Confused and not knowing what to do, Roswaal took the injured Ram in his arms, and Puck started to tell him that he lost. However, he noticed that snow had started, and that Roswaal had successfully managed to simultaneously cast the weather manipulation spell alongside everything else he'd been casting, earning praise from Puck and being told that he would never be like Hector and causing him to go to delay the coming problem and protect the villagers. Meanwhile, with Roswaal lost, he started pouring mana into Ram, as he was unable to heal her, and he cried to his teacher what he should do. ===Emilia's Trials=== After entering the tomb and claiming that she wouldn't forgive Subaru until he apologized for breaking his promise to engrave the words of encouragement into the tomb, she began her first trial, where she met the scornful Echidna and witnessed everything that happened a century prior. Finally able to come to terms with her past, she completed the first task, to Echidna's chagrin. Leaving the tomb, she found Ram there by herself, who she confirmed to that she finally completed the first trial, to Ram's surprise, and after showing her resolve to her, Ram decided to ask Emilia to help her save Roswaal, finally trusting her enough to ask for her help. She explained that Roswaal had lost his way, and when Emilia asked what she could do, Ram asked her to win the Royal Selection, believing that by doing so, she would be able to help free him. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 14 12.png|thumb|right|180x|Emilia placing her faith in Subaru.]] A short time later, Roswaal appeared, causing Ram to slightly tremble. Roswaal commended Emilia for taking on the task, but at the same time, attempted to mentally attack her, wanting to make it so that she would continue to fail. However, not only did this fail to work, but her resolve was even stronger, both in herself and in Subaru, and she had already completed the first trial. Intending to prove him wrong, she went back in and began her second trial. In this trial, she was made to experience an alternate reality in which Pandora and Regulus never attacked the forest, allowing her to have a happy life with both Geuse and Fortuna, and the forest remaining unfrozen. However, after some time of this, she spoke with the illusion of Archi that this was something that could no longer be and accepted that, causing the illusion to turn into Echidna, who was crying after Emilia thanked her for allowing her to see a happy alternate present, and vanished. Afterward, Emilia fell into the lake below, seeing her reflection for the first time since before making a contract with Puck, before completing the second trial. Going outside, she came face to face with the residents of the Sanctuary and Arlam Village. [[Milde Arlam]] had been the one leading the group, and she explained that the villagers had come to trust her in spite of her appearance, and they wanted to support her as she took on the trials. Happy and prepared, Emilia turned to face the third trial. However, when she was forced to look at the possible futures, Echidna had thrust at her numerous futures that would only end badly, causing Minerva to step in and tell her as much. After a short conversation with Minerva, in which Minerva revealed that she knew [[Emilia's Mother]] and Subaru, gave her a hug in response for her turning around, and promised her to have a tea party with all of the Witches, she finally completed the Trials of the Tomb, allowing her to visit one of the cores of the barrier: Echidna's body. Despite being confused about it, not recognizing her due to having been older-looking compared to the Echidna in the Castle of Dreams, she still broke the spell partially maintaining the barrier. Leaving the tomb, however, she bore witness to the entire area being completely covered in snow. ===The Emilia Camp versus the Great Rabbit=== With snow falling on the Sanctuary, Puck had gone to protect the people there with a large structure made of ice, claiming that they could thank Emilia. Nearby, she also witnessed as a massive tree made of ice had grown, leading Emilia to the Ryuzu facility, where she bore witness as Shima sacrificed herself to bring down the barrier completely, and she, alongside the large crystal, disappeared. After asking for Ram and Roswaal's location, the Ryuzus led her to Roswaal, and she tried to convince him to go with her, only for him to claim that it was too late, causing Emilia to chide him for it. Shortly after, the Great Rabbit finally made its appearance, making its way toward the immense amount of mana falling over the area, and Emilia froze the ones that appeared around her. Creating a path, she entrusted Roswaal and Ram to the Ryuzus and created a path back to the Sanctuary, the Great Rabbit hot on their trail. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 15 3.png|thumb|left|250px|Subaru, Beatrice, and Emilia casting Cocytus.]] Having returned to the Witches' Graveyard to take refuge, Emilia prepared herself to take on all of the Great Rabbit. Soon after, Subaru and Beatrice, now contracted, arrived to fight against the Great Rabbit alongside her. Claiming to have the perfect handicap for their first fight together, the two cast Minya against the beast, and coming up with a plan, Subaru used himself as bait while using his spiritual arts while running around the Great Rabbit, lining arrow after arrow around them while carrying Beatrice to let her gather power and leaving Emilia to trace the line he drew with her magic. Eventually, after having completely surrounded the Great Rabbit with magic and elevating it so that it couldn't escape, Beatrice cast Al Shamak, trapping and isolating all of the Great Rabbit in an alternate space, leaving it to tear itself apart. ==Aftermath== Following the fight, Roswaal ended up cursed with an [[Curse#Oath Bound Curse Mark|Oath Bound Curse Mark]], and after Subaru and the other members of the Emilia Camp took their turns striking Roswaal for his transgressions, he informed them of it and that the conditions were that he would not bring harm to anyone in the camp, else his soul burns away, never to return to [[Od Lagna]]. He also agreed to earnestly back Emilia in the Royal Selection, unlike how he used her like a tool before. Later, he spoke with Beatrice in front of Echidna's body, where, after hearing Beatrice's thoughts on leaving the Forbidden Library and contracting with Subaru, he revealed to her that he was still the Roswaal from 400 years ago, causing her to slap him with her shoe. Sometime later, [[Clind]] and [[Annerose Miload]] arrived to move all of the Arlam and Sanctuary Villagers away from the Sanctuary. Due to the destruction of the manor, the members of the camp, as well as the Ryuzus, all left for the manor near [[Costuul]]. After they left, Echidna, having taken over Shima's body and transferring the souls of the Witches to a glintstone necklace, renamed herself Omega and decided to leave on a journey. Setting upon the scavengers who had intended to plunder the corpses meant to be left behind in the Great Rabbit's wake, she used her miasma to kill them. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 15 12.png|thumb|right|250px|Subaru's knighting ceremony.]] Meili, who had been captured as one of the ones responsible for the incident, after being allowed to see the old manor grounds and cry for Elsa's death, she was imprisoned beneath the New Roswaal Manor to hide from Mother. Later on, Subaru, as a reward for his contributions for the [[White Whale]] and Sloth, was knighted and became Emilia's knight in the Royal Selection. During the ceremony, he had a conversation with Roswaal where he threatened to force him to reset if Subaru ever made a mistake, as well as informed him of the fact that he only hired Elsa, not Meili. Garfiel became a military officer for the camp, and Otto became the Internal Affairs officer to assist Emilia and Subaru and keep an eye on Roswaal. Otto also made sure to retrieve the burnt Book of Wisdom that previously belonged to Roswaal, intending to make a guess as to what Roswaal's plans were. Also, as a result of the events at the Sanctuary, rumor of the defeat of the Great Rabbit spread throughout the world. However, until time could pass without any sightings of the Great Rabbit, its defeat could not be officially recognized as the camp's achievement. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Sanctuary]]

title: Siege on the Abellux Castle
wikitext:
{{Infobox battles |name=Siege on the Abellux Castle |conflict=Imperial Selection Ceremony |date=7 BA (before arrival) |result=[[Vincent Vollachia | Vincent Abellux]]'s victory and [[Lamia Godwin]]'s death |image=Re Zero Ex Volume 5 3.png |place=Abellux Castle in Vollachia |side1=[[Lamia Godwin]]'s coalition forces |side2=[[Vincent Vollachia|Vincent Abellux]] |commanders1=[[Lamia Godwin]]

Armies of 3 other [[:Category:Imperial Selection Candidates|Imperial Selection Candidates]]
Forces of the 9 dissenters ''(turncoat)''
