Big Three of [[Flanders]] |forces2 = [[Al|Aldebaran]]’s Gang |forces3 = [[Roy Alphard]]
[[Black Serpent]] |forces4 = |casual1 = N/A |casual2 = Aldebaran sealed |casual3 = N/A |casual4 = |civilian = N/A}} The '''Pleiades Sealing Conflict''' (''unofficial name'') was a series of events beginning with the sealing and abduction of [[Natsuki Subaru]] and his contracted [[spirit]] [[Beatrice]] at the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] by the hand of [[Al|Aldebaran]], and it expanded to be not just a threat to the [[Royal Selection]], but even to the entire world. The conflict took place approximately 1 year and 8 months after Subaru was brought to the world, and it is the primary conflict of [[Arc 9]]. Following the successful yet tragic end to the [[Great Disaster]], Aldebaran, who had lost his primary pillar of support, [[Priscilla Barielle]], set forth on the task given to him by his [[Echidna|teacher]], leading him to set up an elaborate scheme that would allow him to capture and dispose of Subaru in an effort to supposedly prevent the end of the world. Setting his sights on the Grand Mogolade Geyser in the [[Kararagi|Kararagi City-States]], Aldebaran successfully sealed his target, made an ally of the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] itself, kidnapped one of the Royal Selection Candidates, [[Felt]], broke free a dangerous and most hated [[Roy Alphard|Sin Archbishop]], unintentionally wrapped the [[Black Serpent]] into the conflict, and even summoned the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. In the end, by [[Petra Leyte|Petra]] allowing Roy to devour her name and memories, they were able to remove the Witch of Envy from the conflict, allowing [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] to break the seal Subaru was in. With the seal broken, [[Rem]], having been entrusted this task by Petra, was able to kill Subaru to have him reset with Return by Death, and with the chance given to him, sealed Aldebaran before the conflict could even begin. ==Background== ===Aldebaran’s Task=== Four centuries ago, Aldebaran was tutored under the Witch of Greed, learning various [[magic]] spells from her, both ordinary and forbidden, as well as how to use his [[Authority]] with maximum proficiency. During this time, Echidna taught him in preparation for defeating the Witch of Envy. However, when the two set upon this goal, they failed, resulting in Al losing his arm and Echidna sustaining heavy injuries. Believing there was still a chance to take care of secondary damages, she sealed Al with Ol Shamak, and he did not awaken for four centuries. After his unsealing and spending more than a decade on [[Ginunhive]], where he discovered Aggressor, he eventually decided to escape and chase after the trail of the [[Witch]]es. Eventually, he managed to meet with Echidna again, though he discovered that she was different from the Echidna he knew. He ultimately failed to defeat her, and instead, he was informed of his Authority's Aggressor aspect and that they could take care of secondary damages. It is unknown if it is because of this meeting with Echidna, but he came to believe that Subaru would eventually be the reason that the Witch of Envy would escape and destroy the world, and so his goal became to rid him from it. However, after he became the knight of Priscilla Barielle, he had decided to not complete this task, and he settled for being Al rather than Aldebaran. ===Tragedy of House Astrea=== Approximately 17 years prior before Subaru's arrival to the world, the wife of [[Heinkel Astrea]], [[Louanna Astrea|Louanna]], fell into a long slumber caused by her two-year-old son, and since then, Heinkel has been desperate to wake her. Three years later, a crisis unfolded in which the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunican]] [[Royal Family]]'s princess Filore Lugunica was kidnapped, something that is known in the present as the [[Royal Abduction Incident]], and Heinkel, that night, committed a betrayal and made a mistake that made said betrayal pointless, which in the end, gave Heinkel his unnatural durability. [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] was put in charge of searching for the princess while [[Theresia van Astrea]] decided to handle the [[Great Conquest]] at Heinkel's suggestion. However, because of this, Theresia was killed, Wilhelm blamed his grandson Reinhard when he revealed he had his grandmother's [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of the Sword Saint|Divine Protection of the Sword Saint]], and Heinkel refused to allow Wilhelm near his son, shattering the bonds of [[House Astrea]]. Eventually, with Reinhard officially becoming the Sword Saint and Louanna's slumber still unable to end, Heinkel believed that ruining Reinhard's reputation as the Sword Saint and waking his mother were the only ways to somehow help his son, and he became desperate to wake his wife at any cost. Because of his behavior, he became hated, and rumors started to circulate that he was also behind the Royal Abduction Incident. In his desperation, he later joined the [[Priscilla Camp]] in an attempt to get ahold of the castle's [[Dragon]]'s blood. During the [[Battle for Priestella]], however, the bonds between the men of House Astrea shattered further upon the second death of Theresia. In response to this, Wilhelm began retraining himself in the ways of the sword, intent on using his swordsmanship to get through to Reinhard, while Heinkel continued down the path he started a decade prior. ===Attempted Assassination of Priscilla Barielle=== During his time in the Priscilla Camp, Al had come to be acquainted with her head chamberlain, [[Yae Tenzen]], even having worked together to quell the undead incident that plagued the Barielle Domain. However, the night following said quelling, Yae, who had been tasked by [[Chisha Gold]] to kill Priscilla, attempted to sneak into her room and accomplish this task. Al, who became aware of this supposedly through his Authority, confronted her, using his Authority against her to thoroughly instill fear into her heart. Rather than killing her or sending her on her way, Al decided to make use of her, and he had her wait elsewhere until he needed her. The next day, Yae had vanished, and Al told Priscilla that she had left for “familial reasons”. ===[[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]]s=== A little over two months following the Battle for Priestella, the [[Emilia Camp|Emilia]] and [[Anastasia Camp]]s decided to traverse the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] in an effort to reach the Pleiades Watchtower, hoping to obtain the wisdom of the [[Flugel|Sage]] in order to recover the memories and bodies of those who had been affected by the Authorities of the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony and the [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop of Lust]]. After arriving, the camps found themselves in conflict with the tower’s guardians, the Gluttony siblings, and their army of [[witchbeast]]s. In the end, the camps emerged victorious, having killed [[Lye Batenkaitos]] after managing to get him to spit up numerous names and memories and sealing his brother Roy. However, when the Witch of Envy appeared, kidnapped Subaru, Rem, and [[Spica]], and was hit by the dragonhusk Volcanica, who sat atop the tower, the camps decided to head to [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]], with [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]]’s group first taking Roy to be locked away in the Prison Tower. Thanks to the first successful expedition, the Kingdom’s Council of Wise Men decided to send a new expedition team to determine what to do with the tower from that point forward, leading to the [[Felt Camp]] taking on the task. Despite the struggle in getting there and discovering the birds there being used to spy on them and the tower, the second expedition was also considered a success, and with the camp deciding to return, they left behind both [[Ezzo Cadner]] and [[Flam Remendis]] to further investigate the tower. ===[[Great Disaster]] Aftermath=== In order to escape her bindings and bring an end to the Great Disaster that plagued the Vollachia Empire, Priscilla, who had been captured by the Witch [[Sphinx]], used her [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]] to snuff out her own light and become an [[undead]] to continue fighting. In the end, her efforts proved necessary to end the disaster. However, the morning after returning to [[Garkla]], having said what she needed to the people in town, she had a small party with Subaru and Al atop the Fortress City’s ramparts, and there, as she faded away, she praised both Subaru and Al for their efforts. After Priscilla vanished, Al, who had lost the one he loved, decided to revert to being Aldebaran and complete the task given to him by his teacher. In the following days that everyone remained in Vollachia, Al went around using his Authority in order to divide everyone in the Emilia Camp upon their return to Lugunica, as well as to secure the assistance of Heinkel Astrea in exchange for the Royal Castle’s Dragon’s blood. At some point, he even secured Yae’s help, and he had Heinkel and Yae wait for him elsewhere and wait for his signal. With the Anastasia Camp returning to the country via Kararagi, Al left with Subaru’s group as they made for the Pleiades Watchtower, where Subaru intended to help Al in finding the Book of the Dead he wanted to see. After arriving, the group met Ezzo, who had continued his studies of the Books of the Dead, and they spent the day in relative peace. ==Conflict== ===Desert Skirmish=== During the day, Al found one of Subaru’s Books of the Dead, and he hid it in Subaru’s belongings after scratching off its name, and he also grabbed his own Book of the Dead. At the end of the night, he met with Subaru and Beatrice alone in the library while the others rested on the floor below. After a short conversation in which Subaru let his guard down, Al cast the forbidden art Ol Shamak on Subaru, and after Beatrice tried to jump in the way to protect him, the two were sealed together. It took no time at all for [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] and Ezzo to appear and confront him. Using his Authority, he managed to avoid Garfiel’s attacks and counter Ezzo’s magic, preventing them from dealing any true damage to him. Having created a new arm with earth magic, he punched Garfiel, and after Garfiel bit down on it, Al made his false hand rupture in his mouth, dealing a large amount of damage. After escaping the two, Garfiel able to heal himself, Al escaped into the stairway. However, Ezzo, having deduced that he wasn’t using magic, decided to flood the entire stairway while Garfiel protected the others with his [[Divine Protection]]. Having used his Authority once again, Al managed to survive the flood and make it to the top of the tower, where he was cornered by Ezzo and Garfiel. Despite this, Al turned the tables by having Volcanica, who continued to sit atop the tower, read his Book of the Dead. With Volcanica now bearing the mind of Aldebaran, it indirectly struck the two with Dragon’s breath, taking them out of the fight. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 40 5.png|thumb|right|180x|Petra reads Subaru’s Book of the Dead.]] As he made his way downstairs, he also incapacitated Flam, who attempted to ambush him, and pinned her against the wall with magic. Leaving behind Petra Leyte and [[Meili Portroute]], who could do nothing to stop him, he exited the tower. Despite [[Patrasche]] being there to stop him as well, Al ignored her and flew atop Volcanica’s back, only to be knocked out of the sky by the newly arrived Reinhard van Astrea, who had been made aware of the situation thanks to the Divine Protection shared between Flam and her sister [[Grassis Remendis|Grassis]]. As the two fought, steadily leading to Al’s defeat, Petra, who believed that Al had a plan to stop even Reinhard, found a Book of the Dead in Subaru’s belongings. Reading it, she discovered Return by Death, witnessing his conversation with Echidna and the Witch of Envy taking over [[Emilia]]’s body, and the backlash of reading the book caused her to black out. This caused the Witch of Envy to appear for her life. Though Al was defeated, he had bought enough time by bringing up Heinkel, and with Reinhard unable to ignore the Witch, he was forced to let Al go to stop her, and Al flew away. While Al converged with his party and warned the citizens of Mirula to evacuate the town for a week, Meili and Flam gathered everyone together onto the carriage while Patrasche pulled them away as quickly as possible in order to escape the battle between the Sword Saint and the Witch of Envy. Petra, having awakened with a hallucination of Subaru in her head, took the reins, and they escaped to Mirula without stopping, with Flam knocking herself unconscious to quickly regain use of her Divine Protection. With knowledge of Return by Death, she made it her goal to unseal Subaru and force him to reset from the beginning. ===Ambush of the Felt Camp=== After having sent Reinhard on his way, Felt believed that Al had to have planned for something to take care of Reinhard for his bold actions in the tower. With the Divine Dragon having been spotted heading north, Felt suspected that this was meant to distract everyone while Al headed in another direction, likely west toward Kararagi. Felt informed Emilia and [[Otto Suwen]] of the current issue. After a short conversation with them and asking them to stay in the [[Royal Capital]] just in case, she used her connections with the Big Three of [[Flanders]], the three underground groups whose backing in the Royal Selection she had procured by assisting them with resolving an incident that occurred in the city a year prior. Gathering a small army of 500 people, with [[Doltero Amule]] of the Black Silver Coin, [[Toto]] of the Flower Prison Garden, and [[Manfred Madison]] of the Balance commanding their respective forces, as well as the remaining five members of her camp at her side, the parties laid in wait in an attempt to ambush Al. Meanwhile, Otto obtained the cooperation of Wilhelm van Astrea and [[Ferris]] and set his Zodda Bugs as his surveillance system, having Emilia patiently wait in case Al overcame Felt's group. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 40 2.png|thumb|left|250px|Felt and her comrades ambush Al.]] Having left Mirula, Al sent Volcanica north in an effort to distract his enemies, hoping to lead them in a different direction. Meanwhile, his party rested within a cabin in the middle of an unnamed forest. Soon after, however, after smoke started to fill the forest, Al discovered that they had been ambushed by the Felt Camp, who had found him thanks to the Divine Protection in Manfred’s eye. Cornered, he had Yae and Heinkel set up a makeshift cannon using uprooted trees. However, this did not last long thanks to trickery by [[Rachins Hoffman]], and the distraction allowed Felt’s group to push forward their attack. Meanwhile, [[Rom]] used the entire battle to analyze Al’s abilities. While Yae continued restraining her enemies, Al was forced to confront Doltero, who found him no matter what he did. After many attempts and having to master the usage of one of Yae’s special rings, he was ultimately able to bring the man down. However, he was forced to keep fighting the ceaseless numbers, even having to confront Rachins, who attempted to trick Heinkel into triggering his Al Goa trap, break all of the [[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|conversation mirrors]] held by specific people, defeat [[Gaston]], and use Heinkel’s body as a shield to protect him from a blast from the [[Meteor#Star Staff|Star Staff]] being wielded by a Hexcel-using [[Camberley]]. With Camberley knocking himself out and Yae preventing Toto from reaching him with her fan, Al eventually found himself face to face with Rom. Having understood Al’s mentality by leaving everyone alive and telling him that Felt had been trailing them and waking everyone up, having set up a trap to incapacitate Yae with the help of Manfred, and informing Al that he had successfully and nearly completely deduced Al’s Authority, he caused Al to misuse his Authority, who considered Rom more dangerous than Reinhard. With Volcanica on the way and Rom’s trap complete, he used Hexcel to increase his size and break a Night Banishing Stone to create an illusion. However, before he could trap Al in an endless loop, Felt stopped Volcanica from using its Dragon’s breath with the Star Staff, stopping it from killing everyone there. Having managed to escape, Yae used her strings to hold everyone down, signifying Al’s party’s victory. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 40 11.png|thumb|right|180x|Felt speaks to Volcanica.]] Despite this, while they were discussing what to do with Felt in order to keep them from chasing after them, Felt spoke to Volcanica. By doing so, Volcanica realized that it did not want to disobey Felt, even comparing her to [[Farsale Lugunica]]. Due to this, Yae threatened to kill her, causing conflict with Volcanica. In the end, Al decided to accept Felt’s proposition to take her hostage in exchange for leaving everyone else alone and alive. Though Rom attempted to stop it by killing Al then and there, Al knocked him out. With Yae crushing the eye Manfred was using to track them and Felt’s group being forced to retreat, Al informed Felt of their intended destination of the Grand Mogolade Geyser, before setting his sights on the Royal Capital’s Prison Tower and splitting his party up once again. ===Disturbance in the Royal Capital=== ====Battle at the Prison Tower==== After splitting off from the others, Al busted into the Prison Tower, defeating the sparsely gathered guards and using Volcanica's fang to destroy mechanisms in the tower. After freeing the now unsealed Roy Alphard and claiming to need his assistance, he used his Authority to defeat Roy and shatter the bones in his arms, followed by Al using an [[Curse#Oath Bound Curse Mark|oath bound curse mark]] to prevent him from using his Authority on people other than who Al says. After a short conversation, Roy informed him of the strange existence of Zodda Bugs in a place where life should not have been able to be reached, alerting Al to Otto's movements and forcing him to grab Roy and rush out of the tower. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 41 1.png|thumb|left|250px|Emilia confronting Al and Roy.]] Outside the tower, however, he confronted a furious Emilia, who was warned not to listen to Al's words and to quickly take him down. Almost immediately after Al tried to speak with her, Emilia used her Ice Brand Arts to attack him. With Al using his earth version of Emilia's technique to counter her and pinning Roy inside of a pillar to prevent his escape, the two clashed, with Emilia attempting to use the new aspect of her technique to freeze Al, as well as using magic and Icicle Line to trap him and wear him down with the cold. With Al finding himself cornered, he prepared to summon Volcanica to his location, only to watch as it plummeted from the sky over Yae's location, leaving Al cornered further. The clash continued, leaving Al to think of a way to overcome the problem at hand, and after speaking to Roy, he found his answer, telling him to spit up someone's name and memories. As Emilia attempted to defeat Al, Roy did as he was told and regurgitated the name and memories of Rem, causing Emilia to stop in her tracks and struggle with the sudden influx of information that assailed her brain. This gave Al the chance to bring down the large boulder Volcanica had prepared after being forced to descend, and, leaving the crumbling earth for Emilia to deal with, he snatched Roy and ran away. Emilia, with no choice but to stop the falling chunks of earth, created many ice pillars to catch it all, screaming at Al the whole time. Al, having made his escape, watched everything take place atop a wall, making sure to see what he did all the way through before making his escape. ====Battle in the Noble District==== While Al set out to obtain a new ally from the Prison Tower, Heinkel remained in the sky on Volcanica's back while Yae kept an eye on Felt in the Barielle Auxiliary Manor in the Royal Capital. Unbeknownst to Yae, they were under the watch of the Zodda Bugs, which Felt took to her advantage in order to inform Otto of Al's goal. After a short conversation with Felt, Yae found herself on the wrong end of the blades of the Sword Demon, who had attacked and nearly landed a full powered kick on Yae. The two clashed, with Wilhelm overwhelming Yae, even using her strings to his own advantage in the underground space of the manor. Despite her best efforts, she was unable to defeat Wilhelm, causing her to pull on the string around Felt's throat to summon Volcanica. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 41 7.png|thumb|right|180x|Heinkel stabbing Wilhelm in the back.]] After Volcanica appeared and severed Yae's string, Wilhelm called out to Heinkel, who was cowering behind Volcanica's back. After their argument, which bought some time for the citizens in the area to escape, Wilhelm turned his blades toward the Divine Dragon, and the two entered a clash that encompassed the Noble District, with Volcanica booting Heinkel off of its back. Though Wilhelm could not pierce its scales and even found himself trapped between its teeth, his overwhelming tenacity, power, as well as being able to cut through Volcanica's breath, left both Heinkel and Volcanica in fear that he would win, despite such overwhelming odds. Because of this, while Wilhelm was on the ground, Heinkel took advantage of it to stab Wilhelm in the back, and though Wilhelm told him that his actions would not cause a change in Reinhard, Wilhelm ultimately fell. After this, Volcanica took Heinkel, Felt, and Yae and escaped from the area, leaving the area destroyed but with no casualties. ===The Merchant's Pursuit=== As Al and his party escaped to a quarry some distance away from the Royal Capital, Otto, with a backup plan in case he was defeated set in place, used his Divine Protection and an army of Zodda Bugs to begin harassing Al, entering a war of attrition to prevent his party from getting any rest. Meanwhile, once Petra's party arrived in Mirula and spoke with [[Clind]], Petra offered a future to become Subaru's bride as compensation to use his [[Authority#Authority of Melancholy|Authority of Melancholy]] to gather everyone, sans [[Frederica Baumann]] who needed to stay with [[Schult Barielle|Schult]], and bring them to the Royal Capital. There, they were hit with the memories of Rem returning and began discussing Al's Authority with Rom, who claimed that it was to go back in time, something that Petra resonated with, and Rem came to realize the similarity with Subaru's own achievements. With the others discussing how to handle Al, Petra realized a weakness to Al's Authority and stopped Rem from mentioning Subaru's, mentioning the Witch of Envy could be listening. Afterward, they discussed their plan, which included Petra taking the Witch Factor of Melancholy for herself and using it while Clind would be busy elsewhere. Giving it various forms of compensation for her use, Petra was entrusted with the Witch Factor of Melancholy. Likewise, in order to counter Roy's Authority, everyone decided to undergo a "change of names", and to do so, everyone went through a makeshift adoption, giving everyone the surname of Leyte, officially changing their names in the eyes of [[Od Lagna]]. After further discussions, they waited for a signal from Otto so that they could put their plan into action. After about a day of escaping with little rest and preventing Heinkel from killing Felt, Al spoke with Yae, who convinced him to remove the internal shackles on himself that restricted how he used the cards at his disposal. Though he refused to end a battle with someone's death, he decided that deaths caused as collateral damage while in the process of looping and the utilization Roy's Authority in order to subdue an enemy were acceptable to match his opponents. With fewer restraints, he used Volcanica's breath in tandem with his Authority to wipe out the life around them and ascertain Otto's location. After verifying Otto's location in previous loops, Al discussed how to deal with Felt with Yae, while Roy made a secret agreement with her to act as if she'd had her memories eaten and to play the role of the memoryless lost princess of Lugunica. After their plan was put into action with Al loosening the restrictions on his curse and Felt started her act, she was sealed away. However, despite the discomfort of being sealed, she realized that Roy had insurance in place: the Black Serpent, hiding within the shadows. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 42 6.png|thumb|left|180x|Flash Remnade.]] With Felt taken care of, Al entrusted the orb containing Felt to Heinkel and had Volcanica throw Yae, who had a means of cushioning the fall, to quickly ambush Otto and tie him up, as well as defeat [[Frufoo]] who was with him, and his defeat caused all of the Zodda Bugs to disperse, giving his allies his location. Once Al and Roy caught up, Al had Roy devour Otto's memories to prevent him from chasing after them and learn his party's plans. Immediately afterward, however, when Roy learned of Otto's backup plan, they found themselves face to face with Rem, which caused Al to freeze from the influx of memories. In that brief space of time, Al, as well as Yae, who quickly attached herself to him, were teleported into the sky. Meanwhile, the rest of the camp, as well as members of the Felt Camp and the Big Three of Flanders, had teleported to confront Roy, Heinkel, and Volcanica. After a short confrontation, in which Clind knocked down Volcanica with a kick, Roy experienced kickback from attempting to devour Ram's name and mysteriously failing, and Flam and Grassis pinned down Heinkel, Clind, [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]], and the Divine Dragon were all teleported away. ===Struggle for the Grand Mogolade Geyser=== ====Battle in the Mountains==== After everyone's separation, Rom helped Petra to use her Authority to direct and change the locations of everyone on the battlefield where they needed to be, starting with Ram, who attempted to use her magic to behead Roy. Using his stockpile of skills, however, he managed to avoid this, teleport to the sky with her, and try to counter. Despite this, he was unable to do so, as she had vanished and reappeared above him, and after delivering a powerful kick to him, he was sent hurtling to the ground. Before he could return to the sky, he was confronted Meili and her [[witchbeast]]s, the Guiltylowe and Wolgarms. Though he managed to stop the attack of the Guiltylowe, Ram took advantage of the distraction to attack while Meili commanded her Wolgarms forward. On the receiving end of injury, he paralyzed the Wolgarms and used his blood to slay them, and afterward, create explosive magical butterflies from the witchbeasts' corpses, before coagulating his blood and stopping his bleeding. In the lull, he determined Clind's involvement in separating Volcanica, Al, and Yae from the battlefield and determining that it was caused by an Authority, while simultaneously coming to the conclusion that they had come up with specific counters towards his Eclipse. Nearby, Heinkel was forced to take a hard beating from Flam and Grassis, who declared their hostility toward him for his actions. However, they were shocked by his durability and that he hadn't passed out, even after having been struck in the face. After Heinkel received words from Roy, who had looked towards his battle, he steadied himself, only for Flam and Grassis to kick the earth beneath them to create a temporary smokescreen. After he slashed it away, he was ambushed from every direction by the twins until they landed a strike on his abdomen. Though he grabbed their wrists and held on tight, their assault continued. Attempting to knock them out, he raised the two to try and slam them into the ground, but he was stopped thanks to Gaston's interference, and he was stricken backwards. After speaking to Heinkel, Roy sent forward his butterflies, which Ram and Meili countered by having trees knocked over to take their place, triggering numerous explosions. Maneuvering his remaining butterflies around the environment to reach the girls, he teleported above them in an effort to kill the Guiltylowe, only to find a Hungry Horse King instead, destroying the butterflies with its flaming spear, and the Guiltylowe had vanished. Taking advantage of Roy's distracted confusion, Doltero, who had also appeared out of nowhere, struck Roy and sent him flying backward. Correcting himself and noticing Ram in a completely separate area from before, as well as noticing Gaston's sudden arrival, he realized that, though the technique was the same, Clind was not on the battlefield, and someone else was using it. Seeing Petra, who was a distance away and was in the perfect spot to overlook the battlefield, though doubtful when scanning over all of his memories of her, he asked when she became a Sin Archbishop, only for Petra to proclaim herself the Witch of Melancholy. By Rom's command, Petra used the Authority to move Roy's opponents to surround him. With Saintess of a Thousand Visages to see all around him, he used Compactor to obscure the vision of Doltero and Ram before turning his attention to Meili's Hungry Horse King and Guiltylowe, dodging all of their attacks. Eventually, Ram and Doltero broke through the walls, and Roy attempted to use magic spears created by Magia Manus Magister to counter them all, but Ram teleported directly in front of him and countered him instead. With Roy realizing that Ram had changed her true name and scouring through the memories he'd devoured, Roy attempted to devour the name "Ram Mathers", only to fail once again and experience the recoil of his Authority. With their opening made, Ram, her fist clad in wind, Doltero, the spears of the Hungry Horse King, and the paws of the Guiltylowe all crashed towards Roy, and he was blown away. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 42 9.png|thumb|right|180x|The Black Serpent's emergence.]] Despite this, finding themselves cornered, Heinkel shattered the sphere he was given, releasing Felt, and he held her hostage, calling her by the name Filore and apologizing to her for his actions. However, shortly after appearing and seeing the conflict that everyone was in, Felt decided to forego her original plan to play along with Roy in favor of warning everyone of an even greater threat, resulting in the Black Serpent appearing from her shadow. Reacting quickly, Rom had Petra use her Compression to move themselves and everyone near Heinkel away as the corruption caused by the Black Serpent spread. With their allies safe, Rom lunged forward to separate Felt from Heinkel, only to find himself injured by Roy. Shouting to Heinkel to protect [[Ford Lugunica|Ford]]'s daughter, Heinkel attacked Roy, knocking him away, and after pushing Rom and Felt away from the corruption, Heinkel was consumed by the filth of the Black Serpent. Deciding to devour Felt, Roy attempted to use his Gluttony while the Black Serpent's corruption continued to spread, only for Rom to yell out at Petra to use Compression while he protected Felt. In response, Meili appeared with her Guiltylowe, and from its back, she used her Divine Protection to try and stop the Black Serpent, successfully managing to slow the corruption and the witchbeast, allowing for everyone to get out of its range. While everyone was stunned at seeing the Black Serpent's true form, Roy used the distraction to his advantage and used a palm strike to send the Guiltylowe towards the corruption, knocking Meili off of its back, and its life quickly ended. Afterward, with Roy using his blood to avoid touching the corruption, he used the Guiltylowe's corpse to generate more butterflies for his use. As the two sides faced each other, Rachins appeared, using an Ul Goa to attack the Black Serpent and telling Felt to give everyone orders, which she proceeded to do and order everyone to fight, and Petra used her Authority to compress everyone's thoughts into one and act as a single organism. With Roy realizing that it was likely that everyone on the battlefield changed their names prior to the battle and that even Petra's proclamation and announcement of her own name could very well be a trap, Roy attempted to use Compactor, only to be countered by Gaston and Doltero, giving an opening for Rachins and Ram to combine their magics and create a tornado of flame to attack him. Roy countered that with an ice spear and butterflies, also making sure to use the butterflies generated from corpses created by the Black Serpent as mana tanks to maintain his body's Flow Method. Not allowing him a break, Flam and Grassis attacked him, which he tanked with Carnivorous Beast and countered by striking the twins with Snow Vallum and Palm of the Fist King. With the Hungry Horse King catching them before they could hit the ground, it tried to attack him with another spear, only for Roy to paralyze the attack before it could reach him. The Black Serpent also tried to attack with its body, only for it to be countered with the earth ripped from the ground and reinforced by magic, and Meili used her Divine Protection again to hinder the witchbeast's actions. Raising the corrupted earth, Roy used his butterflies to turn it into lethal shrapnel, only to be countered yet again. Finding it odd that the group managed to act together perfectly, despite the bewildering sensation that he got that was reminiscent of Al's actions, Roy came to the conclusion that it was Petra's doing. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 42 11.png|thumb|left|180x|The Witch of Melancholy defeats the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony.]] As the fight continued, Roy continued to weaponize his blood, slowly but steadily wearing away at his life. Roy continued to expend various techniques and magics as he continued to fight, working alongside the Black Serpent, in hopes of wearing away at the compensation for the Authority of Melancholy, but each and every thing that the two attempted was handily countered by Petra's group. Eventually, as the Black Serpent decided to unleash a torrential rain of poison, Roy chose to use a new technique that revived the memories of pain that everyone experienced before, successfully managing to stun everyone and cripple Petra, who was reliving the pain Subaru experienced in each of his first 16 deaths. Despite this, however, Petra was able to use her Authority to compress all of the pain that she and everyone else experienced. With that gone and Camberley appearing on the battlefield, he tossed the Star Staff to Felt, and she started charging it. Though Roy attempted to counter it, his attacks were blocked. Using the distraction, he teleported in an attempt to strike down Petra and Meili, only for the [[Shaula|Crimson Scorpion]] hidden in Meili's hair to fire a needle into his eye, and Garfiel, who also suddenly appeared, used his Divine Protection to shoot him into the sky. Meanwhile, the Black Serpent, who attempted to attack again, exploded from within, having been cut through by Heinkel, stunning Roy. With Garfiel attempting to land a hit, Roy attempted to use Leaper to try and escape, only to be interrupted by numerous Zodda Bugs directed by Otto, who had awakened and been given directions by Garfiel just prior, and he was once again left vulnerable. With Garfiel looming on the horizon, Roy spoke to Petra about the compensation for her Authority, learning that the compensation was paid by the entire Royal Capital, shocking him. Afterward, Garfiel struck him toward the contaminated ground, and Felt fired the Star Staff at him. Following their victory, Meili and Otto, who were exhausted from using her Divine Protection and without his memories respectively, were left behind with some others, who were also mentally worn out from Roy's Authority, and they were tasked with watching over the area, as the Black Serpent had disappeared. Likewise, they made sure to restrain Roy. Seeing an icy landmark in the distance, Petra used her Authority to take those who could still fight and teleported to that location. ====Battle in the Rocky Plains==== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 42 2.png|thumb|right|250px|Roswaal and Clind vs. The Divine Dragon.]] After having been separated from the group, Clind and Roswaal faced Volcanica in an open plain. After Volcanica realized that it was Melancholy that separated everyone, Clind revealed himself to be Volcanica's [[Dragon#Dragonkin|dragonkin]], producing a pair of horns. Charged with purple lightning, Clind charged forward toward the flying Dragon, cutting through Volcanica's breath, and deflecting its tail. Propelling himself while midair, Clind unleashed a hail of strikes in the blink of an eye, forcing Volcanica to ascend further into the skies, only to plunge into a massive water sphere generated by Roswaal. Following this, Roswaal started to make the sphere boil, and Clind struck the water with a lightning-clad fist, causing the water to explode in a steam explosion with enough power to potentially wipe out a town. Despite this, Volcanica easily cut through the steam and was completely unscathed, much to Roswaal's annoyance. After a small discussion with Clind about Volcanica's defenses and any possible weaknesses, such as the effectiveness of the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword]] and Volcanica's inverse scale, Roswaal began preparing a spell in the sky. Volcanica unleashed a massive roar to rend the sky and earth and stifle its enemies, though thanks to Roswaal creating a mist, the sound was dampened. With Clind plunging into the mist, Roswaal unleashed his magic, slamming the Dragon with a massive torrent of wind, ice, and fire. Volcanica weathered through the attack and generated several gigantic fists of stone, awaiting Clind as he surged toward it. To counter this, Clind accessed more of his power to temporarily gain similar defenses as Volcanica, wrapping his body in electricity to contend with the fists, its tail, and its claws. Volcanica prepared its breath of fire and water to strike at Clind while Clind used his electricity to deflect it. Caught within one of the giant fists and wrapping himself in electricity, he barely withstood the attack before Roswaal unleashed his magic once again, using four elements with strength enough to destroy an entire city to attack Volcanica and help Clind escape from injury. However, heavily injured by counteracting the Dragon, he began falling from the sky, Clind rushing to catch him. Volcanica then began chasing after them and attacking, forcing Clind deflect its attacks as he fled, and eventually, he was stricken down by Volcanica's tail. Deciding to finish the two, Volcanica used its breath, only for Roswaal to use the power of five elements to counter it with a massive ray of magic, completely annihilating the battlefield around them. Ultimately, Roswaal had strained his gate terribly and began convulsing and crying tears of blood while Volcanica emerged unscathed once again. Intent on continuing fighting, Roswaal, still mangled, stood up, and shortly after, Ezzo appeared behind him. As Clind continued to fight Volcanica, Ezzo and Roswaal continued discussed magic with each other, with Ezzo providing Clind assistance and with Roswaal learning a new way to incorporate his magic alongside his allies. Asking for Ezzo's assistance in casting a new spell, the two began working on it. As Clind continued holding off Volcanica, it eventually unleashed its breath into the distance, unknowingly to the others triggering the Grand Mogolade Geyser to stop spouting water. With it distracted, Ezzo and Roswaal cast Al Sextet, successfully shattering its halo. Taking advantage of this, Clind unleashed another shackle, and he pierced through Volcanica's reverse scale, reaching its core and defeating it. ====Battle in Agzadd Canyon==== Finding himself falling from the top of Kararagi's Agzadd Canyon, Aldebaran used his Authority to calm his mind and assess the situation, coming to the conclusion that, since magic, Melancholy, and Vainglory were out of the question, he must have been ambushed by the current wielder of the Witch Factor of Pride. After reaching this conclusion, he blocked an attack from Rem's morningstar with his earthen prosthetic, and he claimed that she should not even be alive. Rem, using her water magic to create platforms, used them to propel herself downward and attack him, even using her magic to destabilize their balance when Yae tried to use her strings to attach to them. Shortly after, Emilia appeared from below, and they were ambushed in a pincer attack. Despite being pincered, Al managed to block her attack by coating himself and Yae completely in earth, using this time to have Yae attach the two together with threads. Using an icy hammer and the morningstar, the girls quickly destroyed the earthen wall, allowing for Al to charge toward Emilia and Yae to pounce toward Rem, dodging her attacks and nearly cutting off her head with her thread. Rem then coated her weapon in ice to multiply its mass and brought it down on Yae, forcing Yae to attack it repeatedly until the ice was destroyed and disperse the ball's impact with her thread just before it could reach her. Despite doing so, the impact still sent Yae flying towards Al. As Al and Emilia were using ice and earth weapons to attack each other, Rem used her morningstar to pull Emilia towards herself before Al and Yae could work together to fight Emilia. Realizing how difficult the fight was becoming, the two cast a wide Al Huma together and set it between Al and Yae, keeping them separated while creating a platform to fight on. Once the girls landed on the platform, Yae removed her shoes to increase her threads. After a small conversation, they introduced themselves before attacking once again. Rem used her morningstar to attack, and when Yae dodged, Emilia redirected the attack. With her threads, Yae managed to evade damage and start running along the chain, using her threads to pull down the numerous stone weapons Al created above her like rain. Using her ice soldiers, she had them protect Rem and fight against Yae, ultimately resulting in Rem managing to land a strike against her. After redistributing the damage to her limbs, she was forced to counter Emilia and Rem with both her nigh invisible threads and numerous weapons attached to the ends. However, with Rem using the chains of her morningstar like gauntlets and Emilia using icy fog to find the threads, they managed to counter her instead. With the Icicle Line making her threads useless and Emilia and Rem facing her alongside 7 ice soldiers, she kissed her rings, setting the threads ablaze and cancelling out the cold. Being forced to fight them all off, Yae eventually jumped into the sky and used her threads to spin the entire platform. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 43 1.png|thumb|left|250px|Emilia and Rem vs. Al and Yae.]] The ice soldiers were all flown off of the platform, shattering on the walls of the canyon, with one of them preventing Emilia from falling before it broke. Rem, meanwhile, attempted to attack Yae but was countered by her. With Rem sent flying backwards, Emilia created wings of ice to catch to wind and glide towards Rem. In payback, the two decided to slam into the platform, causing it to spin vertically, unknowingly allowing for Al to fly high into the sky and glide on the wind with wings of stone. Yae, however, was able to keep herself still in the center of the platform and attempted to attack with steel thread iaido. However, with Rem having become more sensitive to emotions in the mana around her, she was able to counter everything Yae threw at them and counter. As they realized that Al had been flung into the sky, Rem helped to fling Emilia upward to take on Al while she kept Yae in check. Fighting on all fours and in concert with her morningstar, Rem was able to prevent Yae from attacking Emilia as well as keep her on defense. Triggering her flames again, she used it as a distraction to use her steel thread iaido again to decapitate Rem, but she failed when Rem dodged it again. Continuing to get under Yae's skin and make her lose her temper, she forced more of her murderous intent out, making it easier for Rem to dodge her. Eventually, when the ice floe reached the final five seconds of its fall, Rem shouted ten seconds, disorienting Yae. With the ice floe slamming into the frozen river below, Rem jumped just prior to the impact to reduce prevent the fall damage, and she used the shattered pieces of ice to propel herself toward Yae, who had taken the impact and was left midair. Using her threads to move herself, she used her threads to grab one of the ice chunks and slammed it directly into Rem, followed by more thrown ice chunks. Despite this, Rem used her morningstar to strike Yae directly. Though heavily damaged, thanks to Yae manipulating the position of her organs, she escaped fatal damage, and by tightening her muscles, she trapped the piercing spike in her body, immobilizing the weapon. Rem then jumped forward to attack her. Before she was torn apart by Yae thread, she froze her blood onto the threads, temporarily immobilizing them and preventing damage. Yae attempted to break through it by igniting her threads again, but Rem readied her final attack, forcing Yae to use the thread ring attached to her tongue to slash Rem's neck. Despite this, the wound quickly shut, and Rem struck Yae, defeating her. Holding her down with her chains, she decided to heal Yae just enough to stop bleeding, but when a sudden explosion hit the area, Yae took advantage of this to escape her chains and rush toward Al's side. ====The Following Star vs the Witch of Melancholy==== Having used his Authority repeatedly to perfect his wings, Al managed to gather enough momentum to glide away from Yae's group. However, behind him, Emilia was chasing after him with her own wings, creating icy platforms to kick off of to gain both height and momentum. Using stones falling from the sky, he attempted to fend her off. However, she was able to overcome all of it with her magic and her icy swords. Intending to make her remove her wings, he used sandy earth to force her to shed her wings, and to prevent her from regrowing them, he created numerous arms from the canyon walls to stop her momentum. However, she overcame all of this with her ice soldiers and recreated her wings. Eventually, Al summoned a meteor like he did in the Royal Capital to try and fend her off. Though she attempted to stop it, Al interfered, forcing her to charge after him instead and escape the meteor. Though he attempted to thwart her numerous times, both firing at her and using his Authority, he eventually put himself visibly at risk in order to force Emilia to protect him, causing her to be knocked out in the process. After landing on the ground, Al pinned her into a wall to prevent her from drowning in the river. At the same time, he realized he was in the Agzadd Canyon and proceeded to make his way to the Grand Mogolade Geyser, expecting to meet up with the others. Still suffering from exhaustion, he trekked forward before being stopped by ice. A few moments later, he found himself faced with Felt and the others who fought off Roy. Using his Authority, he recognized that Petra was using the Authority of Melancholy, and he survived the ambush attacks from the numerous members of the force against him. At one point, he grabbed for Petra, who escaped and confirmed that Al was going back in time. Then, Petra used Compress Agony against Al to speed up his thoughts and overheat from the knowledge he was being forced to accumulate through his Authority. However, now cornered, Al reconstituted his Authority, unintentionally triggering the Aggressor side, and shortly after, Rom, followed by a few others, lost consciousness. After Petra compressed everyone's reactions, Ram took charge of the forces while Petra observed Rom's collapse. After Felt rebuked Al for his behavior and lack of a sense of self, and after he heard Petra when she realized that Rom was counting something, Al reconstituted his Authority once again, this time intentionally triggering Aggressor on each person around him. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 43 9.png|thumb|right|180x|Al's Domain cut off.]] Having defeated everyone, Al attempted to use his Aggressor on Petra, forcing her into numerous loops. Despite this, she eventually, after an extreme number of times, concluded that Al needed to undo the Domain himself. As such, after informing him that it will not work against her, aware that she would not stop trying and that everyone was already defeated anyway, and that she has become the kind of Witch incapable of giving up, she used Compress Agony to force him to experience all of the trauma he suppressed all at once. After that and coming to dread Petra as a true Witch that Aggressor would not work against, he reset his Domain and contemplated her next move. After being released, Petra used Compression to summon Roy between them to distract him, which Al responded to by preventing him from eating anyone's memories and prevent Reinhard's possible arrival. However, she also summoned Ferris behind him, where he used the strongest healing magic in the world to prevent Al from dying, effectively sealing his Domain. Just as he was about to lose, however, the breath from Volcanica struck the Geyser, causing an immense blast of wind and water to give him an opening from everyone, who were also caught up in the blast. Taking advantage of this, Aldebaran yelled for Roy to devour his name, proclaiming himself to be Natsuki Rigel. Despite calling out for him, he could not find Roy, and afterward, having lost access to his Authority, he struggled with indecision of how to proceed. Soon enough, he spotted Roy and rushed in his direction, only to be stopped by Yae, who had heard his cry and who had claimed that she did not want to forget him. Stopped in their tracks as a flood was heading their way, Emilia, who had been healed and awakened by Ferris, appeared overhead, and as the massive flood came close, Emilia used her magic to continuously freeze it all over, putting immense strain on her. As this took place, Petra confronted Roy, giving her name to him and allowing him to devour her name and memories, which consumed his life in the process. However, by doing this, Satella retreated, and Reinhard used his Divine Protection of the Phoenix to revive in the middle of the battlefield, kill Roy, defeat Yae, and cut through Al to retrieve the sealed Subaru. Drawing the Dragon Sword Reid, he cut through the seal and released Subaru and Beatrice, and in that moment, with Rem having been entrusted to do so by Petra, she swung her morningstar at Subaru, allowing him to restart. ===What Followed=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 43 11.png|thumb|left|180x|Aldebaran sealed.]] After returning to a point before Al sealed him, Subaru and Beatrice managed to recreate Ol Shamak and prepared for Al's ambush. After some time warning everyone, they went about normally, waiting for Al to ambush Subaru. After a short conversation in the Taygeta Library, everyone realized that he was set on taking down Subaru, and as he was preparing his seal, Subaru and Beatrice sealed him instead. {{Clear}} ==Aftermath== Ultimately, with Subaru having managed to return to the time before Al had sealed him away and instead sealing him, all the damages that he caused throughout the incident were completely undone. Having come to the conclusion that he could no longer remain ignorant of either the Kingdom's or the world's history, as well as that Roy can regurgitate all of the names and memories of the Gluttony victims, Subaru's party returned to the Royal Capital, intent on confronting Roy and learning about the past. Meanwhile, Ezzo and Flam remained behind at the tower. As all of the events were undone, Yae never received the signal for the commencement of the plan. As such, she returned to Heinkel's side and claimed as much before tying him up and leaving him at the cabin they were using as a hideout. Afterward, she made her way to the Barielle Estate, where she revealed Priscilla's will in making Schult her adoptive son and successor, inheriting the Barielle Domain and becoming Schult Barielle in the process, interfering with Roswaal's intentions. As a result of this, Yae decided to stick with Schult until Al reappeared, and she advised Schult to keep his distance from the Emilia Camp. Meanwhile, Heinkel escaped from his bindings and walked away. ==Trivia== *In a previous Q&A, the author has said [[Arc 8]] (now Arc 9) would have a situation where Subaru would be unable to die in an unnamed battle.[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/347925526373101568 June 20, 2013 Q&A] This seemingly came true in Arc 9, as due to Al sealing away Subaru throughout essentially the entire battle, he was unable to die until the end. **Similarly, in a previous talk show, the author claimed that Subaru would be getting plenty of rest in Arc 9. This was also likely in reference to Subaru's sealing during the course of the conflict. *The Sasageru IF, released in April 2026, takes place in an alternate timeline in which Aldebaran successfully managed to drop the sealed Subaru and Beatrice down the Grand Mogolade Geyser. As such, the aftermath of the conflict was entirely different. **Due to Subaru's sealing, Al became recognized as the Traitor, and Emilia froze him alongside herself, and they remained frozen for the next 400 years. **Otto's descendants harbored a long-held desire to free Subaru from the Geyser and unseal him, which was accomplished 400 years later by [[Nikola Suwen]]. **[[Julius Juukulius]]'s contracted spirits eventually became great spirits, taking new names and the Juukulius surname in accordance with what he left in his will. The six spirit princesses went on to become the lesser lords of the Juukulius Domain of Vollachia. Like Otto's descendants, they were involved in the attempt to free Subaru, with five of them eventually sacrificing their lives to [[Arakiya]] so that she could repel [[Vague Adgard]], while the remaining sister, [[Ia|Lumera Ia Juukulius]], successfully located the orb containing Subaru and Beatrice. **The conspirators of Aldebaran's scheme were all executed. **Due to the Divine Dragon's apparent involvement in the conflict, the [[Divine Dragon Church]] was dismantled. **The majority of the Combined Forces of the Emilia and Felt Camps did not recover from Al's Aggressor. Those that did recounted the tale in the future and spent their lives reconciling with the aftermath. **Petra remained the Witch of Melancholy, and in place of the Witch of Envy, whose fate was left unknown, her name as a Witch was what became feared in her place. During her time, Petra's age seemed to remain unchanged, she protected the Grand Mogolade Geyser for the next 400 years, she erased her name, her ambitions, her relationships, and the Imaginary Subaru to avoid being pursued by the Witch of Envy, and she held enough strength to match Vague Adgard. It remains unclear if Petra's decision to become the Witch of Melancholy became the major disaster prophesied as the "Witch of the Kingdom" that was set to take place in Lugunica. **Having not been part of the final battle, Meili was not subject to the Aggressor of the Domain. After Petra became the Witch of Melancholy, Meili stuck by her side, preventing her from becoming a calamity. In accordance with a request from Meili, the Crimson Scorpion stayed with the Witch for hundreds of years, growing to be large during that timeframe. **Though the reasons were unexplained and it is unclear if it is related to the Pleiades Sealing Conflict, Reinhard was executed. Following his death, the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint was extinguished along with the Astrea bloodline, and the Dragon Sword Reid eventually went missing. **With Subaru gone, Roswaal spent his time helping the survivors of the attack by granting their wishes before passing away. **Due to Subaru's sealing, Rem eventually visited [[Vincent Vollachia]] and requested his assistance, which he gave. **The Witch Cult was completely dismantled, while Lugunica met its end and was eventually subsumed into Vollachia. **Kararagi, like Lugunica, was eventually subsumed into Vollachia by one of the descendants of Vincent and [[Medium O'Connell]], turning the Sacred Vollachia Empire into the Unified Empire of Vollachia. **The fates of the many people involved in the Royal Selection were left undetermined. **Vague Adgard eventually managed to be free of his confinement and eventually went on to slay almost every existing spirit in the world, including [[Zarestia]], [[Odglass]], and most of Julius's contracted spirits. He continues to hunt down all the spirits in an attempt to eradicate the remaining spirits. ***Because Odglass's death diminished the [[Gustekan Church]]'s influence in [[Gusteko]], [[Rosalind Vollachia]], the unified empress, also sought to absorb it into Vollachia. However, after she passed away from illness, her position as the unified emperor and her desire to establish a worldwide empire were succeeded by her daughter. **Arakiya, having devoured [[Muspel]], became long-lived and unaging, staying as a consistent member of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] for over 400 years. She and [[Cecilus Segmunt]] had a number of children together, though within 400 years, the Segmunt line fully died out. Because of her connection to Muspel, she is one of Vague's targets. **Due to their nature as dragonkin, [[Madelyn Eschart]] and Clind lived through the centuries without any changes to their appearances and became involved with Subaru following his unsealing. Like Arakiya, Madelyn remained a member of the Nine Divine Generals, while Clind, having given Petra the Witch Factor of Melancholy, entered a depression, which was exacerbated by Frederica's eventual death. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[Category:Kararagi]]

title: Royal Family
wikitext:
The '''Royal Family of Lugunica''' (ルグニカ王家, ''Rugunika Ōke'') was the family at the top of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]’s hierarchy, ostensibly making them the leaders of Lugunica. Although the royal family has been around since the time of the nation’s founding, the family is on the verge of extinction, and as such, there is no patriarch or matriarch.

==Information==
===Overview===
The royal family is one of the most respected houses in the nation, known for being quite lenient and kind in their ruling, and they are well known for sharing some of the same characteristics throughout every generation: golden hair and crimson eyes, a telltale mark of the royal family.<ref>''"Blond hair and crimson eyes---these are peculiar to be the bloodline of the Lugunica Royal Family."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 1.</ref> The majority of the royal family, by nature, have been shown to be gentle and well-liked by others,<ref>''"By nature, many members of the Lugunican Royal Family had good personalities, who were gentle and well-liked by others, but His Highness Fourier was an individual of exceptionally cheerful and pleasant personality. So he would frequently sneak out of the Castle, and make merry with the people of the Royal Capital."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 9, Section 2.</ref> and they were shown to be willing to bend the rules when necessary in order to help their people. In fact, a previous king, [[Gionis Lugunica]], had even gone out of his way to help the Sword Demon [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]] reclaim his position within the [[Royal Army]] and obtain the acceptance of his replacing the Sword Saint of the time, [[Theresia van Astrea]], to allow her to retire and marry peacefully. They were known to possess the talent of virtue capable of mobilizing their surroundings just by speaking their desires.<ref>''That was why she was always talking, always laughing, always crying, and always on the move. ――The talent of individual virtue capable of mobilizing one’s surroundings just by speaking one’s desires, that was unmistakably the blood pedigree of the Lugunican Royal Family.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 3.</ref> As such, they have commanded a surprising level of loyalty and love from the populace.

This being said, however, the overall rule of the royal family has declined over time, with most internal politics having been deferred to the country’s Council of Wise Men. In fact, it can even be said that the royal family’s only true duty is to continue existing so that the covenant with the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] does not dissolve and so that peace can be maintained. Because of this, the royal family acts more as a figurehead family with only relative authority over the country. Of course, this is not to say that they are completely absent from national politics; the royal family are educated in politics and other such things required of the ruling family in their youth. In times of crisis, such as the [[Raid of Argyle Manor]] or the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]], the royal family can even easily assemble the forces required to combat threats that can threaten the nation.

Unfortunately, the royal family has faced hardships in the present day that have led to their downfall and possible extinction. Approximately 14 years prior to the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, at the same time as the [[Great Conquest]], Filore Lugunica, the daughter of King [[Randohal Lugunica]]’s younger brother Prince [[Ford Lugunica]], was kidnapped from the royal family in an incident known in the present as the [[Royal Abduction Incident]]. Though the incident has been kept quiet to the populace, it has resulted in the young princess’s name becoming something of a taboo that is not to be spoken of. More than a decade later, the royal family faced an unprecedented crisis: the entire family had [[Royal Plague|fallen ill]] and collapsed, one after the other. In time, starting with the prince [[Zabinel Lugunica]], the entire family started to die off, until finally, both Randohal and the fourth prince [[Fourier Lugunica]] died on the same day. As such, the royal family is either nearly or entirely extinct, with the only possible known survivor being the lost princess Filore. At present, while it is unconfirmed, due to her carrying the physical traits of the royal family and being roughly the same age as what Filore would be, [[Felt]] is heavily suspected to be the missing princess.

===Lion King===
[[File:Karstenemblem.png|thumb|right|The former emblem of the Lion King, which is now in use by House Karsten.]]
In times past, there were kings known as '''Lion Kings''' (獅子王, ''Shishiō'') that were regarded as sage kings whose uncanny intuition and leadership guided Lugunica to prosperity in the distant past. It is because of this that, in the past, the royal family carried significantly more influence than compared to the present, and once upon a time, the country and the royal family both carried the symbol of the lion rather than the [[Dragon]]. As of yet, there is only one known Lion King to have been named, and his name has carried a heavy influence as both the last known Lion King and for his efforts leading to the present day Kingdom: [[Farsale Lugunica]], the man responsible for the covenant with the Divine Dragon.

Although there has not been a Lion King since Farsale, there have been those who have been considered to have the traits that could signify them as potential Lion Kings.<ref>''"So you may say, Your Highness, but the blood has not run thin. It is a fact that once every several generations a true master appears in the royal line. Two generations ago..."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], A Dream's Beginning, Section 2.</ref> In particular, there have been two others that have been claimed to have this potential: [[Emerada Lugunica]] and Fourier Lugunica. In the case of Emerada, [[Miklotov McMahon]] has recognized her as having the qualities of being a Lion King, and she was apparently wise and capable. However, she was also unusually cruel and dark for a member of the royal family,<ref>''"Lady Emerada was a terribly beautiful and wise person... But she was also reportedly cruel in the extreme, and constantly shrouded in unfathomable darkness. As such, though she was part of the Royal Family, she was branded a heretic and even news of her passing seemed to have been suppressed for some time."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 3, Section 3.</ref> and as such, despised to the point that others did not want to provide her a funeral.<ref>''"Lady Emerada succumbed to an illness at a young age. However, not only was her death not mourned by the kingdom, she also was denied a state funeral, as would be standard. The stated reason was that the condition at the time were too dire to hold a formal ceremony. However, the real reason was that the kingdom's people had no desire to do any such thing."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 3, Section 3.</ref> On the other hand, Fourier has openly exhibited intuition reminiscent of past Lion Kings, including seemingly being able to predict the future with surprising accuracy, such as when he had the feeling that the wheel of a carriage would soon break, or before the Raid of Argyle Manor, in which his bad feelings came true.<ref>''He would on occasion sense an answer emerge, for no particular reason, from among countless choices. What he discovered this way always led him down the right path.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], A Dream's Beginning, Section 3.</ref> He also displayed intelligence and wisdom beyond his years, to the point that Miklotov believed him to also have the potential to be a Lion King. However, due to the skepticism of Fourier’s tutor toward the concept and neglecting to inform the man of the prince’s intuition, Fourier’s standing as a potential Lion King was left up in the air, and as such, his eventual death became little more than a footnote compared to the death of his father.

===Divine Dragon’s Covenant===
[[File:Re Zero Ex Volume 6 2.png|thumb|left|250px|Wilhelm and King Gionis discussing about the Divine Dragon's covenant.]]
During the era of the [[Witch#Witches of Sin|Witches of Sin]], the last Lion King Farsale went on a journey with several other famous historical figures: the [[Flugel|Sage]], the [[Echidna|Witch of Greed]], the [[Reid Astrea| first Sword Saint]], [[Alec Hoshin|Hoshin of the Wilderness]], and the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. Though it is unknown how these travels occurred, in time came the [[Great Calamity]], in which Satella was corrupted by the Witch Factor of Envy and set to destroy half of the world. Although it is unknown specifically when it happened, either before or after the Great Calamity, Farsale, who had befriended the Divine Dragon Volcanica, made a covenant with it which claimed that so long as the royal family existed, Volcanica would protect the nation from outside threats. This covenant went on to shape the future of the nation and went a long way to prevent further skirmishes with Lugunica’s neighbor, [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. Because of this, the symbol of the nation, the lion, was passed onto the [[House Karsten]], the family of Dukes and extremely loyal retainers to the royal family, while the nation became known as the Dragon Kingdom, and it took up the Dragon as its symbol.

It is because of the peace and prosperity brought about by the insurance of the covenant, however, that the royal family began losing its overall influence in national politics. As the need for a Lion King, of which there had been no more since Farsale, had become unnecessary, the royal family, in time, came to be little more than a family meant solely for upholding the covenant. This overreliance on the Divine Dragon’s protection eventually came back to bite everyone involved. As the nation settled for peace without conflict, as the royal family became less and less relevant to maintaining the country, the country became weaker and weaker over the centuries, and eventually, the royal family fell ill. Because of the deaths of the royal family, the covenant seems to be on the verge of shattering, which has led to the current [[Royal Selection]] in order to maintain it.

While the covenant seems to be on the verge of breaking, however, Felt, who is suspected of being the missing princess Filore, seems to have a heavy sway on the Divine Dragon, so much so that she has been compared to Farsale, and as such, she may possibly be the only thing keeping the covenant and the royal family afloat. However, though she is merely suspected of being Filore and there is no way to confirm her heritage, this is merely speculation.

==History==
===Within 1000 BA===
*Numerous Lion Kings have been born and led the Kingdom of Lugunica to prosperity.

===400 BA===
*Farsale Lugunica, the last Lion King, set out on a journey with Flugel, Echidna, Reid Astrea, Alec Hoshin, and Satella. According to Echidna, they kept their identities secret, and it was likely that the [[Black Serpent]] was chasing them.
*At one point during Farsale's travels, while within the country of [[Magrizza]], despite attempting to hide their identities, he declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. However, the nation's [[Minor Characters#Magrizza's Crown Prince|crown prince]], who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and Volcanica went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the Black Serpent destroyed Magrizza.
*At some point, Farsale befriended Volcanica, and he made a covenant with it to protect the Kingdom.
*At some point, Farsale became the 35th King of Lugunica.

===Approximately 50 BA===
*Princess Emerada Lugunica died at a young age due to a mysterious disease. For unknown reasons, the news of her death was kept secret for many years after. For yet stranger reasons, she was refused a state funeral, the reason vaguely being that “the national sentiment was against it”.

===40 BA===
*Following the end of the [[Demi-Human War]] and Wilhelm’s intrusion on Theresia’s commemoration ceremony, Gionis spoke with Theresia regarding Wilhelm’s treatment and her retirement, and he allowed both his pardon and her retirement in exchange for the two’s marriage.
*Gionis bore witness to Wilhelm’s battle against the [[Royal Army#Zergev Squadron|Zergev Squadron]] and [[Carol Remendis]], and after Wilhelm’s victory and Theresia’s intrusion, he reinstated Wilhelm as the Captain of the Zergev Squadron.
*Gionis attends Wilhelm and Theresia’s marriage ceremony.

===39-38 BA===
*Gionis speaks to the imprisoned [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] regarding [[Sphinx]]’s forbidden art and is given information on how it worked.
*During the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon, Gionis arrived at [[Picoutatte]], having called upon Volcanica using the covenant to end the incident.

===After 38 BA===
*At some point, Gionis was succeeded by his son, Randohal, who became the 41st King of Lugunica.

===Between 20-11 BA===
*Fourier met [[Crusch Karsten]] in the gardens of the royal castle. After meeting her and becoming infatuated with her, as well as giving her the courage to be herself, Fourier began practicing with the sword.

===14 BA===
*During the conflicts surrounding the Great Conquest, Ford Lugunica meets with Valga Cromwell, who at this point has been freed from captivity, and he entrusts an infant to him.
*Filore Lugunica, the infant daughter of Ford Lugunica, was kidnapped by a perpetrator who snuck into the castle undetected. The princess was never recovered. Though a false allegation, [[Heinkel Astrea]] was suspected to be a perpetrator of the incident. The Royal Abduction Incident and even the existence of the child was not publicly known, but the kidnapping of the royal baby would have major consequences within the internal society of the Royal Guard. It is one of few events not recorded in the [[Dragon History Stone]]. However, a current Royal Selection candidate, Felt, who is known to have the signature features of the Lugunica family, is suspected to be Filore.

===7 BA===
*Zabinel Lugunica was set to be engaged to the granddaughter of [[Minor Characters#Azah Febry|Azah Febry]], a member of the Council of Wise Men.

===6 BA===
*With assistance from [[Ferris]], Fourier escaped from a political marriage with the [[Tiriena|daughter]] of a [[Gusteko|Gustekan]] archbishop, resulting in her marrying [[Minor Characters#Misère|Misère]] instead.

===3 BA===
*Fourier battled Crusch in order to make her attend her own birthday party.
*During Crusch’s party, Fourier covers for Crusch after she goes to assist in the battle against the [[Great Rabbit]], which is what allowed her to become known as the Valkyrie.

===1 BA===
*Fourier and the Royal Treatment Center recommend Ferris for the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]], leading to his inauguration.
*At an unknown point, the members of the royal family contract a disease.
*After hearing of troubles surrounding House Argyle, Crusch decides to handle the problem on her own and confers with Fourier about keeping it secret from Ferris.
*Fourier informs Ferris of Crusch’s intentions, and after learning of her going missing and the [[undead]] appearing around Biehn’s residence, Fourier takes Ferris and [[Julius Juukulius]] to the manor while [[Minor Characters#Badak|Badak]] gathers reinforcements for the Raid of Argyle Manor.
*After Crusch was recovered and Argyle Manor burned down, Fourier collapsed to the disease, and soon after, the other members of the royal family fell ill.

===1 Year-9 Months BA===
*Starting with Zabinel Lugunica, the royal family begins to die off. Eventually, Fourier died in Crusch’s lap, and on the same day, Randohal died as well, making Fourier’s death a footnote in comparison. Their deaths became the trigger for the Royal Selection, which was set to determine the next monarch of the Kingdom in order to maintain the covenant with the Divine Dragon.

*Despite Emerada's supposed death, a Sin Archbishop of the [[Witch Cult]], [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]], seems to share her name. Likewise, though her true form is unknown due to her [[Authority#Authority of Lust|Authority of Lust]], the form she most commonly transforms into bears an uncanny resemblance to a member of the royal family, having the characteristics of both golden hair and crimson eyes. She also seems to bear a similar vile personality that Emerada was said to have.
*The royal family succumbing to disease was foretold by the Dragon History Stone.<ref>''Having grasped the fact that the prophetic tablet had been inscribed with information about a calamity that would soon strike the Kingdom of Lugunica―― a disease that would spread through the Royal Family, Leip blazed with aspirations towards the next battle for the throne that would follow thereafter.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 72, Section 1.</ref>
