13 of Miklotov's retainers}} The '''Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy''' (''unofficial name'') is an event that takes place approximately 1 year and 8 months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, in which, the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], silently infiltrated by [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]]'s [[Beloved Children]], began to target the [[Royal Selection]] camps during their attempt to silently bring down the Kingdom. It is the primary conflict of [[Arc 10]]. Due to the aftermath of the [[Battle for Priestella]] from months earlier, in the wake of the demise of [[Priscilla Barielle]] and sealing of [[Al|Aldebaran]], the [[Divine Dragon Church]]'s [[Filore]] appeared in the castle and obtained permission to heal the afflicted victims in [[Priestella]], starting by removing the [[curse]] from and attempting to restore the memories of Crusch. However, due to Crusch's recognition of traitors in the government, apparent murder of [[Miklotov McMahon]], and subsequent escape alongside Subaru and [[Beatrice]], the government of the Kingdom of Lugunica, due to the machinations of the Sin Archbishop of Lust, started to interrogate the camps of the Royal Selection, who had been stricken with false accusations. Meanwhile, Subaru's group joined up with the Kingdom's spy organization, the [[Six Tongues]], to bring down the menace of the [[Witch Cult]]. ==Background== ===The Silent War=== After the end of the [[Demi-Human War]], [[Bordeaux Zergev]] organized the Six Tongues with [[Orphe]] as its Director. Around ten years after its formation, the Six Tongues found itself facing a silent, unknown enemy that had created traitors within the government that were giving information and quietly causing chaos throughout the Kingdom. About two decades later, [[Russell Fellow]] became the Director and took over the silent war with the enemy, using his high-ranking position to, albeit with great difficulty, fight them off. Over the course of those decades, the Sin Archbishop of Lust, Capella, gathered many talented people, using them as her "Beloved Children". Using them, she silently replaced many of the government officials in the Lugunican government and using others to achieve her other goals, all the while keeping her identity and abilities a secret, not even allowing those very Beloved Children to know her face or identity. ===[[Royal Abduction Incident]]=== In an [[Royal Abduction Incident|incident]] supposedly not foretold by the [[Dragon History Stone]], the infant daughter of [[Ford Lugunica]], Filore, was said to have been kidnapped at the same time as the concurrent [[Great Conquest]]. This effectively caused major restructuring of the Royal Guard, threatening their disbandment entirely. Around the same time, [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] was escaping with an [[Felt|infant child]] while cursing the Kingdom, while at the Divine Dragon Church, an infant bearing the name of Filore appeared on their doorstep. This effectively led to the two being raised in environments apart from the castle, while their true identities remained unknown for the following decade. ===[[Royal Plague]]=== At an unknown point in time, [[Leip Barielle]] learned from the Dragon History Stone, of which he was the caretaker of, that the Kingdom's [[Royal Family|royal family]] would one day fall ill to a [[Royal Plague|plague]] and die. Intending to use the Royal Selection that would follow to his own ambition of secretly ruling the Kingdom, he kept this information to himself and made preparations by marrying Priscilla. Eventually, for reasons still unclear, the royal family did fall ill, collapsing one after the other shortly after the [[Raid of Argyle Manor]], and after a month, every member of the royal family perished. Following their deaths, though Crusch intended to remain strong and act in [[Fourier Lugunica]]'s stead, she became disillusioned with the government of the Kingdom, who were all more concerned with the covenant with [[Volcanica]] than with the deaths of their leading family. After Leip revealed the Royal Selection that was foretold by the Dragon History Stone, a Dragon Insignia was passed around until the Dragon Jewel shined in Crusch's hands, marking her as the very first candidate. After the meeting was over, she stood outside the castle and made a vow to Fourier to sever the covenant with Volcanica and restore the country, and she knighted [[Ferris]], who intended to carry on his will alongside her. Although his efforts to be the first one to bring in a candidate for the Royal Selection failed, Leip still kept with his preparations by having the captive [[Sphinx]] prepare a spell to control Priscilla, who he eventually revealed as the second candidate. However, his plans backfired due to both Priscilla and the man she decided to choose as her knight, Al. After his plan was thwarted and Leip experienced Al's Aggressor, he lost his mind, and eventually, he died, taking the secret that the royal family's demise was foretold to his grave. ===[[Subjugation of the White Whale|The]] [[Subjugation of Sloth|Subjugations]]=== Immediately after the commencement of the Royal Selection, Natsuki Subaru, who had made a fool of himself at the ceremony and was soundlessly defeated by [[Julius Juukulius]] in front of all of the knights, went on to negotiate with the [[Crusch Camp]], [[Anastasia Camp]], and Russell Fellow, using his phone as a means to negotiate with Russell. Thanks to this, he was able to lead subjugation forces against both the [[White Whale]] and [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]], successfully killing them and bringing about massive changes, though the events also ended with Crusch losing her memories and [[Rem]] losing her name and memories. Regardless, because of his success, the aftermath resulted in Capella taking drastic actions, something which ultimately led to a pair of her children, one of which included [[Melty Pristis]], to escape from her grasp and reach out to Six Tongues. Because of this, they officially became members, taking on the names of "White Sheep" and "[[Black Dog]]", provided information to Six Tongues, and won Russell's trust, and the fight against the Beloved Children started to take a turn during the following year. ===[[Battle for Priestella]]=== A year after the Royal Selection began, [[Anastasia Hoshin]], the third candidate, invited the other camps, sans Priscilla's who intruded anyway, to Priestella. In the battle with the Witch Cult that followed, many people, including Crusch, whose memories had been devoured the year before by the [[Lye Batenkaitos|Sin Archbishop of Gluttony]], fell victim to the Sin Archbishops. In Crusch and Subaru's case, they were cursed by the [[Dragon]]'s blood held by Capella, with the former being bedridden by the curse while the latter's leg regrew, as well as he absorbed a small portion of her curse into his arm. Julius also had his name erased, leading to his fight with Subaru being forgotten by everyone, possibly affecting the way the knights perceived Subaru. Likewise, it was seen by the Sin Archbishop of Wrath, [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]], that Subaru possessed the Witch Factor of Sloth, leading to her assumptions that Petelgeuse had slipped into his body. Though the Witch Cult was successfully repelled, Crusch remained bedridden for the next few months while Subaru and company left to find a way to heal the victims of the Witch Cult. Meanwhile, Sirius was escorted to the Prison Tower, where she was to be questioned by the government. It was also thanks to this that Capella's ability to transform herself and others came to light, and Six Tongues discovered that she was the leader of the Beloved Children. However, since she proclaimed her name on purpose, she used her identity and abilities to draw the Six Tongues’s eyes by creating several fakes of herself in different places, using the distraction to make her moves. ===The Fall of Priscilla Barielle=== During the [[Great Disaster]], Priscilla gave her life to repel Sphinx and the [[undead]] army that she created by becoming an undead herself. Once the Great Disaster was quelled, Priscilla faded away. Her death ultimately led to the disbandment of the [[Priscilla Camp]] and Aldebaran [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|scheming to seal Subaru away]]. Leaving [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]], the Anastasia Camp left for [[Kararagi]] while the [[Emilia Camp]] were persuaded to split up by Al. This led to [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and [[Frederica Baumann]] heading to the Barielle Domain with [[Schult Barielle|Schult]], Rem and [[Ram]] returning to [[Roswaal Manor]], [[Emilia]] and [[Otto Suwen]] to report the events in Vollachia and Priscilla's death to the Kingdom, and the remaining members of the camp to head for the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] with Al. However, thanks to Subaru having used Return by Death, he was able to seal Al away first, and as he prepared to head to the Royal Capital to reunite with everyone, he decided that he could no longer remain ignorant of the Kingdom's nor the world's history, choosing to look into it, leading to him questioning many things, including the Dragon History Stone, the fact that it supposedly didn't foretell something as major as the deaths of the royal family, and the potential that someone was using it for their schemes. ===The Sacraments of the Divine Dragon Church=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 44 12.png|thumb|right|180x|Filore choosing Heinkel as her knight.]] In response to the Battle for Priestella, Filore of the Divine Dragon Church eventually left for the castle, intending to offer her and the Church's assistance in healing the victims in Priestella. Despite her appearance, just like Felt's, and her name reminding everyone of the missing daughter of Ford who vanished in the Royal Abduction Incident, Miklotov decided to accept her proposal, which ultimately led to her speaking with the emotionally fragile Ferris and obtaining his permission to heal the cursed Crusch and attempt to restore her memories, the aftereffects of which gave her affected left eye draconic qualities. Afterward, she was discovered to have the qualities to become the country's monarch, and after some persuading by Emilia, she decided to accept the offer, taking [[Heinkel Astrea]] as her knight. Filore's decision to heal Crusch led to discord within her camp. Crusch, whose memories of Fourier had returned, awoke and questioned why Ferris would break the vow they made to Fourier. Afterward, Ferris decided to resign as her knight due to his actions and find somewhere else to work, not relying on the help of the other camps so as not to indirectly affect Crusch's already severely affected standings in the Royal Selection, a decision that later resulted in Russell confronting him and retrieving him, and Ferris working with him under the name of "Blue Snake". Crusch was also emotionally fragile because of this decision, and after meeting Subaru, she had questioned if what she was doing was wrong, which he refuted, though she had also harbored some jealousy at the fact that Subaru had gotten rid of the curse on his now bare arm. Without Ferris and after Subaru left, Crusch began questioning the circumstances around the demise of the royal family and the Dragon History Stone. ==Conspiracy== ===[[Great Escape]]=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 44 13.png|thumb|left|Crusch murdering Miklotov for treason.]] Following the invitation to the meet with Miklotov in his manor, Subaru and Beatrice traveled there, accompanied by [[Tiga Rauleon]]. Unbeknownst to them, Crusch had snuck out to speak with the man as well, but ultimately, she drew her blade and slayed them under suspicion of treason. Upon arrival at the manor, Subaru's group confronted her, leading to Tiga ultimately trying to kill her alongside Subaru when he saw the opening. Thanks to this, Beatrice assisted Crusch in escaping for saving Subaru's life, leading them into conflict with the [[Royal Army]] and suspicions that Subaru may have had ties to the Witch Cult in a manner similar to the Sin Archbishops. With the battle in Miklotov's manor as the precursor, Emilia, with Ram, and Felt were solicited and isolated in the castle, cutting them off from their camps. Meanwhile, their camps and [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] acted on their own to escape from the Kingdom's forces, including the coerced [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint]]. Thanks to Wilhelm's assistance and [[Meili Portroute]] using her witchbeasts and effectively ruining her good graces with the Kingdom, they managed to escape from Reinhard, and they hid away with the assistance of [[Conwood Melahau]], who owed Subaru for the White Whale. There, they chose to leave the capital. Meanwhile, Subaru and Beatrice, after having heard the situation of traitors and the Dragon History Stone from Crusch, chose to follow after her. They eventually came across [[Rachins Hoffman]], who was sent by Felt, and "Black Dog", and after confronting and escaping [[Clarissa]] of the Beloved Children, they met with Russell, who told him of their enemy, their enemies' goals, and their own plans to temporarily leave the capital. Despite his hesitation, thanks to "White Sheep", he agreed to go with everyone. Traveling in a convoy, an accident occurred nearby, and though "White Sheep" was told to convince Subaru to leave it be, because of "Blue Snake", Ferris, Subaru and Beatrice went to assist him in helping the victims of the accident. They managed to heal the injured with help from the citizens of the Royal Capital and the Guard Corps, but when the knights attempted to interfere to apprehend Ferris and, in [[Minor Characters#Zeolle|Zeolle]]'s case, kill Subaru, Crusch assisted in holding off the knights while Ferris continued to heal the injured, and after he was done, with the help of Black Dog, the citizens, and the Guard Corps, they managed to escape the Royal Capital with Six Tongues. In response to their escape, the government put out wanted notices for everyone in the camps, and though they sent a summons to Roswaal to appear at the castle, he not only refused the summons, but he, Frederica, the [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzus]], and the servants of Roswaal Manor all vanished, severing all possible contacts. ===Castle Break=== Following the escape of the Royal selection camps, Filore had Heinkel escorted to her, and though he had warned her that it wasn't a good idea to make him her knight, with the offer of curing his [[Louanna Astrea|wife]] on the table, he became Filore's knight. Over the following month and a half, he aided her in her attempts to help the people, directing everyone as needed and doing stacks of paperwork for her and the church. Over that time, Filore made countless appeals to the castle and the church to visit the isolated Emilia and Felt and to heal the people of Priestella, but she was left "pending" by both parties, leaving Heinkel suspicious of the church as well as the castle. Eventually, Filore sent Tiga and Sakura away, and after asking him how one would escape from the castle and showing him a map she made, despite Heinkel's protests, he chose to assist her, claiming that they would need two weeks of preparation before they could infiltrate the castle and maintain updated information. Around the same time, [[Marcos Gildark]], commander of the knight, colluded with Ram in an effort to help them escape, with Ram rewriting the formula preventing the use of magic to one silencing anything that happened within the wing and Marcos purposefully thinning the roster of knights guarding the wing they were isolated in. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 45 13.png|thumb|right|180x|Filore busting Felt out of confinement.]] Once Filore and Heinkel's preparations were complete and the deadline approached, Filore and Heinkel approached the castle with another appeal as a smokescreen, and they made their way to the East Wing where the girls were being held. Heinkel quickly dispatched the knights there to watch over Felt, and after speaking with Felt, who had also been preparing to escape, they left to bust out Emilia, whose room was supposed to be more heavily fortified and blocked off magic. However, upon approaching the room, Heinkel moved ahead out of suspicion due to the lack of knights until he was forcibly halted by Marcos, who was there to escort the candidates out of the castle. Believing Heinkel to be using Filore and to not be an ally, Marcos ruthlessly and mercilessly beat Heinkel to the verge of death, though he was ultimately stopped by Filore, who stood in his path and told him that it was her plan. Felt, meanwhile, helped Emilia out of her room, and Marcos's intentions to help the candidates and leave the capital came to light. Once Filore healed Heinkel, Marcos picked him up, and they made their way to leave. ===[[Emergence of Kugelschreiber Castle]]=== Over the two months that Subaru’s group travelled, they successfully managed to remove six impostors and save many lives at said impostors’ hands. After one such operation, the group gathered and spoke of how to get in touch with Roswaal and the intention to gather information on reversing Capella’s Authority through the soul experiments of [[Echidna]]. After conversation between Subaru and Beatrice, the group decided to go to Flugel’s Tree, where they scattered the crowds and opened up a spatial rift via Door Crossing to reach Beatrice’s childhood home, Kugelschreiber Castle, where she suspected Echidna had stashed her soul experiment records. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 46 13.png|thumb|left|180x|Kugelschreiber Castle emerges from the alternate space.]] After arriving in the castle, the group fell upon many examples of Echidna's experiments, as well as numerous documents. After gathering up the documents, the group chose to split up so that Beatrice could retrieve something she had left behind four hundred years ago. However, having been discovered and followed by the Beloved Children, the group found themselves under attack. In the battle that ensued, Subaru's group were ultimately able to emerge victorious until Tiga appeared to assist the Beloved Children, claiming that the commotion caused the castle to emerge in the real world. {{Clear}} ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Royal Capital]] [[zh:术语:卢克尼卡颠覆阴谋]]

title: Filore Camp

[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 46 2.png|thumb|250px]]
The '''Filore Camp''' (フィルオーレ陣営, ''Firuōre Jin'ei'') is a [[Royal Selection]] team that is led by [[Filore]].

==Information==
Filore's proposed platform in the Royal Selection is to tear down the wall that divides the church and the castle. In doing so, neither group would hesitate to approach the other, and a tragedy like the [[Royal Plague]] would never have to happen again. With the formation of her camp, [[Tiga Rauleon]] and [[Sakura Element]], both members of the church alongside her, became involved in her camp, and later, she chose [[Heinkel Astrea]] as her knight.

Due to her striking resemblance to the Lugunican [[Royal Family]], her age roughly matching the number of years since the child of [[Ford Lugunica]], Filore Lugunica, was kidnapped, and her own name supposedly being Filore, there is a possibility that, like [[Felt]], she could be a potential royal. However, any effect this has on her standings is as of yet unseen.

==History==
Some months following the aftermath of the [[Witch Cult]]'s attack on [[Priestella]], the Divine Dragon Church's Filore approached the Royal Castle as their emissary, intending to provide aid to the victims of the [[Battle for Priestella]] with their sacraments. Following a meeting which had the Council of Wise Men, the knights, and the noble civil servants in attendance, during which they accepted Filore's proposition to provide an example of the Divine Dragon Church's capacity to provide, [[Marcos Gildark]] took Filore to the Karsten Manor, where she met [[Ferris]]. Having been unable to heal [[Crusch Karsten]] from the effects of her [[curse]] no matter how hard he tried, he resigned his efforts and allowed Filore to use a sacrament in order to treat his mistress, and she succeeded. Afterward, once she was brought to the castle, where she met Felt, she was revealed to be a new candidate of the Royal Selection. Shortly afterward, she met members of the [[Emilia Camp]] and befriended them. After a meeting with them concerning her participation in the selection, [[Emilia]] convinced her to participate, and when they later spoke with [[Miklotov McMahon]], she elected to take Heinkel, a man supposedly chosen by the [[Volcanica|Dragon]], as her knight.

In the [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|conflict]] that followed, however, she was left as the only candidate not under suspicion when Crusch apparently killed Mikltov, [[Natsuki Subaru]] aided in her escape, and Felt, as well as the other camps, were placed under scrutiny. Though she supported Emilia and Felt, for the following month and a half, she collected Heinkel, helped provide relief to the people as the Church's Saintess, and continuously sent letters to the castle in regards to visiting the isolated Emilia and Felt and trying to heal the Priestella victims. However, both the church and the castle deliberately acted against her wishes, albeit indirectly. After visiting the castle and learning of the predicament of [[Reinhard van Astrea]], she and Heinkel conspired to break the candidates out of the castle, which they enacted half a month later.

==Achievements==
*Purportedly healing Crusch Karsten, who was afflicted by a curse from the [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop of Lust]]'s Dragon blood, with the use of one of the Divine Dragon Church's sacraments. (Tentative)<ref group="Note">Due to the tension brought about by the apparent assassination of Miklotov McMahon, which was purportedly done by Crusch, this achievement may have backfired and instead been considered negatively. However, as the conflict is ongoing, whether this will remain as an achievement has yet to be seen.</ref>
*Helping restore stability within the [[Royal Capital]] during the turmoil caused by the escape of the Royal Selection camps.

13 of Miklotov's "retainers" slain
Numerous citizens injured}} The '''Great Escape''' (大逃走) is a battle that took place approximately one year and eight months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, and it is the earliest conflict in [[Arc 10]]. It is the earliest battle of the [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy]], in which the [[Royal Selection]] camps, targeted by the corrupted [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunican]] government, escape from the [[Royal Capital]]. With the memories of [[Crusch Karsten]] returned and her [[curse]] removed, she slays [[Miklotov McMahon]] for treason, resulting in her, Subaru, and [[Beatrice]] running from the [[Royal Army]]. Taking the opportunity, the government, corrupted by a [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Sin Archbishop]]'s [[Beloved Children|special forces]], began to isolate the candidates and their camps, effectively forcing the camps to flee from the Royal Capital before they could lose their freedom to act on their own. Despite the Kingdom forcing the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint]] into cooperating with them, with the assistance of the [[Six Tongues]] and the different camps choosing to work together, everyone but [[Emilia]], [[Ram]], and [[Felt]], isolated within the castle, were able to escape. ==Background== ===[[Battle for Priestella]]=== The [[Battle for Priestella]], ignited by the capture of [[Priestella]] by the hands of the [[Witch Cult]], resulted in the death, defeat, and capture of multiple Sin Archbishops. With the capture of [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]], she had made claims that Subaru was instead replaced by [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]] during her interrogations. Meanwhile, Capella Emerada Lugunica, who had merely used the Battle for Priestella, the exposure of her identity there, and the reveal of her [[Authority]] as a stepping-stone to distract the Six Tongues, began speeding up her movements, replacing various members of the government's upper echelons, including members of the Council of Wise Men. Thanks to this, she began using her Beloved Children to start making moves to attack the Royal Selection candidates and their camps. ===[[Pleiades Sealing Conflict]]=== After the death of [[Priscilla Barielle]], Subaru and company, alongside [[Al|Aldebaran]], made their way toward the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] at Al's request. There, Al attempted to seal Subaru away, but instead, because Subaru had already used Return by Death, he and Beatrice sealed him away. Thanks to this, Subaru began to express interest in learning of the history of the Kingdom and the world, as he believed he could no longer remain ignorant, and he and his group traveled to the Royal Capital to reunite with the others and investigate. ===Sacraments of the Divine Dragon Church=== Fed up with the inaction of the castle after the events in Priestella, a young nun from the [[Divine Dragon Church]] named [[Filore]] appeared within the castle and pleaded with them to take action. Thanks to this, she proved herself by removing the curse from Crusch and restoring only her memory of [[Fourier Lugunica]], which helped to solidify her stance and be provided with permission to heal the victims in Priestella. However, because of her actions, Filore was found to be a Royal Selection candidate, [[Ferris]] resigned as Crusch's knight, Crusch was reassured of her actions by Subaru and locked herself away, Subaru learned of her history with Fourier and began to doubt the [[Dragon History Stone]], and Ferris made a deal with [[Russell Fellow]] to assist him. ==Escape== ===The Murder of Miklotov McMahon=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 44 13.png|thumb|left|180x|Crusch murdering Miklotov.]] During the meeting between Filore and Miklotov, where Filore decided to accept her role as the new candidate, Subaru, who had begun questioning the Dragon History Stone, managed to secure a meeting with Miklotov on the following day. The next day, after having shut herself away from the eyes of everyone, Crusch snuck out of the manor and visited Miklotov to ask for his opinion. However, when he sat her in a room on her own and mentioned prior guests, she picked up a strange wind from him, and when she went to question him, his retainers attempted to stop her. Coming to the conclusion that he was one of the traitors that she suspected, she cut down his retainers before cutting him down. At the same time, Subaru approached the estate with Beatrice and [[Tiga Rauleon]], who was also invited to the manor, while their respective camps were preparing to leave for Priestella. However, as they approached, they noticed the scent of blood and decided to investigate quietly, leading to them discovering the bodies of the retainers and Crusch standing over Miklotov's corpse. Realizing that they were there, Crusch asked Subaru if he was the same man that she knew considering how coincidental it was that he would come there on that specific day. Although Subaru was left heavily confused and speechless, Tiga was the one who continued the conversation, asking her if she was the one who killed everyone there, to which she attested to. This led to Crusch and Tiga entering combat. Although Subaru had successfully managed to plea to talk with her, he was killed by an unknown force after she knocked him out, and due to the misunderstanding that his death caused him, he decided to help Tiga subdue her. Interfering with her magic, Subaru asked her to surrender as he had made it difficult for her to fight. Crusch revealed her draconic eye, however, and was able to swiftly deal with Tiga. As they fought, Subaru noticed that she seemed to be on the verge of tears, and thinking he would get rid of those tears, he moved forward, using EMM and Invisible Providence to cancel out her damage and disarm her before he pressed her against the wall, claiming that something was wrong and that he couldn't accept it. However, before they could proceed further, Crusch tackled Subaru to the ground just as Tiga managed to cast fire magic at them in spite of EMT being active, heavily burning Subaru's right arm and knocking him out. Beatrice spoke with Tiga about his actions, and though she didn't blame him and he declared it was to reclaim his own life, Crusch severed the dead spot of the flames. Beatrice, in response to her saving Subaru, decided to side with her and deactivated EMT, allowing Crusch to cast her magic and let them escape. ===Castle Confinement=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 45 6.png|thumb|right|180x|Marcos bringing Emilia to the castle.]] At the same time as Subaru escaped with Crusch, [[Marcos Gildark]] entered the temporary residence the Emilia Camp was using with knights in tow, and after apologizing, he explained that they were there to take Emilia to the castle in order to ascertain Subaru's identity, as he was under suspicion of being connected to the Witch Cult akin to a Sin Archbishop. His accusation served to incense the camp members there and argue against his accusations, and though they managed to keep themselves calm, when Rem asked about Subaru, the knights became hostile, which Marcos was forced to quell. After apologizing to [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]], who had felt his strength, he once again asked for Emilia to accompany them, and after they were told she could only take one attendant who was not primarily a combatant, Ram forced herself to go with her, and they left for the castle. Around the same time, Felt, who was already suspecting that the Royal Selection was being targeted, ordered [[Rachins Hoffman]], [[Gaston]], and [[Camberley]] to search for Subaru's group and keep them in sight, as Felt was also being summoned to the castle with false charges. Upon arriving, Emilia and Ram were brought to the chambers of the Council of Wise Men, every door behind them shut along the way, where Bordeaux and the other wise men, as well as Filore and [[Sakura Element]], were waiting. Though Filore made a scene of taking Emilia's side, she was eventually sat down. Afterward, Emilia was questioned about Subaru's identity, as they claimed that not only were his achievements extremely convenient, especially the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] and the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], and possibly orchestrated, but based on testimonies from Sirius, who they had been interrogating, and Miklotov's own insights, they began to harbor suspicion that Petelgeuse had taken over Subaru and had been masquerading as a part of their camp. They also claimed that they did not know why Miklotov had summoned Subaru, but he claimed that it was likely that Subaru had let him die due to inconvenience. Despite this, Emilia and Ram both heavily refuted those claims, and Emilia announced her identity and her implicitly placed trust in Subaru, claiming that they would not let these allegations win against them. After Marcos received a report that the other members of the camp had escaped, Bordeaux commanded that Emilia and Ram remain at the castle and had them escorted out. Afterward, Felt appeared and expressed her concern, claiming the whole thing to be a farce since she had owed Subaru and Emilia and had seen real Sin Archbishops for herself. Though both she and Filore, who was upset at the one-sided questioning, expressed their concerns, Felt also revealed that she was called in for questioning, and she mentioned that Reinhard had been summoned to another part of the castle, where, unbeknownst to her, he was tasked with capturing the fleeing members of the Emilia Camp, using the name Valga Cromwell as leverage. ===The Emilia Camp in Flight=== Due to the death of Miklotov and Crusch going on the run, Wilhelm approached the castle to speak with Bordeaux, who refused to listen. Furthermore, the knights were sent to apprehend him. However, with the assistance of Rom, [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] managed to escape. Realizing what would happen with the Emilia Camp, he sent Wilhelm to assist them. After Emilia and Ram left with Marcos, Marcos having left knights there to watch over them as a form of house arrest, Otto had the other prepare for departure so that they could find Subaru and clear their names, as he had realized that the timing of this incident likely meant that someone was pulling the strings and attempting to knock both the Emilia and Crusch Camps out of the Royal Selection. With [[Petra Leyte|Petra]] coming up with a plan, they blocked the chimney to the manor they were staying in and set a fire beneath the floorboards to distract most of the knights, and Garfiel and Rem choked out the two remaining by the exit while the other were busy putting the fire out. With Otto speaking to the insects to lead them through back alleys, the group eventually found themselves at the wall between the Noble and Commoner Districts, and with Garfiel and Rem's help, they successfully scaled it. However, Otto could no longer hear the sound of the insects, realizing that they had disappeared after leading him into a trap, and shortly after, Reinhard appeared. Though they lamented the situation and Reinhard tried to persuade them to stand down, having sent out knights to create a perimeter to avoid real harm coming to either side, they declared their intent to keep running. Afterward, Garfiel flashed forward and battled Reinhard one on one for a time, surprising the Sword Saint with his improved strength. Though Otto continued to use his [[Divine Protection]], he couldn't get anything to listen to him, and Petra concluded that someone was using a Divine Protection to command the life around them. [[Meili Portroute|Meili]] considered using her Divine Protection to summon [[witchbeast]]s, though Petra shot her down since it could negatively affect the camp's already shaky standing. As they fought, Garfiel built up power with his own Divine Protection and eventually attempted to unleash it to send Reinhard flying, but this was quashed by a stomp, and Reinhard unleashed a palm strike on Garfiel. Grabbing hold of his right arm, he allowed Otto to charge, only to be struck down. From behind him, Petra unleashed her magic while Meili had the [[Shaula|Crimson Scorpion]] unleash its needles, and after he deflected those, Rem's morningstar came falling down, only to be kicked away. At that moment, Wilhelm appeared and charged in for an attack while Rem brought her morningstar back down and Garfiel continued to hold down his arm. Once again, Reinhard deflected the morningstar and even attempted to use Garfiel as a human shield to stop Wilhelm. However, after Garfiel and Wilhelm silently communicated with their eyes, Wilhelm cut right through Garfiel's flank and managed to deeply injure Reinhard's legs. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 45 8.png|thumb|left|180x|Meili using her Sand Earthworms to end the fight with Reinhard.]] With Reinhard injured and Garfiel released, Garfiel began healing himself while Wilhelm grabbed him and Otto and jumped away. He tasked Rem with carrying Petra and Meili, and Otto provided them a direction where there were no sounds of life. Reinhard, his legs needing time to heal, was not immediately able to follow them as they escaped, and though he called out to his grandfather, Wilhelm claimed he could not entrust matters to the Kingdom as things currently stood. Unable to give chase, Reinhard was able to draw the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]] and prepared to unleash it. However, despite how it would affect both the camp and herself, Meili chose to unleash the [[Witchbeast#Sand Earthworm|Sand Earthworms]] that she had follow beneath the ground from the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] at each gate of the Royal Capital, using that against Reinhard to force him to withdraw and sheathe his blade. Thanks to this, Wilhelm took everyone to a tavern owned by [[Conwood Melahau]], who owed Subaru for the White Whale, where they discussed their plan of action with Rom. Realizing they couldn’t remain in the capital, they chose to leave the capital, trusting Emilia, Felt, and Ram as they could only remain in the castle for the time being. ===The Six Tongues=== Due to the attack, Crusch escaped with Subaru and Beatrice, fleeing from the Royal Army, which was being partially led by Tiga, under the suspicion of murdering Miklotov and attempting to overthrow the Kingdom. They eventually found themselves in the sewers between the Noble and Commercial District, where Beatrice attempted to care for Subaru. After Subaru woke up, Beatrice apologized for being unable to heal him due to the lack of mana. After realizing that he was burned, he recalled what happened at the manor just as Crusch had returned to them, and she began tending to his arm. Although it was much to his confusion, Crusch eventually confirmed again that she killed Miklotov and explained to him that she did so because Miklotov was a traitor to the Kingdom, explaining the conclusion that she had reached prior. Though Subaru wanted more answers, Crusch and Beatrice decided to put that on hold in order to continue fleeing from their pursuers. Once Subaru realized that they were running away, Crusch explained to him their circumstances and that Tiga and the Royal Army were after them. Ultimately, despite the misunderstandings, Crusch was determined to deal with the traitors to the Kingdom and asked for Subaru's and Beatrice's help. After falsely claiming that her memories had returned and disparaging her memoryless self, their pursuers started catching up, and Crusch decided to run, leaving Subaru and Beatrice to make their decision. After a short conversation with Beatrice, the two decided to chase after Crusch, and Subaru hoped Otto would be able to figure things out. After about half a day later without a break, thanks to the tremors caused by Meili's actions, they were able to escape from their pursuers, giving them a brief respite, enough for Beatrice to heal Subaru's arm a little bit and for Crusch to thank them. As Subaru realized how his and Crusch's positions were reversed from back before the Subjugation of the White Whale and was resolved not to abandon her no matter what happened, they eventually noticed Rachins, who had been sent by Felt. Despite Crusch's suspicions, Subaru vouched for him and asked him about the affairs of the Emilia Camp, which led him to learn that not only were they on the run as fugitives, but the members of the Royal Selection were all being targeted, effectively confirming Crusch's suspicions, as well as casting suspicion on the Divine Dragon Church that started the mess. However, as the strain caused by her eye started to affect her, she passed out in Subaru's arms. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 45 10.png|thumb|right|180x|Clarissa appearing to deal with Subaru's group.]] As he put Crusch on his back and they prepared to leave, they found themselves facing a man in a jester's mask, who claimed that he only needed Crusch and hurled fire at them. Though Rachins jumped into the sewage to evade, Subaru stood still with Beatrice, realizing the man's aim was not to hurt Crusch. Thanks to his bet, the fire didn't reach him, and he entered a conversation with the man, learning that he was being accused of being a Sin Archbishop, until a [[Meteor#Conversation Mirror|Conversation Mirror]] lit up. After speaking with the person on the other side, he tossed the mirror to Subaru, allowing him to talk with a girl who called herself "[[Melty Pristis|White Sheep]]" and introduced the man as "Black Dog". She apologized for Black Dog's behavior and claimed they needed the power of Crusch's Divine Protection to fight against the new threat, who they called the "Beloved Children". As Black Dog was about to pull Rachins out of the sewage, however, a new person appeared, a woman that Black Dog and White Sheep recognized as the Cleaver, [[Clarissa]], a Beloved Child who used an unknown power to cause the sewers to collapse. After avoiding the collapse, Rachins unleashed flammable gas from a sedimentation tank, and when Black Dog pulled the others into a dome of earth, Rachins used Goa to ignite the gas, allowing them to escape as they lost consciousness. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 45 11.png|thumb|left|180x|Russell explaining the crisis befalling Lugunica.]] At the manor of Russell Fellow, Subaru, who had been healed by “Blue Snake”, awoke and found Crusch and Rachins asleep nearby. Soon after, White Sheep appeared and expressed her relief, followed by Russell himself, who asked for Subaru's help to resolve the threat to the Kingdom, which had already been quietly infiltrated by a longstanding bitter enemy. Using Subaru's cell phone, his own Divine Protection, and Subaru's actions during the Royal Selection Ceremony to confirm that Subaru wasn't a Witch Cultist, much less a Sin Archbishop, he declared that Subaru would be the most invaluable asset against their current enemy, and after Rachins woke up, he revealed himself to be the leader of Six Tongues. After, he explained their enemy, and after White Sheep spoke up to thank Subaru for defeating Petelgeuse and allowing her and Black Dog escape, they revealed that the enemy was Capella and that it was very likely that the government already had its upper ranks replaced by the Beloved Children and likely already had the Dragon History Stone in her grasp. Afterward, they spoke about leaving the Royal Capital, and despite Subaru’s reluctance to leave Emilia behind in the castle, thanks to Russell’s and White Sheep’s persuasion, he prepared to leave with the group, taking the Cognition Inhibiting Cloak that was provided to them. ===Escape from the Royal Capital=== With preparations made, everyone at Russell's manor created a convoy and followed the cacophony of people attempting to leave the Royal Capital. Upon reaching a checkpoint, Russell and White Sheep managed to persuade the guards to let them through without inspections, but thanks to a crash that caused numerous people injuries, Subaru, after pushing through White Sheep's persuasion after seeing "Blue Snake" go to help the injured, took Beatrice with him to help, where they discovered Blue Snake to be Ferris. Meanwhile, Crusch, having awakened, gave her demands to Russell, who was prepared to leave without Subaru and Ferris, that she would not cooperate with Six Tongues without Subaru there, and after leaving negotiations to Rachins, she left the carriages. Eventually, as Subaru, Beatrice, and Ferris worked to heal the injured with help from citizens like [[Kadomon Risch]] and the Guard Corps, the injured were slowly healed one by one. However, the building they were in began to collapse. With Beatrice casting Murak to reduce the weight of the falling second floor, Subaru, Kadomon, and others from the Guard Corps held it up while others pulled out Ferris and the injured, and afterward, let the building collapse as they moved to escape. At the same time, as Ferris continued to heal the other injured people, he was surrounded by the knights, who intended to bring him to the castle. Subaru got in their way when they began hurling suspicions, and though his words made some of the knights falter, the one commanding them, [[Minor Characters#Zeolle Zandrik|Zeolle Zandrik]], recognized him and pointed his blade at him, intending to kill him. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 45 12.png|thumb|right|180x|Crusch holding off the knights while Ferris heals the injured.]] As he was prepared to kill Subaru, Crusch appeared, her Dragon's Eye uncovered, and began attacking the knights, killing any knight who had been replaced by Capella and injuring those who had not, so that Ferris could heal the injured. Once the injured were healed, Black Dog created a smokescreen to assist in their escape, and Subaru used Invisible Providence to knock out Zeolle, who had not been replaced. With the citizens and the Guard Corps getting in the way of the knights, Subaru's group was able to return to Russell's carriage, and the group escaped the Royal Capital. ==Aftermath== With Emilia and Felt trapped in the castle, they were confined to the East Wing. Felt was left guarded by knights and even had her utensils replaced with wooden ones, and in order to prevent her from having an effect on the actions of Reinhard, they were kept separated. Emilia, meanwhile, was much more heavily guarded, with more patrols and anti-magical methods, though it was claimed to be less out of concern for her strength but out of fear of her lineage. Around this time, Filore had the knight retrieve Heinkel, who had been drinking in a tavern somewhere on the verge of giving up, and she took him as her knight. Meanwhile, Subaru and company started assisting the Six Tongues in their battle against the Beloved Children, taking on new codenames in their efforts to infiltrate the homes of impostors and bring them down quietly, rescuing anyone at odds with said impostor in the process. As for the rest of the camps, with them being forced on the run, the Beloved Children put out warrants for the arrest. Though they continued their search, the Six Tongues purposefully spread rumors of them being sighted within the Royal Capital, limiting the Beloved Children’s movement and narrowing the scope. Meanwhile, Roswaal and everyone else in his estate vanished. As for Reinhard, he was effectively shackled in place due to his strength, kept separate from Felt, monitored through the Beloved Children’s pawns, and was placed along the outside of the capital to utilize his strength and keep him away from the castle. ==Trivia== *The name is not used as a term within the story but is instead coined from the summary of [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 45|Volume 45]]. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Royal Capital]]

title: Kingdom of Lugunica
wikitext:
{{Topnote|This page is about the country. For the capital city of Lugunica, see [[Royal Capital]].}}
[[File:Flag of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica.svg|thumb|170x170px]]
The '''Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica''' (親竜王国ルグニカ, ''Shinryū Ōkoku Rugunika''), also known as the '''Kingdom of Lugunica''' (ルグニカ王国, ''Rugunika Ōkoku''), is one of the [[world]]’s Four Great Nations. It is where most of the main story takes place. It is a monarchy, historically ran by the now-supposedly-extinct Lugunican [[Royal Family]]. It borders, in one way or another, the other three Great Nations. 

Lugunica is a geographically large nation with a massive population of approximately 50 million individuals,<ref>''"Your population’s, like, fifty million people, right? Finding four in half a year sounds downright speedy."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 3, Section 6.</ref> with its territories able to support multiple environments and multiple climates. It is home to many races and ethnic groups and the nation's history spans at least one thousand years. It celebrates its nominal day of foundation on the 25th of the in-universe month, Marshba. The closest person to being the head of state in the absence of the monarch is [[Miklotov McMahon]], who has worked in a position of high office for the greater part of forty years.<ref>''"Miklotov MacMahon—a representative of the Council of Wise Men who was considered the brains of the kingdom. Miklotov was the one who wielded all the real power in the government."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref><ref>''"Mm. Yes, pardon me. I am Miklotov MacMahon. I don’t ordinarily attend these meetings, but as it was I who suggested Lady Mathers should be the one to investigate the magic circles,"'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Third Stanza, Section 1.</ref>

Despite economic recovery and relative peace and stability across most of the country, the contemporary Lugunica is negatively characterized by internal strife, racial tension, economic hardship among the disadvantaged, desperation for new decisive leadership by both the public and the ailing transitional government, and more recently, religious cult extremism and terrorism.

==Information==
===Geography===
[[File:Kingdom Lugunica.png|right|300px]]
The Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica is the easternmost country on the continent,<ref>''"If you look at a map of the continent, Lugunica is the country farthest to the east, so…there’s no country to the east of here."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 1, Section 6.</ref> bordering [[Gusteko]] to its north, [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]] to its south, and [[Kararagi]] to the west. Before the covenant with the Divine Dragon, it was once known as the '''Lion Kingdom''' (獅子王国, ''Shishi Ōkoku'').

The Royal Capital of Lugunica is located inside a complex of '''Five Great Cities''' (五大都市, ''Godai Toshi'') centered around the Royal Capital, forming the approximate shape of a pentagon.

The country contains several regions where mountains and hills are common, with the most prominent peaks located in the Royal Capital region. The country is expansive enough that it can support a wide range of different environments, from large temperate forests to Mediterranean climate regions to desert areas with sand dunes. Lugunica, in reality, doesn't seem to be all that big of a nation, considering the travel distances by foot, but since the country is seldom explored by the characters in the story, any attempts to estimate the size of the kingdom are simply impossible.

One of Lugunica's more notable features was [[Flugel's Tree]], a massive tree towering hundreds of feet high planted by [[Flugel|the Sage]] along the Lifaus Highway leading to the Royal Capital. The tree was brought down during the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], led by [[Crusch Karsten]].

===Population===
It is mentioned in the web novel that the population of the Kingdom of Lugunica is approximately 50 million people, which is absolutely massive for a medieval nation. For comparison, Japan only reached a population count of 50 million in the year 1909.<ref>[http://www.stat.go.jp/english/data/kokusei/2000/final/hyodai.htm Statistics Bureau of Japan]</ref> It is very possible that these numbers are exaggerated or even wildly inaccurate.

The Royal Capital, the city of Lugunica, is mentioned to have a population of around 300,000, with the other Five Great Cities having populations of 200,000 to 300,000 centered around it.<ref>Author Q&A - ''Questions about the Kingdom of Lugunica''</ref> Subaru estimates that the true population of the Royal Capital at any given time is much higher due to the lack of accountability for merchants, travelers, and others.<ref>[[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 1, Section 8.</ref> There are other small cities, towns, villages, and settlements dotted throughout the land, and the larger cities in particular have between 200,000 and 300,000 people each. Meanwhile, [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] are known to make settlements in secluded areas due to poor relations with humans.<ref>''"With the capital in the center, there are large cities placed like a six-pointed star, with populations around 200,000 to 300,000 people. Aside from those, small cities are scattered about, and it continues down through towns, villages, and settlements, you see. If you only look at humans, they mostly live in villages, but there are cases where demihumans create settlements in the mountains and woods and live there. Relations are quite bad."'' August 2, 2014 AskFM Q&A</ref>

The majority of Lugunica is human, but there is also a large minority of demi-humans. Demi-humans have historically been oppressed by the majority of humans, and tensions have led to outbreaks of rebellions. Although demi-humans typically inhabit the eastern, mountainous, and rural areas of the country, there are sizable populations of minorities in the cities.<ref>Author Q&A - ''Questions about the Kingdom of Lugunica''</ref> Elves and half-elves are known to inhabit Lugunica, as do many sentient [[Spirit|spirits]].

It is stated that the country is regionally divided into four: north, east, south, and west. According to [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], the west is considered a "place of exile for weirdos."

===Government===
Lugunica is also referred to as the '''Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica''', having prospered in the past due to the covenant with the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]]. The country often uses the '''[[Dragon History Stone]]''' to suppress any event it foretells, though it is questionable whether some of the things it foretells, such as the [[Royal Abduction Incident]] and the [[Royal Plague]], will be conveyed to the government. Its management was previously supervised by [[Leip Barielle]] before his passing.

As all known members of the royal family are now deceased, martial law is currently in effect, with the Council of Wise Men taking over the role of government for the time being. In accordance with the prophetical Dragon History Stone, five young women have been selected as candidates to become the '''Dragon Maiden''' (竜の巫女, ''Ryū no Miko'') and the elected monarch, who will renew the covenant through the '''Dragon Ceremony''' (親竜儀, ''Shinryūgi'').

===Mages===
The best mages of each of the six elements are given a '''color title''' (『色』の称号, ''Iro no Shougou''), which are aliases that show their skill with a particular element. These titles were first created when Lugunica reorganized the basis of their magic system following the [[Demi-Human War]]. Currently, Blue (water) belongs to [[Ferris|Felix Argyle]], Red (fire), Green (wind), and Yellow (earth) are the titles of Roswaal L. Mathers, while Black (yin) and White (yang) are vacant.

Whereas each country specializes in different forms of combat, Lugunica is said to be the country with the largest advancement in magic.<ref>''Compared to the technological prowess of the Kararagi City-States, the Spiritual Arts and Curse Arts of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, and the magical disciplines of the Kingdom of Lugunica, the Vollachian Empire excelled in the martial arts.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 98, Section 1.</ref> By comparison, in countries such as Kararagi or Vollachia, having magic is rare, and any healing mage is particularly valuable. On the other hand, in Lugunica, magic is a commonly seen skill utilized by the nation. The study of magic truly started when [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] formed the Royal Magic Research Institute, and those who can use healing magic are tutored in the Royal Treatment Center. As such, Lugunica is unique in its ability to provide advanced healthcare for its citizens.  

Following the events of the [[Battle for Priestella]], Ferris desperately researched healing magic in an effort to cure his master, which allowed him to elevate the field of healing magic in the Kingdom by "three whole levels."<ref>''Amidst his feelings of desperation, the research of the Blue had elevated the field of healing magic existing in the Kingdom of Lugunica by not one, but three whole levels in this short period, but at this time, that did not make Ferris feel anything other than worthless.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Curtain's Close, Section 6.</ref>

===Religion===
The country worships the Dragon as its national deity, and it is bound by a covenant established with the [[Farsale Lugunica|Lugunica royal family]] centuries ago. Imagery of the Dragon is seen in nearly every corner of Lugunica, despite the Dragon disassociating itself from the royalty. In response to the faith held in the Divine Dragon, the [[Divine Dragon Church]] was made, and so that they would not be mistaken for being involved in national politics, the church distanced itself from the castle, focusing on the well-being of the citizens. Similarly, because of how embedded faith of the Dragon is into the Kingdom's culture, almost nobody thinks to question the things connected to it unless they are not native or are given the stimulus to question it by someone who has doubts.

Figures such as the Sage and the [[Reid Astrea|first Sword Saint]] also seem to gather a worthy and comparable amount of respect, in both a biblical and secular manner, and imagery of them can be seen embedded into the currency used out of respect.

===Economics & Currency===
[[File:Holy Gold Coins.png|thumb|300px]]
Coinage in Lugunica comes in four known types of coins. The lowest denomination of coin is the copper coin, which has the figure of the Royal Castle on it. The second denomination of coin is the silver coin, which has the figure of the Sage on it. The third denomination of coin is the gold coin, which has the figure of the first Sword Saint on it. And finally, the most valuable coin is the holy gold coin, which has the figure of the Dragon on it.<ref>''"...he was able to confirm that commerce was handled in a currency of gold, silver, and copper coins."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref>

The price of things changes from time to time, especially in trade of vital resources in Lugunica like iron products and mana stones. However, it's been mentioned by characters in universe that in recent years, the country has been going through an economic downturn, further exacerbated by a recent great famine. Despite the current recovery, the nation’s troubles have left its finances unstable and its people desperate.

Considering the immense size of the Kingdom's population even during times of hardship, it can be assumed that the country has a massive, or at least an enhanced agricultural industry, yielding exotic fruits and all sorts of products such apples, lemons, peppers, and sugar at consistent rates, allowing the population to remain stable.

Also considering the extensive use of cut stone and in the construction of many of Lugunica's cities, it can be deduced that Lugunica also has an advanced craft sector composed of skilled stone masons, architects, and city planners. Engineering feats, such as wide paved roads in its major cities,<ref>''"So far, I haven’t seen anything mechanical, but the roads are pretty well paved…and of course I can’t use any of my cash."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> working water fountains in marketplaces, and the waterworks projects in [[Priestella]] give a sense of the advanced state of infrastructure, and thus society in urban Lugunica, which is already far past the state of things in our Medieval Era.

Fifteen is considered the legal age of adulthood in Lugunica and is the time people typically begin to enter the workforce. They're also allowed certain privileges, such as drinking and smoking. Slavery is illegal, thus all servants must be treated as employees and paid appropriately.

===Military===
Lugunica's national army is the [[Royal Army]], which is currently headed by [[Marcos Gildark]]. Beyond them, there are various provincial armies that help defend the country's border governed by regional lords. Lugunica is also capable of fielding an unknown number of magical artilleries bearing similarities to the [https://godzilla.fandom.com/wiki/Maser_Cannon Maser cannons] from the Godzilla series, as well as Night Banishers.

The country is also in the possession of by far the greatest military asset in the known world: the Sword Saint, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], as well as the still active Divine Dragon. Despite this, the Kingdom is much too unwieldy to bring its full strength to bear, nor will the Divine Dragon assist in an invasion. It is worth noting, however, that after forming a covenant with the Kingdom, Volcanica will come to the country's aid in the case of invasions, as it did during the campaigns of [[Stride Vollachia]].

According to Crusch Karsten, the nation has become much weaker due to the over-reliance on the Divine Dragon. As part of her efforts as one of the candidates of the Royal Selection, Crusch has begun resupplying the army with numerous weapons and armor, and she has also increased the quality of their training. The results of this training and re-arming, however, have yet to be seen due to the lack of major military resistance or terrorism.

==History==
*Note: The characters within the story rarely describe historical events within helpful context, so the unit '''BA''', “Before Arrival”, and '''AA''', “After Arrival”, will be used to place moments in time with the best available knowledge. Both are in reference to Natsuki Subaru’s arrival in the new world. In this case, only BA will be used. Also note that the units are not official.

===1000 BA===
*The Lugunica dynasty was founded at least a thousand years ago.<ref>''"Fourier Lugunica belonged to the royal family of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, a dynasty with more than a thousand years of history;"'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref>

===400 BA===
*The [[Sanctuary]] was assaulted by the [[Hector|Warlock of Melancholy]] in pursuit of the [[Echidna|Witch of Greed]]. However, the witch was able to evoke a barrier in time to fend him off.
*[[Alec Hoshin]] creates Priestella, which was said to be built as a trap to kill a Witch.
*The [[Witch#Witches of Sin|Witches of Sin]] start to die off for one reason or another. [[Typhon]] drowns in Priestella; [[Sekhmet]] falls off the Great Waterfall in a battle with the Divine Dragon; [[Daphne]] starves to death in the Augria Sand Dunes; [[Carmilla]] is burned at the stake; [[Minerva]] is trapped by the elves and killed by the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]; Echidna begins collecting the souls of the other Witches of Sin, and with the assistance of Volcanica, she becomes a core of the Sanctuary’s trials.
*The [[Great Calamity]] began with the appearance of the Witch of Envy. Starting from an unknown date and unknown location, the Witch irrationally began destroying the world around her, collapsing most of the old nations and killing many. Her actions also permanently scarred the geography of the world.
*The great sage Flugel, with the combined strengths of his apprentice [[Shaula]], the Divine Dragon Volcanica, and the first Sword Saint Reid Astrea, attempted to kill the rampaging Witch of Envy. However, because the witch is unable to be slain, she was instead sealed away within the vast expanse of the Augria Sand Dunes. The great [[Pleiades Watchtower]] was constructed to ensure that the witch was never freed again.
*Lugunica and its southern neighbor, the Vollachia Empire, were once again at war. The king of Lugunica at the time, Farsale Lugunica, made a covenant with the dragon Volcanica to have it protect the kingdom, bringing the conflict to an end. The pact binded Volcanica to protect the kingdom from any external threat but said nothing about intervening in offensive operations or in internal conflicts.

===Roughly 100 BA===
*The [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]] of the [[Witch Cult]], accompanied by the [[Pandora|Witch of Vainglory]], attack [[Elior Forest]] in search of a mysterious seal deep within the woods. The Witch directed the [[Black Serpent]] to the forest to aid their attack, which resulted in the forest being partially destroyed. Many elves were killed during the campaign. The assault ended when a young half-elf named [[Emilia]] froze the entire forest in a sudden uncontrolled rage. The forest, Emilia, and all of the remaining elves were left frozen in ice for nearly a century. This is referred to as the [[Permafrost of Elior Forest]].
*Around this time, Lugunica and Kararagi fight over the rights to own Priestella due to its geographical location and its creation by Alec Hoshin’s hands. In the end, however, after a drawn-out economic conflict, Lugunica maintained rights over Priestella.

===Approximately 50 BA===
*A Royal Princess of Lugunica, [[Emerada Lugunica]], died at a young age due to a mysterious disease. For unknown reasons, the news of her death was kept secret for many years after. For yet stranger reasons, she was refused a state funeral, the reason vaguely being that “the national sentiment was against it”.

===48-40 BA===
*Racial tensions reach their peak, and demi-humans become involved with a small conflict with a human village. During the negotiations between the two sides, the human representatives were assassinated, and both sides blamed each other. This conflict resulted in the start of the Demi-Human War.
*At some point during these times, the Sword Demon [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]] and the Sword Saint [[Theresia van Astrea]] meet each other.
*[[Battle of Redonas Plateau]], a battle that took place in 46 BA. A very early yet minor battle during the war in which Wilhelm and [[Grimm Fauzen]] took part. It ended in a Royal Army victory.
*[[Battle of Castour Field]], a battle that took place in 46 BA. Demi-humans ambushed and routed the Royal Army in one of the first major engagements of the war. An entire squad was wiped out with the exception of two soldiers, one of them being Wilhelm, due to following his intuition and pushing forward. Roswaal J. Mathers joins the war after the appearance of the Witch [[Sphinx]].
*[[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]], a battle that took place in 43 BA. Demi-humans destroyed three human armies in the largest and deadliest battle of the war.
*[[Invasion of the Royal Castle]], a battle that took place in 43 BA. A major event in which the Demi-Human Alliance attempted to invade the castle in the Royal Capital. This battle ended with one of the Demi-Human Alliance’s leaders, Sphinx, losing her arms, and then being captured by Leip Barielle as she attempted her escape. [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] is also defeated and imprisoned beneath the McMahon Manor.
*[[Battle of the Trias Domain]], a battle that took place in 42 BA. The Trias family, save for Wilhelm, was lost, but the Sword Saint finally joined the war.
*Second Battle of Castour Field. Taking place in 40 BA, this battle marked the end of the Demi-Human War. Following this battle, [[Cragrell Dawson]] signed a peace treaty.
*Sometime after the war’s ending, with a need to re-evaluate the usefulness of magic, Roswaal J. Mathers creates the Royal Magic Research Institute to study and develop magic. Likewise, color titles are proposed and accepted to be used by the government to display the country’s best mages for each respective color of magic.
*During the ceremony to commemorate Theresia's war achievements, Wilhelm Trias returned to “save” Theresia van Astrea from the potentially tainting life of being the Sword Saint. He proposed to her following a sword duel.
*Following his temporary imprisonment, Wilhelm spars with forty combatants handpicked by King [[Gionis Lugunica]], including [[Bordeaux Zergev]], Grimm, [[Carol Remendis]], and [[Conwood Melahau]], in order to prove that the Sword Devil can replace the role of the Sword Saint. He is victorious and gains his knighthood once again. He also puts in a good word for [[Orphe]] and recommends Bordeaux to have the con artist work for him.
*Theresia and Wilhelm get married, which officially allows the former to retire from the Royal Army. Wilhelm foregoes his name of Trias and becomes Wilhelm van Astrea.
*During Wilhelm and Theresia's honeymoon, Stride picks a fight with them by cursing [[Veltol Astrea]]. The [[Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]] ensues, and Wilhelm defeats [[Kurgan]]. However, Stride and Kurgan escape.

===39-38 BA===
*Around this point, Lugunica's intelligence department, the [[Six Tongues]], is formed.
*Theresia van Astrea was confirmed to be pregnant, resulting in Stride springing into action after months of wait. Numerous attacks were started by Stride, including on the Astrea Manor, where he kidnapped Theresia and forced Carol to slay Theresia’s father, Veltol Astrea.
*Stride begins an attack on [[Picoutatte]], where Wilhelm has his victorious rematch with Kurgan and eventually recovers Theresia. During the same attack, Stride summons the Blight Dragon [[Valgren]]. Numerous people lost their lives, including Roswaal J. Mathers. Following Stride’s and his wife [[Melinda]]’s deaths by Valgren, Volcanica appears for the first time in centuries, and it completely destroys the rampaging Valgren. The incident is dubbed the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]].
*The remaining members of the Zergev Squadron are promoted to become members of the Royal Guard. Wilhelm is appointed as commander of the Royal Guard, and Conwood becomes their vice commander. Grimm retires from the Zergev Squadron and marries Carol, and he joins her as one of the [[House Astrea]] attendants.

===~30 BA===
*The Six Tongues begins a silent war with [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]]'s Beloved Children, a battle that would last for decades.

===17 BA===
*[[Heinkel Astrea]]’s wife, [[Louanna Astrea]], falls into the Sleeping Beauty state for reasons unknown. It should be noted that her state is different to that of those affected by the [[Authority#Authority of Gluttony|Authority of Gluttony]], as she is still remembered by those around her.

===15 BA===
*Marcos Gildark leaves the knights on a mission to subjugate The Brotherhood, which sought to benefit the people of the slums. He decides to instead join their cause and becomes their leader. Around the same time, [[Russell Fellow]] subtly persuades [[Fareed Impusen]] to found the Golden Wing Faction, a gathering of nobles without a cause.
*[[Roswaal K. Mathers]] dies and a ceremony is held to commence the succession of his son, Roswaal L. Mathers, to be the new head of [[House Mathers]].
*Roswaal has his family crest stolen by [[Belmont]] and is knocked out by Marcos upon attempting to retrieve it. Russell encounters Roswaal and joins his search for his missing crest. Around the same time, Heinkel Astrea attempts to convince Marcos to rejoin the knights, but ultimately fails, leaving with Reinhard, who accompanied him, back to their manor. Roswaal and Marcos fight shortly afterwards. The fight results in Roswaal’s victory, but only because Reinhard utilized the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing to convince Marcos to rejoin the knights. After the battle, Roswaal gets Russell’s help to host a meeting between The Brotherhood and the Golden Wing Party, resulting in both groups deciding to leave the Royal Capital and move to [[Costuul]], while Marcos resigns to rejoin the knights, appointing [[Leno Rex]] as his replacement. That night, Russell sends people to the Astrea Manor upon discovering the source of the interference in Marcos’s fight, threatening the young Reinhard to protect the Kingdom for his family.

===14 BA===
*The Sword Saint, Theresia van Astrea, joined by a company of knights, was sent to subjugate the [[White Whale]] that had appeared in the country around that time. However, the mission ended catastrophically, and Theresia was not among the few remaining survivors to return. This would be later be remembered as the [[Great Conquest]].
*[[Reinhard van Astrea]] became the next Sword Saint at the age of 5. His inheritance of the Sword Saint’s blessings and powers came at a rather unfortunate time, as the sudden transfer of power resulted in his grandmother and then Sword Saint, Theresia van Astrea, losing her powers mid-battle with the White Whale, unintentionally leading to her death.
*Filore Lugunica, the infant daughter of [[Ford Lugunica]], the brother to the 41st king, [[Randohal Lugunica|Randohal]], was kidnapped by a perpetrator who snuck into the castle undetected. The princess was never recovered. Though a false allegation, Heinkel was suspected to be a perpetrator of the incident. The Royal Abduction Incident and even the existence of the child was not publicly known, but the kidnapping of the royal baby would have major consequences within the internal society of the Royal Guard. It is one of few events not recorded in the Dragon History Stone. However, a current [[Royal Selection]] candidate, [[Felt]], who is known to have the signature features of the Lugunica family, is suspected to be Filore.

===11 BA===
*Disturbing rumors about House Argyle, concerning the alleged abuse and torture of Felix Argyle by his own father, [[Biehn Argyle]], were investigated by the [[Meckart Karsten|Duke Karsten]] and his daughter, Crusch Karsten. The result of the investigation lead to the Argyle family being ruined, losing all of their territories and assets, save for one piece of uncultivated land, which effectively stripped them of their nobility.

===~10 BA===
*Russell Fellow is named the next Director of the Six Tongues and continues the silent war with the Beloved Children.

===10 BA===
*The last [[Oni]] Village was raided and destroyed by the Witch Cult. All of the residing oni were massacred, with the exception of the oni sisters, [[Rem]] and [[Ram]], who now reside in the domain of Roswaal L. Mathers.

===9 BA===
*The Witch Cult attacks Miload Manor in an attempt on the oni girls’ lives. Though the attackers were killed, Dudley Miload was killed, and his wife died of her injuries after giving birth to [[Annerose Miload]].

===Within 7-0 BA===
*[[Al|Aldebaran]] meets Echidna in the Witches Graveyard.

===7 BA===
*[[Puck]], a spirit created by the Witch of Greed, unfroze Emilia in Elior Forest and began to act as her friend and mentor.
*The incident that would be known as the “Day of Red Earth and Sky" occured when [[Melakuera]], the reigning Great Spirit of Fire, attacked the Elior Forest in search of the “half-witch” Emilia. The spirit accompanying Emilia, Puck, protected her and battled Melakuera. Melakuera lost the battle and died, with Puck inheriting the title of the next Great Spirit of Fire.
*At some point, [[Priscilla Barielle]] was smuggled into Lugunica with the assistance of [[Serena Dracroy]].

===6 BA===
*After talks of a political marriage with a member of the lineage of Gusteko’s Archbishop, [[Tiriena]], Fourier and Ferris meet with her, and instead of Fourier marrying her, they manage to set up a marriage between her and the nobleman of the domain they met in, [[Minor Characters#Misère|Misère]].
*Ferris learns how to use healing magic in the Royal Treatment Center from [[Garitch Fabless]], the Blue, for three months.
*Garitch is killed with a [[curse]] by one of his apprentices. The murderer, a healer with a grudge against his former teacher and the Kingdom for not being the successor of the Blue, was caught attempting to poison the wind at Garitch's state funeral to heal the others in attendance and acquire the title of Blue for himself. His plan was foiled by Crusch, Ferris, and Marcos Gildark, the last of whom finished him off. The funeral service ended following this incident, and Garitch was buried in the Kingdom Cemetery.
*Marcos is promoted to the Commander of the Royal Guard for his role in handling the culprit who killed Garitch.

===3 BA===
*The Foutour Plains were ravaged by the [[Great Rabbit]] and the surrounding villages were forced to evacuate. Duke Karsten and his retainers fought it in battle, but he sustained injuries. The 17-year-old Crusch Karsten arrived later with Ferris Argyle, along with another contingent of soldiers, and managed to drive the creature out.
*Several months following the battle against the Great Rabbit, Meckart retired as the Duke and passed the title on to his daughter.
*Hannah Regret, the wife of the ruined Biehn Argyle, died suddenly. Lord Argyle, already a pariah in Lugunican society, began to delve deeper into depravity with his illegal research into resurrection. It would only be much later when it was discovered that Biehn had brutally murdered his wife; the reason is unknown, but frenetic stab wounds suggest an intense argument of some kind.

===1 BA===
*The Great Famine of Cudegra, which was foretold by the Dragon History Stone, ravaged Lugunica.
*All members of the royal family succumb to an unknown disease.
*Ferris joined the Royal Guard via a recommendation by the Royal Treatment Center, as his Divine Protection of Water granted him incredible healing powers critical to the operations of the military. His appointment to the Royal Guard was further influenced by a recommendation by his close friend, the fourth Prince of Lugunica, [[Fourier Lugunica]].
*Biehn Argyle was discovered to have been communicating with [[Miles|a foreign operative]] from Vollachia in order to obtain slaves for human experimentation. House Karsten once again took up the task of investigating the Argyle family and the following events led to a [[Raid of Argyle Manor|clash]] at Argyle estate between the Karsten militia and Biehn's corpse soldiers, the result of his resurrection experiments. Biehn briefly managed to complete the act of resurrection on his wife, only for her to strangle him to death. The last living person in the mansion, [[Hannah Regret]], its sole maid, locked herself in the room with Biehn and his wife as the mansion burned down in the aftermath of the battle. The event was covered up and the residents of the Argyle manor were officially declared to have died by an accidental fire.
*As with the case with the rest of the royal family, Fourier Lugunica fell ill to the mysterious epidemic. His father, the King Randohal Lugunica, also became ill around this time. The royal family was effectively paralyzed.
*Reinhard is sent to reach the Pleiades Watchtower to try and find a cure for the royal family, but he was unable to overcome the Sand Time barrier, and he was forced to return home, failing his mission.

===1-0 year BA===
*Numerous royals, starting with the oldest prince, start to die from the disease. Later, Prince Fourier Lugunica peacefully died after a year-long struggle with illness. With a final dream of marriage, he peacefully passed away in the lap of Crusch Karsten, the woman he loved. The king died on the same day, overshadowing his son.
*The total extinction of the known Lugunica royal family led to the abolition of the covenant between the Kingdom of Lugunica and the dragon Volcanica and the potential power vacuum threatened to become a nationwide emergency. The Council of Wise Men, led by Miklotov McMahon, assumed control of the government and scrambled to deal with the issue of succession. Crusch was the first of five candidates discovered to have the qualifications to potentially be Lugunica's new ruler as signified by the Dragon Insignia.
*Crusch took Ferris as her knight, and she officially began her bid for the Royal Selection, very much influenced by the prince’s death. She immediately moved to meet Sword Demon Wilhelm van Astrea, now an old, though capable man, and invited him into her camp in exchange for House Karsten's assistance in hunting the White Whale that killed his wife.
*Priscilla Barielle, the daughter of Vollachian emperor [[Drizen Vollachia]], and the young wife of the prominent lord Leip Barielle, was discovered to be another ruler candidate. A tournament was held for her to choose her personal knight out of fifty. Surprisingly, a former gladiator by the name of [[Al|Aldebaran]] was picked, despite not finishing in the top four.
*Shortly after, Leip became indisposed after "mysteriously" going into shock and later died. As the sole inheritor, Priscilla gained control over his territory. The domain miraculously prospered thanks to her divine luck.
*[[Anastasia Hoshin]] arrives in Lugunica to expand her business, and she is discovered by [[Julius Juukulius]] to be a Royal Selection Candidate. After bringing her to the Royal Capital to introduce her, he becomes her knight.
*Roswaal L. Mathers met Emilia and Puck. After Puck and Roswaal battled for what was said to be half a day, Emilia defused the situation and accepted Roswaal's invitation to his mansion after he showed her the Dragon Insignia and enticed her into joining the Royal Selection to “free the elves”.
*The Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica entered a [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 3|non-aggression pact]] with the neighboring Sacred Vollachia Empire.
