*Roughly a month later, the famous Silver Flower Dance of the Sword Saint and Blue Lightning took place. The Kingdom's Sword Saint Reinhard van Astrea faced off against the Empire's 1st ranking Divine General [[Cecilus Segmunt]]. The fight ended in a draw.

===0-1 year AA===
*[[Natsuki Subaru]] appears in the Royal Capital, and he is promptly involved in the [[Loot House Incident]], where he and the Sword Saint saved one of the Royal Selection Candidates, Emilia, from being killed by the [[Elsa Granhiert|Bowel Hunter]]. Immediately afterward, Reinhard discovers that Felt, who was also involved, was a Royal Selection Candidate, and he brings her to the auxiliary Astrea Manor.
*Emilia returns to [[Roswaal Manor]] with Subaru, where he becomes a butler for Roswaal. Shortly afterward, he and Roswaal’s maids take care of the Wolgarm infestation in the woods nearby, though Subaru was left with innumerable curses in the process. 
*The Royal Selection begins after the candidates give their respective speeches. Rom attempts to pull Felt away from the place during the speeches, resulting in her officially joining the Royal Selection to prevent him from being killed. Likewise, Reinhard declared himself Felt’s knight.
*With the Witch Cult becoming active again, Subaru forges an alliance with the [[Crusch Camp]] and the [[Anastasia Camp]], and they take part in the Subjugation of the White Whale. The subjugation was a success when Wilhelm successfully landed the final blow and slayed the beast.
*Half of the subjugation force continues on with some reinforcements to complete the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], where they successfully kill the [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]] and arrest his fingers. The other half of the force, however, was ambushed by the Sin Archbishops of Greed and [[Lye Batenkaitos|Gluttony]], resulting in many deaths, the loss of Crusch’s memories, and Rem losing her name and memories.
*Due to Petelgeuse's defeat, Capella's takes drastic actions, allowing two of her Beloved Children to escape from her and join Six Tongues, giving them information on the Beloved Children.
*In [[Flanders]], someone frames [[Ezzo Cadner]] of murder and arson, leading to a confrontation between the mage and the Sword Saint. After uncovering the real perpetrator and handling the underground business in Flanders, Ezzo joins the [[Felt Camp]].
*The [[Emilia Camp]] faces internal issues in the Sanctuary, leading to a massive confrontation with Roswaal, Emilia needing to complete the trials of the Sanctuary, facing off against the assassins in Roswaal Manor, and the camp being forced to fight off the Great Rabbit. In the end, Roswaal loses his bet with Subaru and places a curse upon himself; Emilia completes the trials and frees the Sanctuary residents; Elsa Granhiert is killed by [[Garfiel Tinzel]] while [[Meili Portroute]] is captured, though Roswaal Manor is burned down; and Subaru, Emilia, and [[Beatrice]] manage to defeat the Great Rabbit. Shortly after, Subaru becomes Emilia’s knight.
*Echidna escapes the [[Castle of Dreams]] by taking over the body of [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu Shima]], and she takes on the new name of [[Omega]], taking the souls of the other Witches with her. Shortly after, she slays scavengers who have come to collect the remains from the battle with the Great Rabbit.
*The claim ceremony for slaying the White Whale is held in the Royal Castle, with each party responsible in attendance.
*Omega arrives in a small village and scares all of the villagers with her presence in a failed attempt to make them accept one of their own. The intent backfired, and [[Colette]] and [[Palmyra]] follow her of the country.
*An incident takes place in Costuul caused by [[Hayden Garo]], in which various magicreation tools malfunction and City Hall is destroyed. Though the incident was quelled, Hayden escaped arrest.
*In the Barielle Domain, an incident takes place in a small village where the undead were rising. Priscilla intervened and took care of the undead, but the culprit was not discovered.
*Heinkel Astrea wiped out all of the bandits in a bandit den in an effort to collect a cup rumored to restore one’s body. Though the cup was a sham, Heinkel joined the [[Priscilla Camp]] after a chance encounter with the lady herself.
*At some point, Meckart returned from retirement to assist the memoryless Crusch with running the Karsten Domain.

===1 year AA===
*Anastasia invites three of the other camps to Priestella in an effort to garner new friendships and alliances. Priscilla arrives there uninvited the day after the other three camps arrived.
*Roswaal takes part in a council of western nobles, where he obtains their support for the Royal Selection.
*The Witch Cult takes Priestella hostage, resulting in the Battle for Priestella. In the end, Regulus was killed, the [[Sirius Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Wrath]] was arrested, the corpse soldiers they utilized were slain, and the other Sin Archbishops escaped. In their wake, Crusch and Subaru were left cursed, many citizens were left nameless and without memories, Anastasia locked herself in her Od, numerous people were killed including nine members of the Council of Ten, and many were left malformed by the Authority of Lust. As a result, a set group decided to traverse to the Pleiades Watchtower.
*After said group left, Garfiel, Ezzo, [[Ricardo Welkin]], and [[Liliana Masquerade]] went to retrieve the remains of a Witch that lay beneath the city.
*The Felt Camp escorts Sirius to the Prison Tower in the Royal Capital.
*Priscilla was attacked by assassins after returning to the Barielle Domain. Judging they were from Vollachia, she had a battle with Al, in which she convinced him to follow her to Vollachia.
*The [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]] results in the tower being conquered, the capture of [[Roy Alphard]], and Lye being killed after he spit up the names he’d eaten. However, as a result of the actions of [[Rui Arneb]], the Witch of Envy appeared to take away Subaru, Rem, and the newly manifested [[Spica|Rui]]. After the shadow was struck by the Divine Dragon, the three found themselves in Vollachia, where Rem awoke.
*While Anastasia prepares to enter Vollachia through Kararagi, the Emilia Camp leaves Meili, who they’d gotten to join both the camp and the expedition, in the Royal Capital.
*The Emilia Camp settle a dispute regarding [[Diadora Regundra]] in Picoutatte, and they sneak into Everlasting Darkness. In here, however, they were forced to confront [[Musica]], leaving [[Petra Leyte]] to curse herself to set up a future meeting between him and Emilia.
*Meili assists the second expedition team in reaching the Pleiades Watchtower. After a short investigation, it was decided that people would be regularly stationed at the tower. For the time, Ezzo and [[Flam Remendis]] would remain to continue the tower’s investigation.
*While Roswaal goes to prevent panic in the Barielle Domain, where Schult is proclaimed to be Priscilla's successor. Meanwhile, [[Otto Suwen]] and Emilia go to report to the Council of Wise Men, Subaru takes a group with Al to the Pleiades Watchtower, where Al attempts and fails to [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|seal Subaru]], and afterward, the group returned to the Royal Capital.
*A woman from the Divine Dragon Church meets with the Council of Wise Men, claiming her name to be [[Filore]] and the intention of the Church seemingly to help the Priestella victims.
*Filore uses her Sacraments to restore Crusch's memories and remove her curse. This results in Ferris resigning as her knight and later being retrieved by Russell Fellow.
*Filore is determined to have the qualities to join the Royal Selection.
*Upon returning to the capital and entering the Prison Tower, Subaru, Beatrice, and Reinhard discover seemingly discovered the mangled corpse of Roy Alphard.
*After speaking to members of the Emilia Camp, Filore accepts her position as a Royal Selection candidate, and during the conversation with Miklotov that followed, she chose Heinkel as her knight.
*In Miklotov's manor, Crusch intended to speak with him regarding her suspicions of traitors in the country, but due to Miklotov's heavily suspicious behavior, she cut down Miklotov and his men, resulting in the following battle with Subaru, Beatrice, and [[Tiga Rauleon]], as well as Crusch's escape with Subaru and Beatrice after Tiga nearly killed them.
*The Royal Selection candidates are called in for questioning, and the Emilia Camp flees to find Subaru, obtaining Wilhelm's assistance when they were faced with the coerced Reinhard.
*Following the escape from the Royal Army and one of the Beloved Children, Subaru's group finds themselves in Russell's manor, where they discuss their enemy.

==Locations==
[[File:Kingdom of Lugunica.jpg|thumb|300px|The land of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, alongside the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko]]
'''[[Royal Capital|Lugunica]]''' (ルグニカ, ''Rugunika''), also known as the '''Royal Capital of Lugunica''' (王都ルグニカ, ''Ōto Rugunika''), or simply the '''Royal Capital''', is the capital city of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. It is where the Lugunican royal family traditionally ruled the Kingdom of Lugunica from, until their extinction. The Council of Wise Men is currently regulating the country as its provisional government, waiting for a new monarch to be chosen in the Royal Selection. The Royal Capital is separated into five main regions that vary by class, consisting of the Royal Castle’s grounds, the Noble District, the Commercial District, the Commoner District, and the slums.
{{Clear}}

[[File:Watergate City of Priestella Anime design.png|thumb|260px|Priestella]]
[[File:Priestella Sketch.png|thumb|260px|Sketch of Priestella]]
'''[[Priestella]]''' (プリステラ, ''Purisutera''): Priestella, also known as the '''Watergate City of Priestella''' (水門都市プリステラ, ''Suimon Toshi Purisutera''), is one of the '''Five Great Cities''' in the Kingdom of Lugunica and is the closest to the western nation of Kararagi, separated by the Tigracy River. It is a beautiful city and a famous tourist location that is built in the middle of a great lake, with waterways running through the city. The waterways divide the city into four parts called avenues, which are numbered clockwise from the main gate. It is also the birthplace of Hoshin of the Wilderness and has been long associated with merchants because of its proximity to Kararagi. Priestella is led by the '''Priestellan Council of Ten'''. During the Battle for Priestella, the whole council was annihilated, except for [[Kiritaka Muse]].
*'''Great Tigracy River''' (ティグラシー大河): A large river that runs along the border in Kararagi and it is located in the west part of Lugunica.
**'''Tigracy Bridge''' (ティグラシー大橋): A stone bridge that sits over the Great Tigracy River on the Lugunican side, which leads to the front gates of Priestella.
*'''Water Plumage Inn''' (水の羽衣亭, ''Mizu no Hagoromo-tei''): A Kararagi style inn located in Priestella's first avenue.
*'''City Hall''': The City Hall is a tall building in the center of the city. It houses a large communication device used to broadcast all over the city.
*'''The Great Temple''' (大神殿, ''Daishinden''): A temple, located underneath Priestella, where the Witch of Pride's remains are said to have been kept for four centuries, following her demise. It can be accessed through a hidden door, located somewhere in the area under the canals. The Temple itself is guarded by a Guardian with a very grotesque appearance. Only the Priestellan Council of Ten know of the Temple's location.

[[File:Picoutatte ep.40.png|thumb|260px|Picoutatte]]
'''[[Picoutatte]]''' (ピックタット, ''Pikkutatto''): Picoutatte, also known as the '''Commercial City of Picoutatte''' (商業都市ピックタット, ''Shōgyō Toshi Pikkutatto''), is one of Lugunica's '''Five Great Cities''', located in the very south of the Kingdom, next to the Kingdom's border with the Empire. It is a beautiful merchant city separated into five different areas: north, south, east, west, and central. The rules and features are different in each area. The Suwen Company is located in the west area. The city itself has a unique Arabian flair with both the architecture of the structures and the dress codes of the citizens greatly resembling that from the Arabian Peninsula, from Subaru's original world. The city itself is of great importance to the Kingdom, as it's the main trading hub with the neighbouring Empire.

'''[[Costuul]]''' (コスツール, ''Kosutuuru''): Costuul, also known as the '''Industrial City of Costuul''' (工業都市コスツール, ''Kōgyō Toshi Kosutsūru''), is one of Lugunica's '''Five Great Cities''' and bustling city largely populated by demi-humans. The city is near the main residence of the Mathers family with a population that is close to 100,000. Costuul is the most recent to join the Five Great Cities, having been boosted to that status due to its bustling industry of magicreation tools.

'''[[Flanders]]''' (フランダース, ''Furandāsu''): Flanders, also known as the '''Earth Dragon Capital of Flanders''' (地竜の都フランダース, ''Chiryū no Miyako Furandāsu''), is one of Lugunica's '''Five Great Cities''' located in the southeastern part of the country in the Hyclara Plateau. Volcanica is said to have become friends with the first Sword Saint and the Sage here. In addition, Volcanica is said to have blessed the land through some means in order to create earth dragons would be born. The city is famed for having what is known as a "dragon industry" since it makes use of its earth dragons beyond transport labor for things such as opening and closing canals or raising and lowering drawbridges. These innovations are only made possible due to the abundance of earth dragons there. The Astrea Domain is located nearby.
*'''Forest of the Elves''' (エルフの森): The Forest of the Elves is a relatively large forest located west of Flanders.

[[File:Ganacks Anime design Bonds of Ice.png|thumb|260px|Ganacks]]
'''Ganacks''' (ガナクス, ''Ganakusu''): Ganacks, also known as the '''Mining City of Ganacks''' (鉱山都市ガナクス, ''Kōzan Toshi Ganakusu''), is one of Lugunica's '''Five Great Cities'''. It is a mining city located near Elior Forest to the southeast and it lies at the foot of the Gina Mountain range. In addition to its prolific mining industry, Ganacks is famed for its entertainment district. At night, Ganacks' main street is illuminated by the lights of gorgeous crystal lamps. Away from the main street, Ganacks is home to a violent underworld.

'''Rimpleton''' (リンプルトン, ''Rinpuruton''): Known as the '''River Port City''' (河港都市, ''Kakō Toshi''), Rimpleton lies along the Great Tigracy River, west of the Barielle Domain.

'''[[Elior Forest]]''' (エリオール大森林, ''Eriōru Dai Shinrin''): A dense woodland forest currently owned by Roswaal where the Elves once lived. It is located nearby Ganacks in the northeastern part of Lugunica and north-east of Roswaal's old mansion. The village owned its own seal, which was guarded by the Elves. About 100 years ago, the forest was attacked by both Pandora and Regulus Corneas, which ended up causing the large area to be frozen over by Emilia.

'''Gina Mountain Range''' (ギナ山脈): A mountain range where, according to legend, a Dragon once lived. It has become a magic ore mining source and permission is required from the kingdom to enter it. The mountain range lies in the northeast of Lugunica. The Mining City of Ganacks is at its base.

'''Pappelt''' (パッペルト): A town in the south of Lugunica where [[Regin Suwen]], Otto's younger brother, lives. This town is endangered by the Earth Spider's web.

'''Redonas Plateau''' (レドナス台地): A site where a [[Battle of Redonas Plateau|major battle]] of the Demi-Human War took place. It is also where Wilhelm van Astrea and Grimm Fauzen met for the first time.

'''Castour Field''' (カスツール平原): The site of the second major battle and the final battle of the Demi-Human War. In later years, it became a base for a group known as the Dawn Brigade, which was subjugated by a force commanded by [[Bikram Edditz]].

'''Aihiya Swamp''' (アイヒア湿地帯): A wetland that is located in the southern region of the country and borders the Vollachia Empire. It was a site of the largest battle of the Demi-Human War. The swamps were adjacent to the base of operations for the Demi-Human Alliance's leadership.

[[File:Shamrock_Valley - EX2 Manga.jpg|thumb|200px]]
'''Shamrock Valley''' (シャムロック渓谷): A valley in the southeast of Lugunica.
*'''Sphinx's Testing Grounds''' (スピンクスの実験場): The location where Sphinx conducted her tests during the Demi-Human War. It's described to always be enshrouded by thick fog. The grounds cannot be entered without Sphinx's Od or something that contains it, such as a glintstone.
*'''Everlasting Darkness''' (常闇): A tunnel dug between Vollachia and Lugunica by the Empire's persecuted mole humans.

'''Hakuchuri''' (ハクチュリ, ''Hakuchuri''): Hakuchuri is a small town and the only settlement within the Astrea Domain. It is near where the Astrea Manor is located. The Hyclara Plateau lies between it and Flanders. Its main industries are agriculture, livestock, and earth dragons. Brown-haired people are more common in the area while blonde-haired people are more common near the Royal Capital.
*'''Astrea Manor''' (アストレア邸): The Astrea Manor is a mansion with a modest size compared to the extravagant mansions in the Royal Capital. It has an an iron gate which shows signs of age and rust, and the state of the mansion itself reflects the gate's age. It also had old flower beds in the garden that Wilhelm van Astrea used to like, though they wilted over the years. At Felt's suggestion, Reinhard van Astrea now tends to the garden.

'''Hyclara Plateau''' (ハイクララ高原): An area where a variety of earth dragons live. It is known for raising many earth dragons. It was also the site where hunting festivals were conducted by [[Zabinel Lugunica]].

'''Fleur''' (フルール, ''Fureeru''): A small stopover town on the longer route to Roswaal's territory. Subaru met a drunk Otto here in one loop and hired him for a ride after staying the night there. It is mentioned that Fleur is Grimm Fauzen's home town. The town is situated north-east of the Royal Capital.

'''Warwar''' (ウォーウォー): A town in which a former member of the White Dragon's Scales hid the group's fortune after stealing it for himself and built a mansion to live in luxury.

'''Hanumas''' (ハヌマス): A border village that sits on the entrance to the Mathers Domain. It is located northeast of the Royal Capital.

'''Foutour Plains''' (フォートル平原): An area of wilderness in the Karsten lands where animals like the Ubuzu can be found.

'''Black Serpent Contamination Zone''' (黒蛇汚染地帯): A region near the Karsten Duchy that is afflicted by the Black Serpent's pestilence.

'''Cramlin''' (クラムリン, ''Kuramurin''): A town located southeast near the Royal Capital and near the Lifaus Highway, lying next to Mount Cordor. It has caves lying near the town, one of which was inhabited by a Sand Earthworm. 

'''Mount Cordor''' (コルドロ山): A mountain that is home to numerous cave networks known as '''Nest of the Earth Snake''' (土蛇の巣), where an sand earthworm, feared as the Earth Snake, resided, regularly causing tremors in the earth. It is near the town of Cramlin.

'''Millgray''' (ミルグレー): A city near the Royal Capital. It is located west of Fleur near the Lifaus Highway. The town is famous for its windmills.

'''Bonobo''' (ボノボ, ''Bonobo''): A city near the Royal Capital. It is located between Millgray and Cramlin on the Lifaus Highway. The town is famous for its distilleries. 

[[File:Lifaushighway2(3).png|thumb|194px|Lifaus Highway]]'''Lifaus Plains''' (リーファウス平原): The plains surrounding the Lifaus Highway.
*'''Lifaus Highway''' (リーファウス街道): A vast thoroughfare nearby to where Flugel's Tree formerly stood. The tree was gargantuan enough that it could be seen for miles, though it was destroyed during the Subjugation of the White Whale.

'''[[Arlam Village]]''' (アーラム村): Arlam Village is a village located near the old Roswaal Manor with a population of around 300 people. The name of the village changes based on the surname of the current head. There is also a youth group created by young people in the village.

'''Kremaldy''' (クレマルディ, ''Kuremarudi''): Kremaldy, also known as the '''Lost Forest of Kremaldy''' (クレマルディの迷い森), is the name of the dense forest that surrounds the Sanctuary. It is nicknamed "The Lost Forest" due to the barrier that has prevented explorers from fully exploring its depths.
*'''[[Sanctuary]]''' (聖域, ''Seiiki''): The Sanctuary is a poor village located within Roswaal's territory that has been taken care of by the various Mathers over the years. The village itself is a group of buildings located in a clearing within the forest and only halves live there. It is surrounded by a short fence with an old stone gate at the entrance. Although Roswaal refers to it as the Sanctuary, the villagers refer to it as the '''Witch of Greed's Graveyard''' (強欲の魔女の墓場, ''Gōyoku no Majo no Hakaba''). The place itself is situated east of Roswaal's old manor.
*'''Sanctuary Barrier''' (聖域の結界, ''Seiiki no Kekkai''): A barrier created by Echidna that prevents halves from going through it. Any halves that come close to it start to lose consciousness and feel as if their existence is being disturbed. Even if someone takes an unconscious half that has crossed the barrier, they will never awaken outside the barrier as their spirit is trapped within it. The barrier checks the blood of those that go near it and only affects those it clearly determines as halves. It also causes those who are not permitted to enter the Sanctuary to get lost.

'''Tenrill River''' (テンリル川): A river located in the Barielle Domain. Numerous villages can be found at different points of the river.

'''Krufuna''' (クルフナ, ''Kurufuna''): A city in the Barielle Domain that is near the Barielle mansion. It was unprosperous under Leip's leadership, but it became well-off under Priscilla's.

'''Ladrima''' (ラドリマ, ''Radorima''): A village in southwestern Lugunica that borders the Vollachia Empire in the southern part of the Barielle Domain. It lies east of the Barielle mansion. 

'''Coffleton '''(カッフルトン) A hamlet on the southernmost tip of the Barielle Domain. The hamlet is smaller than the Barielle estate. According to the census records, there are 88 residents. It’s located at the basin of the Tenrill River.

'''Agante''' (アガンテ, ''Agante''): Agante is a bandit town in southwestern Lugunica near the Barielle Domain.

'''Guineb''' (ギネブ, ''Ginebi''): Guineb is an inconspicuous city in the mountains of southern Lugunica. The town is built around a magic ore mine, however, the mine is already depleted.

'''Abiate''' (アビエイト, ''Abieito''): Abiate is a city in southern Lugunica. The McMahon manor is located a half day's journey from the city.

'''McMahon Manor''': The home of the family of Miklotov McMahon that lies half a day away from Abiate. It has cells beneath it meant to hold captured prisoners.

'''San Fantrus''' (サン・ファントラス, ''San Fantorasu''): A town near the home of Viscount [[Minor Characters#Torion Aruz|Torion Aruz]] where one of the House Mathers villas resides.

'''House Mathers's Workshop''': A workshop within a small forest and not located on a map that was previously used by Roswaal K. Mathers. Although it had been abandoned for years and anything of importance removed, aside from some magic dolls, it was cleaned up within the year following the Royal Selection Ceremony.

[[File:Mirula.png|thumb|100px]]
'''Mirula''' (ミルーラ, ''Mirūra''): Mirula is the closest town to the Augria Sand Dunes. The town is described as a practically deserted town, considerably smaller than Lugunica's main cities. The town is located north from the Kingdom's largest forest, and just west of the Dunes. The town experiences the "Sand Time" from the Augria Sand Dunes, to which its few residents shut themselves inside. It's stated that many travelers that challenge the Augria Sand Dunes pass through this town.

'''[[Augria Sand Dunes]]''' (アウグリア砂丘, ''Auguria Sakyū''): The Augria Sand Dunes is an area located in the far eastern part of the Kingdom of Lugunica. Due to its close proximity to the Witch's Shrine, the Augria Sand Dunes has a high concentration of witch miasma, making it an ideal place for witchbeasts to live. Witchbeasts that live here are stronger and more aggressive than normal, though few actually live in the area.
*'''[[Pleiades Watchtower]]''' (プレアデス監視塔, ''Pureadesu Kanshitō''): The Pleiades Watchtower is a watchtower that was originally overseen by Shaula following its creation by the Sage. The tower has six layers and an underground floor. The respective names of each floor from one to six respectively are Maia, Electra, Taygeta, Alcyone, Celaeno, and Asterope. Merope is the name of the underground floor, or floor zero. Even going non-stop on the back of an earth dragon, it can take more than a full day and night to cross the Augria Sand Dunes to reach the Pleiades Watchtower.
*'''Evil Sealing Stone Shrine''' (封魔石の祠, ''Fūmaseki no Hokora''): The Evil Sealing Stone Shrine is where Satella is currently sealed.

'''Oni Village''': A village near the border of Kararagi that was previously home to the Oni Clan. However, it was ultimately destroyed by the Witch Cult and all its residents slain aside from Rem and Ram.

title: Kararagi
wikitext:
The '''Kararagi City-States''' (カララギ都市国家, ''Kararagi Toshi Kokka''), usually referred collectively as '''Kararagi''' (カララギ, ''Kararagi''), is one of the four great nations of the world. It is known for being a center of trade across the continent and its proto-capitalistic market structure. Many of its citizens are heavily individualistic in nature, leading to the rise of businesses and free enterprise.

The region is described to resemble Japan, specifically the early-modern period feudal society of Japan, along with influences from other eras and regions such as the German Hanseatic League. This is seen in Kararagi's architecture, style of dress, cuisine, naming customs, and even its particular speech style. The area is also noted for its high and socially mobile [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] populations, implying that one's race matters very little in your status, unlike in top-down true feudal societies such as the one in Lugunica; only your assets count.

The Kararagi City-States were supposedly founded by [[Alec Hoshin]], who is commonly remembered with the moniker '''Hoshin of the Wilderness'''. However, [[Echidna]] mentioned that she has a connection with Kararagi since she "helped found it".<ref>''“Though from where we are, I’d say Kararagi. I’ve got a connection with that country since I helped found it, so I’m curious to see how it’s doing now.”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Witches's Evaluation Meeting]], Section 2.</ref>

==Information==
===Geography===
Kararagi is presumably the country farthest to the west, bordering the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] on its east, with [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]] to its southeast, and [[Gusteko]] along its northeastern border. The Lugunican city of [[Priestella]] borders Kararagi on the eastern border just across the Tigracy River, and thus shares a unique cultural bond with the region.

Presumably, around the same latitude as Lugunica, the territory supports temperate to sub-tropical climates. Ligers, a mammalian animal similar to wolves (except much larger and stronger to the point that they can be used as steeds), can be commonly found in the region and as such have been domesticated in the same way earth dragons have been in Lugunica. A plant similar to the Japanese cherry can also be found in Kararagi.

Unlike its eastern and southern neighbors, Kararagi is not considered to be blessed with a favorable climate, though it is not as bad as Gusteko. The seasons change and are comprised of an excessive variation in temperature, yearly abnormal weather, and plots with inscrutable characteristics. As such, Kararagi is considered to be harsh on those who lived there, meaning that the people needed to be accustomed to days of hard struggle.<ref>''"...with changes of season that comprised excessive variation in temperature, abnormal weather that seemed to befall them every year, and the likes of plots that propriotized inscrutable characteristics, it had to be said that these lands were rather harsh in their discipline towards those who lived within them. Thus, for anyone to live in Kararagi, there was a need for them to become accustomed to days of hard struggle."'' [[Kararagi Reaper Incident 2]], Section 1.</ref>

===Culture===
Besides being a Hanseatic League-style free trade confederation, the region displays a striking similarity to Japan, mostly the early-modern era (1500-1800), as well as other influences from nearly all periods of Japanese history. Of course, contact with other nations has also allowed a pseudo-western culture to plant itself within.

The citizens of Kararagi are known to speak with a Kansai Japanese dialect, reflecting Japan's pre-Meiji-era Kyoto-based society that the country draws inspiration from. Yukatas and other Japanese clothes are commonly worn by the citizens living in Kararagi. As with most other things, the architecture of the region, known in-universe as Wafuu, is similar to designs of Feudal and Edo Japan-era buildings, though some structures resemble English Tudor-dynasty buildings more than anything else.

The cuisine of the land closely reflects modern Japanese cuisine - [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]] is shown drinking sake (which implies the existence of rice as a staple food), and in [[Anastasia's Rising in Life Memorial Day]], Ricardo gave [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]] a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dorayaki dorayaki]. In [[Arc 5]], Anastasia hosts a dinner party, featuring famous Japanese foods and condiments such as sashimi, wasabi, and soy sauce, among other items. In accordance with the custom of renaming common food items, [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okonomiyaki okonomiyaki] in the new world is known as daisukiyaki. Multiple characters are also shown using chopsticks.

===Population===
Uniquely, the country has a large population, either a large minority or a small majority, of demi-humans. The region appears to form a large part of a greater demi-human nation, which includes eastern Lugunica and areas of the other two great countries. It can be assumed that a large number of demi-humans residing in Kararagi are former refugees from the [[Demi-Human War]] in Lugunica.

Much like the rest of the world, and unlike any actual Japanese person, the humans of Kararagi exhibit extraordinary eye and hair colors not limited to brown and black. It is unknown if Hoshin bore any children. 

===Government===
Based on the official name of Kararagi, it can be inferred that the country is either one unified state with multiple jurisdictions that happen to be entire cities, or a group of mostly independent city states voluntarily in a larger loose confederation. There are ten major cities in Kararagi in total, numbered from one to ten. Each of the ten cities has a single representative, known as a mayor, who make up all ten members of the League of Cities, a council formed by the representatives of each of Kararagi's ten major cities.<ref>''“The Kararagi City-States are, roughly speaking, a country composed of ten large cities. Each city has its own mayor, who is the representative of the city, and there is a council formed by these people, which is the League of Cities.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 35]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> The representatives come together to elect the country's greater representative, the chief, either every five years or when the current chief passes away. The first chief of Kararagi was Alec Hoshin, but in the centuries since his passing, successive chiefs have attained the position through bribing the mayors,<ref>[[Anastasia's Kararagi Merchant Path]]</ref> showing that corruption is rampant within Kararagi's national government.

According to [[Russell Fellow]], the balance of power between the ten mayors of the City-States is showing indications of an upcoming collapse.

===Mages===
Very little is known about the magical aspect of the country.

===Religion===
The citizens of Kararagi do not appear to practice a faith. Much like how [[Volcanica]] is idolized as a religious figure in Lugunican churches, Alec Hoshin, known to history as Hoshin of the Wilderness, is treated with just the same amount of respect and reverence, though not to the point of worship.

===Economics & Currency===
The country is almost anarchist-capitalist to its core, morality can be thrown out of the window. The lack of centralized governance certainly lends its hand however rather than some fundamental ideological nature of extreme greediness. The economy is most likely driven by normal trades such as agriculture and craftwork but also hosts very unpleasant though profitable trades such as prostitution, slavery, contract killings, trafficking, and mercenary work.

Slavery is legal in most parts of Kararagi. However, it is illegal to enslave someone in the town of [[Banan]], whose existence is secured. Conversely, it's legal to enslave street children as long as you're not seen doing so. 

Apparently, Kararagi, unlike the other countries, is known for its creative technical prowess, unlike how the others specialize with spiritual arts/curses, techniques and abilities, and magic.<ref>''Compared to the technological prowess of the Kararagi City-States, the Spiritual Arts and Curse Arts of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, and the magical disciplines of the Kingdom of Lugunica, the Vollachian Empire excelled in the martial arts.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 98, Section 1.</ref> New technologies help influence the economy within the country.

===Military===
Mercenary organizations are abundant in Kararagi, so it can be assumed that the governing of the country hire their armies rather than drawing from feudal lords. According to the author, while the country does not have its own version of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] or Temple Knights, with the exception of Banan, which has [[Halibel]], each of the ten cities maintains its own mercenary-styled force to defend itself, and even in the event that one city should fall, the other cities will not collapse, effectively meaning that Kararagi will not fall unless all ten cities fell.<ref>April 5, 2026 Talk Show.</ref>

A private military company in Kararagi is the [[Iron Fang]], which is currently owned by Anastasia Hoshin and led by captain Ricardo Welkin. They are in charge of both trading supplies to other cities and countries, and service in the front lines of battle. Another mercenary organization is called the '''Scratch of Silver''', a mercenary group that is full of demi-humans. In addition, some [[shinobi]] based out of Kararagi are known to be employed by other powers. In particular, the country's strongest military asset, the shinobi Halibel, is regularly hired by the League of Cities for certain matters.

==History==
*Note: The characters within the story rarely describe historical events within helpful context, so the unit '''BA''', “Before Arrival”, and '''AA''', “After Arrival”, will be used to place moments in time with the best available knowledge. Both are in reference to Natsuki Subaru’s arrival in the new world. In this case, only BA will be used. Also, note that the units are not official.

===400 BA===
*Kararagi was founded by a man named Alec Hoshin with help from Echidna. He supposedly introduced many things similar to Japanese culture to the country.

===Roughly 100 BA===
*Around this time, Lugunica and Kararagi fight over the rights to own Priestella due to its geographical location and its creation by Alec Hoshin’s hands. In the end, however, after a drawn-out economic conflict, Lugunica maintained rights over Priestella.

===14 BA===
*[[Reisel]] offered Ricardo his help in exchange for Ricardo's strength whilst they worked as slave laborers in the mines, and that allowed Ricardo to escape from the beatings. Reisel organized a slave rebellion and both he and other slaves escaped. However, he did not inform Ricardo of his plans.

===12 BA===
*[[Mimi Pearlbaton|Mimi]], [[Hetaro Pearlbaton|Hetaro]], and [[Tivey Pearlbaton]] were abandoned by their parents and were taken in by [[Roshi Pearlbaton]].

===10 BA===
*Ricardo saved a young, purple haired girl from a group of traders and secured her a job. Before parting, the girl pledged she's removed his collar, effectively freeing him from slavery. This girl would later come to be known as Anastasia Hoshin, one of the most influential people in the country.
*Anastasia joined the Chuden Company and Ricardo offered his services as a mercenary to him. [[Chuden Agri|Chuden]] accepted and hired Ricardo to work at the company as his personal bodyguard. He was given a new collar that marked his status as the "hound" of the company, though the collar had its control gem removed.
*Chuden put Ricardo in charge of hunting down thieves and bandits in the outskirts of Banan.
*Anastasia was captured by a man of the Multi-Arm Tribe named [[Didorii]], who brought her to [[Razcrew]] and planned to sell her on the slave markets in the north of Kararagi. However, his plan was thwarted by Anastasia, Mimi, and Hetaro, and he ended up being enslaved himself.
*Ricardo, along with his mercenary group, ambushed the slave trading company and challenged Didorii to a one-on-one fight. He won the battle against Didorii and killed him.

===9 BA===
*Reisel requested Ricardo to do him a favor by stealing from a cargo full of goods. Ricardo asked what his aim was, and Reisel replied that he intended to steal a [[meteor]] from it. On a mountainside outside of Banan, both Ricardo and Reisel tried to ambush the cargo, [[Shiroro Tonerico|Shiroro]] emerged from the cart and attempted to cut off Ricardo's head. Whilst that happened, Reisel stole the cart, leaving Ricardo behind as he battled against Shiroro. After the fight, both Ricardo and Shiroro formed a truce which resulted in Shiroro receiving the stolen goods back.
*Echidna met Anastasia and became her consultant because she was intrigued by her. Anastasia promised Roshi that if he dies, she'll take care of the Pearlbatons.
*After Reisel's defeat, [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]] came to the scene where the weak and sprawling Reisel was in front of her. He tried to explain his failure, but she didn't allow for it. She touched his forehead and used her Authority, making Reisel lose all of his limbs, his eyes and ears, transforming him into something inhuman.

===8-2 BA===
*After Roshi's death, Anastasia and Ricardo took care of the triplets and lived with them ever since.
*At some point, Halibel is sent on a mission to kill Ricardo for breaking his oath to his fellow wolf-human tribesmen. Thanks to Anastasia standing on his behalf, the matter is settled.
*[[Cecilus Segmunt]] is sent to Kararagi to kill Halibel, the most famous wolf-human in the present day. Though the two clash, Cecilus does not kill Halibel, and he returns to Vollachia.
*Eventually, the Ryuushika Commerce Company was founded, during which Anastasia voiced her opinion concerning a small business deal, earning her work. Eventually, she bought the company with her amassed wealth and renamed it into the Hoshin Company.

===1-0 BA===
*Looking to expand into the Lugunica market, she made a visit to the House Juukulius in Lugunica, where it was discovered that she is eligible to participate in the [[Royal Selection]].

===1 AA===
*An incident takes place in Nanou where the living are replaced by the dead. Halibel is sent to investigate, and he destroys the undead.
*Anastasia returns to the country to get to Vollachia. After meeting with the League of Cities and hiring Halibel, she heads south.
*After the [[Great Disaster]] in Vollachia, Anastasia returns to Kararagi to report what she discovered in Vollachia.
*[[Zarestia]] attacks and destroys half of Banan with a windstorm while searching for the thief who stole her Light Sphere, confronting Ricardo in the process. The incident is dubbed the Shinigami Disaster. None of the residents were killed, and thanks to Ricardo's efforts, Zarestia made her windstorm subside.
*After some discussions with Zarestia, another windstorm attacked the city, and Anastasia's group managed to quell it. However, in the process, Anastasia and Eridna were kidnapped by the incident's perpetrator, who Anastasia later refers to as [[Reize|Black Tia]], and they were taken to Zarestia's Bed, where Anastasia manages to make negotiate with her in a rather one-sided conversation. Sometime within the day, Anastasia returned to Banan while Black Tia allowed herself to be put in a cell.

==Locations==
[[File:Kararagi v2.jpg|thumb|300px|The land of the Kararagi City States]]
'''Albis River''' (アルビス河 ''Arubisu Kawa''): A river which is located at the northern most part of Kararagi. The origin of the river is unknown, and it's long enough to go through Gusteko.

'''Free Trade Metropolitan Area''' (自由交易都市群 ''Jiyuu Boueki Toshigun''): The Free Trade Metropolitan Area is presumably a metropolitan area that allows free trade. It is also where Anastasia is from.

'''Hoshin Company''' (ホーシン商会, ''Hōshin Shōkai''): Originally the '''Chuden Company''' (チュデン商会, ''Chuden Shōkai''), which was based in Banan, Anastasia bought the '''Ryuushika Commerce Company''' (リューシカ商工会, ''Ryūshika Shōkōkai'') it was a subsidiary of with her business acumen and renamed it, forming the singular Hoshin Company which she took over as the president in the process, appointing Chuden Agri as the vice president. Since then, she has used her business skills to make it grow into a major power within Kararagi. It has been moved to Ivada, and it is currently the Iron Fang's base of operations. 

'''Kyo '''(キョウ): The First City of Kararagi. It lies in the center of Kararagi, between Banan and Fusumi.

'''[[Banan]]''' (バナン): The Second City of Kararagi. It lies in western Kararagi near its center. It was previously an independent nation, whose destruction during the Hoshin-era gave rise to the phrase "Hoshin was Banan's sunset", which if directed towards another demands total submission, otherwise face violence.
*'''Magoji Mansion''' (マゴージ御殿): The Magoji Mansion, owned by [[Riften Magoji]], is located in the northern part of the city.

'''Ivada''' (イバダ): The Third City of Kararagi. It is the closest city to Lugunica, lying near the eastern border.

'''Fusumi '''(フスミ): The fourth city of Kararagi that lies near the Grand Mogolade Geyser. Many mountains surround the city. White Snow Sakuras blossom in the surrounding areas, thanks to the precipitation from the nearby geyser.

'''Outou''' (オウトウ): The fifth city of Kararagi. It lies in the far west of the nation, bordering the Great Waterfall.

'''Azamiki''' (アザミキ): The sixth city of Kararagi. It lies in the far northwest of the nation, bordering the Great Waterfall.

'''Tenmitsu''' (テンミツ): The seventh city of Kararagi. It lies in the northeast of Kararagi, near the border with Gusteko.

'''Nanou''' (ナンオウ): A small town on the border with Vollachia. A majority of its 2000 residents were turned into [[Undead#Zombies|zombies]] by [[Sphinx]] as a precursor to the Great Disaster in the Vollachia Empire. They were ultimately dispatched by Halibel.

'''Magolia Plateau''' (マーゴリア高原): A large plateau in Kararagi where the Grand Mogolade's Geyser's water spews out to.

'''Horohoro Desert''' (ホロホロ砂漠): A vast desert spread across the southern region of Kararagi.

'''Garagara Sand Steppe''' (ガラガラ砂草原): A sandy grassland region in the north central area of Kararagi.

'''Girall Crimson Dunes''' (ギラル赤丘): Dunes to the northwest which are made entirely out of fragments of small magic stones which lie at the far west of the world map. The fragments of magic stone explode all year round. Because of this, it is rumored that the dunes are rumored to have been the bloody tears of a Great Spirit who failed to become one of the Four Greats.<ref>''――Girall Crimson Dunes were located northwest of the Kararagi City-States, near the Great Waterfall. That place, which appeared as a red desert area, was the most dangerous land in the world, made from delicate Fire Magic Stone particles resembling grains of sand. Because even a puff of wind could trigger a chain of explosions in that region, it was said to have been created from the bloody tears of a Great Spirit who had failed to become a part of the Four Greats.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 41, Section 1.</ref>

'''Cragrell Moving Forest''' (クラグレル移動林): A special kind of body of nature that evolved due to Kararagi's harsh climate. A forest in which the roots of its trees do not sink to the ground. The forest evolved so that it would move as a single entity to areas in which the geyser spewed out its water, depending on the wind's direction. The trees' wood was known to be of very fine quality.

'''Grand Mogolade Geyser''' (モゴレード大噴口): A body of water which is often mistaken as a lake. The geyser is said to be so deep that the water that filled it would lead to the Great Waterfall. Fish and other aquatic animals live in the geyser. The massive hole at the geyser is said to connect to the underside of the world, and it contains something akin to a massive reservoir of [[mana]]. Although not impossible, it is extremely difficult to find something that has drifted into the massive hole at the geyser. The only known method of stopping the flow of water at the geyser is with the breath of a Dragon.

'''Agzadd Canyon''' (アグザッド渓谷, ''Aguzaddo Keikoku''): A massive canyon with a top to bottom elevation of five thousand meters. To reach the bottom from the top, it takes 100 seconds,<ref>''An enormous fissure in the land that existed within the Kararagi City-States, the Agzadd Canyon, had a difference in elevation of five thousand meters from the surface to the deepest part of the valley, and the time it took to descend all the way was around a hundred seconds.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 2.</ref> and it is said to be approximately 5000 meters. Along the rock face are engravings that represent every ten seconds a person has fallen for.<ref>''Markings had been engraved beforehand along the rock face for intervals of every ten seconds, and they were currently passing the third―― seventy seconds remained until they hit the bottom.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 2.</ref> At the bottom of the canyon is a large river.

'''Shinobi Village''' (シノビの里, ''Shinobi no Sato''): A village in an unknown location in Vollachia. The village is home to Kararagi's shinobi, and this village is where all shinobi are trained.

'''Wolf Humans' Hidden Village''': A secret village hidden somewhere in Kararagi that is home to the wolf humans, including Halibel and Ricardo Welkin.

'''Zarestia's Bed''' (ザーレスティアの寝床 ''Zarestia no Nedoko''): A cavern on the western edge of Kararagi inhabited by the Great Spirit Zarestia, who kills anyone who enters.

title: Gusteko
wikitext:
The '''Holy Kingdom of Gusteko''' (グステコ聖王国, ''Gusuteko Sei Ōkoku''), usually referred to as '''Gusteko''' (グステコ, ''Gusuteko''), is one of the [[world]]’s Four Great Nations. It is a theocracy ruled by the [[Gustekan Church]].

==Information==
===Geography===
Gusteko is located directly north of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], and east of [[Kararagi]]. 

Because [[Odglass]] is responsible for creating the perpetual snowfall in Gusteko,<ref name="july2026talkshow">July 26, 2026 Talk Show</ref> the nation primarily has a cold climate in its central areas. The region is very mountainous, which, combined with the cold weather, makes it a very difficult environment to live in. Because of the year-round snowfall, only cold-tolerant crops can be planted. However, there is also a warmer and more humid area in Gusteko's western edge, in the direction of the Jimuna Volcano.

===Culture===
Molded by the harsh weather, among other circumstances, Gusteko, as its complete name suggests, is a spiritual nation. Its national culture reflects the geography and history of the region.

People with dark or black hair tend to be rather alienated in Gusteko, as they are thought to be disliked by [[Spirit|spirits]].<ref>''Elsewhere, hairless demi-humans were considered to be an unlucky thing in the Kararagi City-States; and, in the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, the closer the hair and eyes approached to black, the more alienated one would be, as they would be considered to be disliked by the spirits.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 34]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> It is also said that the women of Gusteko prize fair, snow-white skin.<ref>''Ferris had heard that, in Gusteko, with its continual snowfall, girls prized skin as white as new fallen snow, and this figure was no exception.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 2, Section 4.</ref>

Between the harsh environment and the heavily judgmental and discriminatory gazes and actions of the citizens, numerous serial killers have been born here, of which include [[Elsa Granhiert]] the Bowel Hunter, [[Beli Hainelga]], and [[Trellock]].

===Population===
Information about the population is scarce, but it can be assumed that like the other three great nations, it has a human majority with a [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] minority. Many spirits also count for subjects within the Holy Kingdom. 

Slavery is illegal in Gusteko. The [[Demi-Human War]] in Lugunica is said to have been a relatively distant event in the national consciousness of Gusteko, even during the war.<ref>''"Even we in the Holy Kingdom know of the civil war from decades ago. I had heard resentment still remained from those days, but…I see it hasn’t stopped the two of you from cherishing each other."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 2, Section 4.</ref> However, this does not stop slavery from being an open secret,<ref>''In the Kingdom of Gusteko, the existence of "slaves" was an open secret.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref> nor does it stop powerful people, including members of the Church, from illegally making others into their slaves.<ref>''“The Holy King Church is the one that makes the rules for this country! The very people who forbid the slave trade want slaves!”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref>

===Government===
Gusteko is a theocracy where the Gustekan Church, also known as the Holy King Church, holds a significant amount of power.

The ruler of Gusteko goes by the title of the '''Holy King''' and is selected by Odglass. It is mentioned that the race, blood and origin do not play any role when choosing who will become the Holy King. However, the Holy King is but an acting puppet; the Holy King Church itself holds true dominion over Gusteko.<ref>''The authority to decide the head of the Holy Kingdom and the Church, the Holy King, had been delegated to Odglass, and this tradition had been passed down from the beginning of the history of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko. That format was unbreakable. Odglass had always been, and would always be, the Benevolent Mother of the Church. ――With the Holy King as their puppet, the Church would continue to direct the country.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 3.</ref> As part of the Holy King's contract with Odglass, they able to be aware of everything that happens within the nation and deal with anything bad that appears.<ref name="july2026talkshow" />

Unlike Lugunica's southern neighbor, the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]], the Holy Kingdom does not seem as ideologically opposed to warming relations with its neighbor. In time, events culminated in the marriage of the Viscount [[Minor_Characters#Misère|Misère]], lord of Lugunica's entire northern region, and a [[Tiriena|relative]] of Gusteko's archbishop.<ref>''“I heard how things went. Word is, the young lady Your Highness met will become Viscount Misère’s wife.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 2, Section 5.</ref>

===Mages===
Around the time of the [[Great Calamity]], curse arts users around the world migrated to Gusteko. According to [[Beatrice]], most present-day curse art users hail from Gusteko.<ref>''“Inflictors of curses, or curse art users, hail from the nation of Gusteko to the north and practice an offshoot of magic and spiritualism, in fact.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 2]], Chapter 4, Section 1.</ref> Likewise, most [[Magic#Spiritual Arts|spiritual arts]] users also exist in Gusteko. Because of this, compared to the other countries, Gusteko specializes in spiritual arts and curse arts.<ref>''Compared to the technological prowess of the Kararagi City-States, the Spiritual Arts and Curse Arts of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, and the magical disciplines of the Kingdom of Lugunica, the Vollachian Empire excelled in the martial arts.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 98, Section 1.</ref>

===Religion===
Spirits are far more commonplace in Gusteko, than any other country, and thus, the reverence of spirits has become incorporated into the national teachings of the Gustekan Church. According to the doctrine they teach, all life is equal, for there is no difference in value between human beings. Their doctrine further says that the permafrost of Gusteko is a trial given to its people by a greater being, and the only way for one's soul to feel peace in the afterlife is to endure said trials. These teachings are a salvation to many in the nation, as due to the climate, people are driven to believe in spirits, viewing them as being something higher.

Odglass, one of the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Four Great Spirits]], is revered as a deity in the country. For her friendliness and aid towards humans, she is known as the Church's Benevolent Mother. According to tradition, the one who selected the first Holy King was Odglass, therefore founding the country.

===Economics & Currency===
Instead of animal husbandry, there are many mountains in the steep mountains with magical ore, relying on the mining industry and dealing with magic ore to maintain national strength.

===Military===
While next to nothing is known about the Holy Kingdom's military, a specific group of individuals known as the '''Temple Knights''', executioners for the faith, are rumored to be on par with the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] of the Vollachia Empire in terms of strength and skill. All of them possess a unique Blessing similar to Elsa's: they're granted partial immortality, allowing them to survive fatal strikes. Each member of the Temple Knights seems to train with their very own special set of weapons such as dual katanas, whips of different kinds, twin snake swords, and others. 

Moreover, another group serving the Gustekan Church with the same type of Blessing as the Temple Knights. Known as '''Itinerant Preachers''', this group both spreads the religion's teachings across Gusteko and takes action against anyone who contradicts them. They are powerful and dangerous, and many of them are more than willing to destroy entire settlements if it means killing one “heretic”.

==History==
===1000+ BA===
*Odglass forms a contract with the first Holy King, and from then on, the spirit has been involved with choosing each Holy King.
*At some point, [[Minor Characters#Gaddogi Guadozeaddo|Gaddogi Guadozeaddo]] is sealed away as punishment for reasons unknown.

===Within 1000+ BA===
*Curse art users begin to emerge from the nation of Gusteko.

===Within the last 10 years BA===
*Vague Adgard slays 15-16 of his siblings and is imprisoned in the northernmost tower.
*Elsa Granhiert becomes infamous as the Bowel Hunter. At some point, she is taken in by [[Holosseo Featherrun]] to be recruited into the [[Featherrun Sisters]], and he performs a ritual on her to make her into a Curse Doll. Holosseo and most of the sisters are eventually killed, and in the end, Elsa becomes one of [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]]'s "children".
*Beli Hainelga becomes an active serial killer, though he was eventually forgotten after his name and memories were devoured by [[Lye Batenkaitos]].
*The Ice Thieves accidentally destroy Leanotte in an avalanche. As a result, [[Coatl]] gives up the life for one as a church pastor, and he assists the people of the town in their recovery. Meanwhile, one of the survivors, [[Noelle Tuérico]] joins the Gustekan Church, becoming an Itinerant Preacher, and awaits the day that she can avenge those who died.

===6 BA===
*A member of the lineage of Gusteko’s Archbishop, Tiriena, marries into a noble family of Lugunica.

===1-0 year BA===
*Elsa is involved with the deaths of [[Viktor Orcos]] and [[Igor Kenash]]. Afterward, she sets her sights of the Kingdom of Lugunica.

===0-1 year AA===
*At some point, heretic hunts begin to intensify amidst rumors of a Witch appearing within Gusteko the for the first time in over a hundred years.
*A face-stealing serial killer named Trellock goes on a killing spree, before arriving at the church that Coatl runs.
*[[Omega]] and her [[Omega Party|party]] are assisted by Noelle Tuérico after being forced to trudge through the snow. At the church they arrive at, Coatl is found dead, resulting in an investigation by Omega. A [[Admonsah|former slave]] is discovered to have been responsible for one of the murders, the victim having been his master whom he killed out of self-defense. He is forgiven for is actions. A [[Maqueena|con artist]] who had been at the church to extort Coatl tried to escape, but Noelle confronted her, intent on killing her, believing she was a member of the Ice Thieves. Omega stops her, however, perceiving that Noelle had already killed Coatl before they met one another and correcting her misunderstanding of the con artist's identity, resulting in her arrest by a [[Podoso|guard]]. The serial killer Trellock was subdued by a transformed [[Colette]], his fate unknown. In the end, the guard offered the former slave a position as an assistant, the two of them took the con artist to the nearby town, and Noelle deserted her post after losing the reason for her revenge, joining Omega’s party.
*At some point, [[Shion]] and [[Lilac]] use their dream arts on the town of Sylphoa while being forced to defend themselves from Gusteko’s Temple Knights. [[Mikli Yulitô]] is one of those affected. Meanwhile, [[Zank Metley]] slays his comrades when they suggest destroying the entire village.
*Omega’s party arrives and settles the dispute, and Shion/Lilac decide to follow Omega. The two Temple Knights resign from their positions.
*The town of Limbus faces a string of murders following the execution of a [[Minor Characters#Elderly Healer|local healer]] who is branded a Witch. Because of this, numerous Witch Hunts have taken place within the town.
*The Omega Party arrives in Limbus, and despite their initial treatment in the town, the party chooses to stay at an inn, where they decide to assist in the dispute. After Omega is nearly convicted, the group participates in a Witch Trial, and the conspiracies hidden beneath the Witch Hunts are exposed, resulting in [[Edmon Quayle]] taking a severe injury and losing trust in Limbus, and with [[Mireille Hetia]] and [[Nananna Pezza]] leaving the town. Omega speculates that because of this incident, Limbus would face its destruction in the near future, as the accusations and murders would likely continue until there was nothing left.

==Locations==
[[File:Gusteko v2.jpg|thumb|350px|The land of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko and the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]
'''Glacia''' (グレイシア, ''Gureishia''): Glacia, also known as the '''Holy Capital of Glacia''' (聖都グレイシア, ''Seito Gureishia''), or simply the '''Holy Capital''', is a city that lies at the foot of the Sacred Mountain Pardochia.

'''Sacred Mountain Pardochia''' (霊峰パルドキア, ''Reihō Parudokia''): A mountain where one of the four Great Spirits, Odglass, resides. The Holy Capital of Glacia lies at its foot.

'''Inorandum''' (イノランダム, ''Inorandamu''): Inorandum, also known as the '''Snow Field Capital of Inorandum''' (雪原の都イノランダム, ''Setsugen no Miyako Inorandamu''), is a great city built on one of the largest hallowed lands within Gusteko. It is located in one of the snowiest regions of Gusteko, though the effects of the cold are felt less in the city due to it being built on hallowed land. 

'''Eternia''' (エターニャ, ''Etānya''): Eternia, also known as the '''Spirit City of Eternia''' (霊都エターニャ, ''Reito Etānya''), is a city located in northeastern Gusteko, near the Sacred Mountain Kanai.

'''Albis''' (アルビス, ''Arubisu''): Albis, also known as the '''Glacier City of Albis''' (氷河都市アルビス, ''Hyōga Toshi Arubisu''), is a city that lies beside the Great Sibarell Glacier. The city, despite still having some frosty areas, is unusually warm for a city in Gusteko, and it has an unfrozen river that leads into Kararagi.

'''Drisstay''' (ディリステイ, ''Dirisutei''): Drisstay, also known as the '''Mountain Gate City of Drisstay''' (山門都市ディリステイ, ''Sanmon Toshi Dirisutei''), is a city in the north of Gusteko situated near the Tekran Ravine in the Virga Mountains.

'''Zesperga''' (ゼスペルガ ''Zesuperuga''): Zesperga, also known as the '''Torrid Hot City of Zesperga''' (炎熱都市ゼスペルガ, ''En'netsu Toshi Zesuperuga''), is a city in Gusteko's humid west. It is located at the base of Jimuna Volcano.

'''Leanotte''' (レイアノット, ''Reianotto''): A town in Gusteko. In the past, it was destroyed in an avalanche caused by the Ice Thieves. It was restored by a former Ice Thief named Coatl.

'''Sylphoa''' (シルフォア, ''Shirufoa''): A Gustekan town that was afflicted by a dream world.

'''Limbus''' (リンバス, ''Rinbasu''): A town that experiences more snowfall than normal for Gusteko, though not as much as the Vast Eder Snowfield. The town is situated between three mountains.

'''Vault of Sacraments''' (秘蹟保管庫, ''Hiseki Hokan-ko''): The Vault of Sacraments is a prison-like place where people who get thrown within it are said to undergo an “eternal slumber”.

'''Vast Eder Snowfield''' (エーデル大雪原, ''Ēderu Dai Setsugen''): A vast snowfield that lies in the heart of Gusteko. The Snow Field Capital of Inorandum is situated in it. 

'''Sacred Mountain Kanai''' (カナイ霊山, ''Kanai Reizan''): A mountain located in the northeast of Gusteko, near the Spirit City of Eternia.

'''Great Sibarell Glacier''' (シバレル大氷河, ''Shibareru Dai Hyōga''): A large frozen glacier that connects with the Tigracy River on the Gustekan side. The Glacier City of Albis lies near it. 

'''Albis River''' (アルビス河, ''Arubisu Kawa''): A river originating from Kararagi which has a small part located in western Gusteko.

'''High Virga Mountains''' (ビルガ高山脈, ''Biruga Kō Sanmyaku''): A mountain range in the north of Gusteko, home to the Mountain Gate City of Drisstay.

'''Tekran Ravine''' (テクラン峡谷, ''Tekuran Kyōkoku''): A ravine situated in the Virga Mountains.

'''Jimuna Volcano''' (ジムナ火炎山, ''Jimuna Kaenzan''): A large volcano located at the west edge of Gusteko. It is in close proximity to the Torrid Hot City of Zesperga.

'''Orcos Domain''' (オルコス領, ''Orukosu-ryō''): A stretch of land that was controlled by the former Baron Viktor Orcos. It was mentioned to border the Kenash Domain. The main stronghold of the Orcos family lay deep within the domain.  

'''Kenash Domain''' (ケナシュ領, ''Kenashu-ryō''): A stretch of land that was controlled by the former Baron Igor Kenash. It was mentioned to border the Orcos Domain.

'''Featherrun Mansion''' (フェザーラン邸, ''Fezāran-tei''): A mansion located on a remote plot of Hallowed Land that was home to the Featherrun Sisters. Following their dissolution, the mansion remains under the care of [[Oliver Zeppes]].

'''Northernmost Prison Tower''': A tower in the northernmost reaches of Gusteko that is capable of sealing the power of spirits. Vague Adgard is presently imprisoned there.
