title: Pleiades Watchtower
wikitext:
[[File:Pleiades Watchtower.jpg|thumb]]
The '''Pleiades Watchtower''' (プレアデス監視塔, ''Pureadesu Kanshitō''), otherwise known as the '''Great Library Pleiades''' (大図書館プレイアデス, ''Dai Toshokan Pureiadesu''), is a watchtower located in the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] within the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]. Previously overseen by [[Shaula]], it allowed her to keep a lookout for trespassers who were aiming to visit the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine where the Witch of Envy, [[Satella]], is currently sealed. The tower as a whole also serves as a library, and once entered by someone, the visitor is locked into a series of exams to gain access to the various floors of the tower. This was a primary setting for the events of [[Arc 6]] and [[Arc 9]].

Following the tower's [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|conquering]], [[Emilia]], who completed all three of the exams, was granted the authority of the tower's administrator, and she ordered [[Volcanica]] to prevent anyone else from approaching the area.

==Information==
<gallery type="slideshow">
Pleiades Watchtower.jpg
Episode 79 Pleiades Watchtower.png
Episode 68 Distant Pleiades Watchtower at Night.png
Episode 73 Pleiades Watchtower at Night.png
Re Zero Light Novel 23 14.png
</gallery>
From a distance, behind its defense mechanism known as the '''Sand Time''', the watchtower appears as a silhouette that never changes in position, shape or form, no matter how close you try to approach it. After crossing the Sand Time, the tower appears from its exterior as an extremely tall, circular shaped building made of stone. The tower appears to be over a couple of hundred meters in height, and it has a balcony that juts out from one of the floors. Furthermore, a huge door can be seen at the base which leads to the inside of the tower.

Its first line of defense is the aforementioned mechanism known as the Sand Time. It is an invisible force field that twists and bends space, making it impossible to pass through it. It acts as a deterrent for everyone who wants to approach it, and, upon being sent, not even [[Reinhard van Astrea]] was able to find a way to pass through it. Despite that, there is a single flaw in its defenses: a rift which can only be exploited when a sandstorm occurs. Only then can one pass through Sand Time and reach the actual tower, provided they can avoid Shaula's '''Hell's Snipe''' and countless deadly [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]] residing near the tower's outer walls.

At the end of Arc 6, after relentless attacks from witchbeasts, the three [[Rui Arneb|Sin]] [[Lye Batenkaitos|Archbishops]] of [[Roy Alphard|Gluttony]], and a massive attack from Volcanica's breath, the tower faced some destruction, having massive gaping holes around the upper floors.

Following the liberation of the Watchtower, the Sand Time barrier disappeared (albeit Sand Time still takes place), Shaula was reduced to a small, mindless scorpion, and [[Reid Astrea|Reid]]'s soul shattered, leaving the Divine Dragon as the only living creature to guard the Watchtower. The intense miasma being emanated from the tower was also mostly neutralized, though it was not completely erased. Before her departure, Emilia instructed the Dragon to guard over the tower and attack anyone who approaches, only on the condition that the Dragon may not harm anyone.

==History==
The Pleiades Watchtower, its examinations, and its other mechanisms or locations of note, such as the Green Room and the site of the handprints at the top of the tower, were built with unspecified means at an unknown point during the era of Witches. There are at least two people who are known to have participated in constructing the tower. As the tower's overseer, [[Flugel]] is believed to have had a hand in designing the examinations and mechanisms of the tower. Moreover, the Witch [[Echidna]] managed to trick Od Lagna and take advantage of its properties to create the library within the Pleiades Watchtower.<ref>''The Pleiades Watchtower, built upon the Augria Sand Dunes―― the reason why the tower had been erected, had been neither for a battle-worn Sage to go into retirement, nor because that was where a knowledge-hungry Witch had wished to place the tasteless library she had tricked Od Lagna into creating.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40]], Chapter 1, Section 6.</ref><ref>''There was no doubt that this library was a place that took advantage of Od Lagna’s properties, but it ought to have been the Witch who had made them manifest in the form of books. In that case, why had the Witch gone out of her way to create a library that was so difficult to comprehend?'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 6, Section 16.</ref>

Following the Great Calamity, Flugel commanded Shaula to stay in the tower and kill anyone who approached the tower unless the person was himself. He also put her in charge of upholding the tower's rules. At an unknown point in time after Flugel’s disappearance, the hidden floor Merope was created for unknown reasons. Throughout the four centuries after this, numerous attempts to besiege the tower were made by the [[Witch Cult]] or various other people, though the vast majority of these attempts were unsuccessful, and those who attempted to cross the sand sea were likely either obliterated by Shaula or the numerous witchbeasts in the Augria Sand Dunes. Likewise, over the course of the next few centuries, Shaula regularly killed the witchbeasts that would come to assault her at the tower.

Both Emilia and [[Natsuki Subaru]] noticed that Echidna was related to the tower to some extent. For example, Subaru learned that [[Eridna]] mostly knew nothing about her past except for how to get to the tower, and Emilia noted similarities between the trials at the Sanctuary and the exams of the tower.

Centuries after Shaula took up watch at the Pleiades Watchtower, a group of ~900 people, led by the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, [[Leilani Alnair]], successfully crossed the Augria Sand Dunes. However, the entire group, save for Leilani, was killed by witchbeasts. Shaula, realizing that the woman was pregnant, chose to allow the woman to stay in the tower until she could safely give birth, doing so while recalling Flugel’s teachings about how to treat pregnant women. Over time, Leilani slowly used her [[Authority]] to attempt to have her obey her. However, the moment she acted, because she had failed to replace Shaula’s memories of Flugel, when she called herself the most important person to Shaula, Shaula shot her with her Hell’s Snipe, killing one of her three unborn children, and she tossed her beyond the Sand Time barrier with some provisions and a possible chance to be found.

Over a decade later, approximately one year and five months after Subaru’s arrival to the world, he and his companions managed to reach the tower after trudging through the desert, Sand Time, Shaula’s attacks, and attacks from witchbeasts. Shortly after Subaru awakened from having been knocked out, he completed the first exam of the Pleiades Watchtower and unlocked the Taygeta Library and its Books of the Dead. Shortly after, they attempted to challenge the Electra exam, which Emilia managed to complete. About a day later, the tower was assaulted by the three Sin Archbishops of Gluttony, Shaula’s transformation was triggered, and an army of witchbeasts assaulted the tower. Fortunately, the Gluttonies were defeated, Shaula was handled, the witchbeasts were quelled, and Emilia completed the exam on Maia, making the miasma of the tower and the Sand Time barrier disappear.

After Subaru, [[Rem]], and [[Spica|Rui Arneb]] were taken away by a massive shadow, everyone left the tower once Emilia asked Volcanica to protect the tower. Later, another expedition team managed to reach the tower and began to investigate. While they were there, aside from finding it odd the several empty Books of the Dead were scattered across the floor, they noticed the birds that were there, which Subaru and Eridna had noticed before, were strange. Realizing that the birds were being used to spy, they destroyed them and remained wary. Afterward, while most of the team returned to Lugunica, [[Ezzo Cadner]] and [[Flam Remendis]] remained behind to continue investigating the tower. During this time, Ezzo turned the door of the tower automatic.

Shortly after, Subaru returned with other members of his camp and [[Al]], who came to see a certain Book of the Dead. Although Al tried to use this time to [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|seal]] Subaru and [[Beatrice]] in Ol Shamak, he ultimately failed and was sealed by them instead, as Subaru had already used Return by Death. The next day, Subaru's party returned to the Royal Capital while Ezzo and Flam remained behind.

==Floors==
===Asterope===
The sixth floor, also considered the basement floor of the Pleiades Watchtower, known as '''Asterope''' (アステローペ, ''Asuterōpe''). It is a large circular room that has a radius of roughly 2-300 meters. The room's walls are adorned by magical lamps and luminous moss which provide it some illumination. A spiral staircase located on the outer edge of the room leads up to Celaeno.

===Celaeno===
The fifth and ground floor of the tower is known as '''Celaeno''' (ケラエノ, ''Keraeno''). The room is described as a giant hall with no distinguishing features, except for a large door of around about 10 meters in height which leads to the outside of the Watchtower. The door is operated by some sort of mechanical opening system that reacts to touch. Celaeno is connected by the large spiral staircase leading up to Alycone, and one down to Asterope. The ground is completely covered in sand that has come in from the desert outside, whether by the tower's entrance or some other manner. It is the room that one would first arrive at upon entering the tower.

===Alcyone===
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 22 2.png|thumb|right|250px|The balconies of Alcyone]]
The fourth floor of the tower, and the first floor above the entrance, is called '''Alcyone''' (アルキオネ, ''Arukione''). This is the floor that Shaula used as her living space during her time in the tower, and unlike the other floors of the tower, Alcyone is filled with a multitude of room. Shaula's living quarters, the Green Room, a dining hall, and a well from which to draw water can all be found among these rooms. The fourth floor is also where the balconies are located. Although there are no outright doors that lead to them, there are spots in the hallway where the wall is fake, either by warped space or an illusion, and by crawling through these spaces, anyone can reach the balconies. These balconies are where Shaula perched herself when shooting at intruders.

This floor is also different from the other floors in that it is connected to three different floors. In one part of the floor, one can find the staircase that leads to the previous floor, Celaeno. On the other hand, there is another staircase that leads to the next floor, Taygeta. There is also a third staircase that can lead to the second floor, Electra. However, unlike the other staircases, the entrance to this one is hidden with magic. Said magic makes it to where anyone inside, including the guardian of the tower, will not notice the entrance at all, as if it wasn't there to begin with. People might notice something strange in the area, but ultimately, they will be unable to realize that this area is the entrance to Electra until they pass the Taygeta exam. Once said exam is complete, only then will the magic be lifted and the door becomes visible.

====Green Room====
[[File:Pleiades Watchtower Green Room.png|thumb|right|250px|The Green Room]]
The '''Green Room''' (緑部屋, ''Midori Heya'') is a special room that can be found on Alcyone. The Green Room is a unique space within the tower that is covered in greenery, a large tree, a few stone platforms that can act as temporary beds, and floating motes of yellow light, giving it a special presence in the tower. The room is inhabited by a non-sentient [[spirit]], known simply as the [[Minor Characters#Green Room Spirit|Green Room Spirit]], and it naturally heals anyone who enters the room of its own accord. However, only a limited number of people can enter the room at a time. At most, it has held approximately four people or creatures inside at a time. Furthermore, it is possible to get on the bad side of the spirit, making it impossible to enter the room, such as in Shaula's case, who treated it roughly.<ref>[https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/2049491763656876042 Re:Zero Episode 70 Commentary]</ref> Because its ability to heal is effectively the same as typical healing magic, it cannot heal maladies such as Sleeping Beauty, which was brought about as the result of tampering via an Authority.

===Taygeta===
The third floor of the tower is known as '''Taygeta''' (タイゲタ, ''Taigeta''). In its initial state, the room is completely white and only has a single monolith right after the stairs that lead up to the floor. Once touched, the room enters its examination state and is covered by a series of monoliths which represent stars and their constellations. Once completed, the room transforms into the Taygeta library, which contains the Books of the Dead that are connected to [[Od Lagna]]. With the exceptions of those in the center of the room, the bookshelves extend endlessly high into the floor. Due to how impossibly high this makes the ceiling of the room, which cannot be seen, it is likely that the space has been altered to allow for the floor's ever-expanding nature. Taygeta can be reached by taking a set of stairs from Alcyone. However, unlike previous floor, there is no other entrance leading to other floors.

===Electra===
The second floor is known as '''Electra''' (エレクトラ, ''Erekutora''), and it is the highest floor inside of the tower. The floor in its initial state only has a sword lying in the middle of its room. After the second exam begins, the white floor is replaced with a space that replicates a grassland with an expansive blue sky. It is unknown exactly how large the space has become, however, as there still seems to be a roof in the sky, as evidenced by the spiral staircase that emerges from it upon completing the exam, and because of this, it can be speculated that there are walls of a similar nature. The floor can be reached by a staircase connected to Alcyone, and the spiral staircase that comes from the sky leads to Maia.

===Maia===
The first floor and the very apex of the Pleiades Watchtower is known as '''Maia''' (マイア, ''Maia''). As this floor is the top of the tower itself, it is outside, and there are no ceilings, walls, or supports of any kind. The floor is a large circular space, 100 meters in radius, with six pillars placed around the outskirts of the floor and a giant pillar located at the very middle of it. Overseen by Volcanica, who is idly leaning against the giant pillar in the middle, the final examination takes place on this floor. At the very top of the center pillar is a certain monolith that has six handprints on it, which Emilia assumed to belong to [[Farsale Lugunica]], who Volcanica had mentioned, Flugel, Reid, and perhaps Shaula. In fact, one of them was the same size and shape as her own hand. However, it is not revealed who these handprints belonged to. Maia can be reached by taking a set of stairs from Electra, provided the person who does has beaten its exam.

===Merope===
There is a hidden floor of the Pleiades Watchtower known as '''Merope''' (メローペ, ''Merōpe''). It is unknown exactly when this floor was made, nor where its location is, but according to Shaula, after hearing Subaru's speculation regarding the namesake of the tower and its floors, Shaula referred to Merope, which was made after Flugel vanished, as a zeroth floor.<ref>''“It’s a zeroth floor. It makes sense, since Master named them… But it was a place made after Master disappeared, so you shouldn’t know where it is.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 22]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> However, she refused to give information about it, and due to her threatening demeanor upon warning Subaru, it is likely that Merope is a floor of utmost importance. Subaru speculates that rather than being an upper floor, Merope is actually underground. However, this remains unconfirmed.

===Sand Palace===
The '''Sand Palace''' (砂宮, ''Suna Miya'') is a term used by Shaula to refer to the underground area underneath the sand dunes that connects to the Pleiades Watchtower. The area is not illuminated, and it is full of rocky tunnels and caves. There are two layers to this area, and Hungry Horse Kings infest the area, especially on the left path. In addition to that, a strong miasma emanates throughout the right path; several obstacles which Natsuki Subaru described as "doors" block the path the deeper one traverses through this path. While Subaru has been able to open three of them, it is thought that there are seven in total, with the miasma growing thicker the more doors that are opened. The miasma originates from a door that stands without support in the middle of the above layer. The door transports a person back to the Pleiades Watchtower if they reach a door that they cannot open. Shaula mentioned that it was reckless of Subaru to be there without having all of the "keys" ready. While the exact nature of the keys is unknown, the number of opened doors has corresponded with the number of Witch Factors and Authorities that he possessed during the two instances he found himself on this path.

==Books of the Dead==
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 22 1.png|thumb|left|250px|The Taygeta Library]]
On the Taygeta floor, once one has passed the exam, access to the Taygeta Library is granted. This library, which is the reason for the true name of the Pleiades Watchtower, the Great Library Pleiades, is a greatly extended space that should ordinarily be impossible to fit within the tower, suggesting that its creator expanded the space within on purpose. Apparently, this library was made after a "knowledge-hungry Witch" tricked Od Lagna into making it. Within the library are what Subaru has coined the '''Books of the Dead''' (死者の書, ''Shisha no Sho''). These books are special mediums that connect their readers to Od Lagna's [[Od Lagna#Corridor of Memories|Corridor of Memories]]. By doing so, assuming that the reader is at least somewhat acquainted with the deceased person detailed in the book, they will be allowed to glimpse into their past, regardless of whether the relationship was antagonistic or positive.

<gallery type="slideshow">
Subaru reading Typhon's Book of the Dead.gif|Subaru reading Typhon’s Book of the Dead.
Beatrice reading Book of the Dead.gif|Beatrice reading a Book of the Dead of a person unfamiliar to her.
</gallery>
The Books of the Dead come across as ordinary books at first glance, and nearly all of them are written with the writing system used by the world at large. However, should a person open one of these books, if they do not know the person in the book, the words inside immediately scramble and scatter across the pages, making it impossible to read them. However, this changes the moment a reader comes across a book of someone they are acquainted with. Once the reader opens the book, their mind is practically absorbed into the pages. Afterward, they are able to see a rough outline that person's history and what led to them becoming the person that they were. This being said, for just acquaintances, it does not seem to detail their life in full. When Subaru read [[Typhon]]'s Book of the Dead, it showed him her early life and what led to her becoming a [[Witch]], and nothing more. After reading the book, the reader is then forcefully ejected, leaving them winded. Based off of Ezzo Cadner’s speculation, it seems to be possible to read other Books of the Dead after having encountered the respective deceased in other books, something which he has done himself, though causing him to pass out multiple times.

The stronger the relationship was between the reader and the deceased, the more information the reader can see inside. However, so too does the risk of reading the books increase. If one is unprepared and reads a book of a someone with a strong relationship to them, after reading their book, it directly affects their minds. The reader will begin to hallucinate the person written about in the book, and they will be able to converse with that person as if they were actually there. This same occurrence can take place if the reader reads multiple books of their acquaintances, basically increasing the number of hallucinated people. In the Gluttony IF, Subaru had experienced this personally, having not only read [[Meili Portroute]]'s book in a failed loop, but also having killed as many of his acquaintances, friends, and enemies in order to read their books and leave their presences in his mind. Meanwhile, in the failed loop of Arc 9, because [[Petra Leyte]] read one of Subaru's books, he remained a constant presence in her mind, something which both influenced her personality and provided her with increased mental strength, while also granting her his memories.

Furthermore, it becomes possible for that presence of the person within the book to potentially take over the reader's mind. If one's mind as almost completely absent, then if their vessel is forced to read the Book of the Dead of one of their acquaintances or someone they seemed to have only just seen for the first time, the person within the book can take over the body. Aldebaran took advantage of this by using his own Book of the Dead on Volcanica, whose mind had mostly been absent following the creation of its [[Dragon#Dragonkin|dragonkin]], and by doing so, it allowed his own mind to take over its body, granting him access to its power and aligning their magic signatures.

Despite there being such risks, it is possible to read the Books of the Dead by preparing oneself mentally. When Ezzo read multiple Books of the Dead, he kept himself emotionally and mentally detached from the deceased, acting merely as an observer and successfully preventing the presences within the books to influence him. Of course, it still affected him to read the books, but he was able to continue reading the books after utilizing this method.

In the event that the soul of one of the deceased is being utilized somewhere in the world, then the respective book will become empty, as in the case of the souls being utilized during the [[Great Disaster]]; the books of the souls being used were left lying on the floor of the library, their pages entirely empty. This was also the case for Reid Astrea, whose soul was utilized for the Electra Exam. It is unclear if this would happen in the event someone read any of the other empty books if the reader knew the person who would ordinarily be documented in said book, but when Subaru, who had met Reid prior, attempted to read his empty book, rather than seeing his memories, he instead found his mind within the Corridor of Memories itself. It is unknown what would normally happen or if this would ordinarily be time limited, but in Subaru's case, this allowed him to converse with Rui Arneb, who was trapped there since birth. 

There are a few unique circumstances surrounding these books as well. In one case, Subaru not only has multiple books due to his Return by Death, but his books are also written in kanji. Each of his books can details his life up until a certain point when he is killed, and said book will go no further. Should one read his books in order, they can witness Subaru's life and see every single failed loop that he has experienced, which spans into the thousands following the events in [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. However, because of this, his books can be considered taboo to read, as reading them can summon the Witch of Envy, who will attempt to kill whoever read the book. Meanwhile, Aldebaran only has one book, despite having a similar ability, and with every death, his book updates. Naturally, it is unclear as to why there are such differences between Subaru and Al's respective books.

==Exams==
The Pleiades Watchtower has a set of '''exams''' (試験, ''shiken'') that must be completed in order to conquer the tower, and each one's difficulty is incredibly high. The exams take place on the floors of Taygeta, Electra, and Maia, and one cannot take the second or third exams without first completing the preceding exam. Likewise, they will be incapable of traversing to the following floor without doing so either, as the path to the next floor will remain hidden otherwise. According to the observations of Subaru and Emilia, the exams seem to be quite reminiscent of Echidna’s trials from the [[Sanctuary]].

===Taygeta Exam===
<gallery type="slideshow">
Re Zero Light Novel 22 4.png|The monolith that starts the exam.
Subaru starts the Taygeta Exam.gif|The Taygeta Exam begins.
Re Zero Light Novel 22 5.png|The answer to the Taygeta Exam.
Subaru completes the Taygeta Exam.gif|The Taygeta Exam completed.
</gallery>
On the third floor, Taygeta, those who challenge the exam will find themselves in a large white space, completely absent of shadows, without a single piece of furniture or proper walls or a true ceiling. The only thing within the space is a single monolith, and upon touching it, the challenger hears their own voice echoing within their heads, telling them to touch upon the greatest splendor of the hero destroyed by Shaula. Afterward, the monolith multiplies, and the challenger must touch the correct monolith to complete the challenge. The challenger can take this exam as many times as they wish without the worry of a penalty for failing. This being said, one cannot cheat the exam by randomly selecting a bunch of different monoliths in a row, meaning that the exam requires proper thought before it can be completed. Upon touching a monolith, if it is a failure, the room will return to normal, and the challengers must touch the single monolith once more to trigger the exam again.

The secret of the exam is that the monoliths create an asterism of the night sky. When seen from above, it is possible to see the monoliths as if they were stars. Furthermore, since the exam is not referring to the Star Guardian Shaula, she is instead another clue to completing the exam. The exam is complete upon realizing that the riddle is asking for the challenger to touch the monolith representing one of the stars of the constellation of Orion, specifically the monolith representing the star Rigel, and once the challenger does so, the room turns into the Taygeta Library. Due to its difficulty and how specific it is to knowledge in another world, it is very likely that nobody in this world sans Subaru or possibly Aldebaran would have been able to complete the challenge.

===Electra Exam===
After completing the Taygeta exam, the staircase leading to the next floor, Electra, is revealed. After reaching the top, the challengers enter another white space, and instead of a monolith, there is a single sword. Upon touching it, the challengers are told to overcome the guardian of the floor. Afterward, the white space is replaced with a wide plain, and the examiner of the floor, Reid Astrea appears. Despite his initial practically mechanical responses, his personality emerges, and he is tasked with taking care of the floor. If one recklessly challenges him in an attempt to defeat him, it would ordinarily be impossible to bring him down, effectively making it impossible to overcome with sheer might. On the other hand, if one provides a set of rules to overcome, such as making Reid yield a single step, and if Reid accepts that, then so long as the challenger succeeds in that set task, then they will have completed the challenge.

Upon completing the exam, a large spiral staircase appears from the "ceiling" and touches the ground, allowing the challenger who succeeded proceed to the next floor. However, unlike the previous floor, which allowed everyone to proceed forward, every challenger must overcome Reid individually, else they will not be allowed to proceed. This being said, it is unclear what would happen if Reid's soul was separated from the exam, if everyone would be able to proceed as normal, or if the rules of the tower would have been broken.

===Maia Exam===
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 25 2.png|thumb|right|250px|The Maia Exam]]
After completing the Electra exam and moving up the spiral staircase, the challengers reach the top of the Pleiades Watchtower, where they are surrounded by open air, several pillars, and come face to face with the dragonhusk of Volcanica, who serves as the final examiner of the Pleiades Watchtower, and it repeats the same lines of how to complete the tower over and over again. In order to complete this exam, the challenger must somehow reach the very top of the pillar that Volcanica sits directly in front of, all the while defending themselves from the incredible onslaught of attacks from Volcanica. Upon reaching the top of the tower, in order to complete the exam, the challenger must place their hand upon the monolith that sits at the top. Upon completion, Volcanica stops attacking, and the one who overcomes the exam becomes the next administrator of the tower, allowing them to destroy the exams of the tower and even task Volcanica with protection of the tower.

===Rules===
There are five rules which challengers must obey whilst in the tower. In the case that a rule is violated, then the Stars Keeper Shaula may turn into her scorpion form which she describes as being a "bloodthirsty killing machine" and eliminate them all. The rules are listed as follows:

*It is forbidden to leave the tower without completing the exams.
*It is forbidden to violate the rules of the exams.
*It is forbidden to disrespect the library.
*It is forbidden to damage the tower.
*It is not forbidden to destroy the exams.

==Trivia==
*In Japanese, the name "Subaru" refers to the same cluster as the Pleiades.
*All of the tower's floors are named after the seven sisters of the Pleiades from the ancient Greek religion.
*In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], the underground area had only one door and seven jewels instead of an unknown number of doors. When Subaru approached the door, four of the jewels lit up.
*In the web novel, at the end of Arc 6 when Spica first appeared, it was mentioned that the Green Room spirit had vanished. However, this was ultimately removed from the light novel and has not been touched on upon the return to the tower later in Arc 9, leaving the exact state of the Green Room spirit unknown.
*According to the author, it currently remains impossible to say with certainty what name would be recorded in the Books of the Dead of the Witch Cult's Sin Archbishops due to the adoption of the star names.<ref>April 5, 2026 Talk Show.</ref>
*Although not implicitly stated, it is likely that Flugel could be considered the examiner of the Taygeta examination, as unlike the other two, its exam is directly linked to knowledge only someone from another world, like him, would have.
*While the novels describe the Books of the Dead as all being equally thick, the anime depicts them with various widths.
*Despite their souls still being in the world via a glintstone, the Witches of Sin, sans Satella, still have their demises documented in a Book of the Dead. As the chapter in the web novel detailing Echidna’s life was cut from the light novel, it is unknown if Echidna, who now inhabits the body of [[Ryuzu Meyer (copy)|Ryuzu Shima]] and has named herself [[Omega]], has an empty Book of the Dead, a properly documented one, or if she is recognized as a new being entirely and has yet to produce a new Book of the Dead as Omega.
*The Pleiades Watchtower is seen in [[Season 4]]'s ending, [[Ender Ember]], with six people standing before it. While the identities of the six people are uncertain, their numbers match and their vague appearances resemble several of the core members of the [[Witch Era Party]]. In the event that it is the party, this would mean that the tower was built prior to the Witch of Envy's sealing.
*If Reinhard or any of the other world's strongest accompanied the expedition force to the tower, the difficulty of completing the tower would increase due to Reid's personality.<ref name="July2026">July 26, 2026 Talk Show</ref>
*According to the author, the difference between Al's and Subaru's respective Books of the Dead is a spoiler.<ref name="July2026" />

title: Arlam Village
wikitext:
[[File:Arlam_Village_-_Episode_24.png|thumb|275px]]
'''Arlam Village''' (アーラム村 ''Āramu-mura'') is a village located near the [[Roswaal Manor|old Roswaal Manor]]. The current head of Arlam Village is [[Milde Arlam]]. It is one of the primary settings of [[Arc 2]].

==Information==
The Arlam village is located within the domain of [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] and is surrounded by multiple forests and large meadows. The village itself exists out of many small houses, within the center of the village a house bigger than the others, which even carries a red flag.

There are multiple small bridges and roads that cross Arlam Village, the most notable one is the road to the Mansion of Roswaal. There is also a small bridge which crosses the lake that leads into a forest full of Wolgarms. In order to protect the villagers, they used some magical stones that functioned as a barrier, which prevented any [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]] from trespassing.

==History==
The town was founded in a field near the Mathers territory, and its leader was Milde Arlam for years. Although it appeared to be a peaceful place, it was actually located near a forest full of Wolgarms, causing the villagers to place magical stones around the village, capable of preventing the creatures from approaching.

When Subaru arrived, he met a group of nice children, and they played with him when he’d drop by. However, a few days after his first visit, they disappeared. As the villagers went out to look for them, Subaru and [[Rem]] tried to locate them in the forest, confronting many Wolgarms, but saving the children. The one in charge of everything was [[Meili Portroute|Meili]], a girl who temporarily visited the town while disguised as a traveler’s daughter. As she knew that they would be looking for her, she chose to escape.

On the rest of the days, Subaru decided to do exercises with all the inhabitants every time he visited them, and when he finished, he would give stamps to the children.

Two months later, Subaru hired some merchants to evacuate the town from a possible attack of the [[Witch Cult]]. Half of the population was transported in the capital while the other half went to the [[Sanctuary]]. In almost a week, the [[Emilia Camp]] helped bring the Sanctuary group to its home with the rest of the inhabitants. Of all the children, [[Petra Leyte]] joined the camp, moving with them to the new Roswaal Manor as a maid.

==Trivia==

*It is noted by outsiders that it is strange for a human settlement to be built near a known witchbeast habitat, and the use of magic stones to form large scale wards against them is also unique to the village.

title: Elior Forest
wikitext:
[[File:Elior Forest - OVA 2.png|thumb|300px]]
The '''Great Elior Forest''' (エリオール大森林, ''Eriōru Dai Shinrin''), also known as the '''Freezing Forest''' (氷結の森, ''Hyōketsu no Mori''), is a vast forest located in northeast [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. The forest is first featured in [[Arc 4]]. It belongs to the current head of [[House Mathers]], [[Roswaal L. Mathers]]. 

==Information==
Elior Forest is a dense woodland forest located in northeastern Lugunica, southwest from the Mining City of Ganacks and the Gina Mountain Range. In the past, Elior Forest was like any other forest, filled with trees and greenery, and uniquely, it was a hiding place for a settlement of elves. Those elves regularly traded with the moderate members of the [[Witch Cult]] as of 100 or so years ago, and likewise, they remained guardians of a certain seal that seems to contain something of tremendous value said to be related to the goal of the Witch Cult. Likewise, a large number of glintstones grow in certain areas in the forest thanks to an abundance of mana from mana streams littered throughout the woodland.

However, following the [[Permafrost of Elior Forest]], the forest is now entirely covered in snow and ice, and it has become home to unnatural mana storms and many [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]]. Because of the permafrost, approximately 49 elves were left frozen as ice statues in their previous settlement, while the majority of the forest seems to be mostly uninhabitable. The seal, of course, remains untouched. Due to it being mostly uninhabited, the forest would be used as a smuggling path in order to move goods across Lugunica without incurring the tolls which the main roads charged. However, following the Day of Red Earth and Sky, it is unknown if this is still the case.

For over 7 years after being thawed from her ice, the frozen forest had been the home of [[Emilia]] and [[Puck]], who had kept the statues polished. However, the eventually left the forest so that Emilia could participate in the [[Royal Selection]] and retrieve a way to revert the forest to how it once was and unfreeze the elves. Later, during the events of [[Arc 3]], [[House Karsten]] acquired rights to mine glintstones from the forest as part of the agreement for the establishment of an alliance between the [[Emilia Camp]] and the [[Crusch Camp]]. However, as of yet, it is unknown if they have begun mining processes.

==History==
About 100 years before the main story, a village of elves guarded a mysterious seal located in the forest. Ruin was brought to the forest when [[Pandora]] and [[Regulus Corneas]] led an attack on the forest by bringing the [[Black Serpent]] there. Many elves perished, while the remaining elves were frozen by a young Emilia along with the forest itself.

Over seven and a half years before the main story, Puck unfroze Emilia from the ice she was trapped in. Half a year later the forest became the battleground for Puck's battle against [[Melakuera]]. That day, which marked the [[Spirit#Four Great Spirits|Great Spirit]]'s death, became infamously known across Lugunica as the "Day of Red Earth and Sky". Later, following the creation of Puck and Emilia's contract, Roswaal L. Mathers appeared, and following an intense battle with Puck, he offered Emilia the chance to join the Royal Selection and unfreeze the elves, which she agreed to.

==Locations==
[[File:Elior Forest Seal (2).png|thumb|250px]]
*'''The Seal''' (封印, ''Fūin''): The Seal of Elior Forest is a place in the innermost part of the forest. The surroundings of the seal are surrounded by white trees and the whole area looks like a sacred place. The seal itself takes form of a double-door which stands on its own, not connecting with any buildings or trees. It appears to be made out of wood, it's noted to be very cold to the touch and if rubbed with a hand, one would get the same sensation as rubbing a polished gemstone. There is an old lock located right in the center of the door itself with the keyhole being roughly the same size as young Emilia's hand. It is said that there are only two people capable of unlocking this door, with one of those people being Emilia, and the other person remaining unknown.
*'''The Tree of Prayers''' (祈りの大樹, ''Inori no Taiju''): An extremely tall, sacred tree which the elves in the elf village would pour their prayers to the divine. Its existence was treasured and revered by everyone in the village. Emilia ended up frozen within its trunk when she froze Elior forest.
[[File:Elior Forest village ep.42.png|thumb|250px]]
*'''Unnamed Elf Village''': The village which the elves lived in over 100 years ago before Emilia froze the entire forest, along with the elves.
*'''The Garden''' (庭, ''Niwa''): The area which the ice statues of the frozen elves lie. A small stream is located nearby. It is located south of the blundering snow road. Emilia lived close by to this location in a hollow tree.
*'''The Gnarled Thicket''' (よぼよぼ密林, ''Yoboyobo Mitsurin''): An area deep in the forest surrounded by a dense enclosure of ancient trees with hardly any light exposure. The area is rich in glintstones.
*'''The Twisted Forest '''(うねうね森, ''Uneune Mori''): A woodland area located in the eastern section of the forest.
*'''The Frozen Stiff Thicket''' (かちかち密林, ''Kachikachi Mitsurin''): An area located near the blundering snow road.
*'''The Blundering Snow Road''' (うっかり雪道, ''Ukkari Yukimichi''): A snow-covered woodland road that could fit three people abreast. It is covered with no trespassing signs as it used to lead to the Snow Blight's domain.
*'''Unnamed Eastern Village''': A small village on the outskirts of the forest on the east side. The village is extremely poor, but has a trading center to exchange livestock, crops, and goods. The village was used by [[Chap]] to blackmail Emilia.
*'''Unnamed Western Village''': A small village on the outskirts of the forest on the west side that Emilia traded with after she was prohibited from entering the eastern village.
*'''The Snow Blight's Domain''': An area in the northern section of the forest which was ruled by a [[Witchbeast#Snow Blight|Snow Blight]]. After its defeat, various witchbeasts such as a [[Witchbeast#Guiltylowe|Guiltylowe]] began roaming the domain.
*'''Thorny Woods''' (とげとげ林, ''Togetoge Rin''): A woodland area in the northwestern area of the forest covered in ice sheets and teeming with witchbeasts. This area was heavily affected by the corrosive power of the Black Serpent's poison.
*'''The Lake''' (湖, Mizūmi): A frozen lake dyed in black. The lake was the location where the Black Serpent's poison sank to. Once released, the poison manifested itself as a sentient black liquid, and it acted with the same destructive intent as its creator.

==Residents==

*[[Puck]] (formerly)

*[[Archi Elior]] (deceased)

*[[Minor Characters#Tehena|Tehena]] (unknown) (web novel only)

*The entire southern portion of the forest was destroyed in the battle between Puck and Melakuera.

Zergev Squadron takes minimal casualties |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian =}} The '''Battle of Castour Field''' (カスツール平原の戦い) was a decisive encounter that took place during the early stages of the [[Demi-Human War]]. Occurring approximately 46 years before [[Natsuki Subaru]]'s arrival in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] and two years after the start of the war, a detachment of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunican]] [[Royal Army]] was ambushed and routed by the forces of the Demi-Human Alliance under [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]]. Using a small unit of [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] soldiers as bait, Cromwell was able to lure the Lugunican troops onto a field covered in magic circles that when activated tore up the human battle formations. In the confusion and chaos, the demi-human forces were able to advance and surround the enemy. Though the encirclement operation was a flawless success, the Demi-Human Alliance took considerable losses when a lone soldier named [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]] broke through the front line, temporarily blunting the surprise attack. Though both sides took high numbers of casualties, the battle was a victory for rebel forces. A major embarrassment for the Lugunican military, the battle lead to the reorganization of the Royal Army and the implementation of a new military doctrine with the emphasis on countering magic circles, an idea that would ironically lead to the loss during a [[Battle of Aihiya Swamp|later battle]].[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fourth Stanza, Section 3. The battle also contributed to the growing reputation of the young Wilhelm Trias, who gained the nickname of "Sword Demon" from a [[Grimm Fauzen|fellow survivor]] in reference to his actions on the field.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], First Stanza, Section 5. ==Background== Before the clash at Castour Field, the earlier [[Battle of Redonas Plateau]] taking place just days earlier foreshadowed the coming events, where an overextended human army had been engaged with by demi-human forces utilizing [[magic]] and suffered an abundance of casualties despite winning in the end. The battle was the debut of the 15-year-old swordsman Wilhelm Trias.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], First Stanza, Section 2. As the next military expedition into Castour Field was quickly approaching, the Lugunican military had little time to adjust to the new apparent bait-and-break strategy of the demi-human commander Valga Cromwell. ==Battle== Days after the Battle of Redonas Plateau, the humans continued their advance into enemy territory. Suddenly facing a sizable force of rebels in their path, the Royal Army halted their march and immediately began to prepare for battle. The armies began engaging at sunset,[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], First Stanza, Section 1. with the renowned [[Royal Army#Zergev Squadron|Zergev Squadron]], led by [[Bordeaux Zergev]] at the very front.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Second Stanza, Section 1. With shock, numbers, and momentum, the humans slammed directly into the demi-human troops, completely rupturing the frontline. As the battle progressed, Wilhelm broke through a demi-human encirclement and killed 88 members of a demi-human squadron, including the captain.''“He broke through the demi-human encirclement at the Battle of Castour Field. He confronted and destroyed an entire squadron of demi-humans all by himself. The total number of heads he took was eighty-eight, including their captain’s.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Second Stanza, Section 1. Facing mounting casualties and overwhelming numbers, the demi-humans appeared to rout. Despite this, both Wilhelm and Grimm Fauzen, the latter of which was shielding his [[Tholter Weasily|ally]] as he fired off his arrows, each had a bad feeling about how simple the battle was when compared to the one just days prior. ===Cromwell's Ambush=== Unbeknownst to the human forces, they had been lured into a massive trap set in place by the backbone of the Demi-Human Alliance, [[Sphinx]]. Just as the Lugunican army had appeared victorious, the wide field of magic circles became active. The shaking of the ground quickly threw many soldiers to the ground. The humans, who had unintentionally walked themselves into a giant magical minefield, began to panic. The whole offensive contingent was immediately made combat ineffective. Right on cue was the larger demi-human counterattack force, who came barreling through the dust and the smoke to surround the disorganized Lugunican army. As usual, Wilhelm Trias committed to his own breakthrough, even as the majority of the soldiers implored him to retreat. Suspecting the genocidal intent of demi-human commander Cromwell, Wilhelm correctly assumed the battle plan of the Demi-Human Alliance, which was to slaughter the retreating Lugunican soldiers after breaking up their front lines with a sudden assault.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], First Stanza, Section 5. Realizing that his enemies were intending for the army to retreat, Wilhelm charged into the heart of the demi-human assault while the others, in chaos fell to retreat, ignoring the warning that Wilhelm gave them. Despite his fears, Grimm chased after him to bring him back, claiming that the army still needed him alive. Along the way, he found the lines of a magic circle and damaged it out of fear. Wilhelm, who appeared and explained the entire trap, proceeded to kill a demi-human ambusher, and despite Grimm's protests to bring him back, Wilhelm told him that he could either retreat and die or push on and live, and then he set off to continue battling. Left to make a decision, Grimm chased after him, feeling less fear by moving forward than back, and after catching up to Wilhelm and witnessing his smile as he slaughtered his enemies, he coined him as a Sword Demon. Soon after, Valga's trap went off, causing many casualties for the Royal Army and resulting in the Demi-Human Alliance's victory. Soon after, the main force of the Royal Army arrived and rescued what remained of the contingent. ==Aftermath== The battle was a major defeat for the Lugunican military, which was forced to reconsider their entire strategy. Compared to the Battle of Redonas Plateau, where the humans also suffered major casualties, the battle at Castour lacked the victory of Redonas.''Redonas Plateau and Castour Field, there were too many casualties in those last two battles. Redonas’ battle was a strategic victory, at least, but Castour was inexcusable.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Second Stanza, Section 2. In accordance with new doctrine, the magical specialist [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] was brought in to inspect the magic circles. From then on, the military placed magic circle elimination as a priority before entering a battle. Out of their hundred in their squadron, Wilhelm Trias and Grimm Fauzen were the only two survivors left.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Second Stanza, Section 2. Most of the unit formations were wiped out in the initial ambush or were killed in the rout. Everyone in the Zergev Squadron returned alive.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]]: Second Stanza, Section 2. As news of Wilhelm's violent and heroic actions spread around the country, the name of "Sword Demon" became associated with death and blood.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fifth Stanza, Section 4. For the demi-humans, the battle was a complete success. In the eyes of the Valga Cromwell, the death of so many humans would bring him pride and inspire him to intensify the war. Conversely, commander [[Libre Fermi]] was overall furious at the deadly strategy and criticized Valga's ruthless need to kill humans. Furthermore, he warned Cromwell that the massive number of casualties would only drive the humans to escalate the war.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Third Stanza, Section 3. In the end, Valga only resolved to kill every single human and plotted with Sphinx for the upcoming battles. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Demi-Human War]] [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

Thousands killed |side4 = |forces4 = |casual4 = }} The '''Battle of Aihiya Swamp''' (アイヒア湿地帯攻防戦) was a major battle during the [[Demi-Human War]] that took place 43 years before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]]. The battle is known for being the largest and deadliest engagement of the war, with casualties disproportionally being of the human side. Initially starting as a wider counter-insurgency effort launched by the [[Royal Army]], the campaign quickly centered around Aihiya Swamp, where the resistance by [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] was heaviest and the leaders of the rebellion were rumored to be operating from.''"The field of battle this time was to be Aihiya Swamp in the south of Lugunica...Reports were that the leading figures of the Demi-Human Alliance had gone there to support the resistance effort."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Third Stanza, Section 6. However, unaware to the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]]'s forces, this was actually another trap set by the Demi-Human Alliance's strategist, [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]], who managed to use the Kingdom's wariness of magic circles to fuel another one and lead them into a situation they hoped to avoid. This battle resulted in a massive number of the Royal Army's forces being completely annihilated, including the majority of the Zergev Squadron, including their vice commander, [[Pivot Arnancy]]. Further rebellion was consequently incited across the country, and because of the army's reduced numbers, each revolt was left to be taken care of by the lords in charge of each respective region.''"As casualty reports flooded in, army headquarters was thrown into chaos, and the defense of each region was left to those in charge on the ground."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Sixth Stanza, Section 1. Likewise, this also left the [[Royal Capital]] extremely vulnerable to attack. ==Background== Following the [[Battle of Redonas Plateau]] came the [[Battle of Castour Field]], in which the Royal Army found themselves routed by Valga's strategies, and many of the Kingdom's forces were lost due to the expansive magic circles that were placed prior to the fight. Because the Kingdom sorely lacked the necessary knowledge to properly process the threat of the magic circles, they brought in a specialist, [[Roswaal J. Mathers]], to study the circles. During the first investigation, they encountered the [[Witch]] [[Sphinx]], who commanded [[undead]] forces composed of the deceased warriors of both sides who fell on the battlefield. After quelling this small force, the Lugunican government was made aware of the threat at hand, and they began an organized effort of studying the properties and effects of magic circles and ways to counter them, with the simplest solution being to physically destroy them. Meanwhile, Valga and Sphinx continued strategizing and experimenting with the information they collected from the prior battles. As the war continued, Roswaal continued to join battles with the Zergev Squadron in order to counter any magical traps. Eventually, the battle was deemed the heaviest in Aihiya Swamp, where the leaders of the Demi-Human Alliance were rumored to be. With the Kingdom unaware of their strategies, Valga and Sphinx prepared a magic circle that would activate after other prior set magic circles were destroyed, which would successfully turn the Kingdom's wariness against them. With the government still wary after their first massive failure in Castour Field, they determined that the demi-humans would eventually have to reach their limit. Ultimately, they decided to send the military to Aihiya Swamp. Despite this, the original commander of the forces met his end after being struck by a stray arrow in a previous battle. As a result, command of the forces was given to [[Leip Barielle]], who had achieved previous victories during the war. Soon, the Zergev Squadron was also called forward, and alongside Roswaal, they made their way south. ==Battle== ===Roswaal's Investigation=== Soon after arriving at Aihiya Swamp, the army was split into four smaller armies. Three of them moved forward in the battle while the fourth, led by [[Razak Gildark]], who was brought back to the frontlines despite having been previously responsible for teaching new recruits and other knights, was to sit in the back and keep their eyes focused beyond the border, anxious of the potential movement of the [[Vollachia Empire]]'s forces due to the fighting's proximity to the border. Concurrently, specialists of the human side were scrambled to target magic circles, as doctrine dictated. Leip, familiar with the order of battle, was keen to notice the apparent lack of adaptation towards the Royal Army's countermeasures and found it suspicious. After chastising a general for his lack of forethought, he sought Roswaal's advice. Claiming that the placement seemed strange, she asked for permission to look into a certain part of the battlefield, where she thought there might be something critical. With Leip assigning ten soldiers to protect her and [[Carol Remendis]], they left to investigate. Coming across a magic circle at the spot she went to investigate, just as she was examining the diagram, it activated, responding to the destruction of all of the other magic circles in the swamp.''"Magic circles work by imbuing the circles with meaning and then running magical power through them. You’re terrified of the effects they might have—but these circles were active from the beginning. Those magic circles had power stored up in them. And you destroyed every last one! You released the energy in them, allowing it to charge up the hidden, true magic circle—and you see the result."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fourth Stanza, Section 3. All of the humans affected found themselves brought to their knees under the immense weight and pressure of the circle's effect, as if they were standing in a large amount of a syrupy liquid and feeling as though they were suffocating. Though Roswaal could very well have decoded the circle, Sphinx appeared to prevent that, killing six of the soldiers with her while threatening Roswaal to join her. Despite this, Roswaal refused, and the two entered battle, Roswaal able to resist the circle's effects. With Roswaal equipping her gauntlets, she managed to quickly overwhelm Sphinx, forcing her to just barely fly upward before her life could be claimed. Believing that Roswaal had a counter to knock her out of the sky, Sphinx retreated. Meanwhile, Roswaal made quick work of the magic circle with her yellow eye, freeing everyone from its effects. ===March of the Zergev Squadron=== In a little over six hours since the start of the campaign, the furious hammer of the Royal vanguard had already smashed through the entire front, obliterating any and all Alliance resistance, and never allowing their opponents the chance to form proper battle lines. Among the fighters, the Zergev Squadron met little resistance, with [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]], [[Grimm Fauzen]], [[Bordeaux Zergev]], and [[Pivot Arnancy]] deciding to continue forward into the center of the fighting to rip out the roots of the enemy forces, choosing not to report to Leip, as they expected him to treat them like tools and pawns. As the fighting progressed, [[Libre Fermi]] arrived on the battlefield, intending to challenge Wilhelm to a duel on the field, having seen his immense skill and deeming him too powerful for the others to handle. Shortly after the clash began, Libre's speed and unique weapon proved to be too much for Wilhelm to handle. Although not taking damage from their exchange, neither could he land a hit on Libre. However, even when Libre's speed increased, Wilhelm seemed to be having fun, laughing even as he took a strike from Libre. Although he countered and took Libre's hand, he was sent flying by another strike from Libre, who was entirely unaffected by the loss of his hand. With Wilhelm being cornered, the other core members of the squadron surrounded Libre to cut off his escape and join the fight. Despite this, Libre, whose hand quickly regenerated, decided to step back so that the next phase of the battle could start. ===The Tides Turn=== [[File:BoA Ambush.png|thumb|right|250px|The true magic circle taking effect.]] All across the swamp, a very literal change in the air began to be felt by the humans. The air becoming denser, the smell of iron from blood and the steel of weapons replaced by the moist scent of swamp water. People began to struggle to move and felt as though they were suffocating, as if being trapped beneath water. With the true magic circle taking effect in response to every other magic circle being destroyed, all of the Royal Army's soldiers found themselves at the mercy of their enemies, who were entirely unaffected by the circle. [[File:Re_Zero_Ex_Volume_2_8.jpg|thumb|left|180x|Pivot gives his life to protect Wilhelm.]] Despite not wanting to point his blade at enemies who cannot fight back, Libre point his blade at Bordeaux, claiming that slaying the Zergev Squadron would break humanity's hopes and make them speak with demi-humans to settle for peace. Despite this, Wilhelm managed to make himself move, and he stopped Libre's blade from reaching Bordeaux, much to Libre's shock. Still, Libre overwhelmed Wilhelm, and just as he was about to kill him, Pivot managed to move his body, and he jumped in the way of Libre's strike, yelling at everyone not to let Wilhelm die. Roused by his cry, the remaining members of the Zergev Squadron followed suit, fighting against the effects of the magic circle and jumping to protect Wilhelm's life by fighting off Libre. However, each member of the squad was killed by Libre, one by one, until there were only a few survivors. Even Grimm had stood in to protect Wilhelm, using his shield to defend him and lasting far longer than their squadmates. But even still, Libre managed to slash Grimm's throat, incapacitating him as well. In a rage, Wilhelm pounced Libre before he could finish off Grimm, and the two fell down a hole, beating at each other as they fell. At the bottom of the hole, free from both the fall and the effects of the circle, Wilhelm, enraged by the slaughter, took up his sword and challenged Libre. Despite having previously been able to overwhelm Wilhelm, Libre found that Wilhelm's skills were sharpening, and he was struggling against the Sword Demon. Eventually, Wilhelm managed to strike at an opening, breaking through his blade and piercing through Libre's neck. Though, this failed to kill him, and Libre prepared himself to kill Wilhelm. However, before he could do so, he was pierced by a bright ray of light fired by Sphinx. Surviving the shot, Libre turned his blade on Sphinx, but he was quickly dispatched. Deciding to leave Wilhelm alive for observation, Sphinx turned Libre into a corpse soldier and took him with her. ===The Rise of the Corpse Soldiers=== Meanwhile, as Pivot's life came to an end in Bordeaux's arms, the dead, including Pivot, began to rise once more. As the undead Pivot throttled Bordeaux, Grimm, barely conscious, knocked him off of his commander, and with Pivot setting his sights on Grimm, Bordeaux cut him down. Being forced to face the dead members of his squadron, Bordeaux cursed Sphinx as he cut them down. Across the battlefield, undead forces continued to rise, and ultimately, the Royal Army was forced to completely retreat. ==Aftermath== The casualties for the Royal Army were estimated at greater than 60%,''All the royal troops involved had been simultaneously weakened by the effects of the magic circle around the battlefield, and casualties were reckoned at greater than 60 percent.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fourth Stanza, Section 12. with every single soldier involved suffering some kind of effect from the magic circle. Meanwhile, the army commanded by Razak was left relatively unscathed. From the overall standpoint of the Royal Army, they lost a grand total of 40% of all of their forces.''The losses at Aihiya had cost the kingdom more than 40 percent of its fighting power; the army was undergoing a massive reorganization and was concerned about how to deal with this dramatic reduction in force.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fifth Stanza, Section 1. and sacrificed nearly twice as many men than in the battle of Castour Field, making it the greatest loss of life since the start of the war.''The blow was not as one-sided as Castour, but the Royal Army had sacrificed nearly twice as many men, the greatest loss of life in a single battle since the start of the civil war.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fourth Stanza, Section 12. Likewise, the Zergev Squadron of formerly eighty men was now down to eleven.''Among those whom the battle had badly bloodied was Zergev Squadron, a unit renowned for its heroism. Its survivors numbered just eleven.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Fourth Stanza, Section 12. Meanwhile, despite Libre's death, the Demi-Human Alliance was ultimately unfazed, as they were left unaware that Sphinx had turned him into a corpse soldier. Due to the losses incurred, Leip was blamed for the loss at Aihiya Swamp, and he essentially became a war criminal, even being accused of having slain other people, including former commander Crumere. There were likewise other officers who took on similar blame and became scapegoats. Afterward, the military once more went through restructuring. With most of the Kingdom's army now dead or fighting as corpses alongside demi-humans, Lugunica could no longer afford to fight the demi-humans as a unified force, every battle fought from then on would be one taken to them, the Lugunicans always on the defensive. In the absence of a true standing army, local commanders took it upon themselves to defend their own territories, a losing battle in the long run.''As casualty reports flooded in, army headquarters was thrown into chaos, and the defense of each region was left to those in charge on the ground.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Sixth Stanza, Section 1. The reinvigorated Alliance, bolstered by undead numbers and the swelling of previously neutral demi-humans now finding a cause to fight for with victory in sight, began a nationwide mass uprising, escalating a regional conflict into an all-out war of annihilation, as wished by Valga Cromwell. Ready to avenge his fallen brethren, he decided that it was about time that the horrors of war strike the heart of the Kingdom of Lugunica: the Royal Capital.''"Soon tongues of flame will lick the whole nation… Even the Royal Capital will not escape destruction."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Sixth Stanza, Section 1. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Demi-Human War]] [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

title: Royal Selection
wikitext:
{{Infobox Events
