The '''Royal Selection''' (王選, ''Ō-sen'') is an ongoing event to decide who will become the forty-second monarch of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]] and renew the Kingdom's covenant with the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]]. Starting two months after [[Natsuki Subaru]] arrived in the world, the selection is set to last for three years, ending one month prior to the Dragon Ceremony. The five candidates selected were [[Crusch Karsten]], [[Priscilla Barielle]], [[Anastasia Hoshin]], [[Emilia]], and [[Felt]], all of whom were chosen by the Dragon Jewels. Later on, [[Filore]] of the [[Divine Dragon Church]] was included among the candidates following the drop-out of one of the other candidates.

==Candidates & Platforms==
===Current===
====[[Crusch Karsten]]====
{{Main|Crusch Camp}}
It was shortly after the [[Royal Plague|deaths]] of the entire Lugunican [[Royal Family]] that the Duchess of the [[House Karsten]] was found to be a suitable royal candidate, becoming the first of the candidates, and she took [[Ferris]] as her knight. Direct in her goals, Crusch intends to disband the pact with the Dragon in order to create a nation that does not require the aid of a greater being to survive, instead able to defend itself through its own military power and national standing. Though she understands the many contributions of the Dragon to Lugunica's continued prosperity and peace, Crusch believes in a Lugunica where the citizenry is able to stand up for itself and rule on their own, as all other options are tantamount to indefinite servitude. Among the candidates, Crusch is the one most favored by the populace to win the selection.

====[[Anastasia Hoshin]]====
{{Main|Anastasia Camp}}
Hailing from the mercantile [[Kararagi|Kararagi City-States]], Anastasia Hoshin, the president of the Hoshin Company, was discovered to be eligible in Lugunica's Royal Selection during a visit to House Juukulius during a possible business venture. Pledged knighthood by [[Julius Juukulius]] and backed by her wealthy company seeking to expand its markets into the Kingdom, Anastasia took to becoming the third candidate.

Also direct in her goals, Anastasia's only intention behind running was her greediness, although this may have just been a naïve play made to bluster the unfamiliar Lugunican nobility. In actuality, she believes that she has legitimate qualities to be a prosperous leader, and she points out the success of her company as an example. She promises economic prosperity for the country should she be selected to be the country's monarch. Like the Duchess before her, Anastasia is one of the favorites to win the selection.

====[[Emilia]]====
{{Main|Emilia Camp}}
Little is known about Emilia's origins. She is arguably the most disliked out of any of the candidates, not due to her policies, but her existence as a half-elf and her similar appearance to the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. She was discovered by [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] in the [[Elior Forest]] and found to have the qualifications to become the fourth candidate.

Emilia's only real goal is to become queen so that she has access to the [[Dragon]]'s blood, which would aid her in freeing the frozen elves in Elior Forest. That said, even realizing that she might not be able to save the Elves, she is still willing to work hard to become the king. Her stated goal is to create a society in Lugunica where everybody is treated equally, with respect to identity, which comes from the discrimination she's faced as a half-elf in a world that only sees silver-haired half elves as the epitome of all evils. Emilia isn't a particularly exceptional candidate, but her real magic is in the people who surround her, who have managed to overcome any obstacle without any real casualties. In particular, her knight, Natsuki Subaru, seems to have even greater luck than Priscilla, always possessing incredible foresight and consistently leaving potentially fatal situations relatively untouched.

====[[Felt]]====
{{Main|Felt Camp}}
In the aftermath of the [[Loot House Incident]], Felt was discovered to be the fifth and final missing candidate in the Royal Selection. Bearing red eyes, fair skin, and golden hair, Felt, who has no official origin story, uncannily resembles the members of the deceased Lugunican royal family. Her candidacy was revealed at the very last moment before the start of the opening ceremony to the shock and awe of everybody in the room.

Felt's platform is to destroy the country, or at least the current system that maintains the country. She is fundamentally anti-establishment as a result of her upbringing. Her adoptive grandfather, unknown to everybody, happens to be a former leader in the [[Demi-Human War|civil war]] against the Lugunican government, which may or may not contribute to her attitude. Felt is also the youngest and least accomplished of all the candidates. Of course, she has the least vested interest in governmental affairs. Her entire campaign opening speech was met by fear and abhor by the nobles, and if not for the fact that she was divinely chosen to participate, she'd have been executed for treason. Fortunately, her benefactor happened to be the Sword Saint, [[Reinhard van Astrea]], the most powerful man in the world.

====[[Filore]]====
{{Main|Filore Camp}}
Following the death of Priscilla Barielle, Filore, who had lost her patience with leaving the [[Witch Cult]]'s victims in [[Priestella]] as they were, rushed to the Royal Castle to plead with the Council of Wise Men to allow the Divine Dragon Church to heal them. However, when she visited the castle a second time later, Felt, who was visiting the castle at the time due to her appearance, tossed her an insignia, and the jewel within shined, making her a potential candidate for the throne.<ref name="sixth">''Felt pointed with her thumb, and just beyond it stood the figure of Filóre, both hands enveloping that which she had received―― within her hands, the insignia she received shone. It was undoubtedly proof that she had been chosen as a Dragon Priestess by the Dragon Jewel. ――It was the sixth brilliant omen of light that blessed the existence of a Dragon Priestess recognized by the Dragon Jewel.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref>

Like with Felt, her appearance is a rough match for the fallen Royal Family's, her age matches the number of years since the missing princess of the Royal Family was kidnapped, and her name matches that of the infant Filore Lugunica's as well, putting her in a position at odds with Felt's. Though initially resistant towards the idea of joining the Royal Selection, she ultimately decided to participate, her platform being that she wants to bring the Divine Dragon Church and the citizens of Lugunica together so that the people of both the church and castle could extend their hands without hesitance due to formality,<ref>''"I wish to reform the relationship between the Church and the state that has existed up till now. So that those within the Castle and those of the Church will no longer hesitate to extend a hand to the other due to some strange, stubborn formality."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 11, Section 1.</ref> and in her meeting with [[Miklotov McMahon]], she decided to take [[Heinkel Astrea]] as her knight.

===Former===
====[[Priscilla Barielle]]====
{{Main|Priscilla Camp}}
Though a child of an [[Drizen Vollachia|emperor of Vollachia]], and very much eligible and capable of becoming the ruler of the [[Vollachia Empire]], Priscilla found herself betrayed and ousted from her position by a [[Arakiya|sympathetic general]] fearing for Priscilla's life in the inevitable civil war that occurs as part of Vollachia's succession process, and eventually, she ended up in Lugunica. Her final late husband, [[Leip Barielle]], was a wealthy nobleman with a sizable estate who, after discovering her, introduced her as the second of the candidates. Following his death, she inherited all of his feudal lands, and she managed to carry her estates to prosperity, leading to immense popularity with the common folk. Priscilla preached only to make the country hers and to own everything and everyone. As she had natural fortune, she believed she was chosen by destiny to rule over all of Lugunica. She also pledged to gift her supporters and to listen to her subjects.

During her escapade to end the [[Great Disaster]] in Vollachia, she ultimately gave her life in the fight, resulting in her and her camp dropping out of the Royal Selection.<ref>''No falsehood in those words, the figure of the woman who was loved by the world, and returned said love to the world to an even greater degree, faded. Extolled as the Sun Princess, having lived her life in a manner becoming of a flame, was Priscilla Barielle. ――Amongst the candidates for the Kingdom of Lugunica’s Royal Selection to decide the next Monarch, she was the first to drop out.'' [[Arc 8]], Curtain's Close, Section 7.</ref>

==Regulations and Rules==
*Anybody of any race, if chosen by the Dragon Jewels, is able to run, no matter what. No number of prejudice or racist complaints or even illegal use of authority can prevent one from participating if already chosen. In the end though, barring one (half), all of the candidates turned out to be human.

*Candidates must take care of their insignias, as this qualifies their ability to rule. Should they lose it, their candidacy could be discarded.

*If in care of a domain, i.e. if the candidate holds feudal lands, they are to remain responsible for their land and cannot simply pass it off to another's ownership. Among many other things, this determines whether a candidacy is to be discarded or not.

*No candidate is allowed to be married during the period of the Royal Selection so as to prevent marriage ties from exacerbating political conflict.

*The only way for a candidate to leave the Royal Selection is to either die or simply resign.

==Background==
===The Lion King's Covenant===
Approximately 400 years prior to Subaru's arrival, the last Lion King, [[Farsale Lugunica]], journeyed the world with his friends in what [[Alec Hoshin]] has claimed to be a "journey to save the world". At some point before or after the [[Great Calamity]], Farsale, who had befriended the Divine Dragon Volcanica, formed a covenant with the Dragon, entailing that it would protect that Kingdom from foreign threats so long as his bloodline exists. Likewise, Volcanica offered the country the highly restorative Dragon's Blood. As such, the Kingdom, which had attained peace after being ensured against foreign invaders, as well as holding the [[Dragon History Stone]], which foretold of various threats before they occurred, became soft over time, gradually growing weaker in both government and, relatively, military.

===Outbreak & The First Candidate===
Approximately one year before Subaru's arrival, the entire Lugunica Royal Family fell ill to an unknown disease. Shortly after the successful [[Raid of Argyle Manor]], they began to collapse, and in the mere few months that followed, the entire family died, leaving the country without its leading family and the covenant on the verge of collapse. As a result, the remaining government and their institutions were left in shock. Uncertainty about the pact with the Dragon possibly no longer existing as a result of the line of the pact signatory, Farsale, going extinct caused nationwide fears about the security of the country. Most notable were the fears that the Sacred Vollachia Empire, Lugunica's southern neighbor whom the Kingdom had historically warred against, would invade in a time of instability. Though diplomacy eventually settled the issue, uncertainty still held. In desperate need of guidance, the Council of Wise Men, Lugunica's leading governing body, rather than thinking of a way to strengthen themselves in preparation of attack, instead looking for a way to maintain the covenant, turned to the prophetic Dragon History Stone, administrated by Leip Barielle.

As relayed to Lugunica's nobility by Leip, the Dragon History Stone told of five candidates, referred to as dragon maidens, who were to be found across the Kingdom. Their candidacy would be confirmed through the use of the Dragon Jewels, gemstones contained within insignias which would gleam red if in the hands of a potential Dragon Maiden, and despite the vast number of people that populate the Kingdom, within a single year would those candidates need to be found. Deciding to pass around one such insignia, the nobility present checked to see whether they were eligible to participate as one of the candidates, and though most failed, Crusch, who was present as the Duchess of House Karsten, was given the insignia, and the jewel glowed, marking her as an eligible candidate. Afterward, she took Ferris as her knight and formed the [[Crusch Camp]]. In the year that followed, she improved the training of the knights, circulation of weapons, and attained [[Wilhelm van Astrea]]'s assistance through a promise to slay the [[White Whale]].

===The Second Candidate===
A short time after that, Leip, who had been displeased about being unable to get a jump on other candidates, presented his young wife, Priscilla, as the next candidate. Intent on using her as a puppet to seize the rule of the nation for himself, he began a tournament to give her a knight that would be aligned with his needs. However, Priscilla chose [[Al]] as her knight, leading Leip and one of the knight candidates to assault her and Al, resulting in their respective untimely demises. In the wake of this, the [[Priscilla Camp]] was officially formed, and she also gripped the reins over the previous Baron Barielle's lands, improving her reputation among her citizens and giving her notoriety as one of the Royal Selection candidates.

===The Third Candidate===
Several months passed without much progress finding the remaining three candidates when Anastasia Hoshin, seeking to expand the Hoshin Company into Lugunica, visited the Juukulius Estate. Though she ultimately failed to obtain House Juukulius's assistance with her venture, when she picked up an insignia that [[Mimi Pearlbaton]] knocked over, Julius Juukulius, who she was speaking with her, witnessed that she was the third candidate, and he offered to not only assist her, but also to take her directly to the [[Royal Capital]]. After this, he explained the upcoming Royal Selection and brought her to visit the nobles in the Royal Capital, who were not pleased at a foreigner's eligibility. Despite this, they were forced to accept her eligibility, and they moved on to the topic of her knight. Though Julius at first believed that Reinhard van Astrea would make for a fine selection, Anastasia chose Julius himself, claiming that she would not partake in the Royal Selection otherwise, ultimately resulting in him conceding to her wishes and pledging his service to her. Following this, with the members of the [[Iron Fang]] at her side and [[Joshua Juukulius]] following his brother's decision despite House Juukulius's reluctance to assist a foreigner, the [[Anastasia Camp]] was formed. Afterward, the Hoshin Company expanded into the country, and Anastasia quickly became extremely popular.

===The Fourth Candidate===
Having foreseen the arrival of Subaru coming and his connection with a certain silver-haired half-elf, Roswaal L. Mathers, the current head of [[House Mathers]], let go of a majority of his staff, with the exception of [[Rem]] and [[Ram]], in preparation for the chaos that would ensue in the Royal Selection. After learning of her location, Roswaal set off for Elior Forest, where he found her and [[Puck]]. Due to Puck's hostility towards the suspicious man, the two battled for half a day, until finally, he was able to explain himself. Giving Emilia the knowledge of the Dragon's Blood and the chance to free the elves, he dropped the insignia in her hands, marking her as eligible for the Royal Selection, and she assented, taking Puck with her. After leaving the forest, she was taught everything she needed as a participant, and Roswaal continued his preparations for his own schemes.

===Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed===
As preparations were underway for the Royal Selection, Miklotov McMahon and [[Bordeaux Zergev]], accompanied by Julius, Ferris, and, by the [[Vincent Vollachia|emperor]]'s request, Reinhard, traveled to Vollachia to enter talks of a non-aggression pact with the Kingdom. However, due to a rebellion incited by a [[Gramdart Holstoy|traitorous noble]] and the [[Balleroy Temeglyph|Ninth]] of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]], the emperor and three knights were forced to go on the run. In the end, the noble escaped while the general was felled by Julius, and because of this, the non-aggression pact, set to last for the length of the Royal Selection, was signed.

===The Fifth Candidate===
In preparation for Subaru's arrival, Roswaal sent Emilia, Puck, and Ram to the Royal Capital, as well as hired [[Elsa Granhiert]] to steal the insignia and attack Emilia. On the day of Subaru's arrival, he was dragged into the Loot House Incident, in which he assisted the young thief Felt who was hired by Elsa to steal the insignia for her, Old Man [[Rom]], and Emilia in fighting back the assassin. During the incident, he sent Felt out of the Loot House, where she stumbled upon Reinhard van Astrea, who had met Subaru a short while earlier, and asked for his help. Ultimately, because of this, they were able to repel Elsa at the cost of the Loot House and heavy injury to both Subaru and Rom. During the following discussions, Felt attempted to return the insignia, but Reinhard, who saw the jewel within glow, pieced together her appearance's rough match to the royal family's. With her candidacy and his belief that she was the missing child from the [[Royal Abduction Incident]], Reinhard decided to take her back to the Astrea Manor, while Emilia, who was curious about Subaru and his intentions, decided to return with him to [[Roswaal Manor]]. In the end, Subaru joined the [[Emilia Camp]] after gaining everyone's trust following the [[Wolgarm Incident]], and Felt was kept secret until the day of the ceremony.

==Selection==
===The First Year===
====Royal Selection Ceremony====
Two months following the Loot House Incident, the five candidates were gathered in the Royal Capital. With their respective knights in tow, the candidates were all brought to the Royal Castle, where they were set to give their address to the Council of Wise Men, nobility, and knights. Despite being meant to be left at an inn in the capital, Subaru was also brought to the castle by Priscilla and Al, as shown through Roswaal's Book of Wisdom and according to his plan. With everyone gathered together, the candidates were each introduced and made their address. As they made their respective addresses, it quickly became known the Crusch and Anastasia were the favorites to win while Emilia was heavily prejudiced against, frustrating Subaru. Soon after, Felt was brought in by Reinhard, who introduced her as the final candidate, despite her reluctance and the denial of most of the nobility. However, it didn't take long for them to notice her physical similarities to the royal family’s. Though Felt was willing to leave, thanks to the arrival of Rom, who intended to escape with her, and his quick suppression, she chose to take part in the Royal Selection to save him, and she gave her address, terrifying the nobles.

After this, the ceremony continued, and all of the people present continued to give their opinions on the candidates, with most of them particularly letting their prejudice towards Emilia out. In a foolish attempt to defend her, Subaru lashed out at everyone in the room, disparaging all of the knights and nobles for their prejudice, immediately gaining nearly all of their enmity towards both him and Emilia. With things going as he expected, Roswaal also took the stage, using his [[magic]] to attack him and summoning Puck, who he'd notified of Subaru's outburst beforehand, to protect him. With Puck's appearance, the nobles realized that she had contracted with a Great [[Spirit]] who had enough power to kill them at any moment. With it being known that she completely refrained from allowing Puck to hurt everyone, they all realized the power she held and quickly shut their mouths. Despite this, thanks to Subaru's outburst, Emilia's standing among the candidates was at its lowest, and with the exception of Roswaal, she had nobody's backing. Even the other candidates looked down on Subaru.

After this, the knights and Subaru all left the room. However, the knights wanted to see Subaru beaten or killed for insulting them, and despite Reinhard trying to speak with him, Subaru turned him away. In an effort to protect his life from the numerous knights who wanted to personally kill him, Julius instead challenged him to a duel, which Subaru accepted. With the duel in place, someone informed the candidates, causing Emilia to rush to Subaru. In an arena prepared for them, the knights watched and cheered as Julius one-sidedly thrashed Subaru, and though Subaru attempted to use magic to gain an edge, ultimately, Julius easily dealt with it, and just as Emilia arrived, he defeated Subaru. After this, Subaru was treated, and Julius was put on house arrest for his actions. Ultimately, the ceremony came to a close, and the candidates returned to their various temporary residences. With Emilia and Subaru getting into an argument, she decided to leave him behind in the Royal Capital with Rem and Crusch. With Roswaal leaving Rem with the task of securing an alliance with the Crusch Camp, they returned, and Roswaal began preparing for his upcoming scheme, tampering with Emilia's contract with Puck. At short after this, Felt found herself confronting [[Rachins Hoffman]], [[Gaston]], and [[Camberley]], and despite them being easily dispatched, Felt managed to convince them to join her cause, essentially having them join the [[Felt Camp]].

====The Witch Cult's Resurgence====
Because of her rise as one of the Royal Selection candidates, the Witch Cult decided to make their move. Intent on making her face a set of "trials", [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]] had the White Whale head toward the Lifaus Highway to prevent anyone from reaching [[Arlam Village]] and Roswaal Manor so he could act with the other cultists. At the same time, Subaru, who was receiving treatment regarding his Gate from Ferris and training with Wilhelm in an effort not to confront his own weakness and not to become stronger, found himself using his [[Authority]], confronting the Witch Cult, a furious Puck, the White Whale, and the Royal Selection candidates who refused to help him, Subaru spoke with Rem, who managed to help him overcome his own weakness, and the two began planning on how to save everyone. In the end, after learning of the negotiating tools Roswaal left for Rem, Subaru went to speak with Crusch while Rem went to fetch Anastasia and [[Russell Fellow]]. With his negotiations with Crusch for her assistance going smoothly, Anastasia soon arrived as well. The cards were on the table: magic stone mining in Elior Forest, the location of the White Whale, and Subaru's phone, which he claimed to be a [[meteor]]. Despite nearly causing turbulence through a misunderstanding, in the end, negotiations were successful, and everyone prepared for the upcoming [[Subjugation of the White Whale]].

The next evening, accompanied an assortment of retired knights, members of the Iron Fang, and the Crusch Camp, everyone made their way towards [[Flugel's Tree]] on the Lifaus Highway. After some time and preparations, everyone awaited the appearance of the White Whale. That night, at the sound of Subaru's ringtone, the White Whale appeared, and the battle began. Despite the losing about half of their men, thanks to Subaru's observation of the White Whale's abilities, his plan to bring it to the ground and keep it there, and Wilhelm's strength, they were able to bring down the beast. With Crusch deciding to consider this achievement as part of the Emilia's Camp's victories, she decided to leave Wilhelm, Ferris, and some of the other knights to assist Subaru in the next, more dangerous battle. Meanwhile, she would take Rem and the wounded back with the head of the White Whale to prove its defeat. After their departure, Julius and the rest of the Iron Fang arrived as reinforcements for the upcoming [[Subjugation of Sloth]]. However, unbeknownst to them, after they discussed how to defeat Petelgeuse and left to take care of it, the return convoy was attacked by [[Regulus Corneas]] and [[Lye Batenkaitos]], resulting in many lives lost, Crusch losing her memories, and Rem losing her name and memories. Because of this, Ram began putting up flyers for a new maid, which [[Petra Leyte]] also applied for.

As for the assault force to subjugate Sloth, thanks to Subaru using his Authority, though they had to split up the residents of the village to head to the capital and the [[Sanctuary]], in the end, they managed to successfully defeat Sloth without a single casualty. Thanks to his efforts, Subaru was able to make up with Emilia, despite almost losing his life, and they gained an ally out of [[Otto Suwen]]. However, upon returning to the capital, they bore witness to the devastation of the ambush by Greed and Gluttony. Fortunately, Crusch woke up and was successfully healed by Ferris, but Rem's existence was lost to everyone besides Subaru. In the discussion to determine how each camp would move forward, despite Ferris's insistence on breaking the alliance, Wilhelm and Crusch both denied his suggestion, and they decided to remain allied with the Emilia Camp. Afterward, Wilhelm also showed the return of a wound given to him by his deceased wife, and he concluded that the Crusch Camp would also likely come to confront the Witch Cult in the future. Soon after, Subaru attempted reset to save everyone, but he failed to go back far enough. The next day, the Emilia Camp and the Arlam Villagers returned to the village and Roswaal Manor. At some point after this, Anastasia began looking into Subaru's history, but she was unable to uncover anything beyond his very first day in the world.

At some point after this, because of Petelgeuse's demise, [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]], the Sin Archbishop of Lust and the Mother of the [[Beloved Children]], was put in a frenzy, allowing two of her children to defect.

====[[Sanctuary Incident]] & Awarding Ceremony====
With everyone returning to the village, the Emilia Camp encountered [[Frederica Baumann]], who returned to assist Ram with the manor. After entrusting her with Rem's care, Petra's being hired as a maid for the manor, and speaking with [[Beatrice]], the members of the camp left for the Sanctuary the next day, where they were forced to confront Roswaal, whose next scheme was already underway. Intent on forcing Subaru through the trials of the Sanctuary, meeting with the [[Witch]]es, becoming like him, and becoming a Sage, he hired Elsa to attack the manor's residents, though unbeknownst to him, she was accompanied by another assassin, [[Meili Portroute]]. Likewise, in order to pressure Subaru further, he intended to summon the [[Great Rabbit]]. With Subaru facing several loops and learning of his scheme, he was ultimately able to retrieve the assistance of Otto, Ram, and Puck, get his feelings through to Emilia and help her to push through the trials, defeat [[Garfiel Tinzel]] and get his assistance, and defeat all of the enemies coming their way. Because of this, Elsa died, Meili was taken prisoner, the Great Rabbit was isolated in another space, the [[witchbeast]]s were killed, every villager from the Sanctuary and Arlam Village was protected, the old Roswaal Manor was burnt down, Subaru's Gate was broken, Puck went into hibernation, and the Emilia Camp grew, with Roswaal giving his official backing to the camp and Beatrice forming a contract with Subaru.

With [[Clind]] and [[Annerose Miload]] coming to retrieve everyone, the villagers were taken either to Arlam Village or somewhere near the new Roswaal Manor, and the members of the Emilia Camp began living in the new Roswaal Manor. After this, they returned to the capital for an awarding ceremony for the successful defeat of the White Whale and Sin Archbishop of Sloth. There, they met with members of the Crusch Camp again, with Ferris noticing Subaru's shattered Gate. During the awarding ceremony, Subaru was officially knighted, and he became Emilia's knight.

====In The Year That Followed====
Due to the aftereffects of the subjugations and the defeat of the Great Rabbit, the Emilia Camp was given the majority of the credit for both of the subjugations, and despite being unable to show proof of the Great Rabbit's defeat, because it hadn't appeared over time, rumors began spreading among the populace that the Emilia Camp defeated it as well. As such, though they were still the least popular, their popularity and respect increased. On the other hand, Crusch, whose lost memories and gravitas hindered her progress, slowly started to lose her influence among the Royal Selection, and as she struggled to take care of her lands, her father [[Meckart Karsten]] was brought in to help her with her duties. The Priscilla Camp's popularity also increased as she continued to repair the lands originally governed by Leip, calm the nobles unsettled by his death, and improving relations with their neighbors in Vollachia. On top of this, after confronting him in a bandit's den, she also obtained the assistance of Heinkel Astrea, though she also lost the assistance of [[Yae Tenzen]] following an [[undead]] incident in the Barielle Domain a short time prior. The Felt Camp's influence increased significantly with the common people, particularly with those whose lives center around the slums and underworld. Meanwhile, the Anastasia Camp's influence never waned, essentially putting them in the lead compared to the other candidates. Ultimately, thanks to the Dragon Times and interviews with each of the candidates held by [[Shorty Megan]] and [[Lululala]], the public was made privy to the candidates' thoughts and views on each other, giving everyone an insight to the camps.

At some point within the year, the two children who defected from Capella managed to come into contact with the [[Six Tongues]] and its director, Russell. They successfully joined the organization, and over that year, they managed to thwart Capella multiple times over, forcing her to take new measures and speed up her plans.

====[[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 1|Riot in Flanders]]====

===The Second Year===
====The Witch Cult Strikes Again====
Approximately one year after the Royal Selection's start, Anastasia sent invitations to Felt, Emilia, and Crusch to join her in the Watergate City of Priestella, using the location of Gluttony to lure in Crusch and a glintstone to lure in Emilia. Due to her problematic behavior, she did not invite Priscilla, though she still ultimately caught wind of the gathering anyway. After gathering the group together in Priestella and sharing an inn and taking care of certain priorities for their respective camps, the group started interacting on friendly terms, as they were using this chance to learn more about each other. However, the following morning, Priscilla arrived with her camp in tow, and Heinkel stirred conflict with his family. Afterward, everyone split up to take care of their own priorities once again. However, the Witch Cult [[Battle for Priestella|sieged the city]], with Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice confronting Regulus and [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]], Garfiel and Mimi Pearlbaton confronting terribly powerful corpse soldiers, and numerous others facing the remaining Sin Archbishops. By the end of this initial assault, Emilia was captured, Subaru and Mimi were heavily injured, Beatrice was put out of commission by healing a plethora of injured civilians, Joshua Juukulius had his name and memories devoured, Reinhard was put in a position where he couldn't help, many knights were killed, numerous other people were transformed by the Authority of Lust, civilians began finding their way towards shelters, and everyone was placed under the effects of the Authority of Wrath.

After Subaru awoke, healed just enough not to risk his life, he gathered with the other present Royal Selection camps, where they discussed how to handle the Witch Cult. With a need for a leader, Subaru and Anastasia took charge of commanding the counterattack. Deciding to face the Witch Cult, they attacked again, only to face a stalemate in City Hall. The result ended with Subaru and Crusch being cursed by Capella and everyone else being washed away by the water released from the partially opened floodgates. Meanwhile, Anastasia and the others prevented further casualties at the Muse Company. While the mayhem took place, Capella released her [[Demi-Beast]]s, and everyone was forced to converge again. With Subaru and Anastasia coming to the conclusion that they needed to overcome Wrath's effects first, a discussion was held to determine who would give a speech to rouse the citizens, resulting in Subaru giving it. Afterward, as the remaining camp members began converging together, including Reinhard, with the information gathered by Emilia and passed through Al, Subaru directed everyone towards their respective battlefields.

In the end, Regulus was killed, Sirius was captured, the corpse soldiers were felled, the Gluttony siblings escaped, and Lust escaped. On the other hand, Priestella was still plagued by the forgotten and the transformed, Julius's name was devoured, Anastasia locked herself in her Od, and Crusch was incapacitated. Deciding to leave the Lust victims frozen, specific members of the Emilia and Anastasia Camps were tasked with [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition|reaching]] the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] to gain answers from the [[Flugel|Sage]] about how to fix the victims of Lust and Gluttony, while their other recovering members would remain in Priestella. The Felt Camp was responsible for escorting Sirius to the Prison Tower, and the remaining camps either returned home or remained in Priestella.

Thanks to the battle, the Six Tongues finally managed to learn the identity of the Mother of the Beloved Children, as well as her Authority, and they began hunting her down. However, this was entirely to Capella's calculations, as she used body doubles to distract them while she made her own moves within the Royal Capital, allowing her to steadily replace figures of importance, including within the Council of Wise Men.

After returning home, the Priscilla Camp was faced with assassins sent by Vollachia, and after she dispatched them, they decided to return to Vollachia. Meanwhile, Felt and Reinhard, after handing off Sirius, sat to dinner with Russell Fellow, who informed them of unrest in the other three great nations. After collecting Meili and Ram for their assistance, as well as Rem, and making it to the Pleiades Watchtower, the two camps learned of [[Shaula]] and Flugel's identities and were forced to face several trials, which were only possible for Subaru and Emilia to accomplish. As unrest began to stir in the camp due to [[Eridna]]'s presence within Anastasia's body, Subaru thought of a way to move past the second trial, something which only served to strike at his memories and lure the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony to the tower. Despite this, with Subaru having to go through several loops, they managed to beat the Witch Cult once again. [[Rui Arneb]] was abandoned in [[Od Lagna]]'s Corridor of Memories, Lye spit up numerous names and memories and was killed by Ram, and [[Roy Alphard]] was defeated and sealed by Julius. Meanwhile, Shaula was reduced into a tiny form, and Subaru passed out. After he awoke and spoke with Ram, [[Spica|Rui]] reappeared, followed by a massive [[Satella|shadow]] that swallowed up Subaru, Rui, and Rem. After it took off, it was stricken by Volcanica's Dragon Breath, and they were left in the Vollachia Empire's Buddheim Jungle.

====The Royal Selection Moves Across the Border====
With Subaru's party being transported, the Emilia Camp and Anastasia Camp decided to head for Vollachia through different methods. Leaving Anastasia, who had left her Od, to take Roy to the capital, the Emilia Camp decided to smuggle themselves through the Vollachian border. With the group leaving the Pleiades Watchtower, the Anastasia Camp took Roy to the Prison Tower before deciding to go through Kararagi to reach Vollachia, where they learned of an undead incident on the southern border and successfully obtained the assistance of [[Halibel]] for their own trip south. Meanwhile, the Emilia Camp gathered at Roswaal Manor. Deciding to leave Meili to lead the next expedition to the tower, the rest of the camp, sans Clind and Annerose, made their way to [[Picoutatte]]. After settling things with [[Diadora Regundra]] and obtaining the assistance of the Suwen Company, the party left through Everlasting Darkness, led by the molepeople. Along the way, they met with some resistance by the molepeople due to concerns of a second civil war, but with Petra casting a [[curse]] on herself and promising to let [[Musica]] meet with Emilia about these concerns, they were eventually led into Vollachia.

Simultaneously, Meili, alongside the Felt Camp, made their way to the Pleiades Watchtower after informing the Council of Wise Men of their success. At the tower, despite having to take care of the birds that were acting as somebody's eyes and ears, they believed that they would have to send personnel to watch over the tower regularly, and leaving [[Ezzo Cadner]] and [[Flam Remendis]] behind to watch the tower, the rest of the camp returned to the Royal Capital. There, Meili was pardoned for her past, and the Emilia Camp was credited for her reformation and with assisting the second expedition.

In Vollachia, despite the problems associated with Rem waking up without her memories and Rui's behavior, Subaru's group allied themselves with the dethroned emperor Vincent, who was going by the name Abel. Making allies with the People of Shudrak, numerous soldiers in [[Guaral]] after causing its "[[Fall of Guaral|fall]]", and heading to [[Chaosflame]] to obtain [[Yorna Mishigure]]'s assistance in an effort to obtain the assistance of the newly arrived Priscilla Camp, the [[Imperial Civil War]] escalated, and Subaru ended up finding himself separated from his group and sent across the country, where he made even more allies via the Pleiades Battalion and started marching toward the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital]]. Likewise, the Emilia Camp also arrived in Guaral and helped resist [[Madelyn Eschart]]'s [[Flying Dragon Cataclysm|attack]], while Roswaal and Ram went to meet with [[Serena Dracroy]] to get information and determine whether she would be an enemy or an ally. With Abel's return to Guaral and gaining the Emilia Camp's official help by claiming his likelihood of being in the Imperial Capital, everyone on both sides started preparing for the final showdown.

Eventually, everyone converged at Lupugana, and the [[Battle for the Imperial Capital]] began. Despite the numerous losses on both sides, both Garfiel and the Pleiades Battalion managed to punch through the walls of the bastions, and Abel was brought to the Crystal Palace by the country's official [[Stargazer]], [[Ubilk]]. However, as the battle dragged on, [[Sphinx|another foe]] took to the stage, killing the [[Chisha Gold|false emperor]] through one of her undead soldiers, Balleroy Temeglyph, and triggering the Great Disaster. Ultimately, the battle came to an unofficial close, and everyone was forced to retreat, allowing the undead army to take control of Lupugana. Likewise, Priscilla was captured by the army's ringleader, and Al and a few specific others remained behind. On the way to [[Garkla]], Vollachia and Lugunica, through Vincent, who took back his name and title, and Emilia, acting representative for Lugunica and head of her own party, made an alliance, followed shortly by the arrival of a few members of the Anastasia Camp and Halibel. They also suffered an attack by Sphinx and several zombies, but they ultimately overcame this and arrived in Garkla.

After discussions, a specialized task force was selected to attack the undead forces in Lupugana while others were left to defend Garkla. As those in Garkla faced an army of undead lead by [[Palladio Manesque]], the task force, led by Subaru, split up where he directed them all. Ultimately, they managed to overcome most of the forces sent to stop them, including Sphinx. However, with Sphinx being struck by the [[Enchanted Sword#Yang Sword Vollachia|Yang Sword]], her undead form shifted to take the form of the [[Echidna|Witch of Greed]]. Afterward, the battle escalated, and Priscilla gave her life to become an undead and escape her confines. Afterward, she, Subaru, and Rui, renamed Spica, defeated Sphinx and brought an end to the Great Disaster, causing any surviving zombies to scatter. After the group returned to Garkla, Priscilla spent the day with Subaru, talking to her brother and the people of the other camps. Atop the city's walls, she spent her final moments with Al and Subaru before fading away, essentially forcing her camp to disband and knocking her out of the Royal Selection.

====The Divine Dragon Church Appears and the Sixth Candidate====
Following her death, the Anastasia Camp left for Kararagi, intending to report there before returning to the Kingdom. The Emilia Camp, deciding to leave Spica to assist Vollachia for the time being, decided to return directly to the Kingdom alongside the remnants of the Priscilla Camp. However, due to Aldebaran's efforts in preparation for his [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|scheme]], everyone split up, with Emilia and Otto reporting to the Council of Wise Men regarding Priscilla's fate. Meanwhile, a number of them left for the Pleiades Watchtower again. The night after they arrived, however, when Aldebaran attempted to begin his scheme, due to Subaru having already used Return by Death, they were able to seal him and prevent everything he would have become responsible for.

Because of Aldebaran's failure, Yae ultimately made her way to the Barielle Estate and revealed Priscilla's will, in which [[Schult Barielle|Schult]] was adopted by Priscilla and made her successor, and she decided to stick with Schult until Aldebaran re-emerged, advising Schult to keep his distance from the Emilia Camp. Heinkel, who was left behind, set out on his own. Meanwhile, Subaru's party decided to return to the Royal Capital, intent on learning more of the Kingdom's and the world's history and forcing Roy to spit up all of the names and memories in his Stomach of Souls. Simultaneously, Wilhelm and Ferris returned to the Royal Capital, while a woman from the Divine Dragon Church claiming her name to be Filore spoke on the Church's behalf to the Council of Wise Men, offering their assistance with the Priestella victims. Ultimately, despite knowing the consequences of accepting her help, Ferris agreed to let her use her sacraments to save Crusch.

After a conversation between Emilia and Felt, resulting in their friendship, Felt and Reinhard soon made their way to the castle, while Emilia and Otto made their way to the Karsten Estate, where they encountered Ferris and Wilhelm. Moments later, Filore appeared, having completed healing Crusch, something which Otto mentions would mark the end of Crusch in the Royal Selection. After that, Filore made her way to the castle, where Felt and Reinhard were discussing about the current predicament regarding Filore's identity and the church's appearance. After she arrived, Felt gave her her own Dragon Insignia, and with the jewel within shining, it marked her as a member of the Royal Selection.<ref name="sixth" />

With the situation as it stood, Reinhard and Rom were sent to retrieve Subaru's group, and after discussing the current problem and picking up Ram and Rem, they appeared in the capital, where they discovered the mangled corpse of Roy Alphard, ruining the chance for Subaru to negotiate with him to release the names and memories he and his siblings devoured. In this time, Crusch awoke, emaciated, craving water, and upset that Ferris betrayed the oath they made with Fourier, who she remembered. Because of this, Ferris brought up being removed as her knight, which Crusch ultimately accepted. Before long, after the Emilia Camp discussed the Gluttony problem, Subaru, Emilia, Beatrice, and Rem went to visit the awakened Crusch, who, though grateful they came to see her, was still emotionally fragile about everything that had happened. After their visit, Wilhelm implored they speak with Ferris, who was in the cemetery. Though they learned he was no longer her knight and the history between them and Fourier, they were unable to do anything for him and left. Shortly after, however, Ferris was approached by Russell, and they made a deal for Ferris to assist the Six Tongues in their secret battle.

The next day, after a meeting with the members of the Emilia Camp and being encouraged by Emilia, Filore chose her platform as a Royal Selection candidate and made her decision to participate. During a meeting with Miklotov that followed soon after, she chose Heinkel Astrea, who was supposedly chosen by the Dragon, as her knight.

====[[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy]]====
The day after, various members of the Emilia Camp and Filore's company prepared to depart for Priestella in order to heal all those afflicted by the Witch Cult. Having to meet with Miklotov, Subaru and Beatrice made their way to his manor, picking up [[Tiga Rauleon]] along the way. However, upon arrival, they confronted Crusch, who had apparently killed Miklotov and his retainers while claiming them to be traitors to the Kingdom, believing that they were using the Dragon History Stone for their own convenience. Though this led to a fight between the two parties, upon Subaru cornering her and trying to persuade her to stand down, Tiga took advantage of his position and attacked Crusch and Subaru, and after protecting him, Crusch took Subaru and Beatrice along with her, fleeing from the Royal Army and Tiga as fugitives wanted for murdering Miklotov and conspiring to overthrow the Kingdom. When he later awoke, she claimed that she intended to personally [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|purge to corruption from the Kingdom]].

At the same time, the Emilia Camp fell under suspicion and were effectively isolated when [[Marcos Gildark]] requested Emilia appear in the castle. With Ram accompanying her, Otto suspected that someone was trying to knock out the Emilia and Crusch Camps due to the timing, and the camp escaped from their house arrest to find Subaru, forcing them into a confrontation with the coerced Sword Saint and being assisted by Wilhelm. Meanwhile, Felt, who had realized that the Royal Selection candidates were being targeted and already had her people looking for Subaru's group, was also called in to be questioned just like Emilia. After a while, Subaru eventually confronted a group associated with Russell Fellow, and following an attack by [[Clarissa]], were brought to him, learning that their enemies were known as the Beloved Children and that an enemy had quietly infiltrated the Kingdom, leading to Russell requesting Subaru's assistance. Ultimately, everyone aside from those isolated within the castle were forced to flee from the Royal Capital.

==Trivia==
*Throughout the Royal Selection, the candidates bear standings equivalent to the royal family.
*According to Rom, due to the reason behind holding the Royal Selection, if something was to happen to the Divine Dragon before the Royal Selection was completed, then it was likely to be entirely called off.
*According to Russell Fellow in [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 13]]'s version of [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint: The Lion's Ferocity Chronicle 3|The Lion's Ferocity]], it is possible that the Royal Selection may end early due to various unforeseen circumstances.
*Despite the possibility of Felt being a member of the Royal Family, Subaru speculates that the reason that she was not immediately put on the throne, in turn ending the Royal Selection as soon as it started, was due to the influence of the Dragon History Stone.
*In the various [[Re:Zero EX|April Fools IF side stories]], the Royal Selection has wildly different outcomes due to the numerous changes in the timeline.
**In Ayamatsu, due to Crusch's defeat to the White Whale, the resignation of Anastasia and Priscilla, Felt not being found as one of the candidates, and Subaru's schemes as a Witch Cult Sin Archbishop, Emilia was the ultimate winner of the Royal Selection.
**In Oboreru, Crusch suffered the same fate as in Ayamatsu while Emilia refused to participate to stick with Subaru, who had become the leader of a world-class criminal organization. It is unclear how the Royal Selection ended.
**In the Kararagi IF, it is likely that Emilia died and Crusch suffered the same fate as in the previous IFs. It is unclear how the Royal Selection ended.
**In Kasaneru, the line-up and relationships of the camps are different, but ultimately, the Royal Selection was ongoing.
**In Tsugihagu, Emilia, Anastasia, and Crusch, as well as most of their camps, had all met their ends at Subaru and Shaula's hands, and due to the death of Rom, Felt resigned from the Royal Selection, leaving Priscilla as the effective winner. However, it is unclear if Priscilla had already been making her way to Vollachia by this point, making it unclear how the Royal Selection proceeded.
**In Sasageru, though it is unclear how the Royal Selection proceeded after Subaru's successful sealing, both Lugunica and Kararagi were subsumed into Vollachia for unknown reasons, leaving the results of the Royal Selection unknown, if it finished at all.
*According to the author, the camps have their own information brokers that spread favorable rumors about themselves.<ref>''"“They have something similar to the Kawara-ban, they have a courier network to spread information between areas, and the rich people have any number of Conversation Mirrors to exchange information. Each of the royal candidates has information brokers spreading favorable rumors about themselves. In the Emilia Camp, too, Otto and Roswaal are hard at work.”'' October 4, 2014 AskFM Q&A.</ref>

Guerilla forces |forces3 = |forces4 = |casual1 = Tens of thousands |casual2 = Tens of thousands |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = Unknown}} The '''Demi-Human War''' (亜人戦争) was a protracted civil war fought in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], taking place for nine years from 48 to 40 years before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]]. It was a major conflict that took place during the events of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2|Sword Demon Love Song]], and the effects of the war have had a lasting impact on the world today, with one of its [[Sphinx|remnants]] going on to ignite another [[Great Disaster|devastating conflict]] that flipped the world on its head. Initially a minor regional uprising on the Lugunican frontier, the war escalated into a bloody struggle that lasted for nearly the course of a decade. The two belligerents at the start of the war, the government of Lugunica, and the Demi-Human Alliance, would themselves be relegated to minor players as the war spiraled out of control, turning into a nationwide ethnic conflict with skirmishes breaking out all over the country. The war was brought to an end two years after that generation’s Sword Saint, [[Theresia van Astrea]], joined the war, with the final battle of the war being the Second Battle of Castour Field.''"...the debut battle of the Sword Saint, which caused Wilhelm to desert the [[Royal Army|army]]; and the second battle at Castour Field, which led to the ultimate conclusion of hostilities."'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], Chapter 4, Section 5. With that, an armistice was signed between the Kingdom and the Demi-Human Alliance's third leader and remaining representative, [[Cragrell Dawson]]. ==Background== Though there have always been racial issues in Lugunica, hatred between humans and [[Demi-Human|demi-human]]s intensified after the [[Great Calamity]], in which the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], a half-elf, consumed half of the world. Half races and elves in particular were classified as heretical, but that same prejudice spread towards other races that were not human. For 350 years, the tension simmered and stewed. Eventually, a demi-human caravan heading for the [[Vollachia Empire]] was interrupted by Lugunican border guards, who suspected them of participating in espionage. When the two sides clashed, the demi-humans were slain by the humans. Due to the caravan's strong reputation among demi-humans within Lugunica, their deaths led to a revolt by demi-humans, which began the war. ==Battles== ===[[Battle of Redonas Plateau]]=== This was a minor battle in 46 BA that marked one of the first battles that [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]] and [[Grimm Fauzen]] took part in. Originally, a young noble sought to make a name for himself during an attack on the enemy forces. However, said noble was handled with ease, and the Royal Army’s forces were left in disarray. If not for Wilhelm, the battle may have been lost. ===[[Battle of Castour Field]]=== This battle, which took place in 46 BA, was a battle in which one of the Demi-Human Alliance’s leaders, [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]], successfully ambushed and slaughtered the Royal Army with a magic trap set in place by another of their leaders, Sphinx. If not for Wilhelm moving forward to fight for a time, the army would have lost many more soldiers than they already did. The Zergev Squadron completely survived, fortunately, and Wilhelm garnered the name of Sword Demon as a result of his actions as well. Following this great defeat, Wilhelm and Grimm were taken as members of the Zergev Squadron. ====Post-Battle Investigation==== Following the crushing defeat at Castour Field, the magic specialist [[Roswaal J. Mathers]], alongside her bodyguard [[Carol Remendis]], were brought to Castour Field in order to analyze the magic circles that were used in the previous ambush. Taking Wilhelm, Grimm, and a few other knights of the Zergev Squadron, they made their way deep into the field, where they found a large circle. With Roswaal mentioning that this could threaten the whole Kingdom, Grimm started to have a bad feeling, asking if Wilhelm felt the same thing. Though initially claiming that to be in his head since he couldn't feel anything alive nearby, he quickly moved into action when an arrow fired by the [[undead]] [[Tholter Weasily]], who died in the previous battle, was aimed at Roswaal. Soon after, the contingent was faced with an army of undead from both enemies and allies alike. Elsewhere, the rest of the squadron also faced similar enemies. Leaving Carol and Grimm to protect Roswaal, Wilhelm went to slay the undead, taking many of them down. However, he was met with a magic counterattack by Sphinx, who was exhibiting a tremendous aura. Recognizing Sphinx, Roswaal was furious and moved forward to join the fight herself. However, Sphinx flew away, having collected what she needed, and set the rest of the corpse soldiers on everyone. With knowledge provided by Roswaal, Wilhelm began searching for the "core" corpse soldier to bring down the horde, and eventually, he set his sights on Tholter, who was still firing arrows at his group. Realizing he would be unable to reach him, he tasked Grimm with killing him while he protected Roswaal. After a push from him, Grimm ran off, accompanied by Carol, and successfully slew the undead Tholter. Following this, Roswaal informed everyone of Sphinx's identity and her level of threat. ===[[Battle of Aihiya Swamp]]=== This battle, fought in 43 BA, was the largest and deadliest battle in the entire war. Using the stored magic within the destroyed structures at the Aihiya Swamp, Valga was able to bait and ambush the Royal Army into another employed magic circle trap. A massive portion of the army was completely lost, and the Zergev Squadron was nearly completely lost, with the vice commander of the squad, [[Pivot Arnancy]], losing his life as well. Because of the losses, the rebellions exploded across the nation, and the [[Royal Capital]] was left open as well. [[Leip Barielle]] was demoted for the devastating loss, and on the other side, [[Libre Fermi]] was killed and made an undead by Sphinx, who continued to use his reputation for her own good during the war. ===[[Invasion of the Royal Castle]]=== Taking place in 43 BA, this battle marked a serious change for the entire war, as the three major demi-human leaders, including the undead Libre Fermi, attempted to take the Royal Castle for themselves. However, despite their efforts, they were unable to do so. Libre was completely destroyed, Valga Cromwell was defeated and was imprisoned in the mansion of [[Miklotov McMahon]], and Sphinx lost her limbs and escaped, only to be secretly captured by Leip Barielle, who claimed to have finished her off. Despite this battle being so major, the war did not end, and the Demi-Human Alliance continued fighting under the banner of Cragrell Dawson. ===[[Battle of the Trias Domain]]=== As revenge for his part in the war, the Demi-Human Alliance attacked the Trias Domain to spite Wilhelm in 42 BA. The man left his place in the Royal Capital and eventually arrived in his domain. Though he fought hard, he was brought down and nearly lost his life. If not for Theresia van Astrea, who had come to save his life and finally decided to join the war, he would have died. With her arrival, she successfully defeated the demi-human soldiers there, though the Trias family and many others were still lost. ===Second Battle of Castour Field=== This was the final battle of the war, taking place two years after the Sword Saint entered the war, in 40 BA. This battle resulted in the final Royal Army victory, and afterward, the country was able to sign an armistice with Cragrell, officially ending the war. ==Aftermath== The end of the war did not end prejudice between humans and demi-humans, and in the following decades, much ill will would continue to be felt, especially in the countryside and especially concerning elves. However, compared to before the war, demi-humans faced much less discrimination, and their standing in Lugunica did improve a certain degree. With the war's end and Theresia's part in bringing it to its end, she was awarded with the auxiliary Astrea Manor in the capital, and before long, she would also be given the title of the Kingdom's official Sword Saint. However, with some assistance from King [[Gionis Lugunica|Gionis]], Wilhelm was able to sneak into the ceremony, challenge Theresia, and defeat her, leading to their subsequent engagement. Because of this and his intention to take Theresia's place, Wilhelm was given a chance to prove the might powerful enough to replace the Sword Saint, and after his victory against all of the strongest members of the Royal Army, he became the captain of the Royal Guard, taking [[Conwood Melahau]] as his vice-captain. Likewise, after meeting [[Orphe]] and recommending him to Bordeaux, the organization [[Six Tongues]] was formed, Orphe its director. As part of a way to maintain peace after the signing of the armistice, Cragrell was granted a noble title and given a mansion along with it. Leip kept the limbless Sphinx hidden beneath his own manor in the Barielle Domain, intending to use her for his own machinations, which would later result in the Coffleton Undead Incident, and later, the Great Disaster. Valga was kept beneath the McMahon Manor for years, and eventually he managed to obtain his own freedom, taking on a [[Felt|young girl]] as his granddaughter, and taking ownership of the Loot House. ==Trivia== *According to the author, if Theresia hadn't met Wilhelm, the Kingdom might have fallen to the demi-humans or have come dangerously close to it.''"I think the kingdom would have fallen to the demi-humans, or it would have gone dangerously close to that point."''
