Zergev Squadron suffers minimal casualties |side4 = |forces4 = |casual4 = |civilian = Unknown, severe}} The '''Battle of the Trias Domain''' (トリアス領の戦い) was a minor but significant engagement that took place in 42 years before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]], during the [[Demi-Human War]]. The battle marked the turning point of the war as the [[Theresia van Astrea|Sword Saint]] finally arrived on the battle lines,''The battle of the Trias Domain would loom large in the history of Lugunica. It was not that there was any special value to the Trias Domain in which the battle took place. The carnage wrought on the Trias Domain was just another one of the tragedies that occurred throughout the Demi-Human War. It differed from all the others in just one way. It would go down as the first stunning excursion of the era’s Sword Saint.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Seventh Stanza, Section 8. leading to the war's conclusion two years later.''Many people counted those two years as beginning from the day of the Sword Saint’s first battle. Only a very few who had been involved knew that the actual beginning dated to several weeks prior to that.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Final Stanza, Section 1. ==Background== During the [[Invasion of the Royal Castle]], the leaders of the Demi-Human Alliance all faced defeat at the hands of the [[Royal Army#Zergev Squadron|Zergev Squadron]], with [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] being defeated by one of the most famous and powerful figures of the war, the Sword Demon [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]]. With the Alliance leadership seemingly wiped out, it was expected that the war would soon come to an end. Unfortunately, as Valga had claimed, the loss of their leaders instead became more fevered.''With the Demi-Human Alliance thus losing its main support, it was widely believed that the civil war itself would soon show signs of ending. However, contrary to that expectation, demi-human resistance throughout the land grew more and more fevered.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Sixth Stanza, Section 13. Contrary to human strategical views, the momentum of the demi-human effort not only failed to decrease, but strengthened and became ever more erratic as the revolutionaries began to lash out in reaction to the martyrdom of their leaders. For his efforts during the war, Wilhelm was not only given the title of knight, but he was also recognized as the new vice commander of the Zergev Squadron, and his name was known throughout the land. Because of this, however, [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] had come to warn Wilhelm one day that, likely as revenge for the defeats of their leaders, [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]] were likely planning an attack on his homeland, the Trias Domain.''“Then again, I suppose it could be revenge against you for killing their leaders, my dear Wilhelm Trias.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Seventh Stanza, Section 14. However, having only just been given a status befitting his role, Wilhelm could not go so easily to their aid. Later that day, he met with Theresia, who he had been meeting with regularly. After a conversation with her, he was inspired to do what it took to save his home. After separating from her that day, he left behind his knighthood and a written apology, and he left to save his home. Sometime after he left, his note was found in his room. With [[Bordeaux Zergev]] aware of where he was heading, he began to mobilize to come to his aid. Meanwhile, [[Carol Remendis]], who had also learned of his disappearance, left to tell Theresia. Despite her fear of wielding the blade and taking a life, having been inspired by Wilhelm herself and obtaining the will to fight for his sake, she, for the first time, picked up her sword, and she left with the Zergev Squadron and Carol, intent on saving Wilhelm. ==Battle== ===Arrival of the Sword Demon=== [[File:Triasburning.png|thumb|250px|right]] By the time Wilhelm had arrived at the Trias Domain, rebel forces had long since infiltrated and sacked the region. Lacking strength in numbers, ability, and in mind, House Trias and its vassals immediately fell to the demi-human onslaught, and from the distance, Wilhelm could see the area and estate burning. Alone and without support, Wilhelm charged at his enemies. In a matter of minutes, Wilhelm racked up as many as three hundred kills. However, he was eventually surrounded by the many demi-humans, and he was finally brought down. ===Arrival of the Sword Saint=== [[File:Theresiaarrives.gif|left|250x250px|Theresia arrives.]] Just as Wilhelm was about to face death by the demi-humans' hands, Theresia arrived and killed all the demi-humans nearby, and without facing Wilhelm, she began taking down the opposing army at a fast pace. Soon after, the Zergev Squadron arrived as well, and they quickly recovered Wilhelm, who was stunned by Theresia's swordsmanship and strength. Eventually, the battle came to an end after Theresia racked up more than a thousand kills, and the enemy was completely wiped out. ==Aftermath== Due to this attack, the Trias family would cease to exist, with Wilhelm Trias being the sole surviving member.''Theresia was suggesting that they include the Trias Domain—or rather the former Trias Domain, the family having been obliterated...'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5. Wilhelm, though regretful of not being able to save his family, was even more conflicted after seeing Theresia's power, and he ultimately confronted her about it, where she swiftly and easily dealt with his strength. During the conversation they had, she claimed that she learned the reason for why she should wield the sword. Wilhelm, who loved her and did not want to see her wield a sword, as he could clearly see through her emotions, decided to take away the reason for her to wield a sword. After this, Theresia joined the war alongside the Zergev Squadron while Wilhelm disappeared entirely for two years, strengthening himself through training and speaking only with Roswaal in that time, who informed him regularly of Theresia's exploits and the Demi-Human War's current state. With her stellar performance on the battlefield, the Sword Saint had dispelled every doubt or rumor concerning her abilities. Though over three hundred troops had been killed by Wilhelm, only the nearly one thousand slain by Theresia would be remembered.''In her first battle, she single-handedly took the lives of nearly a thousand demi-humans, a feat that would have been impossible for anyone else.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Seventh Stanza, Section 8. Her first defeat earlier in the war was erased from memory and forgotten, and the Battle of the Trias Domain would forever be remembered as her only debut in battle. And thus, the Sword Saint would from then on lead [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]'s war effort, breaking down the demi-humans' will to fight through sheer power and brutality, while the tales of the Sword Demon were slowly but certainly forgotten. Two years later, King [[Gionis Lugunica]] would meet with the demi-human representative, [[Cragrell Dawson]], for peace talks.[[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Final Stanza, Section 1. The Demi-Human War came to an end after nine years. On the day she was to be awarded for her efforts, Wilhelm, who had been told of her achievements and the awarding ceremony, decided to intrude on the ceremony with help from Roswaal, who had also provided Theresia with a sword. In the main hall, Wilhelm and Theresia fought in a sword dance so fast and powerful that everyone in the room was stunned. In the end, Wilhelm won, took away her reason to wield the sword, and decided to take her place, replacing the Sword Saint with the Sword Demon, and ultimately, the two became lovers. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Demi-Human War]] [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

title: Dragon
wikitext:
{{Parent Tab |tab1 = Information |tab2 = Image Gallery}}
'''Dragons''' (龍, ''Ryū'') are immensely large and powerful beings made up of enormous amounts of mana; distinct from them are lesser '''dragons''' (竜, ''ryū''), made up of a few different subtypes.<ref group=Note>The name of the original "true" Dragons that roamed the world 400 years prior to the main story is rendered in kanji as (龍), while the names of the lesser dragons with subspecies contain a separate kanji (竜). Due to the inability to replicate this difference in English, the term "dragon" is capitalized at times to indicate the difference between the more powerful Dragons and the specialized dragons.</ref>

==Information==
===Dragons===
====Characteristics====
<gallery type="slideshow">
Re Zero Light Novel 25 2.png|The Divine Dragon, Volcanica.
Re Zero Light Novel 32 9.png|The Cloud Dragon, Mezoreia.
Valgren design.jpg|The Three-Headed Dragon, Valgren.
</gallery>
'''Dragons''' (龍, ''Ryū'') are lifeforms that contain great power and are made up of enormous masses of mana,<ref>''“Explaining the origins of dragons to the people of this day and age would be a bit of a pain to do, in fact. To make a long story short, you can think of dragons as living beings that are like enormous masses of mana, I suppose.”'' [[The Dragon Nation / Missing Child Search Chronicle 2]], Section 2.</ref> similar to [[spirit]]s.<ref>''Their bodies were constructed of a large quantity of Mana, and thus were fundamentally different from other races; if a comparison had to be made, the closest thing would probably be Spirits.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> Because of this, Dragons did not require copulation or mating to multiply, and they were capable of asexual reproduction.<ref>''First of all, Dragons did not require copulation or mating in order to multiply. Even without a male and female pairing up, they were creatures capable of asexual reproduction.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> They were capable of speech and were rather intelligent beings, with there being instances of individual Dragons forming pacts and vows with humans in order to create a world where both Dragons and men could coexist. The majority of Dragons to have been shown take the shape of typical western dragons depicted in Earthen myths and stories, bearing a large lizard-like body, a pair of enormous wings, a tail, powerful claws and fangs, and dense scales. Each Dragon can, however, bear a unique appearance that is different from others of their kind; there was a tribe of Dragons known as Silver Dragons known for the color of their bodies, and the Three-Headed Dragon [[Valgren]] bore three heads. In the world, Dragons are a symbol of both awe and fear, and they are unanimously recognized as the strongest living lifeforms in the world.<ref>''Only, unlike Spirits, which had levels such as Micro, Quasi, and Great, Dragons were Dragons by birth, and there was no doubt that their unparalleled might existed at the apex of all living things.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref>

Dragons have access to various abilities to accompany their immense strength. One such ability shared amongst all Dragons is the ability of flight. However, this is not connected to their wings. According to [[Emilia]]’s observations of the Divine Dragon [[Volcanica]], Dragons actually use their mana to lift their enormous bodies and fly. Their wings are instead used to assist them in maintain balance and control of their bodies. Dragons also typically have access to a breath attack which is simply known as Dragon's breath. Despite its similarities to [[magic]], their breath is actually an exceedingly powerful torrent of mana that destroys anything that comes into contact with it.<ref>''A Dragon’s breath was not magic nor anything of the sort; it was simply an exceedingly powerful torrent of mana, pure, primitive to its objective, destroying anything that dared to make contact.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 40]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> Of course, their breaths can also have different effects: for [[Mezoreia]] and Volcanica, their breaths were closer to being powerful lasers, while Valgren's breath was closer to being a cascade of green fire. Volcanica could even change its breath to suit its needs, such as creating a watery mist that could be used to freeze its opponents or obscure their vision,<ref>''The Dragon’s mighty maw gaped wide open, and it unleashed a breath that shone with a light of destruction, reducing all to naught―― such was not the case; instead, unleashed was a mist of fresh water manifested from the Dragon’s vast mana.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 2, Section 6.</ref> or generate both fire and water to create a devastatingly destructive shockwave. This said, different Dragons can bear different abilities. Volcanica alone has mana that can purify flames and heal life-threatening injuries, rupture space, and even unleash powerful blade-like winds with its wings. Meanwhile, Mezoreia can influence the heavens with its mana and manipulate the weather in its favor.

Traits that are shared among Dragonkind is that the density of their dragon scales, is influenced by the mana each individual Dragon possesses, and those scales provide them a powerful physical defense. On top of this, the longer a Dragon lives, the greater their capacity for mana becomes, which in turn increases the density of their scales.<ref>''A Dragon’s scales, their hardness was greatly influenced by the aggregate amount of mana possessed by the individual.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 3, Section 4.</ref> In Mezoreia's case, although it was tough enough to withstand most attacks, it still received damage from a warrior of [[Garfiel Tinzel]]'s strength. By comparison, Volcanica, who is recognized as the currently longest-known-lived Dragon in the world at over 1000 years, bears scales that are even denser than diamonds,<ref>''The mightier and longer-lived the Dragon, the more robust and tenacious they grew; henceforth, in regards to the Divine Dragon who reigned supreme over all others, its draconic scales were of a hardness that surpassed even diamond.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 3, Section 4.</ref> and even a warrior the caliber of the [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Sword Demon]] cannot pierce them. Dragons also bear a dragon halo which can be seen atop their heads. This halo provides them with a dense magical defense, and like the scales, its defense also grows with time.<ref>''“Dragon scales impervious to any physical attacks, and a dragon halo that wards off all magical attacks.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 5.</ref> Volcanica's halo is strong enough to easily repel magic the strength of Roswaal's fivefold magic using five Al level spells combined and emerge entirely unscathed. This being said, it is hard to compare to other Dragons' halos, as there has yet to be another proper example of a Dragon's halo in use. It is only when these two ultimate defenses are both pierced through that one can reach a Dragon's weak point: the '''Heart Stone''' (心核, ''Kokoro Kaku'').<ref>''The overwhelming physical defense of the dragon scales, and the absurd magical defense of the dragon halo; unless they stripped it of those two powerful safeguards, none of their attacks would be able to reach its weak point, the Heart Stone. It was not a matter of which, both were required. Unless they stripped it of both armors, neither would they be able to surpass the astounding regeneration of the Dragon’s mana body, nor would they be able to render it incapable of combat.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 5.</ref> The Heart Stone is the very core of a Dragon's being, and it could be stated reaching the core is perhaps one of the only ways to defeat or kill a Dragon. The only weapon capable of easily bypassing or ignoring these defenses and reaching the Heart Stone, according to [[Clind]], is the [[Enchanted Sword#Dragon Sword Reid|Dragon Sword Reid]] and its ability to cut through anything.<ref>''The Dragon Sword, having been immediately given in response, was an enchanted sword that made it possible to cut things that could not be cut. With the ability of the Dragon Sword, it would have certainly been possible to disregard the dragon scales and dragon halo and launch an attack straight for the Heart Stone. If the wielder felt so inclined, then even just hitting the Divine Dragon with the Dragon Sword might have dealt a notable amount of damage.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 5.</ref>

====Dragon's Blood====
Dragons also have very potent blood. According to "[[Al|Aldebaran]]" while within Volcanica's body, if one were to attempt to strengthen oneself by taking in a Dragon's blood without somehow diluting it, then the person would likely die. However, there is one case in which someone doused in Dragon's blood not only survived, but also had their bodies reconstituted to the point that they became supernaturally durable: [[Heinkel Astrea]], who [[Filore]] claims has become an "immortal knight".<ref>''"――One from the lineage of Sword Saints who, upon conquering the Dragon’s Blood that washed over his body, was reforged into an immortal knight, Heinkel Astrea-sama: I wish to name him as my Knight."'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 44]], Chapter 4, Section 5.</ref> In the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], their government carries Dragon's blood which is said to be able to heal and cure any ailment, and it can even restore an entire land to life. However, according to [[Beatrice]], this blood only retains such powerful effects because it was siphoned from the final heartbeat of a dying Dragon. Of course, while Dragon's blood could still have powerful effects even without it being siphoned in such a way, it does not compare to what is stored in the Kingdom's castle. It is unknown whether the strength of the Dragon the blood is taken from influences the restorative effects, but regardless, retrieving such powerful blood is still difficult to achieve.

====How Dragons Lived====
In the era of the [[Witch]]es, Dragons freely roamed the world in numbers. They lived in flocks everywhere around the world, and formed smaller communities or factions, which were led by their chosen Dragon representatives, who were renowned around the world. They acted very similarly to Spirits and Evil Spirits. However, unlike them, Dragons freely expanded their territory rather often. Additionally, some Dragons hunted and killed people for various reasons, oftentimes to secure new territory. In turn, humans came up with a title, referring to them as '''Blight Dragons''' (邪龍, ''Jyaryū''). It is mentioned by Beatrice that this term is nothing more than a viewpoint of humans wronged by dragons, rather than a designated species name.<ref>''“In other words, Dragons being regarded as Blight Dragons is solely a matter of humans' point of view, in fact.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]], Chapter 1, Section 6.</ref> According to legend, Blight Dragons were all but exterminated by the first Sword Saint, Reid Astrea, four centuries ago. In the present, the only known Blight Dragon was the three-headed black Dragon Valgren, who was slain during the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]]. Still, despite grouping up or forming flocks in times past, Dragons did not actually harbor any interest in other Dragons, nor of protecting their kind or preserving their race.<ref>''Therefore, Dragons possessed almost no sense of protecting other individuals of their race, or of preserving the species.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref><ref>''Since they were capable of parthenogenesis, they inevitably harbored little interest in other Dragons.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> Even those who challenged [[Reid Astrea]] in the name of retribution only did so because their pride deemed it unacceptable for their race to be disdained.<ref>''The ones that challenged Reid in the name of retribution for their species did not do so for the sake of the killed Dragons, but because their pride deemed it unacceptable for the Dragon race to be disdained.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> It is precisely because of this that by the time they realized how dire of a situation their race was in, they were already on the verge of extinction.<ref name="extinction">''As a result, by the time the Dragons had come to realize how bad their situation was, they were already standing on the verge of extinction―― even the mighty Dragon that led one flock came to fill Reid’s stomach, and in another land, their confrontation with the Witch of Sloth had proved to be fatal, so the time had come for them to make a decision.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref>

====Perspective of Dragons====
Dragons were also very prideful due to their positions as the strongest species in the world. However, their take on their pride is also unique: during the era of the first-generation Sword Saint Reid Astrea, when a large number of them were slain by him,<ref>''“Certainly, there’s no time to recite the legend Reid Astrea etched into posterity in all parts of the world. Speaking of things he was famous for… the fight where he slayed a hundred Dragons, or his battle achievement of six thousand undefeated victories recorded in the arena of the Gladiator Island. An existence called to be a fierce god, and the victor of drinking competitions, such varieties are also there.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 24]], Chapter 2, Section 6.</ref> or by the [[Sekhmet|Witch of Sloth]],<ref name="challenge" /><ref name="extinction" /><ref name="hostile">''The Dragons that followed their pride abandoned the land, and while not approving of the attacks led by individual specimens hostile against Reid or the Witch of Sloth, they had chosen to fly away over yonder.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> pushing their species to the brink of extinction,<ref>''Reid killed Dragons as he pleased, and killed the Dragons that had challenged him for retribution because of that; by doing that for several years, the already small number of Dragons had decreased even more in the blink of an eye, and they had been brought to the verge of extinction.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> in order to maintain their pride as the strongest beings, the Dragons decided to fly beyond the Great Waterfall where nobody could reach or challenge them.<ref name="hostile" /> By doing this, they could remain known as the strongest of species and prevent anyone from stealing their spot on the top, effectively allowing them to maintain their pride. Those that remained behind, like Volcanica, who remained due to either personal reasons or to prove an unnecessary point, were considered eccentrics or deviants who abandoned their pride.<ref>''The Dragons that did not follow their pride remained in the land, and without severing relations with those who arrogantly opposed Dragons superior to themselves, they had made the unusual choice to continue feuding.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref><ref>''Therefore, the majority of the Dragons departed from the land, and the Dragons that yet remained were eccentrics―― to put it more directly, they were treated as deviants among the Dragons.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> The reason for this lies in their perspective: as there was no reason to prove that they were indeed the mightiest of all creatures, Dragons viewed battle as merely a means of survival, and as such, the superior species and the one who achieved victory was determined by the one that survived.<ref>''In the first place, Dragons were the ultimate existence that could not possibly be compared with other races. There was no reason for them to go through the trouble of clashing with other species to prove that point. For Dragons, doing battle was defined as vying for survival, so if one wished to compete for victory, they would do so through the act of surviving. Therefore, those who were capable of doing so would be known as superior specimens.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> Either way, it is because of that that only those Dragons that flew beyond the Great Waterfall are thought to know what lies beyond the waterfall and to reside in their own paradise beyond it; though they are said to fly over to the continent they originated from on some occasions.<ref>''“It is said that only Dragons know what lies beyond the Great Waterfall. Although they certainly exist, they have no place to live, and it is said that they have their own paradise beyond the Great Waterfall and that they spread their wings and fly over to this continent from time to time.”'' [[Re:Zero Visual Complete Vol.2 Ram]], Glossary, The Great Waterfall.</ref>

====Dragonhusks====
Dragons did not care about their body's shape, and they had no issue with taking whichever form they believed represented the strongest being;<ref>''Therefore, being the ultimate existence was important to Dragons, and if they indeed were, then there would be no need to fuss over the original form of a Dragon. ――If they were superior, then even the form of a human would be fine.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> in fact, the only reason that they had taken their original form was because there was no other form that displayed their superiority more easily.<ref>''Originally, the reason Dragons took on the majestic form of large bodies that sprouted wings, with sharp fangs and claws, and tough scales, was none other than because it easily displayed their abilities as the ultimate existence. Dragons had retained the same form for so long because there had never appeared a form that could display the power of a Dragon more aptly.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> However, because of the world's changes, they did not shun the idea of taking on the shape of a human.<ref name="change">''But, with the trend of times and changes in the world, were a need to alter themselves into a more suitable form indeed present, the Dragons would not shun the notion of discarding their majestic appearances, and would instead take the same forms as humans.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> In this belief, of the Dragons that remained behind and abandoned their pride, some of them displayed the ability to create a specific form of life known as the dragonkin.<ref name="challenge">''Some Dragons died challenging Reid or the Witch of Sloth, other Dragons lived as hermits in regions that they had grown familiar with, and another portion of Dragons had become humans. ――The decision of this final portion of Dragons had served as the basis for the dragonkin.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> Ironically inspired by Reid Astrea, who left a stronger impression on the Dragons than their own pride,<ref>''It was ironic, but the existence of Reid Astrea had played a large part in the creation of dragonkin. Whether the Dragons followed their pride or not, there was a level of audacity in the man who had driven them to that decision, but it was his strength that had left a stronger impression on the pride of the Dragons.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> Dragons were capable of taking advantage of using the unique construction of their body and their parthogenesis to create new life: the dragonkin.<ref>''It was mentioned that the construction of the Dragons’ bodies was close to that of Spirits, and that ecology would come into use here.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref><ref name="evolved">''That was the origin of the dragonkin, their relationship with Dragons. ――That was to say, the dragonkin were the evolved form of Dragons, the next generation spawned through parthenogenesis.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref>

In the process of creating this special race, however, the Dragon loses most of its personality and capability of speech, and it enters a hibernation-like state of being where merely its consciousness and a certain amount of their power remains. This state is referred to as being a '''dragonhusk''' (竜殻, ''ryū kara''),<ref>''Among those, the most serious flaw was that critical damage would be yielded in the soul of the Dragon that served as a parent to a dragonkin, followed by them becoming an empty shell stripped of their mind, the phenomenon of the dragonhusk.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> and as of yet, the only dragonhusks to be revealed are Valgren, Volcanica, and Mezoreia. In the case of the latter two, their speech was limited to a mere two sentences. Regardless, due to their state of being, Dragons were left with only the instinct for self-defense, and they became the puppets of the will of their respective dragonkin.<ref name="puppet">''A Dragon that had become a dragonhusk was practically in the state of a living corpse, and save for the instinctual act of self-defense, they were transformed into a puppet that obeyed the will of their descended dragonkin with whom they bore a deep connection.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 55, Section 1.</ref> It is possible for outside beings to take control of these dragonhusks, such as each Dragon's respective dragonkin, which occurs usually by said dragonkin touching the husk.<ref>''In essence, all that was required for a dragonkin to house their soul within their Dragon, was the act of touching their dragonhusk.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref> However, Aldebaran showed to be able to possess a dragonhusk by using a Book of the Dead, while it has also been claimed that the method used by spirits such as [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]] could also be used to control this husk.<ref>''In particular, an Evil Spirit whom Clind knew harbored the power to possess the bodies of others, and he had also discussed the possibility of such a power being capable of seizing a dragonhusk in private with his allies. ――Guese, it had been an awfully long time since he had seen the Evil Spirit who went by that name.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref> While other such methods exist, they are unknown.<ref>''However mighty an existence the race known as Dragons was, the means to commandeer an empty vessel did not amount to zero.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref> Despite this, it is possible for a dragonkin to overcome a usurper by striking at a Dragon's Heart Stone.<ref name="hijackrecover">''Regardless, Clind knew that it was possible for a Dragon to have its dragonhusk hijacked, and that in order to recover said dragonhusk, there was a need to strike its Heart Stone.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref>

===Dragonkin===
[[File:Re Zero Volume 29 Inside Cover.png|thumb|180x|Madelyn Eschart, the only openly known dragonkin alive, commanding a horde of flying dragons.]]
'''Dragonkin''' (竜人, ''Ryūto'') were a powerful but rare race that were born as a result of a shift in the view of a Dragon's perspective on which shape the strongest of beings can take, leading to them creating a brand new race.<ref name="change" /><ref name="evolved" /> The dragonkin differed from other races related to humans at a basic level, meaning that they were not [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]].<ref>''Dragonkin were not demi-humans. They differed from those species related to the human race at a basic level.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 30]], Chapter 5, Section 7.</ref> Dragonkin often shared traits with their Dragon counterparts, including long life spans,<ref>''"The lifetime of a dragonkin, is incomparably friggin’ longer than a human’s."'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 69, Section 2.</ref> horns, claw-like nails, enhanced senses, and tougher bodies, and on a basic level, they were much stronger than the majority of humans or humanoid species, but otherwise, they were essentially human in shape. However, they were significantly smaller and much weaker than Dragons, and their basic abilities were much different from the Dragon who birthed them. That said, their strength was a fact. In the times that they existed, they drove ten other races to extinction, and as a result of this and their extreme pride, they were hunted down and nearly led to extinction themselves, leaving [[Madelyn Eschart]] as the only recognized survivor of the race.<ref>''The prideful dragonkin would never tolerate any scorn or disdain towards herself. She would put washing away any disgrace over her own life. It was precisely because of that way of being that led to the downfall of their kind. In the time before the dragonkin themselves had perished, they had driven over ten other races to extinction. Though, since Madelyn had existed, it should probably be said that the dragonkin had not actually perished.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], Sword Identity, Section 12.</ref> However, it is possible that other dragonkin could be in hiding like Madelyn originally was, or, as in the case of Clind, are concealing themselves amongst humanity.

Dragonkin were unique in that they possessed the ability to make emotional connections with the three kinds of lesser dragons.<ref>''“At the very least, that is true according to the person in question… they are a race that has already perished, but I have heard that the dragonkin were able to establish bonds with earth dragons, water dragons, and flying dragons.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 7]], Sword Identity, Section 12.</ref> In the case of Madelyn, a dragonkin born from the Cloud Dragon Mezoreia, she even displayed the ability to command such dragons like subordinates, and when many were slain by [[Heinkel Astrea|Heinkel]], she was very visibly angered by not only the fact that they died but that their deaths came by a coward. That said, it is unknown if her command of the dragons is unique to her or is inherent in all dragonkin.

Dragons tend to be connected emotionally to their respective dragonkin like parents to children. In one case, Valgren showed a connection to its own deceased dragonkin after blood was poured on its skull, and it instinctively found its way towards its dragonkin's remains. In another case, Mezoreia treated strangers with wariness, and following the appearance of [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], once he made a connection with Madelyn, it treated him as a guest for teaching Madelyn. However, it became extremely protective of her when she was tempted to leave her home. Mezoreia would even follow her around while hiding above the clouds as if watching over her.

Dragonkin are usually deeply connected to their respective Dragons, inheriting memories, experiences, and emotions from the respective Dragon which made them. While dragonkin are distinct beings, because of what a dragonkin inherits from a Dragon, a mixture of sorts is formed in a dragonkin's mind, and as such, they are not exactly beings completely separate from one another.<ref>''In the first place, dragonkin were ultimately the forms taken by the next generation of Dragons and, strictly speaking, were not identical existences to their Dragon progenitors. Nevertheless, they inherited many of the memories, experiences, and emotions of their Dragons, harboring an amalgam within their minds that made it difficult to classify them as separate beings entirely.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref> Because of their connections to their Dragons, dragonkin tend to bear abilities reminiscent to their Dragon. One common ability shared among dragonkin is the ability to possess their respective Dragon,<ref name="bond">''Given that a dragonkin’s development would spur on the growth of their Dragon, and that a dragonkin’s death would destroy the mind of their Dragon, that bond was evident―― in fact, if the need ever arose, a dragonkin could even house their own mind within the empty dragonhusk, wielding their rightful strength as a Dragon to their heart’s content.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref> as well as to control them like puppets.<ref name="puppet" /> Madelyn has the capacity to possess Mezoreia's body and has done so on multiple occasions, while Clind has shown to be able to possess Volcanica many times in the past in order to act on Volcanica's covenant with the Kingdom.<ref>''That which she was said to have performed, the housing of one’s own soul into their dragonhusk, was an act which Clind had also performed many times in the past, returning to the Divine Dragon Volcanica in order to act on its Covenant with the Kingdom of Lugunica.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref> Though, they cannot take control of the Dragon's body if its husk has been taken over by another outside force without first striking at the Dragon's Heart Stone.<ref name="hijackrecover" /><ref>''However, for Clind, his soul’s first homecoming in approximately forty years had ended in failure, his dragonhusk remaining in the palm of the usurper.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 6.</ref> It should also be noted, however, that the connection between the dragonkin and Dragon can be both advantageous and detrimental. When a dragonkin grows, so too does their Dragon. On the contrary, if a dragonkin was to die, it would ultimately kill the spirit of its respective Dragon,<ref name="bond" /> such as in the case of Valgren, whose dragonkin died and in turn made Valgren less of an individual being and more of an instinctive presence.<ref>''Mezoreia, still young, was yet underdeveloped as a Dragon; and Valgren, having lost the equilibrium of its mind following the death of its birthed dragonkin, had thus forfeited its future.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 4, Section 5.</ref>

===Earth Dragons===
[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 13 1.png|thumb|250px|Patrasche, an earth dragon of the Diana species.]]
At some point in the past, in the city of [[Flanders]], which in the present is recognized as the Earth Dragon Capital, Volcanica, using an unknown type of blessing, created a lesser species of dragons called '''earth dragons''' (地竜, ''Chiryū'').<ref>''“Yeah, I think I’ve heard that the first earth dragons were born as some kind of blessing from the Divine Dragon about the same time.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5.</ref> Earth dragons, instead of having wings for flight, have strong legs that allow them to run along the ground much easier, and they are all born with the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Wind Evasion|Divine Protection of Wind Evasion]] which allows them to ignore wind resistance while they run, further increasing their speed. Likewise, each species is suited for different types of terrains, making them suitable for transport nearly anywhere. Because of these factors, much like horses on earth, earth dragons are often domesticated to be used in menial labor such as transport or in warfare. That said, earth dragons are most commonly used in Lugunica compared to the rest of the world.

Earth dragons are typically said to be loyal friends of people. However, domesticating them does not mean that they lose their wilderness.<ref>''Even though the earth dragons were known as loyal friends of people, it was not as if they had lost their wildness upon being domesticated.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 1.</ref> Earth dragons are highly empathetic creatures. As such, it is easy for their emotions to pass onto their fellow earth dragons if grouped together.<ref>''Earth dragons were already highly empathetic creatures. If one of them got frightened, that fear would spread like a chain reaction――, "――DODOGYUUUN!!"'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 1.</ref> This being said, there are some earth dragons, like [[Patrasche]], that can go against those shared feelings, including instinctual fear.<ref>''With the quick wittedness of the black earth dragon’s neigh, the contagion of fear was intercepted from spreading throughout the ground dragons.'' [[Arc 8]], Chapter 26, Section 1.</ref> Such dragons can keep the others of their kind from panicking, even when under the distress of being near the dangerous [[undead]] or the pressure from a Dragon like Valgren, and keep them focused and orderly.

The first among the species of earth dragons is the species that the others were derived from, the '''Diana''' species (ダイアナ種, ''Daiana-shu''). Though they are prideful, somewhat rare, and are typically feisty to the point that they will not let people ride them, they are capable of handling all types of terrain, meaning that they practically have no limits to where they can roam. Meanwhile, the '''Flanna''' species (フランナ種, ''Furan'na-shu'') is both the most numerous and the most versatile species. The '''Eliq''' species (エイリーク種, ''Eirīku-shu'') and the '''Aires''' species (アイレス種, ''Airesu-shu'') are species suitable for living in cold environments. Finally, the '''Agaress''' species (アガレス種, ''Agaresu-shu'') and the '''Gyrus''' species (ガイラス種, ''Gairasu-shu'') are species suitable for living in desert environments.

===Flying Dragons===
Among the lesser species of dragons are '''flying dragons''' (飛竜, ''Hiryū''), a type of dragon that are born with wings that grant them the ability to fly, and their speeds are said to be able to surpass the speed of sound. Though, it is unknown if their ability to fly is similar to Dragons or not, and it is unknown if they were born with [[Divine Protection]]s. They can ordinarily be found flying around mountains, living on their own and away from humans. They are nearly impossible to domesticate by normal standards, but people in the [[Vollachia Empire]] have found a way to do so. This resulted in the creation of the Flying Dragon Squadron, led by the Dracroy family, and presently, by [[Serena Dracroy]].

===Water Dragons===
[[File:Episode 51 Water Dragon.png|thumb|250px|Water dragon of Priestella.]]
The final lesser species of dragons are '''water dragons''' (水竜, ''Suiryū''). Water dragons are aquatic creatures with long serpentine bodies, short stubby limbs, blue, slippery skin, and a draconic head. Their mouths are crowded by sharp fangs, and catfish-like whiskers extend from their snouts. They are harder to domesticate than earth dragons, as one must be trained from the very day they hatch from their eggs in order to recognize someone as their master. All water dragons are said to be born with a Divine Protection which protects them from the effects of the water.

*Most earth dragons are vulnerable to the cold, whereas flying and water dragons have varying resistances to it due to their abilities to fly high in the sky and to swim in the deeps of water where the temperatures are cooler.<ref>''It had been a suggestion from Petra, but most ground dragons were vulnerable to cold. In fact, unlike earth dragons, both flying dragons, who flew high up in the skies within cooler temperatures, and water dragons, who swam through cold water, had varying tolerance levels against cold, but this misconception was irrelevant in face of overwhelming cold.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 99, Section 3.</ref>
*Mezoreia's blood is blue. It is unknown whether this is a common trait of all Dragons or unique to Mezoreia.<ref>''In an instant, the nature of the scream changed, and blue blood dripped onto the snow-white decoration.'' [[Arc 7]], Chapter 106, Section 4.</ref>
*According to the author, Dragons and dragonkin love and have a high tolerance for alcohol.<ref>April 5, 2026 Talk Show.</ref>
*In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], it is mentioned that [[Ginunhive]] is located near a Dragon's nest. However, as it was omitted from the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (light novel)|light novels]], it is unknown if this is still the case.

title: Gustekan Church
wikitext:
The '''Gustekan Church''' (グステコ聖教, ''Gusuteko Seikyō''), also known as the '''Holy King Church''' (聖王教会, ''Sei Ō Kyōkai''), is the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom of Gusteko]]'s state church. It is a theocratic governing body that rules over the nation of Gusteko and sanctions the worship of [[Spirit|spirits]].

==Information==
The Gustekan Church's teachings are based around [[Odglass]], the Sacred Beast. Known as the Church's Benevolent Mother, she and many of the spirits in the country are the targets of a majority of the people's faith.<ref name="faithandtrials">''To give an example, take the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, a land covered in permafrost, where spirits were seen on a regular basis, there even existed a nationwide faith worshipping spirits, the Gustekan Church. Extreme regions were considered to be trials put forth by spirits, and the majority of the population believed in these teachings.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 2, Section 1.</ref> Odglass is an exception among most spirits, as she acts friendly towards humans and views everyone in the Holy Kingdom as her children, despite how she spares little mercy for them. With the scores of lesser spirits and spirits that she controls, humans are able to live in Gusteko's harsh territory.<ref>''The simple fact that humans were able to live in Gusteko, which was covered by permafrost, was primarily due to the help of the myriad of spirits and lesser spirits under the control of Odglass.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 3.</ref> Due to Odglass' aid towards humanity, the Gustekan Church was established. It is fronted by the Holy King, who is personally selected by the Sacred Beast herself. However, the Holy King is but an acting puppet; the Holy King Church itself holds true dominion over Gusteko.<ref>''The authority to decide the head of the Holy Kingdom and the Church, the Holy King, had been delegated to Odglass, and this tradition had been passed down from the beginning of the history of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko. That format was unbreakable. Odglass had always been, and would always be, the Benevolent Mother of the Church. ――With the Holy King as their puppet, the Church would continue to direct the country.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 3.</ref> As part of the Holy King's contract with Odglass, they able to be aware of everything that happens within the nation and deal with anything bad that appears. Furthermore, the Gustekan Church's goal is to cover the world in snow in order to understand it.<ref>July 26, 2026 Talk Show</ref>

According to what the Church teaches, all life is equal, for there is no difference in value between human beings. Regardless of this principle, slavery is an open secret in Gusteko,<ref>''In the Kingdom of Gusteko, the existence of "slaves" was an open secret.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref> and despite how the Church makes it illegal, even the adherents who forbid it desire slaves.<ref>''“The Holy King Church is the one that makes the rules for this country! The very people who forbid the slave trade want slaves!”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref> Their doctrine further says that the permafrost of Gusteko is a trial given to its people by greater beings—spirits—and the only way for one's soul to feel peace in the afterlife is to endure said trials.<ref name="faithandtrials" /><ref>''According to the doctrine, the frozen earth and the cold wind were all trials given to the people by a greater being; the only way to give peace to one’s soul in the afterlife was to endure those trials――.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 2.</ref> These teachings are a salvation to many in the nation, who are driven to believe in something higher as a result of the climate.<ref>''The harsh environment that befalls all its people equally drives people to the point where they cannot even stand without putting their faith in something more. In a reality such as this, people often turned to non-human beings for salvation―― in Gusteko, this faith was aimed at spirits.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> Be that as it may, according to [[Noelle Tuérico]], the Church's teachings are currently undergoing a transformation.<ref>''“Our teachings are in the midst of a transformation.”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 1]], Section 2.</ref>

Among the Church's ranks are executioners for the faith, the '''Temple Knights'''. Highly capable warriors who are rumored to be on par with the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] of the [[Vollachia Empire]] in terms of strength and skill,<ref>''Blessed by the Holy King, they were a select group of elites who were said to wield superhuman power―― it is rumored both inside and outside of the country that they were a group of talented individuals comparable to the Nine Divine Generals of the Vollachia Empire.'' [[Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain Part 1]], Section 3.</ref> they are tasked to dispatch those who are deemed heretics. Each Temple Knight possesses a unique Blessing bestowed to them by the Holy King. They also seem to train with their very own special set of weapons such as dual katanas, whips of different kind, twin snake swords, and others. Moreover, '''Itinerant Preachers''', a group of clergy serving the Church, both spreads the Church's teachings across Gusteko and take action against anyone who contradicts them.<ref>''Itinerant Preachers had power in line with Temple Knights—known as the executioners of the Gustekan Church. To have the responsibility of traveling to various places to spread the teachings, you had to be prepared to punish anything that contradicts those teachings.'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 2]], Section 6.</ref> They do not own Blessings.

Anyone who chooses to become a member of the Gustekan Church must take a vow to dedicate their lives to the Church, and though Noelle treated it like a promise, [[Omega]] calls it closer to a contract. The granting of power by the Church is not something the Church can just bestow on anyone, and it likewise cannot be relinquished so simply. As such, anyone who breaks their vow is not likely to be treated amicably by the Church as a result.<ref>''“No, you’re underestimating the Church, Palmyra,” Omega said. “Or shall I say you’re underestimating what the Church bestowed Noelle.”'' It’s the fact that Noelle made a vow to the Church that makes the whole situation tricky. Noelle is an itinerant preacher for the Church. And as we saw in the snow mountain, her body has been enhanced with great power through the Church’s blessing. This isn’t something that’s bestowed upon anyone. It also can’t be relinquished so easily. Palmyra compared it to a ‘promise’, but it’s more of a contract between a devout follower and the Gustekan Church. ''“And what Noelle is doing is breaking the contract without any premeditation. Obviously, the Gustekan Church won’t be amicable about this.”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Extra]].</ref> Noelle, who has broken that vow and abandoned the Church, claims that she would likely experience difficulty in matters related to a Church, and by becoming involved in [[Omega Party|another group]], the troubles with the Church would likely follow after her and involve them.

In the past, the Church made a covert unit known as the '''[[Featherrun Sisters]]''', a group tasked to maintain order and “cleanse” the Holy Kingdom by exterminating other citizens under orders. With the aptitude of curse arts user [[Holosseo Featherrun]], who was appointed as the Featherrun Sisters' overseer, they made so-called “Curse Dolls” out of young women, granting them highly effective regenerative abilities. In the end, this group ultimately collapsed after Holosseo's death, setting into motion the events that led a majority of the Curse Dolls to be killed by one of their own: the future Bowel Hunter, [[Elsa Granhiert]].

The Gustekan Church also takes part in hunting people they deem heretics: those who go against the teachings of their church. The heretic hunts are often led by a Temple Knight, and they are typically willing to go to any length to cleanse the country of heretics, even including wiping out entire towns, believing that hunting these heretics is more important than protecting the Church's believers. As such, the act of taking hostages to hold off the Church is a poor tactic and can very well lead to more deaths by the Church's hands, even if that includes other members of the Church, such as Temple Knights.

According to Omega, the Holy King Church protects those who side with their beliefs, and it has not changed over hundreds of years.<ref>''Dominated by an extreme permafrost, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko is a land far too harsh for humans to exist in. It's exactly for that reason that the Church protects those who cling to their beliefs.'' Thinking to herself, Omega smiled. ''After all, the Holy King Church hasn't changed one bit in hundreds of years.'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 1]], Section 3.</ref> The Church is known to have at least one archbishop within it. Additionally, there is a figure in the Church who appears to have the jurisdiction to judge and punish others, dubbed the '''Silver Blessing''' (白銀の祝福, ''Shirogane no Shukufuku'').<ref>''“Every action is judged by the Silver Blessing. If there is to be a punishment, then so be it.”'' [[The Witch's After Tea Party / One Wild Night Part 2]], Section 3.</ref> It is unknown if this title refers to Odglass or if it is a separate being.

title: Flanders
wikitext:
'''Flanders''' (フランダース, ''Furandāsu''), also known as the '''Earth Dragon Capital of Flanders''' (地竜の都フランダース, ''Chiryū no Miyako Furandāsu''), is one of the Five Great Cities in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]. It is located in the southeastern part of the country.

==Information==
The Earth Dragon Capital of Flanders is a city on the Hyclara Plateau. The region is well-known for housing and raising a variety of different [[Dragon#Earth Dragons|earth dragons]].<ref>''Flanders was a city on the Hyclara Plateau, where a variety of earth dragons lived; the area was known for raising these creatures.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5.</ref> It is built on a dragon industry, which makes use of earth dragons beyond simple uses like transport. The city was built around the existence of earth dragons, and much of the power for urban functions comes from them. For example, earth dragons can be seen opening and closing canals or raising and lowering drawbridges by running on a wheel.<ref>''As a simple example, sometimes they would see an earth dragon running on a gigantic wheel. The motion would open or close a canal or raise or lower a drawbridge.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5.</ref> Due to this, jobs related to earth dragons are in strong demand.<ref>''Its primary industries were agriculture and animal husbandry, and it relied on earth dragon-related jobs, which were in great demand in the nearby city of Flanders.'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 1]], Section 3.</ref>

In the shadows, Flanders is commanded by three underground organizations colloquially known as the '''Big Three''' (三巨頭, ''San Kyotō''). The most powerful of the Big Three is the '''Black Silver Coin''' (黒銀貨, ''Kuro Ginka''), managed by [[Doltero Amule]]. It is the primary governing entity of the city.<ref>''“The Black Silver Coin is the governing entity of one of the Five Great Cities.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint Part 2|Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint]], Section 8.</ref> They can often be seen dealing in earth dragon goods or operating in bars. The '''Flower Prison Garden''' (華獄園, ''Hana Gokuen''), the second of the Big Three, supervises both prostitution and the city's brothels. Its proprietress is [[Toto]]. Finally, '''The Balance''' (天秤, ''Tenbin''), represented in Flanders by [[Manfred Madison]], supervises the gambling dens and regulate games. Their representative, Manfred, appears to revere [[Typhon]]. The Balance controls the gambling quarter, the Flower Prison Garden controls the red-light district, and the Black Silver Coin, headquartered at Doltero Amule's mansion, controls the rest of the city.<ref>''In this city, too, The Balance controlled the gambling quarter. Together with the Flower Prison Garden, which controlled the red-light district, and the Black Silver Coin, which controlled the rest, they made up the Big Three.'' [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 2]], Section 4.</ref>

==History==
Flanders is said to be where the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] met with the [[Reid Astrea|first Sword Saint]] and the [[Flugel|Sage]].<ref>''“According to legend, Flanders is also where the Divine Dragon Volcanica was bound in friendship to the first Sword Saint, Reid, and the Sage, Shaula.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5.</ref> Around the same time, the Divine Dragon supposedly used an unknown type of blessing ability to create earth dragons,<ref>''“Yeah, I think I’ve heard that the first earth dragons were born as some kind of blessing from the Divine Dragon about the same time.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 5.</ref> and as a result, Flanders became known as their birthplace, establishing an expansive history of industry throughout the city.<ref>''“Flanders is said to be the birthplace of earth dragons, with a long history of its industry flourishing within the city.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint Part 1|Royal Selection Life from Zero: The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint]], Section 3.</ref> It was eventually incorporated as one of Lugunica's Five Great Cities due to its dragon industry, becoming known as the Earth Dragon Capital.

Shortly after the start of the [[Royal Selection]], the [[Felt Camp]] arrived in the nearby Hakuchuri. They visited Doltero and resolved an incident in which his most trusted confidant, [[Safis]], had masterminded assassination attempts on his [[Kalifa|mistress]] and [[Ilya|daughter]] to remove his boss's weaknesses out of extreme loyalty to him. Some time later, [[Ezzo Cadner]] was swindled by [[Camberley]], who had been going on outings to Flanders from Hakuchuri, and the magician took as a position as a bodyguard for the Flower Prison Garden. Over the course of a couple of months, members of the Big Three and the Golden Beetle were attacked by assassins. Eventually, one of the Flower Prison Garden's brothels attacked by a subordinate of [[Mozolite|a member]] of the Balance, killing [[Mimosa|a prostitute]], a veteran member of the Black Silver Coin, and setting the place ablaze. With Ezzo having been framed for the arson, this led to a fight between himself and [[Reinhard van Astrea]] once [[Felt]] and her comrades had found him at an abandoned mansion. However, though Ezzo lost the fight, the two settled the misunderstanding and he worked with the Felt Camp to take care of the real arson. Following these events, Ezzo joined the Felt Camp, and the Big Three became indebted to them, collectively deciding to back Felt in the Royal Selection.

==Locations==
*'''Doltero Amule’s Mansion''' (ドルテロ・アムルの豪邸, ''Dorutero Amuru no Gōtei''): A mansion located in the heart of Flanders. It lies on a hill that contains a full view of the whole city. The mansion is owned by Doltero Amule, the head of the Black Silver Coin, and it serves as his organization’s headquarters.
*'''Red-Light District''' (花町, ''Hanamachi''): The red-light district of Flanders is a nightlife district of brothels controlled by the Flower Prison Garden. It is filled with magic crystal lamps and described to have an otherworldly ambience. The most luxurious and high-class of the Flower Prison Garden's brothels was burned down by Mozolite's subordinate.
*'''Gambling Quarter''' (賭け町, ''Kakemachi''): The gambling quarter is an area controlled by The Balance in eastern Flanders. It is populated with a multitude of gambling dens, which tend to reach peak activity at night. The quarter is surrounded by money, violence, and insanity.
**'''Grand Casino''' (大賭場, ''Dai Toba''): The Grand Casino is a large, three-story gambling den with spaces for various types of gambling games. Its first floor has a bar, and the other two floors contain the spaces reserved for gambling. The casino's master is Manfred Madison, the head of The Balance's Flanders branch.
*'''The Golden Beetle's Office''': A sales office ran by the Golden Beetle, a moneylending and loan shark business with a branch in Flanders.
*'''Abandoned Mansion''': An abandoned, run-down mansion that was confiscated by the Golden Beetle as collateral from an unnamed man who could not pay off his debt. It has two known floors.

title: Banan
wikitext:
'''Banan''' (バナン, ''Banan''), also known as the '''Second City Banan''' (第二都市バナン, ''Daini Toshi Banan''), is one of the ten major cities of [[Kararagi]].

==Information==
Banan is roughly located in the center of the Kararagi City-States. Due to its location, it receives an influx of many of Kararagi's diverse cultural aspects. Like the other cities in Kararagi, the architecture is reminiscent of early-modern Japan, and the streets contain a mixture of culture not seen in any other country.

==History==
Before becoming part of the Kararagi City-States, Banan was a small nation of its own. According to legend, [[Alec Hoshin|Hoshin]] brought the nation to ruin. He was purported to have given Banan the choice to surrender or face an all-out attack, thus creating the anecdote “'''''Hoshin was Banan’s sunset'''''”.<ref>''“‘Hoshin was Banan’s sunset’ refers to an anecdote about the legendary trader Hoshin bringing the small nation of Banan to ruin—It refers to giving the opponent two choices: surrender or face all-out attack.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 11]], Chapter 5, Section 4.</ref>

The city of Banan was home to the Chuden Company until its headquarters were moved to the Third City Ivada, and it became the Hoshin Company.

Later, shortly after the events of the [[Vollachia Empire]]’s [[Great Disaster]], the Slasher [[Zarestia]] attacked Banan with a massive windstorm, destroying half the town while searching for the thief who stole her Light Sphere, confronting [[Ricardo Welkin|Ricardo]] in the process. This incident is dubbed the Shinigami Disaster. Fortunately, none of the residents were killed, and thanks to Ricardo's decision to endure her attacks to try and reason with Zarestia, she stopped her windstorm. However, the mayor of the town, [[Riften Magoji]] had gone missing, leaving the people of the city on edge. To keep an eye on her, Ricardo to Zarestia to Riften's holding cells, and later on, [[Anastasia Hoshin]]'s group arrived in Banan. After arriving, they went to speak to Zarestia, where they learned about her missing Light Sphere and that she was a Great Spirit. During their conversation, they also learned that Zarestia was not responsible for other wind cataclysms that have been occurring, something that was confirmed when a tornado unconnected to Zarestia was seen outside of the town.

==Locations==
*'''Magoji Palace''' (マゴージ御殿): The so-called Magoji Palace is a large residence at the north side of Banan owned by Riften Magoji. It was built on a vast spread of land and has multiple tatami rooms.
*'''Destitute Quarter''' (極貧街): The destitute quarter of Banan is a populated area at the back of the city. Its residents, known as hyenas, live in extreme poverty. Slave traders frequently capture hyenas from the quarter, but despite Banan's city laws, their enslavement is overlooked.<ref>''Back when Anastasia used to live in the destitute quarter, nearly being caught by slave traders was not uncommon. Even considering Banan's city laws, the enslavement of hyenas in the destitute quarter was overlooked.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[Kararagi Girl Meets Cats Part 1|Kararagi Girl Meets Cats]], Section 6.</ref>
*'''Disposal Site''': The disposal site in Banan, commonly known as the “trash heap”, is an area where dirt and scrap is buried underground. As most people prefer staying away from the area, it is an optimal hideout for traffickers to utilize.<ref>''The “trash heap” was a common name for the disposal site meant for burying dirt and scrap under the ground. Because it was a place people preferred not to approach, nor to linger around for long, it was the most optimal choice as a hideout for traffickers.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 3]], [[Kararagi Girl Meets Cats Part 1|Kararagi Girl Meets Cats]], Section 6.</ref>
*'''Elementary School''': A school for children that teaches arithmetic, etiquette, and general education.
*'''Bathhouse''': A public bathhouse with a simple structure. It has a space like a lounge at its entrance. The bathhouse’s wide bathtubs are heated by the use of magic stones.
*'''Employment Agency''': An employment agency that the city of Banan officially recognizes. It is run by [[Crane Donahue]].
*'''Park''': A public park dotted with playgrounds. It lies in a corner of Banan.
*'''Unnamed Tavern''': A tavern at the western end of Banan. When Anastasia Hoshin was younger, she worked there as a waitress until she was hired by [[Chuden Agri]].
*'''Halibel's House''': Halibel owned a home within Banan. However, it was destroyed during Zarestia's rampage.
