title: Meteor
wikitext:
'''Meteors''' (ミーティア, ''Mītia'') are ancient tools bearing the name of shooting stars that enable people to make use of [[Magic|magic]] without employing a [[gate]].

==Information==
Meteors received their name from shooting stars, and they were given their name because they have been believed to possess the capabilities to make people's wishes come true.<ref>''“Meteors… they were named after shooting stars because they can make your wishes come true.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6]], [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch]], Section 7.</ref> Meteors allow people to use magic without opening up a gate. However, instead of being used as tools, meteors are typically exchanged as gifts.<ref>''“It’s what you call things you can use to do magic without opening up a gate, like magic users do. That said, they’re mostly used as gifts rather than tools…”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 1]], Chapter 2, Section 4.</ref> Various types of meteors with diverse functions exist, but they are generally scarce in nature. Individual meteors differ greatly from each other, and it is rare for any two of them to have the same function.<ref>''“Individual meteors differ greatly, and it is rare for any two to work precisely the same.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> Yin and Yang magic stones are also used as battery substitutes in meteors.<ref>''“Yin and Yang magic stones do exist, but those are largely used in meteor magical devices. They’re battery substitutes.”'' July 30, 2014 AskFM Q&A</ref> In antiquity and the present, the main issue underlying meteors is that they have tended to deviate from their developers’ intentions, creating trouble in the long run.<ref>''“Wishes like that were fleeting; in the long run they became a breeding ground for causing trouble, deviating from the manufacturer’s intent. Both now, and in the days of yore, that was the main issue underlying these meteors.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6]], [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch]], Section 7.</ref>.

==Types of Meteors==
===Conversation Mirror===
<gallery type="slideshow">
Meteor - Conversing Mirror.gif|thumb|250px|Subaru using a Conversation Mirror to contact Ferris.
Ketty Using a Conversation Mirror.gif|thumb|250px|Ketty activating a Conversation Mirror.
</gallery>
'''Conversation Mirrors''' (対話鏡, ''Taiwa-kyō'') are meteors that allow a user to communicate with others over a long distance by connecting with a separate Conversation Mirror, similar to a cell phone. They were created by [[Echidna]].<ref>''The tool Echidna had invented, the Conversation Mirrors, were there, but she did not carry those with herself.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By]], Chapter 1, Section 4.</ref> Though meteors are usually scarce, Conversation Mirrors are relatively common and easy to obtain.<ref>''Though meteors were scarce by nature, Conversation Mirrors were numerous among them and comparatively easy to acquire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9]], Chapter 1, Section 8.</ref> A method to reproduce Conversation Mirrors was invented, but the costs involved in doing so make the idea of mass producing them impractical.<ref>''“The manufacturing of Conversation Mirrors is an exception because a method to reproduce them has been discovered, but the costs involved make mass production simply unfeasible even for those.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> The [[Witch Cult]] often makes use of these meteors.

===Star Staff===
<gallery type="slideshow">
Meteor - Star Staff.png|thumb|right|250px|The Star Staff.
Meteor - Star Staff activated.gif|thumb|right|250px|The Star Staff being used against Lye Batenkaitos.
</gallery>
The '''Star Staff''' (星杖, ''Seijō'') is a long, white staff with a spear-like shape, made to be a simple and functional design.<ref>''It was a long, pure-white staff, shaped almost like a spear. There was no artisan's signature and no mechanisms that would draw attention. It was just a simple, functional design.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> It allows a user to effectively emit the starlight of Shario without the knowledge to put it into practice. The Star Staff releases a large destructive force when supplied with mana,<ref>''The next instant, Beatrice cracked two more crystals in her cloak and poured an absurd amount of mana into the meteor. Sensing the destructive force, Batenkaitos twisted his expression as he stepped backward.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 4.</ref> and its attack causes utter decimation, mowing down everything in its path.<ref>''Meanwhile, Felt, who was also holding the meteor, was dumbfounded as she looked at the sheer destruction wrought by the staff. Beatrice and Felt’s one attack with the meteor had landed a direct hit on Batenkaitos and mowed down everything else that was in its path.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> If there were buildings in the beam's path, a hole would blast through them, leaving lingering hot steam.<ref>''Hot steam was rising off the pavement wherever the white light had passed, and buildings in the path of the beam had a perfectly symmetrical hole blown through them in the shape of the beam.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> Its aftereffects on a person leave them with scalding hot coils of steam rising from them and horrific burns across their bodies.<ref>''――A few meters away, Batenkaitos was sprawled on the ground, coils of steam rising off him. He was unconscious with hideous burns all over, not making a sound. It was a blazing attack that burned through the entire body, and it was a coin flip whether he was still alive.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> [[Echidna]] created this meteor,<ref>''“This staff was created by Mo… by a great and wise and beautiful mage long ago to annoy a certain Dragon.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref><ref>''There was an air of admiration in her voice as Otto’s face tensed, because he was one of the few people who knew that the mother whom Beatrice was referring to was in fact a Witch who had disappeared from history.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> and according to what [[Beatrice]] heard from [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal A. Mathers]], its primary purpose was to pester the Divine Dragon, [[Volcanica]].<ref>''Though, the one who told Beatrice that was the first-generation Roswaal. Back then, he teased Beatrice in all sorts of ways, so it was possible that report was just another of his pranks. That it was an absurd weapon created with the express purpose of tormenting the Dragon, Volcanica…'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref>

===Collar of Subservience===
[[File:Meteor - Slave Collar.png|thumb|250px|A Collar of Subservience around Ricardo's neck.]]
'''Collars of Subservience''' (服従の首輪, ''Fukujū no Kubiwa''), alternatively known as '''slave collars''' (奴隷の首輪, ''dorei no kubiwa''),<ref>[[Very Very Rough Justice]]</ref> are meteors that connect with the gate of the person controlling the collar and the meteor itself. The meteor administers electric shocks and causes scalding when used. It carries a small jewel in it, and without the jewel, the meteor becomes useless. When [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]] wore a Collar of Subservience during his diplomatic trip to the Vollachia Empire, it made him feel lethargic and limited his powers to a certain extent.<ref>''“It makes me feel sort of lethargic. I can’t tell exactly how limited my power is, but I suppose you could say it works insofar as I clearly can’t use my full abilities.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 1|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 3.</ref> The collars were intended to restrain people who committed unforgivable offenses or criminals of war, but they have been misused in order to enslave and trample on others.

===Void Garb===
The '''Void Garb''' (虚影装, ''Kyokagesou'') was a meteor that [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]] loaned to [[Reisel]]. It can allow the user to create shadowy humanoid figures using their hair that can be controlled. The user shares in the shadows' senses, including in their sense of sight and pain. The Void Garb was destroyed by Reisel to prevent the recoil of his shadows from killing him.

===Beast Protection Bracelet===
The '''Beast Protection Bracelet''' (獣護輪, ''Juugorin'') is a bracelet shaped meteor that transforms the user into a beast when they sense danger, whether it is while they are conscious or unconscious. As a beast, the user gains a rapid influx of mana, making them stronger in combat at the cost the user's capability for reason.<ref>''“When it senses danger, its owner’s mana is temporarily increased, making it so their body is able to fight. The owner’s sense of reason decreases drastically in exchange, and they become similar to a beast.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6]], [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch]], Section 7.</ref> In the days of yore, the meteor was created as a resource to help humans out of pity.<ref>''The Beast Protection Bracelet had been created out of pity for humans, who back then, were putting their lives at risk even to just set up camp. It had been created to help them.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6]], [[The Witch's After Tea Party / The Requirements to be a Witch]], Section 7.</ref> However, once a person has been registered as its owner, should someone else attempt to put it on, they risk the destruction of their Gate by the influx of mana that had already been adjusted for the user. When [[Palmyra]] put it on despite it being registered to [[Colette]], she immediately went pale and started vomiting, and further exertions could have put her on the verge of life and death.

===Cloak of Concealment===
The '''Cloak of Concealment''' (姿隠しのマント, ''Shikakushi no Manto'') is a meteor that, when worn, allows a user to temporarily conceal their presence by tricking others' sense of sight. However, it cannot mask things like sound, odor, footsteps, or anything else like it.<ref>''His meteor could ultimately only trick other people’s sense of vision. It could not mask things like sound, odor and footprints. For that reason, he could not put too much stock into it.'' [[The Land of Wolves / Death unto the Weak, No Mercy 1]], Section 2.</ref> The cloak was used by [[Vincent Vollachia]].

===Insect Whistle===
The '''Insect Whistle''' (蟲笛, ''Mushibue'') is a meteor that allows its user to control and manipulate insects. Its capabilities are similar to that of a member of the Insect Cage Clan.

===White Fox's Nest===
<gallery type="slideshow">
Meteor - White Fox's Nest.jpg|White Fox's Nest.
White Foxs Nest - Trial design from within (1).jpg|Room design.
White Foxs Nest - Trial design from within (2).jpg|The Iron Door and Trial design.
White Foxs Nest - Crystal Trial.jpg|Crystal Trial.
</gallery>
The '''White Fox's Nest''' (白狐の巣, ''Byakko no Su'') is a meteor that captures a person and makes them do a trial based on the owner's magical experience and mana. The target cannot escape unless the trial is finished, and the target cannot die within the trial either. When Ezzo used it against Subaru and Rem, thinking they were Roswaal and Ram, the design of the inside of the meteor was a plain white room with white walls on all four sides and a crystal in the middle. When a person entered a room, the iron door behind them closed and did not open until the trial ended. [[Ezzo Cadner|Ezzo]] forced them to challenge four trials in order to get out of the meteor. In order for the trials to end, the crystal had to be destroyed.

===Crystal Palace Meteor===
The [[Crystal Palace]] in the [[Lupugana|Imperial Capital of Lupugana]] contained within it an enormous meteor that managed the castle, including a magic core that acted as its heart. Upon the removal of the magic core during the [[Great Disaster]], the rest of the meteor, which remained intact, had its defense mechanisms exploited by [[Sphinx]] in order to change the Crystal Palace's form into that of a “giant magic crystal soldier”. This ultimately ended with the Crystal Palace and the meteor being destroyed by several members of the imperial family and the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]], with only the magic core surviving the disaster.

====[[Moguro Hagane]]====
'''[[Moguro Hagane]]''' (モグロ・ハガネ, ''Moguro Hagane'') is the Eighth of the [[Imperial Army#Nine Divine Generals|Nine Divine Generals]] in the [[Vollachia Empire|Sacred Vollachia Empire]] and a living meteor who governed the Crystal Palace as its '''magic core''' (魔核, ''ma kaku''), the heart of the Crystal Palace's meteor as a whole.<ref>''For those who painted over the picture, the main reason why it could not be swayed, no matter what they did, was Moguro Hagane―― no, it was the meteor which governed the Crystal Palace, the heart of the Vollachia Empire.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3.</ref><ref>''Their main body was the magic core, which served as the meteor's heart, whereas the form which everyone recognized as Moguro Hagane of the Nine Divine Generals was merely a single part of that colossal meteor.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 38]], Chapter 5, Section 8.</ref> After the castle's construction, due to the high density of mana absorbed by the rare mana stones used in its makeup, the magic core controlling it eventually gained a spirit of its own,<ref>''The Crystal Palace, the center of the Imperial Capital of Lupugana and the symbol of the entire Vollachia Empire, was not just a fortress of unparalleled offensive and defensive capabilities, but had concentrated so much mana that it had become a sort of spirit in its own right.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 4]], [[Royal Selection Prequel, Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed Part 2|Royal Selection Prequel: Imperial Diplomacy of Bloodshed]], Section 10.</ref> becoming Moguro Hagane. As a meteor, they were influenced by the one who sat upon the Crystal Palace’s throne.<ref>''Then, the one to direct Moguro to return from far away had been the one who sat upon the throne possessing the function of exerting influence on the meteor; none other than Chisha Gold could have done so.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 33]], Chapter 5, Section 2.</ref> They had colossal toughness, a whirlwind fighting style, and an ability to alter the shape of their body. As long as Moguro’s true body, the magic core of the Crystal Palace itself, remained intact, they could not be completely defeated.<ref>''Even if that happened, as long as Moguro’s true body of the Crystal Palace was going strong, then neither would the Steelman, Moguro Hagane, be defeated, nor would the third bastion be overcome.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 32]], Chapter 9, Section 3.</ref> While the consciousness of Moguro themselves lays in the magic core, the rest of the meteor within the Crystal Palace could be used without it. Amidst the chaos of the Great Disaster, the magic core exploded, and afterward, it was discovered to have survived the explosion at the cost of having Moguro's memories reverted to zero.

===Broadcast Meteor===
This meteor, a device shaped like a pipe organ, allows someone's voice to be spread across a large distance via broadcasts. It is designed the enhance a user's voice and only relies on magic stones as its battery.<ref>''The device he spotted was designed for expanding and enhancing the user’s voice, increasing the range of its reach. Relying only upon magic stones for its power source, this was a “machine” shaped like a pipe organ.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 5, Section 5.</ref> The broadcasts from this meteor have an important role in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunican]] city of [[Priestella]], where they broadcast to everyone across the city in preparation for any potential emergencies as a result of the limited escape routes that the city has to offer.<ref>''“I have heard it is preparation for emergencies. Given the construction of the city, there are very few evacuation routes available, so people familiarized them with broadcasts in hopes of avoiding a general panic in case of a real emergency.”''</ref>

===Priestella's Control Towers===
In Priestella, the control towers that occupy the four cardinal directions in each of the four districts are meteors. They regulate the amount of water and flow rate of water within the city by using water magic stones to control the currents. Furthermore, the city’s watergates are controlled inside the towers.<ref>''“Those are the control towers that regulate the flow of water inside the city. Apparently, the towers themselves are complex meteors that use the power of water magic stones to control the current. It seems like the city’s huge watergates are operated there, too.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 2, Section 6.</ref><ref>''These structures were administration facilities that regulated the amount of water as well as the flow rate of the city’s always-running waterways. They occupied the cardinal directions, with one each in the north, south, east, and west.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 17]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref>

===Fireball-Spewing Meteor===
A ring-shaped meteor with a limited quantity of magic sealed within it. The jewel on the ring releases a fireball when it is activated, and the meteor must be kissed in order for it to acknowledge a holder. One copy of the meteor was given to [[Berstetz Fondalfon]] as a mark of being Vollachia's Prime Minister, and Vincent Vollachia owned two other copies for the sake of self-defense.

===Door Meteor===
This meteor appears as a black door with strange patterns marked into its surface, a blue crystal in the middle of it, and an overall eerie air. The material it was made from looks like iron from a glance.<ref>''There was a black wall in front of him, blocking the way to the deepest part of the cave. The wall was practically crammed between the rocky passage, with patterns grooved into its surface and a blue crystal in its middle. Though the material it was made of resembled iron at first glance, its stygian appearance gave it an uncannily creepy and oppressive look.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 15.</ref> When a condition is set on the door, it cannot be opened unless said condition is fulfilled. In one case, this meteor variant was fine-tuned to use a song sung by [[Liliana Masquerade]] as its key.<ref>''“…So this is the door that’s sealed by the song. What a troublesome meteor.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 15.</ref><ref>''“This contraption sets specific conditions ‘n won’t move unless they’re fulfilled. It doesn’t have to always be a song, but this door’s fine-tuned to use the lil’ lady’s song as its key.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 15.</ref>

===Hair Bobble Meteor===
This meteor is a hair bobble that comes in a set of two. So long as one of the hair bobbles is held, it can determine where the other is, no matter the distance between them.<ref>''“It seems like the hair bobble he gave Liliana-sama was a meteor that came as a set of two. Apparently, so long as each of them holds one, it has the ability to tell you where the other is, no matter how far apart they are.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero Episode 3|A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero]], Section 17.</ref> Liliana Masquerade and [[Kiritaka Muse]] own a set of these meteors.

===Tube-Shaped Meteor===
This meteor is a tube-shaped device that has the power to amplify magic. The strength of magic unleashed through this device can be at least five times as potent as its normal level.<ref>''Right after he finished speaking, Leip threw away all pretenses and raised the short tube, unleashing his magic. Conveyed from Leip’s palm, the mana passing through the tube gained overwhelming power. The strength of the magic emerging from the end of the meteor had swollen to over five times its normal level.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 1]], [[The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star]], Section 7.</ref> This meteor was previously used by [[Leip Barielle]].

===Cup Meteor===
This dull-silver cup meteor could turn alcohol into a drug that alleviates pain.<ref>''“That crap is just a sham that turns alcohol into a drug to alleviate pain.”'' [[Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Drunk Father Part]], Section 2.</ref> There were rumors surrounding its effects, such as the claim that it could cure any ailments when alcohol was poured into the cup and drunk. [[Priscilla Barielle]] destroyed the cup after [[Heinkel Astrea]] discovered the rumors' fallaciousness.

===Aerial View Meteor===
This meteor, set throughout various distant-seeing platforms in the [[Kararagi|Kararagi City-States]], allows a person to specify a location and view it from directly above. There is a limit to the distance that can be seen with this meteor, and it is difficult to keep track of moving things with due to the meteor's properties.

===Pearl Meteor===
This meteor is a pearl that can change color depending on the magic affinity of what it was placed on.<ref>''And then, Audrey picked up the meteor, a pearl that changed color based on the magic element of the object it was placed on, on the lap of the person next to her.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 6]], [[The Three Idiots Set Out! Cursed Goddess Statue Episode Part 3|The Three Idiots Set Out! Cursed Goddess Statue Episode]], Section 18.</ref> For example, if the pearl was placed on someone who had Yin Magic, it would change to a black color.

===Protective Meteor===
This meteor, located in [[Miklotov McMahon]]'s mansion, is a meteor that protects the walls and floor of the room it is in, rendering it able to withstand even the fire of a [[Dragon]].

==Trivia==
*In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], meteors were named '''magical devices''' (魔法器, ''Mahō-ki'') up until [[Arc 7]].
*[[Terminology#Magicreation Tools|Magicreation Tools]], invented by [[Roswaal K. Mathers]], are known as modern-day meteors.
*Around 300 years ago, in the Vollachia Empire, meteors were known as '''magic tools''' (魔具, ''magu'').
*[[Roswaal J. Mathers]] speculated that a dagger once owned by Leip Barielle was a meteor.<ref>''Assured of Roswaal’s identity, the knight returned his dagger to its sheath. She didn’t recognize the weapon. Most likely, it was a meteor, a magical item capable of tremendous power. Roswaal made no mention of this and looked past Leip.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Sixth Stanza, Section 11.</ref>
*The [[Witch#Witch of Greed, Echidna|Witch of Greed]], Echidna, is the only known individual who demonstrated the capacity to create meteors. Her Star Staff and the Conversation Mirrors are the only two variants of meteors that have been stated to be made by her.
*Two meteors have appeared in two [[Re:Zero EX]] chapters. One of them, in [[Re:Zero EX#Re: Drowning Life in Another World from Zero|Re: Drowning Life in Another World from Zero]], was [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]]'s throne in Pandemonium, which could protect the area surrounding it from attacks as powerful as a sword slash from Reinhard van Astrea. The other, in [[Re:IF|Re: Natsuki Rem in Another World from Zero]], was a photo-taking meteor in Kararagi, although the author has confirmed that photo-taking meteors also exist in Lugunica.<ref>''“They have a magical device that’s similar.”'' June 10, 2014 AskFM Q&A</ref>
*In the first few arcs of the series, Subaru often claimed that his cell phone was a meteor. Prior to negotiating with [[Crusch Karsten]] in [[Arc 3]], he made a deal with [[Russell Fellow]] to cooperate with each other in the aforementioned negotiations on the condition that he relinquish the phone once he had finished hunting the [[White Whale]].<ref>''“You were a big help, Russell. Just like I promised, I’ll give you my cell phone after we’re done hunting the White Whale.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref><ref>''Once he got ahold of Russell, whose negotiations with Crusch had similarly failed during Subaru’s third time through the loop, they agreed to help each other during the meeting. That cooperation rested on the condition that Subaru would eventually hand over his cell phone.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 7]], Chapter 1, Section 3.</ref> At some point after Arc 3's conclusion, Subaru forfeited his cell phone to Russell under Crusch's supervision.<ref>''“After the results of Arc 3, it was handed over under Crusch’s supervision.”'' July 31, 2014 AskFM Q&A</ref>
*In [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3|Sword Demon Love Story]], [[Stride Vollachia]], the former [[Witch Cult#Sin Archbishops|Sin Archbishop of Pride]], referred to his rings, which bore the ability to curse their targets, as curse tools, claiming that they would be referred to as meteors in Lugunica.<ref>''“This is the Scarlet Pinky Finger. A curse tool of considerable age… I believe in this Kingdom, you call them meteors?”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte Part 2|Sword Demon Love Story: The Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte]], Section 11.</ref> In future content, however, curse tools were not only differentiated from meteors, but the status of Stride's rings as curse tools was contradicted in the novelized version of [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6|Sword Demon Battle Ballad]].
*According to the author, rich people have any number of Conversation Mirrors to exchange information.<ref>''"“They have something similar to the Kawara-ban, they have a courier network to spread information between areas, and the rich people have any number of Conversation Mirrors to exchange information. Each of the royal candidates has information brokers spreading favorable rumors about themselves. In the Emilia Camp, too, Otto and Roswaal are hard at work.”'' October 4, 2014 AskFM Q&A.</ref>

title: Costuul
wikitext:
'''Costuul''' (コスツール, ''Kosutūru''), also known as the '''Industrial City of Costuul''' (工業都市コスツール, ''Kōgyō Toshi Kosutsūru''), is one of the Five Great Cities in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]. It is located in the western part of the country as part of the Mathers Domain.

==Information==
Of the Five Great Cities, the Industrial City of Costuul is the most modest and ordinary, with very few noteworthy sights and no tourist attractions at all.<ref>''The Industrial City of Costuul was the most modest of the Five Great Cities.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 1|Golden Siblings]], Section 3.</ref><ref>''There were no so-called tourist attractions in Costuul.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 1|Golden Siblings]], Section 3.</ref> The primary contribution to the city's prosperity are its major industry of creating [[Terminology#Magicreation Tools|magicreation tools]], items capable of tasks impossible for humans such as producing heat or creating fountains.<ref>''Magicreation Tools were the primary factor that contributed to the prosperity of the Industrial City of Costuul and made it one of the Five Great Cities. Magic stones powered Magicreation Tools and were capable of tasks that would be impossible to accomplish by human hands. These tools were used in Roswaal Manor to produce heat for the kitchen and boil water for the baths, and in the Royal Capital to create fountains, making them a major industry of Costuul.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 1|Golden Siblings]], Section 3.</ref> As the backbone of Costuul's manufacturing power, they can be found throughout the Industrial City.<ref>''Magicreation Tools were the backbone of the manufacturing power of the Industrial City of Costuul. As such, they could be found throughout the city.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 2|Golden Siblings]], Section 7.</ref> The city's value and status as one of the Five Great Cities can be attributed to its production of magicreation tools, which make it easier to manufacture and disseminate goods to others cities across the country.<ref name="value">''“The magicreation tools work faster and more accurately than manual methods, and were introduced into the factories to produce and export goods to other cities… this raised Costuul’s value, leading to it being called one of the Five Great Cities. Unlike the other four cities, it is a rare example of a city that has only recently joined the Five Great Cities.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9]], [[Golden Siblings Part 1|Golden Siblings]], Section 3.</ref>

==History==
Fifteen years before the events of the main story, [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] struck an offer with The Brotherhood and the Golden Wing Faction, two groups in the [[Royal Capital]] who held opposing beliefs. He acquired the manpower of both groups and had many members from each group move to Costuul, either to give jobs to poor slum residents or grant posts to nobles with patriotism that had nowhere to go, in order to develop, manufacture, and export the magicreation tools developed by his predecessor, [[Roswaal K. Mathers]], all throughout Lugunica. Among the residents that moved to moved to Costuul were [[Belmont]], a subordinate of [[Russell Fellow]], [[Fareed Impusen]], the leader of the Golden Wing Faction, and [[Leno Rex]], the newly-appointed leader of The Brotherhood who would be elected as the city's mayor in the years to come.

Due to the establishment of Costuul as a city where magicreation tools were manufactured and disseminated, it was able to join the Five Great Cities of Lugunica, becoming known as the Industrial City.<ref name="value" /> Furthermore, entities that came to be known as lightbugs began appearing as a phenomenon exclusive to the city due to the creation of magicreation tools.

Several months before [[Arc 1]], the lightbugs of Costuul started acting unusually, causing magicreation tools to malfunction. After the events of [[Arc 4]], the sibling duo of [[Frederica Baumann|Frederica]] and [[Garfiel Tinzel|Garfiel]] visited the city on an outing together, but were interrupted by [[Hayden Garo]], a man who, alongside [[Leonardo Baroness|his associate]], discovered a method to control lightbugs with his rare blood and made a magicreation tool malfunction at a factory. As the two of them reported the incident to Mayor Leno Rex, Hayden utilized a large magicreation tool to initiate the collapse of City Hall. After Garfiel saved everyone within City Hall before its collapse and Frederica saved the mayor, Hayden kidnapped the latter when she was alone and made other magicreation tools malfunction to prevent her brother from giving chase to him. With the arrival and assistance of [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], [[Beatrice]], and [[Emilia]], the lightbug incident within Costuul was ultimately quelled while Garfiel and [[Clind]] managed to successfully safely return Frederica from Hayden's clutches at the cost of the lionman's escape.

Following the lightbug incident, reconstruction efforts were initiated to restore the damage done to City Hall and various other areas throughout the city. 

==Locations==
*'''City Hall''': City Hall was a six-story building that had the mayor's office on the top floor. It was destroyed during the lightbug incident orchestrated by Hayden Garo.
*'''Reservoir''': A reservoir used for storing water. It is located behind City Hall.

==Residents==
*[[Leno Rex]] (mayor)
*[[Fareed Impusen]]
*[[Belmont]] (former)

==Gallery==
<gallery>
Re Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9 2.png
Re Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9 7.png
Re Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 9 8.png
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Within [[Otto's Peddling Record of Joy and Sorrow]] from [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], the “Mining City of Costuul” is mistakenly said to be a city with everlasting ores that is a major contributor to Lugunica's magic stone industry, as well as that it was rumored to have once been a [[Dragon]]’s nest. This is an error, as the Mining City in question is Ganacks, not Costuul. The other two details, however, are true for the Mining City of Ganacks, as they had previously been stated in [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]].

[[Conwood Melahau]] |commanders2 = '''[[Pandora]]''' |commanders3 = |commanders 4 = |forces1 = [[Royal Army]] subjugation force |forces2 = [[White Whale]] |forces3 = |forces4 = |casual1 = Heavy losses among the subjugation force and the death of [[Theresia van Astrea]] |casual2 = None |casual3 = |casual 4 = |civilian = }} The '''Great Conquest''' (大征伐) was the failed effort by the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] to bring down the [[White Whale]]. It was led by Sword Saint [[Theresia van Astrea]], who was assumed to have met her end by the White Whale. Unbeknownst to history, however, the [[Witches of Sin#Witch of Vainglory, Pandora|Witch of Vainglory]], [[Pandora]], was involved in the Great Conquest and the circumstances leading to Theresia's death. The repercussions of the Great Conquest incited [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm van Astrea's]] motivation to slay the White Whale, which he successfully accomplished in [[Arc 3]], and thereafter, his confrontations with the Witch Cult in [[Arc 5]]. ==Background== When the window of opportunity arose, the Kingdom of Lugunica began an effort to vanquish the White Whale. At the time the subjugation was set to occur, the commander of the Royal Guard, Wilhelm van Astrea, would be absent from the [[Royal Capital]] to conduct the search for royal princess Filore Lugunica, the daughter of [[Ford Lugunica]], in the aftermath of the [[Royal Abduction Incident]], preventing him from joining the subjugation force.''“That is not so. ――However, the Great Conquest, the effort to bring down the White Whale, included the previous Sword Saint. It took place during the time Wilhelm-sama was absent from the Royal Capital to conduct the search.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7.''The daughter of the king’s brother, Ford, had been abducted by someone, and the Royal Guard was devoting all their power to finding her. Naturally, as the Commander of the Royal Guard, Wilhelm had to fulfill his duty.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 5, Section 10. As a replacement for Wilhelm, his son, [[Heinkel Astrea|Heinkel]], was nominated to lead the subjugation instead. However, Heinkel refused to participate in the subjugation, recommending that his mother, Theresia, who had been retired from active duties for over two decades by that point, join in his place.''“…That is not the half of it. I have heard that at the time, it was Heinkel-sama who recommended that Theresia-sama, who had already laid down her sword and retired from active duty, participate in the Great Conquest.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7.''“We have records remaining from that time. The deputy commander refused to join the Great Conquest, nominating Theresia-sama to join the battle in his stead.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. Theresia accepted the nomination, much to Wilhelm's chagrin. To prevent him from abandoning his duties and joining the subjugation, Theresia shocked Wilhelm by asking if he loved her and took advantage of the momentary distraction to scratch his left shoulder, giving him a wound that would never stop bleeding due to the effects of her [[Theresia van Astrea#Abilities|Divine Protection of the Death God]]. Prior to her departure, she asked her husband to finally let her hear the answer to her question she had asked him so many times. ==Battle== The battle initially began with the subjugation force holding their ground against the White Whale. But unexpectedly, Theresia could not clearly remember what had happened afterwards, and the White Whale unleashed its thick fog as the force collapsed. The [[Theresia van Astrea#Abilities|Divine Protection of the Sword Saint]], which she had possessed for years, was suddenly missing. She instinctually recognized that it was transferred to Reinhard. All of a sudden, a woman with platinum hair, [[Pandora]], appeared from the fog. Theresia tried drawing the [[Terminology#Ten Enchanted Swords|Dragon Sword Reid]] from its sheath, to no avail. Opting to use the longsword at her feet, she attempted to attack the woman, retaining her previous skill with, when suddenly, the woman's voice rendered the Sword Saint unconscious. Thus, the subjugation force all but fell, the Great Conquest ended in failure, and felled was Theresia van Astrea. ==Aftermath== In the wake of the Great Conquest, the White Whale was left unscathed and continued to roam the world. The [[Witch Cult]] seized Theresia's body, making it into an [[Undead|undead]] [[Undead#Corpse Soldiers|corpse soldier]] that was placed under the command of [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]] at an unspecified time. [[Conwood Melahau]], the Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard who accompanied Theresia to the battlefield, returned the Dragon Sword Reid that Theresia left behind.''“I didn’t draw it, but I’m sure Conwood, who represents the old men, has been apologizing to Wilhelm ever since he brought back Theresia’s sword.”'' [https://twitter.com/nezumiironyanko/status/764859766657003521 Re:Zero Season 1 Episode 20 Commentary] Once the search for Filore ended without her whereabouts being discovered, Wilhelm van Astrea resigned from the Royal Guard.''“However, the facts remain that the search was aborted, the Great Conquest itself ended in failure, and Wilhelm-sama resigned from the Royal Guard.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. The Royal Guard only managed to recover from the aftereffects of the Royal Selection through the efforts of [[Marcos Gildark]], the commander who succeeded Wilhelm.''“The Royal Guard surely would not have recovered if it were not for Commander Marcos exhausting every effort to do so.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. The Sword Demon, under the impression that he lost his wife to the White Whale, solely dedicated the next 14 years of his life to studying what was known of it and seeking a chance to take revenge on it. To this end, he withdrew from [[House Astrea]] and reverted to using the name Trias, leaving Heinkel Astrea as the successor to the family. Wilhelm's relationship with his grandson Reinhard, the inheritor of the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, was also damaged. In the years following the Great Conquest, Reinhard would officially be appointed as the Sword Saint to succeed Theresia and joined the Royal Guard. Nearly fourteen years after the Great Conquest's failure, Wilhelm was unsuccessful in convincing his old friend [[Bordeaux Zergev]] to support his quest to end the White Whale’s life and was given a short daylong sentence in the Prison Tower for assaulting him. This incident was witnessed by [[Crusch Karsten]] and [[Ferris]], and after presenting his case to the duchess, he gained her assistance in hunting for the White Whale in exchange for giving her his support in the Royal Selection. Roughly a week after the Royal Selection commenced, at the end of the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], Wilhelm was successful in avenging his wife. Though he had avenged the death of his wife that had occurred during the Great Conquest, the Sword Demon did not end his quest there, as because the wound his wife gave to him before her death was reopened, he chose to pursue the Witch Cult to discover why it happened.''“Theresia van Astrea. This sword wound was opened by my wife. I must continue to pursue the Witch Cult in order to uncover the truth.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 9]], Chapter 6, Section 3. The Witch Cult's acquisition of Theresia after the Great Conquest became known during the [[Battle for Priestella]] that took place one year after the Subjugation of the White Whale. Wilhelm and the undead Theresia crossed blades twice during the battle: once at City Hall and again at the control tower in the first district. Their first bout ended without a conclusion. In the second, Wilhelm was about to deal a finishing blow onto his wife, but faltered and missed the opportunity when his son, Heinkel, witnessed the battle. With Wihelm unable to defeat Theresia, Reinhard entered the fray and concluded the battle in his grandfather's stead, finishing it in one blow with the unsheathed Dragon Sword Reid. The Sword Demon was given an opportunity to share a final farewell and confession of love with his undead wife, who regained sentience, before her body dissolved into ashes. The relationship between the three surviving Astreas was left incorrigibly broken as a result of the circumstances of Theresia's return. In the end, fifteen years after the Great Conquest ended with Theresia's death and the disappearance of her body, Wilhelm collected his wife's ashes and intended to lay them with her family's grave to give her a proper memorial.''“Even if it is only ashes, I wanted to lay her to rest in her family’s grave and have a proper memorial for her.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 6, Section 5. ==Trivia== *Before being used as an in-story term, the author came up with the name “Great Conquest” alongside “Royal Abduction Incident” upon being asked if the events had names by a fan.''"That’s true.... it’s bothersome, and I get confused, too. Hmm, let’s see. Well, the fight with the White Whale where Wilhelm’s wife died is “The Great Conquest”. The incident where Felt (maybe) was abducted is “The Royal Abduction Incident”. Was there anything else? If there was, let me know. I’ll think about it."'' November 27, 2014 AskFM Q&A ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Terminology]] [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

Zergev Squadron takes minimal casualties |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian =}} The '''Battle of Redonas Plateau''' was a minor battle that took place in the early stages of the [[Demi-Human War]]. It ended in a victory for the [[Royal Army]]. The battle marked the first battles of [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]] and [[Grimm Fauzen]], two soldiers who would go on to become members of the elite Zergev Squadron after surviving the ensuing [[Battle of Castour Field]], and later, were instrumental in preventing the Demi-Human Alliance from taking the [[Royal Capital]]. ==Prelude== The battle would occur two years after the start of the war.''The fruitless conflict had dragged on for two years now, and citizens and soldiers alike were tiring of it.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], First Stanza, Section 3. This would become the first battle engaged in by Wilhelm Trias, a runaway noble from the Trias family who enlisted in the army after making it to the Royal Capital,''Wilhelm’s reaction to this quibbling led to a white-hot fight, and the younger boy’s running away from home was in effect the final word. He fled to the Royal Capital, where he joined the Royal Army and, eventually, became the Sword Demon.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Seventh Stanza, Section 7. Grimm Fauzen, a commoner from the town of Fleur, and [[Tholter Weasily]]. In the time since their enlistments, Grimm and Tholter became close. ==Battle== The human commander, a young noble who had sought to acquire glory by attempting to launch an assault on the enemy forces, was made quick work of by the [[Demi-Human|demi-humans]], causing the humans' battle line to fall into disarray.''The commander had been a young noble who had launched himself against the enemy forces in hopes of buying a little glory, but he had been destroyed, and the battle line had fallen into disarray.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], First Stanza, Section 1. Redonas Plateau was set ablaze, the stench of charred wood and flesh, as well as the spilled blood that had oozed out those who fell in battle, permeated the air. Grimm, who had fallen into despair at seeing the chaos of the battle around him and being the only survivor of his unit, was nearly slaughtered by a demi-human until Wilhelm saved his life. The boy had, with his sword, slain numerous demi-humans, leaving a pile of them felled on the battlefield. Shortly thereafter, the Royal Army gave the signal of victory to its soldiers, signifying the end of the battle. ==Aftermath== The Battle of Redonas Plateau managed to be a strategic victory for the Royal Army, despite them suffering large casualties.''Redonas Plateau and Castour Field, there were too many casualties in those last two battles. Redonas’ battle was a strategic victory, at least, but Castour was inexcusable.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], Second Stanza, Section 2. As a result of his achievements in battle, word of the young Wilhelm Trias began to spread. He was given honors for his slaying of two commanding officers and [[Razak Gildark]] placed him into the same squadron as Grimm.''“That last engagement was his first battle, but he killed a couple of the enemy captains, and they even singled him out for honors.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 2]], First Stanza, Section 2. ==References== ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Demi-Human War]] [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

The '''Subjugation of the White Whale''' (白鯨討伐) was a hunt to end one of the Three Great Witchbeasts, the [[White Whale]], and it is one of the two core battles of [[Arc 3]]. Set roughly two months after [[Natsuki Subaru]]’s arrival into the world, shortly after the start of the [[Royal Selection]], Subaru made an alliance between the [[Emilia Camp]], [[Crusch Camp]], and [[Anastasia Camp]], using the location and means to hunt the White Whale as an offering.

With the appearance of a [[Emilia|silver-haired half elf]] as one of the Royal Candidates, the [[Witch Cult]] decided to make their move. With the [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti|Sin Archbishop of Sloth]] wishing to resurrect the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]], he decided to commence an attack in the Mathers Domain. As part of his plan, the White Whale was made to guard the Lifaus Highway between [[Arlam Village]] and the [[Royal Capital]], the eventual battleground that would mark the beast’s end.

Though this subjugation was meant to be a stepping stone towards reaching the [[Subjugation of Sloth|real battle]] that would follow, this was still a battle that signified a change that had not been seen in 400 years.

==Background==
===[[Great Conquest]]===
The Sword Demon, [[Wilhelm van Astrea]], was unable to participate in the Great Conquest in which his wife, [[Theresia van Astrea]], purportedly lost her life to the White Whale fourteen years prior to the Subjugation of the White Whale. With the love of his life lost, Wilhelm dedicated his life to pursuing the Witchbeast of the Mist, creating a rift in his relationships with his [[Heinkel Astrea|son]] and [[Reinhard van Astrea|grandson]]. After nearly fourteen years of trial and error, he presented findings that could determine the White Whale's movement patterns to his old friend [[Bordeaux Zergev]], but he failed to succeed in convincing the Mad Dog to agree. This conversation was witnessed by [[Crusch Karsten]] and [[Ferris]]. In time, the duchess gravitated towards Wilhelm and added him as a member to her camp for the upcoming Royal Selection, promising the Sword Demon the opportunity to slay his foe.

===Forging Alliances===
After experiencing a few loops with his [[Natsuki Subaru#Abilities|Return by Death]] and encountering both the White Whale and the Witch Cult, Subaru acquired the foreknowledge of what times both would emerge. Having understood [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal's]] intentions to forge an alliance with the Crusch Camp, and deducing that Crusch Karsten was aiming to slay the White Whale, he spoke with [[Rem]] and organized for her to bring [[Anastasia Hoshin]] and [[Russell Fellow]] to the Karsten Manor. That evening, Subaru met with Crusch Karsten with Rem by his side and Russell as his collaborator. In an attempt to garner an alliance with her, he, as a proxy of Roswaal L. Mathers and an envoy of Emilia, offered her the rights to the magic crystals that could be found within [[Elior Forest]], which the margrave had told Rem was allowed to be used in negotiations, and as the offer itself could not solely warrant an alliance, he revealed that he could provide the means to hunt the White Whale, which the nearby Wilhelm reacted strongly to.

Subaru then passed his cell phone off as a [[Meteor|meteor]] that would allow him to detect the time that the White Whale would appear. Though Crusch considered it to be rather convenient, she realized that he was not lying and decided to believe him. Soon after, Anastasia made an appearance in the negotiations, which Crusch seemed to believe was Subaru trying to manipulate them by involving the two candidates in a bidding war. This belief was quickly dispelled, however, when Subaru stated his intentions were to assist Crusch in her plans to subjugate the White Whale, revealing her objective to Anastasia and Russell and inciting reactions from everyone in the room.

Following more shaky negotiations, with Anastasia joining on the hunt to kill the fiend that terrorized all merchants and a chance to increase her company’s sales, Russell’s assistance in exchange for Subaru’s phone after the fight, and Crusch’s assistance in exchange for rights to mine within Elior Forest and a chance to make good on her deal with Wilhelm, an alliance between all parties was successfully made.

===Preparing for the Hunt===
The next day, following the conclusion of the negotiations, Subaru and Rem followed Ferris to choose a land dragon to ride, leading him to meeting [[Patrasche]]. Afterward, they went inside of the nearby building and met with numerous knights and mercenaries who had decided to join the fight. Such warriors included [[Ricardo Welkin]], Wilhelm, and even retired soldiers such as [[Conwood Melahau]], who had waited a long time for a rematch to make up for their loss during the Great Conquest. Soon after, he met with Crusch and Anastasia as well, who questioned Subaru’s joining in the coming battle. Subaru agreed to her question and suggested for her to use him as bait, as he has an ability to draw [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]] to himself.

[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 7 5.png|thumb|right|180x|Crusch rallying the soldiers.]]
After Crusch gave a rousing speech to the numerous soldiers and warriors there, everyone mounted the land dragon and ligers and started making their way to [[Flugel’s Tree]] on the Lifaus Highway. Along the way, Ricardo went around bringing up everyone’s spirits, as many were nervous to take on the terrifying beast. Shortly after, Subaru met with the lieutenants of the [[Iron Fang]], [[Mimi Pearlbaton]] and [[Hetaro Pearlbaton]], who pointed this out.

Eventually, everyone set up their encampment in the plains in preparation for the beast’s arrival. Deciding it necessary for the fight, as it would be in the middle of the night that the White Whale appeared, the soldiers set up a Night Banishing cannon to make sure everyone could see when the time came. Similarly, they placed magic artillery cannons at the ready so that they could fire at the beast from long range.

After Subaru and Rem spoke about her becoming his second wife and a short talk with Wilhelm about his love for his wife, they gathered with the other soldiers when it came close to the time for the White Whale to appear. After an eerie silence, the ringtone on Subaru’s phone rang, and shortly after, the White Whale appeared in all its majesty.

==Battle==
As the battle began, Subaru charged forth, having Rem cast her magic to attack the White Whale. Having fallen behind, Crusch ordered her men to attack. Firing the Night Banishing cannon, the entire battlefield was brightened as if it were midday, and soon the soldiers began unleashing numerous attacks on it. Wilhelm jumped onto it, slashing it with all of his might. Numerous spells were cast against it, the magic artillery cannons were fired at it, numerous soldiers stabbed, slashed, and bashed the White Whale, Rem crushed it with her Morningstar, and Mimi and Hetaro used the sonic howls to damage it. Furthermore, Crusch unleashed her signature skill, One Blow, One Hundred Felled, against it, leaving it with a long gash. Finally, Wilhelm carved out its eye, leaving it half blind, and leaving it open for another firing of the magic artillery cannons.

Despite their attacks having been successful, the White Whale was still flying in the air, its damage from Magic having been reduced significantly by its hair. Its eye also changed from yellow to red, signifying that it had gone into its Attack Hue. The beast started unleashing its mist against its enemies, punching holes into the ground as it attempted to kill its attackers. Despite this, Wilhelm, Ricardo, and the others continued their assault, trying to close the pores that were releasing the mist. Unable to reutilize the magic artillery cannons for a time, the Night Banishing eventually faded away, returning the battlefield to night.

The beast continued to unleash more of its mist, until eventually, it covered the entire battlefield in a layer of mist. Having managed to swat away Wilhelm, it proceeded to swallow him. It soon tried to chase after Subaru and Rem after Subaru used his Authority to lure it away from the soldiers, allowing Crusch and company to regroup. Thanks to Ricardo, they managed to escape harm at the cost of taking the injury himself. Unfortunately, many soldiers’ lives were lost within the mist and forgotten. Unleashing a roar, it mentally attacked the fighters, causing those unable to resist to break down and start injuring themselves. With Subaru’s and Ferris’s help, the effected were knocked unconscious. More unfortunately, they faced a new problem: rather than one White Whale, there were now three.

With the help of Rem, Mimi, and Hetaro, they were able to help Wilhelm escape from the inside of one of the White Whales, though he passed out soon after. With Wilhelm having been taken for medical care, Hetaro passed along a message to Subaru from Ricardo, saying the White Whale’s attacks had become lighter. Observing the White Whales around him, Subaru realized that the White Whale that was lingering above the other two and not attacking was the real body, and the other two were clones that were created so that the original could escape danger.

Subaru soon found Crusch, who was baffled that there were three White Whales, and he relayed to her his discovery, as well as a plan to lure the beast down and kill it. Though they agreed the plan was insane, they decided to use it. Crusch returned to her soldiers and revitalized them, and she prepared for the upcoming plan. Meanwhile, Rem cast Al Huma and fired the large icicle at the beast, though it missed it. That said, she accomplished her goal of getting Subaru onto the true White Whale. Standing atop the White Whale’s horn, he mocked it before jumping off and unleashing the Taboo of his Return by Death. 

[[File:Re Zero Light Novel 7 9.png|thumb|left|180x|Wilhelm facing the White Whale.]]
Enraged, the White Whale chased after the falling Subaru, who was caught midair by Rem. With the beast hot on their heels, they lured it around Flugel’s Tree, keeping it low to the ground. Giving Crusch the go-ahead, she ordered her soldiers to fire off the magic artillery cannons at the tree, causing it to collapse on top of the White Whale. With the explosion and the collapse of Flugel’s Tree, the mist produced by the White Whale completely vanished. With the Witchbeast of the Mist unable to escape, Wilhelm jumped atop it, and he unloaded a large number of attacks on it, until eventually, he delivered unto it the final blow, prompting the two White Whale copies to fade away.{{Clear}}

==Aftermath==
With the hunt concluded, the dead were all gathered together, and Ferris healed some of the injured, including the exhausted Rem, who used her exhaustion against Subaru to force him to confess his love for her. Soon after, Crusch spoke with Subaru, offering her gratitude and even a position within her camp. However, he rejected her request. That said, they still shook hands, letting them become friends in the future. Commenting that he still had more to do, he was dismayed that the battle cost so many lives. To that end, Wilhelm, grateful for Subaru giving him the revenge he sought, offered his services in the following Subjugation of Sloth.

Deciding to take the head of the beast back to the Royal Capital as proof of their victory, as well as the injured, Crusch, Rem, and Hetaro went with them, leaving half of the soldiers, Wilhelm, and Ferris there to assist Subaru. Meanwhile, reinforcements from the Iron Fang, as well as [[Julius Juukulius]], came to support Subaru in his efforts.

Unfortunately, the team returning to the Royal Capital was attacked by the Sin Archbishops of [[Regulus Corneas|Greed]] and [[Lye Batenkaitos|Gluttony]], the latter of which came to see and devour those who defeated the White Whale, and the former of which was there by coincidence. Many were killed, Crusch’s arm was severed from her body and her memories were eaten, and Rem’s name and memories were eaten, leaving her in the Sleeping Beauty state.

More than a year later, Subaru's perfectly timed involvement in this subjugation and his seeming prior knowledge to when the White Whale would appear would be used in the allegations that he held connections to the Witch Cult. Meanwhile, the cell phone that he handed Russell would be responsible for proving his identity against that very allegation.

==Trivia==
*In the Ayamatsu, Oboreru, and likely the Kararagi IF side stories, the subjugation ended in failure, and Crusch and Wilhelm were both forgotten by the world.

[[Emilia]] frozen |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Permafrost of the Great Elior Forest''' (エリオール大森林の永久凍土) is a major event that took place approximately 100 years before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world. The battle that took place here had significant impact on [[Emilia]] and [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]], the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, and it had a major influence on both the world’s geography and the events of the present day. In Emilia’s youth, the Witch of Vainglory, [[Pandora]], visited [[Elior Forest]] with the [[Witch Cult]]'s [[Regulus Corneas|Sin Archbishop of Greed]] and the [[Black Serpent]] in tow, with one goal in mind: to find the seal hidden within the forest and release whatever was held within. This conflict led to a drastic change of direction for the entire Witch Cult, as Petelgeuse, having taken in Witch Factor of Sloth, which he was incompatible with, was driven mad and became the new Sin Archbishop of Sloth. Similarly, the conflict ended when Emilia, in her grief and rage of losing her mother figure, [[Fortuna]], froze over the entire forest, herself included, leaving Pandora to take her leave after wiping Emilia’s memory, with her goal incomplete. The forest and elves remained totally frozen for the next century, and sometime after Emilia was awakened from her slumber, she made up her resolve to undo the damage, leading her to taking part in the [[Royal Selection]] and setting up the course of events that lead into the present-day story. ==Background== For as long as she could remember, Emilia lived in a room named the “princess room” until one day, a “fairy” guided her outside. She witnessed her aunt Fortuna, [[Archi Elior]], and the other elves meet with Petelgeuse, but quickly had to return to her room. A fairy returned at a later day to show her outside once again, and this time, she learned of the existence of Elior Forest's seal and was led to it by the fairy. On her way back, she adventitiously met Petelgeuse. From then on, Fortuna was less strict about keeping her cooped within her room at all times. ===The Arrival of Greed and Vainglory=== As Fortuna and Petelgeuse were walking through the forest with a playful Emilia who had learned that the “fairies” she knew were [[Spirit|lesser spirits]], they encountered a lone man standing in their path. Having come to take Fortuna as his 79th wife, he came to the forest and began his snide speech about his rights. However, Petelgeuse and Fortuna still questioned who he was, to which he called himself the Sin Archbishop of Greed, Regulus Corneas. Petelgeuse stated he had made it so that only he and those he took with him were allowed to enter the forest and asked why he was here, to which Pandora made her appearance, to the spirit’s tremendous shock, claiming that Regulus was brought there by her command. Then, she said that her goal was to open the seal and complete the ultimate goal of the Witch Cult. Intending to avenge her brother and his wife, Fortuna release several ice spells against her, piercing her body numerous spells, and dropped a block of ice on both her and Regulus. However, with Regulus complaining about his life being trampled on, he easily shattered the ice, revealing both himself and Pandora to be completely uninjured. Wishing for the two to escape, Petelgeuse had Fortuna take Emilia and run. Wishing to get rid of both of his enemies, Petelgeuse decided to pull out the Witch Factor of Sloth, and, apologizing to [[Flugel]] for his decision, he implanted the Factor into himself, something which caused Regulus some distress, and Pandora to tell him to prepare himself. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 14 8.png|thumb|right|180x|Petelgeuse confronts the Witch of Vainglory.]] After a grueling and painful transformation, Petelgeuse used his Unseen Hands to grab Regulus by his foot and slam him into the ground nearby with incredible force. Impressed by his decision, Pandora granted the spirit the title of Sloth, to which he claimed not to want. After she asked what he saw with his eyes, he claimed he saw hope and attempted to attack Pandora. However, his attack was intercepted by Regulus, who once again had taken no damage whatsoever. Deciding he needed to get rid of Greed first, Petelgeuse unleashed many invisible attacks against him. Despite his newfound strength, he merely exhausted himself as he continuously failed to injure the Sin Archbishop or even make him budge. Annoyed, Regulus released a single attack with his Authority, severing the spirit’s arm from his body. Mocking Petelgeuse, he stomped on his head and prepared to crush it under his foot. However, he was stopped when Fortuna returned and unleashed El Huma against him, sending him flying backwards. Having come back to make sure that Petelgeuse wasn’t alone, they prepared to confront Pandora again. Regulus, angered at being interrupted from killing Petelgeuse, was prepared to kill them. Pandora, however, told him to calm down, leading him to try and kill her by turning her into nothing more than a bloody mist. Despite this, she not only survived, but she sent him away and completely undid all of the damage that was caused by his appearance, with the exception of Petelgeuse taking in the Witch Factor. With all the distractions out of the way, Pandora confronted the two. ==The Great Freeze== Having been sent away by Petelgeuse, Fortuna brought the frightened Emilia to their home, where Archi was waiting for them. Fortuna intended to return to Petelgeuse’s side and tasked Archi with taking Emilia and escaping, claiming that if the seal in the forest were to be opened, the world would end this time. After saying her goodbyes to Emilia, she left, and Archi ran as fast as he could with Emilia, attempting to comfort her as she was afraid of what might happen to Fortuna and Geuse. They met one of Petelgeuse's fingers, a member of the Romanée-Conti family, along the way. However, the Black Serpent, which Pandora had led there, managed to attack the finger, killing him, and then hit Archi’s leg, corrupting it with some form of disease. Severing his leg and freezing it, he told Emilia that he was fine and created an illusion of flowers, telling Emilia to run in that path and that he would catch up. With Emilia gone, the disease took over his entire body. Running as fast as she could, Emilia, guided by the lesser spirits that had helped her before, eventually found her way to the giant pair of doors that she had found before, where she found Pandora waiting for her. Pandora, who had been responsible for manipulating the lesser spirits, attempted to persuade Emilia with opening the seal, helping her to see the key that she was unaware she had. With Pandora attempting to push her into opening the seal, Emilia said that she had made a promise with Fortuna not to come near the seal, which Pandora found to be admirable. Soon after, Fortuna arrived and attempted to kill Pandora again to protect Emilia. However, with every successful attack seemingly managing to kill the [[Witch]], she merely appeared nearby, apparently unaffected. She even used an illusion to make it appear as though Fortuna slapped Emilia, toying with her the entire time. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 14 10.png|thumb|left|180x|Fortuna is killed.]] As Fortuna stated her resolve to keep the Witch from the seal and protect Emilia, Petelgeuse appeared, his vision red with his own blood. Using his Unseen Hands, he attempted to kill Pandora with a sneak attack. However, after apparently piercing through her, the illusion he was under faded, and it was revealed that he had instead struck Fortuna, leading Petelgeuse to breaking down. With Fortuna dying, she tried to comfort Emilia as she passed. Pandora appeared behind Emilia and said that the person which she made the promise with was now dead and that the promise no longer needed to be upheld, intending to use this to have her open the seal. Pandora’s attempt backfired dramatically. After taking Fortuna’s hairpin into her hair, Emilia told Pandora to die and attacked her with ice. Though Pandora survived and attempted to persuade her again, Emilia ignored her and told her to die again, proceeding to attack her with yet another attack. Realizing that her attempt did not go as planned, Pandora was told to die repetitively and received many fatal attacks: being crushed between ice, pierced by a beautiful ice structure, completely frozen over, to name a few. Unfortunately, Emilia could no longer her own power and merely continued to yell at the Witch to die, unleashing an intense cold from her body. With the tremendous amount of power she held within her body, which Pandora claimed to be even stronger than her own, Emilia accidentally froze over the entire forest, freezing all of the remaining elves completely solid. The ice even started to freeze over her own small body. Pandora decided to completely wipe her memory of this day, putting Emilia in a trance of sorts as her power continued to run wild. Leaving Emilia to freeze over, she walked over to Petelgeuse, who was still in the maddening sadness of having killed Fortuna himself. Whispering something into his ear, she finally drove the spirit fully mad, and she left with him in tow. In the end, Emilia was left completely frozen over, and the forest and the people within were completely coated with ice and snow. ==Aftermath== Directly following the permafrost of the forest, [[Puck]] found Emilia, and he would proceed to spend decades watching over her until eventually unfreezing her. The [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] maintained the belief that the permafrost of the forest to have been caused by a great spirit, and so they decided against treading there to not rouse the spirit's anger. Petelgeuse delved into insanity, becoming the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, which effectively extinguished the Witch Cult's moderate faction. The incident, serving as an example of Emilia's power, came to influence the conflict between Puck and [[Melakuera]] nine decades later, culminating in The Day of Red Earth and Sky. Around one hundred years after Emilia and the forest's permafrost,''“Apparently, it was about a hundred years ago.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 13]], Chapter 3, Section 4. the circumstances of said permafrost led her to joining the running for the Royal Selection at the behest of [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], her sponsor, in hopes of obtaining the Dragon's blood stored in the Royal Castle and unfreezing the elves with it. Around the time that The Day of Red Earth and Sky occurred, official records stated that the Great Elior Forest's permafrost had persisted for over one hundred years.''In the northeast in the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, the Great Elior Forest was known as the Frozen Forest. Within Lugunica, this forest was considered to be an extremely unusual environment, and according to records, its peculiarities had persisted for over a hundred years.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Bonds of Ice]], Chapter 2, Section 1. During the [[Battle for Priestella]], Regulus, having served as a Sin Archbishop for over a century and an indeterminate number of decades in total by that point,''I’ve been doing this for years, decades, a century and some decades, and unlike those other fools, I’ve carried out everything right as a Sin Archbishop.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 19]], Chapter 6, Section 1. would meet Emilia once again, taking her as a replacement for Fortuna, whom he had originally sought to make into his 79th wife. Though initially not recognizing her, after having the secret to his Authority discovered with the combined efforts of her and [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]], and being sent into the underground of Priestella by [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]], he finally realized who she was. In his last moments before drowning, he could not bear to imagine the influence his death would have on her and the possibility of her celebrating getting revenge for Fortuna and Petelgeuse by defeating him. However, in a twist of irony, Emilia did not remember where she had met Regulus from. ==Trivia== *In the nineteenth chapter of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]] release of [[Arc 3]], during the Royal Selection Ceremony, Roswaal stated that the permafrost suddenly occurred a hundred years ago. However, mentions of the time at which the forest's permafrost occurred were moved to [[Arc 4]] in the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (light novel)|light novel]]. *In the web novel version of Choose Me, Puck told [[Beatrice]] that he spent three centuries wandering the world until he found Emilia.''“After I left you, I spent about three hundred years wandering the world before I finally found Lia. I’m not sure what you’re waiting for, Betty, but I know your wish will come true.”'' [[Arc 4]], Chapter 129, Section 3. However, this was cut from [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 15|Volume 15]], and the only indication of Puck being within the forest during the century that Emilia was frozen for most of was in the [[Anastasia Camp]] chapter of [[Re:Zero Another Memory Snow|Another Memory Snow]], where Julius recounts a story from his grandfather about a “Phantom Father of the Snow” while he was along the border between Lugunica and [[Gusteko]]. ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Terminology]]
