[[Witchbeast|Witchbeasts]] slaughtered |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Pleiades Watchtower Expedition''' (''unofficial name'') was an event that took place roughly one year and five months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world. It is the primary conflict of [[Arc 6]]. In the wake of the [[Battle for Priestella]], numerous people were left in the Sleeping Beauty state and forgotten, as well as physically altered, by the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony and [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Lust]] respectively. With the intent to return those afflicted to normal as well as return [[Anastasia Hoshin]] to her body, the [[Emilia Camp]] and select members of the [[Anastasia Camp]] decided to embark on a journey to the [[Pleiades Watchtower]], where the [[Flugel|Sage]] was rumored to still live, in an effort to potentially glean answers from him. Though the group successfully managed to reach the tower, a feat even the Sword Saint [[Reinhard van Astrea]] failed to accomplish, they were assailed by numerous challenges throughout its conquering: the Star Guardian [[Shaula]], the trials’ caretakers, Subaru’s memory loss, a potential traitor, the Sin Archbishops of Gluttony invading the tower to take Subaru for themselves, an army of [[Witchbeast|witchbeasts]] being led by the gluttonies who were attracted to the scent of the Witch on Subaru, and even the shadow of the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]]. Although in the end they managed to fully conquer the tower and even successfully forced Lye to spit up the names he’d devoured, another problem presented itself when [[Spica|Rui]] manifested, and she, Subaru, and [[Rem]] were taken away by the Witch’s shadow. ==Background== ===Creation of the Watchtower=== After the Witch of Envy was sealed away by the Sage, the [[Reid Astrea|Sword Saint]], and the [[Volcanica|Divine Dragon]] after the [[Great Calamity]], Flugel created the Pleiades Watchtower to watch over her seal, which was said to be near the Great Waterfall. Using Reid’s soul, his own knowledge, and Volcanica’s presence, the trials were complete, and he left a certain plaque with the handprints of himself and his friends on the top of the tower. After he left Shaula as the guardian of the tower and asked her to wait for his return, Flugel disappeared completely from history. After his disappearance, the seventh floor of the tower known as Merope was created, and its purpose and location was left known only to Shaula. At some point, thanks to Flugel pushing all of his achievements onto Shaula, she became recognized as the Sage rather than Flugel. Sometime later, Reid died of old age. ===Previous Expeditions=== Over the centuries, numerous people attempted to cross into the [[Augria Sand Dunes]] in order to obtain either the help of the Sage or information from him, as it was rumored that the Sage continued to live in the Pleiades Watchtower. All of these expeditions ended in failure, either via the deaths of all who went or their depressing return. One such expedition, as recent as a year before the [[Royal Selection]], saw the current generation’s Sword Saint, Reinhard van Astrea, attempt to traverse the sands and reach the tower in order to potentially save the dying Royal family of [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Lugunica]]. However, though the Witch’s miasma and the witchbeasts presented no issue to the man, he could not find a way to overcome the barrier known as Sand Time, and he was forced to retreat back to Lugunica. ===Greed and Gluttony’s Attack=== Following the successful [[Subjugation of the White Whale]], after Subaru set off for the [[Subjugation of Sloth]], [[Crusch Karsten]] and Rem attempted to return to the [[Royal Capital]] with the injured and confirm the death of the [[White Whale]] with the government. However, the party was ambushed by the Sin Archbishops of [[Regulus Corneas|Greed]] and [[Lye Batenkaitos|Gluttony]]. The ambush resulted in the deaths of the majority of the soldiers, Crusch being injured and having her memories devoured, and Rem having her name and memories devoured by Lye. As a result of this, Lye obtained an obsession with devouring Subaru, influenced both by his Authority and Rem’s memories. ===[[Battle for Priestella]]=== A year after the Royal Selection began, Anastasia invited the different camps to the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]] in order to boost relations with them. While all of the camps, including the [[Priscilla Camp]] who had arrived uninvited, managed to make it to the city, the [[Witch Cult]] also made their move, taking over the city for the day. The Royal Candidates ultimately succeeded in defeating the Witch Cult, successfully arresting [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]] and killing Regulus Corneas, with Subaru taking the latter’s Witch Factor of Greed for himself. However, there were numerous victims left behind by the attack: many lost their names and memories, [[Joshua Juukulius]] losing both while [[Julius Juukulius]] lost his name; many were left malformed into giant flies and even a dragon by Capella Emerada Lugunica, with both Subaru and Crusch Karsten being cursed by her, the latter of which was left bedridden; Anastasia locked herself inside her Od, leaving control of her body to [[Eridna]], her artificial spirit. With a need to discover a way to undo the damage, Eridna provided a solution: to go to the Pleiades Watchtower and gain the assistance of the Sage, With their course set, the Emilia Camp, Eridna, and Julius returned to the Mathers Domain, where they met with [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] to discuss the matter at hand. There, they decided to take [[Meili Portroute]] with them to handle the witchbeasts, [[Ram]] decided to accompany the group, and Roswaal convinced Subaru to take Rem, whose name and memories were devoured a year earlier, on the journey with him. With [[Emilia]] tasked to provide Ram with mana in Roswaal’s place, the group set out. ==Conquering the Watchtower== ===Sand Time=== Arriving in Mirula, the town nearest the Augria Sand Dunes, Subaru and Emilia obtained information regarding the regular sandstorms known as Sand Time, the miasma coming from the tower, and the birds that were flying to and from the tower. Afterward, the group began traveling the sands, with Meili keeping the witchbeasts at bay, even keeping a sandworm under her constant command. After a few days time, they were no closer to reaching the tower than when they had originally set out. However, after concluding that the tower was protected by a barrier and that the Sand Time was the moment it was at its weakest, Subaru noticed the birds above, and he asked Ram to connect to it with her clairvoyance. After several exhausting tries over a few days, Ram managed to connect, and the group was able to follow her instructions and push through the barrier. Unfortunately, after the group came to a stop, they realized that they were before countless courtesan bears, and they could not tread lightly. Having gone through two failed loops, Subaru used his Invisible Providence to pacify the frightened [[Joseph]], and the group retreated to a safe area. There, they discussed the way forward, with Subaru mentioning a deadly light coming from the tower. Soon after, they were forced to confront this light, leading to Subaru and [[Beatrice]]’s use of an anti-magic spell. Though they successfully managed to reduce the power of the needle flying at them, they also disrupted the barrier around them, which resulted in Subaru, Ram, Eridna, and [[Patrasche]] being separated from the group. Having seen this, Shaula made her way down to retrieve them, though she was disappointed to not find Subaru there. Afterward, she led the rest of the group to the tower while she went to fetch the others. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 21 11.png|thumb|right|180x|Shaula arrives to collect Subaru.]] Beneath the sands, Subaru’s group was forced to face the tunnels ahead. Having been through another failed loop, Subaru led them down the left path, where he fell and was forced to confront a centaur witchbeast. Attempting to use the monster’s sense of hearing against it, Subaru tried to climb back up to the others, only to be interrupted. Ram jumped down as well to assist him, but she was swiftly pushed back and knocked out. Holding her in his arms, Subaru tried to use Invisible Providence again to crush the beast’s heart, only to feel his Authority’s kickback. Soon after, assistance came in the form of Shaula, who made quick work of the monster, and Subaru passed out with Ram in his arms. With Shaula retrieving them, Eridna and Patrasche followed behind, and they successfully entered the tower. ===The Trials of the Tower=== After entering the tower, the group tried numerous times to speak to Shaula. However, she would not answer them and merely waited in silence for Subaru to awaken. Later, after having placed Rem in the Green Room of the tower, everyone went to check out the first of the trials. None were able to figure out how to proceed forward, as none of them could understand the riddle presented to them. Ram awakened soon after, having been stuck in Subaru’s arms. The next day, Subaru woke up to Emilia sleeping beside him and Beatrice nearby. After emerging from the carriage, Subaru was confronted with Shaula, who finally broke her silence and pounced Subaru, leading to Emilia waking up to a misunderstanding. After gaining information from the now chatty Shaula, they learned about the rules of the tower and the names of the floors, as well as Shaula believing Subaru to be her master through scent alone, being willing to obey nearly everything he asks of her. Shortly after, Subaru visited Rem in the Green Room for a brief moment. Having Shaula lead the group to the Taygeta trial, Subaru questioned the location of the hidden floor Merope, having already put together the theme of the tower. However, Shaula could not tell him, and warned him not to pry. In the trial room, Subaru challenged the trial but struggled with it. However, upon realizing that the trial was also star themed, he and Beatrice used Murak to jump into the sky, and Subaru passed the trial, much to his irritation, and to the frustration of the others once he explained the trial. Now confronted with the Taygeta Library, Shaula offered up the true name of the Pleiades Watchtower: the Pleiades Great Library. Looking around, Subaru and Julius found books with the names [[Typhon]] and [[Balleroy Temeglyph]], respectively, allowing them to see some of their history. Realizing the books showed the history of those who died, they dubbed them Books of the Dead before moving onto the Electra trial. Touching the sword in the new room, they summoned the soul of Reid Astrea in his youth. Managing to negotiate the success of the challenge to managing to get one strike in on the Sword Saint, Emilia challenged him. Though she had a tough fight, thanks to Reid’s self-caused carelessness, she managed to land a strike. Afterward, Julius decided to step forward, as they couldn’t allow Emilia to take on the final trial alone. However, it took little time for the chopstick-wielding madman to thrash Julius, and even with Eridna trying to back him up, she failed, and both were left unconscious. With Eridna and Julius brought to the Green Room, everyone discussed how they would proceed. Unable to come to a proper conclusion, everyone decided to take a break. Julius, meanwhile, having awakened, went to challenge Reid again, only to lose just as spectacularly as before. With Subaru retrieving him, he brought Julius back to the Green Room. Later that night, Eridna had left the room. Subaru, who had also woken up and noticed her missing, went to look for her. Led by a bird to a balcony, he found Eridna, and the two spoke to each other. Though seemingly friendly enough at first as they spoke about the birds, Eridna soon questioned Subaru’s identity, having been conflicted and fearful of him over his numerous achievements over the past year, speaking with him repeatedly, knowing things that nobody else does, and witnessing others treat him as though he were a unique existence. Subaru was unable to provide an answer, and their conversation continued. Julius, however, had also made his way there, and he learned of Eridna’s existence from her and Subaru. Though shocked and confused, he still treated her properly, and he and Eridna returned to the Green Room. Afterward, Subaru, who didn’t know how to proceed, found himself before Ram, who flicked him in the head and gave him advice. After she left, Subaru came up with an idea for how to get past the second trial, and he made his way towards the Taygeta Library. ===Satiation’s Machinations=== After arriving in the Taygeta Library, Subaru searched for Reid’s Book of the Dead, hoping to find a weakness in his history. However, when he found and tried to read it, as it was empty, Subaru was brought to the Corridor of Memories, where he met with the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, [[Rui Arneb]]. Though at first she didn’t interest him even after looking through the memories of Rem which she had access to thanks to Lye, after she ate his name and memories, noticing he was still awake, she suddenly became obsessed with his memories and his life, and especially his Return by Death. Coming up with a scheme to take over his body, Rui created a clone of herself with her Witch Factor, implanted her growing feelings for Subaru into it, and attached the clone to Subaru. Locking his memories in the Corridor of Memories, she banished him and began her scheme. In the library, having temporarily taken control of Subaru’s body, she spoke with Meili, whose urge to kill Subaru had flared, and she made her question herself. The next morning, Subaru awoke without his memories of the previous year. Going through several loops in this way, he began to question himself from the past year, and he was forced to witness various coming disasters: someone wanting to kill him, someone coming to kill everyone in the tower, the arrival of witchbeasts, Reid’s traversal outside of Electra and fight with Julius, the appearance of a deadly enemy, the giant scorpion, something taking over his body, and a large shadow coming to devour the tower. After coming to terms with what he wanted to protect, he decided to handle the tower problems before his memories, as it should take precedence. He also confronted the distraught Ram and spoke of Rem. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 24 2.png|thumb|left|250px|Subaru confronts Rui in the Corridor of Memories.]] Soon after, with Emilia’s help, they managed to pacify Meili who had killed him twice, and they gained her permanent alliance. Then they headed to the Taygeta Library, where Subaru believed he’d gone before his memory loss. Shortly before entering, however, he confronted Julius and entrusted him with the task of taking care of Reid. In the library, he once again found Reid’s book, and read it. Confronting Rui again, she poked and prodded at him in an attempt to make him question his identity, and if not for the appearance of Rem in the Corridor of Memories, he would have succumbed. Angered, Rui banished him again, leaving him to her brothers. Back in the tower, conflicts began to arise, and everyone went to deal with it. Being forced to go through several loops, Subaru reconfirmed his enemies: Shaula, who transformed against her will following the tower’s rules being broken, and who he vowed to save; Reid, who would escape the Electra floor; Lye Batenkaitos, who would run away when he became disadvantaged; Rui, who could take over her brothers’ bodies; the army of witchbeasts that swarmed the tower; and the shadow, which would attack everyone while Rui was attached to Subaru. Unfortunately, after many more failed loops, Subaru exhausted himself and was left to rest in the library. With his Authority of Greed beginning to resonate, Subaru managed to find his own Books of the Dead, left there by the memories trapped in the Corridor of Memories. After catching up, having hoped to find where he’d gotten his courage before, he reached the Corridor of Memories and confronted himself. After regaining all of his memories, the part of Rui that was attached to him detached, fearful of him and how he could stay sane after experiencing death so many times. Deciding not to offer his hand, Subaru was banished from the Corridor one last time, leaving the two Ruis to fight each other. Thus, he eliminated the chance of her interference and the shadow coming for the tower. After awakening, Subaru made his way to Emilia, whose name was devoured, and providing her with proper assistance, they forced Lye back. Entrusting taking care of him to Ram and protecting Rem to Patrasche and connecting to everyone with his new ability Cor Leonis, he tasked Emilia with ending the trials by taking on the last one, while he went to handle the witchbeasts and the transformed Shaula with Beatrice and Meili. ===The Oni and Gourmet=== On the stairs of the tower, Lye was catching his breath from his previous fight. However, above him, Ram appeared, connected to Subaru’s Cor Leonis and with more access to her power. As their fight started, Ram was able to quickly overpower Lye, despite the vast experience and skill that he had accumulated. Halfway through, she realized what Subaru had done and was annoyed by his decision, and she decided to take care of the fight as soon as she could. Even as he utilized [[Dorkell]]’s Leaper, she would always find him and proceed to beat him in order to make him spit up the names he’d devoured. Even using a combination of the skills of [[Neiji Lockhart]], [[Beli Hainelga]], and an unnamed [[shinobi]], he was unable to so much as scratch her, comparing her sheer power level as comparable to Regulus. Using Leaper, he proceeded to make a temporary retreat. Using Clairvoyance, Ram searched for Lye, and soon, she found him chasing Patrasche, who had Rem on her back, and slashing at the land dragon while being aware of the Clairvoyance connection. As she made her way there, Ram confronted Lye again. However, he’d begun utilizing his Solar Eclipse, and he even took on the image of Rem to get under her skin. Shortly after, when Subaru’s connection was cut, Lye used this and his malforming body’s strength to continuously beat Ram until she knocked her through a wall. Not out of the game, she realized through Synesthesia and Roswaal’s likely intentions for Rem what she could do, and utilizing her horn within her wand, she connected herself to Rem’s unconscious self, and she regained her strength. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 25 10.png|thumb|right|180x|Ram kills Lye.]] After being beaten nearly to death, Lye used Leaper to escape. With his feelings for Ram having grown, Lye realized that the only name he wanted was hers, and he proceeded to spit up all of the names he’d eaten thus far, as they’d merely become bland side dishes to him. Soon after, he ran into Ram’s final trap: a recreation of the invisible blade technique he’d used earlier. Realizing Clairvoyance was still connected, he cut off his own hands and used the blood to convey his love, shortly before she used her wind to sever his head from his body. After a short rest with Patrasche and Rem, she left Rem in the Green Room, and she and Patrasche made their way up towards the top floor. {{Clear}} ===The Finest and the Sword Saint=== Having had a bad feeling, Julius traversed to the Electra floor, where he confronted Reid and [[Roy Alphard]]. Though Roy had been thrashed by Reid, the Sword Saint allowed him to devour his name. Unable to contain his soul, however, Roy’s body was taken over by Reid, and he and Julius confronted each other, with Eridna watching the two. Emilia passed them by as they clashed, and Reid allowed it, as she had already passed the trial and he was busy with Julius. Throughout the fight, Reid constantly had the upper hand, toying with Julius like he had before. When Julius used his cape as a distraction, Reid was impressed, though shortly after, Julius took his cape back. The two had a small argument about how he should handle his chivalric nature. With Julius deciding to maintain his appearance for the sake of others, he undid his contract with his spirits, only to reinvoke it, forging his bonds anew and helping them to evolve from quasi-spirits to proper spirits. Ready to fight again, the two clashed, with Reid wielding a proper sword and Julius even managing to remove Reid’s eyepatch. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 25 7.png|thumb|left|180x|Reid defeated.]] Seeing how Julius was prepared to reforge his bonds from scratch and regained his confidence, Eridna forcefully pulled Anastasia from out of her own Od, returning her to her body. The two watched on, giving Julius more confidence. Eventually, Roy’s body could no longer handle Reid’s soul, and his soul started to take damage, allowing Julius to land one final blow directly into Reid’s chest. Julius confirmed that it was his loss, but he gained the Sword Saint’s respect as his soul shattered and left Roy’s unconscious body on the floor. When he turned around, he confronted Anastasia again and restarted his friendship with her. Afterward, he left to assist the others. {{Clear}} ===Maia=== Reaching the top floor of the tower, Emilia found herself before the Divine Dragon itself. However, due to its senility, she was unable to properly communicate with it. Deciding to get closer to the center pillar atop the tower, she was attacked by Volcanica, forcing herself to defend. After she realized she couldn't defeat Volcanica, even with her Ice Soldiers’ assistance, she came to the conclusion that she needed to reach the very top of the center pillar, and thus, she began her climb. Volcanica, despite its size, followed after her, flying with intense speed to reach her. Unable to maintain her momentum and defend herself at the same time, she used her Ice Soldiers to fling herself higher. Before she could reach the top, she was knocked off of the pillar by the Dragon, and she was forced to hold on to its scales. However, noticing one of its inverted scales, a scar that was given to it by an old injury, Emilia used her Ice Soldiers to touch it, mistakenly believing that it might provide him comfort. As it howled in pain, she fell from its back and landed atop the pillar, where she found a certain plaque decorated with six handprints. Volcanica soon returned, mistaking Emilia for Satella and speaking with her fondly. However, when she tried to claim that she was not Satella, using her Witch moniker, Volcanica went ballistic, claiming he shouldn’t have hesitated before, and he tried to attack Emilia again. Knocked off of the pillar, Ram appeared and blasted her with wind to return to the pillar, and Patrasche’s appearance distracted Volcanica, who had called out her name. Back atop the pillar, Emilia managed to place her hand on the plaque, pacifying Volcanica and cementing her role as the tower’s administrator. With the rules completely cleared, the sky around the tower became clear, and the miasma vanished. ===The Witchbeast Masters and the Crimson Scorpion=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 25 6.png|thumb|right|180x|Subaru, Beatrice, and Meili running from the Crimson Scorpion.]] Having left Ram and Emilia to their tasks, Subaru took to the balcony, where he and Beatrice assisted Meili in holding off several witchbeasts. Nearby, Shaula was unable to keep ahold of her form, and after seeing Subaru, she turned into the giant scorpion. After knocking her off of the tower with a combination of Murak, his whip, and Meili’s witchbeasts, Subaru had Meili summon one of the centaur witchbeasts that he’d encountered earlier, and the group made their way down and traversed the sands, with Shaula following close behind them. Utilizing Subaru’s scent and Meili’s Divine Protection in combination with Subaru’s and Beatrice’s spiritual arts, not to mention Meili’s sandworm, they were able to keep the monsters and Shaula in check. Forced to keep concentrating, the three kept their eyes forward. However, thanks to Ram being forced to use even more power, Subaru was beginning to feel the kickback. After the urging of Beatrice and Meili, he decided to share the pain that he was taking from Ram with them, causing all three of them intense pain. Eventually, however, after losing control of the beast they were riding, they were kicked off, and Meili sustained a life-threatening injury, while Subaru was forced to disconnect Cor Leonis. After getting back up, Subaru reactivated Cor Leonis, and he helped Beatrice with healing Meili. Not long after, the air cleared of miasma. However, Shaula was still behind them and transformed. Enraged, Shaula entered her Attack Hue. Before they faced death, Julius, who had just taken care of Reid/Roy, appeared and protected them. Afterward, with his help, they managed to defeat Shaula. Rather than turning back, though, she instead turned into a small scorpion that no longer retained her intelligence nor personality. ==Aftermath== Following the end of the battle, Julius left Roy sealed in condensed Yin Magic, intending to bring him to the Royal Capital. Fortunately, everyone also managed to remember Emilia’s name. However, Julius remained forgotten, as his name was devoured by Roy rather than Lye. Finally calming down, Subaru passed out, crushed by the exhaustion of his memory problems, his grudge against Gluttony, the kickback of Cor Leonis, and his inability to properly save Shaula. He was left in the Green Room with Ram, Rem, Patrasche, and Meili to recover. Meanwhile, the others moved to the top floor, where they met Volcanica and learned of his senility, as well as Emilia’s new role as the tower’s administrator. In the Green Room, Subaru awoke, and he spoke with the others in the room about the death of Lye as well as the workings of the Authority of Gluttony, hoping that those afflicted would awaken. Shortly after, a bright glow appeared in the center of the room before manifesting as an unconscious Rui. When he recognized her, he and Ram were put on guard while Meili went to inform the others. Shortly after, the shadow returned and threatened to grab them all. Subaru threw Ram and Patrasche and had them leave the room while he grabbed Rem and Rui to do the same. Unfortunately, Subaru, Rem, and Rui were taken by the shadow. As it flew, Volcanica struck it, and the three were left in [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]]. Thanks to the expedition's ultimate success, after the sealed Roy was left in the Prison Tower and the respective camps involved in the expedition were preparing to leave for Vollachia to retrieve their friends, a second expedition was formed, composed of Meili, who was effectively required to pass through the Augria Sand Dunes safely, and members of the [[Felt Camp]], the results of which led to the official pardoning of Meili's crimes, the temporary supervision of the tower by [[Ezzo Cadner]] and [[Flam Remendis]], the reveal of someone spying on the tower through magically created birds, Ezzo's studying of the Books of the Dead, and the future supervision of the tower by the Lugunican government. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

Numerous [[Witch Cult]]ists killed |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian =}} The '''Subjugation of Sloth''' (怠惰の討伐) was an event that took place roughly two months after the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world. It is one of the two core battles of [[Arc 3]]. With the start of the [[Royal Selection]] underway and [[Emilia]] taking up her role as one of the five candidates, the [[Witch Cult]] finally decided to make its move. The Sin Archbishop of Sloth, [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]], and his fingers decided to launch an attack on [[Arlam Village]] and [[Roswaal Manor]] in order to treat Emilia to a trial, and to not be interrupted, they left the [[White Whale]] to guard the highway leading to the village. However, knowing what the Witch Cult was up to, Subaru gathered his allies together to prevent the coming disaster. With the successful [[Subjugation of the White Whale]] out of the way, the group, reinforced with new allies, made their way toward the village to confront Sloth before he could arrive. In the end, the subjugation was a massive success, and nobody lost their life during the attack. This marked the first win against the Witch Cult since the [[Subjugation of the Blight Dragon]], as well as a sign of great change. ==Background== ===[[Subjugation of the White Whale]]=== After experiencing a few failed loops, Subaru managed to create a successful alliance between the [[Emilia Camp|Emilia]], [[Crusch Camp|Crusch]], and [[Anastasia Camp]]s, providing them with mining rights in Elior Forest, a chance to battle the White Whale, and offering his cell phone to [[Russell Fellow]]. Afterward, Crusch began gathering a small army of knights while [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]] allowed for half of the [[Iron Fang]] to take part in the battle. As for Subaru, he and [[Rem]] went to retrieve an earth dragon for Subaru's use, and they chose [[Patrasche]]. He also had Rem write a note that would reach Roswaal Manor before them, and he entrusted it to merchants who would have been heading that way. After a speech later that night, the entire unit to take on the White Whale went to the Lifaus Highway by [[Flugel's Tree]]. After a long battle against the Great [[Witchbeast]] and losing many of their men, they were finally able to trap the beast beneath the fallen Flugel's Tree, and [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] provided the final strike to end its life. Unfortunately, a good number of the knights that were there were too injured to keep going, and the dead needed transport back to the [[Royal Capital]]. Having put her trust in him, [[Crusch Karsten|Crusch]] decided to leave some of them behind to assist Subaru, as well as [[Ferris]] and Wilhelm. Meanwhile, she would take the injured, the dead, [[Hetaro Pearlbaton|Hetaro]], Rem, and the severed head of the White Whale, as proof of its death, with her back to the capital. With their leave, new reinforcements in the form of the rest of the Iron Fang and [[Julius Juukulius]]. With everyone ready to take on Sloth, they began their discussion on how to bring him down. Unbeknownst to everyone, the team returning to the Royal Capital were ambushed by the Sin Archbishops of [[Regulus Corneas|Greed]] and [[Lye Batenkaitos|Gluttony]]. This resulted in many of them being killed or being devoured, including Crusch, who was injured and lost her memories, and Rem, whose existence was entirely forgotten. This resulted in the letter she wrote being completely wiped blank and the misunderstanding that followed. Meanwhile, Subaru, who had experienced another failed loop, made preparations for the unexplained phenomenon of the blank letter and his newfound knowledge of Petelgeuse's ability to possess others. ===Evacuation=== [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 9 5.png|thumb|right|180x|Subaru pleading with the villagers.]] On their way to the village, Subaru had a large sign hefted up for [[Ram]] to see with her clairvoyance, informing her of the letter problem and preventing her from attacking. Gaining her assistance, the group soon arrived at the village. Pleading with the villagers to evacuate the village to protect them, he managed to successfully convince them to start moving. Half of the villagers would go with Ram to the [[Sanctuary]], and half would go to the Royal Capital. Having seen this, [[Puck]], who was mad that Subaru came back despite Emilia's wishes, decided to help Subaru with his plan, realizing the danger that was coming. So that she wouldn't feel alone, Subaru asked [[Petra Leyte|Petra]] and the other kids to protect Emilia while he wasn't there, asking them not to tell her. Afterward, with Wilhelm and Ram's help, they were able to convince Emilia to evacuate with the other villagers. Subaru also tried to convince [[Beatrice]] to leave, but to no avail. Though Emilia was hesitant to ride with the other villagers, knowing about the prejudice levied toward her, Subaru, who was wearing the recognition obstruction cloak she left behind, pointed out that the kids did not mind being with her, and she left with the rest of the villagers, with Wilhelm acting as their primary guardian along with some other knights and mercenaries. ==Battle== ===Capturing the Fingers=== While Subaru was busy taking care of the village, he had [[Ricardo]], [[Mimi Pearlbaton|Mimi]], [[Tivey Pearlbaton|Tivey]], and other members of the subjugation force hunt down the other Fingers and Witch Cultists scattered throughout the various bases within the woods. Having located them all in the previous loop, Subaru marked their locations on a map and directed them. In one such base, they discovered [[Otto Suwen]] bound in a cave. After being rescued, he was tied up again by the Pearlbatons as someone suspicious and returned to the village. After setting up the evacuations, Subaru took a small unit to capture [[Ketty Muttart]], a Finger disguised as a merchant who was feeding information to other Fingers and Petelgeuse. Though perched over the village on a cliff, they managed to catch him by surprise and hold him down, retrieving his conversation mirror for themselves. After his capture, Ricardo returned with Otto, and Subaru covered for the merchant, laughing at how he got himself caught. ===The Battle Against Sloth=== With all of his Fingers taken care of, Subaru went to confront Petelgeuse, knowing the location of his primary base. Upon meeting him, he posed as someone who wished to join the Witch Cult, tricking Petelgeuse into treating him as a future comrade and getting him to talk more about his plan. However, this did not last long, and Subaru revealed that he outsmarted Petelgeuse. In the madman's rage, he attempted to kill Subaru with his Unseen Hands, but because Subaru could see it, he easily dodged. Frustrated, Petelgeuse unleashed the entirety of his Unseen Hands, but to his shock, his Authority was not divided, so he had his full force behind him, making him realize that something had happened to all of his Fingers. Taunting him, Subaru got on Patrasche's back, and they rode off. Petelgeuse quickly set off after him, using his Unseen Hands to chase after Subaru. Other Witch Cultists chased after him as well, but thanks to assistance from Mimi and Tivey, they were taken care of. Before long, Subaru arrived at his desired destination: the bottom of a cliff that he had once died at. Touching down, Petelgeuse questioned Subaru's plan for choosing this location, to which Subaru replied that he was bringing both his and Petelgeuse's worst match-up: Julius. Realizing the young man was a [[spirit]] user, Petelgeuse yelled at him in rage. Afterward, Julius cast Nect to share his senses with Subaru, allowing him to see the Unseen Hands through Subaru's eyes, much to Petelgeuse's frustration. Afterward, their battle ensued. Julius, able to cut through the Unseen Hands, was able to hold his ground, and Subaru was forced to dodge while keeping his eyes on the entire area in front of him so that Julius could react. Though Julius did take several hits, the two were able to corner Petelgeuse, forcing him to cast Ul Dona and protect himself with an earthen shield. Fortunately, by chucking a fire magic stone, he managed to completely destroy the barrier, and Julius used the smokescreen created by it to rush and stab Petelgeuse. With his body dying, he attempted to escape to Subaru's body, which also fell under Subaru's plan. Holding him back and preventing him from taking full control, Subaru attempted to state his Authority's name, summoning the [[Satella|Witch]] the evil spirit wanted to see. However, when she noticed Petelgeuse in the shadow garden that was only meant for herself and Subaru, she angrily banished him. In anguish, Petelgeuse returned to his broken body, questioning why she forgot about him. After slamming one of his Unseen Hands into the cliff above, the debris came crashing down, burying his body. ===Carriage Chase=== After returning to the village after the battle, the group came across a problem. Fire magic stones were not among the contents of the carriages. Subaru immediately recognized the threat, remembering a massive explosion from his previous loop, and he realized that the stones were being used as a bomb on one of the carriage Emilia was riding. Thankfully, when Otto offered a deal to take Subaru with him to chase down the carriages while providing him with a meeting with [[Roswaal L. Mathers]] in order to sell his oil, Subaru immediately took him up on the offer. With Julius injured and in need of healing, Ferris was forced to keep him in place. With Julius leaving Ia with Subaru, he and Otto went on their own. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 9 8.png|thumb|left|180x|Petelgeuse chasing after Subaru.]] Realizing they wouldn't make it in time at the rate that they were going, Otto decided to cut through the forest, a shortcut that would completely ignore the highway. However, after crossing a bridge along this path, Otto could hear a disturbance in the forest wildlife around him, and Subaru went to take a look. Chasing them was Petelgeuse, chasing after them with his Unseen Hands active behind him. Having realized that Subaru would be a threat to the entire Witch Cult, Petelgeuse made it his dying mission to kill Subaru. Attacking the carriage and chipping away at it, Subaru was fighting him off, tossing and shattering bottles of oil on him. Coming out onto the plains, Subaru had Ia burn the oil on Petelgeuse, setting him ablaze and making him drop his gospel. Though Petelgeuse hung tightly onto the carriage, Subaru taunted him by writing his name onto his gospel, and he threw his gospel out, causing Petelgeuse to reach for it and leave the earth dragons' Divine Protection of Wind Evasion. Barely hanging on, Subaru punched him in the face, knocking him backwards and getting him caught and run over by the carriage's wheels. With Petelgeuse dead and his Witch Factor, at some point, latching onto Subaru, he made his way toward Emilia's carriage. The villagers were under attack by other Witch Cultists, but thanks to Wilhelm's and the subjugation force's efforts, they were being repelled, and Subaru managed to successfully make it to Emilia's carriage, surprising her. Forced to ignore her surprise, he began tearing through the floorboards, finding a bag of volatile fire magic stones ready to blow. Realizing it couldn't be stopped, he made his way out of the carriage, answering Emilia that the reason he came back was because he loved her. Taking off on Patrasche, the two made it to the White Whale's beheaded corpse, and he tossed the bag in before taking off to get out of the explosion's radius, narrowly avoiding being killed but still being blown away by the blast. Thanks to Emilia, he was found, and after a short conversation upon him waking up, the two returned to the Royal Capital with everyone else. However, on their return back, when he was speaking to Emilia and Petra about Rem and the decision the two made after the Subjugation of the White Whale, Subaru was stunned to hear Emilia ask, "Who is Rem?" ==Aftermath== Upon returning to the Royal Capital, everyone bore witness to the aftermath of Greed and Gluttony's ambush, leaving Subaru and Ferris in particular devastated. By this point, the Iron Fang and Julius returned to Anastasia's side. Sometime later, as he was watching over Rem, Puck appeared, and he recognized it as the effects of the Authority of Gluttony. Entrusting Emilia's care to him for a while, Puck disappeared. Afterward, when Subaru left the room, Crusch appeared before him, her memories lost, and she brought him to a meeting between the Emilia and Crusch Camps. During the meeting, Ferris proposed severing the alliance, shocking Subaru and angering him. However, both Wilhelm and Crusch herself were against it, despite the dangers involved, and Ferris backed off. [[File:Re Zero Light Novel 9 13.png|thumb|right|180x|Rem in the Sleeping Beauty state.]] With the meeting over and the alliance between the camps secured, Subaru and Wilhelm discussed the meeting and the attack. Wilhelm revealed that a wound given to him by his [[Theresia van Astrea|deceased wife]] had reopened, leading him to want to continue investigating the Witch Cult's activities. A short while later, Subaru was in Rem's room. Thinking that he might be able to go back and prevent the attack, Subaru stabbed himself in the throat, but he went back a mere few seconds, making the entire incident permanent. After Emilia entered the room, the two talked about Rem, and Subaru asked her to turn around so he could cry. The next day, Subaru decided to return to the Mathers Domain with Emilia, Otto, Rem, and the villagers. Having given his phone to Russell and taking Patrasche as his reward for the two successful subjugations, Crusch bid her goodbyes to Subaru and Emilia, wishing to stay friends, and everyone left. At some point after this, having heard of her beloved's death, the Sin Archbishop of Wrath, [[Sirius Romanée-Conti]], recovered his body and cremated it. Afterward, she began hunting down every member of the Witch Cult connected to Petelgeuse, and she slaughtered them, refusing to believe his death and hoping to find him amongst his subordinates. Meanwhile, Subaru's perfectly timed involvement and the knowledge that Petelgeuse was a spirit that could possess other people would be used more than a year later in the accusations that he might have been involved with the Witch Cult. Likewise, thanks to the victory against Petelgeuse, [[Capella Emerada Lugunica]] began to take more drastic actions, allowing for two of her Beloved Children to escape from her and contact the [[Six Tongues]], joining them, taking on the names of [[Melty Pristis]] and [[Black Dog]], and providing them a chance to fight back against them. ==Trivia== *In the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (web novel)|web novel]], Subaru went through additional loops before he ultimately managed to overcome Petelgeuse. These loops were cut from the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (light novel)|light novels]]. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Terminology]]

title: Six Tongues
wikitext:
The '''Six Tongues''' (六枚舌, ''Roku-mai Jita'') is a secret defense organization designed to protect and support the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] from within. It is led by its director, [[Russell Fellow]].

==Information==
The Six Tongues is a secret intelligence agency created in the aftermath of the [[Demi-Human War]], dedicated to serving Lugunica from the shadows, originally made due to the prolonged nature of said war and the Kingdom's underestimation of the intelligence-gathering capacity of their enemies.<ref>''"Originally, the Six Tongues was formed in the aftermath of the Demi-Human War for the purpose of the Kingdom’s counterintelligence operations. This was because the prolonged nature of the Demi-Human War stemmed from underestimating the intelligence gathering capacity of the demi-humans."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2.</ref> Compared to the public-facing Council of Wise Men who manage the Kingdom's politics, the Six Tongues protect and support its backbone,<ref name="origins">''But, his public title did not quite convey his real onus―― while the Council of Wise Men handled the Kingdom’s government, he worked as the Kingdom’s backbone, maintaining the Kingdom’s pillars safe and erect. Forty years ago, after the Demi-Human War, a counterintelligence agency had been formed to protect the peace in the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica―― the Six Tongues, whose current director was none other than him, Russell Fellow.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 10]], [[The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint, Riot in Flanders 5|The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint / Riot in Flanders (Incident Part)]], Section 22.</ref> which they achieve through means such as spying, infiltration, and counterintelligence, and they were made with the knowledge of various abilities and equipment and the capacities to deal with them in mind.<ref>''"Indeed, such special traits, Divine Protections, or Meteors… A specialized organization equipped with knowledge of such things and the capacity to deal with them was required. It was on such grounds that the Six Tongues was founded, and I hold the position of its current Director."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2.</ref> The leader of the organization is given the title of Director, and everyone who joins the organization, including the Director, conceal their status and fabricate identities so that they can perform their duties; even using the title of chairman of the Commerce Guild is not above being used as such a cover.<ref>''"I cannot elaborate on the details that pertain to classified information, but our ultimate objective is the national defense. Those of us who serve in the organization, myself included, conceal our status, fabricate our identities, and engage in counterintelligence work. Even my title as chairman of the Royal Capital’s Commerce Guild is merely a cover to hide the truth."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2.</ref> This being said, not every person in a position of influence is a member of the Six Tongues.<ref>''"It is the result of having given careful thought to the balance of the public-facing authority and influence required. Worry not, it is not the case that all of the influential individuals throughout the Royal Capital are members of our organization."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2.</ref>

The total membership of those within the organization is unknown, as is the internal structure of the organization. However, their numbers are enough to keep tabs on those with important roles in the Kingdom, like [[Marcos Gildark]] or the members of [[House Astrea]], and to completely surround the auxiliary Astrea Manor in the [[Royal Capital]]. Their influence is enough to pull strings to have the Council of Wise Men appoint someone of their choosing to the position of Deputy Commander of the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]]. Furthermore, some of their members have been involved with infiltrating or putting a stop to criminal enterprises, as well as covertly acting in the position of an intermediary between the Big Three underground organizations that govern one of Lugunica's Five Great Cities, the [[Flanders|Earth Dragon Capital of Flanders]], to maintain balance within the city and guarantee their safe operations through moneylending. Due to the confidential nature of their work, members and associates of the Six Tongues take on various codenames when performing their secret duties, typically taking on intentionally vague titles.

Although not outright confirmed to be part of the Six Tongues, several people have acted subordinate to the current Director of the Six Tongues, Russell Fellow, as the organization's members would. In particular, Russell is well-known among certain dwellers of the Royal Capital's slums,<ref>[https://mypage.syosetu.com/mypageblog/view/userid/235132/blogkey/649383/ Web Novel Arc 3 Character Information Part 1]</ref> employing thugs living in the slums under his thumb and developing enough notoriety that [[Rom]] had known his name. Those who work with Russell, whether members of the Six Tongues themselves or thugs living in the slums, display a fear of being on the receiving end of his terrifying nature. To the members who do take part in the missions of Six Tongues, they rely on certain patterns of snapping as a form of "silent" communication.<ref>''As he spoke, Russell started snapping his fingers, and sent a complex code over to the dragon carriage using hand signals. It was a secret language unique to the Six Tongues, and since Subaru had seen it being used here and there, he had been trying to use this opportunity to learn it, but it was not really going very well.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 2.</ref> Though not known if this is a standard practice among lower-ranked members of the group, as a consequence for failing an assignment, at least one person has been tortured through a [[Curse#Six Tongues's Curse Mark|curse mark]] that was prematurely carved onto them, while another showed concern about being killed by a curse mark for failure. Furthermore, it is known that other members of the Six Tongues also bear a curse mark, and in the event that one of them is captured by an enemy to gather information, they will not hesitate to trigger the curse mark and end their own lives, preventing any information from being leaked.<ref>''"No, no, no, nothing at all I’m afraid! You see, every last one of them has been branded with a curse mark. When questioning them, if you so much as brush the heart of the matter with the tip of your nail, they end their own lives in an instant, just like that. There’s absolutely no way to get any information out of them. Such ruthless, uncompromising directives, their leader is truly a “Heartless Bastard” if there ever was one!"'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>

At present, it is unknown where the Six Tongues's current base of operations is. However, the organization owns several small outposts, both within and without the Royal Capital, that can act as the organization's temporary hideaways that can be vacated or abandoned as needed.<ref>''"No, this is nothing more than one of our several smaller outposts. It is insufficient in combatting the present might of the Beloved Children… we shall vacate before long."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 22, Section 2.</ref> One such hideaway is in among some of the largest warehouses in the Royal Capital's Commercial District, hidden in plain sight,<ref>''Rather boldly, this outpost was located among some of the largest warehouses within the Commercial District. Standing near the bulwark sectioning off the adjacent Noble District, it gave but a glimpse into the approach the Six Tongues took to concealing themselves―― blending into the scenery of the Royal Capital, and existing as a natural part of it.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 23, Section 1.</ref> while another is a hut hidden away deep in a forest. Considering this, it is likely that the organization's other small outposts are found in similar locations. It is unclear if any businesses that specific members of the organization are involved with, such as the Commerce Guild, can act as their bases or not.

==History==
===Post-Civil War Period===
In the aftermath of the Demi-Human War, following [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm Trias]]'s arrest for invading the Royal Castle during a ceremony commemorating [[Theresia van Astrea]]'s achievements in the war, he was briefly sent to the Prison Tower and met a man named [[Orphe]] there. He briefly spoke to the man, learning that he had been sentenced during the war because he was seeing six women in the Noble District, giving each one of them a different story about him and his background, which caused him to be arrested and given the nickname Six Tongues. Though he parted ways with the man nearly as soon as they began getting to know one another, he later returned to Orphe to ask for advice on Theresia's situation, promising to put in a good word for him and speed up his release in exchange for his cooperation. After Orphe's release, at Wilhelm's recommendation, [[Bordeaux Zergev]] put the man under his service, having the idea to create an organization for him and for those like him, and name it Six Tongues, after his nickname.<ref>''“It always helps to have a man with smarts like his at hand. Maybe it wouldn’t hurt to create an organization for him and those alike someday. In that case, I suppose it’d be fitting to name it Six Tongues, after him.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 3]], [[Sword Demon Love Story: Wedding Day Part 1|Sword Demon Love Story: Wedding Day]], Section 3.</ref> Not long after, the Six Tongues were formed as an intelligence service dedicated to maintaining peace in Lugunica and supporting its foundations, with Orphe becoming the leader of the organization as its Director.<ref name="origins" /><ref>''Giving him a sidelong glance, Wilhelm remembered the forenamed Six Tongues―― to think that Orphe's organization was now functioning as a part of the Kingdom's intelligence services.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 3, Section 3.</ref>

With his new position under Bordeaux's supervision, Orphe, using his tongue as his primary resource, had been permitted to do a wide range of things throughout the Royal Capital and the Kingdom as a whole, procuring information that officials such as knights would have been unable to.<ref>''“The only skill I've had in my life is smooth talk. With this tongue, I can navigate through every corner of the Royal Capital… of the Kingdom, rather. Just let me get on their good side and they'll start spilling stuff they wouldn't even tell an official.”'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> When meeting with Bordeaux and Wilhelm to discuss the Stride Faction after they had begun attacking Lugunica, he requested permission to contact remnants of the Demi-Human Alliance and interrogate them if necessary. With one of their merits being to uncover an enemy's tracks, the Six Tongues acquired the information that they had been spotted at Abiate,<ref>''Pursuing the Stride Faction would not be so straightforward without the witness report from Abiate relayed by the Six Tongues, so uncovering the enemy's tracks was their merit.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 3, Section 3.</ref> discovered that those responsible for sheltering them while they were staying hidden from view were thugs, broke mercenaries, or those who bore hostilities towards the Kingdom, the demi-humans from across the country with lingering negative sentiments against it after the Demi-Human War. Orphe relayed [[Cragrell Dawson]]'s request to speak with the Sword Saint to Wilhelm and, with the Six Tongues presided over by him, he continued to keep an eye on the remnants of the Demi-Human Alliance.<ref>''Coincidentally, while Theresia collaborated to obtain answers from Cragrell Dawson, the Six Tongues, led by Orphe, had been on the lookout for any remnants of the Demi-Human Alliance lurking throughout the country.'' [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 6]], Chapter 3, Section 6.</ref> In preparation for [[Raizo]]'s attack on [[Gionis Lugunica]]'s life, [[Roswaal J. Mathers]] suggested using [[Clind]] to counter the [[shinobi]], to which [[Miklotov McMahon]] approved and Orphe arranged the preparations for to ensure his defeat as smoothly as possible.

Since over thirty years ago, the Six Tongues have been locked in a covert battle with the [[Beloved Children]], and in this silent war, the Six Tongues has struggled to just barely keep them from having their way, simultaneously having to deal with influential figures suddenly turning traitor and providing information to other countries.

===Pre-Great Conquest Period===
Several decades later, Russell Fellow became involved with the Six Tongues at a young age, quickly acquiring a role that allowed him to act as a supervisor. He provided advice to [[Fareed Impusen]], a noble who felt burning patriotism for Lugunica, guiding him into founding the Golden Wing Party, while he sent [[Belmont]], a subordinate of his, to join the Brotherhood, a parallel organization led by Marcos Gildark, a knight who had deserted his position to support the residents of the slums.

About fifteen years before the [[Royal Selection]], following the ceremony at the Royal Castle commemorating [[Roswaal L. Mathers]]'s succession as the head of [[House Mathers]] and his inheritance of the name Roswaal, Russell had Belmont steal his golden plume, which bore a resemblance to the Golden Wing Faction's symbol. Happening upon Marcos upon attempting to pursue the boy, Roswaal was rendered unconscious, waking up and meeting Russell, who chose to accompany him to locate his missing plume, which had been taken by the Brotherhood. They eventually met with Marcos after he finished speaking with [[Heinkel Astrea]] and seeing his son [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]]. Roswaal and Marcos clashed, with the former being successful in the end once the latter lost his concentration. Later, Russell helped Roswaal form an alliance between the Brotherhood and the Golden Wing Faction led by Fareed Impusen, with a deal being reached to have them contribute to the development of the [[Costuul|Industrial City of Costuul]]. In their conversation afterwards, Roswaal insinuated to Russell that he had caught on to how the Golden Wing Faction had been truly founded, and Marcos decided to rejoin the knights.

That same night, Russell met with Belmont, ordering him to accompany Fareed and the Brotherhood, which Marcos entrusted [[Leno Rex]] to lead, to Costuul. When asked about Roswaal, he said that the noble had caught on to more than he had bargained for, having perceived Russell's involvement with the Golden Wing Faction. Belmont also informed Russell that the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing, which had been used on Marcos during his fight with Roswaal, had been detected from the Astrea Manor. The mansion was then invaded by multiple unknown assailants, and Heinkel was suspected of and questioned for potentially holding intentions of insurrection by means of the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing. Quickly realizing that his son was the only person who could have used it, having so in an attempt to aid his father with convincing Marcos to rejoin the Royal Guard, he rushed to Reinhard's room and scolded him for his actions, and the young boy, who had erased the Divine Protection forever, saw a figure outside of the mansion's window who mouthed to him a threat: that he must protect the Kingdom for his family. When getting ready to return to Costuul, Roswaal confirmed with Belmont that he could be counted on if he needed to get in touch with Russell.

Sometime later, while Russell had dropped by the Royal Magic Research Institute as was Roswaal conducting an experiment, and [[Serena Dracroy]], a noble from the [[Vollachia Empire]] who was visiting Lugunica as an envoy on official business, showed up, requesting a tour of the facility. When Roswaal left with Serena to educate her on magic, [[Minor Characters#Ilzea|Ilzea]], who had been a researcher in the Royal Magic Research Institute, was ordered by Russell to keep an eye on Roswaal's activity, worried that his enthusiasm to teach educate a noble from Vollachia in magic could lead to them making use of it in the future. However, Roswaal had been preemptively aware that Ilzea was affiliated with Russell and had a means of contacting him. Detecting a wavelength of mana that resembled Serena's magic stone earrings as she was leaving Lugunica with [[Gwain Merette|Alagar]] in custody, Roswaal, realizing she had been put in a situation where the magic stones needed to be used, requested Ilzea to get in contact with Russell. Once the situation was resolved, Alagar was allowed to remain in Lugunica so long as he hid his lineage. He assumed the new identity of Gwain Merette, and became employed by the Fellow family.

At some point within the subsequent five years, Orphe's leadership role was succeeded by Russell, who became the new Director of the Six Tongues, having held the position for over a decade to this day.<ref name="origins" />

===Hexcel Trafficking Period===
Five years before the Royal Selection, Belmont, now a young adult, had left Costuul at an indeterminate time and returned to the Royal Capital to infiltrate [[Reiner Wahrheit]]'s organization, becoming a senior member of the underground group responsible for distributing the Hexcel drug. Another member of the Six Tongues, [[Helaine Gatness]], began to work alongside [[Bikram Edditz]] and [[Julius Juukulius]] in order to take down Reiner's group. Under the pseudonym Helena, she took Julius to the slums and introduced him to [[Minor Characters#Blau|Blau]], a member of the organization, providing the man a false story about the rookie knight's identity. When they reconvened after Julius's first day infiltrating the group, he spoke of how he pretended to slay Blau and sought to have him healed, only for Bikram to deny his request. Helaine provided a sample of the Hexcel drug they found, with Bikram saying it was her task to identify their source. While acting as an insider in their group, Julius got to know Belmont and managed to rescue him from capture by the knights. In an attempt to shake up the organization, Belmont spread a rumor that he was affiliated with the knights.

Later, Julius was assigned to transport Hexcel to the Royal Capital with Belmont. However, just as the city was about to reach their sight, the members of the organization ambushed them and captured Belmont, suspecting he was a mole for the knights due to his former membership in the Brotherhood that Marcos, the knight commander, used to lead. Helaine was against rescuing Belmont upon learning of his capture. Julius attempted to convince her and Bikram otherwise, and though she resisted, after she confirmed his view that Belmont would be more beneficial to keep than Blau, they hatched a plan to save him. Using the injured Blau, she drugged him with Hexcel of potent quality, sending him on a rampage that ended with his life being cut short by Reiner's hand while Julius rescued Belmont. The plan succeeded, and Julius sent Belmont outside to a boat along a river where Bikram and Helaine retrieved him. Julius soon clashed with Reiner, ending in the knight's victory and the drug group ringleader's arrest. Another person who had infiltrated the group, a girl calling herself Adelheid, also captured Reiner's collaborator, Count [[Minor Characters#Easley Oruon|Easley Oruon]], ending their operations once and for all. With their mission complete, Helaine and Belmont prepared themselves to move to their next tasks, briefly conversing with one another after the latter's reunion with Marcos.

Following the incident, Adelheid, who had actually been Reinhard in disguise, bargained with the Six Tongues to promote his father, Heinkel, to the role of the knights' deputy commander, which was accepted. Having been confused with the decision upon initially being informed of it by Marcos, Heinkel happened upon Reinhard at a tavern in the Commoner District and voiced the belief his son had pulled strings to cause the promotion. Denying that he spoke with anyone from the Council of Wise Men, Reinhard reminded his father that accepting the position could aid with awakening [[Louanna Astrea]] from her sleep. Heinkel decided to accept the role in the end, telling Reinhard to join the knights once he turned fifteen and returning to Marcos to accept his new appointment, unaware that he had pulled strings with the Six Tongues to bring about the promotion. Following Heinkel's departure, Reinhard spoke with Belmont, informing the young man that he had gained permission to join the knights and subsequently swore he would never swing his sword for the sake of the Six Tongues.

===Royal Selection Period===
Following the death of [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]], the leader of the Beloved Children, [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mama]], was in a panic, allowing two of her children to take advantage of the chaos and escape her grasp.<ref>''"Fing…? That is incorrect, but, it did cause Mama to be rattled, and we slipped out amidst the kerfuffle… and here we are."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2.</ref> The two children, one of which included [[Melty Pristis]], were found by the Six Tongues, and began working under them, with Russell taking measures to prevent the two from betraying the organization.<ref>''"――Please do not worry yourself. I have taken proper measures to prevent any betrayal from them. On account of that, they have bought my trust… no, they have earned it."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 21, Section 2.</ref> At some point, the two escaped children began going by the names White Sheep and [[Black Dog]] respectively, and their assistance has helped the Six Tongues to get a lead on Capella.<ref>''"After we got out of the Beloved Children, and converged with Silver Fox and the others this way, we had a multitude of opportunities to trip up the enemy’s plans. And so, I think Mama took notice due to that. ――That the Six Tongues, had gotten a lead on her trail."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 22, Section 2.</ref>

By the time of the Royal Selection's commencement, the Flanders branch of the Golden Beetle, a moneylending loan shark organization with strong links to the underworld, was managed by Helaine. Around the start of the Royal Selection, [[Mozolite]], the second-in-command of the Balance, allied himself with her in an attempt to snatch the position of his boss, [[Manfred Madison]], orchestrating attacks on the Big Three and her own Golden Beetle organization with assassins and leveraging his position in his group to do so. Helaine, perceiving Mozolite's ambition and detecting that he could be easily exploited, supported his goal, believing it would be in the interest of the Six Tongues. Two months later, during a meeting with the representatives of the Big Three concerning the attacks that had been taking place, she proposed the one responsible was the Royal Selection Candidate being housed by the Sword Saint of Hakuchuri, having received reports that Felt contacted [[Doltero Amule]] and the Black Silver Coin before. As a result, the leaders of the Balance and the Flower Prison Garden, Manfred and [[Toto]], proceeded to seek courtesy visits from Felt as a means to verify her intentions, with Doltero sending his former confidant [[Safis]] to inform her of their wishes.

On a night following Felt's courtesy visits with Toto and Doltero, a subordinate of Mozolite's with an Excess Mana Circulation Constitution attacked [[Mimosa]], a student of [[Ezzo Cadner]] who worked for the Flower Prison Garden, setting the brothel she was in on fire. Although Ezzo rushed to the scene, he was rendered unconscious and framed for the arson. With the Big Three after him, he escaped from his predicament with Camberley's help and sought Helaine for his safety, offering unpublished magic theories he had created to her in exchange for an abandoned mansion to use as a safe house. Felt, Reinhard, [[Flam Remendis]], and [[Rachins Hoffman]] visited the Golden Beetle to inquire his whereabouts. Hoping to establish a professional relationship with Felt, she willingly divulged Ezzo's location. Acting as a representative of Ezzo, Rachins, accompanied by Flam, paid a visit to the gambling quarter to directly confront Helaine, who revealed she was aware of his origins as the son of the Royal Instructor, [[Rickert Hoffman]]. Initially making a bet with the unreasonable request that the name or power of the Sword Saint be lent to her, she changed her condition to something more relaxed and what was her true goal: to send a single letter to the Hoffman family with the contents of her choosing. Rachins accepted her bet and selected Shatranj as their game of choice.

During the game of Shatranj, Helaine easily outmaneuvered Rachins. However, Manfred arrived in the middle of it, calling Helaine by the same derisive Golden Pest nickname that he used to refer to her and what Rachins had said just earlier, making Helaine quickly realizing that her opponent had greeted the Tattoo Face prior to the game, with Ezzo removing the cognitive disruption mask that concealed his identity to verify that his status as a fugitive among the Big Three had been put on hold. Furthermore, she misunderstood that Rachins's condition should he win the game had been to arrange for Ezzo's escape, when in reality he never provided her with any condition. He then made six clicks of his tongue, indicating his awareness of Helaine's allegiance while simultaneously exposing it to Manfred, declaring "Shatzbort" to signal his victory in an off-board game. With her loyalty to the Six Tongues revealed, and Manfred there to ensure that she fulfilled her end of the bargain, her only option was to minimize her side's losses and take accountability for her own failure. As compensation for her loss, she provided Ezzo with the information that would allow him to avenge his fallen student, Mimosa. The Balance took Helaine into custody afterwards, quickly learning the identity of her collaborator, Mozolite, and his betrayal of their organization.

Once everything was said and done, the Golden Beetle's influence and reputation in Flanders plummeted, with its place being succeeded by Felt, and in exchange for a large compensation, the Six Tongues managed to retrieve her from the Balance, with her being taken in and imprisoned underground at an unknown location, likely in a building at the Royal Capital. She personally reported the whole situation to Russell and was subjected to torture from her curse mark in response to her insubordination, vowing to herself that she would overcome the intense pain dealt to her in order to serve him again.

Following the [[Battle for Priestella]], because she revealed herself and her [[Authority]] so publicly, the Six Tongues discovered the identity of the Mother of the Beloved Children to be Capella Emerada Lugunica. However, because of this, Capella was able to use multiple body doubles of herself to distract the Six Tongues, leading to them killing seven of them.<ref>''"――The Six Tongues has already eliminated seven Capella Emerada Lugunicas."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 22, Section 2.</ref> Thanks to the distraction, the Beloved Children were able to move more freely, until eventually, a few months after the battle, it culminated into the successful [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|subversion]] of the Lugunican government and attempted capture of the Royal Selection candidates and their camps. Because of this, after Russell had already successfully retrieved [[Ferris]] after the restoration of his master's memories and the removal of her curse, the Six Tongues sent out their operatives to retrieve [[Crusch Karsten]] after her apparent slaying of Miklotov McMahon, as well as [[Natsuki Subaru]], [[Beatrice]], and Rachins, who had been with her. After having Ferris heal Subaru and securing their assistance with the help of White Sheep and Black Dog, they made to escape from the Royal Capital alongside the other fleeing residents of the capital.

Over the following two months, with the assistance of the Royal Selection participants, they infiltrated the locations where people were replaced by impostors and removed six of them.

==Trivia==
*The name of Orphe's epithet, and by extension, the name of the Six Tongues organization, is likely derived from the Japanese phrase ''ni-mai jita'' (二枚舌), an idiomatic expression meaning to lie and contradict oneself, such as in telling someone one version of a story and another a different story.
*In the Ayamatsu IF and Oboreru IF stories, [[Otto Suwen]] became Russell's debt slave and was forced to act on his orders. It is unknown if he was considered a member of the Six Tongues.
*Despite being unaware of the Six Tongues' existence, while carrying out his first assignment as a knight, Julius perceived that Helaine was far too accustomed to her situation to be a normal citizen, believing that she was affiliated with another group that was separate from the knights. He referred to her organization as the “'''shadow knights'''” (陰の騎士団, ''in no kishi-dan'').
*Although unconfirmed if there is a relation between the Six Tongues and this individual, in [[Once Upon a Time in Astrea]], a man who dressed in all black and donned a white mask attempted to pursue Louanna Hartley, as she had witnessed an attack on a man by an unknown assailant, the aforementioned masked man. The next day, he attempted to launch a dagger at Louanna while she was speaking to Heinkel Astrea, whose right arm was pierced by the dagger after intercepting it. The man knew who Heinkel was, said he had no intention of harming him, and was somehow aware of the young man's humiliation during his first deployment as a knight. After he affirmed himself as a member of [[House Astrea]] and said that he would take Louanna as his fiancée, the man relented and had the two return the dagger that had pierced Heinkel before withdrawing. Following the incident, an individual claiming to be the perpetrator turned themselves in, testifying that Louanna had witnessed a silencing carried out by a human trafficking organization, and that he decided to turn himself in after failing to silence her and getting Heinkel Astrea involved. However, Heinkel was uncertain that the masked man was truly from a human trafficking organization, as his actions seemed to be far too methodical and his sense of duty was similar to that of a knight's.
*Members of the Beloved Children have speculated that Roswaal was a candidate for the leader of the Six Tongues.<ref>''"…What about the person who was our top suspect for the leader of the Six Tongues? That, um, Margrave of the Western Lands…"'' [[Arc 10]], Interlude 2.</ref>
*Despite his reach all over Lugunica, as of the events of Arc 10, Russell was unable to plant any members of the Six Tongues within Roswaal's vicinity.<ref>''"Unfortunately, it would seem that even the third and the fourth have been crushed. To begin with, I was unable to position any members of the Six Tongues in Roswaal’s vicinity, so his whereabouts are truly unknown to me."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 1.</ref>
