Mathers]] |forces2 = [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarm]] Pack |forces3 = |forces4 = |casual1 = [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] injured and cursed |casual2 = [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarms]] slaughtered |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = }} The '''Wolgarm Incident''' (''unofficial name'') is an event that took place within the week following the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] to the world. It was the primary conflict of [[Arc 2]]. As Subaru started working at the [[Roswaal Manor]] as a butler, [[Meili Portroute]] received orders to stir chaos in the area around the manor and [[Arlam Village]]. This led to the kidnapping and [[Curse#Wolgarm Curse|cursing]] of the Arlam Villagers' children. Realizing the danger, the servants of [[House Mathers]] left for the forest outside the village to resolve the matter. In the end, though Subaru received numerous curses from the [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarms]] and they were forced to retrieve [[Rem]], who had gone on a rampage against the [[witchbeast]]s, the Wolgarms, who had been manipulated by the assassin's [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection]], were annihilated when the [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Margrave]] returned to his Domain. However, they failed to capture the assassin. ==Background== ===[[Loot House Incident]]=== In the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]'s [[Royal Capital]], Subaru, who had been summoned to the world and learned of his strange power of Return by Death, had gotten himself involved with the conflict in the Loot House, where he, alongside [[Emilia]], [[Reinhard van Astrea]], [[Felt]], and [[Rom]], were forced to fight off the assassin [[Elsa Granhiert]]. Though they managed to succeed, Subaru received a heavy injury while defending Emilia, and as a result of this and the fight prior, Emilia decided to return to Roswaal Manor with him, both to treat his injuries and to ask him about his intentions. Meanwhile, Elsa, who was forced to retreat, met back up with her partner, Meili, where she had to have her wounds patched up. After Elsa retrieved clothes from someone she killed, she and Meili, with the help of a part of one of Meili's witchbeasts, managed to escape from the Royal Capital. However, Meili revealed that she had received an order from [[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]], telling her to cause havoc in the area around Roswaal Manor. ===The Search for the Curse Arts User=== Following Subaru's arrival at the manor, he was healed. His presence caused disturbance for Rem, who could smell the scent of the [[Witch]] on him, and for the [[Spirit#Great Spirit|Great Spirit]] [[Beatrice]], she was annoyed by the commotion he caused, which led to her playing a prank on him. When Subaru awoke in an unfamiliar room, he fell prey to her prank but saw through it rather quickly, and after entering the Forbidden Library and interacting with Beatrice, she knocked him unconscious by draining his mana. However, his awakening after meeting Beatrice became his checkpoint. Having gone through a few loops, his knowledge had expanded: he knew how to cast Shamak, discovered the effects of a Bokko Fruit, learned the basics of how to read and write the world's language from [[Ram]], experienced the sensation of a [[curse]], found himself on the receiving end of Rem's, and even Ram's, hostility, came to understand that the scent of the [[Witch]] on him was the same as what was exuded from the [[Witch Cult]] members, discovered one of the penalties of trying to reveal his power, and the kindness of the twins in his time of fear. Coming to realize that the residents of the manor were in danger, Subaru became a butler for Roswaal Manor. Thanks to Emilia calming his panicked mind, Subaru was able to properly research curses. Understanding that the user usually needed to touch their target, he and Rem went to the village, where he repeated events and let all the people who had touched him prior do so again so he could figure out who the curse arts user was. Afterward, as he returned from the village, Roswaal was dressed up and ready to leave, leaving the care of everyone to Subaru. Later that night, when he spoke to Beatrice again, she revealed the curse came from a bite on his hand, which he had received from a small puppy near the village. With the curse dispersed, he went to speak with the twins, and with Rem, they went to the village to take care of the problem. Meanwhile, the children of the village, having already befriended Meili, followed her into the forest when the puppy seemingly ran away. After an hour, [[Petra Leyte]], the effective leader of the children, attempted to have them return to the village. However, Meili also decided it was time to do her job, and she had a Wolgarm attack the children, causing them to black out. ==Battle== ===The Search for the Children=== After arriving in the village, Subaru and Rem discovered the villagers awake and looking around for the children of the village, all of whom had vanished. Thinking that it might have been associated with the puppy, Subaru led Rem and a villager to a fence, where they discovered that the barrier around the village had been tampered with. As he and Rem left to find the children, Ram, who arrived in the village later, took care of fixing the barrier, deciding to make sure that no faults were found overnight. A short while after crossing the fence, they found most of the children in an exposed area, having each been cursed. One of the children, Petra, told them that the girl with blue hair was taken deeper into the forest. Trusting Rem to take care of the children and letting her know that he understood why she did not trust him, he informed her that he would go to quickly retrieve the girl and was hoping to see Rem catch up. [[File:A Group of Wolgarm Attacks Subaru.gif|thumb|right|250px|Subaru confronts the Wolgarm pack.]] After separating from Rem, he found Meili unconscious by a log. However, he was ambushed by a fully grown Wolgarm. Wrapping his jacket around his arm to protect it, he blocked its pounce and impaled it on a broken limb on the log. Despite this, he found himself surrounded by the rest of the pack. As they pounced, Rem appeared to protect him, and the two proceeded to escape. When the puppy, the Boss Wolgarm, caused the earth beneath them to attack, Rem pushed Subaru out of the way, exposed her horn, and attacked the Wolgarms. As Subaru saw Rem about to be attacked from behind, he set Meili down and pushed Rem out of the way. Though she almost pulled him with her, because of the scent of the Witch, she hesitated, and Subaru received numerous bites from the Wolgarms. After she killed them, he blacked out. While pleading for him not to die, Rem grabbed Subaru and Meili, and she retreated to the village. ===The Recovery of Rem=== With everyone returned to the village, the children had their curses removed. However, in Subaru's case, though Emilia was able to heal his injuries, the curses were too numerous, meaning that they could no longer be removed. With the only solution to save Subaru being to slaughter the Wolgarms that bit him, Rem immediately went to the forest, her horn exposed as she went on a mad and desperate rampage against the witchbeasts. A short while later, Subaru awoke to Emilia sleeping near the bed he was using. According to [[Puck]], he had been injured from the Wolgarms. After getting out of bed, he went to check on the children, who were still asleep. However, he soon spoke with Beatrice, who informed him of his predicament with the curses. Though he calmly took this in stride, after hearing of Rem having gone into the forest, Ram, having overheard, prepared to chase after her, and Subaru decided to go with her. Shortly before going into the forest, the children, who had woken up, gave him good luck "gifts", and one of the villagers lent him a sword. After traversing in the forest for a while and Ram using her Clairvoyance, killing wild Wolgarms as they attacked, they realized that they were no closer to finding Rem than when they entered the forest. Deciding to bring the Wolgarms and Rem to him, Subaru touched on the penalty of his Return by Death, increasing the scent of the Witch. By doing so, his scent became attractive to the Wolgarms, and they started chasing after him. Ram, who fought them off, quickly exhausted her strength, and Subaru ran off with her, eventually coming to a cliffside, where they fell, the sword snapping after Subaru attempted to stop their fall with it. Thanks to Ram using her magic, they were able to cushion their fall. Soon after, they found themselves surrounded by Wolgarms, and soon after, Rem appeared, having lost her sense of reason thanks to her horn having been exposed for so long. This led her to attack them alongside the Wolgarms. However, as Rem was being overwhelmed by the Wolgarms, Subaru used his penalty to attract their attention, giving Rem the chance to kill more of them. After being informed that he needed to attack her horn to return her to her senses, he threw Ram at her to distract her, and though he missed his shot when he tried to hit her horn, thanks to the Boss Wolgarm using its magic to fling him in the air, he was able to hit her horn with the broken sword and knock her out. [[File:Roswaal bombing forest.gif|thumb|left|250px|Roswaal eliminating all of the Wolgarms.]] After retrieving Rem, he and Ram made their escape with her toward the village. After Rem woke up and cried for failing him and Ram, he gave her a headbutt and scolded her for it. Entrusting Rem's safety to Ram, Subaru used himself as bait to allow them to escape, and he came across the Boss Wolgarm, which had grown in size and taken its proper form. Having eaten the Bokko Fruit that the kids had given him as one of their "gifts" and using Shamak, he stabbed the witchbeast in the throat. However, it didn't finish it off, and as it was about to kill Subaru, Roswaal returned, igniting and killing all of the Wolgarms in the area and effectively preventing Subaru from being able to succumb to the curses. After Subaru was jumped by Rem, who was grateful that he survived, he fell unconscious from his wounds. ==Aftermath== Following the attack, Meili escaped through the forest, having ordered the surviving Wolgarms to retreat and avoid destruction. As she ran, Elsa, who had been watching from a distance, caught up with her to assist in her escape. Though frustrated by it, Meili was made to be held by Elsa as she ran far from the Mathers Domain. After a while, having gotten some distance, Meili eventually stopped Elsa, as they had been surrounded by witchbeasts. Stopping Elsa from killing them, Meili decided to tame the witchbeasts, intending to rebuild her numbers before the next time she received orders. Meanwhile, the next day, Subaru awoke, Rem at his side. Because of the incident, she had been forced to face her guilt for both Ram and what had happened to Subaru because of her mistrust in him. However, as Subaru spoke with her, he was able to free her from her guilt and inferiority complex, leading to Rem falling for Subaru and becoming devoted to him. As for Roswaal, he was informed by Ram that the one responsible for controlling the witchbeasts, one of the children, the Witchbeast User, had escaped, and Roswaal had associated the attack with being a result of being involved in the [[Royal Selection]]. Providing Ram with mana through the spot she lost her horn, he informed Ram that he would be busy for a while. Meanwhile, as a direct result of this incident, Petra, who had felt terribly guilty about her actions leading to Subaru's injuries, confronted and apologized to him. After this and the clearing of her misunderstandings of the adults, Petra's ego mellowed out, she began to harbor a crush on Subaru, and because of this, it would later result in Petra joining the [[Emilia Camp]] as a maid of House Mathers. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

[[Miles]] killed |casual3 = |casual4 = |civilian = [[Hannah Regret]] killed}} The '''Raid of Argyle Manor''' (''unofficial name'') is an event that took place 1 year before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, and it is the primary conflict of the chapter ''Felix Argyle's Curse'' in [[Re:Zero Ex Light Novel Volume 1|The Dream the Lion King Saw]]. Following rumors of a [[Miles|strange visitor]] meeting with [[Biehn Argyle]] in his manor, the Duchess [[Crusch Karsten]] personally investigated the fallen House Argyle, who were being suspected of trading in slavery and human trafficking. This led to the discovery of Biehn’s deal with an [[Imperial Army|Imperial soldier]] from [[Vollachia Empire|Vollachia]] and her own capture. In response, an armed raid led by Fourth Prince [[Fourier Lugunica]] was carried out on the manor. In the end, the fallen House Argyle fell for good after [[Ferris|Felix Argyle]], Biehn’s son, raised [[Minor Characters#Hannah Argyle|Hannah Argyle]]'s body from the dead and let her kill Biehn, while the [[Reinhard van Astrea|Sword Saint]] made sure to slay the imperial soldier, preventing him from spilling the secrets of the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Kingdom]]. While the raid was successful, however, this was a prelude to a coming tragedy, as the Lugunican Royal Family all fell ill. ==Background== ===Fall of House Argyle=== House Argyle was the house entrusted with the tome for the spell Sacrament of the Immortal King. One day, Felix Argyle was born, bearing the traits of a [[Demi-Human|demi-human]] due to atavism. Suspecting this to be a result of infidelity rather than bloodline, Felix was locked away in a cell, and he was barely kept alive. This lasted until one day, [[House Karsten]] heard disturbing rumors surrounding House Argyle, and as a result, when they went to their manor to confirm these suspicions, they discovered the malnourished Felix and unofficially adopted him into House Karsten. As punishment for his treatment, House Argyle was effectively stripped of their nobility and their territory, leaving them with nothing but their manor and a patch of uncultivated land. Years later, Biehn killed his wife, Hannah Argyle, following an argument. Because of all of this and learning of the fact that Ferris was his son after witnessing his inherited and unprecedented skill with water [[magic]], Biehn became mentally unstable, and he set his sights on reviving his wife, gaining a twisted care for his son. ===Treason=== One day, Biehn met with the Imperial soldier, Miles, leading to a deal in which Biehn would buy corpses to practice the forbidden Sacrament of the Immortal King, which raised the dead back to life as [[undead]], so that he could revive his wife. As he practiced, Miles would secretly take notes so as to bring the information back to the Empire. Eventually, rumors of possible slave trading were picked up by the members of House Karsten. Crusch, deciding to wait until the trader appeared at Argyle Manor, decided to wait until the man returned to catch both him and Biehn at once to arrest him. In that time, [[Hannah Regret]] fed Crusch information. Choosing to handle things internally so that the repercussions did not affect Ferris, who had joined the Royal Guard, she spoke with Fourier and entrusted him to the prince. When the trader arrived, she arranged a meeting with Biehn, who willingly agreed with no resistance. According to himself, only he, his wife, who he claimed was sick and in bed, and one maid who remained of her own volition resided in his manor. Stating that she had business with his visitor, she had Biehn lead her to him, and he introduced Miles as a merchant to her. Having the maid bring Crusch tea, they spoke about the rumors of slave trading surrounding them. Throughout her conversation with the two, despite her [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Wind Reading|Divine Protection of Wind Reading]] not picking up on deception, she found that she still did not trust their words. Afterward, given her tea, though she did not drink it, unaware that it was, in fact, the antidote to the drug, she still found herself drugged and was imprisoned in the basement, Biehn claiming that he needed Ferris. ===The Duchess’s Disappearance=== While Ferris was adapting to his time in the Royal Guard, he and [[Julius Juukulius]] were invited to a meeting with Fourier. Meanwhile, Reinhard was sent on a mission regarding matters related to the Vollachia Empire. During the conversation, he claimed that there were bad tidings surrounding House Argyle and that Crusch had gone there by herself to handle the matter. Afterward, they spoke with an official of House Karsten. Though they learned of their countermeasures and witnessed Fourier’s recent coughing fits, another official informed everyone that Crusch had not left the manor, and the soldiers outside the manor were facing corpse soldiers. Because of this, Fourier took Ferris and Julius to the manor while [[Minor Characters#Badak|Badak]] started arranging for reinforcements to be sent to Argyle Manor. ==Battle== ===Confrontation Outside the Manor=== Shortly after Crusch was locked up, Biehn wasted no time in using Sacrament of the Immortal King to set off numerous corpse soldiers to deal with the soldiers awaiting outside, and Biehn gave them his demands for Ferris to be brought to the manor. Eventually, Fourier’s group arrived at the manor, intent on buying time for the reinforcements. They also received a missive from Biehn claiming that Crusch was being held hostage and that Ferris was to be brought to him, which Ferris accepted. Once he left, Julius remained to protect Fourier. After some time, with reinforcements to handle the undead, Fourier sent Julius inside upon seeing the mansion starting to burn. Eventually, Crusch, Ferris, and Julius escape the manor, and everyone watched as all of the undead rushed to burn alongside the manor. ===Negotiations=== Once inside, Ferris met the house's maid, Hannah Regret, who led him to Biehn, passing many undead along the way. After meeting with Biehn again, who was making a fuss over him, Biehn revealed that he wanted for Ferris to use his water magic to help him use the Sacrament of the Immortal King in exchange for Crusch. Ordering the maid to take them to the master bedroom, she led them away, informing Ferris that Crusch was unharmed, and after arriving, Ferris witnessed the corpse of Hannah Argyle, who Biehn wanted Ferris to help bring back with his magic. Despite revolting against the idea, to prevent Crusch from coming to harm, Ferris decided to use the spell on the man’s wife, learning how she died, Ferris’s gaze drawing out a crazed confession. Because of his craze threatening Crusch’s life, Ferris used his magic to animate her corpse, after which she strangled Biehn to death. Afterward, the corpse smiled at Ferris before turning to dust. After a short conversation with the maid, Ferris decided to go to Crusch, whose location the maid had told him, and he claimed he would talk to Crusch about leniency for the maid in regards to her punishment. Shortly after entering the hall, however, Hannah Regret shut and locked the door after telling Ferris goodbye, after which she set fire to the mansion, herself locked in the room with Biehn’s corpse, much to Ferris’s frustration and rage. Afterward, he ran to find Crusch. ===The Valkyrie’s Escape=== In the basement, after speaking with Biehn, Hannah Regret appeared and freed her from her manacles. However, instead of escaping, she used her position to potentially glean information from her enemy. Several hours later, she spoke again with Miles, where she learned about the use of the Sacrament of the Immortal King’s usage and that Miles was not truly in league with Biehn, wanting her assistance later on to smuggle him back into Vollachia. However, she not only refused, but she even stood and readied to defend herself from the corpse soldiers. After freeing her hands, she swiftly used her One Blow, One Hundred Felled to take care of the undead, as well as wound Miles, who played dead to avoid being killed. Immediately after, Julius appeared and assisted her, informing her that they needed to escape since the manor was burning. It didn’t take long for her and Julius to meet up with an emotional Ferris, and they quickly made their escape, pushing through the undead. Soon, they made it outside, where they witnessed all of the undead rush to the burning mansion. ===The Rat’s Escape=== Having survived the Crusch’s attack, Miles used the mass suicide of the undead by fire as a distraction so that he could escape with a copy of Biehn’s spell book via his [[Dragon#Flying Dragons|flying dragon]], [[Minor Characters#Gaius|Gaius]]. However, he was left with a deep bleeding gash that still threatened his life. Soon, he found himself confronted with Reinhard, who insisted that he land so he could be taken in alive. However, he refused and intended to kill him and escape, knocking him off of Gaius. Reinhard, beneath the two, let out a single attack, completely erasing both Miles and Gaius, as well as the copy of the spell book. ==Aftermath== Following the manor’s burning, Crusch explained to Ferris that it was the maid who had given them information and that she was the one to free her from her manacles. Later on, it was revealed that Ferris had taken the spell book for Sacrament of the Immortal King, and he kept it hidden. Julius returned to Fourier’s side and swore his loyalty to him anew, yet as soon as Fourier stepped out of his carriage, he collapsed, having succumbed to his illness, and Julius rushed to retrieve Ferris. This marked the prelude to the complete destruction of the Royal Family of Lugunica, including the king and Fourier. Following their deaths, the [[Royal Selection]] officially began, with Crusch being its first candidate and taking on Ferris as her personal knight. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

title: Royal Abduction Incident
wikitext:
{{Infobox Events |Name = Royal Abduction Incident |Image = Re Zero Light Novel 44 4.png |Kanji = 王族誘拐事件 |Rōmaji = Ōzoku Yūkai Jiken |Date = 14 BA (before arrival) |Place = [[Royal Capital|Royal Capital of Lugunica]] |Result = Filore Lugunica's abduction
[[Heinkel Astrea]]'s "immortality"
Disbandment of the [[Royal Army#Royal Guard|Royal Guard]]}} The '''Royal Abduction Incident''' (王族誘拐事件) was an event fourteen years prior to the [[Royal Selection]] in which Filore Lugunica, the daughter of [[Ford Lugunica]], was abducted by an unknown perpetrator who purportedly managed to enter the Royal Lugunica Castle within the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]]'s [[Royal Capital]] and escape undetected by the knights. Despite efforts to locate Filore led by Commander [[Wilhelm van Astrea]] of the Royal Guard, her whereabouts were never discovered. A national failure on the part of the Kingdom, the incident's aftermath indirectly led to the failed [[Great Conquest]] and directly caused the disbandment and reassembly of the Royal Guard. Although the whereabouts and status of Filore, the only [[Royal Family|royal family]] member whose history is unaccounted for, are definitively unknown in the present, it is suspected that she turned out to be [[Felt]]. ==Background== The factors that led the unknown perpetrator to abduct Filore Lugunica remain a mystery in the present. However, the event was notably not foretold by the [[Dragon History Stone]].''“As it was not written upon the Dragon History Stone, the royal palace permitted the thief to infiltrate easily at the time. Since there were a number of other urgent matters, an all-out search for the daughter could not be conducted.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 1. ==Incident== Information concerning the detailed events of the incident are limited. It has been said that, on the night that the incident occurred, a thief infiltrated the Royal Castle and abducted the young daughter of Ford Lugunica, then-king [[Randohal Lugunica]]'s younger brother. The thief successfully escaped the castle with Ford's daughter, Filore, in tow, and she was never reunited with her family.''“Fourteen years ago, a thief infiltrated the castle, and the previous king's brother’s―― Ford-sama’s daughter was abducted during the incident. The thief was allowed to escape, and his daughter was never found.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 1. On the night of the incident, [[Rom|Valga Cromwell]] escaped from the Royal Castle with a baby through its underground passageways. The man who had pulled the strings behind the events of the night was someone who could pass orders to people under him, and he had arranged for the giant to not be followed by pursuers. Although not the culprit behind Filore's abduction, [[Heinkel Astrea]] committed a betrayal of sorts concurrent to the incident, only to make a mistake afterwards that rendered it meaningless, resulting in him acquiring a supernatural resistance to damage or maladies,''The night of the incident, Heinkel had perpetrated an unforgivable betrayal, and the worst possible mistake that had made his betrayal meaningless. ――The divine punishment bequeathed, was Heinkel's current state.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 3, Section 2. the specifics of which are still unspecified. As he endured the pain of unintentionally spilling something that he had held in his hands and absorbing it into his own body, he endured the immense pain that accompanied it while seeing the figure of his son, [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]], believing that it was an illusion he conjured by his guilt over failing to make do on his promise to bring a hope-filled dawn for them on the subsequent day. According to the nun [[Filore]], Heinkel's body was soaked by Dragon's blood, resulting in his seeming "immortality" once he conquered it.''“――One from the lineage of Sword Saints who, upon conquering the Dragon’s Blood that washed over his body, was reforged into an immortal knight, Heinkel Astrea-sama: I wish to name him as my Knight.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 44]], Chapter 4, Section 5. ==Aftermath== From a young age, Felt has seen a recurring dream in which she was an infant within a box in a dimly-lit room.''――Ever since she was little, she had been seeing one certain dream over and over again. It was a dream which began in a dimly lit room. In a room where only the moonlight was streaming in, she was gazing up at the ceiling. The ceiling was high. It felt like she had been pushed inside a small box, rather than laying down on a bed.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 1. Two other people, a man with a familiar voice and another man with golden hair and crimson eyes whose voice was unfamiliar to her,''Inside the box where she could only see the ceiling, her gaze met with someone’s face when they peeked in. For some reason, a shadow was cast upon the face, and she could not see it because it was smudged black. However, she knew the person was the owner of golden hair and crimson eyes.'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 1. were speaking with each other. The first man asked the second man if he was sure about doing something, to which he replied that his brother or wife would object to it if they knew what he was doing.''“Yes, I’m sure. I can already imagine my brother or wife objecting to it, if they ever happen to know about this.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 1. The large man had a debt to the other man and a group of people associated with him, and accepted the burden of fulfilling something he was entrusted with,''“I’m indebted to ye all. If I can return what I owe, then I don’t mind taking on this job.”'' [[Re:Zero Tanpenshuu Volume 4]], [[Felt-chan's Royal Selection Life from Zero]], Section 1. despite feeling a sense of disgust over helping a human. The man with golden hair and crimson eyes, features that match both Felt's and the royal family's characteristics, left the her in the dream with words of parting and entrusted her to the giant [[Demi-Human|demi-human]], who was disgruntled that he was lending a hand to a human. The large man walked away as the other man told her that he loved her. Coinciding with time that the Commander of the Royal Guard, Wilhelm van Astrea, would be absent from the Royal Capital to conduct the search for Filore, the Kingdom of Lugunica began an effort to vanquish the [[White Whale]], while his duties prevented him from joining the subjugation force.''“That is not so. ――However, the Great Conquest, the effort to bring down the White Whale, included the previous Sword Saint. It took place during the time Wilhelm-sama was absent from the Royal Capital to conduct the search.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7.''The daughter of the king’s brother, Ford, had been abducted by someone, and the Royal Guard was devoting all their power to finding her. Naturally, as the Commander of the Royal Guard, Wilhelm had to fulfill his duty.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 20]], Chapter 5, Section 10. As a replacement for Wilhelm, Heinkel was nominated to lead the subjugation instead. However, Heinkel refused to participate in the subjugation, instead recommending that his mother, [[Theresia van Astrea]], who had been retired from active duty for over two decades by that point, join in his place.''“…That is not the half of it. I have heard that at the time, it was Heinkel-sama who recommended that Theresia-sama, who had already laid down her sword and retired from active duty, participate in the Great Conquest.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7.''“We have records remaining from that time. The deputy commander refused to join the Great Conquest, nominating Theresia-sama to join the battle in his stead.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. This would result in the failed Great Conquest, in which Theresia was recorded to have lost her life to the White Whale. Once the search for Filore ended without her whereabouts being discovered, Wilhelm resigned from the Royal Guard.''“However, the facts remain that the search was aborted, the Great Conquest itself ended in failure, and Wilhelm-sama resigned from the Royal Guard.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. The Royal Guard of the time was dissolved, and it only managed to be remade in the aftermath of Filore's abduction through the efforts of [[Marcos Gildark]], the commander who succeeded Wilhelm.''“Hmm. That incident was the trigger for the dissolution and reconstitution of the Royal Guard. Your relatives were not uninvolved in this matter, I believe?”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 4]], Chapter 4, Section 1.''“The Royal Guard surely would not have recovered if it were not for Commander Marcos exhausting every effort to do so.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. Motivated by his wife's death during the Great Conquest, the Sword Demon left [[House Astrea]] to pursue the White Whale. With Filore never being located, it became an unspoken taboo to speak of her name within the Kingdom of Lugunica.''For Heinkel―― no, for anyone in the Kingdom of Lugunica, speaking that name had gained a perception of being something of a taboo.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 5. Besides resulting in his supernatural resistances, Heinkel came to view the betrayal he committed as a grave sin.''The Divine Dragon’s query had been in regards to Heinkel’s body. Of course, that was his own body. He was aware of its abnormality, and was also properly aware of the reasons for it. ――Among the many sins Heinkel had committed, this was punishment for an especially grave one.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 41]], Chapter 3, Section 2. As a blasphemy to the royal family that he had ought to have sworn fealty towards, and to Ford, who he was indebted and should have been grateful to, it breached on his relationship with them, and in due course, the false accusation that he was responsible for the abduction would be levied against him.''Albeit, the suspicions of abduction were false accusations―― after circulating from one place to the next, Heinkel had, unto the royal family to whom he ought to have sworn his fealty, and unto Ford whom he owed a great debt of gratitude, committed a blasphemy that he could never retract. Far beyond simply betraying the Kingdom, that was a clear breach of faith on his friendship with the royal family.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 42]], Chapter 3, Section 5. These suspicions have persisted to the present day,''“The deputy commander is suspected of involvement with the royal abduction of fifteen years ago.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. and he has been questioned about the incident on numerous occasions.''“There is no conclusive proof. However, the suspicions have led him to be questioned about the circumstances numerous times.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 16]], Chapter 4, Section 7. At the ceremony held to commence the beginning of the Royal Selection. Reinhard van Astrea proposed that Felt met the criteria to be the abducted daughter of Ford Lugunica. [[Rickert Hoffman]], although left in disbelief and rejecting the possibility at first, relented his antagonism upon being assured by Reinhard that he was not engaging in deceit, then declared that no means should exist to confirm her identity with the royal family dead and concurred that she could very well be of their bloodline. As the Royal Selection has progressed, rumors that Felt is the orphan child of the royal family have spread, but she remains unconcerned with her potential lineage. ==Trivia== *Though not yet used as an in-story term, the author came up with the name “Royal Abduction Incident” alongside “Great Conquest” upon being asked if the events had names by a fan.''"That’s true.... it’s bothersome, and I get confused, too. Hmm, let’s see. Well, the fight with the White Whale where Wilhelm’s wife died is “The Great Conquest”. The incident where Felt (maybe) was abducted is “The Royal Abduction Incident”. Was there anything else? If there was, let me know. I’ll think about it."'' November 27, 2014 AskFM Q&A ==References== {{References}} ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Terminology]] [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]] [[Category:Events]]

title: Divine Dragon Church
wikitext:
[[File:Divine Dragon Church Dragon Pendant.png|thumb|165px|The Dragon Pendant, as worn by [[Filore]].]]
The '''Divine Dragon Church''' (神龍教会, ''Shinryū Kyōkai'') is a religion within the [[Kingdom of Lugunica|Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica]]. The church worships its namesake, the Divine Dragon, [[Volcanica]].

==Information==
===Overview===
The Divine Dragon Church is a religious organization that dates back four hundred years, to the era of the Covenant with Volcanica.<ref>''Its establishment unmistakably dated back four hundred years, to the era of the Covenant that earned the Kingdom of Lugunica the moniker of Dragon Kingdom; thus, there could be no objection to calling it a group with an ancient and distinguished history.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> It holds a strong faith in the blessings of Volcanica's power and its protective covenant with the Kingdom.<ref>''――The name Miklotov had raised, the Divine Dragon Church, was, as the name implied, a religious group that worshipped the Divine Dragon Volcanica, founding their faith in the grace of its power and the protection of the covenant.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 5.</ref> Naturally, the Church wishes to ensure that Lugunica is protected, and claims to strive for the happiness of the country's people.<ref>''“The Divine Dragon Church prays night and day for the well-being of the Kingdom’s citizens. No matter the doctrine they embrace, there are no exceptions to that.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 6.</ref> They are known to give out charity to those in need, and according to [[Sakura Element]], their efforts have been of particular help to the [[Royal Capital]]'s slums.<ref>''"Oh my, does Felt-chan hate the Church as well~? I do think our activities in, say, the slums, have had a positive impact thooough."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1.</ref><ref>''"Sorry, but I hate taking charity. I’ve never lined up for the bread the Church hands out. And, it’s not like I’m saying that those activities are useless, or that I hate them. What I’m talking about right now is the part where your bunch can save Duchess Karsten."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 1.</ref> Despite this, since their charity extends outwards rather than inwards, those who serve the church seem to always be famished,<ref>''"Hold up, luxury? By luxury, are you referring to me? If that’s the case, that’s a big mistake. The Divine Dragon Church’s motto is the spirit of charity! Most of the Church’s spirit of compassion and charity is directed outward, not inward. In other words…"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref><ref>''"We’re famished almost all the time!"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref> something which the Church takes great pains to hide.<ref>''"Don’t go around flaunting our shame. It’s a secret we’d taken great pains to keep from the heart of the nation until now. You’re not planning to expose anything and everything like that, are you?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 3, Section 2.</ref>

The Church has remonstrated itself against the expansion of its own influence. As such, there is an unspoken understanding in the Divine Dragon Church that its influence should be kept away from Lugunica's national politics, and they have avoided interacting with the castle or the [[Royal Family|royal family]].<ref>''In order to avoid shaking the nation with that immense influence, the Divine Dragon Church refrained from drawing near the Royal Castle, which bore responsibility for the nation’s politics, and they each contributed to the well-being of the citizens within their own domains. ――That was the unspoken agreement.'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 5.</ref><ref>''In fact, the Divine Dragon Church had remonstrated itself against the expansion of its own influence, and had maintained a certain distance from that which lay at the heart of the Kingdom, such as the Royal Family and the Royal Castle. That is to say, this was proof that the Church of the Divine Dragon had not sought out more power than was necessary, merely choosing instead to define itself as a foundation of faith.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> For this reason, the Church has refrained from interfering with the [[Royal Selection]].<ref name="affairs">''“All adherents of the Divine Dragon Church mourn the recent perils of the Kingdom from the bottom of our hearts. As per the unspoken agreement, we have remained at a distance from national affairs concerning the battle for the throne… the Royal Selection, but ever since news of the catastrophe at the Watergate City reached our ears, we could no longer remain still.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 5.</ref> However, as a result of the disaster wrought by the [[Witch Cult]] during the [[Battle for Priestella]], certain members within the Church have decided to change its approach in order to provide relief to the Watergate City's citizens.<ref name="affairs" /><ref>''“In the Watergate City of Priestella, those who fell upon harm at the hands of the Witch Cult… it seems like several cases have been identified, but the Divine Dragon Church can offer a means to provide aid.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 5.</ref>

===Internal Politics===
Although the entire structure of the church is unknown, it has numerous members. Its main governing body is the '''Holy Synod''' (聖議会, ''Sei Gikai''), a council made up of high rankings church staff. They are the ones in charge of the church's affairs are the ones who make the important decisions. Beyond them, it is known that there are nuns and guards amongst its membership, among which the nuns and other similar staff wear indigo habits, a signifying mark that one works for the Church.<ref>''There were two boys and one girl, with the girl being the one with the nastiest comments. As all of them were clad in habits dyed indigo, nearly as dark as black itself, they were most likely members of the Church.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 7, Section 1.</ref>

Although it is unknown how they retrieve it, the church is highly capable of gathering information. Though the extent of their information is unknown, it is known that they are easily capable of discovering secrets such as the current state of [[Heinkel Astrea]]'s body and how it came to be that way, despite the fact that Heinkel himself should have been the only person who knew about his infiltration of the castle and the mistake he made. Once they have retrieved information, they contain it within what [[Filore]] refers to as the confidential records of the church, where it is kept secret from most of the church's members.<ref>''"Ah, this was something that needs to be kept secret, right? To tell you the truth, it was something I stealthily read in the confidential records of the Church, so I only realized later that it was something that couldn’t be spread around."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 25.</ref><ref>''The Dragon’s Blood from fifteen years prior; the fact that it was even brought up in the first place was a shock, but the pièce de résistance was the fact that it was documented in something like the confidential records of the Divine Dragon Church. The reason was lost on him. There was certainly a time when Heinkel had frequented the church, but it was not as though he was a devout adherent, nor had he ever done anything like confessing his inner heart to no avail.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 25.</ref> Similarly, according to [[Marcos Gildark]], the Divine Dragon Church is also in possession of [[magic]] and techniques that are not publicly known.<ref>''“I’ve heard that the Divine Dragon Church possesses magic and techniques that haven’t been unveiled to the public.”'' [[Re:Zero Light Novel Volume 43]], Chapter 7, Section 6.</ref>

The Divine Dragon Church seems to have individual churches across Lugunica; aside from the church located within the Royal Capital, there is at least one other known church in the [[Priestella|Watergate City of Priestella]], although it was severely damaged by the battle with [[Regulus Corneas]]. This being said, it is unknown if there are any differences in the internal structure of each individual church.

At present, Heinkel is suspicious of corruption in the Divine Dragon Church, due in part to Filore's existence in the church,<ref>''Henceforth, someone was plotting. ――Filore and Felt, in order to prop up either of the two girls as a survivor of the Royal Family, and use them for some ulterior purpose. When he thought about it like that, and considered the circumstances leading to Filore’s participation in the Royal Selection, he had no choice but to bear a strong distrust towards the Divine Dragon Church.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 3.</ref> as well as the fact that, aside from the delay in her joining the Royal Selection, during the [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|events]] of [[Arc 10]], everything seemed as though it was thoroughly set up by them,<ref>''In all honesty, excluding the fact that Filore’s entrance was delayed in the Royal Selection, everything else felt like it had been thoroughly set up by the Divine Dragon Church.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 5.</ref> though their response to dealing with Filore complicates matters further.<ref>''If they truly wanted to make Filore the Monarch, then it was a measure they undoubtedly ought to take. Despite that, rather than supporting this path, the Divine Dragon Church maintained a position that seemed to obstruct it, and the movements of the Council of Wise Men did not side with Filore either.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 5.</ref> It is later confirmed that the [[Beloved Children]] had infiltrated the ranks of the church.<ref>''"So the Beloved Children have infiltrated as far as the Church… though, by the time that they compromised the higher ups at the Castle, it isn’t really that much of a surprise. Moreover…"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 30, Section 1.</ref>

===Saintess===
In the church, one person who has received the Divine Dragon's favor particularly strongly can be appointed as the '''Saintess'''.<ref name="saintess">''"To begin with, “Saintess” isn’t an official rank within the Church, you knowww? It is a special title bestowed upon adherents who have received the Divine Dragon’s favor particularly strongly. Everyone expresses gratitude to them, and they are seated in front of even the high and mighty at ceremonies, buuut, it’s not like they have a seat or any powerful influence at the Holy Synod where the big shots of the Church gather… that’s just how it iiiis."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 4.</ref> As of Arc 10, the nun Filore acts as the current Saintess. The Saintess is considered to be the public face of the Divine Dragon Church, and that person is the one who most commonly speaks with and cares for the people in times of turmoil. The Saintess is also capable of using the esoteric '''Sacraments''' (秘蹟, ''Hiseki''), an ability separate from magic that is not to be shown to outsiders that is capable of healing the maladies of almost any kind of victim.<ref>''"It is a sacrament of the Divine Dragon Church, esoteric and not to be shown to outsiders."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 2, Section 3.</ref><ref>''"The Sacrament? Yes, indeed. It is a secret art handed down from antiquity only within the Church, and there are very few individuals who can use it. The Church calls such individuals Saintesses, and I myself am qualified as well, hence why I can employ that power."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 7, Section 2.</ref> Although exhausting on the person using them<ref name="salvation">''"This too, is in the scriptures. “The salvation of but one, is according to the prayers of the many. For it is only in communion that the grace of the Dragon shall reign supreme.”"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 2, Section 4.</ref> and reliant on the soul of the one being healed,<ref>''"Ah, but, as I said just now, I’m not certain if it will work. The Sacrament isn’t all powerful, and it also depends on the state of that person’s soul… however, the Divine Dragon Church also has a lot of other things that aren’t known to the public, so if we don’t give up, it should be possible to open a path forward. Yes, surely."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 25.</ref> the Sacraments are shown to be capable of countering the effects of [[curse]]s,<ref>''Having spent so long bedridden, Crusch’s beauty had become emaciated, and her skin pale like that of an invalid, even despite the daily care she had received. ――However, the evil poison that had taken root, stretching across her face, neck, and body, was nowhere to be found upon her visible skin.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 2, Section 3.</ref> and supposedly, [[Authority|Authorities]]. It has also been claimed that it should have been possible for the Church to even be able to help the victims of Priestella, which were under the effects of different Authorities.

Despite their influence as a Saintess, they have no real authority within the church itself,<ref name="saintess /> and they are not allowed to make important decisions on their own.<ref>''"She can’t deciiide. It isn’t something so cheap, aaafter all."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 4.</ref> In fact, the Saintess is ordinarily heavily restricted in the movements and actions, and they must go through the Holy Synod in the event they wish to take certain actions, including using their Sacraments. Furthermore, if the Saintess is not careful in their conduct and actions, it is possible for the Saintess to have their title completely revoked,<ref>''"I guess I can’t deny iiit. As a matter of fact, it’s considered a problem that Filore-chan used the Sacrament without going through the Holy Synod first, so it seems like they’re debating revoking recognition of her as a Saintess, aaafter all."'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 4.</ref> though until the present day, it has yet to happen.<ref>''"As per the rules. I don’t think it’s ever been put into practice, thooough. She made it out safe this time, buuut if it’s already been raised for discussion once, she mustn’t get too comfortable, you knowww?"'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 26, Section 4.</ref>

title: Featherrun Sisters
wikitext:
The '''Featherrun Sisters''' (フェザーランの姉妹, ''Fezāran no Shimai'') were a secret unit of the [[Gustekan Church]] consisting of six girls who were made into [[Curse#Curse Doll|curse dolls]] in order to serve the Church's interests and support their “cleansing” of the [[Gusteko|Holy Kingdom of Gusteko]].

==Information==
Overseen by [[Holosseo Featherrun]], the Featherrun Sisters were a unit of the Gustekan Church intended to serve their interests and aid in the cleansing of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko,<ref>''“With Father at the helm, we’re a unit that serves the interests of the Church to maintain order. That’s the duty of us sisters, an indispensable role in the cleansing of the Holy Kingdom.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> killing those whom the Church sought to purge. They existed for many years as a covert unit whose service was never known to the public.<ref>''Even within the Gustekan Church, they were a secret unit, one whose acts of service would never be revealed to the public. That was the position the Featherrun Sisters had been placed in, and had been their duty for many years.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref> To be accepted into the Featherrun Sisters, a candidate had to withstand a ritual Holosseo performed with [[Curse|curse arts]] in order to make them into a curse doll, a secret art that dates back to the era of [[Witch|Witches]].<ref>''“Holosseo’s curse arts, and the curse dolls birthed from them… the Featherrun techniques are a remnant of heresy from the era of the ancient Witches. And, there is a person who cannot help but lust for them.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 5, Section 3.</ref> With their regenerative abilities, combined with the mastery of skills with a weapon of their choosing in order to stand a chance against opponents who were veteran combatants,<ref>''“It’s nothing. More importantly, pick a weapon. If you can’t master a weapon that suits you, then no matter how tough we may be, we won’t stand a chance against the fearless veterans who’ve fought countless battles.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> including the possibility of fighting Temple Knights who at one point served the Holy King Church,<ref>''“It’s not impossible… There are times when we’ll need to face Temple Knights too, after all.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 2.</ref> the sisters carried out assassinations in the name of assisting with Gusteko's cleansing on behalf of the Gustekan Church.

The Featherrun Sisters were mostly loyal to their “father”, Holosseo. Their base of operations and home was Holosseo's property, the Featherrun mansion. Situated on a plot of Hallowed Land located in a remote, hidden region of the country, only a select few members of the Gustekan Church knew of its whereabouts. Although many girls have been recruited to join the ranks of the Featherrun Sisters, the vast majority of them lacked the adaptability to become Curse Dolls and lost their egos in the process, becoming husks who existed only to follow orders,<ref>''She had assuredly thought that they had all lost their lives, but that had not been the case. Because they had lacked the adaptability to become Curse Dolls, it was their ego that they forfeited――, “Just like Ornea, they live only to follow orders…”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref> and they were discarded in the underground area below the mansion.<ref>''“That is my poison. My trump card. This underground, in truth, is not a place for us sisters to battle to the death. It was a place to discard those who failed to become sisters.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref>

As expected of any group, the Featherrun Sisters had rules and practices that were unique to them. In the Featherrun Sisters, it was not one's real age that determines the order of oldest to youngest between the sisters, but how long one has spent as a Featherrun.<ref>''“――Your real age is of no consequence. This is about the number of years one has spent after becoming a Featherrun.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 1, Section 2.</ref> As a custom and unwritten rule, they wore dresses,<ref>''“Hm? Ah, that. Rather than it being to Father’s tastes, it’s a custom of the Featherruns. The Featherrun Sisters are to wear dresses. It’s that sorta unwritten rule.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> all of which matched the hair color of a corresponding sister.<ref>''Aside from Elsa, the other sisters were all clad in dresses that matched their respective features. Perhaps it was their doctrine to match the color of hair and dress, as it remained consistent throughout all of them.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 1, Section 5.</ref> After each assassination, the mark of the Featherrun Sisters, a flower of a deep purple hue, was left after each assassination to serve as a sign to mark who had killed a target or targets and why they had done so.<ref>''As Ornea’s words sparked her memory, Elsa reached into her dress, and took out a single flower. So deeply purple as it was, terribly alluring was the manner in which it blossomed within Elsa’s hands. Taking that flower, she tossed it to rest on top of the collapsed man. That was, unmistakably――, “――The mark of the Featherrun Sisters.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 1.</ref><ref>''The reason why the man and his guards had all died. In order to make that known, this flower served as a signature.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 1.</ref> Outside of their duties, they were not to stay attached to unnecessary emotions.<ref>''They would not hold on to any unnecessary emotions outside of their work. That, too, was a law of the Featherrun Sisters.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 1.</ref> In addition, with Sithonia overseeing them as the one in charge of the property in Holosseo's place, the housework for the Featherrun mansion in which they all lived was handled by the sisters, with specific tasks such as gardening being assigned to [[Dorothea Featherrun|Dorothea]], or caring for the hounds being assigned to [[Saria Featherrun|Saria]] and [[Hildea Featherrun|Hildea]], while tasks like cooking were alternated between them.

For unknown reasons, whether he had been tasked to do so by the Gustekan Church or wanted to do so of his own volition, Holosseo's intent with the Featherrun Sisters was to create a perfected curse doll. To do this, he aimed to reenact how, in the distant past, the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] grew powerful by killing and devouring the other Witches.<ref>''“The reason the Witch of Envy became such a mighty existence, was because she killed and devoured the other Witches. Thus, the one who had thought to enact that very same phenomenon, was Holosseo Featherrun.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 5, Section 3.</ref> Thus, in order to achieve a similar result, he entrusted [[Elsa Granhiert|Elsa]] with the duty to complete the Featherrun Sisters.<ref>''“Elsa, for you, too, there exists a duty.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 5.</ref><ref>''“――To bring the Feathrrun Sisters, to completion.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 2, Section 5.</ref> In order to achieve the goal he felt an ardor for, to create a perfect curse doll, he instructed her to kill each of her sisters in order to carry out the ritual of curse doll completion.<ref>''“Like I said, I was instructed by our father. He said that it was necessary for the completion of the Curse Dolls, that the Featherrun Sisters would thus be brought to completion.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 5, Section 1.</ref><ref>''“That day, if I’m remembering this right, he did tell me. That the ritual to achieve completion as a Curse Doll, slaughtering all the other sisters, was commencing. He said he had completed all the preparations for it.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref> However, Elsa, who had always been jealous of and envied other people, did not wish to reach the perfected existence of a complete curse doll,<ref>''“A completed Curse Doll, a flawless, perfected existence… I don’t particularly want to become that sort of thing.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref><ref>''“I don’t want to become perfect. ――You see, I always envied other people. I was jealous. I yearned. That’s why, I don’t want to be something like a completed Curse Doll.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref> and told this to Holosseo, betraying his expectations and ardor. In spite of Elsa's words, a furious Holosseo responded that there was still a method to complete the ritual, and though Elsa sought to change Holosseo's mind to prevent him from trying to cause the deaths of her sisters, she quickly found it difficult to think, and used force on him instead, killing him in the process.<ref>''She responded the same way she had to Holosseo’s words on that night, and Sithonia was flabbergasted the same way that Holosseo had been. But, in his immediate fury, he declared that even if Elsa did not strive towards becoming a perfected Curse Doll, there was still a method to complete the ritual. Being the puppeteer that he was, it would have been possible for him to pull some strings and cause Elsa’s other sisters to die. Elsa thought that he would do so, so she tried to do something in an attempt to change his mind.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref><ref>''“But, thinking became difficult. And so, I used force.”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref>

As a result of Holosseo's death, the events that led to the dissolution of the Featherrun Sisters were set into motion. [[Sithonia Featherrun|Sithonia]], although having joined the Featherruns for the sake of acquiring the curse doll art, felt that she would have preferred for her days with the others to last as long as possible.<ref>''“For the purpose of acquiring this Curse Doll art, I arrived here at Featherrun… however, if it had never started, that would have been fine. After all, the days I spent here were of great comfort!”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref> With Holosseo's death, however, Sithonia, believing that Elsa had kickstarted the ritual to create a complete curse doll, decided that victory was the only option she had left,<ref>''“By killing Father, you set the rite into motion. You started the rite to bring the Curse Dolls to completion… so then, the only choice I have left is to come out on top.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref> and began taking measures to achieve completion as a curse doll in accordance with her desire to attain a possible means to escape from her “[[Capella Emerada Lugunica|Mother]]”.<ref>''“To be precise, the monster that calls itself my mother. In order to escape that monster’s dominion, I require that secret art…!”'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref><ref>''“Emerging victorious, and becoming a completed Curse Doll. If I do that, I can escape her dominion.'' [[Re:Zero Prequel: Apocalypse Girls]], Chapter 6, Section 1.</ref> She began to operate under the belief that Elsa also sought to become a perfect curse doll even though she had no desire to be one whatsoever, and sent the other sisters after her so they would meet their deaths. Ultimately, Dorothea, Saria, Hildea, and Sithonia herself all met their ends at Elsa's hands, while [[Ornea Featherrun|Ornea]] survived at the cost of losing her own ego. Not wishing to attain perfection as a curse doll, Elsa spared Ornea, entrusted her care to [[Oliver Zeppes]], and exited the Featherrun mansion, where she was met by Mother. After the ordeal, Elsa became one of her “children”.

*For the duration of Elsa's time as a member of the Featherrun Sisters, Sithonia forbade her from participating in housework because of her poor talent with chores, which created more problems than benefits.

Many House Miload servants killed}} The '''Attack on Miload Manor''' (''unofficial name'') was an event that took ten years before the arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world in which House Miload was attacked by the [[Witch Cult]] in order to kill [[Rem]] and [[Ram]]. It is the primary conflict of [[Re:Zero Prequel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village|Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village]]. One day, the Witch Cult led an attack on the [[Oni|Oni Tribe]], driving them to the brink of extinction. Its survivors, Rem and Ram, were eventually forced to become servants of [[Roswaal Manor]], and they swore vengeance on the men who killed their kin. Meanwhile, the Witch Cult was still interested in killing the sisters, eventually leading to their assault on the head of House Miload, [[Dudley Miload]], and his manor, where the girls found themselves a few months later. In the end, the Witch Cult failed to kill the girls, and the cultists involved were also killed. However, because of their attack, House Miload faced its complete demise as well, leading it to fall under the care of [[House Mathers]] until its heir apparent, the newborn [[Annerose Miload]], became of age to take it over. ==Background== ===Extinction of the Oni Tribe=== One night, the Oni Tribe's village was raided by the Witch Cult, led by [[Faust]], [[Sergei]], [[Sado]], and [[Fogg]]. The group managed to kill nearly all of the oni, including [[Setanta]], leaving Ram as the only fighter standing to protect Rem. Though she managed to kill a large number of her attackers, in an effort to protect her sister, her horn was severed. After Rem passed out from shock, Ram took her and escaped, encountering the approaching [[Roswaal L. Mathers]], who had waited for the attack to happen as guided by his Book of Knowledge, on the mountain path. After swearing to serve Roswaal to save her sister, he decided to bring them back to the manor. That same night, he captured Fogg, who he imprisoned beneath the manor. After Rem awoke and saw her sister's state after becoming hornless, Rem pleaded with Roswaal to save her in exchange for serving him, just like Ram. Ultimately, he did as she asked, and she was hired as staff along with her sister. After speaking with her sister, who claimed they were being toyed with, the sisters decided to take retribution for their tribe. Two months after joining the staff, after battling the imprisoned Fogg, torturing him for the names of his co-conspirators, and killing him, Rem decided to become her sister's substitute and began training with her morningstar and with [[magic]]. ===Gifts for House Miload=== A month after the encounter with Fogg, Roswaal, [[Frederica Baumann]], Rem, and Ram, celebrating the coming birth of the child of House Miload, decided to leave for the [[Royal Capital]] to buy gifts. However, there, the group were forced to contend with the scheme of Sado, who had been planting magical miasma stones around town. Though they managed to locate and retrieve the stones, Rem and Frederica were forced to chase the fleeing Sado across town, with the young [[Reinhard van Astrea]] taking care of the cultists the man brought with him. After chasing him down, Ram managed to snipe Sado down with her new wand through Rem's eyes. After dealing with the aftermath, Frederica returned home while the other three visited Miload Manor ten days later and spoke with [[Grace Miload]] and the manor's servants. Meanwhile, Dudley was away for work at [[Costuul]]. ==Battle== ===Carriage Ambush=== Three days later, Dudley found himself ambushed along the highway by the Witch Cult, and he and his servant were both brutally killed. Taking advantage of this, Sergei decided to pose as Dudley's servant, and he approached Miload Manor on his own. At the manor, the group realized that Dudley was late, and when Sergei appeared, saying that the carriage had been damaged on the way home, Roswaal and Rem went to retrieve him in another carriage, leaving Ram to keep Grace company. After arriving at the fallen carriage, Sergei led Rem to it, where he showed her the corpses. Tricking her into using her horn, his mana poisoning constitution managed to nearly incapacitate her, and after summoning other cultists, he attacked Roswaal's carriage before attempting to strangle Rem. However, Roswaal easily survived and attacked them in response, saving Rem. Entrusting her with saving the people at Miload Manor, he protected Rem from her attackers as she ran off. Taking on the more than twenty attackers, he ultimately killed them all and incapacitated Sergei before heading back to the manor. ===Manor Raid=== Meanwhile, Ram had noticed something wrong and ordered the nearby [[Minor Characters#Limrear|Limrear]] to take Grace and prepare to move just as the manor trembled. Claiming it was the Witch Cult, one that she was familiar with, after looking through the dying eyes of the servants and seeing the guards failing to take him down, she led the two to another room while simultaneously using Clairvoyance. Scared, Limrear led the group into a certain room, where they came across several corpses of servants. At the same time, Grace's water broke, so Ram told Limrear to take Grace into the room and help her deliver the baby while she went to hold off the Witch Cultist, Faust. As the man began to smoke his leaf tobacco, Ram attacked him, dodging his explosions by sensing the disturbance in mana. Although she didn't do lasting damage, she used Al Fura try and kill him, destroying the hallway in the process. However, Faust managed to avoid the worst of it with his wind reading skills. Grabbing her by the throat, he intended to throw her into the explosive traps set in the garden, only for Rem to appear and hit him in the head with her morningstar. With Ram on her back, the two avoided the explosions, and Rem struck him. When he attempted a sneak attack, she managed to counter him, and she struck him numerous times while piercing through the upper floors. After pushing through the roof, Rem struck the man and sent him flying into the explosive traps, and when Ram threw his burning leaf tobacco into it, they went off, reducing the man to ash. ==Aftermath== After killing the Witch Cultists, Roswaal brought the incapacitated Sergei to the manor for the twins to kill. After some time, Limrear appeared, saying that the baby had been born but that Grace didn't have much time left. In the room she was in, several bloody rags were nearby, and the baby was in the arms of a servant. Waking Grace, she gave her baby the name Annerose, and she asked Roswaal to take care of her. Dying, she said that she loved Roswaal, and she laughed when he returned her words, saying he was a bad liar. In the end, she died, leaving the servants to cry. After this, Roswaal became Annerose's guardian, and House Miload was put under his control. This led to rumors that Roswaal had set up the attack on the manor in order to obtain power, though these rumors were eventually dispelled by Annerose herself when she got older. Many of the remaining servants who survived the attack resigned, and Roswaal decided to have [[Clind]] and Frederica serve at House Miload to take care of Annerose in his place. Furthermore, Roswaal chose to have his hobby of taking care of and training demi-human servants performed at the Miload Manor and by those two, effectively making Rem and Ram his only servants. Although he eventually seemed to have taken in more servants, they were eventually let go as well. One night, after having Frederica and Clind go to Miload Manor, he spoke with Ram in his office after providing her with mana. She claimed to believe that Roswaal set up the whole affair to give the girls their retribution, and she asked if the sacrifices of Dudley and Grace was worth it. When Roswaal claimed that he would sacrifice anyone for his goal, Ram told him that she would help him achieve his goal, attempting to kiss him while doing so, only for Roswaal to stop her. Pouting, Ram said that she would destroy him: his desires, wishes, and feelings. Following this event, Rem and Ram continued serving House Mathers for the next ten years. ==Navigation== {{Battles & Events Navbox}} [[Category:Kingdom of Lugunica]]

title: Augria Sand Dunes
wikitext:
[[File:Augria Sand Dunes Anime design.png|thumb|300px]]
The '''Augria Sand Dunes''' (アウグリア砂丘, ''Auguria Sakyū'') is a large desert located on the far eastern edge of the continent in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]], and it is considered one of the most dangerous locations in the world. It is a primary setting in [[Arc 6]] and [[Arc 9]].

==Information==
The Augria Sand Dunes is an expansive desert that spans the farthest eastern edge of the continent, although it is not a desert in the sense that it experiences drastic changes in temperatures between night and day. The Augria Sand Dunes are filled with miasma, and as one gets closer and closer to the edge of the desert, the stronger the miasma becomes. Because of the miasma, ordinary life is incapable of residing here, and [[spirit]]s do not come near. Instead, [[Witchbeast#Augria Sand Dunes|witchbeast]]s, such as Hungry Horse Kings and Unicorns, live here, and they are more aggressive, stronger, and in some cases, such as the Sand Earthworms, significantly larger than their more ordinary counterparts. Because of the miasma, plant-life and other forms of life are reduced to dust, and that very dust is what makes up the sand of the desert. The miasma was also responsible for making any travelers who traverse the desert to go mad, and because of the mix of the incredibly dangerous witchbeasts and the miasma in the air, many who attempt to cross the desert never come back. It is for this reason that the Augria Sand Dunes are considered one of the most dangerous places in the world.

The existence of the [[Pleiades Watchtower]] in the center of the desert also provides a few unique additions to the desert. Due to the barrier that previously protected the tower from intruders, the desert experienced extreme sandstorms that would prevent any travelers from moving forward, and likewise, it prevented them from getting any closer to the tower than necessary. The sandstorms, referred to as '''Sand Time''', also affected the nearby town of Mirula, and the sand-covered town's few residents would be forced to hide inside until the storms passed. Should one manage to punch through the Sand Time barrier and find themselves at the bottom of the Pleiades Watchtower, they will come across a flower field, an antithetical existence that should be incapable of living in the desert. However, that very flower field is, in fact, nothing but a large group of Courtesan Bears, their flesh and the flowers attached to the providing the illusion of being a flower field. Despite these unique factors, however, due to the successful [[Pleiades Watchtower Expedition]], the Sand Time barrier has been destroyed, and the Courtesan Bears at the bottom of the tower were wiped out.

Although it is unclear whether it existed before the tower's emergence or if it came with the tower, there is also an underground level of the Augria Sand Dunes, a place which [[Shaula]] refers to as the '''Sand Palace''' (砂宮, ''Suna Miya''). Beneath the sands, there are caves that lead to underground sections of the Pleiades Watchtower. Residing within these tunnels are Hungry Horse Kings, perhaps the most dangerous witchbeasts in the desert.

==History==
Four centuries prior to arrival of [[Natsuki Subaru]] into the world, following the [[Great Calamity]], the [[Satella|Witch of Envy]] was sealed within the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine at the farther edge of the Augria Sand Dunes. At some point after this, the Pleiades Watchtower and the Taygeta Library were made by the Sage [[Flugel]] and a "[[Echidna|knowledge-hungry Witch]]". After leaving Shaula to protect and oversee the tower, Flugel vanished, and Shaula remained the tower's protector for the next four centuries, ordered to kill anyone who comes close to it.

Over the centuries, people from across the world would come to seek the knowledge of the Sage, and in their attempt, they would cross the Augria Sand Dunes. However, everyone who ever crossed the dunes failed to reach the tower. It is unknown how many people have lost their lives over the course of those four centuries to the desert or to Shaula, though it is known that nearly four centuries later, a group of around 900 people led by [[Leilani Alnair]] managed to break through the Sand Time barrier, though only Leilani survived the attacking witchbeasts thanks to Shaula. This being said, even after being taken into the tower, sometime later, she was cast back out beyond the barrier after she caused Shaula to shoot her, killing [[Rui Arneb|one]] of her unborn triplets. In the sands, she was found by travelers, and because they misconstrued her words, they helped her give birth to [[Lye Batenkaitos|her]] [[Roy Alphard|children]], and she died in the process.

One day, more than ten years later and nearly a year before Subaru's arrival, in order to save the [[Royal Family]] of the Kingdom of Lugunica, [[Reinhard van Astrea]] attempted to cross the desert to obtain the knowledge of the Sage. However, even the most powerful Sword Saint was incapable of breaking through the Sand Time barrier, and he was forced to retreat.

Nearly a year and a half after Subaru's arrival, members of the [[Emilia Camp]] and [[Anastasia Camp]] sought to cross the desert as well in order to find a way to heal the people damaged by the [[Witch Cult]]. Although they were at first struggling to cross the desert, thanks to the birds that had been crossing the desert for the past year, Subaru suggested to [[Ram]] to use her Clairvoyance to match their wavelength, and pushing through the Sand Time barrier, the group managed to reach the foot of the tower, where they were forced to temporarily retreat from the Courtesan Bears and face the intense sniper fire from Shaula. However, thanks to Subaru and [[Beatrice]] using [[magic]]-cancelling magic, the barrier around the tower was shattered, and Subaru, Ram, [[Eridna]], and [[Patrasche]] were forced beneath the sands. Shaula, who believed Subaru to be Flugel, then retrieved his allies and brought them to the tower before proceeding retrieve Subaru's group from beneath the sands.

A few days later, Lye Batenkaitos and Roy Alphard commanded an army of witchbeasts to cross the desert at their sister, Rui Arneb's, command. After an intense battle against both the army of witchbeasts and the forcibly transformed Shaula, the witchbeasts were wiped out while Shaula was reduced to her small form. A short while later, Satella's shadow crossed the desert and snatched Subaru, [[Rem]], and [[Spica|Rui]], and after attempting to take them away, the shadow was hit by [[Volcanica]]'s breath. This event caused the group within the tower to retreat from the area. Later, another expedition team composed of [[Meili Portroute]] and members of the [[Felt Camp]] crossed the desert, with Reinhard being forced to withstand Volcanica's strikes until they presented its claw. After their short stay at the tower, the group crossed the desert once again, leaving [[Ezzo Cadner]] and [[Flam Remendis]] behind.

A few months later, members of the Emilia Camp and [[Al|Aldebaran]] once again crossed the desert. However, thanks to Meili, the lack of Courtesan Bears, and the destruction of the Sand Time barrier, they were able to cross without issue, and the next day, they did so once again after preventing Aldebaran from attempting to [[Pleiades Sealing Conflict|seal Subaru]].

==Locations==
*'''[[Pleiades Watchtower]]''' (プレアデス監視塔, ''Pureadesu Kanshitō''): A watchtower located near the center of the Augria Sand Dunes. Created by Flugel, this tower's purpose is to overlook the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine.
*'''Evil Sealing Stone Shrine''' (封魔石の祠, ''Fūmaseki no Hokora''): The Evil Sealing Stone Shrine is where Satella is currently sealed. It lies farther beyond the Pleiades Watchtower, closer to the Great Waterfall.
*'''Sand Palace''' (砂宮, ''Suna Miya''): A cavernous area beneath the sands that contain "doors" that require special "keys" to open. However, it is unclear if they are a part of the Pleiades Watchtower or existed prior to its creation.

==Trivia==
*Despite the similarity between their names, it is unclear if there is any connection between the Augria Sand Dunes and the constellation Auriga.
*Anyone who bears the [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation|Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation]] is capable of easily crossing the desert without running into witchbeasts. Meili Portroute, who currently possesses this [[Divine Protection]], is tasked with helping people cross the desert because of this.
*According to [[Clind]], the effectiveness [[Divine Protection#Divine Protection of Earth Spirits|Divine Protection of Earth Spirits]] is reduced while in the Augria Sand Dunes.
*For unknown reasons, Clind seems to be incapable of teleporting in the Augria Sand Dunes. It is unclear if this is due to choice or if the desert fulfills a condition that prevents him from doing so.
*The Augria Sand Dunes is the place where Reinhard van Astrea is considered to be at his weakest.
*The doors in the Sand Palace are said to require keys, and the number of doors that have been “opened” by Subaru were equivalent to the combined number of [[Authority|Authorities]] and Witch Factors he possessed at the time. It is unclear what relation these two aspects may have to each other.
**This bears a striking similarity to the seal in [[Elior Forest]], which can only be opened by those who have the appropriate “keys”, which in turn can only be seen by their possessors, such as [[Emilia]]. It is unclear, however, if the Sand Palace’s doors, the Forest’s seal, and the seal’s keys are related.
*It has been said that the [[Witch]] of Gluttony, [[Daphne]], starved to death in a sand sea. Considering all the Witches met their end in the Kingdom of Lugunica and there's no other known location in Lugunica known as a sand sea, it is likely she died in the Augria Sand Dunes.
