'''Flugel's Tree''' (フリューゲルの大樹, ''Furyūgeru no Taiju'') is a large tree in the [[Kingdom of Lugunica]] that once grew by the Lifaus Highway between the [[Royal Capital]] and the Mathers Domain. It was felled during the [[Subjugation of the White Whale]].

==Information==
[[File:Flugel Tree Manga.png|thumb|right|180x|Flugel's Tree in the manga.]]
Flugel's Tree is an ancient tree that has stood in the Kingdom of Lugunica for at least four centuries. It is said to have been planted by [[Flugel]], being the only deed recorded to history under his name, and it primarily served as a landmark in the wide-open plains near the center of the Kingdom. However, the tree was ultimately felled during the Subjugation of the White Whale, and its excessive weight as it fell was critical in bringing down and defeating one of the [[Witchbeast#Three Great Witchbeasts|Three Great Witchbeasts]], the [[White Whale]]. Afterward, the tree was summarily put to use by the Kingdom for construction, as the ancient wood was highly valuable,<ref>''The trunk that had been chopped down during the Subjugation of the White Whale had been transported away in the aftermath, and provided with the rare opportunity, its miraculous lumber had been put to use for the Kingdom’s resources. Likely, a multitude of buildings made from Flugel’s Tree were now thriving in various places.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 1.</ref> while the stump became a tourist attraction.<ref>''The stump left behind had become a valuable tourist attraction, and with it seemingly bustling with business, Subaru and the others were currently waiting for all the people to be cleared out.'' [[Arc 10]], Chapter 31, Section 1.</ref>

Despite the tree's destruction, the stump of Flugel's Tree can serve as a port from which [[Beatrice]] can use her Door Crossing in order to reach Kugelschreiber Castle, the former home of both her and the [[Witch]] of Greed, [[Echidna]]. The Witch set up a port at the tree that can be "awakened" through someone who can use Door Crossing, and once the port that acts as a gateway to and from the castle has been stirred, it will appear that will linger for a time. It is unclear how long the port will remain open, however.

==History==
At some point during the era of Witches, it was said that Flugel planted the tree, being the only deed he performed that was recorded to history in his name rather than [[Shaula]]'s. As a result, it was later given the name of Flugel's Tree, and it became one of the most recognizable landmarks in the entirety of the Kingdom. At some point, Echidna arranged for the tree to be one of the ports that would allow users of Door Crossing to access Kugelschreiber Castle.

For the next four centuries, Flugel's Tree stood tall, and it continued to grow larger and larger until it achieved its colossal size in the present day. Eventually, a few days after the start of the [[Royal Selection]], Flugel's Tree served as the location where the Subjugation of the White Whale would take place. For a few hours, [[Natsuki Subaru]], [[Rem]], the [[Crusch Camp]], and members of the [[Iron Fang]] and [[Royal Army]] prepared themselves at the foot of the tree, until eventually, the White Whale appeared in the midnight sky. For the next few hours, the battle ensued, resulting in injuries on the whale and casualties among the subjugation force. As the whale was beginning to corner them after summoning clones of itself, Subaru hatched a plan with [[Crusch Karsten]] to use the tree as a weapon, and after he forced it to chase after him by increasing the [[Mana#Miasma|Witch's Scent]] on himself, the subjugation force used their cannons to heavily damage the base of the tree, causing it to fall atop the whale and allow the group to finish the whale off for good.

After the subjugation ended, the forces split up, with one group returning to the Royal Capital and the other making their plans for the [[Subjugation of Sloth]] at the foot of the fallen tree before going to accomplish their goal of defeating [[Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti]]. The subjugation ultimately returned back to the area around Flugel's Tree, and after Petelgeuse's death, Subaru grabbed the bomb hidden in [[Emilia]]'s carriage and tossed it into the corpse of the White Whale, which was still trapped beneath the tree. It is unknown how much damage was caused to the fallen tree.

Following the tree's felling, its wood was collected by the Kingdom, and it is likely that it was used for construction due to its value. Meanwhile, the stump that remained behind became a tourist attraction that had crowds regularly. Over a year and a half after the subjugations, Beatrice declared that Flugel's Tree was the spot that Subaru and company and the members of the [[Six Tongues]], which they were accompanying while [[Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy|on the run from the corrupted government]], needed to go to in order to reach Echidna's castle. Later, after they arrived at the stump, they made the crowds that were there disperse via [[Melty Pristis]], and after Beatrice and Subaru opened the door Echidna left behind, the group entered the castle beyond the door. Over an hour later, however, for unknown reasons, [[Emergence of Kugelschreiber Castle|Kugelschreiber Castle emerged from the alternate dimension]], floating high above the stump of Flugel's Tree.

==Trivia==
*In the [[Season 4 Opening|opening]] for [[Season 4]] of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (anime)|anime]], there is a visual of a plant growing into an unusually large tree, which may be a reference to Flugel's Tree.
*[[Arbalest]] mentioned that the table he made for the [[Beloved Children]]'s use was made using wood from an ancient tree that stood for centuries. It is unclear if he was referring to Flugel's Tree or another one entirely.
